title: Infrastructure, Cloud & Security Architect
description:
About The Company

We are calling candidates on behalf of a Software Solutions company headquartered in East Brunswick, NJ. Incorporated in 2003, It provides a comprehensive range of solutions in the areas of GRC, Technology, Procurement, Healthcare Provider and Oracle to customers across the globe. Combining our unparalleled experience of over two decades in the software industry and global reach, we have grown with extensive capabilities across multiple industry verticals

Position: Infrastructure, Cloud & Security Architect

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced Infrastructure, Cloud & Security Architect to lead the design, implementation, security, automation, and operations of our enterprise infrastructure and cloud environments. This is a hands-on technical role responsible for building scalable, secure, resilient, and highly available platforms while ensuring compliance, operational excellence, and business continuity.

The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise across cloud infrastructure, networking, cybersecurity, automation, DevSecOps, disaster recovery, and enterprise architecture. The role requires close collaboration with engineering, product, operations, and business teams to deliver secure and reliable technology solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Cloud & Infrastructure Architecture

* Design, implement, and manage cloud infrastructure on Azure and AWS.
* Architect scalable, secure, and highly available cloud platforms.
* Build and manage Kubernetes clusters and containerized workloads.
* Implement Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Pulumi, or equivalent).
* Design multi-environment deployment strategies for development, testing, staging, and production.
* Drive cloud modernization and infrastructure optimization initiatives.

Infrastructure & Platform Engineering

* Manage enterprise Windows and Linux server environments.
* Design and maintain networking components including Load Balancers, Firewalls, VPNs, NAT, DNS, Reverse Proxies, and Virtual Networks.
* Administer storage, virtualization, compute, and enterprise infrastructure services.
* Manage backup infrastructure and recovery solutions.

Information Security

* Design and implement secure infrastructure following security-by-design principles.
* Implement Identity and Access Management (IAM), SSO, MFA, RBAC, and Privileged Access Management.
* Manage SSL/TLS certificates, secrets management, encryption, and key management.
* Secure cloud platforms, Kubernetes environments, and enterprise workloads.
* Implement network segmentation, Zero Trust architecture, and endpoint security.
* Conduct infrastructure hardening and security baseline implementation.
* Support vulnerability management, remediation, and security risk reduction.

Security Operations

* Manage and optimize enterprise security tools including SIEM, EDR, IAM, DLP, and vulnerability management platforms.
* Support incident response, threat investigations, and security monitoring.
* Implement security automation and orchestration where applicable.
* Collaborate with internal teams to strengthen the organization's security posture.

High Availability & Business Continuity

* Design High Availability (HA) architectures across multiple regions and availability zones.
* Define and implement Disaster Recovery (DR) strategies.
* Establish backup policies, recovery procedures, and business continuity plans.
* Define and achieve RPO, RTO, and service availability objectives.
* Conduct disaster recovery testing and resilience assessments.

Automation & DevSecOps

* Automate infrastructure provisioning and operational processes.
* Develop automation using Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar scripting languages.
* Integrate security into CI/CD pipelines.
* Implement policy-as-code and infrastructure governance practices.
* Improve operational efficiency through automation and standardization.

Monitoring & Operations

* Implement enterprise monitoring, logging, tracing, and observability solutions.
* Perform proactive performance tuning, capacity planning, and root cause analysis.
* Ensure infrastructure reliability, scalability, and operational excellence.
* Define operational standards, documentation, and best practices.

Compliance & Governance

* Support compliance initiatives including ISO 27001, SOC 2, and other regulatory frameworks.
* Participate in internal and external security audits.
* Develop and maintain infrastructure and security documentation.
* Implement governance controls for cloud, infrastructure, and security operations.

Cost Optimization

* Monitor and optimize cloud infrastructure costs.
* Recommend architecture improvements for performance and cost efficiency.
* Drive infrastructure utilization and resource optimization initiatives.

Collaboration

* Work closely with Engineering, Product, DevOps, IT, and Security teams.
* Support customer security assessments, technical due diligence, and infrastructure-related RFPs/RFIs.
* Provide technical guidance and mentorship to engineering and operations teams.

Required Skills & Experience

* 10+ years of experience in Infrastructure, Cloud, and Information Security.
* Strong expertise in Microsoft Azure and AWS cloud platforms.
* Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration.
* Experience implementing Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, Pulumi, or similar tools.
* Strong networking knowledge including Firewalls, Load Balancers, VPNs, DNS, NAT, Proxies, and Routing.
* Deep understanding of Identity & Access Management (IAM), SSO, MFA, RBAC, and directory services.
* Experience with enterprise security technologies including SIEM, EDR, DLP, Vulnerability Management, and Endpoint Security.
* Strong experience with Windows and Linux administration.
* Experience implementing High Availability, Disaster Recovery, Backup, and Business Continuity solutions.
* Hands-on scripting experience using Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar languages.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevSecOps practices.
* Knowledge of cloud security frameworks, Zero Trust, and infrastructure hardening.
* Experience supporting ISO 27001, SOC 2, or similar compliance programs.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Qualifications

* Microsoft Azure, AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, or cybersecurity certifications.
* Experience with Microsoft Defender, Microsoft Sentinel, Azure Security Center, or equivalent security platforms.
* Experience with container security and cloud-native security solutions.
* Knowledge of FinOps and cloud cost optimization practices.
* Experience working in SaaS or product engineering environments.
* Exposure to AI-enabled security tools and automation.

title: TC-CS-AD-Cyber LDE
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY GDS CYBER LARGE DEAL GROUP**
**Cyber Solutions Architect**
Pre-Sales | Client Storytelling | Commercial & Pricing | Turnkey Cyber Services
  
  
**Executive mandate to**
Shape and lead differentiated, executable and commercially compelling turnkey cyber services propositions for strategic pursuits, converting complex client priorities into a persuasive value story, integrated architecture, delivery model and price-to-win.
  
  
**The opportunity**
The Cyber Large Deal Engine brings together Business Case Researchers, Cyber Domain Specialists, Solution Architects, and Finance & Commercial Specialists to create an integrated deal-shaping capability, connecting client and market insight, deep cyber expertise, end-to-end solution architecture, and commercial modelling to build propositions that are differentiated, deliverable and positioned to win.
  
  
It is a senior pursuit leadership position for an architect who can operate credibly across the boardroom, the solution room and the commercial model. The role requires breadth across cyber domains, depth in at least one major cyber capability, and the judgement to integrate specialist inputs into one coherent, differentiated and deliverable proposition.
  
  
**Role Accountabilities**
**Lead strategic solutioning and pursuits**

* Own the solution from qualification and discovery through business case build out , architecture, proposal development, governance, oral presentation, negotiation and BAFO.
* Establish the solution strategy, win themes, design principles and response plan for complex RFPs, RFIs and proactive pursuits.
* Translate client requirements into an integrated managed services model spanning people, process, technology, governance, service management and transformation.
* Define scope, architecture, operating model, transition approach, delivery footprint, staffing model, service levels, assumptions, dependencies and risks.
* Mobilise and lead multidisciplinary contributors across domains and geographies, ensuring one solution, one story and one commercial position.

**Create a compelling customer story**

* Frame the client’s business context, cyber risk and operational challenge before presenting the solution.
* Convert technical complexity into an outcome-led narrative that is relevant to CISOs, CIOs, business executives and procurement leaders.
* Connect solution choices to measurable outcomes such as risk reduction, resilience, control effectiveness, experience, operational efficiency and cost transparency.
* Lead executive discovery sessions, workshops, whiteboarding, solution walkthroughs, oral pitches and solution-defence discussions.
* Anticipate objections and competitive alternatives, articulating clearly why the proposition is credible, differentiated, scalable and valuable.

**Own commercial solutioning and pricing**

* Translate the solution into a robust bottom-up cost model covering resource pyramids, effort, delivery locations, platforms, licences, transition and ongoing run costs.
* Work with finance and commercial teams to develop competitive, sustainable and traceable pricing, with clear linkage between scope, service levels, cost and price.
* Evaluate fixed-price, consumption-based, unit-based, outcome-aligned and hybrid charging models based on client context and risk allocation.
* Optimise the solution through automation, standardisation, global delivery leverage, right-shoring, reusable assets and platform choices without compromising outcomes.
* Understand margin drivers, contingencies, contractual dependencies and change levers; support commercial governance, negotiation, BAFO and renewal decisions.

**Architect integrated turnkey cyber services**

* Provide broad solution leadership across Identity and Access Management, Privileged Access Management, Customer IAM, Non-Human Identity, Threat Detection and Response, SOC, SIEM, SOAR, XDR, Vulnerability Management, Threat Intelligence and Threat Hunting.
* Bring familiarity with major platforms including SailPoint, Saviynt, Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, CyberArk, BeyondTrust, Delinea, Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender, Splunk and CrowdStrike.
* Design for cloud, on-premise and hybrid environments, integrating EY capabilities, alliance partners, technology vendors and client-retained responsibilities.
* Know when to make an architectural decision and when to engage a deep specialist, while retaining accountability for the integrity of the end-to-end solution.
* Position AI-enabled security operations, automation and platform-led delivery where they create a credible and measurable client advantage.

**Build repeatable deal-engine capability**

* Create and improve reference architectures, solution patterns, estimators, pricing models, proposal content, assumptions libraries and executive storytelling assets.
* Capture pursuit insights, commercial benchmarks and lessons learned to improve future speed, consistency and win quality.
* Coach solution contributors on structured solutioning, client storytelling, estimation discipline and executive presentation.

**Decision scope and influence**

* Recommends the end-to-end solution strategy, architecture, delivery model and commercial assumptions for assigned pursuits.
* Challenges requirements and design choices that reduce value, increase delivery risk or weaken competitiveness.
* Balances client outcomes, architectural integrity, delivery feasibility, commercial sustainability and speed to market.
* Influences partners, pursuit leaders, SMEs, alliances, delivery executives and commercial stakeholders without relying on formal authority.
* Escalates material solution, delivery, contractual and financial risks with clear options and recommendations.

**Measures of success**

* Pursuit impact: Quality and competitiveness of strategic proposals; contribution to progression and wins.
* Client impact: Clarity of the story, executive confidence and alignment to measurable outcomes.
* Commercial quality: Accurate, traceable estimates and sustainable pricing with risks made explicit.
* Solution integrity: Integrated, scalable and deliverable solutions with clear ownership and dependencies.
* Execution discipline: Timely mobilisation, governance and high-quality outputs under pursuit deadlines.
* Capability uplift: Reusable assets, improved consistency and stronger solutioning maturity across the engine.

**Experience And Capabilities**

* Typically 15+ years of relevant experience in cyber consulting, solution architecture, pre-sales or managed services, with demonstrated leadership of large and complex pursuits.
* Proven ability to move fluently between executive business conversations, cyber architecture, operating model design and commercial/pricing discussions.
* Depth in at least one major cyber domain, combined with sufficient breadth to shape integrated solutions across multiple capabilities.
* Practical experience building bottom-up estimates, cost models and pricing inputs for managed services opportunities.
* Exceptional customer presence, storytelling, writing, facilitation and presentation skills, including leadership of oral pitches and solution defence.
* Strong analytical judgement and the ability to make pragmatic trade-offs under ambiguity, commercial pressure and demanding deadlines.
* Experience working across distributed global teams and with alliance partners, technology vendors, finance, legal, risk and contracting stakeholders.
* Bachelor’s degree such as BTech/BE or equivalent; MCA or another relevant postgraduate qualification is advantageous.

**Preferred Credentials And Exposure**

* Relevant certifications in security architecture, IAM, cloud security, SIEM/SOC or major technology platforms.
* Experience in competitive deal shaping, transformation programmes, renewals and transition from incumbent providers.
* Experience creating reusable propositions, reference architectures, estimators or pricing assets.
* Working knowledge of regulatory, legal, compliance and contractual considerations for managed services.
* Ability to operate effectively with international stakeholders and support Europe and US working hours when required.

**Leadership profile**

* Client-first: listens before designing and anchors the proposition in the client’s priorities.
* Commercially astute: understands that the strongest architecture must also be executable, priceable and competitive.
* Persuasive: makes complex ideas simple and turns technical capability into business value.
* Integrative: creates alignment across specialists, geographies, partners and competing priorities.
* Accountable: owns the quality and integrity of the whole solution, not only an individual component.
* Composed under pressure: brings structure, pace and judgement to high-value pursuits with incomplete information.

**Why this role matters**
The Cyber Solutions Architect will directly influence the quality, differentiation and commercial strength of EY’s most strategic turnkey cyber services pursuits. The role offers the opportunity to shape major client transformations, work across leading technology ecosystems and build the repeatable solutioning capability of the Cyber Large Deal Engine.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Computer Aided Design Engineer
description:
TeleBortiX is building state-of-the-art airborne systems.

You will design the mechanical hardware that holds our aircraft together and the equipment that lets us build and test them — airframe structures, mechanisms, enclosures, mounts, and integration hardware on the product side; test rigs, fixtures, tooling, and ground support equipment on the machinery side. You'll take parts and assemblies from concept through to production-ready CAD, drawings, and hand-off to manufacturing.

This is a hands-on design role with real engineering depth. You will own your designs end to end: the geometry, the tolerances, the load paths, the manufacturability, and the DFMEA. You will scope and review vendor work on detailed CAD and fabrication, and you will be in the loop from first sketch through bench integration.

This role interfaces across TeleBortiX's product line and sits alongside our powertrain, aero, materials, and manufacturing leads.

Key Responsibilities

* Design airframe structures, mechanisms, enclosures, brackets, and integration hardware for our airborne platforms — concept through production-ready models and dimensioned drawings.
* Design machinery and equipment: bench-test rigs, assembly and integration fixtures, tooling, and ground support equipment.
* Own parts and assemblies end to end — geometry, tolerance stack-ups (GD&T), mass properties, load paths, and design for manufacture and assembly across composites, sheet metal, machined, and additive parts.
* Run and interpret structural analysis (hand calcs and FEA); iterate designs against strength, stiffness, weight, and cost targets.
* Support prototyping, bench integration, and iteration — build it, test it, learn, revise.
* Produce and maintain clean drawing packages, BOMs, and configuration/version control.
* Scope and review vendor and contractor work on detailed CAD and fabrication.
* Own the mechanical DFMEA and contribute to design reviews.
* Interface with the Powertrain lead (motor mounts, battery and enclosure mounting, thermal packaging), the Aerodynamics lead (aerostructures, control surfaces), the Materials & Processes lead (composites, thermal composites), and the Manufacturing & Test lead (integration, qualification).

Requirements

Candidates should meet
**four of the six**
criteria below to apply.

* Formal engineering qualification in Mechanical, Automotive, Aerospace, or a related field —
  **OR**
  demonstrated equivalent technical capability through portfolio, published work, or prior shipped hardware.
* Experience designing and shipping mechanical hardware. We're open across levels: a strong recent graduate with a serious portfolio and a senior engineer with a decade of production work are both encouraged to apply — make your level clear and let the work speak.
* You have owned at least one part or assembly from concept through to manufacture, deployment, or customer hand-off.
* Proficiency in a major 3D CAD environment ([SolidWorks / CATIA / Creo / NX]) with the ability to draft to standard (ASME Y14.5 or ISO), and comfort running FEA for sizing and validation.
* Genuine ownership mindset — you scope, design, prototype, test, and iterate; you don't wait to be told what to do next.
* Hands-on experience with lightweight structures, composites, or aerospace / UAV mechanical hardware —
  **or**
  transferable depth from automotive, motorsport, robotics, or precision machinery.

*Note: Candidates whose skills or qualifications fall short of the criteria above may still apply if their interests are strongly aligned with TeleBortiX's vision. Make the case in your application note.*

Strongly preferred

* Composites and lightweight-structures design (layup, bonded joints, metal-to-composite interfaces).
* Drafting Skills
* Aerospace or UAV experience — fixed-wing or multi-rotor airframe, mechanism, or integration hardware.
* FEA depth ([Ansys / Nastran / Abaqus]) — static, modal, and basic fatigue.
* Design for manufacture across several processes: CNC machining, sheet metal, injection moulding, additive, and composite layup.
* Mechanism and actuation design — deployment, articulation, control-surface linkages, latching.
* Fluent GD&T and tolerance stack-up analysis.
* Test-rig, fixture, and ground-support-equipment design (the machinery side of the role).
* Secondary depth in an adjacent cluster — thermal, materials, or manufacturing. Every engineer here owns one primary cluster and a credible secondary.

Tools & standards

3D CAD (SolidWorks / CATIA ) • FEA (Ansys) • ASME Y14.5 GD&T • PDM / PLM • DFM/DFA across machined, sheet-metal, molded, additive, and composite parts.

Org Structure

You will report directly to the Director, Engineering. You will work closely with our Powertrain architect, Aerodynamics Lead (aerostructures, performance), Materials & Processes Lead (composites, thermal), and Manufacturing & Test Lead (integration, qual testing).

About TeleBortiX

We build state-of-the-art airborne systems. Our engineering team is small and multi-skilled. We hire for skills, not for job titles. Every engineer here owns one primary cluster and a credible secondary.

Location, compensation, and how to apply

* **Location:**
  Delhi / NCR / Bengaluru
  **Compensation:**
  Commensurate with experience; equity component negotiable.
  **To apply:**
  Send your CV and a note on an interesting mechanical design challenge you've solved — what the problem was, and how you approached it.

title: Growth Manager
description:
**About Helium**

After chasing brokers, navigating fake listings, and locking up lakhs in deposits, most renters settle because the system leaves them no real choice. Helium is a rental platform for gated homes, where your security deposit is linked to your credit score. Under the hood, we run two fintech products, a rent guarantee for homeowners and a credit led deposit solution for tenants.

We are backed by founders and operators from Blinkit, CRED, Zomato, and Stanza Living.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a proactive and results-driven Growth Manager (Supply) to join our team in

Bangalore. In this role, you will focus on acquiring property owners to partner with our home rental platform. You will play a key role in expanding our property portfolio and ensuring a seamless onboarding experience for property owners.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Owner Onboarding: Identify, connect, and acquire property owners and landlords willing to list their properties on our platform.
* Market Research: Conduct market analysis to identify potential areas and opportunities for property acquisition.
* Relationship Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with property owners, ensuring their needs are met and they receive excellent service.
* Pitching & Negotiation: Present the company’s rental management services, address owner queries, and negotiate rental agreements or service terms.
* Collaboration: Coordinate with internal teams (operations, marketing, and customer service) to ensure a smooth onboarding process and property management.
* Reporting: Track and report acquisition metrics such as new sign-ups, conversion rates, and property onboarding progress.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field.
* 1-3 years of experience in sales, business development or related domains.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to build rapport with clients and negotiate effectively.
* Familiarity with Bangalore’s real estate market is a plus.
* Proactive and self-motivated with a target-driven mindset.
* Willingness to travel locally as required.

title: Associate/ Senior Associate – Academic Outreach (Under-Graduate Programmes)
description:
**About the IIHS Academic Programmes and Schools**

India’s urban transition is unprecedented in scale and complexity. Within it lie both the opportunities of increased economic growth and employment as well as the challenges of persistent inequality, extreme deprivation and environmental degradation. IIHS’ academic programmes aim to foster a new generation of urban practitioners and change makers, to become part of shaping this transition.

The academic programmes are supported by the five interdisciplinary IIHS Schools: School of Environment and Sustainability (SES), School of Systems and Infrastructure (SSI), School of Economic Development (SED), School of Human Development (SHD) and School of Governance (SoG). Each School has a particular transformational theme and a set of teaching, research and practice projects and programmes within it. Collectively, the five schools systematically address a wide range of urban issues, from questions of livelihood and economic development, access to basic infrastructure, affordable housing and healthcare for all, to tackling climate change and land governance.

**Job Description**

This position will be responsible for implementing processes and activities that lead to the design and launch of the undergraduate programme at the IIHS (Institution Deemed to be) University, and subsequently support the admissions process of the undergraduate programme.

The role requires excellent written and oral communication, attention to detail, market orientation, people orientation, and networking skills.

This could be either a regular position or a 11- month contractual engagement, renewable on mutual consent, with the potential to turn into a regular position over time.

**Activities and Tasks**

Responsibilities would include, but not be limited to, the following:

* Coordinating with vendors to commission market studies to understand the undergraduate market;
* Conducting activities to spread awareness about the IIHS University in schools and communities;
* Collaborating with various internal teams to document various aspects of the undergraduate programme;
* Providing support to other IIHS initiatives and activities including admissions, academics, research, training, practice, operations, and others as needed;
* Participating in all activities of Institution-Building at IIHS; carrying out tasks as assigned by IIHS; and travelling on IIHS work within or outside the country as and when needed.

**Structure and Reporting**

The associate will be an External Consultant coordinating with the Lead – Academic Outreach or with any other person designated by the Head – Academic Outreach & Career Development at IIHS and will be required to collaborate effectively with a diverse group of internal teams and external individuals/ organisations, and students.

**Person Specification**

The ideal candidate should have:

* A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in any discipline;
* Total experience of 3-5 years in a related role;
* Experience and expertise in using standard documentation and data analysis tools (Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint and Google Docs, Sheets and Slides are a must);
* The ability to use data visualisation / business intelligence tools (Tableau, Datawrapper, Google Charts, Microsoft PowerBI, etc.) is highly desirable;
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills;
* The ability to organise events and workshops by coordinating with key internal and external stakeholders.

This could be either a regular position or a 11- month contractual engagement, renewable on mutual consent, with the potential to turn into a regular position over time. This offer is on an exclusive basis, which implies that other professional assignments (whether compensated or not) that bear a potential conflict of interest with IIHS cannot be undertaken.

The search will remain open until the position is filled.

**Location**

This position is based in Bengaluru and may entail travel to other locations in India.

**Review and Assessment**

The role and performance of the incumbent shall be subject to normal review and assessment systems at IIHS.

**Diversity Policy**

IIHS is an equal opportunity employer that encourages women, people with disabilities and those from economically and socially excluded communities with the requisite skills and qualifications to apply for positions.

Please write to us at
hr@iihs.co.in
if you need any clarifications while filling the online application form.

description:

It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at Intuitive. As a global leader in robotic-assisted surgery and minimally invasive care, our technologies—like the da Vinci surgical system and Ion—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.
  
  
We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.
  
  
The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.

title: IT Operations Engineer
description:
**About MISUMI Americas**
MISUMI Americas, a division of MISUMI Group, is a leading provider of standard, configurable, and custom manufacturing solutions. By integrating a vast catalog of components with a world-class digital manufacturing platform, MISUMI Americas empowers engineers and procurement teams to accelerate innovation across the entire product lifecycle. With operations in the San Francisco Bay Area and Chicago, the company serves as a vital partner for the most innovative companies in the Americas.
  
  
What’s in it for you?
  
  
The Information Technology Operations (IT Operations) team provides critical operational support for all technology systems. This team covers new IT network setup for LAN/WAN/VPC/VPN, desktop hardware configuration and roll-out, desktop software management, access control, security training, and help desk support. IT Operations collaborates closely with the Cloud Infrastructure Operations team to ensure secure access to systems for all employees.
  
  
Impact In This Role
  
  
The Information Technology Operations (IT Operations) team provides critical operational support for all Fictiv technology systems. This team covers new IT network setup for LAN/WAN/VPC/VPN, desktop hardware configuration and roll out, desktop software management, access control, security training and help desk support. IT Operations collaborates very closely with the Cloud Infrastructure Operations team to ensure secure access to Misumi Americas systems for all Misumi Americas employees.
  
  
As an IT Operations Engineer, you will report to the IT Operations Lead role. You will utilize your deep knowledge of Microsoft Entra, Network Administration, Security Event Management, and SaaS Management to provide critical day-to-day support for Misumi Americas employees and partners. Success in this role will be measured by implementing strategic initiatives through deliverables on key milestones and providing solutions to complex, cross-functional projects, including - systems design, implementation and maintenance, new facility site expansion, employee life-cycle management, and company wide security best practices.
  
  
What You’ll Be Doing
  
  

* Integrate and maintain current SaaS platforms into Microsoft Entra (including Amazon Web Services, Salesforce, Greenhouse, and more).
* Develop automation workflows to compile alerting, monitoring, reporting processes to identify security threats.
* Assist in managing new and current SaaS platforms (including Microsoft 365, Slack, Iru MDM, and more).
* Create and deploy certificates and access controls for company-wide VPN solutions.
* On-site deployment and maintenance of Networking Services (WAN, LAN, and site to VPC) utilizing Cisco Meraki and FortiGate equipment.
* Site location deployments of Security and Facility Access Controls using Avigilon and video monitoring equipment.
* Contribute to the development of IT Operations run-books and knowledge base.
* Enforce security policies and procedures to ensure SOC 2 compliance.
* Design, deploy, and manage SIEM solutions for threat analysis and detection.
* Hardware inventory maintenance and tracking, including assignment, provisioning, and surplus tracking.
* Act as technical expert to assist IT leadership in providing recommendations to improve our security posture.

title: Signal Integrity Engineer-1.6 OSFP Board Design
description:
**Signal Integrity Engineer –1.6T OSFP Board Design**
Bengaluru, Karnataka, India / Onsite
  
  
**About Lumilens**
At Lumilens we are building the critical photonics infrastructure that powers tomorrow’s AI supercomputing. From chip-to-chip optical interconnects to scalable photonic engines, Lumilens is unlocking a new era of computing faster, cooler, and massively more efficient.
  
  
We’re a well-funded startup backed by Mayfield and led by veterans who’ve built And scaled some of the most transformative technologies in the industry. This isn’t incremental innovation, it’s a ground-floor opportunity to rethink the optical layer from the silicon up. You’ll work alongside a team of world-class engineers solving some ofthe hardest challenges in optics, systems, and scale. Every line of code, every design decision, every breakthrough you help deliver will shape the infrastructure of tomorrow.
  
  
If you're looking for mission, momentum, and the chance to make an outsized impact jump on the rocket ship. We’re just getting started.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking a Signal Integrity (SI) Engineer with 6–10 years of experience to own board-level high‑speed electrical design for 1.6T DR8 (200G/lane) OSFP optical modules, from pre‑layout simulations through validation and production support.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Own SI/PI design for 1.6T DR8 OSFP module host and line‑side interfaces, including 200G PAM4 lanes, DSP/ASIC interfaces, retimer/gearbox and connector transitions on the module PCB
* Perform pre‑ and post‑layout SI simulations (time and frequency domain) for very high‑speed channels: insertion/return loss, crosstalk, impedance, eye diagrams, COM and bathtub analysis.
* Define PCB stack‑up, materials, via technology, routing rules and design constraints to meet loss budgets and margin targets at 200G per lane within OSFP mechanical constraints.
* Generate clear SI/PI design guidelines for schematic and layout engineers; review schematics and layout (diff‑pair routing, reference transitions, stitching, breakouts) and sign off on SI.
* Collaborate closely with optical, mechanical, firmware and test teams on overall 1.6T module architecture, pin‑outs, power partitioning and control interfaces.
* Plan and execute lab bring‑up and correlation: TDR, VNA/S‑parameter measurements, eye/PAM4 analysis, jitter decomposition and de‑embedding to validate and refine models.
* Drive SI‑related root‑cause debug on proto and production builds, propose design changes and work with manufacturing/NPI to ensure robust, repeatable performance.
* Contribute to technical documentation: SI test plans, simulation reports, design guidelines, and lessons‑learned for future OSFP generations.

**Required Qualifications:**

* ⁠B.E/B.Tech or M.E/M.Tech in Electrical/Electronics Engineering (or equivalent) with 6–10 years of experience in high‑speed board‑level design/SI for networking, server or optical module products.
* Strong hands‑on experience with pre/post‑layout SI simulations on SerDes links ≥56G, ideally 100G/200G PAM4, using tools such as Sigrity, ADS, HFSS, SIwave, HSPICE or similar.
* Proven track record defining PCB stack‑ups, materials (e.g., low‑loss laminates), via structures and routing rules for multi‑hundred‑Gbps interfaces on dense form‑factor modules or line cards.
* Strong understanding of: transmission lines, S‑parameters, equalization (FFE/DFE/CTLE), jitter, crosstalk, return path design, reference plane design and power distribution networks.
* Solid lab skills with high‑bandwidth scopes, VNAs, BERTs and TDRs, including fixture design/de‑embedding and correlation of measurements to simulations.
* Experience working with cross‑functional teams (layout, optics, mechanical, FW, test, manufacturing) on complex hardware projects through multiple prototype spins.
* Good written and verbal communication to clearly document constraints, justify design decisions and review results with stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience specifically with OSFP/QSFP‑DD/OSFP‑XD optical transceiver modules at 800G/1.6T or similar data‑center interconnect products.
* Familiarity with high‑speed optical components and interfaces: drivers, TIAs, CDRs/DSPs, laser/photodiode sub‑assemblies, and their electrical constraints.
* Exposure to relevant standards and ecosystems (e.g., IEEE 802.3 DR8/FR8/LR8‑class interfaces, OIF/OTN, common management interfaces) is a plus.
* Basic understanding of EMI/EMC, thermal constraints and mechanical limitations for pluggable modules, and how they interact with SI/PI decisions.

**What we offer**

* Competitive salary commensurate with experience
* Comprehensive benefits package including health insurance
* Professional development opportunities and certification support
* Access to cutting-edge technology and cloud platforms
* Collaborative work environment with cross-functional teams

title: People Technology Foundation Senior Product Specialist
description:
**Mott MacDonald**
is a global engineering, management, and development consultancy committed to delivering impactful work that shapes the future.
  
  
We are a team of over 20,000 experts working across the world in more than 50 countries.
  
  
We are proud to be part of an ever-changing global industry, delivering transformative work that’s defining our future. It’s our people who power that performance. As an employee-owned business, we invest in creating a space for everyone to feel safe and valued and empowered with the right tools and support.
  
  
Whether you want to pursue excellence in your specialism or broaden your experience with flexible roles across our business, you’ll be connected to a community of global experts championing you to be your best. Join us and shape your story with Mott MacDonald, where everyone has the opportunity to be
**brilliant**
.
  
  
**Job Description**

* We are creating a new Group People Technology function to provide clear ownership, expertise and direction across the technology that supports our global People services.
* The People Technology Foundation Senior Product Specialist will work closely with business stakeholders to understand their problems, requirements and desired outcomes, translating these into practical, scalable and supportable digital solutions across the People Foundation portfolio.
* Reporting to the People Technology Foundation Product Manager, you will work alongside another Senior Product Specialist and collaborate with Project Managers, People teams, business regions, IT, architecture, data, integration teams and external delivery partners.
* You will bring strong knowledge of SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central and related Foundation capabilities. The portfolio currently includes Employee Central, employee and workforce data, Position Management, Organisation Management, employee lifecycle processes and OpenText, with future scope expected to include Time Off, Absence Management and related Foundation services.
* This is a hands-on product delivery role. You will lead discovery and requirements workshops, challenge solution-led requests, shape functional designs, complete authorised configuration, coordinate testing and releases, investigate defects and deliver product improvements. You will ensure that stakeholders remain focused on the business problem and required outcomes, while People Technology brings the product expertise needed to determine the most effective solution.
* You will also create and maintain the detailed configuration, design, testing, release and operational documentation needed to support effective governance, auditability, continuity and future change. Through direct delivery, partner challenge, knowledge transfer and continuous learning, you will help strengthen internal capability and reduce unnecessary reliance on external partners.
* Although primarily aligned to People Foundation, you will also support other People Technology capability domains when concentrated demand, delivery priorities, holiday cover, business continuity or development opportunities require additional capacity.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Work directly with global, regional and functional stakeholders to understand business problems, requirements, user needs and desired outcomes, ensuring discussions remain focused on the need rather than a predetermined technology solution.
* Lead discovery, requirements and solution-shaping workshops, constructively challenging assumptions and translating business requirements into clear options, recommendations, functional designs and acceptance criteria.
* Act as a senior subject-matter specialist for SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central and assigned Foundation capabilities, bringing relevant platform knowledge, leading practices and product insight into business and delivery decisions.
* Deliver authorised configuration, product administration, enhancements and optimisation activity directly within agreed access, security, control and segregation-of-duties requirements.
* Take ownership of assigned product changes from discovery through functional design, configuration, testing, release and early-life support, progressing work through established change and release controls with accurate status, traceability, decisions and evidence.
* Work with the Foundation Product Manager and Project Managers on larger initiatives, providing product expertise, detailed requirements, scope, estimates, dependencies, risks, decisions and delivery information.
* Analyse People processes, workforce data structures, business rules, roles, permissions, integrations and operational impacts to support effective end-to-end solution design.
* Assess Foundation-related incidents, defects, service issues, enhancements and optimisation opportunities, investigating root causes and recommending appropriate resolution or improvement routes.
* Assess SAP SuccessFactors release updates and product-roadmap changes, identifying relevant impacts, risks and opportunities and coordinating the testing, documentation, stakeholder readiness and adoption activity required.
* Create and maintain configuration workbooks, configuration records, requirements, functional designs, process documentation, solution decisions, test evidence, release artefacts, operating procedures and product knowledge, ensuring documentation remains aligned to the live product and supports auditability, operational continuity, supportability and future change.
* Define test scenarios and acceptance criteria, undertake or coordinate functional and regression testing, support user acceptance testing and ensure defects, decisions and test evidence are recorded appropriately.
* Monitor product health, data quality, recurring defects, adoption and operational performance, identifying and delivering opportunities to simplify processes, improve configuration, reduce manual activity and increase business value.
* Work confidently with support and implementation partners, leading or contributing to workshops, reviewing designs and deliverables, challenging recommendations and ensuring agreed documentation and knowledge transfer are completed.
* Maintain and develop relevant SAP SuccessFactors expertise through product learning, release awareness, practical delivery and appropriate certification.
* Share product knowledge, methods, documentation and lessons with colleagues, reducing single points of failure and increasing the resilience of the People Technology team.
* Contribute to the Foundation People Technology Community, working with regional stakeholders, super users and champions to gather insight, support adoption and improve the effective use of Foundation capabilities.
* Support other People Technology domains where demand and capacity require, providing flexible delivery capacity, holiday cover and broader development while maintaining accountability for assigned Foundation responsibilities.

**Candidate Specification:**

* Essential
* Strong hands-on experience with SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central, including practical configuration, functional design, testing and delivery of controlled product changes.
* Strong understanding of core HR processes, employee lifecycle activities, workforce data, organisational structures, Position Management and related People Foundation capabilities.
* Experience leading discovery and requirements workshops, keeping stakeholders focused on business problems and desired outcomes rather than predetermined technology solutions.
* Ability to translate business requirements into clear process designs, functional requirements, solution options, configuration decisions and acceptance criteria.
* Experience coordinating product and vendor-release cycles, including impact assessment, regression testing, business readiness, deployment, operational handover and post-release review.
* Experience assessing incidents, defects, enhancements and optimisation opportunities, including impact analysis, root-cause investigation and recommendation of appropriate solutions.
* Experience producing and maintaining configuration workbooks, functional designs, process documentation, test evidence, release artefacts, operating procedures and product knowledge.
* Confidence working with business stakeholders, Product Managers, Project Managers, technical specialists and third-party partners, including constructively challenging designs, configuration, testing outputs and documentation.
* Ability to deliver authorised configuration and product improvements directly while observing security, access, change-control and segregation-of-duties requirements.
* Commitment to maintaining deep product expertise, completing relevant learning or certification and sharing knowledge to reduce single-person and external-partner dependency.
* Ability to support adjacent People Technology products or capability domains when demand, resilience, holiday cover or development priorities require.
* Desirable
* SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central certification.
* Additional SAP SuccessFactors experience or certification in Position Management, Time Management, Platform Foundations, Employee Central Payroll or related capabilities.
* Experience with OpenText or comparable enterprise employee document and records-management solutions.
* Experience with Time Off, Absence Management, Workforce Administration, payroll processes or payroll integrations.
* Experience working within a product-led operating model and delivering through internal, blended and partner-led teams.
* Experience supporting SAP SuccessFactors release planning, regression testing and adoption of new platform capabilities.
* Experience working with integrations, data structures, security roles, permissions, business rules and downstream system dependencies.
* Experience supporting global People processes while considering regional requirements, regulatory obligations and operational differences.
* Experience working with super-user groups, champion networks, communities of practice or a People Technology Community.
* Experience using agile, iterative or structured change and release-management practices.
* Experience contributing across more than one People Technology product, platform or functional domain.

**Qualifications & Certifications - Desirable**
**Product and Platform**
SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central certification
  
  
SAP SuccessFactors Position Management certification
  
  
SAP SuccessFactors Time Management certification
  
  
SAP SuccessFactors Platform Foundations certification
  
  
SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central Payroll certification
  
  
OpenText training or certification relevant to document and records management
  
  
Business Analysis and Delivery
  
  
Business-analysis qualification from BCS, IIBA or an equivalent body
  
  
AgilePM
  
  
Scrum certification
  
  
SAFe certification or equivalent agile-delivery qualification
  
  
Service and Change Management
  
  
ITIL Foundation or higher certification
  
  
Relevant change, release or testing qualification
  
  
Relevant SAP SuccessFactors certification is desirable. Where certification is not currently held, the successful candidate will be expected to maintain and develop relevant SAP SuccessFactors expertise through product learning, release awareness, delivery experience and appropriate certification.
  
  
**Flexible working**
At Mott MacDonald, we support our staff to create work-life balance which works for them and welcome candidates looking for career flexibility. We are open to discussing flexible working at interview stage.
  
  
**Our benefits package is designed to enhance your experience:**

* Agile working
* Critical illness and compassionate leave
* Paternity Leave
* Group term life insurance, and Group medical insurance coverage
* Career mobility options
* Short and Long-term global employment opportunities
* Global collaboration and knowledge sharing

**Employment Compliance Requirement**
As part of our global compliance requirements, all candidates must hold a valid Right to Work (RTW) document in India, which will be verified during the recruitment process.
  
  
**Acceptable documents include a Passport, Voter ID, or Birth Certificate.**

Experience in an early-stage startup.

See your content tied to real pipeline and customer conversations.

title: Agentic Growth Marketer
description:
**Agentic Growth Marketer**

**10-12 LPA**

**Location: Bangalore, Koramangala**

**Build the future of marketing. Not another marketing campaign.**

**Company:**
**Porcellia**

**Experience:**
No minimum years required

**Mandatory background:**
Engineering, software development, data, or a closely related quantitative field

**The opportunity**

We believe the future of marketing will be built by people who understand both marketing and technology.

Not marketers who occasionally use ChatGPT.

Not developers who build AI tools without understanding the business problems they’re solving.

We’re looking for someone who sits at the intersection of
**engineering, data, AI agents, and marketing.**

Someone who can look at a marketing problem and think,
*“Why is a human still doing this?”*

Someone who understands how agents work, how to connect them, how to make them reliable, and how to turn them into systems that produce measurable business outcomes.

**You don’t need to be a great marketer yet. I’ll teach you that.**

You need to be an exceptional problem solver who loves numbers, understands technology, and is obsessed with what AI makes possible.

**What you’ll actually do**

Your job is simple:
**Learn marketing. Then agentify it.**

You’ll work directly with me to understand how some of India’s fastest-growing D2C brands are built and scaled.

Then you’ll turn that knowledge into intelligent systems.

You’ll:

* Build AI agents that solve real marketing problems across creative strategy, performance marketing, analytics, CRO, retention, and growth.
* Create agentic workflows that can research, reason, execute, evaluate, and improve with minimal human intervention.
* Connect LLMs, APIs, databases, marketing platforms, and automation tools into working systems.
* Turn complex marketing decisions into repeatable, scalable processes.
* Work with large amounts of data to find patterns, identify opportunities, and make better decisions.
* Experiment constantly with new models, agent frameworks, and AI capabilities.
* Build solutions that don’t just save time, but actually make businesses more money.

**The goal isn’t to automate what marketers do today. It’s to build what marketers will be capable of doing tomorrow.**

**Who we’re looking for**

**1. You understand agents. Really well.**

You should know the difference between an AI chatbot, a workflow, and an autonomous agent.

You should be comfortable with concepts like tool calling, MCP, orchestration, memory, context engineering, APIs, evaluation, and multi-agent systems.

You don’t need to know every framework. But you should be the kind of person who experiments with new AI capabilities before everyone else starts talking about them.

**You should have built things. Not just watched tutorials about them.**

**2. You’re exceptionally good with numbers.**

You should be able to do mental math faster than most people can reach for a calculator.

Percentages, ratios, growth rates, margins, unit economics, probability, and data interpretation should come naturally to you.

You should be able to look at a spreadsheet and quickly figure out what’s happening, what’s wrong, and what matters.

Because great marketing is ultimately a numbers game.

**3. You have a technical or quantitative background.**

This is mandatory.

Ideally, you’re a software developer, data analyst, data scientist, engineer, or someone from a quantitative finance background.

You should be comfortable with structured thinking, logic, and solving problems using technology.

You don’t need a computer science degree. You do need to demonstrate genuine technical ability.

**4. You love marketing.**

You should be genuinely curious about why people buy things.

Why does one advertisement work while another fails? Why do people pay more for one brand than another? Why do some products become categories of their own?

You should find consumer psychology, copywriting, persuasion, business models, and growth fascinating.

You don’t need formal marketing experience. But you need to want to become world-class at it.

**5. You’re a builder, not a spectator.**

You should be someone who experiments relentlessly.

Someone who would rather build a working prototype over the weekend than spend two weeks discussing whether it’s possible.

You don’t wait for instructions. You find problems worth solving and start solving them.

**What you’ll get**

**I’ll teach you everything I know about marketing.**

You’ll learn how positioning works, how to create winning advertisements, how to read performance data, how to understand consumer behaviour, and how to build profitable growth engines.

You’ll get to work on real problems with real businesses, real budgets, and real consequences.

And then you’ll use your technical skills to turn that knowledge into products, agents, and systems.

You’ll be working at the frontier of a rapidly changing industry.

While most marketing teams are learning how to use AI tools,
**you’ll be building the tools and systems that redefine how marketing works.**

You won’t be joining a marketing team that simply follows instructions.

You’ll be helping create the future that other marketing teams eventually follow.

**Who should NOT apply**

* You’re looking for a conventional marketing job.
* Your understanding of AI is limited to writing prompts in ChatGPT.
* You dislike spreadsheets, calculations, or quantitative problems.
* You enjoy talking about ideas more than building them.
* You want a clearly defined role where someone tells you exactly what to do every day.

**Our hiring process**

We don’t care how many years you’ve worked.

We care how you think, what you can build, and how quickly you learn.

**Round 1: Make a video that catches our attention.**

This is the first and most important filter.

Make a video introducing yourself and convincing us why you should be the person building the future of marketing with us.

Show us how you think. Show us what you’ve built. Show us why you’re different.

There is no prescribed format.

You can be creative, technical, funny, analytical, or completely unconventional.

**We will shortlist candidates based on their videos. Not their resumes.**

**Round 2: Live interview**

If your video catches our attention, we’ll invite you for a live interview.

We’ll test two things:

1. **Data fluency:**
   Mental math, business logic, numerical reasoning, and your ability to make sense of unfamiliar data.
2. **Copywriting:**
   Your ability to understand people, communicate clearly, and persuade through words.

You don’t need to know marketing jargon. We’re looking for raw ability, not rehearsed answers.

**Salary**

10-12 LPA

title: Head of Marathi Content
description:
**हे वाचता येतंय? मग तुमच्या आजोबांना विचारा, त्यांच्या जमिनीच्या सातबाऱ्यावर कोणाचं नाव आहे. त्या उत्तरामागची गोष्ट सांगणारी व्यक्ती आम्हाला हवी आहे.**

BhuMe is hiring a Head of Marathi Content to own our Marathi voice, creators and organic reach across Maharashtra. Full-time in Bangalore, ₹10 to 12 LPA fixed and ESOPs if you perform well, reporting to the founders.

**Why this matters**

Why does the Indian judiciary take 7 years on average to resolve disputes? Because over 70% of stuck cases are property disputes. They are complex because the Government doesn't guarantee ownership of property. ₹2 lakh crore is frozen every year because no one can verify who owns what. Ask your family and you will hear the stories.

**About BhuMe**

BhuMe is the intelligence layer for real estate, serving over 3.5 lakh users in Maharashtra. We have helped over 1 lakh farmers make sure their land is legally safe. We bring scattered, hard-to-read land records together so people can check a title, track changes on their land, and make decisions with confidence. We're a small team: the work you ship reaches real users quickly.

**The role**

You'll own BhuMe's voice in Marathi: our own channels, the creators we work with, and the new Marathi ads we put out every week. You'll tell the stories behind land records in the Marathi people actually speak, and get the right Marathi creators to tell them too.

You're judged on one number: paid orders per rupee spent. Views are how you get there, not the goal. You make the posts yourself; this is not a role for managing an agency.

Marathi YouTube has plenty of videos on how to download a 7/12. Almost nobody tells the story behind one, the sale that went wrong or the name that never got changed, in a way people forward to the family WhatsApp group. That story is yours to tell.

**What you'll do**

* Write, shoot and edit Marathi short videos (Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts) yourself, every week: app screen recordings, talking heads, skits, and real stories told with permission
* Make new Marathi ads every week for our paid campaigns, and turn the ones that sell into more posts
* Find and sign Marathi creators and influencers in farming, rural life, comedy, news and personal finance, and pay them for the views and orders they bring, not for follower counts
* Get creators across Maharashtra to film real stories in the villages: you find the story and write the hook, they shoot it on the ground
* Give every creator and every post its own tracked link, so we know which ones bring paid orders and not just views
* Keep a ledger of every post: the idea, who it's for, the hook, views, cost per 1,000 views, installs and orders. Kill what doesn't sell and double down on what does
* Build BhuMe's own Marathi channels on Instagram and YouTube
* Keep it honest: label paid posts as ads the way ASCI requires, show the government source, and never let anyone think BhuMe is a government office

**What we require**

* Marathi you'd use at home, not textbook Marathi: you write and talk the way people across Maharashtra actually do
* Proof you can get views cheaply: posts you made or ran, with real view counts and what each one cost
* An account you grew yourself, your own or a brand's, and the numbers to show how
* You judge a post by what it sells, not by how many people saw it
* You shoot and edit on your phone and can turn an idea into a post the same day
* Comfort with numbers: CPM, cost per install, cost per order. A spreadsheet doesn't scare you
* You're funny in Marathi. We'll check

**Nice to have**

* You're a Marathi creator yourself
* You've paid creators per view or per result, with tracked links or codes
* You know rural Maharashtra: farming, land, and the family fights over property
* You've run creator posts as ads on Meta or YouTube

**What we don't want**

* Rage-bait, fake followers or bought views. We'll look at your analytics live
* Content that mocks real people's land disputes or shows their documents without permission

**How we work**

* Slope over intercept: come in with energy and capacity for growth, and we'll throw you as much rope as you're willing to catch
* Comically fast: a customer has a crazy request? Spot it, ship within 12 hours and get back to them, without a single meeting
* Stepping on toes encouraged: work in any area or product that gets the job done for customers faster. No red tape
* Humble: our customers move the needle; BhuMe gives them peace of mind. Low ego, service minded

**What we offer**

* ₹10 to 12 LPA fixed, and ESOPs if you perform well
* Full-time in Bangalore, on-site preferred, with flexible working hours
* A budget for creators and tests, and room to get some of it wrong while you find what works
* BhuMe's Marathi voice is yours from day one, with a direct line from your work to revenue
* A meaningful problem: making land information accessible to millions
* Access to the best AI tools, and a mini MBA in building a customer-centric organisation

**How to apply**

Apply here with Easy Apply. At the top of your CV, add links to 3 posts you made or ran, with the views and what each cost, and one Marathi hook for BhuMe in one line. We shortlist from your posts and your numbers.

1. Your application: 3 posts, their numbers, one Marathi hook
2. Screen-share, 45 min: open your analytics live, no screenshots. Walk us through one post that worked and one that went viral but sold nothing, and tell us why
3. Paid trial week: we pay you pro rata to this role's salary and give you a budget to make Marathi posts and book your first creators. We judge it on cost per paid order, not views
4. Founders, 45 min: final conversation

More about the role: https://www.bhume.in/careers/head-of-marathi-content

We only ever email you from an @bhume.in address, and we never ask for fees or deposits.

title: Content Creator Intern

description:
**Content Creator Intern (Mobile-First / Social Native)**

​This is not a "Social Media Executive" role where you schedule posts. This is a role for a Creator.

​You are a one-person production crew. You understand that in 2025, the most powerful camera is the one in your pocket. You don't wait for "big budgets"; you use speed, trends, and native storytelling to hack attention.

​You are the face and hands of our "Feed Hygiene." You ensure our clients aren't just posting "content," but creating culture.

**​What You'll Do - The Bridge:**

**​The "Now":**

​Ideate, Shoot, and Edit high-quality short-form video content (Reels, Shorts, TikToks) daily.

​Be "chronically online" (in a good way). Spot trends, audio, and formats before they peak and adapt them for our clients.

​Work with the Art Director and Copy team to bring big campaigns to life on the small screen.

​Be comfortable both behind the camera (shooting product/lifestyle) and on camera (hosting/acting) if needed.

**​The "Future":**

​You are building the "Media Brand." You will move our clients away from "salesy ads" toward "episodic storytelling" that builds a loyal tribe.

Expert-level mobile videography (iPhone/Android). You know lighting, framing, and transitions like the back of your hand. (Basic DSLR/Mirrorless knowledge is a plus, but not required).

You understand the nuances of Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and LinkedIn Video. You know why a hook works and why a video flops.

You can write sharp captions, on-screen text, and video scripts that hook attention in the first 3 seconds.

Basic eye for aesthetics to ensure your thumbnails and cover images are click-worthy (using Canva or similar).

​You have a folder on your phone full of "content ideas."

​You understand "Edutainment"—how to educate an audience while keeping them entertained.

​You are a "misfit" who prefers creating to consuming.

​You are insanely driven and want to build a portfolio that proves you are a top-tier creator.

**About Joveo**

As the global leader in AI-powered recruitment marketing, we are transforming talent attraction and recruitment media buying for the world’s largest and smartest employers, staffing businesses, RPOs, and recruitment advertising agencies.

The Joveo platform enables businesses to attract, source, engage, and hire the most relevant candidates on time, within their budget. * Exposure to programmatic advertising platforms (DSPs, job boards, Joveo or similar)
* MBA or equivalent from a recognised institution — useful but never a substitute for the track record above

**Build the next chapter of Joveo. Apply now**

* Build and maintain structured databases and trackers that support scalable outreach and decision-making across the pipeline
* Support GTM execution, from campaign and meeting planning to on-ground engagement

* Translate client conversations into insight that shapes strategy, positioning, and product priorities

﻿﻿﻿﻿

title: GTM Engineer
description:
The GTM Engineer is a modern, AI-enabled technical partner to our Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success teams. This role blends data expertise, AI innovation, and GTM systems knowledge to help our revenue organization operate with greater clarity, speed, and intelligence.

A core component of the role involves analyzing GTM and customer data, identifying trends, and creating actionable insights and visualizations that guide strategic decisions. In addition, the GTM Engineer enhances productivity by building AI agents, improving workflows, and integrating tools that build pipeline and streamline daily operations.

This position is hands-on and highly collaborative—ideal for someone who enjoys solving problems with data, improving processes with technology, and delivering insights that directly impact pipeline, win rate, retention, and team efficiency. This position is a builder and analyst who elevates the GTM engine through smart use of data, AI, and automation.

The GTM Engineer reports to
**Revenue Operations**
and partners closely with leaders across the GTM organization.

**Key Responsibilities**

**AI Enablement & Agent Development**

* Build AI agents and workflows to support various use cases such as RFP responses, training and new hire onboarding, large data analysis, customer/prospect research, and high volume outbound messaging.
* Configure and leverage platforms like ChatGPT to increase GTM productivity.
* Build lightweight API-based automations connecting AI systems with CRM, content libraries, and GTM tools.
* Identify opportunities to eliminate manual work through intelligent automation.

**Data Analysis, Insights & Visualization**

* Analyze GTM, customer, and product data to uncover trends, patterns, and performance drivers.
* Build dashboards and visualizations using Domo
* Provide predictive insights, statistical modeling, and forecasting support for Sales, Marketing, and CS.
* Turn complex data into clear, actionable recommendations that influence GTM strategy and execution.
* Support strategic and board-level data requests as needed.

**GTM Tooling & Workflow Optimization**

* Improve workflows and user experiences within Salesforce and other GTM systems (Gong, Gainsight, Staircase, Marketo).
* Enhance lead management, lifecycle transitions, onboarding workflows, and productivity tooling through configuration and automation.
* Use outputs from Gong and Gainsight to surface actionable insights, not managed within those tools.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with Sales, Marketing, CS, and Revenue Operations leadership to translate business needs into effective data and AI-driven solutions.
* Advise GTM team members on how to adopt and effectively use AI and insights in their daily workflows.
* Collaborate with team members within and outside of the GTM organization to ensure accuracy and clarity across GTM reporting.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 3–7+ years in GTM engineering, Revenue Operations, Sales/Marketing Operations, data-focused GTM roles, or similar technical roles.
* Strong experience with data visualization tools such as Domo, Power BI, or Tableau.
* Experience with common GTM tooling, including Salesforce, Gong, Gainsight, and Marketo.
* Ability to build/configure AI-driven workflows, agents, and productivity automations.
* Strong analytical and statistical modeling skills; experience with forecasting or predictive analytics preferred.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to support non-technical stakeholders.

**Preferred Skills**

* Familiarity with APIs
* Experience with SQL or Python recommended, but not required

**Success Measures**

* Increased GTM productivity through AI-driven workflows and improved tooling.
* Clear, actionable insights that influence pipeline, win rate, retention, and team efficiency.
* High-quality data visualizations and reporting used across GTM leadership.
* Reduced operational friction and enhanced GTM execution.
* Strong adoption of AI solutions and measurable impact on GTM performance.

title: Manager, Sales Compensation
description:
**About Rippling**
Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.
  
  
Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365 - all within 90 seconds.
  
  
Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.85B+ from the world’s top investors - including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, Bedrock, GIC, Elad Gil and Goldman Sachs—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.
  
  
We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Manager, Sales Compensation
****(Individual Contributor)****
, you’ll play a critical role in scaling and operating the incentive programs that power Rippling’s go-to-market organization. Sitting within Accounting and partnering closely with the RevOps team, you’ll help ensure our sales teams are compensated accurately, on time, and in alignment with Rippling’s growth goals.
  
  
This role sits at the intersection of Finance, Sales Operations, and Systems, with ownership over commission processing, platform administration, and performance analytics. You’ll be responsible for executing and improving core compensation processes, maintaining data integrity across systems, and building reporting that provides visibility into sales performance and incentive outcomes.
  
  
This is a highly quantitative, detail-oriented role. You’ll be trusted as the subject matter expert for commission calculations and payout mechanics, while also contributing to process improvements and scalable systems as Rippling continues to grow. If you enjoy working with complex data, solving compensation challenges, and supporting fast-paced sales organizations, this role offers meaningful impact and growth.
  
  
What You Will Do
  
  

* Support the design, rollout, and ongoing administration of sales compensation programs, plan documentation, stakeholder communication, and continuous process improvements
* Own end-to-end sales commission operations, including monthly and quarterly calculations, validations, reconciliations, accruals, reporting, audit support, and payout preparation, ensuring accuracy and compliance
* Build and maintain dashboards, reporting, and analytical models to track quota attainment, commission payouts, performance trends, and scenario modeling to support incentive strategy and plan updates
* Administer and scale Rippling’s Incentive Compensation Management platform, including compensation plan configuration, calculation logic, reporting automation, user access, and user acceptance testing for new plans and system enhancements
* Partner cross-functionally with Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Finance, Accounting, and Systems to ensure data integrity across Salesforce, compensation tools, and reporting layers, and to support close and governance processes
* Manage escalations related to commission payouts and provide clear, data-backed resolutions

Please note that this role is based on the EST/PST timezone
  
  
What You Will Need
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* 5+ years of experience in sales compensation, commissions administration, sales operations, finance, or a related analytical role, preferably in a high-growth SaaS or technology environment
* Strong proficiency in Salesforce and advanced Excel or Google Sheets, including pivot tables, nested formulas, and data analysis workflows
* Hands-on experience with commission management platforms such as CaptivateIQ, Xactly, Everstage, Spiff, or QuotaPath
* Solid understanding of sales compensation structures, quota-based incentives, revenue crediting methodologies, and payout mechanics
* Exceptional attention to detail and analytical rigor, with the ability to clearly communicate findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
* High ownership mentality and strong interpersonal skills, with comfort working independently in fast-paced, ambiguous environments

****Core Competencies****

* Variable compensation administration & expertise — deep knowledge of commission payout processes, policy, and design
* Data-driven analysis & reporting — builds models, audits payouts, and turns attainment data into clear recommendations
* Process building & scale — designs and implements standardized playbooks, templates, and workflows
* Cross-functional partnership & stakeholder management — partners effectively with Sales, RevOps, Finance, and Accounting; manages seller and leader escalations
* Communication & executive presence — translates complex compensation analysis into slides for leadership

**Additional Information**
Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com
  
  
Rippling highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.
