title: SDET 2
description:
**Who we are :**

Money. A subject that’s always on our mind. We go through a rollercoaster of emotions when it comes to money. That’s why at Jupiter, our mission is to enable people to improve their relationship with money.

We are a financial services platform that leverages technology to offer our customers seamless and user-friendly products related to banking, loans, and investments. So whether it’s a savings account, credit cards, investment and payments, it's all on Jupiter. We also help users cut through the banking jargons, offer smart insights based on spending and provide users with a range of new age features to enable and make sense of their finances.

**Our journey so far:**

Jupiter was founded in 2019 by Jitendra Gupta. Best known as Citrus Pay’s founder, Jiten found himself wondering why personal finance experiences were not customer-centric when everything else like food ordering and entertainment were. That’s how our journey began in 2019, with a simple, powerful idea : to create a modern, customer-centric experience that empowers individuals when it comes to their money.

From our humble beginnings, we've strived relentlessly to make managing money easier. In 2021 when we launched we had a waitlist with over 100,000 people eager to experience the world of Jupiter - and within 10 months we crossed 1 million users. Today, we have 2.8 million + happy users on Jupiter.

Our Insights feature today tells how much and where you’ve been spending automatically, even on your other savings accounts! Our Edge CSB Bank RuPay credit card is getting a lot of love for it’s head-turning transparent design, not to mention it being a rewarding experience. Our No-Penalty SIP and Daily SIP at Rs 10/- has helped scale our investments business and we have over 100,000 users investing on our platform to fulfill their money aspirations.

We've embraced cutting-edge technology, harnessed the power of data analytics, and assembled a diverse team of creative thinkers and industry experts who share our vision for a more accessible, transparent, and inclusive financial ecosystem. We’re now looking for like-minded folks to join the crew.

**Role Overview**

As an SDET at Jupiter, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the seamless performance and reliability of our products. You will design and develop scalable automation frameworks, enhance test coverage, and proactively identify potential issues to maintain top-notch quality standards.

A milestone-focused approach will be key, ensuring continuous improvements in test efficiency and reliability. This role requires a perfect blend of technical expertise, problem-solving skills, and a passion for building robust systems that support Jupiter’s mission of redefining banking.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Automation Framework Development: Design, develop, and maintain robust automation frameworks for web, mobile, and APIs, ensuring scalability and reusability.
* Test Planning & Execution: Define and implement test strategies, create detailed test plans, and perform functional, regression, and integration testing.
* CI/CD Pipeline Integration: Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines, monitor builds, and troubleshoot test failures to ensure smooth deployments.
* Defect Identification & Root Cause Analysis: Identify, document, and analyze defects with detailed root cause analysis to facilitate quick resolution.
* Collaboration with Cross-Functional Teams: Work closely with developers, product managers, and DevOps teams to align quality processes with business goals.
* Performance & Security Testing: Conduct performance, load, and security testing to identify bottlenecks and vulnerabilities, ensuring system stability.
* Process Improvement & Mentorship: Continuously enhance testing processes, tools, and methodologies while mentoring junior team members to build a strong quality culture.

**What We Are Looking For**

* 3-6 years of experience as an SDET with a strong focus on backend testing and automation.
* Mobile app testing exposure is an added advantage.
* Proficiency in Python is highly preferred, though extensive backend automation experience with any language is acceptable.
* Hands-on experience in microservices environments with knowledge of cloud platforms like AWS, GCP, or Azure, along with Kubernetes expertise.
* Strong debugging skills across large tech stacks, with the ability to perform root cause analysis (RCA) effectively.
* Familiarity with Linux OS and the ability to work efficiently in a Linux-based environment.
* Mentoring experience and guiding junior engineers is a desirable plus.

**Why you should work with us:**

* We like people who behave like owners, and we place a high regard on those who take ownership and see projects through to completion.
* We take pleasure in tackling meaningful problems by understanding pain points and developing intuitive experiences that delight customers.
* We appreciate those who can participate in healthy conflict and can commit to every decision as if it were their own. We value consent over consensus.
* In our relentless pursuit of excellence, we consistently set higher standards. If you crave continuous learning, growth, and improvement in a dynamic environment, choosing Jupiter is the right move.

title: ADAS Architect - Simulation, Data & Verification Platform
description:
**About The Team**
You will join a focused team of domain experts building a greenfield, in-house L2+ ADAS software stack for Indian road conditions, covering four-wheelers and two-wheelers. The team designs and owns the complete architecture, algorithms, and tooling, from first principles through to deployment on automotive-grade ECUs. Engineers here shape foundational technical decisions, work directly with experts across perception, fusion, driving functions, motion control, and simulation, and see their work carried from concept to vehicle.
  
  
**Role purpose**
The Simulation, Data & Verification Platform Architect defines and builds the engineering platform on which every ADAS algorithm in the organization is developed, verified, and released. This is not the integration or configuration of an existing framework: the role creates, from the ground up, a proprietary simulation engine and developer application, the automated verification and reporting system that runs on it, and the data platform that feeds both, from recorded vehicle data through labelling to cloud-scale execution.
  
  
The platform is the primary evidence base for every function, before and after vehicles are available. Its correctness, determinism, and traceability directly determine the credibility of every result the organization reports. The role calls for a senior architect with deep software engineering skill, strong automotive domain understanding, and a record of building platforms that entire engineering teams depend on.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Simulation engine and developer application**

* Architect and build a proprietary simulation engine that executes any algorithm component delivered as a host-agnostic C-API library, discovering the component's ports and configuration at run time rather than through hand-written integration.
* Define the execution model: closed-loop simulation, deterministic resimulation against recorded data, and pure replay as distinct, well-defined modes; multi-rate scheduling; and multi-component pipelines in which any stage can run live, stubbed, or injected from a recording.
* Design and build the interactive developer application: timeline and transport control, 2D/3D scene view, signal plots, port and message inspection, layer-based visualization contributed by each component as plug-ins, and side-by-side comparison of runs.
* Guarantee traceability: every value displayed or reported is traceable to the recording, message, build, and configuration that produced it, and the headless command-line interface produces answers identical to the GUI.
* Establish determinism as a measured property: bit-exact resimulation within and across processes, and tracked, explained differences across builds and machines.
* Provide process isolation, timeouts, and crash capture so that a failing component never takes down a run or a campaign.
* Integrate external simulators and scenario tools (e.g., CarMaker, CARLA, esmini) through codecs and adapters, without coupling any algorithm component to a specific tool.

**Automated verification and reporting framework**

* Design and build, from zero, the automated test framework that runs scenario campaigns on the simulation engine: scenario definitions with machine-checkable acceptance criteria, parameter sweeps, and NCAP-based and India-specific scenario libraries.
* Build automated reporting for every campaign: per-scenario verdicts with evidence, function KPIs, coverage against requirements, trend and regression tracking, and drill-down from any failed case to the exact moment in the recording.
* Implement regression gates in CI that block a change when a KPI, scenario outcome, or determinism check regresses.
* Link verification results to requirements so that traceability and coverage reports are generated automatically, never maintained by hand.

**Data platform: recordings, storage, labelling, and cloud execution**

* Define the recording data model and formats (e.g., MCAP, MDF4, rosbag), including embedded schemas and provenance (vehicle, sensor set, software build, configuration, and scenario identity).
* Architect storage and data management for large volumes of vehicle recordings: ingestion from test vehicles, indexing, metadata and search, retention, dataset versioning, and access control.
* Establish labelling and annotation pipelines for ground truth: tool selection or development, auto-labelling, quality control, annotation specifications, and management of external annotation vendors.
* Build scenario extraction and mining from recorded data, turning field drives into reusable, parameterized test scenarios.
* Architect cloud and cluster execution of resimulation and scenario campaigns at scale (thousands of runs), including job orchestration, containerization, cost control, and reproducibility of every run.

**Technical leadership**

* Own the technical roadmap of the platform and make build-versus-buy decisions with clear justification.
* Set engineering standards for the platform: code quality, testing, documentation, and backward compatibility of interfaces.
* Work with algorithm, perception, test, and integration teams as internal customers, and with the ECU-in-the-Loop Test & Release Architect so that SIL, HIL, and vehicle results share one reporting system.
* Mentor engineers and, as the platform grows, build and lead the team around it.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree (PhD a plus) in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics, Mechatronics, Robotics, or a related discipline.
* 7-15 years of software engineering experience, including at least 5 years architecting simulation, SIL/HIL, data, or verification platforms for ADAS, autonomous driving, or robotics.
* Demonstrated design and delivery, from scratch, of a simulation or resimulation platform adopted as the primary development and regression tool of an engineering organization.
* Expert-level C++ (C++17) and Python: C ABIs, dynamic library loading, plug-in architectures, cross-language bindings, and performance-critical, multi-threaded code on Windows and Linux.
* Experience building desktop engineering applications with rich visualization (e.g., Qt, Dear ImGui, OpenGL/Vulkan, or equivalent).
* Deep knowledge of recorded-data formats and large-scale handling of automotive sensor data (camera, radar, lidar, vehicle bus).
* Hands-on experience with ground-truth labelling and annotation workflows for ADAS data, including quality metrics.
* Proven experience with cloud or cluster execution (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, containerized batch workloads) for simulation or data processing at scale.
* Strong knowledge of build, packaging, and CI (CMake, Conan or equivalent, and modern CI systems).
* Experience with schema-driven interfaces (e.g., Protocol Buffers) and long-term interface versioning.
* Working knowledge of ADAS function behaviour, NCAP test protocols, and scenario-based testing (ASAM OpenSCENARIO / OpenDRIVE).

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience building a scenario-mining or data-driven test-generation pipeline from fleet or test-vehicle data.
* Experience with auto-labelling using offline perception models.
* Experience with verification in regulated contexts (ISO 26262, ISO 21448 SOTIF, ASPICE) and with tool qualification.
* Contributions to open-source simulation, robotics, or data tooling.
* Experience leading or growing a platform team.
* Advanced use of AI-assisted software development tools to accelerate platform development.

**Key competencies**

* Ability to explain complex trade-offs clearly to engineers and leadership to drive technical decisions.
* Architectural judgement: designs that stay simple as components, functions, and data volumes grow by orders of magnitude.
* Uncompromising rigor in determinism, traceability, and reproducibility: a result that cannot be traced is not accepted as a result.
* A product mindset toward internal tools: engineers adopt the platform because it is the fastest way to work, not because it is mandated.
* Ownership from first design to organization-wide daily use, without reliance on handoffs.
* Ability to build new systems where architecture and processes are still being defined, and to make them the reference for the organization.
* Clear technical communication with engineers, architects, and management.

**L&T Company Overview / About Us**
L&T is a USD 30 billion Indian multinational engaged in EPC Projects, Hi-Tech Manufacturing, and Services, operating across multiple geographies. A strong, customer–focussed approach and the constant quest for top-class quality have enabled L&T to attain and sustain leadership in its major lines of business for eight decades.
  
  
Given L&T’s capability in strategic electronics and leveraging its foray into semiconductor design and well-established capabilities in L&T Technology Services, the business is expanding its offerings to cover industrial electronic modules, products and systems in critical sectors of Power Electronics, Automotive Electronics, Industrial Robotics & Automation, Communication Platforms and Electronic Systems Design & Manufacturing (ESDM). The focus products under Automotive Electronics are ADAS, Electrification & Connectivity related products.

* PPA Analytics Platform: Build, maintain, and own a unified PPA repository, comprehensive dashboards, and advanced PPA scaling methodologies.
* Flow Integration & Release Management: Manage and integrate all recipe changes within our internal flows, taking full ownership of flow release cycles.
* Memory Compiler Optimization: Collaborate closely with the platform engineering teams to streamline, optimize, and support the memory compiler flow.
* Cross-Functional Integration: Partner with Platform Engineering and Platform Technologies teams to seamlessly integrate compiler-level and internal CAD solutions.
* PD Execution Support: Develop a deep, functional understanding of our internal systems to provide robust, day-to-day support for the Physical Design execution teams.

**Required Qualifications**

* Education & Experience: Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, with 4+ years of relevant industry experience.
* Coding & Scripting: Strong proficiency in programming and scripting languages, specifically Python and TCL, to drive flow automation and tool development.
* Data & Dashboards: Hands-on experience designing and managing databases and visualization platforms, with a strong focus on SQL and Grafana.
* AI-Driven Development: Demonstrated ability to leverage AI agents and modern AI tools to develop innovative CAD solutions and accelerate coding tasks.
* Design Flow Foundation: Solid foundational understanding of the digital ASIC design flow, specifically spanning from Synthesis through Static Timing Analysis (STA).

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Version Control & CI/CD: Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git) and continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) practices for managing flow releases.
* Advanced Analytics: Experience building complex data pipelines or handling large-scale engineering data for PPA optimization.

India

description:
**Hiring for Swiggy**
— via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role.

**About Company**

Founded in 2014, Swiggy is a technology-driven on-demand delivery platform serving consumers across India. Its platform connects consumers with restaurants, stores and delivery partners across 500+ cities. The Analytics team partners with decision-makers across the value chain, from restaurant menus and delivery incentives to marketing channels and hyperlocal demand.

**The Analytics Team**

You will work with decision-makers to solve practical problems across Swiggy's business. The work spans consumer, restaurant-partner and delivery-partner journeys, with opportunities to implement recommendations and see their effects. You will collaborate with statisticians, consultants, programmers and cross-functional business partners in a fast-paced environment.

**Job Roles & Responsibilities**

* Analyze large, complex datasets to solve business problems and monitor and forecast key metrics.
* Define measures that show progress against business goals; plan and review business performance.
* Design, run and measure experiments to test hypotheses and interpret the results.
* Automate recurring root-cause analysis and insight generation through self-serve platforms.
* Tell clear stories from data and work with Business, Product and Data Engineering to improve instrumentation quality and data accuracy.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Economics, Finance, Mathematics, Statistics or a related quantitative field.
* One to four years of experience, including at least one year in core analytics.
* Hands-on data manipulation using SQL, R, Python, Excel or similar tools, and exposure to Power BI, Tableau or another BI platform.
* Working knowledge of descriptive statistics, significance testing and basic regression or classification.
* Structured, creative problem-solving, clear communication, attention to detail and effective cross-functional collaboration.

**What We Offer**

* Work on varied business problems across a large on-demand delivery platform.
* Partner closely with decision-makers and see analytical recommendations implemented.
* Learn alongside colleagues with backgrounds in statistics, consulting and programming.
* Contribute in a flat, direct, fast-moving team that values learning, collaboration and merit-based growth.

For more information, visit Lowes India
  
  
**About The Team**
The Market Intelligence (MI) team of ESS provides external market, supplier, competitor and technology intelligence to support better sourcing and category decisions. We work proactively with category teams to identify opportunities, risks and market shifts early, translating intelligence into actionable insights.
  
  
**I. Job Summary**
The primary purpose of the Market Intel Analyst role is to execute and support Market Intelligence projects. The individual is expected to work in conjunction with Enterprise Strategic Sourcing category leaders & teams and with Market Intel leaders. This position is focused on providing market research, reports/analytics, insights and intelligence as required.
  
  
**II. Roles & Responsibilities**
**Core Responsibilities:**

* Does external secondary research for various Category owners and recommends benchmarks based on the external market, internal spend, key metrics and contractual data.
* Owns specific Market Intelligence trackers/dashboards – category, supplier, regional, etc. Ensures they are refreshed on time and insights are delivered to respective stakeholders.
* Pulls and analyzes data associated with historical/current spend to support market intelligence, benchmarking and category research as required.
* Supports Market Intelligence analysis across categories – both reactive and proactive.
* Consolidates data for key metrics reporting and Market Intelligence deliverables.
* Supports data modelling and enrichment exercises required for Market Intelligence and benchmarking.
* Increases accuracy of data used for Market Intelligence analysis and reporting.
* Supports supplier intelligence, including vendor financials, ISG (Information Security Group) analysis and ESG (Environmental, Social and Governance) data analysis.
* Supports Market Intelligence tools, processes and ways of working as assigned.
* Follows up with stakeholders and communicates key market, supplier and category insights/changes.
* Supports configuration and enhancement of Market Intelligence tools and solutions.
* Helps reduce turnaround time of Market Intelligence research, analysis and reporting.

**III. Years Of Experience**
2 - 4 years
  
  
**IV. Education Qualification & Certifications**
**Required Minimum Qualifications**
Bachelor’s degree
  
  
**V. Skill Set Required**
**Primary Skills (Must have)**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Science, or related field, or equivalent years of experience in lieu of education requirement, if applicable
* 3 years of business experience
* Proficiency in market research and data analysis
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint
* Proficiency in data collection, collation, analysis, and visualization
* Proficiency in collaboration and communication
* Proficiency in data visualization tools such as Power BI
* Working knowledge of procurement and sourcing tools
* Basic knowledge of AI and its applications in research and analysis

**Secondary Skills (Preferred)**

* Exposure to sourcing and procurement
* Cost optimization experience

PA is a Shopify-native return-fraud and order-risk decisioning platform that reinvents the post-purchase experience for retailers. We help merchants catch return abuse, empty-box (FTID) fraud, claim abuse, and payment fraud in real time — making high-stakes approve/decline decisions on live order and return traffic. We''re looking for a hands-on Data Scientist / MLE to help us build and deploy intelligent data systems. You''ll work closely with the Head of Machine Learning to clean, analyse, and model data, and to operationalise models and customer datasets in production.

* Identity Resolution: Connecting entities and related data points into unified customer identities.
* Data Segregation and Clustering: Cleaning, parsing, and geo-clustering data to reveal underlying structure.
* Abuse and Fraud Detection: Modelling behavioural and transactional risk signals to detect fraudulent activity.
* Anomaly Detection and Scoring Pipelines: Identifying irregular patterns across large customer datasets.
* Operational ML Systems: Deploying scoring APIs, automated feature stores, and monitoring pipelines at scale.

**What You''ll Do**

* Perform data analysis, feature engineering, and exploratory insights across business datasets.
* Build and deploy ML models (classification, regression, ranking, anomaly detection, etc.).
* Fine-tune and integrate LLMs (OpenAI, Hugging Face, LangChain, RAG pipelines).
* Support model deployment in cloud / API environments (Docker, GCP).
* Create dashboards, reports, and validation pipelines for model and data monitoring.
* Collaborate with engineering on scalable data workflows and inference pipelines.

**What We''re Looking For**

* Hands-on experience in payment fraud or the payments domain is required — including exposure to transactional risk signals, fraud detection, or related risk-modelling work.
* Python (NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow or PyTorch).
* Experience with LLM frameworks (Hugging Face, LangChain, OpenAI API).
* Basic knowledge of MLOps (Docker, CI/CD, API serving, Git).
* SQL / NoSQL data querying familiarity with cloud data environments.
* Strong analytical mindset comfortable with statistics and data visualisation (e.g., Plotly, Seaborn).
* Curious, pragmatic problem solver who enjoys taking models from notebook to production.
* Able to learn quickly and adapt in a fast-moving AI environment.

**Nice to Have**

* Exposure to RAG, prompt-tuning, or lightweight model fine-tuning.
* Understanding of model monitoring and data drift detection.
* Understanding of deep learning and graph data structures.

**Why PA**
You''ll work on a high-stakes, real-time product where your work directly protects revenue, alongside a small, senior team with a short path from idea to production.

title: AI Architect
description:
Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced and client-focused AI Solution Architect to lead the design and delivery of scalable, secure, data-driven, AI-powered, and cloud-native solutions. The role involves collaborating with business and technology stakeholders to translate business requirements into effective technology solutions, drive digital transformation, and support innovation initiatives. The architect will also contribute to client engagement, solution design, and pre-sales activities.

Key Responsibilities

Solution Architecture & Design

• Lead the design of end-to-end technology solutions aligned with business requirements.

• Develop scalable, secure, and high-performance architecture blueprints.

• Define architecture across applications, data, APIs, cloud infrastructure, security, and DevOps.

• Ensure adherence to architecture standards and best practices.

Data & AI Architecture

• Design and implement AI and data-driven solutions to address business challenges.

• Develop modern data platforms, including data lakes, lakehouses, and real-time data pipelines.

• Enable advanced analytics, machine learning, and AI-driven decision-making.

• Ensure data governance, quality, security, and compliance across data platforms.

Cloud & Technology Modernization

• Design cloud-native and hybrid solutions using AWS, Azure, or GCP.

• Drive application modernization using microservices, APIs, and event-driven architectures.

• Ensure scalability, reliability, and performance optimization across distributed systems.

• Define DevOps, CI/CD, and automation strategies to improve delivery efficiency.

Client Engagement & Stakeholder Management

• Collaborate with senior stakeholders to understand business needs and recommend technology solutions.

• Lead architecture discussions, solution workshops, and technical presentations.

• Translate complex technical concepts into clear business benefits.

• Support pre-sales activities, solution proposals, and client presentations.

• Provide technical guidance and recommendations to support strategic technology decisions.

title: AI Architect
description:
Job Description

We’re looking for a seasoned Software Architect with deep expertise in cloud-native enterprise systems and Generative AI. You will define and deliver scalable, secure, and production-grade GenAI architectures — including multi-agent, RAG, LLMOps and AgentOps systems — and lead cross-functional teams to build and operate them. This role combines hands-on technical leadership, systems thinking, and strong stakeholder management.

Key responsibilities

Architecture & System Design

1. Design scalable, modular, and cloud-native architectures for GenAI applications(microservices, event-driven, serverless).
2. Define system boundaries, data flows, orchestration, and integration patterns forLLMs, vector DBs, embedding services, and tool integrations.
3. Produce architecture artifacts ( Layered Architecture Diagrams, C4 Models, DFDs,Class, Sequence, ER & Use Case diagrams, different types of blueprints, APIcontracts, design and trade-off decisions).
4. GenAI & Agentic Systems
5. Architect and deliver Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, NaturalLanguage to SQL Flows, fine-tuning strategies, multi-modal capabilities, and tool-augmented agents.
6. Design agent orchestration and multi-agent frameworks enabling planning,reasoning, and secure tool invocations, implement and design Agent prototypes andCommunication Protocols.
7. Define prompt engineering standards, memory models(episodic/semantic/procedural), and context management.

LLMOps & AgentOps

1. Define and implement model lifecycle pipelines: training, fine-tuning, validation,deployment, rollback, and monitoring.
2. Build AgentOps processes for agent lifecycle, behavior tracking, governance andperformance optimization.
3. Automate CI/CD for models, agents and services (MLflow, TFX, BentoML, custompipelines).

Integration, Security & Compliance

1. Integrate GenAI services with enterprise systems (ERP, CRM, data lakes, APIs) usingsecure, scalable interfaces.
2. Ensure secure access controls, data privacy, encryption, and compliance (GDPR,HIPAA, SOC2).
3. Define responsible AI practices: bias mitigation, explainability, audit trails, andoutput governance.
4. GenAI security — classify, encrypt & sign data/models; enforce least-privilege withshort-lived creds and CI/CD security gates; telemetry, drift/hallucination alerts, kill-switch & runbooks.
5. Agentic AI security — provable agent identity/attestation, tool allowlist + human gatefor high-risk actions; ephemeral scoped tokens, sandboxed execution,and replayable audit traces.

Observability, Ops & Cost Optimization

1. Define telemetry, tracing, and logging for models and agents; monitor performance,drift, hallucination rates and user feedback loops.
2. Build dashboards, alerts and runbook guidance for operational health.
3. Design systems for cost efficiency (autoscaling, spot instances, serverlesschoices) and support FinOps practices.

Leadership, Collaboration & Documentation

1. Lead cross-functional teams (product, data science, AI engineers, platform)through architecture reviews, workshops, and technical decisioning.
2. Maintain architectural standards, documentation, playbooks, and patternlibraries for GenAI systems.
3. Mentor engineers and evangelize best practices across the organization.

Required qualifications & experience

1. 10+ years software engineering experience with 3+ years in architecture or seniortechnical leadership roles (or equivalent).
2. Proven track record designing and delivering cloud-native, production systems atenterprise scale.
3. Hands-on experience with GenAI/LLM systems, RAG, NL-SQL,agentic frameworks or similar productionized AI applications.
4. Strong knowledge of system design patterns (microservices, event-driven,CQRS, hexagonal architecture), and Low Level Design Patterns.
5. Experience integrating ML/LLM services with enterprise data platforms and APIswhile meeting security/compliance requirements.
6. Solid engineering background in at least two languages (Python, TypeScript, Go,Java, C#) and familiarity with modern frameworks.

Technical skills & technologies (comprehensive)

1. Cloud & Infra: AWS / Azure / GCP; Kubernetes, Docker, serverless (Lambda, Functions, Cloud Run), GPU instances
2. GenAI & ML: Hugging Face Transformers, OpenAI APIs, ,LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, Haystack
3. Vector Stores: FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, Postgres+pgVector, and other cloud vector stores
4. LLMOps / MLOps: Custom Development of Ops Pipelines, MLflow, TFX, BentoML, Kubeflow
5. Data & Integration: Kafka, Spark, Airflow, Flink, ETL/ELT concepts, data lakes, API gateways (Apigee etc)
6. DevOps & IaC: Terraform, Pulumi, CloudFormation, GitHub Actions, Jenkins
7. Observability & Security: Prometheus, Grafana stack, OpenTelemetry, Jaeger, ELK, Datadog; Vault,
8. IAM, LDAP/OAuth2/OIDC/SAML Connect, Snyk, SonarQube, SAST/SCA in pipelines, OWASPs, CWEs, CVEs.
9. Databases & Storage: Relational (RDS/Cloud SQL), NoSQL (Mongo, DynamoDB, Cosmos DB), Redis, S3/Blob/GCS, ORM/ODM frameworks.
10. Agent frameworks / tools: Understanding of Basics of Agents required, Langgraph, Autogen, AutoGPT, AgentVerse, MetaGPT, CrewAI etc.
11. Performance & scalability: SSR/ISR, caching strategies (CDN, edge), lazy loading, bundle optimization, performance budgets.
12. Realtime & asyncRealtime & async: WebSockets, SSE, message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ), background workers. Frontend frameworks: React (Next.js), Angular, Vue; component libraries and state (Redux/RTK, Context, Pinia, Zustand)
13. Styling & UI tooling: Component Libraries, Accessibility best practices, Responsive UI
14. Frontend build & tooling: Vite, Webpack, Storybook, UI Frameworks.
15. Backend frameworks: Node.js/Express, FastAPI, serverless functions (AWS Lambda, Cloud Functions)
16. API design & integration: REST, gRPC, OpenAPI/Swagger, API versioning and contract testing, GraphQL(Optional)
17. UX & product mindset: Design-system familiarity, usability, accessibility, and working with designers

Behavioral & leadership skills

1. Strategic thinking with the ability to align architecture to product and businessgoals.
2. Excellent communicator: simplify complex technical concepts for technical andnon-technical stakeholders.
3. Strong mentorship skills — able to raise team capability in GenAI architectureand engineering.
4. Pragmatic decision-maker with a bias for measurable outcomes and trade-offanalysis.
5. High attention to detail, ownership, and accountability for reliability, security,and cost.

Nice-to-have

1. Experience operating LLMs in regulated industries (pharma).
2. Familiarity with prompt auditing, hallucination detection, and automated qualitychecks.
3. Background in knowledge engineering, semantic search, or knowledge graphs.
4. Academic background in CS, ML, or equivalent applied experience.
5. Mobile & cross-platform (optional): React Native, Flutter basics for mobileintegration
6. Deliverables & success metrics (examples)
7. Production-ready GenAI architecture and deployment runbook.
8. Deployed RAG/agent pipeline with observable SLOs and monitoring dashboards.
9. Reduced model hallucination/incidents and measurable improvement inretrieval quality.
10. Architecture decision records (ADRs), standards library, and cross-teamonboarding materials.
11. Cost targets achieved through optimized infra and autoscaling policies.

title: Engineering Lead_ Agentic Hive
description:
Job description:
  
  
Job Description About the Role and Team

Join Wipro's AI-Native Business & Platforms unit, a forward-thinking team dedicated to advancing the future of enterprise artificial intelligence. Our Agentic Hive Platform team is responsible for creating a robust, scalable platform that enables intelligent AI agents, digital ecosystems, and business process automation for our clients worldwide. This team plays a vital role in pioneering agentic AI technology, integrating delivery and client partnerships across India and the United States to drive innovation at enterprise scale.

We are looking for an experienced and hands-on Engineering Head to spearhead the technical vision and development of the Agentic Hive platform. The ideal candidate will lead architecture design, development, and deployment of agentic AI capabilities with a strong focus on security, scalability, and reliability. In this pivotal leadership role, you will guide a dynamic engineering team responsible for delivering production-ready AI solutions and integrating them seamlessly with enterprise systems.

Operating from India, you will collaborate closely with leadership and technical peers based in the U.S., ensuring alignment and fostering innovation across global teams. This is a unique opportunity to influence the trajectory of agentic AI in a large enterprise context, blending deep technical expertise with strategic leadership and enterprise architecture sensibilities.

͏ Key Responsibilities

* Take full ownership of the architecture and engineering delivery of the Agentic Hive platform, ensuring it meets business priorities, is modular, scalable, and aligned with product roadmaps.
* Lead the design and hands-on development of AI agents and automated workflows leveraging Claude and state-of-the-art agentic AI methodologies, including reasoning algorithms, tool integrations, and interactive human-in-the-loop processes.
* Architect and orchestrate multi-agent systems encompassing specialized agent roles, inter-agent coordination, task routing, stateful management, fault tolerance, and seamless tool collaboration.
* Design comprehensive context management solutions to optimize agent interaction, including memory management, prompt engineering, session persistence, enterprise knowledge integration, semantic search layers, and controlled data access.
* Develop reusable enterprise architecture frameworks, APIs, reference implementations, and governance policies that empower diverse teams to contribute consistently to the Agentic Hive ecosystem.
* Provide technical leadership and mentorship to an AI engineering team of 5 to 6 members, driving design excellence, code quality, development processes, and resolving complex technical challenges effectively.
* Establish agent evaluation standards with a focus on safety, governance, traceability, performance monitoring, hallucination detection, and overall quality benchmarks.
* Collaborate extensively with cross-functional partners including product management, UX/CX design, data teams, security, cloud infrastructure, and domain experts to deliver compelling, trustworthy, and user-centric AI experiences.
* Guide decisions and implementations in data science and data engineering domains ensuring robust data ingestion, transformation, retrieval, feature layer development, model integration, and reliable production workflows.
* Champion engineering best practices such as API-first design, CI/CD automation, container orchestration, cloud scalability, cost management, and secure operations across enterprise cloud environments.
* Engage proactively with stakeholders to translate operational feedback into enhanced platform capabilities and to support the adoption of agentic AI solutions across client engagements.

͏ Preferred Qualifications and Experience

* Proven hands-on experience designing and delivering Agentic AI solutions, specifically utilizing Claude AI for agent constructions and automations.
* Demonstrated expertise in multi-agent orchestration architectures, enabling complex agent interactions and integrations with external tools and systems.
* In-depth understanding of agent context management strategies including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), semantic memory modeling, prompt engineering, and secured data governance.
* Strong background in applying enterprise architecture principles to build modular, scalable, and secure platform infrastructures.
* Experience managing and mentoring AI engineering teams, balancing architectural oversight with active technical contribution.
* Robust data science and engineering skills encompassing Python programming, SQL, data pipelines, model development, and production-grade deployment.
* Familiarity with UX, UI, and customer experience design concepts enabling effective collaboration with design teams to translate user needs into AI solutions.
* Experience developing AI/ML or generative AI systems incorporating engineering practices like automatic testing, continuous integration and delivery, monitoring, security considerations, and governance frameworks.
* Strong communication abilities with a track record of managing technical discussions with diverse stakeholders including engineers, product teams, and clients.

͏ Additional Technical Skills

* Experience with agent frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or similar, including orchestration and agent-to-agent/tool interaction (MCP, A2A patterns).
* Hands-on knowledge of retrieval-augmented generation techniques, hybrid retrieval models, semantic search, knowledge graph integration, and enterprise semantic layers.
* Expertise in AI agent evaluation methodologies, including automated evaluation strategies, policy enforcement, guardrails, and metrics like RAGAS for ongoing assessment.
* Familiarity with LLMOps/MLOps tooling and best practices, including version control of prompts/models, experimentation tracking, automated deployment, performance monitoring, and governance.
* Deep understanding of cloud-native architectures on platforms like Azure, Google Cloud Platform, AWS, and Databricks, tailored for AI and data workloads.
* Competence in containerization and orchestration platforms such as Docker and Kubernetes, RESTful API development, FastAPI, infrastructure as code (IaC), and telemetry systems.
* Experience delivering AI solutions in regulated or complex enterprise environments, successfully transitioning from research and prototyping to robust production systems.

͏ Education, Experience & Leadership Competencies

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or related technical disciplines; or equivalent practical experience in these fields.
* Minimum of 12 years' experience in software, data, or AI engineering roles with substantial recent success in generative AI or Agentic AI architecture leadership and delivery.
* Preferred certifications in cloud platforms, AI/ML, data engineering, or related architecture fields that validate technical expertise.
* Proven leadership in managing and scaling engineering teams while maintaining direct hands-on involvement in architecture and development activities.
* Effective communicator and stakeholder management expert capable of articulating complex technical concepts to executives, product owners, and engineering teams alike.
* Comfortable operating in ambiguous, fast-paced environments, balancing innovation with enterprise-grade demands including security, governance, reliability, user experience, and cost management.
* Strong alignment with Wipro's values such as self-leadership, respect, trust building, transformation leadership, and execution excellence to inspire and drive team success.

What Success Looks Like

* Delivering a scalable, reusable, and secure Agentic Hive platform architecture that serves as a reference model across the organization.
* Ensuring all agentic solutions are production-ready, meeting rigorous safety, observability, reliability, and quality standards.
* Maintaining a highly effective AI engineering team, fostering technical excellence, predictable deliveries, and development of reusable components accelerating future projects.
* Driving strong adoption of the platform by internal teams, partners, and enterprise customers via outstanding developer and end-user experiences.
* Successfully aligning multiple stakeholder groups including product management, engineering, data science, security, governance, cloud operations, and client relations to maximize platform impact.

title: Senior Technical Lead – Traffic
description:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.
  
  
Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.
  
  
Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.
  
  
****Job Type:**
Full-time**
**About The Team**
**At eBay, Traffic Engineering powers secure, scalable, and highly available traffic systems that support our global commerce platform. This role sits at the center of networking, platform engineering, performance optimization, and production reliability. The team is focused on building intelligent traffic management solutions, advancing PoP and caching strategies, improving observability and cyber resilience, and enabling eBay to innovate at internet scale.**
**Role Summary**
**We are looking for a Senior Technical Lead to lead the architecture, development, and evolution of eBay’s traffic engineering platform. This is an L26-level role for an experienced technical leader who can operate beyond a single component or team, drive design across multiple functional areas, influence technical direction, and improve engineering effectiveness across the organization. You will combine deep systems and networking expertise with strong execution, mentoring, and multi-functional leadership to deliver secure, scalable, and high-performance traffic solutions for eBay’s global platform.**
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the technical strategy, architecture, and delivery for traffic engineering systems spanning traffic management, load balancing, service connectivity, PoP optimization, and caching infrastructure.
* Design and build resilient, secure, and high-performance distributed systems using C/C++ and Go, along with modern cloud-native platform patterns.
* Own technical decisions across multiple functional areas, balancing scalability, reliability, performance, security, maintainability, and time-to-market tradeoffs.
* Drive platform evolution on Kubernetes, including networking integrations such as CNI, service mesh, IPAM, and production-grade deployment patterns.
* Establish and improve engineering metrics aligned to team and business goals, using observability and production insights to drive reliability, efficiency, and customer impact.
* Lead incident prevention and operational excellence through strong observability, cyber security controls, performance tuning, and robust system design.
* Partner with product, infrastructure, security, and adjacent engineering teams to align roadmaps, resolve cross-team dependencies, and drive technical consensus.
* Mentor engineers and technical leads through design reviews, code reviews, architecture guidance, and hands-on problem solving, setting the standard for engineering quality across the team.
* Act as a technical multiplier by improving platform capabilities, team productivity, development practices, and long-term architectural direction.
* Contribute to eBay’s innovation culture through open-source engagement, patents, and forward-looking technical exploration in networking and traffic systems.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* 12+ years of software engineering experience, with significant depth in networking, traffic engineering, distributed systems, or cyber security.
* Strong proficiency in C/C++ and Go, with experience building production-grade, high-performance systems.
* Deep expertise in low-level Linux networking, traffic management, and systems performance optimization.
* Strong experience with Kubernetes and cloud-native infrastructure at scale.
* Proven experience designing scalable, secure, and observable distributed systems.
* Proven ability to lead sophisticated technical initiatives across teams and influence architecture beyond an immediate area.
* Strong mentoring, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to guide teams through ambiguity and technical tradeoffs.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Hands-on experience with Envoy, service mesh, control plane and data plane architectures, SDN, eBPF, NGINX, HAProxy, network security, or comparable traffic load-balancing technologies.
* Experience in service mesh, Kubernetes CNI, and IPAM management.
* Experience building or operating products in the security domain.
* Strong background in caching strategies, PoP design, and internet-scale traffic optimization.
* Familiarity with Java or related backend ecosystems.
* Contributions to open-source projects, patents, or externally visible technical innovation.
* Experience working in large-scale, globally distributed engineering environments.

**What Success Looks Like**
**In this role, you will be expected to operate as a senior technical leader who extends impact beyond day-to-day execution: shaping architecture across systems, driving measurable improvements in traffic platform outcomes, mentoring engineers, and influencing adjacent teams through strong technical judgment and collaboration.**

description:
**Meet the Team**
Technical Leader, Cisco Secure Email Threat Defense (ETD) — G11 | Bangalore, India. Cisco Secure Email Threat Defense builds cloud security systems that help organizations detect, investigate, and respond to email threats. In this role, you will set technical direction for applied AI across the product, turning machine learning, generative AI, and agentic workflows into secure, reliable capabilities with measurable customer value. You will lead complex engineering work from exploration and evaluation through production, and raise AI and software engineering capability across the team.
  
  
**Your Impact**
You will combine deep AI expertise with strong software and security engineering judgment. You will guide the team in selecting the right problems for AI, validating solutions against rigorous quality and safety standards, and operating them effectively at cloud scale.
  
  

* Set the technical strategy and architecture for applied AI in ETD, connecting customer problems and product goals to a clear engineering roadmap.
* Design and lead AI capabilities for email threat investigation, triage, verdict quality, analyst assistance, and safe remediation using machine learning, large language models, and agent workflows where they fit.
* Own the AI lifecycle from data and use-case assessment through model or agent selection, prototyping, evaluation, production launch, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
* Build evaluation approaches that test accuracy, precision and recall, false-positive impact, robustness, latency, cost, and consistency across representative threat and customer scenarios.
* Establish safeguards for privacy, data protection, prompt and tool security, access control, auditability, human oversight, and responsible AI use.
* Architect scalable cloud services, APIs, data pipelines, and product integrations that make AI capabilities reliable and maintainable in production.
* Lead the safe adoption of approved AI coding assistants and agentic engineering workflows, with strong review, testing, security, and accountability for generated output.
* Partner with product management, threat research, engineering, customer experience, and support to shape requirements and turn customer and operational evidence into improvements.
* Lead resolution of complex customer-impacting issues and ensure production readiness through observability, incident response, root-cause analysis, and operational follow-through.
* Raise software quality through design and code reviews, automated testing, CI/CD, threat modeling, and engineering practices that improve reliability and delivery speed.
* Measure the impact of AI and engineering investments using customer outcomes, telemetry, adoption, quality, and operational metrics; communicate results and trade-offs clearly.
* Mentor engineers in AI, distributed systems, and security engineering; build shared technical judgment and lead work across teams and partners.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, computer engineering, or a related field, with 8+ years of relevant experience; or equivalent practical experience.
* Strong hands-on software engineering experience building and operating production services or security products, with proficiency in Go, Java, Python, C++, or a comparable language.
* Demonstrated depth in applied AI or machine learning, including the ability to select appropriate approaches and explain their limitations and trade-offs.
* Practical experience designing, evaluating, and deploying machine learning, generative AI, large language model, or agent-based systems in production or production-like environments.
* Experience creating evaluation and testing methods for AI systems, including quality measurement, failure analysis, robustness, and ongoing performance monitoring.
* Experience designing distributed cloud services, APIs, data processing systems, reliability, observability, and secure integrations.
* Strong understanding of security and privacy principles, with the ability to identify risks in AI-enabled systems and build appropriate controls.
* Proven technical leadership across architecture, implementation, complex issue resolution, and cross-team delivery; strong written and verbal communication skills.

* Experience with SaaS email security or cybersecurity, production AI, threat intelligence, and cloud-native systems or SIEM/SOAR integrations.

title: Systems Administrator, Hybrid Cloud and AI Infrastructure
description:
We are Lenovo. We do what we say. We own what we do. We WOW our customers.
  
  
Lenovo is a US$83 billion revenue global technology powerhouse, ranked #153 in the Fortune Global 500, and serving millions of customers every day in 180 markets. Focused on a bold vision to deliver Smarter Technology for All, Lenovo has built on its success as the world’s largest PC company with a full-stack portfolio of AI-enabled, AI-ready, and AI-optimized devices (PCs, workstations, smartphones, tablets), infrastructure (server, storage, edge, high performance computing and software defined infrastructure), software, solutions, and services. Lenovo’s continued investment in world-changing innovation is building a more equitable, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. Lenovo is listed on the Hong Kong stock exchange under Lenovo Group Limited (HKSE: 992) (ADR: LNVGY).
  
  
This transformation together with Lenovo’s world-changing innovation is building a more inclusive, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. To find out more visit www.lenovo.com, and read about the latest news via our StoryHub.
  
  
Position Overview
  
  
Lenovo seeks a Systems Administrator to own end-to-end deployment, support, and administration of hybrid cloud and AI infrastructure primarily for the Bangalore lab, across the network, compute, storage, operating system, and container orchestration (Docker and Kubernetes) layers, plus the NVIDIA technology stack.
  
  
You are a dedicated support resource for the Lab Operations Manager and you keep hybrid cloud and AI infrastructure operational in Bangalore at the scale the AI Lab Consolidation requires. You coordinate remotely with the Morrisville-based Systems Administrator, GPU/AI Infrastructure, Network Engineer on shared standards, escalations, and cross-site incident response, and you provide secondary technical support back to Morrisville. The role sits within Lenovo SSG’s Hybrid Cloud and AI Infrastructure Services (HCAIS) Offering Architecture Engineering organization.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Infrastructure Deployment and Administration
  
  

* Network: deploy, support, and administer lab networking for the Bangalore site.
* Compute: deploy, support, and administer physical and virtual compute infrastructure across the Bangalore lab.
* Storage: deploy, support, and administer lab storage systems across block and file tiers.
* Operating Systems: install, patch, and administer operating systems across Bangalore lab infrastructure.

Hybrid Cloud Platform Administration
  
  

* VMware: deploy, support, and administer VMware virtualization infrastructure (vSphere, ESXi, vCenter).
* Azure: support hybrid cloud integration and workloads extending Bangalore lab infrastructure to Microsoft Azure.
* Nutanix: deploy, support, and administer Nutanix hyperconverged infrastructure (HCI).
* Red Hat OpenShift: deploy, support, and administer Red Hat OpenShift container platform environments, extending the lab’s container orchestration footprint.

Container Orchestration
  
  

* Docker: deploy and administer Docker container runtime environments.
* Kubernetes: own full production Kubernetes administration, including cluster operations, role-based access control (RBAC), cluster networking, and version upgrades.

NVIDIA Platform Administration
  
  

* NVIDIA Technology Stack: administer NVIDIA drivers, the CUDA toolkit, InfiniBand fabric, Run:AI orchestration, and ClearML across the Bangalore lab’s GPU infrastructure.
* Configuration Validation: validate lab configurations against NVIDIA reference architecture (Lenovo Validated Design) certification requirements.

Lab Operations and Smart Hands
  
  

* Equipment Support: provide on-site, hands-on technical support for capital equipment requested by the Bangalore Professional Services / LMS team.
* Day-to-Day Support: provide day-to-day administration, support, and engineering functions for the network, compute, and storage layers in the physical Bangalore lab.
* Rack and Stack: perform rack-and-stack, structured cabling, imaging, and smart-hands support for lab hardware alongside higher-level administration duties.

Cross-Site Support and Coordination
  
  

* Morrisville Secondary Support: provide secondary technical support for NVIDIA technology stack capital equipment hosted in Morrisville.
* Remote Coordination: coordinate remotely with the Morrisville-based Systems Administrator, GPU/AI Infrastructure, Network Engineer, and Junior Systems Administrator on shared standards, escalations, and incident response across a roughly 12-hour time zone gap.
* NVIDIA Relationship: maintain a working relationship with NVIDIA field contacts, coordinating remotely with the Morrisville-based team.

**Required Qualifications**
Required Experience
  
  

* 4+ years of systems administration experience with hands-on breadth across network, compute, storage, and operating system layers, plus a GPU/AI infrastructure specialization.
* Hybrid Cloud Platforms: hands-on experience with hybrid cloud platforms such as VMware (vSphere/ESXi/vCenter), Microsoft Azure, Nutanix HCI, or Red Hat OpenShift.
* Hybrid Cloud or AI Certification: NVIDIA NCP-AI or equivalent in Microsoft or Red Hat OpenShift.
* Production Kubernetes Administration: demonstrated experience with cluster operations, RBAC, cluster networking, and version upgrades in a production environment.
* Docker: hands-on experience administering Docker container runtime environments.
* Hands-on NVIDIA administration: demonstrated experience administering NVIDIA drivers and the CUDA toolkit.
* Physical Infrastructure: comfortable with hands-on hardware work, including rack-and-stack, structured cabling, and smart hands, in addition to higher-level administration.

Core Professional Skills
  
  

* Incident Response: able to own after-hours incident response for a shared, multi-team infrastructure environment.
* Independent Ownership: comfortable working as the senior on-site infrastructure owner in Bangalore, remotely coordinating with the Morrisville-based team across a significant time zone gap.
* Physical Presence: this role requires physical, on-site presence in Bangalore and cannot be performed remotely from elsewhere.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Multi-Tenant Lab Experience: experience supporting a multi-tenant shared lab environment serving distributed teams.
* Experience with DCIM, IPAM, or monitoring tooling comparable to the lab’s stack (Hyperview-class DCIM, BlueCat / Infoblox-class IPAM, NVIDIA DCGM monitoring).
* InfiniBand Fabric: working familiarity with InfiniBand fabric in a multi-node GPU environment.
* GPU Orchestration: experience with Run:AI, ClearML, or a comparable GPU orchestration and MLOps toolset.

title: Performance Marketing Manager
description:
Gushwork is building an Agent Operating System for small and mid-sized businesses around the world. It is modern business software where AI agents and humans work together. Business owners and leaders set the goals. They decide what each agent is allowed to do. Then they review the metric each agent delivers.
  
  
We started with an SEO agent. It owns one metric: organic leads. Once it ranks pages and brings in leads, it reports them back to the customer. We are now expanding into a Paid Ads agent and a Developer agent, each owning a metric the business cares about.
  
  
Our customers sell high-value goods and services and have fewer than 200 employees. Most of them are in industries that are not digitally native: manufacturers, industrial distributors, commercial services. They do not buy AI. They buy outcomes. Our job is to make agents reliable enough that a business owner can trust them with a number.
  
  
We are a team of about 90 people based in Bengaluru, backed by Lightspeed and SIG. If you want to want to help us build reliable agents that runs real businesses, we're excited to meet you!
  
  
**About the role:**
Our customers use paid advertising to generate leads and grow their businesses. The Performance Marketing Specialist owns the execution and continuous improvement of these campaigns across Meta and Google.
  
  
You will work directly with customers to understand their business, translate their objectives into campaign strategies, take campaigns live and continuously improve performance.
  
  
This is a hands-on, customer-facing role. You are expected to understand the numbers, make decisions, identify opportunities and execute experiments. The focus is on improving campaign outcomes, not simply managing campaigns or reporting performance.
  
  
**What you'll do:**

* Own customer campaigns end to end, from understanding requirements and setting up accounts to launching and managing campaigns.
* Understand each customer's business, industry, target audience and objectives to develop relevant campaign strategies.
* Manage and optimize campaigns across Meta Ads and Google Ads, including budgets, targeting, bidding, audiences and campaign structures.
* Continuously monitor campaign performance, identify opportunities and implement optimisations to improve metrics such as CPL, CPA, conversion rates and lead quality.
* Ideate and execute experiments across creatives, messaging, ad formats, audiences, targeting and campaign strategies.
* Explore different creative approaches and formats, including Reels, videos and variations in messaging, to improve campaign performance.
* Communicate directly with customers, understand their feedback, explain campaign performance and align on optimisation plans.
* Take ownership of campaign outcomes and proactively identify issues and opportunities rather than waiting for instructions.

**What you have:**
**Must-haves**

* Hands-on experience running and managing campaigns on both Meta Ads and Google Ads.
* Experience independently setting up, launching, monitoring and optimising campaigns.
* Strong analytical skills and the ability to translate campaign data into actionable decisions.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, particularly in customer-facing situations.

title: Marketing Consultant
description:
****Career Area:****
Marketing
  
  
****Job Description:****
**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**
When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.
  
  
****About EPD****
Caterpillar's Electric Power Division (EPD) offers integrated solutions, parts, and services to meet the needs of our various commercial and industrial electric power customers. EPD supports a wide range of customer applications across the globe, including providing back-up power to hospitals, providing emergency power when natural disasters strike, and supporting critical infrastructure for data centres, municipalities, and more.
  
  
With a rich history of more than 95 years in the electric power business, our team has world-class expertise and a proven ability to adapt to changing demands. We’re committed to providing sustainable and reliable solutions to our customers.
  
  
We are looking for top talent to build and scale the next generation of technologies, products and services to help our customers build a better, more sustainable world. We need self-motivated, intelligent and team-oriented individuals to make our plans a reality. Individuals with high emotional intelligence, humility and openness to discovery will thrive in the teams we are building. Join our team to help build a better, more sustainable world for future generations!
  
  
**The Opportunity**
The Electric Power Division (EPD) is looking for a Marketing Consultant to join our team! Our solutions help meet customer needs in a variety of ways - everything from providing back-up power to hospitals to providing emergency power when natural disasters strike and supporting critical infrastructure for data centers.
  
  
As a Marketing Consultant in EPD, you’ll play a key role in shaping how we bring our products and services to market. You’ll combine customer, market, and competitive insights with strong communication and strategic thinking to develop meaningful positioning, messaging, and marketing plans. Working with teams across the organization, you’ll help equip sales and dealers for effective customer conversations, build thought leadership, and lead initiatives that solve customer challenges while supporting business growth.
  
  
****What You’ll Do:****

* Develop and execute marketing plans for expansion of existing brands and development of new products or services.
* Collaborate and maintain effective internal communications with product, commercial, business development, dealer, customer experience, and marketing teams to align business objectives, customer needs, unique selling points, value propositions, launch readiness, and market execution.
* Conduct and synthesize customer, market, competitive, and channel insights to identify opportunities, define target audiences, develop differentiated positioning and messaging, and build effective customer strategies.
* Develop clear, compelling, and customer-focused messaging that translates complex technical or business information into relevant customer outcomes and reasons to act.
* Develop and maintain marketing content and sales-enablement materials, ensuring accuracy, brand consistency, audience relevance, and usability across regions and channels.
* Train sales and dealer teams on customer needs, value propositions, key messaging, and new offerings to support effective customer conversations and market execution.
* Identify and lead projects that address customer pain points and market needs while advancing key business and growth objectives.
* Manage agency and supplier partners to deliver high-quality work within agreed scope, timing, budget, and brand standards.
* Establish metrics to monitor and review the effectiveness of existing marketing strategies; suggesting necessary interventions for improvement.
* Develop thought leadership content that position Caterpillar Electric Power as a trusted industry voice and support business objectives.

****What You Will Have:****
**Customer Focus:**
Knowledge of the values and practices that align customer needs and satisfaction as primary considerations in all business decisions and ability to leverage that information in creating customized customer solutions.
  
  
**Level Working Knowledge:**

* Communicates the importance of customer needs/expectations and commits to resolving them.
* Researches and verifies customer needs and expectations.
* Solicits customer satisfaction feedback and acts on improvement opportunities.
* Helps link organizational objectives to customer needs and expectations.
* Meets regularly with customers to understand their wants, needs and expectations.

**Global Perspective:**
Knowledge of issues, opportunities, and challenges for conducting business in the international marketplace; ability to apply global perspectives appropriately in a wide range of situations.
  
  
**Level Working Knowledge:**

* Conducts business with multiple countries.
* Follows policies and procedures governing business activities with another country.
* Obtains information regarding operational issues of other countries when making business decisions.
* Assesses key legal, regulatory, and financial issues specific to a particular country.
* Recognizes behaviors that promote or stunt effective relationships in that country; acts accordingly.

**Creativity:**
Knowledge of the approaches, tools, and techniques for promoting creative, original thinking and ability to apply it to a variety of business situations.
  
  
**Level Working Knowledge:**

* Shares ideas and is open to other opinions and views.
* Analyzes own assignments and work environment for creative changes.
* Exhibits interest in new ideas and experimentation.
* Contributes to and encourages new ideas; builds on suggestions of others.
* Explores possibilities and their viability.
* Contributes innovative design concepts and creative solutions while building on feedback and ideas from stakeholders and team members.

**Effective Communications:**
Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors.
  
  
**Level Working Knowledge:**

* Delivers helpful feedback that focuses on behaviors without offending the recipient.
* Listens to feedback without defensiveness and uses it for own communication effectiveness.
* Makes oral presentations and writes reports needed for own work.
* Avoids technical jargon when inappropriate.
* Looks for and considers non-verbal cues from individuals and groups.

**Relationship Management:**
Knowledge of relationship management techniques; ability to establish and maintain healthy working relationships with clients, vendors, and peers.
  
  
**Level Working Knowledge:**

* Provides prompt and effective responses to client requests and interactions.
* Monitors client satisfaction levels on a regular basis.
* Alerts own team to problems in client satisfaction.
* Differentiates the roles and responsibilities in a business relationship.
* Works with clients to address critical issues and resolve major problems.
* Helps solve business problems and meet business goals through collaborative processes.

**Strategic Thinking:**
Knowledge of the importance of "big picture" thinking and planning; ability to apply organizational acumen and competitiveness to identify and maintain focus on key success factors for the organization.
  
  
**Level Basic Understanding:**

* Explains how a sense of competition with industry counterparts can motivate greater productivity.
* Identifies the key elements of the business strategy.
* Demonstrates the ability to articulate how own work supports the business strategy.
* Seeks help to clarify elements of the strategy that are beyond the group's influence.

**Vendor/Supplier Management**
: Knowledge of external provider management processes and ability to effectively manage the business relationship with external providers (e.g. vendors, service providers, contractors, consultants and suppliers).
  
  
**Level Working Knowledge:**

* Works with vendors to assure that products or services are delivered to time and quality specifications.
* Provides feedback on vendor performance to responsible contract administrators.
* Resolves routine issues or problems with vendors in organization's best interest.
* Identifies communications bottlenecks and recommends appropriate solutions.
* Builds effective working relationships with counterparts in vendor or supplier's organization.

**Considerations for Top Candidates**

* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience. Master’s degree would be an advantage.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills, with demonstrated ability to translate complex technical or business information into clear, compelling, and customer-focused messaging.
* Demonstrated experience developing and executing go-to-market strategies and marketing plans for products, services, or solutions.
* Experience developing value propositions, positioning, messaging frameworks, marketing content, and sales-enablement materials for different customer audiences.
* Proven ability to work effectively with global and cross-functional teams.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple stakeholders, priorities, and projects in a fast-paced, matrixed environment while delivering high-quality outcomes.
* Demonstrated ability to manage external vendors and internal stakeholders.
* Experience in B2B, industrial, energy, power generation, or other technically complex industries would be an advantage.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365 tools and experience using marketing analytics, content management, and CRM.

****Additional Information:****

* Position will require around 10-15% travel.
* Relocation is not available for this role.
* Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EEO).

****Posting Dates:****
November 9, 2026 - November 19, 2026
  
  
Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

**Job Title:**
Chief Marketing Officer (CMO) — U.S. B2B Payments & Merchant Solutions
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for an executive-level
**Chief Marketing Officer (CMO)**
with a strong background in performance marketing, paid advertising, and B2B customer acquisition within fintech or SaaS.
  
  
As CMO, you will own the end-to-end marketing organization, leading strategy, budget, execution, and analytics required to turn advertising spend into qualified merchant leads, activated accounts, and recurring revenue in the United States. You will oversee paid acquisition across Google, Meta, and LinkedIn, while driving content creation, SEO, brand development, and team scaling. This is a hands-on leadership role requiring proven experience marketing to U.S. business owners and decision-makers, with consistent overlap with our California-based leadership and sales teams.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Paid Advertising & Customer Acquisition (Primary Focus):

+ Own the global paid acquisition strategy across Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, and emerging channels targeting U.S. businesses.
+ Manage advertising budgets, bidding strategies, audience segmentation, keyword research, retargeting, and continuous optimization to lower CPL and CAC.
+ Implement robust conversion tracking and CRM attribution from ad click to merchant inquiry, underwriting approval, and active account activation.
+ Partner closely with sales and underwriting to optimize lead quality and prioritize high-value merchant segments.

* Content Creation & Creative Production:

+ Lead the development of ad copy, graphics, short-form video, customer testimonials, and high-converting landing pages.
+ Establish a disciplined creative testing framework to identify messaging that resonates with U.S. business owners.
+ Manage internal creatives, external agencies, and specialized freelancers to maintain a steady flow of high-performing assets.

* Organic Social Media, SEO & Brand Growth:

+ Own organic social media strategy, content marketing, and SEO growth to improve visibility across relevant payment services and merchant verticals.
+ Maintain consistent messaging, positioning, and visual standards across the company and related product brands (including Blitz).

* Leadership, Budget & Reporting:

+ Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing marketing team across paid media, creative production, content, social media, and SEO.
+ Own the marketing P&L and budget allocation, prioritizing high-ROI paid acquisition channels.
+ Establish executive dashboards connecting ad spend to qualified merchant pipeline and recurring revenue, reporting directly to the CEO and executive leadership.
+ Maintain active collaboration with the California team through scheduled Pacific Time business hours overlap.

**Required Qualifications**

* 7+ years of marketing leadership experience, with extensive hands-on expertise managing large-scale paid advertising budgets.
* Proven U.S. Market Expertise: Deep understanding of U.S. business audiences, buying behavior, merchant services landscape, and competitive positioning.
* Fintech / B2B SaaS Track Record: Demonstrated success driving measurable lead generation, pipeline growth, and customer acquisition in a fintech or SaaS environment.
* Channel Mastery: Proven ability to scale campaigns successfully across Google Ads, Meta Ads, and LinkedIn Ads.
* Data-Driven & Analytical: Strong command of conversion tracking, CRM attribution, landing-page optimization, and marketing analytics.
* Creative Direction: Experience directing, testing, and scaling ad creative across video, graphics, and copy.
* Team Building: Track record of building, managing, and scaling internal marketing teams, agencies, and contractors.
* Communication & Flexibility: Exceptional written and verbal English communication skills, with the flexibility to combine local hours and consistent Pacific Time U.S. business hours overlap.

**Preferred Experience**

* Industry background in payments, merchant services, payment gateways, POS systems, or financial technology.
* Marketing to U.S. small and midsize businesses across diverse specialty industries.
* Managing longer B2B sales cycles and tracking lifetime value (LTV) beyond initial lead submission.

title: Commercial Excellence-Supervising Associate

Validate solution estimates against typical market approaches to identify sources of differentiated value and/or optimize them for competitiveness.

+ Synthesize sales, price and solution insights into actionable intelligence: Collaborate with competitive intelligence, analytics, and other internal teams to perform research and refine the pursuit’s pricing strategy, positioning and offer design to help build compelling proposals.

+ Active contributor to negotiations and client communications: Lead development of client-facing financial and commercial documents, assist in high-stakes negotiations, and articulate deal constructs and value propositions to engagement partners and pursuit leaders to support securing of strategic agreements and strengthen client relationships.
