+ Adept at team building: Mentor and coach team members to enhance performance.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**




+ Experience with a broad spectrum of pricing and commercial strategies applicable to professional services with a holistic view on value-based pricing, client’s willingness to pay and competitive landscape to determine pricing power.
+ Collaborate effectively across a matrix organization displaying pursuit and relationship management skills to deliver a high-quality work product while navigating conflicting interests.
+ Executive-level communication and negotiation skills to influence senior stakeholders and articulate differentiated value propositions.
+ Possess natural coaching skills, ease team discussions, speak in large group settings, handle difficult conversations and objections, influence without authority and write persuasively.
+ Execute with a high degree of independence and autonomy.
+ Ability to demonstrate innovation and creativity.
+ Strong data driven or statistical and problem-solving skills.
+ Be a transformative leader, both as an individual and as a counsellor.
+ Ability to prioritize strategic decisions under ambiguity and high-stakes timelines.

+ Graduate in relevant field(s) like finance, accounting, statistics, engineering or a related field along with equivalent practical experience.
+ MBA and / or certifications covering financial knowledge (CFA, CMA, CPA) would carry significant advantages.
+ At least 6 years of relevant experience in professional services, preferably in functions like pricing and commercials, Price-to-Win, strategy consulting, financial planning & analysis, SaaS/cloud commercialization etc
+ Advanced excel knowledge with expert proficiency in financial modelling, accounting, budgeting and associated metrics.
+ English language fluency (oral and written).
+ Experience in solution architecture or design is highly desirable and will be an added advantage.

**Additional notes:**




+ Must be flexible with working hours according to the needs of the geography being supported.
+ May be needed to travel on occasions.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.Job DescriptionGracenote, a Nielsen company, is dedicated to connecting audiences to the entertainment they love, powering a better media future for all people. We are the content data business unit of Nielsen that powers innovative entertainment experiences for the world's leading media companies. Our entertainment metadata and connected IDs deliver advanced content navigation and discovery to connect consumers to the content they love and discover new ones.Job Description Great data only matters if it arrives. Gracenote's delivery platform moves millions of pieces of TV entertainment data every day into the backend systems of the world's leading cable, OTT, CE, and digital companies, powering entertainment experiences used by hundreds of millions of consumers.We are hiring a Director of Product Management to own this platform from our Bengaluru product and engineering center. You will set the product vision and roadmap for our Unified Data Delivery Platform, the centralized repository that consolidates diverse data from across Gracenote into a single Source of Truth, and for the full family of Video metadata delivery solutions that carry that data to clients worldwide. You will lead a team of two product managers in India and partner daily with our engineering teams to deliver against that roadmap.Delivery is its own discipline. It is where Gracenote's data meets client systems, with all of the schema, integration, scale, and reliability challenges that implies. It is also the tip of the spear. When something goes wrong for a client, delivery hears about it first and is expected to lead the debugging. We are looking for a leader who has lived in this problem space and knows what it takes to run a delivery platform that clients trust.ResponsibilitiesOwn the product vision and roadmap for the Unified Data Delivery Platform, the new platform being built to deliver all of Gracenote's Video data to clients and partnersOwn the portfolio of Video metadata delivery solutions that clients rely on todayLead, mentor, and develop a team of two product managers in IndiaCollaborate with clients and partners to understand the business problems of delivering and ingesting TV entertainment data into their backend solutions, and turn that insight into a clear product vision and roadmapTravel to the US and Europe a couple of times per year to meet clients and partners face to face, building the direct market understanding that informs the product visionPartner with engineering teams, external partners, and internal stakeholders to prioritize and deliver the roadmapWork closely with UX and engineering to deliver the configuration and analytics tools that make the platform successful for clients and internal teamsServe as the senior product escalation point when delivery issues arise, leading root cause analysis and driving resolution with engineering and client-facing teamsWork with senior management to identify opportunities and risks, including new products, infrastructure strategy, and quality initiativesClosely manage the cloud infrastructure and costs associated with the data platformQualifications12+ years of product management experience, including 3+ years owning data delivery, distribution, or client integration productsExperience managing and mentoring product managersExperience building and operating high-scale data or distribution systemsHands-on experience with XML, JSON, and REST APIs. Actively uses LLMs to write Python scripts and SQL to answer product questions independentlyExperience running structured development processes with distributed engineering teams, from requirements through releaseWillingness to flex working hours for regular overlap with US and European clients and stakeholdersExcellent verbal and written communication skillsPreferred Skills/ExperienceBachelor's degree or higher. Computer Science or Engineering major is preferableExperience in OTT, TV broadcast, or supporting customers who develop products for digital content consumptionDevelopment experience with Gracenote, TMS, ROVI, or other structured entertainment databasesAdditional InformationPlease be aware that job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. title: Content & Communications Lead
description:
**About Kim.cc**

Kim.cc is building AI-native support operations. We help companies deliver better customer experience by combining AI, human judgment, offshore operations, and strong quality systems.

We started with ecommerce and are now expanding into more customer-facing industries. Our story, and how well we tell it, is a core part of how we win.

**Role Overview**

We're looking for a Content Lead to own Kim.cc's content engine end to end — the sales materials, narrative, and thought leadership that help buyers understand why an AI + human support model works.

This is a role for a strong writer, sharp thinker, and fast operator. You'll take rough inputs from founders, sales calls, customer conversations, and market trends, and turn them into clear, credible, buyer-facing content. You won't be a content executor waiting for briefs; you'll shape what we say and why.

**What You'll Own**

•       

Sales Enablement Content: Decks, one-pagers, case studies, battlecards, and industry-specific collateral that sales actually uses to win deals.

•       

Founder & Thought Leadership Content: Founder POV pieces, articles, and LinkedIn content that build Kim.cc's voice in the CX and AI support space.

•       

Website & Campaign Copy: Website copy, landing pages, webinar pages, and campaign pages with clear positioning and messaging.

•       

Webinars, Podcasts & Content-Led Campaigns: Plan, support, and run content-led programs that generate pipeline and credibility.

•       

Content Repurposing: Turn webinars, podcasts, sales calls, and founder inputs into LinkedIn posts, blogs, and sales content.

•       

Content Calendar: Manage the calendar across website, blog, social, and campaigns, and ship consistently.

•       

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with founders, GTM, sales, customer success, and operations to capture real customer insights.

•       

Execution Partners: Coordinate designers, freelancers, agencies, and internal teams to get content out the door.

**What We're Looking For**

•       

4–7 years of experience owning B2B content, product marketing, or founder-led marketing.

•       

Direct experience in B2B SaaS, CX/customer support, BPO/outsourcing, ecommerce/Shopify, or services businesses. You already understand our buyer.

•       

Exceptional writing and editing skills, with a portfolio of buyer-facing work.

•       

Proven experience creating sales collateral, case studies, and landing pages that support revenue.

•       

Experience writing in a founder's or executive's voice, including LinkedIn and thought leadership.

•       

Ability to turn rough, messy inputs into clear, persuasive content.

•       

Strong ownership, speed, and attention to detail.

•       

Comfortable using AI tools for research, drafting, editing, and repurposing.

**Good to Have**

•       

Experience marketing to US customers.

•       

Experience running webinars, podcasts, or content-led campaigns.

•       

Experience in an early-stage startup.

**Why Join Kim.cc?**

•       

Own the content function and shape how Kim.cc is positioned in the market.

•       

Work directly with founders and leadership.

•       

See your content tied to real pipeline and customer conversations.

•       

Join a fast-growing AI + CX company at an early stage.

Data & AI Consulting Mgt. Managing Dir.
  
  
NTT DATA is a trusted global innovator of business and technology services, helping clients innovate, optimize, and transform for success. We strive to hire exceptional, innovative, and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
**Overview:**
The AI Consultant is a client-facing advisor within the AI Go-to-Market organization responsible for identifying, shaping, and mobilizing AI transformation opportunities. This role combines strategy acumen, AI fluency, structured consulting methods, and commercial orientation to help clients define AI value cases, operating models, roadmaps, and adoption approaches. The AI Consultant partners with AI Architects, Forward-Deployed Engineering, Delivery, Sellers, ecosystem partners, and Geo and Industry leaders to convert client priorities into qualified opportunities and successful engagements.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Act as a trusted client advisor to identify AI transformation opportunities, business pain points, and value cases.
* Shape AI strategy, target operating model, governance, adoption, responsible AI, and transformation roadmaps for clients.
* Translate client needs into practical AI solutions in partnership with architects, FDE, delivery, and partner teams.
* Develop proposals, business cases, ROI models, proof-of-concept plans, and executive-ready client materials.
* Support opportunity qualification, deal shaping, solutioning, mobilization, and transition into delivery.
* Lead and support structured consulting activities, including workshops, stakeholder interviews, assessments, prioritization exercises, and roadmap development.

* Reuse and improve global GTM assets, offering content, credentials, delivery patterns, and client-facing narratives.
* Stay current on AI, agentic AI, enterprise adoption trends, responsible AI, and partner capabilities to strengthen client advisory quality.

**Success Measures:**

* Personal sales contribution or qualified pipeline contribution, as applicable by career level.
* Utilization or billability against target.
* Quality of client deliverables, proposal contribution, stakeholder feedback, and reuse of global GTM assets.
* Contribution to downstream implementation opportunities and successful client mobilization.

**Basic Qualifications:**

* 12+ years of professional experience in consulting, professional services, strategy, transformation, AI, data, analytics, or related client-facing roles.
* 3+ years of experience shaping or delivering AI, data science, machine learning, GenAI, agentic AI, analytics, or digital transformation initiatives. Experience may be demonstrated through client delivery, on-the-job AI work, a data science background, or an advanced degree.

* Experience supporting presales activities such as opportunity identification, solution shaping, proposal development, business case creation, or executive-level deal reviews.
* Working knowledge of enterprise AI concepts, including LLMs, AI agents, RAG, ML lifecycle, data readiness, responsible AI, governance, and adoption considerations.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Master's degree, MBA, data science degree, AI/ML certification, or equivalent practical AI experience.
* Experience in one or more industries such as financial services, insurance, manufacturing, healthcare and life sciences, public sector, automotive, or commercial sectors.
* Familiarity with cloud and AI platforms such as Azure, AWS, GCP, OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral, Google/Gemini, Databricks, or Snowflake.
* Strong executive communication, structured problem solving, facilitation, stakeholder management, and collaborative teaming skills.
* Ability to travel as required for client and internal engagements.

NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is a part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in R&D.

If you are looking to launch a new product in a specialty portfolio in a priority TA and create a meaningful impact for patients, then this is the right place for you

* Drive effective pre-launch and launch execution for new product, ensuring readiness across teams, customers, and priority accounts.

* Strong analytics that inform business decisions

title: System Security Engineer
description:
**Why We Stand Out**
Seeking a new challenge where your professional and personal aspirations are not only possible but supported? Kaufman Rossin might be just the place for you!
  
  
Kaufman Rossin Professional Services Private Limited's (the "Company") offices are located in the World Trade Center (WTC) in Bangalore, Karnataka, India, and at Udyog Vihar, in Gurgaon, Haryana, India.
  
  
The Bangalore office provides a range of services, including risk management, corporate governance, tax, assurance, and family office services. Out of the Gurgaon office, we render highly specialized back-office alternative investment services for global hedge funds and related fund types. As one of the top accounting firms in the US, our foundation is "people first". In the words of James Kaufman, one of our founders, "We prioritize our people, their development, and their well-being. Our values are translated into action every day."
  
  
Kaufman Rossin, headquartered in Miami, Florida has been celebrated as the Best Place to Work in South Florida more than a dozen times. The firm has grown to over 700 employees, with offices spanning the tri-county area and sister entities, Kaufman Rossin Wealth and Kaufman Rossin Alternative Investment Services.
  
  
The Firm is ranked 49th among the top 100 firms in the US by Inside Public Accounting 2023. Internationally, the Firm has offices in Bangalore and Haryana in India and the Ivory Coast in Africa.
  
  
**Think you have what it takes?**
**How You'll Contribute:**
Kaufman Rossin is seeking an experienced
**Cybersecurity Engineer/Architect**
to join our team of World-Class professionals. This position resides in the Information Security department, a functional team working alongside Information Technology and Application Development. The Information Security team is responsible for protecting the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of company information and computing networks. As a part of our team, you will work with sophisticated Cyber technologies in the industry to keep Kaufman Rossin systems and data safe from an ever-changing threat landscape. As a Cybersecurity subject matter expert, you will be responsible for providing support and aiding in the enhancing and deployment of new and existing technologies. In addition, you will recommend process and technology-related solutions or improvements to protect the company from cyber security vulnerabilities and threats.
  
  
**Requirements**

* Administers, operates and monitors KRs information security sensors, logging, alerting and other detection mechanisms to identify and respond to threats
* Acts as subject matter expert for one or multiple assigned cybersecurity technology stacks (e.g., identity and access management, network intrusion detection and prevention, host-based security tools)

title: Senior System Administrator
description:
**ABOUT US:**

Azista Industries Private Limited is a fast-growing, highly diversified technology and manufacturing conglomerate. We pride ourselves on driving "Innovation for Simplicity" across three primary, cutting-edge verticals: Healthcare/Pharmaceuticals, Aerospace, and Food Technology. From developing life-saving pharmaceutical drugs and global health products to building advanced satellite components and space-borne systems, Azista is dedicated to solving complex problems that improve lives. With world-class R&D labs and a flat, collaborative startup environment, we empower our team members to think differently, challenge the status quo, and build careers that span across industries.

**JOB SUMMARY:**

As a
**Senior System Administrator**
at our Bengaluru facility, you will take ownership of our core IT operations across endpoints, Windows Server environments, enterprise networking, and perimeter security. You will act as the primary operational anchor ensuring zero-downtime availability, robust endpoint compliance, and seamless cross-site connectivity for our mission engineering teams.

In this role, you will bridge day-to-day user enablement with proactive infrastructure hardening. Your primary success metrics will center on network and server uptime (target 99.9%+), mean time to resolve (MTTR) for L1/L2 escalations, automated patch compliance, and firewall policy security audits.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* **Enterprise Server & Identity Administration:**
  Maintain and tune Windows Server environments, Active Directory, Group Policy Objects (GPOs), DNS, DHCP, and enterprise backup/restore operations to guarantee business continuity.
* **Network & Connectivity Operations:**
  Deploy, segment, and monitor LAN/WLAN environments, including VLAN configurations, switch/AP management, structured cabling, and IP space allocations.
* **Perimeter & Network Security:**
  Manage enterprise firewall policies, site-to-site and remote access VPN tunnels, IPS/IDS, URL filtering, log shipping to SIEM, and incident triage.
* **Modern Endpoint Management:**
  Oversee the full lifecycle of employee workstations—from imaging, provisioning, and patch deployment to endpoint compliance tracking and asset inventory.
* **Threat Mitigation & Compliance:**
  Administer EDR/XDR security agents, isolate endpoint threats, enforce IT security SOPs, and ensure audit readiness for data protection standards.
* **Operational Excellence & Vendor Management:**
  Drive L1/L2 incident resolution, maintain exhaustive system architecture diagrams and SOPs, and manage IT vendor contracts, warranty claims, and escalations.

**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR?**

* **Experience:**
  4–7 years of hands-on experience in enterprise systems administration, network engineering, or infrastructure support.
* **Systems & Directory Services:**
  Deep expertise in Windows Server (2016/2019/2022), Active Directory design/maintenance, Group Policy (GPO), and enterprise backup and disaster recovery tools.
* **Core Networking:**
  Strong grasp of TCP/IP networking, subnetting, VLAN segmentation, routing/switching fundamentals, and wireless infrastructure (WLAN).
* **Firewall & Security Administration:**
  Proven track record configuring and auditing enterprise firewalls (e.g., Fortinet, Palo Alto, Sophos), site-to-site IPsec/SSL VPNs, and endpoint protection suites (EDR/XDR).
* **Endpoint & Productivity Suites:**
  Practical administration of Microsoft 365 / Entra ID (Azure AD), automated software deployment tools, and disk imaging systems.

**NICE-TO-HAVES:**

* Relevant industry certifications: CCNA, Microsoft Certified: Windows Server Hybrid Administrator Associate, CompTIA Security+, or vendor firewall certifications (e.g., NSE 4).
* Experience administering virtualized environments (VMware vSphere / Microsoft Hyper-V).
* Prior experience supporting high-security manufacturing, aerospace, defense, or hardware engineering facilities.
* Exposure to SIEM log ingestion, centralized syslog servers, or network monitoring tools (PRTG, Zabbix, Nagios).

title: IT Continuity Expert
description:
**Job Title:**
IT Continuity Expert
  
  
**Department**
: ITG CDF
  
  
**About Business line/Function:**
Within IT Group, the Cybersecurity & Digital Fraud Department defines, steers and promotes the Group’s approach to IT risk management, cybersecurity, IT Continuity and operational resilience across BNP Paribas entities.
  
  

* Defining the vision, strategy and methodological framework for IT risk management, cybersecurity and IT Continuity,
* Monitoring the security, resilience and continuity posture of the Group’s information systems,
* Ensuring the effective deployment of Group standards and requirements across operating entities.

Against a rapidly evolving cyber threat landscape and increasing regulatory expectations, strengthening cybersecurity maturity, IT risk management and operational resilience is a strategic priority for BNP Paribas.
  
  
Within IT Group Cybersecurity & Digital Fraud department, you will be part of the team based in India.
  
  
In this role, the IT Continuity Expert will contribute to the development of the India platform and ensure that core IT Continuity activities are consistently understood, implemented and monitored across Group entities, in alignment with the Group IT Continuity, Cybersecurity and IT Risk frameworks.
  
  
**Position Purpose:**
The IT Continuity Expert will play a key role in strengthening the Group’s IT Continuity, Backup, Cyber Resilience and Operational Resilience capabilities. The role combines expertise, governance, advisory support and continuous improvement to help entities implement robust continuity arrangements, meet regulatory expectations and enhance their ability to recover from disruptive events.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Direct Responsibilities
  
  

* Framework Governance & Procedures Management
* Procedures Management
* Maintain IT Continuity and Cyber Resilience procedures in an effective, up-to-date and operationally usable state.
* Identify and drive required improvements based on:
* Group and entity maturity evolution,
* Regulatory developments such as DORA, ECB, OCC or PRA expectations,
* Feedback from entities and IT production teams,
* Industry best practices.
* Plan, coordinate and implement framework updates in close collaboration with the Governance team.
* Provide advisory support to entities by:
* Explaining procedures and framework expectations,
* Identifying gaps against Group requirements.
* Requirements & Objectives Management
* Maintain and continuously enhance IT Continuity, Backup and Cyber Resilience requirements and objectives.
* Ensure clear alignment between requirements, procedures, controls and governance expectations.
* Guide entities in interpreting, implementing and evidencing compliance with Group requirements.
* Contribute to the Cyber Program by:
* Providing guidance on requirements and objectives,
* Reviewing evidence submitted by entities,
* Identifying compliance gaps and improvement opportunities.
* Control Framework Management
* Maintain the Permanent Control Plans (GCL Controls) associated with the IT Continuity and Resilience framework.
* Ensure that controls remain relevant, effective and fully aligned with applicable requirements and procedures.
* Support stakeholders in understanding control objectives, expected evidence and implementation standards.
* Framework Consistency & Alignment
* Ensure consistency and coherence across the overall framework, including:
* Procedures,
* Requirements and objectives,
* Control plans,
* IT Continuity & Resilience Officer training materials,
* Exercise success criteria,
* Exercise reporting processes.
* Ensure alignment with related Group frameworks:
* Business Continuity Management (BCM),
* Third-Party Technology Risk Management (TPTRM),
* Cyber Risk Management Framework,
* Operational Resilience Framework.
* Ensure that framework evolutions are properly reflected in supporting tools and reporting platforms, including ServiceNow GRC, Tableau.
* Coordinate changes with tool owners and relevant stakeholders to ensure smooth implementation.
* Maturity Assessment, Compliance and Entity Support
* Entity Maturity Analysis
* Analyze maturity assessment results produced by the Cyber Program and identify key trends, weaknesses and improvement priorities.
* Identify and escalate where appropriate:
* Entities experiencing difficulties,
* Requirements requiring clarification,
* Group-level actions that could support entities.
* Community Engagement & Knowledge Sharing
* Identify topics that require further clarification, communication or guidance for entities through operational committees and community forums.
* Contribute actively to ICRO community meetings and support the continued professionalization of the IT Continuity community.
* Identify, formalize and promote reusable evidence, implementation approaches and best practices across the Group.
* Promote a culture of compliance, performance measurement and continuous improvement.
* Incident Analysis, Lessons Learned and Continuous Improvement
* Incident Analysis
* Analyze major incidents and events impacting IT Continuity, recovery capabilities and operational resilience.
* Identify: Root causes, recurrent issues and trends, systemic weaknesses.
* Lessons Learned Program
* Define and maintain a structured incident categorization and lessons learned framework.
* Produce, formalize and communicate lessons learned to support continuous improvement across the Group.
* Monitor remediation plans and ensure that improvement actions are tracked through to completion.
* Present key findings, trends and recommendations to governance bodies and the IT Continuity community.
* Stakeholder Coordination
* Identify and engage the relevant stakeholders required to contribute to lessons learned and remediation activities.
* Coordinate cross-functional reviews and improvement initiatives to strengthen resilience outcomes.
* Backup, Restore and SaaS Resilience Governance
* Backup Requirements Management
* Review, maintain and enhance Backup and Restore requirements in line with Group resilience objectives.
* Ensure alignment with: Internal standards, regulatory requirements, Cyber resilience expectations.
* Backup Procedures Assessment
* Assess existing backup procedures, operating models and recovery practices to ensure they remain effective and fit for purpose.
* Identify Gaps, obsolete practices, opportunities for improvement.
* Ensure that documentation is clear, actionable and aligned with operational needs.
* SaaS Backup Resilience
* Assess backup and recovery strategies for SaaS solutions and define the associated resilience expectations.
* Validate data protection, recoverability, availability and resilience capabilities for critical SaaS services.
* Review contractual commitments and technical guarantees with vendors where relevant.
* Define best practices for integrating SaaS backup and recovery approaches into the Group resilience framework.
* Cyber Program Support
* Analyze Cyber Program results related to Backup, Restore and Recovery capabilities.
* Recommend Group-wide improvement actions and support their prioritization.
* Support entities in understanding findings, defining remediation plans and implementing corrective actions.
* Operational Resilience Performance and Speed of Restoration
* Velocity Deployment & Adoption
* Support the deployment, adoption and operational integration of Velocity tools and initiatives.
* Promote stakeholder awareness, understanding and adoption of resilience performance improvement initiatives.
* Ensure effective integration with existing governance, monitoring and reporting processes.
* KPI Definition & Performance Measurement
* Define and maintain resilience-related KPIs, including Recovery performance, compliance indicators, incident management efficiency, operational resilience metrics.
* Define calculation methodologies, reporting principles and data quality standards.
* Establish meaningful baselines, targets and performance thresholds to support management decision-making.
* Continuous Improvement
* Analyze performance indicators to identify trends, risks and continuous improvement opportunities.
* Detect bottlenecks, recurring issues and opportunities to optimize recovery performance.
* Recommend, prioritize and monitor corrective actions in coordination with relevant stakeholders.
* Promote a data-driven culture focused on resilience performance, accountability and continuous improvement.
* Reporting & Governance
* Produce clear dashboards, management reports and executive-level insights.
* Present trends, risks, performance indicators and recommendations to governance bodies.
* Share best practices, success stories and improvement opportunities across the Group.

Contributing Responsibilities
  
  
**Technical & Behavioral Competencies**

* Strong autonomy, with the ability to improve methodologies, facilitate entity implementation, support team efficiency and anticipate stakeholder needs.
* Proven ability to operate effectively in large, complex and international organizations.
* Strong understanding of IT infrastructure, including servers, networks, storage systems, virtualization, cloud services and cybersecurity best practices.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Ability to present complex information clearly, concisely and confidently to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* French language skills, including speaking, writing and reading, would be a strong advantage.

**Skills Referential**
**(**

* Ability to collaborate

**Behavioral Skills**

* Ability to synthetize / simplify
* Ability to deliver / Results driven

**Education Level:**
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology or a related discipline, a master’s degree would be an advantage with minimum 15 years of professional experience, including at least 10 years in IT Continuity, resilience, disaster recovery or related domains.
  
  
**Location:**
Bangalore/Chennai
  
  
**About BNP Paribas Group**
BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking & Services for the Group’s commercial & personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment & Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate & Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast-growing business in Asia-Pacific. BNP Paribas has implemented a Corporate Social Responsibility approach in all its activities, enabling it to contribute to the construction of a sustainable future, while ensuring the Group's performance and stability.
  
  
**About BNP Paribas India Solutions**
Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union’s leading bank with an international reach. With delivery centers located in Bengaluru, Chennai and Mumbai, we are a 24x7 global delivery center. title: Principal Information Security Engineer
description:
Job Description

**Summary of the role**

* Act as a trusted security partner, supporting programs, products, platforms, and technology teams to meet defined security objectives.

  **Open Platform and related technology initiatives**

  .

**Business Environment**

You will join a global security function working closely with
**Open Platform, product, technology, architecture, engineering, and business teams across Amadeus**
.

The role focuses on enabling secure solutions while supporting innovation across cloud, AI, DevSecOps, and emerging technologies. The position will provide security expertise across
**Azure, AWS, and GCP**
environments and support the implementation of security capabilities aligned with enterprise security requirements and CISO objectives.

The role requires close collaboration with global security, architecture, engineering, compliance, risk, and business stakeholders to translate security and regulatory requirements into practical and scalable security solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Guide and coordinate
  **security activities for Open Platform**

  **CISO objectives, enterprise security strategy, Information Security Framework, and defined risk appetite**
  .

  **Security Architecture Reviews and Security HLD assessments**
  for programs, projects, platforms, applications, cloud environments, and technology initiatives.

  **confidentiality, integrity, availability, identity, traceability, data protection, and resilience**
  requirements.

  **local and domain-specific policies, standards, baselines, guidelines, security controls, and architecture models**
  .

  **ISO 27001, PCI DSS, SOC 2, NIS2, GDPR, and applicable EU AI Act requirements**

* Identify security and compliance gaps, assess associated risks, define appropriate mitigation measures, and support remediation through established governance processes.
* Provide security expertise across
  **Azure, AWS, and GCP**
  , including cloud architecture, identity and access management, network security, workload security, data protection, logging and monitoring, and cloud-native security controls.
* Support and promote
  **DevSecOps practices**
  across engineering and delivery teams, including CI/CD security, application security testing, software composition analysis, container/Kubernetes security, secrets management, vulnerability management, and security automation.
* Drive the development and adoption of
  **Security Policy as a Service**
  capabilities, enabling platform and engineering teams to consume standardized security policies, controls, and security guardrails.
* Support the adoption of
  **policy-as-code and automated security controls**
  to enable consistent and scalable implementation of security requirements across technology environments.

  **security automation and AI-enabled security capabilities**
  , leveraging APIs, policy-as-code, automation, and AI agents to improve security assessments, compliance validation, and control enforcement.
* Develop and maintain reusable
  **security architecture patterns, reference architectures, security baselines, and secure-by-design guidelines**
  for Open Platform and related technology initiatives.
* Support internal, customer, and regulatory assurance activities through security assessments, control validation, evidence preparation, risk analysis, and remediation tracking.
* Establish and maintain meaningful
  **security metrics and reporting**
  to demonstrate security posture, risk reduction, compliance status, and the business value of security initiatives.
* Provide security guidance and knowledge sharing to engineering, architecture, product, and delivery teams and promote a
  **security-by-design culture**
  across Open Platform.

**Experience & Qualifications**

* **Bachelor's degree in computer science**
  , Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Information Security, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* **10–13 years of experience**
  in Information Security, Cybersecurity, Security Architecture, Cloud Security, Risk, Compliance, or related areas.
* Strong experience in
  **security architecture, Security HLD reviews, security assessments, threat modelling, and secure-by-design principles**
  .
* Good understanding of
  **ISO 27001/ISMS, PCI DSS, SOC 2, NIS2, GDPR, and EU AI Act**
  requirements.
* Practical understanding of security across
  **Azure, AWS, and GCP**
  .
* Experience with
  **DevSecOps, CI/CD security, application security, container/Kubernetes security, vulnerability management, secrets management, and security automation**
  .
* Understanding of
  **AI/ML security, AI risk assessment, LLM security, RAG, Agentic AI, and AI agents**

* Strong analytical, communication, documentation, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to work effectively with architects, engineers, product teams, compliance teams, risk teams, and senior security leadership in a global environment.

**Preferred Certification & Skills**

  .

title: AI Security Risk Manager
description:
**About Astellas**
Astellas is a global life sciences company committed to turning innovative science into VALUE for patients. We provide transformative therapies in disease areas that include oncology, ophthalmology, urology, immunology and women's health. Through our research and development programs, we are pioneering new healthcare solutions for diseases with high unmet medical need. Learn more at Astellas.com (https://www.astellas.com/en)
  
  
**Are you driven to make a real difference in the lives of patients?**
We're seeking passionate individuals who thrive in dynamic environments, embrace new ideas, and aren't afraid to take intelligent risks. People who act with unwavering integrity and are deeply committed to making a tangible impact.
  
  
**Purpose And Scope**
Help Astellas use AI with confidence. As AI Security Risk Manager, you will assess the security risks of the AI tools Astellas builds and buys, from copilots and agents to AI-enabled vendor products, and give clear, practical recommendations so teams can move forward safely.
  
  
**Responsibilities And Accountabilities**
Scope: AI applications, agents, copilots, machine learning systems and AI platforms, built in-house or provided by vendors, including GxP-regulated uses.
  
  

* AI Security Risk Assessments: Assess AI systems for AI-specific threats, such as prompt injection, jailbreaks, data poisoning, model theft, sensitive data leakage and agents acting beyond their intended authority, and evaluate attack surface and control effectiveness.
* AI Security Vendor Reviews: Provide the AI-specific security review within Astellas' third-party risk process: assess AI providers' controls and evidence, check alignment with Astellas AI security requirements, and advise on AI security terms in contracts.
* Security Risk Treatment & Reporting: Document findings and recommendations; assess residual risk and treatment options; facilitate risk acceptance decisions with system owners; track findings through remediation; and produce clear reports and executive summaries.
* Frameworks & Compliance: Assess alignment with NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001, OWASP Top 10 for LLMs, the EU AI Act and Astellas AI policies; support audits; and maintain the AI risk assessment method and procedures.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Systems or a related field.
* 8+ years in cybersecurity risk, GRC or security assessment.
* 5+ years assessing AI or cloud-based technologies.
* Good understanding of AI security threats and attack techniques.
* Strong report writing and the ability to explain risk to business and technical audiences.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in vendor or technology risk management, ideally using OneTrust.
* Experience in pharmaceutical, life sciences or other regulated industries.
* Familiarity with threat modeling and risk quantification methods (e.g., MITRE ATLAS, FAIR).
* Certifications such as CRISC, CISA, CISSP, IAPP AIGP or Certified FAIR Analyst.

**Working Environment**
At Astellas we recognize the importance of work/life balance, and we are proud to offer a hybrid working solution allowing time to connect with colleagues at the office with the flexibility to also work from home. We believe this will optimize the most productive work environment for all employees to succeed and deliver. Hybrid work from certain locations may be permitted in accordance with Astellas’ Responsible Flexibility
  
  
**What awaits you at Astellas?**

* Global collaboration: Become part of a connected global business of like-minded life science leaders, all dedicated to improving patients' lives worldwide.
* Real-world patient impact: Contribute to transformative therapies that reach patients around the world, knowing your work makes a difference every day.
* Relentless Innovation: Join a company at the forefront of scientific breakthroughs, where you'll have the opportunity to shape the future of healthcare.
* A Culture of Growth: Chart your own course within a supportive environment that values your contributions, champions your development, and empowers you to pursue your passions.

**Our Organizational Values and Behaviors**
Values: Innovation, Integrity and Impact sit at the heart of what we do.
  
  
Behaviors: We come together as ‘One Astellas’, working with courage and a sense of urgency. We are outcome focused and consistently take accountability for our personal contribution.
  
  
Category Digital Infrastructure & Cybersecurity
  
  
Astellas is committed to equality of opportunity in all aspects of employment.

description:
* Title: Software Engineer II (SDE 2) - (Backend - Golang)
* Department: Technology / Core Platform Engineering
* Location: Bangalore Corporate Office
* Employment Type: Full Time
* Experience: 3 – 5 years Experience

**The Opportunity**
Nudge is building India’s ultimate commerce rewards platform. Users earn rewards by scanning and uploading shopping bills, linking accounts like Gmail or consumer apps (e.g., Swiggy, Zepto), and playing casual games on the platform.
  
  
Behind that experience sit Go microservices handling bill ingestion, transaction parsing, fraud checks and real-time reward distribution. We are looking for an
**SDE 2 (Backend, Golang)**
who can own features and services end to end: take a problem from design doc to production, and keep it healthy once it ships.
  
  
You will work closely with senior engineers on architecture, while independently owning the services and features you build.
  
  
**What You’ll Achieve**
**Own Services End to End**

* Design, build and ship Go microservices and RESTful APIs for bill processing, third-party app integrations and gaming backends.
* Write design docs for the features you own, and take them from design through rollout and monitoring.

**Build for Concurrency & Correctness**

* Implement reward and ledger flows that stay consistent under concurrent uploads, retries and partial failures.
* Apply idempotency, locking and rate-limiting patterns to prevent double-crediting and abuse.
* Design schemas, indexes and caching strategies for heavy read/write workloads on PostgreSQL and Redis.

**Integrate with the Outside World**

* Build reliable integrations with third-party platforms, handling auth, retries, rate limits and messy data.
* Work on event-driven pipelines that move user activity from ingestion to reward.

**Raise the Engineering Bar**

* Review code with care and help junior engineers through pairing, reviews and clear feedback.
* Improve test coverage, tooling and the maintainability of the services you touch.

**Production Ownership**

* Own the uptime and performance of your services: logging, metrics, alerts and dashboards.
* Take part in on-call, debug production issues and contribute to postmortems.

**Build Faster with AI**

* Use AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) to design, build, test and debug faster, while owning the quality of everything you ship.
* Help the team use AI well: share workflows, set review standards for AI-generated code, and spot where AI can speed up our engineering.

**What You’ll Bring**

* 3–5 years of backend engineering experience building and running production systems.
* Strong hands-on production experience in Golang (mandatory), including goroutines, channels, context and concurrency patterns.
* Solid grasp of microservices, RESTful API design and event-driven systems.
* Good working knowledge of PostgreSQL (schema design, indexing, query tuning) and Redis (caching, distributed locks).
* Experience with Docker and CI/CD; exposure to Kubernetes and cloud platforms (GCP/AWS).
* A track record of owning a service or major feature from design to production, not just implementing tickets.
* Strong debugging skills across logs, metrics and profiles.
* Hands-on use of AI coding tools in day-to-day work, with the judgement to review, test and correct AI-generated code before it ships.
* Startup mindset: high ownership, comfort with ambiguity, and real drive to build something from early stage.

**Why You’ll Love Working Here**

* Real Ownership Early: Own services that sit on the critical path of rewards for millions of transactions.
* Hard, Interesting Problems: Concurrency, ledger consistency, OCR pipelines and third-party integrations, not CRUD.
* Growth to Senior: Work directly with senior engineers and founders on architecture, with a clear path to Senior Engineer.
* Product-First Culture: A fast-paced team where shipping and user impact come first.
* AI-First Workflow: Modern AI coding tools are part of how we build, every day.

description:
About HLTH

HLTH is one of the fastest growing brands of 2026, reaching the top 0.1% in hyper-growth of all stores in the Shopify ecosystem and we're just getting started (literally). At HLTH we believe understanding your health should be effortless. Our products turn health monitoring into clear insights anyone can act on.

The Role

We are looking for our first Senior Backend Engineer to join our small but mighty team. This role will design and own HLTH's backend architecture end to end: the APIs, database, and cloud services that take data from our wearables after it syncs over Bluetooth to our Flutter app and turn it into the insights our members see. You will build on Supabase and Cloudflare R2 and launch our AI coach alongside our new app. You will work hands-on with the founders, our mobile/BLE engineer, and our algorithms team, owning your work from design through production.

What You'll Do

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services and APIs, owning our backend architecture end to end, from design and development to deployment and production support.
* Build and maintain the pipelines that handle wearable data after it syncs to the phone, built on Supabase, Cloudflare R2, or similar.
* Design and maintain database schemas and data models, including query optimization, indexing, and performance tuning on Postgres.
* Build and run cloud services for select health features and alerts, working with our algorithms team to take them from prototype to production.
* With support from the founders and our algorithms team, build and launch a privacy-preserving AI coach backend, live with our app launch, that keeps every member's health data protected.
* Build and maintain an MCP server so paid members can connect their own AI tools and pull their own data.
* Build reliable sync and background processing jobs with retries, timeouts, and safe recovery, so no member data is lost or duplicated.
* Own authentication, access control, and data security across the backend, protecting the health data of members worldwide.
* Set up monitoring, alerting, backups, and recovery so the backend stays fast and available as we scale.
* Monitor application performance, resolve performance, scalability, and production issues, and fix the root causes of incidents.
* Write clean, maintainable, well-tested code, and set the code review and engineering standards for the backend.
* Work closely with our mobile/BLE engineer and founders to deliver new capabilities, and communicate technical ideas clearly to technical and non-technical partners.

Must-Have

* 5+ years of backend development, including a consumer app backend you shipped and maintained in production.
* Strong proficiency in Node.js, Python, or a similar backend language (Python a plus).
* Experience building REST APIs, with a strong understanding of database design, security, and performance optimization.
* Strong hands-on experience with system design, including data flow, caching, queueing, failure modes, and scale.
* Proven ability to own a backend architecture on your own, take and give guidance, and drive technical problems to resolution.
* You take pride in supporting your code in production, with Git, CI/CD, and modern software engineering practices.
* Experience securing APIs and cloud access for sensitive personal data.

Strong Preference

* Shipped an LLM or AI feature in production, including prompt engineering, model integration, retrieval (RAG), and evaluating AI output quality.
* Experience with self-hosted models, guardrails, and responsible handling of personal data in AI features.
* Experience with wearables, connected devices, or time-series device data.
* Experience with serverless and event-driven architectures, object storage, and Postgres-based platforms.
* You use AI coding tools to accelerate your workflow and are eager to explore new technologies to solve complex problems.

What's in it for you

* Competitive regional salaries
* Fully remote, flexible hours
* Access to custom AI tooling and workflows
* Flat team, direct access to founders
* Unlimited PTO (with a required recharge time)

title: Member of Technical Staff (Senior - Specialized Indexing)
description:
Category-defining tech. Career-defining work.
  
  
For more than a decade, Cockroach Labs has built database technology trusted to power some of the world's most mission-critical applications. Now, as AI transforms how software is created and operated, the infrastructure behind it has to keep pace. Cockroach Continuum is built to meet this moment, bringing individual databases together into one fleet designed for agentic applications, where AI agents help teams provision, scale, and optimize workloads at machine speed.
  
  
At Cockroach Labs, you'll solve problems that didn't exist five years ago alongside people who believe the simplest solutions often require the most sophisticated thinking. Your work will run in production at some of the most innovative companies in the world. The people who thrive here are the ones who want to own that opportunity.
  
  
**The Role**
The
**SQL Queries**
team is responsible for the core of CockroachDB’s query execution and optimization layer. This group designs and delivers features that make our distributed SQL engine fast, reliable, and flexible for a wide range of workloads.
  
  
AI is transforming how we search, learn, and build, and databases are evolving to keep up.
  
  
We’re forming a new
**Specialized Indexing**
subteam within SQL Queries to expand CockroachDB’s indexing capabilities beyond traditional relational workloads. This team will design and implement high-performance indexing systems such as
**vector, full-text, and geospatial indexes**
to support the next generation of
**AI-native and search-driven applications**
.
  
  
As part of this team, you’ll work on deep systems problems, collaborate across the SQL organization, and build production-quality features that make CockroachDB a unified platform for both structured and unstructured data.
  
  
**You Will**

* Design, build, and maintain specialized indexing features for CockroachDB, including vector, full-text, and geospatial indexing.
* Improve the performance and reliability of existing vector indexing systems, including backfill, query planning, and import workflows.
* Partner with other database teams to integrate new indexing mechanisms into the query engine.
* Develop hybrid search capabilities that combine vector similarity and text-based search for modern AI and search workloads.
* Participate in design discussions, code reviews, and release planning within the SQL organization.
* Take full ownership of your work, from design through implementation, testing, and release.

**The Expectations**
**In your first month**
, you’ll get familiar with CockroachDB’s SQL architecture, vector indexing implementation, and the surrounding systems. You’ll also begin contributing to smaller improvements and fixes.
  
  
**Within three months**
, you’ll take ownership of components related to specialized indexing, making measurable improvements to performance and reliability.
  
  
**After six months**
, you’ll play a key role in advancing hybrid search capabilities and help shape the roadmap for future indexing and search features.
  
  
**You Have**

* Passion for databases, indexing systems, and high-performance distributed architectures.
* A strong background in backend or systems programming, preferably with Go, C/C++, or Rust.
* Experience working on indexing or query execution systems such as vector, text, or spatial search.
* Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, and distributed systems.
* Curiosity about AI-driven and hybrid workloads that combine structured and unstructured data.
* A focus on building reliable, maintainable, and high-performance software.
* Collaborative mindset and ability to work effectively with a distributed global team.
* Typically 10+ years of experience building large-scale, production-grade systems.
* Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous problems into scalable, production-grade AI-enabled solutions.
* A builder's instinct for reuse and extensibility — your output becomes a platform, pattern, or capability others depend on.
* Clear judgment about where AI should be deeply integrated and where traditional approaches are more reliable.

**The Team**
The SQL Queries team is one of the most impactful and technically challenging groups at Cockroach Labs. Joining the Specialized Indexing subteam means working at the frontier of databases and AI, helping shape how CockroachDB powers intelligent, hybrid applications.
  
  
You’ll be part of a small, autonomous team based in India, collaborating with engineers and leaders across the world. You’ll have the chance to own complex, high-visibility features that directly influence how customers use CockroachDB.
  
  
If you’re excited about building innovative systems that push the boundaries of what a database can do, we’d love to meet you.
  
  
Cockroach Labs is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer building a diverse and inclusive workforce. If you need additional accommodations to feel comfortable during your interview process, please email us at accessibility@cockroachlabs.com.
  
  
Cockroach Labs has a hybrid work model, with Roachers that are local to one of our offices coming in on Mondays, Thursdays, and Fridays and working flexibly the rest of the week. While we’ve learned valuable lessons working remotely, nothing can replace the connection, creativity, and fun that occurs when Roachers get together and we are committed to fostering a workplace that encourages collaboration and allows us all to do our best work.
  
  
**Benefits**

* Medical Insurance
* Flexible Time Off
* Paid Parental Leave
* Mental Wellbeing Benefits
* Internet Reimbursement
* Wellness Allowance
* Food Allowance
* Office Commute Reimbursement
* And more!

title: Staff Engineer- Applied AI
description: About The RoleAI is not a feature in Foundry - it is the operating model. AI-assisted coding and product management is baked into how the team works, and AI-assisted solutioning is baked into what we ship: LLM-based data ingestion that auto-fills the Sizer from unstructured customer files, a constraint-solver recommendation engine that suggests robot configurations, semantic search over historical sizing sheets, and a Copilot that guides users through the solutioning journey. As the Staff Engineer, Applied AI you own all of this. You run the Applied AI capability as a chapter across all Foundry squads- setting the patterns, evaluation frameworks and API contracts that each squad implements rather than centralising all AI work in one team. You are expected to be the most technically credible AI engineer in the organisation, influencing architecture decisions across squads and setting the standard for how AI features are built, measured and shipped.What You'll DoBuild and own the recommendation engine - Design and implement the ML pipeline that recommends solution type (technology, layout, configuration) from customer inputs; own the feature store, training pipeline, model registry and serving layer.Build the constraint-solver intelligence - Implement the AI layer on top of the constraint solver: learned priors for solver warm-starts, anomaly detection for unusual input combinations, and automated sensitivity analysis.Build LLM-based data ingestion- Design the production pipeline that takes unstructured customer documents (PDFs, spreadsheets, emails) and extracts structured Sizer inputs using LLMs; handle uncertainty, partial extractions and human-in-the-loop review.Build the formulator engine and vector DB- Implement semantic search over historical sizing solutions and L1 data sheets; design the embedding pipeline, vector database and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) layer.Define AI chapter patterns- Set the shared patterns that all squads adopt: LLM API integration (streaming, function calling, structured output), prompt engineering standards, evaluation harnesses and A/B experiment frameworks for AI features.Build the AI evaluation framework- Implement offline and online evaluation for every AI feature: golden-set benchmarks, production-shadow evaluation, A/B experiment readout tooling and regression detection.Own the AI API contracts- Design the internal API contracts between the AI squad and consuming squads (Sizer, Layout, GCM); version them, document them and enforce them via contract tests.Mentor and grow AI capability- Pair with and review engineers across squads who are implementing AI features; run the Applied AI chapter meetings; grow the team's collective AI engineering capability.Minimum (required) Qualifications10–15 years professional engineering; at least 4 years in applied ML / LLM productionisation.Deep experience with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, or open-source): function calling, structured output, streaming, embeddings.Production RAG system experience: chunking strategies, embedding models, vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, pgvector), retrieval evaluation.Experience building and deploying recommendation systems or ranking models.Strong software engineering foundations: API design, observability, testing, CI/CD.Track record of cross-team technical influence: setting patterns others adopt.Experience with ML experiment tracking and model-lifecycle management.Preferred QualificationsExperience with optimisation / operations-research methods used in conjunction with ML (hybrid AI + OR solvers).Experience with agentic AI systems: tool-use, ReAct, AutoGen, LangGraph or similar.Domain experience in warehousing, logistics or industrial automation.Experience with online A/B experimentation for AI features (including metric design).Familiarity with structured-extraction frameworks (Instructor, Outlines, Marvin).Experience with feature stores (Feast, Tecton) and ML platforms (MLflow, Vertex AI).Prior Staff-level or principal-equivalent scope at a technology company.Technical QualificationsWe expect you to be proficient in or quickly learn the following. Senior roles (Band E+) are expected to be experts; Band C/D roles are expected to have working knowledge.LLM stack: OpenAI / Anthropic API; LangChain / LlamaIndex / LangGraph for orchestration; structured output parsing (Instructor / Pydantic).RAG: chunking and indexing pipelines; embedding models (text-embedding-3, Cohere, BGE); vector stores (pgvector, Qdrant, Pinecone); hybrid search (dense + BM25).ML: scikit-learn, XGBoost for classical recommendation; PyTorch / HuggingFace for fine-tuning and inference; MLflow or Vertex AI for experiment tracking.Evaluation: RAGAS, TruLens, or custom harnesses; LLM-as-judge pipelines; A/B frameworks integrated with analytics (e.g. Mixpanel).Languages: Python (primary); Java or Go for production service wrappers.APIs: REST (FastAPI or Flask); gRPC for high-throughput internal calls; SSE / WebSocket for streamed LLM responses.Infrastructure: GCP (Vertex AI, Cloud Run, GCS, Pub/Sub); Docker, Kubernetes; Terraform.Observability: LLM call logging (token counts, latency, cost); Prometheus metrics; Grafana dashboards; structured logging with trace IDs.Testing: unit tests for extraction logic; golden-set regression tests; integration tests with mocked LLM responses.Tooling: GitHub monorepo, GitHub Actions CI, Backstage.How We WorkYou are the single senior AI voice across Foundry. You lead the Applied AI chapter- short, weekly craft syncs with engineers across squads who are implementing AI features and you own the AI API contracts that every squad consumes. You report directly to the Senior Director and participate in the weekly squad-of-squads sync. You are expected to influence decisions at the architecture level, not just the implementation level.

description:
**Meet the Team**
Technical Leader, Cisco Secure Email Threat Defense (ETD) — G11 | Bangalore, India. Cisco Secure Email Threat Defense builds cloud security systems that help organizations detect, investigate, and respond to email threats. In this role, you will set technical direction for applied AI across the product, turning machine learning, generative AI, and agentic workflows into secure, reliable capabilities with measurable customer value. You will lead complex engineering work from exploration and evaluation through production, and raise AI and software engineering capability across the team.
  
  
**Your Impact**
You will combine deep AI expertise with strong software and security engineering judgment. You will guide the team in selecting the right problems for AI, validating solutions against rigorous quality and safety standards, and operating them effectively at cloud scale.
  
  

* Set the technical strategy and architecture for applied AI in ETD, connecting customer problems and product goals to a clear engineering roadmap.
* Design and lead AI capabilities for email threat investigation, triage, verdict quality, analyst assistance, and safe remediation using machine learning, large language models, and agent workflows where they fit.
* Own the AI lifecycle from data and use-case assessment through model or agent selection, prototyping, evaluation, production launch, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
* Build evaluation approaches that test accuracy, precision and recall, false-positive impact, robustness, latency, cost, and consistency across representative threat and customer scenarios.
* Establish safeguards for privacy, data protection, prompt and tool security, access control, auditability, human oversight, and responsible AI use.
* Architect scalable cloud services, APIs, data pipelines, and product integrations that make AI capabilities reliable and maintainable in production.
* Lead the safe adoption of approved AI coding assistants and agentic engineering workflows, with strong review, testing, security, and accountability for generated output.
* Partner with product management, threat research, engineering, customer experience, and support to shape requirements and turn customer and operational evidence into improvements.
* Lead resolution of complex customer-impacting issues and ensure production readiness through observability, incident response, root-cause analysis, and operational follow-through.
* Raise software quality through design and code reviews, automated testing, CI/CD, threat modeling, and engineering practices that improve reliability and delivery speed.
* Measure the impact of AI and engineering investments using customer outcomes, telemetry, adoption, quality, and operational metrics; communicate results and trade-offs clearly.
* Mentor engineers in AI, distributed systems, and security engineering; build shared technical judgment and lead work across teams and partners.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, computer engineering, or a related field, with 8+ years of relevant experience; or equivalent practical experience.
* Strong hands-on software engineering experience building and operating production services or security products, with proficiency in Go, Java, Python, C++, or a comparable language.
* Demonstrated depth in applied AI or machine learning, including the ability to select appropriate approaches and explain their limitations and trade-offs.
* Practical experience designing, evaluating, and deploying machine learning, generative AI, large language model, or agent-based systems in production or production-like environments.
* Experience creating evaluation and testing methods for AI systems, including quality measurement, failure analysis, robustness, and ongoing performance monitoring.
* Experience designing distributed cloud services, APIs, data processing systems, reliability, observability, and secure integrations.
* Strong understanding of security and privacy principles, with the ability to identify risks in AI-enabled systems and build appropriate controls.
* Proven technical leadership across architecture, implementation, complex issue resolution, and cross-team delivery; strong written and verbal communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with SaaS email security or cybersecurity, production AI, threat intelligence, and cloud-native systems or SIEM/SOAR integrations.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:

description:
**Hiring for BRAHMA AI**
— via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role.

**About the Company**

BRAHMA AI builds an enterprise AI content platform for media, entertainment and brand content teams. Its BRAHMA AI Core (BAIC) platform grew out of the CLEAR media asset management system and helps organisations ingest, manage, search and localise large libraries of video and media, while BRAHMA AI Studio adds generative AI for content creation. As a Senior Software Engineer (Backend) at BRAHMA AI in Bengaluru, you'll design and build the services behind the BAIC platform: microservices in Go, Python and .NET, the data stores and search that power media workflows, and the React micro-frontends on top of them. * Design, build and maintain scalable backend microservices for the BAIC platform in Go, Python and .NET.
* Model and optimise data in PostgreSQL and MongoDB for media metadata, workflows and assets.
* Build search over large media libraries with Elasticsearch or OpenSearch.
* Build and improve React micro-frontends that sit on top of your services.
* Deploy to AWS and Azure and keep CI/CD pipelines in Jenkins, GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps fast and reliable.
* Pay down technical debt, modernise legacy platform services, review code and contribute to architecture and documentation.

**What you bring**

* 5+ years of software engineering experience, with a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or Engineering.
* Strong production backend development in at least one of Go, Python or .NET (C#/ASP.NET). Strength in one is enough; willingness to work across the others is expected.
* Hands-on React experience, ideally with microservices and micro-frontend architectures.
* Working knowledge of PostgreSQL/SQL and MongoDB, and of a search engine such as Elasticsearch or OpenSearch.
* Has deployed and run services on AWS or Azure, with CI/CD in Jenkins, GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps.
* Experience building an enterprise SaaS or media-tech product, in an agile team.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with media asset management, OTT, video or content platforms.
* Exposure to integrating AI/ML models into product workflows.
* Experience modernising legacy services into cloud-native microservices.

title: Rebar Detailing Quality Checker
description:
**Job Description: Rebar Detailing Quality Checker**

**Location: Chennai**

**Experience: 6–9 Years**

**Qualification: Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Civil Engineering**

**Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced Rebar Detailing Quality Checker with 6–9 years of experience in reinforcement detailing and quality checking. The candidate should have strong expertise in reviewing reinforcement shop drawings and Bar Bending Schedules (BBS), ensuring accuracy, completeness, and compliance with project specifications and European reinforcement detailing standards.

Hands-on experience in CADS RC and a strong understanding of metric units and international project requirements are essential.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Review and perform quality checks on reinforcement shop drawings for slabs, beams, columns, walls, foundations, and other RCC structures.
* Verify Bar Bending Schedules (BBS) for accuracy, completeness, and compliance with project specifications.
* Check reinforcement detailing against structural drawings, design specifications, and engineering requirements.
* Ensure compliance with European reinforcement detailing standards, including Eurocode 2 and BS 8666, as applicable to the project.
* Verify bar dimensions, bending shapes, lap lengths, anchorage lengths, curtailment, cover, spacing, and reinforcement quantities.
* Identify detailing errors, discrepancies, and coordination issues before drawing submission.
* Ensure drawings follow metric units and project-specific detailing standards.
* Review drawings prepared by the detailing team and provide technical feedback and corrections.
* Coordinate with detailers, engineers, and project teams to resolve technical queries and detailing discrepancies.
* Monitor drawing quality and ensure compliance with project QA/QC procedures.
* Maintain quality check records, revision history, and documentation.
* Support and guide junior detailers to improve drawing accuracy and quality.
* Ensure timely completion of quality checks while maintaining project delivery schedules.

**Required Technical Skills**

* CADS RC – Mandatory: Strong hands-on experience in reviewing reinforcement detailing drawings and BBS.
* Quality Checking: Extensive experience in checking and approving reinforcement shop drawings and BBS.
* European Detailing Standards: Good knowledge of Eurocode 2, BS 8666, and other applicable European reinforcement detailing standards.
* Metric Units – Mandatory: Strong understanding of metric measurements and reinforcement detailing practices.
* AutoCAD: Good working knowledge of 2D drafting and drawing review.
* RebarCAD: Knowledge or experience is an added advantage.
* Strong understanding of RCC structures, reinforcement detailing, bar bending shapes, laps, anchorage, curtailment, and reinforcement quantities.
* Ability to identify technical errors and ensure drawing compliance with international project requirements.

**Eligibility Criteria**

* 6–9 years of relevant experience in rebar detailing and quality checking.
* Diploma or B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering is mandatory.
* Strong practical experience in CADS RC is essential.
* Proven experience in checking reinforcement shop drawings and BBS.
* Good knowledge of European rebar detailing standards and metric-based detailing practices.
* Experience handling quality checks for international projects is preferred.
* Ability to review complex structural drawings and identify detailing discrepancies.
* Good communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to guide detailing teams and maintain high-quality standards.
* Immediate joiners will be preferred.

title: Chief Technology Officer, Healthcare AI
description:
**Hiring for Moative**
— via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role.

**About the Company**

Moative is an AI company that partners with mid-market businesses in asset-heavy, regulated industries to co-build industry-specific agentic and machine-learning solutions, then scales them across the industry through revenue-share and equity-linked models. The founders have built and sold two companies, one of them in AI, and the 20+ person team of AI/ML engineers, data scientists and mathematicians comes from IITs, IISc, CERN, UZH and IBM Research. Its healthcare business builds AI agents that run revenue-cycle and administrative work for US healthcare practices.

**About the Role**

As CTO for Moative's healthcare business, you'll lead technology for an AI management services organisation (AI MSO) for US healthcare practices. It combines operational expertise, data infrastructure and AI to manage and improve revenue-cycle and administrative workflows, automating tasks progressively with clear controls and human accountability. You'll own technology strategy, platform architecture and the engineering organisation, and stay hands-on in architecture, prototypes, code reviews and hard production problems. The role is based in Chennai (Bengaluru is possible), hybrid with 3 days a week in person with the founders and the healthcare AI pod.

* Own technology strategy, platform architecture and engineering standards for the healthcare AI MSO

* You've built and scaled a product or technology business as a founder, CTO or senior engineering leader, with clear customer adoption and commercial results
* Experience delivering healthcare or RCM products, with a practical grasp of billing workflows, claim submission, payer interactions, denials, appeals and payment posting
* You've led teams that deploy and support AI in live operations, including LLM applications or agents with evaluation, monitoring and human escalation
* Deep experience integrating and modelling fragmented operational data, including multi-customer platforms with clear data isolation
* Strong Python, SQL and cloud architecture on AWS, Azure or GCP
* Technical controls for sensitive healthcare data: access management, audit trails, secure logging, vendor access and incident response
* Experience owning technology budgets and working directly with CXOs, founders and investors

**Nice to have**

* Building for US outpatient practices, MSOs or RCM companies
* Taking a company through an acquisition, merger or exit, including technical diligence
* Turning services engagements into reusable products
* Healthcare data exchange (claims, remittances, EHR, clearinghouses), process mining, or browser and voice agents for operations
