title: AI Full-Stack Developer, Maintenance & Enhancements
description:
**Hiring for PULS Group**
— via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role.

**About the Company**

PULS is a German manufacturer of industrial DIN-rail power supplies, used by automation OEMs worldwide. Headquartered in Munich with about 1,700 people globally, PULS is building an India-based IT and AI team that works directly with its Munich Software Development department. The team is relaunching the global PULS website as an AI-ready platform for 21 country sites in 7 languages and runs a growing portfolio of in-house AI solutions on Azure.

**About the Role**

PULS runs live AI solutions used every day by Purchasing, Finance, Logistics, R&D and Sales: chat agents integrated with SAP, scheduled Azure jobs, document pipelines, workflow apps and dashboards. You will keep them reliable and keep improving them. That means resolving incidents at the root cause, shipping change requests in regular maintenance releases, and keeping everything monitored and documented. You will work from India with core hours overlapping the Munich morning (about 13:00–18:00 IST), with no night shifts and no solo on-call, alongside the AI team, DevOps and Cybersecurity. Onboarding is in Munich, with one or two visits a year after that.

**What you'll do**

* Own the incident and change-request queue for all live AI solutions: reproduce on the test stage, separate bugs from change requests and agree weekly priorities with the AI Team Lead
* Fix root causes across the stack: TypeScript/React frontend, Node.js or Python (FastAPI) backend, scheduled jobs, SAP OData integration, PDF and mailbox automation, and write the test that proves each fix
* Ship enhancements in maintenance releases (new SAP fields, document layouts, extended agent skills) and turn larger requests into specifications for the project team
* Use Claude Code and Codex to draft fixes and tests, then review, verify on the preview stage and merge
* Catch rising error rates, silently failed jobs and token-cost drift with KQL in Log Analytics; release prompt, skill and model updates on Azure OpenAI only after regression cases and an LLM-as-judge review pass
* Run Azure Container Apps and jobs across preview, pilot and production with DevOps: Bicep, rollbacks, Key Vault secrets, Entra app registrations and Teams app updates
* Take over solutions built by business teams and keep runbooks and documentation current

**What you bring**

* 4–6 years of full-stack development on production systems you not only built but kept running
* TypeScript/React and Node.js, plus Python with FastAPI; SQL with PostgreSQL or Cosmos DB
* Azure in daily practice: Container Apps, Cosmos DB, PostgreSQL, Key Vault, Service Bus, Entra ID, Bicep and the Azure CLI
* Has shipped LLM applications to production: tool calling, prompt guardrails, RAG (pgvector) and evaluation
* Real debugging depth, e.g. has traced a 401/403 through an OAuth on-behalf-of chain and an API gateway to its root cause, and reads logs with KQL
* At least 6 months of daily Claude Code or Codex use on production code. Expect live pairing on a real ticket in the interview
* Secrets management, RBAC and GDPR as everyday practice; clear written English (C1) for non-technical colleagues in Jira and docs

**Nice to have**

* SAP OData integration experience
* PowerShell for Windows-based deployment and operations tooling
* Microsoft Teams app development

description:
\*AGM Projects – Multi Storey Building (Civil) | Saligramam, Chennai\*
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a senior and experienced AGM Projects to lead end-to-end execution of Multi Storey Residential Buildings – Apartments / Villas. The candidate will be responsible for complete project delivery from mobilisation to handover, ensuring timeline, quality, safety, cost and client satisfaction.
  
  

* Experience:\* 15-20 Years
* Salary:\* Rs. 1,00,000 - 1,20,000 per month
* Qualification:\* B.E. / B.Tech Civil Engineering (Mandatory)
* Preferred:\* PMP / Primavera / Construction Management
* Joining:\* Immediate Joiners Preferred

**Detailed Responsibilities**
\*1. Project Planning & Execution\*
  
  
Plan, monitor and control project schedules, construction sequence, manpower, machinery and material planning for multi storey buildings. Ensure execution as per approved drawings, structural designs, specifications, BOQ and project timelines. Identify delays in advance and take corrective action. Coordinate with Project Head for strategic planning and approvals.
  
  
\*2. Site Management & Coordination\*
  
  
Oversee multiple multi storey project sites at Saligramam and nearby locations. Conduct daily / weekly site reviews for progress, productivity, quality and safety. Coordinate with Project Managers, Site Engineers, QA/QC, Safety, Purchase and Stores teams. Ensure site discipline, SOP compliance and smooth day-to-day operations.
  
  
\*3. Technical Coordination\*
  
  
Coordinate with Architects, Structural Consultants, MEP Consultants, Liaison and other stakeholders for drawing clarifications, approvals and design coordination. Review GFC drawings, resolve site technical issues, and ensure execution without rework. Provide technical guidance to site team for complex structural works like raft, basement, podium, tower structure, finishing works.
  
  
\*4. Cost, Budget & Billing Control\*
  
  
Monitor project budget, cost consumption, material wastage and variations. Review BOQ, RA bills, subcontractor bills, variation claims and certifications in coordination with QS and Finance. Control project cash flow, forecast requirements and implement cost optimization measures.
  
  
\*5. Quality & Safety\*
  
  
Ensure strict adherence to quality standards for structure, waterproofing, finishes and MEP integration. Coordinate with QA/QC team for checklists, material testing, cube tests, mock-ups and NCR closure. Ensure 100% safety compliance, toolbox talks, PPE usage, scaffolding / tower crane safety and statutory requirements.
  
  
\*6. Procurement & Vendor Management\*
  
  
Coordinate with Purchase for timely procurement of cement, steel, RMC, blocks, finishing materials and services. Plan material requirements as per schedule to avoid site stoppage. Monitor contractor / subcontractor performance, workmanship, manpower deployment and compliance with agreements.
  
  
\*7. Team Leadership\*
  
  
Lead, mentor and manage Project Managers, Site Engineers, Supervisors and support staff. Define KRAs, review performance, conduct review meetings and build a result-oriented team. Ensure effective communication and adherence to hierarchy.
  
  
\*8. Reporting & Handover\*
  
  
Prepare weekly / monthly MIS, progress reports, delay analysis, risk register and present to Management. Highlight risks, resource gaps and action plans. Ensure snag rectification, final inspections, statutory approvals, customer handover and complete project closure documentation.
  
  
**Skills Required**
Strong knowledge of multi storey building construction, structural execution, finishing works, drawings, BOQ, specifications, MS Project, Primavera, MS Office, ERP. Excellent leadership, planning, coordination, problem-solving and decision-making skills.
  
  
**Ideal Candidate**
15-20 years in Civil Construction with minimum 3-5 years in senior leadership role, with proven track record of completing multi storey apartments / villas on time.
  
  
Work Location: Saligramam, Chennai.
  
  
Immediate joiners are preferred.
  
  
For more details contact us at 9176033506/9791033506.

title: Purchase Manager
description:
Job Opening – Senior Manager – Purchase (Pharma & Surgical)
  
  
**Company:**
Curtis Drug Point Private Limited (Kauvery Hospital Group)
  
  
**Position:**
Senior Manager – Purchase
  
  
**Department:**
Purchase & Procurement
  
  
**Experience:**
12–15 Years (Minimum 5 Years in a Managerial Role)
  
  
**Location:**
Chennai
  
  
**Qualification:**
B.Pharm / M.Pharm / B.Sc. / B.Com; MBA in Materials Management / Supply Chain preferred
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented Senior Manager – Purchase to lead pharmaceutical and surgical product procurement operations across Curtis Drug Point Private Limited. The candidate will be responsible for strategic sourcing, vendor management, rate contract negotiations, centralized purchasing, inventory optimization, cost reduction, and regulatory compliance.
  
  
The ideal candidate should have extensive experience in pharmaceutical procurement, hospital pharmacy purchasing, or pharmaceutical distribution, with strong negotiation, vendor management, and leadership capabilities.
  
  
Key Roles & Responsibilities
  
  

* Procurement Strategy & Planning
* Develop and implement procurement strategies based on demand forecasts, consumption trends, and sales requirements.
* Lead centralized purchasing and purchase order management across all Curtis Drug Point units.
* Ensure uninterrupted availability of essential medicines, surgical products, and fast-moving items.
* Coordinate with the Kauvery Hospital Central Purchase Team for rate contracts, pricing, and commercial terms.
* Standardize purchase policies, approval processes, reorder levels, and procurement procedures.
* Vendor Management & Negotiation
* Identify, evaluate, and develop relationships with pharmaceutical manufacturers, distributors, CFAs, and stockists.
* Negotiate competitive pricing, margins, discounts, schemes, credit terms, and rate contracts.
* Ensure procurement under approved rate contracts and consistent pricing across all units.
* Monitor vendor performance based on product quality, delivery timelines, pricing, and service levels.
* Negotiate returns, credit notes, and adjustments for expired, damaged, and non-moving stock.
* Inventory Optimization & Cost Control
* Monitor inventory levels and coordinate with relevant teams to prevent stockouts and overstocking.
* Implement cost-saving initiatives through strategic sourcing, vendor consolidation, and alternate sourcing.
* Minimize near-expiry, expired, damaged, and non-moving inventory.
* Ensure timely processing of vendor claims, purchase returns, and credit note adjustments.
* Optimize procurement costs while maintaining product availability and quality.
* Regulatory Compliance & Procurement Controls
* Ensure compliance with applicable drug licensing requirements, the Drugs and Cosmetics Act, and GST regulations.
* Verify vendor licences, product registrations, and statutory documentation.
* Maintain accurate procurement records and ensure adherence to purchase SOPs and approval policies.
* Support internal and external audits by providing procurement-related documentation.
* Team Management & Cross-Functional Coordination
* Lead and manage purchase teams across Curtis Drug Point units.
* Allocate vendor and product category responsibilities and monitor team performance.
* Train team members on procurement systems, vendor negotiations, and compliance requirements.
* Coordinate with Pharmacy, Sales, Warehouse, and Finance teams for purchase planning, stock availability, and vendor payments.
* MIS Reporting & Performance Monitoring
* Prepare and present procurement MIS reports covering purchase spend, cost savings, vendor performance, and inventory status.
* Monitor procurement KPIs and identify opportunities for operational improvement.
* Utilize ERP/SAP systems for purchase order management, procurement tracking, and reporting.

**Required Skills & Competencies**

* Strong expertise in pharmaceutical and surgical product procurement.
* Experience in centralized purchasing, strategic sourcing, and rate contract management.
* Excellent vendor negotiation and relationship management skills.
* Knowledge of pharmaceutical pricing, margins, GST, and procurement compliance.
* Strong inventory planning, demand forecasting, and cost optimization skills.
* Proficiency in ERP/SAP, procurement MIS, and MS Excel.
* Strong leadership, analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

Candidate Requirements
  
  

* Education: B.Pharm / M.Pharm or Graduate in Science / Commerce; MBA in Materials Management / Supply Chain preferred.
* Experience: 12–15 years in pharmaceutical purchase or supply chain management, including at least 5 years in a managerial role.
* Experience in hospital pharmacy procurement, pharmacy chain purchasing, or pharmaceutical distribution preferred.
* Proven experience in vendor negotiations, rate contract management, centralized procurement, and cost-saving initiatives.
* Experience managing procurement teams and coordinating purchasing across multiple units will be an advantage.

**Key Skills:**
Pharma Purchase, Pharmaceutical Procurement, Surgical Purchase, Strategic Sourcing, Vendor Management, Rate Contract Negotiation, Centralized Procurement, Purchase Order Management, Inventory Planning, Cost Optimization, Pharma Distribution, Hospital Pharmacy Purchase, ERP, SAP, Supply Chain Management.

The Head of Coffee will be responsible for developing, building and managing Geetham's entire coffee vertical, covering bean sourcing, procurement, roasting, blending, product development, quality control and operational execution across our outlets.

The ideal candidate should possess deep technical knowledge of coffee, hands-on experience in roasting and sourcing, and a strong understanding of traditional South Indian filter coffee as well as contemporary speciality coffee.

This is a leadership role that requires both technical expertise and the ability to build a scalable coffee business within a growing restaurant chain.

* Source premium Arabica, Robusta and other suitable coffee varieties from different coffee-growing regions.
* Develop a strong understanding of coffee origins, varietals, processing methods, altitude, grading and flavour profiles.
* Evaluate green coffee beans based on quality, consistency, pricing and availability.
* Establish long-term sourcing partnerships to ensure consistent quality and a reliable supply chain.
* Explore opportunities for direct sourcing from coffee estates.

**2. Coffee Roasting & Blending**

* Lead the end-to-end roasting process, including roast profiling, batch management and quality evaluation.
* Develop customised roast profiles for different coffee applications.
* Create proprietary coffee blends exclusively for Geetham.
* Develop signature blends for traditional South Indian filter coffee.
* Experiment with Arabica-Robusta ratios, roast levels and different bean origins to achieve distinct flavour profiles.
* Establish roasting standards, protocols and consistency benchmarks.
* Work towards developing an in-house roasting capability for the brand.

**3. South Indian Filter Coffee Development**

* Possess an in-depth understanding of traditional South Indian filter coffee preparation.
* Develop signature filter coffee blends with the right balance of aroma, body, strength and flavour.
* Standardise coffee-to-chicory ratios and evaluate different blending combinations.
* Experiment with different coffee origins, roast profiles and grind sizes.
* Optimise decoction extraction, brewing time, water temperature and coffee-to-water ratios.
* Standardise the preparation of filter coffee across all Geetham outlets.
* Develop a consistent and distinctive Geetham filter coffee experience.

**4. Speciality Coffee & Product Innovation**

* Develop a speciality coffee portfolio that complements Geetham's traditional South Indian identity.
* Experiment with single-origin coffees, speciality blends and different processing methods.
* Explore brewing methods such as pour-over, French press, AeroPress, espresso and other relevant techniques.
* Develop signature coffee beverages and innovative hot and cold coffee offerings.
* Conduct regular coffee tastings, cupping sessions and product trials.
* Stay updated with global coffee trends, emerging brewing techniques and new product innovations.

**5. Quality Control & Standardisation**

* Establish quality benchmarks for green beans, roasted beans, blends and finished beverages.
* Implement cupping and sensory evaluation protocols.
* Monitor consistency in aroma, acidity, body, flavour and extraction.
* Establish standard operating procedures for grinding, brewing, storage and handling.
* Conduct regular quality audits across outlets.
* Ensure consistency of coffee quality irrespective of outlet location or volume.

**6. Operations & Supply Chain Management**

* Build a centralised coffee procurement, roasting and distribution system.
* Plan coffee inventory, production schedules and supply requirements across outlets.
* Establish systems for bean storage, freshness management and shelf-life monitoring.
* Work closely with the procurement, operations and finance teams.
* Manage coffee costs, wastage, yields and gross margins.
* Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency without compromising quality.

**7. Team Building & Training**

* Build and lead a dedicated coffee team.
* Train chefs, beverage staff, supervisors and outlet teams in coffee preparation.
* Develop training modules and standard operating procedures.
* Establish coffee preparation standards and competency assessments.
* Build a culture of coffee appreciation, product knowledge and quality consciousness.

Desired Qualifications & Experience

* 7–12 years of relevant experience in the coffee industry, preferably with hands-on experience in roasting, sourcing and product development.
* Proven experience in green coffee procurement and relationships with coffee estates or suppliers.
* Strong practical knowledge of coffee roasting, roast profiling and blend development.
* Experience in developing commercial coffee blends and proprietary coffee products.
* In-depth knowledge of traditional South Indian filter coffee and its preparation techniques.
* Understanding of speciality coffee, coffee origins, processing methods and sensory evaluation.
* Experience with coffee cupping and quality assessment.
* Familiarity with commercial roasting equipment, grinders, brewing equipment and extraction techniques.
* Experience in managing teams, production operations and quality standards.

Certifications such as SCA Coffee Skills, Q Grader or equivalent coffee education will be an added advantage, but practical expertise and demonstrable results will carry greater weight.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The candidate will be evaluated on:

1. Development of Geetham's signature filter coffee blend.
2. Development of proprietary speciality coffee blends.
3. Consistency of coffee quality across all outlets.
4. Improvement in coffee procurement costs and gross margins.
5. Successful establishment of a centralised roasting and supply system.
6. Reduction in coffee wastage and quality variations.
7. Successful launch of new coffee products and beverages.
8. Training and capability development of outlet teams.
9. Customer satisfaction and coffee product performance.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who is genuinely passionate about coffee and understands it beyond the beverage itself.

Someone who can identify the right beans, understand their origins, roast them to perfection, create unique blends and translate that expertise into a consistent, high-quality coffee experience at scale.

The ideal candidate should be equally comfortable working with coffee estates, operating a roaster, developing a new filter coffee blend, conducting a cupping session and implementing processes across multiple restaurant outlets.

**The larger vision is to build a distinctive Geetham coffee identity — one that respects the heritage of South Indian filter coffee while embracing the possibilities of speciality coffee.**

title: AI Engineer – Healthcare & RCM
description:
**Hiring for Moative**
— via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role.

**About the Company**

Moative is an AI company that partners with mid-market businesses in asset-heavy, regulated industries to co-build industry-specific agentic and machine-learning solutions, then scales them across the industry through revenue-share and equity-linked models. The founders have built and sold two companies, one of them in AI, and the 20+ person team of AI/ML engineers, data scientists and mathematicians comes from IITs, IISc, CERN, UZH and IBM Research. Its healthcare business builds AI agents that run revenue-cycle and administrative work for US healthcare practices.

**About the Role**

You'll build and deploy AI agents, automations and data workflows for US healthcare revenue cycle management (RCM). You'll own each workflow end to end, from understanding how billing teams work today through deployment, evaluation and ongoing improvement. You'll work alongside AI/ML engineers, data scientists and domain specialists, directly with billing and operations teams. The role is based in Chennai, hybrid with 3 days a week in the office.

**What you'll do**

* Build agents for payer-portal automation: claim status checks and EOB retrieval across inconsistent portal layouts
* Build voice agents for payer follow-up, integrating speech-to-text and text-to-speech
* Turn fragmented healthcare data (scanned PDFs, EOBs, ERAs, incomplete records) into validated, structured inputs
* Analyse claim journeys and revenue-cycle bottlenecks and surface AI-assisted insights into practice performance
* Evaluate accuracy and completion rates on representative test sets, and monitor failures and operating costs
* Add retries, exception queues and human escalation to every workflow
* Apply privacy and security controls: access restrictions, audit trails, and no patient data in logs or model inputs
* Measure outcomes such as time saved, claims processed and turnaround, with the teams using the systems

**What you bring**

* 2–5 years of professional AI engineering (not just internships or academic projects), including systems used in real operations
* You've deployed and supported an LLM application or AI agent in production, using RAG, tool calling or multi-step workflows, and can explain how it was evaluated, what failed and how you fixed it
* Hands-on AI or automation work on healthcare RCM workflows such as claim status, AR follow-up, denials, payment posting or payer interactions
* Strong production Python and SQL, API integration, and working JavaScript/TypeScript
* Browser or UI automation with Playwright, Selenium or UiPath, with error handling and human escalation
* Deployment and monitoring on AWS, Azure or GCP using containers, version control and automated testing
* Experience handling sensitive data with access controls and secure logging

**Nice to have**

* Delivering for US healthcare providers, RCM companies or payer-facing operations
* Practice-management or EHR integrations, payer portals, EOB or ERA data
* Voice agents, MCP integrations, Kubernetes, serverless or event-driven architectures

Its healthcare business builds AI agents that run revenue-cycle and administrative work for US healthcare practices.

**About the Role**

As CTO for Moative's healthcare business, you'll lead technology for an AI management services organisation (AI MSO) for US healthcare practices. It combines operational expertise, data infrastructure and AI to manage and improve revenue-cycle and administrative workflows, automating tasks progressively with clear controls and human accountability. You'll own technology strategy, platform architecture and the engineering organisation, and stay hands-on in architecture, prototypes, code reviews and hard production problems. The role is based in Chennai (Bengaluru is possible), hybrid with 3 days a week in person with the founders and the healthcare AI pod.

**What you'll do**

* Own technology strategy, platform architecture and engineering standards for the healthcare AI MSO
* Work with founders, practice owners and billing leaders to assess workflows, set baselines and prioritise by business value and feasibility
* Design solutions across EHRs, practice-management systems, clearinghouses and payer portals, covering payer-portal agents, voice payer follow-up, denial management and payment posting
* Define the practice data architecture: claims, remittances, EOBs and denial codes as validated, traceable data, with isolation between practices and de-identified analytics
* Set healthcare privacy, security and compliance controls, plus production evaluation, monitoring, escalation and release criteria
* Make build-versus-buy, vendor and model decisions, and own engineering and infrastructure budgets
* Hire and develop engineers, data scientists and technical leads, and represent Moative's technology to practice owners, partners and investors

**What you bring**

* 15+ years of engineering and technology leadership, with recent hands-on architecture, prototyping and production troubleshooting
* You've built and scaled a product or technology business as a founder, CTO or senior engineering leader, with clear customer adoption and commercial results
* Experience delivering healthcare or RCM products, with a practical grasp of billing workflows, claim submission, payer interactions, denials, appeals and payment posting
* You've led teams that deploy and support AI in live operations, including LLM applications or agents with evaluation, monitoring and human escalation
* Deep experience integrating and modelling fragmented operational data, including multi-customer platforms with clear data isolation
* Strong Python, SQL and cloud architecture on AWS, Azure or GCP
* Technical controls for sensitive healthcare data: access management, audit trails, secure logging, vendor access and incident response
* Experience owning technology budgets and working directly with CXOs, founders and investors

**Nice to have**

* Building for US outpatient practices, MSOs or RCM companies
* Taking a company through an acquisition, merger or exit, including technical diligence
* Turning services engagements into reusable products
* Healthcare data exchange (claims, remittances, EHR, clearinghouses), process mining, or browser and voice agents for operations

title: Hiring Infection Control Nurse
description:
**Job Summary:**

The Infection Control Nurse will be responsible for implementing, monitoring, and improving infection prevention and control practices across the hospital. The role involves surveillance, audits, staff training, compliance monitoring, and ensuring adherence to hospital infection control policies and NABH standards.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Infection Prevention & Control**

* Implement and monitor infection prevention and control policies and protocols.
* Ensure compliance with standard precautions and transmission-based precautions.
* Monitor hand hygiene practices, PPE usage, sterilization, disinfection, and aseptic techniques.
* Conduct regular infection control rounds across clinical and non-clinical areas.
* Identify infection risks and recommend appropriate corrective and preventive actions.

**2. Infection Surveillance**

* Conduct surveillance of Hospital-Acquired Infections (HAIs).
* Monitor and report infection trends, including device-associated infections.
* Maintain infection control registers, records, and reports.
* Investigate suspected infection outbreaks and coordinate appropriate action.

**3. Audits & Compliance**

* Conduct regular audits on:
* Hand hygiene
* Biomedical waste management
* Environmental cleaning
* Sterilization and disinfection
* PPE compliance
* Isolation practices
* Needle-stick injury prevention
* Prepare audit reports and track corrective actions.
* Ensure compliance with NABH and hospital infection control standards.

**4. Training & Awareness**

* Conduct regular training programs for nurses, doctors, technicians, housekeeping, and other hospital staff.
* Educate employees on hand hygiene, PPE, waste segregation, infection prevention, and occupational safety.
* Conduct induction training for new employees on infection control practices.
* Promote a strong culture of infection prevention across the organization.

**5. Biomedical Waste Management**

* Monitor proper segregation, collection, storage, and disposal of biomedical waste.
* Ensure compliance with applicable biomedical waste management requirements.
* Conduct periodic audits and awareness sessions for staff.

**6. Occupational Health & Safety**

* Monitor and document needle-stick injuries and occupational exposures.
* Coordinate appropriate post-exposure management.
* Ensure staff compliance with recommended vaccination and infection prevention measures.

**7. Documentation & Reporting**

* Maintain infection control documentation, audit reports, surveillance data, training records, and meeting minutes.
* Prepare monthly infection control reports and dashboards.
* Participate in Infection Control Committee meetings and support implementation of committee recommendations.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

* B.Sc Nursing / GNM with relevant infection control experience.
* 2–6 years of experience in a hospital/healthcare setting.
* Certification in Infection Control / Hospital Infection Prevention will be an added advantage.
* Good knowledge of NABH infection prevention and control requirements.
* Strong interpersonal, training, documentation, and auditing skills.

title: Security Support Engineer II
description:
At F5, we strive to bring a better digital world to life. Our teams empower organizations across the globe to create, secure, and run applications that enhance how we experience our evolving digital world. We are passionate about cybersecurity, from protecting consumers from fraud to enabling companies to focus on innovation.
  
  
Everything we do centers around people. That means we obsess over how to make the lives of our customers, and their customers, better. And it means we prioritize a diverse F5 community where each individual can thrive.
  
  
As a Security Support Engineer II, you will be an essential member of our Network Operations Center (NOC) team with strong technical acumen in network automation and deep security analysis. You will deliver in-depth troubleshooting on advanced network, security, and infrastructure issues.
  
  
You will support and troubleshoot enterprise-grade products and production services spanning kubernetes, cloud environments, data centers, LAN/WAN/SD-WAN, switching, routing, remote access, and application security. In this technical role within the NOC, you will drive tooling automation, proactive observability, and rapid incident detection & remediation to ensure our commitment to a 99.999% network availability SLO for our customers.
  
  
**Domain Requirements & Expectations:**
Experience & Education
  
  

* 5–8 years of network/security support experience in a large enterprise NOC or operations environment.
* Bachelors in Computer Science or Information Technology.

Network & Protocol Mastery
  
  

* Deep expertise in OSI model troubleshooting and protocols: OSPF, BGP, STP, TCP/UDP, IPv6, QoS.
* Proven experience managing and troubleshooting Multi-OS LAN/WAN/SD-WAN architectures.

Cloud & Containers
  
  

* Strong working knowledge of Kubernetes (K8s), container networking/ingress, and managed cloud Kubernetes environments (e.g., AWS EKS).

Product & Security Acumen
  
  

* Strong understanding of enterprise application delivery & security products (WAF, DDoS mitigation, DNS, Load Balancers).

Observability & Monitoring
  
  

* Hands-on experience with tools such as Grafana, Splunk, Nagios, New Relic, Cosmos, Zabbix, or equivalent platforms.

Automation & CI/CD
  
  

* Practical experience with automation tooling: Python, Ansible, Jenkins, Git, ZTP (Zero Touch Provisioning), or Infrastructure as Code (IaC).

Operational & Soft Skills
  
  

* Proven ability to troubleshoot calmly under pressure during mission-critical production incidents.
* Strong documentation, stakeholder management, and customer-facing communication skills.

**What will you do?**
**Engineering & Analysis: (60%)**

* Enhance the observability of network infrastructure by implementing numerous automations, advanced monitoring solutions, analyzing data trends, and proactively identifying potential issues from alerts and triggers to ensure a seamless and reliable network experience for our customers.
* Configure and manage customized alerting systems for DDoS attack, availability, latency, packet loss, etc., across various layers of the network.
* Proactively engage with Customer Success team upon triggered alerts to deliver insightful information on the nature and the reason behind the alerts or network performance degradation.
* Conduct thorough Root Cause Analysis (RCA) of network incidents to identify underlying issues causing disruptions or failures. Develop and implement effective solutions and preventive measures to mitigate identified root causes.
* Troubleshoot and implement advanced network configurations including SDN, IaC, switches, routers, firewalls, load balancers, WAF, DDoS, DNS, and Cloud networking environment.
* Design and implement automated processes to deploy, monitor and maintain network systems.
* Proactively ensure ongoing communication with teammates, customers, and stakeholders for ongoing network issues until a closure is reached.

The Sales Manager is a senior individual contributor responsible for accelerating profitable growth across the India market by originating, shaping, and closing complex opportunities for HeadFirst Global's GCC and workforce solutions. The role engages confidently with senior client stakeholders, translating business and workforce challenges into differentiated, outcome-led propositions that demonstrate measurable value, return on investment, and long-term partnership potential. Working closely with the VP - Sales and cross-functional leaders, the role develops territory and account strategies, applies disciplined sales processes, maintains a high-quality pipeline and forecast, and navigates multi-stakeholder buying cycles from initial engagement through commercial negotiation and handover. The Senior Sales Executive brings strong market judgement, consultative and value-selling capability, commercial acumen, and customer advocacy to strengthen client trust, expand strategic relationships, and consistently deliver revenue and margin objectives.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Develop and execute territory, segment, and target-account strategies aligned to India growth priorities, ideal customer profiles, and revenue objectives.
* Originate and qualify high-value opportunities through executive networks, referrals, strategic partnerships, market intelligence, events, and focused outreach.
* Build trusted relationships with C-suite, procurement, HR, talent, finance, and operational stakeholders, mapping influence, decision criteria, and buying dynamics.
* Own the full sales cycle for complex opportunities, from discovery and opportunity strategy through proposal, negotiation, contracting, and transition to delivery.
* Consistently achieve or exceed revenue, gross-margin, new-logo, pipeline coverage, and conversion objectives while protecting commercial quality.
* Represent HeadFirst Global as a credible market voice at senior client forums, industry events, and strategic networking platforms.

**Client Engagement & Solutions:**

* Lead executive-level discovery to uncover strategic priorities, operational pain points, risk considerations, decision criteria, and measurable success outcomes.
* Apply consultative and value-based selling methods to connect HeadFirst Global's capabilities with client outcomes, including productivity, compliance, scalability, experience, cost optimization, and speed to value.
* Orchestrate cross-functional solution design with Sales, Customer Success, Talent Management, Finance, Legal, and Operations, ensuring propositions are differentiated, deliverable, and commercially sound.
* Develop and present compelling business cases, proposals, and executive presentations that articulate value, return on investment, commercial logic, and implementation confidence.
* Lead complex negotiations across scope, commercials, service levels, risk, and contract terms, maintaining client trust while protecting margin and governance standards.
* Act as a customer advocate by bringing client insight into solution development, mobilizing internal support, and setting clear expectations that enable long-term value realisation

**Pipeline Management & Reporting:**

* Maintain rigorous CRM discipline, complete opportunity data, and clear next-step ownership across all active accounts and deals.
* Build and manage a balanced, stage-appropriate pipeline with sufficient coverage, prioritizing opportunities by strategic fit, value, probability, timing, and margin potential.
* Apply the agreed sales methodology and qualification framework consistently, using evidence-based deal reviews to identify risks, remove blockers, and improve conversion.
* Provide accurate weekly, monthly, and quarterly forecasts, clearly articulating assumptions, dependencies, decision paths, and recovery actions.
* Use data, market intelligence, and AI-enabled sales tools to improve account prioritization, research, outreach personalization, pipeline insight, and forecast quality while applying appropriate judgement and data safeguards.
* Provide actionable insight on market trends, competitors, buying behaviour, customer needs, and proposition gaps to inform commercial strategy and portfolio development.

**Governance & Collaboration:**

* Operate within the delegation of authority, pricing, margin, contractual, compliance, and ethical frameworks; escalate exceptions early and with clear recommendations.
* Lead internal deal governance for priority opportunities, aligning stakeholders on win strategy, solution, commercials, risks, approvals, and responsibilities.
* Coordinate a disciplined handover to Customer Success and delivery teams, ensuring commitments, assumptions, risks, success measures, and stakeholder expectations are documented and understood.
* Partner effectively across functions and geographies to mobilize expertise, remove barriers, and present one integrated HeadFirst Global experience to the client.
* Share winning practices, market insight, and constructive coaching with colleagues, contributing to continuous improvement in sales capability, process, and performance.

**Qualifications & Experience:**

* Substantial B2B solution-sales or business-development experience, preferably in staffing, MSP, RPO, GCC, workforce solutions, technology-enabled services, or professional services.
* Demonstrated record of winning new logos, meeting or exceeding revenue and margin targets, and closing complex, multi-stakeholder opportunities.
* Strong proficiency in sales strategy, territory and account planning, consultative and value selling, opportunity qualification, commercial negotiation, and disciplined sales-process execution.
* Advanced pipeline management and forecasting capability, with strong CRM discipline and the ability to convert data into practical deal and portfolio decisions.
* Credibility and confidence engaging C-suite and senior functional leaders, with excellent executive communication, presentation, facilitation, and negotiation skills.
* Commercial acumen with the ability to develop business cases, articulate return on investment, understand pricing and margin implications, and balance customer value with organizational outcomes.
* AI fluency, including effective and responsible use of AI-enabled tools for research, account intelligence, prospecting, personalization, proposal development, productivity, and sales analysis; able to validate outputs and protect confidential data.
* Strong customer-advocacy orientation, with evidence of representing the customer voice internally, resolving barriers, and building relationships that support retention, expansion, and referrals.
* Sound understanding of the India commercial and workforce landscape, including relevant client buying dynamics, market trends, and regulatory considerations.
* High levels of ownership, resilience, judgement, collaboration, and adaptability in a fast-growing, matrixed environment.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Management, or a related field; relevant advanced study or professional sales certification is advantageous.

**What We Offer:**

* The opportunity to shape commercial growth across India's major metropolitan markets and represent a differentiated GCC and workforce solutions portfolio.
* A high-impact senior individual-contributor role with access to executive stakeholders, strategic opportunities, and international expertise.
* A collaborative, ambitious, and customer-led culture that values performance, ownership, innovation, and responsible use of technology.
* Competitive compensation, performance-based incentives, and clear opportunities for continued professional and leadership development.

title: AI Quality Analyst
description:
**About The Opportunity**
Avenue Code is looking for an
**AI Quality Analyst**
to work with
**Fanatics**
as part of its AI/ML Platform team.
  
  
The AI/ML Platform team builds and supports Fanatics’ internal AI platform, including the gateway, agent runtime, registry, retrieval, and evaluation infrastructure used by teams developing solutions with LLMs and AI agents.
  
  
As the team’s dedicated AI Quality Analyst, you will be responsible for evaluating whether AI agents are performing as expected. You will run evaluation sets, review outputs against established rubrics, maintain high-quality ground-truth datasets, identify failure patterns, and provide actionable findings to the engineering and product teams responsible for each agent.
  
  
This is a
**12-month contract opportunity**
based in
**Hyderabad, India**
, following a
**hybrid work model**
.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Run evaluation sets against production and pre-release AI agents on a regular cadence and following meaningful changes to prompts, models, tools, or retrieval systems.
* Analyze and report evaluation results, including pass rates, regressions, trends, and recurring failure patterns.
* Review AI agent outputs against defined quality rubrics covering correctness, grounding, tool-use accuracy, safety, tone, and output format.
* Score outputs consistently, document edge cases, and identify areas where evaluation rubrics need clarification or improvement.
* Curate and maintain ground-truth datasets used to evaluate AI and LLM-based applications.
* Create, review, and validate golden answers and expected outputs for evaluation cases.
* Classify failures by root cause, including prompt issues, retrieval failures, incorrect tool usage, or model-related errors.
* Identify and retire outdated, ambiguous, or low-quality evaluation cases.
* Compare LLM-as-a-judge evaluation results against human review and identify discrepancies between automated and human scoring.
* Provide agent owner teams with reproducible examples, severity assessments, and suspected root causes for identified issues.
* Partner with engineering and product teams to track fixes and re-run evaluations until issues are resolved.
* Convert production failures, user feedback, and user corrections into new evaluation cases to continuously improve evaluation coverage.
* Use Python and SQL to execute evaluation scripts, analyze results, investigate traces, and identify patterns in agent behavior.
* Write clear and concise quality reports, bug reports, and evaluation summaries for technical and product stakeholders.

**Required Qualifications**

* 3+ years of professional experience in Quality Assurance, Data Annotation, Data Analytics, AI Quality, or another evidence-driven role.
* At least 1 year of hands-on experience reviewing or evaluating outputs from LLMs, conversational AI systems, chatbots, or AI agents.
* Strong ability to evaluate open-ended AI-generated content consistently using predefined scoring rubrics.
* Ability to clearly explain and defend evaluation decisions based on defined criteria and evidence.
* Working knowledge of Python and SQL for running evaluation scripts, analyzing datasets, and investigating results.
* Understanding of common failure modes in LLM applications, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), tool calling, and agent workflows.
* Ability to distinguish between issues caused by retrieval, prompting, tools, data, and model hallucinations.
* Experience creating or maintaining ground-truth datasets, golden answers, or labeled evaluation datasets.
* Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document findings clearly for engineers and product stakeholders.
* Fluent written and spoken English.
* Ability to maintain regular overlap with US working hours for team collaboration and pod syncs.
* Familiarity with AI observability, tracing, or evaluation platforms such as Langfuse, Arize Phoenix, or similar tools is a plus.

**Nice To Have Skills**

* Familiarity with Langfuse, Arize Phoenix, or similar tracing and eval tools
* Understanding of RAG
* Understanding of tool calling
* Understanding of agent loops/workflows
* Ability to distinguish retrieval misses vs. model hallucinations
* Familiarity with LLM-as-a-judge calibration against human review
* Experience curating ground-truth datasets / golden answers

Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. title: Network Security Tech Lead
description:
**CREATIVITY IS OUR SUPERPOWER.**
It’s our heritage and it’s also our future. Because we don’t just make toys. We create innovative products and experiences that inspire fans, entertain audiences and develop children through play. Mattel is at its best when every member of our team feels respected, included, and heard—when everyone can show up as themselves and do their best work every day. We value and share an infinite range of ideas and voices that evolve and broaden our perspectives with a reach that extends into all our brands, partners, and suppliers.
  
  
**Job Description**
About the Role
  
  
Network Security Tech Lead is responsible for both leading and delivering enterprise network security operations. This role combines strategic leadership with hands-on technical execution to protect Mattel’s global network infrastructure across on-premises and cloud environments. The position oversees and contributes to the work of Network Security Engineers and Administrators, ensuring robust firewall, email, and web security, as well as Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) management and compliance with enterprise security standards.
  
  
The Tech Lead will drive delivery of secure, resilient, and scalable network security services while also acting as a subject matter expert (SME) and escalation point for complex troubleshooting, incident response, and architecture initiatives. This role requires deep technical expertise in Palo Alto Networks technologies, cloud security platforms, PKI, and WAF solutions, along with a commitment to operational excellence and continuous improvement.
  
  
Roles and Responsibilities
  
  

* Provide direct technical leadership and guidance to Network Security Engineers and Network administrators, ensuring delivery of secure and reliable network protection across enterprise and cloud infrastructures.
* Lead and actively participate in the deployment, operation, and optimization of Palo Alto Networks (PAN) firewalls (hardware and virtual), Prisma Access, GlobalProtect, and related services.
* Oversee configuration management, performance tuning, and security policy enforcement across global firewall environments.
* Manage and maintain enterprise Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), including certificate lifecycle management with tools such as Keyfactor, Venafi, or equivalent, and integrations with external Certificate Authorities (GlobalSign, Entrust, DigiCert).
* Lead configuration, customization, and maintenance of Web Application Firewalls (WAF) (e.g., Imperva) to safeguard applications and APIs, resolving rule conflicts and performance issues.
* Oversee Email Security Gateways (e.g., Checkpoint Harmony, Proofpoint) and related O365 mail routing and DNS security configurations.
* Participate in high-severity incident response, threat mitigation, and root cause analysis alongside infrastructure and SOC teams.
* Develop and maintain operational runbooks, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and technical documentation to support security operations, compliance, and audit readiness.
* Drive continuous improvement in firewall automation, rule optimization, and network visibility using modern tools and analytics.
* Collaborate with enterprise architects, SOC teams, and application owners to align network security initiatives with business and compliance objectives.
* Lead or contribute to design discussions, roadmap planning, and implementation of emerging technologies such as Zero Trust network architecture and cloud-native security controls.
* Mentor engineers, foster professional growth, and promote a culture of accountability and delivery excellence.
* Participating in after-hours support rotation for major outages or critical incidents as needed.

**Skills And Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* 10+ years of experience in Network Security operations, including at least 5 years in a tech lead role or senior engineering capacity within a large enterprise.
* Proven expertise with Palo Alto Networks firewalls, Prisma Access, Global Protect, and related security platforms.
* Experience managing WAF, Email Security, and PKI environments, including integration with cloud services (Azure, AWS, GCP).
* Proficiency in firewall rules are optimization, troubleshooting, and automation.
* Deep understanding of network protocols, VPNs, RADIUS/TACACS+, and cloud networking architectures.
* Familiarity with Windows and Linux systems administration and integration.
* Experience supporting compliance and audit initiatives (e.g., SOX, NIST CSF, PCI).
* Strong leadership, communication, and decision-making skills, with a demonstrated ability to mentor and manage technical teams.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and vendors.

Preferred:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Cybersecurity, or related discipline.
* Certifications such as PCNSE, CCNP Security, CCSP, or GIAC (GSEC).
* Experience with ServiceNow ITSM processes and workflow automation.
* Familiarity with Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) and SASE frameworks.
* Scripting and automation experience (PowerShell, Python, or REST APIs).

**Qualifications**
**What We’re Looking For:**

* Demonstrated a growth mindset by staying curious and continuously learning, embracing challenges, and improving themselves.

**Additional Information**
Don’t meet every single requirement? At Mattel, we are dedicated to an inclusive workplace and a culture of belonging. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.
  
  
**How We Work:**
We are a purpose driven company aiming to empower generations to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential. We live up to our purpose employing the following behaviors:

title: Network Development Engineer, Automation Deployment
description:

You will build automation that directly reduces high-frequency, high-cost ticket resolution for the world's largest enterprises and service providers. * Apply cloud and AI tooling knowledge to enhance automation pipelines and deployment practices.
* Troubleshoot network issues and translate them into reusable automation solutions.
* Collaborate with the team to improve automation tooling coverage and efficiency.
* May need to work on customers' platform cases when needed.

* 2–4 years of Python automation scripting with hands-on automation tools and delivered projects.
* Solid network troubleshooting skills and foundational understanding of network protocols and architectures.
* Experience designing and validating automation workflows: confirming automation behaves correctly at scale.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and AI/ML tooling relevant to automation.
* Strong problem-solving mindset with attention to validation and production-readiness.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

title: Senior Manager- Identity and Access Management
description:
**Role purpose**
The Senior Manager, IAM leads delivery and continuous improvement of identity services that help protect Amgen’s people, information, systems, and operations. The role provides operational leadership across Provisioning and Identity Governance, Access Management, Directory Services, and Privileged Access Management (PAM), while partnering with global service owners, technology teams, business stakeholders, and strategic suppliers. The leader is accountable for reliable day-to-day services and for advancing the IAM strategy through secure, scalable, automated, and compliant capabilities. The position may requires working in US EST shifts, including occasional extended-hours coverage, to support global operations, critical incidents, and effective handovers across time zones.
  
  
The role combines service management, technical and architectural governance, risk reduction, transformation delivery, and people leadership. It operates in a global, highly regulated biopharmaceutical environment where availability, data protection, auditability, and business continuity are essential.
  
  
**Primary Function**
Lead IAM operations and service delivery across multiple platforms. Set clear priorities for incident, problem, change, request, and compliance work; maintain service availability and agreed service levels; and ensure timely risk-based response to issues. Translate IAM strategy, policies, and control requirements into operational practices and technology outcomes. Build a strong team culture, develop talent, manage capacity, and strengthen collaboration across locations and functions.
  
  
**Core Responsibilities**
**IAM service operations and resilience**
Lead operational delivery across identity provisioning and governance, access management, directory services, and PAM, coordinating work across India, the United States, Portugal, and suppliers as applicable.
  
  
Own service performance, operational health, availability, service-level objectives, backlogs, and capacity plans; review trends and take action before service or control risks grow.
  
  
Provide incident leadership for IAM service disruptions and security events: establish severity, coordinate responders, prioritize containment and recovery, communicate clearly, and engage business continuity and crisis teams when needed.
  
  
Oversee problem management and root-cause analysis. Ensure corrective and preventive actions are assigned, tracked, and reflected in runbooks, monitoring, architecture, and control improvements.
  
  
Govern operational changes, maintenance, release readiness, and supplier delivery to protect production stability and ensure adequate testing, rollback plans, and stakeholder readiness.
  
  
Maintain operational readiness through monitoring, alerting, service documentation, support models, knowledge transfer, and succession plans for critical systems and roles.
  
  
**Identity strategy, platforms, and transformation**
Execute the IAM roadmap and translate business, security, privacy, and regulatory needs into prioritized, supportable solutions and measurable outcomes.
  
  
Guide implementation, integration, migration, and modernization across IAM platforms, including IBM Security Identity Manager (ISIM), SailPoint Identity Security Cloud (ISC), Microsoft Entra, on-premises Active Directory, CyberArk, BeyondTrust Endpoint Privilege Management (Avecto), and Sectigo certificate services, as relevant to the environment.
  
  
Partner with enterprise architecture, application, infrastructure, cloud, network, endpoint, HR, and business teams to deliver secure identity patterns and resolve dependencies.
  
  
Provide technical and delivery assurance: review solution designs, operational readiness, integrations, test evidence, supportability, and adherence to architecture and security standards.
  
  
Contribute to identity lifecycle and governance for human, privileged, and non-human identities, including service accounts and other machine identities, in coordination with accountable security and platform owners.
  
  
**Risk, compliance, and governance**
Ensure IAM processes and platforms support applicable corporate policies, security controls, privacy requirements, and regulatory obligations in the biopharmaceutical environment.
  
  
Maintain audit-ready evidence for access governance, privileged access, change management, incident response, supplier oversight, and control operation; coordinate remediation of findings and control gaps.
  
  
Assess operational and technology risks, document decisions and exceptions, and prioritize mitigations according to business impact and risk appetite.
  
  
Ensure access is provisioned, changed, reviewed, and removed through authorized, traceable processes; strengthen segregation of duties and least-privilege practices.
  
  
Oversee supplier performance, deliverables, service levels, quality, and risk actions; clarify accountability between internal service owners and delivery partners.
  
  
**Stakeholder leadership and communication**
Build trusted relationships with global IAM service owners, cybersecurity leaders, business and application owners, control functions, and suppliers.
  
  
Communicate service health, material incidents, risks, decisions, dependencies, and recovery plans in a timely manner, tailoring detail to technical and executive audiences.
  
  
Facilitate cross-functional prioritization and resolve ownership or capacity conflicts with a focus on business outcomes and continuity.
  
  
Represent IAM operations in governance forums, audits, architecture reviews, and transformation steering discussions; present concise, evidence-based recommendations.
  
  
**People Management Responsibilities**
Provide clear direction, connect team priorities to organizational goals, role-model Amgen values, and create an environment where people can raise concerns and offer ideas.
  
  
Lead managers and individual contributors as applicable; establish regular 1:1s, team forums, skip-level conversations, and transparent communication of business context and organizational updates.
  
  
Monitor engagement and pulse feedback, agree measurable action plans with the team, and follow through. Promote inclusion, fairness, and equal opportunity.
  
  
Set clear goals and expectations; provide timely coaching and feedback; complete fair, well-differentiated performance evaluations and contribute constructively to calibration.
  
  
Build individual development plans aligned with strengths and career aspirations. Provide stretch assignments, technical learning, leadership development, and cross-functional exposure.
  
  
Address performance concerns promptly and consistently, partnering with HR and following company processes where formal action is needed.
  
  
Identify critical roles, key-person dependencies, succession options, and retention risks; develop bench strength and maintain continuity plans.
  
  
Forecast skills and capacity needs, define hiring profiles, participate in recruitment, and align staffing and supplier capacity with demand and budget.
  
  
Handle employee concerns and sensitive matters promptly, fairly, and confidentially, engaging HR and escalating appropriately.
  
  
Ensure people-management practices and records comply with company policy and support audit readiness and business continuity.
  
  
**Qualifications And Experience**
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Engineering, or a related discipline; equivalent practical experience may be considered.
  
  
Typically 12+ years of experience in IAM, cybersecurity, infrastructure, or related technology functions, including substantial responsibility for enterprise IAM service delivery.
  
  
Several years of experience leading technical teams, managers, or multi-location delivery teams; experience managing service providers and global stakeholders.
  
  
Demonstrated experience running production IAM services and managing major incidents, problem management, operational risk, change, service levels, and audit or compliance activities.
  
  
Practical knowledge of enterprise identity lifecycle and governance, authentication and authorization, directory services, privileged access, access reviews, and IAM integrations.
  
  
Experience with several platforms relevant to the role, such as IBM ISIM, SailPoint ISC, Microsoft Entra, Active Directory, CyberArk, BeyondTrust EPM/Avecto, and Sectigo; depth in every named platform is not required.
  
  
Experience delivering IAM modernization, cloud adoption, migrations, workflow automation, or operational transformation at enterprise scale.
  
  
Ability to interpret security, privacy, and control requirements and turn them into clear technical and operational practices; regulated-industry experience is an advantage.
  
  
Strong written and verbal communication, sound judgment during incidents, structured problem-solving, and the ability to influence stakeholders without relying solely on authority.
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**
Experience in biopharmaceuticals, healthcare, life sciences, or another highly regulated global organization.
  
  
Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, ITIL, or IAM platform certifications.
  
  
Familiarity with service management and delivery practices such as ITIL, Agile, or SAFe, and with operational metrics and continuous improvement.
  
  
Experience with cloud identity, non-human identity governance, secrets management, or identity-related automation.

description:
**About Chubb**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
Chubb is a world leader in insurance. With operations in 54 countries and territories, Chubb provides commercial and personal property and casualty insurance, personal accident and supplemental health insurance, reinsurance and life insurance to a diverse group of clients. The company is defined by its extensive product and service offerings, broad distribution capabilities, exceptional financial strength and local operations globally. Parent company Chubb Limited is listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: CB) and is a component of the S&P 500 index. Chubb employs approximately 40,000 people worldwide. Additional information can be found at: http://www.chubb.com/
  
  
**About Chubb India**
At Chubb India, we are on an exciting journey of digital transformation driven by a commitment to engineering excellence and analytics. With a team of over 2500 talented professionals, we foster a startup mindset that promotes collaboration, diverse perspectives, and a solution driven attitude. We are dedicated to building expertise in engineering, analytics, and automation, empowering our teams to excel in a dynamic digital landscape. We offer an environment where you will be part of an organization that is dedicated to solving real-world challenges in the insurance industry. Together, we will work to shape the future through innovation and continuous learning.
  
  
**Position Details**
**Job Title:**
Sr .NET Full Stack Engineer
  
  
**Function/Department:**
Engineering
  
  
**Location:**
Hyderabad
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-time
  
  
**About The Role**
Join Chubb’s APAC Claims Engineering team to build and modernize enterprise claims platforms and services. We are looking for a hands-on senior .NET engineer who combines strong software engineering fundamentals with practical, responsible use of AI-assisted development tools. You will own solutions from design through production, collaborate across regional teams, and help raise engineering quality, speed, and reliability.
  
  
This is not a traditional coding-only role. We expect engineers to use AI as part of their everyday engineering workflow while applying sound judgment, rigorous validation, and accountability for the final solution.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Design, develop and maintain scalable backend services and APIs using C#, .NET / ASP.NET Core and modern engineering patterns.
* Own end-to-end delivery: requirements clarification, technical design, estimation, implementation, code review, testing, deployment, production support and continuous improvement.
* Build secure REST APIs, integrations and event-driven services; manage data access, performance, resiliency, logging and observability.
* Use AI coding assistants (such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code or equivalent approved tools) to accelerate implementation, refactoring, test creation, debugging and documentation.
* Apply AI-native engineering practices: break down work into clear context-rich tasks, guide coding agents, review generated changes, validate assumptions, and ensure code meets architecture, security and quality standards.
* Knowledge of AI-enabled engineering workflows, including agentic development, repository-aware code assistance and automation of repetitive SDLC activities, within enterprise controls.
* Write clean, maintainable, well-tested code; implement automated unit, integration and contract tests and contribute to CI/CD pipelines.
* Participate in architecture and design discussions, identify technical debt, propose improvements and make informed engineering trade-offs.
* Investigate production issues, perform root-cause analysis, implement permanent fixes and support operational stability.
* Communicate clearly with product owners, architects, QA, security, platform and distributed engineering teams; proactively flag dependencies, risks and delivery impacts.
* Mentor engineers through reviews, technical guidance and knowledge sharing; take accountability for commitments and engineering outcomes.

**Qualifications**

* 8–10 years of professional software engineering experience, with strong hands-on expertise in C#, .NET Core / modern .NET and ASP.NET Core.
* Strong knowledge of API design, microservices or modular services, dependency injection, asynchronous programming, design patterns and SOLID principles.
* Experience with SQL Server or comparable relational databases, data modelling, query optimisation and ORM frameworks such as Entity Framework Core.
* Practical experience with cloud services (preferably Azure), Git, CI/CD, automated testing, application security and production diagnostics.
* Demonstrated regular use of AI coding tools in real engineering work, with the ability to write effective prompts/context, inspect generated code, run tests and independently verify outputs.
* Understanding of AI-assisted development risks, including hallucinated code, data confidentiality, licensing, vulnerabilities and the need for human review.
* Ability to lead technical discussions, explain complex topics simply, collaborate across time zones and communicate risks and decisions clearly.
* Strong ownership mindset, analytical problem-solving skills and ability to work independently in a fast-moving delivery environment.

**Good to Have**

* Working knowledge of Angular, TypeScript and frontend integration with backend APIs.
* Experience with Azure PaaS, messaging platforms (Kafka / Azure Service Bus), containers and distributed systems.
* Exposure to AI agent frameworks, MCP, RAG, LLM APIs or internal developer tooling; ability to distinguish useful applications from hype.
* Experience in insurance, claims, financial services or regulated enterprise platforms.
* Familiarity with Agile delivery, secure SDLC, observability and engineering metrics.

**Why Join Us?**

* Be at the forefront of digital transformation in the insurance industry.
* Lead impactful initiatives that simplify claims processing and enhance customer satisfaction.
* Work alongside experienced professionals in a collaborative, innovation-driven environment.

**Why Chubb?**
Join Chubb to be part of a leading global insurance company!
  
  
Our constant focus on employee experience along with a start-up-like culture empowers you to achieve impactful results.
  
  

* Industry leader: Chubb is a world leader in the insurance industry, powered by underwriting and engineering excellence
* A Great Place to work: Chubb India has been recognized as a Great Place to Work® for the years 2023-2024, 2024-2025 and 2025-2026
* Laser focus on excellence: At Chubb we pride ourselves on our culture of greatness where excellence is a mindset and a way of being. We constantly seek new and innovative ways to excel at work and deliver outstanding results
* Start-Up Culture: Embracing the spirit of a start-up, our focus on speed and agility enables us to respond swiftly to market requirements, while a culture of ownership empowers employees to drive results that matter
* Growth and success: As we continue to grow, we are steadfast in our commitment to provide our employees with the best work experience, enabling them to advance their careers in a conducive environment

**Employee Benefits**
Our company offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support our employees’ health, well-being, and professional growth. Employees enjoy flexible work options, generous paid time off, and robust health coverage, including treatment for dental and vision related requirements. We invest in the future of our employees through continuous learning opportunities and career advancement programs, while fostering a supportive and inclusive work environment. Our benefits include:
  
  

* Savings and Investment plans: We provide specialized benefits like Corporate NPS (National Pension Scheme), Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP), Long-Term Incentive Plan (LTIP), Retiral Benefits and Car Lease that help employees optimally plan their finances
* Upskilling and career growth opportunities: With a focus on continuous learning, we offer customized programs that support upskilling like Education Reimbursement Programs, Certification programs and access to global learning programs.
* Health and Welfare Benefits: We care about our employees’ well-being in and out of work and have benefits like Hybrid Work Environment, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Yearly Free Health campaigns and comprehensive Insurance benefits.

**Application Process**
Our recruitment process is designed to be transparent, and inclusive.
  
  

* Step 1: Submit your application via the Chubb Careers Portal.
* Step 2: Engage with our recruitment team for an initial discussion.
* Step 3: Participate in Hacker Rank assessments/technical/functional interviews and assessments (if applicable).
* Step 4: Final interaction with Chubb leadership.

**Join Us**
With you Chubb is better. Whether you are solving challenges on a
**global stage**
or creating innovative solutions for local markets, your contributions will help shape the future. If you value
**integrity, innovation, and inclusion**
, and are ready to make a difference, we invite you to
**be part of Chubb India’s journey**
.

title: Data Engineering - Internship (Paid)
description:
Every day, millions of shipments move around the world on data that nobody is looking at in real time. Orders, ASNs, invoices, and tracking events flow between 3PLs, forwarders, brands, and retailers, then get flattened into a status that tells you something went wrong only after it already has.

SwiftB2B is an AI operating system for global supply chains. One platform where 3PLs, freight forwarders, brands, retailers, and manufacturers can see every item, shipment, and exception as it happens, and where the platform works out what a delay costs and starts the fix. We built it on 15 years of SwiftAnt’s EDI and supply chain work. We are a Databricks partner.

**What the internship is**

Six months on the data team, working on real pipelines that feed the product. You will not be building a toy project on the side. You will get a piece of the actual platform, with a mentor who reviews your work, and by the end you will have shipped something a customer’s data flows through. We pay, we give you Databricks Academy access and sponsor the Data Engineer Associate certification if you get there, and we often hire from this program.

**What you will work on**

* Ingesting data from logistics systems (TMS and WMS exports, carrier APIs, EDI files like the 856 and 214) into Delta tables on Databricks.
* Writing PySpark and SQL transformations with data-quality checks that catch bad rows before they reach a dashboard.
* Building a small piece of our KPI catalogue end to end: source, model, test, documentation.
* Learning Unity Catalog, Lakeflow, and medallion architecture by using them, not by reading about them.
* Writing a runbook for what you built, so someone else can run it.

**What we are looking for**

* Final-year students or recent graduates in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field, or anyone who has taught themselves and can show it.
* Python and SQL you have actually used on a dataset bigger than a CSV.
* Curiosity about how goods move around the world. You do not need logistics knowledge; you need to want it.
* You have built something with data, even a small thing, and can show us.

**How to apply**

Send a link to something you built with data: a repo, a notebook, a dashboard, a blog post. Two or three sentences on what was hard about it. That counts for more than your grades. If you have tried our online demo with your own data, tell us what you noticed.

**Equal opportunity**

SwiftB2B hires on talent, skill and curiosity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, nationality, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, or any other protected characteristic. If you need an adjustment at any stage of the process, tell us and we will make it happen.

title: Senior Applied Scientist, Amazon Business - External Integrations
description:
**Description**
Amazon Business System Integrations connects Amazon Business with millions of business users and thousands of partner procurement, ERP, and finance systems. We build the APIs, protocols, and agentic experiences that let customers buy on Amazon Business directly from the systems they already use. As an Applied Scientist on this team, you will own and advance the ML and GenAI capabilities that make these integrations smarter, faster, and more reliable. You will drive model accuracy, scientific innovation, and global scale across external systems integrations.
  
  
Our work includes API-based and protocol-based shopping, such as punchout and emerging agent protocols, along with agentic interactions where buyers and AI agents search, compare, and purchase through natural language. It also covers partner onboarding and integration automation, mapping and normalizing catalog, product, and order data across many partner formats, and evaluation frameworks that measure the quality, accuracy, and latency of our agents.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
As an Applied Scientist on this team, you will work across three dimensions: Invent, Implement, and Influence.
  
  
Invent: You bring deep domain knowledge and fluency with state-of-the-art scientific approaches and emerging research. You practice customer-obsessed science, working backwards from the needs of business buyers, procurement teams, and integration partners to extend or invent new ML approaches, even when no textbook solution exists. You design novel ML and LLM-based methods for agentic shopping, product search and matching, schema and data mapping across partner systems, and automated evaluation of agent quality. You help define the research agenda for our agentic and protocol-based capabilities, and you lead the scientific strategy for accurate, low-latency responses in conversational and API-driven procurement. You author or co-author articles for internal or external peer-reviewed venues when appropriate and not precluded by business considerations.
  
  
Implement: The ML components you develop are integrated directly into production systems serving Amazon Business customers and partners worldwide. You make sound tradeoffs between accuracy and latency, innovation and stability, and short-term and long-term solutions, favoring reuse and established frameworks where appropriate. You make progress semi-autonomously with only occasional guidance, implement at the right level of complexity the first time, and evaluate emerging technologies, including LLMs and GenAI frameworks, largely on your own. You ensure your models and pipelines integrate robustly with catalog, offer, cart, order, and partner data sources and with the services that power external integrations.
  
  
Influence: You contribute to planning for the team, including goals, priorities, and roadmaps for ML and GenAI capabilities. You lead the scientific strategy for expanding agentic and integration capabilities across new partners, protocols, and countries. You collaborate with engineering, product, and program teams across Amazon Business so that data integration and ML pipelines are robust and scale with adoption. You mentor scientists and engineers, champion best practices for the AI-Driven Development Life Cycle (AIDLC), and provide peer feedback on research methods and results. You help recruit bar-raising talent through interview drives, and you are visible in the broader scientific community as a subject matter expert, including serving as a Program Committee member or reviewer for peer-reviewed venues.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* PhD, or Master's degree and 8+ years of applied research experience
* Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with modeling tools such as R, scikit-learn, Spark MLLib, MxNet, Tensorflow, numpy, scipy etc.
* Experience with large scale distributed systems such as Hadoop, Spark etc.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
