title: AI Quality Analyst
description:
**About The Opportunity**
Avenue Code is looking for an
**AI Quality Analyst**
to work with
**Fanatics**
as part of its AI/ML Platform team.
  
  
The AI/ML Platform team builds and supports Fanatics’ internal AI platform, including the gateway, agent runtime, registry, retrieval, and evaluation infrastructure used by teams developing solutions with LLMs and AI agents.
  
  
As the team’s dedicated AI Quality Analyst, you will be responsible for evaluating whether AI agents are performing as expected. You will run evaluation sets, review outputs against established rubrics, maintain high-quality ground-truth datasets, identify failure patterns, and provide actionable findings to the engineering and product teams responsible for each agent.
  
  
This is a
**12-month contract opportunity**
based in
**Hyderabad, India**
, following a
**hybrid work model**
.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Run evaluation sets against production and pre-release AI agents on a regular cadence and following meaningful changes to prompts, models, tools, or retrieval systems.
* Analyze and report evaluation results, including pass rates, regressions, trends, and recurring failure patterns.
* Review AI agent outputs against defined quality rubrics covering correctness, grounding, tool-use accuracy, safety, tone, and output format.
* Score outputs consistently, document edge cases, and identify areas where evaluation rubrics need clarification or improvement.
* Curate and maintain ground-truth datasets used to evaluate AI and LLM-based applications.
* Create, review, and validate golden answers and expected outputs for evaluation cases.
* Classify failures by root cause, including prompt issues, retrieval failures, incorrect tool usage, or model-related errors.
* Identify and retire outdated, ambiguous, or low-quality evaluation cases.
* Compare LLM-as-a-judge evaluation results against human review and identify discrepancies between automated and human scoring.
* Provide agent owner teams with reproducible examples, severity assessments, and suspected root causes for identified issues.
* Partner with engineering and product teams to track fixes and re-run evaluations until issues are resolved.
* Convert production failures, user feedback, and user corrections into new evaluation cases to continuously improve evaluation coverage.
* Use Python and SQL to execute evaluation scripts, analyze results, investigate traces, and identify patterns in agent behavior.
* Write clear and concise quality reports, bug reports, and evaluation summaries for technical and product stakeholders.

**Required Qualifications**

* 3+ years of professional experience in Quality Assurance, Data Annotation, Data Analytics, AI Quality, or another evidence-driven role.
* At least 1 year of hands-on experience reviewing or evaluating outputs from LLMs, conversational AI systems, chatbots, or AI agents.
* Strong ability to evaluate open-ended AI-generated content consistently using predefined scoring rubrics.
* Ability to clearly explain and defend evaluation decisions based on defined criteria and evidence.
* Working knowledge of Python and SQL for running evaluation scripts, analyzing datasets, and investigating results.
* Understanding of common failure modes in LLM applications, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), tool calling, and agent workflows.
* Ability to distinguish between issues caused by retrieval, prompting, tools, data, and model hallucinations.
* Experience creating or maintaining ground-truth datasets, golden answers, or labeled evaluation datasets.
* Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document findings clearly for engineers and product stakeholders.
* Fluent written and spoken English.
* Ability to maintain regular overlap with US working hours for team collaboration and pod syncs.
* Familiarity with AI observability, tracing, or evaluation platforms such as Langfuse, Arize Phoenix, or similar tools is a plus.

**Nice To Have Skills**

* Familiarity with Langfuse, Arize Phoenix, or similar tracing and eval tools
* Understanding of RAG
* Understanding of tool calling
* Understanding of agent loops/workflows
* Ability to distinguish retrieval misses vs. model hallucinations
* Familiarity with LLM-as-a-judge calibration against human review
* Experience curating ground-truth datasets / golden answers

*Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA, and CPRA. Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other companies from the Compass UOL Group to which Avenue Code consultants are allocated to perform their services.*

title: Data Engineering - Internship (Paid)
description:
Every day, millions of shipments move around the world on data that nobody is looking at in real time. Orders, ASNs, invoices, and tracking events flow between 3PLs, forwarders, brands, and retailers, then get flattened into a status that tells you something went wrong only after it already has.

SwiftB2B is an AI operating system for global supply chains. One platform where 3PLs, freight forwarders, brands, retailers, and manufacturers can see every item, shipment, and exception as it happens, and where the platform works out what a delay costs and starts the fix. We built it on 15 years of SwiftAnt’s EDI and supply chain work. We are a Databricks partner.

**What the internship is**

Six months on the data team, working on real pipelines that feed the product. You will not be building a toy project on the side. You will get a piece of the actual platform, with a mentor who reviews your work, and by the end you will have shipped something a customer’s data flows through. We pay, we give you Databricks Academy access and sponsor the Data Engineer Associate certification if you get there, and we often hire from this program.

**What you will work on**

* Ingesting data from logistics systems (TMS and WMS exports, carrier APIs, EDI files like the 856 and 214) into Delta tables on Databricks.
* Writing PySpark and SQL transformations with data-quality checks that catch bad rows before they reach a dashboard.
* Building a small piece of our KPI catalogue end to end: source, model, test, documentation.
* Learning Unity Catalog, Lakeflow, and medallion architecture by using them, not by reading about them.
* Writing a runbook for what you built, so someone else can run it.

**What we are looking for**

* Final-year students or recent graduates in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field, or anyone who has taught themselves and can show it.
* Python and SQL you have actually used on a dataset bigger than a CSV.
* Curiosity about how goods move around the world. You do not need logistics knowledge; you need to want it.
* You have built something with data, even a small thing, and can show us.

**How to apply**

Send a link to something you built with data: a repo, a notebook, a dashboard, a blog post. Two or three sentences on what was hard about it. That counts for more than your grades. If you have tried our online demo with your own data, tell us what you noticed.

**Equal opportunity**

SwiftB2B hires on talent, skill and curiosity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, nationality, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, or any other protected characteristic. If you need an adjustment at any stage of the process, tell us and we will make it happen.

description:

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Cognite Solution Architect – Senior Manager**
**Experience Level - 15+**
**Job Description**
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. We’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better. Join us and help build a better working world.
  
  
We are seeking a hands-on Cognite Solution Architect to design industrial data solutions for upstream and downstream Oil & Gas operations. You will define how operational, enterprise and engineering information is integrated, modelled and contextualized in Cognite Data Fusion (CDF), and how applications and analytical solutions consume that information. You will own solution architecture decisions, establish reusable implementation patterns and resolve complex technical issues across source systems, data models, access controls and consuming applications.
  
  
**Role Details**
**Key responsibilities include:**
**Architecture and integration**

* Translate operational use cases into data requirements, integration designs and application-consumption patterns.
* Define how CDF fits within historian, enterprise application, engineering information and cloud architectures.
* Select source-appropriate extractors, APIs and processing patterns, considering latency, throughput, connectivity and source-system load.
* Define historical loading, incremental extraction, reconciliation and recovery approaches, including late records, corrections and supported deletions.
* Establish requirements for service identities, access capabilities, environment separation, monitoring and operational support.

**Industrial information modelling**

* Design CDF models using spaces, containers, views and instances; select direct relations or edges according to relationship semantics and query requirements.
* Reuse and extend Cognite’s Core Data Model where suitable, introducing custom domain concepts where required.
* Define stable identifiers, source crosswalks and conflict-resolution rules, including repeated tag names across sites and systems.
* Represent physical equipment, functional locations and installation history separately where required.
* Establish schema versioning, migration and consumer-compatibility requirements while preserving lineage, timestamps, units, quality indicators and relationship provenance.

**Contextualization and Oil & Gas semantics**

* Design relationships connecting equipment and assets with time series, maintenance records, documents and engineering diagrams.
* Define matching rules, confidence thresholds, exception handling and domain review for ambiguous associations; assess coverage and match accuracy separately.
* For upstream applications, model fields, wells, wellbores, production facilities, equipment, well tests and interventions, preserving distinctions between measured, calculated and allocated production.
* For downstream applications, model sites, process units, functional locations, equipment, laboratory results and maintenance activities, accounting for replacement, revisions and measurement timing.
* Validate that contextualized information supports the intended engineering workflow.
* Application enablement and technical assurance
* Define consumer data contracts covering entities, relationships, fields, freshness, permissions and query-performance expectations.
* Validate designs against representative Cognite applications, custom applications, and analytical or AI workflows.
* Develop critical prototypes and reference implementations using Python, SQL, Cognite SDKs and APIs.
* Establish deployment and environment-promotion practices using version control, automated validation and Cognite Toolkit.
* Review architecture changes, migration plans, integration code and performance bottlenecks; resolve cross-system design conflicts and mentor data engineering leads.

**Must Have Qualifications & Experience**

* A relevant engineering, computer science or information systems degree, or equivalent technical experience.
* Demonstrated personal architectural contribution to a production Cognite Data Fusion implementation.
* Strong knowledge of CDF data modelling, transformations, contextualization and access controls.
* Substantial industrial data integration experience spanning representative operational, enterprise and engineering sources.
* Strong Python and SQL skills with practical Cognite SDK and REST API experience.
* Experience defining identity strategies, model evolution, deployment patterns and production support requirements.
* Working knowledge of cloud architecture, identity providers, network boundaries and CI/CD.
* Strong Oil & Gas implementation experience in at least one upstream or downstream domain, with ability to adapt relevant concepts to the other.

**Good to Have**

* Cognite implementation experience across multiple assets or sites.
* Experience spanning both upstream and downstream.
* Familiarity with historians, maintenance systems, laboratory systems, engineering repositories or well-data services.
* Experience with diagram contextualization, 3D associations and industrial knowledge graphs.
* Experience enabling Cognite applications or AI workflows using contextualized data.
* Relevant Cognite Academy training or certifications.

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to solve high-impact industrial data and analytics challenges across upstream and downstream Oil & Gas.
* A hands-on leadership role with scope to establish reusable practices and guide multidisciplinary teams.
* A collaborative environment spanning domain engineering, data, technology, product and global EY teams.
* Access to EY’s global network, technology ecosystem and learning opportunities while contributing to a better working world.

**What We Look For**
A hands-on architect who can defend consequential production Cognite decisions involving identity resolution, data-model design, access boundaries, recovery, schema migration and application compatibility, and demonstrate which patterns can be reused across sites and which require adaptation.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Specialist, Data Strategy & Governance
description:
Position Summary
  
  
The Specialist, Data Strategy & Governance will be responsible for analyzing, monitoring, and improving the quality of enterprise data across data platforms, migration programs, and business processes.
  
  
This role will perform advanced data profiling and validation, identify data anomalies and quality gaps, lead the investigation of data defects, and partner with business and technology teams to implement sustainable remediation solutions. The individual will also contribute to the development of enterprise data quality standards, controls, metrics, and reusable practices.
  
  
The successful candidate will bring strong analytical and technical capabilities, hands-on experience with enterprise data quality tools, and the ability to work independently across multiple stakeholders and complex data environments.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Perform in-depth data profiling and analysis to proactively identify data anomalies, inconsistencies, completeness issues, and data quality gaps.
* Translate data analysis findings into actionable recommendations for data cleansing, remediation, enrichment, and preventive controls.
* Define, document, and implement data quality rules, validation checks, thresholds, and monitoring requirements based on business and technical requirements.
* Collaborate with Data Engineers and platform teams to embed automated data quality checks within data ingestion, transformation, and migration pipelines.
* Lead the triage, investigation, root-cause analysis, and resolution of data defects and validation failures.
* Work closely with business stakeholders, IT teams, Data Engineers, Data Stewards, and Project Management teams to resolve complex data quality issues.
* Document data quality issues, remediation actions, root causes, business impacts, and resolution status in a clear and traceable manner.
* Develop comprehensive data quality reports, dashboards, metrics, and insights for business and technology stakeholders.
* Contribute to the development and continuous enhancement of enterprise data quality standards, best practices, methodologies, templates, and reusable artifacts.
* Identify opportunities to automate manual data validation, reconciliation, profiling, and reporting processes to improve efficiency and scalability.
* Support data migration and transformation programs by validating source-to-target data, reconciliation results, and business-critical data attributes.
* Promote consistent adoption of data quality practices across projects, platforms, and data domains.
* Provide technical guidance and knowledge sharing to project teams and less-experienced team members on data quality concepts, tools, and practices.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Data Management, or a related discipline.
* Typically 8-11 years of professional experience in Data Quality, Data Management, Data Engineering, Data Governance, or a related area.
* Hands-on experience performing data profiling, data validation, data quality rule implementation, data remediation, and data quality issue management.
* Experience using enterprise data quality tools such as Collibra Data Quality, Ataccama, Informatica Data Quality, or equivalent platforms.
* Advanced proficiency in SQL, including experience writing and optimizing complex queries for large-scale datasets.
* Experience working with cloud and modern data platforms, including Amazon S3 and Databricks.
* Hands-on experience with Python for data analysis, validation, automation, or data quality rule development.
* Working knowledge of CI/CD practices and orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow.
* Experience performing root-cause analysis and resolving complex data quality defects across integrated data environments.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with excellent attention to detail and a commitment to delivering high-quality outcomes.
* Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and deliver results in a complex, cross-functional environment.
* Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate technical findings clearly and concisely to both technical and business audiences.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience implementing advanced data quality capabilities such as data observability, anomaly detection, automated data monitoring, or augmented data quality.
* Experience applying artificial intelligence or machine learning capabilities to data profiling, rule recommendation, issue detection, or data quality remediation.
* Strong working knowledge of the Databricks platform, including notebooks, workflows, Delta Lake, or Unity Catalog.
* Experience developing data quality dashboards or reports using Power BI.
* Experience with Collibra Data Catalog, data governance workflows, business glossaries, metadata management, or data lineage.
* Experience supporting large-scale data migration, cloud transformation, or enterprise data modernization initiatives.
* Familiarity with data governance, metadata management, master data management, and FAIR data principles.
* Experience working in the life sciences, pharmaceutical, healthcare, or another highly regulated industry.

Core Competencies
  
  

* Drives Results: Takes ownership of deliverables and consistently produces accurate, timely, and high-quality outcomes.
* Manages Ambiguity: Effectively analyses incomplete or complex information and develops practical approaches to resolve data challenges.
* Decision Quality: Uses data, analysis, and sound judgement to make well-informed recommendations.
* Collaborates: Builds effective relationships across business, data, engineering, governance, and project teams.
* Communicates Effectively: Presents complex data quality findings in a clear, concise, and stakeholder-appropriate manner.
* Cultivates Innovation: Identifies opportunities to automate processes and apply modern data quality capabilities.
* Ensures Accountability: Maintains clear ownership, documentation, traceability, and follow-through for data quality issues.
* Instils Trust: Demonstrates integrity, transparency, reliability, and attention to detail.

Expected Outcomes
  
  

* Improved accuracy, completeness, consistency, and reliability of enterprise data.
* Earlier identification and resolution of data defects within migration and data engineering pipelines.
* Increased automation of data profiling, validation, reconciliation, and monitoring activities.
* Consistent implementation of enterprise data quality standards and reusable controls.
* Clear visibility of data quality risks, root causes, remediation actions, and business impacts.
* Stronger collaboration between business, data governance, engineering, and technology teams.

title: Senior Applied Scientist, Amazon Business - External Integrations
description:
**Description**
Amazon Business System Integrations connects Amazon Business with millions of business users and thousands of partner procurement, ERP, and finance systems. We build the APIs, protocols, and agentic experiences that let customers buy on Amazon Business directly from the systems they already use. As an Applied Scientist on this team, you will own and advance the ML and GenAI capabilities that make these integrations smarter, faster, and more reliable. You will drive model accuracy, scientific innovation, and global scale across external systems integrations.
  
  
Our work includes API-based and protocol-based shopping, such as punchout and emerging agent protocols, along with agentic interactions where buyers and AI agents search, compare, and purchase through natural language. It also covers partner onboarding and integration automation, mapping and normalizing catalog, product, and order data across many partner formats, and evaluation frameworks that measure the quality, accuracy, and latency of our agents.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
As an Applied Scientist on this team, you will work across three dimensions: Invent, Implement, and Influence.
  
  
Invent: You bring deep domain knowledge and fluency with state-of-the-art scientific approaches and emerging research. You practice customer-obsessed science, working backwards from the needs of business buyers, procurement teams, and integration partners to extend or invent new ML approaches, even when no textbook solution exists. You design novel ML and LLM-based methods for agentic shopping, product search and matching, schema and data mapping across partner systems, and automated evaluation of agent quality. You help define the research agenda for our agentic and protocol-based capabilities, and you lead the scientific strategy for accurate, low-latency responses in conversational and API-driven procurement. You author or co-author articles for internal or external peer-reviewed venues when appropriate and not precluded by business considerations.
  
  
Implement: The ML components you develop are integrated directly into production systems serving Amazon Business customers and partners worldwide. You make sound tradeoffs between accuracy and latency, innovation and stability, and short-term and long-term solutions, favoring reuse and established frameworks where appropriate. You make progress semi-autonomously with only occasional guidance, implement at the right level of complexity the first time, and evaluate emerging technologies, including LLMs and GenAI frameworks, largely on your own. You ensure your models and pipelines integrate robustly with catalog, offer, cart, order, and partner data sources and with the services that power external integrations.
  
  
Influence: You contribute to planning for the team, including goals, priorities, and roadmaps for ML and GenAI capabilities. You lead the scientific strategy for expanding agentic and integration capabilities across new partners, protocols, and countries. You collaborate with engineering, product, and program teams across Amazon Business so that data integration and ML pipelines are robust and scale with adoption. You mentor scientists and engineers, champion best practices for the AI-Driven Development Life Cycle (AIDLC), and provide peer feedback on research methods and results. You help recruit bar-raising talent through interview drives, and you are visible in the broader scientific community as a subject matter expert, including serving as a Program Committee member or reviewer for peer-reviewed venues.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* PhD, or Master's degree and 8+ years of applied research experience
* Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with modeling tools such as R, scikit-learn, Spark MLLib, MxNet, Tensorflow, numpy, scipy etc.
* Experience with large scale distributed systems such as Hadoop, Spark etc.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Contract Reporting Analyst
description:
Job Summary

We are seeking a detail-oriented State Contract Reporting Analyst to support contract reporting, transaction reconciliation, pricing compliance, and administrative fee reporting. This role is important to maintaining accurate contract records, preparing timely sales reports, validating transaction data, and coordinating with internal teams to resolve discrepancies. The successful candidate will maintain supporting documentation, track reporting deadlines and outstanding actions, and support audit and month-end close activities.

Key Responsibilities

Transaction Tracking and System Updates

* Review and track sales and contract-related transactions for state and cooperative purchasing contracts, including NASPO ValuePoint, TIPS, BuyBoard, Carahsoft, and other applicable programs.
* Extract, consolidate, and update transaction details from purchase orders, invoices, Power BI, and ConnectWise, ensuring records are complete, accurate, and current.
* Monitor outstanding transactions, missing information, reporting exceptions, and aging items; follow up with relevant teams and escalate unresolved issues as needed.

Reconciliation and Documentation

* Reconcile sales and transaction data against purchase orders, invoices, contract records, and supporting documentation before reporting or submission.
* Investigate discrepancies, duplicate or missing transactions, pricing variances, and documentation gaps; coordinate corrective action with the appropriate stakeholders.
* Maintain complete and organized contract-specific records, sales reports, fee statements, submission confirmations, and payment support to facilitate audit requests and compliance reviews.
* Support month-end and periodic close activities by reviewing outstanding transactions, validating report data, and following up on unresolved items.

Contract Pricing and Administrative Fee Coordination

* Review transaction pricing against contract price lists, discount structures, contract terms, and Not-to-Exceed (NTE) requirements; flag discrepancies for review and resolution.
* Calculate and validate administrative fees based on applicable contract terms and reported sales.
* Prepare administrative fee statements, track payment status and pending approvals, and coordinate follow-up with Finance and other responsible teams.

Reporting, Controls, and Process Improvement

* Prepare and maintain periodic contract sales reports and Excel-based trackers covering reported sales, outstanding transactions, administrative fees, exceptions, and submission status.
* Use Excel features such as PivotTables, lookup formulas, and SUMIFS, along with Power BI dashboards, to validate data and monitor reporting activity.
* Track monthly and quarterly reporting deadlines, pending approvals, and outstanding actions to support timely completion of contract obligations.
* Follow established procedures and internal controls when handling commercial, contract, and financial information; maintain accurate records to support audit readiness.
* Identify recurring data-quality issues and recommend workflow improvements that increase reporting accuracy, consistency, and efficiency.

Coordination and Communication

* Coordinate with Pricing, Finance, Sales Operations, Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, and Contract Management to resolve transaction, invoice, pricing, and reporting discrepancies.
* Respond to internal inquiries, provide status updates, and communicate outstanding issues, required actions, and expected resolution timelines.
* Collaborate across teams to ensure accurate reporting, timely follow-up, and adherence to agreed service levels and deadlines.

title: Senior Agentic AI Engineer
description:
**ENGINEERING / ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE / CLOUD PRODUCTS**

Senior Agentic AI Engineer

Hands-on AI Development | AWS & Azure | Enterprise Agents

**EXPERIENCE**
**9-12 Years**

**ROLE TYPE**
**Hands-on senior engineer**

**CLOUD**
**AWS / Azure**

  

About the opportunity

Tachyon Technologies is seeking a strong, hands-on Senior Agentic AI Engineer to build secure, scalable AI agents, intelligent workflows, and cloud-native GenAI applications. You will turn product ideas and technical designs into reliable, reusable features used in real enterprise environments.

This is an individual-contributor engineering role with meaningful feature ownership. You will write production code, design components, integrate enterprise systems, troubleshoot agent behavior, and collaborate with engineering leads and architects to take solutions from prototype to production.

What you will build

* **Agent development & orchestration:**
  Implement AI agents, tool calling, multi-step and multi-agent workflows, human approvals, state management, memory, retries, and safe error recovery using Python.
* **Frameworks & protocols:**
  Develop with frameworks such as LangGraph, Microsoft Agent Framework, AutoGen/AG2, Google ADK, or similar. Build and consume MCP tools; integrate agent-to-agent (A2A) patterns where appropriate.
* **Cloud-native AI services:**
  Build and deploy agent services on AWS or Azure using managed AI models, API services, functions, containers, messaging, storage, secrets, and monitoring.
* **RAG & enterprise integrations:**
  Build document ingestion and retrieval pipelines, metadata filters, hybrid/vector search, grounded responses, and integrations with enterprise APIs, knowledge bases, and operational systems.
* **Testing, safety & observability:**
  Add structured logging and traces, agent evaluations, regression tests, tool-call validation, guardrails, identity-aware access, prompt-injection defenses, and data protection.
* **Feature delivery:**
  Own assigned features from design and implementation through unit/integration testing, CI/CD, deployment, documentation, and production defect resolution.
* **Engineering collaboration:**
  Work with product owners, architects, cloud engineers, QA, and other developers; participate in design reviews, code reviews, and continuous improvement.
  

Required experience & skills

* **Engineering experience:**
  9+ years of professional software engineering experience (9-12 years preferred), including substantial backend/cloud development and experience delivering production systems.
* **Python & backend:**
  Strong hands-on Python expertise, APIs (FastAPI or equivalent), async workflows, microservices, SQL/NoSQL, Git, debugging, testing, and clean software design.
* **Applied GenAI & agents:**
  Hands-on experience building and integrating LLM-powered applications using RAG, model APIs, agent orchestration, tool/function calling, structured output, and error handling.
  

Cloud engineering & production readiness

* **AWS / Azure:**
  Strong implementation experience on at least one platform (AWS or Azure), and readiness to work across both. Understand cloud identity, networking, containers/functions, APIs, monitoring, and secure deployment.
* **Production delivery:**
  Experience with CI/CD, Docker, configuration and secrets, authentication and authorization, instrumentation, performance testing, and incident troubleshooting.
* **Independent ownership:**
  Able to break a feature into implementation tasks, estimate effort, explain trade-offs, write maintainable code, review peers’ work, and communicate blockers early.
  

Cloud specialization (primary platform)

**AWS track**

Amazon Bedrock / Bedrock AgentCore, IAM, Lambda, ECS/EKS, API Gateway, S3, CloudWatch, VPC, and secure model/tool integrations.

**Azure track**

Microsoft Foundry / Agent Service, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Azure Functions, AKS, Entra ID, Key Vault, and Application Insights.

  

Strong advantages

* **Reusable platform engineering:**
  Experience developing SDKs, shared libraries, workflow components, agent templates, connector frameworks, or multi-tenant SaaS services.
* **Advanced AI & data:**
  Exposure to evaluation frameworks, OpenTelemetry, model routing/caching, semantic search, knowledge graphs, multimodal AI, open-source models, or ML serving.
* **Enterprise ecosystem:**
  Integrations with SAP, Salesforce, ServiceNow, Jira, Microsoft 365, Confluence, GitHub, or data platforms such as Snowflake and Databricks.
  

What success looks like

* Delivers working agentic AI features with clean code, documented interfaces, automated tests, and reliable production behavior.
* Improves agent accuracy, tool-call reliability, security, observability, and cost/latency based on real evaluation results.
* Independently resolves technical problems, contributes reusable components, and raises engineering quality through collaboration and code review.
  

Who will thrive in this role

An engineer who enjoys writing code and debugging complex AI workflows, understands the difference between an impressive demo and a production system, and can independently deliver meaningful features. This is not a prompt-only, low-code-only, or project-coordination role.

Tachyon Technologies is an equal opportunity employer.

* **Applied agentic AI:**
  Proven hands-on development of GenAI/agentic applications beyond prompt-only demos; experience with agent orchestration, RAG, tool use, stateful workflows, evaluation, failure handling, and integration with real enterprise systems.
  

Cloud, production & leadership

* **AWS / Azure:**
  Deep implementation experience with at least one of AWS or Azure and demonstrable experience on the other. Ability to design portable services while using appropriate cloud-native managed capabilities.
* **Production ownership:**
  Experience deploying and supporting cloud-native products with authentication/authorization, logging, monitoring, CI/CD, performance engineering, scaling, secure networking, and cost control.
* **Technical leadership:**
  Evidence of leading engineering teams, independently owning complex features, making design trade-offs, mentoring developers, and collaborating with stakeholders on delivery decisions.
  

Cloud specialization (choose a primary track)

**AWS platform track**

Amazon Bedrock / Bedrock AgentCore, IAM, Lambda, ECS/EKS, API Gateway, S3, networking, CloudWatch and production agent deployment patterns.

**Azure platform track**

Microsoft Foundry / Agent Service, Microsoft Agent Framework, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Entra ID, AKS, Azure Functions, Key Vault, Application Insights and managed identities.

  

Strong advantages

* **Platform product background:**
  Experience building SDKs, developer tools, agent builders, template frameworks, internal platforms, marketplaces, workflow engines, or multi-tenant SaaS components.

What success looks like

* Ships well-designed, tested, observable agentic AI capabilities that can be reused across enterprise use cases and cloud environments.
* Improves reliability, security, traceability, evaluation quality, developer experience, and cost/latency of production agent workflows.
* Builds a stronger engineering team while continuing to contribute directly to difficult technical problems and product innovations.
  

Who will thrive in this role

A builder who enjoys owning product features from whiteboard to production, can explain and defend engineering trade-offs, and is equally comfortable designing a robust multi-agent architecture and debugging an unreliable tool call. The role is not intended for purely managerial, governance-only, or low-code/prompt-only profiles.

title: Data Engineering - Internship (Paid)
description:
Every day, millions of shipments move around the world on data that nobody is looking at in real time. Orders, ASNs, invoices, and tracking events flow between 3PLs, forwarders, brands, and retailers, then get flattened into a status that tells you something went wrong only after it already has.

SwiftB2B is an AI operating system for global supply chains. One platform where 3PLs, freight forwarders, brands, retailers, and manufacturers can see every item, shipment, and exception as it happens, and where the platform works out what a delay costs and starts the fix. We built it on 15 years of SwiftAnt’s EDI and supply chain work. We are a Databricks partner.

**What the internship is**

Six months on the data team, working on real pipelines that feed the product. You will not be building a toy project on the side. You will get a piece of the actual platform, with a mentor who reviews your work, and by the end you will have shipped something a customer’s data flows through. We pay, we give you Databricks Academy access and sponsor the Data Engineer Associate certification if you get there, and we often hire from this program.

**What you will work on**

* Ingesting data from logistics systems (TMS and WMS exports, carrier APIs, EDI files like the 856 and 214) into Delta tables on Databricks.
* Writing PySpark and SQL transformations with data-quality checks that catch bad rows before they reach a dashboard.
* Building a small piece of our KPI catalogue end to end: source, model, test, documentation.
* Learning Unity Catalog, Lakeflow, and medallion architecture by using them, not by reading about them.
* Writing a runbook for what you built, so someone else can run it.

**What we are looking for**

* Final-year students or recent graduates in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field, or anyone who has taught themselves and can show it.
* Python and SQL you have actually used on a dataset bigger than a CSV.
* Curiosity about how goods move around the world. You do not need logistics knowledge; you need to want it.
* You have built something with data, even a small thing, and can show us.

**How to apply**

Send a link to something you built with data: a repo, a notebook, a dashboard, a blog post. Two or three sentences on what was hard about it. That counts for more than your grades. If you have tried our online demo with your own data, tell us what you noticed.

**Equal opportunity**

SwiftB2B hires on talent, skill and curiosity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, nationality, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, or any other protected characteristic. If you need an adjustment at any stage of the process, tell us and we will make it happen.

title: AI Quality Analyst
description:
**About The Opportunity**
Avenue Code is looking for an
**AI Quality Analyst**
to work with
**Fanatics**
as part of its AI/ML Platform team.
  
  
The AI/ML Platform team builds and supports Fanatics’ internal AI platform, including the gateway, agent runtime, registry, retrieval, and evaluation infrastructure used by teams developing solutions with LLMs and AI agents.
  
  
As the team’s dedicated AI Quality Analyst, you will be responsible for evaluating whether AI agents are performing as expected. You will run evaluation sets, review outputs against established rubrics, maintain high-quality ground-truth datasets, identify failure patterns, and provide actionable findings to the engineering and product teams responsible for each agent.
  
  
This is a
**12-month contract opportunity**
based in
**Hyderabad, India**
, following a
**hybrid work model**
.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Run evaluation sets against production and pre-release AI agents on a regular cadence and following meaningful changes to prompts, models, tools, or retrieval systems.
* Analyze and report evaluation results, including pass rates, regressions, trends, and recurring failure patterns.
* Review AI agent outputs against defined quality rubrics covering correctness, grounding, tool-use accuracy, safety, tone, and output format.
* Score outputs consistently, document edge cases, and identify areas where evaluation rubrics need clarification or improvement.
* Curate and maintain ground-truth datasets used to evaluate AI and LLM-based applications.
* Create, review, and validate golden answers and expected outputs for evaluation cases.
* Classify failures by root cause, including prompt issues, retrieval failures, incorrect tool usage, or model-related errors.
* Identify and retire outdated, ambiguous, or low-quality evaluation cases.
* Compare LLM-as-a-judge evaluation results against human review and identify discrepancies between automated and human scoring.
* Provide agent owner teams with reproducible examples, severity assessments, and suspected root causes for identified issues.
* Partner with engineering and product teams to track fixes and re-run evaluations until issues are resolved.
* Convert production failures, user feedback, and user corrections into new evaluation cases to continuously improve evaluation coverage.
* Use Python and SQL to execute evaluation scripts, analyze results, investigate traces, and identify patterns in agent behavior.
* Write clear and concise quality reports, bug reports, and evaluation summaries for technical and product stakeholders.

**Required Qualifications**

* 3+ years of professional experience in Quality Assurance, Data Annotation, Data Analytics, AI Quality, or another evidence-driven role.
* At least 1 year of hands-on experience reviewing or evaluating outputs from LLMs, conversational AI systems, chatbots, or AI agents.
* Strong ability to evaluate open-ended AI-generated content consistently using predefined scoring rubrics.
* Ability to clearly explain and defend evaluation decisions based on defined criteria and evidence.
* Working knowledge of Python and SQL for running evaluation scripts, analyzing datasets, and investigating results.
* Understanding of common failure modes in LLM applications, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), tool calling, and agent workflows.
* Ability to distinguish between issues caused by retrieval, prompting, tools, data, and model hallucinations.
* Experience creating or maintaining ground-truth datasets, golden answers, or labeled evaluation datasets.
* Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document findings clearly for engineers and product stakeholders.
* Fluent written and spoken English.
* Ability to maintain regular overlap with US working hours for team collaboration and pod syncs.
* Familiarity with AI observability, tracing, or evaluation platforms such as Langfuse, Arize Phoenix, or similar tools is a plus.

**Nice To Have Skills**

* Familiarity with Langfuse, Arize Phoenix, or similar tracing and eval tools
* Understanding of RAG
* Understanding of tool calling
* Understanding of agent loops/workflows
* Ability to distinguish retrieval misses vs. model hallucinations

title: Software Development Engineer, Time & Pay Innovation
description:
**Description**
Amazon is one of the largest employers on the planet with hundreds of thousands of employees across the globe. Come join us in our journey to deliver solutions for one of the most complex domains in People eXperience Technology (PXT). Your code determines how Amazon associates get paid — accurately, on time, every single day. As an SDE-II in TAA, you own and deliver features across one of Amazon's most critical real-time platforms: a high-throughput, event-driven architecture processing millions of IoT punch events globally. You don't just write code — you own systems. We own and deliver technology to manage employee time expectations and compute their pay, globally, for all our current and emerging businesses. At the core, we are in the business of analytics — real-time and event-driven — of data collected from IoT devices (time clocks) and web user interfaces. We own our own high-availability services to support this processing, and require the ability to work from replay-able, auditable "truth" for any point in an employee's timeline. Our business rules are complex and arcane, varying by role, business, and jurisdiction. We are solving all these problems at Amazon scale, an order of magnitude larger than supported by any commodity solutions and growing exponentially.
  
  
We are looking for a Software Development Engineer II who is a strong, independent builder with growing design maturity. You take ownership of significant features and components, drive them from design through production, and operate them with high standards. You write high-quality code, make sound technical decisions with appropriate trade-offs, and proactively improve the systems you touch. You are developing your ability to influence design direction, mentor junior engineers, and think beyond your immediate deliverables to the health of the broader system.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Own the design and delivery of significant features and components across scalable, multi-tiered applications and services. Drive projects from requirements through design, implementation, testing, deployment, and production operation.

Write high-quality, well-tested production code using modern languages, design patterns, and frameworks. Hold yourself and your peers to high standards through thorough code reviews.
  
  

* Make sound technical decisions with appropriate trade-offs. Evaluate options for caching, retry strategies, concurrency, and data modeling. Justify your choices and communicate trade-offs clearly.

Design and build for scale and resilience. Consider failure modes, rate limits, traffic bursts, and downstream dependency health in your designs. Implement patterns like backpressure, circuit breakers, and graceful degradation.
  
  

* Own operational excellence for your systems. Monitor production health, respond to alarms, investigate root causes, and drive fixes. Write runbooks, improve observability, and reduce operational burden over time.

Contribute to system-level design discussions. Participate actively in design reviews — propose solutions, challenge assumptions, and help the team arrive at better architectures.
  
  
Mentor junior engineers. Support SDE-Is through code reviews, pairing sessions, and technical guidance. Help them grow their skills and develop good engineering habits.
  
  

* Understand and translate business requirements. Work with stakeholders to understand complex domain rules across punch processing, attendance, scheduling, and compliance. Turn ambiguous requirements into clear technical designs.

Identify and resolve technical debt proactively. Improve code quality, simplify complex logic, optimize performance, and refactor systems to support future growth — without being asked.
  
  
Contribute to team processes and culture. Participate in sprint planning, retrospectives, and on-call rotations. Raise the bar for engineering practices and help improve team velocity.
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
You start the day reviewing a design you wrote for a new feature in the compliance system — incorporating feedback from a senior engineer on edge cases around jurisdiction-specific rules. You update the design, get alignment, and start building. Mid-morning, you review a code change from a junior engineer, leaving constructive feedback on error handling and test coverage. After lunch, you investigate a latency spike in one of your services — tracing requests through logs and metrics, identifying a downstream throttling issue, and implementing a retry optimization. You join a design review for a cross-team project, asking questions about failure modes and proposing an alternative caching approach. You close the day deploying your feature to a pre-production environment, validating metrics, and updating the team on progress in standup.
  
  
**About The Team**
We are Time and Attendance (TAA) team within People eXperience Technology (PXT). Our team builds and operates the technology that powers how Amazon tracks, manages, and compensates employee time — globally, across all business lines and geographies.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
* 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
* 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
* Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

description:

**Cognite Solution Architect – Senior Manager**
**Experience Level - 15+**
**Job Description**
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. We’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better. Join us and help build a better working world.
  
  
We are seeking a hands-on Cognite Solution Architect to design industrial data solutions for upstream and downstream Oil & Gas operations. You will define how operational, enterprise and engineering information is integrated, modelled and contextualized in Cognite Data Fusion (CDF), and how applications and analytical solutions consume that information. You will own solution architecture decisions, establish reusable implementation patterns and resolve complex technical issues across source systems, data models, access controls and consuming applications.
  
  
**Role Details**
**Key responsibilities include:**
**Architecture and integration**

* Translate operational use cases into data requirements, integration designs and application-consumption patterns.
* Define how CDF fits within historian, enterprise application, engineering information and cloud architectures.
* Select source-appropriate extractors, APIs and processing patterns, considering latency, throughput, connectivity and source-system load.
* Define historical loading, incremental extraction, reconciliation and recovery approaches, including late records, corrections and supported deletions.
* Establish requirements for service identities, access capabilities, environment separation, monitoring and operational support.

**Industrial information modelling**

* Design CDF models using spaces, containers, views and instances; select direct relations or edges according to relationship semantics and query requirements.
* Reuse and extend Cognite’s Core Data Model where suitable, introducing custom domain concepts where required.
* Define stable identifiers, source crosswalks and conflict-resolution rules, including repeated tag names across sites and systems.
* Represent physical equipment, functional locations and installation history separately where required.
* Establish schema versioning, migration and consumer-compatibility requirements while preserving lineage, timestamps, units, quality indicators and relationship provenance.

**Contextualization and Oil & Gas semantics**

* Design relationships connecting equipment and assets with time series, maintenance records, documents and engineering diagrams.
* Define matching rules, confidence thresholds, exception handling and domain review for ambiguous associations; assess coverage and match accuracy separately.
* For upstream applications, model fields, wells, wellbores, production facilities, equipment, well tests and interventions, preserving distinctions between measured, calculated and allocated production.
* For downstream applications, model sites, process units, functional locations, equipment, laboratory results and maintenance activities, accounting for replacement, revisions and measurement timing.
* Validate that contextualized information supports the intended engineering workflow.
* Application enablement and technical assurance
* Define consumer data contracts covering entities, relationships, fields, freshness, permissions and query-performance expectations.
* Validate designs against representative Cognite applications, custom applications, and analytical or AI workflows.
* Develop critical prototypes and reference implementations using Python, SQL, Cognite SDKs and APIs.
* Establish deployment and environment-promotion practices using version control, automated validation and Cognite Toolkit.
* Review architecture changes, migration plans, integration code and performance bottlenecks; resolve cross-system design conflicts and mentor data engineering leads.

**Must Have Qualifications & Experience**

* A relevant engineering, computer science or information systems degree, or equivalent technical experience.
* Demonstrated personal architectural contribution to a production Cognite Data Fusion implementation.
* Strong knowledge of CDF data modelling, transformations, contextualization and access controls.
* Substantial industrial data integration experience spanning representative operational, enterprise and engineering sources.
* Strong Python and SQL skills with practical Cognite SDK and REST API experience.
* Experience defining identity strategies, model evolution, deployment patterns and production support requirements.
* Working knowledge of cloud architecture, identity providers, network boundaries and CI/CD.
* Strong Oil & Gas implementation experience in at least one upstream or downstream domain, with ability to adapt relevant concepts to the other.

**Good to Have**

* Cognite implementation experience across multiple assets or sites.
* Experience spanning both upstream and downstream.
* Familiarity with historians, maintenance systems, laboratory systems, engineering repositories or well-data services.
* Experience with diagram contextualization, 3D associations and industrial knowledge graphs.
* Experience enabling Cognite applications or AI workflows using contextualized data.
* Relevant Cognite Academy training or certifications.

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to solve high-impact industrial data and analytics challenges across upstream and downstream Oil & Gas.
* A hands-on leadership role with scope to establish reusable practices and guide multidisciplinary teams.
* A collaborative environment spanning domain engineering, data, technology, product and global EY teams.
* Access to EY’s global network, technology ecosystem and learning opportunities while contributing to a better working world.

**What We Look For**
A hands-on architect who can defend consequential production Cognite decisions involving identity resolution, data-model design, access boundaries, recovery, schema migration and application compatibility, and demonstrate which patterns can be reused across sites and which require adaptation.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

description:

**Job Description**
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. We are seeking a hands-on Cognite Solution Architect to design industrial data solutions for upstream and downstream Oil & Gas operations. You will define how operational, enterprise and engineering information is integrated, modelled and contextualized in Cognite Data Fusion (CDF), and how applications and analytical solutions consume that information. You will own solution architecture decisions, establish reusable implementation patterns and resolve complex technical issues across source systems, data models, access controls and consuming applications.
  
  
**Role Details**
**Key responsibilities include:**
**Architecture and integration**

* Translate operational use cases into data requirements, integration designs and application-consumption patterns.
* Define how CDF fits within historian, enterprise application, engineering information and cloud architectures.
* Select source-appropriate extractors, APIs and processing patterns, considering latency, throughput, connectivity and source-system load.
* Define historical loading, incremental extraction, reconciliation and recovery approaches, including late records, corrections and supported deletions.
* Establish requirements for service identities, access capabilities, environment separation, monitoring and operational support.

**Industrial information modelling**

* Design CDF models using spaces, containers, views and instances; select direct relations or edges according to relationship semantics and query requirements.
* Reuse and extend Cognite’s Core Data Model where suitable, introducing custom domain concepts where required.
* Define stable identifiers, source crosswalks and conflict-resolution rules, including repeated tag names across sites and systems.
* Represent physical equipment, functional locations and installation history separately where required.
* Establish schema versioning, migration and consumer-compatibility requirements while preserving lineage, timestamps, units, quality indicators and relationship provenance.

**Contextualization and Oil & Gas semantics**

* Design relationships connecting equipment and assets with time series, maintenance records, documents and engineering diagrams.
* Define matching rules, confidence thresholds, exception handling and domain review for ambiguous associations; assess coverage and match accuracy separately.
* For upstream applications, model fields, wells, wellbores, production facilities, equipment, well tests and interventions, preserving distinctions between measured, calculated and allocated production.
* For downstream applications, model sites, process units, functional locations, equipment, laboratory results and maintenance activities, accounting for replacement, revisions and measurement timing.
* Validate that contextualized information supports the intended engineering workflow.
* Application enablement and technical assurance
* Define consumer data contracts covering entities, relationships, fields, freshness, permissions and query-performance expectations.
* Validate designs against representative Cognite applications, custom applications, and analytical or AI workflows.
* Develop critical prototypes and reference implementations using Python, SQL, Cognite SDKs and APIs.
* Establish deployment and environment-promotion practices using version control, automated validation and Cognite Toolkit.
* Review architecture changes, migration plans, integration code and performance bottlenecks; resolve cross-system design conflicts and mentor data engineering leads.

**Must Have Qualifications & Experience**

* A relevant engineering, computer science or information systems degree, or equivalent technical experience.
* Demonstrated personal architectural contribution to a production Cognite Data Fusion implementation.
* Strong knowledge of CDF data modelling, transformations, contextualization and access controls.
* Substantial industrial data integration experience spanning representative operational, enterprise and engineering sources.
* Strong Python and SQL skills with practical Cognite SDK and REST API experience.
* Experience defining identity strategies, model evolution, deployment patterns and production support requirements.
* Working knowledge of cloud architecture, identity providers, network boundaries and CI/CD.
* Strong Oil & Gas implementation experience in at least one upstream or downstream domain, with ability to adapt relevant concepts to the other.

**Good to Have**

* Cognite implementation experience across multiple assets or sites.
* Experience spanning both upstream and downstream.
* Familiarity with historians, maintenance systems, laboratory systems, engineering repositories or well-data services.
* Experience with diagram contextualization, 3D associations and industrial knowledge graphs.
* Experience enabling Cognite applications or AI workflows using contextualized data.
* Relevant Cognite Academy training or certifications.

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to solve high-impact industrial data and analytics challenges across upstream and downstream Oil & Gas.
* A hands-on leadership role with scope to establish reusable practices and guide multidisciplinary teams.
* A collaborative environment spanning domain engineering, data, technology, product and global EY teams.
* Access to EY’s global network, technology ecosystem and learning opportunities while contributing to a better working world.

**What We Look For**
A hands-on architect who can defend consequential production Cognite decisions involving identity resolution, data-model design, access boundaries, recovery, schema migration and application compatibility, and demonstrate which patterns can be reused across sites and which require adaptation.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
  
  
**Organizational Overview**
The Security Architecture organization enables Synchrony to innovate and grow securely by embedding security-by-design into technology solutions. We partner with engineering, platform, data, cloud, and business teams to translate security strategy and evolving threats into practical architecture requirements, reusable patterns, blueprints, and guardrails. Through risk-based architecture reviews, threat modeling, and scalable security guidance, the team helps protect Synchrony’s digital assets and customer data while supporting resilient, compliant, and efficient technology delivery. This role will contribute to advancing our AI Security Architecture capabilities, helping establish secure patterns and assurance practices for Generative AI, AI agents, and other emerging AI technologies.
  
  
**Role Summary/Purpose**
**The AVP, AI Security Architect**
will design and advance security architectures for Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, Machine Learning, and emerging AI technologies. The role will translate enterprise security strategy and evolving AI threats into practical requirements, reusable patterns, and engineering guidance that enable secure innovation while protecting company, customer, and sensitive data.
  
  
Working across Cybersecurity, Technology, Data, AI/ML Engineering, Cloud, Risk, and Business teams, the architect will lead solution-level security assessments, contribute to enterprise standards, and embed security-by-design through threat modeling, control validation, testing, and continuous assurance across the AI lifecycle.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Apply and help mature enterprise AI security architecture principles, standards, reference architectures, and guardrails.
* Design reusable security patterns for Generative AI, copilots, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), model and inference APIs, autonomous or agentic AI, and enterprise AI platforms.
* Lead security architecture assessments for complex AI solutions across cloud, SaaS, API, data, application, and enterprise technology environments.
* Partner with AI/ML engineers, application teams, cloud architects, data teams, and product owners to embed security throughout design, development, deployment, integration, monitoring, and retirement.
* Perform AI threat modeling using MITRE ATLAS and OWASP guidance, translating identified threats into actionable controls and engineering requirements.
* Define and validate controls for model access, identities, service accounts, secrets, APIs, prompts, training and retrieval data, outputs, plugins, tools, and third-party AI services.
* Assess risks such as prompt injection, data poisoning, sensitive information disclosure, insecure tool interaction, excessive agency, model manipulation, and AI supply-chain compromise.

* Manage and maintain core Apigee components such as Routers, Message Processors, MART, Synchronizer, UDCA, Postgres, Zookeeper, Cassandra, and runtime infrastructure.

* Incident Management & RCA: Own and resolve P1/P2 high-severity incidents with quick response and deep technical troubleshooting.
* Perform detailed Root Cause Analysis (RCA), document post-incident reports, and drive permanent corrective actions.
* Lead communication handling during major incidents and coordinate with cross-functional teams.
* Support Process Management: Oversee ticket lifecycle management, SLA adherence, and escalation handling across support tiers.
* Act as the primary technical liaison between Support, Engineering, Cloud, Network, Security, and Architecture teams.
* Deployment & Release Support: Support API proxy deployments, shared flows, developer portal configurations, and runtime troubleshooting.
* Debug policy-level issues (JavaCallout, JS, Python, OAuth, JWT, KVM, Target Server configs, mTLS, etc.).
* Collaborate with engineering to validate release changes, certify upgrades, and improve CI/CD pipelines.
* Upgrades, Patching & Performance: Plan and execute version upgrades, patching cycles, infrastructure migrations, and configuration refactoring.
* Conduct capacity planning, performance profiling, load testing support, and platform tuning.
* Oversee TLS certificate renewals, key management, rotation, and platform security posture.
* DataPower Operations: Operate and support IBM DataPower Gateways, including configuration of Multi-Protocol Gateways (MPGW), WS-Proxies, Cryptographic profiles, XSLT, GatewayScript services.

* Automation, IaC & Reliability Engineering: Expertise knowledge in Ansible, python, Unix scripting and contribute automating tasks like Monitoring & alerting, Deployment workflows, Health checks, Incident response, Config validation.
* Implement reliability improvements through Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) using Terraform, Ansible, and GitOps.
* Develop automated recovery scripts and tools to reduce manual operational overhead.
* Observability, Monitoring & Alerting: Establish and maintain observability using: Splunk, ELK, Grafana, Prometheus, Dynatrace / AppDynamics
* Build dashboards for SLIs/SLOs, latency, error analysis, backend performance, and capacity metrics.
* Improve proactive alerting to reduce mean time to detect (MTTD) and mean time to recover (MTTR).
* Governance, Change & Architectural Engagement: Participate in design discussions, architectural reviews, API governance activities, and platform modernization initiatives.
* Work with CAB (Change Advisory Board) for change planning, approvals, and execution tracking.
* Contribute to runbooks, SOPs, architectural diagrams, and platform knowledge base assets.
