title: Sr BI Platform Administrator
description:
**Company Description**

**CREATIVITY IS OUR SUPERPOWER**. It’s our heritage and it’s also our future. Because we don’t just make toys. We create innovative products and experiences that inspire, entertain and develop children through play. Mattel is at its best when every member of our team feels respected, included, and heard—when everyone can show up as themselves and do their best work every day. We value and share an infinite range of ideas and voices that evolve and broaden our perspectives with a reach that extends into all our brands, partners, and suppliers.

**The Team**

As part of the Global Technology Organization, the aim of Enterprise Data and Analytics (ED&A) team is to enable Mattel as a data-driven organization, by:

* Delivering high-quality data for self-service analytics and data science through a modern data platform aligned with business strategy.
* Ensuring trusted, governed, and well-managed enterprise data.
* Maximizing the availability and value of enterprise information assets.
* Providing scalable analytics platforms, semantic models, and tools that empower business users.
* Promoting enterprise-wide adoption of analytics through education, governance, and continuous improvement.

  
**Job Description**

Mattel is seeking a **Senior BI Platform Administrator**, based in our Technology & Innovation Center in Hyderabad, India, reporting to the IT Director, Enterprise Data & Analytics.

This role is responsible for the administration, governance, security, performance, availability, and continuous improvement of Mattel's enterprise Business Intelligence platforms, including **ThoughtSpot Cloud, Tableau Cloud/Server, and IBM Cognos Analytics on Cloud**. The Senior BI Platform Administrator partners closely with Business Intelligence Developers, Data Engineers, Cloud Engineers, Information Security, Enterprise Architecture, and business stakeholders to ensure that Mattel's reporting platforms remain highly available, secure, scalable, and optimized for thousands of global users.

The successful candidate is a proactive technical leader who continually identifies opportunities to simplify administration, automate repetitive activities, improve platform reliability, and enhance the overall user experience. In addition to platform administration responsibilities, this individual possesses strong data analysis and reporting skills and is expected to contribute to report development, dashboard enhancements, and analytics initiatives as business priorities allow.

This is a critical role in enabling Mattel's enterprise reporting strategy while supporting the organization's ongoing analytics modernization initiatives.

**What Your Impact Will Be:**

**BI Platform Administration**

* Administer and support Mattel's enterprise BI platforms, including ThoughtSpot Cloud, Tableau Cloud/Server, and IBM Cognos Analytics on Cloud.
* Ensure high platform availability, reliability, scalability, and performance.
* Perform platform configuration, upgrades, patch validation, and release management activities.
* Monitor platform health, capacity, utilization, and performance trends.
* Troubleshoot complex platform issues and coordinate resolution with software vendors.
* Develop and maintain platform administration standards, operational procedures, and documentation.
* Manage production, development, test, and disaster recovery environments.

**Security & Governance**

* Administer user authentication, authorization, groups, roles, and permissions across all BI platforms.
* Partner with Identity Management and Information Security teams to implement secure authentication methods including SSO and MFA.
* Ensure compliance with enterprise security standards and audit requirements.
* Implement governance standards for content lifecycle management, naming conventions, certifications, and platform organization.
* Maintain platform metadata, user access reviews, and administrative audit reporting.

**Operational Excellence & Automation**

* Identify manual administrative activities that can be automated or streamlined.
* Develop scripts, utilities, and operational processes that improve administrator productivity and platform reliability.
* Establish proactive monitoring, alerting, and health dashboards.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives that reduce operational effort while improving service quality.
* Recommend platform enhancements and new capabilities that improve business value.

**Cloud Data Platform Integration**

* Partner with Data Engineering teams supporting Google Cloud Platform.
* Understand Google BigQuery architecture, datasets, permissions, and performance characteristics.
* Assist in troubleshooting connectivity between BI platforms and Google BigQuery.
* Support implementation of secure, performant connections between reporting platforms and enterprise data sources.
* Participate in platform architecture discussions involving cloud analytics technologies.

**Platform Migration & Modernization**

* Support enterprise reporting modernization initiatives.
* Assist with migration planning, platform assessments, validation, testing, and production cutover activities.
* Support migration of IBM Cognos content to ThoughtSpot and other strategic analytics platforms.
* Identify opportunities to improve migration processes, automation, and governance.
* Assist business users during platform transition activities.

**Analytics & Report Development**

* Perform data analysis to validate business requirements and troubleshoot reporting issues.
* Assist BI Developers with dashboard, report, and worksheet development during periods of available capacity.
* Develop and optimize SQL queries for reporting solutions.
* Support testing, deployment, and production validation of reporting enhancements.
* Participate in root cause analysis for data quality and reporting issues.

**Collaboration & Customer Support**

* Serve as an escalation point for complex platform administration issues.
* Partner with business users to resolve platform-related problems and improve user experience.
* Provide technical guidance to BI Developers regarding platform capabilities and best practices.
* Deliver administrator and end-user training sessions.
* Create and maintain platform documentation, knowledge articles, and operational runbooks.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Evaluate emerging BI technologies and recommend platform improvements.
* Promote best practices for platform administration, governance, security, and operational excellence.
* Lead initiatives that improve platform stability, user satisfaction, and administrative efficiency.
* Foster a culture of automation, innovation, and continuous improvement across Enterprise Data & Analytics.

  
**Qualifications**

**What We’re Looking For:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, Business Analytics, or related field.
* **7+ years** of progressive experience administering enterprise Business Intelligence platforms.
* Advanced administration experience with **ThoughtSpot Cloud**, **Tableau**, and **IBM Cognos Analytics**.
* Strong understanding of enterprise reporting architecture and analytics platform administration.
* Experience supporting cloud-based analytics platforms and Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) applications.
* Experience working with **Google Cloud Platform (GCP)**.
* Strong knowledge of **Google BigQuery**, including datasets, security, connectivity, and query performance concepts.
* Strong SQL skills for troubleshooting, validation, and data analysis.
* Experience administering enterprise security, authentication, authorization, and role-based access control.
* Experience with SAML, Single Sign-On (SSO), LDAP, OAuth, or similar authentication technologies.
* Experience monitoring platform health, capacity planning, and performance optimization.
* Experience creating administrative documentation, operational procedures, and knowledge articles.
* Demonstrated ability to identify automation opportunities and improve operational processes.
* Experience supporting large global user communities and mission-critical reporting platforms.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and root cause analysis skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and business audiences.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining high service levels.

  
**Additional Information**

**What It’s Like to Work Here**

We are a purpose driven company aiming to empower the next generation to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential. We live up to our purpose employing the following behaviors:

* **We collaborate:** Being a part of Mattel means being part of one team with shared values and common goals. Every person counts and working closely together always brings better results. Partnership is our process and our collective capabilities is our superpower.
* **We innovate:** At Mattel we always aim to find new and better ways to create innovative products and experiences. No matter where you work in the organization, you can always make a difference and have real impact. We welcome new ideas and value new initiatives that challenge conventional thinking.
* **We execute:** We are a performance driven company. We strive for excellence and are focused on pursuing best in class outcomes. We believe in accountability and ownership and know that our people are at their best when they are empowered to create and deliver results.

**Who We Are**

Mattel is a leading global toy company and owner of one of the strongest catalogs of children’s and family entertainment franchises in the world. We create innovative products and experiences that inspire, entertain and develop children through play. We engage consumers through our portfolio of iconic brands, including Barbie, Hot Wheels, Fisher-Price, American Girl, Thomas & Friends, UNO and MEGA, as well as other popular intellectual properties that we own or license in partnership with global entertainment companies. Our offerings include film and television content, gaming, music and live events. We operate in 35 locations and our products are available in more than 150 countries in collaboration with the world’s leading retail and ecommerce companies. Since its founding in 1945, Mattel is proud to be a trusted partner in empowering children to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential.

Visit us at https://jobs.mattel.com/ and www.instagram.com/MattelCareers.

Mattel is an Equal Opportunity Employer where we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day. We welcome all job seekers including minorities, females, individuals with disabilities, and those of all sexual orientations and gender identities.

title: Manager HR - Performance & Rewards
description:
Following are the Details of the Role .

Role:
**Manager – HR (Performance & Rewards)**

Location: Mumbai

Reports to: Head – Performance & Rewards

Employee numbers : 2500

**What you become a part of:**

Working directly with the Head – Performance & Rewards, the incumbent will run the annual performance management cycle end-to-end, execute the annual reward cycle and sales incentive schemes, build the monthly people dashboards that leadership uses to steer the business, and drive special projects that shapes how Performances are measured and rewarded .

It is a hands-on, deadline-driven role. The person will be close to the data, comfortable in the detail, and able to hold a global process to timeline across multiple geographies and Organizational Units (OUs). Design direction is set with the Head – Performance & Rewards; this role makes it happen, accurately and on time.

**What to expect:**

**Performance Management**

* Run the annual performance management cycle end-to-end across all Units – goal setting, mid-year review, year-end appraisal, calibration and moderation – to published timelines.
* Administer the cycle on the HR system and drive completion through structured follow-up with Unit HR and line managers.
* Prepare calibration and moderation packs – rating distributions, cross-Unit comparisons, outlier analysis - so that leadership can decide from clean data.
* Track cycle progress, publish completion scorecards, and escalate slippage early.
* Refresh goal-setting templates, rating guidelines each cycle in line with business priorities.
* Land the process with users: manager briefings, FAQs, toolkits and helpdesk support through the cycle.

**Rewards & Compensation**

* Execute the annual salary review and bonus cycle: build and issue templates, manage budget allocation and control, model scenarios, validate manager inputs, prepare approval packs and generate letters.
* Administer short-term incentive schemes – eligibility, computation, validation and payout, coordinated with Finance and Payroll.
* Own sales incentive schemes for field forces across geographies: model scheme options and payout curves, run monthly/quarterly computation, validate against sales data, publish achievement and payout reports, and resolve queries and disputes.
* Build offer, retention and out-of-cycle pay proposals with cost modelling, and test them against policy and internal parity.
* Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and internal policy across all performance and compensation activities.

**Analytics & Reporting**

title: Talent Strategy Lead
description:
**Who We Are**

ParamAIQ is building the AI brain for Indian law. Our agentic AI platform helps lawyers research, draft, and manage matters in a fraction of the time, powered by our proprietary 7-Gate Verification Framework that keeps AI answers accurate and trustworthy.

We’re not adding AI to old tools. We’re building the foundation for how legal work gets done in India.

**Why This Role Matters**

Our product is only as good as the people building it. You’ll be the one finding them.

You’ll hire our first engineers, AI/ML builders, data scientists, legal minds, and business leaders, and you’ll sit next to the founders while you do it. Your hires will decide how fast we move and who we become. This isn’t a recruiter seat. It’s a team-builder seat. About 70% of your time will go to talent acquisition. The rest goes to partnering with the business, building our employer brand, and setting up the people basics a growing team needs.

**What You’ll Own**

* Hire the builders (about 70% of the role): AI, ML, data, LLM, and agentic AI engineers, plus legal, product, sales, and ops talent. You own the full cycle from role definition to offer to joining.
* Find the unfindable: Source from LinkedIn, GitHub, AI communities, campuses, and your own network, including passive talent who aren’t looking. Start the conversation, build the relationship, and bring them on board.
* Close with conviction: Sell our vision, negotiate smartly, and win top talent without big-company budgets.
* Business partnering: Sit with founders and function heads to plan roles, timelines, and priorities as we scale. Turn what the business needs into clear hiring plans and push back when the brief is unclear.
* Stakeholder management: Keep founders, hiring managers, interviewers, candidates, and external partners aligned. Run interview panels, give clear feedback, and keep every hiring decision moving.
* Shape our brand: Make ParamAIQ the startup AI talent wants to join. Own our presence on LinkedIn and in AI communities, our campus outreach, and the story we tell candidates.
* Onboarding: Make the first weeks of every new hire smooth, so people who join are productive and stay.
* Build the hiring engine: Create lean processes, trackers, and metrics from scratch. Set up the ATS, report on pipeline health, and improve it over time.
* Light-touch HR foundations: Put in place simple policies, documentation, and people practices that scale with the team.

**What You Bring**

* 7 to 10 years in talent acquisition or HR, ideally at startups or fast-growing tech companies
* Proven hiring across AI, ML, data, and engineering, and the confidence to assess technical talent
* Experience hiring non-tech roles too, and the flexibility to switch gears when priorities change
* A strong grasp of the AI landscape (LLMs, agents, ML, data) and who’s actually good at it
* Comfort working closely with founders and senior leaders, and the confidence to challenge a brief
* Proven experience hiring passive candidates and bringing them through to joining
* Great communication and a knack for closing candidates
* An eye for employer branding, and some experience building it
* Zero attitude, 100% humility: mission over ego, always
* Fire in the belly: you love building under tight constraints and get it done
* Ready to work from our Mumbai office

**Bonus Points**

* Hired for AI-first, SaaS, or legal tech startups
* Built a TA function from zero
* Hired legal professionals or domain experts
* Hands-on with ATS tools and recruitment analytics
* A strong network in India’s AI and tech ecosystem
* Experience with employer branding campaigns, campus programmes, or community events

title: Senior Quant Trader
description:

**Locations:**
India & Global Markets

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

About the Role

We are looking for an exceptional
**Senior Quantitative Trader**
with proven experience in High-Frequency Trading (HFT) and Ultra-High-Frequency Trading (UHFT) to join our expanding quantitative trading business.

The ideal candidate will have a strong track record of developing, deploying, and managing fully automated systematic trading strategies, with a focus on alpha generation, market making, and short-horizon trading across multiple asset classes and global markets.

This is an opportunity to work with advanced trading infrastructure, substantial capital allocation, and a performance-driven environment where trading expertise and profitability are highly rewarded.

Key Responsibilities

* Design, develop, implement, and manage fully automated systematic trading strategies with short holding periods and high trading turnover.
* Research and deploy alpha-generating strategies, market-making models, and other high-frequency trading strategies.
* Conduct rigorous backtesting, simulation, and performance analysis using in-house research infrastructure.
* Identify market inefficiencies and develop quantitative models to generate consistent risk-adjusted returns.
* Monitor live trading performance, optimize execution, and continuously enhance strategy profitability.
* Analyse high-frequency tick-level market data to identify trading opportunities and improve strategy performance.
* Collaborate with quantitative researchers, developers, and infrastructure teams to enhance trading systems and execution efficiency.
* Manage trading risk, capital allocation, and strategy performance while maintaining strong risk-adjusted returns.

Candidate Requirements

* Extensive experience in High-Frequency Trading (HFT) or Ultra-High-Frequency Trading (UHFT).
* Minimum 3+ years of hands-on live HFT trading experience with a demonstrable P&L track record.
* Strong understanding of alpha generation, market making, statistical arbitrage, and systematic trading strategies.
* Proven ability to generate consistent profitability with strong Sharpe ratios and controlled drawdowns.
* Strong programming skills in C or C++.
* Proficiency in Python, R, or MATLAB for statistical modelling, quantitative research, and tick-data analysis.
* Experience working with large-scale market data, backtesting frameworks, and automated execution systems.
* Strong mathematical, statistical, and analytical capabilities.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mathematics, Engineering, Computer Science, Physics, Statistics, or another highly quantitative discipline.

What We Offer :

We offer a highly competitive and performance-driven compensation structure designed to attract and retain exceptional trading talent.

* **Exceptional Compensation:**
  Industry-leading fixed compensation packages, tailored to experience and performance.
* **Performance-Based Payouts:**
  Attractive P&L-sharing arrangements with a significant percentage of strategy-generated profits.
* **Flexible P&L Participation:**
  Opportunity to negotiate performance-linked incentives based on individual contribution, strategy profitability, and capital allocation.
* **Global Opportunities:**
  Opportunities to work across India and international trading locations.
* **Capital Allocation:**
  Access to substantial trading capital for proven strategies, subject to internal risk and allocation parameters.
* **Advanced Infrastructure:**
  Access to sophisticated, low-latency trading systems, execution technology, and in-house research infrastructure.
* **Research Autonomy:**
  Freedom to research, develop, test, and deploy innovative trading strategies.
* **Collaborative Environment:**
  Work alongside experienced quantitative traders, researchers, developers, and technology professionals.
* **Career Growth:**
  Opportunity to take ownership of trading strategies and grow into senior trading leadership roles.
* **Performance Recognition:**
  Compensation and incentives directly aligned with measurable trading performance.
* **Relocation Support:**
  Relocation assistance and visa support for eligible international opportunities.
* **Additional Benefits:**
  Competitive benefits package, subject to location and employment structure.

Compensation Structure

The compensation package will be customised based on the candidate's experience, live trading track record, strategy performance, and capital requirements.

It may include:

* Competitive fixed salary.
* Performance-linked annual bonuses.
* Attractive P&L-sharing percentage.
* Strategy-specific profit participation.
* Additional incentives for consistent profitability and long-term performance.

**We are particularly interested in traders with proven live strategies, independently verifiable P&L records, strong Sharpe ratios, and the ability to scale profitable trading strategies.**

Interested Candidates

If you are an experienced HFT/UHFT trader looking to scale your strategies, access advanced trading infrastructure, and participate in an attractive performance-linked compensation structure, we would love to connect.

**Let's build the next generation of systematic trading strategies together.**

title: Solution Engineer
description:
Job Title: Solution Engineer / Pre-Sales – Cybersecurity

Experience: 4–6 Years

Domain: VAPT, Red Teaming, Application & Network Security

Employment Type: Full-Time

Role Overview

We are looking for a technically strong and client-facing Solution Engineer / Pre-Sales professional with experience in Vulnerability Assessment & Penetration Testing (VAPT), Red Teaming, Application Security, Network Security, and Cybersecurity consulting.

The candidate will be responsible for understanding customer security requirements, designing appropriate security assessment solutions, preparing technical proposals and Statements of Work (SoWs), conducting solution presentations and supporting the sales team throughout the pre-sales cycle.

Key Responsibilities

1. Pre-Sales & Solution

* Understand customer requirements and translate them into appropriate cybersecurity solutions.
* Design solutions for VAPT, Red Teaming, Application Security, Network Security, Cloud Security and Security Assessments.
* Define assessment scope, methodology, assumptions, deliverables and timelines.
* Prepare technical proposals, SoWs, RFP/RFI responses and solution presentations.
* Provide effort estimation, resource planning and project timelines.
* Participate in customer meetings, requirement-gathering sessions and technical discussions.
* Conduct technical presentations, solution walkthroughs and demonstrations.
* Work closely with sales, delivery and cybersecurity teams to ensure proposed solutions are technically feasible.

2. VAPT & Security Assessment Knowledge

* Strong understanding of Web Application, API, Mobile Application and Network VAPT.
* Good understanding of OWASP Top 10, OWASP API Security Top 10 and common security vulnerabilities.
* Knowledge of vulnerability identification, exploitation, risk rating and remediation.
* Understanding of infrastructure security assessments, firewall reviews, configuration reviews and wireless security assessments.
* Ability to define appropriate testing methodologies based on customer requirements.

3. Red Teaming & Adversary Simulation

* Understanding of Red Teaming, Adversary Simulation, Attack Path Analysis and Threat-Based Security Assessments.
* Knowledge of Red Team phases such as:
* Reconnaissance
* Initial Access
* Privilege Escalation
* Lateral Movement
* Persistence
* Defense Evasion
* Command & Control
* Data Discovery / Exfiltration
* Understanding of MITRE ATT&CK framework and attack techniques.
* Ability to explain the difference between VAPT, Red Teaming, Purple Teaming and Vulnerability Scanning.
* Experience in defining Red Team objectives, Rules of Engagement (RoE), scope and success criteria.

4. Technical Solution Development

* Map customer requirements to appropriate security testing activities.
* Develop assessment approaches covering:
* Web/API VAPT
* Mobile VAPT
* Network VAPT
* Cloud Security
* Active Directory / ID Security
* Wireless Security
* Firewall Configuration Review
* Source Code Review
* Threat Modeling
* Red Team / Adversary Simulation
* Phishing / Social Engineering Assessments
* Identify dependencies, prerequisites, access requirements and testing limitations.
* Coordinate with technical teams to validate proposed approaches and estimates.

5. Customer Engagement

* Act as a technical point of contact during the pre-sales lifecycle.
* Conduct discovery workshops and requirement discussions with customers.
* Understand the customer's business objectives, technology landscape and security concerns.
* Explain technical findings and proposed security solutions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Handle technical queries and objections during sales discussions.
* Support Proof of Concept (PoC), demonstrations and pilot engagements where required.

**Requirements**

Required Technical Skills

* Strong knowledge of VAPT and penetration testing methodologies.
* Good understanding of web applications, APIs, mobile applications and network infrastructure.
* Knowledge of common security tools such as:
* Burp Suite
* Nessus
* Nmap
* Metasploit
* Wireshark
* Kali Linux tools
* Knowledge of OWASP, MITRE ATT&CK and PTES.
* Understanding of Active Directory and identity security.
* Understanding of cloud security concepts across AWS/Azure/GCP.
* Knowledge of security architecture and threat modeling.
* Ability to understand technical architecture diagrams and identify security testing requirements.

Pre-Sales Skills

* Strong proposal and technical documentation skills.
* Experience preparing RFP/RFI responses, SoWs, BOQs and technical proposals.
* Ability to estimate effort in person-days/man-days.
* Strong presentation and communication skills.
* Ability to conduct technical discussions with CISOs, security teams, architects and IT teams.
* Ability to work with sales teams to identify opportunities and create security solutions.
* Good negotiation and stakeholder-management skills.

title: Global Service Delivery Manager
description:
**Role Overview**
The Global Field Services Manager is responsible for leading two core functions: Local EUC and EUC Services. Local EUC provides onsite and regional technology support across corporate offices, retail locations, airport sites, vaults, data centre locations and other operational environments. EUC Services acts as the third-line, centrally managed EUC capability, responsible for workstation endpoint, OS hardening, patching, software deployments, mobile device management, device lifecycle management, endpoint compliance and other centrally controlled EUC services.
  
  
The successful candidate will provide strong operational leadership across both functions, ensuring that onsite support and centrally managed EUC services are responsive, secure, consistent and aligned to global IT design standards. The role will work closely with Global Service Delivery, Network Operations, Infrastructure, Security, Retail Operations, Facilities, Change Management, vendors and country leadership teams to ensure local and central EUC services remain stable, supportable and fit for business use.
  
  
**Role Purpose**
The purpose of this role is to provide global leadership for the Local EUC and EUC Services functions, ensuring Travelex colleagues and operational sites receive consistent, high-quality onsite technology support while also benefiting from a robust, centrally managed third-line EUC service. The role will drive standardisation, accountability, lifecycle discipline, endpoint compliance and continual service improvement across both regional field support and centrally managed EUC capabilities.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Global Field Services Leadership**

* Lead the Global Field Services function across two core capabilities: Local EUC and EUC Services.
* Define and maintain the global operating model for both functions, including roles, responsibilities, escalation paths, service standards, technical ownership boundaries and governance routines.
* Ensure Local EUC and EUC Services operate as an integrated support model, with clear hand-offs between onsite support, second-line support, third-line engineering and central service ownership.
* Ensure services are delivered consistently across regions, while allowing controlled local adaptation where business, regulatory or operational requirements justify it.
* Act as the senior escalation point for field services and EUC service issues impacting business operations, colleague productivity, retail trading, endpoint compliance or site readiness.
* Develop a high-performing, customer-focused and accountable global field services culture across both local and central EUC teams.

**Local EUC and Workplace Technology Support**

* Own the delivery of onsite support for end-user devices, workplace technology and local infrastructure across global sites.
* Ensure effective support for laptops, desktops, mobile devices, operating systems, Microsoft 365, collaboration tools, printers, scanners, peripherals, meeting-room technology and approved business applications.
* Oversee executive and VIP support standards, ensuring responsive and professional service for senior stakeholders while maintaining consistent service principles for all users.
* Drive improvements in first-time fix, ageing ticket reduction, service quality, knowledge management and user experience.
* Work closely with EUC Services to ensure endpoint standards, deployment models and support playbooks are understood and adopted consistently by Local EUC and field teams.

**EUC Services and Third-Line Endpoint Engineering**

* Lead EUC Services as the third-line, centrally managed EUC capability responsible for endpoint engineering, standards, control and service reliability.
* Own central EUC responsibilities including OS hardening, patching, endpoint configuration, software packaging, software deployments, mobile device management, endpoint compliance and centrally managed EUC tooling.
* Ensure EUC Services defines and maintains global endpoint build standards, baseline configurations, deployment models, support playbooks and technical acceptance criteria.
* Provide technical escalation and engineering support for complex endpoint, operating-system, application deployment, MDM and device compliance issues that cannot be resolved through local or second-line support.
* Partner with Security, Infrastructure, IT Asset Management and Change Management to ensure endpoint services meet cyber, operational, lifecycle and compliance requirements.
* Drive automation, standardisation and proactive remediation across endpoint services, reducing manual effort and improving resilience, compliance and employee experience.

**Retail, Vault and Site Technology Operations**

* Lead field services support for retail and operational site technology, including tills, workstations, rate boards, local connectivity, peripherals, branch technology, vault support equipment and other approved site devices.
* Ensure technology incidents affecting retail trading, customer-facing services, site openings or operational continuity receive appropriate priority and ownership.
* Partner with Retail Operations, Facilities, Network Operations, Infrastructure and Application Support teams to support site openings, relocations, refurbishments, closures and technology remediation activity.
* Maintain strong operational controls for hardware inventory, site records, local support documentation and technology acceptance evidence.
* Support the adoption of a global Retail Technology Blueprint, ensuring sites are assessed against agreed hardware, configuration, security, resilience and supportability standards.

**Endpoint Lifecycle, Asset, Configuration and Compliance Management**

* Own the combined Local EUC and EUC Services execution model for endpoint build, deployment, replacement, recovery, decommissioning and disposal activities in line with global standards.
* Ensure accurate asset, stock, warranty, ownership, location, configuration and lifecycle information is maintained for equipment managed by field and EUC teams.
* Drive remediation of ageing, unsupported, duplicate, missing, non-compliant or under-utilised devices in partnership with IT Asset Management, Security and EUC Services.
* Oversee centrally managed EUC activities including operating-system upgrades, workstation changes, MDM adoption, software deployments, OS hardening, endpoint patching and endpoint compliance initiatives.
* Ensure Local EUC and EUC Services teams follow controlled processes for secure disposal, data protection, evidence capture, CMDB updates and compliance reporting.

**Service Management and Operational Governance**

* Ensure all field services work is managed through the ITSM platform with clear ownership, accurate categorisation, timely updates and complete resolution notes.
* Establish and monitor field services KPIs, including SLA performance, ticket age, backlog, repeat incidents, customer satisfaction, site readiness, asset accuracy and remediation progress.
* Contribute to incident, major incident, problem and change management processes where onsite support, local infrastructure or site technology is required.
* Drive root-cause analysis and corrective action for recurring local technology issues.
* Create consistent governance routines, reporting packs and operational reviews for regional teams, vendors and senior stakeholders.

**Security, Risk and Compliance**

* Ensure local technology services comply with Travelex security standards, endpoint configuration requirements, access control expectations and operational policies.
* Support vulnerability remediation, endpoint protection, encryption, secure configuration, software compliance and device hygiene activities across the global site estate.
* Ensure suspected security incidents are escalated promptly and relevant evidence is preserved in line with incident response procedures.
* Support audit, risk, regulatory and compliance evidence requests relating to local technology, end-user devices, site equipment and field services processes.
* Promote a security-first culture within field teams, ensuring convenience and speed are balanced with appropriate control and risk management.

**Transformation, Automation and Continuous Improvement**

* Lead field services participation in technology transformation programmes, including ITSM platform uplift, endpoint modernisation, site technology refreshes, security improvements and operational standardisation.
* Identify opportunities to automate repeatable support activities, improve self-service, enable shift-left support and reduce unnecessary onsite demand.
* Use service data, operational insight and regional feedback to drive measurable improvement in service quality, cost efficiency and operational resilience.
* Support global standardisation of workstation builds, site technology design, support documentation, deployment processes and operating procedures.
* Champion pragmatic innovation, including AI-enabled knowledge management, predictive support insights and improved field service scheduling where appropriate.

**Stakeholder, Supplier and Regional Management**

* Build trusted relationships with country leadership, Retail Operations, Facilities, Technology teams, Service Delivery and third-party suppliers.
* Translate local operational needs into clear global requirements, ensuring local teams have a voice in central technology decisions.
* Manage regional escalations, service risks, resourcing pressures, supplier issues and delivery dependencies.
* Ensure vendor activity is governed effectively, including site access, quality assurance, documentation, service acceptance and escalation management.
* Provide clear and concise reporting to senior leadership on field services performance, risks, issues, priorities and improvement plans.

**Essential Experience**
**Experience and Skills Required**

* Significant experience leading field services, Local EUC, deskside support, EUC engineering, workplace technology or regional IT support functions in a complex multi-site organisation.
* Proven experience managing geographically distributed teams across multiple countries, regions or time zones.
* Strong understanding of retail technology support, corporate workplace technology, endpoint lifecycle management, local infrastructure support and centrally managed EUC services.
* Experience leading or working closely with a third-line EUC capability responsible for endpoint engineering, OS hardening, patching, software deployments, MDM, endpoint compliance and technical escalation.
* Experience operating within ITIL-aligned incident, request, problem, change and service transition processes.
* Strong knowledge of Microsoft 365, Windows/MacOS endpoint environments, mobile device management, endpoint deployment, collaboration tools and workplace technologies.
* Experience managing operational performance through KPIs, SLAs, service reviews, governance forums and continuous improvement plans.
* Demonstrable experience supporting business-critical sites, including retail, airport, branch, vault, warehouse, operational or customer-facing environments.
* Experience working in a global, matrixed, multi-vendor technology environment.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, including the ability to influence senior business, technology and regional leaders.

**Desirable Experience**

* Experience within financial services, payments, retail, travel, foreign exchange, aviation or another regulated customer-facing sector.
* Experience delivering hardware refresh, operating-system upgrade, site technology refresh, MDM, endpoint compliance or workstation standardisation programmes.
* Experience operating within or partnering with a Global Capability Centre or offshore support model.
* Experience with endpoint management tooling such as Microsoft Intune, Windows Autopilot, Apple MacOS, Ivanti, Jamf, Entra ID, Active Directory, remote support tools and asset discovery platforms.
* Experience improving asset accuracy, stock control, device lifecycle governance and field service scheduling.
* Experience supporting audit, cyber security, risk or compliance evidence activities relating to endpoint and site technologies.

**Leadership and Behavioural Expectations**

* Leads with ownership, accountability and a strong service mindset.
* Builds high-performing teams across different regions, cultures and working models.
* Communicates clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders, including senior leaders.
* Balances urgency with control, ensuring service issues are resolved quickly without compromising security, governance or quality.
* Uses data and operational insight to drive better decisions, prioritisation and service improvements.
* Creates a culture of collaboration, standardisation, continuous improvement and customer service excellence.
* Demonstrates resilience and calm leadership during high-pressure incidents, escalations and business-critical service issues.

**Qualifications And Certifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Information Systems or equivalent professional experience.
* ITIL certification is strongly preferred.
* Relevant Microsoft, endpoint management, service management, project delivery or leadership certifications are advantageous.
* Additional qualifications in IT asset management, cyber security, Lean, Agile, Prince2, COBIT or SIAM are desirable.

title: Brand Deals Executive.
description:
Brand Deals Executive
  
  
The Perfume Vault | Independent Fragrance Content Creator
  
  
About the role
  
  
I am an independent content creator who creates content around perfumes and the fragrance industry.
  
  
I currently have around 32,000 followers on Instagram and 6,000 subscribers on YouTube. I have also recently started a fragrance focused podcast.
  
  
I am looking for someone who can work directly with me and help bring paid brand collaborations and business opportunities for my social media platforms and podcast.
  
  
This is an individual working role. You will be working directly with me, not joining a marketing agency or a large company.
  
  
What will you be responsible for?
  
  
1. Bringing Brand Collaborations
  
  
- Find Indian and international perfume and fragrance brands that are interested in working with content creators.
  
- Approach brands and bring paid collaboration opportunities.
  
- Focus mainly on long-term partnerships and monthly deals rather than just one-time reel collaborations.
  
- Build good relationships with brands for future collaborations.
  
  
2. Contacting Brands and Closing Deals
  
  
- Find the right people to contact, such as marketing managers, brand managers, founders and other decision-makers.
  
- Reach out to them through email, LinkedIn, Instagram or other suitable channels.
  
- Introduce my content and explain why brands should work with me.
  
- Handle conversations, follow-ups and price negotiations.
  
- Take responsibility for finalising deals and bringing paid work.
  
  
3. Finding Guests for the Podcast
  
  
- Find interesting people from the fragrance industry for podcast appearances.
  
- Connect with perfume brand founders, perfumers, fragrance experts and other relevant personalities.
  
- Contact them, explain the podcast and coordinate their appearance on the show.
  
  
4. Bringing Podcast Sponsors
  
  
- Find perfume and fragrance-related brands that could sponsor the podcast.
  
- Approach potential sponsors and discuss paid sponsorship opportunities.
  
- Negotiate and finalise sponsorship deals.
  
- Look for long-term podcast sponsorships.
  
  
Who am I looking for?
  
  
- Someone with experience in influencer marketing, brand collaborations or bringing brand deals to individual content creators.
  
- Someone who understands how to approach brands and reach the right decision-makers.
  
- Someone who has experience communicating with brands, negotiating prices and closing paid deals.
  
- Someone with good contacts in perfume, grooming, lifestyle or related industries.
  
- Someone who can independently handle the work instead of waiting for instructions every day.
  
- Good communication and negotiation skills are important.
  
  
Important: I am particularly interested in someone who has worked with individual content creators and helped them get paid brand collaborations. Experience working only in an agency or handling large influencer campaigns is not enough by itself.
  
  
Work Details
  
  
- Work Type: Full-time
  
- Work Setup: Remote
  
- Working Directly With: Independent Content Creator
  
- Salary: ₹30,000–₹40,000 per month, depending on experience.
  
- Additional Incentives: Can be discussed based on performance.
  
- Experience: Prior relevant experience preferred.
  
  
One important thing
  
  
I am not looking for someone whose only job is to send emails or messages to brands.
  
  
I am looking for someone who can take responsibility for finding opportunities, contacting the right people, negotiating, closing paid deals and helping grow The Perfume Vault and its podcast.
  
  
If you have the experience and confidence to bring actual business, I would love to hear from you.
  
  
To apply: Please share your experience in influencer marketing or brand collaborations, examples of deals you have personally helped close.

title: Category Manager
description:
**Urgent Hiring || E Commerce Head || Mumbai**

Location: Goregaon, Mumbai

Job Title: Category Head/Category Leader

Experience- 5+ years

Ctc- upto 15 Lpa (Depends on interview)

Working Days- 6 days (2nd & 4th Saturday off)

**Key Responsibilities:**

1. E-commerce Portal Management:

* Oversee the overall performance and optimization of e-commerce platforms to ensure seamless user experience and brand consistency.
* Manage product listings, promotions, and campaigns to maximize visibility and conversions.

2. Vendor Management:

* Manage existing vendors while onboarding new brands and partners to expand the product portfolio.
* Build and maintain strong vendor relationships, ensuring alignment on pricing, terms, and performance metrics.

3. Driving Sales Growth:

* Strategically drive both top-line revenue and bottom-line profitability by implementing effective pricing, promotional, and sales strategies.
* Set and achieve sales targets for specific categories through focused planning and execution.

4. Cost Profit Analysis & Budgeting:

* Conduct detailed cost-profit analysis to assess the financial viability of strategies and campaigns.
* Prepare and manage sales budgets, ensuring optimal allocation of resources for category performance.

5. Inventory Management & Order Processing:

* Monitor inventory levels to ensure availability while minimizing overstock and wastage.
* Oversee the end-to-end order processing cycle to meet customer expectations and delivery timelines.

6. Category Selection & Negotiation:

* Build and expand product selections while negotiating favorable terms with vendors.
* Develop pricing strategies that balance competitiveness with profitability.

7. Sales Deals & Market Implementation:

* Plan and execute sales deals, promotions, and seasonal campaigns to drive customer engagement and revenue growth.
* Implement these strategies effectively across online channels and markets.

8. Market Leadership & Strategic Positioning:

* Create and maintain a leading market position for assigned categories, driving customer loyalty and significant market share growth.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure the unique positioning of new product offerings in the market.

9. Business Planning & Communication:

* Develop long-term business plans for specific categories, focusing on growth and innovation.
* Ensure effective communication of category strategies across internal teams and stakeholders.

10. Phase 2 Development:

* Support the development of new product offerings while ensuring differentiation and strategic market entry.
* Identify opportunities for innovation and growth in existing and emerging categories.

11. Negotiation & Financial Awareness:

* Lead negotiations with a strong understanding of commercial and financial principles to secure advantageous agreements.
* Analyze market trends to adapt strategies that maximize profitability and competitiveness.

**Other Skills**

* Hardworking and ability to meet deadlines
* Reliability and stability
* Prior experience in a Ecommerce company will be an added advantage Ability to apply high attention to detail
* Ability to work independently and in a very dynamic environment
* Strong analytical and communication skills (internally and externally)
* Experience in leading supplier negotiations
* Distinct ability to understand and implement customer needs and market Requirements
* Proficient in MS-Office, especially in MS Excel and PowerPoint
* Excellent verbal and written English language skills, further languages are an advantage

title: Visualizer
description:
Experience: 2–3 Years
  
  
Location: On-site
  
  
Reporting To: Art Director
  
  
Qualification: Design/Art School background preferred
  
  
We are looking for a creative and concept-driven Visualizer who can turn briefs and ideas into strong, contemporary visual executions. The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of visual communication, composition, typography, imagery and visual storytelling, with the ability to think beyond execution and contribute to the creative thought process. You will work closely with the Art Director and creative team across social media, performance campaigns, brand communication and pitch decks. You should be curious about global creative work, emerging trends and new visual styles, with a strong eye for premium, high-quality design.
  
  
Who We’re Looking For
  
  
2–3 years of experience as a Visualizer, Graphic Designer, Art-based Creative or similar role.
  
  

* Strong experience in social media and digital creatives.
* Experience creating performance/paid social creatives.
* Expert knowledge of Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator.
* Strong conceptualisation, visualization and visual storytelling skills.
* Good understanding of composition, typography, hierarchy, colour and imagery.
* Ability to develop a visual direction, not just execute a given reference.
* Strong awareness of current social, design and editing trends.
* Regularly follows global brands, agencies, designers and creative work.
* Comfortable working across different brands, categories and visual styles.
* Good communication skills and ability to explain creative thinking.
* Proactive, collaborative and open to feedback.
* Design/Art School qualification is a plus.

**Key Responsibilities**
Concept & Visualisation
  
  

* Translate briefs and creative ideas into strong visual concepts and executions.
* Explore compositions, imagery, typography and visual treatments to arrive at the right direction.
* Ensure work is creative, relevant, polished and brand-appropriate.

Social & Performance Creatives
  
  

* Create creatives for Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn and other digital platforms.
* Develop static posts, carousels, stories, digital ads and other social formats.
* Create performance-focused creatives with strong visual hooks, clear communication and variations when required.

Pitch Decks
  
  

* Develop visual directions, moodboards, key visuals and sample executions for pitch decks.
* Help create presentations with a strong, cohesive and premium visual narrative.

Trends & Inspiration
  
  

* Stay updated with global design, advertising, social media and editing trends.
* Research inspiring work from global brands, agencies and designers.
* Bring relevant references and new visual approaches to the team.

Collaboration & Quality
  
  

* Work closely with the Art Director, designers, copywriters and creative team.
* Take ownership from visualisation to final execution.
* Maintain high standards of craft, detail, typography, composition and overall visual quality.

Must Have
  
  

* Adobe Photoshop – Expert
* Adobe Illustrator – Expert
* Strong visualisation & conceptual thinking
* Composition & typography
* Visual storytelling
* Social media & performance creative experience
* Strong image manipulation skills
* Strong attention to detail
* Familiarity with AI creative tools such as ChatGPT Image Generation, Higgsfield, Magnific and other AI image/video tools Good to Have
* Basic After Effects / Premiere Pro
* Understanding of motion/editing trends
* Experience with creative pitch decks
* Design/Art School background

title: Social Media Assistant
description:
**Social Media Associate · ELVN Active**

**Mumbai (on-site) · Full-time · 1–3 yrs**

**ELVN Active**
is a premium activewear brand created for people who train, move, and live without compromise. The brand focuses on intentional, small-batch designs rather than mass production, ensuring each release is carefully considered. ELVN is actively scaling production, expanding its team, and building a community-first brand through direct, authentic engagement instead of discounts or short-lived trends. The company’s mission is to create activewear that feels like an extension of ambition, supporting a driven and active lifestyle.

**What you’ll do**

You’ll run ELVN’s social accounts day to day: plan the content calendar around our monthly drops, shoot and edit Reels on your phone, write captions in our voice, and manage comments and DMs. You’ll cover studio events and pop-ups live, coordinate creator collabs, and track what’s working each week so the best organic content can be run as paid ads.

**What we’re looking for**

You have 1–3 years running social for a D2C, fashion, beauty or fitness brand, plus a portfolio to show for it. You can shoot and edit quickly in CapCut or similar tools. You follow brands like Alo, Vuori and Adanola and can explain what makes their social feel premium. You’re organised, you move fast, and you enjoy owning things end to end. Being into fitness yourself is a plus.

**To apply:**
Send your CV, your portfolio, and one ELVN post you’d redo with a note on how, to hr@elvnactive.com

title: Talent Strategy Lead
description:
**Who We Are**

ParamAIQ is building the AI brain for Indian law. Our agentic AI platform helps lawyers research, draft, and manage matters in a fraction of the time, powered by our proprietary 7-Gate Verification Framework that keeps AI answers accurate and trustworthy.

We’re not adding AI to old tools. We’re building the foundation for how legal work gets done in India.

**Why This Role Matters**

Our product is only as good as the people building it. You’ll be the one finding them.

You’ll hire our first engineers, AI/ML builders, data scientists, legal minds, and business leaders, and you’ll sit next to the founders while you do it. Your hires will decide how fast we move and who we become. This isn’t a recruiter seat. It’s a team-builder seat. About 70% of your time will go to talent acquisition. The rest goes to partnering with the business, building our employer brand, and setting up the people basics a growing team needs.

**What You’ll Own**

* Hire the builders (about 70% of the role): AI, ML, data, LLM, and agentic AI engineers, plus legal, product, sales, and ops talent. You own the full cycle from role definition to offer to joining.
* Find the unfindable: Source from LinkedIn, GitHub, AI communities, campuses, and your own network, including passive talent who aren’t looking. Start the conversation, build the relationship, and bring them on board.
* Close with conviction: Sell our vision, negotiate smartly, and win top talent without big-company budgets.
* Business partnering: Sit with founders and function heads to plan roles, timelines, and priorities as we scale. Turn what the business needs into clear hiring plans and push back when the brief is unclear.
* Stakeholder management: Keep founders, hiring managers, interviewers, candidates, and external partners aligned. Run interview panels, give clear feedback, and keep every hiring decision moving.
* Shape our brand: Make ParamAIQ the startup AI talent wants to join. Own our presence on LinkedIn and in AI communities, our campus outreach, and the story we tell candidates.
* Onboarding: Make the first weeks of every new hire smooth, so people who join are productive and stay.
* Build the hiring engine: Create lean processes, trackers, and metrics from scratch. Set up the ATS, report on pipeline health, and improve it over time.
* Light-touch HR foundations: Put in place simple policies, documentation, and people practices that scale with the team.

**What You Bring**

* 7 to 10 years in talent acquisition or HR, ideally at startups or fast-growing tech companies
* Proven hiring across AI, ML, data, and engineering, and the confidence to assess technical talent
* Experience hiring non-tech roles too, and the flexibility to switch gears when priorities change
* A strong grasp of the AI landscape (LLMs, agents, ML, data) and who’s actually good at it
* Comfort working closely with founders and senior leaders, and the confidence to challenge a brief
* Proven experience hiring passive candidates and bringing them through to joining
* Great communication and a knack for closing candidates
* An eye for employer branding, and some experience building it
* Zero attitude, 100% humility: mission over ego, always
* Fire in the belly: you love building under tight constraints and get it done
* Ready to work from our Mumbai office

**Bonus Points**

* Hired for AI-first, SaaS, or legal tech startups
* Built a TA function from zero
* Hired legal professionals or domain experts
* Hands-on with ATS tools and recruitment analytics
* A strong network in India’s AI and tech ecosystem
* Experience with employer branding campaigns, campus programmes, or community events

title: Brand Deals Executive.
description:
Brand Deals Executive
  
  
The Perfume Vault | Independent Fragrance Content Creator
  
  
About the role
  
  
I am an independent content creator who creates content around perfumes and the fragrance industry.
  
  
I currently have around 32,000 followers on Instagram and 6,000 subscribers on YouTube. I have also recently started a fragrance focused podcast.
  
  
I am looking for someone who can work directly with me and help bring paid brand collaborations and business opportunities for my social media platforms and podcast.
  
  
This is an individual working role. You will be working directly with me, not joining a marketing agency or a large company.
  
  
What will you be responsible for?
  
  
1. Bringing Brand Collaborations
  
  
- Find Indian and international perfume and fragrance brands that are interested in working with content creators.
  
- Approach brands and bring paid collaboration opportunities.
  
- Focus mainly on long-term partnerships and monthly deals rather than just one-time reel collaborations.
  
- Build good relationships with brands for future collaborations.
  
  
2. Contacting Brands and Closing Deals
  
  
- Find the right people to contact, such as marketing managers, brand managers, founders and other decision-makers.
  
- Reach out to them through email, LinkedIn, Instagram or other suitable channels.
  
- Introduce my content and explain why brands should work with me.
  
- Handle conversations, follow-ups and price negotiations.
  
- Take responsibility for finalising deals and bringing paid work.
  
  
3. Finding Guests for the Podcast
  
  
- Find interesting people from the fragrance industry for podcast appearances.
  
- Connect with perfume brand founders, perfumers, fragrance experts and other relevant personalities.
  
- Contact them, explain the podcast and coordinate their appearance on the show.
  
  
4. Bringing Podcast Sponsors
  
  
- Find perfume and fragrance-related brands that could sponsor the podcast.
  
- Approach potential sponsors and discuss paid sponsorship opportunities.
  
- Negotiate and finalise sponsorship deals.
  
- Look for long-term podcast sponsorships.
  
  
Who am I looking for?
  
  
- Someone with experience in influencer marketing, brand collaborations or bringing brand deals to individual content creators.
  
- Someone who understands how to approach brands and reach the right decision-makers.
  
- Someone who has experience communicating with brands, negotiating prices and closing paid deals.
  
- Someone with good contacts in perfume, grooming, lifestyle or related industries.
  
- Someone who can independently handle the work instead of waiting for instructions every day.
  
- Good communication and negotiation skills are important.
  
  
Important: I am particularly interested in someone who has worked with individual content creators and helped them get paid brand collaborations. Experience working only in an agency or handling large influencer campaigns is not enough by itself.
  
  
Work Details
  
  
- Work Type: Full-time
  
- Work Setup: Remote
  
- Working Directly With: Independent Content Creator
  
- Salary: ₹30,000–₹40,000 per month, depending on experience.
  
- Additional Incentives: Can be discussed based on performance.
  
- Experience: Prior relevant experience preferred.
  
  
One important thing
  
  
I am not looking for someone whose only job is to send emails or messages to brands.
  
  
I am looking for someone who can take responsibility for finding opportunities, contacting the right people, negotiating, closing paid deals and helping grow The Perfume Vault and its podcast.
  
  
If you have the experience and confidence to bring actual business, I would love to hear from you.
  
  
To apply: Please share your experience in influencer marketing or brand collaborations, examples of deals you have personally helped close.

title: Sales Development Representative
description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.
  
  
**Sales Development Representative (Outbound) — Commercial**
At Snowflake, we are building the future of the data-driven enterprise. We are looking for a Sales Development Representative (Outbound) who thrives on the hunt — someone who creates pipeline from nothing, works at high volume, and knows how to qualify fast and move faster.
  
  
This is a pure outbound role targeting the commercial segment. There is no inbound queue to rely on. You will prospect cold, build your own account list when needed, and generate a consistent volume of high-quality meetings and opportunities for Account Executives. If you are motivated by the challenge of opening doors that aren't already open, this role is built for you.
  
  
The person we are looking for combines relentless outbound drive with sharp commercial judgement. You know how to find the right accounts, reach the right people, and quickly determine whether there's a real opportunity — or move on.
  
  
**AS A SALES DEVELOPMENT REPRESENTATIVE (OUTBOUND) AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:**

* Generate pipeline through high-volume outbound prospecting — cold calling, cold email, LinkedIn, and multi-channel sequencing
* Build and maintain your own target account lists using online research, intent signals, firmographic data, and competitive intelligence — with or without a pre-defined account set
* Meet and exceed activity and pipeline targets: 80+ meetings booked and 35+ qualified opportunities created per quarter
* Qualify and disqualify accounts quickly and accurately — identify fit, urgency, and buying potential without over-investing in low-probability accounts
* Engage commercial buyers with sharp, relevant messaging that connects Snowflake's platform value to their specific business context
* Partner with Account Executives to hand off well-qualified opportunities and support early deal progression
* Maintain disciplined CRM hygiene — accurate pipeline status, activity logging, and prospecting data to support forecasting and outreach effectiveness
* Develop strong working knowledge of Snowflake's data platform, key use cases, and competitive positioning to run credible outbound conversations

**OUR IDEAL SALES DEVELOPMENT REPRESENTATIVE (OUTBOUND) WILL HAVE:**

* 2–4 years of outbound SDR or inside sales experience, preferably in a commercial or high-velocity segment
* Proven track record of high-volume cold calling and outbound prospecting
* Strong ability to self-source accounts and build prospect lists independently, using tools like LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, or similar
* Speed and discipline in qualification — knows how to quickly identify whether an account is worth pursuing and when to move on
* Experience with outbound sequencing and sales engagement platforms (Outreach or Salesloft preferred)
* Proficiency with Salesforce CRM for pipeline tracking and activity management
* Strong verbal communication skills with the confidence and resilience required for high-volume cold outreach
* Curiosity about data, AI, and the enterprise technology landscape
* Ambition to grow into an Account Executive role and readiness to earn that progression through consistent outbound performance

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

title: Co-Founder Chief Revenue Officer
description:
Job Description: Co-Founder & Chief Revenue Officer (CRO) – India

Role Type: Executive Co-Founder / Founding Commercial Leader

Engagement Model: Founding Commercial Partnership (Expense Reimbursement + Success Commission + Equity Grant)

Core 90-Day Mission: Sales Closer — Secure 2 to 3 Paying Client Logos

Location: India (Remote / Field-based with local & intercity travel)

Reporting To: Board of Directors / Co-Founders

Executive Overview

Nonashield is seeking an execution-driven Co-Founder & Chief Revenue Officer (CRO) – India to join our founding team as our primary Sales Closer. In this high-impact co-founding role, your singular focus over the first 90 days will be to validate our commercial offering by originating, managing, and closing 2 to 3 enterprise client logos.

This position is structured as a Founding Commercial Partnership. Designed for a hands-on commercial leader with proven enterprise deal-closing ability, this role offers high commercial upside and co-founder equity ownership tied directly to customer acquisition and revenue collection.

 Primary 90-Day Mandate & Target

 Core Goal: Convert enterprise prospects into 2 to 3 signed, paying client logos within the 90-day validation period.

 Execution Focus: Drive rapid discovery, proof-of-value (PoV) trials, proposal delivery, and commercial negotiations to finalize paid contracts.

 Founder Alignment: Leverage dedicated technical, product, and proposal support from the founding team to accelerate deal cycles and overcome client objections.

 Core Responsibilities

 1. Enterprise Sales Closing & Pipeline Origination

 Originate, qualify, and lead high-priority enterprise opportunities across target sectors in India.

 Drive complete deal lifecycles from initial contact through executive presentations, commercial negotiations, and contract sign-off.

 Position Nonashield’s value proposition directly to $CXOs$, Heads of Procurement, and key technical decision-makers to secure fast commercial commitment.

 2. Deal Execution & Proof-of-Value Management

 Structure and manage targeted proof-of-value (PoV) or pilot programs designed to convert into multi-year production accounts.

 Partner with technical co-founders to align technical solutions with client business objectives.

 Ensure clear commercial terms, payment schedules, and onboarding pathways for all new client logos.

 3. Account Governance & Commercial Pipeline Tracking

 Maintain rigorous CRM tracking across all active account stages, deal values, and closing timelines.

 Operate within pre-approved customer acquisition budgets and account development logistics.

 Feed real-time client feedback back to the product and executive teams to optimize pricing and proposal win rates.

 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

 30-Day Milestone: Identify and qualify top 10 target accounts; establish active discovery and demonstration meetings with at least 5 decision-makers.

 60-Day Milestone: Advance 3 to 5 qualified opportunities into active PoV/pilot trials or final commercial proposal negotiations.

 90-Day Milestone: Successfully close and secure initial revenue collection from 2 to 3 enterprise client logos.

 Candidate Qualifications & Profile

 Proven Deal Closer: 8–15+ years of enterprise commercial experience with a track record of personally closing complex B2B SaaS, deep-tech, or enterprise solution deals in India.

 Execution-Minded: Highly outcome-oriented with the grit to navigate short, intense closing cycles in an early-stage startup environment.

 Enterprise Network: Strong existing network of corporate decision-makers, buyers, and channel partners across India.

 Negotiation & Deal Structuring: Strong skills in navigating enterprise procurement, legal reviews, and contract finalization.

 Communication: Exceptional storytelling, presentation, and executive relationship management skills.

 Commercial Structure & Compensation Framework

This position is structured as a Founding Commercial Partnership with Expense Reimbursement, Success-Based Commission, and Co-Founder Equity Participation. At this stage, Nonashield prioritizes market validation and client acquisition.

 1. Initial 90-Day Validation Period

 Fixed Retainer/Salary: None during the initial 90-day validation period, unless separately agreed in writing.

 Co-Founder Support: Dedicated technical, product, proposal, demonstration, and executive co-founder meeting support for qualified enterprise opportunities.

 Milestone Reviews: Formal reviews at Day 30, 60, and 90 evaluating pipeline velocity and deal progress toward the 2–3 logo objective.

 2. Expense Reimbursement

Reimbursement covers reasonable, necessary, and pre-approved expenses directly linked to documented customer acquisition and business development activities.

 3. Revenue Commission Structure

 Commission is payable exclusively on net customer revenue actually received by Nonashield, directly originating from and materially managed by the CRO.

 Commission Schedule: Commission rates, payment timelines, renewal terms, channel partner splits, founder-assisted attribution, tax withholdings, and refund/cancellation policies will be established in a separate Commission Schedule.

 Commission calculations account for deal margins, contract sizing, customer acquisition costs, sales-cycle length, and whether accounts are self-generated or co-founder-assisted.

 4. Co-Founder Equity & Vesting

 Grant Eligibility: Unlocked upon successful completion of the initial 90-day period and delivery of the 2 to 3 paying client logos mandate.

 Vesting Schedule: Co-founder equity grant subject to a 3-year vesting schedule linked to continued service and defined commercial performance milestones.

 Scope: Equity allocations reflect true co-founder status—building a repeatable revenue engine and securing early production accounts unlocks meaningful founding-tier equity ownership.

title: Senior Solution Consultant
description:
The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech. What drives us, is our aspiration, our desire and ambition to keep pushing the envelope, overcoming any hurdle, challenging the status quo to continually find a better way. You will experience these qualities of passion, pride and aspiration in many ways — from a rich set of career development programs to support of community service projects to social events that foster fun and relationship building across our global community.
  
  
**The Role**
**Your Impact**
As a Sr Solution Consultant, you will partner with AspenTech sales teams during the sales cycle to lead in the consultative discovery process with customers; craft a vision and roadmap of a solution that addresses customer requirements; identify differentiated value capture potential; and design an implementation/sustainment program for that solution. The Sr Solution Consultant is responsible for delivering high quality solutions and business outcomes based on existing AspenTech products. Demonstrating deep knowledge of the solutions and offerings, capable of contributing to the design of a complete solution across the entire lifecycle of a project - from pre-sales through design and delivery of the solution - the Solution Consultant drives transformational results and realizes business strategy for AspenTech customers.
  
  
This is a customer-facing role that requires self-motivated individuals with excellent business, industry and technical knowledge, along with strong consultative and communication skills to position AspenTech solutions and services with our customers.
  
  
The ideal candidate will be self-motivated, with a proven track record in software / technology sales / consulting. We are looking for candidates who are comfortable at the intersection of technology and business. On the business side, the ability to connect technology with measurable business value is critical to this role.
  
  
**Role Details**

* Develop industry- and application-specific solutions for the customer. This is a very customer-facing position that will have you leading value discovery customer sessions, assessing customer needs, and developing solutions.
* Determine and understand prospective customers’ critical business issues in order to present and demonstrate AspenTech’s software capabilities as the best possible solution to win the business.
* Build customer-specific solutions on the AspenTech platform using all the available tool options.

* Candidates will have a strong understanding of manufacturing economics, with an ability to interact with potential customers and talk knowledgeably about their plants, work processes, and manufacturing economics.

* Process Engineering
* Manufacturing Supply Chain – Planning and Scheduling

* Predictive Maintenance
* IT/OT real-time Digital infrastructure modernization
* Strong drive to solve customer problems and rapidly convert pipeline opportunities into closed deals.

title: Sales & Channel Partnerships Manager
description:
**Sales & Channel Partnerships Manager**

Mumbai (hybrid, frequent travel) · Full-time · Reccy Adventures Pvt Ltd

**About Reccy**

Reccy is on a mission to "Inspire Every Indian to GET OUT." We design high-performance outdoor apparel and gear for Indian conditions, built on more than 30 years of mountaineering experience.

**The role**

Reccy sells mainly through our own website, and we already have an early offline and marketplace business: a handful of retail partners, institutional orders and our first marketplace listings. It works, but it's small. We're hiring someone to scale it into a meaningful, profitable part of the business across offline retail, institutional buyers and new marketplaces in India and abroad.

**This is not an inbound-sales role.**
You'll be expected to find, pitch and close new partners, then make them work: sell-through, reorders and payments. You'll report directly to the CEO.

**What success looks like in 12 months**

•    A growing network of retail partners across key cities who reorder regularly without being chased

•    At least one new marketplace or international channel, starting with the UAE, live and contributing real revenue

•    A base of institutional and bulk accounts (trekking companies, outdoor clubs, corporates, schools) that place repeat orders

•    Offline and new channels grown into a significant share of Reccy's revenue, at a healthy contribution margin

**What you'll do**

***Build new channels***

•    Find, pitch and sign outdoor and sports retailers, multi-brand stores and franchise partners across India

•    Win bulk and institutional customers: trekking agencies, outdoor clubs, corporates and educational institutions

•    Launch Reccy on new marketplaces and in new countries, starting with the UAE. You'll own each launch from first conversation to listing, pricing, logistics and ongoing performance.

***Make partners successful***

•    Plan each partner's assortment and stock levels, train their staff and support visual merchandising

•    Track sell-through and drive reorders, and step in early when a partner is slowing down

•    Negotiate commercial terms (margins, consignment versus outright purchase, credit, returns) that work for both sides

***Own the numbers***

•    Run the channel pipeline and report on revenue, margin, receivables and partner health

•    Work with the operations, e-commerce and brand teams on supply, fulfilment and marketing support for partners

•    Represent Reccy at selected outdoor events and trade shows where they lead to partnerships

**Must-haves**

•    5+ years in B2B, channel or distribution sales, ideally in apparel, footwear, sporting goods, consumer goods or D2C brands

•    A track record of building a retail or distribution network from scratch, with real revenue numbers you can talk through

•    Experience negotiating trade terms and managing receivables and returns with retailers or distributors

•    Comfortable with numbers: you think in margins, sell-through and payback, not just order value

•    Willing to travel extensively

**Strong advantages**

•    Experience with marketplaces or distributors in the UAE or the wider Gulf (GCC)

•    An existing network in outdoor, sports or adventure retail

•    You spend your own time trekking, climbing, running or cycling

**What we offer**

•    Competitive fixed compensation

•    Performance-linked incentives tied to channel revenue and margin

•    Performance-linked ESOPs

•    Direct access to the founders, real ownership, and the chance to take Reccy's offline and marketplace business to the next level

**How to apply**

**Applications without the video won't be reviewed.**
Send a video of up to 3 minutes, filmed on your phone (no editing needed), covering:

1.  
**A channel you built from zero.**
Which channel was it, how did you land the first partner, and what were the numbers 12 months later? What didn't work?

2.  
**Where you would start.**
Which channel or partner would you go after first for Reccy, and why?

Email the link to jobs@reccy.co with "Channel Partnerships Manager – [Your Name]" in the subject line, or add it to your LinkedIn application.

Application deadline: November 30, 2026.

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply early.

Shortlisted candidates will be given a short field assignment.

*Ready to help India GET OUT? We'd love to hear from you.*
