Our approach to inclusion encompasses a variety of initiatives, including sensitization campaigns, implementing conducive policies & programs, providing infrastructure support and engaging in community events. Over time, we have made meaningful progress in these areas, and this commitment has been well-recognized across the industry. We are proud recipients of the prestigious Top 10 Employers award by the India Workplace Equality Index (IWEI), IWEI Gold Employer of Choice awards, India CSR Leadership Award 2024 for Holistic Village Development Program and the YUVA Unstoppable Changemaker Awards.

**Divisional Overview:**

The Corporate finance team performs global and seamless Finance operations including trading and product control, Group financial reporting and disclosure, management information and reporting for decision support, planning and development of financial strategy including funding policies and financial analysis, funding and cash management, tax planning and reporting, investor relations management, and much more.

**Business Overview:**

Finance and Capital Reporting (FCR) is a key component of the Finance Department, which has an excellent reputation within the bank and externally. The unit is responsible for ensuring that the firm is adequately always capitalised against its risk weighted assets as well as maintaining leverage asset levels under regulatory limits, identifying any threats to the viability of the firm helping the management identify appropriate actions and ensures timely production of key balance sheet metrics as required by regulators. The unit covers areas as follows:

* Group Reporting: Ensuring Financial statements are complete, accurate, prepared in a timely manner, and are in accordance with Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) on a legal entity and a consolidated basis.
* External Reporting: Ensuring regional regulatory returns are produced and submitted timely covering financial statements, capital ratios, leverage ratio and risk weighted assets on monthly / quarterly / annual basis.
* Daily reporting: Ensuring daily production of capital adequacy components such as counterparty credit risk, market risk, large exposure risk, settlement risk, CVA risk, leverage ratios, management balance sheet to Senior management.
* Finance Policy: Provide guidance and support to the reporting teams on the interpretation of existing and future accounting and capital requirements.

**What We Offer:**

* We support employee wellbeing by ensuring a sense of purpose and belonging.
* We offer a comprehensive range of wellbeing services which allows employees to get access to the assistance they need at any point in their wellbeing journey.
* Our bespoke benefits support employees and their family’s holistic wellbeing and are inclusive of diverse identities and family structures.

**Position Specifications:**

**Qualification:**
CA – Inter Cleared AND completed/pursuing BCom degree.

**Requirement:**
Available for 12 months of Industrial Training (as per ICAI guidelines): Immediate joiner

**Role & Responsibilities:**

The role covers responsibilities for running processes and projects in the capital reporting team, which underpin the Regulatory Reporting of the European / Asian / Japanese consolidation group and its regulated subsidiaries. It will include working with colleagues in Mumbai, London, Frankfurt, Paris, Singapore, Hong-Kong and Japan.

The role will encompass production of key capital adequacy metrics as per Basel III rules including:

* Calculation covering standardized approaches for counterparty credit risk, market risk,
* settlement risk and capital deductions.
* COREP / MAS / JFSA reporting.
* Responding to business / management driven queries & requests
* Large Exposure calculation in accordance with CRDIV and Basel III norms
* Analysis of RWA to monitor movements and identifying optimization opportunities
* Development of daily MI through new age BI tools such as Alteryx and Power BI / Tableau.
* Interaction with Risk management for validating Risk inputs.
* Interaction with other teams like IT, Ops, LE Controllers and Legal
* Defining business requirements for IT implementation in case of new projects / process
* enhancements

The role will be challenging and will provide a variety of responsibilities covering technical, process & interpersonal skill sets. It will be an excellent opportunity to develop knowledge of regulatory financial and capital reporting providing a deep insight into financial positions of EMEA / AEJ / Japan based entities.

**Mind Set:**

**Domain (Mandatory)**

* Financial services industry exposure / good working knowledge in Capital monitoring / reporting function
* Capital Market knowledge
* Excellent communication skills & ability to communicate ideas concisely and clearly
* Ability to work in stringent deadlines
* Ability to deliver accurate reports within agreed timelines
* Understanding of financial products

**Domain (Desired)**

* Proficiency in bringing issues to closure by keeping all the relevant stakeholders informed.
* Previous experience in Capital reporting within Investment Banking is preferred
* Self-starter, problem solver and ability to work with minimal supervision

**Technical (Mandatory)**

— via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role.

**About the Company**

J K Shah Classes is one of India's best-known commerce coaching institutes. Since 1983 it has prepared over half a million students for CA, CS, CMA, ACCA and Commerce, through 120+ branches and a growing online platform. It is now part of the listed Veranda Learning group and is expanding its centres and online business across India. The finance, people and admissions teams based in Mumbai are growing to support that expansion.

**About the Role**

You'll be the planning engine of the finance team: budgets, forecasts, monthly MIS and branch economics for a growing network of coaching centres and an online business. The role suits a qualified CA who wants to move from audit or accounting into business finance.

**What you'll do**

* Build the annual budget and rolling forecasts by branch, course and channel
* Prepare monthly MIS and variance analysis against budget, and explain what moved
* Track branch and centre P&L and unit economics: enrolments, fee realisation, faculty and rent cost
* Prepare management and parent-group reporting packs
* Build financial models for new centres, pricing and online growth decisions
* Partner with business heads to set and track targets

**What you bring**

* Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA)
* Has prepared budgets, forecasts or variance analysis for a business, not only statutory accounts
* Has built a P&L or unit-economics view at business-unit, branch or product level
* Strong Excel financial modelling
* Clear written and verbal communication with non-finance stakeholders

**Nice to have**

* FP&A in a multi-location consumer business (education, retail, QSR, healthcare)
* Power BI or similar reporting tools
* Exposure to listed-company or group reporting timelines

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
Envisstack builds AI systems that work inside Indian businesses: from the first workshop to production, and the support after. We are a forward-deployed AI engineering firm in Mumbai. We sit with the client, learn the real workflow, connect AI to the systems they already run (WhatsApp, Tally, SAP, Salesforce, Zoho, core banking, legacy databases), prove results against an agreed metric, and keep the system working.

**The role**

You build the AI systems we deliver to clients and keep them working after go-live. You own components end to end: retrieval pipelines, document extraction, agent tools, integrations with client systems, and the evaluations that prove they work. You work directly with the founders.

**We welcome career switchers**

Many of the best AI engineers in India today started as Java, .NET, Python or QA engineers in IT services or product companies. If you have two to five years of software engineering and have been building with LLMs on the side, you are who we want. You do not need an ML degree.

**What you will do**

* Build retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems, extraction pipelines and tool-using agents on real client data.
* Integrate with client systems: WhatsApp Business API, Tally, Zoho, SAP, Salesforce, Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, and their databases.
* Design and run evaluations with the client: success metrics, evaluation sets, scorers, thresholds.
* Add guardrails, logging, cost limits and fallbacks to everything you ship.
* Diagnose production failures from traces and turn them into new test cases.
* Join discovery workshops and explain technical options to client teams in plain language.

**What we look for**

* Two or more years of professional software engineering, or strong project evidence.
* Strong Python. Comfortable with APIs, SQL, Git, Docker and one cloud (AWS, Azure or Google Cloud).
* Hands-on experience with LLM APIs: prompting, structured output, tool use, embeddings, vector search.
* You test your own code and review AI-generated code with care.
* You think about evaluation before you think about frameworks.
* Clear written English. An Indian language is a plus, especially for voice and Indic work.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with Indian enterprise systems (Tally, SAP, core banking, hospital information systems).
* Experience with Langfuse, Promptfoo or another evaluation or observability tool.
* Awareness of the DPDP Act and sector rules (RBI, IRDAI, SEBI).

**Interview process**

1. 20-minute call.
2. Take-home (4 to 6 hours, time-boxed): build a small RAG system and write an evaluation report.
3. AI-assisted coding round. Use your own coding agent. We watch how you review and test its output.
4. Eval-design exercise.
5. Review of your take-home, plus a deep-dive on past work.
6. Values conversation.

**An honest note**

Envisstack is a new company. We do not have a client list or a team yet, and you would be one of the first people here. That means real ownership, direct work with the founders, and the chance to shape how we work. It also means less structure and more uncertainty than an established firm. The legal entity, Envisstack India Private Limited, is being formed, and this role starts once it is incorporated and our first client engagement is signed. We will tell you the expected start date and the full terms before any offer. We would rather you know all of this now.

**How to apply**

Apply here, or email careers@envisstack.com with the role title in the subject line. Send a CV or LinkedIn profile, and a short note (five to ten lines) about something you built or fixed that you are proud of. A link to code, a write-up or a demo helps but is not required. We reply to every application within ten working days.

We hire on ability. We welcome applicants of every gender, caste, religion, region, disability status, sexual orientation and background. If you need any adjustment during the interview process, tell us and we will make it.

title: SME-Ins Claims
description:
**Job Summary**
This hybrid role as a subject matter expert in insurance claims focuses on delivering accurate and timely support for customer service and domain driven activities within a multinational organization. The professional will analyze claims guide stakeholders on process nuances and ensure consistent adherence to standards while working in rotational shifts without travel. Their work will help enhance customer trust and operational excellence in the insurance services portfolio.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Analyze incoming insurance claims and related customer service requests to validate coverage identify documentation gaps and ensure that each case is processed accurately in line with internal guidelines and domain standards.
* Handle customer service interactions across multiple channels to provide clear explanations on claims status required next steps and resolution timelines while maintaining a calm and empathetic communication style.
* Coordinate with internal operations teams to streamline claim intake and assessment workflows and contribute to improved turnaround time and reduced rework through detailed case reviews.
* Perform end to end documentation checks on claims files to confirm that information is complete consistent and compliant with process rules thereby reducing downstream processing issues.
* Investigate claim details using available systems and tools to highlight potential inconsistencies and escalate complex or ambiguous cases according to defined escalation paths.
* Provide structured feedback on recurring customer service issues and claim processing pain points helping product and process owners refine procedures and service scripts.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives by tracking key performance metrics related to claim resolution accuracy customer satisfaction scores and cycle time and by suggesting practical enhancements.
* Collaborate with training and quality teams by sharing real world case scenarios and insights from daily work to shape more effective learning materials and quality checklists.
* Contribute to knowledge base updates by drafting clear process notes and frequently asked questions that help colleagues resolve claims and customer queries more efficiently.
* Adapt to a rotational shift environment by managing workload intelligently and maintaining a consistent level of responsiveness and quality regardless of shift timing.
* Utilize hybrid work arrangements effectively by maintaining secure and confidential handling of sensitive claim information both on site and remotely in accordance with company policies.
* Support the company purpose by helping customers navigate stressful claim situations with clarity and fairness thereby strengthening trust in the organization and its insurance service offerings.
* Participate in cross functional discussions to represent claims and customer service perspectives ensuring that operational changes positively impact end customers and broader society through reliable risk protection.

**Qualifications**

* Demonstrate solid experience in insurance claims domain activities with two to four years of hands on involvement in processing or supporting claims operations in a professional setting.
* Show strong customer service skills including active listening precise communication and issue resolution capabilities that drive high satisfaction and minimize repeated contacts.
* Apply foundational knowledge of property and casualty insurance concepts such as policy coverage limits deductibles exclusions and claim life cycle to interpret case details effectively.
* Exhibit proficiency in working with standard office productivity tools and claims related applications to log cases update records and generate simple reports for stakeholders.
* Display adaptability in hybrid work and rotational shifts by organizing tasks efficiently managing time constraints and maintaining consistent performance levels.
* Demonstrate analytical thinking and attention to detail when reviewing claim facts and customer information which supports accurate decisions and fair outcomes for all parties.
* Show openness to learn new processes regulatory updates and system enhancements in the insurance domain and translate that learning into better daily execution.

**Certifications Required**
Preferred certifications include insurance claims or customer service credentials such as INS or AIC or equivalent industry specific training.

title: Site Head - Minimed Pune
description:
At MiniMed, you can begin a lifelong career of exploration and innovation, while helping make a difference in the lives of people living with diabetes around the globe. You'll lead with purpose, breaking down barriers to innovation for a more connected, compassionate world.
  
  
****About The Role****
Our Pune Global Capability Centre has grown from zero to more than 400 colleagues in approximately 18 months. The next chapter is more ambitious: establish Pune as a high-performing, globally connected center of expertise that helps MiniMed innovate faster, operate smarter and deliver greater value to the people we serve.
  
  
We are seeking a Site Director who thinks like an enterprise leader, builds like an entrepreneur, delivers with discipline and who behaves as a reference account for the MiniMed culture. This is not simply a role to manage a location. It is an opportunity to shape one of MiniMed’s critical global hubs and leave a lasting leadership legacy.
  
  
****About MiniMed****
MiniMed is an insulin delivery company advancing automated therapy for people with diabetes, today and tomorrow. Our mission is to make every day a better day for people with diabetes. Everyone in this space claims they’re taking on diabetes. It’s true for all of us, but it’s just table stakes.
  
  
What you should expect from MiniMed is the drive of a startup with the resourcing of a public one. Small enough to make an impact internally but serious enough to play a role in care for millions of customers. And we’re adding to our world class team. Interested? Read on.
  
  
**The opportunity**
*Build the hub. Shape the culture. Accelerate the impact.*
Our Pune Global Capability Centre has grown from zero to more than 400 colleagues in approximately 18 months. The next chapter is more ambitious: establish Pune as a high-performing, globally connected center of expertise that helps MiniMed innovate faster, operate smarter and deliver greater value to the people we serve.
  
  
We are seeking a Site Director who thinks like an enterprise leader, builds like an entrepreneur, delivers with discipline and who behaves as a reference account for the MiniMed culture. This is not simply a role to manage a location. It is an opportunity to shape one of MiniMed’s critical global hubs and leave a lasting leadership legacy.
  
  
**Your mandate**

* Set a bold, practical multi-year vision for Pune, aligned to enterprise strategy, global functional priorities and future capability needs.
* Move the GCC beyond scale and transactional execution toward differentiated expertise, end-to-end ownership, innovation and measurable business outcomes.
* Unite a matrixed community around one MiniMed identity, clear standards, high performance and an exceptional employee experience.
* Build a trusted partnership with global leaders, ensuring Pune is seen as a source of solutions and strategic talent—not simply capacity.

****What You Will Own****
Strategy, growth and enterprise value
  
  

* Translate business demand into an integrated site strategy, capability roadmap and disciplined priorities; identify where Pune can create the greatest enterprise value.
* Partner with functional owners on new capabilities, transitions and transformation, with clear readiness, service, risk and value measures.
* Champion productivity, simplification, automation and continuous improvement; challenge work that adds complexity without impact.

Talent, leadership and culture
  
  

* Build a strong site leadership community across functions, even where reporting lines sit elsewhere; create shared accountability without blurring functional ownership.
* Partner with HR and functional leaders to attract, develop and retain outstanding talent; strengthen succession, leadership capability and internal mobility.
* Create a distinctive, inclusive, high-performance culture rooted in ownership, collaboration, integrity and MiniMed’s mission.

Operational excellence and stewardship
  
  

* Establish a clear site operating rhythm, decision forums, performance dashboard and transparent escalation of risks and dependencies.
* Work with Finance, HR, Legal, Compliance, Digital Technologies, Facilities and Security to maintain safe, resilient and compliant operations.
* Oversee site-level business continuity, workplace experience, security and crisis preparedness, with clear interfaces to accountable functional leaders.

Influence and external presence
  
  

* Be MiniMed’s senior visible leader in Pune, connecting colleagues to enterprise priorities and ensuring global executives understand the site’s contributions and opportunities.
* Build a strong external network in the Pune talent, university and GCC ecosystem to strengthen MiniMed’s reputation and access to capability.

****What Success Looks Like****
Within the first 12–18 months, the successful leader will have established a credible multi-year site strategy; a cohesive cross-functional leadership team; clear site governance and a balanced scorecard; stronger talent pipelines and retention; and demonstrable improvements in capability maturity, productivity, service quality and strategic contribution. Specific targets will be agreed with global functional and executive leaders.
  
  
**The leader we are looking for**

* A proven senior leader in a GCC, global shared services, technology, operations or similarly complex multinational environment, with experience scaling and transforming a significant site or business.
* A builder who has progressed an organization from rapid growth to mature, strategic delivery—and can demonstrate measurable results.
* An enterprise thinker who understands matrix operating models, earns influence without relying on formal authority and can engage confidently with executive stakeholders.
* A talent magnet and culture carrier: demanding about outcomes, generous in developing others and comfortable making decisions amid ambiguity.
* Strong judgement on governance, operational risk and change, balanced with speed, curiosity and an improvement mindset.
* Excellent communication and executive presence; bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.

****Experience That Would Add Value****
Healthcare, medtech, life sciences or other regulated industries; newly established GCCs; digital, data, technology, customer operations or finance capabilities; and familiarity with the Pune and wider India talent ecosystem.
  
  
**Why MiniMed, why now?**
Few roles offer the chance to shape a major global hub at the moment a company is defining its future. At MiniMed, you will have the platform to build capabilities, unlock talent and make decisions that matter—while contributing to a mission that touches people’s lives every day.
  
  
****Physical Job Requirements****
The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this position, but they are not an exhaustive list of all the required responsibilities and skills of this position.
  
  
****Benefits & Compensation****
**MiniMed offers a competitive salary and flexible benefits package**
At MiniMed, we put people first. A commitment to our employees lives at the core of our values: We recognize their contributions. They share in the success they help create. We offer a wide range of benefits, resources, and competitive compensation plans designed to support you at every stage of your career and life.
  
  
This position is eligible for an annual long-term incentive plan.
  
  
****About MiniMed****
We want to make every day a better day for people living with diabetes. Our team of creative innovators around the globe share a passion for finding the simplest solutions to the problems that people with diabetes face on a daily basis. For more than 40 years, we've been redefining what's possible, from intelligent dosing systems designed for real life to predictive insights that stay a step ahead, and we're dedicated to continuing to support our customers through every step of their journey — meeting them where and how they need it.

You are an engineer’s engineer, someone who spent years training, tuning, and deploying models at scale, and who has spearheaded Generative and Agentic AI over the last 3–4 years. This is an exceptional opportunity for an individual who thrives on building sophisticated, production-grade Autonomous AI systems and wants to make a significant impact.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Technical Architecture & System Design**

* Architect and operationalize end-to-end autonomous agentic systems (multi-agent orchestration, dynamic tool-calling, reflection, planner-executor loops, and persistent state management).
* Design robust LLM runtime infrastructure, including hybrid retrieval architectures (Advanced RAG, graph-based context grounding, vector databases, re-rankers, semantic routing).
* Establish scalable evaluation, guardrail, and observability frameworks (latency optimization, cost governors, hallucinations/drift detection, alignment checks, red-teaming).
* Make high-stakes architectural decisions regarding model topologies (proprietary frontier models vs. distilled/fine-tuned SLMs, LoRA, quantization, self-hosted vs. managed endpoints).

Hands-On Execution & Prototyping
  
  

* Lead from the front: write high-leverage production code, design critical framework primitives, and rapidly de-risk zero-to-one concepts via functional PoCs.
* Bridge cutting-edge research and production engineering, ensuring systems are resilient, fault-tolerant, secure, and performant at scale.

Strategy & Cross-Functional Influence
  
  

* Partner directly with the Head of AI, Product leadership, and VP-level stakeholders to chart the AI technology roadmap and identify transformative capability unlocks.
* Lead the exploration and application of Large Language Models, Agentic AI and Generative AI, venturing into new areas within these fields.
* Represent the company’s AI thought leadership through open-source contributions, technical papers, conferences, or industry forums.

**Other Responsibilities**

* Architect, Design and Build robust, scalable, and efficient AI systems leveraging a variety of AI/ML, data science, deep learning, and agentic AI frameworks.
* Drive the integration of complex Model Context Protocol (MCP) and agent-to-agent (A2A) communication protocols, ensuring seamless interaction and optimal performance.
* Design and implement scalable and efficient AI/ML systems, architectures, and pipelines that can handle large volumes of data and deliver accurate and timely results.
* Regularly self-educate while mentoring and provide technical leadership to other engineers, fostering a culture of continuous learning and excellence.

**Who We Are Looking For -**

* Experience: 15+ years of hands-on software development experience, including 5+ years actively building and deploying Generative AI and Agentic AI applications in production.
* Core Engineering & AI Building: Hands-on builder capable of independently architecting, coding, and deploying custom AI tools, autonomous agents, and bots from scratch.
* Programming Mastery: 8+ years writing production-grade code in Python or similar languages with deep expertise in scalable software design, APIs, and microservices.
* Agentic Frameworks & Tools: Deep proficiency with frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, Auto-GPT, CrewAI, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) for multi-agent coordination.
* LLMs & Fine-Tuning: Practical experience with frontier models (GPT-4, Gemini, Claude), fine-tuning, prompt engineering, and custom agentic tool-calling workflows.
* ML/DL Foundations: Background in training, tuning, and running models using PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Scikit-learn in high-throughput environments.
* Inference & Acceleration: Familiarity with inference engines (vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, TGI) and cloud ML infrastructure (NVIDIA GPUs, TPUs).
* Data & Memory Infrastructure: Experience building low-latency vector search indices, in-memory caching layers, streaming pipelines (Kafka/Flink), and NoSQL datastores to power real-time agent context and memory.
* Education: Master's or Ph.D. in Computer Science, AI, ML, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent practical experience).

**Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities**

* Autonomous Execution: Proven track record as a senior IC who takes total ownership—from zero-to-one prototyping to production rollout.
* Cloud & DevOps: Exposure to AWS, Azure, or GCP environments with modern containerized deployment (Kubernetes, Docker).
* Domain & Communication: Experience in contact center/telecom/CX platforms is a plus; excellent technical communication skills required.

Job Description

The Configuration co-ordinator is focused on managing and maintaining the Configuration Management System and the Configuration Management Database (CMDB).

͏

**Title And Summary**
Senior Platform Architect
  
  
Who is Mastercard?
  
  
Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.
  
  
Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.
  
  
**Overview**
The Infrastructure Engineering team is looking for a Senior Platform Architect to lead the design and evolution of secure, scalable, and resilient enterprise infrastructure platforms that power Mastercard's critical business services. The ideal candidate is a strategic technology leader with deep expertise in enterprise architecture, infrastructure engineering, and cloud technologies. They are highly collaborative, intellectually curious, and passionate about solving complex technical challenges while driving innovation, operational excellence, and platform modernization. This individual excels at partnering across engineering, security, and product organizations to deliver scalable solutions that enable business growth and provide exceptional customer experiences.
  
  
Role
  
  

* Lead the architecture, design, and delivery of highly available, scalable, and secure enterprise infrastructure solutions across on-premises, hybrid, and cloud environments.
* Partner with Engineering, Network, Security, Cloud, Database, Middleware, Product, and Program Management teams to develop infrastructure solutions that support business and technology strategies.
* Drive infrastructure solution delivery from initial business engagement through architecture reviews, financial approvals, procurement, implementation, operational readiness, and production deployment.
* Design resilient networking, application delivery, and security architectures utilizing enterprise technologies including load balancing, web application firewalls, API gateways, and distributed infrastructure platforms.
* Lead infrastructure modernization initiatives focused on automation, Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC), platform standardization, performance optimization, resiliency, and operational excellence.
* Develop enterprise architecture standards, technical roadmaps, and infrastructure documentation while mentoring engineering teams and promoting engineering best practices.
* Ensure infrastructure solutions meet stringent requirements for security, compliance, availability, scalability, disaster recovery, and performance across mission-critical platforms.

**All About You**
Essential Knowledge, Skills & Experience
  
  

* Deep expertise in enterprise infrastructure architecture across data center, hybrid cloud, and distributed computing environments.
* Advanced knowledge of enterprise networking, application delivery, and infrastructure security, including Zero Trust principles and modern network architectures.
* Experience designing and supporting enterprise platforms utilizing VMware, cloud technologies (AWS, Azure, GCP), load balancing, web application firewalls, API gateways, and distributed infrastructure.
* Strong expertise in infrastructure automation, Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, Ansible), CI/CD integration, and configuration management using tools such as Git, Bitbucket, and Jenkins.
* Demonstrated ability to architect and deliver highly available, resilient, and secure infrastructure solutions while collaborating effectively across cross-functional engineering and business teams.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to influence technical and executive stakeholders.

**Desirable Or Additional Capabilities**

* Expertise in infrastructure performance engineering, including capacity planning, scalability testing, and performance optimization.
* Advanced experience creating technical architecture documentation and executive presentations using Microsoft Visio.
* Experience supporting mission-critical financial services platforms with stringent availability, security, resiliency, and regulatory compliance requirements.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

ClearRoute is a global, AI-native platform engineering consultancy headquartered in London, with an engineering hub in Pune. It helps enterprises fix how their software gets built, tested and shipped, across cloud platforms, quality engineering and developer experience. On this engagement, ClearRoute is leading a strategic platform engineering programme for a large regulated financial-services firm: an AI-enabled delivery platform on AWS that replaces manual, fragmented delivery with a standardised, policy-driven path to production.

**About the Role**

You'll join ClearRoute's AI-first Developer Platform team as a DevSecOps Engineer, based in Pune on a hybrid model (2 days a week in the office). The team owns the CI/CD pipelines every engineer ships through, and builds its own products on top of GitHub, Artifactory and a Kubernetes-hosted marketplace of build runners. This is a hands-on build role in a regulated environment: you build working software, not documents, and what you ship reaches delivery teams the same week. Evidence counts more than years: show what you built, what you measured, and a decision the measurement changed.

**What you'll do**

* Build CI/CD pipelines on GitHub Actions and make the secure, correct path the default, with policy-as-code guardrails (OPA, AWS Config), automated compliance gates and golden paths
* Define and operate self-service infrastructure patterns in AWS CDK and Terraform

* Infrastructure as code with Terraform or AWS CDK, reviewed and tested as code
* Production experience on AWS or Azure

* Experience in banking, asset management or other regulated environments
* Product instinct: you ask who the user is and what they will adopt before what is technically interesting

title: Lead - Digital Platforms and Consumer AI/Senior Lead - Digital Platforms and Consumer AI
description:
**Location Name:**
Pune Corporate Office - Mantri
  
  
**Job Purpose**
At Bajaj Finance, we help millions of people across India manage their money. People come to us when they want to buy a new phone on EMI, when they need a personal loan for a wedding, when they want to buy insurance, or when they want to grow their savings in a Fixed Deposit. Because we have so many customers, we get thousands of questions every single day. Customers want to know their account balance. They want to change the date their EMI gets deducted. They want to know the fees for closing a loan early.
  
  
In the past, to get these answers, a customer had to wait on hold to talk to a call center agent, or they had to tap through ten different screens on our mobile app. We want to change that. We want to make it as easy as sending a text message to a friend.
  
  
We are building a massive, highly intelligent AI (Artificial Intelligence) platform. Think of it like a super-smart chat assistant built right into the Bajaj Finance app. We want our customers to be able to just type out their problems in plain English, Hindi, or other languages, and have the AI fix the problem instantly. If a customer types, "Hey, I need to pause my loan payment this month," the AI should understand them, check their account, and do the work in seconds.
  
  
Building this is incredibly hard. It is not just a simple robot that gives canned answers. It is a smart system that has to understand human language, connect to our deep banking systems, and follow strict financial rules.
  
  
**Duties And Responsibilities**

* Conversation Flows

A normal conversation flows naturally. But computers need a map. They need to be told exactly how a conversation should go, step by step. You will create these maps, which we call Conversation Flows.
  
  
You will literally use a software tool to draw boxes and arrows on your screen.
  
  

* Box 1: The AI says, "Hello, how can I help?" -> Arrow points to Box 2.
* Box 2: The customer says, "I want to see my statement." -> Arrow points to Box 3.
* Box 3: The system checks if the customer's phone number is verified.

o If Yes -> Arrow points to Box 4.
  
  
o If No -> Arrow points to Box 5.
  
  

* Box 4: Show the statement on the screen.
* Box 5: Ask the customer to type in a one-time password (OTP).

You have to map out every single path the conversation could possibly take. You have to think of all the "what ifs." What if the customer types the wrong password? What if the customer stops replying and walks away from their phone? What if the internet crashes? You must draw a box and an arrow for every single situation. These flowcharts become the actual instruction manual for the engineers. They look at your map and write the code to make it happen exactly as you drew it.|Your Daily Work: The 9 Core Areas
  
  
**About**
Your job will be very hands-on. You will not just be sitting in long meetings talking about big ideas. You will be doing the real, detailed work to make this AI smart. Here are the nine specific areas you will be working on every day:
  
  

* FPR (Future Press Release)

Before a single line of computer code is written, you have to know what your end goal is. We do this by writing a Future Press Release, or FPR.
  
  
A press release is a news article that a company puts out when they launch a cool new product. But here, you will write this news article before we even start building. You will write it as if the product is already finished and launched to the public. You will write a catchy headline like: "Bajaj Finance Launches AI That Solves Loan Issues in 10 Seconds." You will write quotes from pretend customers talking about how much they love the feature. You will explain exactly what problem the feature solves in simple, everyday language.
  
  
Why do we do this? Because it keeps everyone focused. If the news article sounds boring or confusing, it means your idea is probably boring or confusing. Once you write a great FPR, you show it to the engineers and your bosses. When everyone reads it and says, "Wow, this sounds amazing, let's build it!"—that document becomes your team's guide.
  
  

* FAQ (Frequently Asked Questions)

Along with your news article, you will write a massive list of Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ). But these are not just the normal questions a customer might ask. These are questions that anyone involved might ask.
  
  
You have to put yourself in the shoes of a confused customer. What will they ask? "Is my bank data safe with this AI robot?" You write the answer. You have to think like our call center agents. "Will this AI do my job wrong and make the customer angry?" You write the answer. You have to think like our company lawyers. "Does this AI follow the Reserve Bank of India rules?" You write the answer.
  
  
The goal of this FAQ is to force you to find all the problems and risks before the engineers start building. If you cannot answer a tough question in your FAQ document, it means your plan has a hole in it, and you need to fix your plan.
  
  

* PPG (Product Program Guidelines)

Because Bajaj Finance deals with people's money, we have a lot of strict rules. We cannot just give a loan to anyone. We have to charge exact fees. We have to use exact interest rates. All of these strict rules are written down in company rulebooks called Product Program Guidelines, or PPG.
  
  
Every single product has a PPG. The personal loan has a PPG. The fixed deposit has a PPG. When we build the AI, the AI must follow the rules in the PPG perfectly. It cannot make a mistake. If the PPG says the late fee is 500 rupees, the AI cannot accidentally tell the customer the late fee is 400 rupees. That would cause a massive legal problem.|As a Product Manager, you will read these PPG rulebooks. You will pull out all the rules related to your project. You will work with the engineers to make sure these rules are permanently locked into the AI's brain. If the company changes a rule in the PPG next year, you are the person who makes sure the AI gets updated immediately.
  
  

* Synthetic Testing

Once the engineers build a version of the AI, we have to test it. But we cannot let a broken, untested AI talk to real Bajaj Finance customers. That is too risky. If the AI is confused, a real customer might get bad advice about their loan.
  
  
So, we use something called Synthetic Testing. "Synthetic" just means fake or made-up. You will help create thousands of fake conversations to test the AI safely. You will create fake customer profiles. For example, you make a fake customer named Rahul who has a home loan. You will type to the AI pretending to be Rahul. You will ask, "Can I pay off my whole loan today?" and see what the AI says.
  
  
Does the AI say yes? Does it calculate the early payment fee correctly? What if you pretend to be a customer who types with terrible spelling? What if you type in a mix of Hindi and English? What if you pretend to be very angry? Does the AI still understand and stay polite? You will run hundreds of these fake tests. When the AI fails, you write down why it failed, take that information back to the engineers, and tell them what to fix. You keep doing this until the AI passes every fake test perfectly.
  
  

* LLM Parameters (What We Send to the AI Brain)

The core brain of our AI is called a Large Language Model (LLM). Think of the LLM like an incredibly smart person sitting in a dark room. This person knows how to speak perfectly, but they have no idea who they are talking to.
  
  
If a customer types, "What is my balance?", the smart person in the dark room has no idea whose balance to check. So, we have to send the LLM a package of extra information along with the customer's question. We call this setting the LLM Parameters.
  
  
As the Product Manager, you will decide exactly what information goes into that package. When the customer asks about their balance, you will tell our computer systems: "Before you let the AI answer, grab the customer's name, grab their last three payments, and grab their current loan amount. Send all of that to the AI."
  
  
You also have to send strict instructions. You will tell the AI, "You are a helpful assistant for Bajaj Finance. Always be polite. Do not guess numbers. Only use the numbers I just sent you." If you send the AI too much information, it gets confused and it costs the company too much money to process. If you send too little information, the AI gives a stupid answer. Your job is to find the perfect balance of what data to send the AI every time a customer speaks.
  
  

* Visualisations

Chatting with an AI should not just be reading massive blocks of text. Nobody wants to read a giant paragraph of words on their small phone screen.|Sometimes, the best way to answer a customer is by showing them a picture, a chart, or a button. We call these Visualisations.
  
  
Let's say a customer asks, "How much of my loan have I paid off?" The AI could write a long, boring sentence with a bunch of numbers. But it is much better if the AI shows a nice, clean pie chart on the screen. Half the pie is green for the money paid, and half is grey for the money left. The customer understands it instantly.
  
  
Or, if the AI needs the customer to pick a date, it shouldn't make the customer type "October 15th." It should pop up a small calendar on the screen so the customer can just tap the day. You will decide when to use text and when to use these visual tools. You will work with our designers to sketch out how these charts and buttons should look so the chat is beautiful and easy to use.
  
  

* Product Switching

Imagine you are talking to a human salesman at a store. You ask about buying a TV. Then, suddenly, you change your mind and ask about buying a fridge. The human easily switches the topic to the fridge.Computers are not naturally good at this. If the computer is programmed to talk to you about a TV, and you ask about a fridge, the computer will get totally confused. It might say, "Error, I do not understand."
  
  
At Bajaj Finance, we have dozens of products. A customer might start a chat asking about their EMI shopping card. But halfway through the chat, they might say, "By the way, I also want to open a Fixed Deposit." The AI needs to smoothly switch from talking about the shopping card to talking about the Fixed Deposit without breaking or crashing.
  
  
We call this Product Switching. You will write the rules for how the AI handles these sudden changes in conversation. You will plan out how the AI remembers what the customer was talking about first, just in case the customer wants to go back to the original topic later.
  
  
**Required Qualifications And Experience**
The Background You Need (Education & Experience)
  
  
**Requirements**
Because this job requires you to build highly complex computer systems, we are very strict about the background you need to have. We are looking for people who meet these exact requirements:
  
  

* Your Education (The Degree and the College)

You must have a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a closely related technical computer field.
  
  
You must have graduated from a Tier 1 Engineering College. This means premier institutes like the IITs (Indian Institutes of Technology), NITs (National Institutes of Technology), or top-level Regional Engineering Colleges.
  
  
It is because the AI technology we are building is extremely complicated. You will be working side-by-side with some of the smartest software engineers in the country. You need to know how software is actually built. You need to understand coding logic, databases, and how computer servers talk to each other. Top engineering colleges train you to handle these tough, highly technical problems. If you do not have this strong computer science foundation, you will not be able to keep up with the engineering teams.
  
  
If you also have a Master's degree, that is great! We love to see it. But if you do not have a Master's degree, that is perfectly fine. It is not required. The Bachelor's degree from a Tier 1 college is what matters the most.
  
  

* Your Work Experience (2 to 3 Years in NLP/AI)

You cannot be fresh out of college for this job. You must have at least 2 to 3 years of actual, hands-on work experience.
  
  
More importantly, this experience must be in a very specific area. You must have worked on NLP platforms. It is the specific technology that teaches computers how to read, understand, and write human language.
  
  
You must have spent the last few years of your career actually building chatbots, voice assistants, or smart AI text tools. You cannot just be someone who managed a normal website or a standard mobile app.

title: Social Team Lead (India)
description:
Pattern is one of Australia's leading e-commerce digital agencies, awarded Australia's Best Digital Agency at the NORA Awards. We are also the largest seller on Amazon globally, representing brands across all product categories.
  
  
Our team is data-driven, collaborative and ambitious, working across digital marketing, e-commerce consultancy and marketplace management. We support professional development with structured training and development plans in the first 12 months.
  
  
Pattern is expanding, and we are looking for a Social Team Lead to lead our India-based social assistants in Pune. You will own the team's social workload, across paid social builds and social commerce, and drive the AI and automation initiatives that help our Australian and Indian social teams deliver more, faster and with fewer errors. This role suits a proactive leader and innovator with a genuine curiosity for AI and process improvement.
  
  
**What is the day in the life of a Social Team Lead?**
**Team leadership**

* Line-manage the two Social Assistants: 1:1s, delegation, capacity planning, quality checks, career development and performance reviews.
* Manage and allocate the team's ad build workload across all clients, acting as the first point of contact for Account Managers on build requests, timelines and capacity.
* Ensure briefs are actioned within agreed SLAs and quality check builds before Account Manager QA, so campaigns go live with no errors.
* Create and maintain playbooks so best practice is applied consistently across accounts and team members.
* Flag capacity risks early, especially in the lead-up to peak, and recommend solutions.

**AI and automation**

* Own the social team's AI and automation roadmap: identify manual, repetitive work, prioritise what to build and deliver it (e.g. automated ad briefing, ad builds, reporting, pacing alerts, bulk updates, AI-assisted optimisation).
* Run and improve the automated ad briefing workflow (client content calendar to Asana), including tagging the right builders and keeping briefs and calendars in sync.
* Build and maintain automated workflows and alerts (e.g. Claude with the Supermetrics connector, n8n, Launchpad/Payload) that cut manual effort and errors, starting with Meta and expanding to other platforms.
* Track and report the hours saved by each automation, reviewed monthly.
* Drive adoption of internal and AI tools across the team, and document every automation in the Social AI Bible (what it does, how to run it, who owns it) so it can be reused.
* Feedback to the tech team on internal tool feature requirements, and ensure all tools follow Pattern's data privacy and client data requirements.

**Paid social execution and optimisation**

* Execute and optimise paid social activity across Meta, TikTok, Pinterest and Reddit, including budget and KPI/results tracking.
* Monitor campaign performance, look for opportunities to scale and improve results, and make recommendations.
* Support TikTok Shop and social commerce delivery, including shop and product catalogue setup, Shop ads (GMV Max) builds and optimisation, and affiliate creator campaigns, working with the AU team as Pattern's social commerce offering grows.
* Stay across platform updates and social trends, and share relevant learnings with the team.

**Reporting, process and collaboration**

* Partner with Analytics and Account Managers to turn reporting (Looker Studio, Supermetrics) into decisions and recommendations.
* Keep refining processes to improve efficiency without losing quality.
* Work closely with the AU-based Social team, communicating clearly across time zones on progress, blockers and timelines.

**Skills And Qualifications**

* At least 5 years' experience in social media, paid social or performance marketing (social commerce experience a plus), ideally within an agency.
* Team management experience.
* A proven track record of using AI tools (e.g. Claude) and automation or workflow tools (e.g. n8n) to remove manual work, with examples of time saved.
* Proficient in social ad managers including Meta, TikTok, Pinterest and Reddit.
* Excellent analytical skills, including budget management, data interpretation and attention to detail, with experience in Supermetrics, Looker Studio, Google Analytics and Google Suite.
* Experience with Asana or similar project management tools.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, and comfortable working with an Australian team across time zones.
* Marketing, Communications and/or Social Media university graduate.
* Experience working with retail or e-commerce brands (desirable).

**Desired Traits & Competencies**

* Game Changers - look at problems with an open mind, share new ideas, and actively pursue improvements to Pattern's processes and outcomes, especially through AI and automation.
* Data Fanatics - understand problems through data, draw unbiased conclusions that lead to actionable solutions, and keep tracking the effects (e.g. hours saved, error rates).
* Partner Obsessed - clearly explain the status of work to Account Managers and clients, listen to expectations and deliver results that exceed them.
* Team of Doers - uplift team members and recognise their contributions, take initiative, and hold themselves accountable to the team and to partners.
* Builds delivered within agreed SLAs, with minimal errors reaching Account Manager QA.
* Measurable hours saved per week from automation initiatives, reviewed monthly.
* Every automation documented in the Social AI Bible with a clear owner.
* Be prepared to talk about professional accomplishments with specific data to quantify examples.
* Bring examples of automations or AI workflows you have built, and the time they saved.
* Be ready to talk about how you have led and developed a team.
* Focus on how you would make a difference at Pattern.

**Why should I work at Pattern?**
Pattern offers big opportunities to make a difference. We are a company full of talented industry experts that evolves quickly and often, we set big goals and work tirelessly to achieve them, and we love our Pattern family. We also believe in having fun and balancing our lives.
  
  
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: IT Sales - Business Development Manager
description:
**About the Company**

Fineshift is a founder-led technology services company helping enterprise customers solve complex engineering challenges across DevSecOps, Monitoring & Observability, and AI.

As an independent, bootstrapped company, we prioritise customer outcomes, delivery accountability, and fast decision-making. We are authorised partners of GitLab, IBM, JFrog, Snyk, and AWS, working with large enterprises across banking, financial services, and manufacturing.

We are at a stage where the leaders we hire will shape our next phase of growth. This is an opportunity to build and scale a technology practice, not simply inherit one.

**About the role**

We are hiring
**Senior Account Executive - Enterprise Technology Sales**
who have already proven they can hunt, qualify and close enterprise technology deals and who want to own a region, not just a quota. This is a new-business role reporting to the Chief Revenue Officer, with an inside sales rep working for you.

**Locations:**
Mumbai & Pune

**What you'll do**

* Build your own pipeline in your region outbound, OEM co-selling, events and your network and own the full cycle from discovery to closure.
* Sell enterprise AI, DevSecOps and observability and monitoring services, anchored on GitLab and leading AI platforms, to CTOs, CIOs and heads of engineering.
* Carry a gross-margin quota, forecast it accurately and protect pricing and payment terms.
* Be Fineshift's face to the OEM's regional field team: deal registration, joint account plans, co-selling.
* Lead an inside sales rep who books your first meetings.

**What you bring**

* 5+ years in B2B technology sales in India, with a verifiable record of meeting quota we will ask for your last three years of numbers and reference-check them.
* You have closed enterprise or large mid-market deals of 25 lakh and above, in technology services, AI, DevOps, cloud, security, observability or data.
* You have built a territory from cold. You know what a week of outbound looks like, and you do not wait for leads.
* You can run a first meeting with a CTO on your own, and you are comfortable learning a technical product deeply.
* You understand margin, payment terms and risk, and you know when to walk away from a bad deal.
* You are proactive, accountable and results-driven: you set your own weekly targets, own your number without being chased, and measure yourself on closed business, not activity.
* You are looking for a role you can commit to and grow in for the next three to four years, not the next twelve months.

**Why Fineshift**

* **You own a region, with a path to running it.**
  Each Senior AE opens a region South, West or North. Hit your number for 4 quarters and you become the Regional Sales Manager, building the team under you. We are not hiring for a seat on a large sales floor; we are hiring the people who will lead sales as we grow.
* **Uncapped incentives on gross margin, with tiered multipliers.**
  Your earnings go up as you cross tiers, and there is no ceiling. Our top performers earn well above their fixed pay. The plan is written down and shared with you before you sign.
* **You sell what the market is buying right now.**
  Enterprise AI, DevSecOps and observability are the three budget lines growing fastest in Indian enterprises. You will be selling on top of GitLab and leading AI platforms names that open doors.
* **The OEM works your pipeline with you.**
  As one of GitLab's largest partners in India, we get partner-sourced leads, co-selling and deal registration. You are not fighting the OEM's own team for accounts.
* **A presales and delivery team that lets you promise what we deliver.**
  Demos, POCs and solutioning are handled by our in-house technology team, so you sell with confidence and hand over cleanly.
* **A short line to decisions.**
  Pricing, terms and exceptions are decided by the CRO and the founder, usually the same day. No committee, no quarter-long approval cycle.
* **A stable, bootstrapped company with no funding risk.**
  Five years in, profitable, growing, no layoffs. We grow on margin, not on burn which means your incentives get paid.

title: Sales Development Representative
description:
We’re hiring SDRs. You’ll cold call US founders and operators and book meetings. We teach you everything: accent, tonality, scripts, product, objections and mindset. Freshers welcome.

**Comp and basics**

* ₹40,000/month + performance bonus
* Full-time
* On-site in Pune. You must be willing to relocate.
* Night-heavy schedule (US-aligned hours)

**About Ionio**

Ionio is the AI & Growth Arm For Founder-Led Businesses. We run go-to-market end to end for our clients: offers, messaging, cold calling, email, content and sales calls, plus the software and AI systems behind all of it. Our clients are SaaS companies and service businesses across the US and Canada. Some engagements stop at booked meetings. Others run all the way to closed deals.

The SDR team is the engine. Every engagement runs on booked meetings, and booked meetings start on the phone.

**What we’ll teach you**

You don’t need sales experience. We train you on everything a cold call takes.

* **Accent.**
  A clear, natural accent US prospects trust from the first sentence. You’ll drop the scripted call-centre sound for good.
* **Tonality.**
  How to sound calm, confident and peer-to-peer. When to slow down. When to pause. How to sound like you belong on the call.
* **Script discipline.**
  How to stick to a proven script, hit every beat and still sound human.
* **Volume.**
  How to stay sharp across a full night of dials. Rhythm, energy, focus.
* **Product knowledge.**
  What each client sells, who buys it and why. You’ll know the offer well enough to answer questions without stalling.
* **Objections and mindset.**
  You’ll hear a lot of objections and a lot of “no.” We teach you how to handle each one live, and how to stay steady on a bad night.

Training runs alongside live calling: daily roleplays, recorded call reviews and script sessions with the founder.

**What you’ll walk away with**

* A skill most people never build: getting a stranger to say yes on the phone
* The full B2B sales process from the inside: prospecting, calling, objection handling, discovery, closing, deal structure
* Experience selling different offers into different markets
* Direct coaching from the founder on every part of your calls
* A path into senior sales, account ownership or growth roles if you perform

Most people learn to sell ten years into their career. Here you learn from week one, with real prospects and real money on the line. If you ever plan to start a company, go into consulting or work in VC, you’ll use this every week for the rest of your life.

**The honest pitch**

This is a cold calling job. Most of your hours go to the phone. Dial, talk, follow up, dial again. It’s repetitive. People will hang up on you. You’ll hear “no” far more than “yes.” Your scoreboard is simple: qualified meetings booked on the calendar.

Email and LinkedIn are follow-up channels. The phone comes first. This is an execution role, and it rewards people who show up every night and do the work.

**What you’ll do**

* Cold call US founders and operators. Every shift. This is the core of the job.
* Research each prospect well enough to open a real conversation in the first ten seconds
* Handle objections live and push for the meeting
* Follow up by email and LinkedIn after calls
* Log every dial, conversation and booking so we can see what’s working
* Review your recordings with the founder and tighten your script every week
* Hit your daily dial target and weekly booked-meeting target

**Who you are**

* Fluent in spoken and written English. We’ll train the accent. The fluency has to be there already.
* Comfortable talking to strangers. Conversations give you energy.
* Resilient. Your last call of the night sounds as good as your first.
* Coachable. You take direct feedback and apply it on the next shift.
* Disciplined. You hit the numbers, then do it again the next night.
* Curious about business. You want to know how companies make money and why people buy.
* Available for nights. Core hours are roughly 11pm to 2/3am IST for US prospects. EU and Asia prospects get worked earlier, so the schedule can shift week to week.
* Willing to relocate to Pune within two months of joining
* Set up for the remote phase: your own laptop, stable internet and a quiet place to take calls

**Bonus points**

* Any calling experience: inside sales, telesales, customer calls, fundraising
* Background in SaaS, B2B sales, ecommerce or marketing
* Has used Apollo, a power dialer, Loom or Notion
* Has sold something, run outbound for your own project, or led sponsorship for a college fest

**Hiring process**

1. **Apply.**
   Email hr@ionio.io with “SDR Pune” in the subject line. Attach your CV and a 60-second voice note introducing yourself. You can also DM me here.
2. **Phone screen.**
   A short call with us.
3. **Mock call assignment.**
   We send you a short brief on one of our offers and a prospect profile. You prepare, then run live mock cold calls with us playing the prospect. We’re watching how you open, how you handle pushback and whether you ask for the meeting. Nobody expects perfect. We’re hiring for how fast you learn.
4. **Final conversation**
   with the founder.

If you want to learn sales properly, with real reps and real coaching, apply.

Our success is built on technical expertise, a strong commitment to safety and quality, and the dedication of our people. With operations across multiple countries, we combine global capabilities with local knowledge to deliver innovative and reliable solutions to our customers.

We are looking for an experienced and commercially driven
**Sales Manager**
to join our team in Pune, India.

In this role, you will be responsible for driving business growth by identifying new opportunities, developing strong customer relationships, and securing industrial engineering, machinery installation, and factory relocation projects.

You will manage the full B2B sales cycle, from prospecting and technical discussions to proposal development, commercial negotiations, and contract closure.

The ideal candidate will combine strong business development skills with a solid technical understanding of industrial projects and engineering services.

Key Responsibilities

**Business Development & Sales Growth**

* Identify and develop new business opportunities across manufacturing, automotive, FMCG, infrastructure, and heavy engineering sectors.
* Promote our industrial relocation, machinery installation, and turnkey engineering services to potential customers.
* Identify greenfield and brownfield investment projects, including international manufacturers establishing or expanding operations in India.
* Achieve assigned sales targets, order bookings, and revenue objectives while maintaining profitability.
* Build and maintain a strong pipeline of qualified business opportunities.

**Technical Sales & Proposal Management**

* Understand customer technical requirements and work closely with engineering and estimation teams to develop tailored solutions.
* Coordinate the preparation of competitive technical and commercial proposals for industrial projects.
* Manage RFQs, RFPs, and tender submissions, ensuring timely and accurate responses.
* Participate in technical discussions, site visits, and customer meetings to identify project requirements.
* Support the development of solutions involving machinery installation, heavy lifting, mechanical works, and industrial relocation.

**Client Relationship & Key Account Management**

* Develop and maintain relationships with Plant Heads, Procurement Directors, CAPEX decision-makers, and industrial customers.
* Manage existing accounts while identifying opportunities for additional services and repeat business.
* Build long-term partnerships with key customers and international OEMs.
* Coordinate customer vendor registration and onboarding processes.

**Commercial Negotiations & Project Coordination**

* Lead commercial negotiations, including pricing, payment terms, project schedules, and contractual conditions.
* Work closely with Operations, Project Management, Supply Chain, HSE, and Finance teams to ensure a smooth transition from sales to project execution.
* Ensure commercial commitments are aligned with project delivery capabilities and company standards.

**Market Intelligence & Reporting**

* Monitor market developments, competitor activities, industrial investments, and emerging business opportunities.
* Maintain accurate CRM records, sales forecasts, and pipeline reports.
* Provide regular updates to management on sales activities, business opportunities, and market trends.
* Contribute to business planning and sales growth strategies for the Indian market.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering (BE/B.Tech) or Diploma in Mechanical Engineering (DME).
* **8–12 years of experience**
  in technical sales, project sales, or business development within industrial engineering or related sectors.
* Proven experience in selling industrial services such as machinery installation, factory relocation, turnkey mechanical projects, piping, fabrication, or equipment erection.
* Strong network within industrial sectors such as Automotive, FMCG, Chemicals, Metals, Food & Beverage, Building Products, Battery Electrification, Data Centres, Paper & Packaging, or Warehouse Automation.
* Good technical understanding of mechanical engineering, industrial equipment, manufacturing processes, and project execution.
* Experience managing complex technical proposals, commercial negotiations, and B2B sales cycles.
* Strong business development, relationship-building, and negotiation skills.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with technical and operational teams.
* Good understanding of HSE standards and safety requirements within industrial environments.

Why Join Us?

At Beck & Pollitzer, you will have the opportunity to work with a global engineering services company, supporting major industrial customers and contributing to complex and challenging projects.

We offer an international working environment where technical expertise, collaboration, and professional development are valued.

You will play an important role in expanding our business in India while working alongside experienced professionals across our global operations.

Join Us!

If you are passionate about technical sales, industrial engineering, and developing new business opportunities, we would like to hear from you.

title: PMO & Resource Management Analyst
description:
Role Purpose

The PMO & Resource Management Analyst provides day-to-day operational support across resource management, vendor management, procurement coordination, compliance tracking, data management, and broader PMO activities. The role requires disciplined tracking, accurate analysis, regular stakeholder follow-up, and clear reporting to ensure that operational activities progress to closure.

This is a hands-on coordination and analysis role. The successful candidate will not only maintain information, but will also identify missing data, ageing actions, process gaps, dependencies, and items requiring escalation.

Key Responsibilities1. Resource and Workforce Management

·    Maintain tracking of open positions, requisitions, hiring status, target dates, blockers, ownership, and next actions.

·    Review workforce and recruiting data from systems such as Workday and reconcile it with inputs from recruiters, hiring managers, Finance partners, and business leaders.

·    Follow up on delayed or incomplete hiring actions and record reasons, revised dates, dependencies, and resolution plans.

·    Support onboarding, offboarding, resource movements, replacements, assignments, and other workforce changes for CRISIL and supported teams.

·    Prepare accurate weekly and monthly workforce summaries and highlight exceptions requiring attention.

2. Vendor and Procurement Operations

·    Support the creation, modification, monitoring, and follow-up of Purchase Requisitions (PRs).

·    Review PR information and supporting documentation for completeness before approval routing.

·    Track PR status across requesters, Finance, Procurement, Information Security, approvers, and other control functions.

·    Coordinate ownership, preparer, approver, or other workflow changes through the appropriate support channels.

·    Maintain centralized trackers for vendor requests, procurement actions, renewals, extensions, and open approvals.

·    Follow up on actions in Ariba, ServiceNow, and related procurement processes.

·    Assist with SOWs, quotations, business cases, CFAR documentation, approval history, and supporting records.

·    Escalate stalled or ageing items with clear background, evidence, ownership, and required action.

3. PMO Coordination and Action Management

·    Maintain action, issue, risk, dependency, and decision trackers with clear owners and due dates.

·    Coordinate recurring operational meetings and prepare agendas, status inputs, notes, and follow-up actions as required.

·    Capture decisions, owners, due dates, dependencies, and next steps in a clear and consistent format.

·    Follow up regularly with action owners and escalate overdue or blocked items.

·    Maintain Planner or equivalent task-management records, including descriptions, dates, status, supporting communications, and deliverables.

·    Support PMO reporting packs, dashboards, management updates, and ad hoc information requests.

·    Ensure that assigned activities are progressed through closure rather than remaining as open tracker entries.

4. Compliance and Control Tracking

·    Track mandatory training completion and other assigned compliance requirements.

·    Identify non-compliant or pending individuals and coordinate reminders with employees and managers.

·    Maintain evidence of follow-ups, responses, agreed exceptions, and closure.

·    Support access, onboarding, offboarding, and relevant control checklists.

·    Prepare regular compliance summaries and highlight exceptions requiring management attention.

5. Data Management, Reporting, and Quality Assurance

·    Collect information from multiple systems, files, emails, meetings, and stakeholders.

·    Consolidate data into standardized trackers and management-ready summaries.

·    Perform completeness, consistency, and reasonableness checks before issuing reports or communications.

·    Reconcile conflicting information and obtain clarification from the appropriate owners.

·    Maintain organized SharePoint folders, repositories, process documentation, and supporting evidence.

·    Produce analysis covering ageing, outstanding actions, dependencies, risks, and exceptions.

·    Support the development and maintenance of operational dashboards and reporting processes.

6. Stakeholder Coordination

·    Work with business leaders, hiring managers, recruiters, Finance, Procurement, compliance teams, vendor contacts, and CRISIL stakeholders.

·    Communicate clearly and professionally through email, Teams, meetings, trackers, and written status updates.

·    Provide sufficient context when requesting information, following up, or escalating an issue.

·    Coordinate inputs across stakeholders with competing priorities and different levels of process knowledge.

·    Build trusted working relationships while maintaining accountability for agreed actions and timelines.

Expected Deliverables

·    Resource and headcount tracker.

·    Open requisition and hiring-status report.

·    CRISIL workforce onboarding, offboarding, billing, and movement tracker.

·    PR, renewal, and procurement action tracker.

·    Weekly action and escalation report.
