title: Lead AI Application Engineer - AI Research & Innovation
description:
**About Avaya**
Avaya is an enterprise software leader that helps the world’s largest organizations and government agencies forge unbreakable connections.
  
  
The Avaya Infinity™ platform unifies fragmented customer experiences, connecting the channels, insights, technologies, and workflows that together create enduring customer and employee relationships.
  
  
We believe success is built through strong connections – with each other, with our work, and with our mission. At Avaya, you'll find a community that values your contributions and supports your growth every step of the way.
  
  
Learn more at https://www.avaya.com
  
  
Job Information
  
  
Job Code: 00194005
  
  
Job Family: Research and Development
  
  
Job Function: Software Engineering
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a highly experienced and visionary Lead AI Application Engineer to join our core AI team. This pivotal role will be instrumental in designing, developing, and deploying advanced Machine Learning, Generative AI and Agentic AI applications across high-throughput, real-time streaming environments . You are an engineer’s engineer, someone who spent years training, tuning, and deploying models at scale, and who has spearheaded Generative and Agentic AI over the last 3–4 years. This is an exceptional opportunity for an individual who thrives on building sophisticated, production-grade Autonomous AI systems and wants to make a significant impact.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Technical Architecture & System Design**

* Architect and operationalize end-to-end autonomous agentic systems (multi-agent orchestration, dynamic tool-calling, reflection, planner-executor loops, and persistent state management).
* Design robust LLM runtime infrastructure, including hybrid retrieval architectures (Advanced RAG, graph-based context grounding, vector databases, re-rankers, semantic routing).
* Establish scalable evaluation, guardrail, and observability frameworks (latency optimization, cost governors, hallucinations/drift detection, alignment checks, red-teaming).
* Make high-stakes architectural decisions regarding model topologies (proprietary frontier models vs. distilled/fine-tuned SLMs, LoRA, quantization, self-hosted vs. managed endpoints).

Hands-On Execution & Prototyping
  
  

* Lead from the front: write high-leverage production code, design critical framework primitives, and rapidly de-risk zero-to-one concepts via functional PoCs.
* Bridge cutting-edge research and production engineering, ensuring systems are resilient, fault-tolerant, secure, and performant at scale.

Strategy & Cross-Functional Influence
  
  

* Partner directly with the Head of AI, Product leadership, and VP-level stakeholders to chart the AI technology roadmap and identify transformative capability unlocks.
* Lead the exploration and application of Large Language Models, Agentic AI and Generative AI, venturing into new areas within these fields.
* Represent the company’s AI thought leadership through open-source contributions, technical papers, conferences, or industry forums.

**Other Responsibilities**

* Architect, Design and Build robust, scalable, and efficient AI systems leveraging a variety of AI/ML, data science, deep learning, and agentic AI frameworks.
* Drive the integration of complex Model Context Protocol (MCP) and agent-to-agent (A2A) communication protocols, ensuring seamless interaction and optimal performance.
* Design and implement scalable and efficient AI/ML systems, architectures, and pipelines that can handle large volumes of data and deliver accurate and timely results.
* Regularly self-educate while mentoring and provide technical leadership to other engineers, fostering a culture of continuous learning and excellence.

**Who We Are Looking For -**

* Experience: 15+ years of hands-on software development experience, including 5+ years actively building and deploying Generative AI and Agentic AI applications in production.
* Core Engineering & AI Building: Hands-on builder capable of independently architecting, coding, and deploying custom AI tools, autonomous agents, and bots from scratch.
* Programming Mastery: 8+ years writing production-grade code in Python or similar languages with deep expertise in scalable software design, APIs, and microservices.
* Agentic Frameworks & Tools: Deep proficiency with frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, Auto-GPT, CrewAI, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) for multi-agent coordination.
* LLMs & Fine-Tuning: Practical experience with frontier models (GPT-4, Gemini, Claude), fine-tuning, prompt engineering, and custom agentic tool-calling workflows.
* ML/DL Foundations: Background in training, tuning, and running models using PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Scikit-learn in high-throughput environments.
* Inference & Acceleration: Familiarity with inference engines (vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, TGI) and cloud ML infrastructure (NVIDIA GPUs, TPUs).
* Data & Memory Infrastructure: Experience building low-latency vector search indices, in-memory caching layers, streaming pipelines (Kafka/Flink), and NoSQL datastores to power real-time agent context and memory.
* Education: Master's or Ph.D. in Computer Science, AI, ML, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent practical experience).

**Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities**

* Autonomous Execution: Proven track record as a senior IC who takes total ownership—from zero-to-one prototyping to production rollout.
* Cloud & DevOps: Exposure to AWS, Azure, or GCP environments with modern containerized deployment (Kubernetes, Docker).
* Domain & Communication: Experience in contact center/telecom/CX platforms is a plus; excellent technical communication skills required.

**Experience**
12+ Years of Experience
  
  
**Education**
Bachelor degree or equivalent experience
  
  
Advance Degree preferred in Computer Science or Related Field
  
  
Footer
  
  
Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future.
  
  
Avaya is an Equal Opportunity employer and a U.S. Federal Contractor. Our commitment to equality is a core value of Avaya. All qualified applicants and employees receive equal treatment without consideration for race, religion, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran or any other protected characteristic. In general, positions at Avaya require the ability to communicate and use office technology effectively. Physical requirements may vary by assigned work location. title: Lead - Digital Platforms and Consumer AI/Senior Lead - Digital Platforms and Consumer AI
description:
**Location Name:**
Pune Corporate Office - Mantri
  
  
**Job Purpose**
At Bajaj Finance, we help millions of people across India manage their money. People come to us when they want to buy a new phone on EMI, when they need a personal loan for a wedding, when they want to buy insurance, or when they want to grow their savings in a Fixed Deposit. Because we have so many customers, we get thousands of questions every single day. Customers want to know their account balance. They want to change the date their EMI gets deducted. They want to know the fees for closing a loan early.
  
  
In the past, to get these answers, a customer had to wait on hold to talk to a call center agent, or they had to tap through ten different screens on our mobile app. We want to change that. We want to make it as easy as sending a text message to a friend.
  
  
We are building a massive, highly intelligent AI (Artificial Intelligence) platform. Think of it like a super-smart chat assistant built right into the Bajaj Finance app. We want our customers to be able to just type out their problems in plain English, Hindi, or other languages, and have the AI fix the problem instantly. If a customer types, "Hey, I need to pause my loan payment this month," the AI should understand them, check their account, and do the work in seconds.
  
  
Building this is incredibly hard. It is not just a simple robot that gives canned answers. It is a smart system that has to understand human language, connect to our deep banking systems, and follow strict financial rules.
  
  
**Duties And Responsibilities**

* Conversation Flows

A normal conversation flows naturally. But computers need a map. They need to be told exactly how a conversation should go, step by step. You will create these maps, which we call Conversation Flows.
  
  
You will literally use a software tool to draw boxes and arrows on your screen.
  
  

* Box 1: The AI says, "Hello, how can I help?" -> Arrow points to Box 2.
* Box 2: The customer says, "I want to see my statement." -> Arrow points to Box 3.
* Box 3: The system checks if the customer's phone number is verified.

o If Yes -> Arrow points to Box 4.
  
  
o If No -> Arrow points to Box 5.
  
  

* Box 4: Show the statement on the screen.
* Box 5: Ask the customer to type in a one-time password (OTP).

You have to map out every single path the conversation could possibly take. You have to think of all the "what ifs." What if the customer types the wrong password? What if the customer stops replying and walks away from their phone? What if the internet crashes? You must draw a box and an arrow for every single situation. These flowcharts become the actual instruction manual for the engineers. They look at your map and write the code to make it happen exactly as you drew it.|Your Daily Work: The 9 Core Areas
  
  
**About**
Your job will be very hands-on. You will not just be sitting in long meetings talking about big ideas. You will be doing the real, detailed work to make this AI smart. Here are the nine specific areas you will be working on every day:
  
  

* FPR (Future Press Release)

Before a single line of computer code is written, you have to know what your end goal is. We do this by writing a Future Press Release, or FPR.
  
  
A press release is a news article that a company puts out when they launch a cool new product. But here, you will write this news article before we even start building. You will write it as if the product is already finished and launched to the public. You will write a catchy headline like: "Bajaj Finance Launches AI That Solves Loan Issues in 10 Seconds." You will write quotes from pretend customers talking about how much they love the feature. You will explain exactly what problem the feature solves in simple, everyday language.
  
  
Why do we do this? Because it keeps everyone focused. If the news article sounds boring or confusing, it means your idea is probably boring or confusing. Once you write a great FPR, you show it to the engineers and your bosses. When everyone reads it and says, "Wow, this sounds amazing, let's build it!"—that document becomes your team's guide.
  
  

* FAQ (Frequently Asked Questions)

Along with your news article, you will write a massive list of Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ). But these are not just the normal questions a customer might ask. These are questions that anyone involved might ask.
  
  
You have to put yourself in the shoes of a confused customer. What will they ask? "Is my bank data safe with this AI robot?" You write the answer. You have to think like our call center agents. "Will this AI do my job wrong and make the customer angry?" You write the answer. You have to think like our company lawyers. "Does this AI follow the Reserve Bank of India rules?" You write the answer.
  
  
The goal of this FAQ is to force you to find all the problems and risks before the engineers start building. If you cannot answer a tough question in your FAQ document, it means your plan has a hole in it, and you need to fix your plan.
  
  

* PPG (Product Program Guidelines)

Because Bajaj Finance deals with people's money, we have a lot of strict rules. We cannot just give a loan to anyone. We have to charge exact fees. We have to use exact interest rates. All of these strict rules are written down in company rulebooks called Product Program Guidelines, or PPG.
  
  
Every single product has a PPG. The personal loan has a PPG. The fixed deposit has a PPG. When we build the AI, the AI must follow the rules in the PPG perfectly. It cannot make a mistake. If the PPG says the late fee is 500 rupees, the AI cannot accidentally tell the customer the late fee is 400 rupees. That would cause a massive legal problem.|As a Product Manager, you will read these PPG rulebooks. You will pull out all the rules related to your project. You will work with the engineers to make sure these rules are permanently locked into the AI's brain. If the company changes a rule in the PPG next year, you are the person who makes sure the AI gets updated immediately.
  
  

* Synthetic Testing

Once the engineers build a version of the AI, we have to test it. But we cannot let a broken, untested AI talk to real Bajaj Finance customers. That is too risky. If the AI is confused, a real customer might get bad advice about their loan.
  
  
So, we use something called Synthetic Testing. "Synthetic" just means fake or made-up. You will help create thousands of fake conversations to test the AI safely. You will create fake customer profiles. For example, you make a fake customer named Rahul who has a home loan. You will type to the AI pretending to be Rahul. You will ask, "Can I pay off my whole loan today?" and see what the AI says.
  
  
Does the AI say yes? Does it calculate the early payment fee correctly? What if you pretend to be a customer who types with terrible spelling? What if you type in a mix of Hindi and English? What if you pretend to be very angry? Does the AI still understand and stay polite? You will run hundreds of these fake tests. When the AI fails, you write down why it failed, take that information back to the engineers, and tell them what to fix. You keep doing this until the AI passes every fake test perfectly.
  
  

* LLM Parameters (What We Send to the AI Brain)

The core brain of our AI is called a Large Language Model (LLM). Think of the LLM like an incredibly smart person sitting in a dark room. This person knows how to speak perfectly, but they have no idea who they are talking to.
  
  
If a customer types, "What is my balance?", the smart person in the dark room has no idea whose balance to check. So, we have to send the LLM a package of extra information along with the customer's question. We call this setting the LLM Parameters.
  
  
As the Product Manager, you will decide exactly what information goes into that package. When the customer asks about their balance, you will tell our computer systems: "Before you let the AI answer, grab the customer's name, grab their last three payments, and grab their current loan amount. Send all of that to the AI."
  
  
You also have to send strict instructions. You will tell the AI, "You are a helpful assistant for Bajaj Finance. Always be polite. Do not guess numbers. Only use the numbers I just sent you." If you send the AI too much information, it gets confused and it costs the company too much money to process. If you send too little information, the AI gives a stupid answer. Your job is to find the perfect balance of what data to send the AI every time a customer speaks.
  
  

* Visualisations

Chatting with an AI should not just be reading massive blocks of text. Nobody wants to read a giant paragraph of words on their small phone screen.|Sometimes, the best way to answer a customer is by showing them a picture, a chart, or a button. We call these Visualisations.
  
  
Let's say a customer asks, "How much of my loan have I paid off?" The AI could write a long, boring sentence with a bunch of numbers. But it is much better if the AI shows a nice, clean pie chart on the screen. Half the pie is green for the money paid, and half is grey for the money left. The customer understands it instantly.
  
  
Or, if the AI needs the customer to pick a date, it shouldn't make the customer type "October 15th." It should pop up a small calendar on the screen so the customer can just tap the day. You will decide when to use text and when to use these visual tools. You will work with our designers to sketch out how these charts and buttons should look so the chat is beautiful and easy to use.
  
  

* Product Switching

Imagine you are talking to a human salesman at a store. You ask about buying a TV. Then, suddenly, you change your mind and ask about buying a fridge. The human easily switches the topic to the fridge.Computers are not naturally good at this. If the computer is programmed to talk to you about a TV, and you ask about a fridge, the computer will get totally confused. It might say, "Error, I do not understand."
  
  
At Bajaj Finance, we have dozens of products. A customer might start a chat asking about their EMI shopping card. But halfway through the chat, they might say, "By the way, I also want to open a Fixed Deposit." The AI needs to smoothly switch from talking about the shopping card to talking about the Fixed Deposit without breaking or crashing.
  
  
We call this Product Switching. You will write the rules for how the AI handles these sudden changes in conversation. You will plan out how the AI remembers what the customer was talking about first, just in case the customer wants to go back to the original topic later.
  
  
**Required Qualifications And Experience**
The Background You Need (Education & Experience)
  
  
**Requirements**
Because this job requires you to build highly complex computer systems, we are very strict about the background you need to have. We are looking for people who meet these exact requirements:
  
  

* Your Education (The Degree and the College)

You must have a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a closely related technical computer field.
  
  
You must have graduated from a Tier 1 Engineering College. This means premier institutes like the IITs (Indian Institutes of Technology), NITs (National Institutes of Technology), or top-level Regional Engineering Colleges.
  
  
It is because the AI technology we are building is extremely complicated. You will be working side-by-side with some of the smartest software engineers in the country. You need to know how software is actually built. You need to understand coding logic, databases, and how computer servers talk to each other. Top engineering colleges train you to handle these tough, highly technical problems. If you do not have this strong computer science foundation, you will not be able to keep up with the engineering teams.
  
  
If you also have a Master's degree, that is great! We love to see it. But if you do not have a Master's degree, that is perfectly fine. It is not required. The Bachelor's degree from a Tier 1 college is what matters the most.
  
  

* Your Work Experience (2 to 3 Years in NLP/AI)

You cannot be fresh out of college for this job. You must have at least 2 to 3 years of actual, hands-on work experience.
  
  
More importantly, this experience must be in a very specific area. You must have worked on NLP platforms. It is the specific technology that teaches computers how to read, understand, and write human language.
  
  
You must have spent the last few years of your career actually building chatbots, voice assistants, or smart AI text tools. You cannot just be someone who managed a normal website or a standard mobile app.

title: Lead Forward Deployed Engineer
description:

The
**Lead Forward Deployed Engineer**
operates at the intersection of engineering, data, and customer deployment. In this hands-on, customer-facing role, you will lead complex enterprise onboardings to integrate, transform, and operationalize cybersecurity data into Qualys’ Enterprise TruRisk Management (ETM) platform. You will translate fragmented security environments into a unified risk model while bridging the gap between customer needs and core product engineering.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Customer Onboarding & Data Integration
  
  

* Strategic Execution: Lead end-to-end enterprise onboarding from strategy to production rollout, serving as the system of record for customer assets, findings, and business context.
* Pipeline & API Design: Build REST API, webhook, and scalable ingestion (e.g., S3-based ETL/ELT) pipelines to integrate diverse data sources (VM, EDR/XDR, Cloud, IAM, CMDBs, GRC).
* Data Modeling & Correlation: Design custom mapping, transformation, tagging, and asset criticality scoring; implement de-duplication and correlation logic across heterogeneous security feeds.
* Pipeline Reliability: Ensure continuous full and incremental data ingestion with automated scheduling, monitoring, and error handling.

Data Quality & Validation
  
  

* Data Integrity: Establish scalable validation frameworks to audit and maintain asset/findings accuracy for confident risk decision-making.
* Issue Resolution: Execute controlled reprocessing and configuration adjustments to fix data quality issues without disrupting operational metrics.

Dashboards, Remediation & Workflows
  
  

* Analytics & Modeling: Build customized dashboards, trend visualizations, and risk scoring models, including complex "toxic risk combination" scenarios.
* Workflow Automation: Integrate ETM with ticketing/remediation tools (Jira, ServiceNow) and configure automated alerts, escalations, and ownership mapping.
* Executive Reporting: Develop custom reports/utilities using public APIs for board-level, operational, and regulatory audiences.

Product & Engineering Feedback Loop
  
  

* Roadmap Influence: Translate field deployment challenges and recurring integration gaps into technical requirements for product and core engineering teams.
* Customer Maturity: Guide enterprises from initial risk visibility to automated, remediation-driven action.

Required Qualifications:
  
  

* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience: 8–10 years in data engineering, platform engineering, or customer-facing technical roles.
* Technical Stack:
* Strong programming proficiency in Python, Go, or similar languages.
* Deep experience with REST APIs, webhooks, asynchronous systems, and scalable ingestion pipelines (ETL/ELT).
* Hands-on knowledge of relational, NoSQL, search, or graph databases.
* Domain & Data Expertise:
* Strong foundation in data modeling, normalization, transformation, and correlation.
* Solid understanding of core cybersecurity domains (VM, Cloud Security, IAM, Risk Frameworks).
* Hands-on application of AI or automation to optimize data pipelines and onboarding workflows.
* Soft Skills: Exceptional client-facing, communication, and technical consultation skills.

Preferred Qualifications:
  
  

* Background in Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Engineering, or Technical Professional Services.
* Familiarity with large-scale, distributed systems and microservices architectures.
* Proven ability to thrive in high-impact, fast-paced, and ambiguous production environments.

**Job Title: Distinguished Engineer - Data Architect**

We are looking for a Distinguished Engineer- Data Architect to design and build the data foundation for our AI-driven security platform. In this role, you will own the architectural blueprint and core implementation of our data strategy, transforming massive streams of high-velocity network traffic logs, customer configurations, and security alerts into high-performance, ML-ready data fabrics.

As part of a lean, elite three-person Data & AI team, you will serve as the ultimate technical authority on data scale, streaming architecture, multi-tenant security, and cost-efficient storage systems.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* ****Architect the Core Data Platform:****
  Design, implement, and evolve a unified blueprint for streaming and batch data processing capable of ingesting, normalizing, and storing petabyte-scale, high-velocity security telemetry.
* ****Enable AI & Advanced Analytics:****
  Partner directly with the Lead AI Engineer to architect the underlying storage, retrieval systems, and feature stores—including optimal vector database structures and data lakehouse layers—required for low-latency AI inference and training.
* ****Enforce Zero-Trust Data Governance:****
  Architect strict multi-tenant isolation, data privacy guardrails, and compliance controls directly into the data fabric to protect sensitive customer network configurations and logs.
* ****Optimize Economics & Performance:****
  Drive infrastructure cost-efficiency and performance tuning across data processing engines, storage layers, and cloud infrastructure, balancing ultra-low latency requirements with predictable cost scaling.
* ****Lead by Example:****
  Write clean, foundational, high-performance code for critical infrastructure components, setting the standard for engineering excellence within the team.

**Required Experience & Skills:**

* ****Experience:****
  **12+ years of data engineering and architecture experience, with a proven track record of designing production systems handling massive, high-throughput streaming datasets (e.g., networking logs, telemetry, or real-time event streams).**
* ****Distributed Systems Expertise:****
  Deep, authoritative knowledge of distributed processing and streaming engines (e.g., Apache Flink, Spark, Kafka, Pulsar) and modern lakehouse architectures (e.g., Iceberg, Delta Lake).
* ****Hybrid Storage Architecture:****
  Mastery of polyglot persistence, spanning traditional relational databases, NoSQL, Columnar engines (e.g., ClickHouse, DuckDB), and Vector databases (e.g., Milvus, Qdrant, Pinecone).
* ****Security & Infrastructure:****
  Strong fundamentals in secure data architectures, network topography, encryption-at-rest/in-transit, containerization (Kubernetes), and cloud-native infrastructure (AWS/GCP/Azure).
* ****Mindset:****
  A rare combination of visionary architecture and hands-on execution. You thrive in ultra-lean teams, enjoy writing core code, and possess the pragmatism to build for immediate needs while planning for massive scale.

**Experience Level - 15+**
**Job Description**
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. We’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better. Join us and help build a better working world.
  
  
We are seeking a hands-on Cognite Solution Architect to design industrial data solutions for upstream and downstream Oil & Gas operations. You will define how operational, enterprise and engineering information is integrated, modelled and contextualized in Cognite Data Fusion (CDF), and how applications and analytical solutions consume that information. You will own solution architecture decisions, establish reusable implementation patterns and resolve complex technical issues across source systems, data models, access controls and consuming applications.
  
  
**Role Details**
**Key responsibilities include:**
**Architecture and integration**

* Translate operational use cases into data requirements, integration designs and application-consumption patterns.
* Define how CDF fits within historian, enterprise application, engineering information and cloud architectures.
* Select source-appropriate extractors, APIs and processing patterns, considering latency, throughput, connectivity and source-system load.
* Define historical loading, incremental extraction, reconciliation and recovery approaches, including late records, corrections and supported deletions.
* Establish requirements for service identities, access capabilities, environment separation, monitoring and operational support.

**Industrial information modelling**

* Design CDF models using spaces, containers, views and instances; select direct relations or edges according to relationship semantics and query requirements.
* Reuse and extend Cognite’s Core Data Model where suitable, introducing custom domain concepts where required.
* Define stable identifiers, source crosswalks and conflict-resolution rules, including repeated tag names across sites and systems.
* Represent physical equipment, functional locations and installation history separately where required.
* Establish schema versioning, migration and consumer-compatibility requirements while preserving lineage, timestamps, units, quality indicators and relationship provenance.

**Contextualization and Oil & Gas semantics**

* Design relationships connecting equipment and assets with time series, maintenance records, documents and engineering diagrams.
* Define matching rules, confidence thresholds, exception handling and domain review for ambiguous associations; assess coverage and match accuracy separately.
* For upstream applications, model fields, wells, wellbores, production facilities, equipment, well tests and interventions, preserving distinctions between measured, calculated and allocated production.

* Demonstrated personal architectural contribution to a production Cognite Data Fusion implementation.
* Strong knowledge of CDF data modelling, transformations, contextualization and access controls.
* Substantial industrial data integration experience spanning representative operational, enterprise and engineering sources.
* Strong Python and SQL skills with practical Cognite SDK and REST API experience.
* Experience defining identity strategies, model evolution, deployment patterns and production support requirements.
* Working knowledge of cloud architecture, identity providers, network boundaries and CI/CD.
* Strong Oil & Gas implementation experience in at least one upstream or downstream domain, with ability to adapt relevant concepts to the other.

**Good to Have**

* Cognite implementation experience across multiple assets or sites.
* Experience spanning both upstream and downstream.
* Familiarity with historians, maintenance systems, laboratory systems, engineering repositories or well-data services.
* Experience with diagram contextualization, 3D associations and industrial knowledge graphs.
* Experience enabling Cognite applications or AI workflows using contextualized data.
* Relevant Cognite Academy training or certifications.

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to solve high-impact industrial data and analytics challenges across upstream and downstream Oil & Gas.
* A hands-on leadership role with scope to establish reusable practices and guide multidisciplinary teams.
* A collaborative environment spanning domain engineering, data, technology, product and global EY teams.
* Access to EY’s global network, technology ecosystem and learning opportunities while contributing to a better working world.

**What We Look For**
A hands-on architect who can defend consequential production Cognite decisions involving identity resolution, data-model design, access boundaries, recovery, schema migration and application compatibility, and demonstrate which patterns can be reused across sites and which require adaptation.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**

title: Integration Analyst
description:
**Who We Are:**
Since 1906, New Balance has empowered people through sport and craftsmanship to create positive change in communities around the world. We innovate fearlessly, guided by our core values and driven by the belief that conventions were meant to be challenged. We foster a culture in which every associate feels welcomed and respected, where leaders and creatives are inspired to shape the world of tomorrow by taking bold action today.
  
  
**Integrations Analyst**
*The largest and most impactful transformation in our 100+ year history is currently underway at New Balance. We have started a digital revolution, investing in exciting new capabilities for both our customers and associates. One of our primary initiatives is the reimagining of our global integration platforms that will unite our core business processes, aligning the demands of our channel sales with the real-time status of our supply chain. By unlocking new support functionality and consumer insights, this platform will allow us to anticipate and better serve the needs of our customers. We’re seeking agile thinkers who can quickly adapt in a collaborative, high-performance culture. Are you ready to join the revolution?*
**General Summary:**
As a Configuration Analyst for integrations, you will build, configure, and maintain EDI and non-EDI integration solutions on the Partner LINQ platform, contributing to New Balance’s global digital transformation. You will play a central role in migrating legacy IBM Sterling EDI and Cleo Harmony MFT integrations onto Partner LINQ — configuring mappings, orchestration flows, and business rules — helping drive New Balance to be a Top 3 Global Athletic Brand through responsive, standardized integration workflows that support consistent business growth, expand market share, and strengthen brand equity and reputation
  
  
**MAJOR ACCOUNTABILTIES:**

* Create and configure mappings, process/orchestration flows, business rules, cross-reference schemas, and lookups within the PartnerLinQ Design Studio to meet business requirements.
* Convert existing IBM Sterling maps and Cleo MFT flows to PartnerLinQ, leveraging AI Mapping Agent / template-based tooling to standardize and optimize designs for reuse.
* Perform unit testing on all integrations, coordinate with end-system teams, and support SIT and UAT cycles, producing test result reports against production sample files.
* Manage controlled promotion of tested configurations (mappings, alerts, dashboards, partnerships) from lower to production environments, validating dependencies and completeness before migration.
* Support white-glove partner onboarding: gather EDI specifications, IDs, and connection details; build mapping templates; run connection and business-rule testing.
* Support production deployments and provide post-go-live hypercare, troubleshooting transaction and mapping issues and creating SOPs / runbooks.
* Follow approved integration governance patterns, intake, documentation standards, and SLA checkpoints for all net-new and migrated integrations.

**REQUIREMENTS FOR SUCCESS:**
Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent experience). 3 to 5 years of Hands-on experience configuring EDI/B2B integrations, ideally on PartnerLinQ or a comparable platform (IBM Sterling, Cleo), preferred.
  
  

* Working knowledge of EDI standards — X12, EDIFACT/EANCOM — and common transaction sets (850, 855, 856, 810, 820, 846)
* Mapping to/from canonical and flat-file formats
* Data transformation using XML, JSON, flat files, and XSLT
* Target systems such as D365 F&O, SAP, SQL
* Transport protocols — AS2, SFTP, API/VAN
* PartnerLinQ Business Rule Engine, Cross Reference Schema, and Artifacts Migration (plus)
* Azure Integration Services (AIS) exposure (plus)
* Git / Azure DevOps (plus)
* Sterling→PLQ or Cleo→PLQ/AIS migration experience (nice to have)
* Solid analytical, documentation, and troubleshooting skills; ability to translate business requirements into detailed configurations. Good communication, critical thinking, and collaboration skills.
* undefined

Our hybrid model encourages rich in-person experiences, showcasing our commitment to teamwork and connection, while providing high levels of flexibility to associates. description:
**Role Title: 2603010 AVP, AI Security Architect (L11)**
**Company Overview**
Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as #3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the #1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
  
  
**Organizational Overview**
The Security Architecture organization enables Synchrony to innovate and grow securely by embedding security-by-design into technology solutions. We partner with engineering, platform, data, cloud, and business teams to translate security strategy and evolving threats into practical architecture requirements, reusable patterns, blueprints, and guardrails. Through risk-based architecture reviews, threat modeling, and scalable security guidance, the team helps protect Synchrony’s digital assets and customer data while supporting resilient, compliant, and efficient technology delivery. This role will contribute to advancing our AI Security Architecture capabilities, helping establish secure patterns and assurance practices for Generative AI, AI agents, and other emerging AI technologies.
  
  
**Role Summary/Purpose**
**The AVP, AI Security Architect**
will design and advance security architectures for Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, Machine Learning, and emerging AI technologies. The role will translate enterprise security strategy and evolving AI threats into practical requirements, reusable patterns, and engineering guidance that enable secure innovation while protecting company, customer, and sensitive data.
  
  
Working across Cybersecurity, Technology, Data, AI/ML Engineering, Cloud, Risk, and Business teams, the architect will lead solution-level security assessments, contribute to enterprise standards, and embed security-by-design through threat modeling, control validation, testing, and continuous assurance across the AI lifecycle.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Apply and help mature enterprise AI security architecture principles, standards, reference architectures, and guardrails.
* Design reusable security patterns for Generative AI, copilots, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), model and inference APIs, autonomous or agentic AI, and enterprise AI platforms.
* Lead security architecture assessments for complex AI solutions across cloud, SaaS, API, data, application, and enterprise technology environments.
* Partner with AI/ML engineers, application teams, cloud architects, data teams, and product owners to embed security throughout design, development, deployment, integration, monitoring, and retirement.
* Perform AI threat modeling using MITRE ATLAS and OWASP guidance, translating identified threats into actionable controls and engineering requirements.
* Define and validate controls for model access, identities, service accounts, secrets, APIs, prompts, training and retrieval data, outputs, plugins, tools, and third-party AI services.
* Assess risks such as prompt injection, data poisoning, sensitive information disclosure, insecure tool interaction, excessive agency, model manipulation, and AI supply-chain compromise.
* Contribute to automation of architecture reviews, threat modeling, vulnerability assessment, control validation, and security testing.
* Document architecture decisions, material risks, trade-offs, and recommendations for technical teams and senior stakeholders.
* Collaborate with Enterprise Architecture, Cloud, Application Security, Data, Responsible AI, Privacy, Legal, Compliance, Risk, and Business partners.
* Create implementation guidance and enablement that help engineering teams adopt approved AI security patterns consistently.

**Required Skills/Knowledge**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Strong experience in cybersecurity, security architecture, cloud security, application security, or enterprise architecture, including delivery of complex security initiatives.
* Practical knowledge of modern AI architectures, including Large Language Models, RAG, vector databases, embeddings, model gateways, AI agents, orchestration frameworks, managed AI services, and model or inference APIs.
* Strong foundation in identity and access management, application and API security, cloud security, data protection, secrets and key management, DevSecOps, and software supply-chain security.
* Knowledge of AI security and risk frameworks such as the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, MITRE ATLAS, NIST AI Risk Management Framework, and Zero Trust principles.
* Experience designing or reviewing enterprise architectures on AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
* Ability to convert technical risks into architecture requirements, reusable patterns, engineering guidance, and clear recommendations.
* Demonstrated ability to influence technical stakeholders, facilitate architecture decisions, and build alignment across teams.
* Strong written, verbal, presentation, and stakeholder-management skills.

**Desired Skills/Knowledge**

* Experience securing platforms such as Amazon Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Copilot, or comparable enterprise AI services.
* Experience with AI red teaming, adversarial testing, model security assessment, prompt-injection testing, or AI vulnerability management.
* Familiarity with NIST AI RMF, MITRE ATLAS, OWASP guidance, ISO/IEC 42001, and evolving AI governance expectations.
* Ability to move effectively between detailed technical architecture, engineering execution, risk discussions, and stakeholder communication.
* Experience developing reference architectures, security blueprints, automated guardrails, and scalable control-assurance capabilities.
* Financial-services cybersecurity, regulatory, risk-management, or data-protection experience is a plus.
* Collaborative and execution-oriented approach, with a focus on simplification, automation, measurable outcomes, and responsible innovation.

**Eligibility Criteria**
Bachelor's degree with 6+ years of experience in Cyber industry, security architecture experience including on-prem and hybrid environments and practical knowledge of modern AI architectures, including Large Language Models, RAG, vector databases, embeddings, model gateways, AI agents, orchestration frameworks, managed AI services, and model or inference APIs.
  
  
**Work Timings:**
2:00 PM– 11:00 PM IST
  
  
We are proud to offer flexibility at Synchrony. Our way of working allows you the option to work from home or workspaces in our Regional Engagement Hubs—Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Pune, Kolkata, or Delhi/NCR. Occasionally you may be required to commute or travel to Hyderabad or one of the Regional Engagement Hubs for in person engagement activities such as business or team meetings, trainings, and culture events.

title: Software Engineering Manager, Agentic Transformation for Graphics Systems
description:
Agents are changing how all software will be built. Agentic systems can perform substantial engineering work. It is still unproven whether they can be a reliable production capability at graphics systems' quality standards. Meanwhile, teams continue shipping new features, sustaining platforms, and meeting product commitments. Graphics drivers are a difficult proving ground. They involve large codebases, complex hardware-OS interactions, strict performance demands, broad application compatibility, and formal safety obligations in automotive.
  
  
NVIDIA seeks an engineering manager in India to develop a new framework for agentic software development. You will test this model against one of our most fast-paced production software stacks. You will lead a graphics systems team through this transition and continue delivering the necessary product roadmap. Afterwards, you will transform effective practices into a reusable engineering product for other teams. You will grow the people, technology, and operating model together, creating an ambitious, highly engaged team that uses agents to surpass typical capacity. Success goes beyond one team’s transformation; it establishes a production-proven system for software development in the agentic era at NVIDIA.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Develop and launch an end-to-end production model for agentic software development. Apply it to graphics systems, where agents perform engineering tasks from requirements and diagnosis to implementation, validation, review, and release.
* Define the technical strategy and transformation roadmap, turning fast paced agentic capabilities into dependable production execution and steadily growing the work agents complete end to end.
* Keep the team delivering its must-do graphics and display roadmap. This includes new features, platform enablement, performance, stability, and release commitments. At the same time, fundamentally evolve how that work gets done.
* Build an ambitious, highly engaged team that produces outstanding results, nurturing engineers and technical leaders alongside the technology and operating model.
* Transform the established agentic engineering system into a reusable product for other teams. Package its orchestration, skills, tools, evaluations, validators, and operating methods. Collaborate across NVIDIA to encourage adoption with measurable production outcomes.

**What We Need To See**

* Demonstrated experience developing and delivering production software via autonomous engineering systems that include planning, tool application, retrieval, memory, evaluation, and validation, with agents handling a significant portion of actual engineering tasks.
* Demonstrated ability to turn a fast paced and ambiguous technical opportunity into a clear strategy, roadmap, and measurable production system while keeping an existing product roadmap on track.
* 10+ overall years of software engineering experience, including 3+ years of engineering management or technical leadership, with a degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* Strong technical foundations in complex production software, including systems architecture, debugging, validation, CI/CD, and release engineering.
* High-agency, results-focused leadership: you build an environment where people grow, enjoy doing their best work, and use technology to deliver results far beyond the team’s traditional capacity.

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Acknowledged advancements in the field of agentic systems, shown through peer-reviewed publications, widely embraced open-source projects, public benchmarks, or other externally validated outcomes.
* Experience with graphics or display driver development and technologies such as Vulkan, OpenGL ES, EGL, SurfaceFlinger, HWC, Gralloc, UMD/KMD drivers, X11, or Wayland.
* Familiarity with NVIDIA DRIVE OS and experience developing safety-critical automotive software using standards such as ISO 26262 and ASIL.
* Meaningful contributions to the Linux kernel, graphics software ecosystem, developer tools, or other broadly adopted systems software.

NVIDIA is widely considered one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working with us. If you are a creative and autonomous engineering leader who wants to invent how the most demanding production software will be built in the agentic era and prove it by helping real driver teams ship, we would love to hear from you.

description:

We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Senior Platform Architect
  
  
Who is Mastercard?
  
  
Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.
  
  
Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.
  
  
**Overview**
The Infrastructure Engineering team is looking for a Senior Platform Architect to lead the design and evolution of secure, scalable, and resilient enterprise infrastructure platforms that power Mastercard's critical business services. The ideal candidate is a strategic technology leader with deep expertise in enterprise architecture, infrastructure engineering, and cloud technologies. They are highly collaborative, intellectually curious, and passionate about solving complex technical challenges while driving innovation, operational excellence, and platform modernization. This individual excels at partnering across engineering, security, and product organizations to deliver scalable solutions that enable business growth and provide exceptional customer experiences.
  
  
Role
  
  

* Lead the architecture, design, and delivery of highly available, scalable, and secure enterprise infrastructure solutions across on-premises, hybrid, and cloud environments.
* Partner with Engineering, Network, Security, Cloud, Database, Middleware, Product, and Program Management teams to develop infrastructure solutions that support business and technology strategies.
* Drive infrastructure solution delivery from initial business engagement through architecture reviews, financial approvals, procurement, implementation, operational readiness, and production deployment.
* Design resilient networking, application delivery, and security architectures utilizing enterprise technologies including load balancing, web application firewalls, API gateways, and distributed infrastructure platforms.
* Lead infrastructure modernization initiatives focused on automation, Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC), platform standardization, performance optimization, resiliency, and operational excellence.
* Develop enterprise architecture standards, technical roadmaps, and infrastructure documentation while mentoring engineering teams and promoting engineering best practices.
* Ensure infrastructure solutions meet stringent requirements for security, compliance, availability, scalability, disaster recovery, and performance across mission-critical platforms.

**All About You**
Essential Knowledge, Skills & Experience
  
  

* Deep expertise in enterprise infrastructure architecture across data center, hybrid cloud, and distributed computing environments.
* Advanced knowledge of enterprise networking, application delivery, and infrastructure security, including Zero Trust principles and modern network architectures.
* Experience designing and supporting enterprise platforms utilizing VMware, cloud technologies (AWS, Azure, GCP), load balancing, web application firewalls, API gateways, and distributed infrastructure.
* Strong expertise in infrastructure automation, Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, Ansible), CI/CD integration, and configuration management using tools such as Git, Bitbucket, and Jenkins.
* Demonstrated ability to architect and deliver highly available, resilient, and secure infrastructure solutions while collaborating effectively across cross-functional engineering and business teams.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to influence technical and executive stakeholders.

**Desirable Or Additional Capabilities**

* Expertise in infrastructure performance engineering, including capacity planning, scalability testing, and performance optimization.
* Advanced experience creating technical architecture documentation and executive presentations using Microsoft Visio.
* Experience supporting mission-critical financial services platforms with stringent availability, security, resiliency, and regulatory compliance requirements.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

## Sales & Business Development Trainee

### About Vedricx Global

Vedricx Global LLP is focused on career-oriented professional training programs designed to help students and graduates develop industry-relevant skills, professional communication, personality development and customer-service capabilities.

We are looking for motivated and confident individuals to join our Sales & Business Development team and help prospective students understand our Professional Diploma Program.

### Role Overview

As a Sales & Business Development Associate, you will be responsible for contacting interested prospects, conducting initial counseling, presenting the program, managing follow-ups and converting qualified prospects into successful enrollments.

The company will provide product training, sales scripts, lead-handling guidance and support from the management team.

### Key Responsibilities

- Contact prospective students through phone calls and company-provided leads.

- - Understand students' educational backgrounds, career goals and training requirements.

- - Explain the Professional Diploma Program, course structure, duration, fees and learning outcomes.

- - Conduct initial counseling and handle questions professionally.

- - Maintain consistent follow-ups with interested prospects.

- - Support interested students throughout the enrollment and payment process.

- - Update all lead information, follow-up dates, call outcomes and enrollment status in the company CRM.

- - Submit daily performance reports and participate in review meetings.

- - Maintain professional communication and follow ethical sales practices.

### Compensation Structure

\*\*Month 1 — Training/Performance Evaluation and Incentives\*\*

The first month will focus on evaluating your sales ability, communication skills, follow-up discipline and contribution to successful enrollments.

The proposed incentive structure is as follows:

| Performance milestone             | Incentive || ------------------------------------------------------------------------ | --------: || Each successful enrollment            | ₹2,000 || Additional incentive when the student pays 50% of the total program fee |  ₹500 || Additional incentive when the student pays 100% of the total program fee | ₹1,000 |

\*\*Earning example:\*\* If you successfully enroll a student and the student subsequently pays the entire program fee, your total incentive for that enrollment can reach \*\*₹3,500\*\*: ₹2,000 for the enrollment, ₹500 at the 50% payment milestone, and a further ₹1,000 when the full fee is collected.

An enrollment will qualify for the applicable incentive once it meets the company's documented enrollment and payment verification criteria. The complete incentive policy and payout conditions will be communicated in writing before joining.

The first-month compensation arrangement will be documented in the offer terms and will comply with applicable employment and minimum-wage requirements.

\*\*Month 2 Onwards — Fixed Monthly Compensation\*\* Promoted As Assosciate

Based on the first month's performance review, candidates may be considered for a fixed monthly salary in the range of \*\*₹12,000–₹25,000\*\*, plus any applicable performance incentives under the written compensation plan.

The salary offered will depend on demonstrated performance, communication skills, enrollment conversions, verified fee collections, CRM discipline and overall suitability for the role. The final fixed salary and incentive terms will be confirmed in writing before the second month begins and will meet applicable statutory wage requirements.

### How Performance Will Be Evaluated

Performance will be assessed using measurable criteria, including:

1. Quality and consistency of calls.

2. Ability to explain the program and counsel prospects.

3. Follow-up discipline and lead management.

4. Successful enrollments and verified fee collections.

5. CRM accuracy, reporting and professional conduct.

6. Attendance, accountability and willingness to learn.

The company will provide clear expectations and feedback so candidates understand how their performance is being assessed.

### Eligibility Criteria

- Good verbal communication skills in Hindi and English.

- - Confidence in speaking with prospective students over calls.

- - A professional attitude and willingness to learn.

- - Basic computer knowledge and familiarity with Google Sheets or Microsoft Excel.

- - Reliable internet access and a suitable remote working environment.

- - Ability to work six hours per day, Monday to Saturday.

Fresh graduates, final-year students with suitable availability, and candidates interested in sales, business development, counseling or customer service are encouraged to apply.

### Training and Development

Selected candidates will receive guidance in product knowledge, call handling, counseling techniques, objection handling, follow-up strategies, CRM management and ethical sales practices.

### Career Growth

Candidates who demonstrate strong performance, consistency and professional conduct may be considered for higher compensation, expanded responsibilities and future leadership opportunities as the business grows.

### How to Apply

Interested candidates should share their updated CV, educational background, relevant experience (if any), current location and availability.

\*\*Build your sales career with Vedricx Global LLP and grow with a performance-driven team.\*\*

8. **Daily Reporting:**

Mandatory Performance Expectations

* 150–175 outbound calls every working day.
* Consistent lead generation and follow-ups.
* Regular scheduling of qualified product demonstrations.
* Achievement of monthly customer acquisition targets.
* Accurate CRM updates and daily reporting.
* Professional communication with lawyers and legal professionals.

**Cold calling is the core responsibility of this position.**
Candidates must be comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls and handling rejection professionally.

* Freshers with excellent communication and convincing skills may apply.

* Strong persuasion, negotiation and follow-up skills.
* Comfortable working with daily targets and performance metrics.
* Basic knowledge of MS Excel, Google Sheets or CRM tools.

* Enjoys speaking with new people and building professional connections.
* Is confident initiating conversations with strangers.
* Can communicate a product's value convincingly.
* Is persistent, disciplined and comfortable with rejection.
* Takes ownership of daily targets and sales outcomes.
* Wants to grow in a fast-moving startup environment.

Compensation & Work Conditions

  As per company policy.

title: Sales Officer / Area Sales Manager
description:
About Clucks

Clucks is India's food-loving brand that celebrates chicken flavours. We have travelled across the country to learn how India eats, and beyond to see how the world eats. What didn’t add up for us was that three in four Indians eat non-veg and India is a country of a thousand flavours, yet its snacks still come in the 5 generic flavours. And that’s the gap we decided to fill.

Our first product is Chicken-Flavoured Chips, which is 100% vegetarian.

We took almost a year to make the chip “excellent”, and that is the rule we live by: nothing ships until it is “excellent”. We're a small team in Gurugram, launching across channels in Delhi NCR.

The roles

We're hiring two roles for one team in Delhi NCR, and you can apply for either through this post. The Area Sales Manager builds and leads our first field team and owns the territory: the distributors, the secondary sales and the numbers behind them. The Sales Officer is the person who gets Clucks onto shelves and into hands across a beat. Both learn field sales from a founder who has led it at national scale. Tell us which role you're applying for in the first screening question.

Area Sales Manager: what you'll do

• Build the Delhi NCR distributor network: appoint, onboard and review distributors, and hold each one to a plan on coverage, stock and ROI.

• Hire, train and run a team of Sales Officers: beat plans, daily reviews, targets and the field coaching that makes them good.

• Own secondary sales for the territory: forecasts by distributor, primary-to-secondary discipline, stock freshness and claim settlement.

• Run trade schemes and visibility spends in the market, and report what each one returned.

• Bring the market back to the founder every week: what's selling, where we're losing, what to change.

Area Sales Manager: what you bring

• 6–10 years of FMCG general-trade sales, with at least 2 years leading a field team of Sales Officers.

• Distributors you've appointed and grown, ideally in snacks, food or beverages, and a working network across Delhi NCR.

• Comfort with numbers: distributor P&L and ROI, scheme costing, and DMS or SFA reporting.

• A builder's mindset: you'll set the territory up from zero, then run it.

• Fluent Hindi; working English.

Sales Officer: what you'll do

• Appoint distributors and engage wholesalers across your territory.

• Open and grow outlets across your beat: kiranas, modern trade stores and other high-footfall formats.

• Manage your distributors end to end: their salesmen, orders, stock levels, expiry management, claim settlement and collections.

• Run your beat plan and daily calls, and own your secondary sales numbers.

• Win visibility: shelf placement, displays, POSM and in-store sampling.

• Bring back what you see in the market: what's selling, what competitors are doing, what retailers ask for.

• Log your day on our sales app, so decisions are made on real numbers.

Sales Officer: what you bring

• 2–10 years of FMCG field sales, ideally in snacks, food or beverages.

• A working network of distributors, wholesalers and retailers in Delhi NCR.

• Comfort with targets, beat plans and DMS or SFA apps.

• Your own two-wheeler and a valid driving licence.

• Fluent Hindi; working English.

Why Clucks

We went around the world for flavours and brought back something more: the people-first way the best teams work. Trust over hierarchy. Credit where it's earned, by name. Room to grow as fast as Clucks does. You work with the founder and own real problems from day one.

How to apply

Apply with Easy Apply, answer every screening question and attach your latest resume. Applications without a resume won't be reviewed.

description:
**Company Description**
Rohit Exergy India Private Limited accelerates the transition to sustainable energy by manufacturing premium-grade biomass wood pellets for industrial thermal applications. The company delivers high-density, high-calorific bio-coal alternatives that meet stringent technical requirements for boilers, furnaces, thermic fluid heaters, and co-firing systems across sectors such as metal, textiles, food processing, chemicals, pharmaceuticals, and heavy manufacturing. The organization focuses on helping clients transition cost-effectively from fossil fuels while maintaining consistent performance in both automated and manual-feed heating systems.

**Role Description**
The Technical Sales Manager – Biomass Pellets & Industrial Heating is a full-time, on-site role based in Ghaziabad. This role is responsible for driving sales of biomass pellets and briquettes to industrial clients, managing key accounts, and supporting customers in transitioning from fossil fuels to biomass solutions. Day-to-day activities include identifying and qualifying new business opportunities, conducting technical presentations and site visits, preparing proposals, and negotiating contracts with decision-makers in manufacturing and process industries. The role involves providing technical guidance on combustion systems, boiler compatibility, and performance optimization, while coordinating closely with operations teams to ensure timely supply and after-sales support. The Technical Sales Manager will maintain regular communication with customers, monitor market trends, and contribute insights to product and strategy development.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong Technical Sales and Sales skills, including experience selling industrial energy or heating solutions.
* Develop and maintain an active network of industrial biomass pellet buyers.
* Identify customers currently using biomass pellets from competing suppliers and develop opportunities for conversion.
* Candidates should possess Account Management skills to build, retain, and grow long-term industrial customer relationships.
* Candidates should possess Technical Support skills to advise clients on boiler systems, combustion performance, and fuel conversion.
* Candidates should possess Customer Service skills to handle inquiries, resolve issues, and ensure high satisfaction throughout the customer lifecycle.
* Relevant experience in industrial heating, boilers, combustion systems, or biomass/fuel markets is highly beneficial.
* Ability to interpret technical specifications, conduct site assessments, and collaborate with engineering and operations teams.
* Prepare quotations, commercial proposals and techno-commercial offers.
* Strong communication, negotiation, and presentation skills, with proficiency in English and regional languages as applicable.
* Undergraduate degree in engineering, energy, or a related technical or business discipline is preferred; equivalent practical experience will also be considered.
* Willingness to travel to customer sites and industrial facilities as required.
* Existing network of industrial customers or potential biomass pellet buyers.
* Proven experience in biomass pellet sales with measurable sales performance

**Compensation**

Competitive fixed salary + performance-based incentives

Working on Royalty / Commission based model is also open.

Compensation will be aligned with relevant experience, existing customer network and demonstrated pellet-sales performance.

Interested candidates can apply directly through Indeed.

title: TC-CS-AD-Cyber LDE
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY GDS CYBER LARGE DEAL GROUP**
**Cyber Solutions Architect**
Pre-Sales | Client Storytelling | Commercial & Pricing | Turnkey Cyber Services
  
  
**Executive mandate to**
Shape and lead differentiated, executable and commercially compelling turnkey cyber services propositions for strategic pursuits, converting complex client priorities into a persuasive value story, integrated architecture, delivery model and price-to-win.
  
  
**The opportunity**
The Cyber Large Deal Engine brings together Business Case Researchers, Cyber Domain Specialists, Solution Architects, and Finance & Commercial Specialists to create an integrated deal-shaping capability, connecting client and market insight, deep cyber expertise, end-to-end solution architecture, and commercial modelling to build propositions that are differentiated, deliverable and positioned to win.
  
  
It is a senior pursuit leadership position for an architect who can operate credibly across the boardroom, the solution room and the commercial model. The role requires breadth across cyber domains, depth in at least one major cyber capability, and the judgement to integrate specialist inputs into one coherent, differentiated and deliverable proposition.
  
  
**Role Accountabilities**
**Lead strategic solutioning and pursuits**

* Own the solution from qualification and discovery through business case build out , architecture, proposal development, governance, oral presentation, negotiation and BAFO.
* Establish the solution strategy, win themes, design principles and response plan for complex RFPs, RFIs and proactive pursuits.
* Translate client requirements into an integrated managed services model spanning people, process, technology, governance, service management and transformation.
* Define scope, architecture, operating model, transition approach, delivery footprint, staffing model, service levels, assumptions, dependencies and risks.
* Mobilise and lead multidisciplinary contributors across domains and geographies, ensuring one solution, one story and one commercial position.

**Create a compelling customer story**

* Frame the client’s business context, cyber risk and operational challenge before presenting the solution.
* Convert technical complexity into an outcome-led narrative that is relevant to CISOs, CIOs, business executives and procurement leaders.
* Connect solution choices to measurable outcomes such as risk reduction, resilience, control effectiveness, experience, operational efficiency and cost transparency.
* Lead executive discovery sessions, workshops, whiteboarding, solution walkthroughs, oral pitches and solution-defence discussions.
* Anticipate objections and competitive alternatives, articulating clearly why the proposition is credible, differentiated, scalable and valuable.

**Own commercial solutioning and pricing**

* Translate the solution into a robust bottom-up cost model covering resource pyramids, effort, delivery locations, platforms, licences, transition and ongoing run costs.
* Work with finance and commercial teams to develop competitive, sustainable and traceable pricing, with clear linkage between scope, service levels, cost and price.
* Evaluate fixed-price, consumption-based, unit-based, outcome-aligned and hybrid charging models based on client context and risk allocation.
* Optimise the solution through automation, standardisation, global delivery leverage, right-shoring, reusable assets and platform choices without compromising outcomes.
* Understand margin drivers, contingencies, contractual dependencies and change levers; support commercial governance, negotiation, BAFO and renewal decisions.

**Architect integrated turnkey cyber services**

* Provide broad solution leadership across Identity and Access Management, Privileged Access Management, Customer IAM, Non-Human Identity, Threat Detection and Response, SOC, SIEM, SOAR, XDR, Vulnerability Management, Threat Intelligence and Threat Hunting.
* Bring familiarity with major platforms including SailPoint, Saviynt, Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, CyberArk, BeyondTrust, Delinea, Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender, Splunk and CrowdStrike.
* Design for cloud, on-premise and hybrid environments, integrating EY capabilities, alliance partners, technology vendors and client-retained responsibilities.
* Know when to make an architectural decision and when to engage a deep specialist, while retaining accountability for the integrity of the end-to-end solution.
* Position AI-enabled security operations, automation and platform-led delivery where they create a credible and measurable client advantage.

**Build repeatable deal-engine capability**

* Create and improve reference architectures, solution patterns, estimators, pricing models, proposal content, assumptions libraries and executive storytelling assets.
* Capture pursuit insights, commercial benchmarks and lessons learned to improve future speed, consistency and win quality.
* Coach solution contributors on structured solutioning, client storytelling, estimation discipline and executive presentation.

**Decision scope and influence**

* Recommends the end-to-end solution strategy, architecture, delivery model and commercial assumptions for assigned pursuits.
* Challenges requirements and design choices that reduce value, increase delivery risk or weaken competitiveness.
* Balances client outcomes, architectural integrity, delivery feasibility, commercial sustainability and speed to market.
* Influences partners, pursuit leaders, SMEs, alliances, delivery executives and commercial stakeholders without relying on formal authority.
* Escalates material solution, delivery, contractual and financial risks with clear options and recommendations.

**Measures of success**

* Pursuit impact: Quality and competitiveness of strategic proposals; contribution to progression and wins.
* Client impact: Clarity of the story, executive confidence and alignment to measurable outcomes.
* Commercial quality: Accurate, traceable estimates and sustainable pricing with risks made explicit.
* Solution integrity: Integrated, scalable and deliverable solutions with clear ownership and dependencies.
* Execution discipline: Timely mobilisation, governance and high-quality outputs under pursuit deadlines.
* Capability uplift: Reusable assets, improved consistency and stronger solutioning maturity across the engine.

**Experience And Capabilities**

* Typically 15+ years of relevant experience in cyber consulting, solution architecture, pre-sales or managed services, with demonstrated leadership of large and complex pursuits.
* Proven ability to move fluently between executive business conversations, cyber architecture, operating model design and commercial/pricing discussions.
* Depth in at least one major cyber domain, combined with sufficient breadth to shape integrated solutions across multiple capabilities.
* Practical experience building bottom-up estimates, cost models and pricing inputs for managed services opportunities.
* Exceptional customer presence, storytelling, writing, facilitation and presentation skills, including leadership of oral pitches and solution defence.
* Strong analytical judgement and the ability to make pragmatic trade-offs under ambiguity, commercial pressure and demanding deadlines.
* Experience working across distributed global teams and with alliance partners, technology vendors, finance, legal, risk and contracting stakeholders.
* Bachelor’s degree such as BTech/BE or equivalent; MCA or another relevant postgraduate qualification is advantageous.

**Preferred Credentials And Exposure**

* Relevant certifications in security architecture, IAM, cloud security, SIEM/SOC or major technology platforms.
* Experience in competitive deal shaping, transformation programmes, renewals and transition from incumbent providers.
* Experience creating reusable propositions, reference architectures, estimators or pricing assets.
* Working knowledge of regulatory, legal, compliance and contractual considerations for managed services.
* Ability to operate effectively with international stakeholders and support Europe and US working hours when required.

**Leadership profile**

* Client-first: listens before designing and anchors the proposition in the client’s priorities.
* Commercially astute: understands that the strongest architecture must also be executable, priceable and competitive.
* Persuasive: makes complex ideas simple and turns technical capability into business value.
* Integrative: creates alignment across specialists, geographies, partners and competing priorities.
* Accountable: owns the quality and integrity of the whole solution, not only an individual component.
* Composed under pressure: brings structure, pace and judgement to high-value pursuits with incomplete information.

**Why this role matters**
The Cyber Solutions Architect will directly influence the quality, differentiation and commercial strength of EY’s most strategic turnkey cyber services pursuits. The role offers the opportunity to shape major client transformations, work across leading technology ecosystems and build the repeatable solutioning capability of the Cyber Large Deal Engine.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

**Hiring: Data Archiving Analyst**

**Location:**
Gurgaon, India

Hybrid

Permanent

**About the Organisation**

Our client is a leading Canada-based global organisation with a strong international presence and operations across multiple countries.The organisation is investing significantly in its global digital transformation, strengthening enterprise data platforms, governance frameworks and data management capabilities to support business growth, operational excellence and informed decision-making.As part of this transformation, we are looking for an experienced
**Data Archiving Analyst**
to strengthen the organisation's global Data Platform Governance function.

**Role Overview**

The Data Archiving Analyst will be responsible for designing, implementing and managing enterprise-wide data archiving, retention and lifecycle management practices.

The role will focus on ensuring that enterprise data is retained, archived and disposed of in accordance with business, legal and regulatory requirements across global operations.

The position will work closely with SAP, Data Platform, Legal, Privacy, Compliance and Business teams to establish robust data retention policies and controls across SAP S/4HANA and Databricks environments.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Data Archiving & Retention Strategy**

* Develop and implement enterprise-wide data archiving and retention policies aligned with business and regulatory requirements.
* Establish data retention schedules across multiple business domains and systems.
* Define data disposal standards, ensuring secure, compliant and auditable deletion processes.
* Manage legal hold requirements in collaboration with Legal, Privacy and Compliance teams.
* Periodically review and update retention policies based on regulatory and business changes.

**2. SAP S/4HANA Data Archiving**

* 7+ years of experience in Data Management, Data Governance, Enterprise Data Architecture or related areas, with a strong focus on data archiving and retention.
