title: Talent Acquisition Manager
description:
**About Urban Company**

Urban Company is a tech-enabled home services marketplace. Customers use our platform to book services such as beauty treatments, haircuts, massage therapy, cleaning, plumbing, carpentry, appliance repair, and painting, delivered in the comfort of their homes at a time of their choosing.

We are committed to providing customers with a high-quality, standardized, and reliable service experience. To deliver on this promise, we work closely with our hand-picked service partners, enabling them with technology, training, products, tools, financing, insurance, and our brand, helping them succeed and deliver exceptional experiences.

**About the Role & Team**

We are looking for a
**Manager – Talent Acquisition**
who will lead a team of recruiters and drive hiring across business functions at Urban Company.

This is a high-ownership role that goes beyond managing recruitment delivery. You will partner closely with business leaders to understand talent requirements, build effective hiring strategies, and ensure the right talent comes on board at the right time.

You will be responsible for driving the team's performance, building robust talent pipelines, improving hiring processes, and ensuring a seamless experience for both candidates and stakeholders. The role requires someone who can thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, navigate ambiguity, and balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution.

**What You'll Do**

* **Team Management & Development:**
  Lead, mentor, and develop a team of recruiters. Set clear goals, establish performance metrics, provide regular feedback, and build a culture of ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* **End-to-End Hiring:**
  Drive recruitment delivery across assigned business functions, ensuring timely and quality closures. Oversee the complete hiring lifecycle, from workforce planning and sourcing strategy to offer management and onboarding.
* **Stakeholder Management:**
  Partner closely with business leaders and senior stakeholders to understand hiring needs, align on priorities, provide regular updates, and influence hiring decisions.
* **Hiring Strategy:**
  Develop function-specific hiring strategies, identify the right talent pools, explore innovative sourcing channels, and build sustainable pipelines for current and future requirements.
* **Data & Recruitment Analytics:**
  Track and analyse recruitment metrics such as time-to-hire, conversion ratios, source effectiveness, offer-to-join ratios, and recruiter productivity. Use data to identify bottlenecks and drive improvements.
* **Process Excellence:**
  Build and streamline recruitment processes, improve ATS utilisation, establish consistent hiring practices, and drive process efficiencies across the team.
* **Candidate Experience:**
  Ensure a positive and consistent candidate experience throughout the hiring journey, with timely communication, structured feedback, and seamless pre-onboarding handovers.
* **Business Partnership:**
  Act as a trusted talent advisor to business leaders, bringing market insights, talent intelligence, and recruitment expertise to workforce planning and critical hiring decisions.
* **Hiring Reviews & Planning:**
  Drive regular hiring reviews with business stakeholders, monitor progress against hiring plans, flag risks, and proactively identify solutions to hiring challenges.
* **Continuous Improvement:**
  Stay updated on talent market trends, sourcing practices, and recruitment technologies to continuously improve the team's effectiveness and overall hiring outcomes.

**What We'll Need**

* 5–8 years of experience in Talent Acquisition, preferably in a fast-paced, high-growth organisation.
* Prior experience managing and developing a team of recruiters, with the ability to drive performance and build a high-accountability culture.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with experience partnering with business leaders and senior leadership.
* Demonstrated experience in managing end-to-end recruitment across multiple business functions and handling complex hiring mandates.
* Strong understanding of sourcing strategies, talent mapping, market intelligence, and recruitment processes.
* Data-driven approach with the ability to interpret recruitment metrics and translate insights into actionable improvements.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and influencing skills.
* Ability to navigate ambiguity, manage competing priorities, and deliver outcomes in a dynamic environment.
* Strong ownership mindset, with the ability to balance strategic responsibilities with hands-on execution.

**What Can You Expect?**

* A high-ownership role with the opportunity to shape and scale talent acquisition practices.
* The opportunity to work closely with business leaders and influence critical talent decisions.
* A fast-paced startup environment with significant learning and growth opportunities.
* The opportunity to build, lead, and develop a strong recruitment team.
* An environment that values ownership, innovation, collaboration, and execution.

At Urban Company, we are committed to providing equal and fair opportunities in employment and creating an inclusive work environment. We endeavor to maintain a work environment free from harassment based on age, colour, physical ability, marital status, parental status, ethnic origin, religion, sexual orientation, or gender identity.

title: SEO Executive
description:
**Company Description**

The academy offers industry-focused programs for air hostesses, cabin crew, ground staff, and aviation executives, designed by experienced aviation experts. Students benefit from state-of-the-art training facilities, soft skills and personality development, and dedicated placement assistance with leading airlines. With a commitment to excellence, Skytech Aviation aims to empower learners, build confidence, and create future leaders in the aviation industry. The academy promotes continuous growth through regular updates, success stories, and career opportunities in aviation.

**Job description:**

SEO Executive – Roles & Responsibilities1. On-Page SEO Responsibilities

* Conduct keyword research to identify relevant primary, secondary, long-tail, and location-based keywords.
* Optimize website pages, including SEO titles, meta descriptions, headings (H1–H6), URLs, and content structure.
* Perform keyword mapping and ensure appropriate keyword placement across website pages.
* Optimize existing website content and suggest improvements for better search visibility and user experience.
* Implement internal linking strategies to improve website navigation and page authority.
* Optimize images with descriptive file names, alt text, and appropriate compression.
* Identify and resolve duplicate content, missing metadata, and keyword cannibalization issues.
* Coordinate with content writers to develop SEO-friendly blogs, landing pages, and service pages.
* Regularly audit website pages and update content according to SEO best practices.

2. Off-Page SEO Responsibilities

* Develop and execute ethical, quality-focused link-building strategies.
* Identify relevant websites and opportunities for acquiring high-quality backlinks.
* Perform competitor backlink analysis and identify potential link-building opportunities.
* Conduct relevant business listings, local citations, niche directory submissions, and profile creation.
* Manage guest posting and website outreach activities to acquire relevant backlinks.
* Identify broken backlinks and explore suitable link reclamation opportunities.
* Monitor backlink quality and identify potentially harmful or spammy links.
* Maintain accurate records of backlink acquisition and off-page SEO activities.
* Ensure all off-page activities follow Google Search spam policies and avoid manipulative link schemes.

3. Technical SEO Responsibilities

* Conduct regular technical SEO audits to identify website errors affecting crawling, indexing, and performance.
* Monitor website indexing, crawlability, and search performance using Google Search Console.
* Identify and resolve broken links, 404 errors, unnecessary redirects, and redirect chains.
* Review and optimize XML sitemaps and robots.txt files.
* Check canonical tags, noindex directives, and other indexing-related technical elements.
* Monitor Core Web Vitals, page speed, and mobile usability.
* Coordinate with website developers to resolve technical SEO issues.
* Implement and validate relevant structured data (Schema Markup).
* Ensure websites use HTTPS and follow technical SEO best practices.
* Review website architecture, navigation, and URL structures to support search engine crawling.
* Monitor technical issues after website updates, page migrations, or redesigns.

4. Local SEO & Google Business Profile

* Optimize Google Business Profiles with accurate business details, categories, descriptions, services, and relevant images.
* Conduct location-specific keyword research for local SEO campaigns.
* Optimize city-specific and location-based landing pages.
* Maintain consistent business name, address, and phone number (NAP) information across relevant platforms.
* Create and publish relevant Google Business Profile updates.
* Monitor local search visibility, customer reviews, and profile performance.
* Coordinate appropriate and personalized responses to customer reviews.
* Identify and resolve local listing inconsistencies and duplicate business profiles.

5. SEO Monitoring, Analysis & Reporting

* Monitor keyword rankings, organic traffic, impressions, clicks, and click-through rates.
* Use Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4, and other SEO tools to analyze website performance.
* Track organic conversions, enquiry form submissions, and lead generation performance.
* Prepare weekly and monthly SEO performance reports.
* Conduct competitor analysis to identify opportunities for SEO improvement.
* Track SEO tasks, implementation progress, and completed optimization activities.
* Identify pages with declining performance and recommend corrective actions.
* Present SEO findings, challenges, and improvement plans to the reporting manager.

6. Coordination & Additional Responsibilities

* Work closely with content writers, graphic designers, and website developers.
* Coordinate with the marketing team to ensure SEO strategies align with business objectives.
* Stay updated with Google Search updates, SEO industry developments, and best practices.
* Maintain SEO documentation, keyword tracking sheets, audit reports, and activity records.
* Complete assigned SEO tasks within specified deadlines.
* Take responsibility for implementing agreed SEO improvements and reporting measurable progress.

7. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The candidate's performance will be evaluated based on:

* Growth in relevant organic website traffic.
* Improvement in target keyword visibility and rankings.
* Growth in organic enquiries, conversions, and qualified leads.
* Completion and quality of on-page SEO optimization tasks.
* Acquisition of relevant, high-quality backlinks.
* Resolution of technical SEO issues within agreed timelines.
* Improvement in website indexing, crawlability, and Core Web Vitals.
* Improvement in local search and Google Business Profile performance.
* Accuracy and timely submission of SEO reports.
* Completion of assigned tasks according to approved SEO plans and deadlines.

8. Expected Professional Standards

* Maintain transparency and accuracy in SEO reporting.
* Follow ethical SEO practices and Google Search guidelines.
* Avoid spammy backlinks, keyword stuffing, and other manipulative techniques.
* Proactively identify website optimization opportunities.
* Maintain clear communication with managers and team members.
* Demonstrate ownership, attention to detail, and effective time management.

Salary- 18 to 25k per month

Experience- 2 to 54 years

title: Influencer Marketing Coordinator
description:
Vertical: At Buzz (Atraski)

Location: Chittaranjan Park, South Delhi (on-site)

Stipend: ₹10,000 per month (fixed)

Traineeship: 6 months, after which strong performers are absorbed into a full-time role

Joining: Within 15–30 days

Working days: Monday to Friday, plus alternate Saturdays

Working hours: 8-hour day, with flexible punch-in between 9:00 AM and 11:00 AM

About Atraski

Atraski is a national integrated services company that bridges the gap between creative vision and commercial execution. Its flagship marketing arm, At Buzz, works with more than 70 brands across D2C, food and beverage, fashion, real estate and EdTech, with offices in Delhi, Kolkata and Mumbai. Our work has been covered by The Times of India, Hindustan Times, Dainik Jagran, The Telegraph and Red FM, and we have been associated with industry bodies including the Indian Chamber of Commerce (ICC) and FICCI.

The Role:

We are looking for an Influencer Marketing Trainee to help plan and run creator campaigns for our brands. You will work closely with our Account Managers and the operations team, and learn the full influencer workflow: finding the right creators, briefing them, tracking their content and reporting results. This is a hands-on traineeship with a clear path to a full-time role.

What You Will Do:

1. Creator discovery

* Find and shortlist creators on Instagram and YouTube that match each brand's audience, tone and budget.
* Check engagement, audience quality and past brand work before recommending a creator.
* Build and maintain the creator database: handles, followers, categories, rates and contact details.

2. Outreach and briefing

* Reach out to creators, negotiate rates and deliverables within the approved budget, and confirm terms in writing.
* Share clear briefs with each creator: brand messaging, do's and don'ts, deliverables, timelines and reference links.
* Coordinate product dispatch and barter collaborations where relevant.

3. Campaign tracking

* Track every creator's content from draft to approval to posting against the campaign calendar.
* Review content before it goes live so it follows the brief and brand guidelines.
* Follow up on delays and keep the Account Manager updated.

4. Reporting and payments

* Collect post links, reach, views and engagement, and prepare a campaign report for each brand.
* Keep the payment tracker updated and share completed deliverables with the finance team so creators are paid on time.

Who We Are Looking For

* A graduate, or a final-year student in marketing, mass communication or a related field.
* Active on Instagram and YouTube, with a good sense of what makes creator content work.
* Comfortable with Google Sheets, email and WhatsApp-based coordination.
* Clear communication in English and Hindi, and confident speaking with creators.
* Organised, persistent with follow-ups, and careful with details like deadlines and payments.
* Good to have: an earlier internship in influencer or social media marketing, or experience as a creator yourself.

What You Will Gain:

You will learn end-to-end influencer marketing on real brand campaigns, build relationships with creators across categories, and work alongside a team covering social media, performance marketing, production and SEO. After six months, trainees who perform well are absorbed into a full-time Influencer Marketing role. All trainees receive a certificate on completing the traineeship.

title: Social Media Manager - Founder & Personal Branding
description:
**About Touchwood**

Touchwood Team is a content-led creative agency in Ghaziabad. Since 2021 we've run strategy, content, production and social for FMCG, D2C, food, pet, hospitality, sports and founder brands across India. We shoot, edit, design and publish in-house, and we're building the agency AI-native from the ground up.

We spend every day building other people's brands. Our own, and our founders', get whatever time is left. This role fixes that.

**The role**

You'll own the personal brands of our two co-founders and the voice of Touchwood itself, across LinkedIn, X, Instagram and YouTube. Not "manage the posting". Own it. If a week goes quiet, that's on you. When something lands, that's on you too.

**What you'll actually do**

* Define a clear positioning for each founder: what they stand for, what they talk about, what they never post.
* Run the founders' LinkedIn and X. Ghostwrite posts and threads in their voice, comment where it matters, build the right network rather than just a bigger one.
* Pull ideas out of the founders through short weekly interviews, voice notes and shoot-day moments, and turn them into posts, carousels, Reels and long-form.
* Plan and run YouTube end to end: formats, scripts, briefs for our editors, titles, thumbnails, publishing.
* Run Touchwood's own channels. The work, the process, the behind-the-scenes, the point of view.
* Work with our designers, editors and shoot teams so content gets made on schedule, not "when someone's free".
* Track what actually matters (profile visits, inbound DMs, leads, hiring interest, not just likes) and report monthly on what worked and what you're changing.
* Use AI tools properly for research, drafting and repurposing, without the output ever sounding like AI.

**Apply only if this is you**

* 2+ years running personal brands for founders, CXOs or creators. Someone else's name, not just a company page.
* You can show accounts you've grown, with before/after numbers and posts you wrote.
* You write sharp English (Hinglish is a plus) and can sound like someone who isn't you.
* You treat LinkedIn and X as their own platforms, not places to cross-post Instagram.
* You're comfortable telling a founder "this post is weak" and rewriting it.
* You don't need chasing. Calendars, approvals and follow-ups don't stall because you were waiting on someone.

**Probably not a fit if**

* Your experience is mainly brand-page posting, scheduling or community management.
* You need a content plan handed to you before you can start.

**How to apply**

Along with your profile, send us:

1. Two or three personal brands you've handled: links, plus what changed while you ran them.
2. One LinkedIn post you'd write for the founder of a creative agency. Under 200 words.

Applications without work samples won't be reviewed.

title: Marketing Intern
description:
**Company Description**

Himalayan Echoes creates extraordinary, transformative luxury journeys across the Himalayas. We believe the best journeys awaken the
*Stories Within*

Every journey is personal and thoughtfully designed around the person taking it. Through the people our guests meet, the places they enter and experiences that cannot simply be found on a map, we reveal a more intimate side of the Himalayas. Our story begins in Bhutan, the place we know best because it is where we live and work. Ladakh and Nepal will follow.

We travel with heart. Every Himalayan Echoes journey supports four commitments: Culture & Heritage, Community Empowerment, Sustainability & Nature, and Youth & Education.

**Role Description**

As our Marketing Intern, you will work closely with the Marketing team to create content, support campaigns and keep our brand consistent across every channel. You will also work alongside Reservations, Sales and Operations, so you will see how a premium travel company runs from first enquiry to the guest's journey home.

This is a hands-on role. You will be trusted with impactful work that reaches real travellers and travel partners.

* Draft posts, captions and stories for Instagram, Facebook and LinkedIn in the Himalayan Echoes voice

**b. Campaigns and trade marketing**

* Support email newsletters and WhatsApp updates for travel advisors and tour operators

**c. Website and storytelling**

* Write and update blog posts, experience descriptions and destination stories
* Proofread content for accuracy, tone and brand consistency
* Support basic SEO tasks such as keywords, meta descriptions and image alt text

**d. Research and admin**

* Research travel trends, competitor activity and key source markets
* Keep the media library, brand assets and marketing files organised
* Support trade shows, webinars, familiarisation trips and events where needed

**2. Who we're looking for**

**a. Must have**

* A student or recent graduate in Marketing, Communications, Media, Tourism, Hospitality, English or a related field
* Excellent written English, with a good eye for detail and tone
* Comfort with social media platforms and basic content tools such as Canva
* Genuine interest in Bhutan, its culture and responsible travel
* Reliability, good organisation and the confidence to ask questions

**b. Nice to have**

* Photography, video editing or graphic design skills
* Experience running a social media account, blog or student publication
* Basic knowledge of Google Analytics, Meta Business Suite or SEO

**3. What you'll gain**

* Hands-on experience in marketing for a premium, experience-led travel company
* Published work for your portfolio across social media, the website and trade materials
* Mentoring from the Marketing team and exposure to Sales, Reservations and Operations
* An inside view of Bhutan's tourism industry and how bespoke journeys are made
* Letter of recommendation & monthly stipend

**4. How to apply**

Send the following to support@himalayanechoes.travel with the subject line
**"Marketing Intern Application – [Your Name]"**
by 15th November:

1. Your CV
2. A short cover note (up to 300 words) on why you want to join Himalayan Echoes

Shortlisted candidates will be invited to an interview call and a short assignment to check alignment.

title: Asset Management Analyst
description:
**What we are and what we do: -**
Gallagher & Mohan work exclusively within the real estate industry. Our mission is to provide financial analysis, marketing, and accounting support to our clients. Our clients are real estate-focused private equity investors, developers, fund managers, brokers, and more. We pride ourselves on our quality, our strong communication, and our work ethic. We are a natural extension of our client’s existing infrastructure. The type of transactions we currently work on range from multifamily apartment complexes to large office towers in the United States and European markets, and range in value sizes from $10 million USD - $200+ million USD.
  
  
**What we are looking for:-**
The Asset Management Analyst will play a pivotal role in translating operating performance into investment-level return impacts. This role requires strong financial modeling skills and scenario analysis capabilities, with ownership of asset-level financial models and support for portfolio reviews and investor and internal reporting.
  
  
The candidate will collaborate closely with the Asset Management, Operations, Investments and Investor Relations teams to support successful asset-level outcomes.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Portfolio Financial Modelling & Scenario Analysis**

* Build, maintain and own financial models for existing portfolio assets.
* Model the impact of operating scenarios on investment returns, including RevPAR changes, margin shifts, expense variability, capital expenditure timing and refinancing assumptions.
* Assist in transitioning acquisition and development models into stabilized asset management models.
* Perform sensitivity analyses and hold vs. sell evaluations.

**Asset-Level & Portfolio Reporting**

* Assist in the preparation and review of monthly and quarterly asset performance reports.
* Support portfolio-level reporting for senior management and co-investors.
* Prepare materials for quarterly investor reporting, annual meetings and investor day presentations.
* Ensure reporting accuracy, consistency and clarity across all deliverables.

**Operational & Strategic Asset Management Support**

* Partner with Asset Managers and operating teams to analyze performance versus budget and underwriting.
* Support business plan forecasting, re-forecasting and long-range planning.
* Assist with evaluation of capital projects and return implications.
* Support financings, refinancings, recapitalizations and strategic asset-level initiatives

**Investment Committee & Internal Materials**

* Draft and support Investment Committee memorandums related to refinancings, capital projects and strategic asset decisions.
* Prepare analytical materials and recommendations for internal review and approval processes.

**Portfolio Reviews & Data Management**

* Participate in monthly portfolio review meetings and assist with preparation of review materials.
* Maintain industry, market and asset-level data relevant to portfolio performance.
* Support data organization, version control and historical performance tracking.

**Qualifications And Skills**

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Real Estate, Economics, Accounting, Engineering or a related field.
* 2 to 5+ years of experience in real estate asset management, private equity, investment banking or related roles.
* Strong financial modeling, analytical and valuation skills.
* Advanced proficiency in Excel; strong PowerPoint and Word skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment.

**Prefferd**

* Hospitality asset management or operations experience.
* Familiarity with hotel operating statements, STR reports and capital planning.
* Exposure to investor reporting, portfolio reviews and lender communications

title: Trading Intelligence Analyst
description:
**Woolworths Group**
(Australia and New Zealand’s largest retailer) launched Woolworths Market Plus (WMP) in October 2023. WMP is the coming together of two businesses (BigW Market & Everyday Market).

WMP is a new platform for businesses to both sell and manage products across the Woolworths Group Marketplaces. A curated customer destination, bringing together a trusted ecosystem comprising three core banners: Everyday Market and BIG W Market. We have grown in the last year and now operate primarily across three hub locations: Manila, Melbourne & Sydney.

**Welcome to Big W**

At BIG W every day's a big day. For you, this could be the start of something big.

There are over 15,000 of us, in the biggest cities and the tiniest towns. And each of us has an important role to play to help make a real difference for families by providing real value, real solutions and real care.

The Trading Intelligence Analyst is a key contributor of competitor pricing intelligence, delivering data-driven insights that inform our pricing and promotional strategies. This role supports maintaining a competitive market position by tracking competitor activity, identifying pricing trends, and actively managing product matching data. As we evolve our capabilities, this role will champion the use of AI and automation to streamline processes, while also executing essential day-to-day data management to ensure accuracy and competitive advantage for our customers.

**What You'll Do**

* **Competitor Intelligence & Strategy:**
  Monitor competitor pricing activity to provide actionable insights that guide our pricing decisions and ensure we remain competitive.
* **Data Management & Product Matching:**
  Take ownership of maintaining our pricing database, including manual and automated product matching across product categories to ensure data accuracy.
* **Process Innovation & Automation:**
  Lead the adoption of AI, technology, and automated matching tools to drive efficiency, reduce manual effort, and improve the scalability of our pricing processes.
* **Promotional Performance Analysis:**
  Analyze past promotional performance to provide recommendations that improve the effectiveness, profitability, and strategic planning of future campaigns.
* **Insight-Driven Decision Support:**
  Perform deep-dive analysis on pricing and market data to help the buying and merchandising teams make informed, evidence-based decisions.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:**
  Partner with internal teams—including Store Operations and Replenishment—to optimize the execution of promotional plans and ensure reliable stock flow and pricing alignment.
* **Continuous Improvement:**
  Proactively identify opportunities to improve existing systems and workflows, maintaining a "roll up your sleeves" mindset while balancing long-term strategic enhancements.

**What You'll Bring**

* 2–5 years of experience in retail analytics, commercial pricing, business analytics, or a similar data-centric role.
* Demonstrated track record of managing large, complex datasets and translating them into clear, actionable recommendations that influence commercial outcomes.
* Experience in identifying inefficiencies and implementing improvements, with a specific interest in leveraging AI or automation tools to streamline workflows.
* Strong hands-on experience with data manipulation and visualization tools (e.g., SQL, Excel, Power BI/Tableau)
* Customer-Centric: high level of curiosity regarding customer needs and behaviors, ensuring that pricing strategies always put the customer first.
* Collaborating openly with stakeholders to ensure pricing outcomes are accurate and effectively executed.
* Handle manual, time-consuming tasks with accuracy, while simultaneously thinking ahead to build more efficient, automated solutions.
* Innovative Mindset: challenge the status quo, and are proactive in identifying issues and proposing smarter, technology-led solutions

**What you’ll experience**

* Be a part of Australia’s largest retailer
* Constant mentoring and training provided
* Generous sick and vacation leave
* A flexible approach to work
* Premium health insurance coverage

**Everyone belongs at Woolworths Group**

Diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging are key to realising our purpose of better together for a better tomorrow. We recognise the value our team’s diversity brings to our business, customers, and communities and that teams with diverse experiences and backgrounds enrich our group and are better able to innovate and solve problems. As one of the largest employers in Australia and New Zealand, we aim to create a truly inclusive workplace where everyone feels that they belong, can be their best selves, and reach their full potential.

We encourage all candidates to apply; please let us know in your application if we can support you with any adjustments in the hiring process.

to strengthen the organisation's global Data Platform Governance function.

**Role Overview**

The Data Archiving Analyst will be responsible for designing, implementing and managing enterprise-wide data archiving, retention and lifecycle management practices.

The role will focus on ensuring that enterprise data is retained, archived and disposed of in accordance with business, legal and regulatory requirements across global operations.

The position will work closely with SAP, Data Platform, Legal, Privacy, Compliance and Business teams to establish robust data retention policies and controls across SAP S/4HANA and Databricks environments.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Data Archiving & Retention Strategy**

* Develop and implement enterprise-wide data archiving and retention policies aligned with business and regulatory requirements.
* Establish data retention schedules across multiple business domains and systems.
* Define data disposal standards, ensuring secure, compliant and auditable deletion processes.
* Manage legal hold requirements in collaboration with Legal, Privacy and Compliance teams.
* Periodically review and update retention policies based on regulatory and business changes.

**2. SAP S/4HANA Data Archiving**

* Design, configure and manage SAP Information Lifecycle Management (ILM) within an enterprise S/4HANA environment.
* Govern SAP archiving objects across key functional modules, including FI, CO, MM, SD, PP, QM and PM.
* Work with SAP Basis teams and managed service providers to monitor archiving jobs, content server capacity and performance.
* Implement ILM residence rules and destruction rules to ensure appropriate data retention and disposal.
* Assess archiving implications arising from SAP upgrades, releases and system changes.

**3. Databricks & Enterprise Data Platform**

* Establish data lifecycle management policies across Databricks workspaces.
* Manage Delta Lake retention policies, VACUUM operations and time-travel configurations.
* Work with Unity Catalog to implement data classification, retention tagging and access controls.
* Define data tiering strategies to move inactive or archival data into cost-effective storage environments.
* Ensure archived data remains secure, recoverable and compliant with retention requirements.

**4. Data Governance, Compliance & Risk**

* Act as a subject matter expert for enterprise data archiving and retention.
* Partner with Legal, Privacy, Compliance and Information Security teams to translate regulatory requirements into technical controls.
* Identify opportunities to optimise storage costs and reduce unnecessary data accumulation.
* Maintain data archiving risk registers and support governance reviews and audits.
* Ensure compliance with applicable regulations, including GDPR, CCPA, PIPEDA, SOX and relevant local data retention requirements.

**5. Stakeholder Management & Collaboration**

* Collaborate with global technology, business and governance teams.
* Participate in enterprise data governance forums and cross-functional initiatives.
* Communicate archiving policies, implementation progress, risks and improvement opportunities to stakeholders.
* Drive awareness and adoption of data retention and lifecycle management practices across the organisation.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering or a related discipline.
* 7+ years of experience in Data Management, Data Governance, Enterprise Data Architecture or related areas, with a strong focus on data archiving and retention.
* Strong hands-on experience with SAP Data Archiving, including SAP ILM, SARA, archiving objects, residence rules and destruction rules.
* Experience working with SAP S/4HANA environments, preferably SAP RISE or equivalent managed cloud environments.
* Working knowledge of Databricks, including Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, VACUUM operations and data lifecycle management.
* Experience designing and implementing enterprise data retention and disposal policies.
* Understanding of data classification, storage tiering and archival strategies.
* Knowledge of regulatory and compliance requirements relating to enterprise data management.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to work across technical, legal and business teams.
* Ability to translate regulatory and business requirements into practical technical controls and governance processes.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* SAP ILM or SAP Data Archiving certifications.
* CDMP, CIPM or other relevant data governance and privacy certifications.
* Exposure to global enterprise environments, particularly manufacturing, FMCG or CPG organisations.

If you have strong experience in SAP ILM, S/4HANA Data Archiving and enterprise data lifecycle management, we'd be interested in connecting with you.

Please share your updated profile or connect with us to explore this opportunity.

title: Category Growth Analyst
description:
**About Namshi**

Are you ready to embark on an exciting journey in the world of beauty and e-commerce? Namshi, the #1 online fashion and beauty destination in the Middle East, is looking for talented individuals like you to join our dynamic team. We are a community built around young people who are making waves in the region. They’re changing the future, and we’re right next to them every step of the way. If you're passionate, innovative, and eager to be a part of a company whose mission is to be the region’s favorite closet, then Namshi is the place for you. Discover your potential with us and help us redefine the way people shop online and ignite a new generation of personal expression through style. Let's move together!

**About the role**

The Category Growth Analyst serves as the primary analytical engine for the business unit. In this role, you will be responsible for transforming raw data into actionable insights that drive revenue, inventory efficiency, and profitability.

This is a role for a data-savvy professional who excels in SQL and Excel and wants to see their technical skills translate into real-world business impact. We are not just looking for someone who can write code; we need a thinker. You must possess strong logical reasoning to break down complex, vague business problems into structured analyses. You will be expected to drive projects on your own, taking full ownership of the data without needing constant supervision.

***If you are a proactive problem-solver who loves digging into the "why" behind the numbers, this role is for you.***

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Data Analysis & Technical Execution**

* Utilize SQL to query large, complex datasets independently (Joins, Aggregations, Sub-queries) to extract key metrics regarding category performance.
* Build and maintain advanced Excel models to simulate pricing scenarios, forecast inventory needs, and track profitability.
* Apply logical frameworks to unstructured data to identify root causes of performance dips or growth spikes.

**2. Strategic Support & Performance Tracking**

* Proactively monitor competitor pricing and assortment gaps to recommend tactical adjustments.
* Analyze customer behavior and basket data to identify cross-selling opportunities and improve bundle mechanics.
* Track the performance of marketing campaigns and onsite visibility to ensure Return on Ad Spend (ROAS) efficiency.

**3. Reporting & Automation**

* Develop and automate daily/weekly dashboards to track KPIs against business targets.
* Streamline data collection processes to reduce manual reporting time and increase accuracy.

**4. Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Act as the data bridge between the Category team and key stakeholders in Finance, Marketing, and Supply Chain.
* Translate complex data sets into clear, visual presentations for stakeholders during business reviews.

**Qualifications Education & Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Engineering, Economics, Mathematics, Business, or a related quantitative field.
* 2–5 years of experience in a Business Analyst, Commercial Analyst, or Data Analyst role. Technical Skills (Must-Haves):
* Excel: Mastery of VLOOKUP, XLOOKUP, Index/Match, Pivot Tables, and financial modeling is required.
* SQL Proficiency: Strong ability to write complex queries to extract and manipulate data from data warehouses independently.

**Key Competencies (Soft Skills):**

* **Strong Logical Reasoning:**
  Ability to decompose high-level business questions into executed data logic.
  **You can spot when data "doesn't look right" and investigate immediately.**
* **High Ownership & Autonomy:**
  Ability to drive on your own. You don't wait for instructions; you identify gaps in the data and propose solutions proactively.
* **Business Acumen:**
  You understand that data is a means to an end—driving Revenue and Margin is the goal.
* **Resilience:**
  Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where priorities can shift.

**Who will excel?**

* We’re looking for people with high standards, who understand that hard work matters.
* You need to be relentlessly resourceful and operate with a deep bias for action.
* We need people with the courage to be fiercely original.

title: AVP, AI Security Architect
description:
**Role Title: 2603010 AVP, AI Security Architect (L11)**
**Company Overview**
Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as #3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the #1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
  
  
**Organizational Overview**
The Security Architecture organization enables Synchrony to innovate and grow securely by embedding security-by-design into technology solutions. We partner with engineering, platform, data, cloud, and business teams to translate security strategy and evolving threats into practical architecture requirements, reusable patterns, blueprints, and guardrails. Through risk-based architecture reviews, threat modeling, and scalable security guidance, the team helps protect Synchrony’s digital assets and customer data while supporting resilient, compliant, and efficient technology delivery. This role will contribute to advancing our AI Security Architecture capabilities, helping establish secure patterns and assurance practices for Generative AI, AI agents, and other emerging AI technologies.
  
  
**Role Summary/Purpose**
**The AVP, AI Security Architect**
will design and advance security architectures for Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, Machine Learning, and emerging AI technologies. The role will translate enterprise security strategy and evolving AI threats into practical requirements, reusable patterns, and engineering guidance that enable secure innovation while protecting company, customer, and sensitive data.
  
  
Working across Cybersecurity, Technology, Data, AI/ML Engineering, Cloud, Risk, and Business teams, the architect will lead solution-level security assessments, contribute to enterprise standards, and embed security-by-design through threat modeling, control validation, testing, and continuous assurance across the AI lifecycle.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Apply and help mature enterprise AI security architecture principles, standards, reference architectures, and guardrails.
* Design reusable security patterns for Generative AI, copilots, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), model and inference APIs, autonomous or agentic AI, and enterprise AI platforms.
* Lead security architecture assessments for complex AI solutions across cloud, SaaS, API, data, application, and enterprise technology environments.
* Partner with AI/ML engineers, application teams, cloud architects, data teams, and product owners to embed security throughout design, development, deployment, integration, monitoring, and retirement.
* Perform AI threat modeling using MITRE ATLAS and OWASP guidance, translating identified threats into actionable controls and engineering requirements.
* Define and validate controls for model access, identities, service accounts, secrets, APIs, prompts, training and retrieval data, outputs, plugins, tools, and third-party AI services.
* Assess risks such as prompt injection, data poisoning, sensitive information disclosure, insecure tool interaction, excessive agency, model manipulation, and AI supply-chain compromise.
* Contribute to automation of architecture reviews, threat modeling, vulnerability assessment, control validation, and security testing.
* Document architecture decisions, material risks, trade-offs, and recommendations for technical teams and senior stakeholders.
* Collaborate with Enterprise Architecture, Cloud, Application Security, Data, Responsible AI, Privacy, Legal, Compliance, Risk, and Business partners.
* Create implementation guidance and enablement that help engineering teams adopt approved AI security patterns consistently.

**Required Skills/Knowledge**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Strong experience in cybersecurity, security architecture, cloud security, application security, or enterprise architecture, including delivery of complex security initiatives.
* Practical knowledge of modern AI architectures, including Large Language Models, RAG, vector databases, embeddings, model gateways, AI agents, orchestration frameworks, managed AI services, and model or inference APIs.
* Strong foundation in identity and access management, application and API security, cloud security, data protection, secrets and key management, DevSecOps, and software supply-chain security.
* Knowledge of AI security and risk frameworks such as the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, MITRE ATLAS, NIST AI Risk Management Framework, and Zero Trust principles.
* Experience designing or reviewing enterprise architectures on AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
* Ability to convert technical risks into architecture requirements, reusable patterns, engineering guidance, and clear recommendations.
* Demonstrated ability to influence technical stakeholders, facilitate architecture decisions, and build alignment across teams.
* Strong written, verbal, presentation, and stakeholder-management skills.

**Desired Skills/Knowledge**

* Experience securing platforms such as Amazon Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Copilot, or comparable enterprise AI services.
* Experience with AI red teaming, adversarial testing, model security assessment, prompt-injection testing, or AI vulnerability management.
* Familiarity with NIST AI RMF, MITRE ATLAS, OWASP guidance, ISO/IEC 42001, and evolving AI governance expectations.
* Ability to move effectively between detailed technical architecture, engineering execution, risk discussions, and stakeholder communication.
* Experience developing reference architectures, security blueprints, automated guardrails, and scalable control-assurance capabilities.
* Financial-services cybersecurity, regulatory, risk-management, or data-protection experience is a plus.
* Collaborative and execution-oriented approach, with a focus on simplification, automation, measurable outcomes, and responsible innovation.

**Eligibility Criteria**
Bachelor's degree with 6+ years of experience in Cyber industry, security architecture experience including on-prem and hybrid environments and practical knowledge of modern AI architectures, including Large Language Models, RAG, vector databases, embeddings, model gateways, AI agents, orchestration frameworks, managed AI services, and model or inference APIs.

Our way of working allows you the option to work from home or workspaces in our Regional Engagement Hubs—Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Pune, Kolkata, or Delhi/NCR. **About RAYY**
RAYY is a booking marketplace for experiences, covering kids, teens and adults, online and offline. The app is live on the Play Store and App Store, with a website alongside. RAYY started in Gurgaon, officially launched across Delhi NCR on 22 October 2026, and plans to expand to 100–200 cities within a year. We are a small, fast-moving startup, and engineering is being brought fully in-house.
  
  
**Role Overview**
You will be one of the first engineers on RAYY's founding engineering team, reporting to Ashish Virmani, Chief Product & Technical Officer. This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You will write code every day across the mobile app and the backend, build features end to end, and help the product scale as RAYY expands to new cities. Everyone on this team works across the full stack, including the CPTO.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Build and ship product features hands-on across the mobile app and the backend.
* Use AI coding tools (for example Claude Code or Cursor) as part of your daily work, and review, test and debug what they produce.
* Work in a very small team with wide ownership and help scale the product as RAYY grows.
* Work directly with the CPTO and, where needed, the wider leadership team.

**Must-have Requirements**

* 2–4 years of hands-on engineering experience in a product company (startup or enterprise), not in IT services, agency or contract work.
* Has built and shipped a mobile app (B2C or B2B) hands-on, in Flutter or another mobile technology such as Kotlin or Swift.
* Has written backend code in a production system, in any backend language (Python, Node.js, Java, etc.), including work with a database.
* Has used AI coding tools hands-on in real product work, and can explain how they reviewed, tested and debugged AI-generated code.
* Comfortable working a six-day week in a startup environment.

**Good to have**

* Experience with a B2C or consumer platform app.
* Experience integrating a payment gateway such as Razorpay.
* Experience with AWS cloud services, secured backend setups, or Docker and containers.
* Has defined product requirements or a feature roadmap, or worked closely with CXOs on product direction.
* Has worked in a small team with wide ownership.
* Stakeholder experience, and clear spoken communication for remote working.
* Website or React development experience.

**Work setup**
Hybrid, based in Delhi NCR. The team works remotely, with one day a week in the Gurgaon office. Candidates outside NCR are considered only if they are already relocating to NCR and can join within a month.

Round 1 is a coding and design round with the CPTO (open book, AI tools allowed). A second round follows only if something is left unclear, then a final conversation of about 30 minutes with the CEO. There are two to three rounds in total.

title: Generative AI Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
SafeAI Global is a premier technology consultancy focused on solving complex engineering challenges for enterprise clients worldwide. The organization specializes in building robust, production-grade systems where reliability, security, and scalability are critical. SafeAI Global’s teams consist of top-tier engineering talent, delivering solutions that range from custom large language model (LLM) implementations to resilient distributed architectures and stabilized legacy platforms. The company operates as an elite engineering partner rather than a traditional digital agency, stepping in when standard solutions cannot meet business demands. Its core mission is to help partners build safe, intelligent systems that withstand real-world operational pressures.
  
**Role Description**
The Generative AI Engineer role is a full-time, remote position responsible for designing, implementing, and optimizing generative AI solutions for enterprise clients. This role involves developing and fine-tuning LLMs and other generative models, integrating them into distributed systems, and translating business requirements into scalable, secure AI-driven features. Day-to-day tasks include building end-to-end AI pipelines, collaborating with cross-functional teams (such as product, data, and platform engineering), and ensuring models are robust, well-tested, and ready for production deployment. The Generative AI Engineer will also monitor performance, address model drift and reliability issues, and contribute to internal best practices and reusable frameworks for AI engineering. In addition, the role may involve client-facing technical discussions, documentation of architectures, and guidance on responsible and safe AI usage.
  
**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong skills in AI and machine learning engineering, such as experience with generative models (including LLMs), model training and fine-tuning, and designing production-grade ML pipelines.
* Candidates should possess software engineering skills, including proficiency in languages commonly used for AI and backend development (e.g., Python, and at least one statically typed language), knowledge of distributed systems, and experience with microservices architectures and APIs.
* Candidates should possess data and infrastructure skills, such as working with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, or Azure), containerization and orchestration (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes), and data processing frameworks or tools suitable for large-scale model training and inference.
* Candidates should possess skills in testing, monitoring, and reliability, including experience with unit and integration testing for ML systems, observability tools, performance tuning, and strategies for safe and reliable AI deployment in production.
* Candidates should possess communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear language for stakeholders, contribute to technical documentation, and work effectively in remote, cross-functional teams.
* Additional beneficial qualifications include experience with prompt engineering, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) systems, security and compliance in AI systems, prior work in consulting

title: Founding Full Stack Staff Engineer - Frontier Cyber Security
description:
**Hiring for Lean SuperIntelligence**
— via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role.

**ABOUT US**

Lean SuperIntelligence (LSI) is an AI lab building self-improving cybersecurity foundation models for enterprises. LSI publicly announced LSI-Offense-1 and LSI-Defense-1 on October 9, 2026, alongside the closing of its initial pre-seed financing.

LSI-Offense-1 discovers, exploits and validates vulnerabilities; LSI-Defense-1 detects, investigates and responds to threats. The models improve through an offense-defense feedback loop inside LSI Cyber World Models, simulated enterprise environments that turn attack and defense outcomes into training signals.

The models are designed for enterprise-controlled deployment, including on-premises and air-gapped environments, with customization on private enterprise data. Access is currently limited to selected design partners.

Founded by Chandra Khatri, LSI brings together foundation-model builders and security researchers. Its announced backers include investors and angels with AI and security leadership experience at OpenAI, CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, Zscaler, Commvault and Gruve AI. These affiliations do not imply corporate investment by those organizations.

Learn more: LSI website | Launch announcement | Financing and model news.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

We are hiring a Founding Full Stack Staff Engineer to build the product surface of our frontier security platform, from data model and services through to the interfaces security teams work in every day.

You will own features end to end: backend services, agent-facing APIs, and the front end where findings, exploit evidence, and remediation workflows are reviewed and acted on. This is a senior individual-contributor role with broad architectural ownership and a direct line to design partners.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Own features end to end across data model, backend services, APIs, front end, telemetry, and rollout.
* Build the interfaces security teams work in daily: finding triage, exploit evidence review, remediation and retest tracking, agent run inspection, and reporting.
* Design backend services and APIs for scanning, agent execution, evidence storage, and integrations with code hosts, CI/CD, ticketing systems, and cloud accounts.
* Build product surfaces on top of LLMs and autonomous agents, including streaming output, long-running task state, human approval steps, partial results, and graceful failure.
* Turn AppSec workflows into product: finding deduplication, severity and reachability context, ownership routing, SLA tracking, and verification that fixes actually close the vulnerability.
* Design schemas and pipelines for findings, agent trajectories, evidence artifacts, and audit trails.
* Build multi-tenant foundations including authentication, authorization, RBAC, org and project scoping, audit logging, secrets handling, and tenant isolation.
* Make agent behavior legible in the interface: what the agent did, what it proved, what it could not, and where a human needs to decide.
* Own performance, reliability, latency, and cost across the stack, including inference and tool-execution cost surfaced to the user.
* Set engineering standards for code review, testing, CI/CD, observability, incident response, and secure-by-default patterns, and treat our own attack surface as a first-class concern.
* Prototype quickly with design partners, put working software in front of practitioners early, and decide what is ready to ship.
* Partner with security researchers, agent-harness engineers, and product to move research capability into product without losing rigor.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* At least five years building and shipping production software, with meaningful time spent on cybersecurity products.
* Strong full-stack ability: modern TypeScript and React on the front end, plus backend work in Go, Python, TypeScript, Java, or Rust.
* Hands-on experience building application-security products, or closely adjacent ones such as code security, vulnerability management, attack-surface management, DevSecOps, offensive-security tooling, or SOC platforms.
* Working security knowledge across common vulnerability classes, authentication and authorization, and secure design, with the ability to reason about the attack surface of what you build.
* Experience designing APIs, data models, and asynchronous or long-running workflows.
* Front-end craft on data-dense technical interfaces, including state management, streaming and real-time updates, and performance under large result sets.
* Experience with cloud infrastructure, containers, CI/CD, and production operations.
* Ability to scope ambiguous problems, make architectural decisions, and raise the bar for other engineers through code and review rather than process.
* Clear technical writing and comfort working directly with security practitioners and design partners.
* We value demonstrated ability over formal credentials, certifications, or a fixed number of years of experience.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience building products on LLMs or agents, including tool use, streaming, evaluations, prompt and model versioning, and latency and cost tradeoffs.
* Product experience in autonomous pentesting, code security, SAST/DAST/SCA, vulnerability management, CTEM, EDR/XDR, or SOC automation.
* Personal offensive-security depth such as CVEs, bug-bounty findings, advanced CTF performance, or published research.
* Experience integrating with GitHub or GitLab, CI systems, Jira or ServiceNow, SIEM and EDR platforms, or cloud provider APIs.
* Experience meeting enterprise requirements such as SSO, SAML, SCIM, audit logging, VPC or on-premise deployment, and air-gapped installs.
* Experience with real-time systems, websockets, job queues, or event-driven architectures.
* Design sensibility and the ability to own the user experience for technical workflows without a dedicated designer.
* Understanding of AI and agent security risks including prompt injection, tool poisoning or misuse, excessive permissions, untrusted content, and sandbox boundaries.
* Open-source contributions, technical writing, or prior founding-engineer and early-stage experience.

title: Founder's Office Associate (Sales & Ops)
description:
**Company Description**
Privu Tech specializes in providing expert services to Data Fiduciaries, helping organizations manage consent, identify compliance gaps, and implement remediation strategies. The company supports clients in strengthening breach safeguards and conducting regular audits to maintain robust data protection practices. Privu Tech focuses on enabling businesses to comply with India’s Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDPA) with clarity and confidence. Team members work closely with clients on complex data privacy challenges, contributing to secure and compliant digital ecosystems.

**Role Description**
The Founder's Office Associate (Sales & Ops) is a full-time, on-site role based in Noida. This role involves supporting the founder in day-to-day business operations, including coordinating sales activities, preparing client proposals, and maintaining accurate records of leads and opportunities. The associate will help streamline internal processes, assist in project tracking, and ensure timely follow-up on client communications. Responsibilities also include conducting basic market and client research, preparing presentations and reports, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to support delivery of data privacy and compliance services. The role requires proactive problem-solving, ownership of tasks, and the ability to work in a fast-paced early-stage environment.

**Qualifications**

* Strong sales support and operations skills, including pipeline tracking, CRM hygiene, and proposal preparation.
* Ability to perform structured market and client research, analyze data, and derive actionable insights.
* Proficiency in business communication, including clear written and verbal communication and presentation skills.
* Comfort with productivity and collaboration tools (e.g., spreadsheets, slide decks, project management tools).
* Relevant experience in startup, consulting, or B2B services environments is highly beneficial.
* Interest in data privacy, compliance, or technology services; familiarity with India’s DPDPA is a plus.
* Bachelor’s degree in business, economics, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently, prioritize multiple tasks, and maintain a high level of ownership.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Outbound Prospecting: Build target lists and run multi-channel outreach (LinkedIn, cold email, cold calls) to operations heads, compliance owners and leadership at SMBs and mid-market firms.
* Discovery & Demos: Qualify leads, run discovery calls, and present our Consent Platform and DPDP Gap Assessment offerings with clarity and confidence, with founders stepping in on larger deals.
* Proposals & Commercials: Prepare quotes, pitch decks, scope notes and pricing options. Follow deals through negotiation and agreement stages alongside the founders.
* CRM & Pipeline Hygiene: Own the CRM end to end. Track every lead and follow-up, and give founders a clear weekly view of pipeline, conversion and forecast.
* Account Research: Use AI tools to research prospects, map decision-makers and find compliance triggers, so every outreach is relevant and timely.
* Founder's Office Support: Take on cross-functional work for the founders, such as market research, competitor tracking, reporting, partner coordination and special projects.
* Core Groundwork: Navigate early-stage, unstructured challenges, test new pitches and objection handling, and document sales playbooks as we scale.

**Key Requirements**

* Experience: 1 to 3 years in B2B sales, business development, inside sales, SaaS, or tech/agency setups. Strong freshers with proven hustle are welcome.
* Communication: Exceptional written and verbal English with a sharp, professional tone. You will be comfortable on calls with senior decision-makers.
* Sales Instinct: Persistence, resilience in the face of rejection, and a genuine drive to close.
* AI Native: Daily comfort with AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, automation platforms) to multiply research and outreach output.
* Tools: Working knowledge of CRMs, email outreach tools and LinkedIn Sales Navigator is a plus. Spreadsheet fluency is expected.
* Grit & Ownership: High tolerance for early-stage chaos, a strong work ethic, and a willingness to commit time and energy to a foundational role.
* Location: On-site presence in Sector 62, Noida (with flexible daily working hours).
* CTC for this role: Up to 3.5 LPA. As we scale, this pay can increase within a year.

------

**Why Join Us?**

* Direct Founding Access: Work 1-on-1 with leadership, sit in on client calls, and learn how deals are won, priced and closed, with zero corporate bureaucracy.
* High Growth Curve: A 0-to-1 build environment compresses years of corporate sales learning into one, setting you up for a 2x+ leap in your market value.
* Real Ownership: Your outreach, your pipeline, your numbers. You will see the direct line between your work and revenue.
* Modern Stack: Heavy use of AI and LLM tools daily to research prospects, personalise outreach and move faster than a traditional sales team.

----

**Also open to those graduating soon or freshers, via intership.**

**Designation: Founder's Office Intern (Sales & Ops)**

**Stipend: 15k/mo**

All responsibilities same as above, with a lighter scope focused on learning the sales motion in the first few months:

* Support LinkedIn and email outreach, and log every touchpoint in the CRM.
* Shadow discovery and demo calls, and draft follow-ups and proposal inputs.
* Assist founders with market research, competitor tracking and weekly pipeline reports.

We look for strong English, high energy and curiosity. Strong performers will be considered for the full-time role.

title: GM - Human Resources
description:
Key responsibilities

**1. Statutory compliance and industrial relations**

* Keep all three plants compliant with the four labour codes, the Factories Act, CLRA, ESI, EPF, Bonus and Gratuity, under both UP and AP rules.
* Keep salary structures compliant with the Code on Wages, including the rule that basic wages must be at least 50% of remuneration.
* Own labour-department inspections, returns, registers and licences for each plant.
* Manage contract labour: contractor onboarding, wage and PF/ESI checks, and principal-employer liability.
* Keep shop-floor relations stable: grievance handling, discipline, domestic enquiries, and any union or works-committee engagement.

**2. Workforce planning and hiring**

* Build the annual manpower plan for each plant with the plant heads.
* Hire staff and engineers on time, within budget.
* Run the blue-collar pipeline: NAPS apprentices, then LEADS (Learn and Earn), then fixed-term employment.
* Build links with ITIs and polytechnics around Noida and Sri City.

**3. Compensation, payroll and HR policy**

* Own payroll inputs, the salary structure and the annual increment cycle, in line with the engineer salary structure.
* Write and maintain the HR policy manual: leave, attendance, travel, company car, separation and full-and-final settlement.

**4. Performance management and HR systems**

* Roll out a performance management system (PMS) with KRAs for staff, and run the annual appraisal.
* Lead the HRMS implementation and make it the single source of truth for HR data across plants.

**5. People development and retention**

* Run induction, safety and skill training, and leadership development for supervisors.
* Track attrition by plant and cadre, and act on the causes.

**6. HR team and administration**

* Lead and build the plant HR teams, with clear ownership at each plant.
* Oversee plant administration: canteen, transport, housekeeping and security.

**7. EHS (Environment, Health & Safety) compliance**

* Own EHS compliance at all three plants, working with the safety officers and plant heads.
* Keep safety obligations under the Factories Act and the OSH Code current: safety committees, PPE, fire safety, first aid, occupational health checks and accident reporting.
* Make sure consents and returns with the UP and AP pollution control boards, and hazardous-waste records (e.g. enamel solvents and varnish waste), are valid and on time.
* Maintain ISO 14001 (environment) and ISO 45001 (occupational health and safety) certifications, and lead internal and external audits.
* Track safety metrics (incidents, near misses, lost-time injuries) and run monthly safety reviews.

**8. ESG compliance and reporting**

* Own the social and governance data for ESG: headcount, diversity, wages, training hours, safety, grievances and contractor welfare.
* Respond to customer ESG and supplier-code audits and questionnaires on time and with evidence.
* Ensure there is no child labour or forced labour at the plants or at labour contractors, and that a POSH committee and grievance mechanism are in place.
* Work with plant teams on environmental data: energy, water, waste and emissions.
* Run CSR activities and their compliance, if applicable.

title: Senior Data Science
description:
**Senior Data Science**

**About Doceree**

Doceree is the world’s only AI-powered Operating System for healthcare marketing. We aim to be a catalyst for change, improving healthcare by enabling more meaningful interactions with HCPs. Our patented AI brings deeper context to every HCP touchpoint—understanding who HCPs are, what they’re exploring, how they engage, and when they make decisions, all in a privacy-compliant way. With this enriched context, every message becomes clearer, more relevant, and more likely to drive better healthcare outcomes.

In our journey of 5 years, we have earned four patents for innovation and even won a Silver award at the Cannes Lions, one of the world’s top advertising honors. Over the years, we’ve also had the opportunity to work with 115+ pharma companies and collaborate with 30+ media publications, 150+ EHR platforms, 2,000+ publisher networks, and 35+ hospitals and health systems. Our ecosystem connects us with more than 6 million verified doctors worldwide. Today, Doceree operates across 25+ countries, with teams based in New Jersey, London, and India.

**Our Core Belief**

*Technology can connect the fragmented healthcare ecosystem to deliver information when it is most needed to improve patients' outcomes.*

We are expanding our footprints across the globe and enhancing our services, offering, and developing new products and solutions to address the unmet needs of industry. Doceree is operating in 22 countries currently with offices in US, UK and India.

Website http://www.doceree.com/

Social media link https://www.linkedin.com/company/doceree/

**About The Job**

**Position Title:**
Senior Data Science

**Department/Function:**
Product & Engineering

**Job Scope:**
India

**Reporting to:**
CAIO

**Location:**
Noida, India

**Work Setting:**
WFO

**Purpose of the Job**

We are looking for a hands-on Data Science Manager to lead a small, high-impact team of Data Scientists while continuing to contribute technically. This is not a coordination-only management role. You will help shape modeling approaches, review code and experiments, unblock productionization, and improve the operating cadence of the team.

The role sits at the intersection of machine learning, healthcare data, and programmatic advertising. You will oversee work spanning attribution and lift measurement, probabilistic identity, audience quality, benchmarking and evaluation, forecasting, engagement/CTR modeling, and other applied ML problems as the portfolio evolves.

You will also partner closely with Product, AI Engineering, Data/Platform Engineering, and external data partners as Doceree builds a more unified foundation for clinical-intent signals, HCP identity, anonymized patient-level data, claims-derived outcomes, and activation identifiers.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Extract entities and attributes from heterogeneous sources — warehouse tables, registries and feeds, and documents such as literature and trial registries that must be parsed before linking.
* Design and implement probabilistic entity linking and deduplication across multiple large, inconsistent healthcare datasets.
* Own the linking pipeline end to end - pairwise and graph-based scoring, calibrated match probabilities, resolution into stable entities - working alongside existing data scientists to maintain and improve the algorithms already running in production.
* Define how link quality is measured: precision and recall, calibration, error analysis by source and segment, and confidence thresholds per downstream use.
* Link entities and attributes to controlled medical vocabularies, so specialties, conditions and products mean the same thing across sources.
* Use graph representations and graph ML as core linking tools — clustering over candidate-link graphs, centrality, community detection, link prediction, and embeddings for candidate retrieval.
* Build and maintain the data and graph estate - warehouse transformation, refresh, monitoring - and keep raising the performance of existing algorithms as sources, volumes and downstream needs change.

* **Qualifications Requirement: Experience, Skills & Education**
* Experience: 4+ years shipping production ML or data-science work, including hands-on entity linking, entity resolution or record linkage at scale.
* Languages: Python (production-grade, tested, type-hinted), strong SQL.
* Software Engineering: FastAPI, Docker, pytest, Git and CI/CD — code others can run, test and deploy without you in the room.
* Probabilistic Methods: match scoring and calibration, threshold selection, and evaluation where ground truth is scarce.
* Graphs: comfort treating linking itself as a graph problem — graph algorithms (connected components, centrality, community detection) and graph ML (embeddings, GNNs) — and a view on what it takes to run graphs at hundreds of millions of edges rather than in memory.
* Data & ML Engineering: warehouse-centric pipelines, ETL over large public and licensed datasets, extraction from semi-structured and document sources, scalable blocking, vector search, incremental refresh and data-quality monitoring.
* Stack: Snowflake or another distributed SQL warehouse (BigQuery, Databricks, Redshift); PyTorch Geometric or DGL; igraph/NetworkX; Splink; and a graph store you have run at scale, e.g. Amazon Neptune, Neo4j/Cypher, or an RDF/SPARQL store.

**Preferred Candidate**

* Nice to Have: medical ontologies and controlled vocabularies (MeSH, UMLS, SNOMED, RxNorm); prescribing or claims data; healthcare sources such as NPPES/NPI, PubMed or ClinicalTrials.gov; biomedical NLP; AdTech experience and deduplicated reach measurement; regulated-environment work with PII constraints.

title: Technical Analyst - Trader
description:
Job Title: Technical Analyst

Location: Noida

**Company Overview:**

SIHO Research is a cutting-edge stock research and analytics firm that provides high-quality, data-driven investment insights. We leverage the latest technology, including AI, ML, and both fundamental and technical analysis, to evaluate and execute investment opportunities. We are a team of Software Architects, Engineers, Equity research analysts, AI engineers who are passionate about equity investing with a vision to make investing simple and provide the best research services. Our first B2C product is
investvidhi.com
. 

**Job Role Overview:**

We are looking for a Technical Analyst who can identify trading opportunities in Indian equities and turn analysis into clear, actionable research.

You should be comfortable explaining
**why a trade is attractive, what would invalidate it, and how its risk should be managed.**

The role combines chart analysis, strategy testing, market tracking, and research communication.

**Key responsibilities**

* Analyse price action, volume, trends, market structure, support and resistance, and relative strength.
* Identify swing and positional trading opportunities using a repeatable research process.
* Prepare a weekly watchlist and timely trade proposals with entry conditions, stop-loss, targets, expected holding period, and supporting rationale.
* Assess market direction, sector strength, liquidity, volatility, and relevant company events before proposing trades.
* Monitor active recommendations and propose timely updates, exits, or invalidations.
* Backtest trading strategies and evaluate their performance after transaction costs and slippage.
* Maintain a complete research journal covering successful, unsuccessful, and missed trades.
* Work with fundamental analysts to strengthen stock selection and identify material business risks.
* Collaborate with engineers to build screeners, alerts, dashboards, and research automation.
* Prepare clear research notes and educational content following internal review and compliance processes.

**Required skills**

* Strong understanding of technical analysis and Indian equity markets.
* Practical knowledge of price-volume behaviour, breakouts, pullbacks, trend reversals, and risk management.
* Ability to distinguish a promising chart pattern from a strategy supported by evidence.
* Proficiency in TradingView or similar charting platforms.
* Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills.
* Ability to communicate research in simple English; Hindi communication is an advantage.
* Discipline in documenting decisions, acknowledging mistakes, and following a defined process.

**Good to have**

* Python, pandas, Pine Script, or experience building automated screeners.
* Knowledge of backtesting pitfalls, including look-ahead bias, survivorship bias, and overfitting.
* Familiarity with fundamental analysis and earnings-related risks.
* Relevant NISM certifications or progress toward the CMT qualification.

**How success will be measured**

* Quality, clarity, and timeliness of research.
* Consistent adherence to the research and risk-management process.
* Performance across a meaningful sample of trades, including expectancy, drawdown, and risk-reward.
* Accuracy and completeness of recommendation tracking.
* Useful contributions to strategy improvement and research automation.

**Performance will be assessed beyond win rate, with attention to risk, repeatability, and research integrity.**

**Who will thrive in this role**

Someone who is curious, analytical, accountable, and comfortable challenging their own conclusions. You should enjoy researching markets, learning from evidence, and taking ownership of work without repeated follow-ups.

What We Offer:

* Competitive compensation and benefits package.
* ESOPs.
* Mentorship and growth opportunities within the team.
* Access to the latest development tools and technologies.
* A collaborative, inclusive work environment with a strong focus on learning and professional development.

**How to apply**

Share your CV along with:

* Two sample technical research reports with annotated charts.
* One successful and one unsuccessful trade analysis, explaining the original rationale and lessons learned.
* A brief description of a trading strategy you have tested, including its rules and results.

Personal trading profits are not a prerequisite. We value the quality of your reasoning, evidence, and process.

Please send your resume to
jsr.nitin@sihoresearch.com

SimCorp DMS is a complete data management solution for pricing and reference data, provided as a Managed Service. Therefore, in addition to the traditional benefit scheme, we provide an excellent work & life balance: flexible work hours, a hybrid workplace model. On top of that, we have IP sprints where you have 3 weeks per quarter you can spend on mastering your skills as well as contributing to the company development. There is never just only one route - we practice an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take.

**Swati.pal@simcorp.com**
to learn more about the vacancy and what SimCorp offers regarding salary, benefits, and perks. Applications are continuously assessed, so please send your CV in English as soon as possible.
