**Role Title: 2603010 AVP, AI Security Architect (L11)**
**Company Overview**
Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as #3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the #1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
  
  
**Organizational Overview**
The Security Architecture organization enables Synchrony to innovate and grow securely by embedding security-by-design into technology solutions. We partner with engineering, platform, data, cloud, and business teams to translate security strategy and evolving threats into practical architecture requirements, reusable patterns, blueprints, and guardrails. Through risk-based architecture reviews, threat modeling, and scalable security guidance, the team helps protect Synchrony’s digital assets and customer data while supporting resilient, compliant, and efficient technology delivery. This role will contribute to advancing our AI Security Architecture capabilities, helping establish secure patterns and assurance practices for Generative AI, AI agents, and other emerging AI technologies.
  
  
**Role Summary/Purpose**
**The AVP, AI Security Architect**
will design and advance security architectures for Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, Machine Learning, and emerging AI technologies. The role will translate enterprise security strategy and evolving AI threats into practical requirements, reusable patterns, and engineering guidance that enable secure innovation while protecting company, customer, and sensitive data.
  
  
Working across Cybersecurity, Technology, Data, AI/ML Engineering, Cloud, Risk, and Business teams, the architect will lead solution-level security assessments, contribute to enterprise standards, and embed security-by-design through threat modeling, control validation, testing, and continuous assurance across the AI lifecycle.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Apply and help mature enterprise AI security architecture principles, standards, reference architectures, and guardrails.
* Design reusable security patterns for Generative AI, copilots, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), model and inference APIs, autonomous or agentic AI, and enterprise AI platforms.
* Lead security architecture assessments for complex AI solutions across cloud, SaaS, API, data, application, and enterprise technology environments.
* Partner with AI/ML engineers, application teams, cloud architects, data teams, and product owners to embed security throughout design, development, deployment, integration, monitoring, and retirement.
* Perform AI threat modeling using MITRE ATLAS and OWASP guidance, translating identified threats into actionable controls and engineering requirements.
* Define and validate controls for model access, identities, service accounts, secrets, APIs, prompts, training and retrieval data, outputs, plugins, tools, and third-party AI services.
* Assess risks such as prompt injection, data poisoning, sensitive information disclosure, insecure tool interaction, excessive agency, model manipulation, and AI supply-chain compromise.
* Contribute to automation of architecture reviews, threat modeling, vulnerability assessment, control validation, and security testing.
* Document architecture decisions, material risks, trade-offs, and recommendations for technical teams and senior stakeholders.
* Collaborate with Enterprise Architecture, Cloud, Application Security, Data, Responsible AI, Privacy, Legal, Compliance, Risk, and Business partners.
* Create implementation guidance and enablement that help engineering teams adopt approved AI security patterns consistently.

**Required Skills/Knowledge**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Strong experience in cybersecurity, security architecture, cloud security, application security, or enterprise architecture, including delivery of complex security initiatives.
* Practical knowledge of modern AI architectures, including Large Language Models, RAG, vector databases, embeddings, model gateways, AI agents, orchestration frameworks, managed AI services, and model or inference APIs.
* Strong foundation in identity and access management, application and API security, cloud security, data protection, secrets and key management, DevSecOps, and software supply-chain security.
* Knowledge of AI security and risk frameworks such as the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, MITRE ATLAS, NIST AI Risk Management Framework, and Zero Trust principles.
* Experience designing or reviewing enterprise architectures on AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
* Ability to convert technical risks into architecture requirements, reusable patterns, engineering guidance, and clear recommendations.
* Demonstrated ability to influence technical stakeholders, facilitate architecture decisions, and build alignment across teams.
* Strong written, verbal, presentation, and stakeholder-management skills.

**Desired Skills/Knowledge**

* Experience securing platforms such as Amazon Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Copilot, or comparable enterprise AI services.
* Experience with AI red teaming, adversarial testing, model security assessment, prompt-injection testing, or AI vulnerability management.
* Familiarity with NIST AI RMF, MITRE ATLAS, OWASP guidance, ISO/IEC 42001, and evolving AI governance expectations.
* Ability to move effectively between detailed technical architecture, engineering execution, risk discussions, and stakeholder communication.
* Experience developing reference architectures, security blueprints, automated guardrails, and scalable control-assurance capabilities.
* Financial-services cybersecurity, regulatory, risk-management, or data-protection experience is a plus.
* Collaborative and execution-oriented approach, with a focus on simplification, automation, measurable outcomes, and responsible innovation.

**Eligibility Criteria**
Bachelor's degree with 6+ years of experience in Cyber industry, security architecture experience including on-prem and hybrid environments and practical knowledge of modern AI architectures, including Large Language Models, RAG, vector databases, embeddings, model gateways, AI agents, orchestration frameworks, managed AI services, and model or inference APIs.

We are proud to offer flexibility at Synchrony. Our way of working allows you the option to work from home or workspaces in our Regional Engagement Hubs—Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Pune, Kolkata, or Delhi/NCR. Occasionally you may be required to commute or travel to Hyderabad or one of the Regional Engagement Hubs for in person engagement activities such as business or team meetings, trainings, and culture events.

title: Senior ETRM Developer
description:
**Job Description**
Alimentation Couche-Tard Inc. (ACT) is a global Fortune 200 company (https://corpo.couche-tard.com/en/). A leader in convenience store and fuel space, it has a footprint across 31 countries and territories. ACT's India entity i.e. Circle K Business Centre India (CKBCI) is a wholly owned subsidiary and an integrated center, collaborating with our international teams supporting the delivery of ACT's global business operations.
  
  
**About The Role**
This role will be based in Cyber Hub Gurugram. We are looking for an experienced senior ETRM/full-stack developer with strong hands-on experience in commodity trading systems, enterprise application development, and oil and power markets.
  
  
The ideal candidate will have a minimum of 7+ years of relevant professional experience, including at least 3+ years of hands-on experience in power markets.
  
  
Experience working with an ETRM/CTRM application vendor or within a commodity trading organization is highly desirable.
  
  
The role will be part of the Trading Systems Specialist team, supporting the growth of our commercial energy trading business across Europe and North America.
  
  
The successful candidate will work closely with Trading, Middle Office, Trade Management, and Supply and Logistics teams, as well as IT and external application vendors.
  
  
A key responsibility will be to independently contribute to the design, architecture and development of our in-house power trading systems, taking ownership from business requirements and solution design through development, testing, deployment and ongoing support.
  
  
***Roles & Responsibilities
  
  
ETRM Development and Application Management***

* Drive the design, development and delivery of C/ETRM enhancements.
* Analyze business requirements, propose technical solutions and independently deliver application developments.
* Develop, maintain, debug and optimize application code, database components and supporting services.
* Automate application processes, operational tasks and business controls.
* Provide technical support to business users and troubleshoot application issues.
* Maintain technical documentation and work with vendors to resolve defects and improve system functionality.

***In-House Power Trading Systems Development***

* Contribute to the architecture, design and development of in-house power trading systems.
* Translate trading requirements into scalable technical solutions covering trade capture, position management, scheduling, nominations, settlement and reporting.
* Work closely with power trading stakeholders to understand market requirements and operational workflows.
* Independently drive technical initiatives from requirements gathering through design, development, testing and implementation.
* Develop integrations with power market platforms, exchanges, scheduling systems and external data providers.

***Full-Stack Application Development***

* Develop enterprise backend applications and services using Java and Spring Boot.
* Design, develop and maintain REST APIs and microservices.
* Develop modern frontend applications using React, Angular or equivalent frameworks.
* Integrate frontend applications with backend services and relational databases.
* Apply software engineering best practices covering application architecture, performance, security and maintainability.

***System Integration, Cloud and Automation***

* Develop and maintain integrations between ETRM and enterprise applications, including ERP, planning and scheduling systems.
* Design and support APIs, data pipelines and automated workflows.
* Work with relational databases, SQL, data modelling and Python scripting.
* Develop and support application and data workloads on AWS and/or Azure.
* Support workflow orchestration using tools such as AWS MWAA (Apache Airflow).
* Use API testing and documentation tools such as Postman and Swagger.
* Support system monitoring, performance optimization and operational reliability.

***Business Support and Project Delivery***

* Support daily trading, middle-office and operational reporting requirements.
* Work closely with business stakeholders and IT teams to resolve technical and operational challenges.
* Manage application enhancements, releases and vendor upgrades.
* Support technical testing, UAT and production deployments.
* Manage technical issues and vendor escalations.
* Follow established change management, release management and incident management processes.

***Job Requirements
  
  
Education***

* Degree in computer science, software engineering or a related technical discipline.

**Experience**

* Minimum 7+ years of relevant professional experience in software development, ETRM/CTRM systems or enterprise application development.
* Minimum 3+ years of hands-on experience in power markets – essential.
* Experience working with an ETRM/CTRM vendor or commodity trading organization is highly desirable.
* Demonstrated experience independently delivering application development and integration projects.

***Behavioral Skills***

* Ability to work independently and take ownership of technical deliverables end-to-end.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify root causes and deliver sustainable solutions.
* Ability to translate business requirements into practical and scalable technical solutions.
* Demonstrated capability to design and build solutions rather than relying solely on vendor support.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management and collaboration skills.
* High attention to detail, proactive approach and strong delivery focus.

***Technical Skills***

* Experience with AWS and/or Azure cloud platforms.
* Familiarity with AWS MWAA / Apache Airflow.
* Experience with Docker, containerization and automated deployments.
* Familiarity with monitoring tools such as Grafana, Kibana or Zabbix.
* Experience with ServiceNow, JIRA and Change Management processes.
* Strong understanding of ETRM/CTRM applications and end-to-end commodity trading processes.
* Minimum 3+ years of power market experience.
* Understanding power trading workflows, including trade capture, position management, scheduling, nominations, settlement, pricing and risk management.
* Knowledge of physical commodity trading, freight, logistics and supply operations.
* Experience with ETRM platforms such as Amphora Symphony, Endur, RightAngle or equivalent is desirable.

***Knowledge***

* Experience using AI-powered development tools such as ChatGPT, Claude or GitHub Copilot.
* Experience designing or implementing in-house ETRM/CTRM or power trading solutions.
* Exposure to power exchanges, market operators, balancing mechanisms and market data providers.
* Experience with Power BI or other business intelligence tools.
* Experience across multiple commodities, including crude oil, refined products, natural gas and electricity.

***Other Requirement***
**Work Model:**
5-day work-from-office.
  
  
**Working Hours:**
Flexible hours.
  
  
**Notice Period:**
Immediate joiners are preferred, or a maximum of 30 days.
  
  
**Candidate Location:**
Candidates based within a commuting distance from the office are preferred.

description:

is collaborating with

: - Consultant/ Manager/Analyst – Marketing & Customer Data Platforms (GCP, CDP, Agentic AI)
  
  
**Job location**
: - Any out of 6 AI locations
  
  
**About S&C - Global Network (GN)**
: - Accenture GN’s Data & AI (AI Hub India) practice help our clients grow their business in entirely new ways. Analytics enables our clients to achieve high performance through insights from data - insights that inform better decisions and strengthen customer relationships. From strategy to execution, Accenture works with organizations to develop analytic capabilities - from accessing and reporting on data to predictive modelling – to outperform the competition.
  
  
**WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?**
As part of our Analytics practice, you will join a worldwide network of over 20k+ smart and driven colleagues experienced in leading AI/ML/Statistical tools/Agentic AI systems, methods and applications. From data to analytics and insights to actions, our forward-thinking consultants provide analytically-informed, issue-based insights at scale to help our clients improve outcomes and achieve high performance.
  
  
**What You Would Do In This Role**
A Consultant/Manager/Analyst for Customer Data Platforms serves as the day-to-day marketing technology point of contact and helps our clients get value out of their investment into a Customer Data Platform (CDP) by developing a strategic roadmap focused on personalized activation. You will be working with a multidisciplinary team of Solution Architects, Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and Digital Marketers.
  
  
As part of that, we are seeking a highly skilled Consultant/Manager/Analyst to architect, build, and operationalize custom Customer Data Platforms (CDPs), Agentic AI systems and marketing data solutions on the Google Cloud Platform (GCP). You will be at the intersection of data engineering, MLOps, and marketing technology, building the foundational infrastructure that enables our clients to understand their customers, predict their needs, and deliver personalized experiences at scale.
  
  
**Key Duties and Responsibilities: (GCP CDP)**

* Architect & Design: Lead the technical design and architecture of enterprise-grade, custom CDPs and marketing data warehouses on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Build Production-Grade Data Pipelines: Engineer robust, scalable, and automated data pipelines for both streaming and batch ingestion using services like Cloud Dataflow, Pub/Sub, and Cloud Functions. Containerize processing jobs with Docker for portability and scalability.
* Model for Insight & Activation: Design and implement data models in BigQuery optimized for customer identity resolution, 360-degree profile creation, segmentation, and analytics.
* Champion DevOps & MLOps: Champion and implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform. Build CI/CD pipelines using Cloud Build to automate testing and deployment, manage container images in Artifact Registry, and secure credentials using Google Secret Manager.
* Deploy & Serve: Develop and deploy containerized, serverless APIs (using Docker and Cloud Run) for real-time data ingestion and activation, feeding customer segments and triggers into marketing platforms.
* Operationalize Machine Learning: Collaborate with data scientists to productionize ML models (e.g., propensity, LTV, segmentation) using the Vertex AI platform. Build automated training pipelines, and deploy models for real-time inference.
* Collaborate & Innovate: Work within a multi-disciplinary team to translate business requirements into technical solutions, prototype new approaches, and provide expert guidance on the art of the possible with GCP and modern data engineering.
* Ensure Governance & Security: Implement solutions that adhere to data governance best practices and privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR, CCPA), ensuring data is handled securely and ethically.

**Key Duties and Responsibilities: (RTCDP)**

* Be a platform expert in Adobe RTCDP (Adobe Real time CDP). Developer level expertise on Adobe RTCDP (Adobe Experience Platform) is a must with other CDP platforms like Lytics, Segment, Amperity, Tealium, Treasure Data etc. including custom build CDPs as an added advantage
* Deep developer level expertise for real time event tracking for web analytics e.g., Google Tag Manager, Adobe Launch, Adobe Web SDK, etc.
* Provide deep domain expertise in our client’s business and broad knowledge of digital marketing together with a Marketing Strategist industry
* Deep expert level knowledge of reporting tools like GA360/GA4, Adobe Analytics, Customer Journey Analytics
* Deep expert level knowledge of paid media destinations - Google Ads, DV360, Campaign Manager, Facebook Ads Manager, The Trading desk etc.
* Deep developer expertise for Journey Orchestration and Personalization tools like Adobe Target, Adobe Campaign, Adobe Journey Optimizer
* Assess and audit the current state of a client’s marketing technology stack (MarTech) including data infrastructure, ad platforms and data security policies together with a solutions architect.
* Conduct stakeholder interviews and gather business requirements
* Translate business requirements into BRDs, CDP customer analytics use cases, structure technical solution
* Prioritize CDP use cases together with the client.
* Create a strategic CDP roadmap focused on data driven marketing activation.
* Work with the Solution Architect to strategize, architect, and document a scalable CDP/Martech implementation, tailored to the client’s needs. Able to integrate multiple Martech tools.
* Ensure analytics are consistently implemented across digital properties. Diagnose and troubleshoot analytics/Martech implementation and platform configuration issues. Perform end-to-end QA testing for integrations.
* Coordinate with website developers for Analytics integration, datalayer implementation, Martech tools integration
* Design and Implement Adobe Stack Martech tools like Adobe Target, Adobe Campaign, Adobe Journey Optimizer, Adobe Launch, Adobe Web SDK, Adobe Analytics, Customer Journey Analytics
* Deep domain expertise in Tag Management, Journey Orchestration, Campaign Management, A/B Testing
* Perform technical analysis & design for Martech related initiatives. Define requirements for Martech implementation/reporting dashboard.

**Key Duties and Responsibilities: (Agentic AI)**

* Architect the core interaction logic and decision-making frameworks for enterprise-grade, agentic AI systems within marketing on GCP.
* Leverage Google Agent Development Kit (ADKs) and APIs to orchestrate complex, multi-step agentic workflows, focusing on reasoning capabilities.
* Design agentic AI systems for scalability, robustness, and real-time responsiveness in autonomous marketing decision-making.
* Design and implement data storage strategies (Datastores) optimized for efficient retrieval of context for AI agents.
* Design, implement, and optimize Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines to equip Gemini agents with contextually relevant information from various knowledge sources.
* Leverage Gemini models' reasoning capabilities to enable agents for complex analysis, strategic planning, and problem-solving in marketing contexts.
* Develop and apply advanced prompting techniques (e.g., Chain-of-Thought, Few-Shot) to guide and enhance the reasoning, accuracy, and output quality of AI agents.
* Implement and leverage grounding & evaluation capabilities within Agentic AI systems to ensure outputs are factually accurate, contextually relevant, and traceable to specific data sources for marketing applications.
* Develop and deploy AI-driven solutions for generating multimodal marketing assets (e.g., personalized images, video snippets, audio messages) powered by Gemini.
* Implement LLMops best practices for the lifecycle management of agentic AI models, including CI/CD for AI components.
* Ensure secure and compliant interactions for AI agents, managing credentials and secrets relevant to AI model access.
* Implement robust monitoring, logging, and observability specifically for the performance, decision paths, and output quality of agentic AI systems.
* Prototype new approaches and provide expert guidance on GCP AI services, Gemini, RAG, advanced prompting, and reasoning AI techniques.
* Create insights presentations and client-ready decks, effectively communicating findings and recommendations.
* Mentor and guide junior resources, fostering a collaborative and growth-oriented team environment.
* Demonstrate strong communication skills, both verbal and written, to effectively convey complex concepts and insights to stakeholders.
* Develop strong relationships with clients at all levels, understanding their specific challenges and opportunities.

**Other Roles And Responsibilities**

* Business intelligence expertise for insights, actionable recommendations.
* Project management expertise for sprint planning
* Provide hands-on support and platform training for our clients.
* Data processing, data engineer and data schema/models expertise for CDPs to work on data models, unification logic etc.
* Work with Business Analysts, Data Architects, Technical Architects, DBAs to achieve project objectives - delivery dates, quality objectives etc.

**Who are we looking for?**

* B Tech/M Tech from reputed engineering colleges
* Masters/M Tech in Computer Science
* Master degree in Statistics/Econometrics/ Economics from reputed institute
* M.Phil/Ph.D in Statistics/Econometrics or related field
* 3+ years of hands-on experience in data engineering or software engineering with a data focus.
* At least 2+ years of demonstrable experience building and managing data solutions on a major cloud platform (GCP is strongly preferred; AWS/Azure experience is valuable)
* At least 2+ years of relevant work experience in marketing, consulting, or analytics
* Strong understanding of data governance and compliance (i.e. PII, PHI, GDPR, CCPA)
* Experience with analytics tools like Google Analytics or Adobe Analytics or Adobe Customer Journey Analytics is a plus.
* Developer experience with tag management platforms like Adobe Launch/AEP Web SDK, Google Tag Manager, Tealium iQ. Certification in any one is plus
* Strong understanding of implementation of consent management platforms e.g. – Sourcepoint, OneTrust on digital assets
* Experience in requirement gathering, solution design, tag implementation and audits, Martech tools integration
* Experience in defining measurement frameworks for websites/app, suggesting KPIs to track, driving strategy for customer engagement
* Strong experience in ETL, data aggregation and transformation using SQL is a must
* Experience in mobile analytics implementations is a nice to have
* Good to have programming experience in PySpark, Python, Shell Scripts.
* RDBMS, TSQL, NoSQL experience is a plus
* Manage large volumes of structured and unstructured data, extract & clean data to make it amenable for analysis.
* Experience in deployment and operationalizing the code is an added advantage.
* Experience with source control systems such as Git, Bitbucket, and Jenkins build and continuous integration tools.
* Proficient in Excel, MS word, PowerPoint, etc

**RTCDP**
(specific skills)
  
  

* At least 2+ years of relevant work experience of implementing CDP solutions with deep understanding of identity resolution methods with minimum 1 year in Adobe RTCDP
* At least 2+ years of relevant work experience in marketing, consulting, or analytics
* At least 2+ years of experience working in an agency environment
* At least 2 years of experience working as Subject matter expert in Adobe Marketing Cloud Stack
* Experience with A/B testing tools like Adobe Target is a plus.
* Experience with Campaign Management tools like Adobe Journey Optimizer or/and Adobe Campaign is a plus.
* Experience with Adobe Marketing Cloud tools like Adobe Workfront, Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), DAM is a plus
* Experience in Postman APIs is a plus
* Strong hands-on with advanced JavaScript and jQuery. Able to develop custom tags/scripts using tag managers

**Agentic AI**
(specific skills)
  
  

* 2+ years of hands-on experience in software engineering with a data focus, or AI/ML engineering.
* At least 2 years of demonstrable experience building and managing data/AI solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Demonstrable experience building and deploying agentic AI systems, leveraging LLMs for complex decision-making.
* Hands-on experience with Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines and integrating external knowledge sources for LLMs.
* Proven ability to apply advanced prompting techniques (e.g., Chain-of-Thought, Few-Shot) to guide and enhance LLM reasoning and output quality.
* Experience working with large language models (LLMs) with a focus on their reasoning capabilities.
* Hands-on experience working with Google Gemini models and their APIs/SDKs is highly preferred.

* In-depth, hands-on expertise with core GCP data and AI services, including Vertex AI (for LLM integration, prompt engineering, RAG pipeline development).

* Experience in deploying and managing AI models in production environments using Vertex AI.
* Experience integrating with key marketing platform APIs is highly advantageous.

* Outstanding communication and stakeholder management skills.
* A proactive, innovative, and results-driven approach.
* A collaborative spirit and the capacity to mentor and guide junior team members.

**Technical Skills**

* Google Tag Manager, and/or Adobe Launch/AEP Web SDK, and/or Tealium iQ – any and/or any Tag Manager Tool - any one (prefer whoever has any one of these)

**Department**
HR Information System

Gurugram

Manager - HRIS

3
  
  
We’re proud to have been helping our clients build better financial futures for over 50 years. How have we achieved this? By working together - and supporting each other - all over the world. So, join our team and feel like you’re part of something bigger.
  
  
**About Your Team**
The HR Systems Team sits within the FIL Platforms function and works in partnership with Compensation & Benefits, HR Business Partners and business groups to provide assistance in the technological support on Workday Human Capital Management System and other HR applications such as Cornerstone On Demand and LinkedIn Learning
  
  
**About Your Role**
This role focuses on delivering unified, high-quality reporting solutions across HRIS platforms to support data-driven decision-making and service delivery excellence. While Workday remains a core system, the role requires a broader perspective across multiple HR technologies. The ideal candidate will apply AI-enabled tools and techniques to enhance reporting efficiency, accuracy, and insight generation.
  
  
You will collaborate with stakeholders to understand reporting needs, design scalable solutions, and ensure data integrity and governance. The role also supports continuous improvement initiatives and contributes to HR technology transformation projects
  
  
**About You**
Reporting & Analytics
  
  

* Design, development, and continuous improvement of advanced Workday reporting solutions across HCM, Talent, Absence, Time Tracking, and Recruiting.
* Provide technical direction and oversight for Workday reports, dashboards, calculated fields, and analytics solutions, ensuring they are scalable, performant, secure, and maintainable.
* Drive reporting standards, governance, quality assurance, and best practices across the team.

AI, Automation & Innovation
  
  

* Champion an AI-first and automation-focused mindset within the team, continuously identifying opportunities to improve how reporting solutions are designed, developed, tested, documented, and supported.
* Explore and adopt Generative AI and Agentic AI capabilities to enhance developer productivity, reporting operations, data analysis, and user experience.
* Identify suitable use cases for AI agents and intelligent automation across reporting and HR technology workflows.

Strategic HRIS Initiatives
  
  

* Contribute to the HR technology and reporting roadmap, with a focus on analytics, AI, automation, self-service, and unified reporting.
* Identify opportunities for reporting rationalization, process optimization, automation, and improved service delivery.
* Partner with stakeholders to drive adoption of new reporting, analytics, and AI-enabled capabilities.

Collaboration
  
  

* Collaborate with key stakeholders across departments (HR, Finance, CPO Tech) to understand and fulfill reporting needs.
* Provide expert guidance on Workday reporting capabilities and solutions.
* Engage with internal clients and team members to gather reporting requirements and troubleshoot data discrepancies.

**Required Skills & Qualifications:**

* 5–7 years of overall experience in HRIS, HR Technology, Workday, or related domains, with 4+ years of strong hands-on experience in Workday Reporting.
* Strong expertise in Workday Reporting, including Advanced, Matrix and Composite Reports, Calculated Fields, Dashboards, Discovery Boards, and related reporting capabilities.
* Strong understanding of Workday HCM and experience working with modules such as Talent, Absence, Time Tracking, and Recruiting.
* Good knowledge of Workday Business Processes, Security Model, data sources, and reporting security.
* Experience working in an Agile environment, with practical knowledge of SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework) and experience operating within an Agile Release Train (ART).
* Awareness and practical understanding of Generative AI and Agentic AI concepts, including the potential use of AI agents to automate or augment reporting and HR technology workflows.
* Ability to evaluate reporting requirements and determine opportunities for automation, self-service analytics, AI-assisted insights, and simplification of existing solutions.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with experience engaging with HR, Technology, Product Owners, business stakeholders, and cross-functional delivery teams.
* Effective, results-driven written and verbal communicator, capable of communicating technical concepts and data insights to both technical and non-technical audiences.

**Preferred Skills And Certifications**

* Workday Pro Certification (Reporting, HCM, or other relevant modules)
* Understanding of prompt engineering, responsible AI practices, data privacy, security, and governance considerations when applying Generative AI within an enterprise environment.
* Exposure to Power BI or other visualization tools.
* Experience driving reporting governance, rationalization, standardization, and self-service reporting adoption within a large enterprise environment.

**Feel rewarded**
For starters, we’ll offer you a comprehensive benefits package. We’ll value your wellbeing and support your development. title: Trading Intelligence Analyst
description:
**Woolworths Group**
(Australia and New Zealand’s largest retailer) launched Woolworths Market Plus (WMP) in October 2023. WMP is the coming together of two businesses (BigW Market & Everyday Market).

WMP is a new platform for businesses to both sell and manage products across the Woolworths Group Marketplaces. A curated customer destination, bringing together a trusted ecosystem comprising three core banners: Everyday Market and BIG W Market. We have grown in the last year and now operate primarily across three hub locations: Manila, Melbourne & Sydney.

**Welcome to Big W**

At BIG W every day's a big day. For you, this could be the start of something big.

There are over 15,000 of us, in the biggest cities and the tiniest towns. And each of us has an important role to play to help make a real difference for families by providing real value, real solutions and real care.

The Trading Intelligence Analyst is a key contributor of competitor pricing intelligence, delivering data-driven insights that inform our pricing and promotional strategies. This role supports maintaining a competitive market position by tracking competitor activity, identifying pricing trends, and actively managing product matching data. As we evolve our capabilities, this role will champion the use of AI and automation to streamline processes, while also executing essential day-to-day data management to ensure accuracy and competitive advantage for our customers.

**What You'll Do**

* **Competitor Intelligence & Strategy:**
  Monitor competitor pricing activity to provide actionable insights that guide our pricing decisions and ensure we remain competitive.
* **Data Management & Product Matching:**
  Take ownership of maintaining our pricing database, including manual and automated product matching across product categories to ensure data accuracy.
* **Process Innovation & Automation:**
  Lead the adoption of AI, technology, and automated matching tools to drive efficiency, reduce manual effort, and improve the scalability of our pricing processes.
* **Promotional Performance Analysis:**
  Analyze past promotional performance to provide recommendations that improve the effectiveness, profitability, and strategic planning of future campaigns.
* **Insight-Driven Decision Support:**
  Perform deep-dive analysis on pricing and market data to help the buying and merchandising teams make informed, evidence-based decisions.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:**
  Partner with internal teams—including Store Operations and Replenishment—to optimize the execution of promotional plans and ensure reliable stock flow and pricing alignment.
* **Continuous Improvement:**
  Proactively identify opportunities to improve existing systems and workflows, maintaining a "roll up your sleeves" mindset while balancing long-term strategic enhancements.

**What You'll Bring**

* 2–5 years of experience in retail analytics, commercial pricing, business analytics, or a similar data-centric role.
* Demonstrated track record of managing large, complex datasets and translating them into clear, actionable recommendations that influence commercial outcomes.
* Experience in identifying inefficiencies and implementing improvements, with a specific interest in leveraging AI or automation tools to streamline workflows.
* Strong hands-on experience with data manipulation and visualization tools (e.g., SQL, Excel, Power BI/Tableau)
* Customer-Centric: high level of curiosity regarding customer needs and behaviors, ensuring that pricing strategies always put the customer first.
* Collaborating openly with stakeholders to ensure pricing outcomes are accurate and effectively executed.
* Handle manual, time-consuming tasks with accuracy, while simultaneously thinking ahead to build more efficient, automated solutions.
* Innovative Mindset: challenge the status quo, and are proactive in identifying issues and proposing smarter, technology-led solutions

**What you’ll experience**

* Be a part of Australia’s largest retailer
* Constant mentoring and training provided
* Generous sick and vacation leave
* A flexible approach to work
* Premium health insurance coverage

**Everyone belongs at Woolworths Group**

Diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging are key to realising our purpose of better together for a better tomorrow. We recognise the value our team’s diversity brings to our business, customers, and communities and that teams with diverse experiences and backgrounds enrich our group and are better able to innovate and solve problems. As one of the largest employers in Australia and New Zealand, we aim to create a truly inclusive workplace where everyone feels that they belong, can be their best selves, and reach their full potential.

We encourage all candidates to apply; please let us know in your application if we can support you with any adjustments in the hiring process.

title: Engineering Lead - AI
description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**EY Job Description**
**Job Title: Engineering Lead – AI**
**Job Rank (must note a single rank only for each job description): Associate Director**
**Function: EY Technology – Enterprise Technology**
**Scope (indicate either “global/cross-border” or “local/country”):Global**
**Sub Function: EY Technology | CBS Technology | Intelligent Automation**
**Reports to (Job Title): Service Delivery Lead: AI & Automation**
**Job Summary:**
The Engineering Lead is responsible for hands-on engineering delivery of enterprise AI/ML/GenAI and automation solutions, coding standards, design patterns, ensuring production-grade security, scalability, reliability, and supportability. It is not a solution advisory, PoC, or platform administration role. Success is measured by the quality, reliability, scalability, and operability of AI systems in production.
  
  
Operating as a player–coach, the Engineering Lead works alongside AI Engineers to design and build ML Models, LLM pipelines and agentic workflows, while also setting engineering standards, coaching teams, and ensuring delivery.
  
  
**The ideal candidate will possess:**

* Extensive, hands-on software engineering experience, with a proven track record of building and operating complex systems in production environments.
* Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, business-relevant outcomes.
* Ability to independently design and code across multiple technical components, while guiding and elevating the work of senior engineers.
* Deep technical expertise across the full stack, including cloud-native architectures, distributed systems, and data-intensive platforms.
* Strong command of non-functional requirements, including reliability, availability, scalability, performance, and cost optimization, and the ability to make sound technology and architecture decisions as systems evolve over time.
* Demonstrated experience delivering production-grade Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions, including:
* LLM-powered applications and services
* Agentic workflows and orchestration frameworks
* Model integration, evaluation, and lifecycle management
* MLOps / LLMOps pipelines and operational practices
* Proven experience partnering with Data Science and AI Research teams to operationalize models and AI capabilities at enterprise scale.
* Ability to drive the design and delivery of AI-first architectures, including LLM-powered services, agentic workflows, orchestration layers, and human-in-the-loop systems.
* Experience building robust data and software foundations that enable advanced analytics, real-time AI inference, and intelligent decisioning at scale.

**Essential Functions of the Job:**

* Engineering Ownership & Delivery Accountability

+ Own end-to-end technical delivery of AI and GenAI solutions—from design through production and BAU support.
+ Act as the technical authority for the build team, accountable for:

- Code quality and engineering standards
- Security, privacy, and compliance
- Reliability, scalability, performance, and cost
- Operational readiness and supportability

+ Make hard engineering trade-offs balancing latency, accuracy, cost, reliability, and scale.
+ Own production systems post go-live, including incident analysis, performance tuning, and architectural evolution.

* Hands-on GenAI & AI Systems Engineering


+ Collaborate with solution architecture on design and own build production-grade GenAI systems, including:

- Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines
- Agentic workflows and tool-based orchestration
- Prompt pipelines, routing, and integration layers
- Human-in-the-loop and safety guardrails

+ Work shoulder-to-shoulder with AI Engineers and Data Scientists to:

- Productionize models and LLM pipelines
- Implement evaluation, monitoring, and observability
- Optimize inference cost, performance, and reliability

+ Ensure experimental AI capabilities are engineered into real systems, not isolated prototypes.

* Architecture & Engineering Standards

+ Define and enforce reference architectures and engineering standards for AI and GenAI systems.
+ Drive consistent adoption of:

- Clean and modular architecture patterns
- Reusable components and shared frameworks
- CI/CD, DevOps, and cloud-native practices

+ Partner with architecture, platform, security, and data teams while retaining final accountability for build quality.

* AI Platform Engineering & MLOps / LLMOps

+ Build and evolve AI platforms that support:

- Model lifecycle management
- LLMOps / MLOps pipelines
- Evaluation, monitoring, and drift detection
- Secure access, auditability, and governance

+ Ensure AI systems meet enterprise non-functional requirements over time, not just at launch.

* Team Leadership & Capability Building

+ Lead and grow a team of senior engineers within the AI & Automation build function.
+ Coach engineers on:

- Backend and distributed systems engineering
- GenAI application design and implementation
- Writing maintainable, testable, production-quality code

+ Set a strong engineering culture focused on ownership, rigor, and continuous improvement.
+ Support hiring and skills development aligned to future AI engineering needs.

* Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Collaboration

+ Partner closely with:

- AI/ML Engineering and Data Science teams
- Platform, security, and operations teams
- Architecture and governance forums

+ Translate business and functional requirements into robust technical designs.
+ Act as a senior technical voice in design authorities and delivery governance.

**Engineering Expectations (Non Negotiable)**

* Has built and operated complex, distributed backend systems in production.
* Comfortable debugging production incidents involving AI/LLM pipelines.
* Writes, reviews, and maintains production-quality code, not just prototypes.
* Understands failure modes of AI systems and designs for resilience.
* Takes ownership for systems after go-live, including reliability and cost optimization.

**Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities:**
This role is critical to ensuring the enterprise’s AI ambition translates into
**real, reliable, and scalable systems**
—not just innovation theater. You will define how AI is built, shipped, and operated across the organization.
  
  
**Knowledge and Skills Requirements:**
**Core Engineering Skills**

* Strong hands-on experience in Python, Java, C#, or similar backend languages.
* Proven experience building API-driven, cloud-native systems.
* Strong understanding of distributed systems, scalability, and reliability patterns.

**GenAI / AI Engineering (Essential)**

* Hands-on experience building LLM-powered applications, including:

+ RAG pipelines
+ Agentic or tool-augmented workflows
+ Prompt orchestration and integration layers

* Experience with:

+ Vector databases and embeddings
+ LLM evaluation, observability, and monitoring
+ Guardrails, safety, and cost controls

* Experience operationalizing AI models at scale in enterprise environments.

**Nice to Have (Not Core Identity)**

* Experience integrating AI services into enterprise automation platforms (e.g., Power Platform, ServiceNow).
* Familiarity with Azure AI services and data platforms.

**Detailed Responsibilities:**

* Solution Development: Design, develop, and implement automation solutions using Microsoft Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps) and ServiceNow. Create custom workflows, forms, and applications to automate business processes and enhance user experience.
* Integration Management: Integrate Microsoft and ServiceNow platforms with other enterprise applications using APIs, web services, and middleware. Ensure seamless data flow between systems and maintain data integrity across integrated applications.
* Testing and Quality Assurance: Conduct thorough testing of automation solutions to ensure functionality, performance, and compliance with business requirements. Implement best practices for code quality, documentation, and version control.
* Observability and Maintenance: Monitor the performance of automation solutions and troubleshoot issues as they arise. Perform regular maintenance and updates to ensure optimal functionality and security of automation applications.
* Documentation: Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for automation solutions, including design specifications, user guides, and technical manuals. Document processes, workflows, and integration points for future reference and knowledge transfer.
* User Training and Support: Provide training and support to end-users and team members on automation tools and processes.Develop training materials and conduct workshops to facilitate user adoption of automation solutions.
* Collaboration and Stakeholder Engagement: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including business analysts, project managers, and IT staff, to ensure alignment on automation initiatives. Engage with stakeholders to gather feedback and make necessary adjustments to automation solutions.
* Performance Metrics and Reporting: Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure the effectiveness of automation solutions. Generate reports and dashboards to communicate the impact of automation on business processes and operational efficiency.
* Continuous Improvement: Stay updated on the latest trends and advancements in automation, AI, and relevant technologies.Identify areas for continuous improvement and propose enhancements to existing automation solutions.
* Governance and Compliance: Ensure that automation solutions adhere to organizational policies, governance frameworks, and compliance requirements. Participate in risk assessments and audits related to automation initiatives.
* Innovation and Research: Explore and evaluate new technologies, tools, and methodologies to enhance automation capabilities. Conduct research on industry best practices and competitor strategies to inform decision-making and innovation.
* Change Management: Analyze the impact of automation on organizational processes and culture, making recommendations for change management strategies. Assist in developing communication plans to inform stakeholders about automation initiatives and their benefits.

**Other Requirements:**

* Familiarity with Python practices and tools.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management and influence
* Strong leadership and conflict resolution capability
* Leading virtual teams

**Job Requirements:**
**Education:**

* A degree in Computer Science / Engineering or a related discipline; or equivalent work experience

**Experience:**

* 10+ years in a Global IT environment working with multiple disciplines to deliver projects in line with customer needs
* 3+ Years Global delivery or transformation preferably in large scale infrastructure programs
* 3+ Years in a global operations environment

**Certification Requirements:**

* Relevant certifications in MS Power Platform and ServiceNow RPA
* Python Certification
* Azure AI Services
* Azure Data Services

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
  
  
EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

title: Digital Marketing & Client Relationship Manager
description:

The team collaborates with clients to craft impactful campaigns that combine creativity with data-driven insight. Joining Lume means working in an environment that values innovation, thoughtful storytelling, and measurable results.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a highly skilled and hands-on
**Digital Marketing & Client Relationship Manager**

with comprehensive knowledge of digital marketing strategies, campaign execution, promotions, and client engagement. The ideal candidate should be an all-rounder who can independently manage multiple marketing channels, leverage AI tools to improve efficiency and performance, and communicate effectively with clients through meetings, emails, and ongoing discussions.

The candidate must be comfortable working night shifts, demonstrate flexibility in working hours based on business and client requirements, and have a strong execution-oriented approach.

* Advanced practical proficiency with AI tools and the ability to integrate them into everyday marketing workflows.
* Hands-on experience with paid advertising, social media, content marketing, and promotional campaigns.
* Ability to interpret marketing data, track KPIs, and make data-driven decisions.
* Ability to independently manage multiple projects, deadlines, and client requirements.
* Flexibility to work night shifts and adjust working hours when required by business or client needs.

We are looking for a proactive marketing professional who combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution. The ideal candidate should be capable of independently managing client relationships and coordinating with internal teams, leveraging AI tools to enhance marketing efficiency and outcomes, and thriving in a fast-paced, multi-client environment.

**Immediate joiners will be preferred.**

title: Marketing Manager - Events and Conferences
description:

Own the strategy, planning, execution, and ROI of RAAPID’s U.S. healthcare conferences. Collaborate with Marketing, Sales teams, and vendors to leverage trade shows, sponsored events, and executive dinners as channels for building brand visibility and generating qualified pipeline.

**Responsibilities**

* **Own the event calendar and budget.**
  Prioritize Tier 1–3 conferences across Risk Adjustment and Medical Coding & CDI based on audience fit and business goals. Plan months ahead, negotiate with organizers, venues, vendors, and our event agency, and reconcile spend with Finance.
* **Drive the event plan and operations.**
  Build briefs that define the audience, messaging, offers, meeting targets, and KPIs. Track milestones and owners across Creative, Content, Product Marketing, Demand Generation, Sales etc.
* **Track integrated campaigns.**
  Track the progress and outcomes email, social, web, and outbound campaigns for the conference meetings and leads across marketing and sales teams.
* **Manage the event experience.**
  Prepare Sales, Marketing, subject matter experts, and leadership for their roles. Own the run of show, meeting programs, brand and booth experience, and vendor logistics including booth setups, giveaways, print collaterals and related logistics within budget.
* **Develop sponsored and hosted programs.**
  Plan partner activations, executive dinners, and smaller networking events around priority conferences. Agree on goals and promotion with partners/sales, guest selection, invitations, and follow-up plans.
* **Turn event engagement into Sales follow-up.**
  Track post conference follow-ups and event outcomes against objectives. Capture what worked and turn it into playbooks the team can reuse.
* **Report ROI and guide investment.**
  Track registrations, qualified meetings, lead quality, and sourced and influenced pipeline against targets and spend. Report results to Marketing and Sales leadership.

**What you bring**

* 5+ years managing B2B marketing programs, with hands-on experience in field marketing and end-to-end ownership of major conferences or trade shows.
* Familiarity with U.S. healthcare conferences serving health plans, value-based care organizations, or revenue cycle teams.
* Experience running integrated campaigns for multiple buyer groups and delivering sponsored events, partner programs, or executive dinners.

title: Senior Power BI Engineer
description:
We are building a centralised marketing and sales analytics platform for a large multi-market consumer brand: a governed BigQuery data layer feeding a single, certified Power BI reporting product used by head-office marketing and sales teams and by every national market. It replaces a fragmented estate of hand-built, per-market dashboards and manual spreadsheet exports with one version of the truth.
  
  
You will own the Power BI half of that platform end to end — the semantic model, the KPI logic, every report page, and the executive PDF report generated from it. This is not a dashboard-assembly role. One model and one report template must serve every market through filtering, hold up under executive scrutiny, and reconcile to source platforms on demand.
  
  
**Experience:**
3 - 6 Years
  
  
**Location:**
Kolkata (Onsite)
  
  
**‍Key Responsibilities**
‍
  
  
**Strategic Marketing & Brand Building**

* Design, build and own the certified Power BI semantic model over a governed star schema in the cloud warehouse — relationships, cardinality, role-playing dates, hierarchies and field-level documentation.
* Choose and justify the connectivity approach (Import, DirectQuery or composite), and implement incremental refresh, aggregations and partitioning to keep refresh windows and query response inside agreed service levels.
* Author the KPI layer in DAX: a frozen, documented catalogue of measures covering traffic, engagement, conversion and funnel performance, with consistent year-on-year, year-to-date, quarter-on-quarter and custom period-comparison logic.
* Implement weighted and normalised benchmark measures so small and large markets can be compared fairly against a group average.
* Keep the model performant and maintainable — calculation groups, variables, disciplined measure structure, and regular tuning with Performance Analyzer, DAX Studio and Tabular Editor.

‍
  
  
**Report And Experience Design**

* Build the report pages the business actually asked for: a real-time KPI tracker with progress-to-target visuals, market-versus-group benchmarking, product-level performance, an end-to-end lead-to-order funnel with banded performance thresholds, channel and traffic-source analysis, and social performance.
* Design for flexible self-service: independent metric selection per visual, multi-market comparison, switchable chart types, and free choice of reporting and comparison periods — without users needing to export anything.
* Apply a consistent, accessible visual language across every page: clear labelling, sensible visual hierarchy, and charts rather than dense tables.
* Configure workspaces, apps, audiences and deployment pipelines across development, test and production, and implement row-level security where required.

‍
  
  
**Executive reporting layer**

* Build and automate the recurring executive PDF report generated directly from the platform, using paginated reports and export automation, so a market or period can be selected and a complete, correctly formatted pack produced in one action.
* Ensure exported visuals remain visuals — presentation-ready output, not screenshots of tables.

‍
  
  
**Quality, reconciliation and trust**

* Build data quality and anomaly surfacing into the reporting layer: freshness indicators, missing-period detection, and outlier alerting on unexpected drops or spikes.
* Reconcile platform figures against the underlying source platforms, document the variances that are structurally expected, and explain them clearly to non-technical stakeholders before they are discovered in a meeting.
* Write and maintain the model and report documentation, KPI definitions and handover material.

‍
  
  
**Delivery**

* Work to a gated, fixed-scope delivery plan with hard go-live dates, translating business requirements into agreed KPI definitions and report specifications.
* Run user acceptance testing on a reference market, manage a controlled review-and-revision cycle per report page, and support training and handover.

‍
  
  
**‍Required Skills & Qualifications**

* 4+ years in business intelligence or analytics engineering, with at least 3 years hands-on in Power BI on production, business-critical reporting.
* Advanced DAX — time intelligence, calculation groups, context transition, performance-conscious measure design. You can explain why a measure is slow, not just that it is.
* Proven semantic model design over a dimensional warehouse: star schema, incremental refresh, composite models, aggregations, gateways and capacity considerations.
* Strong SQL, and practical experience querying a cloud data warehouse (BigQuery preferred; Snowflake, Redshift or Synapse considered) with an understanding of partitioning, clustering and query cost.
* Direct experience modelling digital analytics data — particularly GA4 event-level exports in a warehouse, including nested and repeated structures, sessionisation and conversion definitions. This is the single most important differentiator for this role.
* Paginated reports (Power BI Report Builder / RDL) and export automation for pixel-accurate PDF output.
* Report and dashboard design judgement — you can take a vague executive requirement and produce something that answers it in seconds, and you can defend your layout decisions.
* Power Query / M for shaping and troubleshooting, and comfort with source-control and deployment discipline.
* Confident written and spoken English, and the composure to present work directly to senior stakeholders and take feedback in the room.

‍
  
  
**Desirable**

* Marketing, media or e-commerce measurement background — an understanding of what marketers and sales leadership actually need to see.
* Working knowledge of consent management and its effect on reported figures, and how modelled data behaves differently across interfaces and warehouse exports.
* Microsoft Fabric, Power BI Premium / Fabric capacity administration.
* Multi-market or multi-tenant reporting at scale, including row-level security design.
* dbt or an equivalent transformation framework; Python for supporting automation.
* Custom or advanced visuals (for example Deneb / Vega-Lite) where the standard library falls short.
* Relevant Microsoft certification (PL-300 or equivalent) — useful, but the portfolio matters more.

‍
  
  
**Interview Process**

* Application review
* 5–10 minute initial screening call with the TA team
* Technical interviews {Domain specific}
* ‍Practical test conducted in the presence of a panel member
* ‍Role match & offer

title: Content Manager - Video + UGC
description:
**Firstly, this is only WFO role with guaranteed best in class compensation.**
If you're not ok with working from kolkata, kindly DO NOT APPLY.

**If you know why a reel gets 10 million views while another barely gets 1,000, we need to talk.**

At MarketingLab, we're looking for a seriously good content professional to lead our UGC and Short-Form Content vertical.

We're not looking for someone who just knows how to make reels, manage creators or put together a content calendar.
**We're looking for someone who understands the science and art of content that works.**

Someone who can look at a piece of content and tell us exactly why it will work, why it won't, what needs to change and how to make it better.

Someone who can turn content into a growth engine.

WHAT YOU'LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

**1. Build a Content Powerhouse**

* Lead and scale our UGC and short-form content vertical.
* Develop high-performing content strategies for multiple D2C brands across categories.
* Work with a team of content strategists, scriptwriters, creators, editors and production resources.
* Establish systems that allow us to produce high-quality content at scale without compromising speed.

**2. Understand What Makes Content Work**

* Have a deep understanding of Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and other short-form platforms.
* Know exactly what makes a reel work: hooks, storytelling, retention, watch time, pacing, transitions, editing and CTAs.
* Understand why certain content formats go viral and why others fail.
* Constantly study winning content, identify patterns and translate those insights into repeatable content strategies.
* Stay ahead of emerging content formats, trends and platform behaviour.

**3. Be Obsessed With Data & Growth**

* Understand social media analytics beyond vanity metrics such as likes and views.
* Track watch time, audience retention, completion rates, shares, saves, engagement and follower growth.
* Analyse content performance and identify opportunities to improve.
* Build a clear feedback loop between content performance and content production.
* Know how to move the needle on an account's organic growth.
* Make decisions based on data, not gut feeling alone.

**4. Be Exceptionally Good at Execution**

* Have an insane bias for action and speed.
* Move from idea to script to shoot to edit to publishing without unnecessary delays.
* Ensure a consistent pipeline of fresh, relevant and high-quality content.
* Be hands-on with ideation, scripting, creative direction, production and editing feedback.
* Maintain high execution standards while handling multiple brands and projects simultaneously.

**5. Build a Culture of Experimentation**

* Constantly test new hooks, formats, storytelling styles and creative approaches.
* Never get comfortable with one winning format.
* Encourage rapid experimentation and learn from failures.
* Build repeatable frameworks that help us consistently produce winning content.

AI-FIRST MINDSET IS NON-NEGOTIABLE

We expect you to be extremely well-versed with AI tools and actively use them to improve the speed, quality and scale of content production.

* Be proficient with AI-powered tools for ideation, scripting, research, video production, editing and content optimisation.
* Know how to leverage AI to accelerate workflows, automate repetitive tasks and improve creative output.
* Constantly experiment with emerging AI tools and identify ways to integrate them into our content engine.
* Understand how AI can help us produce more, experiment faster and achieve better results without compromising quality.

**If you're not actively using AI in your everyday content workflow, please don't apply. We are looking for someone who is AI-first, not someone who is still figuring out why AI matters.**WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

* At least
  **3 years of hands-on experience**
  in content creation, short-form video, social media or digital content.
* Someone who has demonstrably grown social media accounts.
* Someone who understands Instagram's content ecosystem inside out.
* Strong understanding of content analytics, audience behaviour and performance metrics.
* Excellent understanding of storytelling, scripting, hooks and creative direction.
* Experience managing creators, production teams and content workflows.
* Someone who can think strategically but is equally comfortable getting their hands dirty.
* Extremely high ownership, urgency and execution speed.
* Someone who is curious, competitive and constantly studying what works.

**Location:**
Kolkata. Candidates already based in Kolkata will be preferred. Candidates from other cities must be open to relocating to Kolkata.

WHAT WE OFFER

* **Compensation that will be among the best in the industry.**
  We are willing to pay exceptionally well for exceptional talent.
* An opportunity to build and lead a high-impact content vertical.
* Work with an exciting portfolio of D2C brands across multiple categories.
* The freedom to experiment, build teams and create processes.
* A fast-moving environment where good ideas are encouraged and great execution is rewarded.
* The opportunity to build something substantial rather than just manage another content department.

If your idea of content management is creating calendars, scheduling posts and chasing approvals, this probably isn't the role for you.

If you need constant follow-ups to get things done, this isn't the role for you either.

But if you live and breathe short-form content, understand the psychology behind what makes people stop scrolling, know how to turn insights into execution and have a proven ability to grow accounts, we would love to meet you.

**We're looking for someone who doesn't just create content. We want someone who knows how to make content perform.**

title: IT Solutions Analyst (Universal Robots, Bangalore - India)
description:
The
**IT Solutions Analyst - ServiceNow**
is the functional and technical bridge between business stakeholders and the ServiceNow platform, responsible for designing, configuring, enhancing, and supporting solutions across Customer Service Management (CSM), Manufacturing Commercial Operations (MCO), and Sales and Order Management (SOM).
  
  
This role translates customer service, asset management, contracts management, and entitlement-related requirements into scalable ServiceNow workflows, custom applications, and integrations. The analyst partners with Sales, Field Service, Customer Care, Manufacturing, and other IT teams to improve customer experience, order accuracy, and service efficiency, and acts as a subject-matter expert and escalation point for production support. As part of the IT Enterprise Applications team, the analyst also designs and supports integrations between ServiceNow and other systems, including Salesforce, on-premise applications, and databases.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities****
**Requirements analysis and solution design**

* Gather, document, and refine business requirements through workshops, interviews, and process mapping with Sales, Customer Service, Manufacturing, and Finance stakeholders.
* Translate requirements into functional specifications, user stories with acceptance criteria, and solution designs aligned to ServiceNow best practices.
* Assess the impact of platform upgrades, new releases, and process changes, and recommend out-of-the-box (OOTB) approaches over customization where practical.

**Platform configuration and development**

* Configure and enhance CSM (case management, customer and account data, entitlements, SLAs, Customer Service Portal, Virtual Agent, knowledge management).
* Configure and enhance MCO and SOM (product and quote catalogs, order capture, decomposition and fulfillment orchestration, order tracking, and commercial and manufacturing operations workflows).
* Design and build custom scoped applications using Flow Designer, Workflow Studio, Business Rules, Script Includes, UI Policies, Client Scripts, UI Builder / Workspaces, and Service Portal.
* Build and maintain integrations between ServiceNow and Salesforce, on-premise applications, databases, ERP, PLM, MES, telephony, and other enterprise systems using REST/SOAP APIs, Integration Hub, MID Server, JDBC, and data import sets.
* Implement and tune ServiceNow AI features (Now Assist skills, AI Agents, Virtual Agent, AI Search, Build Agent) across CSM, MCO, and SOM processes, and measure their impact on case deflection, resolution time, and agent productivity.

**Testing, deployment, and release management**

* Develop test plans and test cases, execute functional and regression testing, and coordinate user acceptance testing (UAT).
* Manage update sets / application repository deployments across instances and follow established change, release, and source-control practices.
* Produce release notes, training materials, and knowledge articles, and support end-user and super-user training.

**Production support and continuous improvement**

* Provide Tier 2/3 support for CSM, MCO, and SOM, including incident triage, root-cause analysis, and permanent fixes within SLA targets.
* Monitor platform health, data quality, and performance, and proactively identify and close process or configuration gaps.
* Support platform upgrades, family release adoption, and technical debt reduction.
* Maintain solution documentation, data models, and process flows; contribute to the product backlog and sprint planning.

**Governance and collaboration**

* Work with architects, developers, and platform owners to uphold standards for security, ACLs, data governance, and compliance.
* Report on solution adoption and process KPIs (case resolution time, order cycle time, SLA attainment) using Performance Analytics and dashboards.
* Mentor junior analysts and share knowledge across the ServiceNow community of practice.

****All About You****
We seek individuals who share our passion and determination. Our commitment to customer success drives us to go the extra mile. If you’re ready to join us in this mission, take a closer look at the minimum criteria for the position.
  
  
****Education And Experience****

* Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5+ years of hands-on ServiceNow experience as a platform analyst, administrator, or developer, focused specifically on ServiceNow solutions.
* Demonstrated implementation and support experience in at least two of the three target modules: CSM, MCO, and SOM.
* Proven experience developing custom scoped applications on the ServiceNow platform, from requirements through deployment and support.
* Experience supporting production ServiceNow environments, including incident management, root-cause analysis, upgrades, and release cycles.

**ServiceNow certifications**
**Certification**
**Requirement**
ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA)
  
  
**Required**
ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist – Customer Service Management (CSM)
  
  
Optional (preferred)
  
  
ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist – Sales and Order Management (SOM)
  
  
Optional (preferred)
  
  
ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD)
  
  
**Required**
Candidates holding certifications in Manufacturing Commercial Operations (MCO) or comparable manufacturing-industry ServiceNow credentials will be given strong preference.
  
  
****Technical Skills****

* Strong working knowledge of ServiceNow data model, tables, ACLs, roles, and CMDB / Customer Service data structures.
* Proficiency with JavaScript (server-side and client-side), Glide APIs, Flow Designer, Workflow Studio, and scoped application development.
* Experience with integrations to Salesforce, on-premise applications, and databases (SQL, JDBC) using REST/SOAP, Integration Hub spokes, MID Server, and import sets / transform maps.
* Hands-on experience with ServiceNow AI capabilities, including Now Assist skills for CSM and SOM (case and order summarization, resolution notes, knowledge generation), Now Assist Virtual Agent, AI Search, and customizing skills with Now Assist Skill Kit (NASK).
* Working knowledge of agentic AI on the platform, including features available through the Australia release: building, configuring, and governing AI Agents and agentic workflows, selecting model providers (Now LLM Service or third-party models), and managing Now Assist administration, licensing tiers, and guardrails.
* Experience with Customer Service Portal, Service Portal, UI Builder, and Workspaces (Customer Service Workspace).
* Understanding of order-to-cash, quote-to-order, entitlement, and warranty / contract processes.
* Familiarity with Agile (Scrum / SAFe) delivery, user story writing, and tools such as ServiceNow Agile Development, Jira, or Azure DevOps.
* Ability to write functional specifications, test cases, and process documentation, and to present solutions to technical and non-technical audiences.

****Preferred Qualifications****

* Hands-on MCO experience, including manufacturing commercial processes such as contracts, pricing, and order-to-delivery visibility.
* Experience with Configure, Price, Quote (CPQ) solutions, such as ServiceNow Sales and Order Management quoting, Salesforce CPQ, or Oracle CPQ, including product catalogs, pricing rules, quote-to-order flows, and integration with order management and ERP systems (a strong advantage).
* Additional ServiceNow certifications: Certified Technical Architect (in progress), Integration Hub, Performance Analytics, Now Assist / Generative AI / Agentic AI, or Predictive Intelligence.
* Experience building custom AI skills and AI Agents or using Build Agent to create agentic workflows for custom applications, and keeping pace with new AI capabilities in each ServiceNow family release.
* Experience integrating ServiceNow with ERP (Oracle Fusion), CRM (Salesforce), PLM, or MES systems.
* Experience with CI/CD and source control for ServiceNow (for example, Git integration, ATF automated testing).
* Exposure to data analytics and reporting tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
* Prior experience coordinating large/small projects or mentoring junior team members.

****Core Skills And Working Conditions****
**Core skills**

* Analytical and problem-solving ability, with a bias toward root-cause resolution over workarounds.
* Clear written and verbal communication, including facilitating workshops and explaining technical concepts to business users.
* Stakeholder management and the ability to balance multiple priorities across commercial, service, and manufacturing teams.
* Customer-centric mindset, with a focus on measurable outcomes and user adoption.
* Ownership, attention to detail, and comfort being self-directed in a fast-paced, Agile environment.
* Collaboration with onshore and offshore development partners.

**Working conditions**

* Primarily remote-based, with occasional travel.
* Participation in an on-call rotation for critical production issues and occasional after-hours release or upgrade support.

We are only considering candidates local to position location and are unable to provide relocation for this position. This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship.
