title: AVP, AI Security Architect
description:
**Role Title: 2603010 AVP, AI Security Architect (L11)**
**Company Overview**
Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as #3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the #1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
  
  
**Organizational Overview**
The Security Architecture organization enables Synchrony to innovate and grow securely by embedding security-by-design into technology solutions. We partner with engineering, platform, data, cloud, and business teams to translate security strategy and evolving threats into practical architecture requirements, reusable patterns, blueprints, and guardrails. Through risk-based architecture reviews, threat modeling, and scalable security guidance, the team helps protect Synchrony’s digital assets and customer data while supporting resilient, compliant, and efficient technology delivery. This role will contribute to advancing our AI Security Architecture capabilities, helping establish secure patterns and assurance practices for Generative AI, AI agents, and other emerging AI technologies.
  
  
**Role Summary/Purpose**
**The AVP, AI Security Architect**
will design and advance security architectures for Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, Machine Learning, and emerging AI technologies. The role will translate enterprise security strategy and evolving AI threats into practical requirements, reusable patterns, and engineering guidance that enable secure innovation while protecting company, customer, and sensitive data.
  
  
Working across Cybersecurity, Technology, Data, AI/ML Engineering, Cloud, Risk, and Business teams, the architect will lead solution-level security assessments, contribute to enterprise standards, and embed security-by-design through threat modeling, control validation, testing, and continuous assurance across the AI lifecycle.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Apply and help mature enterprise AI security architecture principles, standards, reference architectures, and guardrails.
* Design reusable security patterns for Generative AI, copilots, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), model and inference APIs, autonomous or agentic AI, and enterprise AI platforms.
* Lead security architecture assessments for complex AI solutions across cloud, SaaS, API, data, application, and enterprise technology environments.
* Partner with AI/ML engineers, application teams, cloud architects, data teams, and product owners to embed security throughout design, development, deployment, integration, monitoring, and retirement.
* Perform AI threat modeling using MITRE ATLAS and OWASP guidance, translating identified threats into actionable controls and engineering requirements.
* Define and validate controls for model access, identities, service accounts, secrets, APIs, prompts, training and retrieval data, outputs, plugins, tools, and third-party AI services.
* Assess risks such as prompt injection, data poisoning, sensitive information disclosure, insecure tool interaction, excessive agency, model manipulation, and AI supply-chain compromise.
* Contribute to automation of architecture reviews, threat modeling, vulnerability assessment, control validation, and security testing.
* Document architecture decisions, material risks, trade-offs, and recommendations for technical teams and senior stakeholders.
* Collaborate with Enterprise Architecture, Cloud, Application Security, Data, Responsible AI, Privacy, Legal, Compliance, Risk, and Business partners.
* Create implementation guidance and enablement that help engineering teams adopt approved AI security patterns consistently.

**Required Skills/Knowledge**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Strong experience in cybersecurity, security architecture, cloud security, application security, or enterprise architecture, including delivery of complex security initiatives.
* Practical knowledge of modern AI architectures, including Large Language Models, RAG, vector databases, embeddings, model gateways, AI agents, orchestration frameworks, managed AI services, and model or inference APIs.
* Strong foundation in identity and access management, application and API security, cloud security, data protection, secrets and key management, DevSecOps, and software supply-chain security.
* Knowledge of AI security and risk frameworks such as the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, MITRE ATLAS, NIST AI Risk Management Framework, and Zero Trust principles.
* Experience designing or reviewing enterprise architectures on AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
* Ability to convert technical risks into architecture requirements, reusable patterns, engineering guidance, and clear recommendations.
* Demonstrated ability to influence technical stakeholders, facilitate architecture decisions, and build alignment across teams.
* Strong written, verbal, presentation, and stakeholder-management skills.

**Desired Skills/Knowledge**

* Experience securing platforms such as Amazon Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Copilot, or comparable enterprise AI services.
* Experience with AI red teaming, adversarial testing, model security assessment, prompt-injection testing, or AI vulnerability management.
* Familiarity with NIST AI RMF, MITRE ATLAS, OWASP guidance, ISO/IEC 42001, and evolving AI governance expectations.
* Ability to move effectively between detailed technical architecture, engineering execution, risk discussions, and stakeholder communication.
* Experience developing reference architectures, security blueprints, automated guardrails, and scalable control-assurance capabilities.
* Financial-services cybersecurity, regulatory, risk-management, or data-protection experience is a plus.
* Collaborative and execution-oriented approach, with a focus on simplification, automation, measurable outcomes, and responsible innovation.

**Eligibility Criteria**
Bachelor's degree with 6+ years of experience in Cyber industry, security architecture experience including on-prem and hybrid environments and practical knowledge of modern AI architectures, including Large Language Models, RAG, vector databases, embeddings, model gateways, AI agents, orchestration frameworks, managed AI services, and model or inference APIs.
  
  
**Work Timings:**
2:00 PM– 11:00 PM IST
  
  
We are proud to offer flexibility at Synchrony. Our way of working allows you the option to work from home or workspaces in our Regional Engagement Hubs—Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Pune, Kolkata, or Delhi/NCR. title: Business Development & Site Acquisition Executive
description:
**Business Development & Site Acquisition Executive

Eldvyn | EV Charging Infrastructure

Location: Howrah / Kolkata, West Bengal

Job Type: Full-Time / Short-Term Contract (2 Months)

Work Mode: Field-Based

Fixed Salary: ₹8,000–₹14,000 per month

Incentives: Performance-based, with total monthly earning potential of up to ₹18,000

About Eldvyn

Eldvyn is an early-stage startup focused on developing and expanding EV charging infrastructure across West Bengal.

We’re building our business from the ground up, starting with strategically located charging stations and partnerships along key commercial and highway corridors.

As a lean, founder-led startup, we offer a hands-on working environment where individuals work directly with the founders, contribute to business decisions and take responsibility for real projects.

We’re looking for someone who is proactive, resourceful and willing to take ownership rather than simply follow instructions.

About the Role

We are hiring a Business Development & Site Acquisition Executive to support our EV charging network expansion.

This is not a conventional desk-based sales position.

The selected candidate will be responsible for managing the complete development lifecycle of assigned EV charging locations — from identifying potential sites and approaching property owners to finalizing partnerships, coordinating installation and ensuring successful operational handover.

The role involves extensive fieldwork, stakeholder coordination, commercial negotiations and direct collaboration with Eldvyn’s founders.

Key Responsibilities

1. Site Identification & Acquisition

\* Identify potential EV charging locations across designated territories.

\* Conduct market research, field surveys and preliminary site evaluations.

\* Approach hotels, restaurants, highway establishments, parking facilities and commercial property owners.

\* Assess commercial potential, location suitability, accessibility and basic infrastructure readiness.

2. Business Development & Partnerships

\* Generate and qualify potential site leads.

\* Establish relationships with property owners and business partners.

\* Present Eldvyn’s partnership proposals and business model.

\* Negotiate preliminary commercial terms and coordinate agreements for founder approval.

\* Develop and maintain a pipeline of prospective charging locations.

3. Site Onboarding & Project Execution

\* Coordinate site documentation, onboarding and necessary approvals.

\* Liaise with property owners, equipment suppliers, installation partners and technical teams.

\* Follow up on site readiness, power availability and installation requirements.

\* Track project timelines, identify challenges and coordinate resolutions.

\* Maintain responsibility for assigned projects through installation and commissioning.

4. Operational Launch & Reporting

\* Coordinate technical testing, charger activation and operational onboarding with the responsible teams.

\* Ensure all required documentation and handover activities are completed.

\* Maintain progress reports, partner records and project trackers.

\* Provide regular updates directly to the founders.

\* Track agreed performance targets and project milestones.

Who We’re Looking For

\* Strong communication, interpersonal and negotiation skills.

\* Comfortable with regular field visits and independent assignments.

\* Ability to take initiative, solve problems and manage multiple stakeholders.

\* Organized, accountable and capable of following projects through to completion.

\* Basic knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets and digital reporting tools.

\* Familiarity with Howrah, Kolkata and surrounding West Bengal highway corridors is desirable.

Preferred Experience

Previous experience in field sales, business development, real estate, telecom, infrastructure projects, site acquisition or B2B partnerships would be advantageous.

Knowledge of EV charging infrastructure is a plus, but not mandatory.

Motivated freshers with strong communication skills, initiative and a willingness to learn are encouraged to apply.

Why Join Eldvyn?

Direct Access to Founders

Work closely with the people building the company, with fewer management layers and greater involvement in business operations.

Real Project Ownership

Be involved in the entire process of developing an EV charging location, from initial discussions to operational launch.

Hands-On Industry Experience

Gain practical exposure to business development, commercial negotiations, infrastructure deployment, vendor management and project execution.

Learn Across Functions

Understand how an early-stage infrastructure business operates, rather than being restricted to a narrow sales function.

Grow With the Business

As Eldvyn expands, there may be opportunities to take on broader responsibilities based on performance and business requirements.

Short-Term Opportunity

We are also offering a two-month fixed-term assignment for candidates interested in gaining practical startup and business development experience.

The assignment will focus on site identification, partner acquisition, onboarding and project coordination, with clearly defined milestones and performance targets.

Compensation

\* Fixed monthly salary: ₹8,000–₹14,000, depending on experience and suitability.

\* Performance-based incentives, with total monthly earning potential of up to ₹18,000.

\* Targets and incentive milestones will be communicated during the hiring process.

How to Apply

Interested candidates should submit their updated CV along with:

\* Current location

\* Relevant work experience, if any

\* Availability to join

\* Preferred employment type (Full-Time / 2-Month Contract)

Join Eldvyn and help build an EV charging network from the ground up.**

description:
**Job description:**

NSEG India Pvt. Ltd. has been delivering reliable outsourcing and business support solutions since 2013. With a strong presence in Ahmedabad and a growing team, we are expanding into international healthcare operations, offering opportunities to work with Australian healthcare providers in client coordination, healthcare sales and appointment management.

Job Title: Operations Executive

Job Location: Ahmedabad

Job Type: Full-Time

Job Timings: 04:00 AM to 01:00 PM

***About Role***

We are looking for motivated, compassionate and customer-focused Healthcare Sales & Client Intake Coordinator with a healthcare background who is comfortable speaking with people over the phone.

Your main responsibility will be to speak with families who contact the company for healthcare services, understand their requirements and help them book appointments with the right therapists.

This is a combination of healthcare sales, customer handling and appointment booking.

You will not have to do aggressive sales. The focus is on understanding people's needs, explaining the services and helping them choose the right support.

The company will provide training about Australian healthcare services and the NDIS system.

***Job Responsibilities***

* **Handle New Enquiries:**
  Contact new customers within 5 minutes of receiving an enquiry.
* **Understand Customer Needs:**
  Speak with patients, parents and families to understand their requirements and suggest suitable healthcare services.
* **Explain Services & Book Appointments:**
  Explain the company's services and NDIS funding, answer queries and book appointments with the right therapists.
* **Follow Up with Leads:**
  Follow up with interested and pending customers through calls, emails and messages to confirm appointments.
* **CRM Management:**
  Update customer details, call records, follow-ups and lead status in the CRM.
* **Appointment Coordination:**
  Coordinate with customers and therapists to schedule and confirm appointments.
* **Process Improvement:**
  Manage follow-up reminders and suggest ways to improve the calling and booking process.
* **Marketing Support:**
  Support the marketing team, track enquiries and bookings, and work towards monthly targets.

***Candidate Requirements***

* Educational background in healthcare, allied health, occupational therapy, psychology, speech therapy, nursing or a related field.
* Good spoken and written English communication skills.
* Confident in speaking over the phone with good listening and interpersonal skills.
* Patient, polite and comfortable interacting with patients and their families.
* Good organisational and time-management skills.
* Ability to handle multiple enquiries and regular follow-ups.
* Basic computer knowledge and willingness to learn CRM software.
* Experience in sales, telecalling, customer handling or appointment booking will be an added advantage.
* Knowledge of CRM tools like GoHighLevel, HubSpot or Zoho will be preferred.
* Basic marketing knowledge and experience working with Australian, UK or US clients will be an added advantage.

***Salary and Benefits***

* Fixed monthly salary plus performance-based incentives.
* Training on Australian healthcare services, NDIS and CRM software.
* Proper guidance and support to help you learn the role.
* Opportunity to work with an Australian company and international clients.
* Professional office environment.
* Career growth in sales, marketing and team management.
* Opportunity to work in the healthcare sector and help people.
* Accident Insurance
* Alternate Saturdays Off & Alternate Saturdays half day working

Join NSEG Private Limited and be a part of our dynamic team, contributing to the growth and success of our company.

For any query email us at
**hr@nsegindia.com**

title: Mechanical Engineer
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION

Mechanical Design & Project Engineer

Company: Taylormade Renewables Ltd. (TRL)

Number of Vacancies: 2

Experience: 3–5 Years

Qualification: B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering

Location: Kerala GIDC, Gujarat

Joining: Immediate / Short Notice

About the Role

Taylormade Renewables Ltd. is looking for two technically strong and execution-oriented Mechanical Engineers to join its engineering and project execution team.

The candidates will work on specialised industrial process plants, including Zero Liquid Discharge (ZLD), industrial wastewater treatment, evaporation, MEE, MVR, solvent recovery and heat recovery systems.

The role involves complete project ownership, from conceptual mechanical design and detailed engineering to fabrication, site execution, commissioning and final handover.

Key Roles & Responsibilities

1. Mechanical Design & Engineering

\* Mechanical design of industrial process equipment, including heat exchangers, pressure vessels, evaporators, condensers, tanks, reactors and other process equipment.

\* Design and development of shell & tube heat exchangers, plate heat exchangers and thermal heat recovery systems.

\* Mechanical design of MEE, MVR and industrial evaporation systems.

\* Design of process piping, utility piping, equipment interconnections and piping layouts.

\* Preparation of GA drawings, fabrication drawings, assembly drawings, piping isometrics and detailed manufacturing drawings.

\* Preparation of equipment datasheets, BOMs, material specifications and technical documentation.

\* Material selection, metallurgy, welding and fabrication considerations.

\* Mechanical design calculations involving pressure, temperature, thickness, loads and heat transfer.

2. Software & Technical Competencies

\* Strong proficiency in SolidWorks, including 3D modelling, assemblies and detailed 2D drawings.

\* Ability to prepare fabrication-ready and manufacturing-ready engineering drawings.

\* Working knowledge of AutoCAD and engineering documentation.

\* Ability to interpret P&IDs, process flow diagrams, equipment layouts and technical specifications.

\* Understanding of pressure vessel and piping design standards, welding procedures, hydrotesting and inspection requirements.

3. Fabrication, Installation & Site Execution

\* Coordination and supervision of mechanical fabrication and manufacturing activities.

\* Vendor development, technical coordination and procurement support.

\* Site supervision of equipment erection, piping fabrication, alignment and installation.

\* Coordination of contractors, technicians and site personnel.

\* Inspection of fabricated equipment, dimensional checks, welding quality and hydrotesting.

\* Troubleshooting mechanical and process-related issues during installation and commissioning.

\* Ensuring execution as per approved drawings, specifications, quality requirements and project timelines.

4. End-to-End Project Management

\* Take ownership of projects from engineering and design through fabrication, installation and commissioning.

\* Develop project execution plans, material requirements, BOQs and project schedules.

\* Coordinate with engineering, procurement, fabrication and project teams.

\* Manage vendors, contractors and customer-site coordination.

\* Monitor project progress, cost, quality and timelines.

\* Resolve execution challenges and ensure successful commissioning and handover.

Preferred Technical & Industry Experience

Experience in the following areas will be considered a significant advantage:

\* Industrial wastewater treatment and Zero Liquid Discharge (ZLD) plants.

\* Multiple Effect Evaporators (MEE).

\* Mechanical Vapour Recompression (MVR) systems.

\* Industrial evaporation and condensation technologies.

\* Solvent recovery and distillation systems.

\* Thermal fluid, steam, vacuum and heat recovery systems.

\* Industrial process equipment manufacturing and EPC projects.

Candidate Requirements

\* B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering.

\* 3–5 years of relevant industrial experience.

\* Strong fundamentals in mechanical design and equipment engineering.

\* Hands-on experience with SolidWorks and technical drawing preparation.

\* Practical knowledge of fabrication, manufacturing and site execution.

\* Ability to independently handle engineering assignments and project responsibilities.

\* Strong problem-solving, coordination and project management skills.

\* Willingness to travel to customer sites and project locations as required.

\* Immediate joiners or candidates serving a short notice period preferred.

What We Expect

We are looking for practical, technically sound engineers who can translate engineering concepts into actual industrial equipment and operating plants.

The candidate should be capable of understanding process requirements, developing mechanical designs, preparing detailed drawings, coordinating fabrication, supervising installation and taking complete responsibility for successful project execution and commissioning.

This is an end-to-end engineering and project execution role, not a CAD drafting-only position.

Application Details

Taylormade Renewables Ltd.

\* Email: info@trlindia.com

\* Contact: +91 98986 33390

\* Subject: Application – Mechanical Design & Project Engineer

Interested candidates are requested to share their updated CV at the above email address or contact number.**

title: Analyst I, GBS Global
description:
**Job Description**
Analyst I, GBS ATR - Procurement Accounting
  
  
**Function**
GBS ATR (Account to Report)
  
  
**Band**
B16
  
  
**Location**
Ahmedabad, India
  
  
**Company**
Kraft Heinz
  
  
**Job family**
Procurement Accounting
  
  
**Work model**
Global Business Services
  
  
Overall purpose of position
  
  
Execute procurement accounting activities within GBS ATR, supporting accurate financial reporting, timely close, balance sheet integrity, and disciplined financial control. The role focuses on journals, reconciliations, accruals, provisions, rebates, intercompany recharges, forecast support, and recurring analysis, working closely with Procurement, FP&A, Accounting, GBS, and business-unit teams.
  
  
Key responsibilities
  
  

* Execute assigned month-end, quarter-end, and year-end procurement accounting activities in line with the global close calendar.
* Prepare and post journal entries, including accruals, provisions, reclasses, intercompany recharges, and other procurement-related adjustments, with complete supporting documentation.
* Perform daily, weekly, and monthly reconciliations and checks to validate the accuracy and completeness of procurement-related financial results.
* Prepare balance sheet reconciliations and substantiation schedules; investigate reconciling items and support timely clearing of aged balances.
* Maintain procurement rebate positions through accurate tracking, reconciliation, documentation, and reporting across the monthly cycle.
* Support rebate forecasting with FP&A and Procurement by maintaining assumptions, identifying risks, and processing approved adjustments.
* Support accounting and tracking of procurement-related accruals, provisions, hedge positions, and intercompany items where applicable.
* Prepare variance analysis, balance sheet flux commentary, risk summaries, and open-item reporting for assigned areas.
* Respond to routine accounting queries and coordinate with Procurement, FP&A, Controllers, GBS, AP/P2P, and business-unit teams to resolve issues.
* Maintain audit-ready documentation and support statutory, internal, external, and SOX audit requests.
* Follow company accounting policies, US GAAP or applicable local requirements, internal controls, and process documentation.
* Identify recurring issues and propose improvements to templates, reconciliations, reports, controls, and system-enabled routines.
* Support standardization, automation, and transformation initiatives within GBS ATR Procurement Accounting.
* Complete ad hoc analysis and assignments without compromising close quality or delivery timelines.

Expected outcomes
  
  

* Assigned close activities are completed accurately, completely, and on time.
* Journal entries and reconciliations have a clear audit trail and required support.
* Aged reconciling items are investigated, escalated, and progressed to resolution.
* Rebate, accrual, provision, and intercompany positions are accurately tracked and reported.
* Variance commentary clearly explains financial movements, risks, and required follow-up.
* Control and audit requirements are met with high-quality documentation.

**Skills, Qualifications And Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce, or a related field.
* Professional accounting qualification part-qualified, pursuing, or preferred, such as CA, CPA, ACCA, CIMA, or equivalent.
* Approximately 2-4 years of experience in ATR/RTR, general ledger accounting, financial controlling, or procurement accounting; shared services or GBS experience is preferred.
* Working knowledge of month-end close, journals, balance sheet reconciliations, accruals, provisions, variance analysis, and financial reporting.
* Strong attention to detail, analytical thinking, and ability to investigate and resolve reconciling items.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work to strict deadlines across time zones.
* Strong Microsoft Excel skills and ERP experience; SAP is preferred.
* Experience with BlackLine, Trintech, procurement systems, or reporting tools is an advantage.
* Exposure to SOX controls, audit support, multinational environments, and end-to-end ATR/RTR processes is preferred.
* Fluent in English.

Key stakeholder interactions
  
  

* Procurement teams: transaction support, rebate inputs, issue follow-up, and routine accounting queries.
* FP&A and Finance Controllers: forecast assumptions, variances, provisions, and reporting support.
* GBS ATR, AP/P2P, and related accounting teams: close execution, reconciliations, handoffs, and open-item resolution.
* Business-unit finance and Operations: supporting data, explanations, and resolution of assigned issues.
* Internal Controls, SOX, Internal Audit, and external auditors: supporting evidence and query resolution.
* Manager, GBS ATR - Procurement Accounting: prioritization, review, escalation, and coaching.

Leadership and supervisory scope
  
  
Individual contributor with no direct reports. The role is expected to take ownership of assigned deliverables, raise issues promptly, share process knowledge, and support onboarding or peer coaching when requested.
  
  
Decision making and problem solving
  
  
Works within established accounting policies, controls, close calendars, and operating procedures. Investigates routine variances and reconciling items, recommends corrective actions, and escalates complex, material, or judgment-based matters to the Manager.
  
  
Location(s)
  
  
Ahmedabad - Venus Stratum GCC
  
  
**Kraft Heinz is an Equal Opportunity Employer – Underrepresented Ethnic Minority Groups/Women/Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities/Sexual Orientation/Gender Identity and other protected classes**
**.**

·        A proven record of meeting or beating individual sales, calling or conversion targets

·        Comfort with B2C selling: talking to individual customers, understanding their needs, handling objections and closing the sale

·        Clear, confident spoken English suitable for calls with US customers

·        Resilience, a persuasive and friendly phone manner, and strong follow-through

·        Willingness to work US shift hours, including weekends on rotation

**Experience level:**
Entry level to 3 years. Strong freshers with calling or sales internship experience and excellent communication skills are welcome.

·        Experience selling to US, UK or international customers by phone

·        Experience in hospitality, travel, wellness or luxury or high-ticket sales

·        Familiarity with a CRM, or a reservations system such as Opera or SynXis

title: Lighting Designer
description:
**Company Description**
Stellar Designs is a design-focused & award winning lighting designing and consultancy practice that specialise in creating functional, aesthetically refined spaces for residential, commercial, and hospitality projects. The team combines creative vision with technical expertise to deliver customized solutions that highlight form, function, and user experience. Collaborating closely with architects, interior designers, and clients, Stellar Designs emphasizes quality, innovation, and attention to detail in every project. The company offers a collaborative work environment where design professionals can contribute ideas, grow their skills, and work on diverse, end-to-end design assignments. Joining Stellar Designs means being part of a team committed to elevating spaces through thoughtful and impactful lighting design.

**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Lighting Designer role based in Ahmedabad. The Lighting Designer will develop lighting concepts and detailed layouts for a variety of projects, from residential spaces to commercial and hospitality environments. Day-to-day responsibilities include analyzing project requirements, preparing lighting plans, selecting fixtures, and creating mood boards and presentations that align with the overall design intent. The role involves coordinating with architects, interior designers, contractors, and vendors to ensure that lighting solutions are technically sound, energy-efficient, and compliant with relevant standards. The Lighting Designer will also support site visits, review installations, adjust designs based on field conditions, and assist in preparing documentation, BOQs, and specifications for client approvals and execution.

**Qualifications**

* Strong capabilities in Lighting Design and Lighting to develop creative, functional, and efficient lighting solutions.
* Experience with Architectural Lighting to integrate lighting schemes seamlessly with building and spatial design.
* Knowledge of Interior Design principles to ensure lighting supports materials, finishes, and overall spatial concepts.
* Familiarity with Lighting Control systems to design user-friendly, energy-efficient, and programmable lighting environments.
* Proficiency with design and drafting software (e.g., AutoCAD, Revit, Dialux, Relux, or similar lighting simulation tools).
* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Lighting Design, Architecture, Interior Design, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Ability to read and interpret architectural drawings and technical specifications.
* Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain design intent to clients and project stakeholders.
* Detail-oriented, organized, and comfortable managing multiple projects and deadlines on-site.
* Prior experience in a lighting consultancy, architectural, or interior design firm is an advantage.

title: Marketplace & Quick Commerce Executive
company: A.V. Thomas & Co. Ltd., Consumer Product Division
description:
**Role Purpose:**

To manage and grow AVT's complete online business across marketplaces and quick-commerce platforms, with responsibility for sales achievement, product availability, assortment, listings, pricing, promotions, digital visibility, inventory, platform coordination and commercial performance. The position should be treated as a business and sales role, not merely an online coordination role.

**Key Job Functions:**

**1. Sales & Target Achievement:**
Own monthly and annual platform-wise sales targets. Monitor daily and weekly sales, identify gaps and implement corrective actions. Analyse performance by platform, city, brand, SKU and pack size.

**2. Marketplace Management – Amazon / Flipkart:**
Manage Seller/Vendor Central, listings, account coordination, platform campaigns, commercial issues, ratings/reviews and new-product activation.

**3. Quick-Commerce Management – Blinkit / Zepto / Instamart:**
Manage city-wise and dark-store-wise business performance. Track active stores, availability, assortment and sales. Ensure AVT expands into relevant new cities and dark stores as platforms grow.

**4. Availability & Stock-Out Control:**
Maintain high availability of priority AVT SKUs. Monitor OOS, inventory cover and replenishment requirements and coordinate with Supply Chain and distributors.

**5. Assortment & Range Expansion:**
Ensure the right AVT brands, SKUs and pack sizes are listed. Increase average SKUs per platform/dark store and identify opportunities for range expansion.

**6. Digital Shelf & Product Content:**
Maintain accurate product titles, images, descriptions, MRP, pack information and enhanced content. Improve search visibility and category ranking.

**7. Pricing & Promotions:**
Maintain approved pricing and monitor competitor prices. Execute coupons, discounts and platform campaigns within approved budgets and evaluate incremental sales and profitability.

**8. Platform Advertising & Visibility:**
Coordinate sponsored search, product advertising and platform visibility. Monitor ROAS/ACOS and ensure advertising expenditure produces measurable business results.

**9. New Product / New Market Launches:**
Ensure timely listing and activation of new AVT products. Identify new cities, platforms and dark stores and execute launch plans.

**10. Competition Tracking:**
Maintain a weekly competitor dashboard covering price, discounts, assortment, search position, availability, ratings, new launches and sponsored visibility.

**11. Inventory, Fill Rate & OTIF:**
Forecast requirements based on sales run rates, maintain adequate inventory, prevent promotion-related stock-outs and monitor fill rate and OTIF.

**12. Claims & Reconciliation:**
Track platform deductions, returns, shortages, claims and commercial settlements and coordinate with Finance for timely reconciliation.

**Primary Performance Outcomes:**

The role will ultimately be evaluated on four principal outcomes:

·      Sales Growth

·      Availability

·      Distribution & Assortment Expansion

·      Profitability

The executive is expected to function as the operational business owner for all assigned marketplace and quick-commerce platforms, with disciplined coordination across Marketing, Supply Chain, Finance and Sales.

**Company Description**
IAN Institute of Rehabilitation & Research is a comprehensive multi-specialty hospital dedicated to rehabilitation services for children with diverse disabilities. With over a decade of specialized experience, the institute offers patient-centered care in physical, mental, and neurological rehabilitation. A multidisciplinary team of doctors, therapists, and rehabilitation experts addresses conditions such as Cerebral Palsy, Autism, Down syndrome, genetic disorders, and various physical and neurological challenges. The institute provides state-of-the-art facilities and evidence-based interventions tailored to each child’s needs. Professionals joining IAN can expect a collaborative environment focused on improving functional outcomes and quality of life for differently abled children.
  
**Role Description**
The Licensed Clinical Psychologist will provide comprehensive psychological assessment, diagnosis, and treatment for children with developmental, neurological, and behavioral conditions. Day-to-day responsibilities include conducting psychological evaluations, administering and interpreting standardized tests, and delivering individual and family counseling to support emotional, behavioral, and social functioning. The role involves collaborating closely with pediatricians, neurologists, therapists, and rehabilitation specialists to develop integrated care plans and monitor progress. The psychologist will also offer clinical supervision and guidance to junior clinicians or trainees and contribute to case conferences and interprofessional meetings. This is a full-time, on-site role based in Thrissur, requiring active participation in the hospital’s rehabilitation programs and family education initiatives.

* Strong foundation in Psychology and Counseling Psychology, with the ability to apply theory to clinical practice in pediatric rehabilitation settings.
* Proficiency in Psychological Testing, including selection, administration, scoring, and interpretation of standardized assessment tools for children and adolescents.
* Expertise in Mental Health assessment and intervention, particularly in developmental, behavioral, and neuropsychological conditions such as Autism, Cerebral Palsy, and Down syndrome.
* Experience in Clinical Supervision, including mentoring, guiding, and reviewing the work of junior clinicians, interns, or trainees.
* Recognized license or registration as a Clinical Psychologist, with a master’s or doctoral degree in Clinical Psychology or an equivalent accredited qualification.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work collaboratively in a multidisciplinary team and interact effectively with children and families.
* Experience in rehabilitation or pediatric settings is highly desirable; familiarity with neurodevelopmental and genetic conditions is an advantage.
* Commitment to ethical practice, cultural sensitivity, and continuous professional development, including staying updated on evidence-based interventions.

title: Food Service Staff
description:
**Company Description**
Malabar Restaurant is a small Indian restaurant located in the West End of Dundee near the university area, offering a convenient and welcoming setting for guests and staff. The restaurant is known for its informal atmosphere, helpful team members, and dedicated chefs who focus on delivering a positive dining experience. Malabar specializes in South Indian cuisine, reflecting its name and cultural roots. Team members work together to provide attentive service and ensure customers enjoy the unique taste and quality of the food. The environment supports learning about authentic South Indian dishes and customer-focused hospitality.
  
**Role Description**
The Food Service Staff role at Malabar Restaurant is a full-time, on-site position based in Kunnathunad. The role involves greeting guests, taking orders, serving food and beverages, and ensuring tables and service areas are clean and well-organized throughout the shift. Food Service Staff support the kitchen team by coordinating orders, answering customer questions about menu items, and helping maintain smooth service during busy periods. The position also includes handling payments, assisting with simple sales-related tasks such as promoting specials, and responding promptly to guest requests or concerns. Team members are expected to follow hygiene and safety standards, contribute to a friendly atmosphere, and support coworkers to deliver consistent, high-quality service.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess strong Customer Service and Communication skills to interact effectively with guests and team members.
* Candidates should possess Sales and basic Finance skills to manage billing, payments, and promote menu items or specials.
* Candidates should possess Analytical Skills to handle orders accurately, prioritize tasks, and solve service-related issues efficiently.
* Previous experience in food service, hospitality, or retail is beneficial.
* Ability to stand for extended periods, work flexible shifts, and follow food safety and hygiene standards.
* Basic knowledge or interest in Indian and South Indian cuisine is an advantage.
* Reliability, teamwork, and a customer-focused mindset are essential.

title: Full-Time PHD Scholar
description:
**Company Description:**

Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham is a multi-campus, multi-disciplinary research institution and an Institution of Eminence, recognised as one of India's leading research universities. Accredited with NAAC A++, Amrita is ranked 8th among universities in India in the NIRF India Rankings 2025 and 1st in India in the THE Impact Rankings 2025.

With eight campuses across Amaravati, Amritapuri, Bengaluru, Chennai, Coimbatore, Kochi, Mysuru, and Nagercoil, Amrita provides a vibrant academic environment that fosters advanced research, innovation, and interdisciplinary collaboration.

The university actively collaborates with leading international institutions, including Ivy League universities in the United States and prominent European universities, through joint research initiatives, academic partnerships, and international exchange programmes. Amrita offers scholars opportunities to work on impactful research, access advanced research infrastructure, pursue international collaborations, and contribute to technological and scientific advancements.

**Role Description:**

Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham invites applications from highly motivated candidates for Full-Time Ph.D. Scholar positions in Engineering, Computer Science, and Artificial Intelligence (AI) across its eight campuses.

This is a full-time, on-site research position involving original research under the guidance of experienced faculty members and research supervisors. Selected scholars will be responsible for identifying research problems, conducting comprehensive literature reviews, developing research proposals, designing and executing experiments or computational studies, analysing findings, and publishing research outcomes in reputed peer-reviewed journals and conferences.

The role involves actively participating in research projects, interdisciplinary collaborations, academic discussions, seminars, and conferences. Scholars may also contribute to teaching, mentoring, project documentation, grant applications, and other academic activities as required by their respective departments.

**Research opportunities are available in the following areas:**

- Advanced Automation and Robotics

- Aerospace Engineering

- Artificial Intelligence and Data Science

- Chemical Engineering

- Civil Engineering

- Computer Science and Engineering

- Computer Science and Information Technology

- Cyber Security

- Electrical and Electronics Engineering

- Electronics and Communication Engineering

- Materials Science and Engineering

- Mechanical Engineering

- Wireless Networks and Applications

Selected candidates will benefit from a strong research ecosystem, faculty mentorship, international research collaborations, and institutional support for research infrastructure, publications, conferences, and innovation.

**Qualifications**

* A Master's degree in a relevant discipline with a minimum of 60% marks from a recognised institution, OR
* A four-year/eight-semester Bachelor's degree with Research and a minimum CGPA of 7.5/10.
* Strong academic background and research aptitude, with the ability to identify research problems, conduct literature reviews, and critically evaluate academic literature.
* Good academic writing, documentation, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in multidisciplinary research environments.
* Proficiency in relevant research methodologies, computational tools, laboratory techniques, or analytical software, depending on the chosen research area.
* Effective communication and presentation skills for academic discussions, seminars, and research publications.
* A strong interest in pursuing advanced research and contributing to publications, innovation, and technological development.

**Entrance Test Exemption:**
Candidates with valid UGC-NET, CSIR-NET, or GATE scores are exempted from the written entrance test for Engineering, Computer Science, and AI programmes.

**For Non-NET Candidates:**
Candidates must qualify in the university entrance test with a minimum of 50% marks.

**Selection Process:**
Final selection is based on the Entrance Test (70%) and Interview/Viva-voce (30%). Preference will be given to candidates with verified research publications and high-quality research proposals.

**Scholarship and Research Benefits**

* Monthly scholarship starting at ₹35,000 for Engineering, Computer Science, and AI programmes, with the possibility of an increase up to ₹55,000 per month, subject to programme eligibility.
* Up to ₹10 Lakhs in research infrastructure support.
* Up to ₹6 Lakhs in publication support.
* Eligible candidates may receive scholarships of up to ₹43,750 per month under the Visvesvaraya Ph.D. Scheme, Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY), Government of India.
* Funding support for international conferences and research travel.
* Opportunities for global collaborative research.
* Patent and intellectual property support.
* Startup incubation and entrepreneurship mentoring.
* Additional tuition fee waiver for eligible women scholars.

**Application Details:**

Highly motivated candidates with a strong passion for research are encouraged to apply online.

**Apply Here:**
https://aoap.amrita.edu/phd-26/index/

**Last Date to Apply:**
15 November 2026

For more information, visit: https://spotlight.amrita.edu/phd-engineering/

**Contact:**
phd@amrita.edu

3. Digital Marketing and Meta Ads

* Research business owners, decision-makers and relevant contact persons.
* Build and maintain structured databases of potential customers.

5. Cold Calling and Business Outreach

* Conduct targeted cold email campaigns.

* Maintain records of emails, responses, follow-ups and interested prospects.
* Identify opportunities for B2B partnerships.

7. Sales and Enquiry Management

* Send initial acknowledgement messages using approved templates.
* Maintain and update the company's CRM or lead database.
* Coordinate customer consultations and follow-up activities.
* Track enquiries, meetings, proposals and conversions.
* Assist in preparing marketing presentations and basic sales materials.
* Hand over qualified business opportunities to the management team.

8. AI Tools and Marketing Automation

* Use ChatGPT and other AI tools for content creation, research and campaign planning.
* Generate marketing captions, promotional messages, email drafts and cold calling scripts.
* Explore AI-based creative and video production tools.
* Assist in implementing simple marketing and lead-management automation workflows.
* Identify opportunities to improve productivity using AI and automation.

9. Reporting and Performance Monitoring

* Maintain daily activity and lead trackers.
* Maintain a weekly and monthly content calendar.
* Record outbound calls, emails, responses and follow-ups.
* Prepare weekly marketing and lead-generation reports.
* Monitor advertising performance, qualified leads and business enquiries.
* Suggest improvements to marketing and sales activities.

**Essential Skills**

* Good knowledge of Instagram, Facebook and LinkedIn.
* Practical knowledge of Canva for graphic design.
* Video editing skills using VN, InShot, Adobe Express or similar tools.
* Good written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Ability to communicate in Malayalam, Hindi & English; proficiency is preferred.
* Exceptional understanding of digital marketing and social media promotion.
* Confidence in communicating with business owners and prospective customers.
* Willingness to conduct cold calls and professional email outreach.
* Knowledge of ChatGPT and other AI tools.
* Ability to research businesses and identify potential customers.
* Good organizational and time-management skills.
* Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.
* Knowledge of Meta Business Suite and Meta Ads Manager.
* Understanding of SEO and Google Business Profile.
* Previous experience in cold calling, tele calling or B2B sales and social media marketing
* Experience with LinkedIn prospecting and email marketing.

Candidates do not need to be experts in every area. Practical skills, creativity, communication, confidence and willingness to learn are more important.

**Working Arrangement**

* Fully remote, part-time freelance engagement.
* Four hours of committed work per day.
* Monday to Saturday, with Sunday as the weekly off.
* Flexible working hours; candidates can choose their preferred working time.
* A weekly work roster must be mutually agreed upon in advance.
* Daily task updates and weekly performance reviews are expected.
* Candidates may continue other employment, studies or freelance assignments, provided there is no conflict of interest and the agreed working commitment is maintained.

**Compensation and Performance Incentives**

Fixed Monthly Compensation: ₹7,000

Additional performance incentives are available based on qualified leads.

Potential monthly earnings: ₹12,000 or more, depending on performance.

The detailed incentive structure will be communicated during the recruitment process.

**What We Offer**

* Flexible remote working arrangement.
* Opportunity to work with a growing IT solutions and technology company.
* Exposure to digital marketing, B2B sales and AI-powered marketing tools.
* Additional performance-based earnings.
* Opportunity to take ownership of marketing and lead-generation activities.
* Scope for long-term association and increased responsibilities based on performance.

title: Cloud Engineer
description:
We are seeking an experienced
**cloud professional**
to design, manage, secure, and optimize enterprise infrastructure across AWS, Microsoft Azure, and hybrid environments.

The ideal candidate will bring deep technical expertise in AWS, complemented by strong Azure capabilities, enterprise Microsoft systems administration, and hands-on infrastructure operations experience.

This role combines
**cloud architecture, infrastructure engineering, operational leadership, DevOps automation, security operations, and cost optimization**
to ensure highly available, resilient, secure, and cost-effective technology services.

The successful candidate will lead cloud transformation initiatives, drive Infrastructure as Code (IaC) adoption, oversee business-as-usual (BAU) infrastructure operations, coordinate 24×7 NOC activities, and support the organization's security, compliance, and disaster recovery objectives.

Key Responsibilities1. Multi-Cloud Architecture & Infrastructure Management

* Architect, implement, and manage enterprise cloud infrastructure, with AWS as the primary platform and Azure as the secondary platform.
* Design highly available, scalable, secure, and resilient cloud architectures following AWS and Azure Well-Architected principles.
* Manage core AWS services including EC2, S3, RDS, IAM, VPC, Route 53, CloudFormation, CloudWatch, and associated networking and security services.
* Administer Azure infrastructure including Virtual Machines, Storage, Virtual Networks, Microsoft Entra ID, Key Vault, and Azure Synapse Analytics.
* Design and maintain secure hybrid and multi-cloud connectivity, network segmentation, and identity integration.
* Develop, implement, and periodically test backup, business continuity, and disaster recovery strategies.
* Establish cloud governance, architecture standards, and operational best practices.

2. Microsoft Infrastructure & Enterprise Systems

* Administer and support enterprise Microsoft environments, including Microsoft 365, Exchange Online, Active Directory, and Windows Server.
* Manage Active Directory Domain Services, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, and hybrid identity synchronization.
* Implement and maintain secure identity and access management across on-premises, AWS, and Azure environments.
* Support Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, authentication, and privileged access management.
* Ensure reliable operation, integration, and lifecycle management of enterprise Microsoft services.

3. Infrastructure Operations & Service Reliability

* Lead day-to-day infrastructure BAU operations across cloud and on-premises environments.
* Ensure effective monitoring, backup management, patching, capacity planning, performance optimization, and system availability.
* Oversee and coordinate 24×7 NOC operations, including event monitoring, incident escalation, service restoration, and problem management.
* Drive root cause analysis, corrective actions, and continuous service improvement.
* Maintain limited on-premises infrastructure, including servers, firewalls, network switches, and IP telephony systems.
* Establish operational procedures, runbooks, infrastructure documentation, and service performance dashboards.

4. Cloud Security, SecOps & Compliance

title: Software Development Manager, Just Walk Out
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Lead a new India-based embedded and firmware engineering team for Just Walk Out's edge devices: the cameras, sensors, RFID, gates and networking hardware in our stores, and the device-side software that connects them to the cloud. This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You'll manage 8-12 engineers, set technical direction across firmware, embedded Linux and embedded Android, and partner closely with the US engineering team that owns this charter today.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Hire, coach and develop a high-judgment team of embedded, firmware and edge software engineers, and build an inclusive, high-ownership culture as the team grows in India
* Own the technical roadmap, delivery and operational excellence for your team's firmware and embedded software, from requirements and architecture through release and field support
* Set engineering standards across the embedded stack: firmware and RTOS/bare-metal code, embedded Linux and Android, drivers and board bring-up, secure boot and OTA updates, and on-device diagnostics
* Own the device-to-cloud boundary with cloud teams: provisioning and identity, connectivity, telemetry and remote management, including the device's AWS IoT / embedded-Linux connectivity stack
* Build the test infrastructure, staged rollouts and telemetry needed to ship firmware safely across a large fleet of deployed devices
* Lead the response to field issues, telling firmware from hardware, connectivity or sensor faults, and drive root cause and lasting fixes
* Drive execution with the US engineering team, product and program management, hardware/ODM partners, and cloud, data and UI/UX teams across time zones

  
A day in the life  
You might start with 1:1s and a design review, helping an engineer reason through an OTA rollback path or a latency budget on a constrained target. Later you agree scope for the next release with product and the US partner team, and re-plan the sprint because a hardware revision changed what's possible. In the afternoon you join your engineers on a field issue affecting a few devices at one store, get them the telemetry and a plan, and keep the fix moving.  
  
About the team  
Just Walk Out builds the technology behind checkout-free shopping: the devices, networking and cloud software that let shoppers walk out without stopping to pay. . This India team will take direct ownership of part of that charter, working closely with the US engineering team, hardware partners and the operations teams who rely on what we ship.  
  
About AWS:  
  
Diverse Experiences: AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job below, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  
  
Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  
  
Inclusive Team Culture - Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth - We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.  
  
Work/Life Balance - We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of engineering team management experience
* Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
* Experience partnering with product or program management teams
* Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
* 7+ years of software engineering experience, including embedded systems or firmware development
* Experience leading the development of embedded, real-time, or hardware-interfacing systems delivered on physical hardware

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
* Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers
* Hands-on embedded Linux (including Yocto) and/or embedded Android, with Linux kernel or driver development and low-level debugging
* Sustaining a large fleet of deployed devices: OTA firmware updates, telemetry, and remote diagnostics at scale
* Experience at the device-to-cloud boundary (connectivity, provisioning, fleet management), ideally with AWS IoT / Greengrass and MQTT
* Depth in Android/Linux firmware, secure boot, wireless connectivity, or RFID/sensor devices, plus hardware-in-the-loop testing

title: IT Support Engineer - NOC Analyst
description:
Sikich is hiring an IT Support Engineer - NOC Analyst to join our Managed Services team. This is an infrastructure and server-side NOC role focused on monitoring, triaging, and supporting client server, network, cloud, and backup environments across multiple clients. The engineer will operate within defined NOC procedures, respond to infrastructure alerts, execute standard troubleshooting for common NOC events such as server, internet, and power outages, and escalate complex issues to senior engineers or US-based on-call consultants when required. Strong ownership, documentation discipline, and clean escalation are core expectations for this role.

**About the firm**

Sikich is a global company specializing in Accounting, Advisory, and Technical professional services. With employees across the globe, Sikich ranks as one of the largest professional services companies in the United States. Our comprehensive skillsets, obtained over decades of experience as entrepreneurs, business owners and industry innovators, allow us to provide insights and transformative strategies to help strengthen every dimension of our clients businesses.

**What will you do in this role?**

* Monitor client infrastructure environments including servers, networks, backups, cloud resources, and endpoint management platforms across multiple clients.
* Investigate and triage infrastructure alerts related to servers, networking, internet connectivity, power, backups, and availability of business-critical systems.
* Support Windows Server environments through service and role health checks, event log review, resource utilization checks, disk space monitoring, and basic server-side troubleshooting.
* Perform Active Directory operations tasks including account status checks, group membership validation, account lockout investigation, and escalation of directory-related issues.
* Troubleshoot DNS, DHCP, VPN, connectivity, and basic network incidents using standardized diagnostic steps.
* Troubleshoot basic switching, VLAN, wireless, and firewall connectivity issues using standardized diagnostic steps, and escalate complex network faults to senior engineers or the client's network provider.
* Perform basic health checks on virtualization platforms such as VMware vSphere or Hyper-V, including VM state, host health, and resource utilization.
* Monitor backup jobs, investigate backup failures, and escalate restore-related concerns based on documented backup procedures.
* Monitor patch compliance across servers and endpoints, deploy operating system and third-party updates through RMM tooling, triage patch failures, and coordinate reboots and maintenance windows per documented procedures.
* Execute NOC runbooks and SOPs for common infrastructure events and escalate cleanly when issues fall outside defined procedures.
* Coordinate with senior engineers and US-based on-call consultants for complex incidents by providing clear findings, evidence, and troubleshooting steps already performed.
* Maintain accurate ticket documentation including alert details, business impact, investigation steps, resolution notes, and escalation trail.
* Provide clear and timely updates to internal teams and clients during incident investigation and resolution.
* Contribute to knowledge sharing, SOP updates, and continuous improvement of NOC procedures and runbooks.
* Adhere to company policies, procedures, and SLAs while delivering infrastructure support.
* Participate in after-hours on-call rotation as required to support client NOC needs outside regular business hours.

**What do you need to succeed in this role?**

* 2-4 years of experience in Infrastructure Support, NOC Operations, Managed Services, Server Support, or a closely related IT operations role.
* Hands-on exposure to Windows Server environments and basic server-side troubleshooting.
* Working knowledge of Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, and Group Policy basics.
* Experience with monitoring platforms and infrastructure alert response.
* Exposure to patch management and operating system / third-party update deployment through RMM or patch management tooling.
* Solid understanding of network fundamentals including IP addressing, routing basics, VPN, firewalls, and connectivity troubleshooting.
* Exposure to backup monitoring, failed backup triage, and restore concepts.
* Basic understanding of virtualization platforms such as VMware vSphere or Hyper-V.
* Familiarity with Microsoft 365 and Azure fundamentals, particularly where tied to infrastructure support.
* Ability to follow SOPs and runbooks and document troubleshooting clearly in a ticketing system.
* Strong ownership, communication, and escalation discipline in a client-facing Managed Services environment.
* Experience in a Managed Services Provider (MSP) or multi-client support environment.
* Hands-on experience with tools such as ConnectWise Manage, ConnectWise Automate/LabTech, LogicMonitor, Datto, or similar PSA / RMM / monitoring / backup platforms.
* Certifications from Microsoft (Azure Administrator, Windows Server), VMware (VCP), Cisco, Fortinet, or ITIL Foundation.
* Exposure to firewall, switch, access point, and basic server hardware troubleshooting.
* Experience supporting after-hours or rotational NOC coverage in an MSP delivery model.

**Benefits of being a part of the team**

* Family Health Insurance including parents
* Life & Accident Insurance
* Maternity/paternity leave
* Performance-based incentives
* Referral Bonus program
* Exam Fee Reimbursement Policy
* Indian festival holidays
* 5 days working week
* Doctor's Consultation

title: Security Support Engineer II
description:
At F5, we strive to bring a better digital world to life. Our teams empower organizations across the globe to create, secure, and run applications that enhance how we experience our evolving digital world. We are passionate about cybersecurity, from protecting consumers from fraud to enabling companies to focus on innovation.
  
  
Everything we do centers around people. That means we obsess over how to make the lives of our customers, and their customers, better. And it means we prioritize a diverse F5 community where each individual can thrive.
  
  
As a Security Support Engineer II, you will be an essential member of our Network Operations Center (NOC) team with strong technical acumen in network automation and deep security analysis. You will deliver in-depth troubleshooting on advanced network, security, and infrastructure issues.
  
  
You will support and troubleshoot enterprise-grade products and production services spanning kubernetes, cloud environments, data centers, LAN/WAN/SD-WAN, switching, routing, remote access, and application security. In this technical role within the NOC, you will drive tooling automation, proactive observability, and rapid incident detection & remediation to ensure our commitment to a 99.999% network availability SLO for our customers.
  
  
**Domain Requirements & Expectations:**
Experience & Education
  
  

* 5–8 years of network/security support experience in a large enterprise NOC or operations environment.
* Bachelors in Computer Science or Information Technology.

Network & Protocol Mastery
  
  

* Deep expertise in OSI model troubleshooting and protocols: OSPF, BGP, STP, TCP/UDP, IPv6, QoS.
* Proven experience managing and troubleshooting Multi-OS LAN/WAN/SD-WAN architectures.

Cloud & Containers
  
  

* Strong working knowledge of Kubernetes (K8s), container networking/ingress, and managed cloud Kubernetes environments (e.g., AWS EKS).

Product & Security Acumen
  
  

* Strong understanding of enterprise application delivery & security products (WAF, DDoS mitigation, DNS, Load Balancers).

Observability & Monitoring
  
  

* Hands-on experience with tools such as Grafana, Splunk, Nagios, New Relic, Cosmos, Zabbix, or equivalent platforms.

Automation & CI/CD
  
  

* Practical experience with automation tooling: Python, Ansible, Jenkins, Git, ZTP (Zero Touch Provisioning), or Infrastructure as Code (IaC).

Operational & Soft Skills
  
  

* Proven ability to troubleshoot calmly under pressure during mission-critical production incidents.
* Strong documentation, stakeholder management, and customer-facing communication skills.

**What will you do?**
**Engineering & Analysis: (60%)**

* Enhance the observability of network infrastructure by implementing numerous automations, advanced monitoring solutions, analyzing data trends, and proactively identifying potential issues from alerts and triggers to ensure a seamless and reliable network experience for our customers.
* Configure and manage customized alerting systems for DDoS attack, availability, latency, packet loss, etc., across various layers of the network.
* Proactively engage with Customer Success team upon triggered alerts to deliver insightful information on the nature and the reason behind the alerts or network performance degradation.
* Conduct thorough Root Cause Analysis (RCA) of network incidents to identify underlying issues causing disruptions or failures. Develop and implement effective solutions and preventive measures to mitigate identified root causes.
* Troubleshoot and implement advanced network configurations including SDN, IaC, switches, routers, firewalls, load balancers, WAF, DDoS, DNS, and Cloud networking environment.
* Design and implement automated processes to deploy, monitor and maintain network systems.
* Proactively ensure ongoing communication with teammates, customers, and stakeholders for ongoing network issues until a closure is reached.
* Review and approve team deliverables including customer updates, documentation changes, and network issue handling procedures.

**Production support: (40%)**

* Proactively monitoring network performance, troubleshoot issues, and optimizing network incident triggers configurations for maximum efficiency and uptime.
* Engage in complex troubleshooting including running maintenance and recovery tasks interpreting alarms and errors in the logs and performing maintenance to correct problems.
* Collaborate with vendors and other technical personnel to resolve technical issues and achieve highest levels of systems and infrastructure availability.
* Handle and escalate as needed significant network impacting alerts ensuring swift resolution.
* Participate in customer calls, providing detailed and regular updates on critical issues.
* Communicate with impacted users throughout the troubleshooting/remediation process as needed.
* Participate in on-call rotation and shift duties in line with the 24/7 business operation.

title: Firmware Developer - DLMS/ COSEM ( Smart Gas Metering)
description:
Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Embedded Firmware Developer to design, develop, test and maintain DLMS/COSEM-compliant firmware for battery-operated ultrasonic smart gas meters. The candidate will be responsible for embedded C development, smart metering protocols, secure communication, valve control, low-power optimisation and certification support.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop and maintain embedded C firmware for ultra-low-power ultrasonic smart gas meters.
* Implement DLMS/COSEM protocols, including OBIS codes, interface classes, DLMS services, HDLC and Wrapper communication.
* Develop metering functionalities such as flow measurement, meter indexing, billing profiles, load profiles, events, alarms and tariff management.
* Implement valve control, tamper detection and security features.
* Integrate communication modules such as NB-IoT, LoRaWAN, RF and MIU.
* Implement DLMS security, including HLS authentication, AES-128-GCM and key management.
* Develop Firmware Over-The-Air (FOTA) functionality using DLMS Image Transfer.
* Optimise firmware for long battery life (10–15 years).
* Perform firmware testing, debugging and hardware integration.
* Support product certification, conformance testing and type approval activities.

Required Technical Skills

* Strong programming experience in Embedded C.
* Hands-on experience with ARM Cortex-M microcontrollers such as STM32, Silicon Labs, NXP, Renesas or MSP430.
* Practical knowledge of DLMS/COSEM and IEC 62056 standards.
* Knowledge of UART, SPI, I2C, ADC, RTC, LCD, Flash and EEPROM.
* Experience with RTOS or Bare-Metal embedded development.
* Familiarity with JTAG/SWD debugging tools and Git version control.
* Understanding of low-power embedded system design and battery optimisation.

Standards & Protocol Knowledge

* DLMS/COSEM – IEC 62056 series.
* DLMS UA Blue Book, Green Book and Yellow Book.
* Gas Metering Standards – EN 14236 and OIML R137.
* Communication Protocols – NB-IoT, LTE-M, LoRaWAN, BLE and IEC 62056-21.
* Security Standards – AES-128-GCM and IEC 62443.
* Safety Standards – ATEX, IECEx and IEC 60079.
* IP Protection – IEC 60529.

Good to Have

* Experience in smart gas metering or ultrasonic gas metering products.
* Knowledge of NB-IoT/LTE-M AT commands and communication module integration.
* Experience with DLMS conformance and certification testing.
* Knowledge of Python-based test automation.
* Familiarity with Guru or related DLMS development tools.

Educational Qualification

* B.E./B.Tech in Electronics & Communication Engineering (ECE), Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEE), Embedded Systems or a related discipline.
* Relevant hands-on embedded firmware development experience is preferred.

Preferred Candidate Profile

* Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.
* Ability to independently develop and maintain embedded firmware.
* Good understanding of hardware-software integration.

description:
**ABOUT US:**

Azista Industries Private Limited is a fast-growing, highly diversified technology and manufacturing conglomerate. As a
**Senior System Administrator**
at our Bengaluru facility, you will take ownership of our core IT operations across endpoints, Windows Server environments, enterprise networking, and perimeter security. You will act as the primary operational anchor ensuring zero-downtime availability, robust endpoint compliance, and seamless cross-site connectivity for our mission engineering teams.

In this role, you will bridge day-to-day user enablement with proactive infrastructure hardening. Your primary success metrics will center on network and server uptime (target 99.9%+), mean time to resolve (MTTR) for L1/L2 escalations, automated patch compliance, and firewall policy security audits.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* **Enterprise Server & Identity Administration:**
  Maintain and tune Windows Server environments, Active Directory, Group Policy Objects (GPOs), DNS, DHCP, and enterprise backup/restore operations to guarantee business continuity.
* **Network & Connectivity Operations:**
  Deploy, segment, and monitor LAN/WLAN environments, including VLAN configurations, switch/AP management, structured cabling, and IP space allocations.
* **Perimeter & Network Security:**
  Manage enterprise firewall policies, site-to-site and remote access VPN tunnels, IPS/IDS, URL filtering, log shipping to SIEM, and incident triage.
* **Modern Endpoint Management:**
  Oversee the full lifecycle of employee workstations—from imaging, provisioning, and patch deployment to endpoint compliance tracking and asset inventory.
* **Threat Mitigation & Compliance:**
  Administer EDR/XDR security agents, isolate endpoint threats, enforce IT security SOPs, and ensure audit readiness for data protection standards.
* **Operational Excellence & Vendor Management:**
  Drive L1/L2 incident resolution, maintain exhaustive system architecture diagrams and SOPs, and manage IT vendor contracts, warranty claims, and escalations.

**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR?**

* **Experience:**
  4–7 years of hands-on experience in enterprise systems administration, network engineering, or infrastructure support.
* **Systems & Directory Services:**
  Deep expertise in Windows Server (2016/2019/2022), Active Directory design/maintenance, Group Policy (GPO), and enterprise backup and disaster recovery tools.
* **Core Networking:**
  Strong grasp of TCP/IP networking, subnetting, VLAN segmentation, routing/switching fundamentals, and wireless infrastructure (WLAN).
* **Firewall & Security Administration:**
  Proven track record configuring and auditing enterprise firewalls (e.g., Fortinet, Palo Alto, Sophos), site-to-site IPsec/SSL VPNs, and endpoint protection suites (EDR/XDR).
* **Endpoint & Productivity Suites:**
  Practical administration of Microsoft 365 / Entra ID (Azure AD), automated software deployment tools, and disk imaging systems.

**NICE-TO-HAVES:**

* Relevant industry certifications: CCNA, Microsoft Certified: Windows Server Hybrid Administrator Associate, CompTIA Security+, or vendor firewall certifications (e.g., NSE 4).
* Experience administering virtualized environments (VMware vSphere / Microsoft Hyper-V).
* Prior experience supporting high-security manufacturing, aerospace, defense, or hardware engineering facilities.
* Exposure to SIEM log ingestion, centralized syslog servers, or network monitoring tools (PRTG, Zabbix, Nagios).

While working within the Compliance Management Program framework, the Network Compliance Senior Director is responsible for leading and delivering quality results, providing compliance advice to lines of business as a subject matter expert, and serving as a beacon of our culture of compliance.

**What we’re looking for**

* Advising business leaders on regulatory requirements
* Providing guidance on business policies, standards, and procedures
* Developing and leading department training, as appropriate
* Providing compliance advice to senior leaders on complex business projects, products, and initiatives

* Reviewing business controls and providing guidance on identified risks
* Maintain subject matter expertise in the broader payments industry and applicable laws and regulations
* Provide effective challenge and guidance on compliance risks for the network and merchant businesses through both formal and informal engagements

* Assist lines of business in their responsibilities under the compliance program, such as how to monitor, report, and train on areas of potential risk
* Conduct targeted validations and reviews on controls for applicable regulations
* Assist in capturing, maintaining, and analyzing compliance data, and in interpreting it to ensure consistency and adequate compliance risk management
* Participate in reporting activities to senior leadership in the business and Risk Management

**Basic Qualifications**

* 12+ years of experience in compliance, legal, or risk management within financial services or global payments.
* 5+ years of direct people management experience leading and developing teams of managers or senior specialists.

  **App Store and Google Play release processes**

  .

* Support implementation and validation of
  **push notifications, in-app messages, promotional campaigns, and personalized customer communication**
  .
* Use customer feedback, app reviews, support tickets, and business data to identify recurring usability and functional issues.

* Work closely with
  **Product Managers, UI/UX Designers, Mobile Developers, Backend Developers, QA Teams, DevOps, Business Teams, and external technology vendors**
  .
