title: Sr Manager, Integrated Security Operations
description:
The Senior Manager, GSS India- provides leadership and governance for ISOC and its expanding JAPAC support mandate, while strengthening regional incident readiness and business resilience. The role integrates security operations center governance, intelligence-led monitoring, Incident Management Team (IMT) preparedness, incident coordination, Business Continuity Planning (BCP), and continuous improvement into a coherent operating model.
  
  
This is a senior, critical leadership role with accountability for outcomes, readiness, governance, and cross-functional coordination. Day-to-day monitoring and control room execution remain with the ISOC operational leadership and analyst teams.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* ISOC Leadership & Governance
* Provide end-to-end leadership and governance for ISOC performance, service delivery, operating procedures, service levels, escalation protocols, quality, and risk controls.
* Guide the evolution of ISOC as a scalable, intelligence-driven regional hub supporting India and JAPAC.
* Ensure effective 24x7 monitoring, triage, notification, escalation, incident documentation, and employee assistance support.
* Establish meaningful performance indicators, trend analysis, assurance reviews, and leadership reporting.
* Drive process standardization, technology enablement, automation, workforce capability, and continuous improvement in partnership with GSS Technology and Systems.
* JAPAC Regional Support
* Lead the operational readiness and phased expansion of ISOC support for JAPAC, including service scope, coverage, handoffs, escalation pathways, and regional operating protocols.
* Work closely with the Regional Director, JAPAC, regional GSS leaders, and in-country stakeholders to align ISOC support with regional priorities and global GSS standards.
* Promote consistent regional situational awareness, risk monitoring, incident visibility, and timely escalation across

supported markets.
  
  

* Ensure ISOC regional support complements, and does not replace, local response ownership and country-specific

requirements.
  
  

* Incident Management Team Readiness & Coordination
* Support the Regional GSS Lead in maintaining IMT readiness, governance, rosters, activation protocols, escalation criteria, and supporting documentation.
* Coordinate IMT preparedness activities, including periodic touchpoints, tabletop exercises, simulations, training, and lessons-learned reviews.
* Enable effective incident coordination through timely situational awareness, action tracking, Emergency Notification System support, meeting records, and stakeholder updates.
* Support After-Action Reviews and track corrective and preventive actions to closure.
* Maintain alignment among the regional IMT, local Emergency Response Teams (ERTs), the Corporate Crisis Management

Team (CMT), GSOC, and ISOC.
  
  

* Business Continuity & Operational Resilience
* Coordinate GSS India Business Continuity Planning requirements in alignment with 1-Adobe Enterprise Resilience (1-AER), enterprise BCP processes, and applicable Site Recovery Plans.
* Partner with business and functional stakeholders on Business Impact Analyses (BIAs), continuity plans, recovery priorities, and testing or assurance activities.
* Connect BCP, incident management, emergency response, and site recovery arrangements to support a coordinated response and recovery model.
* Maintain current, controlled, and audit-ready documentation, with clear ownership and remediation tracking.
* Identify resilience gaps, dependencies, and improvement opportunities and provide transparent reporting to leadership.
* Cross-Functional Partnership
* Work as an integrated partner with India Security Operations, Security Systems & Technology, and Environmental Health & Safety / Safety leadership to ensure coordinated delivery across people, places, and technology.
* Partner with Site Operations and Safety teams during incidents, exercises, recovery activities, and operational readiness reviews.
* Build effective relationships with regional GSS leaders, Employee Experience, Employee Communications, Legal, Corporate Risk, Adobe Technology Services, Global Site Operations, Travel, and other subject matter experts.
* Clarify roles, decision rights, handoffs, and escalation paths across partner functions to prevent duplication and strengthen accountability.
* Governance, Reporting & Improvement
* Prepare concise executive briefings, dashboards, decision papers, and incident or resilience updates for India and regional leadership.
* Maintain SOPs, playbooks, control documentation, action trackers, and governance rhythms for the role portfolio.
* Use operational data, incident trends, exercise findings, and stakeholder feedback to prioritize improvements and

investment needs.
  
  

* Support budget planning, supplier governance, workforce planning, audit actions, and capability development relevant to ISOC and resilience.

Key Working Relationships
  
  

* Internal: Director, India Safety & Security; India Security Operations Lead; Security Systems & Technology Lead;

Environmental Health & Safety / Safety Lead; ISOC operational leadership and analysts.
  
  

* Regional: Regional Director, JAPAC; country and regional GSS leaders; GSOC; relevant JAPAC stakeholders.
* Cross-functional: Global Site Operations, Employee Experience, Employee Communications, Legal, Corporate Risk, Adobe

Technology Services, Travel, Enterprise Resilience, and other IMT members.
  
  

* External: Service providers and suppliers supporting ISOC, risk monitoring, emergency notification, continuity, and

specialist response capabilities.
  
  
**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant professional experience; professional certifications in security, incident management, emergency management, or business continuity are preferred.
* Progressive experience in security operations, security operations center leadership, incident or crisis management, business continuity, resilience, or a related discipline.
* Demonstrated experience leading or governing a SOC, GSOC, ISOC, or comparable 24x7 operational environment.
* Experience coordinating cross-functional incident response, exercises, After-Action Reviews, and corrective action programs.
* Experience working across multiple countries, cultures, or time zones, preferably within JAPAC.
* Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, analytical, and governance capabilities.
* Credential such as CPP, CBCP, ISO 22301 Lead Implementer/Auditor, CEM, MBCI, ICS Certifications, will be an added

advantge
  
  
Core Capabilities
  
  

* Operational leadership and disciplined execution
* Incident command support and decision-making under pressure
* Business continuity and operational resilience
* Intelligence-led monitoring, risk assessment, and trend analysis
* Executive communication and stakeholder influence
* Cross-functional collaboration without reliance on direct authority
* Process improvement, technology enablement, and change leadership
* High standards of integrity, confidentiality, accountability, and duty of care

Measures of Success
  
  

* ISOC service reliability, escalation quality, response timeliness, and stakeholder confidence.
* Effective and sustainable expansion of ISOC support across JAPAC.
* IMT readiness demonstrated through current rosters, training, exercises, activation support, and action closure.
* Improved alignment among ISOC, India Security Operations, Systems & Technology, Safety, and regional GSS leadership.
* Current and tested continuity and recovery arrangements for in-scope GSS functions and sites.
* Clear, timely, decision-useful reporting on incidents, risk trends, readiness, and improvement priorities.
* Sustained closure of audit, exercise, incident, and resilience improvement actions.

description:

**Job Description**
The Opportunity
  
  
Adobe’s AI Studio is where the world’s leading brands bring their campaigns to life through generative AI; and behind every great campaign is an equally great production engine. As Content Operations Lead, you’ll be the operational backbone of that engine, working side by side with Creative Designers to keep projects on track, customers unblocked, and nothing falling through the cracks.
  
  
This role is for someone who can walk into an unorganized customer situation, quickly make sense of what’s needed, and get the team delivering. You’re deeply comfortable with data (like wrangling CSVs, building Excel trackers, turning raw inputs into structured outputs), and you bring the kind of can-do energy that keeps teams moving even when timelines are tight.

* Proactively identify and remove blockers so Creative Designers can stay focused on the work, not the logistics.
* Coordinate handoffs between Creative Designers, copywriters, and engagement managers to keep production on schedule.
* Drive the team to on-time delivery, flagging risks early and pushing for resolution before they become problems.

* Build, refine, and document production workflows and processes that increase team efficiency and reduce manual effort. Additionally, you will make sure they’re clearly defined and repeatable.
* Leverage project management platforms and AI-assisted workflows to streamline operations and keep interested parties informed.
* Find opportunities to automate repetitive production tasks and contribute to a growing library of team guidelines.

* Bring a creative eye to production — catching inconsistencies, flagging quality issues, and helping maintain brand standards across deliverables.

* Serve as a reliable point of contact for internal coordination, keeping interested parties informed and aligned.
* Maintain a positive, resourceful presence that helps the team navigate competing priorities and shifting deadlines.
* Contribute to a collaborative team culture where people feel supported and set up to do their best work.

* Proven ability to define, document, and improve processes: you don’t just follow workflows, you build them.
* A track record of unblocking teams and ensuring timely delivery in fast paced, time-sensitive environments.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously with strong attention to detail and follow-through.
* A creative eye and genuine appreciation for design quality, even if you’re not the one pushing pixels.
* Familiarity with generative AI tools and an openness to integrating them into daily work.
* Strong communication skills: you keep people informed without over-communicating, and you know when to flag something versus just handle it.
* A can-do attitude and the kind of steady, positive energy that makes teams want to work with you.

The role is accountable for driving quality excellence through robust quality systems, defect prevention, reliability improvement, and continuous process enhancement.

* Ensure effective management and closure of NCMRs, quality escapes, audit findings, and corrective actions.
* Maintain compliance with QMS, ISO standards, customer specifications, and regulatory requirements.

* Lead cross-functional quality improvement initiatives focused on product reliability, process capability, and operational excellence.

**Company Description**
Siddhivinayak Dyes And Chemical Industries Ltd. is a public limited company focused on becoming a trusted global manufacturer of dye intermediates, specialty chemicals, and reactive dyes through innovation and quality. EY's Real Estate Services (RES) team is responsible for enabling one of the world's largest corporate real estate portfolios, supporting approximately 440,000 professionals across more than 2.3 million square meters of office space and delivering approximately 300 real estate projects annually across the globe.
  
  
The Global Real Estate Services Operations Lead is a strategic leadership role responsible for driving operational excellence, service delivery, transformation, technology enablement and governance across EY's global real estate function. As a member of the Real Estate Services Leadership Team, this individual will lead the operational framework, systems, processes and teams that support the effective delivery of real estate services globally.
  
  
This role will play a critical part in shaping the future operating model of Global Real Estate Services through the adoption of advanced technologies, automation, AI-enabled capabilities, data-driven decision making and continuous improvement initiatives.
  
  
The successful candidate will bring a combination of operational leadership, global stakeholder management, technology enablement, financial management and change leadership experience within complex, multinational environments.

+ Lead the operational strategy and execution framework supporting EY's global real estate portfolio.
+ Establish and maintain global operating standards, governance structures and service delivery models.
+ Drive consistency, scalability and operational excellence across Real Estate Services functions.
+ Partner closely with Real Estate Leaders, Procurement, Finance, Technology, Risk, Legal, Security and Talent teams to ensure aligned and efficient service delivery.
+ Monitor operational performance and implement corrective actions to continuously improve delivery outcomes.

* Transformation, Innovation and AI

+ Lead strategic transformation initiatives across the global RES organization.
+ Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize and automate processes.
+ Drive the implementation and adoption of emerging technologies, including AI, automation and advanced analytics.
+ Develop operational roadmaps that support future workplace, real estate and business strategies.
+ Champion innovation and promote a culture of continuous improvement.

+ Own the development and delivery of operational reporting and performance management frameworks.

+ Drive cost optimization initiatives while maintaining service quality and business outcomes.

+ Establish and monitor service level agreements, operational metrics and performance standards.
+ Build strong partnerships with external providers to drive innovation, value creation and continuous improvement.

+ Create a high-performance culture focused on collaboration, accountability, innovation and continuous learning.
+ Provide leadership for talent attraction, succession planning, coaching and professional development.
+ Build organizational capabilities that support the long-term evolution of the global RES function.

**Job Summary**
As a UI/UX Consultant within the S&C GN Customer Service Analytics & Contact Center AI practice, you will be responsible for designing, prototyping, and implementing intuitive, high-performance user interfaces that power enterprise Contact Center AI platform implementations. Your typical day will involve translating complex business requirements into user-centered design solutions using Figma or Adobe XD, building production-ready frontend components using React/Next.js, integrating real-time WebRTC communication features, collaborating with backend and CCaaS integration teams, and advising clients on design systems, accessibility standards, and UX strategy across all phases of delivery.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**

* Design and deliver end-to-end UX solutions — from user research, wireframes, and high-fidelity prototypes in Figma/Adobe XD/Sketch to production-ready frontend implementations — for Contact Center AI dashboards, agent workspaces, and supervisor monitoring interfaces.
* Build scalable, reusable frontend components and design systems using React/Angular/Vue/Next.js, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3/SCSS, and component libraries (Material UI, Tailwind, Storybook) that are consumed across multiple product teams and client engagements.
* Design and implement real-time communication UX for video/audio/data channels using WebRTC — covering peer-to-peer media streams, signaling server integration (WebSocket/SIP), STUN/TURN/ICE configuration, and SFU/MCU architectures (e.g., Janus, LiveKit) — with robust connection state management and graceful degradation patterns.
* Integrate REST/GraphQL APIs and implement authentication/authorization flows (OAuth2, JWT, SSO) within frontend applications, ensuring secure, token-refresh-aware, and optimistic-update-driven user experiences.
* Ensure cross-browser compatibility and WCAG 2.1 accessibility compliance across all deliverables; conduct and act on usability testing, A/B testing, and user research sessions to continuously improve experience quality.
* Optimize frontend performance through code splitting, lazy loading, virtual scrolling, SSR/SSG strategies, and Core Web Vitals monitoring; advise clients on responsive, mobile-first design principles and progressive enhancement.
* Collaborate with CI/CD pipeline teams to integrate frontend build, lint, test (Jest, Playwright/Cypress), visual regression (Chromatic), and deployment stages into GitHub Actions/GitLab CI workflows; support cloud deployments on AWS/GCP/Azure (S3, CloudFront, Vercel).
* Lead client-facing UX discovery workshops and design reviews; advise on design system governance, component library strategy, and UX toolchain selection prior to and during engagement onboarding.
* Design conversational UI patterns and integrate real-time AI features — including streaming AI responses, transcription overlays, AI confidence indicators, and RAG-powered search UX — into contact center communication platforms.
* Mentor analysts and junior designers/developers; conduct design and code reviews across frontend workstreams; present UX and architecture decisions to senior client stakeholders and maintain documentation for knowledge transfer.

**Professional & Technical Skills**
**Must To Have Skills:**

* UI/UX design and prototyping using Figma, Adobe XD, or Sketch — covering wireframing, interactive prototyping, design tokens, and design system governance
* Frontend development using React/Angular/Vue/Next.js, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3/SCSS, and component libraries (Material UI, Tailwind CSS, Storybook)
* Deep WebRTC expertise — peer-to-peer media streams, signaling servers (WebSocket/SIP), STUN/TURN/ICE configuration, SFU/MCU architectures (e.g., Janus, LiveKit), and real-time communication UX patterns for video/audio/data channels
* REST/GraphQL API integration with authentication/authorization implementation (OAuth2, JWT, SSO, MFA, RBAC) within single-page and server-rendered applications
* Cross-browser compatibility and accessibility compliance (WCAG 2.1) — including semantic HTML, ARIA, keyboard navigation, screen reader testing, and automated auditing (axe-core, Lighthouse)
* Performance optimization — code splitting, lazy loading, virtual scrolling, SSR/SSG/ISR, bundle analysis, CDN strategy, and Core Web Vitals improvement
* Responsive and mobile-first design; user research, usability testing, and A/B testing methodologies
* Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions/GitLab CI), Git branching strategies, and cloud deployment for frontend applications (AWS S3/CloudFront, GCP, Azure, Vercel/Netlify)

**Additional Information**

* The ideal candidate will possess a strong educational background in Computer Science or a related field, along with a proven track record of delivering design systems and production-grade frontend applications within enterprise cloud and Contact Center AI environments.

**Good To Have Skills**

* AI-assisted UX design tools and conversational UI design patterns for contact center and communication platforms
* Integration of real-time AI features — streaming responses (SSE/WebSocket), transcription overlays, AI confidence scoring, and RAG-powered search UX
* Familiarity with CCaaS platforms (Genesys, Amazon Connect, NICE, Five9) and their agent/supervisor UI integration points
* SFU/MCU architecture familiarity beyond WebRTC — Janus Gateway, LiveKit, media server configuration

2.5+ years of experience in video editing, motion content, and graphic design, preferably in full-time roles supporting US-based software or technology companies.
  
  

* Advanced video editing skills with a diverse portfolio demonstrating strong storytelling, pacing, audio effects and music mastery, typography, layout, high production standards, and a keen eye for modern tech branding.

* Strong graphic design fundamentals, including layout, typography, brand consistency, and asset creation across digital and print formats.
* Ability to maintain a working schedule that provides at least 3–4 hours of overlap with the US Pacific Time (PT) business day for synchronous collaboration.
* Proven ability to work cross-functionally, manage feedback effectively, and move quickly without sacrificing quality.
* Experience supporting multiple internal stakeholders and coordinating with freelancers, agencies, or other external creative contributors.

description:

The ideal candidate will be responsible for researching, developing, and validating alpha-generating trading strategies using quantitative methods, statistical modeling, and large-scale market data.

**Responsibilities:**

* Research and develop profitable quantitative trading strategies across multiple asset classes.
* Generate and validate alpha signals using statistical and machine learning techniques.
* Analyze large-scale historical and tick-by-tick market data.
* Design, backtest, and optimize systematic trading strategies.
* Conduct market microstructure research and execution analysis.

* Strong understanding of market microstructure and electronic trading.
* Experience working with large financial datasets and backtesting frameworks.
* Ability to independently research, validate, and improve quantitative models.

**Experience in one or more of the following:**

* Indian, US & European markets, covering Equities, Futures, Options, Commodities, FX, ETFs, Fixed Income and Crypto.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's, master's, or PhD in computer science, mathematics, statistics, physics, engineering, economics, or a related quantitative discipline.
* A strong academic record from Tier-1 institutes (IIT, IISc, ISI, IIIT, BITS, CMI, etc. ) is preferred.

Founded in 2015, the company is one of the fastest growing companies in SaaS, raising approximately $250 million to date and valued at $1.6 billion. Apollo.io provides sales and marketing teams with easy access to verified contact data for over 210 million B2B contacts and 35 million companies worldwide, along with tools to engage and convert these contacts in one unified platform. By helping revenue professionals find the most accurate contact information and automating the outreach process, Apollo.io turns prospects into customers. Apollo raised a series D in 2023 and is backed by top-tier investors, including Sequoia Capital, Bain Capital Ventures, and more, and counts the former President and COO of Hubspot, JD Sherman, among its board members.
  
  
Your Role & Mission
  
  
As a Senior Backend Engineer at Apollo, you'll be a critical part of a fast-growing company, working on a cross-functional team to build highly scalable systems and set the bar for how we engineer. The way we build has changed: this is an
**AI-native**
role. We're not looking for someone who
*also*
uses AI, we're looking for someone who thinks
*with*
it, forms their own hypotheses, pressure-tests what AI produces, catches its errors, and design more robustly than they could alone.
  
  
You'll work in an open, collaborative environment, give and receive hands-on mentorship, and have real opportunities to grow. You'll interface daily with design, front-end, analytics, product, and teams beyond Engineering. You enjoy working cross-functionally to solve hard problems and make an impact. You strive for quality, are obsessed with improving it, automation, monitoring, squashing the bugs that sneak through and you're always investigating performance improvements and better ideas.
  
  
Daily Adventures & Responsibilities
  
  

* Design and implement highly scalable, highly available backend services with proper monitoring and alerting in place
* Ramp quickly into large, unfamiliar codebases, de-risk your changes, understand blast radius, and ship with confidence
* Use AI as a core part of your workflow: generate and pressure-test approaches, verify and catch AI's mistakes, and stand behind the quality of the code you ship with it
* Drive the full lifecycle of software development: product requirements, architecture, solution design, development, quality assurance, and maintenance, ownership doesn't end at deploy
* Scope and reshape under-specified problems, and write clear design docs that satisfy real product needs
* Partner closely with PMs: translate product intent into technical decisions, surface the technical realities they need to make good calls, and push back on the spec when reality changes the answer
* Mentor others on best practices and effectively share knowledge to up-level the team
* Communicate progress clearly to the product lead, engineering manager, and other stakeholders
* Introduce new technologies and ideas when they earn their place
* Give and receive technical and behavioral feedback; engage in scrum ceremonies, team culture, and collaborate with the team.

What We're Looking For
  
  

* AI-native engineers. You use AI to raise your bar, not just move faster forming your own hypotheses, pressure-testing and verifying AI output, catching its errors, and taking full ownership of code quality regardless of how it was produced. You stay current with a fast-moving toolset.
* Comfort in unfamiliar code. You ramp fast into systems you didn't write, reason about blast radius, and de-risk changes rather than hoping they work.
* Architectural ownership & operational readiness. You design for scale and availability, anticipate failure modes, and build with monitoring and alerting from the start.
* Ownership start to finish. Just because a project has been deployed doesn't mean it's done. You own outcomes , think end to end in terms of product and are customer obsessed
* Collaboration you can trust. You let others speak, seek to understand their viewpoints, and are the kind of teammate people want to build with.
* Product judgment. You care about the customer outcome, make the technical calls that produce a great product, and know when to challenge a spec.
* Growth & learning. You actively improve your craft, your team, and how you work.
* Proactivity. You act without being told, identify areas of improvement, and drive best practices.
* Comfort with ambiguity. You can operate without a fully-specified problem and bring structure to it.
* Organization & planning. You break large projects into smaller pieces that are easier to estimate and deliver.
* Strong communication. Clear in writing and in person, across technical and non-technical audiences.

**Qualifications**

* Minimum 5+ years of industry experience in backend development, at least 3-4 years in senior positions, building large-scale applications with right observability.
* Solid computer science fundamentals, data structures, algorithms, and object-oriented design
* Fluency using AI tools in real development work, plus the judgment to verify and pressure-test their output rather than trusting it blindly
* Experience developing distributed web applications
* Write code that is comprehensible, well-structured, and highly performant
* Experience with database modeling (SQL or NoSQL both fine)
* Experience using and designing RESTful services

**Must have:**
Curiosity, AI-native engineering judgment, communication skills, problem solving.
  
  
**Nice to have:**
BS or MS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or similar; GCP, Kubernetes, Docker, Mongo, Redis, Ruby on Rails, Microservices, Machine Learning
  
  
Apollo.io Tech Blog: deep dives into engineering, product design, and company-culture stories from the Apollo team — behind-the-scenes insight into how Apollo builds and scales its B2B sales platform.
  
  
We are AI Native
  
  
Apollo.io is an AI-native company built on a culture of continuous improvement. We’re on the front lines of driving productivity for our customers—and we expect the same mindset from our team. If you're energized by finding smarter, faster ways to get things done using AI and automation, you'll thrive here.
  
  
Why You’ll Love Working at Apollo
  
  
At Apollo, we’re driven by a shared mission: to help our customers unlock their full revenue potential. That’s why we
**take extreme ownership**
of our work,
**move with focus and urgency**
, and
**learn voraciously**
to stay ahead.
  
  
We invest deeply in your growth, ensuring you have the resources, support, and autonomy to
**own your role and make a real impact**
. Collaboration is at our core—we’re
**all for one**
, meaning you’ll have a team across departments ready to help you succeed. We encourage
**bold ideas and courageous action**
, giving you the freedom to experiment, take smart risks, and drive big wins.
  
  
If you’re looking for a place where your work matters, where you can push boundaries, and where your career can thrive—Apollo is the place for you.
  
  
Learn more here!

title: Sr. Systems Java Developer
description:
**Work Schedule**
Standard (Mon-Fri)
  
  
**Environmental Conditions**
Office
  
  
As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.
  
  
**Summarized Purpose**
Join ThermoFisher Scientific as a Senior Systems Developer and help build the software platforms that support scientific workflows and customer outcomes. You will design, develop, and maintain secure, scalable Java applications and services used across enterprise and laboratory-facing environments. Working with product, QA, platform, and business partners, you will turn complex requirements into reliable cloud-ready solutions that help make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer.
  
  
This role is suited to a hands-on senior Java engineer with strong Spring Boot and microservices experience. You will contribute across the delivery lifecycle-from technical design and API development through automated testing, deployment, production support, and mentoring teammates.
  
  
**Education / Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of experience and relevant formal academic/vocational qualification.
* Minimum of 7-9 years of professional software or systems-development experience, with substantial hands-on Java development experience.
* Experience delivering enterprise applications in an Agile, cross-functional environment.

**Major Job Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, enhance, and maintain production-grade Java and Spring Boot applications, REST APIs, and microservices.
* Translate functional and non-functional requirements into clear technical designs, implementation plans, and maintainable code.
* Build service integrations using well-designed, versioned APIs and resilient communication patterns.
* Develop data-access components and optimize SQL for relational databases, including MySQL and Oracle.
* Partner with architects and engineering teams on scalable microservices architecture, service boundaries, observability, and performance.
* Produce automated unit, integration, and API tests; investigate defects; and improve code quality, test coverage, and application reliability.
* Participate in peer reviews, technical design discussions, release planning, and continuous improvement activities.
* Use Git, CI/CD pipelines, and Jira to plan, build, test, release, and trace work through the software-development lifecycle.
* Apply secure coding practices, including authentication/authorization, input validation, secrets management, and dependency/security remediation.
* Create and maintain technical documentation for APIs, designs, operational procedures, and support handoffs.
* Collaborate effectively with product owners, QA, DevOps, and global engineering teams; communicate risks, decisions, and progress clearly.
* Guide and support less-experienced developers through code reviews, technical coaching, and knowledge sharing.
* Participate in an on-call support rotation, as needed, to diagnose and resolve production issues.

**Must-Have Skills**

* Strong, hands-on proficiency in Java and Spring/Spring Boot for enterprise application and service development.
* Demonstrated experience designing, developing, documenting, and consuming RESTful Web APIs.
* Strong understanding of microservices architecture, distributed-system fundamentals, and API integration patterns.
* Experience with Spring ecosystem capabilities such as Spring Data JPA, Spring Security, Spring Cloud, or comparable tools.
* Strong SQL and relational database experience, including PostgreSQL, MySQL and Oracle; ability to design schemas, diagnose query performance, and maintain data integrity.
* Working knowledge of AWS services and cloud deployment concepts.
* Hands-on Node.js development experience.
* Proficiency with Git-based source control, pull-request workflows, and Maven or comparable build tooling.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams and using Jira for backlog, sprint, and defect management.
* Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills, including production-issue investigation.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate independently across technical and business teams.

**Good-to-Have Skills**

* Experience with Angular and TypeScript front-end development in applications backed by Java microservices.
* Familiarity with OpenAPI/Swagger, API gateways, service discovery, and observability/monitoring tools.
* Experience with test-driven development, JUnit, Mockito, integration testing, and code-coverage tools such as JaCoCo.
* Experience designing or operating CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices, including automated builds, deployments, and release management.
* Familiarity with AI concepts and practical integration of AI services or capabilities into enterprise applications.
* Experience in regulated, scientific, healthcare, life-sciences, or other quality-sensitive software environments.

title: SDE I - Golang
description:
**Hiring for Swiggy**
— via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role.

**About the Company**

Swiggy is India's leading on-demand delivery and convenience platform: food delivery, Instamart quick commerce, dining out and more, used by millions of people every day. Its engineering runs on real-time systems at very large scale, with hundreds of microservices on the order path from app home page to doorstep. The backend team is growing with the business, and this hire joins the engineers building the Go services behind it.

**About the Role**

As an SDE I on the Go backend, you'll build and own microservices and APIs that serve millions of users. You'll write production Go from day one, make services faster and more reliable, and work with product and engineering teams across Swiggy. The role is based in Bengaluru and is hybrid.

**What you'll do**

* Build backend components and microservices in Go, using its standard library and ecosystem.
* Design and implement RESTful APIs and integrations between Swiggy services.
* Tune Go services for response time, stability and efficiency: concurrency, memory and runtime behaviour.
* Maintain, refactor and troubleshoot backend codebases so services stay highly available.
* Take part in code reviews, deployments, service monitoring and backend infrastructure work.
* Work with engineering and cross-functional teams, and suggest improvements to how Go is used across services.

**What you bring**

* 1–4 years of professional software engineering experience, with at least 1 year building backend services in Go.
* Has shipped a Go service or API to production and can explain how it works, how it scales and what you changed.
* A solid grasp of REST APIs, microservices architecture and backend system design.
* Hands-on experience with Go concurrency (goroutines, channels) and with performance or memory tuning.
* Comfort with CI/CD, Git and cloud-native practices (containers, cloud deployments).
* Clear communication about API behaviour, and the ability to deliver quickly in a fast-moving team.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with Kafka or other message queues, Redis, and SQL/NoSQL databases.
* Docker, Kubernetes and AWS in production.
* Backend experience at a consumer, fintech or other high-scale product company.
* Able to join immediately or at short notice.

title: Senior Software Engineer — Distributed Systems (Rust)
description:
**Role: Senior Software Engineer — Distributed Systems (Rust)**

**Experience:**
5 - 8 Years

**Education:**
B.Tech/Master's

**Location:**
Bengaluru (Work from office)

**Join Our Journey at VuNet**

**VuNet**
is a pioneer in
*Business Journey Observability*
, leveraging Big Data and Machine Learning to transform digital experiences across the financial services. Our deep-tech platform provides end-to-end visibility into customer journeys — empowering proactive issue resolution, operational resilience, and superior user satisfaction.

If you’ve ever used instant payment systems like UPI, chances are you’ve already experienced the power of our platform — we monitor over
*28 billion digital transactions monthly*

(that’s equal to watching 3 years of tik-tok videos)
**,**
*touching 300 million users*
with leading banks and financial institutions
*.*

VuNet is Series B funded, part of NASSCOM DeepTech Club, awarded NASSCOM’s AI Gamechanger, recognized in Forbes DGEMS 200 and by several global analysts including Gartner, Omdia.

We’re building a new category of observability purpose-built for complex digital journeys — across payments, lending, core banking and more — already powering some of the largest banks in India and MEA.

**Your Role: Senior Software Engineer — Distributed Systems (Rust)**

We are building the database and cold-storage tier for observability data at petabyte scale, with a focus on making telemetry data cost-efficient to store and fast to query.

Our technology stack is centered around Rust and Apache DataFusion, and we are looking for a Senior Software Engineer who enjoys solving hard problems across distributed systems, database engines, query execution, and storage.

You will have the opportunity to shape the architecture of a critical data platform from the ground up and work on systems that ingest and query logs, metrics, and traces.

**Roles & Responsibilities**

* Design and build scalable and reliable systems for storing and querying observability data.
* Build database and storage components using Rust and Apache DataFusion.
* Work across the query engine and storage layers, including query planning, execution, optimization, and data access.
* Design distributed systems for high throughput, low latency, fault tolerance, and horizontal scalability.
* Work with columnar and analytical data formats such as Apache Arrow and Parquet.
* Optimize query performance across CPU, memory, I/O, and network boundaries.
* Design systems for efficient cold-tier storage, balancing storage cost, query performance, and data retention requirements.
* Build production-grade systems with strong observability, reliability, and operational characteristics.
* Participate in architecture and design reviews and make pragmatic technology trade-offs.

**What we are looking for**

* 5+ years of software engineering experience, with significant time spent on backend or infrastructure systems.
* At least 3 years of hands-on Rust programming, including production systems you have shipped and operated. This is a hard requirement.
* Strong understanding of distributed systems and database fundamentals.
* Hands-on experience with one or more of: Query engines, Databases, Distributed storage, Data processing systems, Search/indexing systems, Analytics platforms
* Strong understanding of concurrency, parallelism, memory management, and networking.
* Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, and system design.
* Experience with Kubernetes — deploying, operating, and debugging stateful workloads in production.
* Strong debugging and performance-profiling skills.
* Experience taking systems from design through to reliable operation at scale.

**Good to Have**

* Experience with Apache DataFusion or other query engines such as Spark, Trino, DuckDB, ClickHouse, or Velox.
* Experience contributing to or working with open-source database/query-engine projects.
* Experience with Go.
* Experience with observability systems and telemetry data, particularly logs, metrics, and traces.
* Experience with time-series or analytical databases.
* Familiarity with Apache Arrow, Parquet, Delta Lake, or Iceberg.
* Experience with cloud object storage such as S3, GCS, or Azure Blob Storage, including compaction, indexing, and tiered storage over object stores.
* Experience with cloud-native infrastructure beyond Kubernetes itself — operators, service meshes, and cloud-native storage and networking.

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
From Fivetran's founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We're proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.
  
  
**About Us**
Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.
  
  
Together, we're delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.
  
  
Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.
  
  
As we bring our teams and technology together, we're building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It's an exciting time to join us: we're creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.

**About the Role**
Fivetran is building data pipelines to power the modern data stack for thousands of companies.
  
  
We're looking for a Staff Software Engineer for our data pipeline service to build and work on data pipelines that moves data from various sources to data warehouses. The work is very diverse – all the way from patching software to building new connectors operating on our global Kubernetes compute clusters.
  
  
You will be responsible for ensuring the technical excellence for your team and owned services, by contributing to the code, reviewing code, contributing to architectural design and mentoring your junior colleagues. **Technologies You'll Use**
Java, SQL, Cloud Data Warehouses, AWS, GCP, Azure, Oracle, Grafana
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* You'll be working with Cloud APIs, SQL, and NoSQL databases etc.

* As a technical leader in the team, you will drive engineering excellence within the technology team, come up with architecture and design, work closely with engineers in the team to review designs, and contribute directly to code.

**Skills We're Looking For**

* 8+ years of software engineering experience with a track record of leading complex, team-scope technical work to completion
* Experience in architecting reliable distributed systems, with an emphasis on high-volume data management within enterprise and/or web-scale products and platforms that operate under strict SLAs
* Experience and expertise in building back-end services and data systems
* Broad technical knowledge which encompasses Software development and automation
* Experience with use of wide array of algorithms and data structures
* Strong knowledge and expertise in working with Java, AWS, Cloud-based APIs, databases, data warehouses, software design and programming best practices
* Entrepreneurial mindset, excellent communication, and technical leadership skills
* Mentoring and guiding junior staff
* Create and contribute to an environment that is geared to innovation, high productivity, high quality and customer service
* Strong knowledge and expertise in writing SQL queries and understanding of query execution plans
* Proficiency with observability tools like Grafana
* Understand how to use AI code assist and coding agents to automatically generate code for features, bugs, testing, and investigation
* Ability to use conversational AI systems (like Claude, ChatGPT, and internal chatbots) to support researching, authoring, reviewing, and synthesizing various SDLC artifacts such as TDDs, PRDs, Postmortems, Test Plans, and Proposals

**Bonus Skills**

* Experience in data processing (ETL, ELT) and/or cloud-based platforms

You will architect solutions, ensure timely developement of features, mentor talented engineers, and remain actively involved with team operations.

+ Collaborate across teams to architect scalable, resilient, and elegant solutions.

* Strategic Planning and Roadmap Execution:

+ Estimate delivery timelines accurately and execute flawlessly.

* Technology Exploration and Implementation:

+ Research and recommend new technologies or tools that enhance system performance, stability, and development processes.
+ Be the catalyst for adopting best practices and cutting-edge approaches.

* Security and Scalability Champion:

+ Ensure that our full-stack software solutions adhere to security best practices.
+ Architect systems that can scale effortlessly as our user base grows.

* Innovation and Reliability Advocate:

+ Investigate emerging technologies and processes.
+ Prototype solutions that elevate the feature set, speed, and reliability of our Radancy CRM platform.

* Deployment and Support:

+ Participate in production deployments, ensuring smooth transitions.
+ Provide technical troubleshooting and debug support when needed.

* Technical Documentation and Mentorship:

+ Maintain comprehensive technical documentation.
+ Mentor junior developers, sharing your expertise and fostering their growth.
+ Ensure the team has the necessary resources, knowledge, and tools to succeed in achieving objectives and delivering solutions effectively.

* Roadmap Contribution:

+ Collaborate closely with Product and Engineering peers, providing technical insights and estimates to contribute meaningfully to roadmaps and long-term planning.

* Risk & Planning:

+ Balance design choices with cost efficiency and scalability, and proactively spot risks early to propose practical solutions.

* End-to-End Ownership:

+ Take full ownership end-to-end—from architecture and infrastructure to monitoring and incident management—for your owned platform services.

* Cloud Operations:

+ Own AWS/GCP-hosted services and ensure they run smoothly and reliably at scale. Evolve infrastructure to stay modern and efficient.

* Compliance:

+ Build security into every stage of development and hosting. Keep compliance documentation clear, current, and accessible for B2B standards.

What You Bring:
  
  
Technical Expertise (Primary Focus)
  
  

* 7+ years of software engineering experience, with a proven track record of leading projects or technically guiding teams.
* 2+ Years of experience leading Software development projects and team of Engineers
* Core Language Mastery: Deep and proven expertise in C#/.NET Core and associated frameworks. (Or expertise with any other high level programming language with willingness to learn new languages as needed.)
* Database Expertise: Solid knowledge of Relational Databases (e.g., SQL Server, PostgreSQL) and experience with NoSQL solutions like MongoDB.
* Cloud-Native: Experience designing, developing, and operating services using Cloud Platforms (AWS and/or GCP).
* B2B SaaS Focus: Strong understanding of the architectural needs for high-availability, multi-tenant B2B SaaS applications.
* Scalability: Expertise in Microservices architecture, RESTful API design, and advanced system components like caching (e.g., Redis).
* Process: Comfort with Agile practices and continuous planning.

Leadership & Attributes
  
  

* A passion for mentoring and enabling other engineers to perform at their best.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills to work seamlessly with cross-functional and global teams.
* Agility to independently own and build initial solutions, executing rapid POCs to de-risk key technical decisions.
* Ability to lead the team with confidence during incidents and technical change requests.
* Analytical skills to drive data-informed decisions on quality and performance targets.

title: Engineering Architect - Full Stack / MERN
description:
Lead architecture, design and delivery of enterprise-scale MERN applications while remaining deeply involved in solutioning, coding, reviews, performance optimization, cloud-native implementations, and engineering governance. The role balances technical leadership with business and stakeholder engagement.
  
  
**Job Description:**
**Required Experience:**
14-20 Years
  
  
**Team Management- Yes**
**Key Relationships**
: Product, Delivery, Architecture, Security, DevOps / SRE
  
  
A senior role accountable for target architecture, engineering practices and delivery governance across a polyglot engineering platform spanning React, TypeScript, Node.js, NestJS, MongoDB/Mongoose, GraphQL Federation, Kafka, Python/FastAPI and n8n-based automation. You set target architecture and engineering standards, and stay close enough to the code to assure designs you approve. You own identity, data, event-driven and AI-assisted engineering architecture, translating strategy into a funded roadmap for the engineering team and its sub-pods.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
:
  
  

* Define the target technical architecture for the platform, including architecture principles, reference patterns, and the roadmap from current to target state.
* Govern architecture decisions through documented decision records, design review, and conformance checkpoints, escalating material trade-offs for approval.
* Architect the React/TypeScript frontend, covering component structure, state management, performance budgets, and accessibility standards.
* Direct backend service architecture in Node.js/TypeScript (NestJS), including service boundaries, API contracts, resilience patterns, and versioning strategy.
* Define the data architecture across MongoDB, covering schema and access-pattern design, indexing strategy, data lifecycle, and integrity controls.
* Own the GraphQL Federation architecture: supergraph composition, subgraph boundaries, schema contracts, entity resolution, and breaking-change policy.
* Establish event-driven architecture on Kafka, defining topic and event contract design, partitioning, delivery semantics, and schema evolution rules.
* Set the identity and access architecture, covering authentication and authorization flows, token handling, session policy, and least-privilege service access.
* Guide the Python/FastAPI service architecture, defining where it is the correct tool, its contract and packaging conventions, and its integration with the wider platform.
* Scope and constrain n8n usage to workflow automation and integration orchestration, defining the guardrails that distinguish automation workflows from engineered application services.
* Own the AI architecture, covering model integration and routing, prompt and tooling boundaries, evaluation criteria, and safety and cost controls.
* Assure evidence-based application readiness for Docker and Kubernetes, ensuring applications correctly consume platform-owned Helm charts and GitHub Actions pipelines rather than duplicating them.
* Set runtime performance and observability standards, including Azure Cache for Redis caching patterns and Application Insights instrumentation, tracing, and alerting.
* Partner with the engineering team and its sub-pods to raise engineering practices, embed the testing strategy across unit, integration, contract, and end-to-end layers, and sustain predictable delivery flow.

**Must Have Skills:**

* Proven technical leadership of an engineering team at Lead Technical Architect or Principal Architect scope.
* Deep expertise in TypeScript, React, Node.js, NestJS, MongoDB/Mongoose and Web Components/micro-frontends.
* GraphQL schema design and federated graph architecture (GraphQL Federation), including subgraph composition and contract versioning.
* Experience with event-driven architecture using Kafka, Schema Registry and Avro, including schema evolution and compatibility governance.
* Experience with identity and access architecture: OAuth2/OIDC, Okta, service-account token exchange and ABAC.
* Working knowledge of Python/FastAPI in a polyglot service environment.
* Experience integrating AI capabilities in production systems, including Azure OpenAI and Anthropic model routing, with attention to prompt governance, token-cost control and PII safeguards.
* Strategy and architecture governance in a cross-functional environment.
* Cloud-native, distributed systems design with deployment readiness ownership for Docker/Kubernetes applications consuming platform-owned Helm/GitHub Actions.
* Demonstrable accountability for delivery, reliability and security outcomes.
* Established testing and quality practice across Jest, React Testing Library, Playwright and pytest.
* Track record of establishing engineering practices and architecture governance that scale across a complex organization.

**Strongly Preferred / Nice to Have:**

* TOGAF certification or equivalent structured architecture practice.
* Kubernetes, Docker, Infrastructure as Code and DevSecOps experience beyond core application readiness.
* Legacy modernization and platform re-architecture at scale.
* Platform engineering or SRE practice — service level objectives, observability and operational resilience beyond core responsibilities.
* Prior integration delivery against Media ocean Prisma or comparable media buying and finance platforms.
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert or equivalent AWS certification

title: Software Development Manager, Just Walk Out
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Lead a new India-based embedded and firmware engineering team for Just Walk Out's edge devices: the cameras, sensors, RFID, gates and networking hardware in our stores, and the device-side software that connects them to the cloud. This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You'll manage 8-12 engineers, set technical direction across firmware, embedded Linux and embedded Android, and partner closely with the US engineering team that owns this charter today.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Hire, coach and develop a high-judgment team of embedded, firmware and edge software engineers, and build an inclusive, high-ownership culture as the team grows in India
* Own the technical roadmap, delivery and operational excellence for your team's firmware and embedded software, from requirements and architecture through release and field support
* Set engineering standards across the embedded stack: firmware and RTOS/bare-metal code, embedded Linux and Android, drivers and board bring-up, secure boot and OTA updates, and on-device diagnostics
* Own the device-to-cloud boundary with cloud teams: provisioning and identity, connectivity, telemetry and remote management, including the device's AWS IoT / embedded-Linux connectivity stack
* Build the test infrastructure, staged rollouts and telemetry needed to ship firmware safely across a large fleet of deployed devices
* Lead the response to field issues, telling firmware from hardware, connectivity or sensor faults, and drive root cause and lasting fixes
* Drive execution with the US engineering team, product and program management, hardware/ODM partners, and cloud, data and UI/UX teams across time zones

  
A day in the life  
You might start with 1:1s and a design review, helping an engineer reason through an OTA rollback path or a latency budget on a constrained target. Later you agree scope for the next release with product and the US partner team, and re-plan the sprint because a hardware revision changed what's possible. In the afternoon you join your engineers on a field issue affecting a few devices at one store, get them the telemetry and a plan, and keep the fix moving.  
  
About the team  
Just Walk Out builds the technology behind checkout-free shopping: the devices, networking and cloud software that let shoppers walk out without stopping to pay. . This India team will take direct ownership of part of that charter, working closely with the US engineering team, hardware partners and the operations teams who rely on what we ship.  
  
About AWS:  
  
Diverse Experiences: AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job below, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  
  
Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  
  
Inclusive Team Culture - Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth - We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.  
  
Work/Life Balance - We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of engineering team management experience
* Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
* Experience partnering with product or program management teams
* Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
* 7+ years of software engineering experience, including embedded systems or firmware development
* Experience leading the development of embedded, real-time, or hardware-interfacing systems delivered on physical hardware

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
* Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers
* Hands-on embedded Linux (including Yocto) and/or embedded Android, with Linux kernel or driver development and low-level debugging
* Sustaining a large fleet of deployed devices: OTA firmware updates, telemetry, and remote diagnostics at scale
* Experience at the device-to-cloud boundary (connectivity, provisioning, fleet management), ideally with AWS IoT / Greengrass and MQTT
* Depth in Android/Linux firmware, secure boot, wireless connectivity, or RFID/sensor devices, plus hardware-in-the-loop testing

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Developer
description:
**#RunwiththePack**
===================

  

At Arctic Wolf, we’re on a mission to **end cyber risk** .

  

We are a global leader in security operations, helping organizations stay resilient against evolving cyber threats through industry-leading security operations, threat intelligence, and a people-first approach to cybersecurity.

  

More than 3,000 Pack members across the world work together every day to protect our customers and empower security teams with new levels of speed, accuracy, and intelligence at scale. What sets us apart is our relentless focus on our customers, innovation at scale, and a collaborative culture where talented people can do meaningful work that truly makes a difference.

  

We’re constantly looking for talented people to join the Pack and help us take our performance to the next level.

**About the Position:**
=======================

At Arctic Wolf, you won’t just watch the cybersecurity industry evolve – you'll help lead the change. Our global Pack is made up of people who thrive on solving hard problems, moving fast, and building technology that protects organizations around the world. We’re proud to be recognized by Forbes, CNBC, Fortune, CRN, Gartner Peer Insights and IDC MarketScape – but what matters most is the work behind it: delivering real outcomes for customers through award winning innovation like our Aurora Platform.

If you’re looking for meaningful work, smart teammates and the chance to make a real impact in a high-growth company that’s redefining security operations, Arctic Wolf is the right place for you!

Our mission is simple: End Cyber Risk. We’re looking for a **Full Stack Developer,** to be a part of making this happen.

**Position Overview and Objective**

Our **Exposure Management Platform team** owns the shared frontend foundation — component library, build tooling, and CI/CD infrastructure for our Portals. What we build is used broadly enough that good decisions scale well and poor ones surface quickly.

We're looking for a **Full Stack Developer** who is energized by that kind of leverage. You'll spend as much time understanding *why* something is broken as fixing it, writing the governance and tooling that prevents the next problem, and being a trusted technical partner to the feature teams who depend on what we build.

This role requires deep expertise in **React, TypeScript** , and good experience and interest with **Backend services(Go, Node js…)** including building Backend for Frontend layers, along with a strong focus on engineering excellence, performance, scalability, and developer experience. You’ll be expected to demonstrate frontend best practices and architectural patterns, and help drive operational excellence across our frontend systems.

**Responsibilities**

As a **Full Stack Developer** at Arctic Wolf, you will:

* Design and develop scalable, high-performance frontend architectures and Portals using **React and TypeScript.**
* Investigate systemic issues across the platform - audit unfamiliar codebases, identify root causes, and produce written findings and architectural recommendations before proposing solutions.
* Build and maintain **Node.js /Go - based backend services** supporting frontend platforms (e.g., BFFs, APIs, tooling services).
* Champion **developer experience (DX) and frontend standards** through automation, documentation, and tooling.
* Guide developers through code reviews, design discussions, and pairing. Be a Vocal member on frontend architecture, platform standards, testing strategies, and engineering best practices.
* Identify friction in the development lifecycle and lead platform improvement initiatives that enhance usability, adoption, reliability, and developer productivity.
* Optimize application performance, bundle size, and runtime efficiency.
* Drive adoption of modern frontend technologies and engineering practices.
* Act as a technical partner to feature teams — balancing platform stability and backward compatibility with the ability to evolve APIs and patterns over time.
* Contribute to Agile development processes including sprint planning, retrospectives, and iterative delivery practices.
Contribute to long-term technical strategy through written proposals and cross-team architecture conversations.  

**Required Qualifications**

* **3+ years** of software development experience.
* Strong Fundamentals in HTML, CSS, Javascript and Web Architectures.
* Strong expertise in **TypeScript** and **React** (hooks, state management, performance).
* **Monorepo experience** at scale (we use Nx — familiarity with task graphs and affected builds is a plus).
* **Server-state management and client-side routing** in a large React application.
* Hands-on experience with **Node.js** and backend service development including Go.
* Experience with **testing infrastructure** : unit, component, and E2E (Vitest, Playwright, or equivalents).
* Demonstrated ability to independently investigate a complex codebase and produce clear written architectural assessments - not just code fixes.
Ability to balance ideal architecture with real-world constraints, adapt quickly to changing priorities, and effectively context-switch across multiple initiatives when urgent platform needs arise.  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Familiarity with:
  + Design systems and component libraries (Storybook, etc.)
  + Monorepos (Nx, Turborepo, Lerna)
  + CI/CD pipeline experience (GitHub Actions or similar)
  + TanStack Query and Router
* Deep understanding of:
  + Web performance optimization
  + Cross-browser compatibility
  + Accessibility (a11y) best practices
* Experience building developer tools (CLI tools, plugins, linters, codemods)
* Experience with frontend build tools and bundlers (Webpack, Vite, Rollup, etc.)
* Strong knowledge of API integration patterns (REST, GraphQL)
* Knowledge of SSR/SSG frameworks (Next.js or similar)
* Exposure to micro-frontend architectures
* Cloud experience (Azure, AWS, or GCP)
Strong understanding of observability and monitoring tools , Ex: Sentry  

  

**On-Camera Policy**

To support a fair, transparent, and engaging interview experience, candidates interviewing remotely are expected to be on camera during all video interviews. Being on camera fosters authentic connection, improves communication, and allows for full engagement from both candidates and interviewers. We understand that technical, bandwidth, or location-related challenges may occasionally prevent video use. If this applies, candidates are required to notify us in advance so we can explore appropriate accommodations.

**About Arctic Wolf**

At Arctic Wolf, we foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment that thrives on diversity of thought, background, and culture. This is reflected in our multiple awards, including Top Workplace USA (2021-2025), Best Places to Work – USA (2021-2025), Great Place to Work – Canada (2021-2024), Great Place to Work – UK (2024-2026), and Kununu Top Company – Germany (2024-2026). Our commitment to bold growth and shaping the future of security operations is matched by our dedication to customer satisfaction, with over 10,000 customers worldwide and more than 2,000 channel partners globally. As we continue to expand globally and enhance our technology, Arctic Wolf remains the most trusted name in the industry.

**Our Values**

Arctic Wolf recognizes that success comes from delighting our customers, so we work together to ensure that happens every day. We believe in diversity and inclusion and truly value the unique qualities and unique perspectives all employees bring to the organization. And we appreciate that—by protecting people’s and organizations’ sensitive data and seeking to end cyber risk— we get to work in an industry that is fundamental to the greater good.

We celebrate unique perspectives by creating a platform for all voices to be heard through our Pack Unity program. We encourage all employees to join or create a new alliance.

We also believe and practice corporate responsibility, and have recently joined the Pledge 1% Movement, ensuring that we continue to give back to our community. We know that through our mission to End Cyber Risk we will continue to engage and give back to our communities.

All **India** wolves receive compelling compensation and benefits packages, including:

Employee Assistance Program

Arctic Wolf is committed to fostering a welcoming, accessible, respectful, and inclusive environment ensuring equal access and participation for people with disabilities. As such, we strive to make our entire experience as accessible as possible and provide accommodations as required for candidates and employees with disabilities and/or other specific needs where possible. Please let us know if you require any accommodation by emailing recruiting@arcticwolf.com. View our Hiring Page to learn more about our application process.

title: AI DevOps Engineer – Platform & Infrastructure
description:
**Hiring for PULS Group**
— via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role.

**About the Company**

PULS is a German manufacturer of industrial DIN-rail power supplies, used by automation OEMs worldwide. Headquartered in Munich with about 1,700 people globally, PULS is building an India-based IT and AI team that works directly with its Munich Software Development department. The team is relaunching the global PULS website as an AI-ready platform for 21 country sites in 7 languages and runs a growing portfolio of in-house AI solutions on Azure.

**About the Role**

You will own the cloud infrastructure, CI/CD and operations behind the new global PULS website and the company's AI and agent infrastructure. The goal is a reproducible, highly available and secure Azure platform for 21 country sites, with committed uptime targets, defined RPO/RTO and restores that are actually tested. You will work closely with the Cybersecurity Engineer, the web developers and the AI team, GDPR-compliant with EU data residency. Coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex are part of the everyday toolkit, including for infrastructure code.

**What you'll do**

* Build Azure infrastructure as code (Bicep for Azure-native workloads, Terraform where multi-cloud is needed), container setups on Azure Container Apps or AKS, and dev/stage/prod environments with preview deployments
* Design high availability with replication and failover, committed uptime targets and defined RPO/RTO with regularly tested restores
* Run load balancing, CDN (Azure Front Door) and caching for 21 country sites, including the China setup
* Build CI/CD on GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps with OIDC instead of stored secrets, rollback, and automated quality gates: tests, SAST/DAST, IaC scans (Checkov, Defender for Cloud) and Core Web Vitals checks
* Set up logging, metrics, alerting and dashboards (Azure Monitor, Application Insights or OpenTelemetry), including integration sync status and cloud cost control
* Harden and patch, manage secrets in Azure Key Vault, run WAF/DDoS protection and backups, and operate managed PostgreSQL/MySQL with replication and safe migrations
* Run Claude Code and Codex headless in pipelines with sandboxes and permissions, and deploy MCP servers and the runtime for AI search and the chatbot with the AI team

**What you bring**

* 4–6+ years in DevOps, SRE or platform engineering on production, customer-facing systems
* Hands-on Azure: Container Apps or AKS, Azure Monitor, Key Vault and Entra ID
* Infrastructure as code with Bicep or Terraform that you wrote and maintained across environments
* CI/CD on GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps with security scanning and automated quality gates
* Has operated PostgreSQL, MySQL or similar in production: backups, replication and performance tuning
* Has designed monitoring and alerting and handled real incidents in live operations
* Works AI-natively: uses Claude Code or Codex daily. Expect live pairing with a coding agent in the interview
* English at C1 level and comfort working with colleagues in Munich and 21 markets

**Nice to have**

* Kubernetes depth, global CDN strategies and China deployments
* Operating LLM/RAG workloads (Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Foundry)
* FinOps and cloud cost control; WAF/DDoS and hardening in production
