description:
**Job Description**
**Innovation Hub Overview**
Jefferies is creating a Technology Innovation Hub in Pune, a greenfield opportunity to build the systems that power global markets. As our first India technology center, this hub brings together hands on builders who engineer the platforms behind Jefferies’ growth across capital markets, investment banking, and institutional securities. We’re scaling toward an elite team of 500 engineers while maintaining the agility, ownership, and meritocratic spirit that defines Jefferies. From cloud and data to AI, risk, and core business technologies, teams in Pune will lead high impact work with a global mandate.
  
  
**IT Infrastructure Technology**
Jefferies’ IT Infrastructure Technology team builds and runs the core technology backbone that enables the firm to operate globally. It covers enterprise infrastructure engineering and operations while driving modernization initiatives such as Cloud Adoption and Network Resiliency. The group supports critical platforms including networking, end-user computing, cloud, databases, server/Unix engineering, communications, and global data centers (including low-latency colocations near exchanges).
  
  
**Role Summary**
Drive Azure cloud adoption and engineering excellence as part of our multi-cloud infrastructure strategy. You will design, deploy, and operate Azure-based solutions, establish Azure best practices and standards, and partner with the broader cloud team to ensure seamless integration with our AWS-primary environment. This role requires deep Azure expertise combined with the ability to navigate a multi-cloud landscape, strong Terraform skills, and a focus on security, governance, and operational excellence.
  
  
You will partner closely with Platform Engineering, Cloud Security, Networking, Identity Teams, Power Platform, Database, Unix, and business line technology teams supporting Equities, Investment Banking, and other divisions. Strong collaboration, interpersonal skills, and customer service orientation are critical as you work across global distributed teams. Experience working in Agile environments using Jira and Confluence is expected.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, deploy, and operate highly available, scalable, and secure Azure cloud infrastructure supporting business applications
* Establish Azure reference architectures, best practices, and "golden path" patterns for workload onboarding aligned with existing AWS standards
* Implement Infrastructure as Code using Terraform Enterprise (modules, state management, workspaces) and Terraform Enterprise for Azure resources; maintain parity with AWS IaC patterns where applicable
* Architect and implement Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) clusters with a focus on security, RBAC, networking, autoscaling, and operational excellence
* Collaborate with Cloud Architecture, Cloud Security, Networking, Identity, Database, and Unix teams to integrate Azure workloads with existing infrastructure and security controls
* Develop and implement Azure governance frameworks: subscription design, management groups, Azure Policy, role-based access control (RBAC), and cost management
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for Azure deployments using GitHub, Bamboo, GitLab, ArgoCD, and Azure DevOps
* Provide consulting and technical expertise to application teams on securely integrating Azure services (Azure Functions, Logic Apps, Service Bus, Cosmos DB, Azure SQL, etc.)
* Troubleshoot complex issues spanning Azure infrastructure, AKS, networking (VNet, NSG, Application Gateway, Azure Front Door), and identity (Azure AD, managed identities)
* Drive compliance and security efforts: implement secure architectures, maintain audit readiness, and support regulatory requirements
* Create and maintain Azure-specific documentation, runbooks, and operational procedures
* Identify opportunities for automation and toil reduction; implement GenAI-assisted workflows where appropriate
* Participate in on-call rotation as needed to support Azure infrastructure and workloads
* Lead or contribute to incident response for Azure-related issues; conduct post-incident reviews and track corrective actions
* Develop runbooks and standard operating procedures for Azure operations; support knowledge transfer to global teams
* Define and monitor SLOs/SLIs for Azure services; drive continuous improvement in reliability and performance
*  Maintain compliance with change management, documentation, and security standards

**Requirements**

* 7+ years in cloud engineering, DevOps, or infrastructure roles with 4+ years of hands-on Azure experience
* Azure Administrator Associate and/or Azure Solutions Architect Expert certification required; Azure DevOps or Security certifications preferred
* Strong experience designing and implementing resilient, cloud-native, and multi-region Azure solutions
* Proficiency with Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS): networking, ingress controllers, RBAC, monitoring, security
* Deep understanding of Azure services: compute (VMs, App Service, AKS, Functions), networking (VNet, NSG, Application Gateway, Traffic Manager), storage (Blob, Files, Disks), databases (Azure SQL, Cosmos DB), and identity (Azure AD, managed identities)
* Expert-level Terraform skills for Azure; experience with Terraform Enterprise strongly preferred
* Strong understanding of IaC, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps practices
* Proficiency in Python, PowerShell, Azure CLI, and scripting for automation
* Experience implementing secure architectures for private and public-facing systems
* Strong understanding of networking protocols, distributed systems, and cloud security best practices
* Excellent communication, teamwork, and customer service skills; ability to partner with global technology and business teams
* Proficiency using GenAI assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, GitHub Copilot) for infrastructure design, troubleshooting, code generation, and documentation
* Ability to implement AI agent-driven automation (agentic workflows) safely in enterprise environments: enforce human-in-the-loop controls, maintain comprehensive logging and auditability, establish guardrails, implement rollback mechanisms, and secure credential handling
* Proactive approach to identifying manual toil and shipping automation that measurably reduces repetitive work; track and report efficiency gains

* Background in software development or systems administration

title: AWS Databricks Architect
description:

**What You'll Do:**

* Design enterprise-scale Lakehouse and Data Warehouse architectures using Databricks, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, and Amazon S3.
* Define target-state architecture covering Databricks workspaces, networking, storage, compute, governance, security, disaster recovery, and environment strategy.
* Architect secure integrations between Databricks and AWS services including Amazon S3, IAM, Glue, Redshift, Lambda, Kinesis, RDS, DMS, Secrets Manager, KMS, CloudWatch, and VPC.

* Drive performance tuning and cost optimization across clusters, serverless compute, SQL warehouses, storage architectures, and platform workloads.
* Define CI/CD frameworks, Infrastructure as Code standards, release processes, testing strategies, monitoring frameworks, and operational support models.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, product owners, infrastructure teams, security teams, and engineering leaders to translate requirements into scalable architecture solutions.
* Create architecture blueprints, reference architectures, technology roadmaps, governance standards, and technical decision records.
* Lead architecture reviews, solution governance councils, and technical design workshops.
* Provide technical leadership, mentoring, troubleshooting, and architectural guidance to data engineering and platform teams.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend architectural improvements aligned with business objectives.
* Support platform operationalization, reliability engineering, scalability planning, and enterprise adoption strategies.

**Expertise You'll Bring:**

We are seeking a highly experienced and visionary Lead AI Application Engineer to join our core AI team. You are an engineer’s engineer, someone who spent years training, tuning, and deploying models at scale, and who has spearheaded Generative and Agentic AI over the last 3–4 years. * Design and implement scalable and efficient AI/ML systems, architectures, and pipelines that can handle large volumes of data and deliver accurate and timely results.
* Regularly self-educate while mentoring and provide technical leadership to other engineers, fostering a culture of continuous learning and excellence.

* Experience: 15+ years of hands-on software development experience, including 5+ years actively building and deploying Generative AI and Agentic AI applications in production.
* Core Engineering & AI Building: Hands-on builder capable of independently architecting, coding, and deploying custom AI tools, autonomous agents, and bots from scratch.
* Programming Mastery: 8+ years writing production-grade code in Python or similar languages with deep expertise in scalable software design, APIs, and microservices.
* Agentic Frameworks & Tools: Deep proficiency with frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, Auto-GPT, CrewAI, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) for multi-agent coordination.
* LLMs & Fine-Tuning: Practical experience with frontier models (GPT-4, Gemini, Claude), fine-tuning, prompt engineering, and custom agentic tool-calling workflows.
* ML/DL Foundations: Background in training, tuning, and running models using PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Scikit-learn in high-throughput environments.

* Data & Memory Infrastructure: Experience building low-latency vector search indices, in-memory caching layers, streaming pipelines (Kafka/Flink), and NoSQL datastores to power real-time agent context and memory.
* Education: Master's or Ph.D. in Computer Science, AI, ML, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent practical experience).

12+ Years of Experience

**Job Title: Distinguished Engineer - Data Architect**

**Role Overview:**

We are looking for a Distinguished Engineer- Data Architect to design and build the data foundation for our AI-driven security platform. In this role, you will own the architectural blueprint and core implementation of our data strategy, transforming massive streams of high-velocity network traffic logs, customer configurations, and security alerts into high-performance, ML-ready data fabrics.

As part of a lean, elite three-person Data & AI team, you will serve as the ultimate technical authority on data scale, streaming architecture, multi-tenant security, and cost-efficient storage systems.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* ****Architect the Core Data Platform:****
  Design, implement, and evolve a unified blueprint for streaming and batch data processing capable of ingesting, normalizing, and storing petabyte-scale, high-velocity security telemetry.
* ****Enable AI & Advanced Analytics:****
  Partner directly with the Lead AI Engineer to architect the underlying storage, retrieval systems, and feature stores—including optimal vector database structures and data lakehouse layers—required for low-latency AI inference and training.
* ****Enforce Zero-Trust Data Governance:****
  Architect strict multi-tenant isolation, data privacy guardrails, and compliance controls directly into the data fabric to protect sensitive customer network configurations and logs.
* ****Optimize Economics & Performance:****
  Drive infrastructure cost-efficiency and performance tuning across data processing engines, storage layers, and cloud infrastructure, balancing ultra-low latency requirements with predictable cost scaling.
* ****Lead by Example:****
  Write clean, foundational, high-performance code for critical infrastructure components, setting the standard for engineering excellence within the team.

**Required Experience & Skills:**

* ****Experience:****
  **12+ years of data engineering and architecture experience, with a proven track record of designing production systems handling massive, high-throughput streaming datasets (e.g., networking logs, telemetry, or real-time event streams).**
* ****Distributed Systems Expertise:****
  Deep, authoritative knowledge of distributed processing and streaming engines (e.g., Apache Flink, Spark, Kafka, Pulsar) and modern lakehouse architectures (e.g., Iceberg, Delta Lake).
* ****Hybrid Storage Architecture:****
  Mastery of polyglot persistence, spanning traditional relational databases, NoSQL, Columnar engines (e.g., ClickHouse, DuckDB), and Vector databases (e.g., Milvus, Qdrant, Pinecone).
* ****Security & Infrastructure:****
  Strong fundamentals in secure data architectures, network topography, encryption-at-rest/in-transit, containerization (Kubernetes), and cloud-native infrastructure (AWS/GCP/Azure).
* ****Mindset:****
  A rare combination of visionary architecture and hands-on execution. You thrive in ultra-lean teams, enjoy writing core code, and possess the pragmatism to build for immediate needs while planning for massive scale.

SonicWall is an equal opportunity employer.

We are committed to creating a diverse environment and are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ethnicity, religion, sex, gender, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other basis prohibited by applicable law.
  
  
At SonicWall, we pride ourselves on recruiting a diverse mix of talented people and providing active security solutions in 100+ countries.

title: DevSecOps Engineer
description:
**Hiring for ClearRoute**
— via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role.

**About the Company**

ClearRoute is a global, AI-native platform engineering consultancy headquartered in London, with an engineering hub in Pune. It helps enterprises fix how their software gets built, tested and shipped, across cloud platforms, quality engineering and developer experience. On this engagement, ClearRoute is leading a strategic platform engineering programme for a large regulated financial-services firm: an AI-enabled delivery platform on AWS that replaces manual, fragmented delivery with a standardised, policy-driven path to production.

**About the Role**

You'll join ClearRoute's AI-first Developer Platform team as a DevSecOps Engineer, based in Pune on a hybrid model (2 days a week in the office). The team owns the CI/CD pipelines every engineer ships through, and builds its own products on top of GitHub, Artifactory and a Kubernetes-hosted marketplace of build runners. This is a hands-on build role in a regulated environment: you build working software, not documents, and what you ship reaches delivery teams the same week. Evidence counts more than years: show what you built, what you measured, and a decision the measurement changed.

**What you'll do**

* Build CI/CD pipelines on GitHub Actions and make the secure, correct path the default, with policy-as-code guardrails (OPA, AWS Config), automated compliance gates and golden paths
* Define and operate self-service infrastructure patterns in AWS CDK and Terraform
* Put AI agents to work on the toolchain: remediation at scale, pipeline upgrades, scanner triage and credential rotation
* Design how autonomous agents are allowed to act, including identity, scoping, audit trail and a stop control
* Build new platform products such as self-serve dashboards, MCP servers, skills and developer tooling
* Build prototypes fast, harden the ones that prove their value, and run time-boxed experiments with a decide-or-kill date
* Make the estate observable through monitoring, telemetry, logging, tracing and alerting, and help run it with zero-downtime practices defined in code
* Talk to delivery teams directly and bring back findings that change the roadmap

**What you bring**

* Hands-on CI/CD pipeline engineering (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps or similar), where teams own their pipelines and security is part of building
* Infrastructure as code with Terraform or AWS CDK, reviewed and tested as code
* Production experience on AWS or Azure
* You've wired security into delivery: scanners, secrets detection or policy checks running as pipeline gates
* You write real code for tooling and services in Python, TypeScript or C#
* Real observability experience: monitoring, telemetry, logging, tracing and alerting
* Test-driven and behaviour-driven development, trunk-based development and pairing as your default way of working
* You've driven delivery metrics toward elite DORA performance and measured a problem before solving it
* Hands-on use of AI tools such as Claude and GitHub Copilot, and real interest in how engineering changes in an AI-first world
* Proactive and self-directed, not ticket-led

**Nice to have**

* Built AI agents, MCP servers or automation that acts on a toolchain
* GitHub, Azure DevOps or Artifactory administration; Kubernetes runner fleets
* Experience in banking, asset management or other regulated environments
* Product instinct: you ask who the user is and what they will adopt before what is technically interesting
* Teaching others through pairing, writing or speaking to engineering teams

title: AVP, AI Security Architect
description:
**Role Title: 2603010 AVP, AI Security Architect (L11)**
**Company Overview**
Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as #3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the #1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
  
  
**Organizational Overview**
The Security Architecture organization enables Synchrony to innovate and grow securely by embedding security-by-design into technology solutions. We partner with engineering, platform, data, cloud, and business teams to translate security strategy and evolving threats into practical architecture requirements, reusable patterns, blueprints, and guardrails. Through risk-based architecture reviews, threat modeling, and scalable security guidance, the team helps protect Synchrony’s digital assets and customer data while supporting resilient, compliant, and efficient technology delivery. This role will contribute to advancing our AI Security Architecture capabilities, helping establish secure patterns and assurance practices for Generative AI, AI agents, and other emerging AI technologies.
  
  
**Role Summary/Purpose**
**The AVP, AI Security Architect**
will design and advance security architectures for Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, Machine Learning, and emerging AI technologies. The role will translate enterprise security strategy and evolving AI threats into practical requirements, reusable patterns, and engineering guidance that enable secure innovation while protecting company, customer, and sensitive data.
  
  
Working across Cybersecurity, Technology, Data, AI/ML Engineering, Cloud, Risk, and Business teams, the architect will lead solution-level security assessments, contribute to enterprise standards, and embed security-by-design through threat modeling, control validation, testing, and continuous assurance across the AI lifecycle.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Apply and help mature enterprise AI security architecture principles, standards, reference architectures, and guardrails.
* Design reusable security patterns for Generative AI, copilots, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), model and inference APIs, autonomous or agentic AI, and enterprise AI platforms.
* Lead security architecture assessments for complex AI solutions across cloud, SaaS, API, data, application, and enterprise technology environments.
* Partner with AI/ML engineers, application teams, cloud architects, data teams, and product owners to embed security throughout design, development, deployment, integration, monitoring, and retirement.
* Perform AI threat modeling using MITRE ATLAS and OWASP guidance, translating identified threats into actionable controls and engineering requirements.
* Define and validate controls for model access, identities, service accounts, secrets, APIs, prompts, training and retrieval data, outputs, plugins, tools, and third-party AI services.
* Assess risks such as prompt injection, data poisoning, sensitive information disclosure, insecure tool interaction, excessive agency, model manipulation, and AI supply-chain compromise.
* Contribute to automation of architecture reviews, threat modeling, vulnerability assessment, control validation, and security testing.
* Document architecture decisions, material risks, trade-offs, and recommendations for technical teams and senior stakeholders.
* Collaborate with Enterprise Architecture, Cloud, Application Security, Data, Responsible AI, Privacy, Legal, Compliance, Risk, and Business partners.
* Create implementation guidance and enablement that help engineering teams adopt approved AI security patterns consistently.

**Required Skills/Knowledge**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Strong experience in cybersecurity, security architecture, cloud security, application security, or enterprise architecture, including delivery of complex security initiatives.
* Practical knowledge of modern AI architectures, including Large Language Models, RAG, vector databases, embeddings, model gateways, AI agents, orchestration frameworks, managed AI services, and model or inference APIs.
* Strong foundation in identity and access management, application and API security, cloud security, data protection, secrets and key management, DevSecOps, and software supply-chain security.
* Knowledge of AI security and risk frameworks such as the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, MITRE ATLAS, NIST AI Risk Management Framework, and Zero Trust principles.
* Experience designing or reviewing enterprise architectures on AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
* Ability to convert technical risks into architecture requirements, reusable patterns, engineering guidance, and clear recommendations.
* Demonstrated ability to influence technical stakeholders, facilitate architecture decisions, and build alignment across teams.
* Strong written, verbal, presentation, and stakeholder-management skills.

**Desired Skills/Knowledge**

* Experience securing platforms such as Amazon Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Copilot, or comparable enterprise AI services.
* Experience with AI red teaming, adversarial testing, model security assessment, prompt-injection testing, or AI vulnerability management.
* Familiarity with NIST AI RMF, MITRE ATLAS, OWASP guidance, ISO/IEC 42001, and evolving AI governance expectations.
* Ability to move effectively between detailed technical architecture, engineering execution, risk discussions, and stakeholder communication.
* Experience developing reference architectures, security blueprints, automated guardrails, and scalable control-assurance capabilities.
* Financial-services cybersecurity, regulatory, risk-management, or data-protection experience is a plus.
* Collaborative and execution-oriented approach, with a focus on simplification, automation, measurable outcomes, and responsible innovation.

**Eligibility Criteria**
Bachelor's degree with 6+ years of experience in Cyber industry, security architecture experience including on-prem and hybrid environments and practical knowledge of modern AI architectures, including Large Language Models, RAG, vector databases, embeddings, model gateways, AI agents, orchestration frameworks, managed AI services, and model or inference APIs.
  
  
**Work Timings:**
2:00 PM– 11:00 PM IST
  
  
We are proud to offer flexibility at Synchrony. Our way of working allows you the option to work from home or workspaces in our Regional Engagement Hubs—Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Pune, Kolkata, or Delhi/NCR. Occasionally you may be required to commute or travel to Hyderabad or one of the Regional Engagement Hubs for in person engagement activities such as business or team meetings, trainings, and culture events.

* Understand the criteria or mandatory skills required for the role, before applying.

* Ensure that your professional profile is updated (fields such as education, prior experience, skills) and it is mandatory to upload your updated resume (Word or PDF format).
* Must not be any corrective action plan (First Formal/Final Formal, LPP).
* Employees who have completed 18 months in the organization and 12 months in current role and level are only eligible.
* L9+ Employees can apply.

description:
**About Northern Trust**
As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
  
  
Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
  
  
With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
  
  
The role combines production engineering, Azure platform operations, DevOps automation, infrastructure as code, observability, and incident management. The engineer will partner with application, infrastructure, security, and business teams to reduce operational risk and deliver resilient services.
  
  
Major Duties
  
  

* Operate and support Azure-hosted applications and services, with emphasis on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), networking, Azure Service Bus, Key Vault, Managed Identity, SQL Managed Instance and related platform services.
* Design, implement, and maintain infrastructure as code using Terraform; apply reusable modules, version control, peer review, and automated deployment practices.
* Build and improve CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and/or Azure DevOps, including automated testing, deployment controls, release readiness, and rollback practices.
* Define, monitor, and improve service reliability through SLIs, SLOs, SLAs, availability targets, error budgets, capacity planning, and performance tuning.
* Create actionable monitoring, dashboards, and alerts using Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Log Analytics/KQL, Prometheus, and Grafana.
* Troubleshoot complex production issues across pods, nodes, scaling, connectivity, certificates, identities, dependencies, and Azure resources; lead incident response, root cause analysis, and preventive actions.
* Automate repetitive operational tasks and implement self-healing capabilities using Python, PowerShell, or shell scripting.
* Support disaster recovery, patch validation, access reviews, audit activities, on-call escalation, and continuous service improvement.
* Communicate service health, incident status, reliability trends, risks, and remediation plans clearly to technical teams and management.

**Knowledge / Skills Required**

* Strong hands-on knowledge of Microsoft Azure, especially AKS, Azure networking, Service Bus, Key Vault, Managed Identity, SQL Managed Instance, and Azure monitoring services.
* Advanced Terraform skills, including modules, state management, environment configuration, code review, and CI/CD integration. Working knowledge of ARM or Bicep is beneficial.
* Practical DevOps experience with Git, GitHub Actions and/or Azure DevOps, CI/CD, GitOps, Docker, release automation, and deployment strategies.
* Strong understanding of Kubernetes operations, container orchestration, ingress/service networking, autoscaling, resource management, resilience, and high availability.
* Observability expertise across metrics, logs, traces, alerting, KQL, latency, throughput, CPU/memory, p95/p99, pod scaling, node utilization, and dependency performance.
* Proficiency in Python, PowerShell, or shell scripting for operational automation and troubleshooting.
* Working knowledge of incident, problem, change, and service management practices; familiarity with ServiceNow and workload schedulers such as Control-M is useful.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, collaboration, and written/verbal communication skills.

**Experience Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* 6-8 years of relevant experience in SRE, DevOps, cloud engineering, platform engineering.
* Demonstrated experience operating business-critical workloads on Azure and administering AKS/Kubernetes environments.
* Proven experience delivering infrastructure automation with Terraform and implementing CI/CD pipelines.
* Hands-on experience with production monitoring, incident response, root cause analysis, performance optimization, disaster recovery, and reliability improvement.
* Azure, Kubernetes, Terraform, or DevOps certifications are preferred.

**Working with Us**
As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
  
  
Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.
  
  
**Reasonable Accommodation**
Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.
  
  
**About Our Pune Office**
The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.
  
  
Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

title: Delivery Module Lead
description:
**Role Description**
**JOB DESCRIPTION - AZURE AI DOCUMENT INTELLIGENCE ENGINEER**
**Intelligent Document Processing | OCR | Extraction | Classification | Insurance**
**Experience**
8+ years
  
  
**Role Level**
Senior Azure AI Document Intelligence Engineer
  
  
**Primary Platform**
Microsoft Azure
  
  
**Domain**
Insurance and Benefits Management
  
  
Role Summary
  
  
Seeking a hands-on Azure AI Document Intelligence Engineer with 8+ years of experience in software, data or AI engineering and strong expertise in intelligent document processing. The role will design and implement secure, scalable document ingestion, OCR, classification, extraction, validation and search workflows using Azure AI Document Intelligence, supported by Insurance and Benefits Management domain experience.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Design end-to-end document-processing pipelines for PDFs, scans, images, email attachments and enterprise repositories.
* Implement Azure AI Document Intelligence Read, Layout, prebuilt, custom extraction and custom classification models.
* Define document taxonomies, extraction schemas, field mappings, table structures and confidence-based processing rules.
* Build ingestion, preprocessing, splitting, classification, extraction, validation, enrichment and structured-output workflows.
* Develop custom models for variable insurance documents and compose models for multi-document processing.
* Implement human-in-the-loop review and exception handling for low-confidence, missing or inconsistent fields.
* Integrate extracted content with Azure AI Search, semantic/vector search, Databricks, APIs, workflows and downstream systems.
* Establish accuracy, completeness, straight-through-processing, latency and failure metrics with test datasets and regression suites.
* Implement managed identities, Key Vault, RBAC, encryption, private connectivity, audit logging, retention and privacy controls.
* Collaborate with data, AI, application, QA, security and DevOps teams and provide technical guidance to junior engineers.

Mandatory Technical Skills
  
  
Azure AI Document Intelligence; Document Intelligence Studio; REST APIs and Azure SDKs; Read and Layout models; prebuilt and custom extraction models; custom classification and composed models; OCR; document preprocessing; confidence scores; human review workflows; Python and/or C#; JSON and schema mapping; Azure Functions; Logic Apps or equivalent orchestration; Azure Blob Storage and Event Grid; Azure AI Search; semantic and vector indexing; Azure OpenAI or approved LLM integration; RAG document preparation; Azure Key Vault; managed identities and RBAC; Application Insights and Azure Monitor; Git, CI/CD, automated testing and infrastructure as code.
  
  
**Experience And Qualifications**

* 8+ years of software, data or AI engineering experience, including hands-on delivery of document-processing or content-extraction solutions.
* Proven experience building production workflows with Azure AI Document Intelligence or comparable intelligent-document-processing technology.
* Experience training, evaluating and tuning classification and extraction models across varied document layouts and quality levels.
* Strong API integration, Python or C# development, cloud security, monitoring and production-support skills.
* Experience integrating extracted content with search, analytics, workflow, data and AI platforms.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science or a related discipline; Azure AI certification is preferred.

Domain Experience
  
  

* Insurance or employee-benefits experience involving policy, plan, enrollment, eligibility, carrier, claims, billing or renewal documents.
* Understanding of regulated, sensitive and health-adjacent information and the need for traceability and auditability.
* Experience with document-grounded AI assistants, semantic search or renewal and prospect document analysis is advantageous.

Core Competencies
  
  
Hands-on engineering, extraction-quality ownership, analytical problem-solving, secure design, test discipline, technical documentation, stakeholder collaboration and the ability to convert complex document structures into reliable, governed data products.

title: Lead AI Application Engineer - AI Research & Innovation
description:
**About Avaya**
Avaya is an enterprise software leader that helps the world’s largest organizations and government agencies forge unbreakable connections.
  
  
The Avaya Infinity™ platform unifies fragmented customer experiences, connecting the channels, insights, technologies, and workflows that together create enduring customer and employee relationships.
  
  
We believe success is built through strong connections – with each other, with our work, and with our mission. At Avaya, you'll find a community that values your contributions and supports your growth every step of the way.
  
  
Learn more at https://www.avaya.com
  
  
Job Information
  
  
Job Code: 00194005
  
  
Job Family: Research and Development
  
  
Job Function: Software Engineering
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a highly experienced and visionary Lead AI Application Engineer to join our core AI team. This pivotal role will be instrumental in designing, developing, and deploying advanced Machine Learning, Generative AI and Agentic AI applications across high-throughput, real-time streaming environments . You are an engineer’s engineer, someone who spent years training, tuning, and deploying models at scale, and who has spearheaded Generative and Agentic AI over the last 3–4 years. This is an exceptional opportunity for an individual who thrives on building sophisticated, production-grade Autonomous AI systems and wants to make a significant impact.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Technical Architecture & System Design**

* Architect and operationalize end-to-end autonomous agentic systems (multi-agent orchestration, dynamic tool-calling, reflection, planner-executor loops, and persistent state management).
* Design robust LLM runtime infrastructure, including hybrid retrieval architectures (Advanced RAG, graph-based context grounding, vector databases, re-rankers, semantic routing).
* Establish scalable evaluation, guardrail, and observability frameworks (latency optimization, cost governors, hallucinations/drift detection, alignment checks, red-teaming).
* Make high-stakes architectural decisions regarding model topologies (proprietary frontier models vs. distilled/fine-tuned SLMs, LoRA, quantization, self-hosted vs. managed endpoints).

Hands-On Execution & Prototyping
  
  

* Lead from the front: write high-leverage production code, design critical framework primitives, and rapidly de-risk zero-to-one concepts via functional PoCs.
* Bridge cutting-edge research and production engineering, ensuring systems are resilient, fault-tolerant, secure, and performant at scale.

Strategy & Cross-Functional Influence
  
  

* Partner directly with the Head of AI, Product leadership, and VP-level stakeholders to chart the AI technology roadmap and identify transformative capability unlocks.
* Lead the exploration and application of Large Language Models, Agentic AI and Generative AI, venturing into new areas within these fields.
* Represent the company’s AI thought leadership through open-source contributions, technical papers, conferences, or industry forums.

**Other Responsibilities**

* Architect, Design and Build robust, scalable, and efficient AI systems leveraging a variety of AI/ML, data science, deep learning, and agentic AI frameworks.
* Drive the integration of complex Model Context Protocol (MCP) and agent-to-agent (A2A) communication protocols, ensuring seamless interaction and optimal performance.
* Design and implement scalable and efficient AI/ML systems, architectures, and pipelines that can handle large volumes of data and deliver accurate and timely results.
* Regularly self-educate while mentoring and provide technical leadership to other engineers, fostering a culture of continuous learning and excellence.

**Who We Are Looking For -**

* Experience: 15+ years of hands-on software development experience, including 5+ years actively building and deploying Generative AI and Agentic AI applications in production.
* Core Engineering & AI Building: Hands-on builder capable of independently architecting, coding, and deploying custom AI tools, autonomous agents, and bots from scratch.
* Programming Mastery: 8+ years writing production-grade code in Python or similar languages with deep expertise in scalable software design, APIs, and microservices.
* Agentic Frameworks & Tools: Deep proficiency with frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, Auto-GPT, CrewAI, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) for multi-agent coordination.
* LLMs & Fine-Tuning: Practical experience with frontier models (GPT-4, Gemini, Claude), fine-tuning, prompt engineering, and custom agentic tool-calling workflows.
* ML/DL Foundations: Background in training, tuning, and running models using PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Scikit-learn in high-throughput environments.
* Inference & Acceleration: Familiarity with inference engines (vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, TGI) and cloud ML infrastructure (NVIDIA GPUs, TPUs).
* Data & Memory Infrastructure: Experience building low-latency vector search indices, in-memory caching layers, streaming pipelines (Kafka/Flink), and NoSQL datastores to power real-time agent context and memory.
* Education: Master's or Ph.D. in Computer Science, AI, ML, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent practical experience).

**Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities**

* Autonomous Execution: Proven track record as a senior IC who takes total ownership—from zero-to-one prototyping to production rollout.
* Cloud & DevOps: Exposure to AWS, Azure, or GCP environments with modern containerized deployment (Kubernetes, Docker).
* Domain & Communication: Experience in contact center/telecom/CX platforms is a plus; excellent technical communication skills required.

**Experience**
12+ Years of Experience
  
  
**Education**
Bachelor degree or equivalent experience
  
  
Advance Degree preferred in Computer Science or Related Field
  
  
Footer
  
  
Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future.
  
  
Avaya is an Equal Opportunity employer and a U.S. Federal Contractor. Our commitment to equality is a core value of Avaya. All qualified applicants and employees receive equal treatment without consideration for race, religion, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran or any other protected characteristic. In general, positions at Avaya require the ability to communicate and use office technology effectively. Physical requirements may vary by assigned work location. This job brief/description is subject to change. Nothing in this job description restricts Avaya right to alter the duties and responsibilities of this position at any time for any reason.

title: AI Adoption Specialist
description:
**Job Description – AI Solutions Engineer**

**Experience**
: 2+ Years

**Role Type**
: AI Engineering

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a highly skilled and client-oriented AI Solutions Engineer with strong hands-on experience in Custom AI Development and a proven ability to interact directly with clients.

This is a core AI engineering role with significant client-facing responsibilities. The ideal candidate should possess strong technical expertise in designing and developing custom AI-powered solutions while effectively understanding client requirements, conducting discovery calls, identifying business challenges, and translating them into scalable AI solutions.

The candidate will act as a bridge between clients and internal engineering teams, taking ownership of the solution lifecycle from requirement discovery and technical consultation to development, deployment, and ongoing support.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. AI Engineering & Solution Development

Design, develop, and implement custom AI-powered applications and solutions based on business requirements.

Work hands-on with AI/ML technologies, Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), NLP, and intelligent automation.

Develop AI agents, chatbots, conversational AI solutions, and workflow automation systems.

Build and integrate AI solutions using APIs, third-party platforms, and cloud technologies.

Evaluate different AI models, frameworks, and tools to identify the most suitable solutions for client requirements.

Ensure solutions are scalable, secure, efficient, and aligned with business objectives.

**2. Client Interaction & Requirement Discovery**

Conduct client discovery calls and technical discussions to understand business challenges and requirements.

Interact directly with international clients, particularly US-based customers.

Understand existing business workflows and identify opportunities for AI adoption and automation.

Translate business requirements into technical specifications, solution architecture, and implementation plans.

Present AI capabilities, technical solutions, prototypes, and proof of concepts (POCs) to clients.

Explain complex AI concepts and technical possibilities in a simple, business-friendly manner.

**3. Solution Consulting & Project Execution**

Recommend suitable AI technologies, tools, and approaches based on client requirements.

Collaborate with internal developers, architects, and cross-functional teams to execute AI projects.

Take ownership of technical discussions, solution feasibility, estimations, and delivery planning.

Monitor project progress and ensure solutions are delivered as per agreed requirements.

Provide technical guidance during implementation, deployment, and post-deployment support.

Manage multiple client engagements while maintaining strong communication and delivery standards.

**4. Research & Innovation**

Stay updated with the latest developments in Generative AI, Agentic AI, LLMs, and AI automation.

Explore emerging AI tools, frameworks, and technologies to improve solution capabilities.

Identify opportunities to enhance existing solutions through AI-driven innovation.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

Minimum 2+ years of hands-on experience in Custom AI Development.

Minimum 3+ years of experience in client-facing roles such as Project Manager, Technical Consultant, Customer Success Manager, Account Manager, or similar positions.

Strong practical experience in developing and implementing custom AI solutions.

Good understanding of Generative AI, LLMs, NLP, Machine Learning, AI Agents, and intelligent automation.

Hands-on experience with Python and AI/ML frameworks, libraries, or relevant development technologies.

Experience working with LLM APIs, AI integrations, prompt engineering, and RAG-based applications.

Understanding of cloud platforms and API integrations.

Ability to conduct client discovery calls, requirement-gathering sessions, and technical discussions.

Strong problem-solving and analytical skills with the ability to convert business challenges into technical AI solutions.

Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Comfortable working with international clients, especially during US business hours when required.

**Preferred Qualifications**

Experience in a service-based company, IT consulting firm, or digital agency.

Experience handling end-to-end AI projects from discovery to deployment.

Exposure to Agentic AI, multi-agent systems, AI automation, and enterprise AI solutions.

Experience preparing technical proposals, solution architecture documents, and POCs.

Experience managing multiple client engagements simultaneously.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

**We are looking for someone who is:**

A hands-on AI Engineer with strong custom AI development capabilities.

Comfortable leading client discovery calls and technical discussions.

Capable of understanding business problems and proposing practical AI solutions.

Experienced in managing client expectations and coordinating with engineering teams.

Able to take ownership of both technical solutioning and client communication.

title: Package Consultant-SAP HANA EPM
description:
A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You’ll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you’ll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You’ll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences. As a Package Consultant: SAP HANA EPM, you will implement and configure SAP HANA solutions for clients, serving as an expert working directly with customers to deliver high-quality results and trusted business advice. You will utilize your deep understanding of and/or hands-on experience in the system to analyze business requirements, design and configure solutions, and ensure successful project delivery. Your primary responsibilities will include:
  
  

* Implement SAP HANA Solutions: Design, configure, and implement SAP HANA BPC, Embedded BPC, SAP HANA GR, and SAP HANA SAC for Planning solutions that meet client needs, focusing on simplicity, amplification, and maintainability.
* Deliver Comprehensive Solutions: Develop and implement solutions, leveraging knowledge of the area and working with the latest technologies, to achieve client expectations.
* Analyze Business Requirements: Understand and analyze business requirements to design and configure solutions that effectively integrate packaged technology solutions.
* Collaborate with Clients and Teams: Embody IBM core values while delivering project goals, building trust with clients and team members through knowledge, self-awareness, respect, clear communications, inclusivity, curiosity, and innovation.
* Ensure Successful Project Delivery: Utilize business and industry knowledge, business processes, and techno-functional solution expertise to ensure successful project delivery.
* SAP HANA Solution Implementation: Exposure to implementing and configuring SAP HANA BPC, Embedded BPC, SAP HANA GR, and SAP HANA SAC for Planning solutions, with a focus on simplicity, amplification, and maintainability.
* Business Requirement Analysis: Experience working with business requirements to design and configure solutions that effectively integrate packaged technology solutions.
* Techno-Functional Solution Expertise: Exposure to utilizing business and industry knowledge, business processes, and techno-functional solution expertise to ensure successful project delivery.

title: BC Sector O And G-Cognite-Senior Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Cognite Solution Architect – Senior Manager**
**Experience Level - 15+**
**Job Description**
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. We’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better. Join us and help build a better working world.
  
  
We are seeking a hands-on Cognite Solution Architect to design industrial data solutions for upstream and downstream Oil & Gas operations. You will define how operational, enterprise and engineering information is integrated, modelled and contextualized in Cognite Data Fusion (CDF), and how applications and analytical solutions consume that information. You will own solution architecture decisions, establish reusable implementation patterns and resolve complex technical issues across source systems, data models, access controls and consuming applications.
  
  
**Role Details**
**Key responsibilities include:**
**Architecture and integration**

* Translate operational use cases into data requirements, integration designs and application-consumption patterns.
* Define how CDF fits within historian, enterprise application, engineering information and cloud architectures.
* Select source-appropriate extractors, APIs and processing patterns, considering latency, throughput, connectivity and source-system load.
* Define historical loading, incremental extraction, reconciliation and recovery approaches, including late records, corrections and supported deletions.
* Establish requirements for service identities, access capabilities, environment separation, monitoring and operational support.

**Industrial information modelling**

* Design CDF models using spaces, containers, views and instances; select direct relations or edges according to relationship semantics and query requirements.
* Reuse and extend Cognite’s Core Data Model where suitable, introducing custom domain concepts where required.
* Define stable identifiers, source crosswalks and conflict-resolution rules, including repeated tag names across sites and systems.
* Represent physical equipment, functional locations and installation history separately where required.
* Establish schema versioning, migration and consumer-compatibility requirements while preserving lineage, timestamps, units, quality indicators and relationship provenance.

**Contextualization and Oil & Gas semantics**

* Design relationships connecting equipment and assets with time series, maintenance records, documents and engineering diagrams.
* Define matching rules, confidence thresholds, exception handling and domain review for ambiguous associations; assess coverage and match accuracy separately.
* For upstream applications, model fields, wells, wellbores, production facilities, equipment, well tests and interventions, preserving distinctions between measured, calculated and allocated production.
* For downstream applications, model sites, process units, functional locations, equipment, laboratory results and maintenance activities, accounting for replacement, revisions and measurement timing.
* Validate that contextualized information supports the intended engineering workflow.
* Application enablement and technical assurance
* Define consumer data contracts covering entities, relationships, fields, freshness, permissions and query-performance expectations.
* Validate designs against representative Cognite applications, custom applications, and analytical or AI workflows.
* Develop critical prototypes and reference implementations using Python, SQL, Cognite SDKs and APIs.
* Establish deployment and environment-promotion practices using version control, automated validation and Cognite Toolkit.
* Review architecture changes, migration plans, integration code and performance bottlenecks; resolve cross-system design conflicts and mentor data engineering leads.

**Must Have Qualifications & Experience**

* A relevant engineering, computer science or information systems degree, or equivalent technical experience.
* Demonstrated personal architectural contribution to a production Cognite Data Fusion implementation.
* Strong knowledge of CDF data modelling, transformations, contextualization and access controls.
* Substantial industrial data integration experience spanning representative operational, enterprise and engineering sources.
* Strong Python and SQL skills with practical Cognite SDK and REST API experience.
* Experience defining identity strategies, model evolution, deployment patterns and production support requirements.
* Working knowledge of cloud architecture, identity providers, network boundaries and CI/CD.
* Strong Oil & Gas implementation experience in at least one upstream or downstream domain, with ability to adapt relevant concepts to the other.

**Good to Have**

* Cognite implementation experience across multiple assets or sites.
* Experience spanning both upstream and downstream.
* Familiarity with historians, maintenance systems, laboratory systems, engineering repositories or well-data services.
* Experience with diagram contextualization, 3D associations and industrial knowledge graphs.
* Experience enabling Cognite applications or AI workflows using contextualized data.
* Relevant Cognite Academy training or certifications.

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to solve high-impact industrial data and analytics challenges across upstream and downstream Oil & Gas.
* A hands-on leadership role with scope to establish reusable practices and guide multidisciplinary teams.
* A collaborative environment spanning domain engineering, data, technology, product and global EY teams.
* Access to EY’s global network, technology ecosystem and learning opportunities while contributing to a better working world.

**What We Look For**
A hands-on architect who can defend consequential production Cognite decisions involving identity resolution, data-model design, access boundaries, recovery, schema migration and application compatibility, and demonstrate which patterns can be reused across sites and which require adaptation.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

**Job Title: Distinguished Engineer - Data Architect**

**Role Overview:**

We are looking for a Distinguished Engineer- Data Architect to design and build the data foundation for our AI-driven security platform. In this role, you will own the architectural blueprint and core implementation of our data strategy, transforming massive streams of high-velocity network traffic logs, customer configurations, and security alerts into high-performance, ML-ready data fabrics.

As part of a lean, elite three-person Data & AI team, you will serve as the ultimate technical authority on data scale, streaming architecture, multi-tenant security, and cost-efficient storage systems.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* ****Architect the Core Data Platform:****
  Design, implement, and evolve a unified blueprint for streaming and batch data processing capable of ingesting, normalizing, and storing petabyte-scale, high-velocity security telemetry.
* ****Enable AI & Advanced Analytics:****
  Partner directly with the Lead AI Engineer to architect the underlying storage, retrieval systems, and feature stores—including optimal vector database structures and data lakehouse layers—required for low-latency AI inference and training.
* ****Enforce Zero-Trust Data Governance:****
  Architect strict multi-tenant isolation, data privacy guardrails, and compliance controls directly into the data fabric to protect sensitive customer network configurations and logs.
* ****Optimize Economics & Performance:****
  Drive infrastructure cost-efficiency and performance tuning across data processing engines, storage layers, and cloud infrastructure, balancing ultra-low latency requirements with predictable cost scaling.
* ****Lead by Example:****
  Write clean, foundational, high-performance code for critical infrastructure components, setting the standard for engineering excellence within the team.

**Required Experience & Skills:**

* ****Experience:****
  **12+ years of data engineering and architecture experience, with a proven track record of designing production systems handling massive, high-throughput streaming datasets (e.g., networking logs, telemetry, or real-time event streams).**
* ****Distributed Systems Expertise:****
  Deep, authoritative knowledge of distributed processing and streaming engines (e.g., Apache Flink, Spark, Kafka, Pulsar) and modern lakehouse architectures (e.g., Iceberg, Delta Lake).
* ****Hybrid Storage Architecture:****
  Mastery of polyglot persistence, spanning traditional relational databases, NoSQL, Columnar engines (e.g., ClickHouse, DuckDB), and Vector databases (e.g., Milvus, Qdrant, Pinecone).
* ****Security & Infrastructure:****
  Strong fundamentals in secure data architectures, network topography, encryption-at-rest/in-transit, containerization (Kubernetes), and cloud-native infrastructure (AWS/GCP/Azure).
* ****Mindset:****
  A rare combination of visionary architecture and hands-on execution. You thrive in ultra-lean teams, enjoy writing core code, and possess the pragmatism to build for immediate needs while planning for massive scale.

As a Configuration Analyst for integrations, you will build, configure, and maintain EDI and non-EDI integration solutions on the Partner LINQ platform, contributing to New Balance’s global digital transformation. title: DevSecOps Engineer
description:
**Hiring for ClearRoute**
— via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role.

**About the Company**

ClearRoute is a global, AI-native platform engineering consultancy headquartered in London, with an engineering hub in Pune. It helps enterprises fix how their software gets built, tested and shipped, across cloud platforms, quality engineering and developer experience. On this engagement, ClearRoute is leading a strategic platform engineering programme for a large regulated financial-services firm: an AI-enabled delivery platform on AWS that replaces manual, fragmented delivery with a standardised, policy-driven path to production.

**About the Role**

You'll join ClearRoute's AI-first Developer Platform team as a DevSecOps Engineer, based in Pune on a hybrid model (2 days a week in the office). The team owns the CI/CD pipelines every engineer ships through, and builds its own products on top of GitHub, Artifactory and a Kubernetes-hosted marketplace of build runners. This is a hands-on build role in a regulated environment: you build working software, not documents, and what you ship reaches delivery teams the same week. Evidence counts more than years: show what you built, what you measured, and a decision the measurement changed.

**What you'll do**

* Build CI/CD pipelines on GitHub Actions and make the secure, correct path the default, with policy-as-code guardrails (OPA, AWS Config), automated compliance gates and golden paths
* Define and operate self-service infrastructure patterns in AWS CDK and Terraform
* Put AI agents to work on the toolchain: remediation at scale, pipeline upgrades, scanner triage and credential rotation
* Design how autonomous agents are allowed to act, including identity, scoping, audit trail and a stop control
* Build new platform products such as self-serve dashboards, MCP servers, skills and developer tooling
* Build prototypes fast, harden the ones that prove their value, and run time-boxed experiments with a decide-or-kill date
* Make the estate observable through monitoring, telemetry, logging, tracing and alerting, and help run it with zero-downtime practices defined in code
* Talk to delivery teams directly and bring back findings that change the roadmap

**What you bring**

* Hands-on CI/CD pipeline engineering (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps or similar), where teams own their pipelines and security is part of building
* Infrastructure as code with Terraform or AWS CDK, reviewed and tested as code
* Production experience on AWS or Azure
* You've wired security into delivery: scanners, secrets detection or policy checks running as pipeline gates
* You write real code for tooling and services in Python, TypeScript or C#
* Real observability experience: monitoring, telemetry, logging, tracing and alerting
* Test-driven and behaviour-driven development, trunk-based development and pairing as your default way of working
* You've driven delivery metrics toward elite DORA performance and measured a problem before solving it
* Hands-on use of AI tools such as Claude and GitHub Copilot, and real interest in how engineering changes in an AI-first world
* Proactive and self-directed, not ticket-led

**Nice to have**

* Built AI agents, MCP servers or automation that acts on a toolchain
* GitHub, Azure DevOps or Artifactory administration; Kubernetes runner fleets
* Experience in banking, asset management or other regulated environments
* Product instinct: you ask who the user is and what they will adopt before what is technically interesting
* Teaching others through pairing, writing or speaking to engineering teams

description:
**About Avaya**
Avaya is an enterprise software leader that helps the world’s largest organizations and government agencies forge unbreakable connections.
  
  
The Avaya Infinity™ platform unifies fragmented customer experiences, connecting the channels, insights, technologies, and workflows that together create enduring customer and employee relationships.
  
  
We believe success is built through strong connections – with each other, with our work, and with our mission. At Avaya, you'll find a community that values your contributions and supports your growth every step of the way.
  
  
Learn more at https://www.avaya.com
  
  
Job Information
  
  
Job Code: 00194005
  
  
Job Family: Research and Development
  
  
Job Function: Software Engineering
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a highly experienced and visionary Lead AI Application Engineer to join our core AI team. This pivotal role will be instrumental in designing, developing, and deploying advanced Machine Learning, Generative AI and Agentic AI applications across high-throughput, real-time streaming environments . You are an engineer’s engineer, someone who spent years training, tuning, and deploying models at scale, and who has spearheaded Generative and Agentic AI over the last 3–4 years. This is an exceptional opportunity for an individual who thrives on building sophisticated, production-grade Autonomous AI systems and wants to make a significant impact.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Technical Architecture & System Design**

* Architect and operationalize end-to-end autonomous agentic systems (multi-agent orchestration, dynamic tool-calling, reflection, planner-executor loops, and persistent state management).
* Design robust LLM runtime infrastructure, including hybrid retrieval architectures (Advanced RAG, graph-based context grounding, vector databases, re-rankers, semantic routing).
* Establish scalable evaluation, guardrail, and observability frameworks (latency optimization, cost governors, hallucinations/drift detection, alignment checks, red-teaming).
* Make high-stakes architectural decisions regarding model topologies (proprietary frontier models vs. distilled/fine-tuned SLMs, LoRA, quantization, self-hosted vs. managed endpoints).

Hands-On Execution & Prototyping
  
  

* Lead from the front: write high-leverage production code, design critical framework primitives, and rapidly de-risk zero-to-one concepts via functional PoCs.
* Bridge cutting-edge research and production engineering, ensuring systems are resilient, fault-tolerant, secure, and performant at scale.

Strategy & Cross-Functional Influence
  
  

* Partner directly with the Head of AI, Product leadership, and VP-level stakeholders to chart the AI technology roadmap and identify transformative capability unlocks.
* Lead the exploration and application of Large Language Models, Agentic AI and Generative AI, venturing into new areas within these fields.
* Represent the company’s AI thought leadership through open-source contributions, technical papers, conferences, or industry forums.

**Other Responsibilities**

* Architect, Design and Build robust, scalable, and efficient AI systems leveraging a variety of AI/ML, data science, deep learning, and agentic AI frameworks.
* Drive the integration of complex Model Context Protocol (MCP) and agent-to-agent (A2A) communication protocols, ensuring seamless interaction and optimal performance.
* Design and implement scalable and efficient AI/ML systems, architectures, and pipelines that can handle large volumes of data and deliver accurate and timely results.
* Regularly self-educate while mentoring and provide technical leadership to other engineers, fostering a culture of continuous learning and excellence.

**Who We Are Looking For -**

* Experience: 15+ years of hands-on software development experience, including 5+ years actively building and deploying Generative AI and Agentic AI applications in production.
* Core Engineering & AI Building: Hands-on builder capable of independently architecting, coding, and deploying custom AI tools, autonomous agents, and bots from scratch.
* Programming Mastery: 8+ years writing production-grade code in Python or similar languages with deep expertise in scalable software design, APIs, and microservices.
* Agentic Frameworks & Tools: Deep proficiency with frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, Auto-GPT, CrewAI, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) for multi-agent coordination.
* LLMs & Fine-Tuning: Practical experience with frontier models (GPT-4, Gemini, Claude), fine-tuning, prompt engineering, and custom agentic tool-calling workflows.
* ML/DL Foundations: Background in training, tuning, and running models using PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Scikit-learn in high-throughput environments.
* Inference & Acceleration: Familiarity with inference engines (vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, TGI) and cloud ML infrastructure (NVIDIA GPUs, TPUs).
* Data & Memory Infrastructure: Experience building low-latency vector search indices, in-memory caching layers, streaming pipelines (Kafka/Flink), and NoSQL datastores to power real-time agent context and memory.
* Education: Master's or Ph.D. in Computer Science, AI, ML, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent practical experience).

**Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities**

* Autonomous Execution: Proven track record as a senior IC who takes total ownership—from zero-to-one prototyping to production rollout.
* Cloud & DevOps: Exposure to AWS, Azure, or GCP environments with modern containerized deployment (Kubernetes, Docker).
* Domain & Communication: Experience in contact center/telecom/CX platforms is a plus; excellent technical communication skills required.

title: Integration Analyst
description:
**Who We Are:**
Since 1906, New Balance has empowered people through sport and craftsmanship to create positive change in communities around the world. We innovate fearlessly, guided by our core values and driven by the belief that conventions were meant to be challenged. We foster a culture in which every associate feels welcomed and respected, where leaders and creatives are inspired to shape the world of tomorrow by taking bold action today.
  
  
**Integrations Analyst**
*The largest and most impactful transformation in our 100+ year history is currently underway at New Balance. We have started a digital revolution, investing in exciting new capabilities for both our customers and associates. One of our primary initiatives is the reimagining of our global integration platforms that will unite our core business processes, aligning the demands of our channel sales with the real-time status of our supply chain. By unlocking new support functionality and consumer insights, this platform will allow us to anticipate and better serve the needs of our customers. We’re seeking agile thinkers who can quickly adapt in a collaborative, high-performance culture. Are you ready to join the revolution?*
**General Summary:**
As a Configuration Analyst for integrations, you will build, configure, and maintain EDI and non-EDI integration solutions on the Partner LINQ platform, contributing to New Balance’s global digital transformation. You will play a central role in migrating legacy IBM Sterling EDI and Cleo Harmony MFT integrations onto Partner LINQ — configuring mappings, orchestration flows, and business rules — helping drive New Balance to be a Top 3 Global Athletic Brand through responsive, standardized integration workflows that support consistent business growth, expand market share, and strengthen brand equity and reputation
  
  
**MAJOR ACCOUNTABILTIES:**

* Create and configure mappings, process/orchestration flows, business rules, cross-reference schemas, and lookups within the PartnerLinQ Design Studio to meet business requirements.
* Convert existing IBM Sterling maps and Cleo MFT flows to PartnerLinQ, leveraging AI Mapping Agent / template-based tooling to standardize and optimize designs for reuse.
* Perform unit testing on all integrations, coordinate with end-system teams, and support SIT and UAT cycles, producing test result reports against production sample files.
* Manage controlled promotion of tested configurations (mappings, alerts, dashboards, partnerships) from lower to production environments, validating dependencies and completeness before migration.

title: Senior Data Architect
description:
**About Position:**

We are seeking an experienced Senior Data Architect with 10 to 16 years of experience in designing and implementing enterprise-scale cloud data platforms. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in Snowflake, AWS, ETL/ELT frameworks, data warehousing, data lakes, and cloud-native architectures. This role requires strong architectural leadership to drive data modernization, migration, governance, integration, and analytics initiatives while delivering scalable, secure, and cost-optimized data solutions.

* **Role: Senior Data Architect - Snowflake & AWS**
* **Location: Pune**
* **Experience: 10 to 16 Years**
* **Job Type: Full-Time Employment**

**What You'll Do:**

* Design end-to-end cloud data architectures leveraging Snowflake, AWS, and modern data platform technologies.
* Define architecture standards and implementation strategies for Data Warehouses, Data Lakes, Lakehouse platforms, and analytics ecosystems.
* Architect scalable and resilient ETL/ELT pipelines supporting batch, near real-time, and real-time data processing workloads.
* Lead modernization and migration initiatives from legacy and on-premises systems to Snowflake on AWS.
* Design Snowflake environments including databases, schemas, virtual warehouses, security models, resource monitors, and workload management strategies.
* Build data ingestion and integration frameworks using AWS services such as S3, Glue, Lambda, DMS, Kinesis, and other cloud-native technologies.
* Define enterprise data modeling standards, metadata strategies, data governance frameworks, and integration patterns.
* Optimize Snowflake environments for performance, scalability, concurrency, reliability, and cost efficiency.
* Establish security, compliance, and governance standards including RBAC, encryption, masking policies, auditing, and access management.
* Define CI/CD, automation, deployment, monitoring, and operational best practices for enterprise data platforms.
* Partner with business stakeholders, data engineers, architects, security teams, and cloud teams to convert business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Conduct architecture reviews, technology assessments, and solution design workshops.
* Provide technical leadership, mentoring, and guidance to Data Engineering and Analytics teams.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex performance, scalability, integration, and platform architecture challenges.
* Drive adoption of best practices across cloud data engineering and enterprise data management initiatives.

**Expertise You'll Bring:**

* 10 to 16 years of overall IT experience with significant experience in Data Architecture, Cloud Data Platforms, and Enterprise Analytics solutions.
* Extensive hands-on expertise in designing and implementing Snowflake-based data architectures.
* Strong experience with Snowflake components including databases, schemas, virtual warehouses, RBAC, Snowpipe, Streams & Tasks, Secure Data Sharing, and Time Travel.
* Deep understanding of AWS cloud services including Amazon S3, AWS Glue, Lambda, IAM, KMS, DMS, CloudWatch, Kinesis, and related data platform services.
* Proven experience architecting enterprise-scale ETL/ELT frameworks, data ingestion processes, and integration solutions.
* Strong expertise in Data Warehousing, Data Lakes, Lakehouse architectures, and analytical data platforms.
* Proficiency in data modeling techniques including dimensional modeling, star schema, snowflake schema, and enterprise data architecture principles.
* Experience with structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data processing across large-scale environments.
* Strong understanding of cloud security, governance, compliance, data privacy, and access management frameworks.
* Expertise in Snowflake performance tuning, query optimization, workload management, storage optimization, and cloud cost management.
* Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, infrastructure automation, and data platform monitoring strategies.
* Strong understanding of modern cloud-native architecture patterns and scalable distributed systems.
* Excellent stakeholder management, architecture governance, communication, and presentation skills.
* Proven ability to lead technical discussions, influence architecture decisions, and guide engineering teams across large transformation programs.

**Benefits:**

* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company-sponsored higher education and certifications
* Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies
* Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards
