title: BC Sector O And G-Cognite-Senior Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Cognite Solution Architect – Senior Manager**
**Experience Level - 15+**
**Job Description**
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. We’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better. Join us and help build a better working world.
  
  
We are seeking a hands-on Cognite Solution Architect to design industrial data solutions for upstream and downstream Oil & Gas operations. You will define how operational, enterprise and engineering information is integrated, modelled and contextualized in Cognite Data Fusion (CDF), and how applications and analytical solutions consume that information. You will own solution architecture decisions, establish reusable implementation patterns and resolve complex technical issues across source systems, data models, access controls and consuming applications.
  
  
**Role Details**
**Key responsibilities include:**
**Architecture and integration**

* Translate operational use cases into data requirements, integration designs and application-consumption patterns.
* Define how CDF fits within historian, enterprise application, engineering information and cloud architectures.
* Select source-appropriate extractors, APIs and processing patterns, considering latency, throughput, connectivity and source-system load.
* Define historical loading, incremental extraction, reconciliation and recovery approaches, including late records, corrections and supported deletions.
* Establish requirements for service identities, access capabilities, environment separation, monitoring and operational support.

**Industrial information modelling**

* Design CDF models using spaces, containers, views and instances; select direct relations or edges according to relationship semantics and query requirements.
* Reuse and extend Cognite’s Core Data Model where suitable, introducing custom domain concepts where required.
* Define stable identifiers, source crosswalks and conflict-resolution rules, including repeated tag names across sites and systems.
* Represent physical equipment, functional locations and installation history separately where required.
* Establish schema versioning, migration and consumer-compatibility requirements while preserving lineage, timestamps, units, quality indicators and relationship provenance.

**Contextualization and Oil & Gas semantics**

* Design relationships connecting equipment and assets with time series, maintenance records, documents and engineering diagrams.
* Define matching rules, confidence thresholds, exception handling and domain review for ambiguous associations; assess coverage and match accuracy separately.
* For upstream applications, model fields, wells, wellbores, production facilities, equipment, well tests and interventions, preserving distinctions between measured, calculated and allocated production.
* For downstream applications, model sites, process units, functional locations, equipment, laboratory results and maintenance activities, accounting for replacement, revisions and measurement timing.
* Validate that contextualized information supports the intended engineering workflow.
* Application enablement and technical assurance
* Define consumer data contracts covering entities, relationships, fields, freshness, permissions and query-performance expectations.
* Validate designs against representative Cognite applications, custom applications, and analytical or AI workflows.
* Develop critical prototypes and reference implementations using Python, SQL, Cognite SDKs and APIs.
* Establish deployment and environment-promotion practices using version control, automated validation and Cognite Toolkit.
* Review architecture changes, migration plans, integration code and performance bottlenecks; resolve cross-system design conflicts and mentor data engineering leads.

**Must Have Qualifications & Experience**

* A relevant engineering, computer science or information systems degree, or equivalent technical experience.
* Demonstrated personal architectural contribution to a production Cognite Data Fusion implementation.
* Strong knowledge of CDF data modelling, transformations, contextualization and access controls.
* Substantial industrial data integration experience spanning representative operational, enterprise and engineering sources.
* Strong Python and SQL skills with practical Cognite SDK and REST API experience.
* Experience defining identity strategies, model evolution, deployment patterns and production support requirements.
* Working knowledge of cloud architecture, identity providers, network boundaries and CI/CD.
* Strong Oil & Gas implementation experience in at least one upstream or downstream domain, with ability to adapt relevant concepts to the other.

**Good to Have**

* Cognite implementation experience across multiple assets or sites.
* Experience spanning both upstream and downstream.
* Familiarity with historians, maintenance systems, laboratory systems, engineering repositories or well-data services.
* Experience with diagram contextualization, 3D associations and industrial knowledge graphs.
* Experience enabling Cognite applications or AI workflows using contextualized data.
* Relevant Cognite Academy training or certifications.

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to solve high-impact industrial data and analytics challenges across upstream and downstream Oil & Gas.
* A hands-on leadership role with scope to establish reusable practices and guide multidisciplinary teams.
* A collaborative environment spanning domain engineering, data, technology, product and global EY teams.
* Access to EY’s global network, technology ecosystem and learning opportunities while contributing to a better working world.

**What We Look For**
A hands-on architect who can defend consequential production Cognite decisions involving identity resolution, data-model design, access boundaries, recovery, schema migration and application compatibility, and demonstrate which patterns can be reused across sites and which require adaptation.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Hybrid, based in Delhi NCR. The team works remotely, with one day a week in the Gurgaon office. Candidates outside NCR are considered only if they are already relocating to NCR and can join within a month.

Round 1 is a coding and design round with the CPTO (open book, AI tools allowed). A second round follows only if something is left unclear, then a final conversation of about 30 minutes with the CEO. There are two to three rounds in total.

: - Accenture GN’s Data & AI (AI Hub India) practice help our clients grow their business in entirely new ways. From strategy to execution, Accenture works with organizations to develop analytic capabilities - from accessing and reporting on data to predictive modelling – to outperform the competition.
  
  
**WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?**
As part of our Analytics practice, you will join a worldwide network of over 20k+ smart and driven colleagues experienced in leading AI/ML/Statistical tools/Agentic AI systems, methods and applications. From data to analytics and insights to actions, our forward-thinking consultants provide analytically-informed, issue-based insights at scale to help our clients improve outcomes and achieve high performance.
  
  
**What You Would Do In This Role**
A Consultant/Manager/Analyst for Customer Data Platforms serves as the day-to-day marketing technology point of contact and helps our clients get value out of their investment into a Customer Data Platform (CDP) by developing a strategic roadmap focused on personalized activation. You will be working with a multidisciplinary team of Solution Architects, Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and Digital Marketers.
  
  
As part of that, we are seeking a highly skilled Consultant/Manager/Analyst to architect, build, and operationalize custom Customer Data Platforms (CDPs), Agentic AI systems and marketing data solutions on the Google Cloud Platform (GCP). You will be at the intersection of data engineering, MLOps, and marketing technology, building the foundational infrastructure that enables our clients to understand their customers, predict their needs, and deliver personalized experiences at scale.
  
  
**Key Duties and Responsibilities: (GCP CDP)**

* Architect & Design: Lead the technical design and architecture of enterprise-grade, custom CDPs and marketing data warehouses on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Build Production-Grade Data Pipelines: Engineer robust, scalable, and automated data pipelines for both streaming and batch ingestion using services like Cloud Dataflow, Pub/Sub, and Cloud Functions. Containerize processing jobs with Docker for portability and scalability.
* Model for Insight & Activation: Design and implement data models in BigQuery optimized for customer identity resolution, 360-degree profile creation, segmentation, and analytics.
* Champion DevOps & MLOps: Champion and implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform. Build CI/CD pipelines using Cloud Build to automate testing and deployment, manage container images in Artifact Registry, and secure credentials using Google Secret Manager.
* Deploy & Serve: Develop and deploy containerized, serverless APIs (using Docker and Cloud Run) for real-time data ingestion and activation, feeding customer segments and triggers into marketing platforms.
* Operationalize Machine Learning: Collaborate with data scientists to productionize ML models (e.g., propensity, LTV, segmentation) using the Vertex AI platform. Build automated training pipelines, and deploy models for real-time inference.
* Collaborate & Innovate: Work within a multi-disciplinary team to translate business requirements into technical solutions, prototype new approaches, and provide expert guidance on the art of the possible with GCP and modern data engineering.
* Ensure Governance & Security: Implement solutions that adhere to data governance best practices and privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR, CCPA), ensuring data is handled securely and ethically.

**Key Duties and Responsibilities: (RTCDP)**

* Be a platform expert in Adobe RTCDP (Adobe Real time CDP). Developer level expertise on Adobe RTCDP (Adobe Experience Platform) is a must with other CDP platforms like Lytics, Segment, Amperity, Tealium, Treasure Data etc. including custom build CDPs as an added advantage
* Deep developer level expertise for real time event tracking for web analytics e.g., Google Tag Manager, Adobe Launch, Adobe Web SDK, etc.
* Provide deep domain expertise in our client’s business and broad knowledge of digital marketing together with a Marketing Strategist industry
* Deep expert level knowledge of reporting tools like GA360/GA4, Adobe Analytics, Customer Journey Analytics
* Deep expert level knowledge of paid media destinations - Google Ads, DV360, Campaign Manager, Facebook Ads Manager, The Trading desk etc.
* Deep developer expertise for Journey Orchestration and Personalization tools like Adobe Target, Adobe Campaign, Adobe Journey Optimizer

* Translate business requirements into BRDs, CDP customer analytics use cases, structure technical solution
* Prioritize CDP use cases together with the client.
* Create a strategic CDP roadmap focused on data driven marketing activation.
* Work with the Solution Architect to strategize, architect, and document a scalable CDP/Martech implementation, tailored to the client’s needs. Able to integrate multiple Martech tools.
* Ensure analytics are consistently implemented across digital properties. Diagnose and troubleshoot analytics/Martech implementation and platform configuration issues. Perform end-to-end QA testing for integrations.

**Key Duties and Responsibilities: (Agentic AI)**

* Architect the core interaction logic and decision-making frameworks for enterprise-grade, agentic AI systems within marketing on GCP.
* Leverage Google Agent Development Kit (ADKs) and APIs to orchestrate complex, multi-step agentic workflows, focusing on reasoning capabilities.

\* Proven track record in handling mass billing job monitoring, outsorting worklists, and reversing/re-billing transactions.

The VKS Application Engineering team is responsible for enabling enterprise success with VMware Kubernetes Service (VKS) as part of VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF). Our mission is to accelerate adoption of VKS as the enterprise-grade Kubernetes platform for modern applications in private cloud.
  
  
As a VKS Application Engineer, you will be on the front lines with enterprise customers, driving the successful adoption of VMware Kubernetes Service (vKS) on VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF). * Lead technical discovery sessions, workshops, and proof-of-concepts to validate vKS architectures and demonstrate business value.
* Partner with sales to jointly develop customer proposals that address modernization goals, workload placement, and operational transformation.
* Provide prescriptive guidance on Kubernetes adoption, DevOps/CI-CD integration, and enterprise requirements such as scalability, security, and disaster recovery.
* Build and share reference architectures, deployment patterns, and technical assets to accelerate customer adoption of VKS.
* Deliver clear, compelling technical presentations to diverse audiences, from architects to executive decision makers.
* Stay current on industry trends, competitor offerings, and evolving enterprise requirements to position VKS effectively.
* Collaborate with product management and engineering to provide field feedback that influences roadmap direction.

* Experience in application engineering or technical sales for enterprise IT, cloud, or application platforms.
* Strong expertise in Kubernetes, containers, and VMware Cloud Foundation (vSphere, vSAN, NSX as foundation).
* 10+ years in technology-related roles, with depth in enterprise IT architecture, application modernization, or cloud-native platforms.
* Demonstrated success working directly with enterprise customers to deliver technical solutions and drive platform adoption.
* Excellent communication, storytelling, and presentation skills with the ability to engage both technical and business leaders.
* Strong collaboration skills, able to work hand-in-hand with sales teams to advance customer opportunities.
* Proven ability to identify challenges, design solutions, and articulate value in business terms.
* Enthusiastic self-starter with curiosity, drive, and the ability to thrive in dynamic environments.
* Ability to travel up to 50% of the time

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or related field; or equivalent experience.
* Deep knowledge of VMware Cloud Foundation and Kubernetes platforms.
* Certifications in cloud-native or public cloud technologies (AWS, Azure, GCP, Red Hat OpenShift, etc.) are highly desirable.

title: Solutions Architect, ISV
description:
**Description**
AWS Global Sales (AGS) drives adoption of the AWS Cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud.
  
  
Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and consistent support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud.
  
  
AWS is where innovation, risks, and ideas are celebrated. We are builders; we try new things, imagine big dreams and reuse whenever we can. It is still Day 1 for us, and we are looking for curious people to be part of our diverse teams of thinkers, problem solvers, and doers. Come join us and work with AWS technologies that enable our Independent Software Vendor (ISV) customers and partners to adopt cloud-based solutions.
  
  
Diverse Experiences
  
  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS?
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
This role is within the ISV team in Amazon Web Services India (AWS India) and can be based out of Bangalore, Delhi, Mumbai, Pune and Hyderabad locations.
  
  
As a Solutions Architect, you’ll help your customers plan their successful cloud journey leveraging emerging technologies like GenAI to achieve business outcomes. You’ll solve complex, technical challenges so your customers can focus on their business. This includes using your knowledge to craft scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures. You’ll drive or take part in technical solutions discussions, diving deep into the details with customer teams.
  
  
Building relationships to understand our customers and partners is key. As a trusted technical advisor, you’ll use your interpersonal skills to influence a variety of stakeholders from technical teams to executives. You’ll help ensure their short-term technology decisions are aligned with their long-term goals. Speeding up the adoption of our services will be part of your day to day.
  
  
You’ll also act as thought leader in the wider community. This includes taking part in educating, sharing best practices, presenting at events, writing white papers, blogs, and running workshops. You won’t just be part of an industry movement; you’ll be leading it.
  
  
As a customer obsessed advisor, you’ll also have the chance to shape the direction of our products and services. This is through gathering feedback from customers whilst collaborating with our engineering and service teams.
  
  
To be successful in this role you need to be passionate about ISV and cloud architectures. You are a builder with genuine curiosity about how technology can support your customers’ business models and objectives.
  
  
Want to find out what it’s like to be a Solution Architect at AWS? Watch this video (https://bit.ly/3keYcC9).
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
The Solutions Architect team at AWS is responsible for helping customers successfully implement cloud technologies. In a typical week you will meet multiple customers, and you will collaborate with them on designing and operating well-architected solutions. You will earn their trust and show them the art of the possible, educating them around the capabilities of AWS. Partnering with internal teams and experts, leveraging a deep knowledge of our tools and products, you’ll craft highly scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures that address our customers’ business problems. As part of our team, you’ll have the opportunity to continuously learn and innovate daily.
  
  
**About The Team**
ISV Solutions Architects work hand in hand with AWS customers to help drive AWS services adoption. They are at the crossroads of business and technology and engage with customers of different stages. Supporting the overall technical relationship between customers and AWS, they work to understand the customer's business needs and give prescriptive guidance on how to create business value with technology. Solutions Architects also have broader impact at scale, taking a supporting role in creating and presenting technical content and best practices.
  
  
You will be part of a team that is responsible for driving adoption of AWS technologies while bringing differentiated value to customers. This is a team dedicated to ISV customers, an important and growing subset of customers for AWS India. ISV customers follow unique technology adoption patterns and growth trajectories that distinguish them from traditional businesses, so you will be employing engagement strategies and programs tailored to their business needs and technical preferences.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree
* Experience in design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures
* Experience in a similar role such as technical account manager, consultant, solutions architect, platform engineer, systems engineer, cloud architect, or service delivery manager

Handshake was founded on a simple belief that everyone deserves a path to a great career, regardless of where they went to school or who they know. Today, we power 25 million job seekers, 1 million+ employers, and 1,600 educational institutions.
  
  
In 2025, we started Handshake AI and built the fastest-growing AI data business in history. * Design, build, and deploy production-grade applications that solve high-impact customer problems

title: AI Architect
description:
Job Description

We’re looking for a seasoned Software Architect with deep expertise in cloud-native enterprise systems and Generative AI. You will define and deliver scalable, secure, and production-grade GenAI architectures — including multi-agent, RAG, LLMOps and AgentOps systems — and lead cross-functional teams to build and operate them. This role combines hands-on technical leadership, systems thinking, and strong stakeholder management.

Key responsibilities

Architecture & System Design

1. Design scalable, modular, and cloud-native architectures for GenAI applications(microservices, event-driven, serverless).
2. Define system boundaries, data flows, orchestration, and integration patterns forLLMs, vector DBs, embedding services, and tool integrations.
3. Produce architecture artifacts ( Layered Architecture Diagrams, C4 Models, DFDs,Class, Sequence, ER & Use Case diagrams, different types of blueprints, APIcontracts, design and trade-off decisions).
4. GenAI & Agentic Systems
5. Architect and deliver Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, NaturalLanguage to SQL Flows, fine-tuning strategies, multi-modal capabilities, and tool-augmented agents.
6. Design agent orchestration and multi-agent frameworks enabling planning,reasoning, and secure tool invocations, implement and design Agent prototypes andCommunication Protocols.
7. Define prompt engineering standards, memory models(episodic/semantic/procedural), and context management.

LLMOps & AgentOps

1. Define and implement model lifecycle pipelines: training, fine-tuning, validation,deployment, rollback, and monitoring.
2. Build AgentOps processes for agent lifecycle, behavior tracking, governance andperformance optimization.
3. Automate CI/CD for models, agents and services (MLflow, TFX, BentoML, custompipelines).

Integration, Security & Compliance

1. Integrate GenAI services with enterprise systems (ERP, CRM, data lakes, APIs) usingsecure, scalable interfaces.
2. Ensure secure access controls, data privacy, encryption, and compliance (GDPR,HIPAA, SOC2).
3. Define responsible AI practices: bias mitigation, explainability, audit trails, andoutput governance.
4. GenAI security — classify, encrypt & sign data/models; enforce least-privilege withshort-lived creds and CI/CD security gates; telemetry, drift/hallucination alerts, kill-switch & runbooks.
5. Agentic AI security — provable agent identity/attestation, tool allowlist + human gatefor high-risk actions; ephemeral scoped tokens, sandboxed execution,and replayable audit traces.

Observability, Ops & Cost Optimization

1. Define telemetry, tracing, and logging for models and agents; monitor performance,drift, hallucination rates and user feedback loops.
2. Build dashboards, alerts and runbook guidance for operational health.
3. Design systems for cost efficiency (autoscaling, spot instances, serverlesschoices) and support FinOps practices.

Leadership, Collaboration & Documentation

1. Lead cross-functional teams (product, data science, AI engineers, platform)through architecture reviews, workshops, and technical decisioning.
2. Maintain architectural standards, documentation, playbooks, and patternlibraries for GenAI systems.
3. Mentor engineers and evangelize best practices across the organization.

Required qualifications & experience

1. 10+ years software engineering experience with 3+ years in architecture or seniortechnical leadership roles (or equivalent).
2. Proven track record designing and delivering cloud-native, production systems atenterprise scale.
3. Hands-on experience with GenAI/LLM systems, RAG, NL-SQL,agentic frameworks or similar productionized AI applications.
4. Strong knowledge of system design patterns (microservices, event-driven,CQRS, hexagonal architecture), and Low Level Design Patterns.
5. Experience integrating ML/LLM services with enterprise data platforms and APIswhile meeting security/compliance requirements.
6. Solid engineering background in at least two languages (Python, TypeScript, Go,Java, C#) and familiarity with modern frameworks.

Technical skills & technologies (comprehensive)

1. Cloud & Infra: AWS / Azure / GCP; Kubernetes, Docker, serverless (Lambda, Functions, Cloud Run), GPU instances
2. GenAI & ML: Hugging Face Transformers, OpenAI APIs, ,LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, Haystack
3. Vector Stores: FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, Postgres+pgVector, and other cloud vector stores
4. LLMOps / MLOps: Custom Development of Ops Pipelines, MLflow, TFX, BentoML, Kubeflow
5. Data & Integration: Kafka, Spark, Airflow, Flink, ETL/ELT concepts, data lakes, API gateways (Apigee etc)
6. DevOps & IaC: Terraform, Pulumi, CloudFormation, GitHub Actions, Jenkins
7. Observability & Security: Prometheus, Grafana stack, OpenTelemetry, Jaeger, ELK, Datadog; Vault,
8. IAM, LDAP/OAuth2/OIDC/SAML Connect, Snyk, SonarQube, SAST/SCA in pipelines, OWASPs, CWEs, CVEs.
9. Databases & Storage: Relational (RDS/Cloud SQL), NoSQL (Mongo, DynamoDB, Cosmos DB), Redis, S3/Blob/GCS, ORM/ODM frameworks.
10. Agent frameworks / tools: Understanding of Basics of Agents required, Langgraph, Autogen, AutoGPT, AgentVerse, MetaGPT, CrewAI etc.
11. Performance & scalability: SSR/ISR, caching strategies (CDN, edge), lazy loading, bundle optimization, performance budgets.
12. Realtime & asyncRealtime & async: WebSockets, SSE, message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ), background workers. Frontend frameworks: React (Next.js), Angular, Vue; component libraries and state (Redux/RTK, Context, Pinia, Zustand)
13. Styling & UI tooling: Component Libraries, Accessibility best practices, Responsive UI
14. Frontend build & tooling: Vite, Webpack, Storybook, UI Frameworks.
15. Backend frameworks: Node.js/Express, FastAPI, serverless functions (AWS Lambda, Cloud Functions)
16. API design & integration: REST, gRPC, OpenAPI/Swagger, API versioning and contract testing, GraphQL(Optional)
17. UX & product mindset: Design-system familiarity, usability, accessibility, and working with designers

Behavioral & leadership skills

1. Strategic thinking with the ability to align architecture to product and businessgoals.
2. Excellent communicator: simplify complex technical concepts for technical andnon-technical stakeholders.
3. Strong mentorship skills — able to raise team capability in GenAI architectureand engineering.
4. Pragmatic decision-maker with a bias for measurable outcomes and trade-offanalysis.
5. High attention to detail, ownership, and accountability for reliability, security,and cost.

Nice-to-have

1. Experience operating LLMs in regulated industries (pharma).
2. Familiarity with prompt auditing, hallucination detection, and automated qualitychecks.
3. Background in knowledge engineering, semantic search, or knowledge graphs.
4. Academic background in CS, ML, or equivalent applied experience.
5. Mobile & cross-platform (optional): React Native, Flutter basics for mobileintegration
6. Deliverables & success metrics (examples)
7. Production-ready GenAI architecture and deployment runbook.
8. Deployed RAG/agent pipeline with observable SLOs and monitoring dashboards.
9. Reduced model hallucination/incidents and measurable improvement inretrieval quality.
10. Architecture decision records (ADRs), standards library, and cross-teamonboarding materials.
11. Cost targets achieved through optimized infra and autoscaling policies.

title: Engineering Lead_ Agentic Hive
description:
Job description:
  
  
Job Description About the Role and Team

Join Wipro's AI-Native Business & Platforms unit, a forward-thinking team dedicated to advancing the future of enterprise artificial intelligence. Our Agentic Hive Platform team is responsible for creating a robust, scalable platform that enables intelligent AI agents, digital ecosystems, and business process automation for our clients worldwide. This team plays a vital role in pioneering agentic AI technology, integrating delivery and client partnerships across India and the United States to drive innovation at enterprise scale.

We are looking for an experienced and hands-on Engineering Head to spearhead the technical vision and development of the Agentic Hive platform. The ideal candidate will lead architecture design, development, and deployment of agentic AI capabilities with a strong focus on security, scalability, and reliability. In this pivotal leadership role, you will guide a dynamic engineering team responsible for delivering production-ready AI solutions and integrating them seamlessly with enterprise systems.

Operating from India, you will collaborate closely with leadership and technical peers based in the U.S., ensuring alignment and fostering innovation across global teams. This is a unique opportunity to influence the trajectory of agentic AI in a large enterprise context, blending deep technical expertise with strategic leadership and enterprise architecture sensibilities.

͏ Key Responsibilities

* Take full ownership of the architecture and engineering delivery of the Agentic Hive platform, ensuring it meets business priorities, is modular, scalable, and aligned with product roadmaps.
* Lead the design and hands-on development of AI agents and automated workflows leveraging Claude and state-of-the-art agentic AI methodologies, including reasoning algorithms, tool integrations, and interactive human-in-the-loop processes.
* Architect and orchestrate multi-agent systems encompassing specialized agent roles, inter-agent coordination, task routing, stateful management, fault tolerance, and seamless tool collaboration.
* Design comprehensive context management solutions to optimize agent interaction, including memory management, prompt engineering, session persistence, enterprise knowledge integration, semantic search layers, and controlled data access.
* Develop reusable enterprise architecture frameworks, APIs, reference implementations, and governance policies that empower diverse teams to contribute consistently to the Agentic Hive ecosystem.
* Provide technical leadership and mentorship to an AI engineering team of 5 to 6 members, driving design excellence, code quality, development processes, and resolving complex technical challenges effectively.
* Establish agent evaluation standards with a focus on safety, governance, traceability, performance monitoring, hallucination detection, and overall quality benchmarks.
* Collaborate extensively with cross-functional partners including product management, UX/CX design, data teams, security, cloud infrastructure, and domain experts to deliver compelling, trustworthy, and user-centric AI experiences.
* Guide decisions and implementations in data science and data engineering domains ensuring robust data ingestion, transformation, retrieval, feature layer development, model integration, and reliable production workflows.
* Champion engineering best practices such as API-first design, CI/CD automation, container orchestration, cloud scalability, cost management, and secure operations across enterprise cloud environments.
* Engage proactively with stakeholders to translate operational feedback into enhanced platform capabilities and to support the adoption of agentic AI solutions across client engagements.

͏ Preferred Qualifications and Experience

* Proven hands-on experience designing and delivering Agentic AI solutions, specifically utilizing Claude AI for agent constructions and automations.
* Demonstrated expertise in multi-agent orchestration architectures, enabling complex agent interactions and integrations with external tools and systems.
* In-depth understanding of agent context management strategies including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), semantic memory modeling, prompt engineering, and secured data governance.
* Strong background in applying enterprise architecture principles to build modular, scalable, and secure platform infrastructures.
* Experience managing and mentoring AI engineering teams, balancing architectural oversight with active technical contribution.
* Robust data science and engineering skills encompassing Python programming, SQL, data pipelines, model development, and production-grade deployment.
* Familiarity with UX, UI, and customer experience design concepts enabling effective collaboration with design teams to translate user needs into AI solutions.
* Experience developing AI/ML or generative AI systems incorporating engineering practices like automatic testing, continuous integration and delivery, monitoring, security considerations, and governance frameworks.
* Strong communication abilities with a track record of managing technical discussions with diverse stakeholders including engineers, product teams, and clients.

͏ Additional Technical Skills

* Experience with agent frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or similar, including orchestration and agent-to-agent/tool interaction (MCP, A2A patterns).
* Hands-on knowledge of retrieval-augmented generation techniques, hybrid retrieval models, semantic search, knowledge graph integration, and enterprise semantic layers.
* Expertise in AI agent evaluation methodologies, including automated evaluation strategies, policy enforcement, guardrails, and metrics like RAGAS for ongoing assessment.
* Familiarity with LLMOps/MLOps tooling and best practices, including version control of prompts/models, experimentation tracking, automated deployment, performance monitoring, and governance.
* Deep understanding of cloud-native architectures on platforms like Azure, Google Cloud Platform, AWS, and Databricks, tailored for AI and data workloads.
* Competence in containerization and orchestration platforms such as Docker and Kubernetes, RESTful API development, FastAPI, infrastructure as code (IaC), and telemetry systems.
* Experience delivering AI solutions in regulated or complex enterprise environments, successfully transitioning from research and prototyping to robust production systems.

͏ Education, Experience & Leadership Competencies

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or related technical disciplines; or equivalent practical experience in these fields.
* Minimum of 12 years' experience in software, data, or AI engineering roles with substantial recent success in generative AI or Agentic AI architecture leadership and delivery.
* Preferred certifications in cloud platforms, AI/ML, data engineering, or related architecture fields that validate technical expertise.
* Proven leadership in managing and scaling engineering teams while maintaining direct hands-on involvement in architecture and development activities.
* Effective communicator and stakeholder management expert capable of articulating complex technical concepts to executives, product owners, and engineering teams alike.
* Comfortable operating in ambiguous, fast-paced environments, balancing innovation with enterprise-grade demands including security, governance, reliability, user experience, and cost management.
* Strong alignment with Wipro's values such as self-leadership, respect, trust building, transformation leadership, and execution excellence to inspire and drive team success.

What Success Looks Like

* Delivering a scalable, reusable, and secure Agentic Hive platform architecture that serves as a reference model across the organization.
* Ensuring all agentic solutions are production-ready, meeting rigorous safety, observability, reliability, and quality standards.
* Maintaining a highly effective AI engineering team, fostering technical excellence, predictable deliveries, and development of reusable components accelerating future projects.
* Driving strong adoption of the platform by internal teams, partners, and enterprise customers via outstanding developer and end-user experiences.
* Successfully aligning multiple stakeholder groups including product management, engineering, data science, security, governance, cloud operations, and client relations to maximize platform impact.

description:
**Hiring for Tarento Group**
— via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role.

**About the Company**

Tarento is a Nordic-Indian technology and consulting firm that helps enterprises with data, digital and enterprise engineering work, with offices in Stockholm, Helsinki, Bergen and Bengaluru. Bengaluru is its largest unit and where most of its technology work happens. This role sits on one of Tarento's enterprise client engagements, an organisation running SAP S/4HANA alongside SuccessFactors, Ariba and a wide set of third-party cloud and legacy applications. The client is modernising its integration landscape, retiring SAP PI/PO and moving to SAP BTP Integration Suite, and needs an architect to lead it. One position is open now, with two more to follow.

**About the Role**

As SAP CPI Architect you will own the client's enterprise connectivity strategy: how data moves between SAP S/4HANA, BTP and every system around them. You will design the target integration architecture, lead the migration off PI/PO, set the standards the integration team builds to, and work directly with business process owners and senior leadership. The role is hybrid in Bengaluru, with one position open to remote work from anywhere in India.

**What you'll do**

* Design scalable integration blueprints on SAP Integration Suite (Cloud Integration, API Management, Event Mesh) and event-driven architecture.
* Define and run the roadmap to retire SAP PI/PO and migrate interfaces to BTP, including dual-stack to single-stack moves.
* Set global integration standards: naming conventions, error-handling frameworks, security protocols and monitoring.
* Lead the integration team through project lifecycles, review iFlows and code, and mentor developers.
* Run workshops with business process owners and leadership to turn business goals into integration requirements.
* Tune performance, run security audits and monitor high-volume interfaces to keep them at 99.9% availability.

**What you bring**

* 10+ years in SAP integration technologies, with 5+ years hands-on in SAP Cloud Integration (CPI).
* Strong SAP PI/PO background, and you have led at least 5 migration or integration projects end to end.
* Have integrated S/4HANA (cloud or on-premise), SuccessFactors, Ariba or IBP with third-party systems over REST, OData, SOAP, IDoc and SFTP.
* Have designed solutions on SAP Event Mesh and API Management, and used Integration Assessment to plan a landscape.
* Groovy, Java and XSLT for complex transformations and custom adapters.
* Solid grasp of OAuth 2.0, SAML, SSL/TLS, PGP and certificate management in multi-tenant cloud setups.
* Hands-on with Transport Management Service, Cloud ALM and CI/CD for integration content.
* Very good communication; comfortable leading client workshops and managing senior stakeholders.
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, IT, engineering or a related field.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with MuleSoft or other integration platforms.
* Based in Bengaluru and able to join immediately.

**About the Role and Team**
---------------------------

Join Wipro's AI-Native Business & Platforms unit, a forward-thinking team dedicated to advancing the future of enterprise artificial intelligence. Our Agentic Hive Platform team is responsible for creating a robust, scalable platform that enables intelligent AI agents, digital ecosystems, and business process automation for our clients worldwide. This team plays a vital role in pioneering agentic AI technology, integrating delivery and client partnerships across India and the United States to drive innovation at enterprise scale.

We are looking for an experienced and hands-on Engineering Head to spearhead the technical vision and development of the Agentic Hive platform. The ideal candidate will lead architecture design, development, and deployment of agentic AI capabilities with a strong focus on security, scalability, and reliability. In this pivotal leadership role, you will guide a dynamic engineering team responsible for delivering production-ready AI solutions and integrating them seamlessly with enterprise systems.

Operating from India, you will collaborate closely with leadership and technical peers based in the U.S., ensuring alignment and fostering innovation across global teams. This is a unique opportunity to influence the trajectory of agentic AI in a large enterprise context, blending deep technical expertise with strategic leadership and enterprise architecture sensibilities.

**͏**
-----

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Take full ownership of the architecture and engineering delivery of the Agentic Hive platform, ensuring it meets business priorities, is modular, scalable, and aligned with product roadmaps.
* Lead the design and hands-on development of AI agents and automated workflows leveraging Claude and state-of-the-art agentic AI methodologies, including reasoning algorithms, tool integrations, and interactive human-in-the-loop processes.
* Architect and orchestrate multi-agent systems encompassing specialized agent roles, inter-agent coordination, task routing, stateful management, fault tolerance, and seamless tool collaboration.
* Design comprehensive context management solutions to optimize agent interaction, including memory management, prompt engineering, session persistence, enterprise knowledge integration, semantic search layers, and controlled data access.
* Develop reusable enterprise architecture frameworks, APIs, reference implementations, and governance policies that empower diverse teams to contribute consistently to the Agentic Hive ecosystem.
* Provide technical leadership and mentorship to an AI engineering team of 5 to 6 members, driving design excellence, code quality, development processes, and resolving complex technical challenges effectively.
* Establish agent evaluation standards with a focus on safety, governance, traceability, performance monitoring, hallucination detection, and overall quality benchmarks.
* Collaborate extensively with cross-functional partners including product management, UX/CX design, data teams, security, cloud infrastructure, and domain experts to deliver compelling, trustworthy, and user-centric AI experiences.
* Guide decisions and implementations in data science and data engineering domains ensuring robust data ingestion, transformation, retrieval, feature layer development, model integration, and reliable production workflows.
* Champion engineering best practices such as API-first design, CI/CD automation, container orchestration, cloud scalability, cost management, and secure operations across enterprise cloud environments.
* Engage proactively with stakeholders to translate operational feedback into enhanced platform capabilities and to support the adoption of agentic AI solutions across client engagements.

**͏**
-----

**Preferred Qualifications and Experience**
-------------------------------------------

* Proven hands-on experience designing and delivering Agentic AI solutions, specifically utilizing Claude AI for agent constructions and automations.
* Demonstrated expertise in multi-agent orchestration architectures, enabling complex agent interactions and integrations with external tools and systems.
* In-depth understanding of agent context management strategies including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), semantic memory modeling, prompt engineering, and secured data governance.
* Strong background in applying enterprise architecture principles to build modular, scalable, and secure platform infrastructures.
* Experience managing and mentoring AI engineering teams, balancing architectural oversight with active technical contribution.
* Robust data science and engineering skills encompassing Python programming, SQL, data pipelines, model development, and production-grade deployment.
* Familiarity with UX, UI, and customer experience design concepts enabling effective collaboration with design teams to translate user needs into AI solutions.
* Experience developing AI/ML or generative AI systems incorporating engineering practices like automatic testing, continuous integration and delivery, monitoring, security considerations, and governance frameworks.
* Strong communication abilities with a track record of managing technical discussions with diverse stakeholders including engineers, product teams, and clients.

**͏**
-----

**Additional Technical Skills**
-------------------------------

* Experience with agent frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or similar, including orchestration and agent-to-agent/tool interaction (MCP, A2A patterns).
* Hands-on knowledge of retrieval-augmented generation techniques, hybrid retrieval models, semantic search, knowledge graph integration, and enterprise semantic layers.
* Expertise in AI agent evaluation methodologies, including automated evaluation strategies, policy enforcement, guardrails, and metrics like RAGAS for ongoing assessment.
* Familiarity with LLMOps/MLOps tooling and best practices, including version control of prompts/models, experimentation tracking, automated deployment, performance monitoring, and governance.
* Deep understanding of cloud-native architectures on platforms like Azure, Google Cloud Platform, AWS, and Databricks, tailored for AI and data workloads.
* Competence in containerization and orchestration platforms such as Docker and Kubernetes, RESTful API development, FastAPI, infrastructure as code (IaC), and telemetry systems.
* Experience delivering AI solutions in regulated or complex enterprise environments, successfully transitioning from research and prototyping to robust production systems.

**͏**
-----

**Education, Experience & Leadership Competencies**
---------------------------------------------------

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or related technical disciplines; or equivalent practical experience in these fields.
* Minimum of 12 years' experience in software, data, or AI engineering roles with substantial recent success in generative AI or Agentic AI architecture leadership and delivery.
* Preferred certifications in cloud platforms, AI/ML, data engineering, or related architecture fields that validate technical expertise.
* Proven leadership in managing and scaling engineering teams while maintaining direct hands-on involvement in architecture and development activities.
* Effective communicator and stakeholder management expert capable of articulating complex technical concepts to executives, product owners, and engineering teams alike.
* Comfortable operating in ambiguous, fast-paced environments, balancing innovation with enterprise-grade demands including security, governance, reliability, user experience, and cost management.
* Strong alignment with Wipro's values such as self-leadership, respect, trust building, transformation leadership, and execution excellence to inspire and drive team success.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

* Delivering a scalable, reusable, and secure Agentic Hive platform architecture that serves as a reference model across the organization.
* Ensuring all agentic solutions are production-ready, meeting rigorous safety, observability, reliability, and quality standards.
* Maintaining a highly effective AI engineering team, fostering technical excellence, predictable deliveries, and development of reusable components accelerating future projects.
* Driving strong adoption of the platform by internal teams, partners, and enterprise customers via outstanding developer and end-user experiences.
* Successfully aligning multiple stakeholder groups including product management, engineering, data science, security, governance, cloud operations, and client relations to maximize platform impact.

title: Applications Engineer - UCD
description:
**Job Description:**

We are seeking an experienced and customer-focused Applications Engineer to support the design-in and adoption of our UCD family of digital power controllers. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in digital power control topologies, embedded firmware, and system-level debug, with the ability to translate customer requirements into working solutions. This role requires close collaboration with design, marketing, and field sales teams to enable customers building mission critical data centres, AI servers, and a wide array of Industrial applications.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Customer design support: Provide technical guidance to customers on the design, configuration, and firmware development of systems using TI ASM UCD devices such as the UCD3138/UCD4138, across applications like Power Factor Correction (PFC), DC/DC converters, and other digital power topologies.
* Reference design development: Design, build, and validate reference designs, evaluation modules (EVMs), and demo boards that showcase UCD capabilities and accelerate customer adoption.
* Firmware and GUI tools: Develop and customize firmware, configuration tools, and GUIs (e.g., Fusion Digital Power) to simplify customer evaluation, tuning, and deployment of UCD-based designs.
* System bring-up and debug: Support customers with board bring-up, system integration, and troubleshooting of hardware, firmware, and communication interfaces (e.g., PMBus, I2C, SPI).
* Lab characterization: Use lab equipment such as oscilloscopes, power analyzers, and logic analyzers to characterize system performance, validate control loop stability, and resolve customer-reported issues.
* Pre- and post-sales support: Respond to customer technical queries via E2E forums, service requests, and direct engagement, including both pre-sales design consultation and post-sales production support.
* Cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with design, test, marketing, and field sales teams to relay customer feedback, influence roadmap decisions, and support new product introductions (NPI).
* Documentation and collateral: Create and maintain technical reference manuals, datasheets, application notes, user guides, FAQs, and training materials to support customer self-sufficiency and broaden product adoption.
* Continuous Improvement: Participate in design reviews and contribute to improving applications engineering tools, processes, and support methodologies.

------------------

* 3+ years of industry experience in applications engineering, systems engineering, or embedded firmware development.
* Bachelor's or master's degree in Electronics/Electrical/Computer Engineering, or a related field.
* Strong proficiency in embedded C/C++, with the ability to read, debug, and modify firmware for digital power controllers.
* Experience with industry-standard communication protocols like PMBus, I2C, and SPI.
* Experience with TI's Code Composer Studio (CCS), IAR, Keil and other relevant development and debug tools.

The ideal candidate will lead architecture design, development, and deployment of agentic AI capabilities with a strong focus on security, scalability, and reliability. In this pivotal leadership role, you will guide a dynamic engineering team responsible for delivering production-ready AI solutions and integrating them seamlessly with enterprise systems.

Operating from India, you will collaborate closely with leadership and technical peers based in the U.S., ensuring alignment and fostering innovation across global teams. **͏**
-----

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Take full ownership of the architecture and engineering delivery of the Agentic Hive platform, ensuring it meets business priorities, is modular, scalable, and aligned with product roadmaps.

* Collaborate extensively with cross-functional partners including product management, UX/CX design, data teams, security, cloud infrastructure, and domain experts to deliver compelling, trustworthy, and user-centric AI experiences.
* Guide decisions and implementations in data science and data engineering domains ensuring robust data ingestion, transformation, retrieval, feature layer development, model integration, and reliable production workflows.
* Champion engineering best practices such as API-first design, CI/CD automation, container orchestration, cloud scalability, cost management, and secure operations across enterprise cloud environments.
* Engage proactively with stakeholders to translate operational feedback into enhanced platform capabilities and to support the adoption of agentic AI solutions across client engagements.

**͏**
-----

**Preferred Qualifications and Experience**
-------------------------------------------

* Proven hands-on experience designing and delivering Agentic AI solutions, specifically utilizing Claude AI for agent constructions and automations.
* Demonstrated expertise in multi-agent orchestration architectures, enabling complex agent interactions and integrations with external tools and systems.
* In-depth understanding of agent context management strategies including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), semantic memory modeling, prompt engineering, and secured data governance.
* Strong background in applying enterprise architecture principles to build modular, scalable, and secure platform infrastructures.
* Experience managing and mentoring AI engineering teams, balancing architectural oversight with active technical contribution.
* Robust data science and engineering skills encompassing Python programming, SQL, data pipelines, model development, and production-grade deployment.
* Familiarity with UX, UI, and customer experience design concepts enabling effective collaboration with design teams to translate user needs into AI solutions.
* Experience developing AI/ML or generative AI systems incorporating engineering practices like automatic testing, continuous integration and delivery, monitoring, security considerations, and governance frameworks.
* Strong communication abilities with a track record of managing technical discussions with diverse stakeholders including engineers, product teams, and clients.

**͏**
-----

**Additional Technical Skills**
-------------------------------

* Experience with agent frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or similar, including orchestration and agent-to-agent/tool interaction (MCP, A2A patterns).
* Hands-on knowledge of retrieval-augmented generation techniques, hybrid retrieval models, semantic search, knowledge graph integration, and enterprise semantic layers.
* Expertise in AI agent evaluation methodologies, including automated evaluation strategies, policy enforcement, guardrails, and metrics like RAGAS for ongoing assessment.
* Familiarity with LLMOps/MLOps tooling and best practices, including version control of prompts/models, experimentation tracking, automated deployment, performance monitoring, and governance.
* Deep understanding of cloud-native architectures on platforms like Azure, Google Cloud Platform, AWS, and Databricks, tailored for AI and data workloads.
* Competence in containerization and orchestration platforms such as Docker and Kubernetes, RESTful API development, FastAPI, infrastructure as code (IaC), and telemetry systems.
* Experience delivering AI solutions in regulated or complex enterprise environments, successfully transitioning from research and prototyping to robust production systems.

**͏**
-----

**Education, Experience & Leadership Competencies**
---------------------------------------------------

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or related technical disciplines; or equivalent practical experience in these fields.
* Minimum of 12 years' experience in software, data, or AI engineering roles with substantial recent success in generative AI or Agentic AI architecture leadership and delivery.
* Preferred certifications in cloud platforms, AI/ML, data engineering, or related architecture fields that validate technical expertise.

* Strong alignment with Wipro's values such as self-leadership, respect, trust building, transformation leadership, and execution excellence to inspire and drive team success.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

* Delivering a scalable, reusable, and secure Agentic Hive platform architecture that serves as a reference model across the organization.
* Ensuring all agentic solutions are production-ready, meeting rigorous safety, observability, reliability, and quality standards.
* Maintaining a highly effective AI engineering team, fostering technical excellence, predictable deliveries, and development of reusable components accelerating future projects.
* Driving strong adoption of the platform by internal teams, partners, and enterprise customers via outstanding developer and end-user experiences.
* Successfully aligning multiple stakeholder groups including product management, engineering, data science, security, governance, cloud operations, and client relations to maximize platform impact.

title: Chief Technology Officer, Healthcare AI
description:
**Hiring for Moative**
— via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role.

**About the Company**

Moative is an AI company that partners with mid-market businesses in asset-heavy, regulated industries to co-build industry-specific agentic and machine-learning solutions, then scales them across the industry through revenue-share and equity-linked models. The founders have built and sold two companies, one of them in AI, and the 20+ person team of AI/ML engineers, data scientists and mathematicians comes from IITs, IISc, CERN, UZH and IBM Research. Its healthcare business builds AI agents that run revenue-cycle and administrative work for US healthcare practices.

**About the Role**

As CTO for Moative's healthcare business, you'll lead technology for an AI management services organisation (AI MSO) for US healthcare practices. It combines operational expertise, data infrastructure and AI to manage and improve revenue-cycle and administrative workflows, automating tasks progressively with clear controls and human accountability. You'll own technology strategy, platform architecture and the engineering organisation, and stay hands-on in architecture, prototypes, code reviews and hard production problems. The role is based in Chennai (Bengaluru is possible), hybrid with 3 days a week in person with the founders and the healthcare AI pod.

**What you'll do**

* Own technology strategy, platform architecture and engineering standards for the healthcare AI MSO
* Work with founders, practice owners and billing leaders to assess workflows, set baselines and prioritise by business value and feasibility
* Design solutions across EHRs, practice-management systems, clearinghouses and payer portals, covering payer-portal agents, voice payer follow-up, denial management and payment posting
* Define the practice data architecture: claims, remittances, EOBs and denial codes as validated, traceable data, with isolation between practices and de-identified analytics
* Set healthcare privacy, security and compliance controls, plus production evaluation, monitoring, escalation and release criteria
* Make build-versus-buy, vendor and model decisions, and own engineering and infrastructure budgets
* Hire and develop engineers, data scientists and technical leads, and represent Moative's technology to practice owners, partners and investors

**What you bring**

* 15+ years of engineering and technology leadership, with recent hands-on architecture, prototyping and production troubleshooting
* You've built and scaled a product or technology business as a founder, CTO or senior engineering leader, with clear customer adoption and commercial results
* Experience delivering healthcare or RCM products, with a practical grasp of billing workflows, claim submission, payer interactions, denials, appeals and payment posting
* You've led teams that deploy and support AI in live operations, including LLM applications or agents with evaluation, monitoring and human escalation
* Deep experience integrating and modelling fragmented operational data, including multi-customer platforms with clear data isolation
* Strong Python, SQL and cloud architecture on AWS, Azure or GCP
* Technical controls for sensitive healthcare data: access management, audit trails, secure logging, vendor access and incident response
* Experience owning technology budgets and working directly with CXOs, founders and investors

**Nice to have**

* Building for US outpatient practices, MSOs or RCM companies
* Taking a company through an acquisition, merger or exit, including technical diligence
* Turning services engagements into reusable products
* Healthcare data exchange (claims, remittances, EHR, clearinghouses), process mining, or browser and voice agents for operations

title: DMTS ITP AI Architecture and Delivery
description:
Job ID

JR117033

**Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for** ***all*****.**

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

The Distinguished Member of Technical Staff (DMTS) for ITP (Innovation, Technology and Products) AI is one of the company's important distinguished technical leadership positions, accountable for turning ITP's AI priorities into production-grade solutions that accelerate technology development, silicon design, product development, and engineering execution across ITP. This role is central to Micron's mission to make AI foundational to how ITP innovates and develops technology and products, amplifying its people and unlocking durable competitive advantage through solutions that are deployed, adopted, and delivering value.

  
  

**Position Summary**

The ITP AI DMTS is a hands-on technical architect and execution leader in Artificial Intelligence. This individual will work closely with subject matter experts (SMEs) across ITP to understand engineering workflows and pain points, translate those needs into practical AI architectures, and work alongside implementation teams seeing through to production deployment. The role directly advances ITP's goal to redesign engineering from specification to qualification, enabling more design IDs, faster execution, and first-pass qualification with best-in-class quality.

The DMTS will be accountable alongside implementation teams for delivery of outcomes, partnering directly with internal customers to ensure solutions are adopted and deliver measurable business impact, including ITP's broader goal of significantly faster time-to-market. Success in this role will be measured primarily by the number of AI systems successfully rolled out into production and the business value they deliver. The individual will drive disciplined execution against quarterly objectives while bringing applied innovation to every solution, ensuring Micron continues to lead in how AI is used across engineering.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

Architecture and Execution

* Partner with SMEs across ITP to understand engineering workflows, data, and constraints, and translate them into scalable, implementable AI architectures.

* Define technical designs, solution blueprints, and implementation plans that move AI use cases from concept to production.

* Lead hands-on technical execution, including architecture reviews, build decisions, integration, and deployment readiness.

* Establish reusable architecture patterns, platforms, and standards that accelerate delivery across ITP.

* Translate the ITP AI roadmap into concrete quarterly deliverables with clear milestones, owners, and success criteria.

* Identify and manage technical risks, dependencies, and trade-offs to keep programs on schedule.

Customer Partnership and Production Delivery

* Own delivery of AI outcomes end to end, from requirements through production rollout and adoption.

* Work closely with internal customers across technology development, silicon design, product engineering, and manufacturing to prioritize the use cases with the highest business impact.

* Drive the rollout of production AI systems, ensuring quality, reliability, scalability, security, and supportability.

* Partner with cross-functional engineering and IT teams to integrate AI solutions into existing tools, data, and workflows.

* Track and report adoption, performance, and business impact of deployed solutions, including improvements in velocity, quality, and cost.

* Continuously improve deployed systems based on customer feedback and operational data.

Applied Innovation

* Drive innovation that becomes deployable capability, applying advances in GenAI, agentic AI, machine learning, scientific AI, and semiconductor-focused AI to real ITP problems.

* Rapidly prototype and evaluate new approaches, scaling those that prove value into production.

* Bring emerging AI technologies and industry practices into ITP where they can measurably improve engineering outcomes.

Technical Leadership and Influence

* Drive disciplined execution against objectives set each quarter, translating the ITP AI roadmap into measurable, quarter-over-quarter results.

* Serve as a trusted technical advisor to ITP leaders on AI architecture, delivery priorities, and investment trade-offs.

* Lead cross-functional teams through complex technical challenges requiring exceptional expertise and creativity.

* Mentor senior technical staff, principal engineers, architects, and engineers

* Build and strengthen Micron's AI technical community and talent pipeline.

How Success Is Measured

* Number of AI systems rolled out into production across ITP.

* Customer adoption and sustained usage of deployed solutions.

* Measurable business impact, including faster time-to-market, improved quality, and engineering productivity gains.

* Delivery against quarterly objectives and committed milestones.

* Innovation output, including new IP and novel solutions that reach deployment.

Minimum Qualifications

* MS or PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Computer Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or related field.

* 15+ years of experience in advanced AI research, AI platform development, machine learning, semiconductor or related technical domains.

* Demonstrated record of technical innovation translated into production systems with measurable business impact.

* Deep expertise in multiple AI disciplines, such as Generative AI, agentic AI, machine learning, deep learning, LLMs, AI infrastructure, scientific AI, reinforcement learning, and AI safety and governance.

* Significant experience architecting, building, and deploying large-scale AI or software systems into production.

* Exceptional communication and executive influencing skills.

* Proven ability to drive technical outcomes across organizational boundaries without direct authority.

Preferred Qualifications

* Expertise in AI with a good record of publications, patents, open-source contributions, or industry recognition.

* Experience applying AI within semiconductor technology, EDA, manufacturing, product development, scientific computing, or high-performance computing environments.

* Demonstrated success creating and scaling enterprise AI platforms and capabilities.

* Experience leading AI transformation efforts within global organizations.

* History of mentoring senior technical talent and developing future technical leaders.

* Distinguished engineer experience, or equivalent technical leadership accomplishments.

We are an industry leader in innovative memory and storage solutions transforming how the world uses information to enrich life *for all*. With a relentless focus on our customers, technology leadership, and manufacturing and operational excellence, Micron delivers a rich portfolio of high-performance DRAM, NAND, and NOR memory and storage products through our Micron® and Crucial® brands. Every day, the innovations that our people create fuel the data economy, enabling advances in artificial intelligence and 5G applications that unleash opportunities — from the data center to the intelligent edge and across the client and mobile user experience.

title: Senior Solutions Architect
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100\* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
  
  
The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
  
  

* Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

**An Overview Of This Role**
As a Senior Solutions Architect on GitLab's India team, you'll be a trusted advisor to prospects, customers, and partners across India. You'll help them understand how GitLab's AI-powered DevSecOps platform addresses technical requirements and business goals across the software development lifecycle. This role supports Commercial and Enterprise segments in India's Southern Region. Experience with Global Capability Centers (GCCs), Digital Native organizations, and startups is highly valued given the accounts you'll support.
  
  
You'll partner closely with Account Executives and cross-functional teams to own technical evaluations, including proofs of value and workshops, shape solution architectures, and bring customer feedback to Product Management. You'll also occasionally support regional go-to-market partners that provide Professional Services. Your work will help customers adopt GitLab successfully, support revenue growth through solution selling, and build long-term, trusted relationships.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Lead technical discovery, demonstrations, and validation to show how GitLab's AI-powered DevSecOps platform meets customers' technical and business needs across the software development lifecycle.
* Own the technical evaluation process, including solution design, proofs of concept or value, workshops, and technical contributions to tenders, audits, and value stream assessments.
* Collaborate with Account Executives and regional sales teams across Commercial and Enterprise segments to shape account strategies for new customer acquisition and expansion, with a focus on GCC, Digital Native, and startup accounts.
* Support regional go-to-market partners that provide Professional Services, helping them deliver consistent technical guidance and apply effective practices during partner-led engagements.
* Represent GitLab at online and in-person marketing events, including webinars, industry events, presentations, roundtables, panels, demonstration days, and hackathons.
* Build trusted relationships with technical practitioners and business leaders, guide GitLab-driven transformation, and help customers become GitLab advocates.
* Advise customers on modern software development, continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD), security, and cloud practices to improve their return on investment.
* Share customer feedback, use cases, and competitive insights with Product Management, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing while continuing to build expertise and reusable guidance in GitLab, DevSecOps, AI, and cloud technologies.

**What You’ll Bring**

* Experience guiding Commercial and Enterprise customers through solution design and evaluation in technical presales, consulting, or a similar role.
* Experience working with India's GCCs, Digital Native organizations, and startups is highly valued.
* Knowledge of the end-to-end software development lifecycle, including modern DevSecOps practices and CI/CD workflows.
* Hands-on experience with GitLab or comparable source control, CI/CD, and collaboration platforms, with the ability to connect platform capabilities to customer use cases.
* Practical knowledge of cloud computing concepts and related technologies, including deployment, security, and operations options.
* Ability to lead proofs of concept or value, contribute to tenders or audits, and design and run workshops or value stream assessments.
* Clear technical communication and presentation skills, with the ability to adapt your message for practitioners and senior business and technical decision-makers.
* Skill in building trusted relationships, listening with empathy, advocating for customers, collaborating with go-to-market or Professional Services partners, and continuously learning new technologies.

**About The Team**
The Solutions Architect team is part of GitLab's Sales organization and serves as the technical counterpart to Account Executives. This role focuses on Commercial and Enterprise opportunities across India's Southern Region and works with Account Executives, the broader go-to-market team, and regional partners that provide Professional Services. The team advises on architecture, runs technical evaluations such as proofs of value, and guides customers through digital transformation. We collaborate asynchronously with Sales, Product Management, Engineering, and Marketing to share effective practices, create reusable technical resources, and represent the voice of the customer. Our focus is helping customers modernize software delivery, adopt GitLab at scale, and navigate a changing AI and DevSecOps landscape.
  
  
**How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees**

* Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
* Flexible Paid Time Off
* Team Member Resource Groups
* Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* Growth and Development Fund
* Parental Leave

Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.
  
  
**Country Hiring Guidelines:**
GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.
  
  
**Privacy Policy:**
Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.
