title: Cloud Engineer (Azure)
description:
**Innovation Hub Overview**

Jefferies is creating a Technology Innovation Hub in Pune, a greenfield opportunity to build the systems that power global markets. As our first India technology center, this hub brings together hands on builders who engineer the platforms behind Jefferies’ growth across capital markets, investment banking, and institutional securities. We’re scaling toward an elite team of 500 engineers while maintaining the agility, ownership, and meritocratic spirit that defines Jefferies. From cloud and data to AI, risk, and core business technologies, teams in Pune will lead high impact work with a global mandate.

**IT Infrastructure Technology**

Jefferies’ IT Infrastructure Technology team builds and runs the core technology backbone that enables the firm to operate globally. It covers enterprise infrastructure engineering and operations while driving modernization initiatives such as Cloud Adoption and Network Resiliency. The group supports critical platforms including networking, end-user computing, cloud, databases, server/Unix engineering, communications, and global data centers (including low-latency colocations near exchanges).

**Role summary**

Drive Azure cloud adoption and engineering excellence as part of our multi-cloud infrastructure strategy. You will design, deploy, and operate Azure-based solutions, establish Azure best practices and standards, and partner with the broader cloud team to ensure seamless integration with our AWS-primary environment. This role requires deep Azure expertise combined with the ability to navigate a multi-cloud landscape, strong Terraform skills, and a focus on security, governance, and operational excellence.

You will partner closely with Platform Engineering, Cloud Security, Networking, Identity Teams, Power Platform, Database, Unix, and business line technology teams supporting Equities, Investment Banking, and other divisions. Strong collaboration, interpersonal skills, and customer service orientation are critical as you work across global distributed teams. Experience working in Agile environments using Jira and Confluence is expected.

**Key responsibilities**

* Design, deploy, and operate highly available, scalable, and secure Azure cloud infrastructure supporting business applications
* Establish Azure reference architectures, best practices, and "golden path" patterns for workload onboarding aligned with existing AWS standards
* Implement Infrastructure as Code using Terraform Enterprise (modules, state management, workspaces) and Terraform Enterprise for Azure resources; maintain parity with AWS IaC patterns where applicable
* Architect and implement Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) clusters with a focus on security, RBAC, networking, autoscaling, and operational excellence
* Collaborate with Cloud Architecture, Cloud Security, Networking, Identity, Database, and Unix teams to integrate Azure workloads with existing infrastructure and security controls
* Develop and implement Azure governance frameworks: subscription design, management groups, Azure Policy, role-based access control (RBAC), and cost management
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for Azure deployments using GitHub, Bamboo, GitLab, ArgoCD, and Azure DevOps
* Provide consulting and technical expertise to application teams on securely integrating Azure services (Azure Functions, Logic Apps, Service Bus, Cosmos DB, Azure SQL, etc.)
* Troubleshoot complex issues spanning Azure infrastructure, AKS, networking (VNet, NSG, Application Gateway, Azure Front Door), and identity (Azure AD, managed identities)
* Drive compliance and security efforts: implement secure architectures, maintain audit readiness, and support regulatory requirements
* Create and maintain Azure-specific documentation, runbooks, and operational procedures
* Identify opportunities for automation and toil reduction; implement GenAI-assisted workflows where appropriate
* Participate in on-call rotation as needed to support Azure infrastructure and workloads
* Lead or contribute to incident response for Azure-related issues; conduct post-incident reviews and track corrective actions
* Develop runbooks and standard operating procedures for Azure operations; support knowledge transfer to global teams
* Define and monitor SLOs/SLIs for Azure services; drive continuous improvement in reliability and performance
*  Maintain compliance with change management, documentation, and security standards

**Requirements**

* 7+ years in cloud engineering, DevOps, or infrastructure roles with 4+ years of hands-on Azure experience
* Azure Administrator Associate and/or Azure Solutions Architect Expert certification required; Azure DevOps or Security certifications preferred
* Strong experience designing and implementing resilient, cloud-native, and multi-region Azure solutions
* Proficiency with Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS): networking, ingress controllers, RBAC, monitoring, security
* Deep understanding of Azure services: compute (VMs, App Service, AKS, Functions), networking (VNet, NSG, Application Gateway, Traffic Manager), storage (Blob, Files, Disks), databases (Azure SQL, Cosmos DB), and identity (Azure AD, managed identities)
* Expert-level Terraform skills for Azure; experience with Terraform Enterprise strongly preferred
* Strong understanding of IaC, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps practices
* Proficiency in Python, PowerShell, Azure CLI, and scripting for automation
* Experience implementing secure architectures for private and public-facing systems
* Strong understanding of networking protocols, distributed systems, and cloud security best practices
* Excellent communication, teamwork, and customer service skills; ability to partner with global technology and business teams
* Proficiency using GenAI assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, GitHub Copilot) for infrastructure design, troubleshooting, code generation, and documentation
* Ability to implement AI agent-driven automation (agentic workflows) safely in enterprise environments: enforce human-in-the-loop controls, maintain comprehensive logging and auditability, establish guardrails, implement rollback mechanisms, and secure credential handling
* Proactive approach to identifying manual toil and shipping automation that measurably reduces repetitive work; track and report efficiency gains

**Preferred**

* AWS Solutions Architect Associate or equivalent; multi-cloud experience is highly valued
* CKAD certification or strong Kubernetes operations background
* Experience with Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI for Azure workloads
* Background in software development or systems administration
* Familiarity with Azure monitoring and observability tools (Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Log Analytics)
* Knowledge of compliance frameworks and shared responsibility models

description:
Job Description

**About Persistent**

  

We are an AI-led, platform-driven Digital Engineering and Enterprise Modernization partner, combining deep technical expertise and industry experience to help our clients anticipate what's next. Our offerings and proven solutions create a unique competitive advantage for our clients by giving them the power to see beyond and rise above. We work with many industry-leading organizations across the world, including 18 of the Fortune 50 companies, 7 of the 10 top US banks, 9 of the 10 technology companies, and numerous innovators across the healthcare ecosystem.

  

Our disruptor's mindset, commitment to client success, and agility to thrive in the dynamic environment have enabled us to sustain our growth momentum. Persistent has been recognized across top industry platforms for innovation, leadership, and inclusion. We have delivered 26 sequential quarters of growth with $487.6M in Q4 FY26 revenue, up 7.8% Q-o-Q and 20.0% Y-o-Y. Our 29,500+ global team members, located in 21 countries, have been instrumental in helping the market leaders transform their industries. We received five awards at the ISG (Information Services Group) Provider Lens Awards 2026 and, for the second year in a row, were awarded the Growth Honor of the Year at the Everest Group Elevate 2026.

  

**About Position:**

  

We are seeking an experienced Senior Data Architect with 10 to 16 years of experience in designing and implementing enterprise-scale cloud data platforms. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in Snowflake, AWS, ETL/ELT frameworks, data warehousing, data lakes, and cloud-native architectures. This role requires strong architectural leadership to drive data modernization, migration, governance, integration, and analytics initiatives while delivering scalable, secure, and cost-optimized data solutions.

  

* **Role: Senior Data Architect - Snowflake & AWS**

* Provide technical leadership, mentoring, and guidance to Data Engineering and Analytics teams.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex performance, scalability, integration, and platform architecture challenges.
* Drive adoption of best practices across cloud data engineering and enterprise data management initiatives.
  

**Expertise You'll Bring:**

  

* 10 to 16 years of overall IT experience with significant experience in Data Architecture, Cloud Data Platforms, and Enterprise Analytics solutions.
* Extensive hands-on expertise in designing and implementing Snowflake-based data architectures.
* Strong experience with Snowflake components including databases, schemas, virtual warehouses, RBAC, Snowpipe, Streams & Tasks, Secure Data Sharing, and Time Travel.
* Deep understanding of AWS cloud services including Amazon S3, AWS Glue, Lambda, IAM, KMS, DMS, CloudWatch, Kinesis, and related data platform services.
* Proven experience architecting enterprise-scale ETL/ELT frameworks, data ingestion processes, and integration solutions.
* Strong expertise in Data Warehousing, Data Lakes, Lakehouse architectures, and analytical data platforms.
* Proficiency in data modeling techniques including dimensional modeling, star schema, snowflake schema, and enterprise data architecture principles.
* Experience with structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data processing across large-scale environments.
* Strong understanding of cloud security, governance, compliance, data privacy, and access management frameworks.
* Expertise in Snowflake performance tuning, query optimization, workload management, storage optimization, and cloud cost management.
* Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, infrastructure automation, and data platform monitoring strategies.

**Benefits:**

**Values-Driven, People-Centric & Inclusive Work Environment:**

Persistent is dedicated to fostering diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We invite applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities, and regardless of gender or gender preference. We welcome diverse candidates from all backgrounds.

description:
**About Avaya**
---------------

Avaya is an enterprise software leader that helps the world’s largest organizations and government agencies forge unbreakable connections.

The Avaya Infinity™ platform unifies fragmented customer experiences, connecting the channels, insights, technologies, and workflows that together create enduring customer and employee relationships.

We believe success is built through strong connections – with each other, with our work, and with our mission. At Avaya, you'll find a community that values your contributions and supports your growth every step of the way.

Learn more at https://www.avaya.com

**Job Information**
-------------------

Job Code: 00194005

Job Family: Research and Development

Job Function: Software Engineering

**About The Role**
------------------

We are seeking a highly experienced and visionary Lead AI Application Engineer to join our core AI team. This pivotal role will be instrumental in designing, developing, and deploying advanced Machine Learning, Generative AI and Agentic AI applications across high-throughput, real-time streaming environments . You are an engineer’s engineer, someone who spent years training, tuning, and deploying models at scale, and who has spearheaded Generative and Agentic AI over the last 3–4 years. This is an exceptional opportunity for an individual who thrives on building sophisticated, production-grade Autonomous AI systems and wants to make a significant impact.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Technical Architecture & System Design**

  

* Architect and operationalize end-to-end autonomous agentic systems (multi-agent orchestration, dynamic tool-calling, reflection, planner-executor loops, and persistent state management).
* Design robust LLM runtime infrastructure, including hybrid retrieval architectures (Advanced RAG, graph-based context grounding, vector databases, re-rankers, semantic routing).
* Establish scalable evaluation, guardrail, and observability frameworks (latency optimization, cost governors, hallucinations/drift detection, alignment checks, red-teaming).
* Make high-stakes architectural decisions regarding model topologies (proprietary frontier models vs. distilled/fine-tuned SLMs, LoRA, quantization, self-hosted vs. managed endpoints).

#### **Hands-On Execution & Prototyping**

  

* Lead from the front: write high-leverage production code, design critical framework primitives, and rapidly de-risk zero-to-one concepts via functional PoCs.
* Bridge cutting-edge research and production engineering, ensuring systems are resilient, fault-tolerant, secure, and performant at scale.

#### **Strategy & Cross-Functional Influence**

  

* Partner directly with the Head of AI, Product leadership, and VP-level stakeholders to chart the AI technology roadmap and identify transformative capability unlocks.
* Lead the exploration and application of Large Language Models, Agentic AI and Generative AI, venturing into new areas within these fields.
* Represent the company’s AI thought leadership through open-source contributions, technical papers, conferences, or industry forums.
  

#### **Other Responsibilities**

  

* Architect, Design and Build robust, scalable, and efficient AI systems leveraging a variety of AI/ML, data science, deep learning, and agentic AI frameworks.
* Drive the integration of complex Model Context Protocol (MCP) and agent-to-agent (A2A) communication protocols, ensuring seamless interaction and optimal performance.
* Design and implement scalable and efficient AI/ML systems, architectures, and pipelines that can handle large volumes of data and deliver accurate and timely results.
* Regularly self-educate while mentoring and provide technical leadership to other engineers, fostering a culture of continuous learning and excellence.

**Who we are looking for -**
----------------------------

* **Experience**: 15+ years of hands-on software development experience, including 5+ years actively building and deploying Generative AI and Agentic AI applications in production.
* **Core Engineering & AI Building:** Hands-on builder capable of independently architecting, coding, and deploying custom AI tools, autonomous agents, and bots from scratch.
* **Programming Mastery:** 8+ years writing production-grade code in Python or similar languages with deep expertise in scalable software design, APIs, and microservices.
* **Agentic Frameworks & Tools:** Deep proficiency with frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, Auto-GPT, CrewAI, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) for multi-agent coordination.
* **LLMs & Fine-Tuning:** Practical experience with frontier models (GPT-4, Gemini, Claude), fine-tuning, prompt engineering, and custom agentic tool-calling workflows.
* **ML/DL Foundations:** Background in training, tuning, and running models using PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Scikit-learn in high-throughput environments.
* **Inference & Acceleration:** Familiarity with inference engines (vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, TGI) and cloud ML infrastructure (NVIDIA GPUs, TPUs).
* **Data & Memory Infrastructure:** Experience building low-latency vector search indices, in-memory caching layers, streaming pipelines (Kafka/Flink), and NoSQL datastores to power real-time agent context and memory.
* **Education**: Master's or Ph.D. in Computer Science, AI, ML, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent practical experience).
  

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

  

* Autonomous Execution: Proven track record as a senior IC who takes total ownership—from zero-to-one prototyping to production rollout.
* Cloud & DevOps: Exposure to AWS, Azure, or GCP environments with modern containerized deployment (Kubernetes, Docker).
* Domain & Communication: Experience in contact center/telecom/CX platforms is a plus; excellent technical communication skills required.

**Experience**
--------------

12+ Years of Experience

**Education**
-------------

Bachelor degree or equivalent experience

Advance Degree preferred in Computer Science or Related Field

----------

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future.

title: TC-CS-AD-Cyber LDE
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY GDS CYBER LARGE DEAL GROUP**
**Cyber Solutions Architect**
Pre-Sales | Client Storytelling | Commercial & Pricing | Turnkey Cyber Services
  
  
**Executive mandate to**
Shape and lead differentiated, executable and commercially compelling turnkey cyber services propositions for strategic pursuits, converting complex client priorities into a persuasive value story, integrated architecture, delivery model and price-to-win.
  
  
**The opportunity**
The Cyber Large Deal Engine brings together Business Case Researchers, Cyber Domain Specialists, Solution Architects, and Finance & Commercial Specialists to create an integrated deal-shaping capability, connecting client and market insight, deep cyber expertise, end-to-end solution architecture, and commercial modelling to build propositions that are differentiated, deliverable and positioned to win.
  
  
It is a senior pursuit leadership position for an architect who can operate credibly across the boardroom, the solution room and the commercial model. The role requires breadth across cyber domains, depth in at least one major cyber capability, and the judgement to integrate specialist inputs into one coherent, differentiated and deliverable proposition.
  
  
**Role Accountabilities**
**Lead strategic solutioning and pursuits**

* Own the solution from qualification and discovery through business case build out , architecture, proposal development, governance, oral presentation, negotiation and BAFO.
* Establish the solution strategy, win themes, design principles and response plan for complex RFPs, RFIs and proactive pursuits.
* Translate client requirements into an integrated managed services model spanning people, process, technology, governance, service management and transformation.
* Define scope, architecture, operating model, transition approach, delivery footprint, staffing model, service levels, assumptions, dependencies and risks.
* Mobilise and lead multidisciplinary contributors across domains and geographies, ensuring one solution, one story and one commercial position.

**Create a compelling customer story**

* Frame the client’s business context, cyber risk and operational challenge before presenting the solution.
* Convert technical complexity into an outcome-led narrative that is relevant to CISOs, CIOs, business executives and procurement leaders.
* Connect solution choices to measurable outcomes such as risk reduction, resilience, control effectiveness, experience, operational efficiency and cost transparency.
* Lead executive discovery sessions, workshops, whiteboarding, solution walkthroughs, oral pitches and solution-defence discussions.
* Anticipate objections and competitive alternatives, articulating clearly why the proposition is credible, differentiated, scalable and valuable.

**Own commercial solutioning and pricing**

* Translate the solution into a robust bottom-up cost model covering resource pyramids, effort, delivery locations, platforms, licences, transition and ongoing run costs.
* Work with finance and commercial teams to develop competitive, sustainable and traceable pricing, with clear linkage between scope, service levels, cost and price.
* Evaluate fixed-price, consumption-based, unit-based, outcome-aligned and hybrid charging models based on client context and risk allocation.
* Optimise the solution through automation, standardisation, global delivery leverage, right-shoring, reusable assets and platform choices without compromising outcomes.
* Understand margin drivers, contingencies, contractual dependencies and change levers; support commercial governance, negotiation, BAFO and renewal decisions.

**Architect integrated turnkey cyber services**

* Provide broad solution leadership across Identity and Access Management, Privileged Access Management, Customer IAM, Non-Human Identity, Threat Detection and Response, SOC, SIEM, SOAR, XDR, Vulnerability Management, Threat Intelligence and Threat Hunting.
* Bring familiarity with major platforms including SailPoint, Saviynt, Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, CyberArk, BeyondTrust, Delinea, Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender, Splunk and CrowdStrike.
* Design for cloud, on-premise and hybrid environments, integrating EY capabilities, alliance partners, technology vendors and client-retained responsibilities.
* Know when to make an architectural decision and when to engage a deep specialist, while retaining accountability for the integrity of the end-to-end solution.
* Position AI-enabled security operations, automation and platform-led delivery where they create a credible and measurable client advantage.

**Build repeatable deal-engine capability**

* Create and improve reference architectures, solution patterns, estimators, pricing models, proposal content, assumptions libraries and executive storytelling assets.
* Capture pursuit insights, commercial benchmarks and lessons learned to improve future speed, consistency and win quality.
* Coach solution contributors on structured solutioning, client storytelling, estimation discipline and executive presentation.

**Decision scope and influence**

* Recommends the end-to-end solution strategy, architecture, delivery model and commercial assumptions for assigned pursuits.
* Challenges requirements and design choices that reduce value, increase delivery risk or weaken competitiveness.
* Balances client outcomes, architectural integrity, delivery feasibility, commercial sustainability and speed to market.
* Influences partners, pursuit leaders, SMEs, alliances, delivery executives and commercial stakeholders without relying on formal authority.
* Escalates material solution, delivery, contractual and financial risks with clear options and recommendations.

**Measures of success**

* Pursuit impact: Quality and competitiveness of strategic proposals; contribution to progression and wins.
* Client impact: Clarity of the story, executive confidence and alignment to measurable outcomes.
* Commercial quality: Accurate, traceable estimates and sustainable pricing with risks made explicit.
* Solution integrity: Integrated, scalable and deliverable solutions with clear ownership and dependencies.
* Execution discipline: Timely mobilisation, governance and high-quality outputs under pursuit deadlines.
* Capability uplift: Reusable assets, improved consistency and stronger solutioning maturity across the engine.

**Experience And Capabilities**

* Typically 15+ years of relevant experience in cyber consulting, solution architecture, pre-sales or managed services, with demonstrated leadership of large and complex pursuits.
* Proven ability to move fluently between executive business conversations, cyber architecture, operating model design and commercial/pricing discussions.
* Depth in at least one major cyber domain, combined with sufficient breadth to shape integrated solutions across multiple capabilities.
* Practical experience building bottom-up estimates, cost models and pricing inputs for managed services opportunities.
* Exceptional customer presence, storytelling, writing, facilitation and presentation skills, including leadership of oral pitches and solution defence.
* Strong analytical judgement and the ability to make pragmatic trade-offs under ambiguity, commercial pressure and demanding deadlines.
* Experience working across distributed global teams and with alliance partners, technology vendors, finance, legal, risk and contracting stakeholders.
* Bachelor’s degree such as BTech/BE or equivalent; MCA or another relevant postgraduate qualification is advantageous.

**Preferred Credentials And Exposure**

* Relevant certifications in security architecture, IAM, cloud security, SIEM/SOC or major technology platforms.
* Experience in competitive deal shaping, transformation programmes, renewals and transition from incumbent providers.
* Experience creating reusable propositions, reference architectures, estimators or pricing assets.
* Working knowledge of regulatory, legal, compliance and contractual considerations for managed services.
* Ability to operate effectively with international stakeholders and support Europe and US working hours when required.

**Leadership profile**

* Client-first: listens before designing and anchors the proposition in the client’s priorities.
* Commercially astute: understands that the strongest architecture must also be executable, priceable and competitive.
* Persuasive: makes complex ideas simple and turns technical capability into business value.
* Integrative: creates alignment across specialists, geographies, partners and competing priorities.
* Accountable: owns the quality and integrity of the whole solution, not only an individual component.
* Composed under pressure: brings structure, pace and judgement to high-value pursuits with incomplete information.

**Why this role matters**
The Cyber Solutions Architect will directly influence the quality, differentiation and commercial strength of EY’s most strategic turnkey cyber services pursuits. The role offers the opportunity to shape major client transformations, work across leading technology ecosystems and build the repeatable solutioning capability of the Cyber Large Deal Engine.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: AEM Technical Architect
description:
**About The Role**
Adobe Consulting is seeking an experienced Technical Architect to join our team and lead the delivery of next-generation digital experience solutions for enterprise customers.
  
  
As the Adobe Experience Cloud ecosystem evolves towards AI-powered and agentic experiences, we are looking for an AEM Architect who combines strong expertise in Adobe Experience Manager with an understanding of emerging AI capabilities and their application to digital experiences.
  
  
The role goes beyond traditional AEM architecture. You will work closely with enterprise customers to define technology strategies, modernize digital experience platforms, and adopt emerging solutions such as Adobe Brand Concierge, AEM Co-worker and AI-powered content experiences.
  
  
You will act as a trusted technology advisor to customers, lead complex solution architecture and guide multidisciplinary teams to deliver successful outcomes.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
**AEM and Digital Experience Architecture**

* Be a recognized technical expert in Adobe Experience Manager, including AEM as a Cloud Service, Edge Delivery Services (EDS), Universal Editor and Document-based Authoring.
* Architect scalable, secure and high-performance digital experience solutions across CMS, DAM, personalization and composable architectures.
* Guide customers through modernization journeys, including migration from AEM 6.x, on-premise and other CMS platforms to AEM Cloud Service and EDS.
* Define architecture and engineering practices that improve performance, Core Web Vitals, scalability and content authoring productivity.
* Provide technical leadership across complex enterprise implementations and integrations.

**AI And Agentic Experience Adoption**

* Understand and drive the adoption of emerging Adobe AI and agentic capabilities, including Adobe Brand Concierge, AEM Co-worker and other AI-powered Experience Cloud solutions.
* Identify opportunities to leverage Generative AI and Agentic AI to transform digital experiences and content operations.
* Architect solutions that integrate AI capabilities with existing AEM platforms, enterprise content, customer data and business systems.
* Guide customers on AI-powered content creation, personalization, asset management, content supply chain and workflow automation.
* Understand key AI architecture concepts such as LLMs, RAG, agent orchestration, APIs and MCP integrations, and their application in enterprise solutions.
* Advise customers on responsible AI adoption, including security, data privacy, governance and brand safety.

**Customer and Consulting Leadership**

* Act as a trusted technology advisor to senior customer stakeholders, including CIOs, CTOs and digital business leaders.
* Lead customer workshops, architecture discussions, solution presentations and technology strategy conversations.
* Understand customer business challenges and translate them into effective technology solutions and transformation roadmaps.
* Shape consulting opportunities by defining solution approaches, contributing to proposals and articulating business value.
* Clearly communicate complex technology concepts and the business value of emerging AI capabilities to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Build strong relationships with customers, Adobe account teams, partners and product engineering teams.

**Technical and Delivery Leadership**

* Provide end-to-end architectural leadership across large and complex customer engagements.
* Lead solution discovery, architecture definition, technical design and implementation oversight.
* Work closely with Delivery Managers and Project Managers to ensure successful project execution and customer outcomes.
* Lead and mentor architects, developers and multidisciplinary technical teams.
* Identify and resolve complex technical challenges and take ownership of architecture decisions.
* Develop reusable architecture patterns, accelerators and best practices, particularly around AEM, EDS and AI-enabled solutions.
* Stay current with Adobe Experience Cloud innovations and emerging AI technologies and share knowledge across the consulting community.
* Manage multiple customer engagements and provide technical leadership with minimal supervision.

**What You Need To Succeed**
**AEM and Digital Experience Expertise**

title: Sr. Product Manager
description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------

  
  

Docusign brings agreements to life. More than 1.8 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using the Docusign AI-native IAM platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the #1 company in e-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).

  
  

**What you'll do**
------------------

  
  

As a Sr. Product Manager on the Strategic Partner Integration team, you will own a defined product area within Docusign’s strategic integrations. Your initial focus will be procurement integrations, connecting agreement workflows to source-to-pay and procure-to-pay processes across systems like SAP and other major platforms. You will collaborate closely across customers, partners, Product, Engineering, Sales, and the broader Docusign ecosystem. In this role, you will lead integrations end-to-end—from discovery and requirements through delivery, launch, adoption, and continuous improvement. As the portfolio evolves, your scope may expand to additional strategic partner and enterprise-system integrations.

This position is an individual contributor role reporting to the Sr. Director, Product Management.

**Responsibility**

* Own the roadmap and priorities for designated strategic partner integrations, translating customer, partner, market, and technical insights into clear requirements and measurable outcomes
* Lead end-to-end product development, from discovery and requirements through design, development, launch, adoption, and post-launch iteration
* Conduct customer and partner discovery, synthesize feedback and technical requirements, and translate them into product narratives, epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, and prioritized backlogs
* Partner with strategic ISVs to align on integration use cases, product requirements, responsibilities, dependencies, delivery plans, and launch readiness
* Define seamless integration experiences across APIs, bidirectional data flows, embedded user experiences, data mapping and agentic workflows in partnership with Engineering and Design
* Lead one or more cross-functional product development teams, coordinating dependencies and keeping execution aligned to agreed scope, milestones, and quality expectations
* Contribute to the broader Docusign ecosystem strategy and roadmap by sharing customer insights, delivery learnings, and opportunities to improve repeatability across future integrations
* Collaborate with Business Development, Partner Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Support on launch plans, field enablement, customer communications, and adoption programs
* Establish and monitor product success metrics such as integration activation, usage, workflow completion, partner and customer adoption, reliability, and time to value; use insights to prioritize improvements
* Communicate product direction, roadmap, progress, risks, trade-offs, and decisions clearly to cross-functional stakeholders and external partners, escalating material issues when needed
* Share product management practices and provide informal mentorship to less-experienced colleagues, without formal people-management responsibility

  
  

**Job Designation**
-------------------

  
  

**Hybrid:** Employee divides their time between in-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in-office expectation)

Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.

  
  

**What you bring**
------------------

  
  

**Basic**

* 10+ years of related product management experience with a bachelor’s degree, or 8+ years of related experience with a master’s degree; equivalent experience may be considered
* Experience leading product strategy and roadmap execution for a feature area, platform capability, or product in enterprise SaaS, enterprise applications, or integration-focused products
* Demonstrated success leading cross-functional product development from discovery and requirements through launch, adoption, and iteration
* Experience working directly with customers, partners, and internal stakeholders to understand problems, define requirements, make trade-offs, and deliver products that solve meaningful business needs
* Technical fluency and the ability to engage effectively with Engineering and Architecture on APIs, integration patterns, data models, authentication, event-driven workflows, and embedded experiences
* Hands-on experience with building AI agents, skills and/or MCP tools and integrating with leading AI platforms
Experience working in an Agile product development environment with globally distributed teams  

**Preferred**

* Experience building or managing integrations with procurement, ERP, CRM, CLM, or other systems of record; experience with platforms such as SAP Ariba, SAP S/4HANA, Coupa, Oracle, or Salesforce a big plus.
* Domain knowledge in procurement, source-to-pay, procure-to-pay, supplier management, contract lifecycle management, or agreement workflows]
* Experience defining partner-facing products, integration applications, APIs, developer experiences, or embedded workflows
* Experience working with external technology partners to align priorities, coordinate delivery plans, and support joint launches
* Experience sharing product practices, mentoring peers, or serving as a product resource in a matrixed organization
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical and business concepts to partners, customers, cross-functional teams, and executives
* Strong analytical orientation, with experience using product and business data to make prioritization decisions and improve adoption
  

  

**Life at Docusign**
--------------------

  
  

**Working here**

Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.

We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. And for that, you’ll be loved by us, our customers, and the world in which we live.

If you experience any issues, concerns, or technical difficulties during the application process please get in touch with our Talent organization at taops@docusign.com for assistance.

description:
**About Us:**

Marriott International Inc., headquartered in Bethesda, Maryland, USA, was founded in May 1927 by J. Willard Marriott and Alice S. Marriott with a modest nine-seat A&W root beer stand. Guided by the family's leadership and core principles, Marriott International today has grown into a global hospitality giant, operating approximately 10,000 properties and over 30 leading brands in more than 140 countries and territories

From such humble beginnings to becoming the world’s largest hotel company, Marriott International has never stopped searching for inventive ways to serve its customers, provide opportunities for its associates, and grow their business. At Marriott Tech Accelerator center (MTA), Hyderabad, India, Marriott is exploring the world we live in and all its possibilities. At Marriott Tech Accelerator, we are a team of passionate engineering minds dedicated to creating and building cutting-edge solutions that streamline operations and elevate guest experiences.

Marriott Tech Accelerator center is fully owned and operated by ANSR. All associates at Marriott Tech Accelerator will be ANSR employees, delivering services exclusively to ANSR's client, Marriott International.

Marriott Tech Accelerator is an ANSR entity incorporated exclusively for providing services to Marriott International.

**Senior Quality Engineer II**

**Position Summary:**

The Senior Test Engineer is a hands-on quality engineering role supporting the Loyalty Financial Services (LFS) platform across Core, Partners, Platform/Data & Integrations, UI/Admin Portal, and Operations capabilities. The engineer will design and execute risk-based testing, build maintainable automation, validate complex financial and loyalty processing, and provide objective evidence of release readiness.

The role spans functional, API, UI, data, event-driven, integration, near-neighbor, regression, component performance, and production parallel-validation testing. It requires close collaboration with Product, Engineering, Architecture, DevOps, SRE, Security, enterprise testing teams, and upstream/downstream domains. The successful candidate combines strong automation depth with business-process understanding, disciplined test documentation, and end-to-end ownership.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Own the quality-engineering approach for assigned LFS capabilities from backlog refinement through production validation, including test strategy, scope, estimates, risks, entry/exit criteria, traceability, evidence, and sign-off readiness.

description:
**HMI Software Lead Developer– UAV Ground Control Systems (VC++, MFC, Win32)**

Location: Hyderabad, India (Hybrid/On-site)

**About the Role**

We are seeking a highly technical and hands-on Software Lead to take ownership of our core Ground Control Station (GCS) and mission planning applications. In the mission-critical UAV sector, our ground control software acts as the central nervous system for flight operations, telemetry monitoring, and payload management. You will lead a dedicated engineering pod to architect, modernize, and scale our Windows-based applications, ensuring rock-solid reliability for complex flight profiles.

**What You Will Do**

* Technical Leadership: Lead the architecture, design, and development of high-performance desktop applications used for UAV mission planning, live telemetry tracking, and payload control.
* Core Development: Write, review, and optimize complex multithreaded code using VC++, MFC, and Win32 APIs for Windows environments.
* Team Mentorship: Guide a team of software engineers, enforcing rigorous code quality, memory management practices, and peer review standards.
* Systems Integration: Interface ground software with UAV flight controllers and communication links using protocols like MAVLink, UDP/TCP, and custom serial interfaces.
* Safety & Compliance: Champion aerospace software standards (such as DO-178C guidelines where applicable) to ensure mission-critical reliability and fault tolerance.
* Legacy Modernization: Strategically decouple and refactor legacy MFC codebases into modular architectures to support future cross-platform or UI/UX scaling.

**What You Bring**

* Experience: 6+ years of hands-on software development with a minimum of 2+ years in a technical leadership or team lead capacity.
* Core Stack: Deep, uncompromising expertise in C++, VC++, Microsoft Foundation Classes (MFC), and Win32 API.
* Concurrency: Strong command of multithreading, asynchronous I/O, IPC, and memory leak profiling in a Windows environment.
* Networking: Proven experience with network socket programming (TCP/UDP) for real-time, low-latency data streaming.
* Problem Solving: Exceptional debugging skills using Visual Studio tools, WinDbg, and performance profilers.

* Standout Qualifications (Nice to Have)Prior experience in the aerospace, defense, or UAV industry developing GCS or avionics software.
* Familiarity with geographic information systems (GIS), map rendering (GDAL, QtLocation), or 3D rendering (OpenGL/DirectX).
* Knowledge of aerospace safety-critical verification processes (DO-178C, DO-330).

**Why Join Us?**

You will be directly influencing the software that commands next-generation unmanned aerial systems. We offer a culture of high engineering rigor, competitive compensation, and the opportunity to build products that solve real-world logistical and defense challenges.

**How to Apply**

Apply job here on LinkedIN. OR

Please send your resume to communications@qubistsolutions.com.

title: GG-1531 - Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) - Platform Team(AWS+Hybrid)
description:
Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) – Platform Team (AWS + Hybrid)
  
  
***Purpose of Position***
We’re looking for a
**Site Reliability Engineer**
to join our Platform team and own the reliability of the systems that keep our company trading — from our AWS-based digital platform to the connectivity and point-of-sale systems in every store. You’ll treat reliability as a product: setting SLOs with engineering and product leaders, managing error budgets, and making the call between shipping faster and holding the line.
  
  
This is a hands-on role that spans cloud and ground. One hour you’re tuning a Prometheus federation or an Open Telemetry pipeline; the next you’re troubleshooting a store’s connectivity at peak service. You’ll lead P0/P1 incident response, run blameless post-mortems, and build the observability and on-call practices that let a distributed, multi-site business run calmly through its busiest hours.
  
  
We care about reliability
*and*
cost — uptime at any price isn’t the goal. We want someone who genuinely understands how a technology failure translates into guest experience, crew workflows, and revenue, and who builds systems and schedules around how restaurants operate.
  
  
*****Our Current Stack Includes:*****
**Technology we use**
**Current Stack**

* Application Stack: TypeScript, NestJS, TypeORM/Sequelize, React / React Native, MySQL / Aurora.
* Cloud (AWS): ECS/Fargate, Lambda, RDS Aurora, CloudFront, API Gateway, SQS/SNS, IAM, VPC networking, Flow Logs.
* IaC & Automation: Terraform and AWS CDK at scale, CloudFormation, GitHub Actions, Bitrise.
* Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, Open Telemetry / OTel Collector, Datadog, AWS CloudWatch.
* Networking: SD-WAN, MPLS, BGP, VLANs and firewall policy; AWS Direct Connect, Site-to-Site VPN, Transit Gateway.

**Reliability & Operations**

* SLOs & error budgets: service-level indicators, objectives and agreements shaped with product and engineering leaders.
* Incident response: P0/P1 command, structured blameless post-mortems, and error-budget-driven release decisions.
* On-call by design: rosters built around operational peaks — breakfast, lunch, dinner, and weekend surge.
* Multi-site footprint: store connectivity and last-mile reliability across a distributed retail / QSR estate.

***Reporting to:***
Head of Engineering (Platform & Cloud Operations)
  
  
*****Responsibilities*****
Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
  
  
****Responsibilities****
**Cloud Infrastructure & Reliability**

* Operate AWS at scale — ECS, Lambda, RDS Aurora, CloudFront, IAM, and VPC networking, managed as infrastructure-as-code with Terraform or AWS CDK.
* Engineer for cost-aware reliability — balance availability against cost; right-size and optimise rather than chase uptime at any price.
* Harden release readiness — CI/CD, deployment safety, and rollback so changes reach production reliably.

**Hybrid & On-Premises Networking**

* Run physical and hybrid networks — SD-WAN, MPLS, BGP routing, VLANs, and firewall policy across a multi-site estate.
* Own hybrid connectivity — AWS Direct Connect, Site-to-Site VPN, and Transit Gateway between cloud and stores.
* Solve last-mile problems — diagnose and resolve store connectivity issues remotely, calmly and quickly, at peak service.

**Observability at Scale**

* Operate and scale Prometheus — federation, remote write, cardinality management, and alerting rules.
* Build Grafana for ops — dashboards, alerting, and provisioning at scale (Mimir or Thanos a plus).
* Run Open Telemetry pipelines — OTel Collector processors, exporters, and multi-destination routing.
* Integrate OSS and commercial — Datadog alongside the open-source stack for comprehensive insight.

**SLA / SLO Ownership & Incident Response**

* Define SLIs, SLOs and SLAs — shaped with product and engineering leaders, not filled into a spreadsheet.
* Manage error budgets — translate burn rate into clear release decisions and communicate trade-offs.
* Lead P0/P1 incidents — command response and run structured, blameless post-mortems.
* Report reliability — present metrics clearly to non-technical stakeholders across ops, finance, and exec.

**Restaurant Operations & On-Call**

* Connect tech to the guest — understand how failures hit guest experience, crew workflows, and revenue — not just ticket counts.
* Know the QSR stack — POS systems, kitchen display systems (KDS), ordering integrations, and loyalty platforms.
* Design around peaks — build systems and on-call schedules for breakfast, lunch, dinner, and weekend surge.

**Collaboration & Enablement**

* Partner across teams — support scalable, reliable service design with product and engineering.
* Mentor and document — raise SRE and DevOps practice; document infrastructure, decisions, and runbooks.
* Improve the platform — contribute to internal developer platform and portal tooling that lifts team productivity.

*****Essential Requirements & Behaviour*****
Cloud & Infrastructure
  
  

* 5+ years with AWS — hands-on with ECS, Lambda, RDS Aurora, CloudFront, IAM, and VPC networking
* Proficiency with Terraform or AWS CDK for infrastructure-as-code at scale
* Familiarity with AWS cost optimisation alongside reliability — not just uptime at any cost
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent experience

On-Premises & Hybrid Networking
  
  

* Proven experience managing physical network infrastructure — SD-WAN, MPLS, BGP routing, VLANs, and firewall policy
* Comfortable with last-mile connectivity challenges in distributed, multi-site environments (retail / hospitality preferred)
* Experience with hybrid connectivity patterns — AWS Direct Connect, Site-to-Site VPN, and Transit Gateway
* Able to troubleshoot a store connectivity issue remotely at peak service — calmly and quickly

Observability at Scale
  
  

* Deep experience operating and scaling Prometheus — federation, remote write, cardinality management, alerting rules
* Grafana expertise: dashboard design for ops audiences, alerting, provisioning, and managing at scale (Grafana Mimir or Thanos a plus)
* Hands-on with Open Telemetry and OTel Collector pipelines — processors, exporters, and multi-destination routing
* Experience integrating commercial observability (Datadog) alongside OSS stacks

SLA / SLO Ownership & Incident Response
  
  

* Experience defining service-level indicators, objectives, and agreements — shaping them with product and engineering leaders, not just filling in a spreadsheet
* Able to manage and communicate error budgets and translate burn rate into release decisions
* Track record leading P0/P1 incident response and running structured post-mortems
* Comfortable presenting reliability metrics to non-technical stakeholders (ops, finance, exec)

Restaurant Operations Understanding
  
  

* Genuine understanding of how technology failures translate to guest experience, crew workflows, and revenue — not just ticket counts
* Familiarity with QSR or fast-casual tech: POS systems, kitchen display systems (KDS), ordering integrations, and loyalty platforms
* Awareness of operational peaks (breakfast, lunch, dinner, weekend surge) and how to build systems and on-call schedules around them

Nice to Have
  
  

* Experience across AWS and Azure networking, Transit Gateway, Open Telemetry, and infrastructure reliability
* Background with Datadog Observability Pipelines Worker (OPW) or similar log routing
* Okta or SSO / IAM integration experience for workforce identity
* Contributions to internal developer platforms or portal tooling
* AWS Solutions Architect, or equivalent certification

What Makes You Ideal
  
  
You treat reliability as a product, not a chore — you shape SLOs, defend error budgets, and stay calm when a store goes dark at the lunch peak. You’re as comfortable in a BGP session or a firewall policy as you are in an OTel pipeline or a Terraform module, and you know when spending more on uptime stops being worth it.
  
  
Most of all, you understand that behind every metric is a guest waiting for an order and a crew member trying to serve them. You build systems, dashboards, and on-call schedules around how restaurants run — and you leave behind runbooks and practices the whole team can rely on.

title: Senior Technical Release Manager
description:
**About Sureify**
Sureify is dedicated to modernizing the life insurance and annuity industry. We provide cutting-edge digital solutions that empower insurers to easily engage with, sell to, and service their customers. Our mission is to drive meaningful digital transformation by offering scalable technology that enhances customer engagement and streamlines carrier operations. Sureify's products deliver the advanced digital experiences that life insurance carriers, agents, employees, and consumers now expect in this rapidly evolving technological landscape. At Sureify, we cultivate a culture that prioritizes innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are looking for a
**Senior Technical Release Manager**
to join our Hyderabad office. This role will be responsible for managing all production releases across our enterprise platform and customer-specific solutions. Unlike traditional release roles, this position serves as a
**Technical Release Governor**
in a complex hybrid environment consisting of both
**multi-tenant**
products and
**multi-instance**
siloed environments.
  
  
As we scale our
**carrier customer**
base, we are looking to adopt best of the breed release practices. You will be the single point of accountability for replacing high-intensity manual interventions in releases with a systematic, technically rigorous process. You will ensure releases are delivered with quality, predictability, and efficiency while bridging the gap between engineering, QA, product, and client support teams.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Release Lifecycle Leadership:**
Own and manage the end-to-end release lifecycle for all production deployments, including core platform production updates and customer-specific customizations. Define, document, and enforce
**release management processes and standards**
. Create and maintain the
**release calendar**
, ensuring transparency and alignment across teams.
  
  
**Technical Gatekeeping:**
Conduct deep-dive release readiness reviews. You will audit "Release Manifests" by validating steps such as SQL migrations or PDF template migrations, Temporal workflow versioning, Kafka schemas, and AWS resource configurations. A good overall understanding of deployment architecture in AWS is essential for this role.
  
  
**Environment Governance:**
Manage "Instance Parity" across our
**AWS**
multi-instance architecture to prevent "Environmental Drift" and ensure customer-specific secrets and variables match our global standards.
  
  
**Cross-Functional Orchestration:**
Facilitate formal "Go/No-Go" decisions by tracking a global checklist that includes technical and non-technical readiness.
  
  
**Risk Mitigation:**
Identify, document, and mitigate technical sequencing risks (e.g., database locks or stateful workflow conflicts) associated with production releases.
  
  
**Continuous Improvement:**
Monitor release performance, generate and provide metrics and reports and drive the transition from manual coordination to
**Automated Production Quality Gates**
within our release pipelines.
  
  
**Required Qualifications & Experience**
**10+ years of overall technical experience**
, with a background in software engineering, SRE, or backend operations.
  
  
**5+ years of direct release management experience**
in a complex, enterprise hybrid SaaS environment (Multi-tenant & Multi-instance).
  
  
**Cloud-Native Expertise:**
Expert-level knowledge of
**AWS**
(EKS, RDS, Secrets Manager, IAM, S3, MSK) and the ability to audit infrastructure-level configurations.
  
  
**Stack Fluency:**
Demonstrated familiarity with
**Typescript**
,
**PHP, Go-lang, and Node.js**
ecosystems. You must understand the deployment nuances of each.
  
  
**Modern Orchestration:**
Hands-on experience or strong knowledge of
**Temporal**
(stateful workflows) and
**Kafka**
(event streaming). You understand the risks of deploying to "in-flight" asynchronous processes.
  
  
**Database Proficiency:**
Strong proficiency in
**MySQL and Postgres**
, specifically in auditing complex migration scripts and data sequencing.
  
  
**Containerization Mastery:**
Deep understanding of
**Kubernetes (K8s)**
manifest auditing and deployment patterns (Canary, Blue-Green, or Rolling Updates).
  
  
**Communication & Gravitas:**
Excellent stakeholder management skills with the professional authority to enforce discipline and halt releases if technical or business criteria are not met.
  
  
**Preferred / Nice-to-Have Skills**
Experience in the insurance or financial services domain (or other regulated industries).
  
  
Knowledge of security, compliance (SOC2/ISO), or audit processes as they relate to release operations.
  
  
Experience with
**Infrastructure as Code (IaC)**
tools like Terraform or CloudFormation.
  
  
Familiarity with Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles such as Error Budgets and SLIs/SLOs.
  
  
**Why Join Sureify?**
At Sureify, you’ll be part of a collaborative, innovation-driven culture where your expertise will directly influence the quality and success of products, transforming the life insurance landscape. You’ll work alongside passionate technologists and industry experts, tackling complex challenges with cutting-edge technologies while helping shape the future of digital insurance.
  
  
**Our Guiding Principles**
Our products are for nothing if their creators are not fulfilled in their work. We want our employees to flourish at Sureify. We do not fawn over status or titles; instead, we honour effort and intelligence. The best idea wins, no matter which colleague proposed it. We do not shortcut our mission with overblown claims or false promises. Sticking to the truth is both a strategy and a principle for us.
  
  
Sureify is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to diversity. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, ancestry, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, age, disability, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
**Why qlub**

The end of a great meal shouldn't be the slow part. Waiting for the check, finding someone to take payment, splitting a bill by hand. qlub removes that friction. Guests scan a QR code and pay in seconds. No app, no download, no waiting.

From Pay-at-Table and Digital Menus to Order-and-Pay, Payment Links, and SoftPOS terminals, we handle the full payment experience so restaurants can focus on what they do best: great hospitality. Less friction means faster table turnover, smoother operations, and higher profit.

We're a fast-scaling fintech backed by Mastercard, Mubadala, e& and Shorooq. $72M raised, live across multiple markets worldwide, and headcount doubled in the past year. We're building the teams that take us to the next stage.

**The role**

We need a Senior Data Engineer to own our data platform. Today it runs on GCP: BigQuery as the warehouse, dbt for modelling, Airflow for orchestration, and ClickHouse where we need low-latency analytics. It feeds internal reporting, merchant-facing analytics, and a growing set of AI-assisted tooling.

This is a hands-on job. Most of your week is building and running pipelines, fixing what breaks, and making the data trustworthy enough that people stop double-checking it. You will also set the standards the rest of the team follows and mentor the engineers around you.

You do not need to have used every tool listed below. You do need to have run production data systems and know what goes wrong with them.

**What you’ll own**

**Ingestion**

* Own how data gets in: CDC from our transactional databases, SaaS sources, application events, and third-party APIs.
* Handle the unglamorous parts well: backfills, retries, schema changes, late-arriving data.

**Modelling**

* Own the dbt project end to end: staging through marts, tests, docs, incremental models, and the naming and contract conventions everyone follows.
* Keep BigQuery fast and cheap: partitioning, clustering, query tuning, and cost monitoring.

**Serving and infrastructure**

* Serve low-latency analytics from an OLAP store such as ClickHouse: table design, sorting keys, materialized views, aggregation strategy.
* Look after the GCP estate around the warehouse: Cloud Storage, Cloud Run services, IAM, and the occasional read from sources hosted elsewhere.

**Reliability**

* Run production Airflow: scheduling, dependencies, retries, alerting, and the operational habits that go with it.
* Put freshness and quality checks in place, and fix root causes when they fire rather than restarting the job.
* Set up CI/CD and tests for data code so changes ship safely.

**AI and the team**

* Find where LLMs and agents genuinely help (data discovery, quality monitoring, troubleshooting), and ship those. Skip the demos.
* Review code, mentor junior and mid-level engineers, and write down the decisions and runbooks the team will need later.

**Who you are**

* You own outcomes and you see your work through to production.
* You make good decisions quickly with incomplete information.
* You use AI to move faster without giving up security, maintainability or engineering judgement.
* You're comfortable working anywhere in the stack, and you pick up new tools and languages quickly.
* You collaborate well with engineers, product, design and operations teams.

**What you’ll need**

* 5+ years in data or backend engineering, most of it on production systems.
* Strong Python, with years of writing and debugging production pipelines and services.
* Advanced SQL: window functions, complex transformations, and knowing why a query is slow.
* 2+ years of production dbt experience, including incremental models, macros, tests and docs.
* Experience running production Airflow DAGs, including backfills, monitoring and troubleshooting when things break.
* Strong BigQuery skills: modelling, partitioning, clustering, and query and cost tuning.
* Good knowledge of GCP, including Cloud Storage, IAM and general cloud data infrastructure.
* Solid PostgreSQL experience: indexing, query performance and incremental extraction.
* Experience with stream or distributed processing, such as Apache Flink or similar.
* Comfortable working on a Linux VM: Bash, cron, Docker, reading logs, SSH and basic networking.
* Strong engineering practice with Git, CI/CD, tests and code review, writing code other people can maintain.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with ClickHouse or production OLAP: tuning, materialized views and cluster operations.
* Experience with managed ETL/ELT platforms such as Airbyte or Fivetran.
* Experience with Datastream for CDC and database replication.
* Experience with Kafka and Debezium for event streaming and change data capture.
* Experience with Kubernetes and Terraform.
* Experience with BI tools such as Tableau or Power BI, and a feel for what makes dashboards slow.
* Experience with LLM APIs, RAG and agent frameworks.
* Experience with data observability tools such as Soda, Great Expectations or Monte Carlo.
* Experience with AWS (EC2, S3, RDS).
* A CS or engineering degree, though a strong track record matters more.

**What we offer**

* Real ownership over products that impact millions of diners and thousands of restaurants globally
* The opportunity to solve challenging problems in payments, hospitality, and customer experience
* A fast-moving environment where great ideas quickly become reality
* Close collaboration with experienced operators, builders, and industry experts
* A chance to leave a visible mark on one of the fastest-growing restaurant technology companies globally

**Ready to build?** Join us and help shape how the world pays at the table. If that excites you, apply now.

title: DMTS ITP AI Architecture and Delivery
description:
Job ID

JR117033

**Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for** ***all*****.**

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

The Distinguished Member of Technical Staff (DMTS) for ITP (Innovation, Technology and Products) AI is one of the company's important distinguished technical leadership positions, accountable for turning ITP's AI priorities into production-grade solutions that accelerate technology development, silicon design, product development, and engineering execution across ITP. This role is central to Micron's mission to make AI foundational to how ITP innovates and develops technology and products, amplifying its people and unlocking durable competitive advantage through solutions that are deployed, adopted, and delivering value.

  
  

**Position Summary**

The ITP AI DMTS is a hands-on technical architect and execution leader in Artificial Intelligence. This individual will work closely with subject matter experts (SMEs) across ITP to understand engineering workflows and pain points, translate those needs into practical AI architectures, and work alongside implementation teams seeing through to production deployment. The role directly advances ITP's goal to redesign engineering from specification to qualification, enabling more design IDs, faster execution, and first-pass qualification with best-in-class quality.

The DMTS will be accountable alongside implementation teams for delivery of outcomes, partnering directly with internal customers to ensure solutions are adopted and deliver measurable business impact, including ITP's broader goal of significantly faster time-to-market. Success in this role will be measured primarily by the number of AI systems successfully rolled out into production and the business value they deliver. The individual will drive disciplined execution against quarterly objectives while bringing applied innovation to every solution, ensuring Micron continues to lead in how AI is used across engineering.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

Architecture and Execution

* Partner with SMEs across ITP to understand engineering workflows, data, and constraints, and translate them into scalable, implementable AI architectures.

* Define technical designs, solution blueprints, and implementation plans that move AI use cases from concept to production.

* Lead hands-on technical execution, including architecture reviews, build decisions, integration, and deployment readiness.

* Establish reusable architecture patterns, platforms, and standards that accelerate delivery across ITP.

* Translate the ITP AI roadmap into concrete quarterly deliverables with clear milestones, owners, and success criteria.

* Identify and manage technical risks, dependencies, and trade-offs to keep programs on schedule.

Customer Partnership and Production Delivery

* Own delivery of AI outcomes end to end, from requirements through production rollout and adoption.

* Work closely with internal customers across technology development, silicon design, product engineering, and manufacturing to prioritize the use cases with the highest business impact.

* Drive the rollout of production AI systems, ensuring quality, reliability, scalability, security, and supportability.

* Partner with cross-functional engineering and IT teams to integrate AI solutions into existing tools, data, and workflows.

* Track and report adoption, performance, and business impact of deployed solutions, including improvements in velocity, quality, and cost.

* Continuously improve deployed systems based on customer feedback and operational data.

Applied Innovation

* Drive innovation that becomes deployable capability, applying advances in GenAI, agentic AI, machine learning, scientific AI, and semiconductor-focused AI to real ITP problems.

* Rapidly prototype and evaluate new approaches, scaling those that prove value into production.

* Bring emerging AI technologies and industry practices into ITP where they can measurably improve engineering outcomes.

Technical Leadership and Influence

* Drive disciplined execution against objectives set each quarter, translating the ITP AI roadmap into measurable, quarter-over-quarter results.

* Serve as a trusted technical advisor to ITP leaders on AI architecture, delivery priorities, and investment trade-offs.

* Lead cross-functional teams through complex technical challenges requiring exceptional expertise and creativity.

* Mentor senior technical staff, principal engineers, architects, and engineers

* Build and strengthen Micron's AI technical community and talent pipeline.

How Success Is Measured

* Number of AI systems rolled out into production across ITP.

* Customer adoption and sustained usage of deployed solutions.

title: GG-1531 - Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) - Platform Team(AWS+Hybrid)
description:
Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) – Platform Team (AWS + Hybrid)

***Purpose of Position***

We’re looking for a **Site Reliability Engineer** to join our Platform team and own the reliability of the systems that keep our company trading — from our AWS-based digital platform to the connectivity and point-of-sale systems in every store. You’ll treat reliability as a product: setting SLOs with engineering and product leaders, managing error budgets, and making the call between shipping faster and holding the line.

This is a hands-on role that spans cloud and ground. One hour you’re tuning a Prometheus federation or an Open Telemetry pipeline; the next you’re troubleshooting a store’s connectivity at peak service. You’ll lead P0/P1 incident response, run blameless post-mortems, and build the observability and on-call practices that let a distributed, multi-site business run calmly through its busiest hours.

We care about reliability *and* cost — uptime at any price isn’t the goal. We want someone who genuinely understands how a technology failure translates into guest experience, crew workflows, and revenue, and who builds systems and schedules around how restaurants operate.

***Our current stack includes:***

**Technology we use**

**Current Stack**

  

* **Application Stack:** TypeScript, NestJS, TypeORM/Sequelize, React / React Native, MySQL / Aurora.
* **Cloud (AWS):** ECS/Fargate, Lambda, RDS Aurora, CloudFront, API Gateway, SQS/SNS, IAM, VPC networking, Flow Logs.
* **IaC & Automation:** Terraform and AWS CDK at scale, CloudFormation, GitHub Actions, Bitrise.
* **Observability:** Prometheus, Grafana, Open Telemetry / OTel Collector, Datadog, AWS CloudWatch.
* **Networking:** SD-WAN, MPLS, BGP, VLANs and firewall policy; AWS Direct Connect, Site-to-Site VPN, Transit Gateway.

**Reliability & Operations**

  

* **SLOs & error budgets:** service-level indicators, objectives and agreements shaped with product and engineering leaders.
* **Incident response:** P0/P1 command, structured blameless post-mortems, and error-budget-driven release decisions.
* **On-call by design:** rosters built around operational peaks — breakfast, lunch, dinner, and weekend surge.
* **Multi-site footprint:** store connectivity and last-mile reliability across a distributed retail / QSR estate.

***Reporting to:*** Head of Engineering (Platform & Cloud Operations)

***Responsibilities***

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

**Responsibilities**

**Cloud Infrastructure & Reliability**

  

* **Operate AWS at scale —** ECS, Lambda, RDS Aurora, CloudFront, IAM, and VPC networking, managed as infrastructure-as-code with Terraform or AWS CDK.
* **Engineer for cost-aware reliability —** balance availability against cost; right-size and optimise rather than chase uptime at any price.
* **Harden release readiness —** CI/CD, deployment safety, and rollback so changes reach production reliably.

**Hybrid & On-Premises Networking**

  

* **Run physical and hybrid networks —** SD-WAN, MPLS, BGP routing, VLANs, and firewall policy across a multi-site estate.
* **Own hybrid connectivity —** AWS Direct Connect, Site-to-Site VPN, and Transit Gateway between cloud and stores.
* **Solve last-mile problems —** diagnose and resolve store connectivity issues remotely, calmly and quickly, at peak service.

**Observability at Scale**

  

* **Operate and scale Prometheus —** federation, remote write, cardinality management, and alerting rules.
* **Build Grafana for ops —** dashboards, alerting, and provisioning at scale (Mimir or Thanos a plus).
* **Run Open Telemetry pipelines —** OTel Collector processors, exporters, and multi-destination routing.
* **Integrate OSS and commercial —** Datadog alongside the open-source stack for comprehensive insight.

**SLA / SLO Ownership & Incident Response**

  

* **Define SLIs, SLOs and SLAs —** shaped with product and engineering leaders, not filled into a spreadsheet.
* **Manage error budgets —** translate burn rate into clear release decisions and communicate trade-offs.
* **Lead P0/P1 incidents —** command response and run structured, blameless post-mortems.
* **Report reliability —** present metrics clearly to non-technical stakeholders across ops, finance, and exec.

**Restaurant Operations & On-Call**

  

* **Connect tech to the guest —** understand how failures hit guest experience, crew workflows, and revenue — not just ticket counts.
* **Know the QSR stack —** POS systems, kitchen display systems (KDS), ordering integrations, and loyalty platforms.
* **Design around peaks —** build systems and on-call schedules for breakfast, lunch, dinner, and weekend surge.

**Collaboration & Enablement**

  

* **Partner across teams —** support scalable, reliable service design with product and engineering.
* **Mentor and document —** raise SRE and DevOps practice; document infrastructure, decisions, and runbooks.
* **Improve the platform —** contribute to internal developer platform and portal tooling that lifts team productivity.

***Essential Requirements & Behaviour***

### **Cloud & Infrastructure**

* 5+ years with AWS — hands-on with ECS, Lambda, RDS Aurora, CloudFront, IAM, and VPC networking
* Proficiency with Terraform or AWS CDK for infrastructure-as-code at scale
* Familiarity with AWS cost optimisation alongside reliability — not just uptime at any cost
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent experience

### **On-Premises & Hybrid Networking**

* Proven experience managing physical network infrastructure — SD-WAN, MPLS, BGP routing, VLANs, and firewall policy
* Comfortable with last-mile connectivity challenges in distributed, multi-site environments (retail / hospitality preferred)
* Experience with hybrid connectivity patterns — AWS Direct Connect, Site-to-Site VPN, and Transit Gateway
* Able to troubleshoot a store connectivity issue remotely at peak service — calmly and quickly

### **Observability at Scale**

* Deep experience operating and scaling Prometheus — federation, remote write, cardinality management, alerting rules
* Grafana expertise: dashboard design for ops audiences, alerting, provisioning, and managing at scale (Grafana Mimir or Thanos a plus)
* Hands-on with Open Telemetry and OTel Collector pipelines — processors, exporters, and multi-destination routing
* Experience integrating commercial observability (Datadog) alongside OSS stacks

### **SLA / SLO Ownership & Incident Response**

* Experience defining service-level indicators, objectives, and agreements — shaping them with product and engineering leaders, not just filling in a spreadsheet
* Able to manage and communicate error budgets and translate burn rate into release decisions
* Track record leading P0/P1 incident response and running structured post-mortems
* Comfortable presenting reliability metrics to non-technical stakeholders (ops, finance, exec)

### **Restaurant Operations Understanding**

* Genuine understanding of how technology failures translate to guest experience, crew workflows, and revenue — not just ticket counts
* Familiarity with QSR or fast-casual tech: POS systems, kitchen display systems (KDS), ordering integrations, and loyalty platforms
* Awareness of operational peaks (breakfast, lunch, dinner, weekend surge) and how to build systems and on-call schedules around them

### **Nice to Have**

* Experience across AWS and Azure networking, Transit Gateway, Open Telemetry, and infrastructure reliability
* Background with Datadog Observability Pipelines Worker (OPW) or similar log routing
* Okta or SSO / IAM integration experience for workforce identity
* Contributions to internal developer platforms or portal tooling
* AWS Solutions Architect, or equivalent certification

**What Makes You Ideal**
------------------------

You treat reliability as a product, not a chore — you shape SLOs, defend error budgets, and stay calm when a store goes dark at the lunch peak. You’re as comfortable in a BGP session or a firewall policy as you are in an OTel pipeline or a Terraform module, and you know when spending more on uptime stops being worth it.

Most of all, you understand that behind every metric is a guest waiting for an order and a crew member trying to serve them. You build systems, dashboards, and on-call schedules around how restaurants run — and you leave behind runbooks and practices the whole team can rely on.
