title: Product Manager (Contract) - Subscription & Auto Renewal
description:
Through proprietary software and AI, along with a focus on customer delight, Sleek makes the back-office easy for micro SMEs.
  
  
We give Entrepreneurs time back to focus on what they love doing - growing their business and being with customers. With a surging number of Entrepreneurs globally, we are innovating in a highly lucrative space.
  
  
We operate 3 business segments:
  
  
**Corporate Secretary**
: Automating the company incorporation, secretarial, filing, Nominee Director, mailroom and immigration processes via custom online robots and SleekSign. We are the market leaders in Singapore with :5% market share of all new business incorporations
  
  
**Accounting & Bookkeeping**
: Redefining what it means to do Accounting, Bookkeeping, Tax and Payroll thanks to our proprietary SleekBooks ledger, AI tools and exceptional customer service
  
  
**FinTech payments**
: Overcoming a key challenge for Entrepreneurs by offering digital banking services to new businesses
  
  
Sleek launched in 2017 and now has around 15,000 customers across our offices in Singapore, Hong Kong, Australia and the UK. We have around 600 staff with an intact startup mindset.
  
  
We have recently raised Series B financing off the back of >70% compound annual growth in Revenue over the last 5 years. Sleek has been recognised by The Financial Times, The Straits Times, Forbes and LinkedIn as one of the fastest growing companies in Asia.
  
  
Backed by world-class investors, we are on track to be one of the few cash flow positive, tech-enabled unicorns based out of Asia Pacific.
  
  
At Sleek, we are on a mission to streamline operations and elevate customer experience through intelligent automation and modern engineering.
  
  
**About The Subscription Product And This Role**
Sleek's revenue is overwhelmingly recurring: corporate secretary, accounting and compliance services are sold as annual subscriptions, and each year roughly a quarter of that entitlement base comes up for renewal through a process that remains, in large part, manual. Sales and account teams chase, remind, negotiate and collect; the product nudges but does not yet decide. The gap between the renewal rate we achieve and the rate the service quality warrants is revenue leakage, and closing it is the mandate of this role.
  
  
**Mission:**
Own the subscription renewal journey from first renewal notice to collected payment, and convert it from a team-driven effort into a system-driven engine that raises the renewal rate and the share of renewals collected automatically.
  
  
We are looking for a commercially astute Product Manager on a contract basis who will sit between product, sales and finance and be measured on the renewal number itself. This person is hands on with data and experimentation, comfortable reading a collections ledger and a funnel dashboard in the same sitting, and expects to be in the room when sales sets its weekly renewal targets. The role is a lean one with real ownership over the renewal experience, the auto-renewal and auto-collection mechanics, and the commercial levers that govern them.
  
  
**Primary Accountability**
You own the renewal number and the three levers that move it.
  
  

* #1: Renewal target, jointly with sales. Own the renewal rate across markets and plans alongside the sales and account management leads. Build the renewal pipeline view that shows every entitlement coming due by cohort, risk and value; agree weekly targets with sales; and own the product-side actions that lift conversion on the cohorts sales cannot reach by hand
* #2: Automated renewal and collection. Own the auto-renewal engine and the share of renewals that are charged and collected without human intervention, including payment-method coverage, card and mandate capture at the right lifecycle moments, retry and dunning logic, and the policy for late payment, service restriction and reactivation
* #3: Renewal experience and commercial levers. Own the customer-facing renewal journey (notices, reminders, pricing presentation, plan changes, upgrades triggered by usage or compliance complexity) and the experiment programme that tests which messages, timings, incentives and defaults change behaviour, with a bias toward auto-charge by default and clear consent.

**Key outcomes**

* Renewal rate up, measurably and by cohort: The renewal rate rises against an agreed baseline, with the improvement attributable to specific product changes and experiments rather than to sales effort alone
* A larger share of renewals collected automatically: Auto-collection as a share of total entitlements increases through higher payment-method coverage, earlier mandate capture and more reliable retry logic, reducing the volume sales must chase by hand
* A single renewal pipeline both sales and product work from: Every entitlement coming due is visible by market, plan, risk and value; sales works the list, product works the levers, and both report to the same number
* An experimentation cadence that compounds: A standing programme of tests on renewal messaging, timing, incentives, defaults and pricing presentation, each with a hypothesis, a sample, a read-out and a decision, run on a weekly or fortnightly rhythm
* Fewer leaks at the edges: Failed payments, lapsed services, downgrades and silent churn are classified, counted and owned, and the handling of each is either automated or assigned to a named process

**What You Will Do**

* Run a weekly renewal review with sales and account management: what is due, what is at risk, what converted, what failed, and which product change would have changed the result
* Pull and model the renewal data yourself: cohort renewal curves, payment-method coverage, failed-payment recovery, time from notice to payment, and the revenue at stake in each segment
* Design, launch and read out experiments on the renewal journey, from reminder cadence and channel to pricing presentation, incentives and default settings, and turn winning variants into the standing flow
* Specify changes to the auto-renewal engine with engineering: charge timing, retry schedules, dunning sequences, mandate and card capture, plan-change handling and the rules for service restriction and reactivation
* Work with finance on collection policy, invoicing, credit terms and the reconciliation of collected renewals, so that what the product charges and what finance recognises agree
* Instrument the renewal funnel end to end and publish a dashboard that sales, finance and product leadership read every week
* Listen to renewal calls and read customer replies to understand why customers hesitate, and feed those reasons into both the product backlog and sales playbooks
* Identify upgrade and cross-sell triggers at renewal (usage, compliance complexity, headcount) and build the prompts and offers that surface them
* Ship fast and check your own work: write the spec, review the build, test the flow on a real account, and watch the first week of data

**Requirements**

* 4 to 6 years of experience building digital products, with a meaningful portion spent owning a subscription, billing, renewal, retention or monetisation surface where you were measured on a revenue or retention number
* Commercially astute: you understand entitlements, pricing, discounting, collections and the P&L consequences of each, and you can hold your own in a conversation with a sales lead and a finance controller
* Strong with data and experimentation: fluent in SQL or an equivalent, able to size a cohort, design an A/B test with adequate power, and read the result without an analyst in the loop
* Attention to detail: you notice the mis-timed reminder, the failed retry, the wrong currency on the invoice, and you fix it before the customer does
* Incredibly hands on: you write the spec, QA the build, pull the numbers and run the review yourself; this is a lean setup with no layer between you and the work
* Track record of shipping and iterating on real products used by paying customers, in close partnership with engineering and commercial teams
* Must hold existing legal working rights in your country of residence (Singapore, Malaysia, Vietnam, or India) with no employment sponsorship required and be available to start within 2 weeks post - offer.
* Must be able to commit to Singapore working hours (9:00 AM - 6:00 PM SGT, Monday to Friday) on a hybrid schedule if based in Singapore, or fully remote with an equipped, dedicated home office and high-speed internet if based in Malaysia, Vietnam, or India

**Role-specific attributes**

* Comfortable being accountable for a target set jointly with sales, and energised rather than threatened by a weekly number
* Bias toward system-driven outcomes: you would rather remove the need for a chase than make the chase more efficient
* Able to operate with limited structure and high ambiguity, and to make a defensible call on incomplete data
* Clear communicator across product, sales and finance, with the judgment to know which audience needs which level of detail

**Nice to have**

* Experience in B2B SaaS, fintech, payments or professional services subscriptions
* Familiarity with payment orchestration, card and direct-debit mandates, dunning and retry logic, or billing platforms
* Exposure to small-business customers in Singapore, Hong Kong, Australia or the UK
* Prior work in early-stage or fast-moving product teams

**Why this role matters**
Renewal is where Sleek's service quality is converted into retained revenue, and retained revenue is what funds the next round of automation. Every point of renewal rate and every point of auto-collection reduces the cost of keeping a customer and compounds across a base of 15,000 companies. The person in this role will see the direct result of their work in the company's revenue line within the contract term.
  
  
Behavioural fit is also important at Sleek, and we will be looking for candidates that have a proven track record of embodying the below attributes in their recent roles:
  
  
**Ownership:**
This shows reliability and helps build trust within the team. We move fast and need to know that everyone will see things through to completion and proactively help to get things back on track when challenges arise. Accountability is really important to us.
  
  
**Humility:**
There is so much we don't know. Humility allows for open-mindedness to feedback and a willingness to learn from others. It paves the way for collaboration and creates a positive work environment. It is a key ingredient of self awareness and emotional intelligence.
  
  
**Structured Thinking**
: Our business is complex with many layers (many services, many countries, many cultures). Regardless of whether you're more analytical or creative in nature, being able to show sound judgement is important to us. It ensures solutions are pragmatic and balance the needs of the organisation, team and customers.
  
  
**Attention to detail**
: You'll be managing multiple, complex workstreams from numerous stakeholders. It will be important for you to keep track of everything and notice when information is missing or inconsistent.
  
  
**Excellent listener and clear communicator**
: We have a variety of nationalities and for many people, English isn't their first language. For you to excel, you'll need to be present in your calls and make sure you properly receive and thoughtfully send messages to others in the business.
  
  
**About The Interview Process**
The successful candidate will participate in the below interview stages (note that the order might be different to what you read below).
  
  
We anticipate the process to last no more than 3 weeks from start to finish. Whether the interviews are held over video call or in person will depend on your location and the role.
  
  
A :30 minute chat with our Talent Acquisition team to learn more about you, your background, and what you're looking for.
  
  
A :60 minute technical interview with the Product Team
  
  
A :60 minute AI skills interview with the AI Lead.
  
  
A final interview with our CPO, giving you the opportunity to ask any final questions and hear more about our vision and priorities.
  
  
**Reference verification**
Prior to final offer confirmation, we will conduct one professional reference check with your recent direct manager or supervisor. To keep the process moving smoothly, this step may be initiated during the final interview stages.
  
  
**Requirement for background screening**
Please be aware that Sleek is a regulated entity and as such is required to perform different levels of background checks on staff depending on their role.
  
  
This may include using external vendors to verify the below:
  
  

* Your education
* Any criminal history
* Any political exposure
* Any bankruptcy or adverse credit history

We will ask for your consent before conducting these checks. Depending on your role at Sleek, an adverse result on one of these checks may prohibit you from passing probation.
  
  
By submitting a job application, you confirm that you have read and agree to our Data Privacy Statement for Candidates, found at sleek.com.
  
  
**Benefits**
Some other great things about working at Sleek...
  
  
**Humility and kindness**
: Humility is a core attribute we hire for, which means we have a culture of not taking ourselves too seriously and being able to laugh. Kindness is also incredibly important. We are committed to creating and nurturing a diverse and inclusive environment.
  
  
**Flexibility**
: The role will be fully remote, with work from home five days a week However, if you are based in Singapore, the role will follow a hybrid model. If you need to start early or start late to cater to your family or other needs, we don't mind, so long as you get your work done and proactively communicate. You can also work fully remote from anywhere in the world for 1 month each year
  
  
**Financial benefits**
: We pay competitive market salaries and provide staff with generous paid time off and holiday schedules. Certain staff at Sleek are also eligible for our employee share ownership plan and can share in the upside of our stellar growth trajectory as we work toward listing on a prominent stock exchange in the Asia Pacific region.
  
  
**Personal growth**
: You'll get a lot of responsibility and autonomy at Sleek - we move at a fast pace so you'll be making decisions, making mistakes and learning. There's also a range of internal and external facing training programmes we run. We're also at the forefront of utilising AI in our space and are developing a regional centre of AI excellence. It is our intention that if you leave Sleek, you leave as a more well-rounded person and professional.
  
  
Sleek is also a proudly certified B Corp. Since we started our journey in 2017, we've been committed to building Sleek as a force for good. In just over 5 years, we've joined a community of industry leaders like Patagonia, Ben & Jerry's, and P&G who are building an inclusive, equitable, and a regenerative economy.

title: Senior Power BI Engineer
description:
We are building a centralised marketing and sales analytics platform for a large multi-market consumer brand: a governed BigQuery data layer feeding a single, certified Power BI reporting product used by head-office marketing and sales teams and by every national market. It replaces a fragmented estate of hand-built, per-market dashboards and manual spreadsheet exports with one version of the truth.
  
  
You will own the Power BI half of that platform end to end — the semantic model, the KPI logic, every report page, and the executive PDF report generated from it. This is not a dashboard-assembly role. One model and one report template must serve every market through filtering, hold up under executive scrutiny, and reconcile to source platforms on demand.
  
  
**Experience:**
3 - 6 Years
  
  
**Location:**
Kolkata (Onsite)
  
  
**‍Key Responsibilities**
‍
  
  
**Strategic Marketing & Brand Building**

* Design, build and own the certified Power BI semantic model over a governed star schema in the cloud warehouse — relationships, cardinality, role-playing dates, hierarchies and field-level documentation.
* Choose and justify the connectivity approach (Import, DirectQuery or composite), and implement incremental refresh, aggregations and partitioning to keep refresh windows and query response inside agreed service levels.
* Author the KPI layer in DAX: a frozen, documented catalogue of measures covering traffic, engagement, conversion and funnel performance, with consistent year-on-year, year-to-date, quarter-on-quarter and custom period-comparison logic.
* Implement weighted and normalised benchmark measures so small and large markets can be compared fairly against a group average.
* Keep the model performant and maintainable — calculation groups, variables, disciplined measure structure, and regular tuning with Performance Analyzer, DAX Studio and Tabular Editor.

‍
  
  
**Report And Experience Design**

* Build the report pages the business actually asked for: a real-time KPI tracker with progress-to-target visuals, market-versus-group benchmarking, product-level performance, an end-to-end lead-to-order funnel with banded performance thresholds, channel and traffic-source analysis, and social performance.
* Design for flexible self-service: independent metric selection per visual, multi-market comparison, switchable chart types, and free choice of reporting and comparison periods — without users needing to export anything.
* Apply a consistent, accessible visual language across every page: clear labelling, sensible visual hierarchy, and charts rather than dense tables.
* Configure workspaces, apps, audiences and deployment pipelines across development, test and production, and implement row-level security where required.

‍
  
  
**Executive reporting layer**

* Build and automate the recurring executive PDF report generated directly from the platform, using paginated reports and export automation, so a market or period can be selected and a complete, correctly formatted pack produced in one action.
* Ensure exported visuals remain visuals — presentation-ready output, not screenshots of tables.

‍
  
  
**Quality, reconciliation and trust**

* Build data quality and anomaly surfacing into the reporting layer: freshness indicators, missing-period detection, and outlier alerting on unexpected drops or spikes.
* Reconcile platform figures against the underlying source platforms, document the variances that are structurally expected, and explain them clearly to non-technical stakeholders before they are discovered in a meeting.
* Write and maintain the model and report documentation, KPI definitions and handover material.

‍
  
  
**Delivery**

* Work to a gated, fixed-scope delivery plan with hard go-live dates, translating business requirements into agreed KPI definitions and report specifications.
* Run user acceptance testing on a reference market, manage a controlled review-and-revision cycle per report page, and support training and handover.

‍
  
  
**‍Required Skills & Qualifications**

* 4+ years in business intelligence or analytics engineering, with at least 3 years hands-on in Power BI on production, business-critical reporting.
* Advanced DAX — time intelligence, calculation groups, context transition, performance-conscious measure design. You can explain why a measure is slow, not just that it is.
* Proven semantic model design over a dimensional warehouse: star schema, incremental refresh, composite models, aggregations, gateways and capacity considerations.
* Strong SQL, and practical experience querying a cloud data warehouse (BigQuery preferred; Snowflake, Redshift or Synapse considered) with an understanding of partitioning, clustering and query cost.
* Direct experience modelling digital analytics data — particularly GA4 event-level exports in a warehouse, including nested and repeated structures, sessionisation and conversion definitions. This is the single most important differentiator for this role.
* Paginated reports (Power BI Report Builder / RDL) and export automation for pixel-accurate PDF output.
* Report and dashboard design judgement — you can take a vague executive requirement and produce something that answers it in seconds, and you can defend your layout decisions.
* Power Query / M for shaping and troubleshooting, and comfort with source-control and deployment discipline.
* Confident written and spoken English, and the composure to present work directly to senior stakeholders and take feedback in the room.

‍
  
  
**Desirable**

* Marketing, media or e-commerce measurement background — an understanding of what marketers and sales leadership actually need to see.
* Working knowledge of consent management and its effect on reported figures, and how modelled data behaves differently across interfaces and warehouse exports.
* Microsoft Fabric, Power BI Premium / Fabric capacity administration.
* Multi-market or multi-tenant reporting at scale, including row-level security design.
* dbt or an equivalent transformation framework; Python for supporting automation.
* Custom or advanced visuals (for example Deneb / Vega-Lite) where the standard library falls short.
* Relevant Microsoft certification (PL-300 or equivalent) — useful, but the portfolio matters more.

‍
  
  
**Interview Process**

* Application review
* 5–10 minute initial screening call with the TA team
* Technical interviews {Domain specific}
* ‍Practical test conducted in the presence of a panel member
* ‍Role match & offer

title: AVP, AI Security Architect
description:
**Role Title: 2603010 AVP, AI Security Architect (L11)**
**Company Overview**
Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as #3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the #1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
  
  
**Organizational Overview**
The Security Architecture organization enables Synchrony to innovate and grow securely by embedding security-by-design into technology solutions. We partner with engineering, platform, data, cloud, and business teams to translate security strategy and evolving threats into practical architecture requirements, reusable patterns, blueprints, and guardrails. Through risk-based architecture reviews, threat modeling, and scalable security guidance, the team helps protect Synchrony’s digital assets and customer data while supporting resilient, compliant, and efficient technology delivery. This role will contribute to advancing our AI Security Architecture capabilities, helping establish secure patterns and assurance practices for Generative AI, AI agents, and other emerging AI technologies.
  
  
**Role Summary/Purpose**
**The AVP, AI Security Architect**
will design and advance security architectures for Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, Machine Learning, and emerging AI technologies. The role will translate enterprise security strategy and evolving AI threats into practical requirements, reusable patterns, and engineering guidance that enable secure innovation while protecting company, customer, and sensitive data.
  
  
Working across Cybersecurity, Technology, Data, AI/ML Engineering, Cloud, Risk, and Business teams, the architect will lead solution-level security assessments, contribute to enterprise standards, and embed security-by-design through threat modeling, control validation, testing, and continuous assurance across the AI lifecycle.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Apply and help mature enterprise AI security architecture principles, standards, reference architectures, and guardrails.
* Design reusable security patterns for Generative AI, copilots, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), model and inference APIs, autonomous or agentic AI, and enterprise AI platforms.
* Lead security architecture assessments for complex AI solutions across cloud, SaaS, API, data, application, and enterprise technology environments.
* Partner with AI/ML engineers, application teams, cloud architects, data teams, and product owners to embed security throughout design, development, deployment, integration, monitoring, and retirement.
* Perform AI threat modeling using MITRE ATLAS and OWASP guidance, translating identified threats into actionable controls and engineering requirements.
* Define and validate controls for model access, identities, service accounts, secrets, APIs, prompts, training and retrieval data, outputs, plugins, tools, and third-party AI services.
* Assess risks such as prompt injection, data poisoning, sensitive information disclosure, insecure tool interaction, excessive agency, model manipulation, and AI supply-chain compromise.
* Contribute to automation of architecture reviews, threat modeling, vulnerability assessment, control validation, and security testing.
* Document architecture decisions, material risks, trade-offs, and recommendations for technical teams and senior stakeholders.
* Collaborate with Enterprise Architecture, Cloud, Application Security, Data, Responsible AI, Privacy, Legal, Compliance, Risk, and Business partners.
* Create implementation guidance and enablement that help engineering teams adopt approved AI security patterns consistently.

**Required Skills/Knowledge**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Strong experience in cybersecurity, security architecture, cloud security, application security, or enterprise architecture, including delivery of complex security initiatives.
* Practical knowledge of modern AI architectures, including Large Language Models, RAG, vector databases, embeddings, model gateways, AI agents, orchestration frameworks, managed AI services, and model or inference APIs.
* Strong foundation in identity and access management, application and API security, cloud security, data protection, secrets and key management, DevSecOps, and software supply-chain security.
* Knowledge of AI security and risk frameworks such as the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, MITRE ATLAS, NIST AI Risk Management Framework, and Zero Trust principles.
* Experience designing or reviewing enterprise architectures on AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
* Ability to convert technical risks into architecture requirements, reusable patterns, engineering guidance, and clear recommendations.
* Demonstrated ability to influence technical stakeholders, facilitate architecture decisions, and build alignment across teams.
* Strong written, verbal, presentation, and stakeholder-management skills.

**Desired Skills/Knowledge**

* Experience securing platforms such as Amazon Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Copilot, or comparable enterprise AI services.
* Experience with AI red teaming, adversarial testing, model security assessment, prompt-injection testing, or AI vulnerability management.
* Familiarity with NIST AI RMF, MITRE ATLAS, OWASP guidance, ISO/IEC 42001, and evolving AI governance expectations.
* Ability to move effectively between detailed technical architecture, engineering execution, risk discussions, and stakeholder communication.
* Experience developing reference architectures, security blueprints, automated guardrails, and scalable control-assurance capabilities.
* Financial-services cybersecurity, regulatory, risk-management, or data-protection experience is a plus.
* Collaborative and execution-oriented approach, with a focus on simplification, automation, measurable outcomes, and responsible innovation.

**Eligibility Criteria**
Bachelor's degree with 6+ years of experience in Cyber industry, security architecture experience including on-prem and hybrid environments and practical knowledge of modern AI architectures, including Large Language Models, RAG, vector databases, embeddings, model gateways, AI agents, orchestration frameworks, managed AI services, and model or inference APIs.

title: Production Support Software Engineer, .NET
description:
**Description**
**About WTW**
:
  
  
WTW is a leading global advisory, broking and solutions company that helps clients around the world turn risk into a path for growth. With roots dating to 1828, WTW has 49,000 employees serving more than 140 countries. We design and deliver solutions that manage risk, optimize benefits, cultivate talent, and expand the power of capital to protect and strengthen institutions and individuals. Our unique perspective allows us to see the critical intersections between talent, assets and ideas – the dynamic formula that drives business performance. Together, we unlock potential. Learn more at https://www.wtwco.com/en-us.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Individual Marketplace (IM) team supports people in the U.S. who need to purchase health coverage outside employer-based plans. It provides a seamless experience through Via Benefits, combining digital tools with licensed advisors to guide individuals—active employees, retirees, or those unaffiliated with an employer—through important health‑coverage decisions. IM helps employers offer greater choice, predictable costs, and reduced risk while ensuring individuals receive personalized, confidence‑building support throughout key life transitions.
  
  
**Summary**
WTW is seeking an experienced Production Support Software Engineer specializing in C# and .NET to join our growing IT Operations and Production Support team in Kolkata. This position combines production application support with hands-on software engineering. You will investigate application issues, analyze logs and service behavior, develop fixes for software defects, and implement small, well-defined application enhancements in partnership with the Individual Marketplace product and development teams.
  
  
The application environment includes C#, modern .NET, React, Azure App Services, micro-frontends, REST APIs, integrations, and event-driven architecture. The role’s primary focus is bug fixing and small feature development, followed by production investigation and troubleshooting.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Investigate production application issues using application logs and approved diagnostic tools.
* Analyze exceptions, REST APIs, service integrations, micro-frontends, asynchronous events, and unexpected application behavior.
* Trace application behavior across React front-end components, .NET services, APIs, Azure App Services, and event-driven components.
* Develop evidence-based findings and identify the appropriate owning team.
* Distinguish between application, configuration, integration, infrastructure, and data-related issues.
* Reproduce software defects and develop safe, focused code corrections.
* Create source-code branches and pull requests, add appropriate unit tests, and participate in code reviews.
* Implement small, well-defined enhancements with documented acceptance criteria and approval from the owning product or domain team.
* Provide completed code changes to the Individual Marketplace domain team for functional testing, release approval, and production deployment.
* Participate primarily in lower-severity incident investigations and provide application-engineering escalation support when needed.
* Assist with higher-severity investigations when requested, while the owning domain and incident-management teams retain leadership responsibility.
* Document investigation findings, probable cause, code changes, testing considerations, risks, and handoff information.
* Collaborate with IT Operations, Product, and Engineering colleagues in India and the United States.
* Use approved AI-assisted development tools to improve investigation, coding, and testing productivity while maintaining security, quality, testing, and code-review standards.

**Requirements**

* 7+ years of software development, production application support, or a combination of both.
* Strong software-development experience using C# and modern .NET.
* Experience developing and supporting modern .NET applications, REST APIs, application services, and distributed integrations.
* Experience developing or supporting applications deployed through Azure App Services.
* Understanding of event-driven architecture, including asynchronous processing, event consumers, failure handling, and troubleshooting across distributed components.
* Strong understanding of object-oriented design and software-engineering principles.
* Strong application-investigation and problem-solving skills.
* Experience analyzing application logs, exceptions, error messages, and service behavior.
* Ability to trace application behavior across multiple services and develop an evidence-based probable cause.
* Ability to reproduce software defects and translate investigation findings into safe, focused code changes.
* Experience writing and maintaining unit tests.
* Experience with Git-based source control, branches, pull requests, and code reviews.
* Familiarity with SQL and relational database concepts.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to create clear technical documentation and handoff information.
* Experience collaborating with geographically distributed teams.

**Qualifications**
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related discipline.
  
  
**Application Process**

* Application review
* Pre-recorded video assessment
* Live video interview – round 1
* Live video interview – round 2

***We're committed to equal employment opportunity and provide application, interview and workplace adjustments and accommodations to all applicants. If you foresee any barriers, from the application process through to joining WTW, please email***
***candidatehelpdesk@wtwco.com***
***.***

title: AI Architect
description:
Job Description

We’re looking for a seasoned Software Architect with deep expertise in cloud-native enterprise systems and Generative AI. You will define and deliver scalable, secure, and production-grade GenAI architectures — including multi-agent, RAG, LLMOps and AgentOps systems — and lead cross-functional teams to build and operate them. This role combines hands-on technical leadership, systems thinking, and strong stakeholder management.

Key responsibilities

Architecture & System Design

1. Design scalable, modular, and cloud-native architectures for GenAI applications(microservices, event-driven, serverless).
2. Define system boundaries, data flows, orchestration, and integration patterns forLLMs, vector DBs, embedding services, and tool integrations.
3. Produce architecture artifacts ( Layered Architecture Diagrams, C4 Models, DFDs,Class, Sequence, ER & Use Case diagrams, different types of blueprints, APIcontracts, design and trade-off decisions).
4. GenAI & Agentic Systems
5. Architect and deliver Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, NaturalLanguage to SQL Flows, fine-tuning strategies, multi-modal capabilities, and tool-augmented agents.
6. Design agent orchestration and multi-agent frameworks enabling planning,reasoning, and secure tool invocations, implement and design Agent prototypes andCommunication Protocols.
7. Define prompt engineering standards, memory models(episodic/semantic/procedural), and context management.

LLMOps & AgentOps

1. Define and implement model lifecycle pipelines: training, fine-tuning, validation,deployment, rollback, and monitoring.
2. Build AgentOps processes for agent lifecycle, behavior tracking, governance andperformance optimization.
3. Automate CI/CD for models, agents and services (MLflow, TFX, BentoML, custompipelines).

Integration, Security & Compliance

1. Integrate GenAI services with enterprise systems (ERP, CRM, data lakes, APIs) usingsecure, scalable interfaces.
2. Ensure secure access controls, data privacy, encryption, and compliance (GDPR,HIPAA, SOC2).
3. Define responsible AI practices: bias mitigation, explainability, audit trails, andoutput governance.
4. GenAI security — classify, encrypt & sign data/models; enforce least-privilege withshort-lived creds and CI/CD security gates; telemetry, drift/hallucination alerts, kill-switch & runbooks.
5. Agentic AI security — provable agent identity/attestation, tool allowlist + human gatefor high-risk actions; ephemeral scoped tokens, sandboxed execution,and replayable audit traces.

Observability, Ops & Cost Optimization

1. Define telemetry, tracing, and logging for models and agents; monitor performance,drift, hallucination rates and user feedback loops.
2. Build dashboards, alerts and runbook guidance for operational health.
3. Design systems for cost efficiency (autoscaling, spot instances, serverlesschoices) and support FinOps practices.

Leadership, Collaboration & Documentation

1. Lead cross-functional teams (product, data science, AI engineers, platform)through architecture reviews, workshops, and technical decisioning.
2. Maintain architectural standards, documentation, playbooks, and patternlibraries for GenAI systems.
3. Mentor engineers and evangelize best practices across the organization.

Required qualifications & experience

1. 10+ years software engineering experience with 3+ years in architecture or seniortechnical leadership roles (or equivalent).
2. Proven track record designing and delivering cloud-native, production systems atenterprise scale.
3. Hands-on experience with GenAI/LLM systems, RAG, NL-SQL,agentic frameworks or similar productionized AI applications.
4. Strong knowledge of system design patterns (microservices, event-driven,CQRS, hexagonal architecture), and Low Level Design Patterns.
5. Experience integrating ML/LLM services with enterprise data platforms and APIswhile meeting security/compliance requirements.
6. Solid engineering background in at least two languages (Python, TypeScript, Go,Java, C#) and familiarity with modern frameworks.

Technical skills & technologies (comprehensive)

1. Cloud & Infra: AWS / Azure / GCP; Kubernetes, Docker, serverless (Lambda, Functions, Cloud Run), GPU instances
2. GenAI & ML: Hugging Face Transformers, OpenAI APIs, ,LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, Haystack
3. Vector Stores: FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, Postgres+pgVector, and other cloud vector stores
4. LLMOps / MLOps: Custom Development of Ops Pipelines, MLflow, TFX, BentoML, Kubeflow
5. Data & Integration: Kafka, Spark, Airflow, Flink, ETL/ELT concepts, data lakes, API gateways (Apigee etc)
6. DevOps & IaC: Terraform, Pulumi, CloudFormation, GitHub Actions, Jenkins
7. Observability & Security: Prometheus, Grafana stack, OpenTelemetry, Jaeger, ELK, Datadog; Vault,
8. IAM, LDAP/OAuth2/OIDC/SAML Connect, Snyk, SonarQube, SAST/SCA in pipelines, OWASPs, CWEs, CVEs.
9. Databases & Storage: Relational (RDS/Cloud SQL), NoSQL (Mongo, DynamoDB, Cosmos DB), Redis, S3/Blob/GCS, ORM/ODM frameworks.
10. Agent frameworks / tools: Understanding of Basics of Agents required, Langgraph, Autogen, AutoGPT, AgentVerse, MetaGPT, CrewAI etc.
11. Performance & scalability: SSR/ISR, caching strategies (CDN, edge), lazy loading, bundle optimization, performance budgets.
12. Realtime & asyncRealtime & async: WebSockets, SSE, message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ), background workers. Frontend frameworks: React (Next.js), Angular, Vue; component libraries and state (Redux/RTK, Context, Pinia, Zustand)
13. Styling & UI tooling: Component Libraries, Accessibility best practices, Responsive UI
14. Frontend build & tooling: Vite, Webpack, Storybook, UI Frameworks.
15. Backend frameworks: Node.js/Express, FastAPI, serverless functions (AWS Lambda, Cloud Functions)
16. API design & integration: REST, gRPC, OpenAPI/Swagger, API versioning and contract testing, GraphQL(Optional)
17. UX & product mindset: Design-system familiarity, usability, accessibility, and working with designers

Behavioral & leadership skills

1. Strategic thinking with the ability to align architecture to product and businessgoals.
2. Excellent communicator: simplify complex technical concepts for technical andnon-technical stakeholders.
3. Strong mentorship skills — able to raise team capability in GenAI architectureand engineering.
4. Pragmatic decision-maker with a bias for measurable outcomes and trade-offanalysis.
5. High attention to detail, ownership, and accountability for reliability, security,and cost.

Nice-to-have

1. Experience operating LLMs in regulated industries (pharma).
2. Familiarity with prompt auditing, hallucination detection, and automated qualitychecks.
3. Background in knowledge engineering, semantic search, or knowledge graphs.
4. Academic background in CS, ML, or equivalent applied experience.
5. Mobile & cross-platform (optional): React Native, Flutter basics for mobileintegration
6. Deliverables & success metrics (examples)
7. Production-ready GenAI architecture and deployment runbook.
8. Deployed RAG/agent pipeline with observable SLOs and monitoring dashboards.
9. Reduced model hallucination/incidents and measurable improvement inretrieval quality.
10. Architecture decision records (ADRs), standards library, and cross-teamonboarding materials.
11. Cost targets achieved through optimized infra and autoscaling policies.

title: Engineering Lead_ Agentic Hive
description:
Job description:
  
  
Job Description About the Role and Team

Join Wipro's AI-Native Business & Platforms unit, a forward-thinking team dedicated to advancing the future of enterprise artificial intelligence. Our Agentic Hive Platform team is responsible for creating a robust, scalable platform that enables intelligent AI agents, digital ecosystems, and business process automation for our clients worldwide. This team plays a vital role in pioneering agentic AI technology, integrating delivery and client partnerships across India and the United States to drive innovation at enterprise scale.

We are looking for an experienced and hands-on Engineering Head to spearhead the technical vision and development of the Agentic Hive platform. The ideal candidate will lead architecture design, development, and deployment of agentic AI capabilities with a strong focus on security, scalability, and reliability. In this pivotal leadership role, you will guide a dynamic engineering team responsible for delivering production-ready AI solutions and integrating them seamlessly with enterprise systems.

Operating from India, you will collaborate closely with leadership and technical peers based in the U.S., ensuring alignment and fostering innovation across global teams. This is a unique opportunity to influence the trajectory of agentic AI in a large enterprise context, blending deep technical expertise with strategic leadership and enterprise architecture sensibilities.

͏ Key Responsibilities

* Take full ownership of the architecture and engineering delivery of the Agentic Hive platform, ensuring it meets business priorities, is modular, scalable, and aligned with product roadmaps.
* Lead the design and hands-on development of AI agents and automated workflows leveraging Claude and state-of-the-art agentic AI methodologies, including reasoning algorithms, tool integrations, and interactive human-in-the-loop processes.
* Architect and orchestrate multi-agent systems encompassing specialized agent roles, inter-agent coordination, task routing, stateful management, fault tolerance, and seamless tool collaboration.
* Design comprehensive context management solutions to optimize agent interaction, including memory management, prompt engineering, session persistence, enterprise knowledge integration, semantic search layers, and controlled data access.
* Develop reusable enterprise architecture frameworks, APIs, reference implementations, and governance policies that empower diverse teams to contribute consistently to the Agentic Hive ecosystem.
* Provide technical leadership and mentorship to an AI engineering team of 5 to 6 members, driving design excellence, code quality, development processes, and resolving complex technical challenges effectively.
* Establish agent evaluation standards with a focus on safety, governance, traceability, performance monitoring, hallucination detection, and overall quality benchmarks.
* Collaborate extensively with cross-functional partners including product management, UX/CX design, data teams, security, cloud infrastructure, and domain experts to deliver compelling, trustworthy, and user-centric AI experiences.
* Guide decisions and implementations in data science and data engineering domains ensuring robust data ingestion, transformation, retrieval, feature layer development, model integration, and reliable production workflows.
* Champion engineering best practices such as API-first design, CI/CD automation, container orchestration, cloud scalability, cost management, and secure operations across enterprise cloud environments.
* Engage proactively with stakeholders to translate operational feedback into enhanced platform capabilities and to support the adoption of agentic AI solutions across client engagements.

͏ Preferred Qualifications and Experience

* Proven hands-on experience designing and delivering Agentic AI solutions, specifically utilizing Claude AI for agent constructions and automations.
* Demonstrated expertise in multi-agent orchestration architectures, enabling complex agent interactions and integrations with external tools and systems.
* In-depth understanding of agent context management strategies including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), semantic memory modeling, prompt engineering, and secured data governance.
* Strong background in applying enterprise architecture principles to build modular, scalable, and secure platform infrastructures.
* Experience managing and mentoring AI engineering teams, balancing architectural oversight with active technical contribution.
* Robust data science and engineering skills encompassing Python programming, SQL, data pipelines, model development, and production-grade deployment.
* Familiarity with UX, UI, and customer experience design concepts enabling effective collaboration with design teams to translate user needs into AI solutions.
* Experience developing AI/ML or generative AI systems incorporating engineering practices like automatic testing, continuous integration and delivery, monitoring, security considerations, and governance frameworks.
* Strong communication abilities with a track record of managing technical discussions with diverse stakeholders including engineers, product teams, and clients.

͏ Additional Technical Skills

* Experience with agent frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or similar, including orchestration and agent-to-agent/tool interaction (MCP, A2A patterns).
* Hands-on knowledge of retrieval-augmented generation techniques, hybrid retrieval models, semantic search, knowledge graph integration, and enterprise semantic layers.
* Expertise in AI agent evaluation methodologies, including automated evaluation strategies, policy enforcement, guardrails, and metrics like RAGAS for ongoing assessment.
* Familiarity with LLMOps/MLOps tooling and best practices, including version control of prompts/models, experimentation tracking, automated deployment, performance monitoring, and governance.
* Deep understanding of cloud-native architectures on platforms like Azure, Google Cloud Platform, AWS, and Databricks, tailored for AI and data workloads.
* Competence in containerization and orchestration platforms such as Docker and Kubernetes, RESTful API development, FastAPI, infrastructure as code (IaC), and telemetry systems.
* Experience delivering AI solutions in regulated or complex enterprise environments, successfully transitioning from research and prototyping to robust production systems.

͏ Education, Experience & Leadership Competencies

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or related technical disciplines; or equivalent practical experience in these fields.
* Minimum of 12 years' experience in software, data, or AI engineering roles with substantial recent success in generative AI or Agentic AI architecture leadership and delivery.
* Preferred certifications in cloud platforms, AI/ML, data engineering, or related architecture fields that validate technical expertise.
* Proven leadership in managing and scaling engineering teams while maintaining direct hands-on involvement in architecture and development activities.
* Effective communicator and stakeholder management expert capable of articulating complex technical concepts to executives, product owners, and engineering teams alike.
* Comfortable operating in ambiguous, fast-paced environments, balancing innovation with enterprise-grade demands including security, governance, reliability, user experience, and cost management.
* Strong alignment with Wipro's values such as self-leadership, respect, trust building, transformation leadership, and execution excellence to inspire and drive team success.

What Success Looks Like

* Delivering a scalable, reusable, and secure Agentic Hive platform architecture that serves as a reference model across the organization.
* Ensuring all agentic solutions are production-ready, meeting rigorous safety, observability, reliability, and quality standards.
* Maintaining a highly effective AI engineering team, fostering technical excellence, predictable deliveries, and development of reusable components accelerating future projects.
* Driving strong adoption of the platform by internal teams, partners, and enterprise customers via outstanding developer and end-user experiences.
* Successfully aligning multiple stakeholder groups including product management, engineering, data science, security, governance, cloud operations, and client relations to maximize platform impact.

title: Agentic Growth Marketer
description:
**Agentic Growth Marketer**

**10-12 LPA**

**Location: Bangalore, Koramangala**

**Build the future of marketing. Not another marketing campaign.**

**Company:**
**Porcellia**

**Experience:**
No minimum years required

**Mandatory background:**
Engineering, software development, data, or a closely related quantitative field

**The opportunity**

We believe the future of marketing will be built by people who understand both marketing and technology.

Not marketers who occasionally use ChatGPT.

Not developers who build AI tools without understanding the business problems they’re solving.

We’re looking for someone who sits at the intersection of
**engineering, data, AI agents, and marketing.**

Someone who can look at a marketing problem and think,
*“Why is a human still doing this?”*

Someone who understands how agents work, how to connect them, how to make them reliable, and how to turn them into systems that produce measurable business outcomes.

**You don’t need to be a great marketer yet. I’ll teach you that.**

You need to be an exceptional problem solver who loves numbers, understands technology, and is obsessed with what AI makes possible.

**What you’ll actually do**

Your job is simple:
**Learn marketing. Then agentify it.**

You’ll work directly with me to understand how some of India’s fastest-growing D2C brands are built and scaled.

Then you’ll turn that knowledge into intelligent systems.

You’ll:

* Build AI agents that solve real marketing problems across creative strategy, performance marketing, analytics, CRO, retention, and growth.
* Create agentic workflows that can research, reason, execute, evaluate, and improve with minimal human intervention.
* Connect LLMs, APIs, databases, marketing platforms, and automation tools into working systems.
* Turn complex marketing decisions into repeatable, scalable processes.
* Work with large amounts of data to find patterns, identify opportunities, and make better decisions.
* Experiment constantly with new models, agent frameworks, and AI capabilities.
* Build solutions that don’t just save time, but actually make businesses more money.

**The goal isn’t to automate what marketers do today. It’s to build what marketers will be capable of doing tomorrow.**

**Who we’re looking for**

**1. You understand agents. Really well.**

You should know the difference between an AI chatbot, a workflow, and an autonomous agent.

You should be comfortable with concepts like tool calling, MCP, orchestration, memory, context engineering, APIs, evaluation, and multi-agent systems.

You don’t need to know every framework. But you should be the kind of person who experiments with new AI capabilities before everyone else starts talking about them.

**You should have built things. Not just watched tutorials about them.**

**2. You’re exceptionally good with numbers.**

You should be able to do mental math faster than most people can reach for a calculator.

Percentages, ratios, growth rates, margins, unit economics, probability, and data interpretation should come naturally to you.

You should be able to look at a spreadsheet and quickly figure out what’s happening, what’s wrong, and what matters.

Because great marketing is ultimately a numbers game.

**3. You have a technical or quantitative background.**

This is mandatory.

Ideally, you’re a software developer, data analyst, data scientist, engineer, or someone from a quantitative finance background.

You should be comfortable with structured thinking, logic, and solving problems using technology.

You don’t need a computer science degree. You do need to demonstrate genuine technical ability.

**4. You love marketing.**

You should be genuinely curious about why people buy things.

Why does one advertisement work while another fails? Why do people pay more for one brand than another? Why do some products become categories of their own?

You should find consumer psychology, copywriting, persuasion, business models, and growth fascinating.

You don’t need formal marketing experience. But you need to want to become world-class at it.

**5. You’re a builder, not a spectator.**

You should be someone who experiments relentlessly.

Someone who would rather build a working prototype over the weekend than spend two weeks discussing whether it’s possible.

You don’t wait for instructions. You find problems worth solving and start solving them.

**What you’ll get**

**I’ll teach you everything I know about marketing.**

You’ll learn how positioning works, how to create winning advertisements, how to read performance data, how to understand consumer behaviour, and how to build profitable growth engines.

You’ll get to work on real problems with real businesses, real budgets, and real consequences.

And then you’ll use your technical skills to turn that knowledge into products, agents, and systems.

You’ll be working at the frontier of a rapidly changing industry.

While most marketing teams are learning how to use AI tools,
**you’ll be building the tools and systems that redefine how marketing works.**

You won’t be joining a marketing team that simply follows instructions.

You’ll be helping create the future that other marketing teams eventually follow.

**Who should NOT apply**

* You’re looking for a conventional marketing job.
* Your understanding of AI is limited to writing prompts in ChatGPT.
* You dislike spreadsheets, calculations, or quantitative problems.
* You enjoy talking about ideas more than building them.
* You want a clearly defined role where someone tells you exactly what to do every day.

**Our hiring process**

We don’t care how many years you’ve worked.

We care how you think, what you can build, and how quickly you learn.

**Round 1: Make a video that catches our attention.**

This is the first and most important filter.

Make a video introducing yourself and convincing us why you should be the person building the future of marketing with us.

Show us how you think. Show us what you’ve built. Show us why you’re different.

There is no prescribed format.

You can be creative, technical, funny, analytical, or completely unconventional.

**We will shortlist candidates based on their videos. Not their resumes.**

**Round 2: Live interview**

If your video catches our attention, we’ll invite you for a live interview.

We’ll test two things:

1. **Data fluency:**
   Mental math, business logic, numerical reasoning, and your ability to make sense of unfamiliar data.
2. **Copywriting:**
   Your ability to understand people, communicate clearly, and persuade through words.

You don’t need to know marketing jargon. We’re looking for raw ability, not rehearsed answers.

**Salary**

10-12 LPA

title: AI Inference Engineer
description:
**Hiring for FlexAI**
— via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role.

**About the Company**

FlexAI is building a high-performance, cloud-agnostic AI compute platform for training and inference. Its Token Factory serves 20+ open models through one OpenAI-compatible API, from serverless to dedicated endpoints and private cloud, running across NVIDIA, AMD and emerging AI accelerators. The company is led by the team that deployed the Aurora supercomputer and managed 50,000+ GPUs at Intel, is headquartered in Paris, and is growing its Bengaluru engineering centre as inference demand scales.

**About the Role**

As an AI Inference Engineer you'll design, build and optimise the serving stack that runs large language and multimodal models in production on heterogeneous hardware. It's a hands-on role at the intersection of model architecture, hardware and production serving: you'll own critical parts of an inference runtime built on vLLM, SGLang and PyTorch, help set direction on performance, and work with engineering, research and product to deliver fast, reliable and cost-efficient tokens to customers.

**What you'll do**

* Own the serving stack for LLMs and multimodal models: engine configuration, tensor/expert/data parallelism and deployment across NVIDIA and AMD GPUs.
* Bring new open-weight models to production quickly and correctly: chat templates, tool-calling and reasoning parsers, structured outputs, quantized checkpoints.
* Profile and optimise throughput, time to first token, inter-token latency and cost per token, from kernels to the request path.
* Apply and evaluate FP8/FP4 quantization, speculative decoding, KV-cache reuse and offloading, prefix caching and prefill/decode disaggregation.
* Maintain and contribute patches to vLLM and SGLang, and upstream fixes where it makes sense.
* Run inference on Kubernetes across clusters and clouds with autoscaling, zero-downtime rollouts and graceful failure handling.
* Build observability, benchmarking, load-testing, evaluation and model-release tooling that catches silent quality regressions before customers do.

**What you bring**

* 2+ years building performance-critical systems software in Python and C++.
* Hands-on experience serving LLMs in production with vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM or similar engines.
* A deep understanding of transformer inference: attention and the KV cache, batching and scheduling, and when a workload is memory-bandwidth bound versus compute bound.
* Experience profiling GPU workloads (Nsight, rocprof, PyTorch profiler) and turning findings into measured improvements.
* Familiarity with distributed inference: tensor and expert parallelism, NCCL/RCCL, high-speed interconnects.
* Comfort with Kubernetes, containers and running production services.
* A habit of measuring before and after every change, and of verifying correctness, not only speed.

**Nice to have**

* Contributions to open-source inference engines or GPU kernels (CUDA, HIP, Triton).
* Experience with AMD ROCm or non-GPU AI accelerators.
* Experience with KV-cache systems (e.g. LMCache, Mooncake), speculative decoding or disaggregated serving.
* Experience with model quantization and accuracy evaluation.

5 Nov 2026

title: AI Agent Engineer
description:
**About Us**

Observe.AI is the AI Agents platform for customer experience, designed to help organizations deliver faster, smarter, and more efficient customer service at scale. The platform enables businesses to deploy specialized AI agents that autonomously execute work across the full CX lifecycle—from handling customer conversations to supporting frontline teams and optimizing operations.

Each AI agent is purpose-built for a specific role, equipped to understand context, make decisions, take action, and continuously improve outcomes. This allows organizations to increase resolution speed, elevate service quality, and reduce operational costs while empowering your frontline team to focus on higher-value work.

Built on a CX-native foundation, Observe.AI works with 300+ global brands in Financial Services, Insurance, Healthcare and Consumer Services, including brands like DoorDash, Affordable Care, to improve customer satisfaction, boost productivity, and deliver consistent, scalable performance across every customer interaction.

We’re looking for a client-facing AI Agent Engineer to design, integrate, and deploy enterprise-grade Voice and Chat AI agents and AI Copilots. This is a hands-on, delivery-focused role centered on bringing AI solutions to life within customer environments—not building foundational AI models.

You will work directly with customers to translate requirements into working solutions by configuring integrations, designing prompts and workflows, and deploying scalable AI agents. Teams work all across the company, in areas such as information retrieval, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking, security, data compression, user interface design; the list goes on and is growing every day. With technical and leadership expertise, you manage engineers across multiple teams and locations, a large product budget and oversee the deployment of large-scale projects across multiple sites internationally.
  
  
Our team is focused around driving continuous improvements to the machine learning software/hardware stacks through providing insightful performance debugging for workloads and custom kernels. We prioritize security, efficiency, and reliability across everything we do - from developing our latest TPUs to running a global network, while driving towards shaping the future of hyperscale computing. Our global impact spans software and hardware, including Google Cloud’s Vertex AI, the leading AI platform for bringing Gemini models to enterprise customers.

Partner with ML Stack leads to understand model optimization use cases and bring debugging to feel native in 3P environments (VSCode, Cursor, Grafana, etc).

title: Member of Technical Staff (Senior - Specialized Indexing)
description:
Category-defining tech. Career-defining work.
  
  
For more than a decade, Cockroach Labs has built database technology trusted to power some of the world's most mission-critical applications. Now, as AI transforms how software is created and operated, the infrastructure behind it has to keep pace. Cockroach Continuum is built to meet this moment, bringing individual databases together into one fleet designed for agentic applications, where AI agents help teams provision, scale, and optimize workloads at machine speed.
  
  
At Cockroach Labs, you'll solve problems that didn't exist five years ago alongside people who believe the simplest solutions often require the most sophisticated thinking. Your work will run in production at some of the most innovative companies in the world. The people who thrive here are the ones who want to own that opportunity.
  
  
**The Role**
The
**SQL Queries**
team is responsible for the core of CockroachDB’s query execution and optimization layer. This group designs and delivers features that make our distributed SQL engine fast, reliable, and flexible for a wide range of workloads.
  
  
AI is transforming how we search, learn, and build, and databases are evolving to keep up.
  
  
We’re forming a new
**Specialized Indexing**
subteam within SQL Queries to expand CockroachDB’s indexing capabilities beyond traditional relational workloads. This team will design and implement high-performance indexing systems such as
**vector, full-text, and geospatial indexes**
to support the next generation of
**AI-native and search-driven applications**
.
  
  
As part of this team, you’ll work on deep systems problems, collaborate across the SQL organization, and build production-quality features that make CockroachDB a unified platform for both structured and unstructured data.
  
  
**You Will**

* Design, build, and maintain specialized indexing features for CockroachDB, including vector, full-text, and geospatial indexing.
* Improve the performance and reliability of existing vector indexing systems, including backfill, query planning, and import workflows.
* Partner with other database teams to integrate new indexing mechanisms into the query engine.
* Develop hybrid search capabilities that combine vector similarity and text-based search for modern AI and search workloads.
* Participate in design discussions, code reviews, and release planning within the SQL organization.
* Take full ownership of your work, from design through implementation, testing, and release.

**The Expectations**
**In your first month**
, you’ll get familiar with CockroachDB’s SQL architecture, vector indexing implementation, and the surrounding systems. You’ll also begin contributing to smaller improvements and fixes.
  
  
**Within three months**
, you’ll take ownership of components related to specialized indexing, making measurable improvements to performance and reliability.
  
  
**After six months**
, you’ll play a key role in advancing hybrid search capabilities and help shape the roadmap for future indexing and search features.
  
  
**You Have**

* Passion for databases, indexing systems, and high-performance distributed architectures.
* A strong background in backend or systems programming, preferably with Go, C/C++, or Rust.
* Experience working on indexing or query execution systems such as vector, text, or spatial search.
* Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, and distributed systems.
* Curiosity about AI-driven and hybrid workloads that combine structured and unstructured data.
* A focus on building reliable, maintainable, and high-performance software.
* Collaborative mindset and ability to work effectively with a distributed global team.
* Typically 10+ years of experience building large-scale, production-grade systems.
* Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous problems into scalable, production-grade AI-enabled solutions.
* A builder's instinct for reuse and extensibility — your output becomes a platform, pattern, or capability others depend on.
* Clear judgment about where AI should be deeply integrated and where traditional approaches are more reliable.

**The Team**
The SQL Queries team is one of the most impactful and technically challenging groups at Cockroach Labs. Joining the Specialized Indexing subteam means working at the frontier of databases and AI, helping shape how CockroachDB powers intelligent, hybrid applications.
  
  
You’ll be part of a small, autonomous team based in India, collaborating with engineers and leaders across the world. You’ll have the chance to own complex, high-visibility features that directly influence how customers use CockroachDB.
  
  
If you’re excited about building innovative systems that push the boundaries of what a database can do, we’d love to meet you.
  
  
Cockroach Labs is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer building a diverse and inclusive workforce. If you need additional accommodations to feel comfortable during your interview process, please email us at accessibility@cockroachlabs.com.
  
  
Cockroach Labs has a hybrid work model, with Roachers that are local to one of our offices coming in on Mondays, Thursdays, and Fridays and working flexibly the rest of the week. While we’ve learned valuable lessons working remotely, nothing can replace the connection, creativity, and fun that occurs when Roachers get together and we are committed to fostering a workplace that encourages collaboration and allows us all to do our best work.
  
  
**Benefits**

* Medical Insurance
* Flexible Time Off
* Paid Parental Leave
* Mental Wellbeing Benefits
* Internet Reimbursement
* Wellness Allowance
* Food Allowance
* Office Commute Reimbursement
* And more!

title: Technical Lead & Manager
description:
**We are WisdomAI.**
*We exist to help people unlock clarity from complexity.*
WisdomAI builds AI-powered analytics that put answers directly in the hands of the people closest to the business. Our platform doesn’t just surface insights — it explains the why behind them, helping teams move from data to decisions with speed, confidence, and context.
  
  
We’re trusted by companies like Cisco, Patreon, and Rubrik — and we’re just getting started.The problems here are hard, and the expectations are high. Our team is energized by both. If you’re compelled by ambitious problems, high standards, and meaningful ownership, you’ll thrive here.
  
  
**The Role**
We're looking for our first Technical Lead & Manager in India. This role will help shape the next chapter of that organization while remaining deeply involved in the technical work itself.
  
  
**How We Work**
**Hands-On Leadership**
We don't see management and engineering as separate tracks.Our Technical lead will participate in architecture reviews, code reviews, technical discussions, hiring decisions, and occasionally jump into code themselves. The ideal balance is roughly 40% leadership and 60% technical contribution.
  
  
**Ownership**
Both the geographies - India and US - own meaningful parts of the product and platform. Engineers are trusted with end-to-end ownership and leaders are expected to create the environment where that ownership thrives.
  
  
**Talent Density**
We're intentional about every hire.The team includes engineers from companies such as Google, Meta, Rubrik, Glean, and other world-class organizations. Maintaining and raising that bar is one of the most important responsibilities of this role.
  
  
**Product Thinking**
The best engineering decisions start with understanding the customer problem.We look for leaders who can connect technical choices to customer outcomes and help teams prioritize accordingly.
  
  
**Builders**
We value people who can build from first principles.Processes, operating rhythms, performance management, career development, organizational design—none of these are finished products. You'll help create and evolve them as the organization grows.
  
  
**What You'd Work On**
**Scaling a High-Performance Engineering Organization**
The India team has grown rapidly and now spans backend systems, platform infrastructure, frontend experiences, and machine learning.
  
  
You'll help build the systems that allow that team to scale without losing speed, quality, or culture.
  
  
**Developing Future Technical Leaders**
Many of our engineers are capable of becoming future staff engineers, tech leads, and engineering managers.
  
  
A significant part of this role is helping them get there through mentorship, coaching, feedback, and career development.
  
  
**Raising the Hiring Bar**
We're actively growing.
  
  
You'll partner closely with leadership to identify exceptional talent, evaluate candidates, and ensure every hire improves the organization.
  
  
**Driving Technical Excellence**
As the organization grows, maintaining a high technical bar becomes harder.
  
  
You'll help guide architecture discussions, participate in design reviews, review code, and ensure engineering quality scales alongside headcount.
  
  
**Building the Next Generation of Analytics**
From agent orchestration and reasoning systems to distributed data infrastructure and AI-powered user experiences, you'll work alongside the team solving technically ambitious problems at the intersection of AI, data, and enterprise software.
  
  
**You may be a good fit if you**

* Have spent years building and shipping complex software systems
* Have managed engineers and genuinely enjoy helping people grow
* Still love engineering and want to remain technically involved
* Hold a high bar for technical quality and execution
* Operate with high ownership and low ego
* Can balance speed with sound engineering judgment
* Have strong product instincts and care about customer outcomes
* Want to help build an organization, not simply inherit one

**Strong candidates may also have**

* Experience at companies that have built at scale and have strong engineering cultures
* Startup or founding engineer experience
* Experience scaling engineering organizations from
* Experience with distributed systems, infrastructure, AI, data platforms, or developer tools
* Experience hiring and developing senior engineering talent

**Not sure this is the right fit?**

* Looking for a pure people-management role with little technical involvement? This probably isn't it.
* Looking for a remote role? We work together in-office five days a week.
* Looking primarily for title progression? We're more interested in builders than titles.

**Why WisdomAI?**
You'll join a company founded by repeat entrepreneurs and early builders from companies including Rubrik and Glean.
  
  
We're tackling one of the largest software categories in the world: business intelligence and analytics.
  
  
We're backed by leading investors including Kleiner Perkins and NVIDIA Ventures.
  
  
Most importantly, you'll inherit a strong team and have the opportunity to shape what engineering leadership looks like in India from the ground up.
  
  
**Our CRAFT**
CRAFT isn’t a list of aspirational values. It’s how we hire, how we promote, how we resolve hard calls, and how we stay honest with ourselves.
  
  
**C — Customer trust.**
Everything starts here. We listen carefully, act with integrity, and respond with urgency. Delight is downstream of trust — never the other way around.
  
  
**R — Relentless on outcomes.**
We move with urgency, take initiative, and see things through. Effort isn’t the measure — results are. If something isn’t working, we change the approach now.
  
  
**A — Authenticity.**
We say the hard things, directly and with respect. We also show up as full humans. That combination is how trust is earned and how we grow together.
  
  
**F — First principles, grounded in reality.**
We don’t accept “that’s how it’s done.” We strip problems to what’s actually true and build up from there — then validate quickly and let real-world results decide.
  
  
**T — Transparency.**
We share the why, not just the what. When something can’t be shared, we say so. We’re one team — information flows so we can do our best work and challenge each other when we’re wrong.
  
  
**Equal opportunity employer**
WisdomAI is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive team where everyone can do their best work.
