title: AVP, AI Security Architect
description:
**Role Title: 2603010 AVP, AI Security Architect (L11)**
**Company Overview**
Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as #3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the #1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
  
  
**Organizational Overview**
The Security Architecture organization enables Synchrony to innovate and grow securely by embedding security-by-design into technology solutions. We partner with engineering, platform, data, cloud, and business teams to translate security strategy and evolving threats into practical architecture requirements, reusable patterns, blueprints, and guardrails. Through risk-based architecture reviews, threat modeling, and scalable security guidance, the team helps protect Synchrony’s digital assets and customer data while supporting resilient, compliant, and efficient technology delivery. This role will contribute to advancing our AI Security Architecture capabilities, helping establish secure patterns and assurance practices for Generative AI, AI agents, and other emerging AI technologies.
  
  
**Role Summary/Purpose**
**The AVP, AI Security Architect**
will design and advance security architectures for Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, Machine Learning, and emerging AI technologies. The role will translate enterprise security strategy and evolving AI threats into practical requirements, reusable patterns, and engineering guidance that enable secure innovation while protecting company, customer, and sensitive data.
  
  
Working across Cybersecurity, Technology, Data, AI/ML Engineering, Cloud, Risk, and Business teams, the architect will lead solution-level security assessments, contribute to enterprise standards, and embed security-by-design through threat modeling, control validation, testing, and continuous assurance across the AI lifecycle.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Apply and help mature enterprise AI security architecture principles, standards, reference architectures, and guardrails.
* Design reusable security patterns for Generative AI, copilots, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), model and inference APIs, autonomous or agentic AI, and enterprise AI platforms.
* Lead security architecture assessments for complex AI solutions across cloud, SaaS, API, data, application, and enterprise technology environments.
* Partner with AI/ML engineers, application teams, cloud architects, data teams, and product owners to embed security throughout design, development, deployment, integration, monitoring, and retirement.
* Perform AI threat modeling using MITRE ATLAS and OWASP guidance, translating identified threats into actionable controls and engineering requirements.
* Define and validate controls for model access, identities, service accounts, secrets, APIs, prompts, training and retrieval data, outputs, plugins, tools, and third-party AI services.
* Assess risks such as prompt injection, data poisoning, sensitive information disclosure, insecure tool interaction, excessive agency, model manipulation, and AI supply-chain compromise.
* Contribute to automation of architecture reviews, threat modeling, vulnerability assessment, control validation, and security testing.
* Document architecture decisions, material risks, trade-offs, and recommendations for technical teams and senior stakeholders.
* Collaborate with Enterprise Architecture, Cloud, Application Security, Data, Responsible AI, Privacy, Legal, Compliance, Risk, and Business partners.
* Create implementation guidance and enablement that help engineering teams adopt approved AI security patterns consistently.

**Required Skills/Knowledge**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Strong experience in cybersecurity, security architecture, cloud security, application security, or enterprise architecture, including delivery of complex security initiatives.
* Practical knowledge of modern AI architectures, including Large Language Models, RAG, vector databases, embeddings, model gateways, AI agents, orchestration frameworks, managed AI services, and model or inference APIs.
* Strong foundation in identity and access management, application and API security, cloud security, data protection, secrets and key management, DevSecOps, and software supply-chain security.
* Knowledge of AI security and risk frameworks such as the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, MITRE ATLAS, NIST AI Risk Management Framework, and Zero Trust principles.
* Experience designing or reviewing enterprise architectures on AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
* Ability to convert technical risks into architecture requirements, reusable patterns, engineering guidance, and clear recommendations.
* Demonstrated ability to influence technical stakeholders, facilitate architecture decisions, and build alignment across teams.
* Strong written, verbal, presentation, and stakeholder-management skills.

**Desired Skills/Knowledge**

* Experience securing platforms such as Amazon Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Copilot, or comparable enterprise AI services.
* Experience with AI red teaming, adversarial testing, model security assessment, prompt-injection testing, or AI vulnerability management.
* Familiarity with NIST AI RMF, MITRE ATLAS, OWASP guidance, ISO/IEC 42001, and evolving AI governance expectations.
* Ability to move effectively between detailed technical architecture, engineering execution, risk discussions, and stakeholder communication.
* Experience developing reference architectures, security blueprints, automated guardrails, and scalable control-assurance capabilities.
* Financial-services cybersecurity, regulatory, risk-management, or data-protection experience is a plus.
* Collaborative and execution-oriented approach, with a focus on simplification, automation, measurable outcomes, and responsible innovation.

**Eligibility Criteria**
Bachelor's degree with 6+ years of experience in Cyber industry, security architecture experience including on-prem and hybrid environments and practical knowledge of modern AI architectures, including Large Language Models, RAG, vector databases, embeddings, model gateways, AI agents, orchestration frameworks, managed AI services, and model or inference APIs.
  
  
**Work Timings:**

We are proud to offer flexibility at Synchrony. Our way of working allows you the option to work from home or workspaces in our Regional Engagement Hubs—Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Pune, Kolkata, or Delhi/NCR. Occasionally you may be required to commute or travel to Hyderabad or one of the Regional Engagement Hubs for in person engagement activities such as business or team meetings, trainings, and culture events.

title: Lead, AI Data Engineer
description:
**About Amplify Health**

**Who We Are**

Amplify Health Asia Pte. Limited (Amplify Health) is a pan-Asian health technology and analytics company which brings together health technology assets, proprietary data analytics and healthcare expertise to support innovation across the healthcare value chain.

Headquartered in Singapore, Amplify Health operates in 10 markets across the region: Australia, Hong Kong, India, Indonesia, Malaysia, New Zealand, the Philippines, Singapore, Thailand and Vietnam.

Amplify Health develops integrated solutions that empower healthcare payors, providers and policymakers across Asia to identify value and drive new partnerships, understand variation and address systemic inefficiencies—with the aim of improving outcomes for individuals and the sustainability of health systems.

Powered by a clinically enriched data foundation, Amplify Health’s health intelligence platform combines modular AI solutions, context-aware automation and deep regional insights to offer localised, AI-powered health solutions spanning health payment integrity to chronic disease management. The company’s technology has earned recognition at several industry competitions, including the Celent Model Insurer Awards, ITC Asia Awards and SBR Technology Excellence Awards.

As an ISO27001 certified organisation, Amplify Health maintains clearly defined policies, structured oversight mechanisms and ongoing risk assessments that ensure alignment with global best practices on enterprise data security.

**Our Vision and Ambition**

To build the leading healthcare AI and platform services company in Asia that transforms the delivery of health and wellness for patients and communities by combining and leveraging the distinctive and complementary assets and strengths of AIA and Discovery.

Amplify Health will simplify access to health data and AI Innovation to accelerate distinct and disruptive healthcare value insights and resulting improvements in health outcomes through value-based care, personalised care plans and aligning individuals’ lifestyle/ behavioural choices.

By 2028, Amplify Health will have in place one of Asia’s strongest health-tech and AI capabilities; a comprehensive, integrated health technology stack supported by precision insights derived from proprietary data pools.

**The Position**

**Role Overview**

As Lead, AI Data Engineering, you will lead multiple teams and projects that deliver data and AI solutions on Azure and Databricks, and act as a trusted technical advisor to clients and senior stakeholders. You stay hands-on, shaping architectures, building reference implementations and reviewing critical code, while setting the technical direction, delivery standards and talent strategy for AI data engineering. Your job is to turn AI ambition into governed, measurable outcomes: help clients choose the right use cases, design the data foundations to support them, and make sure they run reliably and responsibly at scale.

**Role at a Glance**

* **Experience:**
  12+ years in data engineering or data architecture, including 4+ years leading multiple teams and 3+ years delivering AI/ML or GenAI solutions
* **Team leadership:**
  Leads multiple teams or pods (typically 8 to 20 engineers, including lead engineers); line-manages leads and senior engineers
* **Project scope:**
  Accountable for multiple concurrent projects or programmes (typically 3 or more)
* **Stakeholder / client exposure:**
  Client-facing trusted advisor; leads technical solutioning, pre-sales and executive engagement
* **Hands-on expectation:**
  About 30 to 50% hands-on (architecture, reference implementations, critical code and reviews, proofs of concept)

**Responsibilities**

**Strategy and architecture**

* Define the AI data engineering vision, reference architectures and reusable accelerators (for example, RAG ingestion frameworks, evaluation harnesses, MCP / agent data-access patterns and governance templates) used across projects.
* Act as design authority across projects: review and approve solution architectures, key trade-offs and non-functional requirements (security, scalability, cost, resilience, disaster recovery).
* Maintain a technology radar for data and AI (lakehouse, agentic AI, evaluation, AI gateways, open table formats) and lead structured evaluations of new platforms and vendors.
* Stay hands-on: build reference implementations and proofs of concept, lead reviews of critical production incidents, and review high-risk code and designs.

**Client and business engagement**

* Serve as the senior technical counterpart for clients and business executives: shape AI and data roadmaps and prioritise use cases by value, feasibility and risk.
* Lead technical solutioning for pre-sales, proposals and statements of work: scope, architecture, estimates, assumptions, client dependencies and risks.
* Present to executive and board-level audiences, translating technical choices into business impact, risk and cost.
* Build long-term client relationships and identify opportunities to expand and improve engagements.

**Delivery leadership**

* Oversee delivery of multiple concurrent projects, ensuring quality, timelines, budget and margin, and resolving escalations.
* Establish delivery governance: architecture reviews, AI release gates (evaluation thresholds, red-teaming, guardrails), production-readiness reviews and post-incident reviews.
* Drive FinOps for data and AI: forecast, optimise and report platform, GPU and token costs.

**Governance, risk and responsible AI**

* Own responsible-AI and AI-risk practices across the portfolio, aligned with frameworks such as the NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, Singapore's Model AI Governance Framework for Agentic AI and the EU AI Act where applicable.
* Work with legal, compliance, data protection and security teams on AI risk assessments, data residency, consent, auditability and the limits of agent autonomy.
* Ensure sensitive data, including health and personal data, is protected by design across every solution.

**People and capability leadership**

* Lead, manage and develop multiple teams, including lead engineers: set goals, run performance reviews and plan succession.
* Own the skills framework and learning roadmap for AI data engineering: identify skill gaps, sponsor certifications and run communities of practice.
* Lead hiring strategy and team design (pod structure, skill mix, location mix).
* Set the standard and policy for AI-assisted and agentic engineering across teams, balancing productivity with quality, security and IP protection.
* Build a culture of engineering excellence, psychological safety, learning and innovation.

**Candidate Profile**

**Required Qualifications**

* 12+ years in data engineering or data architecture, with 4+ years leading multiple teams or a practice of 8+ engineers, including leads.
* Expert, current hands-on skills in Python, PySpark and SQL, Azure and Databricks lakehouse engineering, and distributed system design.
* A track record of delivering multiple GenAI / ML solutions to production at enterprise scale, including RAG or agentic systems, evaluation frameworks and LLMOps.
* Deep data and AI architecture expertise: lakehouse, streaming, unstructured data, vector retrieval, semantic layers, model serving, AI gateways and MCP-based agent integration.
* Strong grounding in data governance, privacy, security and responsible AI in regulated environments.
* Proven client-facing experience: pre-sales solutioning, estimation, statement-of-work inputs, executive presentations and managing client expectations.
* Experience managing multi-project delivery, budgets and risks.
* Proven people leadership: hiring, performance management, coaching leads and building learning programmes.
* Exceptional communication and influencing skills with technical, business and executive audiences.

**Technology stack: Primary stack (Azure + Databricks)**

* **Cloud & storage:**
  ADLS Gen2, Azure Data Factory, Event Hubs, Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, Key Vault, Microsoft Fabric / OneLake
* **Lakehouse & processing:**
  Azure Databricks: Delta Lake, Lakeflow (Connect, Spark Declarative Pipelines, Jobs), Structured Streaming, Photon, serverless compute
* **Governance & catalog:**
  Unity Catalog (lineage, tags, ABAC, row/column security), Microsoft Purview
* **AI, retrieval & agents:**
  Databricks Vector Search, Model Serving, Agent Bricks, Lakebase; Azure AI Search; Microsoft Foundry (Azure OpenAI and other models, Agent Service); Azure AI Document Intelligence
* **MLOps / LLMOps:**
  MLflow 3 (tracking, tracing, evaluation, prompt registry), Feature Store, Unity AI Gateway, inference tables
* **Engineering & DevOps:**
  Python, PySpark, SQL, Git, GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps, Terraform / Bicep, Databricks Asset Bundles, Docker
* **AI-assisted engineering:**
  GitHub Copilot, Databricks Genie Code / Assistant

**Nice to have**

* Industry depth in healthcare, insurance or financial services; familiarity with data standards such as HL7 FHIR and regional privacy regulations (for example, PDPA, PDPO, HIPAA, GDPR).
* Experience setting up AI governance (AI system inventory, risk tiering, model and agent registers) or an AI centre of excellence.
* Multi-cloud (AWS, GCP) experience and Snowflake or Microsoft Fabric interoperability.
* Thought leadership: talks, publications, open-source contributions or partner advisory boards.
* Consulting, product management or business qualifications (for example, an MBA).

**Preferred certifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305).
* Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional and Databricks Certified Generative AI Engineer Associate.
* IAPP Artificial Intelligence Governance Professional (AIGP) or ISO/IEC 42001 Lead Implementer (desirable).
* TOGAF or an equivalent architecture certification (optional).

**How you lead**

* Trusted advisor: clients and executives seek your view because you are candid about value, risk and trade-offs.
* Multiplier: you raise the capability of every team through standards, reusable assets and coaching of leads.
* Hands-on credibility: you can still go deep on architecture and code when it matters.
* Accountability: you own outcomes across the portfolio, including responsible and secure use of AI.

**How success is measured**

* Portfolio delivery: projects delivered on scope, quality, timeline and budget, with no unmanaged critical risks.
* Client outcomes: client satisfaction, renewals and expansions, and AI use cases moved from pilot to production with measured business value.
* Reusable assets: accelerators and reference architectures adopted across projects, reducing delivery time and cost.
* Responsible AI: all AI solutions pass release gates and governance reviews, with no material data or AI incidents.
* People: engaged teams, leads developed and promoted, and strong growth in skills and certifications.
* Thought leadership: active communities of practice and external talks or publications.

**Join Us**

If you are passionate about leveraging data to drive healthier outcomes across Asia and thrive in a dynamic, mission-driven environment, we encourage you to apply.

Amplify Health is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Principal Architect- Ontology
description:
**About MathCo**

TheMathCompany or MathCo® is a global Enterprise AI and Analytics company trusted for data driven decision-making by leading Fortune 500 and Global 2000 enterprises. Founded in 2016, MathCo builds custom AI and advanced analytics solutions focused on enterprise problem solving through its innovative hybrid model. NucliOS, MathCo’s proprietary platform with prebuilt workflows and reusable plug-and-play modules, enables the vision of connected intelligence at a lower TCO.

For our employees, we foster an open, transparent, and collaborative culture with no barriers, making MathCo a great place to work. We provide exciting growth opportunities, value capabilities, and attitude over experience, enabling the Mathemagicians to ‘Leave a Mark’.

**About the Role:**

As enterprises scale their AI and GenAI capabilities, the organizations that win are the ones who can give machines a reliable, structured understanding of their business. We're hiring an Ontology Architect to build that understanding from the ground up — designing the ontologies, taxonomies, and knowledge graphs that turn fragmented enterprise data into a coherent, machine-readable model of the business. You'll work at the seam between data architecture and applied AI, partnering with domain data owners and AI/ML teams to ensure every downstream system — from analytics dashboards to LLM-powered agents — is grounded in a single, trustworthy semantic foundation.

**What You'll Do**

* Build base ontologies for a domain in pharma and CPG in collaboration with domain SMEs that we can take to market as an offering
* Own the end-to-end architecture of enterprise ontologies, knowledge graphs, and semantic/context layers for enterprise clients
* Build the knowledge graph backbone. Architect ingestion pipelines, storage design, and governance for production knowledge graphs, whether triple-store or property-graph based, so the graph stays accurate and scalable as the business grows
* Partner with client stakeholders and SMEs to model business domains and drive consensus on shared definitions across teams
* Architect the technical implementation on graph platforms (e.g., Neo4j, GraphDB, Stardog) and integrate with enterprise data warehouses/lakehouses
* Design and oversee integration of the knowledge/context layer into GenAI applications (RAG pipelines, LLM grounding, semantic search, agent tooling)
* Guide and mentor delivery teams and junior architects through implementation, ensuring adherence to modeling standards and best practices
* Collaborate with data engineering teams to build and maintain the pipelines that keep the graph/ontology current and trustworthy
* Present architecture decisions and trade-offs directly to client leadership; translate technical modeling choices into business value

**What You'll Bring**

* Direct experience integrating a knowledge graph, semantic layer, or context layer into an LLM/GenAI application (RAG, GraphRAG, semantic search, or agent-based systems)
* Hands-on experience leading at least one full-lifecycle knowledge graph or enterprise ontology implementation- not just a pilot or POC
* 14+ years in Knowledge Architecture, data architecture/engineering, and enterprise data platform design (Data Vault 2.0, Kimball, canonical data models), with a strong foundation in cloud data platforms (Databricks/Spark, Snowflake, or equivalent) and orchestration tools (Airflow or similar)
* Proficiency with one or more graph/semantic platforms (Neo4j, Stardog, GraphDB, Amazon Neptune, or similar) and familiarity with RDF/OWL/SPARQL or property-graph modeling
* Experience working directly with U.S. or global enterprise clients, ideally in a consulting or professional services environment
* Excellent communication skills- able to guide both technical teams and non-technical business stakeholders through complex modeling decisions

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with data quality and constraint validation across graph structures
* Exposure to graph algorithms, graph ML (GNNs), or using knowledge graphs to strengthen LLM grounding via GraphRAG

**Being a Mathemagician**

* Understand & embody MathCo’s culture and way of working
* Demonstrate an ownership mindset to drive results, striving for excellence
* Engage actively and contribute to initiatives fostering company growth
* Support diversity and understanding different perspectives
* As a testament to our growth, we have been, positioned as a Leader in Top Generative AI Service Providers – PeMa Quadrant 2023 by AIMResearch
* Recognized among the Inspiring Workplaces in North America, 2023 Accredited for Inclusive Practices by Great Place to Work Institute, India Recognized among India’s Best Workplaces™ for Diversity, Equity, Inclusion & Belonging 2023 by Great Place To Work® India .... among others

To know more visit our website.

title: Associate, Portfolio Strategy, Brio India
description:
TITLE: Analyst/ Associate, Portfolio Strategy Group, India
  
  
DEPARTMENT: Brio Portfolio Strategy Group
  
  
REPORTS TO: Vice President, Brio Portfolio Strategy, India
  
  
In 2025, Blackstone established Brio Real Estate (“Brio”) as a portfolio company focused on real estate
  
  
credit. Brio is a specialized global commercial real estate asset services platform that manages and
  
  
supports Blackstone’s Real Estate Debt Strategies business (“BREDS”) across the globe. Today,
  
  
BREDS has more than $77 billion in investor capital across high yield / opportunistic real estate credit
  
  
funds, a publicly traded Mortgage REIT, CMBS securities and insurance capital. Brio is a sophisticated
  
  
real estate credit solutions provider that enhances value for investors and supports BREDS across key
  
  
functions, including asset management, transactions, capital markets, surveillance, portfolio
  
  
management and legal & compliance. Brio provides critical infrastructure and capabilities for BREDS
  
  
to allow for effective investments and management of its global portfolio.
  
  
Blackstone is the world’s largest alternative asset manager with more than $1 trillion in assets under
  
  
management. Blackstone’s scale, with roughly 12,700 real estate assets and over 240 portfolio
  
  
companies, enables them to invest in dynamic sectors positioned for long-term growth. The firm seeks
  
  
to deliver compelling returns for institutional and individual investors by building strong businesses
  
  
that deliver lasting value. Blackstone’s global investment strategies focus on real estate, private
  
  
equity, infrastructure, life sciences, growth equity, credit, secondaries and hedge funds.
  
  
**Job Summary**
The Associate, Portfolio Strategy in India will execute portfolio management and reporting processes
  
  
for the BREDS portfolio. The portfolio spans Opportunistic, Core+ and Core capital sources for
  
  
commercial and residential real estate debt in public and private markets. This role offers the
  
  
opportunity to work across BREDS strategies and contribute analysis and insights that support the
  
  
broader business.
  
  
The role will focus on data governance, data management, and business systems support for the
  
  
Portfolio Strategy group, while contributing to data workflow improvements and the use of technology
  
  
to enable effective reporting and insights.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

glossaries.
  
  
 Assist with data lineage, source-to-target mapping, and data ownership documentation.

coordinate issue resolution with business and technical teams.
  
  
 Track data governance decisions and maintain supporting documentation for system
  
  
functionality, business rules, calculations, and workflows.

processes & systems via Confluence pages, user guides, and training materials.
  
  
 Assist with user acceptance testing (UAT) and validation of system enhancements, releases &
  
  
implementation.
  
  
 Coordinate and facilitate communication with business users, internal stakeholders, IT teams
  
  
and external partners or vendors to troubleshoot data-related issues.
  
  
 Provide support for business-critical applications and data platforms.
  
  
 Support project planning, tracking, and coordination activities.
  
  
Reporting, Analytics
  
  
 Support reporting and dashboard initiatives, with high focus on AI and automation tooling to
  
  
develop recurring and adhoc reports providing valuable insights for business stakeholders.
  
  
 Perform data validation and reconciliation activities.
  
  
 Maintain and deliver recurring and ad hoc reports for business stakeholders, ensuring outputs
  
  
remain accurate, timely, and aligned with evolving business needs.
  
  
Documentation & Knowledge Management
  
  
Stakeholder Engagement
  
  
 Partner with Asset Management, Portfolio Strategy, Finance, Operations, and Technology
  
  
teams.
  
  
 Gather business requirements and translate them into actionable work items.
  
  
Present findings and recommendations to stakeholders.
  
  
Portfolio Reporting
  
  

* Synthesize portfolio performance, activity, and composition into executive-level insights for

the Brio and BREDS leadership teams and external clients.
  
  

* Creation of presentations and other deliverables for internal and external meetings
* Work with broader Brio team and BREDS Portfolio Management to gather, coordinate and

synthesize data and analytics, ensuring accurate and timely reporting
  
  

* Partner with Brio Asset Management and other teams to support monitoring of credit

positions within funds and contribute to a consistent, global approach to strategy, analysis,
  
  
and reporting.
  
  

* Collaborate with internal stakeholders to develop value-added portfolio analysis and

communicate relevant insights on strategies and underlying assets.
  
  
Key Priorities / Focus Areas
  
  

* Create and maintain tools that support oversight of portfolio performance and inform

decisions intended to enhance fund returns and mitigate risk.
  
  

* Develop dynamic models to evaluate portfolio impacts under various sensitivities and

provide analysis that supports return optimization and relative outperformance.
  
  

* Participate in business plan reviews and create portfolio-based reporting materials
* Calculate and maintain key position metrics including DSCR and other key loan metrics
* Help to benchmark internal and external portfolio performance
* Strengthen portfolio oversight by embedding governed data and AI-enabled workflows into

analysis, reporting, and decision-making processes.
  
  
Process Improvements / Infrastructure Uplifts
  
  

* Document business requirements for reporting and process changes, ensuring clarity and

alignment across business areas and reducing redundancies
  
  

* Assess existing workflows, identify bottlenecks and redundancies, and redesign processes to

improve efficiency, control, and scalability.
  
  

* Evaluate technology solutions to automate reporting processes and enhance data accuracy
* Collaborate with technology teams to ensure integration of new tools and systems

**What You’ll Bring**
 Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Finance, Computer Science,
  
  
or related field; CA and / or CFA a plus
  
  
 Advanced skills in Excel and experience Snowflake, SQL, Power BI, Sigma, Tableau, or similar
  
  
analytics platforms preferred
  
  
 Knowledge of data governance and data quality practices, cloud data platforms and enterprise
  
  
reporting environments, preferred.

an asset management firm, private equity firm, lender, owner / operator, servicer, rating
  
  
agency, Big 4, investment bank or broker is preferred
  
  
 Strong analytical skills with demonstrable experience in analyzing quantitative and qualitative
  
  
research
  
  
 Experience in developing board presentations and reports for senior leadership
  
  
 Experience contributing to process improvements and the implementation of technology
  
  
solutions.
  
  
 Excellent in clear and effective communications with the ability to engage with a diverse range
  
  
of stakeholders
  
  
 Motivated to excel in a collaborative, fast-paced environment, working with competing

title: AI Architect
description:
Job Description

We’re looking for a seasoned Software Architect with deep expertise in cloud-native enterprise systems and Generative AI. You will define and deliver scalable, secure, and production-grade GenAI architectures — including multi-agent, RAG, LLMOps and AgentOps systems — and lead cross-functional teams to build and operate them. This role combines hands-on technical leadership, systems thinking, and strong stakeholder management.

Key responsibilities

Architecture & System Design

1. Design scalable, modular, and cloud-native architectures for GenAI applications(microservices, event-driven, serverless).
2. Define system boundaries, data flows, orchestration, and integration patterns forLLMs, vector DBs, embedding services, and tool integrations.
3. Produce architecture artifacts ( Layered Architecture Diagrams, C4 Models, DFDs,Class, Sequence, ER & Use Case diagrams, different types of blueprints, APIcontracts, design and trade-off decisions).
4. GenAI & Agentic Systems

title: Senior Principal Engineer - Jira Platform
description:
**Overview**
**Working at Atlassian**
Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. Interviews and onboarding are conducted virtually, a part of being a distributed-first company.
  
  
We're looking for a Senior Principal Backend Software Engineer to join our team, passionately focused on delivering creative improvements for our engineering teams.
  
  
**Your Future Org**
**“Jira Platform enables Jira to become the trusted, agent-native system of record and control plane for human and agent teamwork at enterprise scale.”**
As a Senior Principal Engineer In This Future Organization, You Will Help Turn This Vision Into Reality. You Will Shape The Platform Capabilities, Technical Strategy, And Engineering Practices That Enable Jira To Become The System Of Record And Control Plane For The Next Generation Of Human And Agent Teamwork. Our Work Is Guided By Three Forces That Will Power The Jira Platform Flywheel
  
  

* AI TRANSFORMATION: Make Jira the agent-native system of record and control plane for human and agent teamwork, designing systems that enable people and AI agents to work together effectively.
* ENTERPRISE READINESS: Build the security, scale, resilience, and administrative capabilities required to earn the trust of the world’s largest and most demanding enterprises as they move to the Cloud.
* EFFICIENCY: Create a platform with sound unit economics that accelerates developer productivity, supports a growing agentic workload, and delivers world-class reliability for Jira Cloud customers.

**Your future team**
**Jira Data Management**
focuses on empowering users with effective control over the transfer and management of data within Jira Cloud. For enterprise customers, the capability to move and manage large volumes of data both within and outside their cloud site is essential for leveraging Atlassian's cloud offerings. We develop and support various data migration pathways for Jira products, facilitating transitions from Data Center to Cloud, Cloud to Cloud, and External to Cloud data migrations. Additionally, we offer data-shape management capabilities that power products like Site Optimizer for Jira. Our goal is to deliver scalable, seamless, and highly predictable data management solutions for Jira Cloud customers.
  
  
The JDM team comprises over 50 engineers, along with product managers and designers, dedicated to overcoming challenges that may hinder customers from fully utilizing our cloud offerings. Each feature we release has a direct impact on Atlassian's cloud revenue.
  
  
We are actively focused on improving reliability at scale, performance, and features for diverse product use cases built on our services. Currently, we are looking for individuals who are enthusiastic about tackling challenging tasks and who excel in a fast-paced environment. Our mission is high-profile, and we expect our team members to take initiative in driving and contributing to Atlassian's overarching objectives.

At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.
  
  
This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.
  
  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Proven experience at department-level: shaping technical direction across teams and influencing architecture beyond a single service.

title: BC Sector O And G-Cognite-Senior Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Cognite Solution Architect – Senior Manager**
**Experience Level - 15+**
**Job Description**
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. We’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better. Join us and help build a better working world.
  
  
We are seeking a hands-on Cognite Solution Architect to design industrial data solutions for upstream and downstream Oil & Gas operations. You will define how operational, enterprise and engineering information is integrated, modelled and contextualized in Cognite Data Fusion (CDF), and how applications and analytical solutions consume that information. You will own solution architecture decisions, establish reusable implementation patterns and resolve complex technical issues across source systems, data models, access controls and consuming applications.
  
  
**Role Details**
**Key responsibilities include:**
**Architecture and integration**

* Translate operational use cases into data requirements, integration designs and application-consumption patterns.
* Define how CDF fits within historian, enterprise application, engineering information and cloud architectures.
* Select source-appropriate extractors, APIs and processing patterns, considering latency, throughput, connectivity and source-system load.
* Define historical loading, incremental extraction, reconciliation and recovery approaches, including late records, corrections and supported deletions.
* Establish requirements for service identities, access capabilities, environment separation, monitoring and operational support.

**Industrial information modelling**

* Design CDF models using spaces, containers, views and instances; select direct relations or edges according to relationship semantics and query requirements.
* Reuse and extend Cognite’s Core Data Model where suitable, introducing custom domain concepts where required.
* Define stable identifiers, source crosswalks and conflict-resolution rules, including repeated tag names across sites and systems.
* Represent physical equipment, functional locations and installation history separately where required.
* Establish schema versioning, migration and consumer-compatibility requirements while preserving lineage, timestamps, units, quality indicators and relationship provenance.

**Contextualization and Oil & Gas semantics**

* Design relationships connecting equipment and assets with time series, maintenance records, documents and engineering diagrams.
* Define matching rules, confidence thresholds, exception handling and domain review for ambiguous associations; assess coverage and match accuracy separately.
* For upstream applications, model fields, wells, wellbores, production facilities, equipment, well tests and interventions, preserving distinctions between measured, calculated and allocated production.
* For downstream applications, model sites, process units, functional locations, equipment, laboratory results and maintenance activities, accounting for replacement, revisions and measurement timing.
* Validate that contextualized information supports the intended engineering workflow.
* Application enablement and technical assurance
* Define consumer data contracts covering entities, relationships, fields, freshness, permissions and query-performance expectations.
* Validate designs against representative Cognite applications, custom applications, and analytical or AI workflows.
* Develop critical prototypes and reference implementations using Python, SQL, Cognite SDKs and APIs.
* Establish deployment and environment-promotion practices using version control, automated validation and Cognite Toolkit.
* Review architecture changes, migration plans, integration code and performance bottlenecks; resolve cross-system design conflicts and mentor data engineering leads.

**Must Have Qualifications & Experience**

* A relevant engineering, computer science or information systems degree, or equivalent technical experience.
* Demonstrated personal architectural contribution to a production Cognite Data Fusion implementation.
* Strong knowledge of CDF data modelling, transformations, contextualization and access controls.
* Substantial industrial data integration experience spanning representative operational, enterprise and engineering sources.
* Strong Python and SQL skills with practical Cognite SDK and REST API experience.
* Experience defining identity strategies, model evolution, deployment patterns and production support requirements.
* Working knowledge of cloud architecture, identity providers, network boundaries and CI/CD.
* Strong Oil & Gas implementation experience in at least one upstream or downstream domain, with ability to adapt relevant concepts to the other.

**Good to Have**

* Cognite implementation experience across multiple assets or sites.
* Experience spanning both upstream and downstream.
* Familiarity with historians, maintenance systems, laboratory systems, engineering repositories or well-data services.
* Experience with diagram contextualization, 3D associations and industrial knowledge graphs.
* Experience enabling Cognite applications or AI workflows using contextualized data.
* Relevant Cognite Academy training or certifications.

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to solve high-impact industrial data and analytics challenges across upstream and downstream Oil & Gas.
* A hands-on leadership role with scope to establish reusable practices and guide multidisciplinary teams.
* A collaborative environment spanning domain engineering, data, technology, product and global EY teams.
* Access to EY’s global network, technology ecosystem and learning opportunities while contributing to a better working world.

**What We Look For**
A hands-on architect who can defend consequential production Cognite decisions involving identity resolution, data-model design, access boundaries, recovery, schema migration and application compatibility, and demonstrate which patterns can be reused across sites and which require adaptation.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Engineer AI/ML
description:
Our vision for the future is based on the idea that transforming financial lives starts by giving our people the freedom to transform their own. We have a flexible work environment, and fluid career paths. We not only encourage but celebrate internal mobility. We also recognize the importance of purpose, well-being, and work-life balance. Within Empower and our communities, we work hard to create a welcoming and inclusive environment, and our associates dedicate thousands of hours to volunteering for causes that matter most to them.
  
  
Chart your own path and grow your career while helping more customers achieve financial freedom. Empower Yourself.
  
  
The AI/ML Engineer is responsible for designing, building, and optimizing AI and machine learning solutions within the Generative AI Platform. This role involves coding in Python and using relevant AI frameworks to develop scalable models and data pipelines. By collaborating with cross-functional teams, the AI/ML Engineer ensures that the platform’s AI capabilities meet technical and business objectives.
  
  
**Essential Functions**
***Model Development & Deployment***

* Build and deploy machine learning models using Python and relevant libraries (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn).
* Optimize models for performance, scalability, and security.

***Data Pipeline Management***

* Collaborate with data engineers to design robust data pipelines for model training and inference.
* Validate and preprocess datasets to ensure model accuracy and reliability.

***Research & Innovation***

* Stay current on the latest AI/ML trends and incorporate best practices into the platform.
* Experiment with novel techniques in generative AI and provide recommendations for platform enhancements.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or related field; Master’s preferred.
* 3+ years of AI/ML development experience.
* Strong Python programming skills and familiarity with major AI/ML frameworks.
* Experience deploying models into production environments (cloud or on-prem).
* AI/ML certifications from AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud are beneficial.
* Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving.
* Detail-oriented with an emphasis on model reliability and validation.
* Excellent communication skills for cross-functional collaboration.
* Occasional need to support after-hours release cycles or troubleshooting.
* Authority to recommend new AI/ML tools and frameworks for adoption.
* Collaborates with product managers, data engineers, and QA teams.
* May interface with external vendors for AI tools.

Normal Office Working Conditions: Office based with potential for remote or hybrid.

title: Staff Engineer- Applied AI
description:
**About The Role**
AI is not a feature in Foundry - it is the operating model. AI-assisted coding and product management is baked into how the team works, and AI-assisted solutioning is baked into what we ship: LLM-based data ingestion that auto-fills the Sizer from unstructured customer files, a constraint-solver recommendation engine that suggests robot configurations, semantic search over historical sizing sheets, and a Copilot that guides users through the solutioning journey. As the Staff Engineer, Applied AI you own all of this. You run the Applied AI capability as a chapter across all Foundry squads- setting the patterns, evaluation frameworks and API contracts that each squad implements rather than centralising all AI work in one team. You are expected to be the most technically credible AI engineer in the organisation, influencing architecture decisions across squads and setting the standard for how AI features are built, measured and shipped.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Build and own the recommendation engine - Design and implement the ML pipeline that recommends solution type (technology, layout, configuration) from customer inputs; own the feature store, training pipeline, model registry and serving layer.
* Build the constraint-solver intelligence - Implement the AI layer on top of the constraint solver: learned priors for solver warm-starts, anomaly detection for unusual input combinations, and automated sensitivity analysis.
* Build LLM-based data ingestion- Design the production pipeline that takes unstructured customer documents (PDFs, spreadsheets, emails) and extracts structured Sizer inputs using LLMs; handle uncertainty, partial extractions and human-in-the-loop review.
* Build the formulator engine and vector DB- Implement semantic search over historical sizing solutions and L1 data sheets; design the embedding pipeline, vector database and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) layer.
* Define AI chapter patterns- Set the shared patterns that all squads adopt: LLM API integration (streaming, function calling, structured output), prompt engineering standards, evaluation harnesses and A/B experiment frameworks for AI features.
* Build the AI evaluation framework- Implement offline and online evaluation for every AI feature: golden-set benchmarks, production-shadow evaluation, A/B experiment readout tooling and regression detection.
* Own the AI API contracts- Design the internal API contracts between the AI squad and consuming squads (Sizer, Layout, GCM); version them, document them and enforce them via contract tests.
* Mentor and grow AI capability- Pair with and review engineers across squads who are implementing AI features; run the Applied AI chapter meetings; grow the team's collective AI engineering capability.

**Minimum (required) Qualifications**

* 10–15 years professional engineering; at least 4 years in applied ML / LLM productionisation.
* Deep experience with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, or open-source): function calling, structured output, streaming, embeddings.
* Production RAG system experience: chunking strategies, embedding models, vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, pgvector), retrieval evaluation.
* Experience building and deploying recommendation systems or ranking models.
* Strong software engineering foundations: API design, observability, testing, CI/CD.
* Track record of cross-team technical influence: setting patterns others adopt.
* Experience with ML experiment tracking and model-lifecycle management.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with optimisation / operations-research methods used in conjunction with ML (hybrid AI + OR solvers).
* Experience with agentic AI systems: tool-use, ReAct, AutoGen, LangGraph or similar.
* Domain experience in warehousing, logistics or industrial automation.
* Experience with online A/B experimentation for AI features (including metric design).
* Familiarity with structured-extraction frameworks (Instructor, Outlines, Marvin).
* Experience with feature stores (Feast, Tecton) and ML platforms (MLflow, Vertex AI).
* Prior Staff-level or principal-equivalent scope at a technology company.

**Technical Qualifications**
*We expect you to be proficient in or quickly learn the following. Senior roles (Band E+) are expected to be experts; Band C/D roles are expected to have working knowledge.*

* LLM stack: OpenAI / Anthropic API; LangChain / LlamaIndex / LangGraph for orchestration; structured output parsing (Instructor / Pydantic).
* RAG: chunking and indexing pipelines; embedding models (text-embedding-3, Cohere, BGE); vector stores (pgvector, Qdrant, Pinecone); hybrid search (dense + BM25).
* ML: scikit-learn, XGBoost for classical recommendation; PyTorch / HuggingFace for fine-tuning and inference; MLflow or Vertex AI for experiment tracking.
* Evaluation: RAGAS, TruLens, or custom harnesses; LLM-as-judge pipelines; A/B frameworks integrated with analytics (e.g. Mixpanel).
* Languages: Python (primary); Java or Go for production service wrappers.
* APIs: REST (FastAPI or Flask); gRPC for high-throughput internal calls; SSE / WebSocket for streamed LLM responses.
* Infrastructure: GCP (Vertex AI, Cloud Run, GCS, Pub/Sub); Docker, Kubernetes; Terraform.
* Observability: LLM call logging (token counts, latency, cost); Prometheus metrics; Grafana dashboards; structured logging with trace IDs.
* Testing: unit tests for extraction logic; golden-set regression tests; integration tests with mocked LLM responses.
* Tooling: GitHub monorepo, GitHub Actions CI, Backstage.

**How We Work**
You are the single senior AI voice across Foundry. You lead the Applied AI chapter- short, weekly craft syncs with engineers across squads who are implementing AI features and you own the AI API contracts that every squad consumes. You report directly to the Senior Director and participate in the weekly squad-of-squads sync. You are expected to influence decisions at the architecture level, not just the implementation level.

title: Staff Software Engineer_Fusion Adapters
description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.
  
  
**About Us**
Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.
  
  
Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.
  
  
Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.
  
  
As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.
  
  
During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.
  
  
**About The Role**
dbt Fusion is building the next generation of data execution and connectivity infrastructure, enabling dbt workloads to run efficiently across diverse compute engines and data platforms. As a Senior Engineer on the Fusion Adapters and Connectivity team, you’ll design and ship core abstractions powering how dbt communicates with execution systems — leveraging Rust, Go, Arrow, and emerging open standards. This is a rare opportunity to work at the intersection of systems programming, database internals, and high-visibility open-source development. Your work will shape a foundational platform leveraged across the dbt ecosystem and the broader data community.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Design, build, and maintain Rust-first connectivity layers, execution APIs, and adapter scaffolding.
* Partner with teams building the dbt compiler, semantic layer, and runtime to evolve adapter interfaces and system boundaries.
* Contribute to Arrow/ADBC and other open-source specifications or implementations, strengthening the data ecosystem.
* Own CI, testing frameworks, profiling, error reporting surfaces, and release readiness for Fusion adapters.
* Debug complex interoperability and performance issues across drivers, engines, and compute domains.
* Collaborate with internal and community maintainers to review PRs, write RFCs, and evolve public code architectures.
* Mentor engineers on systems best practices and contribute to shared patterns around resilience, debuggability, and API clarity.

**Skills We’re Looking For**

* Strong programming background in Rust, Go, C++ or similar performance-oriented languages.
* Experience designing or maintaining SDKs, libraries, connectors, or compute/data integration codebases.
* Exposure to data warehouses, query engines, Arrow/columnar ecosystems, or execution runtimes.
* A desire to build foundational platform components that other teams and community members rely on.
* Comfort working in public code review loops, async-first communication, and collaborative RFC processes.
* A mindset grounded in debuggability, reliability, and ownership in ambiguous problem spaces.

You’ll have an edge if you have:
  
  

* Contributed to or interacted with Arrow, ADBC, DuckDB, Presto, DataFusion, Spark, ClickHouse, or similar engines.
* Experience shaping adapter/plugin standards, driver contracts, or architectural interfaces used by others.
* Familiarity with Rust async ecosystems (tokio, tower, tracing) or Go concurrency practices.
* Prior OSS governance experience — triaging issues, reviewing PRs, or working with community maintainers.
* An interest in building developer-experience layers or scaffolding frameworks for adapter authors.

Qualifications:
  
  

* 6+ years experience in software engineering, with strong systems-level skills.
* 2+ years working in open-source, SDK, runtime, or low-level integration environments.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science / related field or equivalent experience through industry OSS contributions.

**Perks And Benefits**
100% employer-paid medical insurance- Generous paid time away from work, including paid vacation or flexible/unlimited vacation depending on role and country, plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave, paid holidays, including a year-end Global Week of Rest, and volunteer days off.
- RSU stock grants\*
- Professional development and training opportunities
- Company virtual happy hours, free food, and fun team-building activities
- Monthly cell phone stipend
- Access to an innovative mental health support platform that offers personalized care and resources in areas such as: therapy, coaching, and self-guided mindfulness exercises for all covered employees and their covered dependents.
\*May vary by country and worker type - please reach out to your recruiter for more information
  
  
*Click here to learn more about Fivetran's Benefits by Region.*
We’re honored to be valued at over $5.6 billion, but more importantly, we’re proud of our core values of Get Stuck In, Do the Right Thing, and One Team, One Dream. Read about us in Forbes.
  
  
Fivetran brings together high-quality talent across the globe to make data access as easy and reliable as electricity for our customers. We value and recognize that our customers benefit from having innovative teams made of people from many backgrounds, experiences, and identities. Fivetran promotes diversity, equity, inclusion & belonging through attracting, recruiting, developing, and retaining a diverse workforce, not only because it is the right thing to do, but because it helps us build a world-class company to better serve our customers, our people and our communities.

title: Senior Engineering Manager
description:
***Acceldata is reimagining the way companies observe their Data!***
*Acceldata is the pioneer and leader in data observability, revolutionizing how enterprises manage and observe data by offering comprehensive insights into various key aspects of data, data pipelines and data infrastructure across various environments. Our platform empowers data teams to manage products effectively by ensuring data quality, preventing failures, and controlling costs.*
**About The Role**
We are seeking an exceptional
**Senior Engineering Manager**
to lead an engineering team of 15-20 engineers. This is a techno-managerial role responsible for delivering high-quality software while ensuring the team is productive, engaged, and aligned with business goals. This role is responsible for managing a team that works on building the next generation of Acceldata's platform and products and owns the responsibility to ship the key features of the product on-time.
  
  
As a Senior Engineering Manager, you will work closely with Engineering Leadership to build the product strategy, reviewing the product roadmaps, track the engineering progress and plan the releases. You will play a key role in hiring, coaching the team members, providing technical guidance and ensuring engineering excellence across the team.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
**Technical Leadership**

* Guide architecture and design decisions.
* Review technical proposals and trade-offs.
* Establish engineering best practices.
* Ensure scalability, reliability, security, and maintainability.
* Partner with senior engineers and architects on technical strategy.

**People Leadership**

* Build a strong engineering team.
* Guide the team, resolve conflicts and remove blockers.
* Conduct performance reviews and career development discussions.
* Build a healthy and inclusive team culture.

**Project & Delivery Management**

* Own execution of engineering roadmaps.
* Ensure projects are delivered on time and with quality.
* Manage project planning, resource allocation, risk assessment, and dependency management across multiple initiatives. Balance technical debt with feature delivery.
* Drive engineering productivity and predictability.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Work closely with Product Managers on roadmap planning.
* Collaborate with Design, Customer Success, Sales, and Support teams.
* Align engineering efforts with business objectives.
* Communicate status, risks, and priorities to stakeholders.

**Operational Excellence**

* Define engineering processes and metrics.
* Improve CI/CD, testing, observability, and release management.
* Manage incident response and postmortems.
* Monitor team health and delivery metrics.

**What We're Looking For**

* 14–18 years of hands-on software engineering experience with deep expertise in backend systems and platform engineering.
* 6+ years of experience in managing a high performance team of 20+ engineers
* Experience designing complex systems around data, applications, and enterprise-scale workloads.
* Strong programming expertise in Java, Scala, Golang, or similar backend technologies.
* Hands-on experience with distributed data processing and streaming technologies such as Apache Spark, Apache Flink, and Apache Kafka, along with NoSQL databases (e.g., Cassandra, MongoDB, HBase, DynamoDB).
* Strong experience working within the Big Data ecosystem, including technologies such as Hadoop, HDFS, Hive, YARN, Iceberg, Trino, and Airflow, is highly preferred.
* Expertise in project planning, resource allocation, risk assessment, and dependency management
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to balance technical depth with people leadership and business priorities.
* Exceptional problem-solving, debugging, and analytical skills.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to engage effectively with engineering leaders, architects, product leaders, and executives.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with large-scale data platforms, analytics systems, or data infrastructure products.
* Experience building observability, monitoring, reliability, or platform engineering solutions.

**Why Join Us?**

* Build products that solve some of the most challenging problems in Data and AI Observability.
* Influence the architecture and technical direction of a category-defining platform.
* Work on large-scale distributed systems serving some of the world's largest enterprises.
* Collaborate with a world-class engineering team focused on innovation and technical excellence.
* Enjoy significant ownership, autonomy, and opportunities to shape the future of the company and its products.

***We care for our team***

* Mentorship & Growth
* ESOPs
* Medical and Life Insurance
* Paid Maternity & Parental Leave
* Corporate Uber Program
* Learning & Development Support

***Acceldata for All***
*We are a fast-growing company, solving complex data problems at scale. We are driven by strong work ethics, high standards of excellence, and a spirit of collaboration. We promote innovation, commitment, and accountability. Our goal is to cultivate a healthy work environment that fosters a sense of belonging, encourages teamwork, and brings out the best in every individual.*
***Why Acceldata?***
*Acceldata is redefining data observability for enterprise data systems. Founded by experts who recognized the need for innovative monitoring and management solutions in a cloud-first, AI-driven environment, our platform empowers data teams to effectively manage data products. We address common challenges such as scaling and performance issues, cost overruns, and data quality problems by providing operational visibility, proactive alerts, and monitoring reliability across the various environments.*
*Delivered as a SaaS product, Acceldata's solutions have been embraced by global customers, such as HPE, HSBC, Visa, Freddie Mac, Manulife, Workday, Zoominfo, GSK, Oracle, PubMatic, PhonePe (Walmart), Hersheys, Dun & Bradstreet, and many more. Acceldata is a Series-C funded company and its investors include Insight Partners, March Capital, Lightspeed, Sorenson Ventures, Industry Ventures, and Emergent Ventures.*
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

* Lead adoption of modern data and analytics platforms such as Microsoft Fabric for unified reporting, insights, and intelligence

* Collaborate with business, product, and technology leaders to influence enterprise digital and AI strategy

* Bachelor's Degree Computer Science required or
* Bachelor's Degree Information System required

****Work Experience****

* Minimum 8+ years of relevant work experience required

**Preferred Knowledge, Skills And Abilities**

* Strong expertise in cloud-native architecture and enterprise application development on Microsoft Azure
* Hands-on experience building scalable web, mobile, and native applications with modern frameworks
* Experience with data and analytics platforms such as Microsoft Fabric, including enterprise reporting and insights
* Working knowledge of AI and Generative AI, intelligent automation, and AI-enabled enterprise solutions
* Exposure to IoT, edge computing, and connected systems, including Digital Manufacturing as one component

**Leadership Attributes**

* Hands-on and execution-oriented, strategic and future-focused, comfortable operating across multiple enterprise domains, strong communicator and influencer, passionate about AI, innovation, and building intelligent enterprise platforms.

20%: Up to 52 business days per year

title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer, India
description:
**About Handshake**
Handshake was founded on a simple belief that everyone deserves a path to a great career, regardless of where they went to school or who they know. Today, we power 25 million job seekers, 1 million+ employers, and 1,600 educational institutions.
  
  
In 2025, we started Handshake AI and built the fastest-growing AI data business in history. We work directly with frontier AI lab researchers to create evaluations, publish benchmarks, and push the boundary of data. We’ve grown from $0 to ~$1B run rate and pay ~$60M to over 30K individuals every month.
  
  
**Why Join Handshake Now**

* Shape how every career evolves in the AI economy, at global scale, with impact your friends, family and peers can see and feel
* Partner hand-in-hand with world-class AI labs, Fortune 500 partners and the world’s top educational institutions
* Work together with engineers, scientists, operators, and more from Palantir, Meta, Scale AI, and former YC founders
* Build a massive, fast-growing business with billions in revenue

**About Handshake AI**
Human data is the core infrastructure to AI advancement. Frontier AI labs currently improve model capabilities with various data-intensive post-training techniques. We believe that data spend for AI training will increase by 3-5x in the next few years and continue for much longer as models take on new domains. Handshake AI supports all of the frontier AI labs, working on their most complex data at the largest scale.
  
  
**About The Role**
We're hiring a
**Senior Forward Deployed Engineer**
to work directly with frontier AI labs to solve their most complex engineering challenges.
  
  
As a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll own the end-to-end lifecycle of customer deployments—from understanding technical requirements to architecting, building, and scaling production systems that improve customer workflows and model performance. You'll operate across the stack, partnering closely with Engineering, Research, Product, and Operations teams in both India and the US to deliver solutions for our most strategic customers.
  
  
This is a unique opportunity to combine deep software engineering with customer partnership, helping shape how Handshake AI delivers solutions to the world's leading AI labs.
  
  
**Location:**
Bengaluru, India. This is an in-office role.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  

* Partner directly with frontier AI labs to understand complex technical challenges and translate them into scalable engineering solutions
* Partner closely with Engineering, Research, Product, and Operations teams in the US to execute against a shared roadmap
* Design, build, and deploy production-grade applications that solve high-impact customer problems
* Own technical architecture for customer deployments with a focus on reliability, scalability, security, and maintainability
* Rapidly prototype, test, and iterate on solutions based on customer feedback
* Build reusable tools, frameworks, and deployment patterns that improve delivery across customer engagements
* Mentor engineers through technical leadership, code reviews, and engineering best practices
* Help establish a strong engineering culture as we continue building our India engineering organization

What We're Looking For
  
  

* 6+ years of professional software engineering experience
* Experience leading technically complex customer-facing, solutions engineering, or forward deployed engineering projects
* Strong proficiency with TypeScript, React, and modern backend architectures
* Deep understanding of relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL), system design, distributed systems, and cloud infrastructure
* Experience building and operating production systems on AWS or GCP
* Strong technical judgment and the ability to solve complex engineering problems in fast-moving, ambiguous environments
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
* Experience collaborating effectively with globally distributed engineering teams, including teams based in the US

Nice to Have
  
  

* Experience building AI-powered products, LLM infrastructure, or machine learning platforms
* Experience working directly with enterprise customers or strategic technical partners
* Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines
* Experience supporting applied AI or ML research teams
* Experience working in a fast-growing startup or high-growth engineering organization

What Success Looks Like
  
  

* Customer deployments launch successfully and deliver measurable value
* Technical solutions become reusable across multiple customer engagements
* Deployments are reliable, scalable, and easy to maintain
* Customer feedback directly informs platform improvements and future product capabilities
* You become a trusted technical partner across customers and engineering teams in both India and the US

**You’ll Thrive Here If You**

* Are motivated by solving operational problems that have direct, measurable impact.
* Want to be part of a company shaping the future of AI through human data.
* Can navigate ambiguity, act with urgency, and keep multiple workstreams moving in parallel.

**Perks**

* Generous Equity Grant vested over 4 years
* Housing Bonus: 1.3 Lakhs spread throughout the first year
* Well Defined Performance Bonus ranging between 10 - 100% of base
* Medical Insurance Coverage
* Food credit for every in person day.

The ideal candidate will have extensive experience designing, developing, and maintaining scalable ETL/ELT pipelines across multiple enterprise data sources. Strong expertise in ADF pipeline orchestration, Azure DevOps-based CI/CD, and Power BI semantic modelling is essential.

* Experience integrating additional enterprise platforms such as SAP, ServiceNow, Workday, or similar systems.

**Job Summary:**
The Engineering Lead is responsible for hands-on engineering delivery of enterprise AI/ML/GenAI and automation solutions, coding standards, design patterns, ensuring production-grade security, scalability, reliability, and supportability. It is not a solution advisory, PoC, or platform administration role. Success is measured by the quality, reliability, scalability, and operability of AI systems in production.
  
  
Operating as a player–coach, the Engineering Lead works alongside AI Engineers to design and build ML Models, LLM pipelines and agentic workflows, while also setting engineering standards, coaching teams, and ensuring delivery.
  
  
**The ideal candidate will possess:**

* Extensive, hands-on software engineering experience, with a proven track record of building and operating complex systems in production environments.
