**Essential Functions of the Job:**

* Engineering Ownership & Delivery Accountability

+ Own end-to-end technical delivery of AI and GenAI solutions—from design through production and BAU support.
+ Act as the technical authority for the build team, accountable for:

- Code quality and engineering standards
- Security, privacy, and compliance
- Reliability, scalability, performance, and cost
- Operational readiness and supportability

+ Make hard engineering trade-offs balancing latency, accuracy, cost, reliability, and scale.
+ Own production systems post go-live, including incident analysis, performance tuning, and architectural evolution.

* Hands-on GenAI & AI Systems Engineering


+ Collaborate with solution architecture on design and own build production-grade GenAI systems, including:

- Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines
- Agentic workflows and tool-based orchestration
- Prompt pipelines, routing, and integration layers
- Human-in-the-loop and safety guardrails

+ Work shoulder-to-shoulder with AI Engineers and Data Scientists to:

- Productionize models and LLM pipelines
- Implement evaluation, monitoring, and observability
- Optimize inference cost, performance, and reliability

+ Ensure experimental AI capabilities are engineered into real systems, not isolated prototypes.

* Architecture & Engineering Standards

+ Define and enforce reference architectures and engineering standards for AI and GenAI systems.
+ Drive consistent adoption of:

- Clean and modular architecture patterns
- Reusable components and shared frameworks
- CI/CD, DevOps, and cloud-native practices

+ Partner with architecture, platform, security, and data teams while retaining final accountability for build quality.

* AI Platform Engineering & MLOps / LLMOps

+ Build and evolve AI platforms that support:

- Model lifecycle management
- LLMOps / MLOps pipelines
- Evaluation, monitoring, and drift detection
- Secure access, auditability, and governance

+ Ensure AI systems meet enterprise non-functional requirements over time, not just at launch.

* Team Leadership & Capability Building

+ Lead and grow a team of senior engineers within the AI & Automation build function.
+ Coach engineers on:

- Backend and distributed systems engineering
- GenAI application design and implementation
- Writing maintainable, testable, production-quality code

+ Set a strong engineering culture focused on ownership, rigor, and continuous improvement.
+ Support hiring and skills development aligned to future AI engineering needs.

* Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Collaboration

+ Partner closely with:

- AI/ML Engineering and Data Science teams
- Platform, security, and operations teams
- Architecture and governance forums

+ Translate business and functional requirements into robust technical designs.
+ Act as a senior technical voice in design authorities and delivery governance.

**Engineering Expectations (Non Negotiable)**

* Has built and operated complex, distributed backend systems in production.
* Comfortable debugging production incidents involving AI/LLM pipelines.
* Writes, reviews, and maintains production-quality code, not just prototypes.
* Understands failure modes of AI systems and designs for resilience.
* Takes ownership for systems after go-live, including reliability and cost optimization.

**Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities:**
This role is critical to ensuring the enterprise’s AI ambition translates into
**real, reliable, and scalable systems**
—not just innovation theater. You will define how AI is built, shipped, and operated across the organization.
  
  
**Knowledge and Skills Requirements:**
**Core Engineering Skills**

* Strong hands-on experience in Python, Java, C#, or similar backend languages.
* Proven experience building API-driven, cloud-native systems.
* Strong understanding of distributed systems, scalability, and reliability patterns.

**GenAI / AI Engineering (Essential)**

* Hands-on experience building LLM-powered applications, including:

+ RAG pipelines
+ Agentic or tool-augmented workflows
+ Prompt orchestration and integration layers

* Experience with:

+ Vector databases and embeddings
+ LLM evaluation, observability, and monitoring
+ Guardrails, safety, and cost controls

* Experience operationalizing AI models at scale in enterprise environments.

**Nice to Have (Not Core Identity)**

* Experience integrating AI services into enterprise automation platforms (e.g., Power Platform, ServiceNow).
* Familiarity with Azure AI services and data platforms.

**Detailed Responsibilities:**

* Solution Development: Design, develop, and implement automation solutions using Microsoft Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps) and ServiceNow. Create custom workflows, forms, and applications to automate business processes and enhance user experience.
* Integration Management: Integrate Microsoft and ServiceNow platforms with other enterprise applications using APIs, web services, and middleware. Ensure seamless data flow between systems and maintain data integrity across integrated applications.
* Testing and Quality Assurance: Conduct thorough testing of automation solutions to ensure functionality, performance, and compliance with business requirements. Implement best practices for code quality, documentation, and version control.
* Observability and Maintenance: Monitor the performance of automation solutions and troubleshoot issues as they arise. Perform regular maintenance and updates to ensure optimal functionality and security of automation applications.
* Documentation: Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for automation solutions, including design specifications, user guides, and technical manuals. Document processes, workflows, and integration points for future reference and knowledge transfer.
* User Training and Support: Provide training and support to end-users and team members on automation tools and processes.Develop training materials and conduct workshops to facilitate user adoption of automation solutions.
* Collaboration and Stakeholder Engagement: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including business analysts, project managers, and IT staff, to ensure alignment on automation initiatives. Engage with stakeholders to gather feedback and make necessary adjustments to automation solutions.
* Performance Metrics and Reporting: Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure the effectiveness of automation solutions. Generate reports and dashboards to communicate the impact of automation on business processes and operational efficiency.
* Continuous Improvement: Stay updated on the latest trends and advancements in automation, AI, and relevant technologies.Identify areas for continuous improvement and propose enhancements to existing automation solutions.
* Governance and Compliance: Ensure that automation solutions adhere to organizational policies, governance frameworks, and compliance requirements. Participate in risk assessments and audits related to automation initiatives.
* Innovation and Research: Explore and evaluate new technologies, tools, and methodologies to enhance automation capabilities. Conduct research on industry best practices and competitor strategies to inform decision-making and innovation.
* Change Management: Analyze the impact of automation on organizational processes and culture, making recommendations for change management strategies. Assist in developing communication plans to inform stakeholders about automation initiatives and their benefits.

Job Description About the Role and Team

Join Wipro's AI-Native Business & Platforms unit, a forward-thinking team dedicated to advancing the future of enterprise artificial intelligence. Our Agentic Hive Platform team is responsible for creating a robust, scalable platform that enables intelligent AI agents, digital ecosystems, and business process automation for our clients worldwide. This team plays a vital role in pioneering agentic AI technology, integrating delivery and client partnerships across India and the United States to drive innovation at enterprise scale.

We are looking for an experienced and hands-on Engineering Head to spearhead the technical vision and development of the Agentic Hive platform. The ideal candidate will lead architecture design, development, and deployment of agentic AI capabilities with a strong focus on security, scalability, and reliability. In this pivotal leadership role, you will guide a dynamic engineering team responsible for delivering production-ready AI solutions and integrating them seamlessly with enterprise systems.

Operating from India, you will collaborate closely with leadership and technical peers based in the U.S., ensuring alignment and fostering innovation across global teams. This is a unique opportunity to influence the trajectory of agentic AI in a large enterprise context, blending deep technical expertise with strategic leadership and enterprise architecture sensibilities.

͏ Key Responsibilities

* Take full ownership of the architecture and engineering delivery of the Agentic Hive platform, ensuring it meets business priorities, is modular, scalable, and aligned with product roadmaps.
* Lead the design and hands-on development of AI agents and automated workflows leveraging Claude and state-of-the-art agentic AI methodologies, including reasoning algorithms, tool integrations, and interactive human-in-the-loop processes.
* Architect and orchestrate multi-agent systems encompassing specialized agent roles, inter-agent coordination, task routing, stateful management, fault tolerance, and seamless tool collaboration.
* Design comprehensive context management solutions to optimize agent interaction, including memory management, prompt engineering, session persistence, enterprise knowledge integration, semantic search layers, and controlled data access.
* Develop reusable enterprise architecture frameworks, APIs, reference implementations, and governance policies that empower diverse teams to contribute consistently to the Agentic Hive ecosystem.
* Provide technical leadership and mentorship to an AI engineering team of 5 to 6 members, driving design excellence, code quality, development processes, and resolving complex technical challenges effectively.

* Collaborate extensively with cross-functional partners including product management, UX/CX design, data teams, security, cloud infrastructure, and domain experts to deliver compelling, trustworthy, and user-centric AI experiences.
* Guide decisions and implementations in data science and data engineering domains ensuring robust data ingestion, transformation, retrieval, feature layer development, model integration, and reliable production workflows.
* Champion engineering best practices such as API-first design, CI/CD automation, container orchestration, cloud scalability, cost management, and secure operations across enterprise cloud environments.
* Engage proactively with stakeholders to translate operational feedback into enhanced platform capabilities and to support the adoption of agentic AI solutions across client engagements.

͏ Preferred Qualifications and Experience

* Proven hands-on experience designing and delivering Agentic AI solutions, specifically utilizing Claude AI for agent constructions and automations.
* Demonstrated expertise in multi-agent orchestration architectures, enabling complex agent interactions and integrations with external tools and systems.
* In-depth understanding of agent context management strategies including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), semantic memory modeling, prompt engineering, and secured data governance.
* Strong background in applying enterprise architecture principles to build modular, scalable, and secure platform infrastructures.
* Experience managing and mentoring AI engineering teams, balancing architectural oversight with active technical contribution.
* Robust data science and engineering skills encompassing Python programming, SQL, data pipelines, model development, and production-grade deployment.

* Experience developing AI/ML or generative AI systems incorporating engineering practices like automatic testing, continuous integration and delivery, monitoring, security considerations, and governance frameworks.
* Strong communication abilities with a track record of managing technical discussions with diverse stakeholders including engineers, product teams, and clients.

͏ Additional Technical Skills

* Experience with agent frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or similar, including orchestration and agent-to-agent/tool interaction (MCP, A2A patterns).
* Hands-on knowledge of retrieval-augmented generation techniques, hybrid retrieval models, semantic search, knowledge graph integration, and enterprise semantic layers.
* Expertise in AI agent evaluation methodologies, including automated evaluation strategies, policy enforcement, guardrails, and metrics like RAGAS for ongoing assessment.
* Familiarity with LLMOps/MLOps tooling and best practices, including version control of prompts/models, experimentation tracking, automated deployment, performance monitoring, and governance.
* Deep understanding of cloud-native architectures on platforms like Azure, Google Cloud Platform, AWS, and Databricks, tailored for AI and data workloads.
* Competence in containerization and orchestration platforms such as Docker and Kubernetes, RESTful API development, FastAPI, infrastructure as code (IaC), and telemetry systems.
* Experience delivering AI solutions in regulated or complex enterprise environments, successfully transitioning from research and prototyping to robust production systems.

͏ Education, Experience & Leadership Competencies

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or related technical disciplines; or equivalent practical experience in these fields.
* Minimum of 12 years' experience in software, data, or AI engineering roles with substantial recent success in generative AI or Agentic AI architecture leadership and delivery.

description:
Job Description

We’re looking for a seasoned Software Architect with deep expertise in cloud-native enterprise systems and Generative AI. You will define and deliver scalable, secure, and production-grade GenAI architectures — including multi-agent, RAG, LLMOps and AgentOps systems — and lead cross-functional teams to build and operate them. This role combines hands-on technical leadership, systems thinking, and strong stakeholder management.

Key responsibilities

Architecture & System Design

1. Design scalable, modular, and cloud-native architectures for GenAI applications(microservices, event-driven, serverless).
2. Define system boundaries, data flows, orchestration, and integration patterns forLLMs, vector DBs, embedding services, and tool integrations.
3. Produce architecture artifacts ( Layered Architecture Diagrams, C4 Models, DFDs,Class, Sequence, ER & Use Case diagrams, different types of blueprints, APIcontracts, design and trade-off decisions).
4. GenAI & Agentic Systems
5. Architect and deliver Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, NaturalLanguage to SQL Flows, fine-tuning strategies, multi-modal capabilities, and tool-augmented agents.
6. Design agent orchestration and multi-agent frameworks enabling planning,reasoning, and secure tool invocations, implement and design Agent prototypes andCommunication Protocols.
7. Define prompt engineering standards, memory models(episodic/semantic/procedural), and context management.

LLMOps & AgentOps

1. Define and implement model lifecycle pipelines: training, fine-tuning, validation,deployment, rollback, and monitoring.
2. Build AgentOps processes for agent lifecycle, behavior tracking, governance andperformance optimization.
3. Automate CI/CD for models, agents and services (MLflow, TFX, BentoML, custompipelines).

Integration, Security & Compliance

1. Integrate GenAI services with enterprise systems (ERP, CRM, data lakes, APIs) usingsecure, scalable interfaces.
2. Ensure secure access controls, data privacy, encryption, and compliance (GDPR,HIPAA, SOC2).
3. Define responsible AI practices: bias mitigation, explainability, audit trails, andoutput governance.
4. GenAI security — classify, encrypt & sign data/models; enforce least-privilege withshort-lived creds and CI/CD security gates; telemetry, drift/hallucination alerts, kill-switch & runbooks.
5. Agentic AI security — provable agent identity/attestation, tool allowlist + human gatefor high-risk actions; ephemeral scoped tokens, sandboxed execution,and replayable audit traces.

Observability, Ops & Cost Optimization

1. Define telemetry, tracing, and logging for models and agents; monitor performance,drift, hallucination rates and user feedback loops.
2. Build dashboards, alerts and runbook guidance for operational health.
3. Design systems for cost efficiency (autoscaling, spot instances, serverlesschoices) and support FinOps practices.

Leadership, Collaboration & Documentation

1. Lead cross-functional teams (product, data science, AI engineers, platform)through architecture reviews, workshops, and technical decisioning.
2. Maintain architectural standards, documentation, playbooks, and patternlibraries for GenAI systems.
3. Mentor engineers and evangelize best practices across the organization.

Required qualifications & experience

1. 10+ years software engineering experience with 3+ years in architecture or seniortechnical leadership roles (or equivalent).
2. Proven track record designing and delivering cloud-native, production systems atenterprise scale.
3. Hands-on experience with GenAI/LLM systems, RAG, NL-SQL,agentic frameworks or similar productionized AI applications.
4. Strong knowledge of system design patterns (microservices, event-driven,CQRS, hexagonal architecture), and Low Level Design Patterns.
5. Experience integrating ML/LLM services with enterprise data platforms and APIswhile meeting security/compliance requirements.
6. Solid engineering background in at least two languages (Python, TypeScript, Go,Java, C#) and familiarity with modern frameworks.

Technical skills & technologies (comprehensive)

1. Cloud & Infra: AWS / Azure / GCP; Kubernetes, Docker, serverless (Lambda, Functions, Cloud Run), GPU instances
2. GenAI & ML: Hugging Face Transformers, OpenAI APIs, ,LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, Haystack
3. Vector Stores: FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, Postgres+pgVector, and other cloud vector stores
4. LLMOps / MLOps: Custom Development of Ops Pipelines, MLflow, TFX, BentoML, Kubeflow
5. Data & Integration: Kafka, Spark, Airflow, Flink, ETL/ELT concepts, data lakes, API gateways (Apigee etc)
6. DevOps & IaC: Terraform, Pulumi, CloudFormation, GitHub Actions, Jenkins
7. Observability & Security: Prometheus, Grafana stack, OpenTelemetry, Jaeger, ELK, Datadog; Vault,
8. IAM, LDAP/OAuth2/OIDC/SAML Connect, Snyk, SonarQube, SAST/SCA in pipelines, OWASPs, CWEs, CVEs.
9. Databases & Storage: Relational (RDS/Cloud SQL), NoSQL (Mongo, DynamoDB, Cosmos DB), Redis, S3/Blob/GCS, ORM/ODM frameworks.
10. Agent frameworks / tools: Understanding of Basics of Agents required, Langgraph, Autogen, AutoGPT, AgentVerse, MetaGPT, CrewAI etc.
11. Performance & scalability: SSR/ISR, caching strategies (CDN, edge), lazy loading, bundle optimization, performance budgets.
12. Realtime & asyncRealtime & async: WebSockets, SSE, message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ), background workers. Frontend frameworks: React (Next.js), Angular, Vue; component libraries and state (Redux/RTK, Context, Pinia, Zustand)
13. Styling & UI tooling: Component Libraries, Accessibility best practices, Responsive UI
14. Frontend build & tooling: Vite, Webpack, Storybook, UI Frameworks.
15. Backend frameworks: Node.js/Express, FastAPI, serverless functions (AWS Lambda, Cloud Functions)
16. API design & integration: REST, gRPC, OpenAPI/Swagger, API versioning and contract testing, GraphQL(Optional)
17. UX & product mindset: Design-system familiarity, usability, accessibility, and working with designers

Behavioral & leadership skills

1. Strategic thinking with the ability to align architecture to product and businessgoals.
2. Excellent communicator: simplify complex technical concepts for technical andnon-technical stakeholders.
3. Strong mentorship skills — able to raise team capability in GenAI architectureand engineering.
4. Pragmatic decision-maker with a bias for measurable outcomes and trade-offanalysis.
5. High attention to detail, ownership, and accountability for reliability, security,and cost.

Nice-to-have

1. Experience operating LLMs in regulated industries (pharma).
2. Familiarity with prompt auditing, hallucination detection, and automated qualitychecks.
3. Background in knowledge engineering, semantic search, or knowledge graphs.

title: Agentic Growth Marketer
description:
**Agentic Growth Marketer**

**10-12 LPA**

**Location: Bangalore, Koramangala**

**Build the future of marketing. Not another marketing campaign.**

**Company:**
**Porcellia**

**Experience:**
No minimum years required

**Mandatory background:**
Engineering, software development, data, or a closely related quantitative field

**The opportunity**

We believe the future of marketing will be built by people who understand both marketing and technology.

Not marketers who occasionally use ChatGPT.

Not developers who build AI tools without understanding the business problems they’re solving.

We’re looking for someone who sits at the intersection of
**engineering, data, AI agents, and marketing.**

Someone who can look at a marketing problem and think,
*“Why is a human still doing this?”*

Someone who understands how agents work, how to connect them, how to make them reliable, and how to turn them into systems that produce measurable business outcomes.

**You don’t need to be a great marketer yet. I’ll teach you that.**

You need to be an exceptional problem solver who loves numbers, understands technology, and is obsessed with what AI makes possible.

**What you’ll actually do**

Your job is simple:
**Learn marketing. Then agentify it.**

You’ll work directly with me to understand how some of India’s fastest-growing D2C brands are built and scaled.

Then you’ll turn that knowledge into intelligent systems.

You’ll:

* Build AI agents that solve real marketing problems across creative strategy, performance marketing, analytics, CRO, retention, and growth.
* Create agentic workflows that can research, reason, execute, evaluate, and improve with minimal human intervention.
* Connect LLMs, APIs, databases, marketing platforms, and automation tools into working systems.
* Turn complex marketing decisions into repeatable, scalable processes.
* Work with large amounts of data to find patterns, identify opportunities, and make better decisions.
* Experiment constantly with new models, agent frameworks, and AI capabilities.
* Build solutions that don’t just save time, but actually make businesses more money.

**The goal isn’t to automate what marketers do today. It’s to build what marketers will be capable of doing tomorrow.**

**Who we’re looking for**

**1. You understand agents. Really well.**

You should know the difference between an AI chatbot, a workflow, and an autonomous agent.

You should be comfortable with concepts like tool calling, MCP, orchestration, memory, context engineering, APIs, evaluation, and multi-agent systems.

You don’t need to know every framework. But you should be the kind of person who experiments with new AI capabilities before everyone else starts talking about them.

**You should have built things. Not just watched tutorials about them.**

**2. You’re exceptionally good with numbers.**

You should be able to do mental math faster than most people can reach for a calculator.

Percentages, ratios, growth rates, margins, unit economics, probability, and data interpretation should come naturally to you.

You should be able to look at a spreadsheet and quickly figure out what’s happening, what’s wrong, and what matters.

Because great marketing is ultimately a numbers game.

**3. You have a technical or quantitative background.**

This is mandatory.

Ideally, you’re a software developer, data analyst, data scientist, engineer, or someone from a quantitative finance background.

You should be comfortable with structured thinking, logic, and solving problems using technology.

You don’t need a computer science degree. You do need to demonstrate genuine technical ability.

**4. You love marketing.**

You should be genuinely curious about why people buy things.

Why does one advertisement work while another fails? Why do people pay more for one brand than another? Why do some products become categories of their own?

You should find consumer psychology, copywriting, persuasion, business models, and growth fascinating.

You don’t need formal marketing experience. But you need to want to become world-class at it.

**5. You’re a builder, not a spectator.**

You should be someone who experiments relentlessly.

Someone who would rather build a working prototype over the weekend than spend two weeks discussing whether it’s possible.

You don’t wait for instructions. You find problems worth solving and start solving them.

**What you’ll get**

**I’ll teach you everything I know about marketing.**

You’ll learn how positioning works, how to create winning advertisements, how to read performance data, how to understand consumer behaviour, and how to build profitable growth engines.

You’ll get to work on real problems with real businesses, real budgets, and real consequences.

And then you’ll use your technical skills to turn that knowledge into products, agents, and systems.

You’ll be working at the frontier of a rapidly changing industry.

While most marketing teams are learning how to use AI tools,
**you’ll be building the tools and systems that redefine how marketing works.**

You won’t be joining a marketing team that simply follows instructions.

You’ll be helping create the future that other marketing teams eventually follow.

**Who should NOT apply**

* You’re looking for a conventional marketing job.
* Your understanding of AI is limited to writing prompts in ChatGPT.
* You dislike spreadsheets, calculations, or quantitative problems.
* You enjoy talking about ideas more than building them.
* You want a clearly defined role where someone tells you exactly what to do every day.

**Our hiring process**

We don’t care how many years you’ve worked.

We care how you think, what you can build, and how quickly you learn.

**Round 1: Make a video that catches our attention.**

This is the first and most important filter.

Make a video introducing yourself and convincing us why you should be the person building the future of marketing with us.

Show us how you think. Show us what you’ve built. Show us why you’re different.

There is no prescribed format.

You can be creative, technical, funny, analytical, or completely unconventional.

**We will shortlist candidates based on their videos. Not their resumes.**

**Round 2: Live interview**

If your video catches our attention, we’ll invite you for a live interview.

We’ll test two things:

1. **Data fluency:**
   Mental math, business logic, numerical reasoning, and your ability to make sense of unfamiliar data.
2. **Copywriting:**
   Your ability to understand people, communicate clearly, and persuade through words.

You don’t need to know marketing jargon. We’re looking for raw ability, not rehearsed answers.

**Salary**

10-12 LPA

title: AI Inference Engineer
description:
**Hiring for FlexAI**
— via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role.

**About the Company**

FlexAI is building a high-performance, cloud-agnostic AI compute platform for training and inference. Its Token Factory serves 20+ open models through one OpenAI-compatible API, from serverless to dedicated endpoints and private cloud, running across NVIDIA, AMD and emerging AI accelerators. The company is led by the team that deployed the Aurora supercomputer and managed 50,000+ GPUs at Intel, is headquartered in Paris, and is growing its Bengaluru engineering centre as inference demand scales.

**About the Role**

As an AI Inference Engineer you'll design, build and optimise the serving stack that runs large language and multimodal models in production on heterogeneous hardware. It's a hands-on role at the intersection of model architecture, hardware and production serving: you'll own critical parts of an inference runtime built on vLLM, SGLang and PyTorch, help set direction on performance, and work with engineering, research and product to deliver fast, reliable and cost-efficient tokens to customers.

**What you'll do**

* Own the serving stack for LLMs and multimodal models: engine configuration, tensor/expert/data parallelism and deployment across NVIDIA and AMD GPUs.
* Bring new open-weight models to production quickly and correctly: chat templates, tool-calling and reasoning parsers, structured outputs, quantized checkpoints.
* Profile and optimise throughput, time to first token, inter-token latency and cost per token, from kernels to the request path.
* Apply and evaluate FP8/FP4 quantization, speculative decoding, KV-cache reuse and offloading, prefix caching and prefill/decode disaggregation.
* Maintain and contribute patches to vLLM and SGLang, and upstream fixes where it makes sense.
* Run inference on Kubernetes across clusters and clouds with autoscaling, zero-downtime rollouts and graceful failure handling.
* Build observability, benchmarking, load-testing, evaluation and model-release tooling that catches silent quality regressions before customers do.

**What you bring**

* 2+ years building performance-critical systems software in Python and C++.
* Hands-on experience serving LLMs in production with vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM or similar engines.
* A deep understanding of transformer inference: attention and the KV cache, batching and scheduling, and when a workload is memory-bandwidth bound versus compute bound.
* Experience profiling GPU workloads (Nsight, rocprof, PyTorch profiler) and turning findings into measured improvements.
* Familiarity with distributed inference: tensor and expert parallelism, NCCL/RCCL, high-speed interconnects.
* Comfort with Kubernetes, containers and running production services.
* A habit of measuring before and after every change, and of verifying correctness, not only speed.

**Nice to have**

* Contributions to open-source inference engines or GPU kernels (CUDA, HIP, Triton).
* Experience with AMD ROCm or non-GPU AI accelerators.
* Experience with KV-cache systems (e.g. LMCache, Mooncake), speculative decoding or disaggregated serving.
* Experience with model quantization and accuracy evaluation.

description:

You will work directly with customers to translate requirements into working solutions by configuring integrations, designing prompts and workflows, and deploying scalable AI agents. You’ll own the end-to-end lifecycle of AI agent delivery—from initial design and integration through testing, client demos, deployment, and ongoing iteration.

**About the job**
Like Google's own ambitions, the work of a Software Engineer goes beyond just Search. Software Engineering Managers have not only the technical expertise to take on and provide technical leadership to major projects, but also manage a team of Engineers. You not only optimize your own code but make sure Engineers are able to optimize theirs. As a Software Engineering Manager you manage your project goals, contribute to product strategy and help develop your team. Teams work all across the company, in areas such as information retrieval, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking, security, data compression, user interface design; the list goes on and is growing every day. Operating with scale and speed, our exceptional software engineers are just getting started -- and as a manager, you guide the way.
  
  
With technical and leadership expertise, you manage engineers across multiple teams and locations, a large product budget and oversee the deployment of large-scale projects across multiple sites internationally.
  
  
Our team is focused around driving continuous improvements to the machine learning software/hardware stacks through providing insightful performance debugging for workloads and custom kernels. We provide insights by summarizing different views of captured profile data - such as trace timelines, memory usage, Compiler profiles, ML graph summariesThe ML, Systems, & Cloud AI (MSCA) organization at Google designs, implements, and manages the hardware, software, machine learning, and systems infrastructure for all Google services (Search, YouTube, etc.) and Google Cloud. title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer, India
description:
**About Handshake**
Handshake was founded on a simple belief that everyone deserves a path to a great career, regardless of where they went to school or who they know. Today, we power 25 million job seekers, 1 million+ employers, and 1,600 educational institutions.
  
  
In 2025, we started Handshake AI and built the fastest-growing AI data business in history. We work directly with frontier AI lab researchers to create evaluations, publish benchmarks, and push the boundary of data. We’ve grown from $0 to ~$1B run rate and pay ~$60M to over 30K individuals every month.
  
  
**Why Join Handshake Now**

* Shape how every career evolves in the AI economy, at global scale, with impact your friends, family and peers can see and feel
* Partner hand-in-hand with world-class AI labs, Fortune 500 partners and the world’s top educational institutions
* Work together with engineers, scientists, operators, and more from Palantir, Meta, Scale AI, and former YC founders
* Build a massive, fast-growing business with billions in revenue

**About Handshake AI**
Human data is the core infrastructure to AI advancement. Frontier AI labs currently improve model capabilities with various data-intensive post-training techniques. We believe that data spend for AI training will increase by 3-5x in the next few years and continue for much longer as models take on new domains. Handshake AI supports all of the frontier AI labs, working on their most complex data at the largest scale.
  
  
**About The Role**
We're hiring a
**Senior Forward Deployed Engineer**
to work directly with frontier AI labs to solve their most complex engineering challenges.
  
  
As a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll own the end-to-end lifecycle of customer deployments—from understanding technical requirements to architecting, building, and scaling production systems that improve customer workflows and model performance. You'll operate across the stack, partnering closely with Engineering, Research, Product, and Operations teams in both India and the US to deliver solutions for our most strategic customers.
  
  
This is a unique opportunity to combine deep software engineering with customer partnership, helping shape how Handshake AI delivers solutions to the world's leading AI labs.
  
  
**Location:**
Bengaluru, India. This is an in-office role.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  

* Partner directly with frontier AI labs to understand complex technical challenges and translate them into scalable engineering solutions
* Partner closely with Engineering, Research, Product, and Operations teams in the US to execute against a shared roadmap
* Design, build, and deploy production-grade applications that solve high-impact customer problems
* Own technical architecture for customer deployments with a focus on reliability, scalability, security, and maintainability
* Rapidly prototype, test, and iterate on solutions based on customer feedback
* Build reusable tools, frameworks, and deployment patterns that improve delivery across customer engagements
* Mentor engineers through technical leadership, code reviews, and engineering best practices
* Help establish a strong engineering culture as we continue building our India engineering organization

What We're Looking For
  
  

* 6+ years of professional software engineering experience
* Experience leading technically complex customer-facing, solutions engineering, or forward deployed engineering projects
* Strong proficiency with TypeScript, React, and modern backend architectures
* Deep understanding of relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL), system design, distributed systems, and cloud infrastructure
* Experience building and operating production systems on AWS or GCP
* Strong technical judgment and the ability to solve complex engineering problems in fast-moving, ambiguous environments
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
* Experience collaborating effectively with globally distributed engineering teams, including teams based in the US

Nice to Have
  
  

* Experience building AI-powered products, LLM infrastructure, or machine learning platforms
* Experience working directly with enterprise customers or strategic technical partners
* Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines
* Experience supporting applied AI or ML research teams
* Experience working in a fast-growing startup or high-growth engineering organization

What Success Looks Like
  
  

* Customer deployments launch successfully and deliver measurable value
* Technical solutions become reusable across multiple customer engagements
* Deployments are reliable, scalable, and easy to maintain
* Customer feedback directly informs platform improvements and future product capabilities
* You become a trusted technical partner across customers and engineering teams in both India and the US

**You’ll Thrive Here If You**

* Are motivated by solving operational problems that have direct, measurable impact.
* Want to be part of a company shaping the future of AI through human data.
* Can navigate ambiguity, act with urgency, and keep multiple workstreams moving in parallel.

**Perks**

* Generous Equity Grant vested over 4 years
* Housing Bonus: 1.3 Lakhs spread throughout the first year
* Well Defined Performance Bonus ranging between 10 - 100% of base
* Medical Insurance Coverage
* Food credit for every in person day.

title: Member of Technical Staff (Senior - Specialized Indexing)
description:
Category-defining tech. Career-defining work.
  
  
For more than a decade, Cockroach Labs has built database technology trusted to power some of the world's most mission-critical applications. Now, as AI transforms how software is created and operated, the infrastructure behind it has to keep pace. Cockroach Continuum is built to meet this moment, bringing individual databases together into one fleet designed for agentic applications, where AI agents help teams provision, scale, and optimize workloads at machine speed.
  
  
At Cockroach Labs, you'll solve problems that didn't exist five years ago alongside people who believe the simplest solutions often require the most sophisticated thinking. Your work will run in production at some of the most innovative companies in the world. The people who thrive here are the ones who want to own that opportunity.
  
  
**The Role**
The
**SQL Queries**
team is responsible for the core of CockroachDB’s query execution and optimization layer. This group designs and delivers features that make our distributed SQL engine fast, reliable, and flexible for a wide range of workloads.
  
  
AI is transforming how we search, learn, and build, and databases are evolving to keep up.
  
  
We’re forming a new
**Specialized Indexing**
subteam within SQL Queries to expand CockroachDB’s indexing capabilities beyond traditional relational workloads. This team will design and implement high-performance indexing systems such as
**vector, full-text, and geospatial indexes**
to support the next generation of
**AI-native and search-driven applications**
.
  
  
As part of this team, you’ll work on deep systems problems, collaborate across the SQL organization, and build production-quality features that make CockroachDB a unified platform for both structured and unstructured data.
  
  
**You Will**

* Design, build, and maintain specialized indexing features for CockroachDB, including vector, full-text, and geospatial indexing.
* Improve the performance and reliability of existing vector indexing systems, including backfill, query planning, and import workflows.
* Partner with other database teams to integrate new indexing mechanisms into the query engine.
* Develop hybrid search capabilities that combine vector similarity and text-based search for modern AI and search workloads.
* Participate in design discussions, code reviews, and release planning within the SQL organization.
* Take full ownership of your work, from design through implementation, testing, and release.

**The Expectations**
**In your first month**
, you’ll get familiar with CockroachDB’s SQL architecture, vector indexing implementation, and the surrounding systems. You’ll also begin contributing to smaller improvements and fixes.
  
  
**Within three months**
, you’ll take ownership of components related to specialized indexing, making measurable improvements to performance and reliability.
  
  
**After six months**
, you’ll play a key role in advancing hybrid search capabilities and help shape the roadmap for future indexing and search features.
  
  
**You Have**

* Passion for databases, indexing systems, and high-performance distributed architectures.
* A strong background in backend or systems programming, preferably with Go, C/C++, or Rust.
* Experience working on indexing or query execution systems such as vector, text, or spatial search.
* Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, and distributed systems.
* Curiosity about AI-driven and hybrid workloads that combine structured and unstructured data.
* A focus on building reliable, maintainable, and high-performance software.
* Collaborative mindset and ability to work effectively with a distributed global team.
* Typically 10+ years of experience building large-scale, production-grade systems.
* Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous problems into scalable, production-grade AI-enabled solutions.
* A builder's instinct for reuse and extensibility — your output becomes a platform, pattern, or capability others depend on.
* Clear judgment about where AI should be deeply integrated and where traditional approaches are more reliable.

**The Team**
The SQL Queries team is one of the most impactful and technically challenging groups at Cockroach Labs. Joining the Specialized Indexing subteam means working at the frontier of databases and AI, helping shape how CockroachDB powers intelligent, hybrid applications.
  
  
You’ll be part of a small, autonomous team based in India, collaborating with engineers and leaders across the world. You’ll have the chance to own complex, high-visibility features that directly influence how customers use CockroachDB.
  
  
If you’re excited about building innovative systems that push the boundaries of what a database can do, we’d love to meet you.
  
  
Cockroach Labs is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer building a diverse and inclusive workforce. If you need additional accommodations to feel comfortable during your interview process, please email us at accessibility@cockroachlabs.com.
  
  
Cockroach Labs has a hybrid work model, with Roachers that are local to one of our offices coming in on Mondays, Thursdays, and Fridays and working flexibly the rest of the week. While we’ve learned valuable lessons working remotely, nothing can replace the connection, creativity, and fun that occurs when Roachers get together and we are committed to fostering a workplace that encourages collaboration and allows us all to do our best work.
  
  
**Benefits**

* Medical Insurance
* Flexible Time Off
* Paid Parental Leave
* Mental Wellbeing Benefits
* Internet Reimbursement
* Wellness Allowance
* Food Allowance
* Office Commute Reimbursement
* And more!

title: Technical Lead & Manager
description:
**We are WisdomAI.**
*We exist to help people unlock clarity from complexity.*
WisdomAI builds AI-powered analytics that put answers directly in the hands of the people closest to the business. Our platform doesn’t just surface insights — it explains the why behind them, helping teams move from data to decisions with speed, confidence, and context.
  
  
We’re trusted by companies like Cisco, Patreon, and Rubrik — and we’re just getting started.The problems here are hard, and the expectations are high. Our team is energized by both. If you’re compelled by ambitious problems, high standards, and meaningful ownership, you’ll thrive here.
  
  
**The Role**
We're looking for our first Technical Lead & Manager in India. This role will help shape the next chapter of that organization while remaining deeply involved in the technical work itself.
  
  
**How We Work**
**Hands-On Leadership**
We don't see management and engineering as separate tracks.Our Technical lead will participate in architecture reviews, code reviews, technical discussions, hiring decisions, and occasionally jump into code themselves. The ideal balance is roughly 40% leadership and 60% technical contribution.
  
  
**Ownership**
Both the geographies - India and US - own meaningful parts of the product and platform. Engineers are trusted with end-to-end ownership and leaders are expected to create the environment where that ownership thrives.
  
  
**Talent Density**
We're intentional about every hire.The team includes engineers from companies such as Google, Meta, Rubrik, Glean, and other world-class organizations. Maintaining and raising that bar is one of the most important responsibilities of this role.
  
  
**Product Thinking**
The best engineering decisions start with understanding the customer problem.We look for leaders who can connect technical choices to customer outcomes and help teams prioritize accordingly.
  
  
**Builders**
We value people who can build from first principles.Processes, operating rhythms, performance management, career development, organizational design—none of these are finished products. You'll help create and evolve them as the organization grows.
  
  
**What You'd Work On**
**Scaling a High-Performance Engineering Organization**
The India team has grown rapidly and now spans backend systems, platform infrastructure, frontend experiences, and machine learning.
  
  
You'll help build the systems that allow that team to scale without losing speed, quality, or culture.
  
  
**Developing Future Technical Leaders**
Many of our engineers are capable of becoming future staff engineers, tech leads, and engineering managers.
  
  
A significant part of this role is helping them get there through mentorship, coaching, feedback, and career development.
  
  
**Raising the Hiring Bar**
We're actively growing.
  
  
You'll partner closely with leadership to identify exceptional talent, evaluate candidates, and ensure every hire improves the organization.
  
  
**Driving Technical Excellence**
As the organization grows, maintaining a high technical bar becomes harder.
  
  
You'll help guide architecture discussions, participate in design reviews, review code, and ensure engineering quality scales alongside headcount.
  
  
**Building the Next Generation of Analytics**
From agent orchestration and reasoning systems to distributed data infrastructure and AI-powered user experiences, you'll work alongside the team solving technically ambitious problems at the intersection of AI, data, and enterprise software.
  
  
**You may be a good fit if you**

* Have spent years building and shipping complex software systems
* Have managed engineers and genuinely enjoy helping people grow
* Still love engineering and want to remain technically involved
* Hold a high bar for technical quality and execution
* Operate with high ownership and low ego
* Can balance speed with sound engineering judgment
* Have strong product instincts and care about customer outcomes
* Want to help build an organization, not simply inherit one

**Strong candidates may also have**

* Experience at companies that have built at scale and have strong engineering cultures
* Startup or founding engineer experience
* Experience scaling engineering organizations from
* Experience with distributed systems, infrastructure, AI, data platforms, or developer tools
* Experience hiring and developing senior engineering talent

**Not sure this is the right fit?**

* Looking for a pure people-management role with little technical involvement? This probably isn't it.
* Looking for a remote role? We work together in-office five days a week.
* Looking primarily for title progression? We're more interested in builders than titles.

**Why WisdomAI?**
You'll join a company founded by repeat entrepreneurs and early builders from companies including Rubrik and Glean.
  
  
We're tackling one of the largest software categories in the world: business intelligence and analytics.
  
  
We're backed by leading investors including Kleiner Perkins and NVIDIA Ventures.
  
  
Most importantly, you'll inherit a strong team and have the opportunity to shape what engineering leadership looks like in India from the ground up.
  
  
**Our CRAFT**
CRAFT isn’t a list of aspirational values. It’s how we hire, how we promote, how we resolve hard calls, and how we stay honest with ourselves.
  
  
**C — Customer trust.**
Everything starts here. We listen carefully, act with integrity, and respond with urgency. Delight is downstream of trust — never the other way around.
  
  
**R — Relentless on outcomes.**
We move with urgency, take initiative, and see things through. Effort isn’t the measure — results are. If something isn’t working, we change the approach now.
  
  
**A — Authenticity.**
We say the hard things, directly and with respect. We also show up as full humans. That combination is how trust is earned and how we grow together.
  
  
**F — First principles, grounded in reality.**
We don’t accept “that’s how it’s done.” We strip problems to what’s actually true and build up from there — then validate quickly and let real-world results decide.
  
  
**T — Transparency.**
We share the why, not just the what. When something can’t be shared, we say so. We’re one team — information flows so we can do our best work and challenge each other when we’re wrong.
  
  
**Equal opportunity employer**
WisdomAI is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive team where everyone can do their best work.

title: BIE, Speed Benchmarking, CXBT Capability Team
description: DescriptionHow does Amazon know whether it is delivering faster than the competition? That question is answered by the Speed Measurement and Analytics team within Customer Experience and Business Trends (CXBT), and as a Business Intelligence Engineer I on this team, you will help build the answer. You will own data pipelines, dashboards, and analytical deep-dives that feed into Pulse, the team's benchmarking product that tracks competitive delivery speed across 10+ geographies worldwide. Your work will directly inform how Amazon invests in speed improvements across Worldwide Stores. If you are curious, analytical, and energized by turning large-scale data into clear, actionable insights, this is a great opportunity to grow your career while shaping decisions that matter.Key job responsibilities Build and maintain data pipelines, ETL jobs, and data models that power competitive delivery-speed benchmarking across your assigned geography or horizontal function, ensuring data freshness, accuracy, and completeness. Write and optimize SQL/PySPARK queries to produce weekly and monthly speed benchmark reports, translating raw data into actionable insights for regional leads and senior leadership. Collaborate with Product Managers, Program Managers, and peer Business Intelligence Engineers to align data definitions, standardize metrics, and support the onboarding of new geographies into the benchmarking platform. Investigate data anomalies, root-cause quality issues, and implement validation checks so that discrepancies are caught before they reach stakeholders. Maintain clear documentation of your data artifacts and analytical methodology, and identify opportunities to automate manual processes for improved pipeline reliability and reporting efficiency.A day in the lifeYou will start your day checking pipeline health and dashboard accuracy for your assigned geography, then move into writing or refining SQL queries that feed the latest benchmarking signals into Pulse. You might spend part of the afternoon investigating a data discrepancy flagged by a regional lead, or meeting with a Product Manager to scope a new competitive analysis. Between tasks you will review a teammate's code, update your documentation, and brainstorm ways to automate a manual reporting step.About The TeamThe Speed Measurement and Analytics team sits within Amazon's Customer Experience and Business Trends (CXBT) organization. Our mission is to give Worldwide Stores a single, trusted view of how Amazon's delivery speed compares to competitors globally. We are a collaborative group of Business Intelligence Engineers and Product Managers working together to expand coverage to new geographies and new speed signals. Joining now means you will help build, not just maintain, the platform that shapes Amazon's speed investment strategy.Basic Qualifications 2+ years of analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc. experience Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools Experience with one or more industry analytics visualization tools (e.g. Excel, Tableau, QuickSight, MicroStrategy, PowerBI) and statistical methods (e.g. t-test, Chi-squared) Experience with scripting language (e.g., Python, Java, or R)Preferred Qualifications Master's degree, or Advanced technical degree Knowledge of data modeling and data pipeline design Experience with statistical analysis, co-relation analysisOur inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: Cyber Security Engineer, Asssistant Vice President
description:

The Lead Security Engineering (AVP) role will engage with business and support personnel to design, implement and maintain robust, secure and user friendly solutions. Technologies include Identity and Access management, Multi-Factor Authentication and Single SignOn.

  

**Responsibilities include:**

* Leading the development, deployment and management of Access Management solutions.

* Designing highly resilient Authentication infrastructure

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------

  
  

Docusign brings agreements to life. More than 1.8 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using the Docusign AI-native IAM platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the #1 company in e-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).

  
  

**What you'll do**
------------------

  
  

As a Senior Data Engineer, you will build the foundational pipelines that bring together multi-cloud billing and operational data. You will make data dependable, traceable, and easy for downstream teams to consume by supporting cost visibility, budget monitoring, anomaly detection, shared-cost allocation, and cost-to-serve reporting. This is an execution-oriented engineering role with end-to-end ownership of pipeline components, including source onboarding, normalization, transformation, validation, monitoring, incident response, and documentation.

This is an individual contributor role reporting to the Senior Director, Engineering.

**Responsibility**

* Build batch and/or streaming pipelines for Azure and GCP billing data, with an architecture that can extend to additional cloud providers
* Normalize provider-specific billing and usage data into a consistent, FOCUS-aligned model
* Ingest and join resource inventory, tagging, ownership, product, service, and environment metadata
* Implement reconciliation checks between source billing systems, the normalized warehouse, and downstream reporting datasets
* Establish data contracts, schemas, lineage, freshness checks, completeness checks, and failure-handling patterns
* Create reusable transformations that support executive dashboards, product-level cost views, burn-rate reporting, and anomaly detection
* Build operational visibility for pipeline health, including freshness, latency, volume, schema drift, and failed-record monitoring
* Partner with platform, FinOps, Finance, and service-owning teams to resolve data-quality gaps and improve attribution coverage
* Document pipeline behavior, ownership, runbooks, recovery procedures, and known data limitations
* Improve automation, test coverage, deployment safety, and cost efficiency of the data platform
* Build or integrate event-driven ingestion patterns so new Cost Management exports trigger processing without manual refreshes
* Support Microsoft Fabric, Data Lake, Data Factory, and KQL-based consumption patterns where they fit the target architecture
* Treat private endpoints, private DNS, managed identities, Entra ID/RBAC, and disabled public access as part of the data-platform design—not afterthoughts
* Participate in on-call rotations and contribute to improving system reliability and incident response

  

**Job Designation**
-------------------

  
  

**Hybrid:** Employee divides their time between in-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in-office expectation)

Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.

  
  

**What you bring**
------------------

  
  

**Basic**

* 5+ years of professional experience designing, implementing, and operating production data pipelines
* Strong SQL and Python or an equivalent data-engineering language
* Experience with cloud billing, usage, infrastructure, telemetry, or other operational datasets
* Experience with dimensional modeling, data warehouses/lakes, ETL/ELT, and data-quality testing
* Practical experience with pipeline orchestration, monitoring, alerting, and incident response

**Preferred**

* Multi-cloud billing data or FinOps data engineering
* FOCUS, cloud-cost normalization, resource tagging, or showback/chargeback systems
* Azure, GCP, BigQuery, Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, Data Lake Storage, KQL, or comparable warehouse technologies
* Event Grid or equivalent event-driven ingestion, managed identities, Entra ID/RBAC, private endpoints, private DNS, and network-isolated data services
* Data lineage, schema evolution, reconciliation, anomaly detection, deployment verification, or finance-system integration
* Ability to work across engineering and business stakeholders to clarify data definitions and ownership

  

**Life at Docusign**
--------------------

  
  

**Working here**

Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.

We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. And for that, you’ll be loved by us, our customers, and the world in which we live.

**Accommodation**

Docusign is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If you need such an accommodation, or a religious accommodation, during the application process, please contact us at accommodations@docusign.com.

If you experience any issues, concerns, or technical difficulties during the application process please get in touch with our Talent organization at taops@docusign.com for assistance.

title: Software Development Manager, Just Walk Out
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Lead a new India-based embedded and firmware engineering team for Just Walk Out's edge devices: the cameras, sensors, RFID, gates and networking hardware in our stores, and the device-side software that connects them to the cloud. This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You'll manage 8-12 engineers, set technical direction across firmware, embedded Linux and embedded Android, and partner closely with the US engineering team that owns this charter today.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Hire, coach and develop a high-judgment team of embedded, firmware and edge software engineers, and build an inclusive, high-ownership culture as the team grows in India
* Own the technical roadmap, delivery and operational excellence for your team's firmware and embedded software, from requirements and architecture through release and field support
* Set engineering standards across the embedded stack: firmware and RTOS/bare-metal code, embedded Linux and Android, drivers and board bring-up, secure boot and OTA updates, and on-device diagnostics
* Own the device-to-cloud boundary with cloud teams: provisioning and identity, connectivity, telemetry and remote management, including the device's AWS IoT / embedded-Linux connectivity stack
* Build the test infrastructure, staged rollouts and telemetry needed to ship firmware safely across a large fleet of deployed devices
* Lead the response to field issues, telling firmware from hardware, connectivity or sensor faults, and drive root cause and lasting fixes
* Drive execution with the US engineering team, product and program management, hardware/ODM partners, and cloud, data and UI/UX teams across time zones

  
A day in the life  
You might start with 1:1s and a design review, helping an engineer reason through an OTA rollback path or a latency budget on a constrained target. Later you agree scope for the next release with product and the US partner team, and re-plan the sprint because a hardware revision changed what's possible. In the afternoon you join your engineers on a field issue affecting a few devices at one store, get them the telemetry and a plan, and keep the fix moving.  
  
About the team  
Just Walk Out builds the technology behind checkout-free shopping: the devices, networking and cloud software that let shoppers walk out without stopping to pay. . This India team will take direct ownership of part of that charter, working closely with the US engineering team, hardware partners and the operations teams who rely on what we ship.  
  
About AWS:  
  
Diverse Experiences: AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job below, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  
  
Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  
  
Inclusive Team Culture - Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth - We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.  
  
Work/Life Balance - We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of engineering team management experience
* Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
* Experience partnering with product or program management teams
* Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
* 7+ years of software engineering experience, including embedded systems or firmware development
* Experience leading the development of embedded, real-time, or hardware-interfacing systems delivered on physical hardware

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
* Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers
* Hands-on embedded Linux (including Yocto) and/or embedded Android, with Linux kernel or driver development and low-level debugging
* Sustaining a large fleet of deployed devices: OTA firmware updates, telemetry, and remote diagnostics at scale
* Experience at the device-to-cloud boundary (connectivity, provisioning, fleet management), ideally with AWS IoT / Greengrass and MQTT

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
**Why qlub**

The end of a great meal shouldn't be the slow part. Waiting for the check, finding someone to take payment, splitting a bill by hand. qlub removes that friction. Guests scan a QR code and pay in seconds. No app, no download, no waiting.

From Pay-at-Table and Digital Menus to Order-and-Pay, Payment Links, and SoftPOS terminals, we handle the full payment experience so restaurants can focus on what they do best: great hospitality. Less friction means faster table turnover, smoother operations, and higher profit.

We're a fast-scaling fintech backed by Mastercard, Mubadala, e& and Shorooq. $72M raised, live across multiple markets worldwide, and headcount doubled in the past year. We're building the teams that take us to the next stage.

**The role**

We need a Senior Data Engineer to own our data platform. Today it runs on GCP: BigQuery as the warehouse, dbt for modelling, Airflow for orchestration, and ClickHouse where we need low-latency analytics. It feeds internal reporting, merchant-facing analytics, and a growing set of AI-assisted tooling.

This is a hands-on job. Most of your week is building and running pipelines, fixing what breaks, and making the data trustworthy enough that people stop double-checking it. You will also set the standards the rest of the team follows and mentor the engineers around you.

You do not need to have used every tool listed below. You do need to have run production data systems and know what goes wrong with them.

**What you’ll own**

**Ingestion**

* Own how data gets in: CDC from our transactional databases, SaaS sources, application events, and third-party APIs.
* Handle the unglamorous parts well: backfills, retries, schema changes, late-arriving data.

**Modelling**

* Own the dbt project end to end: staging through marts, tests, docs, incremental models, and the naming and contract conventions everyone follows.
* Keep BigQuery fast and cheap: partitioning, clustering, query tuning, and cost monitoring.

**Serving and infrastructure**

* Serve low-latency analytics from an OLAP store such as ClickHouse: table design, sorting keys, materialized views, aggregation strategy.
* Look after the GCP estate around the warehouse: Cloud Storage, Cloud Run services, IAM, and the occasional read from sources hosted elsewhere.

**Reliability**

* Run production Airflow: scheduling, dependencies, retries, alerting, and the operational habits that go with it.
* Put freshness and quality checks in place, and fix root causes when they fire rather than restarting the job.
* Set up CI/CD and tests for data code so changes ship safely.

**AI and the team**

* Find where LLMs and agents genuinely help (data discovery, quality monitoring, troubleshooting), and ship those. Skip the demos.
* Review code, mentor junior and mid-level engineers, and write down the decisions and runbooks the team will need later.

**Who you are**

* You own outcomes and you see your work through to production.
* You make good decisions quickly with incomplete information.
* You use AI to move faster without giving up security, maintainability or engineering judgement.
* You're comfortable working anywhere in the stack, and you pick up new tools and languages quickly.
* You collaborate well with engineers, product, design and operations teams.

**What you’ll need**

* 5+ years in data or backend engineering, most of it on production systems.
* Strong Python, with years of writing and debugging production pipelines and services.
* Advanced SQL: window functions, complex transformations, and knowing why a query is slow.
* 2+ years of production dbt experience, including incremental models, macros, tests and docs.
* Experience running production Airflow DAGs, including backfills, monitoring and troubleshooting when things break.
* Strong BigQuery skills: modelling, partitioning, clustering, and query and cost tuning.
* Good knowledge of GCP, including Cloud Storage, IAM and general cloud data infrastructure.
* Solid PostgreSQL experience: indexing, query performance and incremental extraction.
* Experience with stream or distributed processing, such as Apache Flink or similar.
* Comfortable working on a Linux VM: Bash, cron, Docker, reading logs, SSH and basic networking.
* Strong engineering practice with Git, CI/CD, tests and code review, writing code other people can maintain.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with ClickHouse or production OLAP: tuning, materialized views and cluster operations.
* Experience with managed ETL/ELT platforms such as Airbyte or Fivetran.
* Experience with Datastream for CDC and database replication.
* Experience with Kafka and Debezium for event streaming and change data capture.
* Experience with Kubernetes and Terraform.
* Experience with BI tools such as Tableau or Power BI, and a feel for what makes dashboards slow.
* Experience with LLM APIs, RAG and agent frameworks.
* Experience with data observability tools such as Soda, Great Expectations or Monte Carlo.
* Experience with AWS (EC2, S3, RDS).
* A CS or engineering degree, though a strong track record matters more.

**What we offer**

* Real ownership over products that impact millions of diners and thousands of restaurants globally
* The opportunity to solve challenging problems in payments, hospitality, and customer experience
* A fast-moving environment where great ideas quickly become reality
* Close collaboration with experienced operators, builders, and industry experts
* A chance to leave a visible mark on one of the fastest-growing restaurant technology companies globally

**Ready to build?** Join us and help shape how the world pays at the table. If that excites you, apply now.

title: ASIC Infrastructure/ Digital Design Engineer
description:
**Date posted** 11/07/2026

### **Category** **Engineering****Hire Type** **Employee****Job ID** **19317****Date Posted** **11/07/2026**

**We Are:**

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP integration, simulation and analysis solutions and design services., empowering the creation of high-performance silicon chips and software content. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

**You Are:**

You’re an early-career engineer eager to build semiconductor design infrastructure. You value rigorous digital design and enjoy improving tool flows as much as writing code. You understand that when a designer’s environment breaks, productivity drops and milestones slip—and you care. You think in systems, not just scripts, considering dependencies, data ownership, and failure modes before automating. You can debug Linux, Python, and EDA issues independently, knowing when a workaround is acceptable versus when to fix the root cause. You take initiative, ask questions, read documentation, and test safely before deploying changes. You are keen on improving productivity of design flow using latest available AI tools and methodology. At Synopsys, you’ll keep ASIC teams productive and accelerate silicon IP delivery.

  
  

**What You'll Be Doing:**

* Develop and maintain infrastructure supporting daily ASIC design, verification, test and implementation workflows.
* Install, configure, upgrade, and manage EDA tools and licenses (simulation, synthesis, timing, etc.).
* Build and maintain automation for flow setup, job submission, tracking, data management, and reporting (Python/Tcl/Bash/Perl).
* Support compute and storage platforms: filesystem management, monitoring, and ensuring capacity/availability for large datasets.
* Support HPC/compute farms and schedulers: batch submissions, resource allocation, and job scheduling.
* Troubleshoot and proactively monitor environments (tool configs, permissions, paths, licenses), and maintain clear documentation for users.
* Work with the central methodology teams to test, deploy new design flows. Use AI tools/flow to improve the execution efficiency.
  

  

**The Impact You Will Have:**

* Keep ASIC design teams productive and on track for tapeout by ensuring infrastructure uptime and stability.
Automate repetitive setup and flow tasks to* engineers significant time each week.
* Proactively monitor compute, storage, and licenses to prevent issues from blocking critical runs.
* Ensure compute farm and storage capacity scales smoothly during simulation/synthesis workload spikes.
* Deliver reliable updates, documentation, and self-serve processes that reduce troubleshooting and prevent downstream failures.
  

  

**What You'll Need:**

* Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* 0-2 years of experience in software development, scripting, IT infrastructure, or engineering support roles.
* Proficiency in at least one scripting language such as Python, Tcl, Bash, or Perl.
* Working knowledge of Linux operating systems and command-line tools.
* Ability to read technical materials, follow procedures, and learn new tools independently.
* Exposure to ASIC design flows, EDA tools, or semiconductor engineering environments is a plus.
* Familiarity with compute farms, HPC environments, or large-scale storage systems is a plus.
* Experience with configuration management or release processes is a plus.
* Some experience of AI tools/flow is an added plus.
  

  

**Who You Are:**

* Proactive problem solver, comfortable with ambiguity and rapid change.
* R&D mindset engineer someone who can troubleshoot issues end-to-end by reproducing failures, checking logs, and isolating tool vs. environment vs. user causes.
* Collaborative team player who communicates clearly with engineers, explaining problems like license failures without blame.
* Problem solver. Writes robust automation with logging and error handling to handle real-world usage and edge cases.
* Detail-oriented and highly organized. Creates clear, beginner-friendly documentation that enables self-service and consistent execution. Stays organized and proactive: track tasks, provide status updates, and escalate blockers early to keep workflows reliable.
  

  

**The Team You'll Be Part Of**

You will join a team at Synopsys that builds and supports the infrastructure powering daily ASIC design and verification. You’ll collaborate with CAD/IT and R&D IP engineering teams to maintain EDA tool environments, automation, compute farms, and storage systems. The team values strong troubleshooting, clear documentation, and safe change management to keep workflows stable and teams on track for tapeout.

  
  

**Rewards and Benefits:**

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.
