title: Data Engineering - Internship (Paid)
description:
Every day, millions of shipments move around the world on data that nobody is looking at in real time. Orders, ASNs, invoices, and tracking events flow between 3PLs, forwarders, brands, and retailers, then get flattened into a status that tells you something went wrong only after it already has.

SwiftB2B is an AI operating system for global supply chains. One platform where 3PLs, freight forwarders, brands, retailers, and manufacturers can see every item, shipment, and exception as it happens, and where the platform works out what a delay costs and starts the fix. We built it on 15 years of SwiftAnt’s EDI and supply chain work. We are a Databricks partner.

**What the internship is**

Six months on the data team, working on real pipelines that feed the product. You will not be building a toy project on the side. You will get a piece of the actual platform, with a mentor who reviews your work, and by the end you will have shipped something a customer’s data flows through. We pay, we give you Databricks Academy access and sponsor the Data Engineer Associate certification if you get there, and we often hire from this program.

**What you will work on**

* Ingesting data from logistics systems (TMS and WMS exports, carrier APIs, EDI files like the 856 and 214) into Delta tables on Databricks.
* Writing PySpark and SQL transformations with data-quality checks that catch bad rows before they reach a dashboard.
* Building a small piece of our KPI catalogue end to end: source, model, test, documentation.
* Learning Unity Catalog, Lakeflow, and medallion architecture by using them, not by reading about them.
* Writing a runbook for what you built, so someone else can run it.

**What we are looking for**

* Final-year students or recent graduates in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field, or anyone who has taught themselves and can show it.
* Python and SQL you have actually used on a dataset bigger than a CSV.
* Curiosity about how goods move around the world. You do not need logistics knowledge; you need to want it.
* You have built something with data, even a small thing, and can show us.

**How to apply**

Send a link to something you built with data: a repo, a notebook, a dashboard, a blog post. Two or three sentences on what was hard about it. That counts for more than your grades. If you have tried our online demo with your own data, tell us what you noticed.

**Equal opportunity**

SwiftB2B hires on talent, skill and curiosity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, nationality, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, or any other protected characteristic. If you need an adjustment at any stage of the process, tell us and we will make it happen.

title: Associate AI/ML Engineer
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

As an Associate AI/ML Engineer, you will join an innovative engineering team dedicated to transforming healthcare delivery through advanced artificial intelligence and machine learning solutions. In this role, you will contribute directly to designing, developing, and operationalizing generative AI, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems, and agentic workflows that solve complex business and clinical challenges. You will collaborate with cross-functional software and data teams to build secure, scalable, and reliable production-grade AI applications using modern cloud services and enterprise data platforms.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Design and implement AI systems for conversational search in M&R Sales content
* Develop AIML based data ingestion quality gates based on pattern analysis
* Evaluate, debug, and improve conversational AI to ensure accuracy and efficiency
* Monitor and optimize system performance for latency, cost, and reliability
* Explore and apply reinforcement learning and self-improving techniques
* Collaborate and communicate effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders to deliver scalable solutions
* Ensure responsible and ethical AI practices throughout all stages of development
* Design, build, and deploy production-grade AI-powered solutions, including agentic workflows, RAG architectures, and conversational AI applications that solve complex enterprise challenges.
* Develop, optimize, and maintain scalable batch and real-time streaming data pipelines using Spark (including Spark Structured Streaming), Scala, and Python within Azure Databricks and Snowflake.
* Integrate event-streaming technologies (e.g., Apache Kafka, Azure Event Hubs) to process continuous, low-latency data feeds for real-time inference, dynamic context retrieval, and vector store updates
* Expose AI model outputs and streaming analytics via secure REST APIs and microservices, connecting data streams to downstream business platforms and interactive PowerBI dashboards
* Apply security best practices, data privacy standards, and responsible AI principles across all data processing and application workflows
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements.

**Required Qualifications:**

* 3+ years of software engineering experience, including hands-on experience building AI/GenAI or LLM-based applications (e.g., RAG systems, agentic workflows, or AI chatbots)
* Experience designing and building both batch and real-time streaming data pipelines using Spark, Scala, or Python
* Hands-on experience working with event-streaming or distributed messaging platforms (e.g., Apache Kafka, Azure Event Hubs, or Spark Structured Streaming)
* Experience building data pipelines within cloud data platforms such as Azure Databricks or Snowflake
* Practical experience integrating foundation models via commercial or open-source APIs (e.g., Azure OpenAI, OpenAI, Anthropic, Amazon Bedrock)
* Hands-on experience with at least one GenAI orchestration framework (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph, or Spring AI)
* Firm understanding of RAG components (chunking, embeddings, vector indexing, retrieval, prompt engineering) and agentic patterns (tool/function calling, memory, orchestration)
* Solid understanding of REST APIs, microservices architecture, Git, CI/CD pipelines, and Docker containerization
* Awareness of security, privacy, and responsible AI practices when building production systems

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Relevant certifications in data engineering or cloud AI/ML (e.g., Databricks Certified Data Engineer, Azure AI Engineer Associate, Confluent Certified Developer for Apache Kafka)
* Experience modeling and serving streaming or batch datasets to PowerBI for operational and executive reporting
* Experience implementing LLM observability, evaluation, and guardrail frameworks (e.g., MLflow, Langfuse, or TruLens)
* Familiarity with data governance, schema registry, and data quality frameworks in streaming architectures
* Good understanding of analytics tools: Python, SQL, Databricks, Snowflake
* Good knowledge of Business intelligence tools like Tableau/Power BI, etc.
* Solid problem-solving skills
* Good knowledge around Predictive & Prescriptive Analytics techniques like Hypothesis testing, Probability, Supervised & Unsupervised Learnings
* Ability in slicing and dicing of data structures, Natural Language Processing and good to have fundamental understanding on Gen-AI & Large Language Models

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

title: DMTS ITP AI Architecture and Delivery
description:
Job ID

JR117033

**Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for** ***all*****.**

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

The Distinguished Member of Technical Staff (DMTS) for ITP (Innovation, Technology and Products) AI is one of the company's important distinguished technical leadership positions, accountable for turning ITP's AI priorities into production-grade solutions that accelerate technology development, silicon design, product development, and engineering execution across ITP. This role is central to Micron's mission to make AI foundational to how ITP innovates and develops technology and products, amplifying its people and unlocking durable competitive advantage through solutions that are deployed, adopted, and delivering value.

  
  

**Position Summary**

The ITP AI DMTS is a hands-on technical architect and execution leader in Artificial Intelligence. This individual will work closely with subject matter experts (SMEs) across ITP to understand engineering workflows and pain points, translate those needs into practical AI architectures, and work alongside implementation teams seeing through to production deployment. The role directly advances ITP's goal to redesign engineering from specification to qualification, enabling more design IDs, faster execution, and first-pass qualification with best-in-class quality.

The DMTS will be accountable alongside implementation teams for delivery of outcomes, partnering directly with internal customers to ensure solutions are adopted and deliver measurable business impact, including ITP's broader goal of significantly faster time-to-market. Success in this role will be measured primarily by the number of AI systems successfully rolled out into production and the business value they deliver. The individual will drive disciplined execution against quarterly objectives while bringing applied innovation to every solution, ensuring Micron continues to lead in how AI is used across engineering.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

Architecture and Execution

* Partner with SMEs across ITP to understand engineering workflows, data, and constraints, and translate them into scalable, implementable AI architectures.

* Define technical designs, solution blueprints, and implementation plans that move AI use cases from concept to production.

* Lead hands-on technical execution, including architecture reviews, build decisions, integration, and deployment readiness.

* Establish reusable architecture patterns, platforms, and standards that accelerate delivery across ITP.

* Translate the ITP AI roadmap into concrete quarterly deliverables with clear milestones, owners, and success criteria.

* Identify and manage technical risks, dependencies, and trade-offs to keep programs on schedule.

Customer Partnership and Production Delivery

* Own delivery of AI outcomes end to end, from requirements through production rollout and adoption.

* Work closely with internal customers across technology development, silicon design, product engineering, and manufacturing to prioritize the use cases with the highest business impact.

* Drive the rollout of production AI systems, ensuring quality, reliability, scalability, security, and supportability.

* Partner with cross-functional engineering and IT teams to integrate AI solutions into existing tools, data, and workflows.

* Track and report adoption, performance, and business impact of deployed solutions, including improvements in velocity, quality, and cost.

* Continuously improve deployed systems based on customer feedback and operational data.

Applied Innovation

* Drive innovation that becomes deployable capability, applying advances in GenAI, agentic AI, machine learning, scientific AI, and semiconductor-focused AI to real ITP problems.

* Rapidly prototype and evaluate new approaches, scaling those that prove value into production.

* Bring emerging AI technologies and industry practices into ITP where they can measurably improve engineering outcomes.

Technical Leadership and Influence

* Drive disciplined execution against objectives set each quarter, translating the ITP AI roadmap into measurable, quarter-over-quarter results.

* Serve as a trusted technical advisor to ITP leaders on AI architecture, delivery priorities, and investment trade-offs.

* Lead cross-functional teams through complex technical challenges requiring exceptional expertise and creativity.

* Mentor senior technical staff, principal engineers, architects, and engineers

* Build and strengthen Micron's AI technical community and talent pipeline.

How Success Is Measured

* Number of AI systems rolled out into production across ITP.

* Customer adoption and sustained usage of deployed solutions.

* Measurable business impact, including faster time-to-market, improved quality, and engineering productivity gains.

* Delivery against quarterly objectives and committed milestones.

* Innovation output, including new IP and novel solutions that reach deployment.

Minimum Qualifications

* MS or PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Computer Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or related field.

* 15+ years of experience in advanced AI research, AI platform development, machine learning, semiconductor or related technical domains.

* Demonstrated record of technical innovation translated into production systems with measurable business impact.

* Deep expertise in multiple AI disciplines, such as Generative AI, agentic AI, machine learning, deep learning, LLMs, AI infrastructure, scientific AI, reinforcement learning, and AI safety and governance.

* Significant experience architecting, building, and deploying large-scale AI or software systems into production.

* Exceptional communication and executive influencing skills.

* Proven ability to drive technical outcomes across organizational boundaries without direct authority.

Preferred Qualifications

* Expertise in AI with a good record of publications, patents, open-source contributions, or industry recognition.

* Experience applying AI within semiconductor technology, EDA, manufacturing, product development, scientific computing, or high-performance computing environments.

* Demonstrated success creating and scaling enterprise AI platforms and capabilities.

* Experience leading AI transformation efforts within global organizations.

* History of mentoring senior technical talent and developing future technical leaders.

* Distinguished engineer experience, or equivalent technical leadership accomplishments.

**About Micron Technology, Inc.**

We are an industry leader in innovative memory and storage solutions transforming how the world uses information to enrich life *for all*. With a relentless focus on our customers, technology leadership, and manufacturing and operational excellence, Micron delivers a rich portfolio of high-performance DRAM, NAND, and NOR memory and storage products through our Micron® and Crucial® brands. Every day, the innovations that our people create fuel the data economy, enabling advances in artificial intelligence and 5G applications that unleash opportunities — from the data center to the intelligent edge and across the client and mobile user experience.
  
  
To learn more, please visit micron.com/careers
  
  
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.
  
  
To request assistance with the application process and/or for reasonable accommodations, please contact hrsupport\_india@micron.com

title: Security Engineer L2 (EDR Specialist)
description:
Hello,

Greetings for the day !!!

We are hiring "Security Engineer L2 (EDR Specialist)" for our organization specialized into end-to-end Cyber Security, IT Infrastructure, OT Security, and Managed Services based at BKC, Mumbai !!!

**Job Title:** Technical Lead – Endpoint, Identity & Email Security

**1. Role Summary**

L A Technologies Pvt Ltd is a system integrator with over two decades of experience in consulting, designing, implementing, monitoring and managing network and cyber security solutions for large enterprises in banking and financial services, retail, manufacturing, pharma, ITES, and food and beverages.

We are looking for a senior technical lead to own delivery of our endpoint, identity and email security offerings, built around **SentinelOne** (EDR/XDR, Identity Threat Detection and Response, AI security), **Barracuda** Email Security and **Sophos** (EDR/XDR/MDR) and Crowdstrike ( EDR/XDR) . The role leads a team of implementation and support engineers and doubles as the pre-sales technical expert on these technologies.

**2. Key ResponsibilitiesDelivery and team leadership**

* Lead, mentor and plan capacity for the implementation and L2/L3 support team; set technical standards, runbooks and delivery checklists.

* Own end-to-end delivery of EDR/XDR, ITDR and email security projects: assessment, design, pilot, phased rollout, policy tuning, hand-over to operations.

* Act as technical escalation point for critical incidents and complex customer issues; drive root cause analysis and corrective actions.

* Track delivery against timelines, SLAs and customer satisfaction; report progress and risks to practice leadership and customer stakeholders.

* Coordinate with OEMs (SentinelOne, Barracuda, Sophos) on escalations, roadmaps, partner programmes and certifications.

**Technical ownership**

* Design and implement SentinelOne Singularity EDR/XDR across large, heterogeneous estates (Windows, Linux, macOS, servers, VDI, cloud workloads), including agent deployment at scale, policies, exclusions and integration with SIEM/SOAR and ticketing.

* Implement and operate SentinelOne Identity Threat Detection and Response for Active Directory and Entra ID environments, and the vendor's AI security and AI-assisted analytics capabilities.

* Design, deploy and tune Barracuda and Sophos email security, including mail-flow architecture, anti-phishing, impersonation and BEC protection, DMARC/DKIM/SPF alignment, and migration from legacy gateways.

* Support the managed SOC/MDR service: detection tuning, threat hunting guidance, playbooks and incident response for ransomware, credential theft and phishing campaigns.

* Maintain solution documentation: HLD/LLD, configuration baselines, test plans and operating procedures.

**Pre-sales and customer engagement**

* Act as the technical expert in customer meetings, workshops, proofs of concept and demos with CISOs, CIOs and security teams.

* Prepare solution architectures, bills of material, sizing and technical responses to RFPs and RFIs.

* Build effort estimates and statements of work with the sales and delivery teams; support commercial and risk review of proposals.

* Build and present competitive positioning against competing EDR/XDR and email security products.

**3. Required Qualifications and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science or equivalent; **minimum 7 years** in security implementation and management, with at least 2–3 years leading a technical team.

* Proven hands-on delivery of **SentinelOne** EDR/XDR, Sophos EDR/XDR in enterprise environments, including Identity Threat Detection and Response.

* Hands-on delivery of **Barracuda** and **Sophos** email security solutions.

* Working knowledge of endpoint and identity attack techniques, the MITRE ATT&CK framework, Active Directory and Entra ID security, and email threat vectors.

* Experience in a pre-sales or solution-architect capacity: workshops, POCs, RFP responses, estimation.

* Strong communication skills for CXO-level presentations and clear written documentation.

**4. Preferred**

title: Lead - Digital Platforms and Consumer AI/Senior Lead - Digital Platforms and Consumer AI
description:
**Location Name:**
Pune Corporate Office - Mantri
  
  
**Job Purpose**
At Bajaj Finance, we help millions of people across India manage their money. People come to us when they want to buy a new phone on EMI, when they need a personal loan for a wedding, when they want to buy insurance, or when they want to grow their savings in a Fixed Deposit. Because we have so many customers, we get thousands of questions every single day. Customers want to know their account balance. They want to change the date their EMI gets deducted. They want to know the fees for closing a loan early.
  
  
In the past, to get these answers, a customer had to wait on hold to talk to a call center agent, or they had to tap through ten different screens on our mobile app. We want to change that. We want to make it as easy as sending a text message to a friend.
  
  
We are building a massive, highly intelligent AI (Artificial Intelligence) platform. Think of it like a super-smart chat assistant built right into the Bajaj Finance app. We want our customers to be able to just type out their problems in plain English, Hindi, or other languages, and have the AI fix the problem instantly. If a customer types, "Hey, I need to pause my loan payment this month," the AI should understand them, check their account, and do the work in seconds.
  
  
Building this is incredibly hard. It is not just a simple robot that gives canned answers. It is a smart system that has to understand human language, connect to our deep banking systems, and follow strict financial rules.
  
  
**Duties And Responsibilities**

* Conversation Flows

A normal conversation flows naturally. But computers need a map. They need to be told exactly how a conversation should go, step by step. You will create these maps, which we call Conversation Flows.
  
  
You will literally use a software tool to draw boxes and arrows on your screen.
  
  

* Box 1: The AI says, "Hello, how can I help?" -> Arrow points to Box 2.
* Box 2: The customer says, "I want to see my statement." -> Arrow points to Box 3.
* Box 3: The system checks if the customer's phone number is verified.

o If Yes -> Arrow points to Box 4.
  
  
o If No -> Arrow points to Box 5.
  
  

* Box 4: Show the statement on the screen.
* Box 5: Ask the customer to type in a one-time password (OTP).

You have to map out every single path the conversation could possibly take. You have to think of all the "what ifs." What if the customer types the wrong password? What if the customer stops replying and walks away from their phone? What if the internet crashes? You must draw a box and an arrow for every single situation. These flowcharts become the actual instruction manual for the engineers. They look at your map and write the code to make it happen exactly as you drew it.|Your Daily Work: The 9 Core Areas
  
  
**About**
Your job will be very hands-on. You will not just be sitting in long meetings talking about big ideas. You will be doing the real, detailed work to make this AI smart. Here are the nine specific areas you will be working on every day:
  
  

* FPR (Future Press Release)

Before a single line of computer code is written, you have to know what your end goal is. We do this by writing a Future Press Release, or FPR.
  
  
A press release is a news article that a company puts out when they launch a cool new product. But here, you will write this news article before we even start building. You will write it as if the product is already finished and launched to the public. You will write a catchy headline like: "Bajaj Finance Launches AI That Solves Loan Issues in 10 Seconds." You will write quotes from pretend customers talking about how much they love the feature. You will explain exactly what problem the feature solves in simple, everyday language.
  
  
Why do we do this? Because it keeps everyone focused. If the news article sounds boring or confusing, it means your idea is probably boring or confusing. Once you write a great FPR, you show it to the engineers and your bosses. When everyone reads it and says, "Wow, this sounds amazing, let's build it!"—that document becomes your team's guide.
  
  

* FAQ (Frequently Asked Questions)

Along with your news article, you will write a massive list of Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ). But these are not just the normal questions a customer might ask. These are questions that anyone involved might ask.
  
  
You have to put yourself in the shoes of a confused customer. What will they ask? "Is my bank data safe with this AI robot?" You write the answer. You have to think like our call center agents. "Will this AI do my job wrong and make the customer angry?" You write the answer. You have to think like our company lawyers. "Does this AI follow the Reserve Bank of India rules?" You write the answer.
  
  
The goal of this FAQ is to force you to find all the problems and risks before the engineers start building. If you cannot answer a tough question in your FAQ document, it means your plan has a hole in it, and you need to fix your plan.
  
  

* PPG (Product Program Guidelines)

Because Bajaj Finance deals with people's money, we have a lot of strict rules. We cannot just give a loan to anyone. We have to charge exact fees. We have to use exact interest rates. All of these strict rules are written down in company rulebooks called Product Program Guidelines, or PPG.
  
  
Every single product has a PPG. The personal loan has a PPG. The fixed deposit has a PPG. When we build the AI, the AI must follow the rules in the PPG perfectly. It cannot make a mistake. If the PPG says the late fee is 500 rupees, the AI cannot accidentally tell the customer the late fee is 400 rupees. That would cause a massive legal problem.|As a Product Manager, you will read these PPG rulebooks. You will pull out all the rules related to your project. You will work with the engineers to make sure these rules are permanently locked into the AI's brain. If the company changes a rule in the PPG next year, you are the person who makes sure the AI gets updated immediately.
  
  

* Synthetic Testing

Once the engineers build a version of the AI, we have to test it. But we cannot let a broken, untested AI talk to real Bajaj Finance customers. That is too risky. If the AI is confused, a real customer might get bad advice about their loan.
  
  
So, we use something called Synthetic Testing. "Synthetic" just means fake or made-up. You will help create thousands of fake conversations to test the AI safely. You will create fake customer profiles. For example, you make a fake customer named Rahul who has a home loan. You will type to the AI pretending to be Rahul. You will ask, "Can I pay off my whole loan today?" and see what the AI says.
  
  
Does the AI say yes? Does it calculate the early payment fee correctly? What if you pretend to be a customer who types with terrible spelling? What if you type in a mix of Hindi and English? What if you pretend to be very angry? Does the AI still understand and stay polite? You will run hundreds of these fake tests. When the AI fails, you write down why it failed, take that information back to the engineers, and tell them what to fix. You keep doing this until the AI passes every fake test perfectly.
  
  

* LLM Parameters (What We Send to the AI Brain)

The core brain of our AI is called a Large Language Model (LLM). Think of the LLM like an incredibly smart person sitting in a dark room. This person knows how to speak perfectly, but they have no idea who they are talking to.
  
  
If a customer types, "What is my balance?", the smart person in the dark room has no idea whose balance to check. So, we have to send the LLM a package of extra information along with the customer's question. We call this setting the LLM Parameters.
  
  
As the Product Manager, you will decide exactly what information goes into that package. When the customer asks about their balance, you will tell our computer systems: "Before you let the AI answer, grab the customer's name, grab their last three payments, and grab their current loan amount. Send all of that to the AI."
  
  
You also have to send strict instructions. You will tell the AI, "You are a helpful assistant for Bajaj Finance. Always be polite. Do not guess numbers. Only use the numbers I just sent you." If you send the AI too much information, it gets confused and it costs the company too much money to process. If you send too little information, the AI gives a stupid answer. Your job is to find the perfect balance of what data to send the AI every time a customer speaks.
  
  

* Visualisations

Chatting with an AI should not just be reading massive blocks of text. Nobody wants to read a giant paragraph of words on their small phone screen.|Sometimes, the best way to answer a customer is by showing them a picture, a chart, or a button. We call these Visualisations.
  
  
Let's say a customer asks, "How much of my loan have I paid off?" The AI could write a long, boring sentence with a bunch of numbers. But it is much better if the AI shows a nice, clean pie chart on the screen. Half the pie is green for the money paid, and half is grey for the money left. The customer understands it instantly.
  
  
Or, if the AI needs the customer to pick a date, it shouldn't make the customer type "October 15th." It should pop up a small calendar on the screen so the customer can just tap the day. You will decide when to use text and when to use these visual tools. You will work with our designers to sketch out how these charts and buttons should look so the chat is beautiful and easy to use.
  
  

* Product Switching

Imagine you are talking to a human salesman at a store. You ask about buying a TV. Then, suddenly, you change your mind and ask about buying a fridge. The human easily switches the topic to the fridge.Computers are not naturally good at this. If the computer is programmed to talk to you about a TV, and you ask about a fridge, the computer will get totally confused. It might say, "Error, I do not understand."
  
  
At Bajaj Finance, we have dozens of products. A customer might start a chat asking about their EMI shopping card. But halfway through the chat, they might say, "By the way, I also want to open a Fixed Deposit." The AI needs to smoothly switch from talking about the shopping card to talking about the Fixed Deposit without breaking or crashing.
  
  
We call this Product Switching. You will write the rules for how the AI handles these sudden changes in conversation. You will plan out how the AI remembers what the customer was talking about first, just in case the customer wants to go back to the original topic later.
  
  
**Required Qualifications And Experience**
The Background You Need (Education & Experience)
  
  
**Requirements**
Because this job requires you to build highly complex computer systems, we are very strict about the background you need to have. We are looking for people who meet these exact requirements:
  
  

* Your Education (The Degree and the College)

You must have a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a closely related technical computer field.
  
  
You must have graduated from a Tier 1 Engineering College. This means premier institutes like the IITs (Indian Institutes of Technology), NITs (National Institutes of Technology), or top-level Regional Engineering Colleges.
  
  
It is because the AI technology we are building is extremely complicated. You will be working side-by-side with some of the smartest software engineers in the country. You need to know how software is actually built. You need to understand coding logic, databases, and how computer servers talk to each other. Top engineering colleges train you to handle these tough, highly technical problems. If you do not have this strong computer science foundation, you will not be able to keep up with the engineering teams.
  
  
If you also have a Master's degree, that is great! We love to see it. But if you do not have a Master's degree, that is perfectly fine. It is not required. The Bachelor's degree from a Tier 1 college is what matters the most.
  
  

* Your Work Experience (2 to 3 Years in NLP/AI)

You cannot be fresh out of college for this job. You must have at least 2 to 3 years of actual, hands-on work experience.
  
  
More importantly, this experience must be in a very specific area. You must have worked on NLP platforms. It is the specific technology that teaches computers how to read, understand, and write human language.
  
  
You must have spent the last few years of your career actually building chatbots, voice assistants, or smart AI text tools. You cannot just be someone who managed a normal website or a standard mobile app.

description:
**Role Title: 2603010 AVP, AI Security Architect (L11)**
**Company Overview**
Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as #3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the #1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
  
  
**Organizational Overview**
The Security Architecture organization enables Synchrony to innovate and grow securely by embedding security-by-design into technology solutions. We partner with engineering, platform, data, cloud, and business teams to translate security strategy and evolving threats into practical architecture requirements, reusable patterns, blueprints, and guardrails. Through risk-based architecture reviews, threat modeling, and scalable security guidance, the team helps protect Synchrony’s digital assets and customer data while supporting resilient, compliant, and efficient technology delivery. This role will contribute to advancing our AI Security Architecture capabilities, helping establish secure patterns and assurance practices for Generative AI, AI agents, and other emerging AI technologies.
  
  
**Role Summary/Purpose**
**The AVP, AI Security Architect**
will design and advance security architectures for Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, Machine Learning, and emerging AI technologies. The role will translate enterprise security strategy and evolving AI threats into practical requirements, reusable patterns, and engineering guidance that enable secure innovation while protecting company, customer, and sensitive data.
  
  
Working across Cybersecurity, Technology, Data, AI/ML Engineering, Cloud, Risk, and Business teams, the architect will lead solution-level security assessments, contribute to enterprise standards, and embed security-by-design through threat modeling, control validation, testing, and continuous assurance across the AI lifecycle.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Apply and help mature enterprise AI security architecture principles, standards, reference architectures, and guardrails.
* Design reusable security patterns for Generative AI, copilots, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), model and inference APIs, autonomous or agentic AI, and enterprise AI platforms.
* Lead security architecture assessments for complex AI solutions across cloud, SaaS, API, data, application, and enterprise technology environments.
* Partner with AI/ML engineers, application teams, cloud architects, data teams, and product owners to embed security throughout design, development, deployment, integration, monitoring, and retirement.
* Perform AI threat modeling using MITRE ATLAS and OWASP guidance, translating identified threats into actionable controls and engineering requirements.
* Define and validate controls for model access, identities, service accounts, secrets, APIs, prompts, training and retrieval data, outputs, plugins, tools, and third-party AI services.
* Assess risks such as prompt injection, data poisoning, sensitive information disclosure, insecure tool interaction, excessive agency, model manipulation, and AI supply-chain compromise.
* Contribute to automation of architecture reviews, threat modeling, vulnerability assessment, control validation, and security testing.
* Document architecture decisions, material risks, trade-offs, and recommendations for technical teams and senior stakeholders.
* Collaborate with Enterprise Architecture, Cloud, Application Security, Data, Responsible AI, Privacy, Legal, Compliance, Risk, and Business partners.
* Create implementation guidance and enablement that help engineering teams adopt approved AI security patterns consistently.

**Required Skills/Knowledge**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Strong experience in cybersecurity, security architecture, cloud security, application security, or enterprise architecture, including delivery of complex security initiatives.
* Practical knowledge of modern AI architectures, including Large Language Models, RAG, vector databases, embeddings, model gateways, AI agents, orchestration frameworks, managed AI services, and model or inference APIs.
* Strong foundation in identity and access management, application and API security, cloud security, data protection, secrets and key management, DevSecOps, and software supply-chain security.
* Knowledge of AI security and risk frameworks such as the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, MITRE ATLAS, NIST AI Risk Management Framework, and Zero Trust principles.
* Experience designing or reviewing enterprise architectures on AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
* Ability to convert technical risks into architecture requirements, reusable patterns, engineering guidance, and clear recommendations.
* Demonstrated ability to influence technical stakeholders, facilitate architecture decisions, and build alignment across teams.
* Strong written, verbal, presentation, and stakeholder-management skills.

**Desired Skills/Knowledge**

* Experience securing platforms such as Amazon Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Copilot, or comparable enterprise AI services.
* Experience with AI red teaming, adversarial testing, model security assessment, prompt-injection testing, or AI vulnerability management.
* Familiarity with NIST AI RMF, MITRE ATLAS, OWASP guidance, ISO/IEC 42001, and evolving AI governance expectations.
* Ability to move effectively between detailed technical architecture, engineering execution, risk discussions, and stakeholder communication.
* Experience developing reference architectures, security blueprints, automated guardrails, and scalable control-assurance capabilities.
* Financial-services cybersecurity, regulatory, risk-management, or data-protection experience is a plus.
* Collaborative and execution-oriented approach, with a focus on simplification, automation, measurable outcomes, and responsible innovation.

**Eligibility Criteria**
Bachelor's degree with 6+ years of experience in Cyber industry, security architecture experience including on-prem and hybrid environments and practical knowledge of modern AI architectures, including Large Language Models, RAG, vector databases, embeddings, model gateways, AI agents, orchestration frameworks, managed AI services, and model or inference APIs.
  
  
**Work Timings:**
2:00 PM– 11:00 PM IST
  
  
We are proud to offer flexibility at Synchrony. Our way of working allows you the option to work from home or workspaces in our Regional Engagement Hubs—Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Pune, Kolkata, or Delhi/NCR. Occasionally you may be required to commute or travel to Hyderabad or one of the Regional Engagement Hubs for in person engagement activities such as business or team meetings, trainings, and culture events.

title: Lead - Digital Platforms and Consumer AI/Senior Lead - Digital Platforms and Consumer AI
description:
**Location Name:**
Pune Corporate Office - Mantri
  
  
**Job Purpose**
At Bajaj Finance, we help millions of people across India manage their money. People come to us when they want to buy a new phone on EMI, when they need a personal loan for a wedding, when they want to buy insurance, or when they want to grow their savings in a Fixed Deposit. Because we have so many customers, we get thousands of questions every single day. Customers want to know their account balance. They want to change the date their EMI gets deducted. They want to know the fees for closing a loan early.
  
  
In the past, to get these answers, a customer had to wait on hold to talk to a call center agent, or they had to tap through ten different screens on our mobile app. We want to change that. We want to make it as easy as sending a text message to a friend.
  
  
We are building a massive, highly intelligent AI (Artificial Intelligence) platform. Think of it like a super-smart chat assistant built right into the Bajaj Finance app. We want our customers to be able to just type out their problems in plain English, Hindi, or other languages, and have the AI fix the problem instantly. If a customer types, "Hey, I need to pause my loan payment this month," the AI should understand them, check their account, and do the work in seconds.
  
  
Building this is incredibly hard. It is not just a simple robot that gives canned answers. It is a smart system that has to understand human language, connect to our deep banking systems, and follow strict financial rules.
  
  
**Duties And Responsibilities**

* Conversation Flows

A normal conversation flows naturally. But computers need a map. They need to be told exactly how a conversation should go, step by step. You will create these maps, which we call Conversation Flows.
  
  
You will literally use a software tool to draw boxes and arrows on your screen.
  
  

* Box 1: The AI says, "Hello, how can I help?" -> Arrow points to Box 2.
* Box 2: The customer says, "I want to see my statement." -> Arrow points to Box 3.
* Box 3: The system checks if the customer's phone number is verified.

o If Yes -> Arrow points to Box 4.
  
  
o If No -> Arrow points to Box 5.
  
  

* Box 4: Show the statement on the screen.
* Box 5: Ask the customer to type in a one-time password (OTP).

You have to map out every single path the conversation could possibly take. You have to think of all the "what ifs." What if the customer types the wrong password? What if the customer stops replying and walks away from their phone? What if the internet crashes? You must draw a box and an arrow for every single situation. These flowcharts become the actual instruction manual for the engineers. They look at your map and write the code to make it happen exactly as you drew it.|Your Daily Work: The 9 Core Areas
  
  
**About**
Your job will be very hands-on. You will not just be sitting in long meetings talking about big ideas. You will be doing the real, detailed work to make this AI smart. Here are the nine specific areas you will be working on every day:
  
  

* FPR (Future Press Release)

Before a single line of computer code is written, you have to know what your end goal is. We do this by writing a Future Press Release, or FPR.
  
  
A press release is a news article that a company puts out when they launch a cool new product. But here, you will write this news article before we even start building. You will write it as if the product is already finished and launched to the public. You will write a catchy headline like: "Bajaj Finance Launches AI That Solves Loan Issues in 10 Seconds." You will write quotes from pretend customers talking about how much they love the feature. You will explain exactly what problem the feature solves in simple, everyday language.
  
  
Why do we do this? Because it keeps everyone focused. If the news article sounds boring or confusing, it means your idea is probably boring or confusing. Once you write a great FPR, you show it to the engineers and your bosses. When everyone reads it and says, "Wow, this sounds amazing, let's build it!"—that document becomes your team's guide.
  
  

* FAQ (Frequently Asked Questions)

Along with your news article, you will write a massive list of Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ). But these are not just the normal questions a customer might ask. These are questions that anyone involved might ask.
  
  
You have to put yourself in the shoes of a confused customer. What will they ask? "Is my bank data safe with this AI robot?" You write the answer. You have to think like our call center agents. "Will this AI do my job wrong and make the customer angry?" You write the answer. You have to think like our company lawyers. "Does this AI follow the Reserve Bank of India rules?" You write the answer.
  
  
The goal of this FAQ is to force you to find all the problems and risks before the engineers start building. If you cannot answer a tough question in your FAQ document, it means your plan has a hole in it, and you need to fix your plan.
  
  

* PPG (Product Program Guidelines)

Because Bajaj Finance deals with people's money, we have a lot of strict rules. We cannot just give a loan to anyone. We have to charge exact fees. We have to use exact interest rates. All of these strict rules are written down in company rulebooks called Product Program Guidelines, or PPG.
  
  
Every single product has a PPG. The personal loan has a PPG. The fixed deposit has a PPG. When we build the AI, the AI must follow the rules in the PPG perfectly. It cannot make a mistake. If the PPG says the late fee is 500 rupees, the AI cannot accidentally tell the customer the late fee is 400 rupees. That would cause a massive legal problem.|As a Product Manager, you will read these PPG rulebooks. You will pull out all the rules related to your project. You will work with the engineers to make sure these rules are permanently locked into the AI's brain. If the company changes a rule in the PPG next year, you are the person who makes sure the AI gets updated immediately.
  
  

* Synthetic Testing

Once the engineers build a version of the AI, we have to test it. But we cannot let a broken, untested AI talk to real Bajaj Finance customers. That is too risky. If the AI is confused, a real customer might get bad advice about their loan.
  
  
So, we use something called Synthetic Testing. "Synthetic" just means fake or made-up. You will help create thousands of fake conversations to test the AI safely. You will create fake customer profiles. For example, you make a fake customer named Rahul who has a home loan. You will type to the AI pretending to be Rahul. You will ask, "Can I pay off my whole loan today?" and see what the AI says.
  
  
Does the AI say yes? Does it calculate the early payment fee correctly? What if you pretend to be a customer who types with terrible spelling? What if you type in a mix of Hindi and English? What if you pretend to be very angry? Does the AI still understand and stay polite? You will run hundreds of these fake tests. When the AI fails, you write down why it failed, take that information back to the engineers, and tell them what to fix. You keep doing this until the AI passes every fake test perfectly.
  
  

* LLM Parameters (What We Send to the AI Brain)

The core brain of our AI is called a Large Language Model (LLM). Think of the LLM like an incredibly smart person sitting in a dark room. This person knows how to speak perfectly, but they have no idea who they are talking to.
  
  
If a customer types, "What is my balance?", the smart person in the dark room has no idea whose balance to check. So, we have to send the LLM a package of extra information along with the customer's question. We call this setting the LLM Parameters.
  
  
As the Product Manager, you will decide exactly what information goes into that package. When the customer asks about their balance, you will tell our computer systems: "Before you let the AI answer, grab the customer's name, grab their last three payments, and grab their current loan amount. Send all of that to the AI."
  
  
You also have to send strict instructions. You will tell the AI, "You are a helpful assistant for Bajaj Finance. Always be polite. Do not guess numbers. Only use the numbers I just sent you." If you send the AI too much information, it gets confused and it costs the company too much money to process. If you send too little information, the AI gives a stupid answer. Your job is to find the perfect balance of what data to send the AI every time a customer speaks.
  
  

* Visualisations

Chatting with an AI should not just be reading massive blocks of text. Nobody wants to read a giant paragraph of words on their small phone screen.|Sometimes, the best way to answer a customer is by showing them a picture, a chart, or a button. We call these Visualisations.
  
  
Let's say a customer asks, "How much of my loan have I paid off?" The AI could write a long, boring sentence with a bunch of numbers. But it is much better if the AI shows a nice, clean pie chart on the screen. Half the pie is green for the money paid, and half is grey for the money left. The customer understands it instantly.
  
  
Or, if the AI needs the customer to pick a date, it shouldn't make the customer type "October 15th." It should pop up a small calendar on the screen so the customer can just tap the day. You will decide when to use text and when to use these visual tools. You will work with our designers to sketch out how these charts and buttons should look so the chat is beautiful and easy to use.
  
  

* Product Switching

Imagine you are talking to a human salesman at a store. You ask about buying a TV. Then, suddenly, you change your mind and ask about buying a fridge. The human easily switches the topic to the fridge.Computers are not naturally good at this. If the computer is programmed to talk to you about a TV, and you ask about a fridge, the computer will get totally confused. It might say, "Error, I do not understand."
  
  
At Bajaj Finance, we have dozens of products. A customer might start a chat asking about their EMI shopping card. But halfway through the chat, they might say, "By the way, I also want to open a Fixed Deposit." The AI needs to smoothly switch from talking about the shopping card to talking about the Fixed Deposit without breaking or crashing.
  
  
We call this Product Switching. You will write the rules for how the AI handles these sudden changes in conversation. You will plan out how the AI remembers what the customer was talking about first, just in case the customer wants to go back to the original topic later.
  
  
**Required Qualifications And Experience**
The Background You Need (Education & Experience)
  
  
**Requirements**
Because this job requires you to build highly complex computer systems, we are very strict about the background you need to have. We are looking for people who meet these exact requirements:
  
  

* Your Education (The Degree and the College)

You must have a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a closely related technical computer field.
  
  
You must have graduated from a Tier 1 Engineering College. This means premier institutes like the IITs (Indian Institutes of Technology), NITs (National Institutes of Technology), or top-level Regional Engineering Colleges.
  
  
It is because the AI technology we are building is extremely complicated. You will be working side-by-side with some of the smartest software engineers in the country. You need to know how software is actually built. You need to understand coding logic, databases, and how computer servers talk to each other. Top engineering colleges train you to handle these tough, highly technical problems. If you do not have this strong computer science foundation, you will not be able to keep up with the engineering teams.
  
  
If you also have a Master's degree, that is great! We love to see it. But if you do not have a Master's degree, that is perfectly fine. It is not required. The Bachelor's degree from a Tier 1 college is what matters the most.
  
  

* Your Work Experience (2 to 3 Years in NLP/AI)

You cannot be fresh out of college for this job. You must have at least 2 to 3 years of actual, hands-on work experience.
  
  
More importantly, this experience must be in a very specific area. You must have worked on NLP platforms. It is the specific technology that teaches computers how to read, understand, and write human language.
  
  
You must have spent the last few years of your career actually building chatbots, voice assistants, or smart AI text tools. You cannot just be someone who managed a normal website or a standard mobile app.

The role leads the evolution of container platform capabilities as a product, providing secure, resilient, scalable and reusable services that enable application teams to deploy and operate containerized workloads consistently across the enterprise.
  
  
The leader combines deep technical credibility with product and people leadership. The role sets the platform vision, prioritizes investments, drives engineering standards and automation, influences technology vendors and internal stakeholders, and partners closely with Operations Service Delivery Managers (SDMs) to ensure reliable day-to-day service delivery. The team owns the container platform engineering capability and developer enablement experience; it does not own application development, application code, or application-specific workload engineering.
  
  
Key Accountabilities
  
  
Product Strategy, Roadmap & Portfolio Ownership
  
  

* Own the multi-year product strategy and roadmap for enterprise container platforms across public and private cloud.
* Define platform outcomes, target capabilities, investment priorities, product lifecycle decisions and measurable adoption goals.
* Balance business demand, developer experience, security, resiliency, cost, technical debt and regulatory requirements in roadmap prioritization.
* Maintain a transparent feature backlog and communicate platform direction, trade-offs and delivery progress to senior stakeholders.
* Assess build, buy and partner options, and influence vendor roadmaps to meet enterprise requirements.

Platform Engineering & Technology Leadership
  
  

* Provide engineering leadership for enterprise Kubernetes and container capabilities, including managed Kubernetes services, private-cloud Kubernetes, container registries, cluster services, networking, ingress, identity, secrets, policy, observability and platform integrations.
* Drive platform standardization, reusable patterns, golden paths, automation and self-service onboarding through Infrastructure as Code and GitOps practices.
* Establish technology standards and reference architectures for secure multi-tenant container platforms and workload onboarding.
* Guide platform modernization, version lifecycle, upgrades, patching, capacity evolution and end-of-life planning.
* Remain technically engaged in architecture and engineering decisions, design reviews, complex problem solving and proof-of-concept evaluation.

Platform as a Product & Developer Experience
  
  

* Treat container services as an enterprise product with clear consumers, service offerings, roadmaps, documentation, onboarding journeys and feedback mechanisms.
* Improve developer experience through simplified onboarding, product documentation, paved-road patterns, APIs, templates and automated controls.
* Partner with application, DevOps and architecture teams to understand demand and translate recurring needs into reusable platform capabilities.
* Drive adoption of strategic container platforms and reduce fragmentation, bespoke solutions and unsupported patterns.
* Define service boundaries and shared-responsibility expectations between the platform team, application teams, security and operations.

Reliability, Operations Partnership & Service Outcomes
  
  

* Partner with Operations SDMs and support providers to define support models, operational acceptance criteria, runbooks, observability, escalation paths and service-review mechanisms.
* Own platform service outcomes, including reliability, resilience, capacity, performance, security posture, lifecycle health and customer experience.
* Define and review SLAs, SLOs, service indicators and operational KPIs with engineering and operations stakeholders.
* Drive permanent engineering remediation, automation and problem elimination from incidents, recurring support demand and operational data.
* Ensure disaster recovery, business continuity and platform resilience expectations are designed, tested and continuously improved.

Security, Risk & Governance
  
  

* Embed security, identity, policy and compliance controls into the platform engineering lifecycle and automated delivery patterns.
* Partner with Cybersecurity, Risk, Architecture and Compliance teams on guardrails, vulnerability remediation, audit evidence and regulatory obligations.
* Drive least-privilege access, workload isolation, image and supply-chain controls, secrets protection and policy enforcement.
* Maintain clear ownership and timely remediation of platform vulnerabilities, technical risks and lifecycle exposures.
* Ensure platform changes follow enterprise change, control and governance requirements without compromising engineering agility.

Stakeholder, Vendor & Financial Management
  
  

* Build trusted relationships with application leaders, infrastructure teams, architecture, cybersecurity, operations, finance and senior technology stakeholders.
* Serve as the senior product and engineering representative for container platform strategy, investment and service decisions.
* Manage strategic relationships with cloud providers, Kubernetes technology partners and managed service providers.
* Drive commercial and technical outcomes through vendor governance, roadmap influence, service reviews and accountability for commitments.
* Own platform demand, capacity and cost transparency, and promote FinOps practices and efficient consumption patterns.

People & Organizational Leadership
  
  

* Lead, mentor and develop a high-performing team of container platform engineers and technical leaders.
* Build capability across Kubernetes engineering, automation, cloud-native architecture, product management, reliability and security.
* Establish clear roles, decision rights, engineering standards and outcome-based objectives across globally distributed teams.
* Create succession plans, strengthen technical leadership depth and foster a culture of ownership, experimentation, inclusion and continuous improvement.
* Coordinate internal teams and strategic partners while retaining accountability for platform direction and engineering quality.

Scope Boundaries
  
  

* The team owns: Container platform product strategy, roadmap, architecture, platform engineering, automation, shared platform services, guardrails, developer enablement and engineering remediation.
* The team partners on: Production operations, incident and change execution, service management, capacity, resilience testing, security controls and vendor-supported operations.
* The team does not own: Application development, application-specific CI/CD pipelines, business application code, workload-level troubleshooting owned by application teams, or product engineering for applications running on the platform.

**Required Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology or a related discipline; an advanced degree is beneficial.
* Significant experience in cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, container engineering, DevOps or cloud-native technology leadership.
* Proven leadership of enterprise-scale Kubernetes or container platform capabilities across Azure, AWS and/or private-cloud environments.
* Demonstrated ownership of a platform product strategy, roadmap, prioritization process and measurable adoption or service outcomes.
* Experience leading engineering teams and developing senior technical talent in complex, globally distributed environments.
* Experience influencing senior stakeholders, architecture forums, cybersecurity partners, vendors and managed service providers.
* Experience partnering with production operations and service delivery teams while retaining accountability for platform engineering and product outcomes.
* Experience operating in a regulated enterprise environment with strong technology risk, control, audit and change-management expectations.

Technical & Leadership Capabilities
  
  
**Technical / Platform**
**Product / Leadership**

* Kubernetes architecture and managed services such as AKS and EKS
* Platform-as-a-product strategy and roadmap ownership
* Private-cloud or on-premises Kubernetes platforms
* Executive communication and enterprise stakeholder influence
* Containers, registries, Helm and cloud-native ecosystem tooling
* Investment prioritization and outcome-based planning
* GitOps, CI/CD, GitHub, Argo CD and Infrastructure as Code
* Developer experience, product adoption and customer feedback
* Terraform/Bicep or equivalent automation frameworks
* Architecture governance and technology decision-making
* Cloud networking, ingress, service connectivity and private access patterns
* Vendor strategy, commercial awareness and roadmap influence
* Identity, RBAC, managed identities, secrets and policy controls
* People leadership, coaching and organizational capability building
* Observability, SRE, resilience, capacity and platform security
* Operational partnership, risk management and service accountability

Key Success Measures
  
  

* Clear, funded and actively governed multi-year container platform roadmap aligned to enterprise cloud and application strategies.
* Increased adoption of strategic public- and private-cloud container platform services, with reduced platform fragmentation and unsupported patterns.
* Improved onboarding speed, developer experience and self-service adoption through automation and standardized golden paths.
* Measurable improvement in platform reliability, resilience, security posture, lifecycle currency and operational efficiency.
* Reduced manual support effort and recurring incidents through engineering remediation and automation.
* Transparent platform capacity, utilization, cost, risk and service-health insights for leadership and consumers.
* High-performing engineering organization with strong ownership, technical depth, succession and cross-functional credibility.

Leadership Profile
  
  
A strategic and technically credible platform leader who can move comfortably between executive discussions, product prioritization, architecture decisions, engineering reviews and service-outcome discussions. The successful candidate will combine long-term vision with disciplined execution, create clarity across engineering and operations boundaries, and build a secure, scalable and consumer-focused container platform capability for the enterprise.

title: Lead AI Application Engineer
description:
**About Avaya**
---------------

Avaya is an enterprise software leader that helps the world’s largest organizations and government agencies forge unbreakable connections.

The Avaya Infinity™ platform unifies fragmented customer experiences, connecting the channels, insights, technologies, and workflows that together create enduring customer and employee relationships.

We believe success is built through strong connections – with each other, with our work, and with our mission. At Avaya, you'll find a community that values your contributions and supports your growth every step of the way.

Learn more at https://www.avaya.com

**Job Information**
-------------------

Job Code: 00194005

Job Family: Research and Development

Job Function: Software Engineering

**About The Role**
------------------

We are seeking a highly experienced and visionary Lead AI Application Engineer to join our core AI team. This pivotal role will be instrumental in designing, developing, and deploying advanced Machine Learning, Generative AI and Agentic AI applications across high-throughput, real-time streaming environments . You are an engineer’s engineer, someone who spent years training, tuning, and deploying models at scale, and who has spearheaded Generative and Agentic AI over the last 3–4 years. This is an exceptional opportunity for an individual who thrives on building sophisticated, production-grade Autonomous AI systems and wants to make a significant impact.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Technical Architecture & System Design**

  

* Architect and operationalize end-to-end autonomous agentic systems (multi-agent orchestration, dynamic tool-calling, reflection, planner-executor loops, and persistent state management).
* Design robust LLM runtime infrastructure, including hybrid retrieval architectures (Advanced RAG, graph-based context grounding, vector databases, re-rankers, semantic routing).
* Establish scalable evaluation, guardrail, and observability frameworks (latency optimization, cost governors, hallucinations/drift detection, alignment checks, red-teaming).
* Make high-stakes architectural decisions regarding model topologies (proprietary frontier models vs. distilled/fine-tuned SLMs, LoRA, quantization, self-hosted vs. managed endpoints).

#### **Hands-On Execution & Prototyping**

  

* Lead from the front: write high-leverage production code, design critical framework primitives, and rapidly de-risk zero-to-one concepts via functional PoCs.
* Bridge cutting-edge research and production engineering, ensuring systems are resilient, fault-tolerant, secure, and performant at scale.

#### **Strategy & Cross-Functional Influence**

  

* Partner directly with the Head of AI, Product leadership, and VP-level stakeholders to chart the AI technology roadmap and identify transformative capability unlocks.
* Lead the exploration and application of Large Language Models, Agentic AI and Generative AI, venturing into new areas within these fields.
* Represent the company’s AI thought leadership through open-source contributions, technical papers, conferences, or industry forums.
  

#### **Other Responsibilities**

  

* Architect, Design and Build robust, scalable, and efficient AI systems leveraging a variety of AI/ML, data science, deep learning, and agentic AI frameworks.
* Drive the integration of complex Model Context Protocol (MCP) and agent-to-agent (A2A) communication protocols, ensuring seamless interaction and optimal performance.
* Design and implement scalable and efficient AI/ML systems, architectures, and pipelines that can handle large volumes of data and deliver accurate and timely results.
* Regularly self-educate while mentoring and provide technical leadership to other engineers, fostering a culture of continuous learning and excellence.

**Who we are looking for -**
----------------------------

* **Experience**: 15+ years of hands-on software development experience, including 5+ years actively building and deploying Generative AI and Agentic AI applications in production.
* **Core Engineering & AI Building:** Hands-on builder capable of independently architecting, coding, and deploying custom AI tools, autonomous agents, and bots from scratch.
* **Programming Mastery:** 8+ years writing production-grade code in Python or similar languages with deep expertise in scalable software design, APIs, and microservices.
* **Agentic Frameworks & Tools:** Deep proficiency with frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, Auto-GPT, CrewAI, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) for multi-agent coordination.
* **LLMs & Fine-Tuning:** Practical experience with frontier models (GPT-4, Gemini, Claude), fine-tuning, prompt engineering, and custom agentic tool-calling workflows.
* **ML/DL Foundations:** Background in training, tuning, and running models using PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Scikit-learn in high-throughput environments.
* **Inference & Acceleration:** Familiarity with inference engines (vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, TGI) and cloud ML infrastructure (NVIDIA GPUs, TPUs).
* **Data & Memory Infrastructure:** Experience building low-latency vector search indices, in-memory caching layers, streaming pipelines (Kafka/Flink), and NoSQL datastores to power real-time agent context and memory.
* **Education**: Master's or Ph.D. in Computer Science, AI, ML, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent practical experience).
  

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

  

* Autonomous Execution: Proven track record as a senior IC who takes total ownership—from zero-to-one prototyping to production rollout.
* Cloud & DevOps: Exposure to AWS, Azure, or GCP environments with modern containerized deployment (Kubernetes, Docker).
* Domain & Communication: Experience in contact center/telecom/CX platforms is a plus; excellent technical communication skills required.

**Experience**
--------------

12+ Years of Experience

**Education**
-------------

Bachelor degree or equivalent experience

Advance Degree preferred in Computer Science or Related Field

----------

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future.

title: Specialist Automation Test Engineer, CX
description:

**So, what's the role all about?**

In NiCE, as a **Specialist Automation Engineer**, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining scalable test automation frameworks and automated test suites across UI, API, integration, and end-to-end testing layers. You will partner closely with engineering, product, and DevOps teams to ensure high-quality software delivery through automation-first quality engineering practices.

This role focuses on building enterprise-grade automation solutions, integrating automation into CI/CD pipelines, and leveraging AI-assisted engineering tools to accelerate test design, automation development, and failure analysis. You will take end-to-end ownership of automation quality, framework reliability, and release confidence for cloud-based products. This is a **100% automation-focused position**, with manual testing not being a primary responsibility.

**How will you make an impact?**

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable, reusable, and maintainable automation frameworks using industry-standard design patterns.
* Build automated UI, API, integration, regression, and end-to-end test suites for web applications, microservices, and cloud-based platforms.
* Integrate automation suites into CI/CD pipelines with automated quality gates, parallel execution, and actionable reporting.
* Debug test failures and product defects, perform root-cause analysis, and continuously improve automation stability and execution efficiency.
* Manage test environments and test data to support reliable and repeatable automated test execution.
* Utilize AI-powered engineering tools and LLM-based assistants to accelerate automation development, maintenance, test generation, and failure triage.
* Review and validate AI-generated code, ensuring correctness, security, maintainability, and engineering quality.
* Identify opportunities to improve quality engineering processes through AI-assisted workflows and automation innovation.
* Partner with developers, product owners, and DevOps teams to promote shift-left testing practices and early quality ownership.
* Participate in code reviews, drive automation standards, and mentor peers on automation framework best practices.
* Communicate automation results, quality risks, and release readiness clearly to stakeholders.
* Own automation framework health, coverage, stability, maintainability, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Drive quality issues to closure and proactively raise risks with evidence-based recommendations.

**Have you got what it takes?**

* Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* Strong programming experience in at least one of the following languages:
* + Java
  + Python
  + JavaScript / TypeScript
* Strong understanding of Object-Oriented Programming, clean coding principles, and software design patterns.
* Hands-on experience with **Playwright** and test frameworks such as Playwright Test, TestNG, JUnit, Pytest, or Jest.
* Experience building UI, API, integration, and end-to-end automation solutions.
* Strong expertise in API automation for REST services using tools such as REST Assured, Playwright API, Postman/Newman, Requests/Pytest, or equivalent.
* Experience with SQL and database validation techniques.
* Proven experience designing, building, and maintaining automation frameworks from the ground up.
* Strong knowledge of Git workflows and CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Azure DevOps.
* Working knowledge of microservices architectures and cloud-based applications.
* Demonstrated experience using AI coding assistants and LLM-based tools to improve engineering productivity.
* Understanding of prompt engineering concepts and AI-assisted automation workflows.
* Strong ability to validate AI-generated outputs and identify risks such as hallucinations, outdated implementations, privacy concerns, and maintainability issues.
* Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Self-driven with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
* Experience working in Agile software development environments.
* Ability to work effectively in distributed global teams.

**Bonus Experience**

* Experience with agent-based or agentic engineering workflows.
* Experience with AI-assisted test generation and self-healing automation solutions.
* Hands-on experience with AWS or other major cloud platforms.
* Experience with Docker and Kubernetes for containerized test execution.
* Experience with performance and load testing tools such as JMeter, Gatling, or k6.
* Knowledge of observability platforms including Grafana, Kibana, and Datadog.
* Experience testing messaging and streaming platforms such as Kafka.
* Exposure to contract testing, chaos engineering, or resilience testing practices.
* Experience testing AI/LLM-powered applications and product features.
* Experience in Customer Experience (CCaaS) or Financial Crime / Compliance domains.
* ISTQB Advanced Test Automation Engineering certification or ISTQB CT-GenAI certification.
