title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
**Why qlub**

The end of a great meal shouldn't be the slow part. Waiting for the check, finding someone to take payment, splitting a bill by hand. qlub removes that friction. Guests scan a QR code and pay in seconds. No app, no download, no waiting.

From Pay-at-Table and Digital Menus to Order-and-Pay, Payment Links, and SoftPOS terminals, we handle the full payment experience so restaurants can focus on what they do best: great hospitality. Less friction means faster table turnover, smoother operations, and higher profit.

We're a fast-scaling fintech backed by Mastercard, Mubadala, e& and Shorooq. $72M raised, live across multiple markets worldwide, and headcount doubled in the past year. We're building the teams that take us to the next stage.

**The role**

We need a Senior Data Engineer to own our data platform. Today it runs on GCP: BigQuery as the warehouse, dbt for modelling, Airflow for orchestration, and ClickHouse where we need low-latency analytics. It feeds internal reporting, merchant-facing analytics, and a growing set of AI-assisted tooling.

This is a hands-on job. Most of your week is building and running pipelines, fixing what breaks, and making the data trustworthy enough that people stop double-checking it. You will also set the standards the rest of the team follows and mentor the engineers around you.

You do not need to have used every tool listed below. You do need to have run production data systems and know what goes wrong with them.

**What you’ll own**

**Ingestion**

* Own how data gets in: CDC from our transactional databases, SaaS sources, application events, and third-party APIs.
* Handle the unglamorous parts well: backfills, retries, schema changes, late-arriving data.

**Modelling**

* Own the dbt project end to end: staging through marts, tests, docs, incremental models, and the naming and contract conventions everyone follows.
* Keep BigQuery fast and cheap: partitioning, clustering, query tuning, and cost monitoring.

**Serving and infrastructure**

* Serve low-latency analytics from an OLAP store such as ClickHouse: table design, sorting keys, materialized views, aggregation strategy.
* Look after the GCP estate around the warehouse: Cloud Storage, Cloud Run services, IAM, and the occasional read from sources hosted elsewhere.

**Reliability**

* Run production Airflow: scheduling, dependencies, retries, alerting, and the operational habits that go with it.
* Put freshness and quality checks in place, and fix root causes when they fire rather than restarting the job.
* Set up CI/CD and tests for data code so changes ship safely.

**AI and the team**

* Find where LLMs and agents genuinely help (data discovery, quality monitoring, troubleshooting), and ship those. Skip the demos.
* Review code, mentor junior and mid-level engineers, and write down the decisions and runbooks the team will need later.

**Who you are**

* You own outcomes and you see your work through to production.
* You make good decisions quickly with incomplete information.
* You use AI to move faster without giving up security, maintainability or engineering judgement.
* You're comfortable working anywhere in the stack, and you pick up new tools and languages quickly.
* You collaborate well with engineers, product, design and operations teams.

**What you’ll need**

* 5+ years in data or backend engineering, most of it on production systems.
* Strong Python, with years of writing and debugging production pipelines and services.
* Advanced SQL: window functions, complex transformations, and knowing why a query is slow.
* 2+ years of production dbt experience, including incremental models, macros, tests and docs.
* Experience running production Airflow DAGs, including backfills, monitoring and troubleshooting when things break.
* Strong BigQuery skills: modelling, partitioning, clustering, and query and cost tuning.
* Good knowledge of GCP, including Cloud Storage, IAM and general cloud data infrastructure.
* Solid PostgreSQL experience: indexing, query performance and incremental extraction.
* Experience with stream or distributed processing, such as Apache Flink or similar.
* Comfortable working on a Linux VM: Bash, cron, Docker, reading logs, SSH and basic networking.
* Strong engineering practice with Git, CI/CD, tests and code review, writing code other people can maintain.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with ClickHouse or production OLAP: tuning, materialized views and cluster operations.
* Experience with managed ETL/ELT platforms such as Airbyte or Fivetran.
* Experience with Datastream for CDC and database replication.
* Experience with Kafka and Debezium for event streaming and change data capture.
* Experience with Kubernetes and Terraform.
* Experience with BI tools such as Tableau or Power BI, and a feel for what makes dashboards slow.
* Experience with LLM APIs, RAG and agent frameworks.
* Experience with data observability tools such as Soda, Great Expectations or Monte Carlo.
* Experience with AWS (EC2, S3, RDS).
* A CS or engineering degree, though a strong track record matters more.

**What we offer**

* Real ownership over products that impact millions of diners and thousands of restaurants globally
* The opportunity to solve challenging problems in payments, hospitality, and customer experience
* A fast-moving environment where great ideas quickly become reality
* Close collaboration with experienced operators, builders, and industry experts
* A chance to leave a visible mark on one of the fastest-growing restaurant technology companies globally

**Ready to build?** Join us and help shape how the world pays at the table. If that excites you, apply now.

• B.Tech / B.E. (Computer Science, IT, or related field)• M.Tech / MCA (Preferred)• M.Sc. (Statistics / Mathematics / Data Science)

Shift timing : 12 PM -9 PM

title: AVP, AI Security Architect
description:
**Role Title: 2603010 AVP, AI Security Architect (L11)**
**Company Overview**
Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as #3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the #1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
  
  
**Organizational Overview**
The Security Architecture organization enables Synchrony to innovate and grow securely by embedding security-by-design into technology solutions. We partner with engineering, platform, data, cloud, and business teams to translate security strategy and evolving threats into practical architecture requirements, reusable patterns, blueprints, and guardrails. Through risk-based architecture reviews, threat modeling, and scalable security guidance, the team helps protect Synchrony’s digital assets and customer data while supporting resilient, compliant, and efficient technology delivery. This role will contribute to advancing our AI Security Architecture capabilities, helping establish secure patterns and assurance practices for Generative AI, AI agents, and other emerging AI technologies.
  
  
**Role Summary/Purpose**
**The AVP, AI Security Architect**
will design and advance security architectures for Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, Machine Learning, and emerging AI technologies. The role will translate enterprise security strategy and evolving AI threats into practical requirements, reusable patterns, and engineering guidance that enable secure innovation while protecting company, customer, and sensitive data.
  
  
Working across Cybersecurity, Technology, Data, AI/ML Engineering, Cloud, Risk, and Business teams, the architect will lead solution-level security assessments, contribute to enterprise standards, and embed security-by-design through threat modeling, control validation, testing, and continuous assurance across the AI lifecycle.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Apply and help mature enterprise AI security architecture principles, standards, reference architectures, and guardrails.
* Design reusable security patterns for Generative AI, copilots, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), model and inference APIs, autonomous or agentic AI, and enterprise AI platforms.
* Lead security architecture assessments for complex AI solutions across cloud, SaaS, API, data, application, and enterprise technology environments.
* Partner with AI/ML engineers, application teams, cloud architects, data teams, and product owners to embed security throughout design, development, deployment, integration, monitoring, and retirement.
* Perform AI threat modeling using MITRE ATLAS and OWASP guidance, translating identified threats into actionable controls and engineering requirements.
* Define and validate controls for model access, identities, service accounts, secrets, APIs, prompts, training and retrieval data, outputs, plugins, tools, and third-party AI services.
* Assess risks such as prompt injection, data poisoning, sensitive information disclosure, insecure tool interaction, excessive agency, model manipulation, and AI supply-chain compromise.
* Contribute to automation of architecture reviews, threat modeling, vulnerability assessment, control validation, and security testing.
* Document architecture decisions, material risks, trade-offs, and recommendations for technical teams and senior stakeholders.
* Collaborate with Enterprise Architecture, Cloud, Application Security, Data, Responsible AI, Privacy, Legal, Compliance, Risk, and Business partners.
* Create implementation guidance and enablement that help engineering teams adopt approved AI security patterns consistently.

**Required Skills/Knowledge**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Strong experience in cybersecurity, security architecture, cloud security, application security, or enterprise architecture, including delivery of complex security initiatives.
* Practical knowledge of modern AI architectures, including Large Language Models, RAG, vector databases, embeddings, model gateways, AI agents, orchestration frameworks, managed AI services, and model or inference APIs.
* Strong foundation in identity and access management, application and API security, cloud security, data protection, secrets and key management, DevSecOps, and software supply-chain security.
* Knowledge of AI security and risk frameworks such as the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, MITRE ATLAS, NIST AI Risk Management Framework, and Zero Trust principles.
* Experience designing or reviewing enterprise architectures on AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
* Ability to convert technical risks into architecture requirements, reusable patterns, engineering guidance, and clear recommendations.
* Demonstrated ability to influence technical stakeholders, facilitate architecture decisions, and build alignment across teams.
* Strong written, verbal, presentation, and stakeholder-management skills.

**Desired Skills/Knowledge**

* Experience securing platforms such as Amazon Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Copilot, or comparable enterprise AI services.
* Experience with AI red teaming, adversarial testing, model security assessment, prompt-injection testing, or AI vulnerability management.
* Familiarity with NIST AI RMF, MITRE ATLAS, OWASP guidance, ISO/IEC 42001, and evolving AI governance expectations.
* Ability to move effectively between detailed technical architecture, engineering execution, risk discussions, and stakeholder communication.
* Experience developing reference architectures, security blueprints, automated guardrails, and scalable control-assurance capabilities.
* Financial-services cybersecurity, regulatory, risk-management, or data-protection experience is a plus.
* Collaborative and execution-oriented approach, with a focus on simplification, automation, measurable outcomes, and responsible innovation.

**Eligibility Criteria**
Bachelor's degree with 6+ years of experience in Cyber industry, security architecture experience including on-prem and hybrid environments and practical knowledge of modern AI architectures, including Large Language Models, RAG, vector databases, embeddings, model gateways, AI agents, orchestration frameworks, managed AI services, and model or inference APIs.
  
  
**Work Timings:**
2:00 PM– 11:00 PM IST
  
  
We are proud to offer flexibility at Synchrony. Our way of working allows you the option to work from home or workspaces in our Regional Engagement Hubs—Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Pune, Kolkata, or Delhi/NCR. Occasionally you may be required to commute or travel to Hyderabad or one of the Regional Engagement Hubs for in person engagement activities such as business or team meetings, trainings, and culture events.
  
  
**For Internal Applicants**

* Understand the criteria or mandatory skills required for the role, before applying.
* Inform your manager or HRM before applying for the role on Workday.
* Ensure that your professional profile is updated (fields such as education, prior experience, skills) and it is mandatory to upload your updated resume (Word or PDF format).
* Must not be any corrective action plan (First Formal/Final Formal, LPP).
* Employees who have completed 18 months in the organization and 12 months in current role and level are only eligible.
* L9+ Employees can apply.

Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham invites applications from highly motivated candidates for Full-Time Ph.D. Scholar positions in Engineering, Computer Science, and Artificial Intelligence (AI) across its eight campuses.

The role involves actively participating in research projects, interdisciplinary collaborations, academic discussions, seminars, and conferences. Scholars may also contribute to teaching, mentoring, project documentation, grant applications, and other academic activities as required by their respective departments.

**Research opportunities are available in the following areas:**

- Advanced Automation and Robotics

- Aerospace Engineering

- Artificial Intelligence and Data Science

- Chemical Engineering

- Civil Engineering

- Computer Science and Engineering

- Computer Science and Information Technology

- Cyber Security

- Electrical and Electronics Engineering

- Electronics and Communication Engineering

- Materials Science and Engineering

- Mechanical Engineering

- Wireless Networks and Applications

* A Master's degree in a relevant discipline with a minimum of 60% marks from a recognised institution, OR

title: Software Development Manager, Just Walk Out
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Lead a new India-based embedded and firmware engineering team for Just Walk Out's edge devices: the cameras, sensors, RFID, gates and networking hardware in our stores, and the device-side software that connects them to the cloud. This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You'll manage 8-12 engineers, set technical direction across firmware, embedded Linux and embedded Android, and partner closely with the US engineering team that owns this charter today.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Hire, coach and develop a high-judgment team of embedded, firmware and edge software engineers, and build an inclusive, high-ownership culture as the team grows in India
* Own the technical roadmap, delivery and operational excellence for your team's firmware and embedded software, from requirements and architecture through release and field support
* Set engineering standards across the embedded stack: firmware and RTOS/bare-metal code, embedded Linux and Android, drivers and board bring-up, secure boot and OTA updates, and on-device diagnostics
* Own the device-to-cloud boundary with cloud teams: provisioning and identity, connectivity, telemetry and remote management, including the device's AWS IoT / embedded-Linux connectivity stack
* Build the test infrastructure, staged rollouts and telemetry needed to ship firmware safely across a large fleet of deployed devices
* Lead the response to field issues, telling firmware from hardware, connectivity or sensor faults, and drive root cause and lasting fixes
* Drive execution with the US engineering team, product and program management, hardware/ODM partners, and cloud, data and UI/UX teams across time zones

  
A day in the life  
You might start with 1:1s and a design review, helping an engineer reason through an OTA rollback path or a latency budget on a constrained target. Later you agree scope for the next release with product and the US partner team, and re-plan the sprint because a hardware revision changed what's possible. In the afternoon you join your engineers on a field issue affecting a few devices at one store, get them the telemetry and a plan, and keep the fix moving.  
  
About the team  
Just Walk Out builds the technology behind checkout-free shopping: the devices, networking and cloud software that let shoppers walk out without stopping to pay. . This India team will take direct ownership of part of that charter, working closely with the US engineering team, hardware partners and the operations teams who rely on what we ship.  
  
About AWS:  
  
Diverse Experiences: AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job below, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  
  
Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  
  
Inclusive Team Culture - Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth - We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.  
  
Work/Life Balance - We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of engineering team management experience
* Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
* Experience partnering with product or program management teams
* Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
* 7+ years of software engineering experience, including embedded systems or firmware development
* Experience leading the development of embedded, real-time, or hardware-interfacing systems delivered on physical hardware

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
* Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers
* Hands-on embedded Linux (including Yocto) and/or embedded Android, with Linux kernel or driver development and low-level debugging
* Sustaining a large fleet of deployed devices: OTA firmware updates, telemetry, and remote diagnostics at scale
* Experience at the device-to-cloud boundary (connectivity, provisioning, fleet management), ideally with AWS IoT / Greengrass and MQTT
* Depth in Android/Linux firmware, secure boot, wireless connectivity, or RFID/sensor devices, plus hardware-in-the-loop testing

title: Senior Manager Customer Experience
description:
**Senior Manager, Customer Experience**
=======================================

**Company:** Supertails, Bengaluru (in office)

**Reports to:** Head of Customer Experience

**Teams you run:** The order support desk, Clinic booking and calling team, Super companion team, Online consultation veterinary doctors, Sales teams along with Quality & Training and Analytics teams

**About Supertails**

Supertails is one of India's fastest-growing integrated pet-care platforms. We are not just an online store. We are building everything a pet parent needs in one place:

* A wide product catalogue across hundreds of brands
* India's largest digital pet pharmacy
* Vet consultations through a large team of in-house veterinarians
* A Fear-Free certified clinic network
* Express delivery in multiple cities

Every one of these businesses creates customer contacts: an order that is late, a prescription that needs a vet's sign-off, a clinic slot that has to be booked, a new pet parent who needs a hand in the first weeks. The Customer Experience team handles all of them.

**Our CX team**
---------------

Our CX team is not a cost centre that answers tickets. It is the part of the company that sees every broken process first, fixes it at the root, and turns the rest into bookings, repeat orders and reviews. We build a good part of our own tooling, and we use AI wherever it answers a customer faster and better than a queue would.

Over the last quarter the team cut contacts per 100 orders by 24% and cost per contact by 21%, mostly by fixing root causes upstream with supply chain and product and by moving simple contacts to bots. The next leg is harder. The contacts that remain need judgment, and the plan for the coming quarters assumes bots and automation carry more of the load with a team that does not grow with volume.

**The role**
------------

We are looking for the second-most senior person in the function: someone who runs the operation day to day and builds the systems that make it cheaper and better every month.

You have run the morning queue review on Monday, shipped a Retool dashboard or a Claude Code script on Wednesday, and presented a cost-per-contact plan to leadership on Friday. That is the mix.

You will own all customer-facing support operations. Assistant managers and team leads report to you. You report to a product-minded CX leader and work daily with Product, Engineering, Supply Chain, Category and Marketing.

**Pillar 1: Run the operation**
-------------------------------

You own the numbers and the people behind them.

* **Numbers you own:** contacts per 100 orders; cost per contact; resolution time and first response time; CSAT, answer rate and abandonment on inbound lines; schedule adherence and agent attrition; bookings per 100 tickets and show rate for clinic calling; recovered revenue and return on spends.
* Daily, weekly and monthly running of every pod: rosters, shrinkage, queue health, escalations, quality audits and coaching through the team leads.
* Seven-day coverage and festival-peak planning. You are the escalation point for outages, founder escalations, social media and consumer-forum complaints.
* A weekly operating review with a one-page view per pod: goal, actual, gap, and what changes this week.
* Hire and grow assistant managers, team leads and subject experts, and manage performance, including exits. Build a bench so no pod depends on one person.
* Make quality and training work for every pod, not only the biggest one: scoring for calls, chats and emails, calibration sessions, and feedback loops that change what agents do.
* Customer data handling on a pharmacy floor: call-recording consent, prescription data and the data protection law, agreed with Legal and enforced on the floor.

**Pillar 2: Build the tools, the automation and the roadmap**
-------------------------------------------------------------

You are not a full-stack engineer, but you are technical enough to ship on your own and you do not wait for engineering time.

* Build internal tools and dashboards with low-code platforms (Retool, Appsmith), AI-assisted development (Claude Code, Cursor) and cloud services (GCP Cloud Run, Firebase). Give leadership a live view of CX health and emerging issues.
* Own the integrations between our CX platforms (Nugget for tickets and bots, Ameyo and Exotel for telephony, or their equivalents), the CRM, and our analytics database, through APIs, webhooks and middleware.
* Prototype and ship the AI pieces: smart routing, auto-tagging, auto-refunds, agent assist, chatbot and voice-bot improvements. Own the bot and self-serve roadmap with Product: which contact types move, in what order, and what the quality bar is.
* Keep a CX technology roadmap tied to company goals: what to build, buy or shut down, and when. Decide on speed and plain economics.
* Drive cost per contact down through automation, self-serve and smarter routing, without giving up quality. Know what you would refuse to cut.
* Monitor system health, debug integration failures and keep the critical CX workflows up. Keep the documentation current.

**Pillar 3: Fix the processes**
-------------------------------

You know what a good support floor looks like, from ticket routing to agent training to quality frameworks.

* Audit and redesign workflows across support, sales and onboarding to cut friction, shorten resolution and raise CSAT.
* Write and enforce the standard operating procedures for the messy cases: unresolved delivery tickets, refunds, resends, duplicate orders, prescription holds. Build them so they hold at twice today's volume.
* Keep a dated list of root-cause projects, each with an assumed and an actual impact on contacts per 100 orders, reviewed every week with Product, Supply Chain and Category. Be the person who shows up with the number that proves a customer problem exists.
* Manage the vendors: the outsourced calling partner, telephony, ticketing and bots. You own the service levels, the invoices and the renewals.

**Pillar 4: Grow the revenue lines**
------------------------------------

* Clinic bookings from the calling team, Revenue recovery, proactive outreach, and upsell flows that customers thank us for.
* New channels (WhatsApp, in-app chat) and differentiated service by customer segment.

**What the first 90 days look like**
------------------------------------

* **Days 1 to 30:** sit in every queue. Know every pod's volume, staffing, cost and quality by heart. Run the weekly review by week four.
* **Days 31 to 60:** publish the root-cause project list with owners and dates. Fix the two or three broken metric definitions that stop us reading our own numbers the same way twice. Ship one tool.
* **Days 61 to 90:** present the next quarter's plan for your pods: contacts, cost, quality, staffing and automation, with the assumptions written down and a view on what you would cut or add.

**You should apply if**
-----------------------

* You have 7 to 10 years in CX operations, CX technology, business operations or a hybrid role at a D2C, e-commerce, quick-commerce, consumer internet or healthcare company.
* You have managed managers, not only agents, on a multi-channel floor of 50 or more seats (voice, chat, email, bots). You have hired team leads.
* You have owned a cost line, not only a service level. You can explain cost per contact, how you brought it down, and what broke along the way.
* You build, you do not only manage tools. You have shipped internal tools, automated workflows or integrations on your own, using low-code platforms, APIs or scripting.
* You read your own data. Comfortable with SQL, spreadsheets and BI tools. You do not wait for an analyst to tell you what happened yesterday.
* You have configured, customised or integrated at least one CX platform: Nugget, Freshdesk, Zendesk, Intercom, Ameyo, Exotel, Genesys or similar.
* You can write a clear SOP, present a plan to leadership and explain a technical decision to a non-technical colleague, all in the same day. Plain, direct English. Hindi or Kannada helps on the floor.
* You are in Bengaluru and in the office with the team.

**Good to have**

* You have run a floor of 100 or more seats.
* You can deploy a small service on Cloud Run or its AWS equivalent and run a simple data pipeline.
* You have run an outsourced vendor or taken a team through a telephony or ticketing platform change.
* Pet care, healthcare or pharmacy experience, or any category where the customer is anxious and the stakes are real.
* Experience setting up a clinic or appointment-based calling team.

**How we will assess you**
--------------------------

* A 30-minute screening call on your operating history: teams, volumes, costs, tools you built, what you changed.
* A take-home case built on a closed past quarter's actuals (masked): a contact-mix, staffing and automation problem. You present your plan and defend it.
* Interviews with the Head of Customer Experience, Heads of Product and Supply Chain and a founder conversation.

**What you will get**
---------------------

* A seat where you build, operate and plan at the same time. One approver.. You own the rest.
* Direct impact on how pet parents experience Supertails, from the first order to the clinic visit.
* A Bengaluru office with a team that likes being in the office together. Yes, there are office dogs.

title: MERN Stack Trainer + Gen AI
description:
MERN Stack + Generative AI Trainer

**Scholar’sEdge Academy** · J. P. Nagar 2nd Phase, Bengaluru · On-site · Full-time

**Role at a glance**

* **Teaches:** Full Stack Development with GenAI (5 months + 2-month internship), AI Application Developer (5 + 2) and the AI Foundations Weekend Bootcamp
* **Reports to:** Founder / Academic Head
* **Schedule:** live batches of 3 hours a day, Saturday labs and workshops, and free demo classes. About [45-46] teaching hours a week, plus prep and mentoring
* **Experience:** Freshers or minimum 1 year building with MERN, plus at least one deployed GenAI app. Practical teaching or mentoring experience with Hands on practice strongly preferred.
* **Pay:** ₹15,000 - ₹20,000 per month full-time

About Scholar’sEdge Academy

Scholar’sEdge Academy is a skills-and-internship institute in J. P. Nagar, Bengaluru. Every program pairs 3–5 months of live, mentor-led training with a 2-month internship on real projects. Our promise to students is simple: you’ll leave able to show what you can do, not just with a certificate. We’re early, we’re building fast, and the trainer we hire now will shape how we teach.

The role

You’ll teach students to build and ship real web applications with the MERN stack, and to put AI inside them: chatbots, Q&A over documents (RAG), AI features and agents. You’ll also show them how to use AI coding assistants without losing the ability to read, debug and judge the code. You’ll be the face of our tech courses, in the classroom, in demo classes and in short videos on our social pages.

What you’ll do

**Teach**

* Deliver live, hands-on classes (3 hours a day) in Full Stack Development with GenAI and AI Application Developer. Spend most of the time coding live, not reading slides.
* Run Saturday labs, free weekend workshops and free demo classes for prospective students and parents.
* Teach beginners from zero, including non-CS graduates, and stretch advanced learners in the same batch.

**Build proof with students**

* Guide every student through 4–6 portfolio projects and a final capstone, each deployed live with a clean GitHub repository and README.
* Review code every week. Give written feedback, require fixes and track each student’s progress.
* Mentor students during the 2-month internship: plan real project work, run daily stand-ups and sign off the deliverables.

**Keep the course current**

* Own and update the syllabus, assignments, quizzes and project briefs for both courses, and review them every quarter for new tools and practices.
* Build marking guides and run mock technical interviews. Help students turn their projects into strong resumes and LinkedIn and GitHub profiles.

**Be the face of the courses**

* Appear on camera in 1–2 short teaching videos a week. Scripts and editing support are provided. Example: “Build a RAG chatbot in 60 seconds.”
* Answer course questions honestly, and never promise jobs or salaries.

What you must know

**JavaScript**

* Must have: ES6+, async/await, promises, closures, modules, the DOM, debugging in DevTools
* Good to have: TypeScript

**Frontend**

* Must have: React (hooks, React Router, forms, state management with Context, Redux Toolkit or Zustand), HTML5, CSS3, Tailwind, responsive design
* Good to have: Next.js (App Router), React Query, accessibility

**Backend**

* Must have: Node.js, Express, REST API design, middleware, login with JWT or sessions, input validation, error handling
* Good to have: WebSockets or Socket.io, GraphQL, rate limiting

**Database**

* Must have: MongoDB, Mongoose, schema design, indexing, aggregation
* Good to have: PostgreSQL or SQL basics, Redis

**Generative AI**

* Must have: LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini), prompt design, structured output and function calling, embeddings, RAG with a vector store (MongoDB Atlas Vector Search, pgvector, Pinecone or Chroma), streaming AI responses into a React UI
* Good to have: LangChain or LlamaIndex, AI agents and tool use, MCP, evaluating AI output, open-source models (Ollama)

**AI-assisted coding**

* Must have: daily use of GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code or similar, and the ability to teach students to review and test what these tools produce

**Shipping**

* Must have: Git and GitHub (branches, pull requests), deployment (Vercel, Render or Railway), environment variables and keeping API keys safe
* Good to have: Docker, CI/CD with GitHub Actions, AWS basics, testing with Jest or Vitest

**Python**

* Must have: enough to read and run AI examples
* Good to have: FastAPI

Who we’re looking for

* Freshers or minimum 1 year building production or client apps with MERN, and at least one deployed GenAI project you can show us live.
* Has taught before: as a trainer, teaching assistant, mentor, college faculty, YouTube creator, or a team lead who onboarded juniors. A fresher with an outstanding portfolio and a strong demo class will also be considered.
* Explains hard ideas simply, is patient with beginners and is honest when they don’t know something.
* Comfortable teaching in English. Kannada and/or Hindi is a plus for students and parents.
* Degree in CS, IT or a related field (B.E., B.Tech, BCA, MCA, B.Sc.), or equivalent proven skill.

**Not a fit:** people who teach from slides only, who’ve never deployed a full app, or who think AI tools mean students don’t need to understand code.

**About the Role and Team**
---------------------------

Join Wipro's AI-Native Business & Platforms unit, a forward-thinking team dedicated to advancing the future of enterprise artificial intelligence. Our Agentic Hive Platform team is responsible for creating a robust, scalable platform that enables intelligent AI agents, digital ecosystems, and business process automation for our clients worldwide. This team plays a vital role in pioneering agentic AI technology, integrating delivery and client partnerships across India and the United States to drive innovation at enterprise scale.

We are looking for an experienced and hands-on Engineering Head to spearhead the technical vision and development of the Agentic Hive platform. The ideal candidate will lead architecture design, development, and deployment of agentic AI capabilities with a strong focus on security, scalability, and reliability. In this pivotal leadership role, you will guide a dynamic engineering team responsible for delivering production-ready AI solutions and integrating them seamlessly with enterprise systems.

Operating from India, you will collaborate closely with leadership and technical peers based in the U.S., ensuring alignment and fostering innovation across global teams. This is a unique opportunity to influence the trajectory of agentic AI in a large enterprise context, blending deep technical expertise with strategic leadership and enterprise architecture sensibilities.

**͏**
-----

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Take full ownership of the architecture and engineering delivery of the Agentic Hive platform, ensuring it meets business priorities, is modular, scalable, and aligned with product roadmaps.
* Lead the design and hands-on development of AI agents and automated workflows leveraging Claude and state-of-the-art agentic AI methodologies, including reasoning algorithms, tool integrations, and interactive human-in-the-loop processes.
* Architect and orchestrate multi-agent systems encompassing specialized agent roles, inter-agent coordination, task routing, stateful management, fault tolerance, and seamless tool collaboration.
* Design comprehensive context management solutions to optimize agent interaction, including memory management, prompt engineering, session persistence, enterprise knowledge integration, semantic search layers, and controlled data access.
* Develop reusable enterprise architecture frameworks, APIs, reference implementations, and governance policies that empower diverse teams to contribute consistently to the Agentic Hive ecosystem.
* Provide technical leadership and mentorship to an AI engineering team of 5 to 6 members, driving design excellence, code quality, development processes, and resolving complex technical challenges effectively.
* Establish agent evaluation standards with a focus on safety, governance, traceability, performance monitoring, hallucination detection, and overall quality benchmarks.
* Collaborate extensively with cross-functional partners including product management, UX/CX design, data teams, security, cloud infrastructure, and domain experts to deliver compelling, trustworthy, and user-centric AI experiences.
* Guide decisions and implementations in data science and data engineering domains ensuring robust data ingestion, transformation, retrieval, feature layer development, model integration, and reliable production workflows.
* Champion engineering best practices such as API-first design, CI/CD automation, container orchestration, cloud scalability, cost management, and secure operations across enterprise cloud environments.
* Engage proactively with stakeholders to translate operational feedback into enhanced platform capabilities and to support the adoption of agentic AI solutions across client engagements.

**͏**
-----

**Preferred Qualifications and Experience**
-------------------------------------------

* Proven hands-on experience designing and delivering Agentic AI solutions, specifically utilizing Claude AI for agent constructions and automations.
* Demonstrated expertise in multi-agent orchestration architectures, enabling complex agent interactions and integrations with external tools and systems.
* In-depth understanding of agent context management strategies including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), semantic memory modeling, prompt engineering, and secured data governance.
* Strong background in applying enterprise architecture principles to build modular, scalable, and secure platform infrastructures.
* Experience managing and mentoring AI engineering teams, balancing architectural oversight with active technical contribution.
* Robust data science and engineering skills encompassing Python programming, SQL, data pipelines, model development, and production-grade deployment.
* Familiarity with UX, UI, and customer experience design concepts enabling effective collaboration with design teams to translate user needs into AI solutions.
* Experience developing AI/ML or generative AI systems incorporating engineering practices like automatic testing, continuous integration and delivery, monitoring, security considerations, and governance frameworks.
* Strong communication abilities with a track record of managing technical discussions with diverse stakeholders including engineers, product teams, and clients.

**͏**
-----

**Additional Technical Skills**
-------------------------------

* Experience with agent frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or similar, including orchestration and agent-to-agent/tool interaction (MCP, A2A patterns).
* Hands-on knowledge of retrieval-augmented generation techniques, hybrid retrieval models, semantic search, knowledge graph integration, and enterprise semantic layers.
* Expertise in AI agent evaluation methodologies, including automated evaluation strategies, policy enforcement, guardrails, and metrics like RAGAS for ongoing assessment.
* Familiarity with LLMOps/MLOps tooling and best practices, including version control of prompts/models, experimentation tracking, automated deployment, performance monitoring, and governance.
* Deep understanding of cloud-native architectures on platforms like Azure, Google Cloud Platform, AWS, and Databricks, tailored for AI and data workloads.
* Competence in containerization and orchestration platforms such as Docker and Kubernetes, RESTful API development, FastAPI, infrastructure as code (IaC), and telemetry systems.
* Experience delivering AI solutions in regulated or complex enterprise environments, successfully transitioning from research and prototyping to robust production systems.

**͏**
-----

**Education, Experience & Leadership Competencies**
---------------------------------------------------

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or related technical disciplines; or equivalent practical experience in these fields.
* Minimum of 12 years' experience in software, data, or AI engineering roles with substantial recent success in generative AI or Agentic AI architecture leadership and delivery.
* Preferred certifications in cloud platforms, AI/ML, data engineering, or related architecture fields that validate technical expertise.
* Proven leadership in managing and scaling engineering teams while maintaining direct hands-on involvement in architecture and development activities.
* Effective communicator and stakeholder management expert capable of articulating complex technical concepts to executives, product owners, and engineering teams alike.
* Comfortable operating in ambiguous, fast-paced environments, balancing innovation with enterprise-grade demands including security, governance, reliability, user experience, and cost management.
* Strong alignment with Wipro's values such as self-leadership, respect, trust building, transformation leadership, and execution excellence to inspire and drive team success.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

* Delivering a scalable, reusable, and secure Agentic Hive platform architecture that serves as a reference model across the organization.
* Ensuring all agentic solutions are production-ready, meeting rigorous safety, observability, reliability, and quality standards.
* Maintaining a highly effective AI engineering team, fostering technical excellence, predictable deliveries, and development of reusable components accelerating future projects.
* Driving strong adoption of the platform by internal teams, partners, and enterprise customers via outstanding developer and end-user experiences.
* Successfully aligning multiple stakeholder groups including product management, engineering, data science, security, governance, cloud operations, and client relations to maximize platform impact.

About Media Star AI

Media Star AI produces AI-powered entertainment content, including cinematic short dramas, concept films, and episodic storytelling. We are a small, fast-moving team where creative, production, and technology skills come together to tell stories for a new generation of viewers.

About the Role

We are looking for a creative and technically curious **AI Voice, Sound & Music Specialist** to give our stories their voice and sound. You will generate and refine AI voiceovers, dialogue, background music, and sound effects, and make sure every episode sounds clear, emotional, and cinematic. You will work closely with the video editor, scriptwriters, and the production team, so this role suits someone with a strong ear and an interest in AI audio tools.

Key Responsibilities

**AI Voice and Dialogue**

* Generate AI voiceovers and character dialogue from approved scripts using AI voice tools.
* Match voice tone, emotion, pacing, and accent to each character and scene.
* Refine and re-generate lines to fix pronunciation, timing, and delivery issues.
* Support multilingual voice work, including Telugu, Hindi, and English, where required.

**Music and Sound Design**

* Create or select background music that fits the mood and genre of each scene.
* Add sound effects, ambient sound, and audio cues that strengthen the storytelling.

* Clean, edit, and sync audio with video, including dialogue timing and lip-sync support.
* Mix and balance voice, music, and effects for clear, consistent loudness.
* Remove noise, artifacts, and glitches from AI-generated audio.
* Prepare final audio files and stems for handover to the video editor.

**Coordination and Compliance**

* Coordinate with the video editor, scriptwriters, and production team to deliver audio on schedule.
* Make audio revisions based on feedback within agreed timelines.
* Check voice, music, and sound assets for licensing, consent, and usage rights before use.
* Support required AI-generated content disclosures for voice and music in final videos.
* Keep organized records of tools, prompts, versions, and approved audio assets.

Expected Deliverables

* AI voiceovers and dialogue tracks for each episode
* Background music and sound effect packs
* Mixed and balanced final audio, with stems where needed
* Organized audio asset library with version history
* Audio rights and usage records for each title
* Weekly audio status updates to the AI Video Production Manager

Required Skills

* Hands-on experience with AI voice and audio tools
* Audio editing and mixing (Audacity, Adobe Audition, Reaper, or DaVinci Resolve Fairlight)
* Good ear for tone, emotion, pacing, and sound quality
* Understanding of dialogue syncing and basic sound design
* Prompt writing for AI audio and music generation
* Ability to meet deadlines and manage multiple audio tasks
* Good communication and willingness to accept feedback

Preferred Tools

* ElevenLabs or similar AI voice platforms
* Suno, Udio, or similar AI music generators
* Adobe Audition, Audacity, or DaVinci Resolve
* Premiere Pro or CapCut for audio-video syncing
* Google Drive and Google Sheets for asset tracking

Qualifications

* 1–2 years of experience in audio editing, music production, voiceover, or a related role

Good to Have

* Knowledge of music theory, instruments, or music production
* Understanding of Indian regional languages and voice styles
* Basic video editing skills

title: Lead AI Application Engineer
description:
**About Avaya**
---------------

Avaya is an enterprise software leader that helps the world’s largest organizations and government agencies forge unbreakable connections.

The Avaya Infinity™ platform unifies fragmented customer experiences, connecting the channels, insights, technologies, and workflows that together create enduring customer and employee relationships.

We believe success is built through strong connections – with each other, with our work, and with our mission. At Avaya, you'll find a community that values your contributions and supports your growth every step of the way.

Learn more at https://www.avaya.com

**Job Information**
-------------------

Job Code: 00194005

Job Family: Research and Development

Job Function: Software Engineering

**About The Role**
------------------

We are seeking a highly experienced and visionary Lead AI Application Engineer to join our core AI team. This pivotal role will be instrumental in designing, developing, and deploying advanced Machine Learning, Generative AI and Agentic AI applications across high-throughput, real-time streaming environments . You are an engineer’s engineer, someone who spent years training, tuning, and deploying models at scale, and who has spearheaded Generative and Agentic AI over the last 3–4 years. This is an exceptional opportunity for an individual who thrives on building sophisticated, production-grade Autonomous AI systems and wants to make a significant impact.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Technical Architecture & System Design**

  

* Architect and operationalize end-to-end autonomous agentic systems (multi-agent orchestration, dynamic tool-calling, reflection, planner-executor loops, and persistent state management).
* Design robust LLM runtime infrastructure, including hybrid retrieval architectures (Advanced RAG, graph-based context grounding, vector databases, re-rankers, semantic routing).
* Establish scalable evaluation, guardrail, and observability frameworks (latency optimization, cost governors, hallucinations/drift detection, alignment checks, red-teaming).
* Make high-stakes architectural decisions regarding model topologies (proprietary frontier models vs. distilled/fine-tuned SLMs, LoRA, quantization, self-hosted vs. managed endpoints).

#### **Hands-On Execution & Prototyping**

  

* Lead from the front: write high-leverage production code, design critical framework primitives, and rapidly de-risk zero-to-one concepts via functional PoCs.
* Bridge cutting-edge research and production engineering, ensuring systems are resilient, fault-tolerant, secure, and performant at scale.

#### **Strategy & Cross-Functional Influence**

  

* Partner directly with the Head of AI, Product leadership, and VP-level stakeholders to chart the AI technology roadmap and identify transformative capability unlocks.
* Lead the exploration and application of Large Language Models, Agentic AI and Generative AI, venturing into new areas within these fields.
* Represent the company’s AI thought leadership through open-source contributions, technical papers, conferences, or industry forums.
  

#### **Other Responsibilities**

  

* Architect, Design and Build robust, scalable, and efficient AI systems leveraging a variety of AI/ML, data science, deep learning, and agentic AI frameworks.
* Drive the integration of complex Model Context Protocol (MCP) and agent-to-agent (A2A) communication protocols, ensuring seamless interaction and optimal performance.
* Design and implement scalable and efficient AI/ML systems, architectures, and pipelines that can handle large volumes of data and deliver accurate and timely results.
* Regularly self-educate while mentoring and provide technical leadership to other engineers, fostering a culture of continuous learning and excellence.

**Who we are looking for -**
----------------------------

* **Experience**: 15+ years of hands-on software development experience, including 5+ years actively building and deploying Generative AI and Agentic AI applications in production.
* **Core Engineering & AI Building:** Hands-on builder capable of independently architecting, coding, and deploying custom AI tools, autonomous agents, and bots from scratch.
* **Programming Mastery:** 8+ years writing production-grade code in Python or similar languages with deep expertise in scalable software design, APIs, and microservices.
* **Agentic Frameworks & Tools:** Deep proficiency with frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, Auto-GPT, CrewAI, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) for multi-agent coordination.

**So, what's the role all about?**

In NiCE, as a **Specialist Automation Engineer**, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining scalable test automation frameworks and automated test suites across UI, API, integration, and end-to-end testing layers. You will partner closely with engineering, product, and DevOps teams to ensure high-quality software delivery through automation-first quality engineering practices.

This role focuses on building enterprise-grade automation solutions, integrating automation into CI/CD pipelines, and leveraging AI-assisted engineering tools to accelerate test design, automation development, and failure analysis. You will take end-to-end ownership of automation quality, framework reliability, and release confidence for cloud-based products. This is a **100% automation-focused position**, with manual testing not being a primary responsibility.

**How will you make an impact?**

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable, reusable, and maintainable automation frameworks using industry-standard design patterns.
* Build automated UI, API, integration, regression, and end-to-end test suites for web applications, microservices, and cloud-based platforms.
* Integrate automation suites into CI/CD pipelines with automated quality gates, parallel execution, and actionable reporting.
* Debug test failures and product defects, perform root-cause analysis, and continuously improve automation stability and execution efficiency.
* Manage test environments and test data to support reliable and repeatable automated test execution.
* Utilize AI-powered engineering tools and LLM-based assistants to accelerate automation development, maintenance, test generation, and failure triage.
* Review and validate AI-generated code, ensuring correctness, security, maintainability, and engineering quality.
* Identify opportunities to improve quality engineering processes through AI-assisted workflows and automation innovation.
* Partner with developers, product owners, and DevOps teams to promote shift-left testing practices and early quality ownership.
* Participate in code reviews, drive automation standards, and mentor peers on automation framework best practices.
* Communicate automation results, quality risks, and release readiness clearly to stakeholders.
* Own automation framework health, coverage, stability, maintainability, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Drive quality issues to closure and proactively raise risks with evidence-based recommendations.

**Have you got what it takes?**

* Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* Strong programming experience in at least one of the following languages:
* + Java
  + Python
  + JavaScript / TypeScript
* Strong understanding of Object-Oriented Programming, clean coding principles, and software design patterns.

* Experience building UI, API, integration, and end-to-end automation solutions.

* Experience with SQL and database validation techniques.
* Proven experience designing, building, and maintaining automation frameworks from the ground up.
* Strong knowledge of Git workflows and CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Azure DevOps.
* Working knowledge of microservices architectures and cloud-based applications.
* Demonstrated experience using AI coding assistants and LLM-based tools to improve engineering productivity.
* Understanding of prompt engineering concepts and AI-assisted automation workflows.
* Strong ability to validate AI-generated outputs and identify risks such as hallucinations, outdated implementations, privacy concerns, and maintainability issues.
* Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Self-driven with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
* Experience working in Agile software development environments.
* Ability to work effectively in distributed global teams.

**Bonus Experience**

* Experience with agent-based or agentic engineering workflows.
* Experience with AI-assisted test generation and self-healing automation solutions.
* Hands-on experience with AWS or other major cloud platforms.
* Experience with Docker and Kubernetes for containerized test execution.
* Experience with performance and load testing tools such as JMeter, Gatling, or k6.
* Knowledge of observability platforms including Grafana, Kibana, and Datadog.
* Experience testing messaging and streaming platforms such as Kafka.
* Exposure to contract testing, chaos engineering, or resilience testing practices.

* Experience in Customer Experience (CCaaS) or Financial Crime / Compliance domains.
* ISTQB Advanced Test Automation Engineering certification or ISTQB CT-GenAI certification.
* Experience mentoring engineers and driving automation best practices across teams.

**What's in it for you?**

Join an ever-growing, market-disrupting, global company where innovation, technology, and customer success come together. At NiCE, you will work alongside talented engineering teams building world-class AI-powered cloud products used by organizations worldwide.

You will have the opportunity to shape modern quality engineering practices, leverage cutting-edge AI technologies, contribute to large-scale cloud platforms, and grow your career through global exposure, continuous learning, and internal development opportunities. **Enjoy NICE-FLEX!**

At NiCE, we work according to the **NICE-FLEX** hybrid model, enabling maximum flexibility with **2 days in the office and 3 days working remotely each week**. Office days are designed to encourage collaboration, innovation, learning, and face-to-face teamwork while maintaining flexibility and work-life balance.

title: AVP, AI Security Architect
description:
**Role Title: 2603010 AVP, AI Security Architect (L11)**
**Company Overview**
Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as #3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the #1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
  
  
**Organizational Overview**
The Security Architecture organization enables Synchrony to innovate and grow securely by embedding security-by-design into technology solutions. We partner with engineering, platform, data, cloud, and business teams to translate security strategy and evolving threats into practical architecture requirements, reusable patterns, blueprints, and guardrails. Through risk-based architecture reviews, threat modeling, and scalable security guidance, the team helps protect Synchrony’s digital assets and customer data while supporting resilient, compliant, and efficient technology delivery. This role will contribute to advancing our AI Security Architecture capabilities, helping establish secure patterns and assurance practices for Generative AI, AI agents, and other emerging AI technologies.
  
  
**Role Summary/Purpose**
**The AVP, AI Security Architect**
will design and advance security architectures for Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, Machine Learning, and emerging AI technologies. The role will translate enterprise security strategy and evolving AI threats into practical requirements, reusable patterns, and engineering guidance that enable secure innovation while protecting company, customer, and sensitive data.
  
  
Working across Cybersecurity, Technology, Data, AI/ML Engineering, Cloud, Risk, and Business teams, the architect will lead solution-level security assessments, contribute to enterprise standards, and embed security-by-design through threat modeling, control validation, testing, and continuous assurance across the AI lifecycle.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Apply and help mature enterprise AI security architecture principles, standards, reference architectures, and guardrails.
* Design reusable security patterns for Generative AI, copilots, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), model and inference APIs, autonomous or agentic AI, and enterprise AI platforms.
* Lead security architecture assessments for complex AI solutions across cloud, SaaS, API, data, application, and enterprise technology environments.
* Partner with AI/ML engineers, application teams, cloud architects, data teams, and product owners to embed security throughout design, development, deployment, integration, monitoring, and retirement.
* Perform AI threat modeling using MITRE ATLAS and OWASP guidance, translating identified threats into actionable controls and engineering requirements.
* Define and validate controls for model access, identities, service accounts, secrets, APIs, prompts, training and retrieval data, outputs, plugins, tools, and third-party AI services.
* Assess risks such as prompt injection, data poisoning, sensitive information disclosure, insecure tool interaction, excessive agency, model manipulation, and AI supply-chain compromise.
* Contribute to automation of architecture reviews, threat modeling, vulnerability assessment, control validation, and security testing.
* Document architecture decisions, material risks, trade-offs, and recommendations for technical teams and senior stakeholders.
* Collaborate with Enterprise Architecture, Cloud, Application Security, Data, Responsible AI, Privacy, Legal, Compliance, Risk, and Business partners.
* Create implementation guidance and enablement that help engineering teams adopt approved AI security patterns consistently.

**Required Skills/Knowledge**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Strong experience in cybersecurity, security architecture, cloud security, application security, or enterprise architecture, including delivery of complex security initiatives.
* Practical knowledge of modern AI architectures, including Large Language Models, RAG, vector databases, embeddings, model gateways, AI agents, orchestration frameworks, managed AI services, and model or inference APIs.
* Strong foundation in identity and access management, application and API security, cloud security, data protection, secrets and key management, DevSecOps, and software supply-chain security.
* Knowledge of AI security and risk frameworks such as the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, MITRE ATLAS, NIST AI Risk Management Framework, and Zero Trust principles.
* Experience designing or reviewing enterprise architectures on AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
* Ability to convert technical risks into architecture requirements, reusable patterns, engineering guidance, and clear recommendations.
* Demonstrated ability to influence technical stakeholders, facilitate architecture decisions, and build alignment across teams.
* Strong written, verbal, presentation, and stakeholder-management skills.

**Desired Skills/Knowledge**

* Experience securing platforms such as Amazon Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Copilot, or comparable enterprise AI services.
* Experience with AI red teaming, adversarial testing, model security assessment, prompt-injection testing, or AI vulnerability management.
* Familiarity with NIST AI RMF, MITRE ATLAS, OWASP guidance, ISO/IEC 42001, and evolving AI governance expectations.
* Ability to move effectively between detailed technical architecture, engineering execution, risk discussions, and stakeholder communication.
* Experience developing reference architectures, security blueprints, automated guardrails, and scalable control-assurance capabilities.
* Financial-services cybersecurity, regulatory, risk-management, or data-protection experience is a plus.
* Collaborative and execution-oriented approach, with a focus on simplification, automation, measurable outcomes, and responsible innovation.

**Eligibility Criteria**
Bachelor's degree with 6+ years of experience in Cyber industry, security architecture experience including on-prem and hybrid environments and practical knowledge of modern AI architectures, including Large Language Models, RAG, vector databases, embeddings, model gateways, AI agents, orchestration frameworks, managed AI services, and model or inference APIs.
  
  
**Work Timings:**
2:00 PM– 11:00 PM IST
  
  
We are proud to offer flexibility at Synchrony. Our way of working allows you the option to work from home or workspaces in our Regional Engagement Hubs—Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Pune, Kolkata, or Delhi/NCR. Occasionally you may be required to commute or travel to Hyderabad or one of the Regional Engagement Hubs for in person engagement activities such as business or team meetings, trainings, and culture events.

* Must not be any corrective action plan (First Formal/Final Formal, LPP).
* Employees who have completed 18 months in the organization and 12 months in current role and level are only eligible.
* L9+ Employees can apply.

Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X.
  
  
**Job Description Summary**
Analog Devices is seeking an experienced Industrial Engineer to join the Central Industrial Engineering team. This role will lead high-impact initiatives focused on capacity modeling, factory scheduling, cycle time reduction, operations research, and productivity improvement across ADI's front-end manufacturing network. The successful candidate will drive development of cross-site analytical models, optimization tools, and data-driven decision systems that maximize factory output, support expansion planning, and establish standardized Industrial Engineering practices across multiple manufacturing sites.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead development of cross-site capacity models, utilization analyses, loading scenarios, and expansion planning studies.
* Drive cycle time reduction and WIP optimization initiatives through Factory Physics methodologies, bottleneck analysis, and constraint management.
* Develop and maintain advanced analytical tools supporting factory scheduling, output optimization, and operational decision making.
* Perform operations research and statistical analyses to identify key output levers and productivity improvement opportunities.
* Design and implement predictive models, optimization algorithms, and AI-enabled analytical solutions for manufacturing applications.
* Lead validation and continuous improvement of scheduling logic, factory planning assumptions, and manufacturing data structures.
* Establish standard methodologies, governance processes, and best practices across multiple manufacturing sites.
* Mentor junior Industrial Engineers and provide technical leadership on analytical projects.
* Partner with site leadership, operations teams, supply chain, manufacturing engineering, and IT to drive strategic improvement initiatives.
* Present recommendations, scenario analyses, and business cases to management and senior leadership.
* Support development of long-range capacity plans and fab expansion scenarios.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Industrial Engineering, Operations Research, Manufacturing Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related engineering discipline.
* Proficiency in SQL, Python, Power BI, and statistical analysis tools.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's Degree in Industrial Engineering, Operations Research, Data Science, Analytics, or related field.
* Semiconductor wafer fabrication experience.
* Experience with Factory Physics, cycle time engineering, capacity planning, production scheduling, or manufacturing optimization.
* Experience with simulation, optimization modeling, machine learning, or operations research techniques.

**Work Experience**

* 3–5 years of Industrial Engineering experience in semiconductor manufacturing or other complex manufacturing environments.
* Experience building capacity models, productivity analyses, factory scheduling models, or optimization tools.
* Demonstrated success leading cross-functional improvement initiatives.
* Strong analytical, communication, and project leadership skills.
* Experience working with globally distributed teams is preferred.

title: Full-Time PHD Scholar
description:
**Company Description:**

Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham is a multi-campus, multi-disciplinary research institution and an Institution of Eminence, recognised as one of India's leading research universities. Accredited with NAAC A++, Amrita is ranked 8th among universities in India in the NIRF India Rankings 2025 and 1st in India in the THE Impact Rankings 2025.

With eight campuses across Amaravati, Amritapuri, Bengaluru, Chennai, Coimbatore, Kochi, Mysuru, and Nagercoil, Amrita provides a vibrant academic environment that fosters advanced research, innovation, and interdisciplinary collaboration.

The university actively collaborates with leading international institutions, including Ivy League universities in the United States and prominent European universities, through joint research initiatives, academic partnerships, and international exchange programmes. Amrita offers scholars opportunities to work on impactful research, access advanced research infrastructure, pursue international collaborations, and contribute to technological and scientific advancements.

**Role Description:**

Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham invites applications from highly motivated candidates for Full-Time Ph.D. Scholar positions in Engineering, Computer Science, and Artificial Intelligence (AI) across its eight campuses.

This is a full-time, on-site research position involving original research under the guidance of experienced faculty members and research supervisors. Selected scholars will be responsible for identifying research problems, conducting comprehensive literature reviews, developing research proposals, designing and executing experiments or computational studies, analysing findings, and publishing research outcomes in reputed peer-reviewed journals and conferences.

The role involves actively participating in research projects, interdisciplinary collaborations, academic discussions, seminars, and conferences. Scholars may also contribute to teaching, mentoring, project documentation, grant applications, and other academic activities as required by their respective departments.

**Research opportunities are available in the following areas:**

- Advanced Automation and Robotics

- Aerospace Engineering

- Artificial Intelligence and Data Science

- Chemical Engineering

- Civil Engineering

- Computer Science and Engineering

- Computer Science and Information Technology

- Cyber Security

- Electrical and Electronics Engineering

- Electronics and Communication Engineering

- Materials Science and Engineering

- Mechanical Engineering

- Wireless Networks and Applications

Selected candidates will benefit from a strong research ecosystem, faculty mentorship, international research collaborations, and institutional support for research infrastructure, publications, conferences, and innovation.

**Qualifications**

* A Master's degree in a relevant discipline with a minimum of 60% marks from a recognised institution, OR
* A four-year/eight-semester Bachelor's degree with Research and a minimum CGPA of 7.5/10.
* Strong academic background and research aptitude, with the ability to identify research problems, conduct literature reviews, and critically evaluate academic literature.
* Good academic writing, documentation, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in multidisciplinary research environments.
* Proficiency in relevant research methodologies, computational tools, laboratory techniques, or analytical software, depending on the chosen research area.
* Effective communication and presentation skills for academic discussions, seminars, and research publications.
* A strong interest in pursuing advanced research and contributing to publications, innovation, and technological development.

**Entrance Test Exemption:**
Candidates with valid UGC-NET, CSIR-NET, or GATE scores are exempted from the written entrance test for Engineering, Computer Science, and AI programmes.

**For Non-NET Candidates:**
Candidates must qualify in the university entrance test with a minimum of 50% marks.

**Selection Process:**
Final selection is based on the Entrance Test (70%) and Interview/Viva-voce (30%). Preference will be given to candidates with verified research publications and high-quality research proposals.

**Scholarship and Research Benefits**

* Monthly scholarship starting at ₹35,000 for Engineering, Computer Science, and AI programmes, with the possibility of an increase up to ₹55,000 per month, subject to programme eligibility.
* Up to ₹10 Lakhs in research infrastructure support.
* Up to ₹6 Lakhs in publication support.
* Eligible candidates may receive scholarships of up to ₹43,750 per month under the Visvesvaraya Ph.D. Scheme, Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY), Government of India.
* Funding support for international conferences and research travel.
* Opportunities for global collaborative research.
* Patent and intellectual property support.
* Startup incubation and entrepreneurship mentoring.
* Additional tuition fee waiver for eligible women scholars.

title: Senior Quant Trader
description:
