**Locations:**
India & Global Markets

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

About the Role

We are looking for an exceptional
**Senior Quantitative Trader**
with proven experience in High-Frequency Trading (HFT) and Ultra-High-Frequency Trading (UHFT) to join our expanding quantitative trading business.

The ideal candidate will have a strong track record of developing, deploying, and managing fully automated systematic trading strategies, with a focus on alpha generation, market making, and short-horizon trading across multiple asset classes and global markets.

This is an opportunity to work with advanced trading infrastructure, substantial capital allocation, and a performance-driven environment where trading expertise and profitability are highly rewarded.

Key Responsibilities

* Design, develop, implement, and manage fully automated systematic trading strategies with short holding periods and high trading turnover.
* Research and deploy alpha-generating strategies, market-making models, and other high-frequency trading strategies.
* Conduct rigorous backtesting, simulation, and performance analysis using in-house research infrastructure.
* Identify market inefficiencies and develop quantitative models to generate consistent risk-adjusted returns.
* Monitor live trading performance, optimize execution, and continuously enhance strategy profitability.
* Analyse high-frequency tick-level market data to identify trading opportunities and improve strategy performance.
* Collaborate with quantitative researchers, developers, and infrastructure teams to enhance trading systems and execution efficiency.
* Manage trading risk, capital allocation, and strategy performance while maintaining strong risk-adjusted returns.

Candidate Requirements

* Extensive experience in High-Frequency Trading (HFT) or Ultra-High-Frequency Trading (UHFT).
* Minimum 3+ years of hands-on live HFT trading experience with a demonstrable P&L track record.
* Strong understanding of alpha generation, market making, statistical arbitrage, and systematic trading strategies.
* Proven ability to generate consistent profitability with strong Sharpe ratios and controlled drawdowns.
* Strong programming skills in C or C++.
* Proficiency in Python, R, or MATLAB for statistical modelling, quantitative research, and tick-data analysis.
* Experience working with large-scale market data, backtesting frameworks, and automated execution systems.
* Strong mathematical, statistical, and analytical capabilities.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mathematics, Engineering, Computer Science, Physics, Statistics, or another highly quantitative discipline.

What We Offer :

We offer a highly competitive and performance-driven compensation structure designed to attract and retain exceptional trading talent.

* **Exceptional Compensation:**
  Industry-leading fixed compensation packages, tailored to experience and performance.
* **Performance-Based Payouts:**
  Attractive P&L-sharing arrangements with a significant percentage of strategy-generated profits.
* **Flexible P&L Participation:**
  Opportunity to negotiate performance-linked incentives based on individual contribution, strategy profitability, and capital allocation.
* **Global Opportunities:**
  Opportunities to work across India and international trading locations.
* **Capital Allocation:**
  Access to substantial trading capital for proven strategies, subject to internal risk and allocation parameters.
* **Advanced Infrastructure:**
  Access to sophisticated, low-latency trading systems, execution technology, and in-house research infrastructure.
* **Research Autonomy:**
  Freedom to research, develop, test, and deploy innovative trading strategies.
* **Collaborative Environment:**
  Work alongside experienced quantitative traders, researchers, developers, and technology professionals.
* **Career Growth:**
  Opportunity to take ownership of trading strategies and grow into senior trading leadership roles.
* **Performance Recognition:**
  Compensation and incentives directly aligned with measurable trading performance.
* **Relocation Support:**
  Relocation assistance and visa support for eligible international opportunities.
* **Additional Benefits:**
  Competitive benefits package, subject to location and employment structure.

Compensation Structure

The compensation package will be customised based on the candidate's experience, live trading track record, strategy performance, and capital requirements.

It may include:

* Competitive fixed salary.
* Performance-linked annual bonuses.
* Attractive P&L-sharing percentage.
* Strategy-specific profit participation.
* Additional incentives for consistent profitability and long-term performance.

**We are particularly interested in traders with proven live strategies, independently verifiable P&L records, strong Sharpe ratios, and the ability to scale profitable trading strategies.**

Interested Candidates

If you are an experienced HFT/UHFT trader looking to scale your strategies, access advanced trading infrastructure, and participate in an attractive performance-linked compensation structure, we would love to connect.

**Let's build the next generation of systematic trading strategies together.**

title: Risk Management CA Industrial Trainee – Credit Risk
description:
**Nomura Overview:**

Nomura is a financial services group with an integrated global network. For further information about Nomura, visit www.nomura.com
.

Nomura Services, India supports the group’s global businesses. With world-class capabilities in trading support, research, information technology, financial control, operations, risk management and legal support, the firm plays a key role in facilitating the group’s global operations across four international regions.

At Nomura, creating an inclusive workplace is a priority. Our approach to inclusion encompasses a variety of initiatives, including sensitization campaigns, implementing conducive policies & programs, providing infrastructure support and engaging in community events. Over time, we have made meaningful progress in these areas, and this commitment has been well-recognized across the industry. We are proud recipients of the prestigious Top 10 Employers award by the India Workplace Equality Index (IWEI), IWEI Gold Employer of Choice awards, India CSR Leadership Award 2024 for Holistic Village Development Program and the YUVA Unstoppable Changemaker Awards.

**Divisional Overview:**

The Global Risk Management Division in Powai has the following functions – Credit risk, Market risk, Risk and Control, Risk Infrastructure, Model Validation, Risk Methodology, Operational Risk Management and Risk HQ. The division is responsible for effectively managing the firm's risk-return profile, which ensures the efficient deployment of the firm's capital.

**Business Overview:**

Risk Management in Nomura globally, works as a partner to business. Risk management teams are present in all the regions and are organized broadly by the Risk type – Market, Credit, and Operational. The Risk Management set up in Powai (Mumbai), is a global hub for Risk Management functions. Powai also delivers several strategic initiatives.

**Department overview:**

Global Credit Risk Management (CRM) is an independent Risk oversight function, reporting directly into the Global Chief Risk Officer (CRO). Its mandate is to manage the risk of loss arising from an obligor or counterparty’s default, insolvency or administrative proceeding which results in the obligor’s failure to meet its contractual obligations in accordance with agreed terms.

To achieve this, CRM has professionals located in each of the Firm’s principal regions, employing a range of qualitative and quantitative analytical skills needed to:

1. provide independent risk management oversight.
2. continuously evaluate, monitor and rate all the Firm’s counterparties.
3. evaluate and approve credit exposures (subject to established credit authority guidelines and approval procedures)
4. provide timely and accurate credit data and analysis to the Firm’s management, Business Units and Regulators

**Team overview:**

CRM Powai is an integral part of global CRM, responsible for credit risk management of a diverse portfolio of counterparties across sectors and regions. Closely aligned with the regional teams, we are amongst the highest value-added Risk Management divisions in India. The team comprises of professional degree holders, who are driven to tackle unstructured problems independently.

Besides core CRM responsibilities of assigning credit ratings, credit limit management, suggesting credit terms for legal agreements, and portfolio monitoring, the team also participates in structured deal analysis, presents at global forums, and plays a leading role in global projects. Outside of Risk Management, the team collaborates with other Divisions such as Sales and Trading, Legal, Finance, Compliance, Treasury, On-Boarding, Operations to achieve its objective of protecting the firm against credit losses. The team is also involved in the firms’ FinTech initiative and independently works on end-to-end projects to generate in-house solutions.

**What We Offer:**

* We support employee wellbeing by ensuring a sense of purpose and belonging.
* We offer a comprehensive range of wellbeing services which allows employees to get access to the assistance they need at any point in their wellbeing journey.
* Our bespoke benefits support employees and their family’s holistic wellbeing and are inclusive of diverse identities and family structures.

**Position Specifications:**

**Qualification:**
CA – Inter Cleared AND completed/pursuing BCom degree.

**Requirement:**
Available for 12 months of Industrial Training (as per ICAI guidelines): Immediate joiner

**Role & Responsibilities:**

As a Credit Analyst, you will be given training in analysis of financial statements, macro/economic environment and business profile of entities to arrive at a credit rating. You will learn to write detailed analytical reports and use credit rating models to arrive at a credit rating, which is used to set risk appetite and in capital calculations for the bank.

You will be part of a dynamic team that not only manages credit risk for the bank, but also participates in global projects, strives to improve processes by using technology and tools available in the firm, and is well integrated with the global CRM Division.

**Role Description**

A fully trained Credit Analyst is responsible for carrying out the below responsibilities with respect to an assigned portfolio of Nomura counterparties. As a member of the team, you will:

* Carry out credit risk assessment for Corporates, Financial Institutions (Banks, Broker-Dealers, Insurers), Funds (Investment Advisors, Mutual Funds, Pension Funds) or Hedge Funds counterparties globally.
* Daily responsibilities include:

- Performing in-depth analysis and writing credit reviews to assign credit ratings for

counterparties on an annual/semi-annual basis. This would include financial statement

analysis (P&L, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow Statement), business profile analysis etc.

-Perform in-depth sector and peer reviews, highlighting key trends, growing risks and

possible risk mitigation to be undertaken by the firm

-Approving new client onboarding requests, after performing necessary due diligence

-Investigate credit limit breaches by liaising with Sales, Operations, Middle Office teams

etc. to determine the cause of the breach, and take necessary action as per Credit

Policies

-Monitor the performance of counterparties and closely track developments related to a

counterparty, industry, economy, regulations, markets etc. which could adversely impact

the credit profile of a counterparty. Where necessary, detailed notes with the

view/outlook and appropriate risk management action will have to be sent to senior

management within the Risk Division

-Participating in ad-hoc projects e.g., using data to create models/scorecards, automating

processes using data analytical.

**Mind Set:**

**Skills, experience, qualifications and knowledge required:**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills are a must.
* Good analytical and logical reasoning ability, a desire to create a career in research / analysis.
* Self-starter with the inclination to work hard and flexibly, in a rewarding environment.
* Interest and willingness to learn new skills and apply these to grow as an analyst.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint is a must.
* Knowledge of Python, Alteryx, PowerBI, or SQL is an added advantage.

*We are committed to providing equal opportunities throughout employment including in the recruitment, training and development of employees. We prohibit discrimination in the workplace whether on grounds of gender, marital or domestic partnership status, pregnancy, carer’s responsibilities, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, race, color, national or ethnic origins, religious belief, disability or age.*

*\*Applying for this role does not amount to a job offer or create an obligation on Nomura to provide a job offer. The expression "Nomura" refers to Nomura Services India Private Limited together with its affiliates.*

*\*The benefits are subject to change and will be in accordance with Company’s policies as may be applicable from time to time).*

Our global presence spans the US, Europe, and Southeast Asia, with a portfolio that employs over 3,000 individuals, manages assets exceeding £1.8 billion, and boasts total portfolio sales of over £500 million.

As a Senior / Lead Engineer, you will play a key role in designing and delivering scalable systems across core platforms. You will collaborate closely with Product, Data, and Engineering teams in Mumbai and London, helping shape technical direction while remaining hands-on.

* Conduct exploratory data analysis to uncover patterns and trends.
* Identify opportunities for process improvement and drive continuous improvement in operations.
* Stay updated on industry trends, technologies, and best practices in engineering.

**About You:**
We are seeking to onboard candidates with a track record of leading complex delivery, demonstrating technical depth and pragmatic leadership. You’re hands‑on when it matters, coach others effectively, and make clear design trade‑offs that improve customer and business outcomes. You communicate crisply, collaborate across functions, and keep teams focused on the few things that move the needle.
  
  
**The Ideal Candidate:**

* Professional experience in full-stack software engineering with evidence of architecting and delivering production systems at scale.
* Proven experience mentoring and developing engineers and raising code quality standards.
* Strong proficiency in one or more programming languages commonly used in engineering, such as Python or Java.

* Highly adaptable and comfortable working in ambiguous, problem-solving environments.
* Strong evidence of teamwork and successful cross-functional delivery; including particularly with customers, Product, Marketing, and Sales.
* Excellent communication, leadership, and collaboration skills.

Behaviours that we look for
  
  

* Rigorous problem-solving and systems thinking. Breaks down complex problems, evaluates multiple approaches, and designs scalable, maintainable architectures.
* Clean, performant, and secure code. Chooses suitable data structures, writes readable & defensive code, and bakes in performance and security from the start.
* Test-first and observable engineering. Designs for testability, automates meaningful unit/integration tests, and implements robust logging, metrics, and monitoring.
* Production and operations excellence. Understands CI/CD, infrastructure and cost drivers, engineers for reliable development, resilience, and fast recovery.

Process - We have a rigorous, but streamlined recruitment process, which respects the time of candidates and portfolio companies alike. This process starts with a 15-minute call with our Talent Acquisition team and a member of the Engineering Centre of Excellence, followed by further interviews with the Engineering Centre of Excellence team.

**About The Role**
We are seeking a highly experienced and visionary Lead AI Application Engineer to join our core AI team. This pivotal role will be instrumental in designing, developing, and deploying advanced Machine Learning, Generative AI and Agentic AI applications across high-throughput, real-time streaming environments . You are an engineer’s engineer, someone who spent years training, tuning, and deploying models at scale, and who has spearheaded Generative and Agentic AI over the last 3–4 years. **Technical Architecture & System Design**

Hands-On Execution & Prototyping
  
  

* Lead from the front: write high-leverage production code, design critical framework primitives, and rapidly de-risk zero-to-one concepts via functional PoCs.
* Bridge cutting-edge research and production engineering, ensuring systems are resilient, fault-tolerant, secure, and performant at scale.

Strategy & Cross-Functional Influence
  
  

* Partner directly with the Head of AI, Product leadership, and VP-level stakeholders to chart the AI technology roadmap and identify transformative capability unlocks.
* Lead the exploration and application of Large Language Models, Agentic AI and Generative AI, venturing into new areas within these fields.
* Represent the company’s AI thought leadership through open-source contributions, technical papers, conferences, or industry forums.

title: Lead - Digital Platforms and Consumer AI/Senior Lead - Digital Platforms and Consumer AI
description:
**Location Name:**
Pune Corporate Office - Mantri
  
  
**Job Purpose**
At Bajaj Finance, we help millions of people across India manage their money. People come to us when they want to buy a new phone on EMI, when they need a personal loan for a wedding, when they want to buy insurance, or when they want to grow their savings in a Fixed Deposit. Because we have so many customers, we get thousands of questions every single day. Customers want to know their account balance. They want to change the date their EMI gets deducted. They want to know the fees for closing a loan early.
  
  
In the past, to get these answers, a customer had to wait on hold to talk to a call center agent, or they had to tap through ten different screens on our mobile app. We want to change that. We want to make it as easy as sending a text message to a friend.
  
  
We are building a massive, highly intelligent AI (Artificial Intelligence) platform. Think of it like a super-smart chat assistant built right into the Bajaj Finance app. We want our customers to be able to just type out their problems in plain English, Hindi, or other languages, and have the AI fix the problem instantly. If a customer types, "Hey, I need to pause my loan payment this month," the AI should understand them, check their account, and do the work in seconds.
  
  
Building this is incredibly hard. It is not just a simple robot that gives canned answers. It is a smart system that has to understand human language, connect to our deep banking systems, and follow strict financial rules.
  
  
**Duties And Responsibilities**

* Conversation Flows

A normal conversation flows naturally. But computers need a map. They need to be told exactly how a conversation should go, step by step. You will create these maps, which we call Conversation Flows.
  
  
You will literally use a software tool to draw boxes and arrows on your screen.
  
  

* Box 1: The AI says, "Hello, how can I help?" -> Arrow points to Box 2.
* Box 2: The customer says, "I want to see my statement." -> Arrow points to Box 3.
* Box 3: The system checks if the customer's phone number is verified.

o If Yes -> Arrow points to Box 4.
  
  
o If No -> Arrow points to Box 5.
  
  

* Box 4: Show the statement on the screen.
* Box 5: Ask the customer to type in a one-time password (OTP).

You have to map out every single path the conversation could possibly take. You have to think of all the "what ifs." What if the customer types the wrong password? What if the customer stops replying and walks away from their phone? What if the internet crashes? You must draw a box and an arrow for every single situation. These flowcharts become the actual instruction manual for the engineers. They look at your map and write the code to make it happen exactly as you drew it.|Your Daily Work: The 9 Core Areas
  
  
**About**
Your job will be very hands-on. You will not just be sitting in long meetings talking about big ideas. You will be doing the real, detailed work to make this AI smart. Here are the nine specific areas you will be working on every day:
  
  

* FPR (Future Press Release)

Before a single line of computer code is written, you have to know what your end goal is. We do this by writing a Future Press Release, or FPR.
  
  
A press release is a news article that a company puts out when they launch a cool new product. But here, you will write this news article before we even start building. You will write it as if the product is already finished and launched to the public. You will write a catchy headline like: "Bajaj Finance Launches AI That Solves Loan Issues in 10 Seconds." You will write quotes from pretend customers talking about how much they love the feature. You will explain exactly what problem the feature solves in simple, everyday language.
  
  
Why do we do this? Because it keeps everyone focused. If the news article sounds boring or confusing, it means your idea is probably boring or confusing. Once you write a great FPR, you show it to the engineers and your bosses. When everyone reads it and says, "Wow, this sounds amazing, let's build it!"—that document becomes your team's guide.
  
  

* FAQ (Frequently Asked Questions)

Along with your news article, you will write a massive list of Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ). But these are not just the normal questions a customer might ask. These are questions that anyone involved might ask.
  
  
You have to put yourself in the shoes of a confused customer. What will they ask? "Is my bank data safe with this AI robot?" You write the answer. You have to think like our call center agents. "Will this AI do my job wrong and make the customer angry?" You write the answer. You have to think like our company lawyers. "Does this AI follow the Reserve Bank of India rules?" You write the answer.
  
  
The goal of this FAQ is to force you to find all the problems and risks before the engineers start building. If you cannot answer a tough question in your FAQ document, it means your plan has a hole in it, and you need to fix your plan.
  
  

* PPG (Product Program Guidelines)

Because Bajaj Finance deals with people's money, we have a lot of strict rules. We cannot just give a loan to anyone. We have to charge exact fees. We have to use exact interest rates. All of these strict rules are written down in company rulebooks called Product Program Guidelines, or PPG.
  
  
Every single product has a PPG. The personal loan has a PPG. The fixed deposit has a PPG. When we build the AI, the AI must follow the rules in the PPG perfectly. It cannot make a mistake. If the PPG says the late fee is 500 rupees, the AI cannot accidentally tell the customer the late fee is 400 rupees. That would cause a massive legal problem.|As a Product Manager, you will read these PPG rulebooks. You will pull out all the rules related to your project. You will work with the engineers to make sure these rules are permanently locked into the AI's brain. If the company changes a rule in the PPG next year, you are the person who makes sure the AI gets updated immediately.
  
  

* Synthetic Testing

Once the engineers build a version of the AI, we have to test it. But we cannot let a broken, untested AI talk to real Bajaj Finance customers. That is too risky. If the AI is confused, a real customer might get bad advice about their loan.
  
  
So, we use something called Synthetic Testing. "Synthetic" just means fake or made-up. You will help create thousands of fake conversations to test the AI safely. You will create fake customer profiles. For example, you make a fake customer named Rahul who has a home loan. You will type to the AI pretending to be Rahul. You will ask, "Can I pay off my whole loan today?" and see what the AI says.
  
  
Does the AI say yes? Does it calculate the early payment fee correctly? What if you pretend to be a customer who types with terrible spelling? What if you type in a mix of Hindi and English? What if you pretend to be very angry? Does the AI still understand and stay polite? You will run hundreds of these fake tests. When the AI fails, you write down why it failed, take that information back to the engineers, and tell them what to fix. You keep doing this until the AI passes every fake test perfectly.
  
  

* LLM Parameters (What We Send to the AI Brain)

The core brain of our AI is called a Large Language Model (LLM). Think of the LLM like an incredibly smart person sitting in a dark room. This person knows how to speak perfectly, but they have no idea who they are talking to.
  
  
If a customer types, "What is my balance?", the smart person in the dark room has no idea whose balance to check. So, we have to send the LLM a package of extra information along with the customer's question. We call this setting the LLM Parameters.
  
  
As the Product Manager, you will decide exactly what information goes into that package. When the customer asks about their balance, you will tell our computer systems: "Before you let the AI answer, grab the customer's name, grab their last three payments, and grab their current loan amount. Send all of that to the AI."
  
  
You also have to send strict instructions. You will tell the AI, "You are a helpful assistant for Bajaj Finance. Always be polite. Do not guess numbers. Only use the numbers I just sent you." If you send the AI too much information, it gets confused and it costs the company too much money to process. If you send too little information, the AI gives a stupid answer. Your job is to find the perfect balance of what data to send the AI every time a customer speaks.
  
  

* Visualisations

Chatting with an AI should not just be reading massive blocks of text. Nobody wants to read a giant paragraph of words on their small phone screen.|Sometimes, the best way to answer a customer is by showing them a picture, a chart, or a button. We call these Visualisations.
  
  
Let's say a customer asks, "How much of my loan have I paid off?" The AI could write a long, boring sentence with a bunch of numbers. But it is much better if the AI shows a nice, clean pie chart on the screen. Half the pie is green for the money paid, and half is grey for the money left. The customer understands it instantly.
  
  
Or, if the AI needs the customer to pick a date, it shouldn't make the customer type "October 15th." It should pop up a small calendar on the screen so the customer can just tap the day. You will decide when to use text and when to use these visual tools. You will work with our designers to sketch out how these charts and buttons should look so the chat is beautiful and easy to use.
  
  

* Product Switching

Imagine you are talking to a human salesman at a store. You ask about buying a TV. Then, suddenly, you change your mind and ask about buying a fridge. The human easily switches the topic to the fridge.Computers are not naturally good at this. If the computer is programmed to talk to you about a TV, and you ask about a fridge, the computer will get totally confused. It might say, "Error, I do not understand."
  
  
At Bajaj Finance, we have dozens of products. A customer might start a chat asking about their EMI shopping card. But halfway through the chat, they might say, "By the way, I also want to open a Fixed Deposit." The AI needs to smoothly switch from talking about the shopping card to talking about the Fixed Deposit without breaking or crashing.
  
  
We call this Product Switching. You will write the rules for how the AI handles these sudden changes in conversation. You will plan out how the AI remembers what the customer was talking about first, just in case the customer wants to go back to the original topic later.
  
  
**Required Qualifications And Experience**
The Background You Need (Education & Experience)
  
  
**Requirements**
Because this job requires you to build highly complex computer systems, we are very strict about the background you need to have. We are looking for people who meet these exact requirements:
  
  

* Your Education (The Degree and the College)

You must have a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a closely related technical computer field.
  
  
You must have graduated from a Tier 1 Engineering College. This means premier institutes like the IITs (Indian Institutes of Technology), NITs (National Institutes of Technology), or top-level Regional Engineering Colleges.
  
  
It is because the AI technology we are building is extremely complicated. You will be working side-by-side with some of the smartest software engineers in the country. You need to know how software is actually built. You need to understand coding logic, databases, and how computer servers talk to each other. Top engineering colleges train you to handle these tough, highly technical problems. If you do not have this strong computer science foundation, you will not be able to keep up with the engineering teams.
  
  
If you also have a Master's degree, that is great! We love to see it. But if you do not have a Master's degree, that is perfectly fine. It is not required. The Bachelor's degree from a Tier 1 college is what matters the most.
  
  

* Your Work Experience (2 to 3 Years in NLP/AI)

You cannot be fresh out of college for this job. You must have at least 2 to 3 years of actual, hands-on work experience.
  
  
More importantly, this experience must be in a very specific area. You must have worked on NLP platforms. It is the specific technology that teaches computers how to read, understand, and write human language.
  
  
You must have spent the last few years of your career actually building chatbots, voice assistants, or smart AI text tools. You cannot just be someone who managed a normal website or a standard mobile app.

title: BC Sector O And G-Cognite-Senior Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Cognite Solution Architect – Senior Manager**
**Experience Level - 15+**
**Job Description**
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. We’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better. Join us and help build a better working world.
  
  
We are seeking a hands-on Cognite Solution Architect to design industrial data solutions for upstream and downstream Oil & Gas operations. You will define how operational, enterprise and engineering information is integrated, modelled and contextualized in Cognite Data Fusion (CDF), and how applications and analytical solutions consume that information. You will own solution architecture decisions, establish reusable implementation patterns and resolve complex technical issues across source systems, data models, access controls and consuming applications.
  
  
**Role Details**
**Key responsibilities include:**
**Architecture and integration**

* Translate operational use cases into data requirements, integration designs and application-consumption patterns.
* Define how CDF fits within historian, enterprise application, engineering information and cloud architectures.
* Select source-appropriate extractors, APIs and processing patterns, considering latency, throughput, connectivity and source-system load.
* Define historical loading, incremental extraction, reconciliation and recovery approaches, including late records, corrections and supported deletions.
* Establish requirements for service identities, access capabilities, environment separation, monitoring and operational support.

**Industrial information modelling**

* Design CDF models using spaces, containers, views and instances; select direct relations or edges according to relationship semantics and query requirements.
* Reuse and extend Cognite’s Core Data Model where suitable, introducing custom domain concepts where required.
* Define stable identifiers, source crosswalks and conflict-resolution rules, including repeated tag names across sites and systems.
* Represent physical equipment, functional locations and installation history separately where required.
* Establish schema versioning, migration and consumer-compatibility requirements while preserving lineage, timestamps, units, quality indicators and relationship provenance.

**Contextualization and Oil & Gas semantics**

* Design relationships connecting equipment and assets with time series, maintenance records, documents and engineering diagrams.
* Define matching rules, confidence thresholds, exception handling and domain review for ambiguous associations; assess coverage and match accuracy separately.
* For upstream applications, model fields, wells, wellbores, production facilities, equipment, well tests and interventions, preserving distinctions between measured, calculated and allocated production.
* For downstream applications, model sites, process units, functional locations, equipment, laboratory results and maintenance activities, accounting for replacement, revisions and measurement timing.
* Validate that contextualized information supports the intended engineering workflow.
* Application enablement and technical assurance
* Define consumer data contracts covering entities, relationships, fields, freshness, permissions and query-performance expectations.
* Validate designs against representative Cognite applications, custom applications, and analytical or AI workflows.
* Develop critical prototypes and reference implementations using Python, SQL, Cognite SDKs and APIs.
* Establish deployment and environment-promotion practices using version control, automated validation and Cognite Toolkit.
* Review architecture changes, migration plans, integration code and performance bottlenecks; resolve cross-system design conflicts and mentor data engineering leads.

**Must Have Qualifications & Experience**

* A relevant engineering, computer science or information systems degree, or equivalent technical experience.
* Demonstrated personal architectural contribution to a production Cognite Data Fusion implementation.
* Strong knowledge of CDF data modelling, transformations, contextualization and access controls.
* Substantial industrial data integration experience spanning representative operational, enterprise and engineering sources.
* Strong Python and SQL skills with practical Cognite SDK and REST API experience.
* Experience defining identity strategies, model evolution, deployment patterns and production support requirements.
* Working knowledge of cloud architecture, identity providers, network boundaries and CI/CD.
* Strong Oil & Gas implementation experience in at least one upstream or downstream domain, with ability to adapt relevant concepts to the other.

**Good to Have**

* Cognite implementation experience across multiple assets or sites.
* Experience spanning both upstream and downstream.
* Familiarity with historians, maintenance systems, laboratory systems, engineering repositories or well-data services.
* Experience with diagram contextualization, 3D associations and industrial knowledge graphs.
* Experience enabling Cognite applications or AI workflows using contextualized data.
* Relevant Cognite Academy training or certifications.

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to solve high-impact industrial data and analytics challenges across upstream and downstream Oil & Gas.
* A hands-on leadership role with scope to establish reusable practices and guide multidisciplinary teams.
* A collaborative environment spanning domain engineering, data, technology, product and global EY teams.
* Access to EY’s global network, technology ecosystem and learning opportunities while contributing to a better working world.

**What We Look For**
A hands-on architect who can defend consequential production Cognite decisions involving identity resolution, data-model design, access boundaries, recovery, schema migration and application compatibility, and demonstrate which patterns can be reused across sites and which require adaptation.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

description:

---------------

Avaya is an enterprise software leader that helps the world’s largest organizations and government agencies forge unbreakable connections.

The Avaya Infinity™ platform unifies fragmented customer experiences, connecting the channels, insights, technologies, and workflows that together create enduring customer and employee relationships.

We believe success is built through strong connections – with each other, with our work, and with our mission. At Avaya, you'll find a community that values your contributions and supports your growth every step of the way.

Learn more at https://www.avaya.com

**Job Information**
-------------------

Job Code: 00194005

Job Family: Research and Development

Job Function: Software Engineering

**About The Role**
------------------

We are seeking a highly experienced and visionary Lead AI Application Engineer to join our core AI team. This pivotal role will be instrumental in designing, developing, and deploying advanced Machine Learning, Generative AI and Agentic AI applications across high-throughput, real-time streaming environments . You are an engineer’s engineer, someone who spent years training, tuning, and deploying models at scale, and who has spearheaded Generative and Agentic AI over the last 3–4 years. This is an exceptional opportunity for an individual who thrives on building sophisticated, production-grade Autonomous AI systems and wants to make a significant impact.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Technical Architecture & System Design**

  

* Architect and operationalize end-to-end autonomous agentic systems (multi-agent orchestration, dynamic tool-calling, reflection, planner-executor loops, and persistent state management).
* Design robust LLM runtime infrastructure, including hybrid retrieval architectures (Advanced RAG, graph-based context grounding, vector databases, re-rankers, semantic routing).
* Establish scalable evaluation, guardrail, and observability frameworks (latency optimization, cost governors, hallucinations/drift detection, alignment checks, red-teaming).
* Make high-stakes architectural decisions regarding model topologies (proprietary frontier models vs. distilled/fine-tuned SLMs, LoRA, quantization, self-hosted vs. managed endpoints).

#### **Hands-On Execution & Prototyping**

  

* Lead from the front: write high-leverage production code, design critical framework primitives, and rapidly de-risk zero-to-one concepts via functional PoCs.
* Bridge cutting-edge research and production engineering, ensuring systems are resilient, fault-tolerant, secure, and performant at scale.

#### **Strategy & Cross-Functional Influence**

  

* Partner directly with the Head of AI, Product leadership, and VP-level stakeholders to chart the AI technology roadmap and identify transformative capability unlocks.
* Lead the exploration and application of Large Language Models, Agentic AI and Generative AI, venturing into new areas within these fields.
* Represent the company’s AI thought leadership through open-source contributions, technical papers, conferences, or industry forums.
  

#### **Other Responsibilities**

  

* Architect, Design and Build robust, scalable, and efficient AI systems leveraging a variety of AI/ML, data science, deep learning, and agentic AI frameworks.
* Drive the integration of complex Model Context Protocol (MCP) and agent-to-agent (A2A) communication protocols, ensuring seamless interaction and optimal performance.
* Design and implement scalable and efficient AI/ML systems, architectures, and pipelines that can handle large volumes of data and deliver accurate and timely results.
* Regularly self-educate while mentoring and provide technical leadership to other engineers, fostering a culture of continuous learning and excellence.

**Who we are looking for -**
----------------------------

* **Experience**: 15+ years of hands-on software development experience, including 5+ years actively building and deploying Generative AI and Agentic AI applications in production.
* **Core Engineering & AI Building:** Hands-on builder capable of independently architecting, coding, and deploying custom AI tools, autonomous agents, and bots from scratch.
* **Programming Mastery:** 8+ years writing production-grade code in Python or similar languages with deep expertise in scalable software design, APIs, and microservices.
* **Agentic Frameworks & Tools:** Deep proficiency with frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, Auto-GPT, CrewAI, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) for multi-agent coordination.
* **LLMs & Fine-Tuning:** Practical experience with frontier models (GPT-4, Gemini, Claude), fine-tuning, prompt engineering, and custom agentic tool-calling workflows.
* **ML/DL Foundations:** Background in training, tuning, and running models using PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Scikit-learn in high-throughput environments.
* **Inference & Acceleration:** Familiarity with inference engines (vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, TGI) and cloud ML infrastructure (NVIDIA GPUs, TPUs).
* **Data & Memory Infrastructure:** Experience building low-latency vector search indices, in-memory caching layers, streaming pipelines (Kafka/Flink), and NoSQL datastores to power real-time agent context and memory.
* **Education**: Master's or Ph.D. in Computer Science, AI, ML, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent practical experience).
  

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

  

* Autonomous Execution: Proven track record as a senior IC who takes total ownership—from zero-to-one prototyping to production rollout.
* Cloud & DevOps: Exposure to AWS, Azure, or GCP environments with modern containerized deployment (Kubernetes, Docker).
* Domain & Communication: Experience in contact center/telecom/CX platforms is a plus; excellent technical communication skills required.

12+ Years of Experience

title: Trading Intelligence Analyst
description:
**Woolworths Group**
(Australia and New Zealand’s largest retailer) launched Woolworths Market Plus (WMP) in October 2023. WMP is the coming together of two businesses (BigW Market & Everyday Market).

WMP is a new platform for businesses to both sell and manage products across the Woolworths Group Marketplaces. A curated customer destination, bringing together a trusted ecosystem comprising three core banners: Everyday Market and BIG W Market. We have grown in the last year and now operate primarily across three hub locations: Manila, Melbourne & Sydney.

**Welcome to Big W**

At BIG W every day's a big day. For you, this could be the start of something big.

There are over 15,000 of us, in the biggest cities and the tiniest towns. And each of us has an important role to play to help make a real difference for families by providing real value, real solutions and real care.

The Trading Intelligence Analyst is a key contributor of competitor pricing intelligence, delivering data-driven insights that inform our pricing and promotional strategies. This role supports maintaining a competitive market position by tracking competitor activity, identifying pricing trends, and actively managing product matching data. As we evolve our capabilities, this role will champion the use of AI and automation to streamline processes, while also executing essential day-to-day data management to ensure accuracy and competitive advantage for our customers.

**What You'll Do**

* **Competitor Intelligence & Strategy:**
  Monitor competitor pricing activity to provide actionable insights that guide our pricing decisions and ensure we remain competitive.
* **Data Management & Product Matching:**
  Take ownership of maintaining our pricing database, including manual and automated product matching across product categories to ensure data accuracy.
* **Process Innovation & Automation:**
  Lead the adoption of AI, technology, and automated matching tools to drive efficiency, reduce manual effort, and improve the scalability of our pricing processes.
* **Promotional Performance Analysis:**
  Analyze past promotional performance to provide recommendations that improve the effectiveness, profitability, and strategic planning of future campaigns.
* **Insight-Driven Decision Support:**
  Perform deep-dive analysis on pricing and market data to help the buying and merchandising teams make informed, evidence-based decisions.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:**
  Partner with internal teams—including Store Operations and Replenishment—to optimize the execution of promotional plans and ensure reliable stock flow and pricing alignment.
* **Continuous Improvement:**
  Proactively identify opportunities to improve existing systems and workflows, maintaining a "roll up your sleeves" mindset while balancing long-term strategic enhancements.

**What You'll Bring**

* 2–5 years of experience in retail analytics, commercial pricing, business analytics, or a similar data-centric role.
* Demonstrated track record of managing large, complex datasets and translating them into clear, actionable recommendations that influence commercial outcomes.
* Experience in identifying inefficiencies and implementing improvements, with a specific interest in leveraging AI or automation tools to streamline workflows.
* Strong hands-on experience with data manipulation and visualization tools (e.g., SQL, Excel, Power BI/Tableau)
* Customer-Centric: high level of curiosity regarding customer needs and behaviors, ensuring that pricing strategies always put the customer first.
* Collaborating openly with stakeholders to ensure pricing outcomes are accurate and effectively executed.
* Handle manual, time-consuming tasks with accuracy, while simultaneously thinking ahead to build more efficient, automated solutions.
* Innovative Mindset: challenge the status quo, and are proactive in identifying issues and proposing smarter, technology-led solutions

**What you’ll experience**

* Be a part of Australia’s largest retailer
* Constant mentoring and training provided
* Generous sick and vacation leave
* A flexible approach to work
* Premium health insurance coverage

**Everyone belongs at Woolworths Group**

Diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging are key to realising our purpose of better together for a better tomorrow. We recognise the value our team’s diversity brings to our business, customers, and communities and that teams with diverse experiences and backgrounds enrich our group and are better able to innovate and solve problems. As one of the largest employers in Australia and New Zealand, we aim to create a truly inclusive workplace where everyone feels that they belong, can be their best selves, and reach their full potential.

We encourage all candidates to apply; please let us know in your application if we can support you with any adjustments in the hiring process.

**What You'll Be Doing**

* Leading project teams that deliver bespoke algorithms and high-stakes AI solutions to clients across the sector.
* Conceiving the core data science approach and designing the associated robust software architecture for new engagements.
* Mentoring a small number of data scientists and supporting the professional growth of technical team members on projects.
* Partnering with commercial teams to build client relationships and shape project scope for technical feasibility.
* Contributing to Faculty’s thought leadership and reputation through delivering courses, public speaking, or open-source projects.
* Ensuring best practices are followed throughout the project lifecycle to guarantee high-quality, impactful delivery.

**Who We're Looking For**

* You possess senior experience in a professional data science position or a quantitative academic field.
* You demonstrate strong programming skills, with the ability to be a fluent Python programmer, using core libraries (NumPy, Pandas) and a deep-learning framework (e.g., PyTorch).
* You have a deep expertise in core data science paradigms (supervised/unsupervised, NLP, validation), demonstrating a proficiency across the standard data science toolkit, including the ability to develop new, innovative algorithms.
* You bring a leadership mindset, focused on growing the technical capabilities of the team and nurturing a collaborative culture.
* You exhibit commercial awareness, with experience in client-facing work and the ability to translate business problems into a rigorous mathematical framework.
* You are skilled in project planning, assessing technical feasibility, estimating delivery timelines, and leading a team to deliver high-quality work on a strict schedule.

**Interview Process**
Talent Team Screen (30 minutes)
  
  
Take Home Technical Assessment
  
  
Technical Interview (90 minutes)
  
  
Commercial Interview (60 minutes)
  
  
**Our Recruitment Ethos**
We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.
  
  
If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.
  
  
A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.

title: Full-Time PHD Scholar
description:
**Company Description:**

Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham is a multi-campus, multi-disciplinary research institution and an Institution of Eminence, recognised as one of India's leading research universities. Accredited with NAAC A++, Amrita is ranked 8th among universities in India in the NIRF India Rankings 2025 and 1st in India in the THE Impact Rankings 2025.

With eight campuses across Amaravati, Amritapuri, Bengaluru, Chennai, Coimbatore, Kochi, Mysuru, and Nagercoil, Amrita provides a vibrant academic environment that fosters advanced research, innovation, and interdisciplinary collaboration.

The university actively collaborates with leading international institutions, including Ivy League universities in the United States and prominent European universities, through joint research initiatives, academic partnerships, and international exchange programmes. Amrita offers scholars opportunities to work on impactful research, access advanced research infrastructure, pursue international collaborations, and contribute to technological and scientific advancements.

**Role Description:**

Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham invites applications from highly motivated candidates for Full-Time Ph.D. Scholar positions in Engineering, Computer Science, and Artificial Intelligence (AI) across its eight campuses.

This is a full-time, on-site research position involving original research under the guidance of experienced faculty members and research supervisors. Selected scholars will be responsible for identifying research problems, conducting comprehensive literature reviews, developing research proposals, designing and executing experiments or computational studies, analysing findings, and publishing research outcomes in reputed peer-reviewed journals and conferences.

The role involves actively participating in research projects, interdisciplinary collaborations, academic discussions, seminars, and conferences. Scholars may also contribute to teaching, mentoring, project documentation, grant applications, and other academic activities as required by their respective departments.

**Research opportunities are available in the following areas:**

- Advanced Automation and Robotics

- Aerospace Engineering

- Artificial Intelligence and Data Science

- Chemical Engineering

- Civil Engineering

- Computer Science and Engineering

- Computer Science and Information Technology

- Cyber Security

- Electrical and Electronics Engineering

- Electronics and Communication Engineering

- Materials Science and Engineering

- Mechanical Engineering

- Wireless Networks and Applications

Selected candidates will benefit from a strong research ecosystem, faculty mentorship, international research collaborations, and institutional support for research infrastructure, publications, conferences, and innovation.

**Qualifications**

* A Master's degree in a relevant discipline with a minimum of 60% marks from a recognised institution, OR
* A four-year/eight-semester Bachelor's degree with Research and a minimum CGPA of 7.5/10.
* Strong academic background and research aptitude, with the ability to identify research problems, conduct literature reviews, and critically evaluate academic literature.
* Good academic writing, documentation, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in multidisciplinary research environments.
* Proficiency in relevant research methodologies, computational tools, laboratory techniques, or analytical software, depending on the chosen research area.
* Effective communication and presentation skills for academic discussions, seminars, and research publications.
* A strong interest in pursuing advanced research and contributing to publications, innovation, and technological development.

**Entrance Test Exemption:**
Candidates with valid UGC-NET, CSIR-NET, or GATE scores are exempted from the written entrance test for Engineering, Computer Science, and AI programmes.

**For Non-NET Candidates:**
Candidates must qualify in the university entrance test with a minimum of 50% marks.

**Selection Process:**
Final selection is based on the Entrance Test (70%) and Interview/Viva-voce (30%). Preference will be given to candidates with verified research publications and high-quality research proposals.

**Scholarship and Research Benefits**

* Monthly scholarship starting at ₹35,000 for Engineering, Computer Science, and AI programmes, with the possibility of an increase up to ₹55,000 per month, subject to programme eligibility.
* Up to ₹10 Lakhs in research infrastructure support.
* Up to ₹6 Lakhs in publication support.
* Eligible candidates may receive scholarships of up to ₹43,750 per month under the Visvesvaraya Ph.D. Scheme, Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY), Government of India.
* Funding support for international conferences and research travel.
* Opportunities for global collaborative research.
* Patent and intellectual property support.
* Startup incubation and entrepreneurship mentoring.
* Additional tuition fee waiver for eligible women scholars.

**Application Details:**

Highly motivated candidates with a strong passion for research are encouraged to apply online.

https://aoap.amrita.edu/phd-26/index/

15 November 2026

phd@amrita.edu

title: Applications Engineer - UCD
description:
**Job Description:**

We are seeking an experienced and customer-focused Applications Engineer to support the design-in and adoption of our UCD family of digital power controllers. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in digital power control topologies, embedded firmware, and system-level debug, with the ability to translate customer requirements into working solutions. This role requires close collaboration with design, marketing, and field sales teams to enable customers building mission critical data centres, AI servers, and a wide array of Industrial applications.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Customer design support: Provide technical guidance to customers on the design, configuration, and firmware development of systems using TI ASM UCD devices such as the UCD3138/UCD4138, across applications like Power Factor Correction (PFC), DC/DC converters, and other digital power topologies.
* Reference design development: Design, build, and validate reference designs, evaluation modules (EVMs), and demo boards that showcase UCD capabilities and accelerate customer adoption.
* Firmware and GUI tools: Develop and customize firmware, configuration tools, and GUIs (e.g., Fusion Digital Power) to simplify customer evaluation, tuning, and deployment of UCD-based designs.
* System bring-up and debug: Support customers with board bring-up, system integration, and troubleshooting of hardware, firmware, and communication interfaces (e.g., PMBus, I2C, SPI).
* Lab characterization: Use lab equipment such as oscilloscopes, power analyzers, and logic analyzers to characterize system performance, validate control loop stability, and resolve customer-reported issues.
* Pre- and post-sales support: Respond to customer technical queries via E2E forums, service requests, and direct engagement, including both pre-sales design consultation and post-sales production support.
* Cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with design, test, marketing, and field sales teams to relay customer feedback, influence roadmap decisions, and support new product introductions (NPI).
* Documentation and collateral: Create and maintain technical reference manuals, datasheets, application notes, user guides, FAQs, and training materials to support customer self-sufficiency and broaden product adoption.
* Continuous Improvement: Participate in design reviews and contribute to improving applications engineering tools, processes, and support methodologies.

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Required Skills and Qualifications:**

* 3+ years of industry experience in applications engineering, systems engineering, or embedded firmware development.
* Bachelor's or master's degree in Electronics/Electrical/Computer Engineering, or a related field.
* Strong proficiency in embedded C/C++, with the ability to read, debug, and modify firmware for digital power controllers.
* Experience with industry-standard communication protocols like PMBus, I2C, and SPI.
* Experience with TI's Code Composer Studio (CCS), IAR, Keil and other relevant development and debug tools.
* Familiarity with scripting languages like Python, JavaScript and ability to automate characterization, test, and support workflows.
* Strong customer-facing communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to customers of varying expertise.
* Direct, hands-on experience with TI's UCD digital power controller family or Fusion Digital Power GUI will be an added advantage.
* Deep understanding of digital power control theory and common topologies (PFC, buck, boost, LLC, etc.).
* Basic understanding of signal processing and experience using model-based development tools like MATLAB and Simulink will be a definite plus.
* Ability to read and interpret schematics and datasheets, with experience in hardware-software interaction and board-level debugging.
* Proficiency in using standard lab equipment and debugging tools.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, excellent communication abilities, and a collaborative, customer-centric mindset.

**About Us**

**Why TI?**

* Surround yourself with a team of innovators who value your unique perspective and will challenge you to bring your best self to work every day. We believe that fostering a culture of collaboration fuels both personal growth and technological breakthroughs. Explore our company culture.
* At TI, your success goes beyond your work. Take advantage of comprehensive benefits designed to support your total well-being at work and in life, from competitive compensation to extensive health coverage and wellness programs. Learn more about our benefits offerings.

Texas Instruments Incorporated (Nasdaq: TXN) is a global semiconductor company that designs, manufactures and sells analog and embedded processing chips for markets such as industrial, automotive, data center, personal electronics and communications equipment. At our core, we have a passion to create a better world by making electronics more affordable through semiconductors. This passion is alive today as each generation of innovation builds upon the last to make our technology more reliable, more affordable and lower power, making it possible for semiconductors to go into electronics everywhere. Make a greater impact through our digitally enabled enterprise. Use your skills in data and technology to transform and optimise our operations, helping us deliver meaningful work that changes lives.

If you're a self-aware self-starter who craves autonomy, AstraZeneca provides the perfect environment to take ownership and grow. Here, you'll feel empowered to lead and reach excellence at every level — with unrivalled support when you need it.

Adapting and advancing our progress means constantly challenging the status quo. In this dynamic environment where everything we do has urgency and focus, you'll have the ability to show up, speak up and confidently take smart risks.

### **Proactive collaborators**

Your unique perspectives make our ambitions and capabilities possible. Our culture of sharing ideas, learning and improving together helps us consistently set the bar higher. As a proactive collaborator, you'll seek out ways to bring people together to achieve their best.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

**Job ID** R-263574 **Date posted** 11/09/2026

**Job Title: Lead Engineer - CMBD, Discovery & Integration**
------------------------------------------------------------

**GCL: E**
----------

**Introduction to role:**
-------------------------

Are you ready to own and elevate the ServiceNow CMDB that underpins operational resilience, security, and speed at a global scale? This is a rare opportunity to lead the technical spine of our digital enterprise—Discovery, Service Mapping, CSDM and integrations—so our teams can deliver life-changing medicines with confidence and pace.

In this role, you will set the standards, solve complex data and modeling challenges, and guide engineering teams to deliver a trusted, consolidated source of configuration truth. You will work across platform, cloud, security, infrastructure and application groups to ensure configuration data is accurate, transparent and actionable. Can you picture yourself diagnosing critical issues in minutes, enabling faster incident response, seamless change, and stronger risk decisions for thousands of colleagues worldwide?

**Accountabilities:**
---------------------

* Act as the technical authority for CI classes, attributes, and relationships. Optimize IRE rules and reconciliation precedence. Maintain a single, reconciled source of truth. Use CMDB Health, the 360-degree CMDB view, and the Data Manager tool to improve data quality continuously.
* Discovery and Service Mapping Skills: Build, provide, and resolve issues in asset identification and the visualization of services for both on-premises and cloud environments, adjusting schedules, MID Servers, credentials, ranges, and patterns to improve coverage, precision, and dependability of application-to-infrastructure connections.
* CSDM Modelling and Implementation: Define and socialize modeling patterns across Business Applications, Application and Business Services, Technical Services and Service Offerings; remediate legacy models and embed consistent, standards-based onboarding.
* CMDB Integrations and Data Controls: Engineer robust Service Graph and IntegrationHub ETL integrations for cloud, endpoint, security and network sources; normalize and reconcile data across APIs, transforms and IRE with clear monitoring, exception handling and data-quality controls.
* Standards, Reviews and Guidance: Set technical standards, challenge unnecessary customization, review solution designs and provide hands-on guidance to implementation teams to ensure scalable, maintainable outcomes.
* Influence Across Multiple Functions: Partner with platform, cyber, cloud, infrastructure, network, architecture and application collaborators to align builds, resolve issues at speed and increase business value from configuration data.
* Continuous Improvement and Automation: Use scripting, Flow Designer and ATF to automate quality checks, lifecycle controls and regression testing; drive an experimentation approach to simplify, standardize and scale.

**Essential Skills/Experience:**
--------------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or equivalent experience.
* 8–12+ years of technology experience, including 5+ years of hands-on ServiceNow CMDB / ITOM delivery and 2+ years in a technical lead capacity.
* Experience delivering at least two major enterprise CMDB implementations or transformations, with strong hands-on experience in automated resource identification and service topology documentation.
* Practical enterprise CSDM implementation experience, with expertise in CI class models, IRE, identification and reconciliation, and ITIL 4 configuration management practices.
* Significant hands-on experience configuring and administering CMDB, Discovery, MID Servers, patterns, Service Graph Connectors and CMDB Health, with working-to-advanced knowledge of CMDB 360 and Data Manager.
* Demonstrated ability to integrate multiple authoritative data sources through IntegrationHub ETL, REST/SOAP APIs and transform maps, including AWS and/or Azure environments.
* Proficiency in ServiceNow scripting and automation, encompassing JavaScript, developing with Flow Designer features and Business Rules, plus platform governance with update sets, Automated Test Framework (ATF) and release management.
* Experience leading technical delivery, mentoring engineers and handling third-party or outsourced service provider resources.
* Strong analytical and root-cause skills in fixing issues within large enterprise environments, with the ability to explain technical issues clearly to technical and non-technical collaborators.

**Desirable Skills/Experience:**
--------------------------------

* Relevant ServiceNow certifications in system administration, CMDB, Discovery or Service Mapping; ITIL 4 Foundation or above.
* Experience in the biopharmaceutical or life sciences industry, or another regulated environment, including GxP.
* Experience with ServiceNow Predictive Intelligence.
* Experience with security exposure and vulnerability management tooling.
* Experience working across cultures and time zones, including a Global Technology Centre operating model.
* Experience with software development lifecycle (SDLC), Agile and Scrum methodologies.

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.

**Why AstraZeneca:**
--------------------

You will join a technology community that is scaling a bold digital and data-led strategy to transform how science moves from lab to patient. We bring diverse technologists and scientists together to spark new ideas, experiment through hackathons and real-world pilots, and ship solutions that simplify data, automate operations and unlock speed at enterprise scale.
