title: Sr BI Platform Administrator
description:
**Company Description**

**CREATIVITY IS OUR SUPERPOWER**. It’s our heritage and it’s also our future. Because we don’t just make toys. We create innovative products and experiences that inspire, entertain and develop children through play. Mattel is at its best when every member of our team feels respected, included, and heard—when everyone can show up as themselves and do their best work every day. We value and share an infinite range of ideas and voices that evolve and broaden our perspectives with a reach that extends into all our brands, partners, and suppliers.

**The Team**

As part of the Global Technology Organization, the aim of Enterprise Data and Analytics (ED&A) team is to enable Mattel as a data-driven organization, by:

* Delivering high-quality data for self-service analytics and data science through a modern data platform aligned with business strategy.
* Ensuring trusted, governed, and well-managed enterprise data.
* Maximizing the availability and value of enterprise information assets.
* Providing scalable analytics platforms, semantic models, and tools that empower business users.
* Promoting enterprise-wide adoption of analytics through education, governance, and continuous improvement.

  
**Job Description**

Mattel is seeking a **Senior BI Platform Administrator**, based in our Technology & Innovation Center in Hyderabad, India, reporting to the IT Director, Enterprise Data & Analytics.

This role is responsible for the administration, governance, security, performance, availability, and continuous improvement of Mattel's enterprise Business Intelligence platforms, including **ThoughtSpot Cloud, Tableau Cloud/Server, and IBM Cognos Analytics on Cloud**. The Senior BI Platform Administrator partners closely with Business Intelligence Developers, Data Engineers, Cloud Engineers, Information Security, Enterprise Architecture, and business stakeholders to ensure that Mattel's reporting platforms remain highly available, secure, scalable, and optimized for thousands of global users.

The successful candidate is a proactive technical leader who continually identifies opportunities to simplify administration, automate repetitive activities, improve platform reliability, and enhance the overall user experience. In addition to platform administration responsibilities, this individual possesses strong data analysis and reporting skills and is expected to contribute to report development, dashboard enhancements, and analytics initiatives as business priorities allow.

This is a critical role in enabling Mattel's enterprise reporting strategy while supporting the organization's ongoing analytics modernization initiatives.

**What Your Impact Will Be:**

**BI Platform Administration**

* Administer and support Mattel's enterprise BI platforms, including ThoughtSpot Cloud, Tableau Cloud/Server, and IBM Cognos Analytics on Cloud.
* Ensure high platform availability, reliability, scalability, and performance.
* Perform platform configuration, upgrades, patch validation, and release management activities.
* Monitor platform health, capacity, utilization, and performance trends.
* Troubleshoot complex platform issues and coordinate resolution with software vendors.
* Develop and maintain platform administration standards, operational procedures, and documentation.
* Manage production, development, test, and disaster recovery environments.

**Security & Governance**

* Administer user authentication, authorization, groups, roles, and permissions across all BI platforms.
* Partner with Identity Management and Information Security teams to implement secure authentication methods including SSO and MFA.
* Ensure compliance with enterprise security standards and audit requirements.
* Implement governance standards for content lifecycle management, naming conventions, certifications, and platform organization.
* Maintain platform metadata, user access reviews, and administrative audit reporting.

**Operational Excellence & Automation**

* Identify manual administrative activities that can be automated or streamlined.
* Develop scripts, utilities, and operational processes that improve administrator productivity and platform reliability.
* Establish proactive monitoring, alerting, and health dashboards.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives that reduce operational effort while improving service quality.
* Recommend platform enhancements and new capabilities that improve business value.

**Cloud Data Platform Integration**

* Partner with Data Engineering teams supporting Google Cloud Platform.
* Understand Google BigQuery architecture, datasets, permissions, and performance characteristics.
* Assist in troubleshooting connectivity between BI platforms and Google BigQuery.
* Support implementation of secure, performant connections between reporting platforms and enterprise data sources.
* Participate in platform architecture discussions involving cloud analytics technologies.

**Platform Migration & Modernization**

* Support enterprise reporting modernization initiatives.
* Assist with migration planning, platform assessments, validation, testing, and production cutover activities.
* Support migration of IBM Cognos content to ThoughtSpot and other strategic analytics platforms.
* Identify opportunities to improve migration processes, automation, and governance.
* Assist business users during platform transition activities.

**Analytics & Report Development**

* Perform data analysis to validate business requirements and troubleshoot reporting issues.
* Assist BI Developers with dashboard, report, and worksheet development during periods of available capacity.
* Develop and optimize SQL queries for reporting solutions.
* Support testing, deployment, and production validation of reporting enhancements.
* Participate in root cause analysis for data quality and reporting issues.

**Collaboration & Customer Support**

* Serve as an escalation point for complex platform administration issues.
* Partner with business users to resolve platform-related problems and improve user experience.
* Provide technical guidance to BI Developers regarding platform capabilities and best practices.
* Deliver administrator and end-user training sessions.
* Create and maintain platform documentation, knowledge articles, and operational runbooks.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Evaluate emerging BI technologies and recommend platform improvements.
* Promote best practices for platform administration, governance, security, and operational excellence.
* Lead initiatives that improve platform stability, user satisfaction, and administrative efficiency.
* Foster a culture of automation, innovation, and continuous improvement across Enterprise Data & Analytics.

  
**Qualifications**

**What We’re Looking For:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, Business Analytics, or related field.
* **7+ years** of progressive experience administering enterprise Business Intelligence platforms.
* Advanced administration experience with **ThoughtSpot Cloud**, **Tableau**, and **IBM Cognos Analytics**.
* Strong understanding of enterprise reporting architecture and analytics platform administration.
* Experience supporting cloud-based analytics platforms and Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) applications.
* Experience working with **Google Cloud Platform (GCP)**.
* Strong knowledge of **Google BigQuery**, including datasets, security, connectivity, and query performance concepts.
* Strong SQL skills for troubleshooting, validation, and data analysis.
* Experience administering enterprise security, authentication, authorization, and role-based access control.
* Experience with SAML, Single Sign-On (SSO), LDAP, OAuth, or similar authentication technologies.
* Experience monitoring platform health, capacity planning, and performance optimization.
* Experience creating administrative documentation, operational procedures, and knowledge articles.
* Demonstrated ability to identify automation opportunities and improve operational processes.
* Experience supporting large global user communities and mission-critical reporting platforms.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and root cause analysis skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and business audiences.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining high service levels.

  
**Additional Information**

**What It’s Like to Work Here**

We are a purpose driven company aiming to empower the next generation to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential. We live up to our purpose employing the following behaviors:

* **We collaborate:** Being a part of Mattel means being part of one team with shared values and common goals. Every person counts and working closely together always brings better results. Partnership is our process and our collective capabilities is our superpower.
* **We innovate:** At Mattel we always aim to find new and better ways to create innovative products and experiences. No matter where you work in the organization, you can always make a difference and have real impact. We welcome new ideas and value new initiatives that challenge conventional thinking.
* **We execute:** We are a performance driven company. We strive for excellence and are focused on pursuing best in class outcomes. We believe in accountability and ownership and know that our people are at their best when they are empowered to create and deliver results.

**Who We Are**

Mattel is a leading global toy company and owner of one of the strongest catalogs of children’s and family entertainment franchises in the world. We create innovative products and experiences that inspire, entertain and develop children through play. We engage consumers through our portfolio of iconic brands, including Barbie, Hot Wheels, Fisher-Price, American Girl, Thomas & Friends, UNO and MEGA, as well as other popular intellectual properties that we own or license in partnership with global entertainment companies. Our offerings include film and television content, gaming, music and live events. We operate in 35 locations and our products are available in more than 150 countries in collaboration with the world’s leading retail and ecommerce companies. Since its founding in 1945, Mattel is proud to be a trusted partner in empowering children to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential.

Visit us at https://jobs.mattel.com/ and www.instagram.com/MattelCareers.

Mattel is an Equal Opportunity Employer where we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day. We welcome all job seekers including minorities, females, individuals with disabilities, and those of all sexual orientations and gender identities.

**Software Developer**  
**Experience: 4-7 Years**  
**Location: Hyderabad, India**  
  
We are seeking a Software Developer to join our Digital Technology & Innovation (DTI) team and support our mission to deliver reliable, scalable, and efficient enterprise software solutions. This role is designed for a hands-on developer with a strong background in Python, experience working with large enterprise datasets, and a passion for building automation solutions that streamline real-world business operations.

As a Software Developer, you will collaborate closely with senior engineers and managers, contributing to the design, development, and integration of software applications and automated workflows across our enterprise platforms. You will work directly with business units to discover and understand business processes, identify opportunities for automation and efficiency gains, and collaborate with stakeholders throughout the solution lifecycle. **Software Development & Automation**

* Build and maintain automated workflows that reduce manual effort, improve accuracy, and scale across the enterprise.
* Develop integrations between internal systems and third-party APIs, enabling seamless data flow and process orchestration.
* Assist in building reusable tools, libraries, and best practices for deploying automation solutions at scale.
* Where applicable, explore lightweight integrations with LLM-based services to enhance existing automation capabilities.

**Enterprise Data Engineering & Transformation**

* Partner with data engineering teams to ensure software systems have access to clean, reliable, and secure datasets.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration & Innovation**

* Support API integrations with enterprise systems such as ERP, CRM, and IT service management platforms.
* Participate in proof-of-concepts and pilot projects, exploring new applications of automation and integration technologies.
Contribute ideas to continuously improve our software development and process automation initiatives.  

**WHO YOU ARE**  
  
To perform this role successfully, the Software Developer must be able to perform each duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, education, and overall experience required for the role.

**Education, Experience & Technical Skills**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or relax`ted technical field.
* 3+ years of strong Python development experience with emphasis on performance, scalability, and maintainability.
* 3+ years of experience building automation solutions — including scripting, scheduled jobs, event-driven workflows, and process orchestration.
* Code AI agents with a deep grasp of reasoning loops, tool calling, memory, and orchestration
* Deploy and scale solutions on Microsoft Azure
* Familiarity with data engineering and data transformation practices, including handling large enterprise-scale datasets.
* Strong understanding of API integration and the ability to connect software systems with enterprise platforms.
* Experience with workflow/automation tools or frameworks.
* Familiarity with LLMs as a tool within broader software solutions is a plus.
* Nice to have: Experience with machine learning libraries (TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn) for data-driven automation.

**Collaboration & Mindset**

* Comfortable working in cross-functional teams spanning infrastructure, data engineering, and business operations.
* Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to think creatively about applying software to business problems.
* Enthusiasm for emerging technologies, continuous learning, and driving operational efficiency.
Ability to work independently but also thrive in a collaborative team environment.  

  
  
**Qualifications**  

* 3+ years of strong Python development
* Hands-on agent code using raw LLM APIs and LangChain/LangGraph
* Azure cloud experience (e.g., Azure Functions, Azure OpenAI, Data Factory)
* Solid automation, ETL, and API integration experience
* Bachelor’s in Computer Science or a related field

  
**Additional Information**

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

* Experience analyzing application logs, exceptions, error messages, and service behavior.
* Ability to trace application behavior across multiple services and develop an evidence-based probable cause.
* Ability to reproduce software defects and translate investigation findings into safe, focused code changes.

title: PostgreSQL DBA
description:
We are building a high-performance, multi-tenant B2B SaaS application designed for massive-scale bulk data processing. Our platform mirrors large catalogs of external data for thousands of tenants, requiring the system to handle millions of rows and execute complex filters. Our backend is powered by Node.js, distributed task queues, and a serverless PostgreSQL database hosted on Neon.

The Role

We are seeking a highly motivated **Junior PostgreSQL Database Engineer (with ~1 year of experience)** to help build, support, and optimize our Neon database architecture. You will work closely with our backend engineering team to bridge the gap between our Node.js environment, our ORM, and raw SQL. This is a high-growth opportunity where you will get hands-on experience dealing with extreme concurrency, multi-tenant data modeling, and serverless Postgres at scale.

Key Responsibilities

* **Query Development:** Write, test, and optimize complex SQL queries, learning to build efficient filtering logic using subqueries and specific indexing.
* **Schema Support:** Work within our multi-tenant schema structure, ensuring queries maintain strict data isolation between tenant accounts.
* **Data Ingestion:** Assist in writing and optimizing upsert logic (INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE) to handle high-volume webhooks without locking tables.
* **ORM to SQL Translation:** Help identify when generated ORM queries (Prisma) are slowing down the system and rewrite them into highly performant raw SQL for our background worker jobs.
* **Database Operations:** Use Neon’s database branching features to safely test schema migrations and support the team in monitoring connection pooling limits.

Required Qualifications

* **Database Foundations:** ~1 year of hands-on, professional experience working with PostgreSQL.
* **Core SQL Skills:** Strong grasp of relational database fundamentals, joins, constraints, and basic indexing strategies.
* **Backend Familiarity:** Experience working alongside Node.js environments and an understanding of how backend code interacts with databases via ORMs.
* **Growth Mindset:** A strong desire to learn advanced Postgres topics (like analyzing EXPLAIN plans, fillfactor tuning, and partial indexing) and serverless database architecture.
* **Problem Solving:** Ability to debug slow queries and a basic understanding of why massive tables slow down under load.

Nice-to-Haves

* Any prior exposure to serverless Postgres platforms (like Neon or Supabase).
* Familiarity with managing JSON/JSONB data within PostgreSQL.
* Basic knowledge of Redis, message brokers, or background job queues.
* Side projects or experience demonstrating an interest in database optimization.

title: Opening at HCLTech for Business Process Reengineering & Transformation
description:
Opening at HCLTech for Business Process Reengineering & Transformation

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Business Analyst supports BPR and automation engagement delivery by conducting detailed process documentation, requirements gathering, and data analysis. The role develops core analytical and consulting skills while gaining hands-on exposure to Lean Six Sigma, VSM, and intelligent automation methodologies.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

● Document current-state (As-Is) processes through interviews, process walkthroughs, observation, documentation, and data collection.

● Prepare detailed process maps, SIPOC diagrams, and workflow documentation in Visio / Lucidchart.

● Gather, clean, and analyze process performance data (cycle times, volumes, error rates, FTE utilization).

● Support VSM sessions by preparing pre-work materials, data packs, and post-session documentation.

● Prepare presentation slides, templates, and supporting materials for client workshops and deliverables.

● Support data analysis tasks using Excel: pivot tables, VLOOKUPs, charts, and summaries.

● Compile and organize performance data from client systems and structured templates.

● Develop Process Definition Documents (PDDs) and requirements specifications for automation projects.

● Assist in preparing client workshop materials, reports, dashboards, and presentation decks.

● Maintain project trackers, issue logs, RAID registers, and meeting minutes.

● Conduct benchmarking research and industry best-practice analysis to support engagement deliverables.

● Assist in business case development by compiling effort data, cost models, and benefit projections.

● Support RPA UAT by executing test scripts and logging defect reports.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

● 5-8 years of experience in business analysis, process documentation, or operations in BFSI / Healthcare.

● Lean Six Sigma Yellow Belt or Green Belt (in progress acceptable).

● Proficiency in MS Office Suite (Excel – advanced, PowerPoint, Visio).

● Basic understanding of RPA concepts, automation principles, and digital transformation.

● Strong written communication skills; ability to produce structured, client-ready documentation.

● Analytical mindset with attention to detail and comfort working with data.

Interested candidates please share resume to (suriyapriya.t@hcltech.com)

title: Lead Business Analyst
description:
**About Chubb**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
Chubb is a world leader in insurance. With operations in 54 countries and territories, Chubb provides commercial and personal property and casualty insurance, personal accident and supplemental health insurance, reinsurance and life insurance to a diverse group of clients. The company is defined by its extensive product and service offerings, broad distribution capabilities, exceptional financial strength and local operations globally. Parent company Chubb Limited is listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: CB) and is a component of the S&P 500 index. Chubb employs approximately 40,000 people worldwide. Additional information can be found at: http://www.chubb.com/
  
  
**About Chubb India**
At Chubb India, we are on an exciting journey of digital transformation driven by a commitment to engineering excellence and analytics. With a team of over 2500 talented professionals, we foster a startup mindset that promotes collaboration, diverse perspectives, and a solution driven attitude. We are dedicated to building expertise in engineering, analytics, and automation, empowering our teams to excel in a dynamic digital landscape. We offer an environment where you will be part of an organization that is dedicated to solving real-world challenges in the insurance industry. Together, we will work to shape the future through innovation and continuous learning.
  
  
**Position Details**
**Job Title:**
Lead Business Analyst
  
  
**Function/Department:**
Business Analysis
  
  
**Location:**
Hyderabad
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-time
  
  
**About The Role**
Join Chubb's APAC Claims Technology team as a Lead Business Analyst, shaping the requirements, process design and delivery of a next-generation, multi-market insurance claims platform. This is not a conventional business analysis role. You will work in an AI-augmented delivery model where AI agents help draft epics and stories, analyze requirements, generate test scenarios and keep documentation current, and you will lead how the team uses these capabilities responsibly. You act as the key link between Claims business stakeholders (Product Owners, Production Support Operations. engineering teams and set the standard for requirement quality across the region.
  
  
**Your Team**
You will be part of the APAC Claims Technology team, a regional group within Chubb Global Claims Technology. The team is responsible for technology delivery, platform engineering, and product feature adoption across the APAC region, serving Insureds, Agents, and diverse Chubb customer segments on the claims platform.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead discovery to delivery Own business analysis end to end for APAC claims initiatives: elicitation, process mapping, solution definition, UAT support and release readiness
* Bridge business and technology Partner with Product Owners, Claims Operations, and Engineering leads to turn business needs into clear, prioritized, testable backlog items
* Own story quality Set the bar for epics, user stories, acceptance criteria and bugs in Jira, well scoped enough for engineers and AI coding agents to implement independently
* Work with AI as a partner Use AI assistants such as Claude and Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools to analyze documents and regulations, draft requirements, summarize stakeholder input, generate acceptance criteria and test scenarios, and query and update Jira and Confluence. Set team standards for prompts, story templates and review checkpoints, and validate AI output against business rules, regulatory expectations and data privacy requirements before it is accepted or shared
* Deliver business value Link epics and stories to business outcomes and measurable KPIs, define success measures up front, and track benefits realisation after release with Product Owners and Claims stakeholders
* Drive analysis delivery Plan and track analysis work across sprints and program increments, keeping the backlog ready, and raising dependencies, risks and scope changes early with Product Owners and delivery leads
* Support operations Bring business context to incident and defect triage to drive swift root cause analysis and resolution

**Qualifications**

* 10+ years of business analysis experience in complex, enterprise-scale technology programs, including 3+ years leading analysts or workstreams, with relevant certifications such as CSPO or SAFe POPM
* Prior experience in insurance, claims or financial services, ideally across multiple APAC markets, with familiarity with the end-to-end claims lifecycle (FNOL, triage, adjudication, settlement, recovery), claims platforms, and the regulatory, compliance and data privacy requirements that affect claims
* Strong requirements elicitation, process modelling (BPMN or equivalent), as-is and to-be and gap analysis, user story writing and acceptance criteria definition
* Requirements documentation and traceability: business and functional requirements, use cases, non-functional requirements and traceability from requirement to test and release
* Business value and prioritisation: value-based prioritisation (for example MoSCoW or WSJF), business cases with cost-benefit and impact analysis, outcome-based success measures, and validating that delivered solutions achieve the intended value
* Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving, with the ability to resolve ambiguity and conflicting stakeholder needs
* Proven Agile delivery and product backlog management: refinement, sprint planning and UAT coordination, and building and sequencing the backlog from roadmap to sprint level with a clear definition of ready and done
* Delivery planning and coordination skills: supporting sprint and program increment planning, release readiness, and maintaining risks, issues and dependency logs in partnership with Product Owners and delivery leads
* Cross-team dependency management through close collaboration between Product Owners and Business Analysts: jointly identifying, prioritising and resolving dependencies across teams and aligning scope, priorities and delivery commitments to keep work on track
* Leadership qualities: ability to inspire, coach and develop analysts, lead by example, make sound decisions under ambiguity, take ownership and accountability, and build trust with senior stakeholders
* Advanced Jira and Confluence skills, including JQL, dashboards, workflows and reporting
* Strong stakeholder management, facilitation and negotiation skills, with the ability to influence senior business and technology leaders
* Working knowledge of APIs, integration patterns and data concepts, with data analysis skills (for example SQL, Excel or Power BI) to validate assumptions and support evidence-based decisions, and enough technical fluency to collaborate effectively with engineers and architects
* Excellent verbal and written communication, with the ability to collaborate across distributed, cross-functional teams.

**AI skills: the differentiator**
**Comfort with AI-assisted analysis and agentic tooling is a core expectation, not a bonus.**

* Hands-on, regular use of generative AI assistants (Claude or equivalent) for analysis, documentation, test design and reporting
* Strong prompt engineering instincts: precise task descriptions, the right context, and well-scoped requests that produce reliable output
* Ability to write clear, well-scoped story files that AI coding agents can implement independently
* Basic understanding of Model Context Protocol (MCP), the standard that lets AI assistants call tools such as Jira and Confluence
* Awareness of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG): how structured context, good naming and explicit documentation improve AI output
* Understanding of responsible AI, including hallucination risk, bias, data privacy, confidentiality and human-in-the-loop review
* Ability to critically evaluate AI output against business rules, policy wording and regulatory requirements before acceptance
* Experience identifying and shaping AI and automation use cases, and measuring their business value
* Experience with structured agentic development methodologies such as BMAD, where AI agents participate across the delivery lifecycle

**Why Join Us?**

* Be at the forefront of digital transformation in the insurance industry.
* Lead impactful initiatives that simplify claims processing and enhance customer satisfaction.
* Work alongside experienced professionals in a collaborative, innovation-driven environment.

**Why Chubb?**
Join Chubb to be part of a leading global insurance company!
  
  

* Our constant focus on employee experience along with a start-up-like culture empowers you to achieve impactful results.
* Industry leader: Chubb is a world leader in the insurance industry, powered by underwriting and engineering excellence
* A Great Place to work: Chubb India has been recognized as a Great Place to Work® for the years 2023-2024, 2024-2025 and 2025-2026
* Laser focus on excellence: At Chubb we pride ourselves on our culture of greatness where excellence is a mindset and a way of being. We constantly seek new and innovative ways to excel at work and deliver outstanding results
* Start-Up Culture: Embracing the spirit of a start-up, our focus on speed and agility enables us to respond swiftly to market requirements, while a culture of ownership empowers employees to drive results that matter
* Growth and success: As we continue to grow, we are steadfast in our commitment to provide our employees with the best work experience, enabling them to advance their careers in a conducive environment

**Employee Benefits**
Our company offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support our employees’ health, well-being, and professional growth. Employees enjoy flexible work options, generous paid time off, and robust health coverage, including treatment for dental and vision related requirements. We invest in the future of our employees through continuous learning opportunities and career advancement programs, while fostering a supportive and inclusive work environment. Our benefits include:
  
  

* Savings and Investment plans: We provide specialized benefits like Corporate NPS (National Pension Scheme), Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP), Long-Term Incentive Plan (LTIP), Retiral Benefits and Car Lease that help employees optimally plan their finances
* Upskilling and career growth opportunities: With a focus on continuous learning, we offer customized programs that support upskilling like Education Reimbursement Programs, Certification programs and access to global learning programs.
* Health and Welfare Benefits: We care about our employees’ well-being in and out of work and have benefits like Hybrid Work Environment, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Yearly Free Health campaigns and comprehensive Insurance benefits.
* Application Process

**Our recruitment process is designed to be transparent, and inclusive.**

* Step 1: Submit your application via the Chubb Careers Portal.
* Step 2: Engage with our recruitment team for an initial discussion.
* Step 3: Participate in Hacker Rank assessments/technical/functional interviews and assessments (if applicable).
* Step 4: Final interaction with Chubb leadership.

**Join Us**
With you Chubb is better. Whether you are solving challenges on a global stage or creating innovative solutions for local markets, your contributions will help shape the future. If you value integrity, innovation, and inclusion, and are ready to make a difference, we invite you to be part of Chubb India’s journey.
  
  
**Apply Now**

title: Sr BI Platform Administrator
description:
**Company Description**

**CREATIVITY IS OUR SUPERPOWER**. It’s our heritage and it’s also our future. Because we don’t just make toys. We create innovative products and experiences that inspire, entertain and develop children through play. Mattel is at its best when every member of our team feels respected, included, and heard—when everyone can show up as themselves and do their best work every day. We value and share an infinite range of ideas and voices that evolve and broaden our perspectives with a reach that extends into all our brands, partners, and suppliers.

**The Team**

As part of the Global Technology Organization, the aim of Enterprise Data and Analytics (ED&A) team is to enable Mattel as a data-driven organization, by:

* Delivering high-quality data for self-service analytics and data science through a modern data platform aligned with business strategy.
* Ensuring trusted, governed, and well-managed enterprise data.
* Maximizing the availability and value of enterprise information assets.
* Providing scalable analytics platforms, semantic models, and tools that empower business users.
* Promoting enterprise-wide adoption of analytics through education, governance, and continuous improvement.

  
**Job Description**

Mattel is seeking a **Senior BI Platform Administrator**, based in our Technology & Innovation Center in Hyderabad, India, reporting to the IT Director, Enterprise Data & Analytics.

This role is responsible for the administration, governance, security, performance, availability, and continuous improvement of Mattel's enterprise Business Intelligence platforms, including **ThoughtSpot Cloud, Tableau Cloud/Server, and IBM Cognos Analytics on Cloud**. The Senior BI Platform Administrator partners closely with Business Intelligence Developers, Data Engineers, Cloud Engineers, Information Security, Enterprise Architecture, and business stakeholders to ensure that Mattel's reporting platforms remain highly available, secure, scalable, and optimized for thousands of global users.

The successful candidate is a proactive technical leader who continually identifies opportunities to simplify administration, automate repetitive activities, improve platform reliability, and enhance the overall user experience. In addition to platform administration responsibilities, this individual possesses strong data analysis and reporting skills and is expected to contribute to report development, dashboard enhancements, and analytics initiatives as business priorities allow.

This is a critical role in enabling Mattel's enterprise reporting strategy while supporting the organization's ongoing analytics modernization initiatives.

**What Your Impact Will Be:**

**BI Platform Administration**

* Administer and support Mattel's enterprise BI platforms, including ThoughtSpot Cloud, Tableau Cloud/Server, and IBM Cognos Analytics on Cloud.
* Ensure high platform availability, reliability, scalability, and performance.
* Perform platform configuration, upgrades, patch validation, and release management activities.
* Monitor platform health, capacity, utilization, and performance trends.
* Troubleshoot complex platform issues and coordinate resolution with software vendors.
* Develop and maintain platform administration standards, operational procedures, and documentation.
* Manage production, development, test, and disaster recovery environments.

**Security & Governance**

* Administer user authentication, authorization, groups, roles, and permissions across all BI platforms.
* Partner with Identity Management and Information Security teams to implement secure authentication methods including SSO and MFA.
* Ensure compliance with enterprise security standards and audit requirements.
* Implement governance standards for content lifecycle management, naming conventions, certifications, and platform organization.
* Maintain platform metadata, user access reviews, and administrative audit reporting.

**Operational Excellence & Automation**

* Identify manual administrative activities that can be automated or streamlined.
* Develop scripts, utilities, and operational processes that improve administrator productivity and platform reliability.
* Establish proactive monitoring, alerting, and health dashboards.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives that reduce operational effort while improving service quality.
* Recommend platform enhancements and new capabilities that improve business value.

**Cloud Data Platform Integration**

* Partner with Data Engineering teams supporting Google Cloud Platform.
* Understand Google BigQuery architecture, datasets, permissions, and performance characteristics.
* Assist in troubleshooting connectivity between BI platforms and Google BigQuery.
* Support implementation of secure, performant connections between reporting platforms and enterprise data sources.
* Participate in platform architecture discussions involving cloud analytics technologies.

**Platform Migration & Modernization**

* Support enterprise reporting modernization initiatives.
* Assist with migration planning, platform assessments, validation, testing, and production cutover activities.
* Support migration of IBM Cognos content to ThoughtSpot and other strategic analytics platforms.
* Identify opportunities to improve migration processes, automation, and governance.
* Assist business users during platform transition activities.

**Analytics & Report Development**

* Perform data analysis to validate business requirements and troubleshoot reporting issues.
* Assist BI Developers with dashboard, report, and worksheet development during periods of available capacity.
* Develop and optimize SQL queries for reporting solutions.
* Support testing, deployment, and production validation of reporting enhancements.
* Participate in root cause analysis for data quality and reporting issues.

**Collaboration & Customer Support**

* Serve as an escalation point for complex platform administration issues.
* Partner with business users to resolve platform-related problems and improve user experience.
* Provide technical guidance to BI Developers regarding platform capabilities and best practices.
* Deliver administrator and end-user training sessions.
* Create and maintain platform documentation, knowledge articles, and operational runbooks.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Evaluate emerging BI technologies and recommend platform improvements.
* Promote best practices for platform administration, governance, security, and operational excellence.
* Lead initiatives that improve platform stability, user satisfaction, and administrative efficiency.
* Foster a culture of automation, innovation, and continuous improvement across Enterprise Data & Analytics.

  
**Qualifications**

**What We’re Looking For:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, Business Analytics, or related field.
* **7+ years** of progressive experience administering enterprise Business Intelligence platforms.
* Advanced administration experience with **ThoughtSpot Cloud**, **Tableau**, and **IBM Cognos Analytics**.
* Strong understanding of enterprise reporting architecture and analytics platform administration.
* Experience supporting cloud-based analytics platforms and Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) applications.
* Experience working with **Google Cloud Platform (GCP)**.
* Strong knowledge of **Google BigQuery**, including datasets, security, connectivity, and query performance concepts.
* Strong SQL skills for troubleshooting, validation, and data analysis.
* Experience administering enterprise security, authentication, authorization, and role-based access control.
* Experience with SAML, Single Sign-On (SSO), LDAP, OAuth, or similar authentication technologies.
* Experience monitoring platform health, capacity planning, and performance optimization.
* Experience creating administrative documentation, operational procedures, and knowledge articles.
* Demonstrated ability to identify automation opportunities and improve operational processes.
* Experience supporting large global user communities and mission-critical reporting platforms.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and root cause analysis skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and business audiences.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining high service levels.

  
**Additional Information**

**What It’s Like to Work Here**

We are a purpose driven company aiming to empower the next generation to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential. We live up to our purpose employing the following behaviors:

* **We collaborate:** Being a part of Mattel means being part of one team with shared values and common goals. Every person counts and working closely together always brings better results. Partnership is our process and our collective capabilities is our superpower.
* **We innovate:** At Mattel we always aim to find new and better ways to create innovative products and experiences. No matter where you work in the organization, you can always make a difference and have real impact. We welcome new ideas and value new initiatives that challenge conventional thinking.
* **We execute:** We are a performance driven company. We strive for excellence and are focused on pursuing best in class outcomes. We believe in accountability and ownership and know that our people are at their best when they are empowered to create and deliver results.

**Who We Are**

Mattel is a leading global toy company and owner of one of the strongest catalogs of children’s and family entertainment franchises in the world. We create innovative products and experiences that inspire, entertain and develop children through play. We engage consumers through our portfolio of iconic brands, including Barbie, Hot Wheels, Fisher-Price, American Girl, Thomas & Friends, UNO and MEGA, as well as other popular intellectual properties that we own or license in partnership with global entertainment companies. Our offerings include film and television content, gaming, music and live events. We operate in 35 locations and our products are available in more than 150 countries in collaboration with the world’s leading retail and ecommerce companies. Since its founding in 1945, Mattel is proud to be a trusted partner in empowering children to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential.

Visit us at https://jobs.mattel.com/ and www.instagram.com/MattelCareers.

Mattel is an Equal Opportunity Employer where we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day. We welcome all job seekers including minorities, females, individuals with disabilities, and those of all sexual orientations and gender identities.

title: Senior Analyst/Manager - Business operations
description:

description:

Our international reach has helped us to understand and penetrate specialist markets at a global level. In addition to this, our service is also extended to complement our client’s in-house research.

**About our client**

For more than 80 years, our client’s engineers and product specialists have partnered with customers to produce highly engineered connectivity and sensing solutions that make a connected world possible. Their focus on reliability, durability, and sustainability exemplifies their commitment to progress. The unmatched range of their product portfolio enables companies, large and small, to turn ideas into technology that can transform how the world works and lives tomorrow.

**About the role**

* Supply Planning Leader is accountable for end-to-end supply planning across an assigned product portfolio and multiple distribution centers.
* The role ensures timely, cost-effective product availability while balancing customer service, inventory health, working capital, capacity, and logistics performance. This leader converts demand into feasible supply plans, manages risks and constraints, and drives cross-functional execution and continuous improvement in a global, matrix environment.

**As a Supply Planning Leader, you will be responsible for...**

* Developing and executing supply plans aligned with customer demand, inventory targets, business priorities, capacity, material availability, supplier constraints, and transportation lead times.
* Ensuring finished-goods availability and timely replenishment across distribution centers, regional warehouses, and source plants by driving MRP recommendations and monitoring plan adherence.
* Leading weekly and monthly supply reviews and actively supporting S&OP and S&OE by providing supply status, reviewing demand outlook, recommending trade-offs, and driving approved actions.
* Optimizing safety stock, MRP policies, inventory deployment, stock coverage, turns, availability, and working capital while maintaining healthy inventory levels.
* Managing phase-in and phase-out planning for the assigned portfolio.
* Identifying demand-supply gaps, capacity bottlenecks, material constraints, revenue risks, and service opportunities; leading root-cause analysis, recovery plans, prioritization, and allocation decisions.
* Supporting customer-service targets, including Fill Rate, STR, OTIF, and PP Confirmation, by aligning commitments with realistic supply capabilities.
* Partnering with Demand Planning, Procurement, Manufacturing, Logistics, Customer Service, Product Management, and Sales on material availability, inventory strategy, supply risks, and executive reviews.
* Preparing monthly and annual inventory and freight projections and improving sourcing and transportation economics, including ocean buying from source.

**What you already have...**

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Operations, Business, or a related field.
* 10+ years of experience in supply planning, materials planning, inventory management, manufacturing, distribution, OEM, automotive, industrial, or aftermarket environments.
* At least 4 years of team-leadership experience, with demonstrated stakeholder management, influencing, communication, and problem-solving capability.
* Experience working effectively in fast-paced, global, matrix, and ambiguous environments.
* Strong knowledge of supply and demand planning, forecasting, inventory optimization, capacity and constraint management, distribution networks, transportation, warehousing, and S&OP/S&OE.
* Proficiency in SAP MRP and inventory planning, SAP IBP, and advanced Microsoft Excel; strong Microsoft PowerPoint and analytics capability.

description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Cognite Solution Architect – Senior Manager**
**Experience Level - 15+**
**Job Description**
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. We’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better. Join us and help build a better working world.
  
  
We are seeking a hands-on Cognite Solution Architect to design industrial data solutions for upstream and downstream Oil & Gas operations. You will define how operational, enterprise and engineering information is integrated, modelled and contextualized in Cognite Data Fusion (CDF), and how applications and analytical solutions consume that information. You will own solution architecture decisions, establish reusable implementation patterns and resolve complex technical issues across source systems, data models, access controls and consuming applications.
  
  
**Role Details**
**Key responsibilities include:**
**Architecture and integration**

* Translate operational use cases into data requirements, integration designs and application-consumption patterns.
* Define how CDF fits within historian, enterprise application, engineering information and cloud architectures.
* Select source-appropriate extractors, APIs and processing patterns, considering latency, throughput, connectivity and source-system load.
* Define historical loading, incremental extraction, reconciliation and recovery approaches, including late records, corrections and supported deletions.
* Establish requirements for service identities, access capabilities, environment separation, monitoring and operational support.

**Industrial information modelling**

* Design CDF models using spaces, containers, views and instances; select direct relations or edges according to relationship semantics and query requirements.
* Reuse and extend Cognite’s Core Data Model where suitable, introducing custom domain concepts where required.
* Define stable identifiers, source crosswalks and conflict-resolution rules, including repeated tag names across sites and systems.
* Represent physical equipment, functional locations and installation history separately where required.
* Establish schema versioning, migration and consumer-compatibility requirements while preserving lineage, timestamps, units, quality indicators and relationship provenance.

**Contextualization and Oil & Gas semantics**

* Design relationships connecting equipment and assets with time series, maintenance records, documents and engineering diagrams.
* Define matching rules, confidence thresholds, exception handling and domain review for ambiguous associations; assess coverage and match accuracy separately.
* For upstream applications, model fields, wells, wellbores, production facilities, equipment, well tests and interventions, preserving distinctions between measured, calculated and allocated production.
* For downstream applications, model sites, process units, functional locations, equipment, laboratory results and maintenance activities, accounting for replacement, revisions and measurement timing.
* Validate that contextualized information supports the intended engineering workflow.
* Application enablement and technical assurance
* Define consumer data contracts covering entities, relationships, fields, freshness, permissions and query-performance expectations.
* Validate designs against representative Cognite applications, custom applications, and analytical or AI workflows.
* Develop critical prototypes and reference implementations using Python, SQL, Cognite SDKs and APIs.
* Establish deployment and environment-promotion practices using version control, automated validation and Cognite Toolkit.
* Review architecture changes, migration plans, integration code and performance bottlenecks; resolve cross-system design conflicts and mentor data engineering leads.

**Must Have Qualifications & Experience**

* A relevant engineering, computer science or information systems degree, or equivalent technical experience.
* Demonstrated personal architectural contribution to a production Cognite Data Fusion implementation.
* Strong knowledge of CDF data modelling, transformations, contextualization and access controls.
* Substantial industrial data integration experience spanning representative operational, enterprise and engineering sources.
* Strong Python and SQL skills with practical Cognite SDK and REST API experience.
* Experience defining identity strategies, model evolution, deployment patterns and production support requirements.
* Working knowledge of cloud architecture, identity providers, network boundaries and CI/CD.
* Strong Oil & Gas implementation experience in at least one upstream or downstream domain, with ability to adapt relevant concepts to the other.

**Good to Have**

* Cognite implementation experience across multiple assets or sites.
* Experience spanning both upstream and downstream.
* Familiarity with historians, maintenance systems, laboratory systems, engineering repositories or well-data services.
* Experience with diagram contextualization, 3D associations and industrial knowledge graphs.
* Experience enabling Cognite applications or AI workflows using contextualized data.
* Relevant Cognite Academy training or certifications.

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to solve high-impact industrial data and analytics challenges across upstream and downstream Oil & Gas.
* A hands-on leadership role with scope to establish reusable practices and guide multidisciplinary teams.
* A collaborative environment spanning domain engineering, data, technology, product and global EY teams.
* Access to EY’s global network, technology ecosystem and learning opportunities while contributing to a better working world.

**What We Look For**
A hands-on architect who can defend consequential production Cognite decisions involving identity resolution, data-model design, access boundaries, recovery, schema migration and application compatibility, and demonstrate which patterns can be reused across sites and which require adaptation.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Technical Analyst - Trader
description:
Job Title: Technical Analyst

Location: Noida

**Company Overview:**

SIHO Research is a cutting-edge stock research and analytics firm that provides high-quality, data-driven investment insights. We leverage the latest technology, including AI, ML, and both fundamental and technical analysis, to evaluate and execute investment opportunities. We are a team of Software Architects, Engineers, Equity research analysts, AI engineers who are passionate about equity investing with a vision to make investing simple and provide the best research services. Our first B2C product is
investvidhi.com
. 

**Job Role Overview:**

We are looking for a Technical Analyst who can identify trading opportunities in Indian equities and turn analysis into clear, actionable research.

You should be comfortable explaining
**why a trade is attractive, what would invalidate it, and how its risk should be managed.**

The role combines chart analysis, strategy testing, market tracking, and research communication.

**Key responsibilities**

* Analyse price action, volume, trends, market structure, support and resistance, and relative strength.
* Identify swing and positional trading opportunities using a repeatable research process.
* Prepare a weekly watchlist and timely trade proposals with entry conditions, stop-loss, targets, expected holding period, and supporting rationale.
* Assess market direction, sector strength, liquidity, volatility, and relevant company events before proposing trades.
* Monitor active recommendations and propose timely updates, exits, or invalidations.
* Backtest trading strategies and evaluate their performance after transaction costs and slippage.
* Maintain a complete research journal covering successful, unsuccessful, and missed trades.
* Work with fundamental analysts to strengthen stock selection and identify material business risks.
* Collaborate with engineers to build screeners, alerts, dashboards, and research automation.
* Prepare clear research notes and educational content following internal review and compliance processes.

**Required skills**

* Strong understanding of technical analysis and Indian equity markets.
* Practical knowledge of price-volume behaviour, breakouts, pullbacks, trend reversals, and risk management.
* Ability to distinguish a promising chart pattern from a strategy supported by evidence.
* Proficiency in TradingView or similar charting platforms.
* Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills.
* Ability to communicate research in simple English; Hindi communication is an advantage.
* Discipline in documenting decisions, acknowledging mistakes, and following a defined process.

**Good to have**

* Python, pandas, Pine Script, or experience building automated screeners.
* Knowledge of backtesting pitfalls, including look-ahead bias, survivorship bias, and overfitting.
* Familiarity with fundamental analysis and earnings-related risks.
* Relevant NISM certifications or progress toward the CMT qualification.

**How success will be measured**

* Quality, clarity, and timeliness of research.
* Consistent adherence to the research and risk-management process.
* Performance across a meaningful sample of trades, including expectancy, drawdown, and risk-reward.
* Accuracy and completeness of recommendation tracking.
* Useful contributions to strategy improvement and research automation.

**Performance will be assessed beyond win rate, with attention to risk, repeatability, and research integrity.**

**Who will thrive in this role**

Someone who is curious, analytical, accountable, and comfortable challenging their own conclusions. You should enjoy researching markets, learning from evidence, and taking ownership of work without repeated follow-ups.

What We Offer:

* Competitive compensation and benefits package.
* ESOPs.
* Mentorship and growth opportunities within the team.
* Access to the latest development tools and technologies.
* A collaborative, inclusive work environment with a strong focus on learning and professional development.

**How to apply**

Share your CV along with:

* Two sample technical research reports with annotated charts.
* One successful and one unsuccessful trade analysis, explaining the original rationale and lessons learned.
* A brief description of a trading strategy you have tested, including its rules and results.

Personal trading profits are not a prerequisite. We value the quality of your reasoning, evidence, and process.

Please send your resume to
jsr.nitin@sihoresearch.com

title: National Air Logistics Trucking Manager
description:
**It's more than a job**
As a member of the Freight Forwarding team Kuehne+Nagel, you will play a key role in transporting goods, optimising processes, and fulfilling our customers' promises. At Kuehne+Nagel, our contribution counts in more ways than we imagine.
  
  
‎
  
  
We are looking for an experienced National Air Logistics Trucking Manager to lead and drive the trucking strategy across India. This role will be responsible for managing end-to-end trucking operations supporting air logistics, ensuring efficient, scalable, and high-quality service delivery aligned with business goals.
  
  
**How you create impact**

* Lead and manage pan-India trucking operations supporting import and export air shipments
* Drive 70% road logistics (core focus) and 30% air freight coordination
* Develop and implement trucking strategy, processes, and operational frameworks integrated with air logistics
* Oversee resource planning, cost management, and operational efficiency
* Manage supplier relationships, carrier networks, and drive procurement initiatives
* Monitor KPIs, service quality, and customer satisfaction through continuous improvement
* Ensure compliance with regulatory and operational standards
* Lead pricing coordination and contribute to business growth and profitability
* Manage and transition the current outsourced team to an in-house capability, building a strong internal team
* Support solution design and transportation planning across complex logistics requirements

**What we would like you to bring**

* 10–15 years of experience in logistics, with strong focus on road trucking operations
* Proven experience in national-level trucking / transportation management
* Strong understanding of air logistics integration with road transport
* Expertise in costing, vendor management, and operational execution
* Exposure to industries such as Semiconductor, Aerospace, Healthcare, White Glove, or Hyperscalers preferred
* People management experience with ability to build and scale teams
* Strong analytical, leadership, and stakeholder management skills

**What's in it for you**
At Kuehne+Nagel, you’ll be part of a global logistics leader that believes in creating real impact—on business, on customers, and on careers. Here’s what you can look forward to:
  
  

* Global Exposure: Step into a world of international opportunities with a presence in 100+ countries.
* People-Centric Culture: Join a team where your voice matters and people genuinely care.
* Learning & Development: Grow with us—personally and professionally—through world-class training and career pathways.

Logistics shapes everyday life - from the goods we consume to the healthcare we rely on. At Kuehne+Nagel, your work goes beyond logistics; it enables both ordinary and special moments in the lives of people around the world.

title: Product Manager
description:
**Company Description**
JSR IMPEX is a leading export house focused on the manufacturing and global export of high-end apparel across woven, knit, and beaded fabrics. Headquartered in Noida, India, the company serves international fashion brands and retailers. With over five decades of industry experience, JSR IMPEX has built a strong reputation for quality, craftsmanship, and reliable delivery. The organization offers a dynamic environment for professionals interested in fashion, global trade, and product development. Team members collaborate across design, production, and merchandising to bring premium apparel collections to markets worldwide.
  
**Role Description**
The Product Manager will oversee the end-to-end lifecycle of apparel products, from concept through production to export. This full-time, on-site role in Noida involves coordinating with design, sampling, production, merchandising, and quality teams to define product requirements and ensure timely delivery. Day-to-day responsibilities include managing product assortments, tracking development and production timelines, monitoring costs and margins, and aligning collections with buyer specifications and market trends. The Product Manager will analyze performance data, gather feedback from international clients, and recommend improvements to product lines and processes. This role also requires maintaining accurate documentation, supporting compliance with buyer and industry standards, and contributing to continuous process optimization within the export operations.
  
**Qualifications**

* Product management and apparel development skills, including experience managing end-to-end product lifecycles and coordinating with cross-functional teams.
* Strong analytical and planning abilities, with proficiency in tracking timelines, costs, margins, and performance metrics.
* Knowledge of fashion manufacturing processes, fabrics (woven, knits, beaded), and quality standards relevant to export markets.
* Effective communication and stakeholder management skills for working with internal teams and international buyers.
* High level of organization, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple product lines simultaneously.
* Proficiency with productivity and reporting tools (such as spreadsheets, ERP or PLM systems) and comfort with data-driven decision-making.
* Bachelor’s degree in Fashion Management, Textile Engineering, Business, or a related field; relevant experience in fashion export or apparel production is strongly preferred.
* Ability to work on-site in Noida, collaborate in a fast-paced environment, and adapt to changing market and buyer requirements.

title: Growth Marketing Manager
description:
**About Stock Knocks**

India’s First AI-Powered Investor Research & IR Marketplace.

Where investors discover tomorrow’s companies, and businesses connect with verified investors through AI, videos and community.

Investors use Stock Knocks to research SME-listed and IPO-bound companies. They can ask questions about DRHPs, annual reports and investor presentations and get clear answers in seconds, in English and Indian languages. Companies use it to reach verified investors through investor-relations videos, live meetings and our community.

**The role**

You’ll grow both sides of the marketplace: the investors who come to research and the companies that want to reach them. On the investor side, you’ll own the funnel from the first ad someone sees to their tenth research question. On the company side, you’ll bring in a steady flow of SME and IPO-bound companies for our sales team to sign up. You’ll run campaigns yourself, set up the tracking, and run the tests that decide where our next rupee goes. You’ll work directly with the founders, product and sales.

**What you’ll do**

*Investor growth (B2C)*

* Plan, launch and optimise app-install and web campaigns on Google (App Campaigns, Search, YouTube, Performance Max), Meta and Apple Search Ads.
* Build keyword and audience plans around IPO and SME search demand: DRHP filings, subscription windows, allotment and listing days.
* Test creatives quickly: hooks, formats, languages and UGC-style video
* Improve the funnel: install → sign-up → first AI question → paid use → repeat use.
* Own lifecycle messaging on push, email and WhatsApp to activate new users and win back inactive ones

*Company growth (B2B)*

* Generate qualified leads from SME-listed companies, IPO-bound companies and their promoters through LinkedIn Ads, Google Search and targeted outreach campaigns.
* Build partnerships with merchant bankers, IPO consultants, CA firms and other intermediaries who work with these companies.
* Run webinars, events and case studies that show how companies use Stock Knocks to reach investors
* Work with sales on lead scoring, CRM handoff and follow-up, and track lead → meeting → onboarded company
* Build landing pages and pitch material for each segment (newly listed SMEs, pre-IPO companies, companies already listed on the main board)

*Organic & community*

* Build SEO and content around IPOs and SME stocks, such as IPO pages, DRHP explainers and listing-day coverage.
* Grow our community and creator partnerships on YouTube, X, Telegram, Instagram and LinkedIn, within SEBI’s rules on finfluencers

*Measurement*

* Own tracking across an attribution tool (AppsFlyer, Branch or Adjust), Firebase, GA4, GTM, Meta SDK and Conversions API, SKAN on iOS, and the LinkedIn Insight Tag
* Report investor metrics (cost per install, cost per activated user, conversion to paid, retention, lifetime value against acquisition cost) and company metrics (cost per qualified lead, lead-to-onboarding rate, acquisition cost per company)
* Use AI tools and automation for making creatives, bidding, reporting and analysis.

*Compliance*

* Make sure every campaign follows SEBI’s advertising rules, its disclosure and publicity rules for listed and IPO-bound companies, and Google’s and Meta’s financial-services policies: no promised returns, no stock tips, correct disclosures.

**What we’re looking for**

* 4–7 years in performance or growth marketing, with at least 2 years on a consumer app (fintech, investing, edtech or similar)
* Hands-on experience with Google App Campaigns and Meta app campaigns: you’ve run the budgets yourself, not just supervised them
* B2B lead generation experience, ideally on LinkedIn Ads, where you were measured on lead quality and not just volume
* Comfortable with an attribution tool and cohort analysis; you think about retention and payback, not just cost per install.
* Experience with CRM and lifecycle tools (HubSpot or Zoho for B2B; CleverTap, MoEngage or WebEngage for B2C)
* A record of tests you designed, ran and learned from, both wins and losses.
* A real interest in Indian capital markets: you know what a DRHP, an anchor book and allotment status are

**Good to have**

* Experience marketing a SEBI-regulated or financial-services product, including financial-services verification on Google and Meta
* Contacts among merchant bankers, IPO consultants or SME promoters
* Experience growing a two-sided marketplace
* SEO for high-intent, time-sensitive searches
* Campaigns or content in Hindi or other Indian languages
* Basic SQL or Python
* Experience as an early marketing hire at a startup

**Why join us**

* Grow both sides of a new kind of marketplace for India’s capital markets.
* An AI product you’ll use yourself every day
* A small team: your tests go live in days, not quarters
* Work directly with the founders and see your impact on the company's numbers.

title: Junior Manager
description:
**Department:**
Hospital Operations

**Reporting To:**
Chief Operating Officer (COO)

**Location:**
Krisha Hospital, Ahmedabad

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

1. JOB PURPOSE

The Junior Manager – Healthcare Management will work closely with the
**Chief Operating Officer (COO)**
to support the efficient functioning, coordination, monitoring, and continuous improvement of hospital operations.

The role will focus on ensuring that clinical, administrative, patient-care, and support functions operate in a coordinated, efficient, patient-centric, and process-driven manner.

The candidate will be expected to understand hospital workflows, identify operational gaps, coordinate with different departments, monitor performance, and support implementation of systems and processes defined by the COO.

2. KEY RESPONSIBILITIESA. Hospital Operations

* Monitor day-to-day hospital operations and ensure smooth functioning of all departments.
* Coordinate between OPD, IPD, OT, physiotherapy, nursing, reception, billing, pharmacy, diagnostics, and other support services.
* Identify operational bottlenecks and report them to the COO.
* Assist in implementing corrective and preventive actions.
* Ensure that hospital SOPs and operational protocols are followed.
* Monitor patient movement and workflow from registration to consultation, investigations, admission, surgery, discharge, and follow-up.

B. Patient Experience & Service Quality

* Monitor patient experience at various touchpoints.
* Track patient complaints, feedback, delays, and service-related concerns.
* Coordinate with relevant departments for timely resolution of complaints.
* Develop and maintain patient-service improvement initiatives.
* Monitor waiting times and patient flow.

C. Data & MIS Management

* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly operational MIS reports.
* Track OPD, IPD, surgeries, admissions, discharges, cancellations, occupancy, revenue, and other operational indicators.
* Maintain dashboards for management review.
* Analyse operational data and highlight trends, gaps, and areas requiring intervention.
* Support the COO in preparing management presentations and review reports.

D. Quality & Compliance

* Assist in implementation and monitoring of NABH-related processes.
* Ensure departmental documentation and records are maintained appropriately.
* Conduct periodic internal operational audits as directed.
* Monitor compliance with hospital SOPs and checklists.
* Assist in preparing the hospital for inspections, audits, and accreditation activities.

E. Human Resource Coordination

* Coordinate with departmental heads regarding staffing requirements and operational issues.
* Monitor attendance, duty rosters, punctuality, and manpower deployment where required.
* Assist in onboarding and orientation of new employees.
* Identify training requirements and coordinate staff training programmes.
* Support performance monitoring of operational staff.

F. OT & Clinical Operations Coordination

* Coordinate with OT, nursing, anaesthesia, physiotherapy, and other departments to facilitate smooth surgical workflows.
* Monitor OT scheduling and identify avoidable delays.
* Coordinate pre-operative and post-operative processes.
* Assist in improving surgical turnaround time and patient preparedness.

G. Inventory & Resource Management

* Monitor availability of essential operational supplies.
* Coordinate with stores, pharmacy, purchase, and administration.
