title: AI Architect
description:
Job Description

We’re looking for a seasoned Software Architect with deep expertise in cloud-native enterprise systems and Generative AI. You will define and deliver scalable, secure, and production-grade GenAI architectures — including multi-agent, RAG, LLMOps and AgentOps systems — and lead cross-functional teams to build and operate them. This role combines hands-on technical leadership, systems thinking, and strong stakeholder management.

Key responsibilities

Architecture & System Design

1. Design scalable, modular, and cloud-native architectures for GenAI applications(microservices, event-driven, serverless).
2. Define system boundaries, data flows, orchestration, and integration patterns forLLMs, vector DBs, embedding services, and tool integrations.
3. Produce architecture artifacts ( Layered Architecture Diagrams, C4 Models, DFDs,Class, Sequence, ER & Use Case diagrams, different types of blueprints, APIcontracts, design and trade-off decisions).
4. GenAI & Agentic Systems
5. Architect and deliver Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, NaturalLanguage to SQL Flows, fine-tuning strategies, multi-modal capabilities, and tool-augmented agents.
6. Design agent orchestration and multi-agent frameworks enabling planning,reasoning, and secure tool invocations, implement and design Agent prototypes andCommunication Protocols.
7. Define prompt engineering standards, memory models(episodic/semantic/procedural), and context management.

LLMOps & AgentOps

1. Define and implement model lifecycle pipelines: training, fine-tuning, validation,deployment, rollback, and monitoring.
2. Build AgentOps processes for agent lifecycle, behavior tracking, governance andperformance optimization.
3. Automate CI/CD for models, agents and services (MLflow, TFX, BentoML, custompipelines).

Integration, Security & Compliance

1. Integrate GenAI services with enterprise systems (ERP, CRM, data lakes, APIs) usingsecure, scalable interfaces.
2. Ensure secure access controls, data privacy, encryption, and compliance (GDPR,HIPAA, SOC2).
3. Define responsible AI practices: bias mitigation, explainability, audit trails, andoutput governance.
4. GenAI security — classify, encrypt & sign data/models; enforce least-privilege withshort-lived creds and CI/CD security gates; telemetry, drift/hallucination alerts, kill-switch & runbooks.
5. Agentic AI security — provable agent identity/attestation, tool allowlist + human gatefor high-risk actions; ephemeral scoped tokens, sandboxed execution,and replayable audit traces.

Observability, Ops & Cost Optimization

1. Define telemetry, tracing, and logging for models and agents; monitor performance,drift, hallucination rates and user feedback loops.
2. Build dashboards, alerts and runbook guidance for operational health.
3. Design systems for cost efficiency (autoscaling, spot instances, serverlesschoices) and support FinOps practices.

Leadership, Collaboration & Documentation

1. Lead cross-functional teams (product, data science, AI engineers, platform)through architecture reviews, workshops, and technical decisioning.
2. Maintain architectural standards, documentation, playbooks, and patternlibraries for GenAI systems.
3. Mentor engineers and evangelize best practices across the organization.

Required qualifications & experience

1. 10+ years software engineering experience with 3+ years in architecture or seniortechnical leadership roles (or equivalent).
2. Proven track record designing and delivering cloud-native, production systems atenterprise scale.
3. Hands-on experience with GenAI/LLM systems, RAG, NL-SQL,agentic frameworks or similar productionized AI applications.
4. Strong knowledge of system design patterns (microservices, event-driven,CQRS, hexagonal architecture), and Low Level Design Patterns.
5. Experience integrating ML/LLM services with enterprise data platforms and APIswhile meeting security/compliance requirements.
6. Solid engineering background in at least two languages (Python, TypeScript, Go,Java, C#) and familiarity with modern frameworks.

Technical skills & technologies (comprehensive)

1. Cloud & Infra: AWS / Azure / GCP; Kubernetes, Docker, serverless (Lambda, Functions, Cloud Run), GPU instances
2. GenAI & ML: Hugging Face Transformers, OpenAI APIs, ,LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, Haystack
3. Vector Stores: FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, Postgres+pgVector, and other cloud vector stores
4. LLMOps / MLOps: Custom Development of Ops Pipelines, MLflow, TFX, BentoML, Kubeflow
5. Data & Integration: Kafka, Spark, Airflow, Flink, ETL/ELT concepts, data lakes, API gateways (Apigee etc)
6. DevOps & IaC: Terraform, Pulumi, CloudFormation, GitHub Actions, Jenkins
7. Observability & Security: Prometheus, Grafana stack, OpenTelemetry, Jaeger, ELK, Datadog; Vault,
8. IAM, LDAP/OAuth2/OIDC/SAML Connect, Snyk, SonarQube, SAST/SCA in pipelines, OWASPs, CWEs, CVEs.
9. Databases & Storage: Relational (RDS/Cloud SQL), NoSQL (Mongo, DynamoDB, Cosmos DB), Redis, S3/Blob/GCS, ORM/ODM frameworks.
10. Agent frameworks / tools: Understanding of Basics of Agents required, Langgraph, Autogen, AutoGPT, AgentVerse, MetaGPT, CrewAI etc.
11. Performance & scalability: SSR/ISR, caching strategies (CDN, edge), lazy loading, bundle optimization, performance budgets.
12. Realtime & asyncRealtime & async: WebSockets, SSE, message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ), background workers. Frontend frameworks: React (Next.js), Angular, Vue; component libraries and state (Redux/RTK, Context, Pinia, Zustand)
13. Styling & UI tooling: Component Libraries, Accessibility best practices, Responsive UI
14. Frontend build & tooling: Vite, Webpack, Storybook, UI Frameworks.
15. Backend frameworks: Node.js/Express, FastAPI, serverless functions (AWS Lambda, Cloud Functions)
16. API design & integration: REST, gRPC, OpenAPI/Swagger, API versioning and contract testing, GraphQL(Optional)
17. UX & product mindset: Design-system familiarity, usability, accessibility, and working with designers

Behavioral & leadership skills

1. Strategic thinking with the ability to align architecture to product and businessgoals.
2. Excellent communicator: simplify complex technical concepts for technical andnon-technical stakeholders.
3. Strong mentorship skills — able to raise team capability in GenAI architectureand engineering.
4. Pragmatic decision-maker with a bias for measurable outcomes and trade-offanalysis.
5. High attention to detail, ownership, and accountability for reliability, security,and cost.

Nice-to-have

1. Experience operating LLMs in regulated industries (pharma).
2. Familiarity with prompt auditing, hallucination detection, and automated qualitychecks.
3. Background in knowledge engineering, semantic search, or knowledge graphs.
4. Academic background in CS, ML, or equivalent applied experience.
5. Mobile & cross-platform (optional): React Native, Flutter basics for mobileintegration
6. Deliverables & success metrics (examples)
7. Production-ready GenAI architecture and deployment runbook.
8. Deployed RAG/agent pipeline with observable SLOs and monitoring dashboards.
9. Reduced model hallucination/incidents and measurable improvement inretrieval quality.
10. Architecture decision records (ADRs), standards library, and cross-teamonboarding materials.
11. Cost targets achieved through optimized infra and autoscaling policies.

title: Microsoft 365 Platform Engineering, Staff
description:
**We Are**
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
  
  
**You Are**
You have spent years making Microsoft 365 actually work at scale, not just turning features on, but architecting governance, automation, and workflows that hold up when 30,000 people depend on them daily. You understand that the hardest part is not deploying Teams or SharePoint, it is making sure the platform does not become a sprawling mess six months later when every department has spun up their own workflows without guardrails.
  
  
You write PowerShell and Python scripts that save hours of manual work. You build Power Platform solutions that solve real problems, not demos that look good in a deck. When someone mentions Microsoft Graph, you already know which API endpoints you would call and why. You have opinions on tenant governance, data residency, and lifecycle policies because you have seen what happens when those things are ignored.
  
  
Emerging tech like Copilot and AI-powered productivity tools excite you, not because they are shiny, but because you can see the actual use cases and the governance challenges that come with them. You ask the right questions before rolling something out. You push back when a request does not account for security, compliance, or long-term maintainability. At Synopsys, you will work on a global collaboration platform that directly impacts how engineers, researchers, and teams get work done every day.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**
Architect, govern, and enhance Microsoft 365 services including Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Power Platform, Power BI, and Microsoft Graph integrations across a global enterprise environment
  
  
Build automation solutions using PowerShell, Python, Microsoft Graph APIs, and Power Platform to eliminate manual work, improve user experience, and scale operational efficiency
  
  
Lead deployment, governance, and adoption strategies for Microsoft Copilot and AI-powered productivity services, partnering with business stakeholders to identify real-world use cases
  
  
Define and maintain platform governance frameworks, lifecycle policies, and technical standards for collaboration tools, ensuring security, compliance, and operational sustainability
  
  
Support SharePoint Online migration initiatives using ShareGate, including planning, execution, and post-migration validation
  
  
Serve as technical escalation for complex Microsoft 365 issues, leading root-cause analysis and implementing long-term fixes that prevent recurrence
  
  
Partner with security, compliance, and infrastructure teams to ensure Microsoft 365 services meet enterprise data protection, regulatory requirements, and Synopsys security policies
  
  
**The Impact You Will Have**
Enable 30,000 employees globally to collaborate securely and efficiently through well-governed, scalable Microsoft 365 services
  
  
Reduce operational overhead and manual effort through automation solutions that streamline repetitive tasks and improve platform reliability
  
  
Accelerate adoption of AI-powered productivity tools like Copilot by establishing governance, best practices, and stakeholder confidence in new technologies
  
  
Prevent platform sprawl and security risks by implementing governance frameworks that balance user flexibility with enterprise control
  
  
Improve incident resolution time and platform stability by building sustainable solutions and mentoring teams on technical best practices
  
  
Drive modernization of collaboration workflows, enabling teams to leverage Power Platform, Microsoft Graph, and low-code solutions to solve business problems faster
  
  
Shape the technical roadmap for enterprise productivity platforms, influencing how Synopsys invests in and deploys collaboration technologies
  
  
**What You'll Need**
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent hands-on experience
  
  
5+ years supporting enterprise collaboration and productivity platforms at scale
  
  
Deep technical expertise with Microsoft 365 services including Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Power Platform, Power BI, and Microsoft Graph
  
  
Strong experience building automation using PowerShell, Python, and Microsoft Graph APIs to solve operational and user experience challenges
  
  
Proven ability to architect, implement, and govern enterprise collaboration platforms with a focus on security, compliance, and scalability
  
  
Experience leading technical initiatives across distributed teams and geographies, with minimal supervision
  
  
Experience with Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, or enterprise AI platforms is a strong plus
  
  
Microsoft certifications related to Microsoft 365, Power Platform, Azure, Security, or Copilot technologies are a plus
  
  
**Who You Are**
You can explain a complex governance tradeoff to a business stakeholder in two sentences without losing the technical nuance or oversimplifying the risk
  
  
You troubleshoot by asking the right questions first, not by guessing, and you document what you learn so the next person does not have to start from scratch
  
  
You mentor engineers and administrators by sharing what works and what does not, based on real experience, not theory
  
  
You balance user needs with platform sustainability, knowing when to say yes, when to say not yet, and when to propose a better alternative
  
  
You stay current on Microsoft 365 and AI developments because you want to understand what is actually useful, not just what is new
  
  
You work across time zones and cultures comfortably, adjusting your communication style to make sure the message lands no matter who is on the other end
  
  
**The Team You'll Be Part Of**
You will be part of the Global Digital Workplace and Collaboration Engineering team responsible for delivering secure, scalable, and innovative Microsoft 365 services across Synopsys. The team drives enterprise productivity solutions, platform governance, automation, and AI adoption, enabling employees worldwide to collaborate effectively and work more efficiently.

title: Staff Engineer- Applied AI
description:
**About The Role**
AI is not a feature in Foundry - it is the operating model. AI-assisted coding and product management is baked into how the team works, and AI-assisted solutioning is baked into what we ship: LLM-based data ingestion that auto-fills the Sizer from unstructured customer files, a constraint-solver recommendation engine that suggests robot configurations, semantic search over historical sizing sheets, and a Copilot that guides users through the solutioning journey. As the Staff Engineer, Applied AI you own all of this. You run the Applied AI capability as a chapter across all Foundry squads- setting the patterns, evaluation frameworks and API contracts that each squad implements rather than centralising all AI work in one team. You are expected to be the most technically credible AI engineer in the organisation, influencing architecture decisions across squads and setting the standard for how AI features are built, measured and shipped.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Build and own the recommendation engine - Design and implement the ML pipeline that recommends solution type (technology, layout, configuration) from customer inputs; own the feature store, training pipeline, model registry and serving layer.
* Build the constraint-solver intelligence - Implement the AI layer on top of the constraint solver: learned priors for solver warm-starts, anomaly detection for unusual input combinations, and automated sensitivity analysis.
* Build LLM-based data ingestion- Design the production pipeline that takes unstructured customer documents (PDFs, spreadsheets, emails) and extracts structured Sizer inputs using LLMs; handle uncertainty, partial extractions and human-in-the-loop review.
* Build the formulator engine and vector DB- Implement semantic search over historical sizing solutions and L1 data sheets; design the embedding pipeline, vector database and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) layer.
* Define AI chapter patterns- Set the shared patterns that all squads adopt: LLM API integration (streaming, function calling, structured output), prompt engineering standards, evaluation harnesses and A/B experiment frameworks for AI features.
* Build the AI evaluation framework- Implement offline and online evaluation for every AI feature: golden-set benchmarks, production-shadow evaluation, A/B experiment readout tooling and regression detection.
* Own the AI API contracts- Design the internal API contracts between the AI squad and consuming squads (Sizer, Layout, GCM); version them, document them and enforce them via contract tests.
* Mentor and grow AI capability- Pair with and review engineers across squads who are implementing AI features; run the Applied AI chapter meetings; grow the team's collective AI engineering capability.

**Minimum (required) Qualifications**

* 10–15 years professional engineering; at least 4 years in applied ML / LLM productionisation.
* Deep experience with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, or open-source): function calling, structured output, streaming, embeddings.
* Production RAG system experience: chunking strategies, embedding models, vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, pgvector), retrieval evaluation.
* Experience building and deploying recommendation systems or ranking models.
* Strong software engineering foundations: API design, observability, testing, CI/CD.
* Track record of cross-team technical influence: setting patterns others adopt.
* Experience with ML experiment tracking and model-lifecycle management.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with optimisation / operations-research methods used in conjunction with ML (hybrid AI + OR solvers).
* Experience with agentic AI systems: tool-use, ReAct, AutoGen, LangGraph or similar.
* Domain experience in warehousing, logistics or industrial automation.
* Experience with online A/B experimentation for AI features (including metric design).
* Familiarity with structured-extraction frameworks (Instructor, Outlines, Marvin).
* Experience with feature stores (Feast, Tecton) and ML platforms (MLflow, Vertex AI).
* Prior Staff-level or principal-equivalent scope at a technology company.

**Technical Qualifications**
*We expect you to be proficient in or quickly learn the following. Senior roles (Band E+) are expected to be experts; Band C/D roles are expected to have working knowledge.*

* LLM stack: OpenAI / Anthropic API; LangChain / LlamaIndex / LangGraph for orchestration; structured output parsing (Instructor / Pydantic).
* RAG: chunking and indexing pipelines; embedding models (text-embedding-3, Cohere, BGE); vector stores (pgvector, Qdrant, Pinecone); hybrid search (dense + BM25).
* ML: scikit-learn, XGBoost for classical recommendation; PyTorch / HuggingFace for fine-tuning and inference; MLflow or Vertex AI for experiment tracking.
* Evaluation: RAGAS, TruLens, or custom harnesses; LLM-as-judge pipelines; A/B frameworks integrated with analytics (e.g. Mixpanel).
* Languages: Python (primary); Java or Go for production service wrappers.
* APIs: REST (FastAPI or Flask); gRPC for high-throughput internal calls; SSE / WebSocket for streamed LLM responses.
* Infrastructure: GCP (Vertex AI, Cloud Run, GCS, Pub/Sub); Docker, Kubernetes; Terraform.
* Observability: LLM call logging (token counts, latency, cost); Prometheus metrics; Grafana dashboards; structured logging with trace IDs.
* Testing: unit tests for extraction logic; golden-set regression tests; integration tests with mocked LLM responses.
* Tooling: GitHub monorepo, GitHub Actions CI, Backstage.

**How We Work**
You are the single senior AI voice across Foundry. You lead the Applied AI chapter- short, weekly craft syncs with engineers across squads who are implementing AI features and you own the AI API contracts that every squad consumes. You report directly to the Senior Director and participate in the weekly squad-of-squads sync. You are expected to influence decisions at the architecture level, not just the implementation level.

title: Senior Solutions Architect
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100\* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
  
  
The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
  
  

* Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

**An Overview Of This Role**
As a Senior Solutions Architect on GitLab's India team, you'll be a trusted advisor to prospects, customers, and partners across India. You'll help them understand how GitLab's AI-powered DevSecOps platform addresses technical requirements and business goals across the software development lifecycle. This role supports Commercial and Enterprise segments in India's Southern Region. Experience with Global Capability Centers (GCCs), Digital Native organizations, and startups is highly valued given the accounts you'll support.
  
  
You'll partner closely with Account Executives and cross-functional teams to own technical evaluations, including proofs of value and workshops, shape solution architectures, and bring customer feedback to Product Management. You'll also occasionally support regional go-to-market partners that provide Professional Services. Your work will help customers adopt GitLab successfully, support revenue growth through solution selling, and build long-term, trusted relationships.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Lead technical discovery, demonstrations, and validation to show how GitLab's AI-powered DevSecOps platform meets customers' technical and business needs across the software development lifecycle.
* Own the technical evaluation process, including solution design, proofs of concept or value, workshops, and technical contributions to tenders, audits, and value stream assessments.
* Collaborate with Account Executives and regional sales teams across Commercial and Enterprise segments to shape account strategies for new customer acquisition and expansion, with a focus on GCC, Digital Native, and startup accounts.
* Support regional go-to-market partners that provide Professional Services, helping them deliver consistent technical guidance and apply effective practices during partner-led engagements.
* Represent GitLab at online and in-person marketing events, including webinars, industry events, presentations, roundtables, panels, demonstration days, and hackathons.
* Build trusted relationships with technical practitioners and business leaders, guide GitLab-driven transformation, and help customers become GitLab advocates.
* Advise customers on modern software development, continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD), security, and cloud practices to improve their return on investment.
* Share customer feedback, use cases, and competitive insights with Product Management, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing while continuing to build expertise and reusable guidance in GitLab, DevSecOps, AI, and cloud technologies.

**What You’ll Bring**

* Experience guiding Commercial and Enterprise customers through solution design and evaluation in technical presales, consulting, or a similar role.
* Experience working with India's GCCs, Digital Native organizations, and startups is highly valued.
* Knowledge of the end-to-end software development lifecycle, including modern DevSecOps practices and CI/CD workflows.
* Hands-on experience with GitLab or comparable source control, CI/CD, and collaboration platforms, with the ability to connect platform capabilities to customer use cases.
* Practical knowledge of cloud computing concepts and related technologies, including deployment, security, and operations options.
* Ability to lead proofs of concept or value, contribute to tenders or audits, and design and run workshops or value stream assessments.
* Clear technical communication and presentation skills, with the ability to adapt your message for practitioners and senior business and technical decision-makers.
* Skill in building trusted relationships, listening with empathy, advocating for customers, collaborating with go-to-market or Professional Services partners, and continuously learning new technologies.

**About The Team**
The Solutions Architect team is part of GitLab's Sales organization and serves as the technical counterpart to Account Executives. This role focuses on Commercial and Enterprise opportunities across India's Southern Region and works with Account Executives, the broader go-to-market team, and regional partners that provide Professional Services. The team advises on architecture, runs technical evaluations such as proofs of value, and guides customers through digital transformation. We collaborate asynchronously with Sales, Product Management, Engineering, and Marketing to share effective practices, create reusable technical resources, and represent the voice of the customer. Our focus is helping customers modernize software delivery, adopt GitLab at scale, and navigate a changing AI and DevSecOps landscape.
  
  
**How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees**

* Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
* Flexible Paid Time Off
* Team Member Resource Groups
* Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* Growth and Development Fund
* Parental Leave

Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.
  
  
**Country Hiring Guidelines:**
GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.
  
  
**Privacy Policy:**
Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.
  
  
GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also GitLab’s EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. As a VKS Application Engineer, you will be on the front lines with enterprise customers, driving the successful adoption of VMware Kubernetes Service (vKS) on VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF). This is a hands-on, customer-facing role focused on designing and validating solutions, running proof-of-concepts, and guiding customers through their modernization journey.

* Act as a trusted advisor for enterprise customers, guiding them through the design, validation, and deployment of vKS solutions on VCF.
* Collaborate closely with field account teams to align solution architecture with customer priorities and drive successful engagement outcomes.
* Lead technical discovery sessions, workshops, and proof-of-concepts to validate vKS architectures and demonstrate business value.
* Partner with sales to jointly develop customer proposals that address modernization goals, workload placement, and operational transformation.
* Provide prescriptive guidance on Kubernetes adoption, DevOps/CI-CD integration, and enterprise requirements such as scalability, security, and disaster recovery.
* Build and share reference architectures, deployment patterns, and technical assets to accelerate customer adoption of VKS.
* Deliver clear, compelling technical presentations to diverse audiences, from architects to executive decision makers.
* Stay current on industry trends, competitor offerings, and evolving enterprise requirements to position VKS effectively.
* Collaborate with product management and engineering to provide field feedback that influences roadmap direction.

* Experience in application engineering or technical sales for enterprise IT, cloud, or application platforms.
* Strong expertise in Kubernetes, containers, and VMware Cloud Foundation (vSphere, vSAN, NSX as foundation).
* 10+ years in technology-related roles, with depth in enterprise IT architecture, application modernization, or cloud-native platforms.
* Demonstrated success working directly with enterprise customers to deliver technical solutions and drive platform adoption.
* Excellent communication, storytelling, and presentation skills with the ability to engage both technical and business leaders.
* Strong collaboration skills, able to work hand-in-hand with sales teams to advance customer opportunities.
* Proven ability to identify challenges, design solutions, and articulate value in business terms.
* Enthusiastic self-starter with curiosity, drive, and the ability to thrive in dynamic environments.
* Ability to travel up to 50% of the time

title: AI Studio - Content Operations Lead (GenStudio & Firefly)
description:
Content Operations Lead, AI Studio
  
  
**Job Description**
The Opportunity
  
  
Adobe’s AI Studio is where the world’s leading brands bring their campaigns to life through generative AI; and behind every great campaign is an equally great production engine. As Content Operations Lead, you’ll be the operational backbone of that engine, working side by side with Creative Designers to keep projects on track, customers unblocked, and nothing falling through the cracks.
  
  
This role is for someone who can walk into an unorganized customer situation, quickly make sense of what’s needed, and get the team delivering. You’re deeply comfortable with data (like wrangling CSVs, building Excel trackers, turning raw inputs into structured outputs), and you bring the kind of can-do energy that keeps teams moving even when timelines are tight.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  
**Drive Programs and Unblock the Team**

* Quickly assess what’s needed from a customer brief or request — even when information is incomplete or unorganized — and get the team moving.
* Organize complex inputs from customers into clear, structured briefs and action plans that creative partners can complete immediately.
* Proactively identify and remove blockers so Creative Designers can stay focused on the work, not the logistics.
* Coordinate handoffs between Creative Designers, copywriters, and engagement managers to keep production on schedule.
* Drive the team to on-time delivery, flagging risks early and pushing for resolution before they become problems.

**Own Data, Workflow, and Tooling**

* Work extensively in Excel and with CSV data to manage asset tracking, reporting, and production operations at scale. Strong spreadsheet fluency is essential in this role.
* Build, refine, and document production workflows and processes that increase team efficiency and reduce manual effort. Additionally, you will make sure they’re clearly defined and repeatable.
* Leverage project management platforms and AI-assisted workflows to streamline operations and keep interested parties informed.
* Find opportunities to automate repetitive production tasks and contribute to a growing library of team guidelines.

**Support Creative Quality and Output**

* Partner closely with Creative Designers to organize and prepare assets, manage file structures, and ensure outputs are formatted correctly for each channel and format.
* Bring a creative eye to production — catching inconsistencies, flagging quality issues, and helping maintain brand standards across deliverables.
* Manage variant tracking and asset organization at scale across formats, channels, and campaign phases.

**Be the Team’s Connective Tissue**

* Serve as a reliable point of contact for internal coordination, keeping interested parties informed and aligned.
* Maintain a positive, resourceful presence that helps the team navigate competing priorities and shifting deadlines.
* Contribute to a collaborative team culture where people feel supported and set up to do their best work.

What We’re Looking For
  
  

* 5+ years of experience in program management, marketing operations, creative production, or a related role. Agency, in-house, or studio environments all translate well.
* Demonstrated ability to quickly understand deliverables needed, organize ambiguous or incomplete information, and drive a team to execution.
* Strong data fluency: you’re deeply comfortable working in Excel and with CSV files, building and maintaining complex spreadsheets, and using data to drive clarity and decisions.
* Proven ability to define, document, and improve processes: you don’t just follow workflows, you build them.
* A track record of unblocking teams and ensuring timely delivery in fast paced, time-sensitive environments.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously with strong attention to detail and follow-through.
* A creative eye and genuine appreciation for design quality, even if you’re not the one pushing pixels.
* Familiarity with generative AI tools and an openness to integrating them into daily work.
* Strong communication skills: you keep people informed without over-communicating, and you know when to flag something versus just handle it.
* A can-do attitude and the kind of steady, positive energy that makes teams want to work with you.
* Experience in digital marketing, advertising production, or campaign operations is a plus.
* Comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment where priorities can shift and timelines are rarely forgiving.

title: IT Solutions Analyst (Universal Robots, Bangalore - India)
description:
The
**IT Solutions Analyst - ServiceNow**
is the functional and technical bridge between business stakeholders and the ServiceNow platform, responsible for designing, configuring, enhancing, and supporting solutions across Customer Service Management (CSM), Manufacturing Commercial Operations (MCO), and Sales and Order Management (SOM).
  
  
This role translates customer service, asset management, contracts management, and entitlement-related requirements into scalable ServiceNow workflows, custom applications, and integrations. The analyst partners with Sales, Field Service, Customer Care, Manufacturing, and other IT teams to improve customer experience, order accuracy, and service efficiency, and acts as a subject-matter expert and escalation point for production support. As part of the IT Enterprise Applications team, the analyst also designs and supports integrations between ServiceNow and other systems, including Salesforce, on-premise applications, and databases.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities****
**Requirements analysis and solution design**

* Gather, document, and refine business requirements through workshops, interviews, and process mapping with Sales, Customer Service, Manufacturing, and Finance stakeholders.
* Translate requirements into functional specifications, user stories with acceptance criteria, and solution designs aligned to ServiceNow best practices.
* Assess the impact of platform upgrades, new releases, and process changes, and recommend out-of-the-box (OOTB) approaches over customization where practical.

**Platform configuration and development**

* Configure and enhance CSM (case management, customer and account data, entitlements, SLAs, Customer Service Portal, Virtual Agent, knowledge management).
* Configure and enhance MCO and SOM (product and quote catalogs, order capture, decomposition and fulfillment orchestration, order tracking, and commercial and manufacturing operations workflows).
* Design and build custom scoped applications using Flow Designer, Workflow Studio, Business Rules, Script Includes, UI Policies, Client Scripts, UI Builder / Workspaces, and Service Portal.
* Build and maintain integrations between ServiceNow and Salesforce, on-premise applications, databases, ERP, PLM, MES, telephony, and other enterprise systems using REST/SOAP APIs, Integration Hub, MID Server, JDBC, and data import sets.
* Implement and tune ServiceNow AI features (Now Assist skills, AI Agents, Virtual Agent, AI Search, Build Agent) across CSM, MCO, and SOM processes, and measure their impact on case deflection, resolution time, and agent productivity.

**Testing, deployment, and release management**

* Develop test plans and test cases, execute functional and regression testing, and coordinate user acceptance testing (UAT).
* Manage update sets / application repository deployments across instances and follow established change, release, and source-control practices.
* Produce release notes, training materials, and knowledge articles, and support end-user and super-user training.

**Production support and continuous improvement**

* Provide Tier 2/3 support for CSM, MCO, and SOM, including incident triage, root-cause analysis, and permanent fixes within SLA targets.
* Monitor platform health, data quality, and performance, and proactively identify and close process or configuration gaps.
* Support platform upgrades, family release adoption, and technical debt reduction.
* Maintain solution documentation, data models, and process flows; contribute to the product backlog and sprint planning.

**Governance and collaboration**

* Work with architects, developers, and platform owners to uphold standards for security, ACLs, data governance, and compliance.
* Report on solution adoption and process KPIs (case resolution time, order cycle time, SLA attainment) using Performance Analytics and dashboards.
* Mentor junior analysts and share knowledge across the ServiceNow community of practice.

****All About You****
We seek individuals who share our passion and determination. Our commitment to customer success drives us to go the extra mile. If you’re ready to join us in this mission, take a closer look at the minimum criteria for the position.
  
  
****Education And Experience****

* Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5+ years of hands-on ServiceNow experience as a platform analyst, administrator, or developer, focused specifically on ServiceNow solutions.
* Demonstrated implementation and support experience in at least two of the three target modules: CSM, MCO, and SOM.
* Proven experience developing custom scoped applications on the ServiceNow platform, from requirements through deployment and support.
* Experience supporting production ServiceNow environments, including incident management, root-cause analysis, upgrades, and release cycles.

**ServiceNow certifications**
**Certification**
**Requirement**
ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA)
  
  
**Required**
ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist – Customer Service Management (CSM)
  
  
Optional (preferred)
  
  
ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist – Sales and Order Management (SOM)
  
  
Optional (preferred)
  
  
ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD)
  
  
**Required**
Candidates holding certifications in Manufacturing Commercial Operations (MCO) or comparable manufacturing-industry ServiceNow credentials will be given strong preference.
  
  
****Technical Skills****

* Strong working knowledge of ServiceNow data model, tables, ACLs, roles, and CMDB / Customer Service data structures.
* Proficiency with JavaScript (server-side and client-side), Glide APIs, Flow Designer, Workflow Studio, and scoped application development.
* Experience with integrations to Salesforce, on-premise applications, and databases (SQL, JDBC) using REST/SOAP, Integration Hub spokes, MID Server, and import sets / transform maps.
* Hands-on experience with ServiceNow AI capabilities, including Now Assist skills for CSM and SOM (case and order summarization, resolution notes, knowledge generation), Now Assist Virtual Agent, AI Search, and customizing skills with Now Assist Skill Kit (NASK).
* Working knowledge of agentic AI on the platform, including features available through the Australia release: building, configuring, and governing AI Agents and agentic workflows, selecting model providers (Now LLM Service or third-party models), and managing Now Assist administration, licensing tiers, and guardrails.
* Experience with Customer Service Portal, Service Portal, UI Builder, and Workspaces (Customer Service Workspace).
* Understanding of order-to-cash, quote-to-order, entitlement, and warranty / contract processes.
* Familiarity with Agile (Scrum / SAFe) delivery, user story writing, and tools such as ServiceNow Agile Development, Jira, or Azure DevOps.
* Ability to write functional specifications, test cases, and process documentation, and to present solutions to technical and non-technical audiences.

****Preferred Qualifications****

* Hands-on MCO experience, including manufacturing commercial processes such as contracts, pricing, and order-to-delivery visibility.
* Experience with Configure, Price, Quote (CPQ) solutions, such as ServiceNow Sales and Order Management quoting, Salesforce CPQ, or Oracle CPQ, including product catalogs, pricing rules, quote-to-order flows, and integration with order management and ERP systems (a strong advantage).
* Additional ServiceNow certifications: Certified Technical Architect (in progress), Integration Hub, Performance Analytics, Now Assist / Generative AI / Agentic AI, or Predictive Intelligence.
* Experience building custom AI skills and AI Agents or using Build Agent to create agentic workflows for custom applications, and keeping pace with new AI capabilities in each ServiceNow family release.
* Experience integrating ServiceNow with ERP (Oracle Fusion), CRM (Salesforce), PLM, or MES systems.
* Experience with CI/CD and source control for ServiceNow (for example, Git integration, ATF automated testing).
* Exposure to data analytics and reporting tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
* Prior experience coordinating large/small projects or mentoring junior team members.

****Core Skills And Working Conditions****
**Core skills**

* Analytical and problem-solving ability, with a bias toward root-cause resolution over workarounds.
* Clear written and verbal communication, including facilitating workshops and explaining technical concepts to business users.
* Stakeholder management and the ability to balance multiple priorities across commercial, service, and manufacturing teams.
* Customer-centric mindset, with a focus on measurable outcomes and user adoption.
* Ownership, attention to detail, and comfort being self-directed in a fast-paced, Agile environment.
* Collaboration with onshore and offshore development partners.

**Working conditions**

* Primarily remote-based, with occasional travel.
* Participation in an on-call rotation for critical production issues and occasional after-hours release or upgrade support.

We are only considering candidates local to position location and are unable to provide relocation for this position. This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

description:
IFS is a billion-dollar revenue company with 7000+ employees on all continents. Our leading AI technology is the backbone of our award-winning enterprise software solutions, enabling our customers to be their best when it really matters–at the Moment of Service™. Our commitment to internal AI adoption has allowed us to stay at the forefront of technological advancements, ensuring our colleagues can unlock their creativity and productivity, and our solutions are always cutting-edge.

We help solve some of society’s greatest challenges, fostering a better future through our agility, collaboration, and trust.

We celebrate diversity and understand our responsibility to reflect the diverse world we work in. We are committed to promoting an inclusive workforce that fully represents the many different cultures, backgrounds, and viewpoints of our customers, our partners, and our communities. As a truly international company serving people from around the globe, we realize that our success is tantamount to the respect we have for those different points of view.

By joining our team, you will have the opportunity to be part of a
**global, diverse environment;**
you will be joining a
**winning team**
with a
**commitment to sustainability;**
and a company where we get things done so that you can
**make a positive impact**
on the world.

We’re looking for innovative and original thinkers to work in an environment where you can
**#MakeYourMoment**
so that we can help others make theirs. With the power of our AI-driven solutions, we empower our team to change the status quo and make a real difference.

If you want to change the status quo, we’ll help you make your moment. Join Team Purple. Join IFS.

**Job Description**

**About IFS Logistics**

IFS Logistics helps enterprise shippers connect transport data, manage carrier spend and automate execution. The product began as 7bridges and is now part of IFS, with a small team building and running it.

**The role**

We are hiring two Tech Onboarding Engineers for six-month fixed-term roles, starting as soon as possible. You will connect carriers and providers, bring customer data into the platform and help named customers reach production while the core squads continue building longer-term foundations.

The work is hands-on integration engineering. You will deal with ERP exports, shipment files, invoices, APIs and third-party feeds that are rarely as clean or stable as their documentation suggests.

The goal is not simply to process more onboarding work. When the same manual step appears repeatedly, you will turn it into a template, configuration option, self-service tool or well-defined product change. By the end of the contract, the platform should need less manual onboarding than it did when you joined.

This is a genuine six-month engagement with no implied permanent conversion.

**What you'll work on**

* Connect new carriers and providers through APIs and file feeds, including credentials, testing and go-live support.
* Map, clean and validate customer ERP exports, shipment files and invoices into our data model.
* Own onboarding tasks for named customers against clear delivery dates.
* Support the Product Operations team as they onboard customers and handle master data management.
* Diagnose failures involving authentication, pagination, rate limits, schema changes and poor source data.
* Convert repeated manual steps into reusable templates, configuration or self-service tooling.
* Document integrations and failure modes so the core squads can support them after the contract ends.

**Qualifications**

**What we're looking for**

* Around two to five years of hands-on software or integration engineering experience.
* Python and enough SQL to investigate data properly.
* Experience with REST APIs, authentication, pagination, retries and rate limits.
* Confidence working with inconsistent third-party data, including missing fields, changing schemas and bad encodings.
* A track record of automating repeated work rather than quietly absorbing it.
* The ability to run a technical working session with a customer's team and communicate data problems clearly.
* Regular use of AI coding tools such as Cursor or Claude, with a reliable process for checking output.
* The ability to organise your own work and become productive quickly in a time-boxed engagement.

**Nice to have**

* Logistics, freight, parcel or supply-chain data experience.
* BigQuery, dbt or comparable data-warehouse tooling.
* EDI or carrier and 3PL integrations.
* Previous onboarding or implementation engineering in a SaaS company.

**Tech stack**

Python and Django REST, TypeScript, Node and React; BigQuery, dbt, Cube Cloud and Superset; Pub/Sub and Datastream; GCP, Kubernetes, Terraform and GitLab CI/CD. We use Cursor and Claude for development, Notion for specifications and Jira for delivery.

**What success looks like in the first six months**

* The named customers assigned to you are live on time.
* New carrier and provider integrations are running with their known failure modes documented.
* At least two previously manual onboarding steps have become self-service or automated.
* The permanent squads have a clear, usable handover for every integration you owned.

**Why we're hiring now**

Customer and carrier onboarding demand is higher than the core squads can absorb while they improve the platform itself. These roles provide immediate delivery capacity and turn the lessons from current onboardings into better tooling for the next ones.

**Additional Information**

*We embrace flexibility and hybrid work opportunities to support diverse needs and lifestyles, while also valuing inclusive workplace experiences. By fostering a sense of community, we drive innovation, strengthen connections, and nurture belonging. Our commitment ensures you can work in a way that suits you best, while also engaging with colleagues to share ideas and build meaningful relationships.*

title: Sr. Manager, Data Engineering
description:
**Role Summary**
We're looking for a Senior Manager to lead a blended AI engineering team building the agentic AI platform and the marketing solutions that run on top of it. This is a delivery-leadership role: you own the roadmap, execution, and quality bar for a team of platform engineers, applied-AI solutions builders, and data engineering — turning cutting-edge agentic AI into reliable, production systems that marketing and analytics teams depend on every day.
  
  
You will operate at the intersection of platform and product: hardening the agentic infrastructure (LLM orchestration, retrieval, tool/MCP integration, deploys, reliability) while making sure the AI solutions built on it deliver real marketing outcomes. You'll grow the people on your team, set a high engineering bar, and partner across a global AI organization.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
**Platform & infrastructure**

* Own delivery and reliability of the agentic AI platform: LLM orchestration, retrieval/RAG pipelines, tool and MCP integration, model routing, and evaluation.
* Drive engineering quality — test discipline, deployment safety, observability, cost and latency management — across everything the team ships.
* Set technical direction with your senior engineers; make the hard architecture calls and unblock the team (design-level involvement; not expected to write production code day-to-day).

**Applied AI solutions**

* Lead the team that builds AI agents and workflows for marketing use cases (analytics, paid media, content-to-intent, executive reporting) on top of the platform.
* Ensure solutions are grounded in real business outcomes and adopted by stakeholders — not demos that stall.
* Balance platform investment against solution delivery so both advance.

**People leadership & delivery**

* Manage, coach, and grow a blended team; run hiring to build out the function.
* Own the roadmap and quarterly planning; convert ambiguous priorities into committed, sequenced delivery.
* Represent the team's work to leadership and cross-functional partners; drive alignment across a globally distributed AI organization.

**The Team You'll Lead**
A blended engineering team of:
  
  

* Agentic AI / platform engineers — Python, LLM orchestration, RAG, MCP/tooling, cloud-native deploys.
* Applied-AI solutions builders — wiring AI to marketing and analytics use cases.
* Data engineering — the pipelines and semantic layer the AI grounds on.

**Must-Have Qualifications**

* ~12+ years in software / AI/ML engineering, with 4+ years managing engineering teams (including hiring and growing engineers).
* Demonstrated depth in agentic AI / LLM systems — orchestration, retrieval/RAG, tool use, agent frameworks, and evaluation of AI quality.
* Track record of shipping production AI/ML systems at scale — reliability, deployment safety, cost/latency awareness — not just prototypes.
* Strong Python and modern cloud-native / containerized delivery.
* Ability to set a high engineering bar and make sound architecture decisions while leading primarily through the team.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management across a globally distributed organization.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Marketing technology or analytics domain experience — AEP / AJO / CJA, adtech, or digital marketing analytics.
* Experience with Databricks, vector databases (pgvector), graph stores (Neo4j), or similar data/AI infrastructure.
* Hands-on with agent/LLM frameworks and MCP, prompt/eval tooling, and LLM cost governance.
* Experience standing up or scaling a new AI engineering function.

**What Success Looks Like (First 6–12 Months)**

* A team operating with a clear roadmap, predictable delivery, and a visibly higher quality/reliability bar.
* At least one AI solution moved from concept to in-production use, adopted by marketing/analytics stakeholders.
* Platform reliability, evaluation, and cost/observability practices established as the default, not the exception.
* Key hires made; team members growing and taking on larger scope.

**Leadership Behaviors**

* Candor and clarity — lead with the bottom line, disagree openly, separate fact from guess, flag risks early.
* Ownership — own outcomes end-to-end, not just handoffs; the team ships things that work and says so honestly when they don't.
* Bar-raiser — hire people better than the current team and hold a high engineering standard.

**Builder's bias —**
move fast on real problems, cut scope ruthlessly, prefer working systems over polished plans.

title: Creative Technologist-AI Studio
description:

Workflow Automation
  
  

* Generative AI
* Creative Production

The Opportunity
  
  
Adobe’s AI Studio partners with the world’s leading brands to produce campaign creative at scale. Creative Technologists are the builders at the center of that production engine — designing and maintaining the automated workflows that allow our Creative Designers to move faster, produce more, and focus on what only humans can do.
  
  
As Creative Technologist, you will architect and operate the technical infrastructure behind AI Studio’s creative production workflows. You bring deep hands-on fluency in ComfyUI, Weavy, and other node based design apps. and you know how to stitch those tools together into production-grade systems that scale. You are equally comfortable in a technical build session and a customer conversation , and you take personal ownership of the reliability and quality of everything you ship.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  
Build and Operate Production Workflows
  
  

* Design, build, and maintain automated creative production workflows.
* Architect end-to-end pipelines that integrate generative AI outputs into brand-compliant, activation-ready creative assets.
* Develop and maintain reusable workflow components, node libraries, and prompt templates that accelerate production across the team.
* Optimize pipelines for throughput and consistency, enabling high-volume variant production across formats, channels, and aspect ratios.
* Monitor workflow performance, diagnose failures, and continuously improve reliability and output quality.

Collaborate with Creative and Operations Teams
  
  

* Partner closely with Creative Designers, Motion Designers, and Content Operations Leads to translate campaign briefs into automated production pipelines.
* Serve as the technical bridge between creative intent and workflow execution — ensuring that automated outputs meet the quality bar set by the creative team.
* Document workflows, configurations, and best practices so the full team can build on and maintain your work.
* Contribute to a growing internal knowledge base of workflow patterns, prompting strategies, and tooling integrations.

Partner with Customers and Inform the Product
  
  

* Engage directly with customer counterparts to understand technical requirements and configure workflows that meet their brand and production standards.
* Present workflow logic and capabilities clearly to non-technical stakeholders, translating complexity into confidence.
* Provide structured feedback on Adobe tools and adjacent tools to help inform Adobe’s product roadmap.
* Stay current on emerging tools and techniques — and bring what’s working back to the team.

What We’re Looking For
  
  

* 5+ years of experience in creative technology, workflow automation, or a related technical role — agency, in-house, or production studio environments all translate well.
* Hands-on proficiency with ComfyUI, including custom node development, pipeline design, and troubleshooting.
* Fluency in Adobe Creative Cloud; working knowledge of Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, and related tools as workflow inputs and outputs.
* Solid understanding of generative AI models, image generation pipelines, and prompt engineering best practices.
* Ability to read and write code sufficient for workflow scripting and automation — Python, JavaScript, or equivalent is a strong plus.
* Experience integrating APIs and third-party tools into production pipelines.
* Strong communication skills across creative, technical, and business audiences.
* A high bar for quality and a sense of ownership over the systems and outputs you build.
* Comfort operating in a fast-moving environment with shifting priorities and tight timelines.
* Experience in digital marketing, campaign production, or creative operations is a strong plus.

title: Quality Technical Specialist – Customer Quality & Locomotive Testing
description:
**Job Description**
The
**Quality Technical Specialist**
provides strategic leadership for Customer Quality, Pre-Delivery Inspection (PDI), and Locomotive Testing Quality, ensuring product compliance with customer, regulatory, and organizational requirements while optimizing Cost of Quality. The role is accountable for driving quality excellence through robust quality systems, defect prevention, reliability improvement, and continuous process enhancement.
  
  
As a key quality Specialist, the incumbent leads a team of Quality Inspectors and partners closely with Operations, Engineering, Program Management, Service Quality, Reliability, and Supplier Quality teams to achieve world-class product quality, customer satisfaction, and operational performance.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**

* Lead Customer Quality, PDI, and Locomotive Testing Quality activities to ensure flawless product build Quality and and customer satisfaction.
* Champion a First-Time-Right culture through rigorous testing, inspection, documentation, and process discipline.
* Drive structured RCA, CAPA, and defect prevention strategies for manufacturing, reliability, and field quality issues.
* Ensure effective management and closure of NCMRs, quality escapes, audit findings, and corrective actions.
* Maintain compliance with QMS, ISO standards, customer specifications, and regulatory requirements.
* Establish and continuously improve inspection, testing, and detection plans across incoming, in-process, and finished product stages.
* Lead cross-functional quality improvement initiatives focused on product reliability, process capability, and operational excellence.
* Drive the vision of Zero Defects, Zero Customer Escapes, and a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.
* Develop organizational capability through coaching, auditing, training, and implementation of quality best practices.
* Promote strong EHS and compliance standards across all quality activities.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Electronics or Mechanical Engineering
* 12–16 years of progressive experience in Complex Products testing, troubleshooting and Customer Quality, preferably from Locomotive or Rolling Stock, Heavy Machinery, or related industry
* Strong technical expertise in locomotive systems, troubleshooting, testing and manufacturing processes
* Demonstrated experience with APQP, PPAP, NPI, Problem Solving and customer quality management
* Qualified Process Auditor with working knowledge of ISO and QMS
* Six Sigma Green Belt or equivalent problem-solving and continuous improvement experience

**Leadership Competencies**

* Customer-centric mindset with a strong focus on quality and reliability
* Proven ability to lead teams and influence cross-functional stakeholders
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities
* Effective communicator with excellent presentation and stakeholder management skills
* Results-oriented, data-driven, and committed to operational excellence

title: System Administrator
description:
**Job Summary**
We are looking for a skilled and proactive System Administrator to manage, maintain, and support the company's IT infrastructure, systems, servers, and network operations.
  
  
The ideal candidate should have
**hands-on experience in system administration, network management**
,
**troubleshooting, IT security, and infrastructure maintenance**
to ensure smooth and uninterrupted business operations.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot physical and virtual servers, desktops, laptops, printers, and other IT hardware and peripherals.
* Administer Windows Server environments and Active Directory, including user account creation, onboarding and offboarding, group policies, and access permissions.
* Monitor and maintain LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, and VPN connectivity, including routers, switches, and firewall configurations.
* Monitor system health and performance, proactively identify and resolve issues, and minimize infrastructure downtime.
* Deploy, manage, and monitor virtualized environments on VMware and Hyper-V, including virtual machine provisioning, resource allocation, snapshots, and host maintenance.
* Administer Microsoft Azure resources, including virtual machines, storage, networking, identity and access, and cost monitoring, and support connectivity between on-premises and cloud environments.
* Apply operating system updates and security patches on a regular schedule across servers, virtual hosts, and end-user devices.
* Perform and monitor scheduled data backups of physical servers, virtual machines, and cloud workloads, test restores periodically, and support disaster recovery procedures.
* Maintain system security through endpoint protection and antivirus management, access control, and adherence to security best practices.
* Provide technical support to employees for hardware, software, network, and system-related issues, and log and resolve requests within defined timelines.
* Administer email systems, domain and DNS services, and Microsoft 365 / Office 365, including mailboxes, licenses, and security settings.
* Maintain IT asset inventory, software licenses, and up-to-date system and network documentation.
* Coordinate with vendors and service providers for IT-related purchases, maintenance contracts, and support.
* Ensure compliance with IT policies and prepare periodic reports on IT operations, incidents, and system status.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 1-2 years of relevant experience in System Administration or IT Infrastructure Support.
* Strong knowledge of Windows Server administration and Active Directory.
* Good understanding of networking concepts, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, LAN, WAN, and VPN.
* Hands-on experience with firewall, antivirus, and endpoint security management.
* Knowledge of backup and disaster recovery solutions.
* Familiarity with Microsoft 365 / Office 365 administration.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple IT support requirements.

**Preferred Skills**

* Knowledge of Linux server administration.
* Hands-on experience with virtualization platforms such as VMware or Hyper-V.
* Hands-on experience with cloud platforms, preferably Microsoft Azure.
* Knowledge of IT security practices and network monitoring tools.
* Relevant certifications such as Microsoft, CompTIA Network+, CCNA, or equivalent would be an advantage.

**Key Competencies**

* Technical troubleshooting and analytical skills.
* Time management and prioritization.
* Ownership and accountability.
* Effective communication and teamwork.
* Ability to handle IT support requests and resolve issues within defined timelines.

description:
**About Avaya**
---------------

Avaya is an enterprise software leader that helps the world’s largest organizations and government agencies forge unbreakable connections.

The Avaya Infinity™ platform unifies fragmented customer experiences, connecting the channels, insights, technologies, and workflows that together create enduring customer and employee relationships.

We believe success is built through strong connections – with each other, with our work, and with our mission. At Avaya, you'll find a community that values your contributions and supports your growth every step of the way.

Learn more at https://www.avaya.com

**Job Information**
-------------------

Job Code: 00194005

Job Family: Research and Development

Job Function: Software Engineering

**About The Role**
------------------

We are seeking a highly experienced and visionary Lead AI Application Engineer to join our core AI team. This pivotal role will be instrumental in designing, developing, and deploying advanced Machine Learning, Generative AI and Agentic AI applications across high-throughput, real-time streaming environments . You are an engineer’s engineer, someone who spent years training, tuning, and deploying models at scale, and who has spearheaded Generative and Agentic AI over the last 3–4 years. This is an exceptional opportunity for an individual who thrives on building sophisticated, production-grade Autonomous AI systems and wants to make a significant impact.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Technical Architecture & System Design**

  

* Architect and operationalize end-to-end autonomous agentic systems (multi-agent orchestration, dynamic tool-calling, reflection, planner-executor loops, and persistent state management).
* Design robust LLM runtime infrastructure, including hybrid retrieval architectures (Advanced RAG, graph-based context grounding, vector databases, re-rankers, semantic routing).
* Establish scalable evaluation, guardrail, and observability frameworks (latency optimization, cost governors, hallucinations/drift detection, alignment checks, red-teaming).
* Make high-stakes architectural decisions regarding model topologies (proprietary frontier models vs. distilled/fine-tuned SLMs, LoRA, quantization, self-hosted vs. managed endpoints).

#### **Hands-On Execution & Prototyping**

  

* Lead from the front: write high-leverage production code, design critical framework primitives, and rapidly de-risk zero-to-one concepts via functional PoCs.
* Bridge cutting-edge research and production engineering, ensuring systems are resilient, fault-tolerant, secure, and performant at scale.

#### **Strategy & Cross-Functional Influence**

  

* Partner directly with the Head of AI, Product leadership, and VP-level stakeholders to chart the AI technology roadmap and identify transformative capability unlocks.
* Lead the exploration and application of Large Language Models, Agentic AI and Generative AI, venturing into new areas within these fields.
* Represent the company’s AI thought leadership through open-source contributions, technical papers, conferences, or industry forums.
  

#### **Other Responsibilities**

  

* Architect, Design and Build robust, scalable, and efficient AI systems leveraging a variety of AI/ML, data science, deep learning, and agentic AI frameworks.
* Drive the integration of complex Model Context Protocol (MCP) and agent-to-agent (A2A) communication protocols, ensuring seamless interaction and optimal performance.
* Design and implement scalable and efficient AI/ML systems, architectures, and pipelines that can handle large volumes of data and deliver accurate and timely results.
* Regularly self-educate while mentoring and provide technical leadership to other engineers, fostering a culture of continuous learning and excellence.

**Who we are looking for -**
----------------------------

* **Experience**: 15+ years of hands-on software development experience, including 5+ years actively building and deploying Generative AI and Agentic AI applications in production.
* **Core Engineering & AI Building:** Hands-on builder capable of independently architecting, coding, and deploying custom AI tools, autonomous agents, and bots from scratch.
* **Programming Mastery:** 8+ years writing production-grade code in Python or similar languages with deep expertise in scalable software design, APIs, and microservices.
* **Agentic Frameworks & Tools:** Deep proficiency with frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, Auto-GPT, CrewAI, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) for multi-agent coordination.
* **LLMs & Fine-Tuning:** Practical experience with frontier models (GPT-4, Gemini, Claude), fine-tuning, prompt engineering, and custom agentic tool-calling workflows.
* **ML/DL Foundations:** Background in training, tuning, and running models using PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Scikit-learn in high-throughput environments.
* **Inference & Acceleration:** Familiarity with inference engines (vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, TGI) and cloud ML infrastructure (NVIDIA GPUs, TPUs).
* **Data & Memory Infrastructure:** Experience building low-latency vector search indices, in-memory caching layers, streaming pipelines (Kafka/Flink), and NoSQL datastores to power real-time agent context and memory.
* **Education**: Master's or Ph.D. in Computer Science, AI, ML, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent practical experience).
  

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

  

* Autonomous Execution: Proven track record as a senior IC who takes total ownership—from zero-to-one prototyping to production rollout.
* Cloud & DevOps: Exposure to AWS, Azure, or GCP environments with modern containerized deployment (Kubernetes, Docker).
* Domain & Communication: Experience in contact center/telecom/CX platforms is a plus; excellent technical communication skills required.

**Experience**
--------------

12+ Years of Experience

**Education**
-------------

Bachelor degree or equivalent experience

Advance Degree preferred in Computer Science or Related Field

**Footer**
----------

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future.

Avaya is an Equal Opportunity employer and a U.S. Federal Contractor. Our commitment to equality is a core value of Avaya. All qualified applicants and employees receive equal treatment without consideration for race, religion, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran or any other protected characteristic. In general, positions at Avaya require the ability to communicate and use office technology effectively. Physical requirements may vary by assigned work location. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100\* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

As a Senior Solutions Architect on GitLab's India team, you'll be a trusted advisor to prospects, customers, and partners across India. You'll help them understand how GitLab's AI-powered DevSecOps platform addresses technical requirements and business goals across the software development lifecycle. This role supports Commercial and Enterprise segments in India's Southern Region. Experience with Global Capability Centers (GCCs), Digital Native organizations, and startups is highly valued given the accounts you'll support.

Your work will help customers adopt GitLab successfully, support revenue growth through solution selling, and build long-term, trusted relationships.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Lead technical discovery, demonstrations, and validation to show how GitLab's AI-powered DevSecOps platform meets customers' technical and business needs across the software development lifecycle.
* Own the technical evaluation process, including solution design, proofs of concept or value, workshops, and technical contributions to tenders, audits, and value stream assessments.
* Collaborate with Account Executives and regional sales teams across Commercial and Enterprise segments to shape account strategies for new customer acquisition and expansion, with a focus on GCC, Digital Native, and startup accounts.

* Represent GitLab at online and in-person marketing events, including webinars, industry events, presentations, roundtables, panels, demonstration days, and hackathons.
* Build trusted relationships with technical practitioners and business leaders, guide GitLab-driven transformation, and help customers become GitLab advocates.
* Advise customers on modern software development, continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD), security, and cloud practices to improve their return on investment.
* Share customer feedback, use cases, and competitive insights with Product Management, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing while continuing to build expertise and reusable guidance in GitLab, DevSecOps, AI, and cloud technologies.

* Experience guiding Commercial and Enterprise customers through solution design and evaluation in technical presales, consulting, or a similar role.

* Knowledge of the end-to-end software development lifecycle, including modern DevSecOps practices and CI/CD workflows.

* Practical knowledge of cloud computing concepts and related technologies, including deployment, security, and operations options.
* Ability to lead proofs of concept or value, contribute to tenders or audits, and design and run workshops or value stream assessments.
* Clear technical communication and presentation skills, with the ability to adapt your message for practitioners and senior business and technical decision-makers.
* Skill in building trusted relationships, listening with empathy, advocating for customers, collaborating with go-to-market or Professional Services partners, and continuously learning new technologies.

The Solutions Architect team is part of GitLab's Sales organization and serves as the technical counterpart to Account Executives. This role focuses on Commercial and Enterprise opportunities across India's Southern Region and works with Account Executives, the broader go-to-market team, and regional partners that provide Professional Services. The team advises on architecture, runs technical evaluations such as proofs of value, and guides customers through digital transformation. We collaborate asynchronously with Sales, Product Management, Engineering, and Marketing to share effective practices, create reusable technical resources, and represent the voice of the customer.
