As the firm modernizes infrastructure, strengthens cyber resilience, expands cloud connectivity, and improves global platform reliability, EY requires a senior product leader to provide end-to-end ownership of the global datacenter dataroom network product portfolio.
  
  
The Senior Network Product Manager will own network strategy, roadmap, lifecycle, standards, observability, service health, and vendor governance. This role requires deep technical credibility across Cisco and Arista route/switch platforms, VXLAN, L2/L3 networking, WAN, routing protocols, and network management tools, combined with practical product leadership and executive communication skills.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Product Strategy and Ownership
  
  

* Own the global Network Product strategy, roadmap, standards, and lifecycle management.
* Define multi-year modernization plans for network resiliency, security, automation, supportability, and simplification.
* Align network capabilities with business priorities, cloud strategy, regulatory obligations, cyber requirements, and operational needs.
* Define product KPIs, OKRs, service levels, technical debt plans, capacity trends, and platform health metrics.
* Partner with engineering, operations, security, procurement, and finance teams to support roadmap execution and investment planning.

Technical Product Leadership
  
  

* Act as the senior product owner and technical authority for enterprise route/switch networking across data centers, data rooms, campus, WAN, and cloud connectivity.
* Provide product direction for Cisco Catalyst 9000, Cisco Nexus, Arista switching, routers, load balancer connectivity, DCI, and network segmentation patterns.
* Guide architecture standards for VXLAN EVPN fabrics, L2/L3 designs, routing domains, high availability, resiliency, and failover patterns.
* Ensure network standards account for OSPF, EIGRP, BGP, route redistribution, multicast, QoS, network segmentation, and secure connectivity requirements.
* Review product risks, design gaps, lifecycle exposure, and operational friction points across the global network estate.

Network Observability and Intelligence
  
  

* Own product strategy for syslog, telemetry, packet visibility, network performance monitoring, configuration compliance, and network maps.
* Improve visibility into device health, topology, routing state, capacity, configuration drift, fault domains, and service impact.
* Drive adoption of proactive monitoring, event correlation, root cause analysis, and automated runbook capabilities.
* Establish network health dashboards used by operations, engineering, security, and leadership teams.

Lifecycle, Risk, and Compliance
  
  

* Maintain product lifecycle plans for hardware, software, firmware, support contracts, end-of-life, end-of-support, and vulnerability exposure.
* Partner with cyber, risk, and operations teams to prioritize patching, remediation, modernization, and compensating controls.
* Ensure audit-ready documentation, ownership clarity, design traceability, and standard evidence for critical network products.
* Drive technical debt reduction and simplify non-standard designs, legacy connectivity, and unsupported platforms.

Vendor and Partner Governance
  
  

* Govern network delivery from strategic partners, managed service providers, telecom carriers, Cisco, Arista, and network tooling vendors.
* Review vendor designs, operational changes, implementation plans, support performance, and service quality against product standards.
* Hold partners accountable for resiliency, documentation, standards compliance, operational readiness, and measurable outcomes.
* Influence sourcing, contract renewals, support models, licensing, and platform investment decisions.

Automation and Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Champion network automation, configuration standardization, and infrastructure-as-code practices.
* Drive use of APIs, Ansible, Git-based network configuration, telemetry, and orchestration to reduce manual effort and improve control.
* Promote repeatable deployment models, self-service capabilities, automated compliance checks, and self-healing operations where practical.

Core Technical Expertise
  
  
**Domain**
**Expected Knowledge**
**Cisco Platforms**
Cisco Catalyst 9000, Cisco Nexus, IOS-XE, NX-OS, route/switch, HA patterns, software lifecycle, Smart Licensing, TAC engagement
  
  
**Arista Platforms**
Arista data center and campus switching, EOS, CloudVision concepts, route/switch operations, lifecycle and support models
  
  
**Network Architecture**
L2/L3 enterprise networking, data center fabrics, VXLAN EVPN, DCI, LAN, campus, WAN, SD-WAN, cloud connectivity
  
  
**Routing and Switching**
OSPF, EIGRP, BGP, route redistribution, STP, VLANs, VRFs, multicast, QoS, HSRP/VRRP, ECMP, segmentation
  
  
**Observability and Tools**
NetBrain, SNMP, syslog, telemetry, packet capture, ThousandEyes, SolarWinds, LogicMonitor, Elastic.
  
  
**Automation and Governance**
Ansible, APIs, templates, configuration compliance, drift monitoring, Git-based workflows, policy-based controls, runbook automation
  
  
**Risk and Lifecycle**
EOL/EOS, vulnerability remediation, firmware/software upgrades, capacity planning, resiliency testing, audit evidence, documentation standards
  
  
**Skills And Experience**

* 14+ years of progressive enterprise networking experience in large, global, highly regulated environments.
* 5+ years of product ownership, platform ownership, architecture leadership, or senior network engineering leadership experience.
* Proven experience managing network product roadmaps, lifecycle plans, budgets, vendor governance, and operational performance.
* Deep hands-on understanding of Cisco and Arista route/switch technologies with ability to challenge designs and guide standards.
* Strong understanding of LAN, WAN, data center, cloud connectivity, routing protocols, network segmentation, and resiliency engineering.
* Experience building product health dashboards, service metrics, technical debt plans, and leadership-facing executive updates.
* Ability to communicate clearly with executives, technical teams, security stakeholders, procurement, finance, and vendor partners.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* CCIE Enterprise Infrastructure, CCNP Enterprise, Arista ACE, cloud networking, or equivalent practical expertise.
* Experience with network automation, telemetry, NPM/NCM tooling, and configuration compliance platforms.
* Experience operating global network services across multiple data centers, regions, business-critical sites, and cloud providers.
* ITIL, product management, Agile, or service ownership experience.
* Experience modernizing legacy network estates and reducing vendor dependency through standards, automation, and better documentation.

Success Measures
  
  

* Clear product roadmap with measurable delivery milestones and funding alignment.
* Reduced lifecycle risk across network hardware, software, firmware, and support contracts.
* Improved network availability, observability, configuration compliance, and incident response quality.
* Standardized designs and documentation across global data center, data room, WAN, and cloud connectivity services.
* Measurable reduction in technical debt, non-standard patterns, vendor ambiguity, and operational handoff gaps.

description:
**How You'll Help Us Keep Climbing (Overview & Key Responsibilities)**
**About The Team /role Overview**
We are looking for a Salesforce Solutions Specialist to support, enhance, and evolve Delta Air Lines’ Salesforce capabilities. This role combines Salesforce Administration, Production Support, Release Management, and technical platform support responsibilities. The successful candidate will partner with business stakeholders, product teams, architects, and technical teams to deliver scalable solutions, support production operations, drive continuous improvements, and contribute to Delta’s digital transformation initiatives.

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business, or related field.

* Experience supporting Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and/or Experience Cloud.
* Experience with production support, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis.
* Excellent communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Ability to work in collaborative environments and embrace diverse perspectives.
* Communicate clearly and concisely, express thoughts and ideas effectively, and embrace cultural differences with respect when engaging with others.
* Ability to engage effectively with peers and stakeholders to build strong partnerships.
* Prioritize, maintain focus, and consistently deliver commitment.
* Proactively understand customer expectations and willingness to create customer-based solutions.

**What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)**

* Salesforce Certified Administrator.
* Salesforce Certified Platform App Builder or Advanced Administrator.
* Salesforce Platform Developer I Certification.
* Hands-on experience with Apex, Lightning Web Components, and Triggers.
* Experience with Copado, Git, and CI/CD practices.
* Experience with Salesforce integration and API-based solutions.
* Knowledge of airline industry processes is a plus.

**About The Company**
What started as a humble, little aerial crop-dusting operation called Huff Daland Dusters in 1924 has now grown into the U.S. global airline leader in safety, innovation, reliability, and customer experience. Headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, Delta Air Lines is known for its operational excellence and award-winning customer service.
  
  
Powered by our employees worldwide, Delta has led the airline industry in operational excellence for a decade while maintaining our reputation for award-winning customer service. With our mission of connecting the people and cultures of the globe, Delta strives to foster understanding across a diverse world and serve as a force for social good.
  
  
In 2026, Delta Air Lines continued to earn global recognition for its performance, culture and operational excellence. Delta was named to Glassdoor’s 2026 Top 100 Best Places to Work list for the ninth time, standing as the only airline recognized. Delta also secured the 11th spot on Fortune’s World’s Most Admired Companies list, marking its 13th consecutive year earning this distinction. Delta was also recognized by Cirium as the top on-time airline in North America for the fifth consecutive year, underscoring its unwavering commitment to reliability and customer experience.
  
  
**About The Delta Technology Hub (DTH), Bangalore**
The DTH is one of Delta Air Lines' investments in world-class business capabilities and technology aimed at transforming how Delta Air Lines operates and provides world-class travel experiences to its customers through innovation and cutting-edge methodologies. By continuously reimagining processes and driving technology-led transformation, the Delta Technology Hub plays a pivotal role in Scripting The Future of Aviation. The organization is certified by the Great Place to Work Institute (India). The Delta Technology Hub was a finalist for the iVolunteer Awards 2024/2025 in the "Leader in Employee Volunteering" category. This nomination highlights our remarkable volunteering initiatives and the outstanding practices we implement to encourage and support our employee volunteering program. For more information, please visit www.deltatechhub.com
  
  
**Why join?**

* Technology is a key enabler of the differentiated services that Delta provides. At the DTH, you get the opportunity to work on projects with a significant impact on business outcomes and customer experience.
* Deepen your knowledge by taking part in multifaceted learning and development programs –exposure to extensive internal and partner repositories, institutional affiliations, and industry SIG (Special Interest Groups) partnerships.
* Immerse yourself in an employee-centric culture.
* Develop deep and broad business acumen on airline operations while retaining focus on cutting-edge technology driven solutions.
* Avail a full range of benefits that support you and your family: Medical Insurance, Transportation to and from the DTH office, Complementary Cafeteria Meals, Special Travel opportunities and Travel Privileges, Car Lease Program, Paid time off, Parental Benefits and National Pension Scheme.

title: Basis Senior Analysts
description:
At Zimmer Biomet, we believe in pushing the boundaries of innovation and driving our mission forward. As a global medical technology leader for nearly 100 years, a patient’s mobility is enhanced by a Zimmer Biomet product or technology every 8 seconds. As a Zimmer Biomet team member, you will share in our commitment to providing mobility and renewed life to people around the world. To support our talent team, we focus on development opportunities, robust employee resource groups (ERGs), a flexible working environment, location specific competitive total rewards, wellness incentives and a culture of recognition and performance awards. We are committed to creating an environment where every team member feels included, respected, empowered and recognised.
  
  
What You Can Expect
  
  
The SAP Basis Senior Analyst is a senior technical expert responsible for the administration, stability, performance, and optimization of enterprise SAP landscapes. This role leads complex
  
  
Basis activities, provides advanced troubleshooting, and serves as a technical escalation point while partnering closely with Application, Infrastructure, Security, and Architecture teams.
  
  
The role focuses on operational excellence, system modernization, and reliability across SAP ECC and S/4HANA environments and operates without direct people-management responsibility.
  
  
This role includes accountability for modern SAP operations, incorporating AIOps, predictive monitoring, and operational automation to proactively detect issues, optimize performance, and improve enterprise system reliability across SAP landscapes.
  
  
Work Location: Bangalore
  
  
Work Mode: Hybrid (3 Days in office)
  
  
Shift Timing - 3:00 PM - 12:00 AM
  
  
How You'll Create Impact
  
  
**SAP System Administration & Operations**

* Administer and support complex SAP landscapes across DEV, QA, and PROD environments
* Lead system copies, client refreshes, upgrades, kernel patches, and support pack implementations
* Manage SAP transports, background jobs, spool systems, and system configurations
* Ensure SAP systems meet availability, performance, and SLA requirements
* Standardize and automate recurring SAP Basis operational activities to improve consistency, scalability, and reliability
* Design and maintain repeatable operational processes supporting enterprise SAP platforms
* Apply platform ownership principles to ensure long‑term operational sustainability

**Performance, Stability & Troubleshooting**

* Perform advanced performance tuning and capacity planning for SAP systems
* Act as senior escalation point for complex Basis and system-level issues
* Lead structured root-cause analysis and remediation for production incidents
* Proactively identify risks and recommend preventive actions
* Utilize predictive performance and capacity analytics to identify and mitigate potential system issues before service impact
* Leverage event correlation and anomaly detection across SAP, database, operating system, and infrastructure layers
* Apply data‑driven operational insights to proactively reduce incidents and system downtime

**Security, Compliance & Audit Support**

* Partner with Security and GRC teams on SAP security configuration and compliance support
* Support audit activities (e.g., SOX ITGC, access reviews, system controls)
* Ensure SAP systems comply with enterprise security and regulatory standards
* Support continuous compliance monitoring and automated evidence collection for audit and regulatory requirements

**Change, Transport & Release Management**

title: Tech Lead
description:
**Technical Lead (Lead Software Engineer) – Product Engineering - Bangalore, India**
Join the global leader in Talent Acquisition Technologies that’s committed to finding new ways to leverage software, strategy and creative to enhance our clients’ employer brands – across every connection point. We’re looking for unconventional thinkers. Relentless collaborators. And ferocious innovators. Talented individuals who are ready to work towards solutions that transform the way employers and job seekers connect.
  
  
We are looking for a deeply hands-on Technical Lead to drive the technical direction and engineering excellence for the services underpinning our market-leading B2B SaaS Talent Acquisition Platform in our Bangalore office.
  
  
As a Technical Lead, you’ll take ownership of the applications and services behind Radancy’s Talent Acquisition Platform offering. You’ll stay hands-on in writing and reviewing production code to ensure our platform is scalable, reliable, and continuously evolving to meet enterprise client needs. You will architect solutions, ensure timely developement of features, mentor talented engineers, and remain actively involved with team operations.
  
  
**What You'll Do: Core Responsibilities:**

* Team Leadership and Collaboration:

+ Lead a team of skilled Software and Quality Engineers, inspiring them to deliver their best work.
+ Collaborate closely with Product Owners, Project Managers, and Engineering Managers to execute the product roadmap seamlessly.

* Cutting-Edge Technology Stack:

+ Dive into exciting technologies, including .NET Core, Angular, JavaScript, DynamoDB, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Kafka, RabbitMQ, Redis, Jenkins, and GitHub.
+ As part of an agile Scrum team, you’ll contribute to building robust solutions.

* Ownership:

+ Write and review production code to set and maintain rigorous quality standards, ensuring solutions are robust, efficient, and maintainable under enterprise load.
+ Take ownership end-to-end — from architecture and incidents to monitoring and infrastructure.

* Engineering Excellence and Design:

+ Guide engineering aspects, from initial design to test automation and implementation.
+ Collaborate across teams to architect scalable, resilient, and elegant solutions.

* Strategic Planning and Roadmap Execution:

+ Actively participate in roadmap planning sessions, ensuring alignment with business goals.
+ Estimate delivery timelines accurately and execute flawlessly.

* Technology Exploration and Implementation:

+ Research and recommend new technologies or tools that enhance system performance, stability, and development processes.
+ Be the catalyst for adopting best practices and cutting-edge approaches.

* Security and Scalability Champion:

+ Ensure that our full-stack software solutions adhere to security best practices.
+ Architect systems that can scale effortlessly as our user base grows.

* Innovation and Reliability Advocate:

+ Investigate emerging technologies and processes.
+ Prototype solutions that elevate the feature set, speed, and reliability of our Radancy CRM platform.

* Deployment and Support:

+ Participate in production deployments, ensuring smooth transitions.
+ Provide technical troubleshooting and debug support when needed.

* Technical Documentation and Mentorship:

+ Maintain comprehensive technical documentation.
+ Mentor junior developers, sharing your expertise and fostering their growth.
+ Ensure the team has the necessary resources, knowledge, and tools to succeed in achieving objectives and delivering solutions effectively.

* Roadmap Contribution:

+ Collaborate closely with Product and Engineering peers, providing technical insights and estimates to contribute meaningfully to roadmaps and long-term planning.

* Risk & Planning:

+ Balance design choices with cost efficiency and scalability, and proactively spot risks early to propose practical solutions.

* End-to-End Ownership:

+ Take full ownership end-to-end—from architecture and infrastructure to monitoring and incident management—for your owned platform services.

* Cloud Operations:

+ Own AWS/GCP-hosted services and ensure they run smoothly and reliably at scale. Evolve infrastructure to stay modern and efficient.

* Compliance:

+ Build security into every stage of development and hosting. Keep compliance documentation clear, current, and accessible for B2B standards.

What You Bring:
  
  
Technical Expertise (Primary Focus)
  
  

* 7+ years of software engineering experience, with a proven track record of leading projects or technically guiding teams.
* 2+ Years of experience leading Software development projects and team of Engineers
* Core Language Mastery: Deep and proven expertise in C#/.NET Core and associated frameworks. (Or expertise with any other high level programming language with willingness to learn new languages as needed.)
* Database Expertise: Solid knowledge of Relational Databases (e.g., SQL Server, PostgreSQL) and experience with NoSQL solutions like MongoDB.
* Cloud-Native: Experience designing, developing, and operating services using Cloud Platforms (AWS and/or GCP).
* B2B SaaS Focus: Strong understanding of the architectural needs for high-availability, multi-tenant B2B SaaS applications.
* Scalability: Expertise in Microservices architecture, RESTful API design, and advanced system components like caching (e.g., Redis).
* Process: Comfort with Agile practices and continuous planning.

Leadership & Attributes
  
  

* A passion for mentoring and enabling other engineers to perform at their best.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills to work seamlessly with cross-functional and global teams.
* Agility to independently own and build initial solutions, executing rapid POCs to de-risk key technical decisions.
* Ability to lead the team with confidence during incidents and technical change requests.
* Analytical skills to drive data-informed decisions on quality and performance targets.

✨ Nice to Have
  
  

* Experience with Single Page Application (SPA) frameworks like Angular or React.
* Experience in the broader Talent Acquisition domain.
* Knowledge of emerging capabilities in Large Language Models (LLMs) and AI and their potential integration into user-facing solutions.
* A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

**Life at Radancy**
At Radancy, we believe that great products are built by great teams. Collaboration, learning, and trust are at the core of how we work. Our engineers are empowered to take ownership, experiment with new ideas and make decisions that create real impact.
  
  
We live by four core values:
  
  
Innovative Spirit – We challenge ourselves to think differently and push boundaries.
  
  
Rewarding Impact – Our work connects people to opportunities and helps businesses succeed worldwide.
  
  
Performance Driven – We rely on data, insights and continuous improvement.
  
  
Supportive Teams – We foster an inclusive environment where people feel valued, grow their skills and succeed together.
  
  
We know that diverse teams build better products and we’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone can contribute and thrive.
  
  
Why Join Us?
  
  
At Radancy, your work has a real impact. You’ll lead a talented engineering team, work on cutting-edge tech and help shape the future of our SaaS platform. We value innovation, collaboration and growth — and we provide the environment to make it happen.
  
  
Radancy is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes all qualified applicants regardless of race, ethnicity, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We actively work to create an inclusive environment where all of our employees can thrive. If you require any accommodations during the application process, please reach out to us at recruiting@radancy.com and we will work with you to meet your needs
  
  
If you’re excited to shape the future of Radancy’s Talent Acquisition Cloud and thrive in a supportive, innovative environment, we’d love to hear from you.

title: IT Solutions Analyst (Universal Robots, Bangalore - India)
description:
The
**IT Solutions Analyst - ServiceNow**
is the functional and technical bridge between business stakeholders and the ServiceNow platform, responsible for designing, configuring, enhancing, and supporting solutions across Customer Service Management (CSM), Manufacturing Commercial Operations (MCO), and Sales and Order Management (SOM).
  
  
This role translates customer service, asset management, contracts management, and entitlement-related requirements into scalable ServiceNow workflows, custom applications, and integrations. The analyst partners with Sales, Field Service, Customer Care, Manufacturing, and other IT teams to improve customer experience, order accuracy, and service efficiency, and acts as a subject-matter expert and escalation point for production support. As part of the IT Enterprise Applications team, the analyst also designs and supports integrations between ServiceNow and other systems, including Salesforce, on-premise applications, and databases.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities****
**Requirements analysis and solution design**

* Gather, document, and refine business requirements through workshops, interviews, and process mapping with Sales, Customer Service, Manufacturing, and Finance stakeholders.
* Translate requirements into functional specifications, user stories with acceptance criteria, and solution designs aligned to ServiceNow best practices.
* Assess the impact of platform upgrades, new releases, and process changes, and recommend out-of-the-box (OOTB) approaches over customization where practical.

**Platform configuration and development**

* Configure and enhance CSM (case management, customer and account data, entitlements, SLAs, Customer Service Portal, Virtual Agent, knowledge management).
* Configure and enhance MCO and SOM (product and quote catalogs, order capture, decomposition and fulfillment orchestration, order tracking, and commercial and manufacturing operations workflows).
* Design and build custom scoped applications using Flow Designer, Workflow Studio, Business Rules, Script Includes, UI Policies, Client Scripts, UI Builder / Workspaces, and Service Portal.
* Build and maintain integrations between ServiceNow and Salesforce, on-premise applications, databases, ERP, PLM, MES, telephony, and other enterprise systems using REST/SOAP APIs, Integration Hub, MID Server, JDBC, and data import sets.
* Implement and tune ServiceNow AI features (Now Assist skills, AI Agents, Virtual Agent, AI Search, Build Agent) across CSM, MCO, and SOM processes, and measure their impact on case deflection, resolution time, and agent productivity.

**Testing, deployment, and release management**

* Develop test plans and test cases, execute functional and regression testing, and coordinate user acceptance testing (UAT).
* Manage update sets / application repository deployments across instances and follow established change, release, and source-control practices.
* Produce release notes, training materials, and knowledge articles, and support end-user and super-user training.

**Production support and continuous improvement**

* Provide Tier 2/3 support for CSM, MCO, and SOM, including incident triage, root-cause analysis, and permanent fixes within SLA targets.
* Monitor platform health, data quality, and performance, and proactively identify and close process or configuration gaps.
* Support platform upgrades, family release adoption, and technical debt reduction.
* Maintain solution documentation, data models, and process flows; contribute to the product backlog and sprint planning.

**Governance and collaboration**

* Work with architects, developers, and platform owners to uphold standards for security, ACLs, data governance, and compliance.
* Report on solution adoption and process KPIs (case resolution time, order cycle time, SLA attainment) using Performance Analytics and dashboards.
* Mentor junior analysts and share knowledge across the ServiceNow community of practice.

****All About You****
We seek individuals who share our passion and determination. Our commitment to customer success drives us to go the extra mile. If you’re ready to join us in this mission, take a closer look at the minimum criteria for the position.
  
  
****Education And Experience****

* Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5+ years of hands-on ServiceNow experience as a platform analyst, administrator, or developer, focused specifically on ServiceNow solutions.
* Demonstrated implementation and support experience in at least two of the three target modules: CSM, MCO, and SOM.
* Proven experience developing custom scoped applications on the ServiceNow platform, from requirements through deployment and support.
* Experience supporting production ServiceNow environments, including incident management, root-cause analysis, upgrades, and release cycles.

**ServiceNow certifications**
**Certification**
**Requirement**
ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA)
  
  
**Required**
ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist – Customer Service Management (CSM)
  
  
Optional (preferred)
  
  
ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist – Sales and Order Management (SOM)
  
  
Optional (preferred)
  
  
ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD)
  
  
**Required**
Candidates holding certifications in Manufacturing Commercial Operations (MCO) or comparable manufacturing-industry ServiceNow credentials will be given strong preference.
  
  
****Technical Skills****

* Strong working knowledge of ServiceNow data model, tables, ACLs, roles, and CMDB / Customer Service data structures.
* Proficiency with JavaScript (server-side and client-side), Glide APIs, Flow Designer, Workflow Studio, and scoped application development.
* Experience with integrations to Salesforce, on-premise applications, and databases (SQL, JDBC) using REST/SOAP, Integration Hub spokes, MID Server, and import sets / transform maps.
* Hands-on experience with ServiceNow AI capabilities, including Now Assist skills for CSM and SOM (case and order summarization, resolution notes, knowledge generation), Now Assist Virtual Agent, AI Search, and customizing skills with Now Assist Skill Kit (NASK).
* Working knowledge of agentic AI on the platform, including features available through the Australia release: building, configuring, and governing AI Agents and agentic workflows, selecting model providers (Now LLM Service or third-party models), and managing Now Assist administration, licensing tiers, and guardrails.
* Experience with Customer Service Portal, Service Portal, UI Builder, and Workspaces (Customer Service Workspace).
* Understanding of order-to-cash, quote-to-order, entitlement, and warranty / contract processes.
* Familiarity with Agile (Scrum / SAFe) delivery, user story writing, and tools such as ServiceNow Agile Development, Jira, or Azure DevOps.
* Ability to write functional specifications, test cases, and process documentation, and to present solutions to technical and non-technical audiences.

****Preferred Qualifications****

* Hands-on MCO experience, including manufacturing commercial processes such as contracts, pricing, and order-to-delivery visibility.
* Experience with Configure, Price, Quote (CPQ) solutions, such as ServiceNow Sales and Order Management quoting, Salesforce CPQ, or Oracle CPQ, including product catalogs, pricing rules, quote-to-order flows, and integration with order management and ERP systems (a strong advantage).
* Additional ServiceNow certifications: Certified Technical Architect (in progress), Integration Hub, Performance Analytics, Now Assist / Generative AI / Agentic AI, or Predictive Intelligence.
* Experience building custom AI skills and AI Agents or using Build Agent to create agentic workflows for custom applications, and keeping pace with new AI capabilities in each ServiceNow family release.
* Experience integrating ServiceNow with ERP (Oracle Fusion), CRM (Salesforce), PLM, or MES systems.
* Experience with CI/CD and source control for ServiceNow (for example, Git integration, ATF automated testing).
* Exposure to data analytics and reporting tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
* Prior experience coordinating large/small projects or mentoring junior team members.

****Core Skills And Working Conditions****
**Core skills**

* Analytical and problem-solving ability, with a bias toward root-cause resolution over workarounds.
* Clear written and verbal communication, including facilitating workshops and explaining technical concepts to business users.
* Stakeholder management and the ability to balance multiple priorities across commercial, service, and manufacturing teams.
* Customer-centric mindset, with a focus on measurable outcomes and user adoption.
* Ownership, attention to detail, and comfort being self-directed in a fast-paced, Agile environment.
* Collaboration with onshore and offshore development partners.

**Working conditions**

* Primarily remote-based, with occasional travel.
* Participation in an on-call rotation for critical production issues and occasional after-hours release or upgrade support.

We are only considering candidates local to position location and are unable to provide relocation for this position. This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

TITLE: Analyst/ Associate, Portfolio Strategy Group, India

DEPARTMENT: Brio Portfolio Strategy Group

REPORTS TO: Vice President, Brio Portfolio Strategy, India

In 2025, Blackstone established Brio Real Estate (“Brio”) as a portfolio company focused on real estate

credit. Brio is a specialized global commercial real estate asset services platform that manages and

supports Blackstone’s Real Estate Debt Strategies business (“BREDS”) across the globe. Today,

BREDS has more than $77 billion in investor capital across high yield / opportunistic real estate credit

funds, a publicly traded Mortgage REIT, CMBS securities and insurance capital. Brio is a sophisticated

real estate credit solutions provider that enhances value for investors and supports BREDS across key

functions, including asset management, transactions, capital markets, surveillance, portfolio

management and legal & compliance. Brio provides critical infrastructure and capabilities for BREDS

to allow for effective investments and management of its global portfolio.

Blackstone is the world’s largest alternative asset manager with more than $1 trillion in assets under

management. Blackstone’s scale, with roughly 12,700 real estate assets and over 240 portfolio

companies, enables them to invest in dynamic sectors positioned for long-term growth. The firm seeks

to deliver compelling returns for institutional and individual investors by building strong businesses

that deliver lasting value. Blackstone’s global investment strategies focus on real estate, private

equity, infrastructure, life sciences, growth equity, credit, secondaries and hedge funds.

The Associate, Portfolio Strategy in India will execute portfolio management and reporting processes

for the BREDS portfolio. The portfolio spans Opportunistic, Core+ and Core capital sources for

commercial and residential real estate debt in public and private markets. This role offers the

opportunity to work across BREDS strategies and contribute analysis and insights that support the

broader business.

The role will focus on data governance, data management, and business systems support for the

Portfolio Strategy group, while contributing to data workflow improvements and the use of technology

to enable effective reporting and insights.

glossaries.

coordinate issue resolution with business and technical teams.

functionality, business rules, calculations, and workflows.

processes & systems via Confluence pages, user guides, and training materials.

develop recurring and adhoc reports providing valuable insights for business stakeholders.

 Maintain and deliver recurring and ad hoc reports for business stakeholders, ensuring outputs

remain accurate, timely, and aligned with evolving business needs.

Documentation & Knowledge Management

Stakeholder Engagement

 Partner with Asset Management, Portfolio Strategy, Finance, Operations, and Technology

teams.

 Gather business requirements and translate them into actionable work items.

the Brio and BREDS leadership teams and external clients.

* Creation of presentations and other deliverables for internal and external meetings
* Work with broader Brio team and BREDS Portfolio Management to gather, coordinate and

synthesize data and analytics, ensuring accurate and timely reporting

* Partner with Brio Asset Management and other teams to support monitoring of credit

positions within funds and contribute to a consistent, global approach to strategy, analysis,

and reporting.

* Collaborate with internal stakeholders to develop value-added portfolio analysis and

communicate relevant insights on strategies and underlying assets.

Key Priorities / Focus Areas

* Create and maintain tools that support oversight of portfolio performance and inform

decisions intended to enhance fund returns and mitigate risk.

provide analysis that supports return optimization and relative outperformance.

* Calculate and maintain key position metrics including DSCR and other key loan metrics
* Help to benchmark internal and external portfolio performance

* Collaborate with technology teams to ensure integration of new tools and systems

agency, Big 4, investment bank or broker is preferred

solutions.

of stakeholders

deadlines

presentations, reports, and documentation for senior stakeholders.

title: IT Security Compliance and Assurance Manager
description:
**Basic Function**
Wolters Kluwer Global Business Services (GBS) is designed to provide services to the business units in the areas of technology, sourcing, procurement, legal, finance, and human resources. These global centers promote team collaboration using best practices around a specific focus area to drive results and enhance operational efficiencies. There is a constant endeavor to benchmark against best-in-class industry standards to improve the quality of deliverables, increase cost savings, enhance productivity, and reduce time to market for products and applications.
  
  
We are looking for a detail-oriented, Compliance-driven, Team oriented, IT Security Manager to join our growing Cyber Technology Controls (CTC) team.
  
  
This role focuses on technology control assessments, audit coordination, regulatory compliance, and IT issue management. You will work closely with internal technology teams, external auditors, and business stakeholders to ensure compliance with the required regulations, standards and frameworks by leading critical IT control testing, audit, and assessment programs across various business units and products.
  
  
**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**

* Conduct compliance assessments by reviewing processes, policies, audit reports, security controls and evidence to advise on compliance outcomes, residual risk, and remediation strategies.
* Monitor and support internal and external audits, ensuring readiness for certification and regulatory validations.
* Monitor and assess security controls, finding / gaps, and recommending improvements.
* Help enforce compliance across industry frameworks such as AICPA SOC 2, ISO 27001/27701, PCI-DSS, NIST 800-53, HIPAA/HITRUST, FISMA and others.
* Prepare audit reports, track findings, and support corrective action/remediation plans.
* Champion/Drive security compliance and educate team members and stakeholders on the latest regulatory/industry security compliance requirements, controls, remediation strategies, tools and technologies.
* Work with the Policies and Standards team to communicate gaps, findings, and recommendations to strengthen and expand required control language.
* Exhibit strong judgement across testing, communication, and reporting to technical, non-technical, external and internal personnel across all IT Compliance and Audit topics and domains.
* Maintain up-to-date knowledge of compliance trends, versions, requirements, and best practices.
* Effective communication and reporting of Compliance for and from External Audits/Certifications.

**Job Qualifications**
**Education:**
Required: Bachelor’s degree in science, Computer Applications, Business Information Systems, Information Technology, or equivalent in related fields. Knowledge across any of the frameworks and regulations such as PCI-DSS, SSAE 18/SOC, ISO/IEC, HIPAA/HITRUST, NIST 800-53, NIST CSF, etc.
  
  
**Preferred:**
Certifications proving expertise in Information Security or certifications related to the above-mentioned frameworks, specially – Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA), Certified in Risk and Information Systems Control (CRISC), Certified Cloud Security Professional (CCSP), MITRE, ISO Lead Auditor/Implementor or further that would complement the role.
  
  
Experience:
  
  

* Minimum 12+ years’ experience in developing/contributing to industry standard compliance documentation, building relationships, conducting/facilitating audits, providing performance feedback while meeting stakeholders and client expectations.
* 8+ years of experience testing IT and Security controls across design and operating effectiveness.
* 6+ years of knowledge and experience of compliance and audit with all or any of SOC1, SOC2, SOX, HIPAA, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, Fed Ramp/State Ramp, etc.
* 6+ years as a Subject Matter Expert (SME); working with industry frameworks including ISO, NIST 800-53, NIST/CSF, etc.
* Strong written, verbal and presentation skills; including interactions with key stakeholders, internal executive management, external executive management, supervisors, and leaders.
* Experienced working in office and remote environments. Independent, motivated self-starter with the ability to analyze requirements, compliance and related problems, think critically, problem solve, influence change.
* Strong experience in managing complex technical audits and assessments and driving them to successful outcomes within stringent deadlines
* Excellent interpersonal skills, including the ability to work across a highly matrixed organization, interacting, influencing, and negotiating effectively with all levels of leadership and peers.
* Strong leadership skills and experience leading engagements, establishing budgets, developing work programs/plans, building relationships, mentoring staff, providing performance feedback, and monitoring workloads of team(s) while meeting stakeholder and client expectations.
* Experienced with security compliance services with ability to identify continuous improvement opportunities to drive control assessments and remediation mgmt.
* Knowledge of ITGC and demonstrated risk-based approach to information security.
* Ability to travel as needed.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a highly motivated Senior Data Privacy Consultant to join our growing Privacy Consulting practice. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in implementing privacy programs, conducting privacy assessments, advising on global privacy regulations, and driving enterprise-wide data protection initiatives.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Conduct privacy maturity assessments, gap assessments, compliance reviews, and privacy health checks.
* Develop practical remediation roadmaps to address regulatory and operational privacy risks.
* Design and implement enterprise privacy governance frameworks, policies, standards, procedures, and operational controls.
* Conduct data discovery, data mapping, and data flow assessments to identify personal data processing activities.
* Prepare and maintain Records of Processing Activities (RoPA), Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs), Privacy Impact Assessments (PIAs), Legitimate Interest Assessments (LIAs), and Transfer Impact Assessments (TIAs), Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs)
* Implementing Privacy by Design and Privacy by Default principles across business processes and technology platforms.
* Engage with Legal, Compliance, Information Security, Risk, HR, Product, Procurement, and Business teams to embed privacy controls across the organization.
* Conduct stakeholder workshops, executive presentations, and privacy awareness sessions.
* Assist in developing privacy notices, consent management frameworks, data retention policies, breach response procedures, and data subject rights processes.
* Draft, review, and negotiate privacy-related contractual documents, including Data Processing Agreements (DPAs), Data Sharing Agreements (DSAs), Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs), Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDAs), and vendor contracts.
* Conduct vendor privacy assessments and third-party risk reviews to evaluate processor compliance.
* Advise on cross-border data transfers and international privacy obligations.
* Identify privacy and compliance risks across business operations and recommend practical mitigation strategies.

**Required Skills and Experience**

* Strong working knowledge of the DPDP Act, 2023 and applicable DPDP Rules.
* Hands-on experience in end-to-end privacy compliance implementation and consulting.
* Practical knowledge of RoPA, DFDs, DPIAs, consent management, data principal rights and third-party privacy risk management.
* Strong project management, stakeholder coordination, documentation and communication skills.
* Bachelor's or master's degree in IT, Cybersecurity, Law, Management, or a related field.
* Privacy certifications such as CIPP/A, CIPM, CDPSE, or DSCI privacy certifications are preferred.
* Knowledge of ISO 27701, ISO 27001 and GDPR is an added advantage.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Law, Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* LLB/LLM, B.Tech, B.E., MCA, or equivalent qualifications are preferred.
* Candidates with a background in Privacy, Cybersecurity, Risk, or Compliance Consulting will be given preference.

**About the Company**

ClearRoute is a global, AI-native platform engineering consultancy headquartered in London, with an engineering hub in Pune. It helps enterprises fix how their software gets built, tested and shipped, across cloud platforms, quality engineering and developer experience. On this engagement, ClearRoute is leading a strategic platform engineering programme for a large regulated financial-services firm: an AI-enabled delivery platform on AWS that replaces manual, fragmented delivery with a standardised, policy-driven path to production.

**About the Role**

You'll join ClearRoute's AI-first Developer Platform team as a DevSecOps Engineer, based in Pune on a hybrid model (2 days a week in the office). The team owns the CI/CD pipelines every engineer ships through, and builds its own products on top of GitHub, Artifactory and a Kubernetes-hosted marketplace of build runners. This is a hands-on build role in a regulated environment: you build working software, not documents, and what you ship reaches delivery teams the same week. Evidence counts more than years: show what you built, what you measured, and a decision the measurement changed.

**What you'll do**

* Build CI/CD pipelines on GitHub Actions and make the secure, correct path the default, with policy-as-code guardrails (OPA, AWS Config), automated compliance gates and golden paths
* Define and operate self-service infrastructure patterns in AWS CDK and Terraform
* Put AI agents to work on the toolchain: remediation at scale, pipeline upgrades, scanner triage and credential rotation
* Design how autonomous agents are allowed to act, including identity, scoping, audit trail and a stop control
* Build new platform products such as self-serve dashboards, MCP servers, skills and developer tooling
* Build prototypes fast, harden the ones that prove their value, and run time-boxed experiments with a decide-or-kill date
* Make the estate observable through monitoring, telemetry, logging, tracing and alerting, and help run it with zero-downtime practices defined in code
* Talk to delivery teams directly and bring back findings that change the roadmap

**What you bring**

* Hands-on CI/CD pipeline engineering (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps or similar), where teams own their pipelines and security is part of building
* Infrastructure as code with Terraform or AWS CDK, reviewed and tested as code
* Production experience on AWS or Azure
* You've wired security into delivery: scanners, secrets detection or policy checks running as pipeline gates
* You write real code for tooling and services in Python, TypeScript or C#
* Real observability experience: monitoring, telemetry, logging, tracing and alerting
* Test-driven and behaviour-driven development, trunk-based development and pairing as your default way of working
* You've driven delivery metrics toward elite DORA performance and measured a problem before solving it
* Hands-on use of AI tools such as Claude and GitHub Copilot, and real interest in how engineering changes in an AI-first world
* Proactive and self-directed, not ticket-led

**Nice to have**

* Built AI agents, MCP servers or automation that acts on a toolchain
* GitHub, Azure DevOps or Artifactory administration; Kubernetes runner fleets
* Experience in banking, asset management or other regulated environments
* Product instinct: you ask who the user is and what they will adopt before what is technically interesting
* Teaching others through pairing, writing or speaking to engineering teams

title: Senior Manager- Information Security and Compliance
description:
**We’re Hiring | Senior Manager – Information Security & Compliance**

**Location:**
Pune, India | Work from Office

**Working Hours:**
US Business Hours

**Company:**
Orvera AI

**1. About Orvera**

Orvera is a conversational AI voice platform that automates inbound and outbound customer calls for enterprises, primarily in the United States. Our AI agents hold live conversations, integrate with customer systems of record, and process voice recordings, transcripts and customer data on behalf of our clients — including clients in regulated sectors such as US healthcare.

Enterprise buyers evaluate us on security and trust as much as on product capability. We hold a SOC 2 attestation and face a rising volume of security questionnaires, due-diligence reviews and contractual security obligations. This is our first dedicated security role, and a chance to build the function from the ground up.

**2. Role Purpose**

The Senior Manager – Information Security & Compliance will own the day-to-day security and compliance program at Orvera and build it into a scalable function. The role is hands-on and delivery-focused, working closely with the CTO and engineering team and supported by a Security Steering Group for strategic and risk-acceptance decisions. The role has three dimensions:

* **Builder:**
  design and implement security controls, policies, processes and tooling — largely from first principles, not by maintaining an existing program.
* **Trust enabler:**
  remove security as a blocker in enterprise sales by owning customer security reviews, audits and assurance evidence.
* **Risk manager:**
  identify, prioritise and drive reduction of risk across cloud, application, AI, data, people and third parties, and run incident response when incidents occur.

**3. Key Responsibilities**

**3.1 Security Program and Governance**

* Develop and execute the information security roadmap, and recommend priorities and budget to the Security Steering Group.
* Write, maintain and drive adoption of the information security policy framework, standards and procedures across engineering, operations and corporate functions.
* Prepare monthly security posture, risk and KPI reporting for the Steering Group and leadership.

**3.2 Compliance, Audit and Assurance**

* **Own SOC 2 Type II end to end:**
  scoping, readiness, control design, evidence collection, auditor coordination, exception remediation and bridge letters.
* Lead PCI DSS scoping and compliance for any product flows involving payment card data, with an emphasis on scope reduction (tokenisation, DTMF masking, redaction).
* Map controls across frameworks (SOC 2, PCI DSS, ISO/IEC 27001, HIPAA Security Rule, GDPR, CCPA/CPRA) to avoid duplicated effort; assess ISO/IEC 42001 and NIST AI RMF alignment.
* Implement and administer compliance automation tooling (e.g. Vanta, Drata, Secureframe or equivalent).
* Support Legal on the security content of MSAs, DPAs, BAAs and customer security exhibits, including breach notification timelines and audit rights.

**3.3 Customer Security Reviews and Trust**

* Own the full lifecycle of customer security questionnaires (SIG, CAIQ, custom enterprise questionnaires), RFP security sections and due-diligence calls.
* Build a reusable answer library, standard security pack and trust center to reduce turnaround time and sales-cycle friction.
* Represent Orvera in technical security discussions with enterprise customer security and procurement teams in the US and EU.
* Track and report review volumes, turnaround times and deal impact.

**3.4 Risk Management**

* Maintain the information security risk register and risk assessment methodology; present risk treatment and acceptance recommendations to the Steering Group.
* Conduct risk assessments across products, infrastructure, data flows and business processes; track treatment plans with accountable owners.
* Maintain data classification and data flow mapping for PII, PHI, payment data, voice recordings and transcripts.

**3.5 Cloud, Infrastructure and Application Security**

* Work with the CTO and engineering to secure the cloud environment: IAM, network segmentation, encryption and key management, logging and monitoring.
* **Embed a secure SDLC:**
  threat modelling, secure code review, SAST/DAST/SCA, secrets management, infrastructure-as-code scanning and container security.
* Run vulnerability management and annual third-party penetration testing, including remediation tracking and customer-shareable summaries.
* Verify multi-tenant isolation and customer data segregation controls.

**3.6 AI and Conversational Platform Security**

* **Define and implement controls for LLM-based voice agents:**
  prompt injection and jailbreak resistance, tool/function-call authorisation, output guardrails and abuse monitoring (OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications).
* **Assess third-party AI model vendors:**
  zero data retention and no-training commitments, data residency, PII/PHI redaction before inference, and model/vendor change management.
* Address voice-specific risks including caller impersonation, synthetic voice and social engineering, and secure handling of recordings and transcripts.

**3.7 Incident Response and Resilience**

* Maintain the incident response plan and run incident response: detection, containment, investigation, root cause and lessons learned, escalating to the Steering Group and Legal for notification decisions.
* Run tabletop exercises at least annually, including AI-specific and data leakage scenarios.
* Support business continuity and disaster recovery planning and testing with Engineering.

**3.8 Vendor and Third-Party Risk**

* Operate a risk-tiered third-party risk management process covering cloud, LLM, speech-to-text, telephony/CPaaS and other sub-processors.
* Review vendor SOC reports (including complementary user entity controls), questionnaires and contractual protections; maintain the sub-processor register.

**3.9 Security Operations, Awareness and Partners**

* Manage security monitoring (SIEM, EDR, cloud security posture management) through a managed detection and response (MDR) provider, plus access reviews and identity lifecycle controls.
* Run security awareness, phishing simulation and role-based training.
* Manage external partners — MDR provider, penetration testers and auditors — and help hire future team members.

**4. Required Experience**

* 8+ years of progressive information security experience, including at least 3 years at a startup or growth-stage SaaS / technology product company (ideally 100–200 employees).
* Demonstrable experience building security controls, policies and processes from the ground up — not solely operating within a mature enterprise program.
* Personal ownership of at least one SOC 2 Type II audit cycle end to end (two or more preferred), including auditor coordination and exception remediation.
* Hands-on experience with PCI DSS scoping, assessments or compliance (SAQ or ROC).
* Direct experience handling enterprise customer security questionnaires and due-diligence reviews for US and/or EU customers.
* Practical experience in risk management, incident response, third-party risk, cloud security and application security in a SaaS environment.
* Experience working closely with engineering teams, with enough technical depth to review architecture and cloud configurations.

**5. Preferred Certifications**

Certifications support but do not substitute for demonstrated hands-on, build-from-scratch experience.

* **Security management:**
  CISSP or CISM (one strongly preferred).
* **Audit and risk:**
  CISA, CRISC, ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor.
* **Cloud:**
  CCSP, AWS Certified Security – Specialty, or Azure/GCP equivalents.
* **Payments:**
  PCI ISA, or prior experience working alongside a QSA.
* **Privacy and AI governance:**
  CIPP/US, CIPP/E, CIPT, IAPP AIGP (advantageous).

**6. Working Style and Leadership Expectations**

* **Hands-on ownership:**
  personally writes policies, configures tools, answers questionnaires and reviews architecture — no large team to delegate to at the start.
* **Pragmatic judgement:**
  frames security in terms of revenue enablement, risk and cost, and proposes practical trade-offs rather than maximum control.
* **Clear communication:**
  explains risk concisely to leadership and holds credible technical conversations with customer security teams.
* **Influence without authority:**
  drives security outcomes through engineering, product, sales and operations.
* **Composure under pressure:**
  runs incidents in a structured way and escalates early and accurately.
* **Integrity and candour:**
  represents Orvera's security posture accurately to customers and auditors, including gaps.

**7. Governance**

* **Security Steering Group:**
  a monthly forum of the Group CFO, CTO and this role, which approves the security roadmap, risk acceptance decisions and major incident decisions.
* **Information Security Officer:**
  the role holder is formally designated in policy as Orvera's Information Security Officer for SOC 2, HIPAA and customer purposes.

* Time management and prioritization.
* Ownership and accountability.
* Effective communication and teamwork.
* Ability to handle IT support requests and resolve issues within defined timelines.

title: Network Security Tech Lead
description:
**CREATIVITY IS OUR SUPERPOWER.**
It’s our heritage and it’s also our future. Because we don’t just make toys. We create innovative products and experiences that inspire fans, entertain audiences and develop children through play. Mattel is at its best when every member of our team feels respected, included, and heard—when everyone can show up as themselves and do their best work every day. We value and share an infinite range of ideas and voices that evolve and broaden our perspectives with a reach that extends into all our brands, partners, and suppliers.
  
  
**Job Description**
About the Role
  
  
Network Security Tech Lead is responsible for both leading and delivering enterprise network security operations. This role combines strategic leadership with hands-on technical execution to protect Mattel’s global network infrastructure across on-premises and cloud environments. The position oversees and contributes to the work of Network Security Engineers and Administrators, ensuring robust firewall, email, and web security, as well as Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) management and compliance with enterprise security standards.
  
  
The Tech Lead will drive delivery of secure, resilient, and scalable network security services while also acting as a subject matter expert (SME) and escalation point for complex troubleshooting, incident response, and architecture initiatives. This role requires deep technical expertise in Palo Alto Networks technologies, cloud security platforms, PKI, and WAF solutions, along with a commitment to operational excellence and continuous improvement.
  
  
Roles and Responsibilities
  
  

* Provide direct technical leadership and guidance to Network Security Engineers and Network administrators, ensuring delivery of secure and reliable network protection across enterprise and cloud infrastructures.
* Lead and actively participate in the deployment, operation, and optimization of Palo Alto Networks (PAN) firewalls (hardware and virtual), Prisma Access, GlobalProtect, and related services.
* Oversee configuration management, performance tuning, and security policy enforcement across global firewall environments.
* Manage and maintain enterprise Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), including certificate lifecycle management with tools such as Keyfactor, Venafi, or equivalent, and integrations with external Certificate Authorities (GlobalSign, Entrust, DigiCert).
* Lead configuration, customization, and maintenance of Web Application Firewalls (WAF) (e.g., Imperva) to safeguard applications and APIs, resolving rule conflicts and performance issues.
* Oversee Email Security Gateways (e.g., Checkpoint Harmony, Proofpoint) and related O365 mail routing and DNS security configurations.
* Participate in high-severity incident response, threat mitigation, and root cause analysis alongside infrastructure and SOC teams.
* Develop and maintain operational runbooks, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and technical documentation to support security operations, compliance, and audit readiness.
* Drive continuous improvement in firewall automation, rule optimization, and network visibility using modern tools and analytics.
* Collaborate with enterprise architects, SOC teams, and application owners to align network security initiatives with business and compliance objectives.
* Lead or contribute to design discussions, roadmap planning, and implementation of emerging technologies such as Zero Trust network architecture and cloud-native security controls.
* Mentor engineers, foster professional growth, and promote a culture of accountability and delivery excellence.
* Participating in after-hours support rotation for major outages or critical incidents as needed.

**Skills And Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* 10+ years of experience in Network Security operations, including at least 5 years in a tech lead role or senior engineering capacity within a large enterprise.
* Proven expertise with Palo Alto Networks firewalls, Prisma Access, Global Protect, and related security platforms.
* Experience managing WAF, Email Security, and PKI environments, including integration with cloud services (Azure, AWS, GCP).
* Proficiency in firewall rules are optimization, troubleshooting, and automation.
* Deep understanding of network protocols, VPNs, RADIUS/TACACS+, and cloud networking architectures.
* Familiarity with Windows and Linux systems administration and integration.
* Experience supporting compliance and audit initiatives (e.g., SOX, NIST CSF, PCI).
* Strong leadership, communication, and decision-making skills, with a demonstrated ability to mentor and manage technical teams.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and vendors.

Preferred:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Cybersecurity, or related discipline.
* Certifications such as PCNSE, CCNP Security, CCSP, or GIAC (GSEC).
* Experience with ServiceNow ITSM processes and workflow automation.
* Familiarity with Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) and SASE frameworks.
* Scripting and automation experience (PowerShell, Python, or REST APIs).

**Qualifications**
**What We’re Looking For:**

* Demonstrated a growth mindset by staying curious and continuously learning, embracing challenges, and improving themselves.

**Additional Information**
Don’t meet every single requirement? At Mattel, we are dedicated to an inclusive workplace and a culture of belonging. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.
  
  
**How We Work:**
We are a purpose driven company aiming to empower generations to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential. We live up to our purpose employing the following behaviors:
  
  

* We collaborate: Being a part of Mattel means being part of one team with shared values and common goals. Every person counts and working closely together always brings better results. Partnership is our process and our collective capabilities is our superpower.
* We innovate: At Mattel we always aim to find new and better ways to create innovative products and experiences. No matter where you work in the organization, you can always make a difference and have real impact. We welcome new ideas and value new initiatives that challenge conventional thinking.
* We execute: We are a performance-driven company. We strive for excellence and are focused on pursuing best-in-class outcomes. We believe in accountability and ownership and know that our people are at their best when they are empowered to create and deliver results.

**Our Approach to Flexible Work:**
We embrace a flexible work model designed to empower a culture of growth, optimism, and wellbeing, where every employee can reach their full potential. Combining purposeful in-person collaboration with flexibility, our focus is to optimize performance and drive connection for moments that matter.
  
  
**Who We Are:**
Mattel is a leading global toy and family entertainment company and owner of one of the most iconic brand portfolios in the world. We engage consumers and fans through our franchise brands, including Barbie, Hot Wheels, Fisher-Price, American Girl, Thomas & Friends, UNO, Masters of the Universe, Matchbox, Monster High, MEGA and Polly Pocket, as well as other popular properties that we own or license in partnership with global entertainment companies. Our offerings include toys, content, consumer products, digital and live experiences. Our products are sold in collaboration with the world’s leading retail and ecommerce companies. Since its founding in 1945, Mattel is proud to be a trusted partner in empowering generations to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential.
  
  
Mattel’s award-winning workplace culture has been recognized by Forbes, Fast Company, Newsweek, Great Place to Work, TIME, and more.
  
  
Visit us at https://jobs.mattel.com/ and www.instagram.com/MattelCareers.

title: Senior Manager Customer Experience
description:
**Senior Manager, Customer Experience**
=======================================

**Company:** Supertails, Bengaluru (in office)

**Reports to:** Head of Customer Experience

**Teams you run:** The order support desk, Clinic booking and calling team, Super companion team, Online consultation veterinary doctors, Sales teams along with Quality & Training and Analytics teams

**About Supertails**

Supertails is one of India's fastest-growing integrated pet-care platforms. We are not just an online store. We are building everything a pet parent needs in one place:

* A wide product catalogue across hundreds of brands
* India's largest digital pet pharmacy
* Vet consultations through a large team of in-house veterinarians
* A Fear-Free certified clinic network
* Express delivery in multiple cities

Every one of these businesses creates customer contacts: an order that is late, a prescription that needs a vet's sign-off, a clinic slot that has to be booked, a new pet parent who needs a hand in the first weeks. The Customer Experience team handles all of them.

**Our CX team**
---------------

Our CX team is not a cost centre that answers tickets. It is the part of the company that sees every broken process first, fixes it at the root, and turns the rest into bookings, repeat orders and reviews. We build a good part of our own tooling, and we use AI wherever it answers a customer faster and better than a queue would.

Over the last quarter the team cut contacts per 100 orders by 24% and cost per contact by 21%, mostly by fixing root causes upstream with supply chain and product and by moving simple contacts to bots. The next leg is harder. The contacts that remain need judgment, and the plan for the coming quarters assumes bots and automation carry more of the load with a team that does not grow with volume.

**The role**
------------

We are looking for the second-most senior person in the function: someone who runs the operation day to day and builds the systems that make it cheaper and better every month.

You have run the morning queue review on Monday, shipped a Retool dashboard or a Claude Code script on Wednesday, and presented a cost-per-contact plan to leadership on Friday. That is the mix.

You will own all customer-facing support operations. Assistant managers and team leads report to you. You report to a product-minded CX leader and work daily with Product, Engineering, Supply Chain, Category and Marketing.

**Pillar 1: Run the operation**
-------------------------------

You own the numbers and the people behind them.

* **Numbers you own:** contacts per 100 orders; cost per contact; resolution time and first response time; CSAT, answer rate and abandonment on inbound lines; schedule adherence and agent attrition; bookings per 100 tickets and show rate for clinic calling; recovered revenue and return on spends.
* Daily, weekly and monthly running of every pod: rosters, shrinkage, queue health, escalations, quality audits and coaching through the team leads.
* Seven-day coverage and festival-peak planning. You are the escalation point for outages, founder escalations, social media and consumer-forum complaints.
* A weekly operating review with a one-page view per pod: goal, actual, gap, and what changes this week.
* Hire and grow assistant managers, team leads and subject experts, and manage performance, including exits. Build a bench so no pod depends on one person.
* Make quality and training work for every pod, not only the biggest one: scoring for calls, chats and emails, calibration sessions, and feedback loops that change what agents do.
* Customer data handling on a pharmacy floor: call-recording consent, prescription data and the data protection law, agreed with Legal and enforced on the floor.

**Pillar 2: Build the tools, the automation and the roadmap**
-------------------------------------------------------------

You are not a full-stack engineer, but you are technical enough to ship on your own and you do not wait for engineering time.

* Build internal tools and dashboards with low-code platforms (Retool, Appsmith), AI-assisted development (Claude Code, Cursor) and cloud services (GCP Cloud Run, Firebase). Give leadership a live view of CX health and emerging issues.
* Own the integrations between our CX platforms (Nugget for tickets and bots, Ameyo and Exotel for telephony, or their equivalents), the CRM, and our analytics database, through APIs, webhooks and middleware.
* Prototype and ship the AI pieces: smart routing, auto-tagging, auto-refunds, agent assist, chatbot and voice-bot improvements. Own the bot and self-serve roadmap with Product: which contact types move, in what order, and what the quality bar is.
* Keep a CX technology roadmap tied to company goals: what to build, buy or shut down, and when. Decide on speed and plain economics.
* Drive cost per contact down through automation, self-serve and smarter routing, without giving up quality. Know what you would refuse to cut.
* Monitor system health, debug integration failures and keep the critical CX workflows up. Keep the documentation current.

**Pillar 3: Fix the processes**
-------------------------------

You know what a good support floor looks like, from ticket routing to agent training to quality frameworks.

* Audit and redesign workflows across support, sales and onboarding to cut friction, shorten resolution and raise CSAT.
* Write and enforce the standard operating procedures for the messy cases: unresolved delivery tickets, refunds, resends, duplicate orders, prescription holds. Build them so they hold at twice today's volume.
* Keep a dated list of root-cause projects, each with an assumed and an actual impact on contacts per 100 orders, reviewed every week with Product, Supply Chain and Category. Be the person who shows up with the number that proves a customer problem exists.
* Manage the vendors: the outsourced calling partner, telephony, ticketing and bots. You own the service levels, the invoices and the renewals.

**Pillar 4: Grow the revenue lines**
------------------------------------

* Clinic bookings from the calling team, Revenue recovery, proactive outreach, and upsell flows that customers thank us for.
* New channels (WhatsApp, in-app chat) and differentiated service by customer segment.

**What the first 90 days look like**
------------------------------------

* **Days 1 to 30:** sit in every queue. Know every pod's volume, staffing, cost and quality by heart. Run the weekly review by week four.
* **Days 31 to 60:** publish the root-cause project list with owners and dates. Fix the two or three broken metric definitions that stop us reading our own numbers the same way twice. Ship one tool.
* **Days 61 to 90:** present the next quarter's plan for your pods: contacts, cost, quality, staffing and automation, with the assumptions written down and a view on what you would cut or add.

**You should apply if**
-----------------------

* You have 7 to 10 years in CX operations, CX technology, business operations or a hybrid role at a D2C, e-commerce, quick-commerce, consumer internet or healthcare company.
* You have managed managers, not only agents, on a multi-channel floor of 50 or more seats (voice, chat, email, bots). You have hired team leads.
* You have owned a cost line, not only a service level. You can explain cost per contact, how you brought it down, and what broke along the way.
* You build, you do not only manage tools. You have shipped internal tools, automated workflows or integrations on your own, using low-code platforms, APIs or scripting.
* You read your own data. Comfortable with SQL, spreadsheets and BI tools. You do not wait for an analyst to tell you what happened yesterday.
* You have configured, customised or integrated at least one CX platform: Nugget, Freshdesk, Zendesk, Intercom, Ameyo, Exotel, Genesys or similar.
* You can write a clear SOP, present a plan to leadership and explain a technical decision to a non-technical colleague, all in the same day. Plain, direct English. Hindi or Kannada helps on the floor.
* You are in Bengaluru and in the office with the team.

**Good to have**

* You have run a floor of 100 or more seats.
* You can deploy a small service on Cloud Run or its AWS equivalent and run a simple data pipeline.
* You have run an outsourced vendor or taken a team through a telephony or ticketing platform change.
* Pet care, healthcare or pharmacy experience, or any category where the customer is anxious and the stakes are real.
* Experience setting up a clinic or appointment-based calling team.

**How we will assess you**
--------------------------

* A 30-minute screening call on your operating history: teams, volumes, costs, tools you built, what you changed.
* A take-home case built on a closed past quarter's actuals (masked): a contact-mix, staffing and automation problem. You present your plan and defend it.
* Interviews with the Head of Customer Experience, Heads of Product and Supply Chain and a founder conversation.

**What you will get**
---------------------

* A seat where you build, operate and plan at the same time. One approver.. You own the rest.
* Direct impact on how pet parents experience Supertails, from the first order to the clinic visit.
* A Bengaluru office with a team that likes being in the office together. Yes, there are office dogs.
