title: Software Development Manager, Just Walk Out
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Lead a new India-based embedded and firmware engineering team for Just Walk Out's edge devices: the cameras, sensors, RFID, gates and networking hardware in our stores, and the device-side software that connects them to the cloud. This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You'll manage 8-12 engineers, set technical direction across firmware, embedded Linux and embedded Android, and partner closely with the US engineering team that owns this charter today.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Hire, coach and develop a high-judgment team of embedded, firmware and edge software engineers, and build an inclusive, high-ownership culture as the team grows in India
* Own the technical roadmap, delivery and operational excellence for your team's firmware and embedded software, from requirements and architecture through release and field support
* Set engineering standards across the embedded stack: firmware and RTOS/bare-metal code, embedded Linux and Android, drivers and board bring-up, secure boot and OTA updates, and on-device diagnostics
* Own the device-to-cloud boundary with cloud teams: provisioning and identity, connectivity, telemetry and remote management, including the device's AWS IoT / embedded-Linux connectivity stack
* Build the test infrastructure, staged rollouts and telemetry needed to ship firmware safely across a large fleet of deployed devices
* Lead the response to field issues, telling firmware from hardware, connectivity or sensor faults, and drive root cause and lasting fixes
* Drive execution with the US engineering team, product and program management, hardware/ODM partners, and cloud, data and UI/UX teams across time zones

  
A day in the life  
You might start with 1:1s and a design review, helping an engineer reason through an OTA rollback path or a latency budget on a constrained target. Later you agree scope for the next release with product and the US partner team, and re-plan the sprint because a hardware revision changed what's possible. In the afternoon you join your engineers on a field issue affecting a few devices at one store, get them the telemetry and a plan, and keep the fix moving.  
  
About the team  
Just Walk Out builds the technology behind checkout-free shopping: the devices, networking and cloud software that let shoppers walk out without stopping to pay. . This India team will take direct ownership of part of that charter, working closely with the US engineering team, hardware partners and the operations teams who rely on what we ship.  
  
About AWS:  
  
Diverse Experiences: AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job below, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  
  
Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  
  
Inclusive Team Culture - Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth - We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.  
  
Work/Life Balance - We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of engineering team management experience
* Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
* Experience partnering with product or program management teams
* Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
* 7+ years of software engineering experience, including embedded systems or firmware development
* Experience leading the development of embedded, real-time, or hardware-interfacing systems delivered on physical hardware

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
* Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers
* Hands-on embedded Linux (including Yocto) and/or embedded Android, with Linux kernel or driver development and low-level debugging
* Sustaining a large fleet of deployed devices: OTA firmware updates, telemetry, and remote diagnostics at scale
* Experience at the device-to-cloud boundary (connectivity, provisioning, fleet management), ideally with AWS IoT / Greengrass and MQTT
* Depth in Android/Linux firmware, secure boot, wireless connectivity, or RFID/sensor devices, plus hardware-in-the-loop testing

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

description:

* Continuous Improvement and Automation: Use scripting, Flow Designer and ATF to automate quality checks, lifecycle controls and regression testing; drive an experimentation approach to simplify, standardize and scale.

* Significant hands-on experience configuring and administering CMDB, Discovery, MID Servers, patterns, Service Graph Connectors and CMDB Health, with working-to-advanced knowledge of CMDB 360 and Data Manager.
* Demonstrated ability to integrate multiple authoritative data sources through IntegrationHub ETL, REST/SOAP APIs and transform maps, including AWS and/or Azure environments.
* Proficiency in ServiceNow scripting and automation, encompassing JavaScript, developing with Flow Designer features and Business Rules, plus platform governance with update sets, Automated Test Framework (ATF) and release management.
* Experience leading technical delivery, mentoring engineers and handling third-party or outsourced service provider resources.

title: Security Support Engineer II
description:
At F5, we strive to bring a better digital world to life. Our teams empower organizations across the globe to create, secure, and run applications that enhance how we experience our evolving digital world. We are passionate about cybersecurity, from protecting consumers from fraud to enabling companies to focus on innovation.
  
  
Everything we do centers around people. That means we obsess over how to make the lives of our customers, and their customers, better. And it means we prioritize a diverse F5 community where each individual can thrive.
  
  
As a Security Support Engineer II, you will be an essential member of our Network Operations Center (NOC) team with strong technical acumen in network automation and deep security analysis. You will deliver in-depth troubleshooting on advanced network, security, and infrastructure issues.
  
  
You will support and troubleshoot enterprise-grade products and production services spanning kubernetes, cloud environments, data centers, LAN/WAN/SD-WAN, switching, routing, remote access, and application security. In this technical role within the NOC, you will drive tooling automation, proactive observability, and rapid incident detection & remediation to ensure our commitment to a 99.999% network availability SLO for our customers.
  
  
**Domain Requirements & Expectations:**
Experience & Education
  
  

* 5–8 years of network/security support experience in a large enterprise NOC or operations environment.
* Bachelors in Computer Science or Information Technology.

Network & Protocol Mastery
  
  

* Deep expertise in OSI model troubleshooting and protocols: OSPF, BGP, STP, TCP/UDP, IPv6, QoS.
* Proven experience managing and troubleshooting Multi-OS LAN/WAN/SD-WAN architectures.

Cloud & Containers
  
  

* Strong working knowledge of Kubernetes (K8s), container networking/ingress, and managed cloud Kubernetes environments (e.g., AWS EKS).

Product & Security Acumen
  
  

* Strong understanding of enterprise application delivery & security products (WAF, DDoS mitigation, DNS, Load Balancers).

Observability & Monitoring
  
  

* Hands-on experience with tools such as Grafana, Splunk, Nagios, New Relic, Cosmos, Zabbix, or equivalent platforms.

Automation & CI/CD
  
  

* Practical experience with automation tooling: Python, Ansible, Jenkins, Git, ZTP (Zero Touch Provisioning), or Infrastructure as Code (IaC).

Operational & Soft Skills
  
  

* Proven ability to troubleshoot calmly under pressure during mission-critical production incidents.
* Strong documentation, stakeholder management, and customer-facing communication skills.

**What will you do?**
**Engineering & Analysis: (60%)**

* Enhance the observability of network infrastructure by implementing numerous automations, advanced monitoring solutions, analyzing data trends, and proactively identifying potential issues from alerts and triggers to ensure a seamless and reliable network experience for our customers.
* Configure and manage customized alerting systems for DDoS attack, availability, latency, packet loss, etc., across various layers of the network.
* Proactively engage with Customer Success team upon triggered alerts to deliver insightful information on the nature and the reason behind the alerts or network performance degradation.
* Conduct thorough Root Cause Analysis (RCA) of network incidents to identify underlying issues causing disruptions or failures. Develop and implement effective solutions and preventive measures to mitigate identified root causes.
* Troubleshoot and implement advanced network configurations including SDN, IaC, switches, routers, firewalls, load balancers, WAF, DDoS, DNS, and Cloud networking environment.
* Design and implement automated processes to deploy, monitor and maintain network systems.
* Proactively ensure ongoing communication with teammates, customers, and stakeholders for ongoing network issues until a closure is reached.
* Review and approve team deliverables including customer updates, documentation changes, and network issue handling procedures.

**Production support: (40%)**

* Proactively monitoring network performance, troubleshoot issues, and optimizing network incident triggers configurations for maximum efficiency and uptime.
* Engage in complex troubleshooting including running maintenance and recovery tasks interpreting alarms and errors in the logs and performing maintenance to correct problems.
* Collaborate with vendors and other technical personnel to resolve technical issues and achieve highest levels of systems and infrastructure availability.
* Handle and escalate as needed significant network impacting alerts ensuring swift resolution.
* Participate in customer calls, providing detailed and regular updates on critical issues.
* Communicate with impacted users throughout the troubleshooting/remediation process as needed.
* Participate in on-call rotation and shift duties in line with the 24/7 business operation.

title: Senior Technical Lead
description:
**Job Summary**
---------------

**Roles & Responsibilities:**

* Develop, review, and maintain production-quality SQL and database objects for PostgreSQL, including complex joins, CTEs, window functions, DISTINCT ON patterns, conditional aggregation, and date-effective data selection.
* Tune queries used by Composite Services API workflows, including cash balance, assets under management (AUM), account indicators, holdings, maturities, group/party search, and transaction-related reads.
* Diagnose slow queries using EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS) in approved non-production or controlled environments; interpret actual-versus-estimated rows, loops, buffer hits/reads, execution time, sort/hash behavior, and I/O waits.
* Identify and address performance issues caused by large intermediate result sets, repeated nested-loop lookups, inaccurate cardinality estimates, expensive aggregation, sort operations, and pagination applied after full aggregation.
* Design and validate indexes, including composite, partial, and expression indexes where appropriate; evaluate selectivity, column order, write overhead, and index maintenance costs before recommending changes.
* Improve pagination, filtering, ordering, and count-query patterns while maintaining correct totals, stable ordering, and API contract behavior. Assess keyset/cursor pagination where product behavior permits.
* Review data access patterns involving account, party, advisor, branch, balance, position, price, and FX relationships; validate join keys, effective-date rules, de-duplication, and missing-price or fallback logic.
* Analyze PostgreSQL runtime behavior including CPU versus I/O waits, temporary-file activity, sort/hash spills, locks, connection-pool pressure, statement timeouts, and read-replica lag.
* Collaborate with Java/Spring service engineers, DBAs, QA, and platform teams to trace API latency to SQL, reproduce issues with representative data volumes, and deliver measurable improvements.
* Create repeatable query-performance tests and document baseline plans, representative parameters, expected row counts, risks, and before/after results. Include performance checks in code review and release validation.
* Support production incidents through evidence-based diagnosis and follow established change, access-control, rollback, and data-protection procedures.
* Communicate findings clearly to technical and business stakeholders; explain trade-offs among latency, resource consumption, data freshness, and consistency.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Requirements / Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience.
* 6–8 years of hands-on SQL development, with substantial experience building and tuning **PostgreSQL** workloads in a production environment.
* Strong knowledge of PostgreSQL query planning and execution, including EXPLAIN/EXPLAIN ANALYZE, buffers, join strategies, statistics, indexes, CTE behavior, aggregation, sorting, and parallel query considerations.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze high-row-count workloads and distinguish database execution time from connection acquisition, application processing, serialization, and network latency.
* Experience diagnosing major estimate-versus-actual row-count gaps and understanding how statistics and data distribution can influence plan selection.
* Practical experience tuning queries with joins and aggregation across large business datasets; ability to preserve correctness while reducing scanned rows, repeated lookups, and unnecessary intermediate results.
* Understanding of PostgreSQL transactions, isolation levels, read-only sessions, statement and lock timeouts, connection pooling, and safe cancellation behavior.
* Experience with Git-based source control, peer review, testing, and controlled release practices.
* Strong analytical, communication, documentation, and problem-solving skills; able to take ownership of an issue from evidence gathering through validation.
* Strong analytical abilities and problem-solving skills; strong communication skills
* Experience using code management tools, for example GIT or BitBucket
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to show flexibility and reach compromise where appropriate
* Willingness to take ownership for assigned aspects of the project
* Ability to innovate and iterate, willingness to experiment quickly
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills and an ability to work constructively in a shared team environment
* Good Communication skills.

**Nice to have:**

* Experience with Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL or PostgreSQL managed on AWS, including reader/writer endpoints, connection routing, replica lag, and failover considerations.
* Experience with performance observability tools such as pg\_stat\_statements, database load/wait dashboards, CloudWatch, or application tracing/APM.
* Experience with financial-services or wealth-management data, including accounts, parties, advisor/branch hierarchies, positions, balances, pricing, and FX conversion.
* Experience collaborating with Java/Spring services and understanding how datasource configuration, connection pools, request deadlines, and concurrent API traffic affect database load.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, automated SQL checks, and database change-management practices.

**Shift Timings:** UK Shift (1pm to 10pm)

**Skill Requirements**
----------------------

**Must-Have Skills**
--------------------

* PostgreSQL
* Advanced SQL Development
* Query Performance Tuning
* EXPLAIN ANALYZE Execution Plan Analysis
* Indexing Strategies (Composite, Partial, Expression)
* Large Data Volume Optimization
* Production Support & Troubleshooting
* Git/BitBucket

-----------------------

* AWS Aurora PostgreSQL
* pg\_stat\_statements
* CloudWatch / APM Tools
* Java/Spring Ecosystem Knowledge
* CI/CD Pipelines
* Wealth Management / Financial Services Domain

-------------------

PostgreSQL,SQL Proficiency

title: Global Service Delivery Manager
description:
**Role Overview**
The Global Field Services Manager is responsible for leading two core functions: Local EUC and EUC Services. Local EUC provides onsite and regional technology support across corporate offices, retail locations, airport sites, vaults, data centre locations and other operational environments. EUC Services acts as the third-line, centrally managed EUC capability, responsible for workstation endpoint, OS hardening, patching, software deployments, mobile device management, device lifecycle management, endpoint compliance and other centrally controlled EUC services.
  
  
The successful candidate will provide strong operational leadership across both functions, ensuring that onsite support and centrally managed EUC services are responsive, secure, consistent and aligned to global IT design standards. The role will work closely with Global Service Delivery, Network Operations, Infrastructure, Security, Retail Operations, Facilities, Change Management, vendors and country leadership teams to ensure local and central EUC services remain stable, supportable and fit for business use.
  
  
**Role Purpose**
The purpose of this role is to provide global leadership for the Local EUC and EUC Services functions, ensuring Travelex colleagues and operational sites receive consistent, high-quality onsite technology support while also benefiting from a robust, centrally managed third-line EUC service. The role will drive standardisation, accountability, lifecycle discipline, endpoint compliance and continual service improvement across both regional field support and centrally managed EUC capabilities.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Global Field Services Leadership**

* Lead the Global Field Services function across two core capabilities: Local EUC and EUC Services.
* Define and maintain the global operating model for both functions, including roles, responsibilities, escalation paths, service standards, technical ownership boundaries and governance routines.
* Ensure Local EUC and EUC Services operate as an integrated support model, with clear hand-offs between onsite support, second-line support, third-line engineering and central service ownership.
* Ensure services are delivered consistently across regions, while allowing controlled local adaptation where business, regulatory or operational requirements justify it.
* Act as the senior escalation point for field services and EUC service issues impacting business operations, colleague productivity, retail trading, endpoint compliance or site readiness.
* Develop a high-performing, customer-focused and accountable global field services culture across both local and central EUC teams.

**Local EUC and Workplace Technology Support**

* Own the delivery of onsite support for end-user devices, workplace technology and local infrastructure across global sites.
* Ensure effective support for laptops, desktops, mobile devices, operating systems, Microsoft 365, collaboration tools, printers, scanners, peripherals, meeting-room technology and approved business applications.
* Oversee executive and VIP support standards, ensuring responsive and professional service for senior stakeholders while maintaining consistent service principles for all users.
* Drive improvements in first-time fix, ageing ticket reduction, service quality, knowledge management and user experience.
* Work closely with EUC Services to ensure endpoint standards, deployment models and support playbooks are understood and adopted consistently by Local EUC and field teams.

**EUC Services and Third-Line Endpoint Engineering**

* Lead EUC Services as the third-line, centrally managed EUC capability responsible for endpoint engineering, standards, control and service reliability.
* Own central EUC responsibilities including OS hardening, patching, endpoint configuration, software packaging, software deployments, mobile device management, endpoint compliance and centrally managed EUC tooling.
* Ensure EUC Services defines and maintains global endpoint build standards, baseline configurations, deployment models, support playbooks and technical acceptance criteria.
* Provide technical escalation and engineering support for complex endpoint, operating-system, application deployment, MDM and device compliance issues that cannot be resolved through local or second-line support.
* Partner with Security, Infrastructure, IT Asset Management and Change Management to ensure endpoint services meet cyber, operational, lifecycle and compliance requirements.
* Drive automation, standardisation and proactive remediation across endpoint services, reducing manual effort and improving resilience, compliance and employee experience.

**Retail, Vault and Site Technology Operations**

* Lead field services support for retail and operational site technology, including tills, workstations, rate boards, local connectivity, peripherals, branch technology, vault support equipment and other approved site devices.
* Ensure technology incidents affecting retail trading, customer-facing services, site openings or operational continuity receive appropriate priority and ownership.
* Partner with Retail Operations, Facilities, Network Operations, Infrastructure and Application Support teams to support site openings, relocations, refurbishments, closures and technology remediation activity.
* Maintain strong operational controls for hardware inventory, site records, local support documentation and technology acceptance evidence.
* Support the adoption of a global Retail Technology Blueprint, ensuring sites are assessed against agreed hardware, configuration, security, resilience and supportability standards.

**Endpoint Lifecycle, Asset, Configuration and Compliance Management**

* Own the combined Local EUC and EUC Services execution model for endpoint build, deployment, replacement, recovery, decommissioning and disposal activities in line with global standards.
* Ensure accurate asset, stock, warranty, ownership, location, configuration and lifecycle information is maintained for equipment managed by field and EUC teams.
* Drive remediation of ageing, unsupported, duplicate, missing, non-compliant or under-utilised devices in partnership with IT Asset Management, Security and EUC Services.
* Oversee centrally managed EUC activities including operating-system upgrades, workstation changes, MDM adoption, software deployments, OS hardening, endpoint patching and endpoint compliance initiatives.
* Ensure Local EUC and EUC Services teams follow controlled processes for secure disposal, data protection, evidence capture, CMDB updates and compliance reporting.

**Service Management and Operational Governance**

* Ensure all field services work is managed through the ITSM platform with clear ownership, accurate categorisation, timely updates and complete resolution notes.
* Establish and monitor field services KPIs, including SLA performance, ticket age, backlog, repeat incidents, customer satisfaction, site readiness, asset accuracy and remediation progress.
* Contribute to incident, major incident, problem and change management processes where onsite support, local infrastructure or site technology is required.
* Drive root-cause analysis and corrective action for recurring local technology issues.
* Create consistent governance routines, reporting packs and operational reviews for regional teams, vendors and senior stakeholders.

**Security, Risk and Compliance**

* Ensure local technology services comply with Travelex security standards, endpoint configuration requirements, access control expectations and operational policies.
* Support vulnerability remediation, endpoint protection, encryption, secure configuration, software compliance and device hygiene activities across the global site estate.
* Ensure suspected security incidents are escalated promptly and relevant evidence is preserved in line with incident response procedures.
* Support audit, risk, regulatory and compliance evidence requests relating to local technology, end-user devices, site equipment and field services processes.
* Promote a security-first culture within field teams, ensuring convenience and speed are balanced with appropriate control and risk management.

**Transformation, Automation and Continuous Improvement**

* Lead field services participation in technology transformation programmes, including ITSM platform uplift, endpoint modernisation, site technology refreshes, security improvements and operational standardisation.
* Identify opportunities to automate repeatable support activities, improve self-service, enable shift-left support and reduce unnecessary onsite demand.
* Use service data, operational insight and regional feedback to drive measurable improvement in service quality, cost efficiency and operational resilience.
* Support global standardisation of workstation builds, site technology design, support documentation, deployment processes and operating procedures.
* Champion pragmatic innovation, including AI-enabled knowledge management, predictive support insights and improved field service scheduling where appropriate.

**Stakeholder, Supplier and Regional Management**

* Build trusted relationships with country leadership, Retail Operations, Facilities, Technology teams, Service Delivery and third-party suppliers.
* Translate local operational needs into clear global requirements, ensuring local teams have a voice in central technology decisions.
* Manage regional escalations, service risks, resourcing pressures, supplier issues and delivery dependencies.
* Ensure vendor activity is governed effectively, including site access, quality assurance, documentation, service acceptance and escalation management.
* Provide clear and concise reporting to senior leadership on field services performance, risks, issues, priorities and improvement plans.

**Essential Experience**
**Experience and Skills Required**

* Significant experience leading field services, Local EUC, deskside support, EUC engineering, workplace technology or regional IT support functions in a complex multi-site organisation.
* Proven experience managing geographically distributed teams across multiple countries, regions or time zones.
* Strong understanding of retail technology support, corporate workplace technology, endpoint lifecycle management, local infrastructure support and centrally managed EUC services.
* Experience leading or working closely with a third-line EUC capability responsible for endpoint engineering, OS hardening, patching, software deployments, MDM, endpoint compliance and technical escalation.
* Experience operating within ITIL-aligned incident, request, problem, change and service transition processes.
* Strong knowledge of Microsoft 365, Windows/MacOS endpoint environments, mobile device management, endpoint deployment, collaboration tools and workplace technologies.
* Experience managing operational performance through KPIs, SLAs, service reviews, governance forums and continuous improvement plans.
* Demonstrable experience supporting business-critical sites, including retail, airport, branch, vault, warehouse, operational or customer-facing environments.
* Experience working in a global, matrixed, multi-vendor technology environment.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, including the ability to influence senior business, technology and regional leaders.

**Desirable Experience**

* Experience within financial services, payments, retail, travel, foreign exchange, aviation or another regulated customer-facing sector.
* Experience delivering hardware refresh, operating-system upgrade, site technology refresh, MDM, endpoint compliance or workstation standardisation programmes.
* Experience operating within or partnering with a Global Capability Centre or offshore support model.
* Experience with endpoint management tooling such as Microsoft Intune, Windows Autopilot, Apple MacOS, Ivanti, Jamf, Entra ID, Active Directory, remote support tools and asset discovery platforms.
* Experience improving asset accuracy, stock control, device lifecycle governance and field service scheduling.
* Experience supporting audit, cyber security, risk or compliance evidence activities relating to endpoint and site technologies.

**Leadership and Behavioural Expectations**

* Leads with ownership, accountability and a strong service mindset.
* Builds high-performing teams across different regions, cultures and working models.
* Communicates clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders, including senior leaders.
* Balances urgency with control, ensuring service issues are resolved quickly without compromising security, governance or quality.
* Uses data and operational insight to drive better decisions, prioritisation and service improvements.
* Creates a culture of collaboration, standardisation, continuous improvement and customer service excellence.
* Demonstrates resilience and calm leadership during high-pressure incidents, escalations and business-critical service issues.

**Qualifications And Certifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Information Systems or equivalent professional experience.
* ITIL certification is strongly preferred.
* Relevant Microsoft, endpoint management, service management, project delivery or leadership certifications are advantageous.
* Additional qualifications in IT asset management, cyber security, Lean, Agile, Prince2, COBIT or SIAM are desirable.

2. Define and maintain technical guidelines, standards, and procedures for \*\*wireless networks and services\*\*.

3. Develop guidelines and technical requirements for \*\*wireless traffic management and data services\*\*.

2. Strong understanding of \*\*IP networking and routing protocols\*\*, including Static Routing, OSPF, and BGP.

3. Good understanding of \*\*wireless networking technologies and standards\*\*, including IEEE 802.11a/b/g/n/ac/ax and LTE.

4. Knowledge of network security concepts and protocols, including \*\*WPA2/WPA3, AES, 802.1X, and RADIUS\*\*.

Knowledge or hands-on experience with \*\*Cisco Cyber Vision\*\* and Industrial OT network visibility, asset discovery, and security monitoring.

12. Ability to work effectively with multiple stakeholders and translate business/service requirements into practical technical solutions.

  

**### Qualifications & Experience**

\*\*8–10 years of relevant experience\*\* in Network Engineering, Wireless Engineering, Network Planning, Service Planning, or a similar role.

\* Strong understanding of enterprise/service-provider networking and wireless technologies. \* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

\* Ability to prepare and present technical designs, architecture documents, and service requirements to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

\* Relevant industry certifications such as \*\*CCNA, CCNP, CWNA, CWNP\*\*, or equivalent certifications are desirable. \* Experience with \*\*Cisco networking and security technologies\*\* would be an added advantage.

**Join our digital revolution in NatWest Digital X**
----------------------------------------------------

In everything we do, we work to one aim. To make digital experiences which are effortless and secure.

So we organise ourselves around three principles: engineer, protect, and operate. We engineer simple solutions, we protect our customers, and we operate smarter.

-------------------

This role is based in India and as such all normal working days must be carried out in India.

Join us as a Release Train Manager

  
  

* This is a unique opportunity to join a fast paced and Agile team, responsible for aligning the vision, planning, and interdependencies of many teams by providing cross-team or domain synchronisation of the portfolio delivery and domain pipeline
* With no two days the same, you'll have the chance to be a true servant leader and help ensure consistent Agile delivery at scale

------------------

  
  

In this key role, you’ll be developing and maintaining the release train. This will include the preparation and review of the release and environment strategy, involving plans and estimation, and management of interdependencies. With your vital leadership, you’ll provide cross-team synchronisation, making sure everyone has a clear understanding of how their work helps our customers.

  
  

You’ll drive continuous improvement across delivery via various channels, including improving or removing manual steps, and we’ll look to you to demonstrably improve release train agility and value to end state customers.

* Assisting with the economic decision-making by facilitating estimation by teams and the roll up to programme and portfolio levels

--------------------------

  
  

We’re looking for someone with an expert understanding of running complex projects spanning multiple scrum and non-scrum teams.

  
  

You’ll also need:

  
  

* Expert level knowledge and proficiency with scaled Agile and P3M tools and methodologies spanning value stream, portfolio, programme and team levels

The candidate will be responsible for handling end-to-end order processing, commercial documentation, client coordination, logistics, dispatch management, and payment follow-ups. * Strong working knowledge of MS Excel and Google Sheets.

* Strong ownership, follow-up, coordination, and problem-solving abilities.

title: Senior Coupa Consultant
description:
**Company Description**
Zenardy is a technology consulting company specializing in the implementation of NetSuite industry solutions for hi-tech, food and beverage, manufacturing and distribution, and general business organizations. The company focuses on aligning cloud ERP capabilities with the unique operational needs of each client, helping them streamline processes and improve decision-making.

**Role Description**

We are seeking a Coupa Functional Consultant with 3-7 years of experience in Coupa implementation, configuration, and support. The role involves managing P2P processes, supplier onboarding, e-invoicing, compliance, and NetSuite–Coupa integrations in a global, multi-country environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Configure, implement, and support Coupa core modules: Supplier Information Management (SIM), Coupa Supplier Portal (CSP), Coupa Pay, Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM), Expense Management, and Invoice Management with InvoiceSmash.
* Design and maintain SIM onboarding forms, approval workflows, supplier risk and compliance checks, and bank detail verification processes.
* Drive supplier enablement on the Coupa Supplier Portal and ensure accurate supplier data synchronization with the ERP.
* Set up and manage country-specific e-invoicing, including PEPPOL, Mexico CFDI, and India e-invoicing, along with regional tax configurations.
* Ensure regulatory compliance across all operating regions in a multi-currency, multi-entity environment.
* Lead and support the NetSuite–Coupa integration, including master data sync for suppliers, chart of accounts, departments, and subsidiaries.
* Partner with procurement, finance, AP, and IT stakeholders to gather requirements, resolve issues, and continuously improve processes.
* Provide ongoing production support, troubleshooting, testing, and user training.

**Required Qualifications**

* 3-7 years of relevant experience in Coupa implementation, configuration, and production support.
* Proven hands-on experience configuring and implementing Coupa in global, multi-country, multi-currency environments.
* Strong working knowledge of SIM, CSP, Coupa Pay, CLM, Expense Management, and Invoice Management/InvoiceSmash.
* Practical experience with e-invoicing frameworks (PEPPOL, CFDI, India e-invoicing) and indirect tax configuration.
* Demonstrated experience integrating Coupa with NetSuite, including master data and supplier data flows.
* Solid understanding of procure-to-pay (P2P) and source-to-pay (S2P) processes.
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to work with cross-functional, international teams.

title: SAP QM Consultant
description:
**Hiring for PULS Group**
— via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role.

**About Company**

PULS develops power supplies and industrial power systems and operates with teams across India, Germany, the Czech Republic and China. The SAP team supports global processes and further S/4HANA rollouts.

**Job Roles & Responsibilities**

* Own SAP QM requirements analysis, functional specifications, customizing, testing, documentation and deployment for change requests and rollout projects.
* Support quality inspection planning, inspection lots, notifications, usage decisions and quality processes across procurement and production.
* Work with the global SAP/IT team and business stakeholders on S/4HANA template rollout, cross-module integration, incidents and improvements.
* Coordinate with developers on ABAP debugging and with external systems such as MES where relevant.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

* At least seven years in SAP ERP/S/4HANA work, including at least five years of substantive IT-side SAP QM consulting rather than only key-user or business-side exposure.
* Hands-on SAP S/4HANA experience and SAP QM process configuration and implementation.
* Integration experience with at least one of SAP MM, PP or EWM; experience in two is valued.
* Strong English communication for collaboration with teams in China, the Czech Republic and Germany.
* Electronics manufacturing experience, traceability or certification processes, and full-cycle implementations are highly valued but not mandatory.

**Hiring Process**

* Profiles are first reviewed by the internal hiring manager against the QM consulting, S/4HANA and cross-module integration requirements.
* Relevant candidates then complete a Flexiple interview focused on their own SAP QM configuration, rollout contributions and communication.

**What We Offer**

* Work on global SAP QM change initiatives and S/4HANA rollouts.
* Collaborate with cross-functional SAP and manufacturing teams across multiple countries.
* Shape quality processes and integrations for industrial products.

title: Senior BP Project Management Specialist
description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

**A Day in the Life**
=====================

Review the knowledge queue and AI-drafted suggestions; apply style, metadata and route for approval. Tune synonyms and semantic search; run UAT for a new Agent Assist snippet addressing the top call driver. Lead a KCS huddle with Content Owners; convert Problem RCA into a reusable article; configure Virtual Agent intent hints. Publish a mini-report from the Knowledge dashboard highlighting precision/recall and zero-result trends.
  
  
Our Global IT Support Organization operates within IT Operations and the IT Service Management Office (ITSMO). We deliver customer-centric services at scale across regions with a follow-the-sun support model. Knowledge Management is treated as a product and practice—integrated with Incident, Problem, Change, Service Configuration (CMDB), Asset, Catalog and Request Fulfillment. The team partners closely with the Global Service Desk (GSD) and the Data Analytics group, using the Knowledge dashboard to drive deflection, search effectiveness, and MTTR improvements.  

**Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:**

* Operational owner of the day-to-day Knowledge process and AI-assisted content operations.
* Front-line partner to GSD and process peers to ensure knowledge appears at the point of need (IT Portal, Service Operation Workspace, request/incident flows) with Agent Assist/Virtual Agent and IT Virtual Assistant (Robin) support.
* Co-administrator of the Knowledge dashboard; translate analytics into actions (synonyms, content fixes, experiments).
Execute intake review approve/publish* retire; enforce style/taxonomy/metadata standards; maintain human-in-the-loop review for AI-drafted content.

* Convert Problems/KEDB into reusable articles; ensure Change/Release has pre–go-live knowledge; embed guided help in Catalog/Request.
* Co-own the Knowledge dashboard: define measures with analytics, validate PA data, run A/B tests on search/intent tuning, and publish insights.
Coordinate UAT for AI features and search changes; document SOPs/work instructions; keep the process audit-ready.

* A Bachelor’s or Master degree or equivalent with 7+ year’s experience in the below is required, along with proficiency in English (C1+).
* Minimum ITIL v3 Practitioner/Professional; ITIL 4 practice-level or Managing Professional preferred.
* 5+ years in ITSM support/process roles; 2+ years in Knowledge or adjacent processes (Incident/Request).
* ServiceNow knowledge administration and familiarity with Predictive Intelligence/Agent Assist/Virtual Agent; PA reports.
* Working familiarity with KCS v6 and corporate GenAI guidelines (review, disclosure, PII checks).
Strong BA skills: requirements, SOPs, acceptance criteria, light data analysis; excellent written communication.  

Desired Skills & Experience,

* Prompt library maintenance; basic A/B testing design; GenAI moderation workflows;
Multi-language content pipeline (English primary).

* Time-to-publish;

* Article quality/helpfulness;

* Contribution rate;

title: Technical Onboarding Engineer - IFS Logistics
description:

Our commitment to internal AI adoption has allowed us to stay at the forefront of technological advancements, ensuring our colleagues can unlock their creativity and productivity, and our solutions are always cutting-edge.

We celebrate diversity and understand our responsibility to reflect the diverse world we work in. We are committed to promoting an inclusive workforce that fully represents the many different cultures, backgrounds, and viewpoints of our customers, our partners, and our communities. As a truly international company serving people from around the globe, we realize that our success is tantamount to the respect we have for those different points of view.

By joining our team, you will have the opportunity to be part of a
**global, diverse environment;**
you will be joining a
**winning team**
with a
**commitment to sustainability;**
and a company where we get things done so that you can
**make a positive impact**
on the world.

We’re looking for innovative and original thinkers to work in an environment where you can
**#MakeYourMoment**
so that we can help others make theirs. With the power of our AI-driven solutions, we empower our team to change the status quo and make a real difference.

If you want to change the status quo, we’ll help you make your moment. Join Team Purple. Join IFS.

**Job Description**

**About IFS Logistics**

IFS Logistics helps enterprise shippers connect transport data, manage carrier spend and automate execution. The product began as 7bridges and is now part of IFS, with a small team building and running it.

**The role**

We are hiring two Tech Onboarding Engineers for six-month fixed-term roles, starting as soon as possible. You will connect carriers and providers, bring customer data into the platform and help named customers reach production while the core squads continue building longer-term foundations.

The work is hands-on integration engineering. You will deal with ERP exports, shipment files, invoices, APIs and third-party feeds that are rarely as clean or stable as their documentation suggests.

The goal is not simply to process more onboarding work. When the same manual step appears repeatedly, you will turn it into a template, configuration option, self-service tool or well-defined product change. By the end of the contract, the platform should need less manual onboarding than it did when you joined.

This is a genuine six-month engagement with no implied permanent conversion.

**What you'll work on**

* Connect new carriers and providers through APIs and file feeds, including credentials, testing and go-live support.
* Map, clean and validate customer ERP exports, shipment files and invoices into our data model.
* Own onboarding tasks for named customers against clear delivery dates.
* Support the Product Operations team as they onboard customers and handle master data management.
* Diagnose failures involving authentication, pagination, rate limits, schema changes and poor source data.
* Convert repeated manual steps into reusable templates, configuration or self-service tooling.
* Document integrations and failure modes so the core squads can support them after the contract ends.

**Qualifications**

**What we're looking for**

* Around two to five years of hands-on software or integration engineering experience.
* Python and enough SQL to investigate data properly.
* Experience with REST APIs, authentication, pagination, retries and rate limits.
* Confidence working with inconsistent third-party data, including missing fields, changing schemas and bad encodings.
* A track record of automating repeated work rather than quietly absorbing it.
* The ability to run a technical working session with a customer's team and communicate data problems clearly.
* Regular use of AI coding tools such as Cursor or Claude, with a reliable process for checking output.
* The ability to organise your own work and become productive quickly in a time-boxed engagement.

**Nice to have**

* Logistics, freight, parcel or supply-chain data experience.
* BigQuery, dbt or comparable data-warehouse tooling.
* EDI or carrier and 3PL integrations.
* Previous onboarding or implementation engineering in a SaaS company.

**Tech stack**

Python and Django REST, TypeScript, Node and React; BigQuery, dbt, Cube Cloud and Superset; Pub/Sub and Datastream; GCP, Kubernetes, Terraform and GitLab CI/CD. We use Cursor and Claude for development, Notion for specifications and Jira for delivery.

**What success looks like in the first six months**

* The named customers assigned to you are live on time.
* New carrier and provider integrations are running with their known failure modes documented.
* At least two previously manual onboarding steps have become self-service or automated.
* The permanent squads have a clear, usable handover for every integration you owned.

**Why we're hiring now**

Customer and carrier onboarding demand is higher than the core squads can absorb while they improve the platform itself. These roles provide immediate delivery capacity and turn the lessons from current onboardings into better tooling for the next ones.

**Additional Information**

*We embrace flexibility and hybrid work opportunities to support diverse needs and lifestyles, while also valuing inclusive workplace experiences. By fostering a sense of community, we drive innovation, strengthen connections, and nurture belonging. Our commitment ensures you can work in a way that suits you best, while also engaging with colleagues to share ideas and build meaningful relationships.*

title: IT Solutions Analyst (Universal Robots, Bangalore - India)
description:
The
**IT Solutions Analyst - ServiceNow**
is the functional and technical bridge between business stakeholders and the ServiceNow platform, responsible for designing, configuring, enhancing, and supporting solutions across Customer Service Management (CSM), Manufacturing Commercial Operations (MCO), and Sales and Order Management (SOM).
  
  
This role translates customer service, asset management, contracts management, and entitlement-related requirements into scalable ServiceNow workflows, custom applications, and integrations. The analyst partners with Sales, Field Service, Customer Care, Manufacturing, and other IT teams to improve customer experience, order accuracy, and service efficiency, and acts as a subject-matter expert and escalation point for production support. As part of the IT Enterprise Applications team, the analyst also designs and supports integrations between ServiceNow and other systems, including Salesforce, on-premise applications, and databases.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities****
**Requirements analysis and solution design**

* Gather, document, and refine business requirements through workshops, interviews, and process mapping with Sales, Customer Service, Manufacturing, and Finance stakeholders.
* Translate requirements into functional specifications, user stories with acceptance criteria, and solution designs aligned to ServiceNow best practices.
* Assess the impact of platform upgrades, new releases, and process changes, and recommend out-of-the-box (OOTB) approaches over customization where practical.

**Platform configuration and development**

* Configure and enhance CSM (case management, customer and account data, entitlements, SLAs, Customer Service Portal, Virtual Agent, knowledge management).
* Configure and enhance MCO and SOM (product and quote catalogs, order capture, decomposition and fulfillment orchestration, order tracking, and commercial and manufacturing operations workflows).
* Design and build custom scoped applications using Flow Designer, Workflow Studio, Business Rules, Script Includes, UI Policies, Client Scripts, UI Builder / Workspaces, and Service Portal.
* Build and maintain integrations between ServiceNow and Salesforce, on-premise applications, databases, ERP, PLM, MES, telephony, and other enterprise systems using REST/SOAP APIs, Integration Hub, MID Server, JDBC, and data import sets.
* Implement and tune ServiceNow AI features (Now Assist skills, AI Agents, Virtual Agent, AI Search, Build Agent) across CSM, MCO, and SOM processes, and measure their impact on case deflection, resolution time, and agent productivity.

**Testing, deployment, and release management**

* Develop test plans and test cases, execute functional and regression testing, and coordinate user acceptance testing (UAT).
* Manage update sets / application repository deployments across instances and follow established change, release, and source-control practices.
* Produce release notes, training materials, and knowledge articles, and support end-user and super-user training.

**Production support and continuous improvement**

* Provide Tier 2/3 support for CSM, MCO, and SOM, including incident triage, root-cause analysis, and permanent fixes within SLA targets.
* Monitor platform health, data quality, and performance, and proactively identify and close process or configuration gaps.
* Support platform upgrades, family release adoption, and technical debt reduction.
* Maintain solution documentation, data models, and process flows; contribute to the product backlog and sprint planning.

**Governance and collaboration**

* Work with architects, developers, and platform owners to uphold standards for security, ACLs, data governance, and compliance.
* Report on solution adoption and process KPIs (case resolution time, order cycle time, SLA attainment) using Performance Analytics and dashboards.
* Mentor junior analysts and share knowledge across the ServiceNow community of practice.

****All About You****
We seek individuals who share our passion and determination. Our commitment to customer success drives us to go the extra mile. If you’re ready to join us in this mission, take a closer look at the minimum criteria for the position.
  
  
****Education And Experience****

* Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5+ years of hands-on ServiceNow experience as a platform analyst, administrator, or developer, focused specifically on ServiceNow solutions.
* Demonstrated implementation and support experience in at least two of the three target modules: CSM, MCO, and SOM.
* Proven experience developing custom scoped applications on the ServiceNow platform, from requirements through deployment and support.
* Experience supporting production ServiceNow environments, including incident management, root-cause analysis, upgrades, and release cycles.

**ServiceNow certifications**
**Certification**
**Requirement**
ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA)
  
  
**Required**
ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist – Customer Service Management (CSM)
  
  
Optional (preferred)
  
  
ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist – Sales and Order Management (SOM)
  
  
Optional (preferred)
  
  
ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD)
  
  
**Required**
Candidates holding certifications in Manufacturing Commercial Operations (MCO) or comparable manufacturing-industry ServiceNow credentials will be given strong preference.
  
  
****Technical Skills****

* Strong working knowledge of ServiceNow data model, tables, ACLs, roles, and CMDB / Customer Service data structures.
* Proficiency with JavaScript (server-side and client-side), Glide APIs, Flow Designer, Workflow Studio, and scoped application development.
* Experience with integrations to Salesforce, on-premise applications, and databases (SQL, JDBC) using REST/SOAP, Integration Hub spokes, MID Server, and import sets / transform maps.
* Hands-on experience with ServiceNow AI capabilities, including Now Assist skills for CSM and SOM (case and order summarization, resolution notes, knowledge generation), Now Assist Virtual Agent, AI Search, and customizing skills with Now Assist Skill Kit (NASK).
* Working knowledge of agentic AI on the platform, including features available through the Australia release: building, configuring, and governing AI Agents and agentic workflows, selecting model providers (Now LLM Service or third-party models), and managing Now Assist administration, licensing tiers, and guardrails.
* Experience with Customer Service Portal, Service Portal, UI Builder, and Workspaces (Customer Service Workspace).
* Understanding of order-to-cash, quote-to-order, entitlement, and warranty / contract processes.
* Familiarity with Agile (Scrum / SAFe) delivery, user story writing, and tools such as ServiceNow Agile Development, Jira, or Azure DevOps.
* Ability to write functional specifications, test cases, and process documentation, and to present solutions to technical and non-technical audiences.

****Preferred Qualifications****

* Hands-on MCO experience, including manufacturing commercial processes such as contracts, pricing, and order-to-delivery visibility.
* Experience with Configure, Price, Quote (CPQ) solutions, such as ServiceNow Sales and Order Management quoting, Salesforce CPQ, or Oracle CPQ, including product catalogs, pricing rules, quote-to-order flows, and integration with order management and ERP systems (a strong advantage).
* Additional ServiceNow certifications: Certified Technical Architect (in progress), Integration Hub, Performance Analytics, Now Assist / Generative AI / Agentic AI, or Predictive Intelligence.
* Experience building custom AI skills and AI Agents or using Build Agent to create agentic workflows for custom applications, and keeping pace with new AI capabilities in each ServiceNow family release.
* Experience integrating ServiceNow with ERP (Oracle Fusion), CRM (Salesforce), PLM, or MES systems.
* Experience with CI/CD and source control for ServiceNow (for example, Git integration, ATF automated testing).
* Exposure to data analytics and reporting tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
* Prior experience coordinating large/small projects or mentoring junior team members.

****Core Skills And Working Conditions****
**Core skills**

* Analytical and problem-solving ability, with a bias toward root-cause resolution over workarounds.
* Clear written and verbal communication, including facilitating workshops and explaining technical concepts to business users.
* Stakeholder management and the ability to balance multiple priorities across commercial, service, and manufacturing teams.
* Customer-centric mindset, with a focus on measurable outcomes and user adoption.
* Ownership, attention to detail, and comfort being self-directed in a fast-paced, Agile environment.
* Collaboration with onshore and offshore development partners.

**Working conditions**

* Primarily remote-based, with occasional travel.
* Participation in an on-call rotation for critical production issues and occasional after-hours release or upgrade support.

We are only considering candidates local to position location and are unable to provide relocation for this position. This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

title: Engineer AIT – Optical Payloads
description:
**ABOUT US**

Join a team that is redefining the accessibility of space. Azista space is a transformative force in the global aerospace sector, uniquely positioned at the intersection of indigenous innovation and industrial scalability. Operating India’s first private-sector satellite mass-production facility in Ahmedabad, we have bridged the gap between complex engineering and high-volume manufacturing.

As a vertically integrated leader, we provide end-to-end solutions from the precision design of satellite buses and advanced payloads to mission management and communication systems. We don’t just build hardware, we are democratizing the final frontier by providing global clientele with the cost-effective, high-performance technology needed to power the next generation of orbital missions. At Azista, you won't just be starting a job, you’ll be fuelling the future of space exploration.

Overview / Role Summary

This role is responsible for supporting Assembly, Integration and Testing (AIT) activities for space optical payloads, including optical alignment, calibration, performance verification, and preparation of technical documentation, in close collaboration with senior engineers.

**JOB SUMMARY**

We are seeking a driven
**AIT Engineer – Optical Payloads**
to support Assembly, Integration, and Testing (AIT) operations at our Ahmedabad facility. Working closely with senior engineers and multidisciplinary teams, you will play a crucial role in bringing complex space-borne optical systems from individual components to fully integrated, launch-ready payloads.

In this role, you will own optical alignment tasks, assist with critical performance measurements (MTF, EFL, distortion), and support environmental testing (Thermal Vacuum, Vibration, Shock). Your success will be measured by test execution accuracy, payload calibration reliability, strict adherence to cleanroom standards, and the quality of integration documentation generated for mission assurance.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* **Optical Alignment & Metrology:**
  Support the alignment of optical subsystems using interferometers, autocollimators, collimators, theodolites, and precision test instruments under senior engineering guidance.
* **Payload Integration & Assembly:**
  Assist in the hands-on assembly, subsystem integration, and end-to-end verification of space optical payloads.
* **Performance Verification & Calibration:**
  Perform key optical measurements—including Modulation Transfer Function (MTF), Effective Focal Length (EFL), and distortion—alongside radiometric and spectral calibrations.
* **Environmental Test Campaign Support:**
  Prepare test setups and monitor critical optical parameters during Thermal Vacuum (TVAC), vibration, and shock testing.
* **Documentation & Mission Assurance:**
  Author detailed integration procedures, test setups, observation logs, and verification records to ensure strict traceabilty.
* **Cleanroom Protocol Management:**
  Enforce cleanroom standards, contamination control, and ESD safety practices across all integration activities.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:**
  Partner with mechanical, electronics, thermal, and systems engineering teams to resolve payload integration challenges.

**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR?**

* **Education:**
  Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Optical Engineering, Applied Optics, Physics, Photonics, or a related discipline.
* **Experience:**
  0–3 years of hands-on experience in optical system integration, alignment, or optical laboratory/academic projects.
* **Core Technical Knowledge:**
  Strong foundational understanding of optical principles, imaging systems, and precision alignment techniques.
* **Software Competency:**
  Familiarity with optical simulation or data analysis tools such as Zemax, Code V, MATLAB, or Python.
* **Soft Skills:**
  High adaptability, strong analytical problem-solving skills, and a passion for space systems engineering.

**NICE-TO-HAVE (PREFERRED)**

* Direct experience with optical metrology equipment (interferometers, spectrometers, autocollimators).
* Practical exposure to cleanroom protocols (ISO 5–8) and contamination control protocols.
* Academic or internship exposure to optical testing, spectral calibration, or radiometric measurements.
* Familiarity with international space qualification standards (ISRO, NASA, ECSS, or equivalent).

**WHY JOIN US?**

* **Pioneer the New Space Economy:**
  Work at India’s premier private-sector satellite mass-production facility and directly impact active orbital missions.
* **Cutting-Edge Technology:**
  Gain hands-on exposure to advanced optical metrology tools, space-grade cleanrooms, and environmental testing infrastructure.
* **Accelerated Career Growth:**
  Work side-by-side with industry experts in a high-growth, merit-driven environment that values initiative and continuous learning.
* **End-to-End Ownership:**
  See your work transition directly from lab setups and integration racks to active deployment in space.
* **Collaborative Culture:**
  Join a multidisciplinary team of passionate engineers committed to democratizing space technology.
