title: Technical Onboarding Engineer - IFS Logistics
description:
IFS is a billion-dollar revenue company with 7000+ employees on all continents. Our leading AI technology is the backbone of our award-winning enterprise software solutions, enabling our customers to be their best when it really matters–at the Moment of Service™. Our commitment to internal AI adoption has allowed us to stay at the forefront of technological advancements, ensuring our colleagues can unlock their creativity and productivity, and our solutions are always cutting-edge.

At IFS, we’re flexible, we’re innovative, and we’re focused not only on how we can engage with our customers but on how we can make a real change and have a worldwide impact. We help solve some of society’s greatest challenges, fostering a better future through our agility, collaboration, and trust.

We celebrate diversity and understand our responsibility to reflect the diverse world we work in. We are committed to promoting an inclusive workforce that fully represents the many different cultures, backgrounds, and viewpoints of our customers, our partners, and our communities. As a truly international company serving people from around the globe, we realize that our success is tantamount to the respect we have for those different points of view.

By joining our team, you will have the opportunity to be part of a
**global, diverse environment;**
you will be joining a
**winning team**
with a
**commitment to sustainability;**
and a company where we get things done so that you can
**make a positive impact**
on the world.

We’re looking for innovative and original thinkers to work in an environment where you can
**#MakeYourMoment**
so that we can help others make theirs. With the power of our AI-driven solutions, we empower our team to change the status quo and make a real difference.

If you want to change the status quo, we’ll help you make your moment. Join Team Purple. Join IFS.

**Job Description**

**About IFS Logistics**

IFS Logistics helps enterprise shippers connect transport data, manage carrier spend and automate execution. The product began as 7bridges and is now part of IFS, with a small team building and running it.

**The role**

We are hiring two Tech Onboarding Engineers for six-month fixed-term roles, starting as soon as possible. You will connect carriers and providers, bring customer data into the platform and help named customers reach production while the core squads continue building longer-term foundations.

The work is hands-on integration engineering. You will deal with ERP exports, shipment files, invoices, APIs and third-party feeds that are rarely as clean or stable as their documentation suggests.

The goal is not simply to process more onboarding work. When the same manual step appears repeatedly, you will turn it into a template, configuration option, self-service tool or well-defined product change. By the end of the contract, the platform should need less manual onboarding than it did when you joined.

This is a genuine six-month engagement with no implied permanent conversion.

**What you'll work on**

* Connect new carriers and providers through APIs and file feeds, including credentials, testing and go-live support.
* Map, clean and validate customer ERP exports, shipment files and invoices into our data model.
* Own onboarding tasks for named customers against clear delivery dates.
* Support the Product Operations team as they onboard customers and handle master data management.
* Diagnose failures involving authentication, pagination, rate limits, schema changes and poor source data.
* Convert repeated manual steps into reusable templates, configuration or self-service tooling.
* Document integrations and failure modes so the core squads can support them after the contract ends.

**Qualifications**

**What we're looking for**

* Around two to five years of hands-on software or integration engineering experience.
* Python and enough SQL to investigate data properly.
* Experience with REST APIs, authentication, pagination, retries and rate limits.
* Confidence working with inconsistent third-party data, including missing fields, changing schemas and bad encodings.
* A track record of automating repeated work rather than quietly absorbing it.
* The ability to run a technical working session with a customer's team and communicate data problems clearly.
* Regular use of AI coding tools such as Cursor or Claude, with a reliable process for checking output.
* The ability to organise your own work and become productive quickly in a time-boxed engagement.

**Nice to have**

* Logistics, freight, parcel or supply-chain data experience.
* BigQuery, dbt or comparable data-warehouse tooling.
* EDI or carrier and 3PL integrations.
* Previous onboarding or implementation engineering in a SaaS company.

**Tech stack**

Python and Django REST, TypeScript, Node and React; BigQuery, dbt, Cube Cloud and Superset; Pub/Sub and Datastream; GCP, Kubernetes, Terraform and GitLab CI/CD. We use Cursor and Claude for development, Notion for specifications and Jira for delivery.

**What success looks like in the first six months**

* The named customers assigned to you are live on time.
* New carrier and provider integrations are running with their known failure modes documented.
* At least two previously manual onboarding steps have become self-service or automated.
* The permanent squads have a clear, usable handover for every integration you owned.

**Why we're hiring now**

Customer and carrier onboarding demand is higher than the core squads can absorb while they improve the platform itself. These roles provide immediate delivery capacity and turn the lessons from current onboardings into better tooling for the next ones.

**Additional Information**

*We embrace flexibility and hybrid work opportunities to support diverse needs and lifestyles, while also valuing inclusive workplace experiences. By fostering a sense of community, we drive innovation, strengthen connections, and nurture belonging. Our commitment ensures you can work in a way that suits you best, while also engaging with colleagues to share ideas and build meaningful relationships.*

title: IT Solutions Analyst (Universal Robots, Bangalore - India)
description:
The
**IT Solutions Analyst - ServiceNow**
is the functional and technical bridge between business stakeholders and the ServiceNow platform, responsible for designing, configuring, enhancing, and supporting solutions across Customer Service Management (CSM), Manufacturing Commercial Operations (MCO), and Sales and Order Management (SOM).
  
  
This role translates customer service, asset management, contracts management, and entitlement-related requirements into scalable ServiceNow workflows, custom applications, and integrations. The analyst partners with Sales, Field Service, Customer Care, Manufacturing, and other IT teams to improve customer experience, order accuracy, and service efficiency, and acts as a subject-matter expert and escalation point for production support. As part of the IT Enterprise Applications team, the analyst also designs and supports integrations between ServiceNow and other systems, including Salesforce, on-premise applications, and databases.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities****
**Requirements analysis and solution design**

* Gather, document, and refine business requirements through workshops, interviews, and process mapping with Sales, Customer Service, Manufacturing, and Finance stakeholders.
* Translate requirements into functional specifications, user stories with acceptance criteria, and solution designs aligned to ServiceNow best practices.
* Assess the impact of platform upgrades, new releases, and process changes, and recommend out-of-the-box (OOTB) approaches over customization where practical.

**Platform configuration and development**

* Configure and enhance CSM (case management, customer and account data, entitlements, SLAs, Customer Service Portal, Virtual Agent, knowledge management).
* Configure and enhance MCO and SOM (product and quote catalogs, order capture, decomposition and fulfillment orchestration, order tracking, and commercial and manufacturing operations workflows).
* Design and build custom scoped applications using Flow Designer, Workflow Studio, Business Rules, Script Includes, UI Policies, Client Scripts, UI Builder / Workspaces, and Service Portal.
* Build and maintain integrations between ServiceNow and Salesforce, on-premise applications, databases, ERP, PLM, MES, telephony, and other enterprise systems using REST/SOAP APIs, Integration Hub, MID Server, JDBC, and data import sets.
* Implement and tune ServiceNow AI features (Now Assist skills, AI Agents, Virtual Agent, AI Search, Build Agent) across CSM, MCO, and SOM processes, and measure their impact on case deflection, resolution time, and agent productivity.

**Testing, deployment, and release management**

* Develop test plans and test cases, execute functional and regression testing, and coordinate user acceptance testing (UAT).
* Manage update sets / application repository deployments across instances and follow established change, release, and source-control practices.
* Produce release notes, training materials, and knowledge articles, and support end-user and super-user training.

**Production support and continuous improvement**

* Provide Tier 2/3 support for CSM, MCO, and SOM, including incident triage, root-cause analysis, and permanent fixes within SLA targets.
* Monitor platform health, data quality, and performance, and proactively identify and close process or configuration gaps.
* Support platform upgrades, family release adoption, and technical debt reduction.
* Maintain solution documentation, data models, and process flows; contribute to the product backlog and sprint planning.

**Governance and collaboration**

* Work with architects, developers, and platform owners to uphold standards for security, ACLs, data governance, and compliance.
* Report on solution adoption and process KPIs (case resolution time, order cycle time, SLA attainment) using Performance Analytics and dashboards.
* Mentor junior analysts and share knowledge across the ServiceNow community of practice.

****All About You****
We seek individuals who share our passion and determination. Our commitment to customer success drives us to go the extra mile. If you’re ready to join us in this mission, take a closer look at the minimum criteria for the position.
  
  
****Education And Experience****

* Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5+ years of hands-on ServiceNow experience as a platform analyst, administrator, or developer, focused specifically on ServiceNow solutions.
* Demonstrated implementation and support experience in at least two of the three target modules: CSM, MCO, and SOM.
* Proven experience developing custom scoped applications on the ServiceNow platform, from requirements through deployment and support.
* Experience supporting production ServiceNow environments, including incident management, root-cause analysis, upgrades, and release cycles.

**ServiceNow certifications**
**Certification**
**Requirement**
ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA)
  
  
**Required**
ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist – Customer Service Management (CSM)
  
  
Optional (preferred)
  
  
ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist – Sales and Order Management (SOM)
  
  
Optional (preferred)
  
  
ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD)
  
  
**Required**
Candidates holding certifications in Manufacturing Commercial Operations (MCO) or comparable manufacturing-industry ServiceNow credentials will be given strong preference.
  
  
****Technical Skills****

* Strong working knowledge of ServiceNow data model, tables, ACLs, roles, and CMDB / Customer Service data structures.
* Proficiency with JavaScript (server-side and client-side), Glide APIs, Flow Designer, Workflow Studio, and scoped application development.
* Experience with integrations to Salesforce, on-premise applications, and databases (SQL, JDBC) using REST/SOAP, Integration Hub spokes, MID Server, and import sets / transform maps.
* Hands-on experience with ServiceNow AI capabilities, including Now Assist skills for CSM and SOM (case and order summarization, resolution notes, knowledge generation), Now Assist Virtual Agent, AI Search, and customizing skills with Now Assist Skill Kit (NASK).
* Working knowledge of agentic AI on the platform, including features available through the Australia release: building, configuring, and governing AI Agents and agentic workflows, selecting model providers (Now LLM Service or third-party models), and managing Now Assist administration, licensing tiers, and guardrails.
* Experience with Customer Service Portal, Service Portal, UI Builder, and Workspaces (Customer Service Workspace).
* Understanding of order-to-cash, quote-to-order, entitlement, and warranty / contract processes.
* Familiarity with Agile (Scrum / SAFe) delivery, user story writing, and tools such as ServiceNow Agile Development, Jira, or Azure DevOps.
* Ability to write functional specifications, test cases, and process documentation, and to present solutions to technical and non-technical audiences.

****Preferred Qualifications****

* Hands-on MCO experience, including manufacturing commercial processes such as contracts, pricing, and order-to-delivery visibility.
* Experience with Configure, Price, Quote (CPQ) solutions, such as ServiceNow Sales and Order Management quoting, Salesforce CPQ, or Oracle CPQ, including product catalogs, pricing rules, quote-to-order flows, and integration with order management and ERP systems (a strong advantage).
* Additional ServiceNow certifications: Certified Technical Architect (in progress), Integration Hub, Performance Analytics, Now Assist / Generative AI / Agentic AI, or Predictive Intelligence.
* Experience building custom AI skills and AI Agents or using Build Agent to create agentic workflows for custom applications, and keeping pace with new AI capabilities in each ServiceNow family release.
* Experience integrating ServiceNow with ERP (Oracle Fusion), CRM (Salesforce), PLM, or MES systems.
* Experience with CI/CD and source control for ServiceNow (for example, Git integration, ATF automated testing).
* Exposure to data analytics and reporting tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
* Prior experience coordinating large/small projects or mentoring junior team members.

****Core Skills And Working Conditions****
**Core skills**

* Analytical and problem-solving ability, with a bias toward root-cause resolution over workarounds.
* Clear written and verbal communication, including facilitating workshops and explaining technical concepts to business users.
* Stakeholder management and the ability to balance multiple priorities across commercial, service, and manufacturing teams.
* Customer-centric mindset, with a focus on measurable outcomes and user adoption.
* Ownership, attention to detail, and comfort being self-directed in a fast-paced, Agile environment.
* Collaboration with onshore and offshore development partners.

**Working conditions**

* Primarily remote-based, with occasional travel.
* Participation in an on-call rotation for critical production issues and occasional after-hours release or upgrade support.

We are only considering candidates local to position location and are unable to provide relocation for this position. This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

This role is based out of our Bangalore office, with a hybrid work model that includes 3 days in the office and 2 days working remotely each week.

title: Sr. Product Manager
description:
**Company Overview**
Docusign brings agreements to life. More than 1.8 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using the Docusign AI-native IAM platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the #1 company in e-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).
  
  
What you'll do
  
  
As a Sr. Product Manager on the Strategic Partner Integration team, you will own a defined product area within Docusign’s strategic integrations. Your initial focus will be procurement integrations, connecting agreement workflows to source-to-pay and procure-to-pay processes across systems like SAP and other major platforms. You will collaborate closely across customers, partners, Product, Engineering, Sales, and the broader Docusign ecosystem. In this role, you will lead integrations end-to-end—from discovery and requirements through delivery, launch, adoption, and continuous improvement. As the portfolio evolves, your scope may expand to additional strategic partner and enterprise-system integrations.
  
  
This position is an individual contributor role reporting to the Sr. Director, Product Management.
  
  
**Responsibility**

* Own the roadmap and priorities for designated strategic partner integrations, translating customer, partner, market, and technical insights into clear requirements and measurable outcomes
* Lead end-to-end product development, from discovery and requirements through design, development, launch, adoption, and post-launch iteration
* Conduct customer and partner discovery, synthesize feedback and technical requirements, and translate them into product narratives, epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, and prioritized backlogs
* Partner with strategic ISVs to align on integration use cases, product requirements, responsibilities, dependencies, delivery plans, and launch readiness
* Define seamless integration experiences across APIs, bidirectional data flows, embedded user experiences, data mapping and agentic workflows in partnership with Engineering and Design

title: Sr Staff, Product/Program Management - Semiconductor NPI(Analog/Power)
description:
Renesas is a global semiconductor leader shaping the backbone of next‑generation automotive, industrial, cloud, and IoT innovation. With over $9.3 billion in annual revenue (2024) and a world‑class team of 22,700+ employees, Renesas operates at scale while retaining the agility to drive category‑defining breakthroughs. The company’s footprint spans more than 30 countries, enabling deep customer proximity and a uniquely global innovative engine. As Japan’s semiconductor powerhouse and a top global player in microcontrollers, analog, and power technologies, Renesas delivers real‑world impact across EVs, smart factories, renewable energy infrastructure, and edge intelligence. For ambitious problem‑solvers who want to work on meaningful, systems‑level challenges with huge industry leverage, Renesas offers the scale, stability, and strategic clarity of a market leader—paired with the transformative momentum of a company reinventing how the world computes, connects, and electrifies.

Renesas has a growing presence in India with HC approaching 1000+ and significant presence with active government and university collaboration as well as OSAT footprint (JV with CG India). With the growing importance of India as a market (Growing semiconductor market and government goals / mandates of localization needs) and talent hub, our division’s (India for India) mission is to grow India market. We aspire to create products (SoCs, Software, Power and Analog chips etc) which serve needs for local market. Renesas is a leading electronics supplier globally, and this is a unique opportunity to directly influence the future products which will be offered to our customers in a new, fast growing and large Indian market with specific needs and applications.

**Job Description**

* Responsible for managing the development of New Products (Industrial and Automotive) and delivering on all program commitments from inception through execution to tape out and start of production.
* Develop and maintain project schedules, budgets, and resource allocations to ensure on-time project completion within budget constraints while maintaining high quality
* Drive cross-functional teams including design, test, product engineering, validation, marketing, systems, applications, operations, planning, various factories, and vendors as Program Manager to meet project milestones and objectives.
* Manage several key projects in parallel or singular large program
* Continuously reviews program progress, proactively identify risks and collaboratively develops and drives risk mitigation efforts
* Collaborate with cross-functional and peers from other business groups to drive collaboration and harvest best practices and lessons learned to keep the business group in sync with One Renesas methodologies, tools and systems
* Drive execution initiatives and process improvements at the functional, cross functional and business group level
* Monitor and report on project progress, including key performance indicators and metrics, to senior management and stakeholders.

**Responsibilities may include:**

* Collaborate and work in a team environment with Design, Applications, Test, Marketing, Manufacturing, Quality and Reliability in all aspects of new product development, production release to accomplish goals and objectives
* Design bench evaluation PCBs (printed circuit boards) and generating characterizations programs for bench evaluations
* Perform evaluation, debug and characterization of integrated circuits to ensure they meet the product requirement specifications and manufacturing requirements
* Work with failure analysis (FA) to determine root cause of any reliability and qualification failures
* Knowledge of statistics and tools (example: Spotfire) to analyze large amounts of characterization data and determine and set production test limits and predict yield data
* Work with process and package technology development to develop and qualify technologies for new product development
* Work closely with the global manufacturing facilities to address customer specific product quality, yield management and cost reductions issues on mature products. Scope of work could include product spins and derivatives

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering

* 7+ years of hand`s on technical program/project management experience leading cross functional teams to develop broad market or custom Power/Analog/ Mixed-Signal products for commercial, industrial or automotive applications with at least 10 years of experience working in the Semiconductor domain

* Solid understanding of Semiconductor Manufacturing, Development and Management

* Ability to work in a team setup comprising of other functional groups

* Strong time management skills that enable on-time project delivery

* Demonstrated ability to build strong, influential relationships

* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and rapidly changing environment

* Ability to take the initiative and drive for results

* Strong problem solving, verbal and written communications skills

* Ability to multiplex between projects and be able to maintain project schedules

* Familiarity with JEDEC / AEC Qualification standards

* Familiarity with ATE tester platforms (Teradyne / Eagle)

* Knowledge of statistics and tools (example: Spotfire) to analyse large amounts of characterization data and determine and set production test limits and predict yield data

* Knowledge of back-end semiconductor processes like Wafer Fabrication, Bump, Packaging, Assembly and Test is an asset.

* Working experience in a high-pressure environment, competing priorities and tight turnaround times.

* Strong communication, presentation, and leadership skills; Ability to lead technical discussions and summarize outcome for executive level status reporting.

* Proficient with industry standard project management tools such as MS Project, Jira, SharePoint, DFMEA, Root Cause Analysis , Confluence, Microsoft OneNote

**Additional Information**

Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose,
**To Make Our Lives Easier**
. With a global team of over 21,000 engineers and problem solvers in more than 30 countries, we offer the opportunity to work on world‑leading technology for Automotive, Industrial, Infrastructure, and IoT, shaping a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter future.

At Renesas, TAGIE is our culture, grounded in being Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. It shapes how we work, grow and deliver on our purpose together. This collaborative spirit and mindset drive our semiconductor technology to transform industries and impact millions of lives.

We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process.

Are you ready to join our team and
**shape the future**
with us?

Renesas Electronics is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer, committed to supporting diversity and fostering a work environment free of discrimination on the basis of sex, race, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, military status, veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. For more information, please read our Diversity & Inclusion Statement.

title: Lead Applied Value Engineer - CPGR /CMT -NAM
description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.
  
  
**The Team:**
The position of
**Lead Applied Value Engineer**
is a trusted advisor helping customers achieve their strategic goals and realise significant value using the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform. A Value Engineer has full responsibility for the end-to-end value journey of our customers – landing, expanding, adopting and renewing. Responsibilities include translating customers’ objectives into value assessments or proof-of-value projects, building specific Celonis business cases and demos, running value workshops, and engaging with multiple senior stakeholders to deliver value driven results and secure long term partnership agreements.
  
  
**The Role:**
As a
**Lead Applied Value Engineer**
for the
**High Tech**
industry you are spearheading our mission of data-driven business transformation with our customers. You will work in partnership with the Celonis Sales Team and have full responsibility for the end-to-end value journey of our customers. You are our customers' trusted advisor and help them achieve their strategic goals and realize significant value using the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform. In collaboration with our partners and Celonis Services, you will drive measurable business impact across various processes and industries and accelerate the adoption of our platform. You will blend deep process and industry expertise with a proven consulting skill set with strong analytical skills at the forefront of one of the fastest-growing tech companies worldwide.
  
  
**The work you’ll do:**
**Identify & Frame Value**

* Discover and translate customers’ strategic priorities into high-impact Celonis use cases
* Build demos and business cases, leveraging industry benchmarks and best practices in order to win new customers
* Undertake Value Assessments or Proof-of-Value Projects and communicate the value opportunity and strategic roadmap to C-Level executive

**Realize Value**

* Facilitate business value workshops and use Celonis to identify and qualify opportunities for process enhancement
* Derive improvement measures in core business functions and initiate improvement actions and enterprise-wide change initiatives
* Present results and realized value to senior management and C-level executives

**Scale Value**

* Responsible for the end-to-end customer value journey, landing, expanding, adoption and renewing
* Build a strategic expansion roadmap for customers embedding Celonis Process Intelligence as a strategic business transformation platform in their organization and therefore drive adoption and expansion
* Provide feedback to our product development teams to enhance the Celonis platform and Apps based on new use cases

**The qualifications you need:**
**Live for Customer Value:**
Experience in an analytical role with the objective to demonstrate or secure value through business data analysis, business process improvement and respective Software deployment. Ideally in a customer-facing role in Solution Consulting, Sales Engineering or IT/Management Consulting with a Business Software / SaaS Provider or a Consultancy. Alternatively in an Inhouse role (e.g. Center of Excellence for Data Mining / Analytics / Intelligence) within an Enterprise.
  
  
**Data, Analytics, Applications & IT:**
Good knowledge of Business Software / SaaS applications (e.g. SAP), experience with implementing RPA and/or BI Tools and/or building Dashboards, Apps and Action Flows. Knowledge of Python and/or SQL. Experience in collaborating with IT teams.
  
  
**Process Improvement & Value Realization:**
Experience in identifying use cases for business process improvement and deploying improvement measures, being a change agent and training users/process owners to realize value
  
  
**Project Management:**
Experience in planning and managing project scopes, expectations and timelines. You will manage multiple projects across your aligned accounts that will be at different parts of the value journey. Also, you will leverage partners from the Celonis Ecosystem wherever possible.
  
  
**Executive Stakeholder Management:**
Experience in preparing and communicating (value) roadmaps and results to stakeholders and management, both internally and externally. Excellent communication and presentation skills in English and sovereign appearance.
  
  
**Business Domain Expertise:**
Understanding of theHigh Tech domain as well as strategic transformation initiatives (e.g. Shared Services Transformation or System Transformation)
  
  
**Industry Expertise:**
Expertise in the High Tech industry and the ability to develop a deep understanding of industry trends and strategic opportunities
  
  
**Degree:**
In Technology & Management, Industrial/Business Engineering, Business Informatics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics or a comparable degree program
  
  
**What Celonis Can Offer You:**

* Pioneer Innovation: Work with the leading, award-winning process mining technology, shaping the future of business.
* Accelerate Your Growth: Benefit from clear career paths, internal mobility, a dedicated learning program, and mentorship opportunities.
* Receive Exceptional Benefits: Including generous PTO, hybrid working options, company equity (RSUs), comprehensive benefits, extensive parental leave, dedicated volunteer days, and much more. Interns and working students explore your benefits here.
* Prioritize Your Well-being: Access to resources such as gym subsidies, counseling, and well-being programs.

* Make Meaningful Impact: Be part of a company driven by strong values that guide everything we do: Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future.
* Collaborate Globally: Join a dynamic, international team of talented individuals.
* Empowered Environment: Contribute your ideas in an open culture with autonomous teams.

**What Celonis can offer you:**

* Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time Celonaut is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
* Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
* Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.

**About Us:**
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. title: Senior Manager, Technical Program Management
description:
**Overview**
At Zebra, we are a community of innovators who come together to create new ways of working. United by curiosity and a culture of caring, we develop smart solutions that anticipate our customer’s and partner’s needs and solve their challenges.
  
  
Being part of Zebra Nation means you are seen, heard, valued, and respected. Drawing from our unique perspectives, we collaborate to deliver on our purpose. Here you are part of a team pushing boundaries today to redefine the work of tomorrow for organizations, their employees, and those they serve.
  
  
You’ll have opportunities to learn and lead in a forward-thinking environment, defining your path to a fulfilling career while channeling your skills toward causes you care about—locally and globally.
  
  
Come make an impact every day at Zebra.
  
  
**What We're Looking For**
We are looking for a seasoned Technical Program Management leader to build and run our Software PMO end to end. This is a high-visibility transformation leadership role that owns the delivery of complex, multi-year software product and cloud solution programs, from concept and development through go-to-market and scale.
  
  
You will lead a team of program managers, run a portfolio with a sizable budget, and partner with Engineering, Product, DevOps, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success leaders across the globe. You will be both a strategic leader and a hands-on operator: someone who understands the technology deeply enough to challenge architecture and release trade-offs, and who can drive a transformation program from vision to measurable business outcomes.
  
  
You will also bring hands-on GenAI program experience, using AI to transform how software is planned, built, delivered, and launched. This is not a reporting-only PMO role. We want a builder who sets the delivery standard, develops people, and is accountable for outcomes.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Transformation Leadership
* Own and lead enterprise-level transformation programs for the software organization, such as Agile/SAFe at scale, cloud migration, platform modernization, and AI-enabled engineering, from vision and business case to measurable outcomes.
* Define the transformation roadmap with executive sponsors, secure funding, and align Engineering, Product, Cloud, and Go-to-Market leaders behind a single plan.
* Lead change management end to end: stakeholder alignment, communication, training, adoption tracking, and resolving resistance across teams and geographies.
* Be the visible change agent who sets the vision, coaches senior leaders, and holds the organization accountable for realized value, not just delivered milestones.
* PMO Strategy & Leadership
* Build, lead, and mentor a high-performing team of program and technical program managers, including hiring, career development, performance management, and succession planning.
* Establish the Software PMO operating model, governance framework, standards, and playbooks covering planning, execution, risk, and release management.
* Define portfolio-level KPIs (on-time delivery, release quality, predictability, velocity, cost variance, customer adoption) and maintain an executive dashboard for the leadership team and steering committees.
* Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership on roadmap feasibility, capacity, dependencies, and investment priorities.
* Technical Program & Portfolio Delivery
* Own end-to-end delivery of multiple large, cross-functional software programs across the full product lifecycle, from requirements and architecture through development, test, release, and sustaining.
* Drive Agile, SAFe, and hybrid delivery models at scale, including program increment planning, release trains, and dependency management across teams.
* Partner with architects and engineering leads on technical trade-offs, build-vs-buy decisions, technical debt, and platform strategy.
* Proactively identify, escalate, and mitigate risks, and make timely, data-driven decisions on scope, schedule, and resourcing.
* Lead programs involving cloud-native architectures, SaaS and PaaS platforms, microservices, APIs, and data platforms on AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Ensure security, privacy, compliance, and scalability requirements are built into the SDLC (DevSecOps).
* Financial & Vendor Management
* Own program and portfolio budgets including forecasting, tracking, variance analysis, and business-case/ROI development with Finance.
* Manage vendors, system integrators, and engineering partners, including contracts, SLAs, performance, and commercial negotiations.
* Optimize resource allocation and sourcing across in-house, offshore, and partner teams.
* Go-to-Market & Solution Delivery
* Partner with Product Management, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success to align product development milestones with go-to-market launches.
* Coordinate launch readiness: pricing and packaging, enablement, documentation, support readiness, and partner/channel preparation.
* Support solution development for strategic customers and pilots, ensuring feedback loops into the roadmap.
* Track post-launch adoption, revenue, and customer satisfaction metrics and drive continuous improvement.
* Global Team & Stakeholder Leadership
* Lead and collaborate with distributed teams across India, the US, Europe, and other regions, building a unified one-team culture across time zones and cultures.
* Manage executive stakeholders at VP and C-level, communicating progress, risks, and decisions with clarity and credibility.
* Drive alignment across Engineering, Product, QA, Operations, Legal, and Sales on priorities and trade-offs.
* GenAI Program Leadership & Continuous Improvement
* Lead and manage GenAI-based programs, from use-case identification and prototyping through pilot, scale, and adoption, covering areas such as AI-assisted coding, testing, documentation, program reporting, and customer-facing AI features.
* Partner with AI/ML, Cloud, and Security teams on LLM platforms, RAG, and agentic workflows, including build-vs-buy decisions, cost, and Responsible AI, privacy, and IP guardrails.
* Apply GenAI within the PMO itself to improve the workflow, optimize planning, enhance risk prediction, status reporting, and engineering productivity, and quantify the gains.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* 15+ years of total experience in software engineering and technical program management, with a proven track record of delivering complex software products and solutions.
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.

**Preferred Qualification**
: MBA or equivalent preferred.
  
  

* Demonstrated experience building, leading, and developing a team of program managers.
* Proven experience leading large-scale, multi-year transformative programs as a program manager, with demonstrated business outcomes and organization-wide change leadership.
* 1-2 years of hands-on experience running or managing GenAI-based programs in an enterprise setting (for example AI-assisted software development, AI-enabled products or workflow automation).
* Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle and software product development.
* Solid working knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), SaaS, DevOps, and cloud-native architecture.
* Experience managing teams and stakeholders across geographies, including the US and Europe.
* Exposure to go-to-market and product/solution development, including launches and customer engagement.
* Certifications such as PMP, PgMP, SAFe (SPC/RTE) preferred.

**People Management Experience**
The ideal candidate is expected to have direct people management experience, including building and leading teams of program and technical program managers (ideally 8-15 or more, including managers of managers) across India, the US, and Europe. You have hired and onboarded talent, defined clear career paths, set goals, delivered regular coaching and candid performance feedback, and built succession plans. You can grow first-time program managers into senior leaders, manage underperformance fairly, and keep distributed teams engaged and motivated across time zones and cultures. You lead by example, build a culture of ownership, accountability, and inclusion, and are as invested in developing your people as in delivering programs.
  
  
Program & Business
  
  

* Exceptional program management, structured problem-solving, and prioritization skills.
* Strong financial acumen: budgeting, forecasting, business cases, and ROI.
* Outstanding executive communication, storytelling, and stakeholder influence.
* Proven transformation and change leadership, with the ability to drive adoption in complex, resistant organizations.

Leadership Attributes
  
  

* Visionary, influential transformation leader who inspires senior leaders and large teams.
* Servant leader who builds teams, grows talent, and raises the bar on delivery.
* Hands-on, outcome-oriented, with a high degree of ownership and accountability.
* Collaborative, low-ego, culturally aware, and comfortable with ambiguity.
* Intellectually curious, continuously learning about emerging technologies.

**Why This Role**
This is an opportunity to lead the transformation of the software program management function of a global organization and to shape how products and cloud solutions are built, launched, and scaled. You will work directly with senior leadership across geographies, manage significant investments, and build a team that sets the benchmark for delivery excellence.
  
  
If you are a seasoned technical program leader who is equally comfortable in the boardroom and in the details of a release plan, this role is built for you.
  
  
**Benefits**
We understand the importance of work-life balance and wellbeing, which is why we offer flexibility for our teams including: hybrid work, adaptable hours, Summer Flex Fridays, Focus Fridays, and an annual companywide well-being day to promote revitalization and success.
  
  
**Job Posting Statement**
To protect candidates from falling victim to online fraudulent activity involving fake job postings and employment offers, please be aware our recruiters will always connect with you via @zebra.com email accounts. Applications are only accepted through our applicant tracking system and only accept personal identifying information through that system. Our Talent Acquisition team will not ask for you to provide personal identifying information via e-mail or outside of the system. If you are a victim of identity theft contact your local police department.
  
  
**AI Technology Statement**
Zebra Technologies leverages AI technology to evaluate job applications using objective, job-relevant criteria. This approach enhances efficiency and promotes fairness in the hiring process. However, every decision regarding interviews and hiring is made by our dedicated team, because we believe people make the best decisions about people. For more on how we use technology in hiring and how we process applicant data, see our Zebra Privacy Policy.

title: Hardware Technical Program Manager
description:
**Arista Networks**
is an industry leader in data-driven, client-to-cloud networking for large data center, campus and routing environments. Arista is a well-established and profitable company with over $12 billion in revenue. Arista’s award-winning platforms, ranging in Ethernet speeds up to 800G bits per second, redefine scalability, agility, and resilience. Arista is a founding member of the Ultra Ethernet consortium. We have shipped over 20 million cloud networking ports worldwide with CloudVision and EOS, an advanced network operating system. Arista is committed to open standards, and its products are available worldwide directly and through partners.

At Arista, we value the diversity of thought and perspectives each employee brings. We believe fostering an inclusive environment where individuals from various backgrounds and experiences feel welcome is essential for driving creativity and innovation.

Our commitment to excellence has earned us several prestigious awards, such as the Great Place to Work Survey for Best Engineering Team and Best Company for Diversity, Compensation, and Work-Life Balance. At Arista, we take pride in our track record of success and strive to maintain the highest quality and performance standards in everything we do.

**Who You’ll Work With:**

Arista is seeking a Hardware Technical Program Manager. This is a critical role, ensuring that Arista customer driven programs complete milestone deliverables to meet the customer’s needs and prevent delays to their internal development and deployment programs. As a Technical Program Manager you will work directly with experienced internal cross-disciplinary engineering team leaders, customers, and strategic partners to drive hardware product development from planning, design, validation, qualification, through release to volume production. You will lead the cross-functional engineering team through the NPI product lifecycle phases and the associated design and phase gate reviews. Strong leadership, communications, problem solving, and communication skills are essential.

**What You’ll Do:**

Specific Duties and Responsibilities:

* Creating statement of work (SoW) and product requirement documents (PRD) for complex technical programs
* Owns and facilitates weekly cross-functional engineering team meetings.
* Interface with key customers and strategic partners to develop program plans including negotiating schedules, milestone deliverables, prototype allocations, and feature set.
* Lead a cross-functional team from HW, SW, Central, and Diagnostic engineering, manufacturing engineering, product management, ODM/JDM partners, and customer support to deliver outstanding products to the market.
* You will be responsible for tracking and reporting on the cross-functional design engineering validation, and qualification status of your programs, as well as identifying and solving any concerns prior to them causing impact.
* Create a master schedule that captures and inter-connects the key cross-functional deliverables as defined by the product development lifecycle and ensure the team stays on track to meet program milestones.
* Lead program design review and bug scrub meetings
* Identify risks on program planning and actively work on mitigation plan with all stake holders
* Drive, coordinate, and monitor engineering programs including scheduling, planning, product and project cost analysis, and milestone checkpoint reviews.
* Drive cross-functional issue resolution ensuring issues are identified, assigned owners, and tracked to closure. Ensure issues are escalated to the appropriate functional leaders.
* Facilitate engineering portion of phase gate review meetings

This information supports the creation of accurate quotes and order documents for customer transactions, including extensions, renewals, expansions, migrations, terminations, and amendments.

The team plays an important role in enabling efficient, accurate transaction processing and supporting operational improvements across related business functions.

We are seeking an Automation & Operations Specialist to drive business process improvements, develop practical automation solutions, and support transaction processing and operational initiatives within Oracle Health's Customer Entitlement Services team.

The role combines hands-on automation development, business analysis, stakeholder engagement, and operational execution.

The successful candidate will independently identify improvement opportunities, translate business requirements into actionable solutions, and build basic to moderately complex automations using approved robotic process automation (RPA), AI, AI-agent, and low-code/no-code platforms.

This position requires strong analytical thinking, cross-functional collaboration, and the ability to manage initiatives from problem identification through implementation, adoption, and measurable business outcomes.

* **Drive process improvement initiatives:**

* **Coordinate cross-functional projects:**

* **Ensure solution quality and governance:**
  Support testing, user acceptance testing (UAT), output validation, rollout, and ongoing maintenance while following data privacy, access control, and responsible AI practices.
* **Deliver measurable operational improvements:**
  Analyze process performance, identify automation opportunities, maintain operating procedures and reporting, and track improvements in efficiency, accuracy, quality, and user experience.

**Mandatory — Essential requirements:**

* Experience delivering business process improvement, operational transformation, or automation initiatives.
* Hands-on experience using at least one business-user-accessible automation or AI platform, such as RPA, AI, or low-code/no-code technology.
* Ability to independently manage defined projects or workstreams involving multiple stakeholders.
* Strong business analysis skills, including requirements gathering, process understanding, and translating needs into practical solutions.
* Ability to design, build, test, and validate basic to moderately complex automation solutions.
* Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills, including working with ambiguous or incomplete information.
* Effective stakeholder facilitation, communication, and influencing skills without formal authority.
* Ability to manage operational activities, investigate exceptions, prioritize competing tasks, and follow through to resolution.
* Working understanding of data privacy, access controls, responsible AI use, and solution governance.
* Proficiency in spreadsheets, reporting, and process documentation.

**Good-to-Have — Differentiators:**

* Experience working across multiple business functions and understanding process or system dependencies.
* Exposure to strategic or complex initiatives requiring evaluation of alternative solutions.
* Experience supporting UAT, rollout, user adoption, and benefits tracking.
* Demonstrated curiosity and learning agility across business functions and emerging technologies.

**Self-Assessment Questions:**

**Candidates can assess their fit by considering:**

1. Do I have hands-on experience building and testing automations using at least one RPA, AI, or low-code/no-code platform?

title: Assistant Manager/Manager- Finance
description:
**About Gravity**

Gravity is building the operating system for India's home interiors & renovation industry. Today, more than $40 billion of home interior material purchases are controlled by Interior Designers and Studios, yet procurement remains fragmented across multiple suppliers with unreliable fulfillment and limited visibility. Gravity brings together AI-native technology, strategic manufacturing partnerships, curated materials and an integrated supply chain to simplify how projects are designed, specified and delivered.

**Mission of the Role**

Your mission is to build and run a strong, reliable finance backbone for Gravity as we scale. You will own accounting, book-keeping, financial controls, statutory compliance and reporting across our business, ensuring the leadership team has accurate, timely numbers to make decisions. You will bring the discipline of high-volume Retail and Internet businesses to a fast-growing, suspply-chain-heavy model spanning customers, supply partners and inventory.

**What You'll Own**

**1. Accounting & Financial Reporting ●**

Own end-to-end accounting operations, including general ledger, accounts payable, accounts receivable and fixed assets. ● Ensure accurate and timely recording of all transactions in line with Indian Accounting Standards (Ind AS / AS). ● Drive monthly, quarterly and annual book closures with clean reconciliations of bank, vendor, customer and inter-company accounts. ● Monthly/Quarterly preparation & consolidation of financial statements.

**2. Financial Control & Internal Controls**
●

Act as Financial Controller, designing and enforcing internal controls, approval matrices and SOPs across procure-to-pay and order-to-cash. ● Oversee inventory accounting, stock reconciliations and valuation across warehouses and supply partners. ● Identify control gaps, revenue leakages and process risks, and fix them proactively. ● Oversee and lead the banking & treasury operations for the business.

**3. Taxation & Statutory Compliance ●**

Ensure timely compliance with GST, TDS, Income Tax, ROC and other statutory requirements, including returns and reconciliations (GSTR-2B, 26AS). ● Coordinate with statutory, internal and tax auditors; own audit readiness and closure of audit points. ● Manage marketplace / payment-gateway reconciliations and TCS compliance relevant to Retail and Internet businesses.

**4. Financial Reporting & MIS ●**

Prepare monthly MIS, P&L, balance sheet and cash-flow statements with variance analysis. ● Track unit economics, gross margins, working capital and category-level profitability. ● Build dashboards and periodic finance reviews for the leadership team and investors.

**5. Budgeting, Cash & Cross-Functional Partnership ●**

Drive annual budgeting, forecasting and cash-flow planning; monitor burn and runway. ● Manage banking relationships, payments, collections and working-capital cycles with vendors and customers. ● Partner with Sales, Supply Chain, Category and Tech teams to support pricing, commercial terms and process automation.

**Key KPIs**
● Timely monthly book closure (within defined close calendar). ● Accuracy of financial statements and MIS; zero material audit observations. ● 100% on-time statutory filings (GST, TDS, Income Tax, ROC) with no penalties. ● Reconciliation coverage and ageing of open items (bank, vendor, customer, marketplace). ● Receivable and payable days; working-capital efficiency. ● Inventory accuracy and reduction in write-offs / leakages. ● Banking & treasury operations ● Strength of internal controls and SOP adherence across processes.

**What We Are Looking For**

Qualification: Chartered Accountant (CA) – completed. Experience: 5–8 years of post-qualification experience in accounting, book-keeping and financial control. Industry exposure: Experience in Retail- Inventory led business and / or Internet (e-commerce, marketplace, D2C, consumer-tech) companies. Accounting expertise: Strong command of Ind AS / Indian GAAP, book closures, reconciliations, finalisation & consolidation of accounts. Financial control: Proven experience as Financial Controller or in a controllership role, setting up internal controls and SOPs. Compliance: Hands-on knowledge of GST, TDS, Income Tax and statutory / internal audits. Tools & systems: Proficiency in Tally / Zoho Books / SAP / NetSuite (or similar ERP) and advanced Excel. Core skills: High ownership, attention to detail, strong analytical thinking and ability to work in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. Good target backgrounds: Finance Manager / Assistant Finance Controller / Accounts Manager from Retail, E-commerce, Marketplace, D2C or Internet companies, or Big 4 / mid-size CA firms with subsequent industry experience in these sectors.

**Why Join Gravity?**

This is a high-ownership role for a CA who wants to build the finance function of a fast-scaling company from the ground up, not just maintain it. You will work closely with the founders, shape how Gravity accounts, controls and reports as it grows, and see the direct impact of your work on the business. If you want to be the person who makes the numbers trustworthy at scale, Gravity offers the room to do it.

**Finance Analyst**

join

**What You Will Do**
We are looking for a
**Finance Analyst**
to join our
**Invoice to Cash**
team. This role is responsible for the end-to-end operational and accounting support for
**factoring business**
. This role will own periodically factoring operational tasks, including report running, document sign off, payment clearance, journal entry booking, reconciliation, and month end adjustment. The core objective is to ensure factoring operations run smoothly, accurately, and fully compliant with local legal, regulatory and accounting policy requirements. In addition, this role is expected to proactively identify process gaps, explore optimization opportunities, and drive ongoing process standardization to align with the global factoring framework.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities：**
**End-to-end factoring transaction processing**

* Run weekly dealer receivable reports, conduct transaction reviews, select eligible invoices for purchase, consider factoring limit, and finally generate Offer to Sale and Bill of Sale reports; process docsign; prepare and release payment as defined in the program workflow. Ensure data integrity, consistency and completeness for downstream analysis.
* Collect dealer payment information and execute accurate fund settlement to Cat Financial following standard process.
* Estimate upcoming dealer collection at month end, to facilitate appropriate accounting entries for both sides.
* Raise request to RTR to complete all factoring related journal entry booking, including Offer to Sale entries, discounts entries, and service fee. Ensure all accounting treatments comply with accounting policy, factoring agreement and regulatory requirements.

**Reconciliation, exception and variance management**

* Prepare periodic reconciliations with Cat Financial, investigate variances, resolve exceptions and track outstanding/open items, actively follow up to drive timely closure. Support RTR to complete month-end adjustment entries and resolve intercompany discrepancy.

**Periodic reporting and stakeholder coordination**

**Standardization and continuous improvement**

+ Preferred: SAP (CBS/Mach1)

* Financial and accounting knowledge to understand and apply the contractual rights, obligations and responsibilities of each party under the factoring agreement.
* Ability to understand the broader financial impact of factoring transactions, including cash flow, receivables, factoring costs, and period-end financial reporting

* Communicating Complex Concepts: Knowledge of effective presentation tools and techniques to ensure clear understanding; ability to use summarization and simplification techniques to explain complex technical concepts in simple, clear language appropriate to the audience.
* Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations.
* Compliance awareness: Ensure all transactions, accounting treatments and fund flows comply with regulations and company policy, maintain complete audit trails.
* Cross-team collaboration: Work effectively with Cat Financial, RTR, Treasury and other internal teams to ensure smooth and timely execution of factoring operations and respond to any inquiry from tax authorities or RBI.
* Planning and Organizing: Knowledge of the process of planning and arranging tasks and resources; ability to plan and organize both time and resources to get things completed while structuring and maintaining work in a systematic and highly methodical way.
* Financial Analysis: Knowledge of tools and approaches of financial analysis; ability to read, interpret and draw accurate conclusions from financial and numerical material.

description: Teamwork makes the stream work. What is the role?The Manager, Financial Operations will lead the day-to-day execution of financial close operations, multi-partner reconciliation, data pipeline governance, and operational reporting within Roku's Revenue Infrastructure function. Strong candidates know how to frame problems, guide AI-assisted work, check the output, and learn quickly. Above all, they bring curiosity, adaptability, and sound judgment. What are the responsibilities of the role?Oversee and review the team's end-to-end month-end and quarter-end financial close for Commerce Platform revenue, liabilities, and partner payables — own the close calendar, priorities, and on-time completionDirect and review the team's execution and validation of automated journal entries across revenue recognition, deferred revenue, chargebacks, and partner settlements; ensure posting failures are investigated and resolvedPartner with Revenue Accounting and Treasury to resolve close blockers, inter-company settlements, and timing differences; represent the team in US / PST close reviewsEnsure the team maintains close checklists, run books, and process documentation, and that SOX evidence packages are complete and audit-readyOversee the team's daily and monthly multi-partner reconciliation workflows across authorization-to-settlement, settlement-to-payout, and bank reconciliationReview, triage, and prioritize reconciliation breaks, exceptions, and discrepancies; ensure the team resolves them within SLAsMonitor exception aging trackers and drive resolution, escalating to payment processors, banks, and internal teams as neededGuide root-cause investigation on recurring breaks; review the team's findings and approve process fixes for implementationOversee partner onboarding into reconciliation workflows against readiness criteria and acceptance standardsDirect the team's build and maintenance of operational dashboards (Looker / Tableau) tracking reconciliation status, exception rates, close timelines, and pipeline health; review them for accuracyReview and present weekly and monthly operational status reports to leadership — exception aging, SLA performance, pipeline uptimeDirect ad-hoc analytical support for financial investigations, partner disputes, and settlement discrepancy research; review outputs before they reach stakeholdersEnsure the team executes SOX control activities for owned financial workflows; review control steps, evidence, and test resultsOversee preparation and delivery of audit evidence packages for internal and external audit requests within required timelines; act as the primary point of contactReview day-to-day processes for control gaps and operational risks; escalate for framework-level decisionsEnsure standard operating procedures (SOPs) with clear RACI ownership are maintained for all operational workflowsSet clear expectations and allocate daily workload across reconciliation, close, data operations, and reporting; follow up and track every deliverable to closureReview and quality-check the team's deliverables (reconciliations, journals, dashboards, reports) before release — hold the bar on accuracy, timeliness, and documentationDrive skill development in SQL, Python, financial analysis, and reconciliation methodologies; conduct regular one-on-ones and career development conversationsRun daily connects / standups with the India team, plan and track work, remove blockers, and ensure operational continuity during US business hoursProactively identify manual, repetitive, or error-prone areas and direct the team to build automation (Python scripts, Airflow DAGs, SQL procedures) that reduces toilChampion AI adoption within the team — leverage AI tools to accelerate development, surface patterns in data, and improve productivityDefine and track monthly KPIs and performance metrics for the team — throughput, error rates, SLA adherence, and automation coverageFoster an analytical, data-driven mindset — encourage hypothesis-driven investigation, evidence-based decisions, and connecting the dots across workflowsBuild a culture of documentation and knowledge sharing — ensure processes are organized, repeatable, and not dependent on any single individual What experience would help someone be successful in this role at Roku?Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Commerce, Finance, Accounting, Computer Science, or a quantitative field. 7+ years in Financial Operations, Revenue Operations, Reconciliation, or Commerce / Payments, including 3+ years directly managing analyst teams (ideally distributed / offshore teams supporting US-based stakeholders). Strong working proficiency in SQL (window functions, CTEs, complex joins across large datasets) — enough to review and guide the team's analytical work. Familiarity with Python for data automation and scripting — enough to review and guide the automation the team builds. Experience with data warehouse platforms (such as Snowflake), ETL/orchestration tools (Airflow, dbt), and BI tools (Looker, Tableau). Experience operating in high-volume commerce, payments, or subscription environments with multi-currency, multi-partner complexity. Strong analytical mindset with the ability to investigate discrepancies, perform root-cause analysis, and drive resolution. Detail-oriented with high standards for accuracy, timeliness, and documentation. Demonstrated ability to identify automation opportunities and implement solutions that reduce manual effort by measurable margins. Experience using AI/ML tools or LLMs to enhance operational workflows, data analysis, or code generation. Proven people-management track record — leading, mentoring, and developing analyst teams; allocating work, reviewing output, following up to closure, and getting results through others. Strong decision-making skills with the ability to balance speed, accuracy, and risk in a fast-paced operational environment. Demonstrated ability to work across time zones and partner effectively with US-based stakeholders. Effective communication skills — ability to explain complex financial/data issues clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. Experience in streaming, media, ecommerce, or digital subscription businesses is a plus. Experience with payment settlement operations across multiple processors (such as Adyen, PayPal, Braintree) is a plus. Familiarity with financial controls frameworks (SOX, SOC2) and audit processes is a plus. Experience building automated reconciliation solutions or financial data pipelines from scratch is a plus. Experience with Git/GitLab version control for SQL/Python code management is a plus. Experience with Jupyter Notebooks for financial analysis and data exploration is a plus. What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance. What are some of the benefits?Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter. AccommodationsRoku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to EmployeeRelations@Roku.com. What should I know about Roku's culture?Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002. To learn more about Roku, our global footprint, and how we've grown, visit https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet.By providing your information, you acknowledge that you want Roku to contact you about job roles, that you have read Roku's Applicant Privacy Notice, and understand that Roku will use your information as described in that notice. We are seeking a
**Senior Revenue Accountant**
to join our rapidly expanding team of seasoned finance professionals. This position shall report to the Finance Head (India) and play an important role in helping shape the accounting team as the company grows. This role presents an incredible learning opportunity and will include exposure to a variety of accounting processes and business process optimization (for the US parent company and our India subsidiary) in a global, fast-paced, and growing environment.
  
  
**Location:**
Bangalore (Onsite 5 day workweek)
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Revenue Recognition and Contract Accounting
* Review customer contracts, Statements of Work (SOWs), amendments, and other sales arrangements to determine appropriate revenue recognition treatment under ASC 606 and Ind AS 115, as applicable.
* Analyse SaaS subscriptions, professional services, implementation services, managed services, and other revenue streams to identify performance obligations, determine transaction prices, allocate consideration, and establish appropriate revenue recognition schedules.
* Prepare and maintain revenue schedules, deferred revenue reconciliations, unbilled revenue, accrued revenue, and contract asset/liability balances.
* Assess contract modifications, variable consideration, milestone-based arrangements, and customer acceptance or UAT clauses to determine the appropriate timing of revenue recognition.
* Partner with Sales, Legal, Customer Success, Delivery, and FP&A teams to review contractual terms and ensure accurate revenue accounting.
* Prepare monthly revenue analysis, reconciliations, and supporting schedules for financial reporting and management review.
* Month-End Close and Financial Reporting
* Execute month-end and year-end close activities, including preparation and review of journal entries, general ledger reconciliations, and balance sheet account reconciliations.
* Ensure revenue, deferred revenue, unbilled revenue, and related accounts are accurately recorded and reconciled within established closing timelines.
* Support preparation of monthly financial reports, revenue variance analysis, and management information reports.
* Assist with intercompany reconciliations, financial consolidation, and reporting to the US parent company.
* Maintain complete and audit-ready documentation supporting revenue transactions, accounting judgments, and key reconciliations.
* Indian Accounting and Statutory Compliance
* Apply relevant Indian accounting and financial reporting requirements, including applicable Ind AS provisions and Schedule III presentation requirements, where relevant to the entity.
* Coordinate with the tax and compliance teams on the accounting implications of GST, TDS, and other applicable statutory requirements relating to customer contracts and revenue transactions.
* Support statutory audits, tax audits, and other financial compliance activities by providing reconciliations, schedules, documentation, and responses to auditor queries.
* Ensure accounting records and supporting documentation are maintained in accordance with applicable Indian statutory requirements and company policies.
* Internal Controls and Process Improvement
* Develop, document, and maintain revenue accounting policies, standard operating procedures, and month-end close checklists.
* Identify opportunities to streamline and automate revenue accounting processes, improve data quality, and strengthen internal controls.
* Support the implementation, enhancement, and administration of accounting systems and revenue reporting tools.
* Drive consistency in accounting practices between the Indian entity and the US parent company, ensuring compliance with applicable accounting policies and reporting requirements.
* Audit and Stakeholder Management
* Coordinate with internal and external auditors during quarterly and annual audit cycles, responding to information requests and resolving audit observations.
* Work closely with the US Finance team to ensure timely and accurate submission of revenue reports, reconciliations, and supporting schedules.
* Communicate significant accounting judgments, revenue recognition issues, and potential reporting risks to relevant stakeholders.
* Support ad hoc financial analysis and other accounting initiatives as required.

**Required Qualifications And Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, or a related discipline. CA, CMA, ACCA, or equivalent professional qualification is preferred.
* 5–10 years of relevant experience in revenue accounting, financial reporting, or general accounting, preferably within a SaaS, technology, IT services, or multinational organisation.
* Experience in a Big Four accounting firm or a reputed public accounting firm is preferred.
* Strong working knowledge of ASC 606 and/or Ind AS 115, including the application of revenue recognition principles to SaaS contracts and service arrangements.
* Experience reviewing customer contracts, identifying performance obligations, preparing revenue recognition assessments, and maintaining revenue schedules.
* Good understanding of Indian accounting practices, GST, TDS, statutory audit requirements, and applicable financial reporting regulations.
* Experience supporting month-end close, general ledger accounting, balance sheet reconciliations, and financial reporting.
* Familiarity with intercompany accounting, financial consolidation, and reporting to overseas parent entities is preferred.
* Advanced MS Excel skills, including pivot tables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, SUMIFS, and data analysis. Experience with ERP and accounting systems such as Sage Intacct, NetSuite, SAP, Oracle, or Zoho Books is an advantage.
* Ability to develop accounting policies, document processes, and recommend improvements to existing controls and workflows.

**Desired Competencies**

* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and reconciliation skills.
* Excellent attention to detail and commitment to financial accuracy.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work across teams and geographies.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet tight month-end and reporting deadlines.
* A proactive, hands-on approach with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional and international teams.

*Avathon is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, pregnancy, genetic information, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected category under applicable federal, state, and local laws.*
