description:
Job Description: Finance Executive

Company: AdvanzIT Technologies Pte. Ltd.

Location: Bangalore but supporting Finance for SG & MY branch

Role Type: Full-time

About AdvanzIT

AdvanzIT is a Singapore-headquartered technology company providing Data Center,

Enterprise IT, Audio-Visual, Collaboration, and Managed Services solutions across the

region. We work with customers, partners, vendors, and internal teams to deliver reliable,

high-quality technology solutions.

We are looking for a Finance Executive to support and manage our day-to-day finance

operations for AdvanzIT Singapore and adjacent regional business activities.

Role Summary

The Finance Executive will be responsible for handling daily finance activities including

accounts payable, accounts receivable, bookkeeping, invoice management, expense tracking,

payment follow-up, GST support, and financial reporting coordination.

This role is suitable for someone who is detail-oriented, responsible, organized, and

comfortable working in a growing company environment.

Key Responsibilities

Accounts Payable

• Process vendor invoices and ensure accurate recording.

• Coordinate vendor payments and payment schedules.

• Track supplier outstanding payments.

• Match purchase orders, invoices, and delivery/service completion details.

• Support vendor onboarding and maintain vendor finance records.

Accounts Receivable

• Prepare and issue customer invoices.

• Track customer payments and outstanding receivables.

• Follow up with customers for overdue payments.

• Maintain accurate AR aging reports.

• Coordinate with sales and operations teams on billing milestones.

Bookkeeping & General Ledger

• Maintain day-to-day bookkeeping entries.

• Record financial transactions accurately in accounting software.

• Support general ledger updates and reconciliations.

• Ensure proper documentation of all finance transactions.

• Assist in month-end and year-end closing activities.

Invoice & Expense Management

• Manage customer and vendor invoices.

• Review employee claims and company expenses.

• Track business expenses, receipts, and supporting documents.

• Ensure expenses are properly approved and recorded.

• Maintain organized finance files and records.

Bank, GST & Compliance Support

• Assist with bank reconciliation.

• Support GST filing preparation and documentation.

• Coordinate with external accountant, auditor, tax consultant, or corporate secretary

when required.

• Ensure finance records are maintained properly for compliance and audit purposes.

Reporting & Coordination

• Prepare basic finance reports such as AR aging, AP aging, cash flow summary,

expense reports, and payment status.

• Support management with finance data and analysis.

• Coordinate with internal teams for project billing, vendor payments, and customer

collections.

• Help improve finance processes and documentation.

Requirements

• Diploma or degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or related field.

• 5+ years of experience in finance, accounting, and bookkeeping.

• Knowledge of AP, AR, invoice processing, bookkeeping, and basic accounting

principles.

• Familiarity with GST and Singapore accounting practices will be an advantage.

• Experience using accounting software such as Zoho Books, Xero, QuickBooks, or

similar tools.

• Good knowledge of Microsoft Excel.

• Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

• Good communication and follow-up skills.

• Able to work independently and coordinate with multiple stakeholders.

• Responsible, trustworthy, and well-organized.

Preferred Skills

• Experience in IT, services, projects, or system integrator business will be an

advantage.

• Knowledge of multi-country billing, vendor payments, or regional business support is

a plus.

• Ability to manage both finance operations and administrative coordination when

required.

What We Offer

• Opportunity to be part of a growing Singapore-based technology company.

• Exposure to regional business operations.

• Hands-on role with learning and growth opportunities.

• Collaborative and entrepreneurial work environment.

:

4 days' work from office

title: Performance Management Lead
description:
**About the Role**

We're looking for someone who can take our leadership team's goals and turn them into something every department can work toward and be measured on:
**clear KPIs, real ownership, and a simple way to see whether we're on track**
.You'll be working on business performance across the whole organisation. That means figuring out what "good" looks like for Projects, Design, MEP, Finance, Procurement, Sales and Operations, building the systems to track it, and helping leaders act when things slip.

**Responsibilities**

* **Building the performance framework.**
  You'll set up a performance system for the whole company that connects our annual goals to department targets, team targets and individual KRAs. Everyone should know what they own, what they're aiming for, and how it'll be measured.
* **Designing KPIs**
  A KPI for a site project manager looks nothing like one for a sales lead or a finance controller. You'll design role-specific KPIs with the right weightages, benchmarks and targets, tied to quality, timelines, cost and profitability. As the business changes, you'll revisit them.
* **Running the PMO**
  . You'll track our key initiatives and strategic priorities, including milestones, deliverables, budgets and timelines. When something is stuck or falling behind, you'll spot it early and bring it to leadership with a clear picture of what's going on.
* **Fixing how we work.**
  You'll look closely at how things get done across departments and find where time, money or effort is being wasted. Then you'll work with functional heads to fix it through better workflows, SOPs, process maps and responsibility matrices, and follow up to make sure the changes stick.
* **Linking performance to rewards.**
  You'll design bonus and incentive frameworks that are fair, transparent and tied to real outcomes: score calculations, achievement slabs, eligibility and payouts. You'll work with Finance to keep these in line with budgets, and set up support plans for teams or individuals who aren't hitting the mark.
* **Being leadership's performance partner.**
  You'll work directly with the CEO, COO and business heads. You'll run performance reviews, build the dashboards they rely on, and bring honest, data-backed insight on what's working, what isn't, and what to do about it.
* **What success looks like**
  after a yearEvery department and key role has clear, agreed performance metricsLeadership can see how the business is performing at any point, without chasing anyone for updatesStrategic initiatives are tracked properly and delays are caught earlyA few process improvements have made a visible difference to efficiencyBonus and incentive decisions are transparent and based on dataPeople across the organisation feel more ownership over resultsIf this sounds like the kind of role you'd enjoy building from the ground up, we'd love to hear from you.

**Qualifications**

* 8–12 years in
  **PMO, Business Excellence, Strategy Execution, Operational Excellence or Process Improvement**
* An MBA/PGDM in Operations, Strategy, Finance, Business Management or something related

**Required Skills**

* You've built KPI/KRA frameworks at an organisational level, not just for one team
* You've designed scorecards and dashboards that leadership actually uses
* You've worked on incentive or variable pay frameworks
* You're comfortable with process re-engineering and standardisation

Job Title: Junior Trader Intern

Location: Remote

Organization: PipRaisers

Duration: 2 Months

PipRaisers is a performance-focused proprietary trading and portfolio research firm committed to shaping elite traders through structured training, real-time market immersion, and deep mentorship. We operate across major asset classes—Forex, Commodities, Indices, and Cryptocurrencies—bringing institutional discipline to retail talent.

Role Overview

As a Junior Trader Intern at PipRaisers, you’ll be embedded within a fast-paced trading environment. You’ll support trade identification, execution, and performance tracking—while learning how to navigate markets with a strategy-first mindset. 1. Track and analyse real-time movements across global asset classes—forex, indices, metals, and crypto

Start Date: Immediate preferred

title: Senior Product Specialist
description:
**Job Summary**
---------------

We are seeking an experienced Product Manager to drive the strategy, development, launch and lifecycle management of Data Protection solutions, centered on purpose-built HPE server solutions for Data Protection workloads. This role is responsible for identifying, evaluating, and bringing to market integrated solutions that combine HPE IP products and Independent Software Vendor (ISV) technologies to address customer requirements and accelerate the HPE IP portfolio.

In this role, you will work closely with the HPE Hardware Systems Architects, Product Teams, ISV partners, and customers to define solution requirements and develop purpose-built server configurations and Bills of Material (BOMs) that optimize performance, scalability, interoperability, and customer value throughout the product lifecycle.

Success in this role requires strong product management expertise, technical acumen, and cross-functional leadership. The ideal candidate will collaborate across Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, Sales, Marketing and partner organizations to deliver differentiated solutions, achieve business objectives, and enhance customer satisfaction.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Own product strategy, roadmap, and lifecycle management for HPE and partner-integrated solutions.
* Define product value propositions, market positioning, customer segments, and business cases to drive portfolio growth.
* Develop and sustain HPE server configuration and BOMs, optimized for ISV software solutions.
* Collaborate with HPE and partner stakeholders to identify, develop, and launch differentiated joint solutions.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams across Engineering, Supply Chain, Marketing, Pricing, and Sales to successfully deliver products to market.
* Drive product launches through HPE's New Product Introduction (NPI) process and lifecycle governance requirements.
* Develop pricing and financial strategies that support competitive offerings and business objectives.
* Develop technical documentation and contribute to marketing content development for sales enablement and solution adoption.
* Serve as the subject matter expert for assigned products and support strategic customer and partner engagements.
* Build and maintain strong partner relationships, monitor business performance, and identify growth opportunities through ongoing business reviews.

**Skill Requirements**
----------------------

* Knowledge of product management methodologies and lifecycle management practices.
* Knowledge of Data Protection technologies, markets, and customer requirements.
* Understanding of enterprise server hardware, including architecture, component selection, configuration design, and lifecycle management.
* Experience developing and sustaining server hardware BOMs and technical solution documentation.
* Strong technical acumen and problem-solving skills.
* Detail-oriented with strong process and execution discipline.
* Ability to develop business cases, pricing strategies, and financial models.
* Experience collaborating with ISV and technology partners.
* Strong cross-functional leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to translate customer and market needs into product strategy and roadmap priorities.

Marketing Analytics & Product Management,New Product Introduction,PLM-Program/Project Management

**Good to Have Skill**
----------------------

**Other Requirements**
----------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field; MBA or advanced technical degree preferred.
* 8+ years of experience in Product Management, Engineering, or a related role within the enterprise IT industry.
* Experience with enterprise server hardware, infrastructure solutions, or software-integrated systems.
* Experience developing business cases, product roadmaps, and go-to-market strategies.
* Experience working with ISV partners or technology ecosystem partnerships preferred.
* Demonstrated success leading cross-functional initiatives and bringing products to market.

title: Marketing activation /Neighbourhood Marketing Senior Executive
description:
**About the Role**

Apollo Cradle is looking for a passionate and results-driven Marketing Activation & Neighbourhood Marketing Executive to strengthen our community presence across key catchment areas. This role focuses on reaching expectant mothers, young families, and women in their reproductive years through targeted ground-level activations — including maternity health camps, antenatal workshops, community events, and corporate wellness programmes. You will be the face of Apollo Cradle in the neighbourhood, building trust and awareness for our maternity, gynaecology, and newborn care services.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Health Camps & Screening Drives**

* Organise and execute free maternity health camps covering antenatal check-ups, gynaecology consultations, fertility awareness, and newborn care screenings.
* Coordinate with Apollo Cradle's gynaecologists, obstetricians, and paediatricians for doctor participation at camps.
* Manage all camp logistics — venue booking, patient registration, equipment, medicines, branding, and post-camp follow-up calls.
* Track camp attendance, leads generated, and OPD/delivery conversions from each activation.

**Antenatal & Parenting Events**

* Plan and execute antenatal classes, mommy-baby workshops, breastfeeding awareness sessions, and new parent orientation programmes both at the hospital and in the community.
* Organise baby showers, gender-neutral maternity celebrations, and Apollo Cradle-branded community events to build emotional connect with expectant mothers.
* Coordinate with internal clinical teams for content and speaker participation at events.
* Manage event branding, photography/videography, giveaways, and social media coverage.

**Neighbourhood & Local Area Marketing (LAM)**

* Build and execute a monthly LAM calendar covering societies, schools, creches, play areas, and mother-baby retail touchpoints within the hospital's catchment area.
* Establish and nurture relationships with Obstetricians, Gynaecologists, Paediatricians, and General Practitioners (GPs) in the neighbourhood for referral generation.
* Visit maternity wear stores, baby product outlets, childbirth preparation studios, and yoga/Lamaze centres to create referral partnerships.
* Conduct door-to-door awareness drives, society notice board placements, and targeted pamphlet distribution to pregnant women and young families.

**Corporate & Institutional Tie-Ups**

* Approach corporates, IT parks, and large employers to offer Apollo Cradle's maternity health packages and employee wellness benefits for female employees.
* Present maternity packages, delivery programmes, and newborn care plans to HR managers and corporate wellness teams.
* Tie up with schools, playgroups, and creches for paediatric health camps and awareness sessions targeting parents.

**Reporting & Internal Coordination**

* Maintain daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports tracking activations, footfall, leads, OPD visits, and admissions linked to marketing activities.
* Coordinate with the digital marketing team for real-time social media coverage and post-event content creation.
* Collaborate with the Business Development Manager and clinical teams to align activation plans with hospital occupancy and seasonal maternity trends.

**Qualifications & Requirements**

**Education**

* Graduate in any discipline; MBA/PGDM in Marketing or Healthcare Management preferred.
* Certification in Healthcare or Hospital Marketing is an added advantage.

**Experience**

* 2–5 years of experience in field marketing, BTL activations, or business development — experience in a maternity hospital, women's health brand, or paediatric centre is strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to plan and execute health camps, community events, and referral programmes.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Empathetic and warm communication style
* Strong on-ground execution skills with the ability to manage multiple activations simultaneously.
* Self-starter with a target-oriented mindset; comfortable working in the field five or more days a week.
* Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word); familiarity with CRM tools is a plus.
* Two-wheeler or car with valid driving licence preferred for field mobility.
* Fluency in the local language(s) along with English is essential.

Pay: ₹35,000.00 - ₹45,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Manager, Sales Compensation
description:
**About Rippling**
------------------

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.  
  
Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365 - all within 90 seconds.  
  
Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.85B+ from the world’s top investors - including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, Bedrock, GIC, Elad Gil and Goldman Sachs—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.  
  
We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the Role**
------------------

As a Manager, Sales Compensation **(Individual Contributor)**, you’ll play a critical role in scaling and operating the incentive programs that power Rippling’s go-to-market organization. Sitting within Accounting and partnering closely with the RevOps team, you’ll help ensure our sales teams are compensated accurately, on time, and in alignment with Rippling’s growth goals.

This role sits at the intersection of Finance, Sales Operations, and Systems, with ownership over commission processing, platform administration, and performance analytics. You’ll be responsible for executing and improving core compensation processes, maintaining data integrity across systems, and building reporting that provides visibility into sales performance and incentive outcomes.

This is a highly quantitative, detail-oriented role. You’ll be trusted as the subject matter expert for commission calculations and payout mechanics, while also contributing to process improvements and scalable systems as Rippling continues to grow. If you enjoy working with complex data, solving compensation challenges, and supporting fast-paced sales organizations, this role offers meaningful impact and growth.

**What You Will Do**
--------------------

* Support the design, rollout, and ongoing administration of sales compensation programs, plan documentation, stakeholder communication, and continuous process improvements
* Own end-to-end sales commission operations, including monthly and quarterly calculations, validations, reconciliations, accruals, reporting, audit support, and payout preparation, ensuring accuracy and compliance
* Build and maintain dashboards, reporting, and analytical models to track quota attainment, commission payouts, performance trends, and scenario modeling to support incentive strategy and plan updates
* Administer and scale Rippling’s Incentive Compensation Management platform, including compensation plan configuration, calculation logic, reporting automation, user access, and user acceptance testing for new plans and system enhancements
* Partner cross-functionally with Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Finance, Accounting, and Systems to ensure data integrity across Salesforce, compensation tools, and reporting layers, and to support close and governance processes
* Manage escalations related to commission payouts and provide clear, data-backed resolutions

**Please note that this role is based on the EST/PST timezone**
---------------------------------------------------------------

**What You Will Need**
----------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* 5+ years of experience in sales compensation, commissions administration, sales operations, finance, or a related analytical role, preferably in a high-growth SaaS or technology environment
* Strong proficiency in Salesforce and advanced Excel or Google Sheets, including pivot tables, nested formulas, and data analysis workflows
* Hands-on experience with commission management platforms such as CaptivateIQ, Xactly, Everstage, Spiff, or QuotaPath
* Solid understanding of sales compensation structures, quota-based incentives, revenue crediting methodologies, and payout mechanics
* Exceptional attention to detail and analytical rigor, with the ability to clearly communicate findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
* High ownership mentality and strong interpersonal skills, with comfort working independently in fast-paced, ambiguous environments

**Core Competencies**

* Variable compensation administration & expertise — deep knowledge of commission payout processes, policy, and design
* Data-driven analysis & reporting — builds models, audits payouts, and turns attainment data into clear recommendations
* Process building & scale — designs and implements standardized playbooks, templates, and workflows
* Cross-functional partnership & stakeholder management — partners effectively with Sales, RevOps, Finance, and Accounting; manages seller and leader escalations
* Communication & executive presence — translates complex compensation analysis into slides for leadership

**Additional Information**
--------------------------

Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com

Rippling highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

Documentation & Filing

* Ensure accounting documents are easily accessible when required.

title: Director, Product Management
description:
**Company Description**

At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.

 **Job Description**

Gracenote, a Nielsen company, is dedicated to connecting audiences to the entertainment they love, powering a better media future for all people. We are the content data business unit of Nielsen that powers innovative entertainment experiences for the world's leading media companies. Our entertainment metadata and connected IDs deliver advanced content navigation and discovery to connect consumers to the content they love and discover new ones.

Job Description Great data only matters if it arrives. Gracenote's delivery platform moves millions of pieces of TV entertainment data every day into the backend systems of the world's leading cable, OTT, CE, and digital companies, powering entertainment experiences used by hundreds of millions of consumers.

We are hiring a Director of Product Management to own this platform from our Bengaluru product and engineering center. You will set the product vision and roadmap for our Unified Data Delivery Platform, the centralized repository that consolidates diverse data from across Gracenote into a single Source of Truth, and for the full family of Video metadata delivery solutions that carry that data to clients worldwide. You will lead a team of two product managers in India and partner daily with our engineering teams to deliver against that roadmap.

Delivery is its own discipline. It is where Gracenote's data meets client systems, with all of the schema, integration, scale, and reliability challenges that implies. It is also the tip of the spear. When something goes wrong for a client, delivery hears about it first and is expected to lead the debugging. We are looking for a leader who has lived in this problem space and knows what it takes to run a delivery platform that clients trust.

Responsibilities

* Own the product vision and roadmap for the Unified Data Delivery Platform, the new platform being built to deliver all of Gracenote's Video data to clients and partners
* Own the portfolio of Video metadata delivery solutions that clients rely on today
* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of two product managers in India
* Collaborate with clients and partners to understand the business problems of delivering and ingesting TV entertainment data into their backend solutions, and turn that insight into a clear product vision and roadmap
* Travel to the US and Europe a couple of times per year to meet clients and partners face to face, building the direct market understanding that informs the product vision
* Partner with engineering teams, external partners, and internal stakeholders to prioritize and deliver the roadmap
* Work closely with UX and engineering to deliver the configuration and analytics tools that make the platform successful for clients and internal teams
* Serve as the senior product escalation point when delivery issues arise, leading root cause analysis and driving resolution with engineering and client-facing teams
* Work with senior management to identify opportunities and risks, including new products, infrastructure strategy, and quality initiatives
* Closely manage the cloud infrastructure and costs associated with the data platform

 **Qualifications**  

* 12+ years of product management experience, including 3+ years owning data delivery, distribution, or client integration products
* Experience managing and mentoring product managers
* Experience building and operating high-scale data or distribution systems
* Hands-on experience with XML, JSON, and REST APIs. Actively uses LLMs to write Python scripts and SQL to answer product questions independently
* Experience running structured development processes with distributed engineering teams, from requirements through release
* Willingness to flex working hours for regular overlap with US and European clients and stakeholders
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills

Preferred Skills/Experience

* Bachelor's degree or higher. Computer Science or Engineering major is preferable
* Experience in OTT, TV broadcast, or supporting customers who develop products for digital content consumption
* Development experience with Gracenote, TMS, ROVI, or other structured entertainment databases

 **Additional Information**

Please be aware that job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

Job Purpose To identify and secure strategic locations for new store openings, conduct detailed geographical and market mapping, develop structured beat and route plans, and establish partnerships with residential societies and commercial establishments to maximise market penetration and business potential. 2. Key Roles & Responsibilities A. Site Identification & Store Acquisition - Identify, shortlist and evaluate potential locations for new store openings. - Conduct physical site visits and assess location suitability based on visibility, accessibility, population density and business potential. - Evaluate catchment areas, residential density, commercial activity and competitor presence. - Prepare comparative site evaluation reports with photographs, Google Maps locations and commercial details. - Recommend suitable sites for management approval and finalisation. B. Landlord Negotiation & Commercial Finalisation - Identify and establish contact with property owners and landlords. - Negotiate rental terms, security deposits, lock-in periods, escalation clauses and lease tenure. - Negotiate rent-free periods, fit-out periods and other commercial benefits. - Coordinate documentation and ensure commercial terms are aligned with company requirements. - Maintain a database of shortlisted properties, landlords and negotiation status. C. Market Mapping & Catchment Area Analysis - Conduct comprehensive market mapping of assigned geographical territories. - Identify and map all residential societies, apartments, gated communities, independent households and commercial establishments. - Capture details such as society name, address, approximate number of households, population density and contact details wherever available. - Identify high-potential catchment areas based on household density and accessibility. - Map competitors and other relevant businesses within the assigned territory. - Prepare detailed geographical maps using Google Maps and other mapping tools. D. Beat Planning & Route Development - Develop structured beat plans and daily route plans for assigned territories. - Divide geographical areas into clearly defined routes and micro-markets. - Ensure complete geographical coverage without duplication or overlapping routes. - Map all residential societies, individual households and commercial establishments along each route. - Establish route-wise coverage targets and maintain daily activity reports. - Continuously update route maps based on new developments and market changes. E. Society Tie-ups & Strategic Partnerships - Establish relationships and negotiate tie-ups with residential welfare associations, society management committees and apartment associations. - Secure permissions for promotional activities, branding, stalls and customer acquisition campaigns. - Explore partnerships with societies for exclusive offers and resident engagement programmes. - Develop relationships with commercial establishments, offices, institutions and other potential business partners. - Maintain a database of all society tie-ups, permissions and partnership agreements. F. End-to-End Geographical Mapping - Take ownership of complete geographical mapping of assigned territories. - Ensure every society, residential complex, household cluster and commercial pocket is mapped. - Create route-wise digital maps with clearly marked boundaries and locations. - Maintain an updated master database of mapped areas and business opportunities. - Identify uncovered locations and recommend expansion opportunities. - Submit territory-wise market potential and penetration reports to management. 3. Required Skills & Competencies - Excellent communication and negotiation skills. - Strong local market knowledge and geographical understanding. - Proficiency in Google Maps, Google My Maps, Google Sheets and Excel. - Ability to conduct extensive fieldwork and market surveys. - Relationship-building and networking capabilities. - Good analytical and reporting skills. - Ability to independently manage assigned territories. - Willingness to travel extensively within assigned geographical areas. 5. Educational Qualification & Experience - Graduate in any discipline. - 1–3 years of experience in business development, retail expansion, real estate, site acquisition or field sales. - Experience in property negotiations and market mapping will be an added advantage. - Two-wheeler and valid driving licence preferred. 6. Reporting & Accountability The Business Development Executive will be responsible for end-to-end execution of assigned territory development activities, from identifying potential store locations and negotiating with landlords to completing geographical mapping, route planning and establishing society partnerships. title: Senior Product Designer
description:
**About the Role:-**

As a Senior Product Designer, you will play a critical role in shaping the user experience of a modern B2B SaaS platform.

You will be responsible for designing complex product workflows, developing interactive prototypes directly in code, improving shared design systems, and introducing thoughtful interaction patterns for AI-powered experiences.

You will collaborate with US-based stakeholders and design products primarily for a US audience, making strong communication, independent decision-making, and exceptional design judgment essential.

**Key Responsibilities:-**

**1. Product Design & Experience Strategy**

* Lead end-to-end product design initiatives, translating complex business requirements into intuitive user experiences.
* Design sophisticated B2B SaaS interfaces involving data-dense dashboards, tables, forms, permissions, and multi-role workflows.
* Apply strong product thinking, visual hierarchy, usability principles, and interaction design practices.
* Balance user needs, technical feasibility, and business objectives when developing design solutions.

**2. Code-Based Prototyping & Implementation**

* Design and prototype interfaces directly within the existing production codebase using established component libraries and design systems.
* Navigate existing codebases, understand component structures, and assemble functional product interfaces.
* Use AI-powered design and development tools to accelerate prototyping and product experimentation.
* Ensure prototypes align with existing design patterns, accessibility standards, and component architecture.
* Translate design concepts into working, interactive experiences rather than relying on static mockups.

**3. AI-Native Product Experiences**

* Design innovative AI-native interfaces and intelligent user interactions.
* Develop intuitive experiences for AI-generated content, streaming responses, agentic workflows, and human-in-the-loop interactions.
* Create effective visual representations of AI confidence, uncertainty, progress, and system feedback.
* Explore emerging AI-driven interaction patterns and introduce meaningful design innovations.
* Leverage AI tools effectively throughout the design and prototyping workflow.

**4. Interaction Design & Visual Excellence**

* Own detailed interaction behaviors, transitions, loading states, streaming states, and micro-interactions.
* Create polished and responsive user experiences with strong attention to visual consistency.
* Develop motion patterns that enhance usability and communicate system behavior.
* Ensure interfaces remain accessible, intuitive, and consistent across different user workflows.

**5. Design Systems & Component Architecture**

* Contribute reusable components, interaction patterns, and design standards to the shared design system.
* Improve existing component libraries while maintaining consistency and scalability.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to ensure design decisions align with the underlying product architecture.
* Establish repeatable design and prototyping practices that improve product development efficiency.

**6. Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Work within a dedicated product pod alongside Product Managers and Engineering Leads.
* Take ownership of features from concept development through prototyping, validation, and shipment.
* Participate in product reviews, design critiques, and technical discussions.
* Communicate design decisions and trade-offs clearly to US-based stakeholders.
* Report to the Head of Design and contribute to the overall product design direction.

Mandatory Skills & Qualifications

Candidates must demonstrate strong practical expertise in the following areas:

* **Product Design Experience:** 5+ years of professional product design experience, preferably within B2B SaaS or product-led technology companies.
* **Complex Interface Design:** Proven experience designing data-dense interfaces, including dashboards, tables, complex forms, permission systems, and multi-role workflows.
* **Code-Based Prototyping:** Ability to work directly inside an existing codebase and design system to create functional, interactive product prototypes.
* **Component Library Expertise:** Strong understanding of reusable components, design systems, and established product UI patterns.
* **AI-Assisted Design Workflow:** Hands-on ability to direct AI tools to generate and refine prototypes while respecting existing component systems, accessibility, and product standards.
* **AI-Native UX:** Experience or strong practical interest in designing AI-powered interfaces, streaming interactions, agentic workflows, and human-in-the-loop experiences.
* **Interaction & Motion Design:** Ability to design refined loading states, transitions, micro-interactions, and other detailed interaction behaviors.
* **Product Design Judgment:** Strong visual design capabilities, problem-solving skills, and the ability to explain design decisions through real product case studies.
* **End-to-End Ownership:** Experience collaborating with product and engineering teams to take features from initial concepts to shipped product experiences.
* **Communication:** Excellent English communication skills and the ability to work effectively with international stakeholders, particularly US-based teams.
* **Portfolio:** A mandatory portfolio with password access, demonstrating actual product prototypes and real product design problem-solving capabilities.
* **Professional Background:** Experience in a B2B SaaS product environment, preferably within a small or mid-sized product organization with established design-system practices.

Pay: ₹3,500,000.00 - ₹5,500,000.00 per year

Application Question(s):

title: Staff Product Manager
description:
**About Tekion**
Positively disrupting an industry that has not seen any innovation in over 50 years, Tekion has challenged the paradigm with the first and fastest cloud-native automotive platform that includes the revolutionary Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) for retailers, Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC) for manufacturers and other large automotive enterprises and Automotive Partner Cloud (APC) for technology and industry partners. Tekion connects the entire spectrum of the automotive retail ecosystem through one seamless platform. The transformative platform uses cutting-edge technology, big data, machine learning, and AI to seamlessly bring together OEMs, retailers/dealers and consumers. With its highly configurable integration and greater customer engagement capabilities, Tekion is enabling the best automotive retail experiences ever. Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia and Europe.
  
  
**Job Introduction**
**Role**
Tekion is expanding its platform into security and compliance products for automotive retail, and we are hiring a senior product professional to own this new product area end to end. This role will build across two connected domains:
  
  

* Compliance / GRC: Products that help dealerships meet regulatory obligations, including F&I deal compliance, privacy and data governance, and evolving federal and state requirements, directly within the systems they already use.
* Cybersecurity: A modular suite of security capabilities delivered as independent products over time, including vulnerability and network scanning, continuous exposure management, endpoint detection and response, email security, credential-exposure monitoring, data-loss prevention, and log analytics / SIEM.

This is both a zero-to-one and scaling mandate. The role will define strategy, roadmap, packaging, pricing, and go-to-market approach, turning validated customer demand into shippable, monetizable products. The role requires close collaboration with US-based stakeholders and customers, including periodic time-zone overlap.
  
  
What You’ll Own
  
  

* Product strategy for Tekion’s security and compliance product lines, including the vision, boundaries, and how the two domains reinforce one another.
* Roadmaps for both domains, including sequencing of a modular, SKU-based product portfolio and defining the scope of each release.
* Packaging and pricing models, including subscriptions, consumption-based models, entitlements, and bundling.
* Voice of customer through continuous discovery with dealerships and dealer groups to validate demand before build.
* Cross-functional delivery in partnership with engineering, design, GTM, legal/compliance, security, and platform teams.

Key Responsibilities
  
  
Product Development & Strategy
  
  

* Own the holistic vision, roadmap, strategy, and launch plan for Automotive Security Cloud across security and compliance workstreams.
* Conduct market and competitive research to identify customer needs, product opportunities, market size, and differentiation.
* Define product positioning, messaging, and business rationale for new security and compliance offerings.
* Build alignment across product, engineering, security, compliance, GTM, legal, and leadership stakeholders.

Requirements & Analysis
  
  

* Run continuous customer discovery and translate findings into prioritized, well-specified product requirements.
* Write clear PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and launch requirements; partner with engineering on scope, sequencing, and trade-offs.
* Track relevant regulatory requirements, including GLBA Safeguards, FTC rules, CCPA/CPRA, and GDPR, and translate obligations into product capabilities.
* Assess feasibility, risks, dependencies, costs, infrastructure needs, and resource requirements for proposed capabilities.

Go-to-Market & Commercialization
  
  

* Define the product/SKU catalog, entitlements, packaging, and pricing models for individual offerings and bundles.
* Build business cases and revenue models for new products, including subscription, usage-based, or modular SKU approaches.
* Recruit and manage design partners, run pilots, and convert validated pilots into referenceable customers and GA launches.
* Represent the product area to executives, sales, customers, and partners; support enablement, launch planning, and market entry.
* Define success metrics such as adoption, attach rate, retention, revenue, and risk reduction, and ensure products are instrumented to measure outcomes.

Cross-Functional Leadership
  
  

* Lead collaboration across technical teams working on areas such as email security, vulnerability management, continuous testing, detection, compliance, and platform integration.
* Maintain alignment with leadership stakeholders on product progress, roadmap decisions, customer feedback, and market dynamics.
* Make independent product decisions with strong ownership, accountability, and clear communication.
* Set and communicate a multi-quarter vision and roadmap with measurable outcomes.

**Must-Have Qualifications**

* 7+ years of product management experience, including 3+ years owning security, compliance/GRC, infrastructure, platform, or B2B SaaS products.
* Strong product management fundamentals, including discovery, roadmap definition, prioritization, stakeholder alignment, and translating business goals into executable requirements.
* Domain knowledge in at least one of the following: US automotive retail, dealership operations, F&I, DMS/CRM ecosystems, cybersecurity, GRC/privacy tooling, SIEM, EDR/XDR, vulnerability/exposure management, or DLP.
* Demonstrated experience taking a zero-to-one product to market or scaling an existing product line.
* Working knowledge of security architectures, threat models, security controls, and relevant compliance frameworks.
* Experience with subscription, usage-based, or modular SKU packaging and pricing for B2B SaaS products.
* Proven ability to work autonomously, make decisions independently, and drive products from concept through launch.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex technical, business, and regulatory requirements into clear product decisions.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence technical and non-technical audiences.
* Comfortable working with US-based teams and customers, including periodic time-zone overlap.

**Good-to-Have Qualifications**

* Experience selling into or building products for regulated SMB or mid-market verticals.
* Familiarity with building on a platform or system of record such as DMS, CRM, or ERP.
* Experience productizing an internal capability into a customer-facing offering.
* Familiarity with ISO standards, SOC 2, dealership compliance, privacy regulations, and broader security governance needs.
* Hands-on exposure to security product categories such as vulnerability scanners, continuous penetration testing platforms, email security, threat detection, endpoint security, cloud security, or SIEM/log analytics.
* Experience evaluating build, buy, or partner decisions based on technical feasibility, cost, time-to-market, integration effort, vendor maturity, and long-term differentiation.
* Track record launching greenfield products, entering new markets, or operating in early-stage or 0-to-1 environments.
* Experience with pricing strategy, cost analysis, revenue modeling, or budget planning for security or compliance products.

**Job Opening – GRN & Billing Executive (Pharma)**
==================================================

**Company:** Curtis Drug Point Private Limited (Kauvery Hospital Group)

**Department:** GRN & Billing / Supply Chain Operations
  
**Location:** Banglore, Trichy & Chennai
  
**Experience:** 0–5 Years
  
**Qualification:** Any Graduate (Commerce, Science, or Pharmacy preferred)

### **Job Summary**

We are looking for a detail-oriented Billing Executive to manage pharmaceutical billing operations, ensure accurate invoice processing, and coordinate with warehouse, sales, and dispatch teams. The ideal candidate should have knowledge of pharma billing, GST, inventory coordination, and ERP/SAP billing systems.

### **Key Roles & Responsibilities**

* **Billing & Invoice Processing**

* Prepare and process pharmaceutical sales invoices accurately and on time.
* Verify product details, batch numbers, expiry dates, quantities, pricing, discounts, and GST.
* Ensure proper approvals and pricing accuracy before generating invoices.
* Process credit notes, debit notes, sales returns, and billing corrections.

* **Order & Inventory Coordination**

* Coordinate with sales, warehouse, and dispatch teams for order verification and billing.
* Verify picked quantities against customer orders before invoice generation.
* Ensure billed quantities match dispatched quantities.

* Process billing transactions using ERP/SAP or other billing software.
* Maintain accurate invoice records, billing registers, and supporting documents.
* Prepare daily billing reports and update transaction records.
* Ensure proper documentation for billing adjustments and returns.

* **Compliance & Audit Support**

* Ensure compliance with company SOPs, GST requirements, and approved pricing policies.
* Identify and report billing discrepancies, pricing errors, and quantity mismatches.
* Support internal and external audits by providing billing documents.
* Resolve billing-related queries from customers, hospital units, and internal departments.

### **Required Skills & Competencies**

* Knowledge of pharmaceutical billing and invoice processing.
* Understanding of GST, batch numbers, expiry dates, discounts, and pricing.
* Experience using ERP/SAP or pharmaceutical billing software.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and basic computer applications.
* Strong numerical accuracy and attention to detail.
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Ability to handle billing transactions efficiently.

### **Candidate Requirements**

* **Education:** Any Graduate (B.Com, B.Sc., B.Pharm preferred).

* Candidates with experience in hospital pharmacies, pharmaceutical distributors, or CFA operations will be preferred.

**Key Skills:** Pharma Billing, Billing Executive, GST Billing, Invoice Processing, SAP, ERP, Pharmaceutical Distribution, Sales Billing, Credit Notes, Debit Notes, Inventory Coordination, Batch Verification, FEFO, FIFO, MS Excel.

title: Senior Hardware Product Manager - IoT Wireless/IC Design (6+years exp)
description:
Silicon Labs (NASDAQ: SLAB) is the leading innovator in low-power wireless connectivity, building embedded technology that connects devices and improves lives. Merging cutting-edge technology into the world’s most highly integrated SoCs, Silicon Labs provides device makers the solutions, support, and ecosystems needed to create advanced edge connectivity applications. Headquartered in Austin, Texas, Silicon Labs has operations in over 16 countries and is the trusted partner for innovative solutions in the smart home, industrial IoT, and smart cities markets. Learn more at www.silabs.com.

**Meet the Team**

IoT is the only focus area for Silicon Labs and is one of the most visible and fastest growing segments of the semiconductor industry. Our portfolio of industry leading wireless solutions includes Bluetooth, Zigbee, Thread, Z-Wave, Wi-Fi, Wi-Sun, Proprietary Wireless and other emerging technologies driving the next generation of IoT smart connected products. With the addition of AI acceleration, rich MCU content combined with best-in-class software stacks, tools and development environments we offer compulsive and complete solutions to customers.

As a member of the Hardware Product Management team, you will be responsible for the Silicon Labs IoT products starting from concept to plan and customer alphas. You will be required to interact with a wide range of cross functional teams including silicon design, product test, validation, software product management & engineering, project management and business management to ensure the best of the products come to the market.

As a team, hardware product management:

* Provides leadership and vision on IC product roadmap and requirements.
* Continuously improves our portfolio offering, balancing business needs with R&D efficiency.
* Creates product roadmaps based on various segment inputs to meet the requirements for a diverse range of applications

This is one of the few functions where you will have the great opportunity to discuss with top executives regarding strategy and execution on a day-to-day basis, thus having invaluable amount of learning.

Come and join us in our goal to become the undisputed leader in wireless connectivity for IoT!

**Responsibilities**

* Define SoC product requirements, features, specifications, and system KPIs for core CPU, co-processors, accelerators, power management, digital and analog peripherals, security sub-system, radio sub-system, and packages.
* Map market systems application requirements to product use cases, including system block diagrams, compute and peripheral requirements, and protocol stack features and performance requirements for Wi-Fi, Matter, Thread, ZigBee, Bluetooth Low Energy, Bluetooth Classic, Sidewalk, Wi-SUN, and proprietary protocols.
* Define hardware and evaluation tools for customers, including debug interfaces such as JTAG, SWD, ETM trace, PTI, virtual communication port requirements, and user interfaces such as push buttons, LCDs, LEDs, analog joysticks, and RHT sensors.
* Collaborate with leaders and individual contributors across functional teams such as IC design, product test, software development, product and segment marketing, applications, operations, and sales to develop long-term innovation ideas, roadmap, and silicon definition.
* Drive the product development process from concept through definition and pitch the most promising product ideas to executive staff.
* Conduct key competitive analysis, including tear-down at the die level and various spec analyses, to provide conclusive takeaways for design, specification, and fighting guides.
* Manage the entire portfolio of scalable products with clear mapping to target applications.

**Skills You Will Need**

*Minimum Qualifications*

* BSEE/BSCS (or equivalent) and 6+ years of experience in semiconductor product management or IoT industry
* Core development experience in IC front end / architecture / verification / embedded systems
* Knowledge of key architectural considerations for PPA, including power estimation, die size estimation, and fundamental process node technology principles.
* Knowledge of Wireless Modem and RF Design principles for any of Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, 802.15.4, and other Low Power Wireless standards
* Proven ability to work successfully at a technical level with cross-functional engineering teams, including hardware and software engineers
* Experience developing business cases for Technology investments working with Business Unit partners, sensitivity analysis of business case to variables under consideration.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, especially to executive management

*The following qualifications will be considered a plus:*

* Development experience in either wireless or wired communication protocols
* MBA or equivalent business graduation

Benefits & Perks

Not only will you be joining a highly skilled and tight-knit team where every engineer makes a significant impact on the product; we also strive for good work/life balance and to make our environment welcoming and fun.

· Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)

· Insurance plans with Outpatient cover

· National Pension Scheme (NPS)

· Flexible work policy

description:
**About Sureify**
Sureify is dedicated to modernizing the life insurance and annuity industry. At Sureify, we cultivate a culture that prioritizes innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are looking for a
**Senior Technical Release Manager**
to join our Hyderabad office. This role will be responsible for managing all production releases across our enterprise platform and customer-specific solutions. Unlike traditional release roles, this position serves as a
**Technical Release Governor**
in a complex hybrid environment consisting of both
**multi-tenant**
products and
**multi-instance**
siloed environments.
  
  
As we scale our
**carrier customer**
base, we are looking to adopt best of the breed release practices. You will be the single point of accountability for replacing high-intensity manual interventions in releases with a systematic, technically rigorous process. You will ensure releases are delivered with quality, predictability, and efficiency while bridging the gap between engineering, QA, product, and client support teams.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Release Lifecycle Leadership:**
Own and manage the end-to-end release lifecycle for all production deployments, including core platform production updates and customer-specific customizations. Define, document, and enforce
**release management processes and standards**
. Create and maintain the
**release calendar**
, ensuring transparency and alignment across teams.
  
  
**Technical Gatekeeping:**
Conduct deep-dive release readiness reviews. You will audit "Release Manifests" by validating steps such as SQL migrations or PDF template migrations, Temporal workflow versioning, Kafka schemas, and AWS resource configurations. A good overall understanding of deployment architecture in AWS is essential for this role.
  
  
**Environment Governance:**
Manage "Instance Parity" across our
**AWS**
multi-instance architecture to prevent "Environmental Drift" and ensure customer-specific secrets and variables match our global standards.
  
  
**Cross-Functional Orchestration:**
Facilitate formal "Go/No-Go" decisions by tracking a global checklist that includes technical and non-technical readiness.
  
  
**Risk Mitigation:**
Identify, document, and mitigate technical sequencing risks (e.g., database locks or stateful workflow conflicts) associated with production releases.
  
  
**Continuous Improvement:**
Monitor release performance, generate and provide metrics and reports and drive the transition from manual coordination to
**Automated Production Quality Gates**
within our release pipelines.
  
  
**Required Qualifications & Experience**
**10+ years of overall technical experience**
, with a background in software engineering, SRE, or backend operations.
  
  
**5+ years of direct release management experience**
in a complex, enterprise hybrid SaaS environment (Multi-tenant & Multi-instance).
  
  
**Cloud-Native Expertise:**
Expert-level knowledge of
**AWS**
(EKS, RDS, Secrets Manager, IAM, S3, MSK) and the ability to audit infrastructure-level configurations.
  
  
**Stack Fluency:**
Demonstrated familiarity with
**Typescript**
,
**PHP, Go-lang, and Node.js**
ecosystems. You must understand the deployment nuances of each.
  
  
**Modern Orchestration:**
Hands-on experience or strong knowledge of
**Temporal**
(stateful workflows) and
**Kafka**
(event streaming). You understand the risks of deploying to "in-flight" asynchronous processes.
  
  
**Database Proficiency:**
Strong proficiency in
**MySQL and Postgres**
, specifically in auditing complex migration scripts and data sequencing.
  
  
**Containerization Mastery:**
Deep understanding of
**Kubernetes (K8s)**
manifest auditing and deployment patterns (Canary, Blue-Green, or Rolling Updates).
  
  
**Communication & Gravitas:**
Excellent stakeholder management skills with the professional authority to enforce discipline and halt releases if technical or business criteria are not met.
  
  
**Preferred / Nice-to-Have Skills**
Experience in the insurance or financial services domain (or other regulated industries).
  
  
Knowledge of security, compliance (SOC2/ISO), or audit processes as they relate to release operations.
  
  
Experience with
**Infrastructure as Code (IaC)**
tools like Terraform or CloudFormation.
  
  
Familiarity with Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles such as Error Budgets and SLIs/SLOs.
  
  
**Why Join Sureify?**
At Sureify, you’ll be part of a collaborative, innovation-driven culture where your expertise will directly influence the quality and success of products, transforming the life insurance landscape. You’ll work alongside passionate technologists and industry experts, tackling complex challenges with cutting-edge technologies while helping shape the future of digital insurance.

title: Founder's Office, Operator - Inspirelabs Solutions Ltd (GrabOn)
description:
**GrabOn (Inspirelabs Solutions Ltd) · Hyderabad, in office · 18 months to 4 years of full-time work · Reports to the founder · [3] seats**

**Most Founder's Office roles hire people to think about the business. This one hires people to make sure what the business reports is true, and to fix what isn't.**

**Most people who read this should not apply.**

**The application below takes about two hours of real work before we look at a resume. That is deliberate.**

Read this first

Do not apply if any of these is true. We will not read the rest of your application.

* You have less than 18 months of full-time, paid work in total. Internships, college clubs, case competitions, fellowships and time as a full-time student do not count. Consulting counts only where you carried the work through implementation yourself.
* You want a strategy role ONLY: frameworks, market maps, decks for the founder.
* You cannot work from our Hyderabad office [5] days a week.
* You need a defined job description to do good work.
* You need someone else to build the first version. Here you build v0 yourself, with AI tools, sheets, no-code or scripts.
* You have never owned a number that someone else checked.

Why this role exists

GrabOn has been profitable for over a decade. The founder runs many fronts at once, and the company moves fast. In a company like this, money leaks through the gap between "done" and done.

A campaign is reported live but tracks nothing. An offer is listed but fails at checkout. A partner is "onboarded" but has not sent a sale in weeks.

Your first job is to close that gap. Your second is to run initiatives that do not leak in the first place.

What you will do

**Run the operating system (about 45% of your time).**
You keep one live view of every open initiative in your scope: owner, deadline, and a signal that proves status without asking the owner. You check "done" claims yourself. You open the page, run the report, test the code, call the partner. You run the weekly founder review from that view, and you chase what slips, including work owned by people senior to you.

**Lead initiatives end to end (about 40%).**
One or two at a time. Examples of the kind of work: take a new affiliate partner from signed contract to first tracked sale. Replace a manual workflow with an automation or an AI agent, and prove the hours it saves. Get a stalled partner integration live. You set the metric before you start, and you report it whether it flatters you or not.

**Recommend (about 15%).**
When a decision needs the founder, you bring a one-page written recommendation. It states the options, the evidence, what you would do, and what would change your mind. No decks.

Who decides what

We will not pretend this role has more authority than it has. It has more than most, and it grows with your record.

What good looks likeWho does well here

* You get uncomfortable when something is marked complete and nobody has checked it.
* You would rather tell a senior person their project is late than write a soft update.
* You write things down, and your trackers are current without reminders. When someone copies the same data by hand every week, you automate it yourself.
* You move fast, and you can still tell a reversible call from one that is not.
* You can hold five threads and drop none. You change your view when the evidence changes, not when the room does.

Who struggles here

* People who enjoy thinking more than finishing.
* People who need agreement before they act.
* People who find checking a colleague's work awkward.
* People who want a steady routine. People who lose interest once something launches.
* People whose main reason to apply is working near the founder.

What you get

Daily access to how a profitable, founder-run internet business makes decisions. A path to own a product, a business line or a function, decided by your record and not your tenure. Pay for the work trial in Stage 4. Promoted to Cofounder role in couple years for one of the Inspirelabs products.

How to apply

There is no Easy Apply. A resume without the work below will not be read.

**Stage 1: The Ground Truth Test (about 2 hours, on your own)**

*Part A. Test the offers.*
Pick any two store pages on grabon.in, or on a competitor's site if you prefer. On each, test the first five distinct offers as a shopper would, up to the payment step. Do not pay for anything. Use your own existing accounts; do not create new ones to unlock new-user offers. Skip duplicate codes and take the next one.

Send us:

1. A sheet with 10 rows: store, offer, what the offer claims, what happened, a proof link, and the date and time you tested it. "What happened" is one of four: works, fails, misleading, or untestable (say why: app-only, new-user only, needs a card you don't have).
2. Proof for every tested row: a screenshot of the merchant's own cart or checkout showing the code applied or rejected, with your device clock visible. A screenshot of the coupon page is not proof. Share links must open without a login request.
3. One continuous screen recording, three minutes at most, of you testing one offer that failed or misled, with your own voice narrating. Pause the recording while you enter an OTP, and keep your phone number and address off screen.
4. A message of 150 words or fewer to the person who owns those pages (on a competitor's site, the person who would own them). Tell them what to fix first and why. Mark which points you saw yourself and which you would still need to check.

If we use your findings to fix live GrabOn pages, we pay you ₹25,000 for them, whether or not we hire you.

*Part B. One outcome you owned.*
In 300 words or fewer: the starting problem and its baseline; what you did personally, separate from the team; the hardest decision you made; what failed or had to change; the result, its timeframe and how you measured it; and how you checked that it kept working after handover. Redact anything confidential to your employer. An anonymised reconstruction is fine if you label it. Tell us the role of one person who saw the work. We ask for their contact details only at Stage 4, with your consent, and a former colleague is fine.

*Part C. You
.*
Attach your resume or LinkedIn link. Add three lines: months of full-time paid work in total, your expected fixed pay, and your notice period. Then one more line: which part of this job is your weakest (operating system, initiatives or recommendations), and one example that shows it.

**If you used AI for any part, say which part and how you checked its output.**
We use AI every day. We want to see whether you verify it.

Email everything to careers@grabon.in with this subject line: FO-OPS | Your name | [months of full-time paid work] months | [number of rows marked fails or misleading] of 10

**The number comes from your own sheet.**

**No number is better than another.**

**We re-test rows ourselves, at the merchant, and the number has to match what we find.**

**Stage 2: Two short assessments (about 20 minutes, online).**
The Predictive Index Behavioral Assessment, which has no right answers, and the PI Cognitive Assessment, a short timed reasoning test. We use them to plan your interview, not to decide on their own. Your results are processed by the Predictive Index, a US-based provider; we ask for your consent before you take them.

**Stage 3: Structured interview (60 minutes).**
You walk us through your sheet, then through one thing you built yourself that replaced manual work. Partway through, we change one fact and ask you to re-plan.

**Stage 4: Paid work trial (3 days, in our office).**
A live, non-confidential problem, paid at ₹5,000 per day. We judge the output by one test: can the person who will use it act on it without asking you a question?

**Stage 5: Founder conversation and references.**

**﻿**

What we commit to

* We reply to every complete Stage 1 submission within [7] days. The full process takes about [4] weeks. If we say no after Stage 3, we tell you why in two lines.

We work to recognize you in meaningful, personalized ways including competitive fixed pay, performance-based incentive programs, a family-first benefits program, employer contributions for your retirement, attractive time off and leave offerings, wellbeing support, and MomentMakers, our social, points-based recognition program.

Our spaces and technological toolkit will make it simple to bring together great minds to create innovative solutions that make a difference for our clients worldwide

We cultivate a culture where you can express your ambition through initiatives like Purpose Day, a paid day off dedicated for you to use to invest in your growth and development.

**JOB PURPOSE:**

The Quality Engineer is responsible for leading the quality assurance and control functions for the wire payments and commercial payments hub platform. This role ensures robust, secure, and compliant payment processing solutions by overseeing test planning, execution, automation, and compliance with regulatory and security standards. The incumbent collaborates with product, development, and operations teams to deliver high-quality solutions supporting business objectives.

**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES:**

**Testing Coordination & Execution:**

* Develop, publish, and execute test plans, test cases, traceability matrices, automation scripts, virtualization, status reports, defect and exit reports.
* Identify and obtain required test data and test environments.
* Develop, publish, and execute testing estimates and manage financials related to testing activities.
* Track and report QA/QE metrics and KPIs such as velocity and defect slippage.

**Defect & Compliance Management:**

* Manage defects throughout their lifecycle, ensuring timely resolution and documentation.
* Identify, manage, and implement remediation for any noncompliance items and deviations.
* Ensure adherence to QA/QE standards and support the implementation of new standards.
* Recognize and identify areas for process, policy, or tool improvement.

**Technical Leadership:**

* Provide input, feedback, and challenge to technical designs and assess impacts to testing.
* Identify and implement automation, AI, or other emerging solutions to expedite testing and improve quality.
* Lead the adoption of automation frameworks and tools.

**CROSS-FUNCTIONAL RELATIONSHIPS:**

* Collaborates with project managers, business analysts, developers, and other stakeholders to coordinate testing activities and ensure alignment with project objectives.
* Works closely with development teams to provide feedback on technical designs and assess testing impacts.
* Interacts with external vendors and tool providers to evaluate and integrate testing solutions.
* Partners with other QA/QE professionals across the organization to share best practices and drive continuous improvement.

**COMPLIANCE REQUIREMENTS/RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* As an employee of CIBC, the incumbent must comply with all applicable CIBC and Line of Business policies, standards, guidelines, and controls.

**AUTHORITIES/DECISION RIGHTS:**

* As a key contributor to the business unit, this job has the authority to recommend changes to business processes in order to enhance operational efficiency and effectiveness.

**JOB DIMENSIONS:**

* Responsible for the delivery of testing services for assigned projects/initiatives, supporting retail banking, mobile, web-based, UX, API, and accessibility testing.
* Provides technical and process leadership to ensure quality standards are met.
* Supports achievement of business unit goals through effective quality engineering and testing practices.

**KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS:**

**Education:**
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology or related field.

**Experience:**

description:

**Senior Quality Engineer II**

**Position Summary:**

The Senior Test Engineer is a hands-on quality engineering role supporting the Loyalty Financial Services (LFS) platform across Core, Partners, Platform/Data & Integrations, UI/Admin Portal, and Operations capabilities. The engineer will design and execute risk-based testing, build maintainable automation, validate complex financial and loyalty processing, and provide objective evidence of release readiness.

The role spans functional, API, UI, data, event-driven, integration, near-neighbor, regression, component performance, and production parallel-validation testing. It requires close collaboration with Product, Engineering, Architecture, DevOps, SRE, Security, enterprise testing teams, and upstream/downstream domains. The successful candidate combines strong automation depth with business-process understanding, disciplined test documentation, and end-to-end ownership.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Own the quality-engineering approach for assigned LFS capabilities from backlog refinement through production validation, including test strategy, scope, estimates, risks, entry/exit criteria, traceability, evidence, and sign-off readiness.
* Partner with Product Owners, Business Analysts, architects, and developers to improve acceptance criteria, identify edge cases, define testable requirements, and embed quality early in design and development.
* Design, build, and maintain reusable automation for web UI, REST APIs, microservices, batch processes, data pipelines, Kafka/event flows, and database validations using an automation-first approach.
* Execute functional, integration, near-neighbor, end-to-end, regression, accessibility, negative, boundary, resiliency, and component performance testing appropriate to the capability and release risk.
* Validate financial and loyalty data across source, processing, persistence, events, APIs, UI, and downstream outputs, including reconciliation, calculation accuracy, status transitions, idempotency, audit history, and exception handling.
* Support parallel validation by comparing modern LFS outputs with approved legacy or expected results, analyzing variances, documenting evidence, and partnering with Engineering, Product, and Business teams on disposition and sign-off.
* Create and manage test data that covers positive, negative, boundary, historical, effective-date, role/permission, rejected/resubmitted, duplicate, late-arriving, and error-recovery scenarios while protecting sensitive data.
* Integrate automated suites into CI/CD pipelines and establish reliable quality gates, execution reporting, failure diagnostics, and regression feedback for sprint and release decisions.
* Coordinate cross-POD and cross-domain testing dependencies, environment readiness, service availability, test stubs/mocks, defect retesting, and release or dark-launch validation.
* Lead defect triage and root-cause analysis with clear severity, business impact, reproducible evidence, target resolution, deployment status, and closure verification.
* Contribute to LFS common testing standards, reusable utilities, metrics, dashboards, documentation, and knowledge transfer; mentor engineers and help raise automation and domain capability across PODs.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies, technical reviews, demos, release planning, and production-support activities, providing concise and transparent quality status, risks, decisions, and recommendations.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience.
* 6+ years of software quality engineering experience, including hands-on test automation for enterprise applications and distributed systems.
* Strong programming skills in Java and/or JavaScript/TypeScript; working knowledge of Python or SQL-based test utilities is beneficial.
* Hands-on experience with modern UI automation such as Playwright or Selenium, and API automation using REST Assured, Postman/Newman, ReadyAPI, or equivalent.
* Strong SQL skills and experience validating data across relational databases such as PostgreSQL, Aurora PostgreSQL, or DB2, including reconciliation of high-volume processing results.
* Experience testing REST/OpenAPI services, asynchronous or event-driven integrations, Kafka messages, batch/file processing, microservices, and multi-system workflows.
* Experience creating test frameworks, reusable libraries, mocks/service virtualization, test-data utilities, and actionable execution reports.
* Experience integrating tests with Git-based development and CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Harness, or equivalent.
* Working knowledge of performance testing concepts and tools such as JMeter, Gatling, k6, LoadRunner, or equivalent, including analysis against non-functional requirements.
* Experience with Jira and Confluence for test planning, test evidence, defect management, traceability, and status reporting.
* Strong analytical, debugging, communication, and collaboration skills in Agile/Scrum delivery across distributed teams and time zones.
* Ability to understand complex business rules and translate them into risk-based scenarios, automated checks, and clear release-readiness recommendations.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience in loyalty, hospitality, travel, e-commerce, billing, reimbursement, financial processing, accounting interfaces, or controls-oriented platforms.
* Experience testing cloud-native systems on AWS, containerized workloads using Docker/Kubernetes, and observability platforms such as Splunk, Dynatrace, Grafana, or CloudWatch.
* Experience with contract/schema testing, consumer-driven contracts, Avro/Schema Registry, CDC/data-pipeline testing, and data-quality validation.
* Experience with accessibility testing and WCAG-aligned validation for enterprise web applications.
* Understanding of secure testing, authentication/authorization, role-based access, auditability, privacy, and SOX/ITGC-sensitive application controls.
* Exposure to AI-assisted engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot or Cursor, with disciplined review of generated automation code and test assets.
* Experience guiding other SDETs, conducting automation code reviews, and establishing shared quality-engineering practices across multiple teams.
* LFS Testing Scope Across PODs

**Core Competencies:**

* Automation-first quality engineering
* End-to-end systems thinking
* Financial and data accuracy mindset
* Risk-based testing and critical thinking
* Ownership and execution discipline
* Cross-team collaboration and concise communication
* Root-cause analysis and continuous improvement
* Mentoring, documentation, and knowledge sharing Education
* Graduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related discipline; equivalent practical experience will be considered.

**Work Location and Mode:**

* Hyderabad, India
* Hybrid

**Marriott's Core Values:**

At Marriott, our core values make us who we are. We believe that success is never final. As we change and grow, the beliefs that are most important to us stay the same: putting people first, pursuing excellence, embracing change, acting with integrity, and serving our world. Being part of Marriott Tech Accelerator means being part of a proud history and a thriving culture.
