title: Agile Product Owner Senior Advisor - HIH - Evernorth
description:
Agile Product Owner Senior Advisor
  
  
**Position Overview:**  
The Agile Product Owner Senior Advisor is a strategic and collaborative leader within an agile development team, responsible for managing the product backlog and ensuring that development efforts align with customer needs and business goals. This role involves translating high-level business requirements into clear, actionable features, defining acceptance criteria, and prioritizing work to maximize value delivery. The Product Owner serves as the voice of the customer, working closely with developers, architects, operations, and business stakeholders to guide product development through iterative cycles.
  
The Product Owner should embrace the “Product Mindset” and is expected to understand strategic roadmap goals, conduct customer interviews, analyze data, and participate in portfolio discussions to shape the product vision. They are empowered to support intake, prioritize delivery in partnership with business and Engineering, and ensure the Scrum team is focused on solving the right problems with innovative solutions. This role demands strong business and technical acumen, the ability to communicate effectively across teams, and a commitment to delivering measurable outcomes.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**  

* Understand and align product goals with strategic business objectives to ensure delivery of meaningful value.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with business and technology partners, fostering cross-functional collaboration.
* Act as the primary contact for resolving escalations, removing impediments, and managing stakeholder negotiations and conflicts.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to onboard new initiatives and integrate them effectively into the product development lifecycle.
* Support the development of specifications, including value propositions and technical financial estimates, to guide delivery planning.
* Align with delivery teams to understand capacity and ensure prioritization is accurately reflected in the product backlog.
* Own and refine the product backlog, maintaining a steady flow of well-defined work items for the development team.
* Analyze business needs and support requirement gathering, architecture discussions, and design decisions within agile teams.
* Translate business requirements into actionable features and define iteration scope to guide development.
* Participate actively in agile ceremonies and respond to team inquiries, clarifying features and acceptance criteria.
* Communicate the product vision and strategic decisions to the team, reinforcing customer-centric thinking and business rationale.
* Conduct data analysis and profiling to support product decisions, including mapping source-to-target data and investigating issues using tools like SQL, SAS, or Python

**Qualifications:**  

* Bachelor’s degree in MIS, Business, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 14-16 years of experience in data analysis; Healthcare data domain experience and Agile certification (e.g., SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager) are highly desirable.
* Demonstrated experience as a Product Owner or in a similar role within Agile development environments, with a strong grasp of Agile principles, Scrum methodology, and modern delivery practices such as continuous integration and test-driven development.
* Proven ability to translate complex business needs into clear, actionable features and acceptance criteria, with a focus on delivering customer-centric solutions.
* Aptitude for gaining deep knowledge of the industry, business strategy, and key data domains (e.g., provider data, claims, membership, benefits), and proactively applying this knowledge to drive meaningful results.
* Strong interpersonal and relationship management skills, with the ability to facilitate collaboration across multiple functions, departments, and levels.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills, with the ability to influence and negotiate effectively across technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Proficiency in Agile and collaboration tools (JIRA) with hands-on experience supporting agile ceremonies and backlog management.
* Advanced data analysis capabilities, including experience with SQL tools (e.g.,Toad, SAS, Alation), and data profiling techniques; familiarity with cloud technologies and data warehousing is a plus.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate code, decode data issues, and support architecture and design decisions.
* Exceptional organizational and work management skills, with experience managing dependencies, risks, and delivery timelines in dynamic, lean/agile environments.

**Required Skills:**  

* Data Analytics Platforms (Databricks and/or Snowflake)
* Python, DevOps, Basic Cloud Experience (AWS/Azure)

**Preferred Skills, Experience Education:**  

* Cloud Certification (AWS Cloud Practitioner or similar)

About Evernorth Health Services
  
Evernorth Health Services, a division of The Cigna Group, creates pharmacy, care and benefit solutions to improve health and increase vitality. We relentlessly innovate to make the prediction, prevention and treatment of illness and disease more accessible to millions of people. Join us in driving growth and improving lives.

title: E-commerce Business Manager – Amazon, Shopify & Growth
description:
Hiring: E-commerce Business Manager – Amazon, Shopify & Growth

**Company:** LuxuryKase  
**Location:** Karkardooma, East Delhi (Work From Office)  
**Salary:** ₹60,000–₹80,000 per month + Performance Incentives  
**Experience:** 4–7+ years in E-commerce  
**Employment:** Full-Time

About the Role

LuxuryKase is a growing mobile accessories brand selling across Amazon, Shopify, Flipkart, Meesho, and Myntra.

We are looking for a highly capable, analytical, tech-savvy and result-oriented **E-commerce Business Manager** who can take end-to-end responsibility for our online business operations, profitability, sales growth, advertising, inventory planning, website management and process automation.

We need someone with an **ownership mindset**, who identifies problems independently, implements solutions, leads the team and consistently improves business performance.

This is not a routine 9-to-5 execution role. We want a proactive business leader who can plan, execute, monitor and continuously improve our e-commerce business.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Amazon Marketplace & Advertising Management**

* Take complete ownership of Amazon Seller Central operations and growth.
* Plan, manage and optimize Amazon Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands and Sponsored Display campaigns.
* Monitor and improve ACOS, TACOS, ROAS, CTR, CVR, CPC and organic sales.
* Optimize campaign structures, keywords, bids, placements and advertising budgets.
* Improve product rankings, Buy Box performance, listing quality and overall account health.
* Monitor FBA/Flex inventory, suppressed listings, stranded inventory, returns and stockouts.
* Improve product reviews and ratings through compliant methods.
* Identify new growth opportunities and improve contribution profitability.

**2. Shopify Website & Meta Ads**

* Manage complete Shopify website operations, including theme, apps, product catalogue and integrations.
* Manage Meta/Facebook/Instagram advertising campaigns, budgets, audiences, creatives and retargeting.
* Improve website conversion rate, average order value, customer acquisition cost and ROAS.
* Optimize landing pages, checkout experience, website speed and customer journey.
* Coordinate integrations with shipping partners, inventory systems, payment gateways and third-party applications.
* Monitor COD performance, RTO, returns and net delivered revenue.
* Work on customer retention, repeat purchases and profitable sales growth.

**3. Inventory Planning & Stock Management**

* Forecast SKU-wise demand based on historical sales, seasonality and advertising plans.
* Minimize out-of-stock situations and prevent excess inventory.
* Establish reorder points, safety stock levels and replenishment schedules.
* Identify dead stock, slow-moving products and inventory liquidation opportunities.
* Coordinate with procurement, warehouse and operations teams.
* Improve inventory turnover, working capital utilization and stock availability across channels.

**4. Listing Optimization & Creative Management**

* Improve product titles, descriptions, keywords, attributes, A+ Content and product detail pages.
* Create or coordinate high-quality product images, infographics and advertising creatives using AI and design tools.
* Conduct competitor research and improve listing conversion rates.
* Ensure catalogue accuracy across all marketplaces.
* Plan new product launches and improve performance of existing SKUs.

**5. Automation & Process Improvement**

* Identify repetitive manual tasks and implement practical automation solutions.
* Automate reporting, inventory alerts, order tracking, advertising monitoring and operational workflows wherever feasible.
* Improve integrations between Shopify, Amazon, OMS, shipping platforms and other business systems.
* Create SOPs, checklists, dashboards and automated alerts.
* Reduce manual errors, operational delays and dependency on individual employees.
* Use AI tools, spreadsheets, APIs, no-code automation and relevant software to improve efficiency.

**6. Business P&L, Strategy & Profitability**

* Take ownership of channel-wise business performance and controllable P&L.
* Monitor sales, advertising costs, marketplace fees, shipping expenses, returns, inventory costs and contribution margins.
* Prepare weekly and monthly growth plans, budgets and profitability reports.
* Identify and implement opportunities to increase revenue and net contribution profit.
* Ensure advertising expenditure is aligned with profitability targets.
* Make data-driven decisions and provide actionable business recommendations.

**7. Team Management & Daily Operations**

* Assign, monitor and review tasks across catalogue, advertising, customer support, inventory and operations teams.
* Create daily, weekly and monthly work plans with measurable KPIs.
* Coordinate with the founder on priorities, budgets and business expansion.
* Train employees, establish accountability and improve productivity.
* Identify staffing requirements and participate in hiring and team development.
* Resolve operational bottlenecks without requiring constant founder involvement.

**8. Other Marketplace Growth**

* Manage and improve Flipkart, Meesho and Myntra performance.
* Optimize listings, advertising, pricing, inventory and promotional activities.
* Identify opportunities in emerging marketplaces and quick-commerce channels.
* Develop profitable expansion strategies for new sales channels.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Minimum 4 years of relevant e-commerce experience, preferably with consumer products or mobile accessories.
* Strong practical experience with Amazon Seller Central and Amazon PPC advertising is mandatory.
* Proven experience managing meaningful advertising budgets and improving ACOS/TACOS.
* Good understanding of Shopify, Meta Ads, marketplace integrations and e-commerce analytics.
* Experience with SKU-level inventory planning, stock forecasting and replenishment.
* Strong understanding of P&L, contribution margins, ROAS, ROI and business KPIs.
* Advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills, including Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP and reporting dashboards.
* Familiarity with AI tools, automation platforms, APIs and e-commerce software.
* Strong analytical, leadership, communication and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to independently plan, prioritize and execute work.
* Bachelor's degree preferred; proven practical experience and measurable results are more important.

Preferred Experience

* Experience managing ₹50 lakh–₹2 crore+ monthly e-commerce revenue.
* Experience with large catalogues containing 1,000+ SKUs.
* Experience in FBA, Amazon Flex, multi-channel inventory and order management systems.
* Familiarity with tools such as ChatGPT, Canva, Photoshop, Make, Zapier, n8n, Looker Studio and inventory management software.
* Experience managing and improving an existing e-commerce team.

What Success Looks Like

* Consistent profitable revenue growth.
* Improved Amazon ACOS/TACOS and Shopify advertising efficiency.
* Reduced stockouts, excess inventory and operational errors.
* Improved product listings and conversion rates.
* Reliable dashboards, SOPs and automated workflows.
* Higher team productivity and reduced founder dependency.

**Important:** We are looking for someone who has personally managed e-commerce business performance, advertising and operations—not someone whose experience is limited to uploading products or coordinating orders.

Candidates must be prepared to discuss their previous business results, advertising performance, inventory improvements and process automation projects during the interview.

Pay: ₹60,000.00 - ₹80,000.00 per month

Application Question(s):

* 1. How many years of hands-on experience do you have managing Amazon Seller Central and Amazon PPC?
* 2. What is the highest monthly e-commerce revenue you have personally managed?
* 3. What is the highest monthly Amazon advertising budget you have personally managed?
* 4. Have you managed Shopify and Meta Ads campaigns?
* 5. Have you independently managed inventory forecasting and stock replenishment?
* 6. Have you implemented business process automations or system integrations?
* 7. Have you been responsible for channel-level profitability or P&L?
* 8. Are you comfortable working full-time from our Karkardooma, East Delhi office?

Education:

* Bachelor's (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

title: IT Solutions Analyst (Universal Robots, Bangalore - India)
description:
The
**IT Solutions Analyst - ServiceNow**
is the functional and technical bridge between business stakeholders and the ServiceNow platform, responsible for designing, configuring, enhancing, and supporting solutions across Customer Service Management (CSM), Manufacturing Commercial Operations (MCO), and Sales and Order Management (SOM).
  
  
This role translates customer service, asset management, contracts management, and entitlement-related requirements into scalable ServiceNow workflows, custom applications, and integrations. The analyst partners with Sales, Field Service, Customer Care, Manufacturing, and other IT teams to improve customer experience, order accuracy, and service efficiency, and acts as a subject-matter expert and escalation point for production support. As part of the IT Enterprise Applications team, the analyst also designs and supports integrations between ServiceNow and other systems, including Salesforce, on-premise applications, and databases.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities****
**Requirements analysis and solution design**

* Gather, document, and refine business requirements through workshops, interviews, and process mapping with Sales, Customer Service, Manufacturing, and Finance stakeholders.
* Translate requirements into functional specifications, user stories with acceptance criteria, and solution designs aligned to ServiceNow best practices.
* Assess the impact of platform upgrades, new releases, and process changes, and recommend out-of-the-box (OOTB) approaches over customization where practical.

**Platform configuration and development**

* Configure and enhance CSM (case management, customer and account data, entitlements, SLAs, Customer Service Portal, Virtual Agent, knowledge management).
* Configure and enhance MCO and SOM (product and quote catalogs, order capture, decomposition and fulfillment orchestration, order tracking, and commercial and manufacturing operations workflows).
* Design and build custom scoped applications using Flow Designer, Workflow Studio, Business Rules, Script Includes, UI Policies, Client Scripts, UI Builder / Workspaces, and Service Portal.
* Build and maintain integrations between ServiceNow and Salesforce, on-premise applications, databases, ERP, PLM, MES, telephony, and other enterprise systems using REST/SOAP APIs, Integration Hub, MID Server, JDBC, and data import sets.
* Implement and tune ServiceNow AI features (Now Assist skills, AI Agents, Virtual Agent, AI Search, Build Agent) across CSM, MCO, and SOM processes, and measure their impact on case deflection, resolution time, and agent productivity.

**Testing, deployment, and release management**

* Develop test plans and test cases, execute functional and regression testing, and coordinate user acceptance testing (UAT).
* Manage update sets / application repository deployments across instances and follow established change, release, and source-control practices.
* Produce release notes, training materials, and knowledge articles, and support end-user and super-user training.

**Production support and continuous improvement**

* Provide Tier 2/3 support for CSM, MCO, and SOM, including incident triage, root-cause analysis, and permanent fixes within SLA targets.
* Monitor platform health, data quality, and performance, and proactively identify and close process or configuration gaps.
* Support platform upgrades, family release adoption, and technical debt reduction.
* Maintain solution documentation, data models, and process flows; contribute to the product backlog and sprint planning.

**Governance and collaboration**

* Work with architects, developers, and platform owners to uphold standards for security, ACLs, data governance, and compliance.
* Report on solution adoption and process KPIs (case resolution time, order cycle time, SLA attainment) using Performance Analytics and dashboards.
* Mentor junior analysts and share knowledge across the ServiceNow community of practice.

****All About You****
We seek individuals who share our passion and determination. Our commitment to customer success drives us to go the extra mile. If you’re ready to join us in this mission, take a closer look at the minimum criteria for the position.
  
  
****Education And Experience****

* Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5+ years of hands-on ServiceNow experience as a platform analyst, administrator, or developer, focused specifically on ServiceNow solutions.
* Demonstrated implementation and support experience in at least two of the three target modules: CSM, MCO, and SOM.
* Proven experience developing custom scoped applications on the ServiceNow platform, from requirements through deployment and support.
* Experience supporting production ServiceNow environments, including incident management, root-cause analysis, upgrades, and release cycles.

**ServiceNow certifications**
**Certification**
**Requirement**
ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA)
  
  
**Required**
ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist – Customer Service Management (CSM)
  
  
Optional (preferred)
  
  
ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist – Sales and Order Management (SOM)
  
  
Optional (preferred)
  
  
ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD)
  
  
**Required**
Candidates holding certifications in Manufacturing Commercial Operations (MCO) or comparable manufacturing-industry ServiceNow credentials will be given strong preference.
  
  
****Technical Skills****

* Strong working knowledge of ServiceNow data model, tables, ACLs, roles, and CMDB / Customer Service data structures.
* Proficiency with JavaScript (server-side and client-side), Glide APIs, Flow Designer, Workflow Studio, and scoped application development.
* Experience with integrations to Salesforce, on-premise applications, and databases (SQL, JDBC) using REST/SOAP, Integration Hub spokes, MID Server, and import sets / transform maps.
* Hands-on experience with ServiceNow AI capabilities, including Now Assist skills for CSM and SOM (case and order summarization, resolution notes, knowledge generation), Now Assist Virtual Agent, AI Search, and customizing skills with Now Assist Skill Kit (NASK).
* Working knowledge of agentic AI on the platform, including features available through the Australia release: building, configuring, and governing AI Agents and agentic workflows, selecting model providers (Now LLM Service or third-party models), and managing Now Assist administration, licensing tiers, and guardrails.
* Experience with Customer Service Portal, Service Portal, UI Builder, and Workspaces (Customer Service Workspace).
* Understanding of order-to-cash, quote-to-order, entitlement, and warranty / contract processes.
* Familiarity with Agile (Scrum / SAFe) delivery, user story writing, and tools such as ServiceNow Agile Development, Jira, or Azure DevOps.
* Ability to write functional specifications, test cases, and process documentation, and to present solutions to technical and non-technical audiences.

****Preferred Qualifications****

* Hands-on MCO experience, including manufacturing commercial processes such as contracts, pricing, and order-to-delivery visibility.
* Experience with Configure, Price, Quote (CPQ) solutions, such as ServiceNow Sales and Order Management quoting, Salesforce CPQ, or Oracle CPQ, including product catalogs, pricing rules, quote-to-order flows, and integration with order management and ERP systems (a strong advantage).
* Additional ServiceNow certifications: Certified Technical Architect (in progress), Integration Hub, Performance Analytics, Now Assist / Generative AI / Agentic AI, or Predictive Intelligence.
* Experience building custom AI skills and AI Agents or using Build Agent to create agentic workflows for custom applications, and keeping pace with new AI capabilities in each ServiceNow family release.
* Experience integrating ServiceNow with ERP (Oracle Fusion), CRM (Salesforce), PLM, or MES systems.
* Experience with CI/CD and source control for ServiceNow (for example, Git integration, ATF automated testing).
* Exposure to data analytics and reporting tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
* Prior experience coordinating large/small projects or mentoring junior team members.

****Core Skills And Working Conditions****
**Core skills**

* Analytical and problem-solving ability, with a bias toward root-cause resolution over workarounds.
* Clear written and verbal communication, including facilitating workshops and explaining technical concepts to business users.
* Stakeholder management and the ability to balance multiple priorities across commercial, service, and manufacturing teams.
* Customer-centric mindset, with a focus on measurable outcomes and user adoption.
* Ownership, attention to detail, and comfort being self-directed in a fast-paced, Agile environment.
* Collaboration with onshore and offshore development partners.

**Working conditions**

* Primarily remote-based, with occasional travel.
* Participation in an on-call rotation for critical production issues and occasional after-hours release or upgrade support.

We are only considering candidates local to position location and are unable to provide relocation for this position. This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

title: AEM Technical Architect
description:
**About The Role**
Adobe Consulting is seeking an experienced Technical Architect to join our team and lead the delivery of next-generation digital experience solutions for enterprise customers.
  
  
As the Adobe Experience Cloud ecosystem evolves towards AI-powered and agentic experiences, we are looking for an AEM Architect who combines strong expertise in Adobe Experience Manager with an understanding of emerging AI capabilities and their application to digital experiences.
  
  
The role goes beyond traditional AEM architecture. You will work closely with enterprise customers to define technology strategies, modernize digital experience platforms, and adopt emerging solutions such as Adobe Brand Concierge, AEM Co-worker and AI-powered content experiences.
  
  
You will act as a trusted technology advisor to customers, lead complex solution architecture and guide multidisciplinary teams to deliver successful outcomes.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
**AEM and Digital Experience Architecture**

* Be a recognized technical expert in Adobe Experience Manager, including AEM as a Cloud Service, Edge Delivery Services (EDS), Universal Editor and Document-based Authoring.
* Architect scalable, secure and high-performance digital experience solutions across CMS, DAM, personalization and composable architectures.
* Guide customers through modernization journeys, including migration from AEM 6.x, on-premise and other CMS platforms to AEM Cloud Service and EDS.
* Define architecture and engineering practices that improve performance, Core Web Vitals, scalability and content authoring productivity.
* Provide technical leadership across complex enterprise implementations and integrations.

**AI And Agentic Experience Adoption**

* Understand and drive the adoption of emerging Adobe AI and agentic capabilities, including Adobe Brand Concierge, AEM Co-worker and other AI-powered Experience Cloud solutions.
* Identify opportunities to leverage Generative AI and Agentic AI to transform digital experiences and content operations.
* Architect solutions that integrate AI capabilities with existing AEM platforms, enterprise content, customer data and business systems.
* Guide customers on AI-powered content creation, personalization, asset management, content supply chain and workflow automation.
* Understand key AI architecture concepts such as LLMs, RAG, agent orchestration, APIs and MCP integrations, and their application in enterprise solutions.
* Advise customers on responsible AI adoption, including security, data privacy, governance and brand safety.

**Customer and Consulting Leadership**

* Act as a trusted technology advisor to senior customer stakeholders, including CIOs, CTOs and digital business leaders.
* Lead customer workshops, architecture discussions, solution presentations and technology strategy conversations.
* Understand customer business challenges and translate them into effective technology solutions and transformation roadmaps.
* Shape consulting opportunities by defining solution approaches, contributing to proposals and articulating business value.
* Clearly communicate complex technology concepts and the business value of emerging AI capabilities to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Build strong relationships with customers, Adobe account teams, partners and product engineering teams.

**Technical and Delivery Leadership**

* Provide end-to-end architectural leadership across large and complex customer engagements.
* Lead solution discovery, architecture definition, technical design and implementation oversight.
* Work closely with Delivery Managers and Project Managers to ensure successful project execution and customer outcomes.
* Lead and mentor architects, developers and multidisciplinary technical teams.
* Identify and resolve complex technical challenges and take ownership of architecture decisions.
* Develop reusable architecture patterns, accelerators and best practices, particularly around AEM, EDS and AI-enabled solutions.
* Stay current with Adobe Experience Cloud innovations and emerging AI technologies and share knowledge across the consulting community.
* Manage multiple customer engagements and provide technical leadership with minimal supervision.

**What You Need To Succeed**

title: User Acquisition & Retention Executive - Mobile App
description:
**Role Overview**

We are looking for a results-driven
User Acquisition & Retention Executive

to take ownership of the growth, engagement, and marketing of the 123Greetings mobile app.

The person will be responsible for creating a strong first experience for new app users, driving ongoing engagement through push notifications and in-app communication, maintaining the app presence across the 123Greetings website, managing ASO and developing marketing initiatives that increase
**app installs, downloads, active users, engagement, retention and ultimately app revenue/subscriptions**
.

This role requires a combination of
**app marketing, user engagement, CRM, ASO, content, analytics, and performance marketing**
skills.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. New User Welcome & Onboarding**

•  Own the welcome experience for new app users.

•  Develop and manage onboarding communication that helps users understand the value of the 123Greetings app.

•  Create strategies to ensure that new users quickly reach their first meaningful action, such as:

◦   Browsing cards

◦   Creating/sending an eCard

◦   Saving a favorite

◦   Sharing a card

◦   Subscribing to Pro

•  Develop welcome journeys for different user segments and acquisition sources.

•  Continuously analyze the onboarding funnel and identify opportunities to improve activation and retention.

**2. Push Notification & User Engagement**

•  Own the complete push notification strategy for the 123Greetings apps.

•  Develop engaging, timely and relevant push campaigns around:

◦   Birthdays

◦   Holidays

◦   Festivals

◦   Seasonal occasions

◦   Friendship and relationships

◦   Important calendar events

◦   New card launches

◦   Trending occasions

◦   Pro subscription

•  Create segmentation-based notification strategies based on user behavior, interests, relationships and past activity.

•  Test different notification:

◦   Headlines

◦   Copy

◦   Timing

◦   Frequency

◦   CTAs

•  Monitor open rates, click-through rates, card sends, conversions and unsubscribe/opt-out rates.

•  Build automated notification journeys wherever possible.

•  Ensure notifications add value and do not result in notification fatigue.

**3. 123Greetings Website → App Growth**

•  Own the 123Greetings App page/section on the website homepage.

•  Develop strategies to convert website visitors into app users.

•  Work with the product, design and technology teams to continuously improve:

◦   App promotion placements

◦   App banners

◦   App download CTAs

◦   QR codes

◦   App landing pages

◦   Website-to-app journeys

•  Identify high-traffic website pages and opportunities for app install promotion.

•  Develop campaigns that leverage the existing 123Greetings website audience to increase app downloads.

**4. ASO – App Store Optimization**

Own the ongoing
**ASO strategy**
for both iOS and Android apps.

Responsibilities include:

•  Keyword research and optimization.

•  App title and subtitle optimization.

•  App description optimization.

•  Keyword optimization.

•  App screenshots and creative optimization.

•  App icon testing and optimization.

•  Store listing localization where relevant.

•  Competitor ASO research.

•  Monitoring app-store rankings and visibility.

•  Improving conversion from store visit → install.

•  Managing seasonal ASO updates around major occasions and holidays.

•  Conducting A/B tests on store creatives and messaging wherever available.

**5. App Install & Download Growth**

Develop and execute an overall marketing strategy to increase
**qualified app installs and downloads**
.

Channels may include:

•  123Greetings website

•  Email marketing

•  Push notifications

•  Social media

•  Organic search

•  App Store / Google Play optimization

•  Paid digital advertising

•  Influencer/creator partnerships

•  Affiliate partnerships

•  Content marketing

•  Referral campaigns

•  Cross-promotion

•  Seasonal campaigns

•  PR and media outreach

•  Partnerships and co-marketing

•  QR-code campaigns

•  Offline-to-online campaigns

•  Retargeting

**6. App Engagement & Retention**

•  Develop strategies to increase DAU/MAU and user retention.

•  Identify reasons for user drop-off after installation.

•  Create re-engagement campaigns for inactive users.

•  Build lifecycle campaigns

**7. Seasonal & Occasion-Based App Marketing:**

123Greetings is an occasion-driven product, so the person will be responsible for creating an annual
**App Marketing Calendar**
covering major:

•  U.S. holidays

•  Birthdays

•  Relationship occasions

•  Festivals

•  Awareness days

•  Seasonal events

•  Trending occasions

**8. Analytics & Performance Reporting**

Track and report on the complete app growth funnel.

Key metrics include:

•  App installs

•  App Store conversion rate

•  New users

•  Retention

•  Push notification open rate

•  Push CTR

•  Cards sent per user

•  Repeat users

•  Re-engagement

•  Pro conversion

**Ideal Candidate**

•  1-3 years of experience in
**app marketing, mobile growth, digital marketing, CRM or user engagement**
.

•  Strong analytical and data interpretation skills.

•  Excellent copywriting and campaign-planning skills.

•  Strong understanding of the U.S. consumer market is preferred.

title: Business Manager
description:
Company Description

Rushika Capital is an RBI-registered and licensed Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC), focused on providing accessible and responsible financial solutions to individuals, entrepreneurs, and businesses.

With a commitment to customer-centric financial services, operational efficiency, and sustainable growth, Rushika Capital aims to build long-term relationships while delivering financial solutions that meet the evolving needs of its customers.

Role Description

We are seeking an experienced, dynamic, and result-oriented 
**Business Manager**
 with a strong understanding of the NBFC, banking, and financial services sector.

The role involves managing and developing business activities, identifying growth opportunities, overseeing operational performance, strengthening business relationships, and contributing to the organization's overall strategic objectives.

The ideal candidate should possess strong business acumen, leadership capabilities, and a comprehensive understanding of financial products, business operations, and the regulatory environment.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Business Development & Strategic Growth**

* Develop and execute strategies to drive business growth, revenue generation, and profitability.
* Identify new business opportunities, financial products, customer segments, and potential markets.
* Explore opportunities for business diversification, expansion, and strategic partnerships.
* Establish and monitor business targets, budgets, and performance indicators.

**2. Business Operations & Performance Management**

* Oversee and coordinate business activities to ensure smooth and efficient operations.
* Monitor business performance, operational productivity, and financial outcomes.
* Identify opportunities for process improvements, cost optimization, and enhanced service delivery.
* Ensure effective coordination among various business functions and departments.

**3. Financial Products & Portfolio Management**

* Manage and monitor performance across relevant financial products and business portfolios.
* Evaluate product performance, customer requirements, and market opportunities.
* Oversee relevant aspects of customer acquisition, servicing, portfolio quality, collections, and recovery management.
* Work closely with credit, risk, operations, and compliance teams to maintain sound business practices.

**4. Team Leadership & Management**

* Lead, guide, and coordinate teams to achieve organizational objectives.
* Establish clear performance expectations and monitor team productivity.
* Encourage accountability, collaboration, and professional development.
* Support resource planning and team development in line with business requirements.

**5. Partnerships & Stakeholder Management**

* Build and maintain relationships with customers, business associates, channel partners, and financial institutions.
* Identify and develop opportunities for strategic collaborations and distribution partnerships.
* Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure effective business execution.
* Represent the organization in relevant business discussions and professional engagements.

**6. Risk, Compliance & Reporting**

* Ensure business activities adhere to applicable RBI regulations, internal policies, and regulatory requirements.
* Coordinate with relevant departments to monitor operational risks, portfolio performance, and compliance.
* Prepare and review periodic business reports, financial performance indicators, and operational metrics.
* Provide recommendations and insights to management for improving overall business performance.

Qualifications & Experience

* Relevant managerial experience in an NBFC, bank, or financial services organization.
* Strong understanding of financial products, business operations, and the NBFC ecosystem.
* Proven experience in business development, strategic planning, and performance management.
* Knowledge of lending operations, portfolio management, risk management, and financial services distribution.
* Experience in team management, stakeholder relationships, and business expansion.
* Familiarity with applicable RBI regulations and compliance requirements.
* Strong analytical, negotiation, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to take independent ownership of responsibilities and deliver results.
* Bachelor's degree in commerce, finance, business administration, or a related field. An MBA or equivalent qualification is preferred.

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for a proactive, commercially driven professional with an entrepreneurial mindset and a hands-on approach to business management.

* The ideal candidate should demonstrate strong leadership, sound financial understanding, operational discipline, and the ability to identify opportunities, manage responsibilities independently, and contribute to the organization's long-term growth.

title: Marketplace & Quick Commerce Executive
company: A.V. Thomas & Co. Ltd., Consumer Product Division
description:
**Role Purpose:**

To manage and grow AVT's complete online business across marketplaces and quick-commerce platforms, with responsibility for sales achievement, product availability, assortment, listings, pricing, promotions, digital visibility, inventory, platform coordination and commercial performance. The position should be treated as a business and sales role, not merely an online coordination role.

**Key Job Functions:**

**1. Sales & Target Achievement:**
Own monthly and annual platform-wise sales targets. Monitor daily and weekly sales, identify gaps and implement corrective actions. Analyse performance by platform, city, brand, SKU and pack size.

**2. Marketplace Management – Amazon / Flipkart:**
Manage Seller/Vendor Central, listings, account coordination, platform campaigns, commercial issues, ratings/reviews and new-product activation.

**3. Quick-Commerce Management – Blinkit / Zepto / Instamart:**
Manage city-wise and dark-store-wise business performance. Track active stores, availability, assortment and sales. Ensure AVT expands into relevant new cities and dark stores as platforms grow.

**4. Availability & Stock-Out Control:**
Maintain high availability of priority AVT SKUs. Monitor OOS, inventory cover and replenishment requirements and coordinate with Supply Chain and distributors.

**5. Assortment & Range Expansion:**
Ensure the right AVT brands, SKUs and pack sizes are listed. Increase average SKUs per platform/dark store and identify opportunities for range expansion.

**6. Digital Shelf & Product Content:**
Maintain accurate product titles, images, descriptions, MRP, pack information and enhanced content. Improve search visibility and category ranking.

**7. Pricing & Promotions:**
Maintain approved pricing and monitor competitor prices. Execute coupons, discounts and platform campaigns within approved budgets and evaluate incremental sales and profitability.

**8. Platform Advertising & Visibility:**
Coordinate sponsored search, product advertising and platform visibility. Monitor ROAS/ACOS and ensure advertising expenditure produces measurable business results.

**9. New Product / New Market Launches:**
Ensure timely listing and activation of new AVT products. Identify new cities, platforms and dark stores and execute launch plans.

**10. Competition Tracking:**
Maintain a weekly competitor dashboard covering price, discounts, assortment, search position, availability, ratings, new launches and sponsored visibility.

**11. Inventory, Fill Rate & OTIF:**
Forecast requirements based on sales run rates, maintain adequate inventory, prevent promotion-related stock-outs and monitor fill rate and OTIF.

**12. Claims & Reconciliation:**
Track platform deductions, returns, shortages, claims and commercial settlements and coordinate with Finance for timely reconciliation.

**Primary Performance Outcomes:**

The role will ultimately be evaluated on four principal outcomes:

·      Sales Growth

·      Availability

·      Distribution & Assortment Expansion

·      Profitability

The executive is expected to function as the operational business owner for all assigned marketplace and quick-commerce platforms, with disciplined coordination across Marketing, Supply Chain, Finance and Sales.

description:
\*AGM Projects – Multi Storey Building (Civil) | Saligramam, Chennai\*
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a senior and experienced AGM Projects to lead end-to-end execution of Multi Storey Residential Buildings – Apartments / Villas. The candidate will be responsible for complete project delivery from mobilisation to handover, ensuring timeline, quality, safety, cost and client satisfaction.
  
  

* Experience:\* 15-20 Years
* Salary:\* Rs. 1,00,000 - 1,20,000 per month
* Qualification:\* B.E. / B.Tech Civil Engineering (Mandatory)
* Preferred:\* PMP / Primavera / Construction Management
* Joining:\* Immediate Joiners Preferred

**Detailed Responsibilities**
\*1. Project Planning & Execution\*
  
  
Plan, monitor and control project schedules, construction sequence, manpower, machinery and material planning for multi storey buildings. Ensure execution as per approved drawings, structural designs, specifications, BOQ and project timelines. Identify delays in advance and take corrective action. Coordinate with Project Head for strategic planning and approvals.
  
  
\*2. Site Management & Coordination\*
  
  
Oversee multiple multi storey project sites at Saligramam and nearby locations. Conduct daily / weekly site reviews for progress, productivity, quality and safety. Coordinate with Project Managers, Site Engineers, QA/QC, Safety, Purchase and Stores teams. Ensure site discipline, SOP compliance and smooth day-to-day operations.
  
  
\*3. Technical Coordination\*
  
  
Coordinate with Architects, Structural Consultants, MEP Consultants, Liaison and other stakeholders for drawing clarifications, approvals and design coordination. Review GFC drawings, resolve site technical issues, and ensure execution without rework. Provide technical guidance to site team for complex structural works like raft, basement, podium, tower structure, finishing works.
  
  
\*4. Cost, Budget & Billing Control\*
  
  
Monitor project budget, cost consumption, material wastage and variations. Review BOQ, RA bills, subcontractor bills, variation claims and certifications in coordination with QS and Finance. Control project cash flow, forecast requirements and implement cost optimization measures.
  
  
\*5. Quality & Safety\*
  
  
Ensure strict adherence to quality standards for structure, waterproofing, finishes and MEP integration. Coordinate with QA/QC team for checklists, material testing, cube tests, mock-ups and NCR closure. Ensure 100% safety compliance, toolbox talks, PPE usage, scaffolding / tower crane safety and statutory requirements.
  
  
\*6. Procurement & Vendor Management\*
  
  
Coordinate with Purchase for timely procurement of cement, steel, RMC, blocks, finishing materials and services. Plan material requirements as per schedule to avoid site stoppage. Monitor contractor / subcontractor performance, workmanship, manpower deployment and compliance with agreements.
  
  
\*7. Team Leadership\*
  
  
Lead, mentor and manage Project Managers, Site Engineers, Supervisors and support staff. Define KRAs, review performance, conduct review meetings and build a result-oriented team. Ensure effective communication and adherence to hierarchy.
  
  
\*8. Reporting & Handover\*
  
  
Prepare weekly / monthly MIS, progress reports, delay analysis, risk register and present to Management. Highlight risks, resource gaps and action plans. Ensure snag rectification, final inspections, statutory approvals, customer handover and complete project closure documentation.
  
  
**Skills Required**
Strong knowledge of multi storey building construction, structural execution, finishing works, drawings, BOQ, specifications, MS Project, Primavera, MS Office, ERP. Excellent leadership, planning, coordination, problem-solving and decision-making skills.
  
  
**Ideal Candidate**
15-20 years in Civil Construction with minimum 3-5 years in senior leadership role, with proven track record of completing multi storey apartments / villas on time.
  
  
Work Location: Saligramam, Chennai.
  
  
Immediate joiners are preferred.
  
  
For more details contact us at 9176033506/9791033506.

**Company:**
Curtis Drug Point Private Limited (Kauvery Hospital Group)
  
  
**Position:**
Senior Manager – Operations
  
  
**Department:**
Operations & Supply Chain

12–15 Years (Minimum 5 Years in a Managerial Role)
  
  
**Location:**
Chennai
  
  
**Qualification:**
B.Pharm / B.Sc. / B.Com; MBA in Operations / Supply Chain preferred
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented Senior Manager – Operations to lead end-to-end pharmaceutical distribution operations across all four Curtis Drug Point locations. The role involves overseeing warehousing, inventory management, order fulfilment, dispatch, logistics, regulatory compliance, cost optimization, and operational efficiency.
  
  
The ideal candidate should have strong experience in pharmaceutical supply chain management, multi-location operations, process standardization, and team leadership.
  
  
Key Roles & Responsibilities
  
  

* Operations Management & Leadership
* Lead and monitor day-to-day warehouse, dispatch, and outlet operations across all four locations.
* Develop and implement standardized SOPs for receiving, storage, picking, billing, credit notes, and dispatch.
* Establish and monitor operational KPIs, including order fill rate, turnaround time, inventory accuracy, and service levels.
* Drive process automation, AI-based warehouse management initiatives, and ERP/HMS system improvements.
* Warehouse & Inventory Management
* Ensure effective inventory control, stock accuracy, and adherence to FIFO/FEFO procedures.
* Oversee proper pharmaceutical storage, cold-chain management, and stock audits.
* Minimize near-expiry, expired, damaged, and non-moving inventory.
* Implement centralized purchase order and indent processing.
* Reduce inventory losses, stock variances, and wastage.
* Order Fulfilment & Logistics
* Ensure accurate and timely processing of customer and hospital unit orders.
* Oversee dispatch planning, transportation, delivery routes, and logistics vendor performance.
* Resolve delivery delays, shortages, and operational escalations.
* Develop strategies to optimize transportation and distribution costs.
* Regulatory Compliance & Quality Control
* Ensure compliance with drug licence conditions, the Drugs and Cosmetics Act, GST requirements, and applicable regulations.
* Maintain statutory documentation, licences, and operational compliance across locations.
* Coordinate internal and external audits and drug inspector visits.
* Implement operational controls to ensure product safety and regulatory compliance.
* Cost Optimization & Process Improvement
* Monitor operational expenses, including manpower, logistics, inventory losses, and wastage.
* Identify opportunities for process improvement, automation, and operational efficiency.
* Implement cost-saving initiatives and strengthen internal controls.
* Collaborate with IT teams to enhance ERP/HMS functionalities and resolve system gaps.
* Team Management & MIS Reporting
* Lead and develop warehouse, operations, and dispatch teams.
* Plan manpower deployment, shifts, training, and performance reviews.
* Prepare and present operations MIS reports covering stock accuracy, order fulfilment, turnaround time, near-expiry stock, and compliance.
* Coordinate with Sales, Purchase, Pharmacy, Finance, and IT departments for seamless operations.

**Required Skills & Competencies**

* Strong expertise in pharmaceutical distribution, warehousing, and supply chain operations.
* Experience managing multi-location pharmaceutical operations.
* Knowledge of inventory management, FIFO/FEFO, and cold-chain processes.
* Understanding of pharmaceutical regulatory compliance and drug licensing requirements.
* Experience with ERP/SAP, warehouse management systems, and operations MIS.
* Strong cost control, process improvement, and operational planning skills.
* Excellent leadership, analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.

Candidate Requirements
  
  

* Education: Graduate in Pharmacy, Science, or Commerce; MBA in Operations / Supply Chain preferred.
* Experience: 12–15 years in pharmaceutical operations or supply chain management, including at least 5 years in a managerial role.
* Experience in pharmaceutical distribution, CFA operations, or pharmacy chain management preferred.
* Proven experience managing warehouse operations, inventory control, logistics, and cross-functional teams.
* Experience handling multi-location operations and implementing operational improvements will be an advantage.

**Key Skills:**
Pharma Operations, Pharmaceutical Distribution, Supply Chain Management, Warehouse Management, Inventory Control, Logistics Management, FIFO, FEFO, Cold Chain Management, ERP, SAP, Operations MIS, Regulatory Compliance, Cost Optimization, Process Improvement, Team Management.

Your individuality enriches our collective strength, and we strive to ensure everyone feels respected, valued, and empowered.

**Position Summary**

We are seeking a Development Associate – Data Center to support the development of hyperscale, colocation, AI, and other mission-critical Data Center projects, from site feasibility and technical due diligence through concept development, infrastructure planning, and pre-construction development. The role will support site screening, technical due diligence, feasibility assessments, concept development, infrastructure planning, utility coordination, consultant reviews, and technical reporting.

This multidisciplinary engineering role sits within CIR’s Development function and combines engineering fundamentals with Data Center development, technical assessment, concept design, and multidisciplinary coordination. The candidate will work closely with CIR’s Development, Engineering, GIS, Environmental, Commercial, and Project Management teams, as well as clients, utilities, and external engineering consultants.

Candidates may come from Data Center, MEP, infrastructure, power, renewable energy, BESS, industrial, or related engineering backgrounds. Direct Data Center experience is preferred but not mandatory.

**Core Responsibilities**

**Data Center Development & Concept Design**

o Support Data Center projects from site feasibility through concept and pre-construction development.

o Translate project requirements into preliminary technical, infrastructure, and master-planning concepts.

o Support Data Center capacity planning, including IT load, facility load, PUE, utility/infrastructure capacity, backup capacity, energy storage, and renewable integration.

o Develop and review preliminary system architectures, block diagrams, layouts, and infrastructure concepts.

o Support evaluation of N, N+1, 2N, and distributed redundancy concepts.

o Support planning for hyperscale, colocation, and AI Data Center developments.

**Data Center Infrastructure**

o Support planning and coordination across the key Data Center infrastructure ecosystem, including Utilities & Power, Substations, Backup Generation, UPS & BESS, Cooling & Mechanical Systems, Water & Fuel, Fiber & Telecommunications, Fire & Security, Civil & Site Infrastructure, and Building & Facility Systems.

o Develop an understanding of how these systems interact to create a resilient, scalable, and operationally reliable Data Center.

**Site Due Diligence & Feasibility**

o Support site screening and technical due diligence for potential Data Center sites.

o Assess availability and suitability of key infrastructure, including power, water, natural gas/fuel, fiber, transportation, utilities, and site infrastructure.

o Support preliminary infrastructure capacity assessments and identify key technical constraints, development risks, and infrastructure gaps.

o Coordinate with GIS and technical teams to incorporate site information into development assessments.

o Support preparation of site feasibility and development assessments.

**Design Development & Engineering Coordination**

o Support engineering activities across LoD 100–300, with exposure to LoD 400 where applicable.

o Contribute to concept design, design criteria, system architecture, and technical concepts.

o Support capacity and infrastructure sizing, preliminary layouts, block diagrams, and system schematics.

o Prepare equipment schedules, technical specifications, design reviews, and technical documentation.

o Coordinate with specialist disciplines and external consultants to ensure individual systems are effectively integrated into the overall Data Center development.

**Technical Analysis & Option Assessment**

o Depending on background, support capacity and load assessments, infrastructure and equipment sizing, energy and PUE analysis, and reliability and redundancy assessments.

o Support system performance and energy-efficiency assessments, as well as preliminary CAPEX and technical option assessments.

**Design, Consultant & Utility Coordination**

o Coordinate with multidisciplinary engineering teams, consultants, utilities, and infrastructure providers.

o Review drawings, models, calculations, equipment schedules, and technical reports for technical completeness and consistency.

o Participate in design reviews and prepare technical comments / review matrices.

o Identify design conflicts and support resolution of technical issues.

o Coordinate requirements across civil, structural, MEP, utility, technology, and site infrastructure disciplines.

**Energy, Utility & Infrastructure Strategy**

o Support assessment of alternative Data Center infrastructure and energy strategies, including grid supply and utility infrastructure, on-site generation, BESS, renewable energy / Solar PV, and microgrids.

o Evaluate water and fuel infrastructure, fiber connectivity, energy efficiency and resilience, and carbon reduction strategies.

**Technical Due Diligence & Reporting**

o Support preparation of Data Center Technical Due Diligence Reports, Site Feasibility Studies, Concept Development Reports, Infrastructure Assessment Reports, Technical Memoranda, Development Risk Assessments, and technical presentations.

o Convert technical information into clear development insights, constraints, risks, and recommendations.

**Software Proficiency**

• Engineering analysis / simulation software (preferred)

• Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint (preferred)

• HOMER Pro, PVsyst, or other energy modelling platforms (advantage)

• ArcGIS / GIS platforms, data analysis tools, and digital engineering / automation tools (advantage)

**Engineering & Technical**

• Strong engineering fundamentals and a good understanding of infrastructure and building systems.

• Ability to interpret technical drawings, layouts, system diagrams, and engineering documentation.

• Ability to perform or interpret engineering calculations.

• Ability to understand multidisciplinary infrastructure and system interfaces, and to work with technical datasets and development information.

**Data Center / Mission-Critical Knowledge (Preferred)**

title: Manager - TMF Operations
description:
Manager, TMF Operations
  
  
ICON is a global healthcare intelligence and clinical research organisation united by a mission to bring new medicines and treatments to patients faster.
  
  
As a values-driven organisation, integrity, collaboration, agility, and inclusion are at the heart of how we work and interact with each other, customers, patients and suppliers.
  
  
As a Manager, Trial Master File (TMF) Operations at ICON, you will oversee the management, maintenance, and compliance of the Trial Master File (TMF) for clinical research studies.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
You will oversee trial master file management workstreams, ensuring deliverables meet quality and timeline expectations.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities Include**

* Managing the TMF Operations team responsible for maintaining the Trial Master File (TMF) across multiple clinical studies, ensuring compliance with GCP and regulatory requirements.
* Overseeing the collection, review, and filing of essential documents, ensuring timely and accurate updates to the TMF throughout the clinical trial lifecycle.
* Collaborating with cross-functional teams, including clinical operations, regulatory affairs, and quality assurance, to ensure TMF completeness and readiness for audits and inspections.
* Developing and implementing TMF management strategies, policies, and procedures to improve efficiency and ensure adherence to industry standards.
* Monitoring TMF quality metrics, identifying areas for improvement, and driving continuous process enhancements.
* Providing leadership and training to TMF staff, fostering a culture of quality and compliance within the team.
* Ensuring readiness of TMF for regulatory audits and client inspections, addressing any findings or gaps in documentation as needed.

**Your Profile**
You will have solid trial master file management experience, with the ability to manage competing priorities and develop your team.
  
  
**Required Qualifications And Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in life sciences, documentation management, or a related discipline
* Extensive experience in TMF management or clinical operations within the pharmaceutical or clinical research industry.
* Strong understanding of GCP, ICH guidelines, and global regulatory requirements related to TMF management and clinical trial documentation.
* Proven leadership skills, with experience managing and developing teams in a fast-paced, regulated environment.
* Excellent organizational and project management skills, with the ability to oversee multiple clinical studies and maintain high standards of documentation.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with experience collaborating with cross-functional teams and external stakeholders.
* Proficiency in electronic TMF systems and document management tools, with a focus on maintaining regulatory compliance and audit readiness.
* Willingness to travel as required (approximately 25%)

**What ICON Can Offer You**
Our success depends on the quality of our people. That’s why we’ve made it a priority to build a diverse culture that rewards high performance and nurtures talent.
  
  
In addition to your competitive salary, ICON offers a range of additional benefits. Our benefits are designed to be competitive within each country and are focused on well-being and work life balance opportunities for you and your family.
  
  
**Our Benefits Examples Include**

* Various annual leave entitlements
* A range of health insurance offerings to suit you and your family’s needs.
* Competitive retirement planning offerings to maximize savings and plan with confidence for the years ahead.
* Global Employee Assistance Programme, LifeWorks, offering 24-hour access to a global network of over 80,000 independent specialized professionals who are there to support you and your family’s well-being.
* Life assurance
* Flexible country-specific optional benefits, including childcare vouchers, bike purchase schemes, discounted gym memberships, subsidized travel passes, health assessments, among others.

Visit our careers site to read more about the benefits ICON offers.

title: Associate Senior Lead Engineer - Electrical
description:
**About Us:**
Barry-Wehmiller is a diversified global supplier of engineering consulting and manufacturing technology for the packaging, corrugating, sheeting and paper-converting industries. By blending people-centric leadership with disciplined operational strategies and purpose-driven growth, Barry-Wehmiller has become a $3 billion organization with nearly 12,000 team members united by a common belief: to use the power of business to build a better world.
  
  
**Job Description:**
**Join Us. Build a Better World Through Business.**
At Barry-Wehmiller Companies, we believe business can be a powerful force for good. Headquartered in St. Louis, Missouri, we are a global leader in manufacturing technology and services. Since our founding in 1885 as a maker of brewing machinery, we've grown through the acquisition of more than 80 companies, serving industries such as packaging, paper converting, sheeting, corrugating, engineering, and IT consulting. In 2016, we ranked No. 10 on the St. Louis Business Journal list of the city's Top 150 Privately Held Companies.
  
  
What truly sets us apart is our culture—rooted in Truly Human Leadership, a philosophy that prioritizes the well-being and growth of every individual. We measure success by the way we touch lives, not just by financial results.
  
  
In India, Barry-Wehmiller operates as a hub of innovation and collaboration through our Global Competency Center (GCC) and other strategic functions. The GCC houses centers of excellence in engineering, content management, sourcing, software development, global IT operations, and shared financial services—providing critical support to Barry-Wehmiller divisions worldwide.
  
  
**Our culture is built on:**

* Ownership – Drive features end-to-end, from design to deployment.
* Flexibility – A friendly, results-oriented environment that respects your time.
* Empowerment – Your ideas matter, and your work creates visible impact.
* Learning and Growth – Tackle complex challenges alongside passionate peers, with continuous support for your development.

**Career Development and Global Exposure**
At Barry-Wehmiller, your growth is our priority. You'll have access to world-class learning programs, leadership development opportunities, and mentorship from industry experts. Our global footprint means you'll collaborate with teams across continents, gaining exposure to diverse markets, cutting-edge technologies, and best practices from around the world. Whether you aspire to deepen your technical expertise or take on leadership roles, we provide the resources and support to help you thrive.
  
  
If you're ready to bring your best thinking to a high-impact, future-focused environment—where long-term stability meets start-up agility—and be part of a company that cares deeply about people, we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
**Job description:**
Experienced Electrical Engineer adept at Electrical Design, BOM release, Production and Testing Support for Industrial Machineries and Equipment such as Printing, Packaging, Converting, Textile and Paper machinery and discrete product machinery.
  
  

* Leads complex electrical engineering design projects from scoping through verification, including novel design challenges and cross-discipline requirements.
* Develops electrical design, drawings and Bill of Materials based on customer requirements and participates in concept design, production support, testing, safety standards, field installation, commissioning, and new product development.
* Defines project scope, prepares design specifications, and manages engineering deliverables to schedule and budget; coordinates with mechanical and controls teams to resolve integration challenges.
* Guides and develops junior and lead engineers, and represents the GCC in design reviews and technical discussions with BW division engineering teams.

**Technical skills:**

* Proficiency in calculation and selection of Motors, Servo Drives (Rockwell / Baumuller), AC Load calculations, and low and medium voltage switchgear systems in industrial control cabinets as per UL508A
* Familiarity with industrial control and protection schemes relevant to electrical distribution systems and motor controls
* Hands-on experience in preparing single and three-line diagrams, panel IGA & OGA drawings, electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, network drawings and design of wire runs
* Knowledge of electrical maintenance practices, machine operation principles, and standards for machinery control cabinets
* Expertise in major OEM motors, Servo Drive power supplies, motor controls, transformers, disconnect switches and protective relays
* Understanding of materials, components, and equipment used in electrical cabinets as per UL listed and CSA requirements
* Familiarity with NFPA70E and OSHA regulations related to electrical safety practices and procedures
* Knowledge of UL508A, IEC, NEMA, NEC, and other standards
* Experience designing and testing Safety Interlocks in compliance with safety standards
* Proficiency in AutoCAD Electrical and Zuken E3, including creating symbols, creating libraries, creating macros, 3D macros, and detailing drawings
* Experience creating Hydraulic / Pneumatic schematics using AutoCAD Electrical and Zuken E3
* Capability in creating and updating functional specifications of machines and replacing obsolete electrical parts while maintaining design integrity
* Experience performing risk assessments and preparing drawings and SRS documents
* Knowledge of using a PLM tool for creating Bills of Materials and drawing release

**Mandatory Tool Skills:**

* AutoCAD Electrical
* Zuken E3
* MS Office applications (Outlook, Teams, Excel, Word, PowerPoint, etc.)

**Education and Experience:**

* Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering
* 15+ years of experience in Industrial Machineries/Equipment and discrete product machinery
* Experience with Printing, Packaging and Converting Machines OEMs is preferable

**Travel:**

* May need to travel up to 15% each year based on requirements.

**Key Result Areas:**

* Ability to study and understand existing machine functions
* Excellent CAD tool skills, experienced in using electrical CAD software
* Good documentation preparation and maintenance skills
* Effort and schedule adherence with error-free deliverables, requiring minimal oversight to deliver results
* Good problem-solving skills with technical issues in machine function
* Plans and conducts work requiring judgment in independent evaluation, selection, and adaptation of standard techniques, procedures, and criteria
* Guiding and developing junior and lead engineers through regular feedback and technical direction
* Project execution and on-time delivery across concurrent assignments
* Providing technical support to customers and stakeholders

title: Supplier Development Engineer
description:
**Location:**
Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India, 600077
  
  
**Company:**
Chart Industries
  
  
***Ensuring Chart’s Success…***
*CHART INDUSTRIES, INC. (Chart) (NYSE: GTLS) is a leading independent global manufacturer of highly engineered equipment and services related to cryogenic gas processing and rotating equipment. In the cryogenic sector, the Chart brand is synonymous with the liquefaction, distribution, and storage of liquid gases, including oxygen, nitrogen, LNG, biogas, hydrogen, helium, and carbon dioxide. The acquisition of Howden expanded our portfolio to include air and gas handling products such as compressors, cooling fans, steam turbines, and more, expanding our offering of products and solutions across traditional markets and providing access to new ones such as nuclear, energy recovery, tunnel ventilation, mine safety, and electrification.*
*Chart products are widely used across industry, leisure, science, medicine, food and beverages, water treatment, and clean energy. The ability to combine multiple products to create complete end-to-end solutions is what makes Chart unique and has established the company as a pioneer in developing applications such as LNG to power, hydrogen, carbon capture, and cooling systems for high-energy users such as data centres, green steel, and many more.*
***What Will You Do?***
We are looking for a passionate and driven Supplier Development Engineer (SDE) to strengthen our supply chain and support Howden's product development and export projects.
  
  
This role offers a unique opportunity to work across casting, machining, fabrication, and FRP (Fiber Reinforced Plastic) manufacturing, including hands-on exposure to FRP fan blades within our manufacturing facilities.
  
  

* Develop and qualify suppliers for castings, machining, fabrication components
* Will be responsible for development and quality of FRP products in Chennai factory.
* Drive APQP, PPAP, FMEA, and process validation at supplier end & in factory
* Support new product development (NPD) and prototype readiness
* Conduct supplier audits and drive continuous improvement
* Improve supplier performance in quality, delivery, and cost
* Support export projects, customer audits, and compliance requirements

**Your Experience Should Be...**

* Experience in Supplier Quality / Supplier Development / Manufacturing (5-8 years)
* B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering
* Strong knowledge of casting, machining, fabrication, and FRP/composites
* Exposure to FRP blade manufacturing, molding, curing, and inspection preferred

title: LV Secondary System Engineer
description:
********Job Description Summary********
About GE Grid Solutions: At GE Grid Solutions we are electrifying the world with advanced grid technologies. As leaders in the energy space our goal is to accelerate the transition for a more energy efficient grid to full fill the needs of tomorrow. With a focus on growth and sustainability GE Grid Solutions plays a pivotable role in integrating Renewables onto the grid to drive to carbon neutral. In Grid Solutions we help enable the transition for a greener more reliable Grid. GE Grid Solutions has the most advanced and comprehensive product and solutions portfolio within the energy sector.
  
  
Why we come to work: At GE Renewable Energy, our engineers are always up for the challenge - and we’re always driven to find the best solution. Our projects are unique and interesting, and you’ll need to bring a solution-focused, positive approach to each one to do your best. Surrounded by committed, loyal colleagues, if you can dare to bring your ingenuity and desire to make an impact, you’ll be exposed to game-changing, diverse projects that truly allow you to play your part in the energy transition.
  
  
**What We Offer:**

* Working in an international team which is part of global Engineering HVDC Centre of Excellence
* A key role in a dynamic, international working environment with a large degree of flexibility of work agreements
* Competitive benefits, and great development opportunities

**Job Description Summary**
Systems engineering is a cross-functional engineering discipline centred on an approach, mindset, and process. All activities that consider both the business and the technical needs of the customers with the goal of providing a quality product that meets the users needs. The discipline that executes a robust process of design, creation, and optimization of systems, consisting of identification and quantification of system requirements, creation of alternate system design concepts, performance of design trade studies, selection and implementation of the best designs and verification that the design is properly integrated and executed. Process that proceeds from concept to production to operation.
  
  
Impacts departmental operations and responsible for planning/execution. The role has some autonomy but is focused on execution of activities within an operating discipline covered by standard functional practices and procedures.
  
  
Some judgment may be required but this is typically with guidance.
  
  
The role will work within defined parameters to make decisions, apply concepts to issues of moderate complexity, and resolve issues through immediate action or short-term planning.
  
  
We are looking for our future electrical technical project Lead Engineer to strengthen our engineering department. If you project yourself into our mission and our values, then here are more details on GE GRID, the missions of the position and who we wish to become
  
  
The GE Renewable - Grid Integration product line is globally recognized for the design, manufacture and supply of custom high voltage direct current (HVDC) solutions for utilities worldwide. With over 130 years of pioneering experience, GE offers two HVDC technologies, Line Commutated Converters (LCCs) and Voltage Source Converters (VSCs), to support a wide range of applications in different countries on land or at sea.
  
  
Each HVDC solution is tailored and designed based on a project-by-project assessment of customer needs, whether connecting offshore wind generation, long-distance power transmission or utility trading. energy between independent power grids.
  
  
In our department we design the control / command / protections of the AC part of HVDC substations. We are responsible for secondary and low voltage engineering, automation and protection. The department's teams are located in France, the United Kingdom and India.
  
  
Our Technical project Lead Engineer contributes to our HVDC projects. You will be part of a project team that delivers the "conventional" control and protection system for our HVDC substations and is in charge of the electrical protection systems, interlocks, wiring and oversees the power supply studies for the auxiliary services.
  
  
As a LV Secondary System Engineer, you will report to the Control System Engineering Manager and will be part of a highly motivated and dynamic team of engineers working on the requirement, design, integration, installation, and commissioning of HVDC and AC Control and Protection System.
  
  
****Job Description****
**Roles and Responsibilities**
Overseeing the overall technical solution that meets customer Requirement
  
  
**This Includes The Following Actives:**

* Requirement Capture, Gap Analysis
* Define Schematic diagrams requirements of the Control & protection system and produce detailed design documentation, drawings, test specification and test report.
* Prepare substation Single line diagrams & Protection Single line diagrams and Protection list & specification.
* On the basis of the single line Diagram of the sub station and the architecture of the control system, clarify the specifications and refine the technical solution with the customer.
* Prepare Principal diagrams (Interlockings, Protection actions, Polarities, HVDC specific functions)
* Monitor the manufacture of control and protection cabinets and supervise factory tests.
* Follow the departments standard design practices, engineering reviews and guidelines.
* Prepare Technical specification for cabling, fibre optic, cable list , Cable Schedule
* Interface with equipment supplier and reviewing in-house designs and those produced by external contractors and analyse a variety of engineering data, documents, and reports.
* Ensure that design projects are undertaken by competent personnel and sub-contractors reviewing designs created by others
* Participate in the investigation of technical problems and the establishment of procedures and corrective actions to avoid recurrences.
* Prepare Bill of Material for LV equipment using available tools.
* Prepare replies to customer comments on technical submittals in coordination with project management.
* Attend meeting with customers/contractors/ consultants for technical discussions.
* Prepare design calculations including load list, power consumption & heat dissipation data calculations.
* Define Control Panel requirements and produce detailed design documentation for the control system using standard design blocks.
* Panel Electrical Schematics (using Engineering Base tool)
* Wire/Cable Schedules
* Routine Test specification
* General Assembly drawings
* Bill of Materials
* undefined
* Oversee the testing and FAT witnessing of the Control System.
* Assist site activities relevant to the installation and commissioning of the control system.
* Share engineering information and promote open dialogue.
* Assure proper documentation of technical data generated for the assigned projects and/or tasks consistent with engineering policies and procedures.

****Required Qualifications****

* Engineering degree in electrical or electronic engineering.7 years minimum experience in an EPC project environment in the T&D, Power Gen, or Oil & Gas industries, with at least 2 projects as an engineer responsible for the business. Good experience in project management and budget management processes, quality, planning, R&O. Motivated to evolve in an international environment & recognizes himself in our key values.
* Good leadership, listening and communication skills.
* Experience in functional team management.
* Good experience in managing technical interfaces and systems integration. Solid knowledge of conventional substation control system design. Solid experience in the design of control and protection cabinets, preferably in high voltage substation or power plant environments.
* Good knowledge of the control and protection functions of high voltage AC substations. Good knowledge of ancillary services engineering in a substation environment and understanding of design/commissioning of secondary systems. Knowledge of networking and telecommunications.
* Experience with engineering tools such as AutoCAD, Engineering Base or Microsoft Visio.

****Desired Characteristics:****
Strong oral and written communication skills. Demonstrated ability to analyze and resolve problems. Ability to document, plan, market, and execute programs. Established project management skills.

**Relocation Assistance Provided:**
Yes
