title: T&T Program Manager
description:
Job Description

**Role**

**Transition and Transformation Program Manager**

  

**Practice**

Cloud Infrastructure and Security Services

  

**Location**

Pune

  

**Employment Type**

Full-time

  

**Experience**

15+ years overall, including 10+ years in transition, transformation, or large-scale program management

  

**Reporting**

Cloud Infrastructure and Security Services leadership / assigned program leadership

Job Summary

The Transition and Transformation Program Manager will lead complex, multi-tower programs across cloud, infrastructure, cybersecurity, workplace, network, data center, and managed services portfolios. The role is accountable for transition strategy, governance, execution control, stakeholder alignment, operational readiness, and a smooth handover into steady-state operations.

The role also requires proven experience in merger and acquisition driven technology transitions, including integration planning, Day-1 readiness, TSA governance, divestiture support, carve-out planning, and risk management across acquiring and acquired organizations.

Key Accountabilities

* Lead end-to-end transition and transformation programs across multiple service towers, geographies, and customer environments.
* Own transition strategy, mobilization approach, governance model, delivery framework, success criteria, KPIs, and milestone tracking.
* Participate in RFPs, solution shaping, transition estimation, planning assumptions, and customer transition discussions.
* Drive program execution across transition managers, tower leads, solution teams, delivery teams, customer stakeholders, vendors, and partner teams.
* Lead merger, acquisition, divestiture, carve-out, and separation transition planning, including integration roadmap, Day-1 readiness, TSA exit plan, risk closure, and controlled handover.

Core Delivery Areas

* **Transition Governance:** Establish steering forums, stage-gate reviews, reporting cadence, escalation paths, RAID controls, and executive decision points.
* **Cloud and Infrastructure Transition:** Oversee cloud migration, hybrid infrastructure, data center services, workplace, network, and managed services transition scope.
* **Cybersecurity Transition:** Govern security operations, identity and access, compliance, GRC, SOC readiness, vulnerability management, and security control transition.
* **M&A Technology Integration:** Manage infrastructure and security integration, Day-1 readiness, TSA obligations, service separation, vendor dependencies, licensing impacts, and business acceptance.
* **Commercial and Financial Control:** Track transition budgets, effort estimates, assumptions, dependencies, cost risks, commercial obligations, and value realization.
* **Operational Readiness and Hypercare:** Ensure KT completion, runbook readiness, service acceptance, stabilization, SLA readiness, and handover to steady-state delivery.

Qualifications and Certifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Science, or Business Management.
* MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification preferred.
* PMP, PgMP, MSP, PRINCE2, or equivalent program management certification preferred.
* ITIL certification required; ITIL Managing Professional or equivalent is preferred.
* Cloud certification in Azure, AWS, or GCP is desirable.

Experience Required

* 15+ years of IT industry experience, with at least 10+ years in transition, transformation, or complex program management roles.
* Strong experience leading global cloud, infrastructure, cybersecurity, network, workplace, data center, and managed services transitions.
* Proven background in large, multi-million-dollar programs involving multiple stakeholders, vendors, delivery teams, and executive sponsors.
* Experience in outsourcing, managed services, digital transformation, and service integration engagements.
* Hands-on exposure to M&A technology integration, divestiture, carve-out, TSA exit, or post-acquisition infrastructure and security transition programs.
* Demonstrated ability to manage geographically distributed teams and work across diverse customer and delivery environments.

Technical and Functional Skills

* Enterprise transition governance, program management, portfolio assurance, RAID management, and executive reporting.
* Cloud platforms and hybrid environments across Azure, AWS, GCP, private cloud, and multi-cloud architectures.
* Infrastructure modernization, workplace transformation, network operations, data center transition, and managed services onboarding.
* Cybersecurity transition planning covering SOC, IAM, GRC, Zero Trust, endpoint security, vulnerability management, and security operations.
* M&A transition management, TSA governance, service separation, integration planning, vendor transition, licensing impact analysis, and Day-1 readiness.
* Commercial governance, business case tracking, financial forecasting, value realization, dependency management, and contract-aligned delivery control.

Behavioral Competencies

* Executive presence with strong customer and leadership engagement.
* Clear ownership, accountability, and delivery discipline.
* Strong influencing, negotiation, conflict resolution, and decision-making skills.
* Ability to work through ambiguity, pressure, and competing priorities.
* Collaborative leadership style with the ability to align business, technology, security, commercial, and delivery stakeholders.
* Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to simplify complex program matters for senior audiences.

Preferred Skills

* Prior experience in global delivery organizations, IT services, consulting, or managed services environments.
* Experience working with customers across BFSI, manufacturing, retail, healthcare, technology, telecom, or public sector domains.
* Exposure to tools such as ServiceNow, Microsoft Project, Jira, Azure DevOps, Power BI, and Microsoft 365.
* Experience working with legal, procurement, finance, HR, security, and compliance teams during M&A-led technology transitions.

title: AI Studio - Content Operations Lead (GenStudio & Firefly)
description:
Content Operations Lead, AI Studio
  
  
**Job Description**
The Opportunity
  
  
Adobe’s AI Studio is where the world’s leading brands bring their campaigns to life through generative AI; and behind every great campaign is an equally great production engine. As Content Operations Lead, you’ll be the operational backbone of that engine, working side by side with Creative Designers to keep projects on track, customers unblocked, and nothing falling through the cracks.
  
  
This role is for someone who can walk into an unorganized customer situation, quickly make sense of what’s needed, and get the team delivering. You’re deeply comfortable with data (like wrangling CSVs, building Excel trackers, turning raw inputs into structured outputs), and you bring the kind of can-do energy that keeps teams moving even when timelines are tight.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  
**Drive Programs and Unblock the Team**

* Quickly assess what’s needed from a customer brief or request — even when information is incomplete or unorganized — and get the team moving.
* Organize complex inputs from customers into clear, structured briefs and action plans that creative partners can complete immediately.
* Proactively identify and remove blockers so Creative Designers can stay focused on the work, not the logistics.
* Coordinate handoffs between Creative Designers, copywriters, and engagement managers to keep production on schedule.
* Drive the team to on-time delivery, flagging risks early and pushing for resolution before they become problems.

**Own Data, Workflow, and Tooling**

* Work extensively in Excel and with CSV data to manage asset tracking, reporting, and production operations at scale. Strong spreadsheet fluency is essential in this role.
* Build, refine, and document production workflows and processes that increase team efficiency and reduce manual effort. Additionally, you will make sure they’re clearly defined and repeatable.
* Leverage project management platforms and AI-assisted workflows to streamline operations and keep interested parties informed.
* Find opportunities to automate repetitive production tasks and contribute to a growing library of team guidelines.

**Support Creative Quality and Output**

* Partner closely with Creative Designers to organize and prepare assets, manage file structures, and ensure outputs are formatted correctly for each channel and format.
* Bring a creative eye to production — catching inconsistencies, flagging quality issues, and helping maintain brand standards across deliverables.
* Manage variant tracking and asset organization at scale across formats, channels, and campaign phases.

**Be the Team’s Connective Tissue**

* Serve as a reliable point of contact for internal coordination, keeping interested parties informed and aligned.
* Maintain a positive, resourceful presence that helps the team navigate competing priorities and shifting deadlines.
* Contribute to a collaborative team culture where people feel supported and set up to do their best work.

What We’re Looking For
  
  

* 5+ years of experience in program management, marketing operations, creative production, or a related role. Agency, in-house, or studio environments all translate well.
* Demonstrated ability to quickly understand deliverables needed, organize ambiguous or incomplete information, and drive a team to execution.
* Strong data fluency: you’re deeply comfortable working in Excel and with CSV files, building and maintaining complex spreadsheets, and using data to drive clarity and decisions.
* Proven ability to define, document, and improve processes: you don’t just follow workflows, you build them.
* A track record of unblocking teams and ensuring timely delivery in fast paced, time-sensitive environments.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously with strong attention to detail and follow-through.
* A creative eye and genuine appreciation for design quality, even if you’re not the one pushing pixels.
* Familiarity with generative AI tools and an openness to integrating them into daily work.
* Strong communication skills: you keep people informed without over-communicating, and you know when to flag something versus just handle it.
* A can-do attitude and the kind of steady, positive energy that makes teams want to work with you.
* Experience in digital marketing, advertising production, or campaign operations is a plus.
* Comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment where priorities can shift and timelines are rarely forgiving.

**About Adobe**
Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.
  
  
Our 30,000+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours.
  
  
**Let’s Adobe together**
At Adobe, we believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. Learn more about Adobe life, including our values and culture, focus on people, purpose and community, Adobe for All, comprehensive benefits programs, the stories we tell, the customers we serve, and how you can help us advance our mission of empowering everyone to create.
  
  
Adobe is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Learn more.
  
  
Adobe aims to make our Careers website and recruiting process accessible to any and all users. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation to navigate our website or complete the application process, email accommodations@adobe.com.
  
  
**AI Use Guidelines for Interviews:**
Our interviews are designed to reflect your own skills and thinking. If these tools are used inappropriately or in a way that misrepresents your work, your application may not move forward in the process.
  
  
At Adobe, we empower employees to innovate with AI — and we look for candidates eager to do the same. title: QA Software Engineering
description:
**Job Description**
As a Software Quality Engineer, you will be responsible for ensuring the quality and reliability of our software products through comprehensive test planning, test execution, and defect management. You will work closely with developers and product teams to identify and address potential issues early in the software development lifecycle. You will be expected to write automated tests using Python and the Robot Framework, contribute to test processes, and manage end-to-end testing to ensure our software products deliver the best user experience.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Test Planning & Strategy:

+ Develop comprehensive test plans and test strategies for software applications based on requirements and specifications.
+ Define test cases, test data, and create a clear roadmap for testing activities.

* Automated Testing:

+ Write, maintain, and execute automated test scripts using Python and Robot Framework.
+ Design and develop reusable and scalable automated tests for both functional and non-functional requirements (e.g., performance, security).
+ Integrate automated tests with Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines.

* End-to-End Testing:

+ Lead and perform end-to-end testing for the entire software product, ensuring that all parts of the system work together as expected.
+ Conduct regression testing, smoke testing, and functional testing across multiple environments.
+ Identify, reproduce, and document defects and work with development teams to ensure timely resolution.

* Test Execution & Reporting:

+ Execute both manual and automated test cases across various platforms (web, desktop, etc.).
+ Track, report, and prioritize defects and issues found during testing, ensuring proper communication with relevant teams.
+ Ensure thorough test coverage by validating the full functionality of the product, including edge cases.

* Continuous Improvement:

+ Collaborate with development teams to improve the testing process, quality practices, and automation strategies.
+ Participate in daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and retrospectives to continuously improve testing workflows.

* Collaboration & Communication:

+ Work closely with developers, product managers, and other stakeholders to clarify requirements, review user stories, and ensure proper test coverage.
+ Provide detailed feedback and suggestions to the development team to enhance the quality of the product.

**Requirements**

* Educational Qualifications:

+ Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent practical experience).

* Relevant Experience:

+ 3-7 years of experience as a Software Quality Engineer or equivalent.

* Technical Skills:

+ Proficient in Python programming for test automation and scripting.
+ Strong hands-on experience with Robot Framework for automated testing.
+ Solid understanding of Test Process and Test Lifecycle (requirement analysis, test planning, test execution, defect management, etc.).
+ Experience with end-to-end testing of software applications, ensuring full coverage of all functionality.
+ Familiarity with CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI) and integrating tests into automated pipelines.
+ Knowledge of version control systems like Git and experience with branching and merging strategies.

* Testing Experience:

+ Strong background in manual testing (functional, regression, smoke, and system testing).
+ Experience in automated testing, with a deep understanding of test frameworks and tools.
+ Familiar with test case design, test execution, and defect tracking tools (e.g., JIRA, TestRail).
+ Exposure to performance testing tools (e.g., JMeter, LoadRunner) is a plus.

* Soft Skills:

+ Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
+ Strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail.
+ Ability to work independently and in a team-oriented, fast-paced environment.

* Nice to Have:

+ Familiarity with cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP).
+ Experience with medical device/biomedical device is a plus.

title: Manager, ML Engineering
description:
**Who are we?**
Smarsh empowers its customers to manage risk and unleash intelligence in their digital communications. Our growing community of over 6500 organizations in regulated industries counts on Smarsh every day to help them spot compliance, legal or reputational risks in 80+ communication channels before those risks become regulatory fines or headlines. Relentless innovation has fueled our journey to consistent leadership recognition from analysts like Gartner and Forrester, and our sustained, aggressive growth has landed Smarsh in the annual Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing American companies since 2008.
  
  
We are looking for an experienced Engineering Manager to lead and grow the Cortex team. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will manage a talented team of ML and delivery engineers, drive technical delivery of AI service initiatives, and help define the direction of Smarsh's AI platform capability.
  
  
You will report directly to a Senior ML Engineering Manager based in the UK and will be the primary engineering leader for the Cortex team on the ground in Bangalore. You will work closely with Smarsh's Applied Machine Learning team — who build and train our in-house models — as well as Product Management, Technical Program Management (TPM), the Fabric platform organisation, and sister Cognition teams: Cognition Logic and Cognition Analytics, all part of the wider Enterprise Conduct organisation.
  
  
This is a hybrid role based in our Bangalore office, with the expectation of 3 days per week on-site.
  
  
This role is AI-first. You will be expected to champion and actively use AI-powered engineering productivity tools — including Windsurf and Claude Code — and embed these practices into the team's day-to-day ways of working
  
  
**What You Will Do**
**Team Leadership & People Management**

* Lead, mentor and grow a team of 4 ML Engineers and 1 Delivery Engineer across India and the UK.
* Run effective 1:1s, performance conversations, and career development planning.
* Foster a high-trust, high-performance team culture grounded in continuous improvement.
* Manage hiring, onboarding, and team capacity planning as Cortex expands.

**Technical Delivery & Model Operations**

* Own end-to-end delivery of Cortex initiatives — from planning and scoping to production release and post-go-live operational support.
* Drive delivery of new capabilities including Audio Analytics as a Service, In App Translation and Intelligent Agent Review.
* Work closely with the Applied ML team to take in-house models from research handoff through to production-grade deployment — managing integration, validation, and operational readiness.
* Own and evolve Cortex's gated model deployment pipeline: ensuring models progress through automated quality gates, shadow mode, canary, and full rollout stages with clear promotion and rollback criteria.
* Establish model evaluation and monitoring frameworks — tracking quality, performance drift, and SLO compliance in production.
* Maintain and improve Cortex's operational SLOs, reliability posture, and incident response process.
* Ensure engineering practices, code quality, and architectural decisions meet Smarsh engineering standards.

**AI-First Ways of Working**

* Actively use and champion AI productivity tooling: Windsurf, Claude Code, and similar tools.
* Set the standard for how the team leverages AI-assisted development to increase velocity and code quality.
* Identify and help to introduce new AI tooling where it adds measurable value to the team.

**Technical Strategy, Stakeholder Management & Developer Experience**

* Contribute to the Cortex technical roadmap, working with engineering leadership, Product Management, and TPM to align delivery to business priorities.
* Build strong working relationships with the Applied Machine Learning team — acting as a bridge between model development and production AI service deployment.
* Partner closely with sister Cognition teams — Cognition Logic and Cognition Analytics — to align on shared platform patterns, APIs, and service contracts within the Enterprise Conduct organisation.
* Engage proactively with the Fabric organisation on infrastructure, platform standards, and shared tooling dependencies.
* Represent Cortex in cross-team forums, architecture reviews, and planning sessions — advocating for Cortex consumers' developer experience.
* Help to drive the AI Service Catalogue vision: discoverable, well-documented, and operationally excellent services that product engineers across Smarsh can consume with confidence.

**What You Bring**

* 2+ years of engineering management experience, ideally in an AI/ML, platform, or MLOps context.
* Solid track record of delivering production ML or AI services at scale.
* Experience working at the interface between applied research or ML teams and production engineering — you understand how to take a model from handoff to a reliable, monitored service.
* Experience managing distributed teams across geographies and time zones.
* Demonstrated ability to build trusted relationships with Product, TPM, and platform stakeholders — translating business priorities into engineering plans and vice versa.
* Experience with COGs analysis and FinOps practices for AI/ML workloads — you understand how to track, attribute, and optimise infrastructure and inference costs, and can make informed build vs. buy decisions on managed services.
* Solid release management and planning experience — you can own a release calendar, coordinate cross-team dependencies, manage risk gates, and ensure smooth, well-communicated production deployments.
* Hands-on engineering background — you can credibly engage with technical design decisions and code reviews.

**Technical Skills**

* Proficiency in Python; familiarity with Kotlin or JVM-based frameworks is a plus.
* Experience with cloud-native AI/ML infrastructure: AWS (Bedrock, SageMaker, EKS), Kubernetes, and Kafka.
* Solid understanding of audio and NLP model architectures — specifically Parakeet (ASR), NeMo framework, and XLM-R based multilingual models.
* Solid MLOps foundations with practical production experience across the full model lifecycle — including experiment tracking, model registry management, gated deployment strategies (shadow mode, canary, blue/green with automated quality gates), drift detection, rollback handling, and SLO-linked promotion criteria.
* Understanding of ML model serving patterns, including inference optimisation and managed inference platforms (e.g. Triton Inference Server).
* Solid understanding of modern AI/ML architectures and system design patterns — including transformer-based models, agentic workflows, RAG, and multi-agent orchestration — with the ability to engage credibly in technical design discussions and evaluate trade-offs.
* Comfort with operational excellence practices: SLOs, observability, incident management, and on-call culture.

**AI Productivity & Tooling**

* Active user of AI-powered coding assistants (Windsurf, Claude Code, or similar).
* Genuine conviction that AI tooling meaningfully accelerates engineering teams — and a desire to prove it.
* Ability to coach engineers on effective use of AI tools and to separate hype from practical value.

**Leadership & Communication**

* Clear, direct communicator — able to translate complex technical topics for non-technical stakeholders.
* Data-driven approach to engineering decisions and team health.
* Comfortable with ambiguity and capable of bringing structure to new problem spaces.
* Collaborative leader who builds trust quickly across cultures and time zones.

**About Our Culture**
Smarsh hires lifelong learners with a passion for innovating with purpose, humility and humor. Collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. We work closely with the most popular communications platforms and the world’s leading cloud infrastructure platforms. We use the latest in AI/ML technology to help our customers break new ground at scale. We are a global organization that values diversity, and we believe that providing opportunities for everyone to be their authentic self is key to our success. Smarsh leadership, culture, and commitment to developing our people have all garnered Comparably.com Best Places to Work Awards. Come join us and find out what the best work of your career looks like.

Join our innovative team and make a meaningful impact on global scientific discovery. As a Software Engineer II, you'll develop sophisticated software solutions for scientific instruments and platforms. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams to design, implement and maintain software that enables breakthrough research in fields like cancer treatment, environmental protection, and advanced materials. We are looking for a highly experienced Lead Java Engineer with 4–6 years of software development experience and strong expertise in designing and developing scalable, secure, and high-performance backend systems.
  
  
The ideal candidate should have deep hands-on experience with Java, Spring Boot, REST API development, database design, and backend integration. * Strong experience with Spring Boot and the broader Spring ecosystem.
* Strong experience in designing and developing RESTful APIs and backend services.
* Good understanding of API design principles, HTTP standards, authentication, authorization, and error handling.
* Strong experience in database design, data modeling, normalization, and performance optimization.
* Experience with relational databases such as Oracle, PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, or equivalent technologies.

* Experience with ORM and persistence frameworks such as Spring Data JPA, Hibernate, or equivalent technologies.
* Strong understanding of backend integration patterns and enterprise application integration.
* Experience integrating applications with internal and external services through REST APIs, messaging, or other integration mechanisms.
* Good understanding of concurrency, multithreading, asynchronous processing, and transaction management.
* Experience developing modular, reusable, and maintainable backend components.
* Strong understanding of application security and secure API development.
* Familiarity with unit testing, integration testing, and automated testing frameworks.
* Experience with source control systems such as Git.
* Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and modern software development practices.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience working on large-scale enterprise applications and distributed systems.
* Experience with microservices-based applications.
* Knowledge of messaging technologies such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, JMS, or equivalent solutions.
* Experience with caching technologies such as Redis or similar platforms.
* Experience with API documentation tools such as OpenAPI/Swagger.
* Knowledge of containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
* Understanding of logging, monitoring, tracing, and observability practices.
* Experience with automated testing frameworks such as JUnit, Mockito, or equivalent technologies.
* Exposure to event-driven systems and asynchronous integration patterns.
* Experience with Agile/Scrum software development environments.

Behavioral Competencies
  
  

* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to translate business and system requirements into robust backend solutions.
* Strong ownership and accountability for technical deliverables.
* Ability to lead technical discussions and influence solution decisions.
* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within cross-functional teams.
* Strong mentoring and coaching capabilities.
* Ability to troubleshoot complex backend, database, and integration issues.
* Strong focus on software quality, reliability, and engineering excellence.

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.

title: Scrum Master
description:
Job Description

**Your role**
-------------

The Scrum Master acts as a Servant Leader who facilitates and supports Product teams throughout the IT delivery lifecycle. The role ensures that Agile practices are followed effectively, helps remove impediments, and enables the team to deliver high-quality solutions that create value for the business.

**Your day-to-day**
-------------------

* Facilitate Agile/Scrum ceremonies including:
  + Daily Stand-ups
  + Sprint Planning
  + Sprint Reviews
  + Sprint Retrospectives
  + Backlog refinement sessions
* Support the Product team in adopting and following Agile principles, practices, and ways of working.
* Work closely with Product Owners to support effective backlog management and sprint planning.
* Identify, track, and help remove impediments that impact team delivery.
* Encourage team collaboration, accountability, and self-organization.
* Monitor sprint progress and support the team in achieving sprint goals.
* Help the team continuously improve through retrospectives, feedback, and Agile metrics.
* Facilitate effective communication between Product Owners, development teams, and relevant stakeholders.
* Support the resolution of team conflicts and delivery challenges.
* Ensure Agile tools such as Jira and Confluence are effectively used for planning, tracking, and documentation.
* Support dependency and risk management across the delivery lifecycle.
* Promote transparency and visibility of progress, risks, impediments, and dependencies.
* Help create a positive and collaborative working environment focused on continuous improvement.

**Your skills and experience**
------------------------------

* 3+ years of experience as a Scrum Master in Agile software/product delivery environments.

description: Location Name: Pune Corporate Office - MantriJob PurposeAt Bajaj Finance, we help millions of people across India manage their money. People come to us when they want to buy a new phone on EMI, when they need a personal loan for a wedding, when they want to buy insurance, or when they want to grow their savings in a Fixed Deposit. Because we have so many customers, we get thousands of questions every single day. Customers want to know their account balance. They want to change the date their EMI gets deducted. They want to know the fees for closing a loan early.In the past, to get these answers, a customer had to wait on hold to talk to a call center agent, or they had to tap through ten different screens on our mobile app. We want to change that. We want to make it as easy as sending a text message to a friend.We are building a massive, highly intelligent AI (Artificial Intelligence) platform. Think of it like a super-smart chat assistant built right into the Bajaj Finance app. We want our customers to be able to just type out their problems in plain English, Hindi, or other languages, and have the AI fix the problem instantly. If a customer types, "Hey, I need to pause my loan payment this month," the AI should understand them, check their account, and do the work in seconds.Building this is incredibly hard. It is not just a simple robot that gives canned answers. It is a smart system that has to understand human language, connect to our deep banking systems, and follow strict financial rules.Duties And Responsibilities Conversation FlowsA normal conversation flows naturally. But computers need a map. They need to be told exactly how a conversation should go, step by step. You will create these maps, which we call Conversation Flows.You will literally use a software tool to draw boxes and arrows on your screen. Box 1: The AI says, "Hello, how can I help?" -> Arrow points to Box 2. Box 2: The customer says, "I want to see my statement." -> Arrow points to Box 3. Box 3: The system checks if the customer's phone number is verified.o If Yes -> Arrow points to Box 4.o If No -> Arrow points to Box 5. Box 4: Show the statement on the screen. Box 5: Ask the customer to type in a one-time password (OTP).You have to map out every single path the conversation could possibly take. You have to think of all the "what ifs." What if the customer types the wrong password? What if the customer stops replying and walks away from their phone? What if the internet crashes? You must draw a box and an arrow for every single situation. These flowcharts become the actual instruction manual for the engineers. They look at your map and write the code to make it happen exactly as you drew it.|Your Daily Work: The 9 Core AreasAboutYour job will be very hands-on. You will not just be sitting in long meetings talking about big ideas. You will be doing the real, detailed work to make this AI smart. Here are the nine specific areas you will be working on every day: FPR (Future Press Release)Before a single line of computer code is written, you have to know what your end goal is. We do this by writing a Future Press Release, or FPR.A press release is a news article that a company puts out when they launch a cool new product. But here, you will write this news article before we even start building. You will write it as if the product is already finished and launched to the public. You will write a catchy headline like: "Bajaj Finance Launches AI That Solves Loan Issues in 10 Seconds." You will write quotes from pretend customers talking about how much they love the feature. You will explain exactly what problem the feature solves in simple, everyday language.Why do we do this? Because it keeps everyone focused. If the news article sounds boring or confusing, it means your idea is probably boring or confusing. Once you write a great FPR, you show it to the engineers and your bosses. When everyone reads it and says, "Wow, this sounds amazing, let's build it!"—that document becomes your team's guide. FAQ (Frequently Asked Questions)Along with your news article, you will write a massive list of Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ). But these are not just the normal questions a customer might ask. These are questions that anyone involved might ask.You have to put yourself in the shoes of a confused customer. What will they ask? "Is my bank data safe with this AI robot?" You write the answer. You have to think like our call center agents. "Will this AI do my job wrong and make the customer angry?" You write the answer. You have to think like our company lawyers. "Does this AI follow the Reserve Bank of India rules?" You write the answer.The goal of this FAQ is to force you to find all the problems and risks before the engineers start building. If you cannot answer a tough question in your FAQ document, it means your plan has a hole in it, and you need to fix your plan. PPG (Product Program Guidelines)Because Bajaj Finance deals with people's money, we have a lot of strict rules. We cannot just give a loan to anyone. We have to charge exact fees. We have to use exact interest rates. All of these strict rules are written down in company rulebooks called Product Program Guidelines, or PPG.Every single product has a PPG. The personal loan has a PPG. The fixed deposit has a PPG. When we build the AI, the AI must follow the rules in the PPG perfectly. It cannot make a mistake. If the PPG says the late fee is 500 rupees, the AI cannot accidentally tell the customer the late fee is 400 rupees. That would cause a massive legal problem.|As a Product Manager, you will read these PPG rulebooks. You will pull out all the rules related to your project. You will work with the engineers to make sure these rules are permanently locked into the AI's brain. If the company changes a rule in the PPG next year, you are the person who makes sure the AI gets updated immediately. Synthetic TestingOnce the engineers build a version of the AI, we have to test it. But we cannot let a broken, untested AI talk to real Bajaj Finance customers. That is too risky. If the AI is confused, a real customer might get bad advice about their loan.So, we use something called Synthetic Testing. "Synthetic" just means fake or made-up. You will help create thousands of fake conversations to test the AI safely. You will create fake customer profiles. For example, you make a fake customer named Rahul who has a home loan. You will type to the AI pretending to be Rahul. You will ask, "Can I pay off my whole loan today?" and see what the AI says.Does the AI say yes? Does it calculate the early payment fee correctly? What if you pretend to be a customer who types with terrible spelling? What if you type in a mix of Hindi and English? What if you pretend to be very angry? Does the AI still understand and stay polite? You will run hundreds of these fake tests. When the AI fails, you write down why it failed, take that information back to the engineers, and tell them what to fix. You keep doing this until the AI passes every fake test perfectly. LLM Parameters (What We Send to the AI Brain)The core brain of our AI is called a Large Language Model (LLM). Think of the LLM like an incredibly smart person sitting in a dark room. This person knows how to speak perfectly, but they have no idea who they are talking to.If a customer types, "What is my balance?", the smart person in the dark room has no idea whose balance to check. So, we have to send the LLM a package of extra information along with the customer's question. We call this setting the LLM Parameters.As the Product Manager, you will decide exactly what information goes into that package. When the customer asks about their balance, you will tell our computer systems: "Before you let the AI answer, grab the customer's name, grab their last three payments, and grab their current loan amount. Send all of that to the AI."You also have to send strict instructions. You will tell the AI, "You are a helpful assistant for Bajaj Finance. Always be polite. Do not guess numbers. Only use the numbers I just sent you." If you send the AI too much information, it gets confused and it costs the company too much money to process. If you send too little information, the AI gives a stupid answer. Your job is to find the perfect balance of what data to send the AI every time a customer speaks. VisualisationsChatting with an AI should not just be reading massive blocks of text. Nobody wants to read a giant paragraph of words on their small phone screen.|Sometimes, the best way to answer a customer is by showing them a picture, a chart, or a button. We call these Visualisations.Let's say a customer asks, "How much of my loan have I paid off?" The AI could write a long, boring sentence with a bunch of numbers. But it is much better if the AI shows a nice, clean pie chart on the screen. Half the pie is green for the money paid, and half is grey for the money left. The customer understands it instantly.Or, if the AI needs the customer to pick a date, it shouldn't make the customer type "October 15th." It should pop up a small calendar on the screen so the customer can just tap the day. You will decide when to use text and when to use these visual tools. You will work with our designers to sketch out how these charts and buttons should look so the chat is beautiful and easy to use. Product SwitchingImagine you are talking to a human salesman at a store. You ask about buying a TV. Then, suddenly, you change your mind and ask about buying a fridge. The human easily switches the topic to the fridge.Computers are not naturally good at this. If the computer is programmed to talk to you about a TV, and you ask about a fridge, the computer will get totally confused. It might say, "Error, I do not understand."At Bajaj Finance, we have dozens of products. A customer might start a chat asking about their EMI shopping card. But halfway through the chat, they might say, "By the way, I also want to open a Fixed Deposit." The AI needs to smoothly switch from talking about the shopping card to talking about the Fixed Deposit without breaking or crashing.We call this Product Switching. You will write the rules for how the AI handles these sudden changes in conversation. You will plan out how the AI remembers what the customer was talking about first, just in case the customer wants to go back to the original topic later.Required Qualifications And ExperienceThe Background You Need (Education & Experience)RequirementsBecause this job requires you to build highly complex computer systems, we are very strict about the background you need to have. We are looking for people who meet these exact requirements: Your Education (The Degree and the College)You must have a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a closely related technical computer field.You must have graduated from a Tier 1 Engineering College. This means premier institutes like the IITs (Indian Institutes of Technology), NITs (National Institutes of Technology), or top-level Regional Engineering Colleges.It is because the AI technology we are building is extremely complicated. You will be working side-by-side with some of the smartest software engineers in the country. You need to know how software is actually built. You need to understand coding logic, databases, and how computer servers talk to each other. Top engineering colleges train you to handle these tough, highly technical problems. If you do not have this strong computer science foundation, you will not be able to keep up with the engineering teams.If you also have a Master's degree, that is great! We love to see it. But if you do not have a Master's degree, that is perfectly fine. It is not required. The Bachelor's degree from a Tier 1 college is what matters the most. Your Work Experience (2 to 3 Years in NLP/AI)You cannot be fresh out of college for this job. You must have at least 2 to 3 years of actual, hands-on work experience.More importantly, this experience must be in a very specific area. You must have worked on NLP platforms. It is the specific technology that teaches computers how to read, understand, and write human language.You must have spent the last few years of your career actually building chatbots, voice assistants, or smart AI text tools. You cannot just be someone who managed a normal website or a standard mobile app.

title: Senior Associate Engineer – System Integration Electrified Powertrain
description:
**Career Area**
Engineering
  
  
**Job Description**
**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**
When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.
  
  
**About This Role**
Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.
  
  
When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do, but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation. We make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.
  
  
Caterpillar’s Integrated Drivetrain & Energy Solutions (IDES) organization is focused on developing and delivering advanced drivetrain and electrification technologies and solutions to support Caterpillar products across industries. The organization brings together system integration, electrified powertrain, motors, power electronics, controls, energy storage, and related technologies to deliver safe, reliable, efficient, and integrated solutions for our customers.
  
  
We are looking for a Senior Associate Engineer – System Integration to join our electrified powertrain engineering team at the Bengaluru PSN facility.
  
  
In this role, you will support the integration, development, validation, and troubleshooting of electrified drivetrain systems. You will work across motors, power electronics, energy storage, controls, mechanical systems, and vehicle interfaces to ensure individual components operate effectively as an integrated system.
  
  
You will collaborate with global and cross-functional engineering teams to translate product requirements into system-level designs, develop and execute validation plans, analyze system performance, support prototype builds and testing, and resolve integration issues. The role provides an opportunity to work directly on Caterpillar's current and future electrified powertrain products.
  
  
**Roles And Responsibilities**

* Support the development and integration of electrified powertrain systems, including electric drive, power electronics, energy storage, controls, drivetrain, and related vehicle interfaces.
* Translate product and vehicle requirements into system and subsystem requirements and support interface definition between components.
* Support development activities throughout the product development cycle, including concept development, prototype builds, validation, and product introduction.
* Develop and execute Design Verification Plans and Reports (DVP&R) for system and subsystem validation.
* Participate in DFMEA and system-level risk assessment activities to identify potential failure modes and develop appropriate mitigation and validation actions.
* Support on-vehicle and off-vehicle testing for functionality, performance, efficiency, durability, and reliability.
* Analyze test and system data to identify performance gaps and support root-cause analysis and issue resolution.
* Support integration of electric drive, controls, software, power electronics, and vehicle systems, including changes and upgrades that could affect overall system performance or vehicle safety.
* Support prototype and validation platform development, instrumentation, test setup, and execution.
* Perform engineering analysis and simulation to support system architecture, component selection, design decisions, and validation.
* Collaborate with electrical, mechanical, controls, software, simulation, validation, and product engineering teams across global locations.
* Work with suppliers and engineering partners to support component integration, technical issue resolution, quality, and delivery.
* Identify opportunities to improve system performance, efficiency, reliability, cost, and robustness.
* Document engineering decisions, test results, technical issues, root-cause findings, and recommended solutions.
* Stay current with electrification technologies, system engineering methods, tools, and industry developments.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related engineering discipline.
* Engineering experience in one or more areas such as electric vehicles, electrified powertrain, drivetrain, power electronics, controls, system integration, or validation.
* Fundamental understanding of electrified powertrain systems and interaction between components such as electric motors, inverters, DC/DC converters, batteries, controls, and mechanical drivetrain systems.
* Experience with engineering development, testing, validation, troubleshooting, or root-cause analysis.
* Ability to interpret engineering requirements, test results, schematics, technical drawings, specifications, and system data.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to make data-based engineering decisions.
* Good written and verbal communication skills and ability to work effectively within global cross-functional engineering teams.
* Ability to independently learn new technologies, engineering tools, and system concepts.

**Desired Qualifications**

* Master’s degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Mechatronics, Automotive, or related engineering discipline.
* Experience with electric or hybrid vehicle system integration and validation.
* Experience with DFMEA, DVP&R, requirements management, and structured root-cause analysis.
* Hands-on experience with electrified powertrain components such as motors, inverters, batteries, DC/DC converters, or electric drive systems.
* Knowledge of high-voltage electrical systems and electrical safety principles.
* Experience with automotive communication networks and diagnostic tools, particularly CAN-based systems.
* Experience with engineering modeling and simulation tools such as MATLAB/Simulink or equivalent tools.
* Exposure to data acquisition, instrumentation, vehicle testing, or Hardware-in-the-Loop/System-in-the-Loop validation.
* Understanding of system engineering principles, interfaces, requirements traceability, and change management.
* Previous experience working with an OEM, Tier-1 supplier, electrification, off-highway, automotive, or industrial powertrain organization.
* Interest in exploring emerging electrification technologies and applying new engineering methods to product development.

**Posting Dates**
November 9, 2026 - November 23, 2026
  
  
Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply
  
  
Not ready to apply? Join our Talent Community.

title: Travel Technology Operations Specialist
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Travel Technology**
**Operations Specialist**
The opportunity
  
  
The Travel Technology Operations Specialist supports technology and AI initiatives across the Travel, Meetings & Events (TME) portfolio. Acting as the operational representative and communication bridge between Enterprise Technology (ET), business subject matter experts (SMEs) and delivery teams, the role ensures operational realities, business impacts and market-specific considerations are understood throughout the solution lifecycle.
  
  
Working across ET, project teams, local Travel Managers and operational stakeholders, the role translates operational expertise into clear, actionable input for technology teams and communicates solution direction, impacts and decisions back to SMEs. This two-way coordination helps ensure travel technology and AI solutions are practical, well-informed, supportable and fit for purpose once live.
  
  
Key responsibilities
  
  
Operational representation
  
  

* Provide operational insight and business context throughout Travel Technology and AI solution delivery.
* Help delivery teams understand travel processes, market variations, user impacts and support considerations.
* Coordinate the collection, organisation and validation of operational content from SMEs to support knowledge bases used by AI-enabled travel solutions.
* Identify operational risks, dependencies and practical constraints, and raise them with the project team.

Stakeholder and SME coordination
  
  

* Act as the primary communication bridge between ET, delivery teams and business and operational SMEs.
* Identify and engage the appropriate SMEs, coordinating their participation in workshops, walkthroughs and validation activities.
* Translate operational knowledge into clear, structured input for technology teams and communicate technical direction, decisions and impacts back to SMEs in accessible business language.
* Engage traveler user groups early to validate strategy and proposed deliverables, gathering feedback to inform decision-making, prioritization and delivery planning.
* Maintain clear information flows, decisions and follow-ups so ET and project teams can access the operational expertise needed to inform their work.

Operational review and validation
  
  

* Review proposed solutions from an operational perspective, including process impacts, market considerations and support implications.
* Provide clear operational feedback and recommendations without owning requirements, functional design or technical decisions.
* Confirm that key operational assumptions are practical and scalable.

Deployment and stabilisation support
  
  

* Support deployment readiness by confirming that operational impacts have been identified and relevant stakeholders engaged.
* Provide local Travel Managers with the operational input needed to support market communications and engagement.
* Gather post-go-live feedback, provide business context for issue assessment and identify improvement opportunities.

Scope
  
  
**In scope:**
Travel-specific TME tools and automations, non-Concur travel integrations, AI-enabled travel solutions owned by TME Innovation, coordination of operational content for AI knowledge bases, and related travel ecosystem technology.
  
  
**Out of scope:**
Concur ownership or support; business analysis; requirements or functional documentation; process or solution design ownership; technical architecture; project budgets, timelines or governance; formal ownership of communications, training or change management; and technical ownership of AI platforms or knowledge-base architecture.

title: AI QA/QC Engineer Intern
description:
**Role Overview**

We are looking for a curious and detail-oriented intern to help test AI-powered

products for accuracy, safety, and reliable behavior.

Can you make AI invent an answer, ignore an instruction, or contradict itself? Help us find these failures, document them clearly, and verify fixes with engineers.

This role combines manual testing with basic scripting. It suits someone curious, detail-oriented, patient with repeated attempts, and willing to raise problems and suggest improvements.

𝗪𝗛𝗔𝗧 𝗬𝗢𝗨'𝗟𝗟 𝗗𝗢

• Take initiative in choosing what to test and exploring new failure cases.

• Turn requirements into test cases and ask questions when expected behavior is unclear.

• Test everyday conversations, unusual inputs, spelling variations, unclear requests, and longer conversations.

• Explore jailbreak prompts that attempt to make AI ignore its instructions.

• Check for invented facts, inconsistent answers, inappropriate responses, and unnecessary refusals.

• Repeat tests to understand how often failures occur and what triggers them.

• Write clear bug reports with inputs, conversation history, reproduction steps, and expected versus actual results.

• Use basic Python or JavaScript to send API requests, repeat tests, and compare responses.

• Prioritize issues, discuss improvements with engineers, and retest fixes.

𝗪𝗛𝗔𝗧 𝗪𝗘'𝗥𝗘 𝗟𝗢𝗢𝗞𝗜𝗡𝗚 𝗙𝗢𝗥

• Curiosity about AI and how it fails.

• Patience for trial and error.

• Attention to detail and organized documentation.

• Clear communication and willingness to explain your thinking.

• Basic Python or JavaScript​: enough to read and modify simple scripts.

• Basic understanding of APIs and JSON responses.

• Ability to check confident-sounding answers against supplied facts and instructions.

• Willingness to learn from feedback.

𝗡𝗜𝗖𝗘 𝗧𝗢 𝗛𝗔𝗩𝗘

Familiarity with Git, Postman, or curl exposure to testing or bug reporting; personal AI experiments or coding projects; or experience testing conversations in multiple languages.

Professional experience is not required. Experienced applicants are welcome if the internship's responsibilities and terms suit them.

Some testing may involve sensitive or harmful content, within company-authorized environments.

𝗛𝗢𝗪 𝗧𝗢 𝗔𝗣𝗣𝗟𝗬

Complete our seven-question application questionnaire.

Allow approximately 15–30 minutes; this is not a speed test. Advanced ML knowledge is not required. Partial answers with clear reasoning are welcome.

Use of AI is not appreciated. Submit your own thinking, wording, and code. Do not use AI to generate, rewrite, or polish answers. We may ask you to explain your work later.

title: Applications Engineer - UCD
description:
**Job Description**
**Job Description:**
We are seeking an experienced and customer-focused Applications Engineer to support the design-in and adoption of our UCD family of digital power controllers. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in digital power control topologies, embedded firmware, and system-level debug, with the ability to translate customer requirements into working solutions. This role requires close collaboration with design, marketing, and field sales teams to enable customers building mission critical data centres, AI servers, and a wide array of Industrial applications.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Customer design support: Provide technical guidance to customers on the design, configuration, and firmware development of systems using TI ASM UCD devices such as the UCD3138/UCD4138, across applications like Power Factor Correction (PFC), DC/DC converters, and other digital power topologies.
* Reference design development: Design, build, and validate reference designs, evaluation modules (EVMs), and demo boards that showcase UCD capabilities and accelerate customer adoption.
* Firmware and GUI tools: Develop and customize firmware, configuration tools, and GUIs (e.g., Fusion Digital Power) to simplify customer evaluation, tuning, and deployment of UCD-based designs.
* System bring-up and debug: Support customers with board bring-up, system integration, and troubleshooting of hardware, firmware, and communication interfaces (e.g., PMBus, I2C, SPI).
* Lab characterization: Use lab equipment such as oscilloscopes, power analyzers, and logic analyzers to characterize system performance, validate control loop stability, and resolve customer-reported issues.
* Pre- and post-sales support: Respond to customer technical queries via E2E forums, service requests, and direct engagement, including both pre-sales design consultation and post-sales production support.
* Cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with design, test, marketing, and field sales teams to relay customer feedback, influence roadmap decisions, and support new product introductions (NPI).
* Documentation and collateral: Create and maintain technical reference manuals, datasheets, application notes, user guides, FAQs, and training materials to support customer self-sufficiency and broaden product adoption.
* Continuous Improvement: Participate in design reviews and contribute to improving applications engineering tools, processes, and support methodologies.

**Qualifications**
**Required Skills and Qualifications:**

* 3+ years of industry experience in applications engineering, systems engineering, or embedded firmware development.
* Bachelor's or master's degree in Electronics/Electrical/Computer Engineering, or a related field.
* Strong proficiency in embedded C/C++, with the ability to read, debug, and modify firmware for digital power controllers.
* Experience with industry-standard communication protocols like PMBus, I2C, and SPI.
* Experience with TI's Code Composer Studio (CCS), IAR, Keil and other relevant development and debug tools.
* Familiarity with scripting languages like Python, JavaScript and ability to automate characterization, test, and support workflows.
* Strong customer-facing communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to customers of varying expertise.
* Direct, hands-on experience with TI's UCD digital power controller family or Fusion Digital Power GUI will be an added advantage.
* Deep understanding of digital power control theory and common topologies (PFC, buck, boost, LLC, etc.).
* Basic understanding of signal processing and experience using model-based development tools like MATLAB and Simulink will be a definite plus.
* Ability to read and interpret schematics and datasheets, with experience in hardware-software interaction and board-level debugging.
* Proficiency in using standard lab equipment and debugging tools.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, excellent communication abilities, and a collaborative, customer-centric mindset.

**About Us**
**Why TI?**

* The future starts here. As a TIer, you'll play a critical role in defining the next era of semiconductor technology and help create the innovations that shape the world around us.
* Surround yourself with a team of innovators who value your unique perspective and will challenge you to bring your best self to work every day. We believe that fostering a culture of collaboration fuels both personal growth and technological breakthroughs. Explore our company culture .
* At TI, your success goes beyond your work. Take advantage of comprehensive benefits designed to support your total well-being at work and in life, from competitive compensation to extensive health coverage and wellness programs. Learn more about our benefits offerings .

Texas Instruments Incorporated (Nasdaq: TXN) is a global semiconductor company that designs, manufactures and sells analog and embedded processing chips for markets such as industrial, automotive, data center, personal electronics and communications equipment. At our core, we have a passion to create a better world by making electronics more affordable through semiconductors. title: People Technology Foundation Senior Product Specialist
description:
**Mott MacDonald**
is a global engineering, management, and development consultancy committed to delivering impactful work that shapes the future.
  
  
We are a team of over 20,000 experts working across the world in more than 50 countries.
  
  
We are proud to be part of an ever-changing global industry, delivering transformative work that’s defining our future. It’s our people who power that performance. As an employee-owned business, we invest in creating a space for everyone to feel safe and valued and empowered with the right tools and support.
  
  
Whether you want to pursue excellence in your specialism or broaden your experience with flexible roles across our business, you’ll be connected to a community of global experts championing you to be your best. Join us and shape your story with Mott MacDonald, where everyone has the opportunity to be
**brilliant**
.
  
  
**Job Description**

* We are creating a new Group People Technology function to provide clear ownership, expertise and direction across the technology that supports our global People services.
* The People Technology Foundation Senior Product Specialist will work closely with business stakeholders to understand their problems, requirements and desired outcomes, translating these into practical, scalable and supportable digital solutions across the People Foundation portfolio.
* Reporting to the People Technology Foundation Product Manager, you will work alongside another Senior Product Specialist and collaborate with Project Managers, People teams, business regions, IT, architecture, data, integration teams and external delivery partners.
* You will bring strong knowledge of SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central and related Foundation capabilities. The portfolio currently includes Employee Central, employee and workforce data, Position Management, Organisation Management, employee lifecycle processes and OpenText, with future scope expected to include Time Off, Absence Management and related Foundation services.
* This is a hands-on product delivery role. You will lead discovery and requirements workshops, challenge solution-led requests, shape functional designs, complete authorised configuration, coordinate testing and releases, investigate defects and deliver product improvements. You will ensure that stakeholders remain focused on the business problem and required outcomes, while People Technology brings the product expertise needed to determine the most effective solution.
* You will also create and maintain the detailed configuration, design, testing, release and operational documentation needed to support effective governance, auditability, continuity and future change. Through direct delivery, partner challenge, knowledge transfer and continuous learning, you will help strengthen internal capability and reduce unnecessary reliance on external partners.
* Although primarily aligned to People Foundation, you will also support other People Technology capability domains when concentrated demand, delivery priorities, holiday cover, business continuity or development opportunities require additional capacity.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Work directly with global, regional and functional stakeholders to understand business problems, requirements, user needs and desired outcomes, ensuring discussions remain focused on the need rather than a predetermined technology solution.
* Lead discovery, requirements and solution-shaping workshops, constructively challenging assumptions and translating business requirements into clear options, recommendations, functional designs and acceptance criteria.
* Act as a senior subject-matter specialist for SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central and assigned Foundation capabilities, bringing relevant platform knowledge, leading practices and product insight into business and delivery decisions.
* Deliver authorised configuration, product administration, enhancements and optimisation activity directly within agreed access, security, control and segregation-of-duties requirements.
* Take ownership of assigned product changes from discovery through functional design, configuration, testing, release and early-life support, progressing work through established change and release controls with accurate status, traceability, decisions and evidence.
* Work with the Foundation Product Manager and Project Managers on larger initiatives, providing product expertise, detailed requirements, scope, estimates, dependencies, risks, decisions and delivery information.
* Analyse People processes, workforce data structures, business rules, roles, permissions, integrations and operational impacts to support effective end-to-end solution design.
* Assess Foundation-related incidents, defects, service issues, enhancements and optimisation opportunities, investigating root causes and recommending appropriate resolution or improvement routes.
* Assess SAP SuccessFactors release updates and product-roadmap changes, identifying relevant impacts, risks and opportunities and coordinating the testing, documentation, stakeholder readiness and adoption activity required.
* Create and maintain configuration workbooks, configuration records, requirements, functional designs, process documentation, solution decisions, test evidence, release artefacts, operating procedures and product knowledge, ensuring documentation remains aligned to the live product and supports auditability, operational continuity, supportability and future change.
* Define test scenarios and acceptance criteria, undertake or coordinate functional and regression testing, support user acceptance testing and ensure defects, decisions and test evidence are recorded appropriately.
* Monitor product health, data quality, recurring defects, adoption and operational performance, identifying and delivering opportunities to simplify processes, improve configuration, reduce manual activity and increase business value.
* Work confidently with support and implementation partners, leading or contributing to workshops, reviewing designs and deliverables, challenging recommendations and ensuring agreed documentation and knowledge transfer are completed.
* Maintain and develop relevant SAP SuccessFactors expertise through product learning, release awareness, practical delivery and appropriate certification.
* Share product knowledge, methods, documentation and lessons with colleagues, reducing single points of failure and increasing the resilience of the People Technology team.
* Contribute to the Foundation People Technology Community, working with regional stakeholders, super users and champions to gather insight, support adoption and improve the effective use of Foundation capabilities.
* Support other People Technology domains where demand and capacity require, providing flexible delivery capacity, holiday cover and broader development while maintaining accountability for assigned Foundation responsibilities.

**Candidate Specification:**

* Essential
* Strong hands-on experience with SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central, including practical configuration, functional design, testing and delivery of controlled product changes.
* Strong understanding of core HR processes, employee lifecycle activities, workforce data, organisational structures, Position Management and related People Foundation capabilities.
* Experience leading discovery and requirements workshops, keeping stakeholders focused on business problems and desired outcomes rather than predetermined technology solutions.
* Ability to translate business requirements into clear process designs, functional requirements, solution options, configuration decisions and acceptance criteria.
* Experience coordinating product and vendor-release cycles, including impact assessment, regression testing, business readiness, deployment, operational handover and post-release review.
* Experience assessing incidents, defects, enhancements and optimisation opportunities, including impact analysis, root-cause investigation and recommendation of appropriate solutions.
* Experience producing and maintaining configuration workbooks, functional designs, process documentation, test evidence, release artefacts, operating procedures and product knowledge.
* Confidence working with business stakeholders, Product Managers, Project Managers, technical specialists and third-party partners, including constructively challenging designs, configuration, testing outputs and documentation.
* Ability to deliver authorised configuration and product improvements directly while observing security, access, change-control and segregation-of-duties requirements.
* Commitment to maintaining deep product expertise, completing relevant learning or certification and sharing knowledge to reduce single-person and external-partner dependency.
* Ability to support adjacent People Technology products or capability domains when demand, resilience, holiday cover or development priorities require.
* Desirable
* SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central certification.
* Additional SAP SuccessFactors experience or certification in Position Management, Time Management, Platform Foundations, Employee Central Payroll or related capabilities.
* Experience with OpenText or comparable enterprise employee document and records-management solutions.
* Experience with Time Off, Absence Management, Workforce Administration, payroll processes or payroll integrations.
* Experience working within a product-led operating model and delivering through internal, blended and partner-led teams.
* Experience supporting SAP SuccessFactors release planning, regression testing and adoption of new platform capabilities.
* Experience working with integrations, data structures, security roles, permissions, business rules and downstream system dependencies.
* Experience supporting global People processes while considering regional requirements, regulatory obligations and operational differences.
* Experience working with super-user groups, champion networks, communities of practice or a People Technology Community.
* Experience using agile, iterative or structured change and release-management practices.
* Experience contributing across more than one People Technology product, platform or functional domain.

**Qualifications & Certifications - Desirable**
**Product and Platform**
SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central certification
  
  
SAP SuccessFactors Position Management certification
  
  
SAP SuccessFactors Time Management certification
  
  
SAP SuccessFactors Platform Foundations certification
  
  
SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central Payroll certification
  
  
OpenText training or certification relevant to document and records management
  
  
Business Analysis and Delivery
  
  
Business-analysis qualification from BCS, IIBA or an equivalent body
  
  
AgilePM
  
  
Scrum certification
  
  
SAFe certification or equivalent agile-delivery qualification
  
  
Service and Change Management
  
  
ITIL Foundation or higher certification
  
  
Relevant change, release or testing qualification
  
  
Relevant SAP SuccessFactors certification is desirable. Where certification is not currently held, the successful candidate will be expected to maintain and develop relevant SAP SuccessFactors expertise through product learning, release awareness, delivery experience and appropriate certification.
  
  
**Flexible working**
At Mott MacDonald, we support our staff to create work-life balance which works for them and welcome candidates looking for career flexibility. We are open to discussing flexible working at interview stage.
  
  
**Our benefits package is designed to enhance your experience:**

* Agile working
* Critical illness and compassionate leave
* Paternity Leave
* Group term life insurance, and Group medical insurance coverage
* Career mobility options
* Short and Long-term global employment opportunities
* Global collaboration and knowledge sharing

**Employment Compliance Requirement**

**Acceptable documents include a Passport, Voter ID, or Birth Certificate.**

title: Bids & Tenders Specialist
description:
**ABOUT US:**

Join a team that is redefining the accessibility of space. Azista space is a transformative force in the global aerospace sector, uniquely positioned at the intersection of indigenous innovation and industrial scalability. Operating India’s first private-sector satellite mass-production facility in Ahmedabad, we have bridged the gap between complex engineering and high-volume manufacturing.

As a vertically integrated leader, we provide end-to-end solutions from the precision design of satellite buses and advanced payloads to mission management and communication systems. We don’t just build hardware, we are democratizing the final frontier by providing global clientele with the cost-effective, high-performance technology needed to power the next generation of orbital missions. At Azista, you won't just be starting a job, you’ll be fuelling the future of space exploration.

**JOB SUMMARY:**

We are looking for a proactive, highly organized Bids & Tenders Specialist to own our end-to-end proposal engine. Based in Hyderabad, you will spearhead the complete bid management lifecycle for high-stakes aerospace and defense programs across domestic and international markets.

In this role, you will act as the critical bridge between Engineering, Finance, Legal, and Supply Chain teams to transform complex technical capabilities into fully compliant, winning proposals. You will directly impact Azista’s growth pipeline by tracking opportunities, mitigating compliance risks, and owning key metrics around bid accuracy, compliance rates, and win ratios for agencies like ISRO, DRDO, NASA, and Tier-1 aerospace contractors.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* **Opportunity Pipeline Tracking:**
  Actively monitor public procurement portals (GeM, CPPP, SAM.gov) and defense buyer networks to scout, evaluate, and present actionable RFPs, RFQs, and EOIs.
* **End-to-End Bid Management:**
  Drive the full proposal workflow—from initial query generation to final submission—ensuring strict adherence to technical, financial, and timeline requirements.
* **Cross-Functional Orchestration:**
  Collaborate with technical SMEs, Engineering, Legal, and Supply Chain to assemble robust technical compliance sheets, Basis of Estimates (BOE), and project schedules.
* **Commercial & Financial Assembly:**
  Prepare comprehensive commercial proposals, including price schedules, payment terms, EMDs, and Performance Bank Guarantees (PBG).
* **Regulatory & Compliance Governance:**
  Ensure rigorous compliance with international defense and quality standards, including ITAR, AS9100, FAR/DEFCON, and DAP/DPP guidelines.
* **Bid Asset Management:**
  Build, scale, and maintain a centralized proposal content library, including past performance certificates, standard responses, and capability matrices to streamline future bid cycles.

**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR?**

* **Education:**
  Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Aerospace, ECE, Industrial) or Business Administration.
* **Experience:**
  2+ years of direct experience managing bids, tenders, and RFPs within the Aerospace, Space, or Defense sectors.
* **Portal Expertise:**
  Proven experience navigating public procurement platforms (e.g., GeM, CPPP, DRDO/ISRO portals, SAM.gov).
* **Commercial Literacy:**
  Solid understanding of financial bid terms, including INCOTERMS, EMD, PBG, Liquidated Damages (LD), and cost structures.
* **Regulatory Knowledge:**
  Hands-on exposure to regulatory frameworks such as ITAR, AS9100, or DAP/DPP guidelines.
* **Tool Proficiency:**
  Advanced skills in MS Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and experience with ERP systems (e.g., SAP).

**NICE-TO-HAVE**

* Prior experience dealing with international defense procurement channels or Tier-1 global aerospace prime contractors.
* Formal certifications in Bid and Proposal Management (e.g., APMP).

**WHY JOIN US ?**

* **Pioneer Space Tech:**
  Work at the forefront of the new space movement and play a direct role in democratizing access to orbit.
* **Tangible Impact:**
  Your bids will directly win contracts for missions heading into low Earth orbit (LEO) and beyond.
* **Collaborative Culture:**
  Thrive in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment where engineering excellence meets entrepreneurial agile scale.
* **Career Growth:**
  Unmatched exposure to cross-functional operational leadership and global aerospace stakeholders.
