title: SAP Techno-Functional Specialist (SAP QM, SAP PP & ABAP)
description:
**Job Summary:**

* We are seeking an experienced SAP Techno-Functional Consultant with strong expertise in SAP Quality Management (QM) , SAP Production Planning (PP ) and ABAP development. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, implementing, enhancing, and supporting SAP S/4HANA and ECC solutions in a manufacturing environment. This role requires a blend of functional process expertise and technical development skills to deliver integrated business solutions across quality, production, and enterprise systems.

**Responsibilities:**

**SAP Quality Management (QM) - Primary Skill**

* Lead design, configuration, implementation, and support of SAP QM processes in SAP S/4HANA
* Configure and support Quality Planning, Inspection Processing, Quality Notifications, and Quality Certificates.
* Manage all QM master data connecting to Inspection plans and COA Profiles and assignments as well as Quality Notifications and catalogs.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders to define requirements and implement scalable quality management solutions.
* Support integration between SAP QM and MM, PP, PM, SD, WM/EWM, MES/MII, LIMS, and external systems.
* Participate in testing, defect resolution, cutover planning, go-live support, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Support data governance, master data management, and quality data standards across the enterprise.

**Data Migration & Integration**

* Lead SAP S/4HANA and ECC data migration activities using Migration Cockpit (LTMC/LTMOM), LSMW, SAP Data Services, and custom ABAP programs.
* Define source-to-target mappings, validation rules, reconciliation procedures, and testing strategies.
* Support migration of QM and PP master and transactional data.
* Design and support integrations between SAP and non-SAP systems including MES, MII, Sample Manager, LIMS, and legacy applications.
* Troubleshoot data conversion, interface, and integration issues across enterprise landscapes.

**SAP Production Planning (PP) - Secondary Skill**

* Configure and support SAP PP processes including Demand Management, MRP, Capacity Planning, Production Orders, Process Orders, Scheduling, and Shop Floor Execution.
* Maintain and support production master data such as BOMs, Routings, Work Centers, Production Versions, Resources, and Master Recipes.
* Drive process integration between production planning, manufacturing execution, inventory management, and quality management.
* Analyze manufacturing business requirements and recommend process improvements leveraging SAP best practices.
* Support manufacturing transformation initiatives and S/4HANA production planning enhancements.
* Collaborate with plant operations, supply chain, and quality teams to improve efficiency and operational performance.

**Experience:**

* 7+ years of SAP experience with strong techno-functional expertise.
* Minimum 5+ years of hands-on SAP QM experience.
* Minimum 3+ years of SAP PP configuration and support experience.
* Minimum 3+ years of ABAP development, debugging, and enhancement experience.
* Strong knowledge of SAP S/4HANA and ECC architectures.
* Experience with at least two full-cycle SAP implementation projects.
* Strong understanding of manufacturing business processes.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent.

**Nice to Have:**

* Experience in Chemical, Process Manufacturing, or Specialty Materials industries.
* SAP S/4HANA migration or transformation project experience.
* Experience with Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A) integrations.
* Knowledge of SAP Fiori, CDS Views, Embedded Analytics, SAP BTP, and API-based integrations.
* SAP QM, PP, ABAP, or S/4HANA certifications preferred.

description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Specialist Assistant Manager, Strategic Market Insights and Thought Leadership (TMT- AI Data Centers, Semiconductors, and Tech Hardware Research)**
Deloitte’s Center for TMT is one of the industry teams within the Research & Insights (R&I) group, focusing primarily on the TMT industry. The Center's goals are to:
  
  

* Assess opportunities and challenges facing companies in the TMT industry
* Provide practical and actionable insights - whether they are strategic, technical, operational.
* Bring together a range of stakeholders to address issues impacting the health and evolution of the TMT industry.
* Make extensive use of leading practices from TMT professionals across diverse disciplines, including content strategy, digital distribution, advertising and monetization, consumer analytics, rights management, finance, risk management, regulation, and human capital, to identify innovative steps they have taken to address critical challenges.

Learn more about the TMT Center and have a peek into our work here .
  
  
This role involves contributing to thought leadership and research projects across the full lifecycle—from design to delivery—examining critical challenges and opportunities in the Technology sector with particular focus primarily on semiconductor and enterprise hardware sub-sectors (including AI data center infrastructure), as well as consumer tech (secondary focus).
  
  
The candidate will contribute to advancing the quality of the Center's research and thought-leadership work in Technology sector, with a focus on AI tech infrastructure (e.g., data centers, memory, GPUs, networking, edge, etc.), hybrid computing architectures, advanced packaging of hardware and chips, AI in chip design and manufacturing, strategic supply chain chokepoints, and adoption of AI/agent powered consumer devices and edge applications. These include whitepapers, in-depth research reports, case studies, articles, data-based research tools, client presentations, and collaterals for specific client accounts. These deliverables would integrate information from a range of primary and secondary sources, including Deloitte subject-matter experts, primary research (surveys), publicly available data, third-party research, analyst reports, presentations, industry commentaries, and news articles.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**
As a Specialist Assistant Manager, focused on developing thought leadership, you will be required to –
  
  

* Work across diverse Tech sector (with a focus on semiconductor and enterprise hardware) topics, quickly build subject-matter familiarity, synthesize complex information, and deliver high-quality research insights.
* Develop and maintain subsector-level expertise across tech (and specifically hardware, semiconductor and consumer tech) landscape, including emerging technologies, business models, and financial drivers. This includes proactively researching companies, trends, themes, underlying technologies, and potential disruptions through direct study of industry reports, company disclosures and other credible sources.
* Identify novel topics, areas and trends to focus on, based on extensive analysis of competition thoughtware/articles and importance of issues based on market studies, industry reports and tracking.
* Design research proposals, build consensus, and formulate a research plan. Execute structured research plans by translating business objectives into clear research questions, identifying areas of investigation, and conducting thorough secondary research using relevant and trustworthy industry, company, and news sources.
* Interact with internal and external subject matter experts on industry topics and synthesize takeaways and findings into concise and well-structured narratives, assisting senior research leads to shape internal/external thought-leadership content and collaterals – through a combination of expertise and direct study, complemented by AI tools.
* Liaison with U.S. colleagues and senior researchers to understand, refine, and manage internal client expectations and priorities.
* Apply established research tools and methodologies to support business decision-making.
* Work on varied data sets (e.g., survey data, publicly available data sets) to derive data-driven insights.
* Identify and use the relevant data analysis methods and work with the relevant data science and analytics professionals to analyze voluminous and complex datasets.
* Demonstrate strong writing skills as required for thought leadership reports.
* Display strong consultative and engaging presentation skills.
* Being largely autonomous (with minimal supervision) and managing the projects to ensure outcomes and meet deadlines, demonstrating a high level of ownership and accountability.
* Assist senior researchers and practice leaders with internal briefings and external client meetings/webinars – by performing customized data analysis and presenting results and insights into client-ready briefing decks.
* Ability to apply sound research judgment by grounding outputs in direct study and critical thinking, while using generative AI tools to enhance efficiency (and not as a substitute for independent synthesis.)
* Develop an understanding of Deloitte’s solutions, services, and offerings

**Requisite Experience And Skills**
**Experience**

* 6-9 years of experience in supporting/managing research projects, preferably in Technology industry related topics and areas as noted earlier in this document.
* Experience working with US/global clients and teams is preferred. Since the job requires working closely with US-based colleagues, the ability to work across cultures is important.

**Industry/sector/subsector skills**

* Business research/thought-leadership development in Technology sector is preferred. Knowledge of AI [1] driven chip demand, AI chips and accelerators that support data centers, role of AI in chip design and manufacturing, chip hardware and integrated systems’ time-to-market, and fab efficiency.
* Familiarity with architectural innovation, heterogeneous compute. (CPU/GPU/NPU/memory/interconnects), chiplet-based designs, co-packaged optics, advanced chip packaging and their role in performance and cost curves.
* Awareness about strategic chokepoints and importance of supply chain resilience for hardware and semiconductor components; Geopolitical and operational risks in this space.
* Consumer and end-user needs and attitudes towards AI and agent-powered devices and applications for work, education, and personal reasons – including AI at the edge.

**Technical skills**

* Proficiency in using one or more of the research tools/databases, including S&P Global, Factiva, Thomson Research, Refinitiv Workspace, and Gartner.
* Sound analytical skills with experience in one or more of the following research methods: Primary research (surveys), secondary research, academic research, and case study research.
* Strong data analysis skills with the ability to work with quantitative and qualitative data – interpret, analyze, visualize, and provide data-driven insights.
* Ability to use statistical and advanced data analysis methods to analyze large and complex datasets, including surveys.
* Ability to develop compelling and analytical data visualizations using one or more tools like Excel, Tableau, Power BI, or others.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Problem-solving and critical thinking skills to generate meaningful analytical insights.
* Broad understanding of strategy models and frameworks, and the ability to apply them to research problems.
* Ability to understand the impact of marketplace changes on the industry, sector, or sub-sector.
* Proficiency in using generative AI-based platforms and tools in a responsible and transparent way to elevate research discovery, data insights, analytical rigor, and business writing.
* Proficiency in using generative AI and related tools to identify early signals and trends shaping the market through continuous sensing will be preferred.
* Familiarity with building custom GPTs and custom gen-AI research tools will be an added advantage

title: Product Description Content Writer

**Job Category**
Professional

PENJERLA, Telangana, India
  
  
**Job Description**
**Position Summary**
The Key Account Manager – Immunology is a target-carrying account owner responsible for launching and scaling the Tremfya franchise (PSO, PsA / psoriatic disease and the emerging IBD opportunity) across government / institutional reimbursed accounts. The role follows a focused launch-and-scale model: establish IL-23 leadership in high-readiness accounts, convert accessible patient pools into treated and continued patients.
  
  
Central access creation (Rate Contracts, registrations, listings, GTE and tenders) is owned by the Central Account Team; the incumbent facilitates that access at account level and converts it into procurement and reimbursed sales. Launch priority accounts are Army, CGHS and Railways, expanding to ESI, States, Autonomous institutes and PSU as the business scales. The unifying discipline is: Map deeply → Facilitate access → Shape protocol & biologic sequencing → Identify opportunity pool.
  
  
**Major Duties & Responsibilities**
In order of importance, briefly describe, in sentence form, the major responsibilities of this position as it exists today. Describe the job, not the person in the job. Each item should be a major responsibility, not a day-to-day activity. Typically no more than seven or eight major responsibilities ranked in order of highest percentage time to least.
  
  
**Approximate**
**Major Duties / Responsibilities**
Reimbursed Business Delivery & Tremfya Commercial Ownership
  
  

* Accountable for achieving Tremfya reimbursed sales targets (PSO, PsA and IBD SKUs) in assigned accounts, in line with the RB incentive plan
* Own the account outcome: grow account budget share and drive quarter-on-quarter reimbursed growth.
* Ensure accurate demand forecasting, order fulfilment coordination and timely account receivables in partnership with the Value and Supply teams.
* Map each account end-to-end — PsD / IBD patient pool, treating specialists, formulary and access status — and build a prioritized 360° launch account plan.
* Apply account-archetype logic: Army (early adoption / biologic leadership), CGHS (referral roadmap + formulary), Railways (scalable platform), ESI (future pathway), Autonomous / State (setting pathway and discussions for Franchise (Product promotion) & Medical Team for advocacy & protocol inclusion)

Facilitate Access & Navigate Reimbursement Pathways
  
  

* Facilitate the Value Team’s central access (Army RC, CGHS listing, Railway AMI/registration, GTE inclusion) at account level via account intelligence, documentation and ground follow-up — the KAM facilitates and utilises access.
* Navigate account-specific approval and procurement processes (e.g., Army MMF / PVMS, CGHS STC / non-STC, local-purchase routes) to minimise access-to-treatment timelines.

Value, Influence, Stakeholder Orchestration & Compliance
  
  

* Deliver the differential IL-23 value proposition vs IL-17 / anti-TNF competition, engage KOLs and government decision networks, and build advocacy for formulary and protocol inclusion .
* Act as cross-functional ‘quarterback’ across Medical, Franchise and Value; ensure ethical, compliant engagement and adherence to SOPs on tender interactions and HCC.

**Quality, Regulatory & Compliance (QRC) Responsibilities**
Describe important QRC responsibilities applicable for this job.
  
  

* Ensure all account and commercial activities comply with the J&J Credo, Health Care Compliance (HCC) policies, anti-bribery / anti-corruption standards and applicable local regulations.
* Adhere to SOPs on tender management, sales-achievement documentation, interactions with government officials and pharmacovigilance / adverse-event reporting requirements.

**Key Performance Indicators**
Primary measures of success for this position.
  
  

* Tremfya reimbursed business growth % and target achievement (PSO, PsA, IBD SKUs) vs. plan and vs. the incentive threshold.
* PsD / IBD accessible-pool conversion: eligible → treated patients, and account budget-share growth.
* New patient starts and patient continuation / persistence rates on Tremfya.
* Biologic-adoption progress: protocol inclusion, IL-23 share vs IL-17 / anti-TNF, and Stelara-to-Tremfya IBD upgradation.
* Access utilisation of Value-Team-secured RCs, listings and formulary inclusions (facilitation, not ownership).
* Quality of launch account plans, forecasting accuracy and KOL / stakeholder engagement.

**Functional Competencies**
Competencies (skills, knowledge and attributes) required to perform the job.
  
  

* Commercial / Target Delivery & Selling
* Biologic Adoption & Scientific Selling
* Strategic Account Management
* Access & Reimbursement Pathway Navigation
* Market & Policy Knowledge and Compliance
* Financial Acumen & Forecasting

**Behavioural Competencies**
Behavioural and leadership competencies required to perform the job (Leadership Imperatives).
  
  

* Collaboration and Partnering
* Influence and Impact
* Decision Making
* Customer & Patient Insights
* Change Management
* Ethical Conduct

**Key Working Relationships**
The most important working relationships inside and outside the company.
  
  
Internal
  
  
Value Team, Immunology Franchise, Medical Affairs (MAF), Market Access, Supply Chain, HCC and Finance teams.
  
  
External
  
  
Dermatologists, rheumatologists, gastroenterologists, KOLs, institutional decision-makers, government / scheme authorities, empanelled hospitals, distributors and service providers.
  
  
**Required Skills**
**Preferred Skills:**
Account Management, AI Judgement Integration, Business Behavior, Clinical Experience, Competitive Landscape, Cross-Functional Collaboration, Cultural Competence, Customer Centricity, Data Savvy, Developing Partnerships, Immunology, Market Knowledge, Pharmaceutical Industry, Pharmaceutical Sales Marketing, Problem Solving, Product Knowledge, Sales, Sales Enablement, Sales Trends, Strategic Sales Planning

title: Senior Technical Lead
description:
**Job Summary**
---------------

**Roles & Responsibilities:**

* Develop, review, and maintain production-quality SQL and database objects for PostgreSQL, including complex joins, CTEs, window functions, DISTINCT ON patterns, conditional aggregation, and date-effective data selection.
* Tune queries used by Composite Services API workflows, including cash balance, assets under management (AUM), account indicators, holdings, maturities, group/party search, and transaction-related reads.
* Diagnose slow queries using EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS) in approved non-production or controlled environments; interpret actual-versus-estimated rows, loops, buffer hits/reads, execution time, sort/hash behavior, and I/O waits.
* Identify and address performance issues caused by large intermediate result sets, repeated nested-loop lookups, inaccurate cardinality estimates, expensive aggregation, sort operations, and pagination applied after full aggregation.
* Design and validate indexes, including composite, partial, and expression indexes where appropriate; evaluate selectivity, column order, write overhead, and index maintenance costs before recommending changes.
* Improve pagination, filtering, ordering, and count-query patterns while maintaining correct totals, stable ordering, and API contract behavior. Assess keyset/cursor pagination where product behavior permits.
* Review data access patterns involving account, party, advisor, branch, balance, position, price, and FX relationships; validate join keys, effective-date rules, de-duplication, and missing-price or fallback logic.
* Analyze PostgreSQL runtime behavior including CPU versus I/O waits, temporary-file activity, sort/hash spills, locks, connection-pool pressure, statement timeouts, and read-replica lag.
* Collaborate with Java/Spring service engineers, DBAs, QA, and platform teams to trace API latency to SQL, reproduce issues with representative data volumes, and deliver measurable improvements.
* Create repeatable query-performance tests and document baseline plans, representative parameters, expected row counts, risks, and before/after results. Include performance checks in code review and release validation.
* Support production incidents through evidence-based diagnosis and follow established change, access-control, rollback, and data-protection procedures.
* Communicate findings clearly to technical and business stakeholders; explain trade-offs among latency, resource consumption, data freshness, and consistency.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Requirements / Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience.
* 6–8 years of hands-on SQL development, with substantial experience building and tuning **PostgreSQL** workloads in a production environment.
* Strong knowledge of PostgreSQL query planning and execution, including EXPLAIN/EXPLAIN ANALYZE, buffers, join strategies, statistics, indexes, CTE behavior, aggregation, sorting, and parallel query considerations.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze high-row-count workloads and distinguish database execution time from connection acquisition, application processing, serialization, and network latency.
* Experience diagnosing major estimate-versus-actual row-count gaps and understanding how statistics and data distribution can influence plan selection.
* Practical experience tuning queries with joins and aggregation across large business datasets; ability to preserve correctness while reducing scanned rows, repeated lookups, and unnecessary intermediate results.
* Understanding of PostgreSQL transactions, isolation levels, read-only sessions, statement and lock timeouts, connection pooling, and safe cancellation behavior.
* Experience with Git-based source control, peer review, testing, and controlled release practices.
* Strong analytical, communication, documentation, and problem-solving skills; able to take ownership of an issue from evidence gathering through validation.
* Strong analytical abilities and problem-solving skills; strong communication skills
* Experience using code management tools, for example GIT or BitBucket
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to show flexibility and reach compromise where appropriate
* Willingness to take ownership for assigned aspects of the project
* Ability to innovate and iterate, willingness to experiment quickly
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills and an ability to work constructively in a shared team environment
* Good Communication skills.

**Nice to have:**

* Experience with Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL or PostgreSQL managed on AWS, including reader/writer endpoints, connection routing, replica lag, and failover considerations.
* Experience with performance observability tools such as pg\_stat\_statements, database load/wait dashboards, CloudWatch, or application tracing/APM.
* Experience with financial-services or wealth-management data, including accounts, parties, advisor/branch hierarchies, positions, balances, pricing, and FX conversion.
* Experience collaborating with Java/Spring services and understanding how datasource configuration, connection pools, request deadlines, and concurrent API traffic affect database load.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, automated SQL checks, and database change-management practices.

**Shift Timings:** UK Shift (1pm to 10pm)

The role will be responsible for issue analysis, coordination with internal cross-functional teams, testing, data validation, client communication, SLA adherence, and continuous process improvement.
  
  
The Product Support Analyst will also be expected to leverage AI and Generative AI tools responsibly and effectively to improve research, analysis, documentation, testing, process efficiency, and overall quality of deliverables.

* Analyze data, identify issues or trends, and support troubleshooting and resolution activities.
* Develop, document, and continuously improve business and support processes.
* Maintain a high standard of quality across all deliverables and client interactions.
* Proactively identify opportunities to improve support processes, efficiency, quality, and customer experience.
* Strive to generate strong customer satisfaction scores through effective communication, ownership, and timely resolution.

The candidate should be proficient in the responsible use of AI, Generative AI, and Large Language Model (LLM) tools to improve the speed, quality, accuracy, and efficiency of project and support-related work.

* Demonstrate sound judgment regarding what AI-generated content can be trusted, edited, escalated, or rejected.
* Validate AI-generated outputs for accuracy, completeness, consistency, and alignment with business and organizational standards.
* Understand and manage risks associated with AI usage, including data privacy, confidentiality, sensitive information, inaccurate outputs, and inappropriate use of customer or company data.
* Identify opportunities to use AI to automate or accelerate repetitive support, testing, documentation, analysis, and reporting activities.
* Have introductory-level experience or understanding of AI agents, agent-based workflows, or automation using AI, with the ability to contribute to the development or use of agents that improve team productivity, implementation timelines, quality, and efficiency.
* Demonstrate proven examples of using AI to deliver faster, more efficient, higher-quality, or higher-value outcomes.

title: Lead - Digital Platforms and Consumer AI/Senior Lead - Digital Platforms and Consumer AI
description:
**Location Name:**
Pune Corporate Office - Mantri
  
  
**Job Purpose**
At Bajaj Finance, we help millions of people across India manage their money. People come to us when they want to buy a new phone on EMI, when they need a personal loan for a wedding, when they want to buy insurance, or when they want to grow their savings in a Fixed Deposit. Because we have so many customers, we get thousands of questions every single day. Customers want to know their account balance. They want to change the date their EMI gets deducted. They want to know the fees for closing a loan early.
  
  
In the past, to get these answers, a customer had to wait on hold to talk to a call center agent, or they had to tap through ten different screens on our mobile app. We want to change that. We want to make it as easy as sending a text message to a friend.
  
  
We are building a massive, highly intelligent AI (Artificial Intelligence) platform. Think of it like a super-smart chat assistant built right into the Bajaj Finance app. We want our customers to be able to just type out their problems in plain English, Hindi, or other languages, and have the AI fix the problem instantly. If a customer types, "Hey, I need to pause my loan payment this month," the AI should understand them, check their account, and do the work in seconds.
  
  
Building this is incredibly hard. It is not just a simple robot that gives canned answers. It is a smart system that has to understand human language, connect to our deep banking systems, and follow strict financial rules.
  
  
**Duties And Responsibilities**

* Conversation Flows

A normal conversation flows naturally. But computers need a map. They need to be told exactly how a conversation should go, step by step. You will create these maps, which we call Conversation Flows.
  
  
You will literally use a software tool to draw boxes and arrows on your screen.
  
  

* Box 1: The AI says, "Hello, how can I help?" -> Arrow points to Box 2.
* Box 2: The customer says, "I want to see my statement." -> Arrow points to Box 3.
* Box 3: The system checks if the customer's phone number is verified.

o If Yes -> Arrow points to Box 4.
  
  
o If No -> Arrow points to Box 5.
  
  

* Box 4: Show the statement on the screen.
* Box 5: Ask the customer to type in a one-time password (OTP).

You have to map out every single path the conversation could possibly take. You have to think of all the "what ifs." What if the customer types the wrong password? What if the customer stops replying and walks away from their phone? What if the internet crashes? You must draw a box and an arrow for every single situation. These flowcharts become the actual instruction manual for the engineers. They look at your map and write the code to make it happen exactly as you drew it.|Your Daily Work: The 9 Core Areas
  
  
**About**
Your job will be very hands-on. You will not just be sitting in long meetings talking about big ideas. You will be doing the real, detailed work to make this AI smart. Here are the nine specific areas you will be working on every day:
  
  

* FPR (Future Press Release)

Before a single line of computer code is written, you have to know what your end goal is. We do this by writing a Future Press Release, or FPR.
  
  
A press release is a news article that a company puts out when they launch a cool new product. But here, you will write this news article before we even start building. You will write it as if the product is already finished and launched to the public. You will write a catchy headline like: "Bajaj Finance Launches AI That Solves Loan Issues in 10 Seconds." You will write quotes from pretend customers talking about how much they love the feature. You will explain exactly what problem the feature solves in simple, everyday language.
  
  
Why do we do this? Because it keeps everyone focused. If the news article sounds boring or confusing, it means your idea is probably boring or confusing. Once you write a great FPR, you show it to the engineers and your bosses. When everyone reads it and says, "Wow, this sounds amazing, let's build it!"—that document becomes your team's guide.
  
  

* FAQ (Frequently Asked Questions)

Along with your news article, you will write a massive list of Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ). But these are not just the normal questions a customer might ask. These are questions that anyone involved might ask.
  
  
You have to put yourself in the shoes of a confused customer. What will they ask? "Is my bank data safe with this AI robot?" You write the answer. You have to think like our call center agents. "Will this AI do my job wrong and make the customer angry?" You write the answer. You have to think like our company lawyers. "Does this AI follow the Reserve Bank of India rules?" You write the answer.
  
  
The goal of this FAQ is to force you to find all the problems and risks before the engineers start building. If you cannot answer a tough question in your FAQ document, it means your plan has a hole in it, and you need to fix your plan.
  
  

* PPG (Product Program Guidelines)

Because Bajaj Finance deals with people's money, we have a lot of strict rules. We cannot just give a loan to anyone. We have to charge exact fees. We have to use exact interest rates. All of these strict rules are written down in company rulebooks called Product Program Guidelines, or PPG.
  
  
Every single product has a PPG. The personal loan has a PPG. The fixed deposit has a PPG. When we build the AI, the AI must follow the rules in the PPG perfectly. It cannot make a mistake. If the PPG says the late fee is 500 rupees, the AI cannot accidentally tell the customer the late fee is 400 rupees. That would cause a massive legal problem.|As a Product Manager, you will read these PPG rulebooks. You will pull out all the rules related to your project. You will work with the engineers to make sure these rules are permanently locked into the AI's brain. If the company changes a rule in the PPG next year, you are the person who makes sure the AI gets updated immediately.
  
  

* Synthetic Testing

Once the engineers build a version of the AI, we have to test it. But we cannot let a broken, untested AI talk to real Bajaj Finance customers. That is too risky. If the AI is confused, a real customer might get bad advice about their loan.
  
  
So, we use something called Synthetic Testing. "Synthetic" just means fake or made-up. You will help create thousands of fake conversations to test the AI safely. You will create fake customer profiles. For example, you make a fake customer named Rahul who has a home loan. You will type to the AI pretending to be Rahul. You will ask, "Can I pay off my whole loan today?" and see what the AI says.
  
  
Does the AI say yes? Does it calculate the early payment fee correctly? What if you pretend to be a customer who types with terrible spelling? What if you type in a mix of Hindi and English? What if you pretend to be very angry? Does the AI still understand and stay polite? You will run hundreds of these fake tests. When the AI fails, you write down why it failed, take that information back to the engineers, and tell them what to fix. You keep doing this until the AI passes every fake test perfectly.
  
  

* LLM Parameters (What We Send to the AI Brain)

The core brain of our AI is called a Large Language Model (LLM). Think of the LLM like an incredibly smart person sitting in a dark room. This person knows how to speak perfectly, but they have no idea who they are talking to.
  
  
If a customer types, "What is my balance?", the smart person in the dark room has no idea whose balance to check. So, we have to send the LLM a package of extra information along with the customer's question. We call this setting the LLM Parameters.
  
  
As the Product Manager, you will decide exactly what information goes into that package. When the customer asks about their balance, you will tell our computer systems: "Before you let the AI answer, grab the customer's name, grab their last three payments, and grab their current loan amount. Send all of that to the AI."
  
  
You also have to send strict instructions. You will tell the AI, "You are a helpful assistant for Bajaj Finance. Always be polite. Do not guess numbers. Only use the numbers I just sent you." If you send the AI too much information, it gets confused and it costs the company too much money to process. If you send too little information, the AI gives a stupid answer. Your job is to find the perfect balance of what data to send the AI every time a customer speaks.
  
  

* Visualisations

Chatting with an AI should not just be reading massive blocks of text. Nobody wants to read a giant paragraph of words on their small phone screen.|Sometimes, the best way to answer a customer is by showing them a picture, a chart, or a button. We call these Visualisations.
  
  
Let's say a customer asks, "How much of my loan have I paid off?" The AI could write a long, boring sentence with a bunch of numbers. But it is much better if the AI shows a nice, clean pie chart on the screen. Half the pie is green for the money paid, and half is grey for the money left. The customer understands it instantly.
  
  
Or, if the AI needs the customer to pick a date, it shouldn't make the customer type "October 15th." It should pop up a small calendar on the screen so the customer can just tap the day. You will decide when to use text and when to use these visual tools. You will work with our designers to sketch out how these charts and buttons should look so the chat is beautiful and easy to use.
  
  

* Product Switching

Imagine you are talking to a human salesman at a store. You ask about buying a TV. Then, suddenly, you change your mind and ask about buying a fridge. The human easily switches the topic to the fridge.Computers are not naturally good at this. If the computer is programmed to talk to you about a TV, and you ask about a fridge, the computer will get totally confused. It might say, "Error, I do not understand."
  
  
At Bajaj Finance, we have dozens of products. A customer might start a chat asking about their EMI shopping card. But halfway through the chat, they might say, "By the way, I also want to open a Fixed Deposit." The AI needs to smoothly switch from talking about the shopping card to talking about the Fixed Deposit without breaking or crashing.
  
  
We call this Product Switching. You will write the rules for how the AI handles these sudden changes in conversation. You will plan out how the AI remembers what the customer was talking about first, just in case the customer wants to go back to the original topic later.
  
  
**Required Qualifications And Experience**
The Background You Need (Education & Experience)
  
  
**Requirements**
Because this job requires you to build highly complex computer systems, we are very strict about the background you need to have. We are looking for people who meet these exact requirements:
  
  

* Your Education (The Degree and the College)

You must have a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a closely related technical computer field.
  
  
You must have graduated from a Tier 1 Engineering College. This means premier institutes like the IITs (Indian Institutes of Technology), NITs (National Institutes of Technology), or top-level Regional Engineering Colleges.
  
  
It is because the AI technology we are building is extremely complicated. You will be working side-by-side with some of the smartest software engineers in the country. You need to know how software is actually built. You need to understand coding logic, databases, and how computer servers talk to each other. Top engineering colleges train you to handle these tough, highly technical problems. If you do not have this strong computer science foundation, you will not be able to keep up with the engineering teams.
  
  
If you also have a Master's degree, that is great! We love to see it. But if you do not have a Master's degree, that is perfectly fine. It is not required. The Bachelor's degree from a Tier 1 college is what matters the most.
  
  

* Your Work Experience (2 to 3 Years in NLP/AI)

You cannot be fresh out of college for this job. You must have at least 2 to 3 years of actual, hands-on work experience.
  
  
More importantly, this experience must be in a very specific area. You must have worked on NLP platforms. It is the specific technology that teaches computers how to read, understand, and write human language.
  
  
You must have spent the last few years of your career actually building chatbots, voice assistants, or smart AI text tools. You cannot just be someone who managed a normal website or a standard mobile app.

title: Food Technologist
description:
We're hiring: Part-time Food Technologist – Product Development (NPD) | Gurugram
  
3 days a week | Freelance consultants also welcome
  
JBR International Ventures Pvt. Ltd. (JBR Bakery | Heemu®) supplies fresh breads and bakery products to ~100 cafés, hotels, restaurants and corporate cafeterias across Delhi NCR from our 100% vegetarian, butter-based kitchen.
  
We are now launching JBR Café Solutions, a one-stop kitchen for cafés: fresh breads, frozen meals, snacks, desserts and beverage premixes in one free morning delivery. Café staff only open, heat or mix, and serve.
  
We're looking for an experienced Food Technologist, part-time, to take this range from kitchen recipe to commercial scale, starting with 40 hero SKUs by January 2027.
  
What you'll develop:
  
- Frozen gravies and meals: dal makhani, chole, rajma, pav bhaji, kadhi, makhani base gravy (incl. Jain)
  
- Frozen rice and breads: jeera rice, pulao, lachha and stuffed parathas, Amritsari kulcha
  
- Snacks and Italian: burger patties, samosa, sandwich fillings, pasta and pizza sauces
  
- Desserts: choco lava cake, cheesecakes, mousse cups, tiramisu jars, brownies
  
- Beverage premixes: chai, coffee, frappé, shakes, hot chocolate, iced tea, mocktails
  
What you'll do:
  
- Formulate and standardise recipes into batch sheets and SOPs
  
- Design products ready in 3–5 minutes by café staff
  
- Run shelf-life and freezing studies with accredited labs
  
- Guide scale-up to commercial batches
  
- Cost every SKU per serve
  
- Finalise packaging and FSSAI-compliant labels
  
- Set up HACCP and batch traceability
  
- Write specs for co-packed products and audit partner plants
  
- Run taste trials with cafés and improve recipes
  
You bring:
  
- B.Tech / M.Tech / M.Sc in Food Technology or Food Science
  
- 3+ years of NPD in frozen/RTE Indian food, bakery and desserts, premixes or sauces
  
- Strong knowledge of shelf-life studies, FSSAI, HACCP and GMP
  
- Ability to work independently and deliver against clear milestones
  
Work arrangement:
  
- 3 fixed days a week (~24 hours) at our Gurugram site, hours agreed in advance
  
- Some remote work for documentation, costing and labels
  
- Suits experienced professionals, consultants and those balancing other commitments
  
Pay: ₹25,000–40,000 per month based on experience + bonus for on-time product launches
  
How to apply: email your CV, availability and 2–3 products you have developed to info@jbrinternational.in (subject: Part-time Food Technologist), or call/WhatsApp +91 92687 33031.

title: IT Solutions Analyst (Universal Robots, Bangalore - India)
description:
The
**IT Solutions Analyst - ServiceNow**
is the functional and technical bridge between business stakeholders and the ServiceNow platform, responsible for designing, configuring, enhancing, and supporting solutions across Customer Service Management (CSM), Manufacturing Commercial Operations (MCO), and Sales and Order Management (SOM).
  
  
This role translates customer service, asset management, contracts management, and entitlement-related requirements into scalable ServiceNow workflows, custom applications, and integrations. The analyst partners with Sales, Field Service, Customer Care, Manufacturing, and other IT teams to improve customer experience, order accuracy, and service efficiency, and acts as a subject-matter expert and escalation point for production support. As part of the IT Enterprise Applications team, the analyst also designs and supports integrations between ServiceNow and other systems, including Salesforce, on-premise applications, and databases.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities****
**Requirements analysis and solution design**

* Gather, document, and refine business requirements through workshops, interviews, and process mapping with Sales, Customer Service, Manufacturing, and Finance stakeholders.
* Translate requirements into functional specifications, user stories with acceptance criteria, and solution designs aligned to ServiceNow best practices.
* Assess the impact of platform upgrades, new releases, and process changes, and recommend out-of-the-box (OOTB) approaches over customization where practical.

**Platform configuration and development**

* Configure and enhance CSM (case management, customer and account data, entitlements, SLAs, Customer Service Portal, Virtual Agent, knowledge management).
* Configure and enhance MCO and SOM (product and quote catalogs, order capture, decomposition and fulfillment orchestration, order tracking, and commercial and manufacturing operations workflows).
* Design and build custom scoped applications using Flow Designer, Workflow Studio, Business Rules, Script Includes, UI Policies, Client Scripts, UI Builder / Workspaces, and Service Portal.
* Build and maintain integrations between ServiceNow and Salesforce, on-premise applications, databases, ERP, PLM, MES, telephony, and other enterprise systems using REST/SOAP APIs, Integration Hub, MID Server, JDBC, and data import sets.
* Implement and tune ServiceNow AI features (Now Assist skills, AI Agents, Virtual Agent, AI Search, Build Agent) across CSM, MCO, and SOM processes, and measure their impact on case deflection, resolution time, and agent productivity.

**Testing, deployment, and release management**

* Develop test plans and test cases, execute functional and regression testing, and coordinate user acceptance testing (UAT).
* Manage update sets / application repository deployments across instances and follow established change, release, and source-control practices.
* Produce release notes, training materials, and knowledge articles, and support end-user and super-user training.

**Production support and continuous improvement**

* Provide Tier 2/3 support for CSM, MCO, and SOM, including incident triage, root-cause analysis, and permanent fixes within SLA targets.
* Monitor platform health, data quality, and performance, and proactively identify and close process or configuration gaps.
* Support platform upgrades, family release adoption, and technical debt reduction.
* Maintain solution documentation, data models, and process flows; contribute to the product backlog and sprint planning.

**Governance and collaboration**

* Work with architects, developers, and platform owners to uphold standards for security, ACLs, data governance, and compliance.
* Report on solution adoption and process KPIs (case resolution time, order cycle time, SLA attainment) using Performance Analytics and dashboards.
* Mentor junior analysts and share knowledge across the ServiceNow community of practice.

****All About You****
We seek individuals who share our passion and determination. Our commitment to customer success drives us to go the extra mile. If you’re ready to join us in this mission, take a closer look at the minimum criteria for the position.
  
  
****Education And Experience****

* Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5+ years of hands-on ServiceNow experience as a platform analyst, administrator, or developer, focused specifically on ServiceNow solutions.
* Demonstrated implementation and support experience in at least two of the three target modules: CSM, MCO, and SOM.
* Proven experience developing custom scoped applications on the ServiceNow platform, from requirements through deployment and support.
* Experience supporting production ServiceNow environments, including incident management, root-cause analysis, upgrades, and release cycles.

**ServiceNow certifications**
**Certification**
**Requirement**
ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA)
  
  
**Required**
ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist – Customer Service Management (CSM)
  
  
Optional (preferred)
  
  
ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist – Sales and Order Management (SOM)
  
  
Optional (preferred)
  
  
ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD)
  
  
**Required**
Candidates holding certifications in Manufacturing Commercial Operations (MCO) or comparable manufacturing-industry ServiceNow credentials will be given strong preference.
  
  
****Technical Skills****

* Strong working knowledge of ServiceNow data model, tables, ACLs, roles, and CMDB / Customer Service data structures.
* Proficiency with JavaScript (server-side and client-side), Glide APIs, Flow Designer, Workflow Studio, and scoped application development.
* Experience with integrations to Salesforce, on-premise applications, and databases (SQL, JDBC) using REST/SOAP, Integration Hub spokes, MID Server, and import sets / transform maps.
* Hands-on experience with ServiceNow AI capabilities, including Now Assist skills for CSM and SOM (case and order summarization, resolution notes, knowledge generation), Now Assist Virtual Agent, AI Search, and customizing skills with Now Assist Skill Kit (NASK).
* Working knowledge of agentic AI on the platform, including features available through the Australia release: building, configuring, and governing AI Agents and agentic workflows, selecting model providers (Now LLM Service or third-party models), and managing Now Assist administration, licensing tiers, and guardrails.
* Experience with Customer Service Portal, Service Portal, UI Builder, and Workspaces (Customer Service Workspace).
* Understanding of order-to-cash, quote-to-order, entitlement, and warranty / contract processes.
* Familiarity with Agile (Scrum / SAFe) delivery, user story writing, and tools such as ServiceNow Agile Development, Jira, or Azure DevOps.
* Ability to write functional specifications, test cases, and process documentation, and to present solutions to technical and non-technical audiences.

****Preferred Qualifications****

* Hands-on MCO experience, including manufacturing commercial processes such as contracts, pricing, and order-to-delivery visibility.
* Experience with Configure, Price, Quote (CPQ) solutions, such as ServiceNow Sales and Order Management quoting, Salesforce CPQ, or Oracle CPQ, including product catalogs, pricing rules, quote-to-order flows, and integration with order management and ERP systems (a strong advantage).
* Additional ServiceNow certifications: Certified Technical Architect (in progress), Integration Hub, Performance Analytics, Now Assist / Generative AI / Agentic AI, or Predictive Intelligence.
* Experience building custom AI skills and AI Agents or using Build Agent to create agentic workflows for custom applications, and keeping pace with new AI capabilities in each ServiceNow family release.
* Experience integrating ServiceNow with ERP (Oracle Fusion), CRM (Salesforce), PLM, or MES systems.
* Experience with CI/CD and source control for ServiceNow (for example, Git integration, ATF automated testing).
* Exposure to data analytics and reporting tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
* Prior experience coordinating large/small projects or mentoring junior team members.

****Core Skills And Working Conditions****
**Core skills**

* Analytical and problem-solving ability, with a bias toward root-cause resolution over workarounds.
* Clear written and verbal communication, including facilitating workshops and explaining technical concepts to business users.
* Stakeholder management and the ability to balance multiple priorities across commercial, service, and manufacturing teams.
* Customer-centric mindset, with a focus on measurable outcomes and user adoption.
* Ownership, attention to detail, and comfort being self-directed in a fast-paced, Agile environment.
* Collaboration with onshore and offshore development partners.

**Working conditions**

* Primarily remote-based, with occasional travel.
* Participation in an on-call rotation for critical production issues and occasional after-hours release or upgrade support.

We are only considering candidates local to position location and are unable to provide relocation for this position. This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

provides strategic leadership for Customer Quality, Pre-Delivery Inspection (PDI), and Locomotive Testing Quality, ensuring product compliance with customer, regulatory, and organizational requirements while optimizing Cost of Quality. title: Technical Account Manager
description:
**Technical Account Engineer - I**

Sumo Logic helps companies keep applications reliable and secure. Our Technical Account Engineers are the people who make sure customers actually get value out of the platform, and they are the first point of contact for a portfolio of named post-sales accounts.

**About the Role**

Around 70% of the role is technical, hands-on-keyboard work: guiding customers through complex use cases, untangling deployment problems and showing practitioners how to get more out of the platform. The other 30% is building the kind of trust that makes you the first person customers call, whether that's an engineer stuck on a query or a security lead thinking about renewal.

Our playbooks and automated health signals will give you a strong baseline, but at this level you'll go well beyond them. You'll know your named customers' environments well enough to spot problems before they do and find the next use case before they ask. You'll also design tailored plans when the standard play doesn't fit, and bring in Support, Product, Engineering or Sales when a situation calls for it. You'll help shape the playbooks themselves, and support Associate TAEs as they grow into the role.

You'll have real visibility internally, including with senior leadership, and a genuine say in how we serve these customers.

**What You Will Actually Do**

* **Own your named accounts technically.** Be the go-to technical lead for a portfolio of customers, and know their environments, priorities and risks inside out.
* **Get customers using the platform extensively.** Build new use cases, bring in new data sources, teach advanced features and work through hard problems with security, DevSecOps and observability teams.
* **Craft success plans that can be measured.** Understand what customers are trying to achieve, turn it into a technical plan, help them deliver it and expand it as the value shows up.
* **See trouble coming.** Combine automated usage signals with your own judgement to spot adoption or technical risk early. Then pull the account team together to turn a wobbly account into an advocate.
* **Run the cadence.** Lead health checks and contribute to Business Reviews, building credibility with practitioners, team leads and executive stakeholders.
* **Help the accounts grow.** Work with Sales on renewals and expansion in a way that's good for the customer and delivers additional value.
* **Make the team better.** Feed customer insight back to Product and Engineering and improve our playbooks.

**Where and When**

* This role is based in Noida, India, and candidates must be located in Noida.
* Shifts are designed to overlap core Australia and New Zealand business hours.
* You'll join the local team in our Noida office from time to time, typically once a fortnight.

**What You Will Bring**

* 5 to 6 years in a technical, customer-facing role such as technical account management, customer success engineering, professional services, solutions engineering, DevOps or SOC analysis.
* Real production experience across enterprise infrastructure: operating systems, virtualisation, databases, networking and security.
* Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure or GCP).
* SQL or query language skills, and the ability to look at usage data, work out what's really going on and act on it.
* A track record of owning multiple customer accounts and building relationships from practitioners to senior stakeholders.
* Comfort with ambiguity: if something is unclear, you go and find out rather than waiting to be told.
* A strong team player who collaborates across GTM functions and gets things done with no fuss.
* A degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field (B.Tech/BE or equivalent).

**The Technical Stuff We Would Love to See**

* Experience with Observability or SIEM platforms (e.g. Splunk, Datadog, Elastic, Dynatrace, CrowdStrike, QRadar, Exabeam).
* A background in alerting and monitoring in security, operations or DevSecOps settings.
* Familiarity with security frameworks and how they apply across customers' lifecycle.
* Knowledge of Kubernetes (Helm), OTel, Prometheus and API scripting.
* Proficiency in using AI tools to accelerate day-to-day work. Certifications such as AWS AI Practitioner or Microsoft AI Fundamentals are a plus.
* Hyperscaler certifications at Associate level or above.
* Sumo Logic experience is a big plus but not required.

title: Copywriter
description:
**ABOUT XAPADS MEDIA**

Xapads Media is a global AdTech company offering audience reaching, digital monetization, and performance marketing solutions. We deliver data-driven campaign performance across global markets by connecting brands, publishers, and platforms with targeted digital solutions. Driven by technology, cross-functional collaboration, and continuous content innovation, Xapads empowers brands to build meaningful presence across major social and digital channels.

We believe that a strong organization is built on strong people and a culture that enables them to grow. Recognized as a Great Place to Work for four consecutive years and ranked among the Top 100 Companies for Women, We believe in building not just careers, but fostering an environment where people can grow, make a meaningful impact, and contribute to something enduring.

**ABOUT THE SEGMENT**

The Social Media and Brand Communications team builds global awareness, authority, and engagement across all Xapads product lines and international markets. The team simplifies complex programmatic, advertising technology, and publisher monetizing concepts into sharp, compelling narratives across social media, digital campaigns, executive thought leadership, and corporate communications.

**THE ROLE**

The Copywriter will strengthen Xapads’ brand and social communication capabilities by creating clear, engaging, and persuasive content across global digital channels. Operating as a core creative storyteller, this person will translate complex AdTech products, business objectives, and campaign briefs into impactful copy that highlights Xapads’ value proposition. The role independently owns content from brief interpretation and research through drafting, executive ghostwriting, editing, and final publishing handoff while maintaining strong brand consistency across all platforms.

**WHAT YOU'LL OWN**

* **End-to-End Content Ownership:** Own assigned content deliverables from brief interpretation and independent research through drafting, editing, fact-checking, and final handoff.
* **Social & Campaign Messaging:** Own social media copy, campaign narratives, ad copy, and pitch messaging across global brand initiatives.
* **Executive & Brand Voice:** Own executive ghostwriting and thought-leadership communications, capturing leadership perspectives in a credible, authentic tone.
* **Brand Consistency:** Ensure consistent brand voice, terminology, narrative quality, and clarity across all digital channels and client-facing presentations.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* **Campaign & Social Copywriting:** Create compelling copy for social media platforms, brand campaigns, advertising materials, PR initiatives, award submissions, and client pitches.
* **AdTech Simplification:** Translate technical AdTech, programmatic, mobile performance, and digital advertising concepts into clear, accessible, and creative communications.
* **Long-Form & Thought Leadership:** Develop long-form articles, case studies, blogs, and executive ghostwritten pieces for leadership LinkedIn profiles and industry publications.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with design, social media, marketing, product, SEO, sales, and executive leadership to brainstorm creative concepts, messaging strategies, and campaign plans.
* **Editing & Quality Assurance:** Edit and refine content to preserve accuracy, logical flow, proper grammar, brand voice, and clear calls-to-action.
* **SEO & Workflow Optimization:** Apply foundational SEO principles to web and long-form content while utilizing AI-assisted tools responsibly to support research and workflow efficiency.

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

* **Relevant Experience:** 1–3 years of professional copywriting or content writing experience in an agency (creative/digital) or in-house marketing setting. A strong portfolio showcasing creative storytelling and campaign execution is essential.
* **Core Writing & Grammar Skills:** Exceptional command of American English grammar, vocabulary, structural editing, and proofreading.
* **Executive Ghostwriting Capability:** Demonstrated ability to interview leaders or subject-matter experts and translate raw inputs into credible, well-structured thought-leadership posts.
* **Research & Fact-Checking:** Strong ability to research unfamiliar B2B or technical topics, verify claims independently, and explain complex subjects simply.
* **Adaptable Tone:** Ability to tailor voice, messaging depth, and calls-to-action based on target audiences, digital platforms, and business goals.

**GOOD TO HAVE**

* **Industry Background:** Prior copywriting experience in B2B technology, SaaS, digital advertising, ad-tech, or programmatic media ecosystems.
* **Agency Background:** Hands-on experience working in creative or digital marketing agencies.
* **SEO & AI Familiarity:** Basic knowledge of search intent, keyword integration, and experience leveraging AI tools for content research and workflow support.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

* Consistently deliver sharp, engaging social copy and creative campaign narratives aligned with business goals with minimal revisions.
* Successfully ghostwrite authentic, authoritative thought-leadership content for executive leadership across professional channels.
* Seamlessly translate technical AdTech and product updates into clear, high-impact content that elevates Xapads’ global market positioning.

**Life at Xapads Media:**

At Xapads Media, we place a strong emphasis on employee growth and continuous development. Individuals are encouraged to build expertise, take ownership of their work, and explore areas that align with their interests over time.

Our culture supports collaboration, knowledge sharing, and open communication. Teams engage in ongoing discussions, exchange ideas, and contribute to broader conversations across the business.

We also value moments that bring teams together-recognising achievements, sharing progress, and building a sense of collective momentum.

To learn more about our culture and ways of working, visit: https://www.xapads.com/life-at-xapads

description:
Business Development ExecutiveAbout Devmani Traders

Devmani Traders Pvt. Ltd. is a Mumbai-based financial services firm, established in 2008. We are an AMFI Registered Mutual Fund Distributor (ARN-289110), a SIF distributor and an Authorised Person of Kotak Securities Ltd.

From our office at Horniman Circle, Fort, we serve individual investors, families, corporates, trusts and societies. Our mutual fund book is above ₹200 crore in AUM, supported by in-house research, operations and back-office teams, so that our sales team can focus on the market.

Role Summary

We are hiring a Business Development Executive whose main job is to bring in leads and convert them into new clients. This is a field-facing, target-driven role: you will build your own pipeline, set up meetings, and bring clients on board across mutual funds, SIF, insurance, loans and equity broking.

Success in this role is measured by qualified meetings generated, new clients onboarded, and net AUM and SIP book added.

Key Responsibilities

* **Lead generation:** Build a steady pipeline through your own network, referrals, cold outreach, events and tie-ups with corporates, professionals and community groups.
* **Meeting setting:** Reach out to prospects, fix qualified meetings, and present Devmani's mutual fund, SIF and insurance offerings with the senior team where needed.
* **Client acquisition:** Convert prospects into investors and take them through the full process: KYC, account opening, SIP registration and first investment, in coordination with the operations team.
* **AUM growth:** Achieve monthly and quarterly targets on new clients, SIP book and net AUM added.
* **Cross-sell:** Introduce existing and new clients to the wider Devmani product basket, including SIF, insurance, and equity through our Kotak Securities Authorised Person arrangement.
* **Sales strategy:** Plan and execute a sales strategy for both online and offline channels, covering digital lead sources such as social media, WhatsApp and website enquiries alongside field meetings, events and referral tie-ups, and track which channels deliver the best conversions.
* **Referral network:** Build and maintain relationships with CAs, lawyers, HR heads, society and trust members who can refer clients.
* **Follow-up and relationship upkeep:** Maintain regular contact with prospects and clients, and coordinate portfolio reviews with the research and operations team.
* **Reporting:** Maintain a lead tracker in the CRM or Excel, and share weekly activity and pipeline updates with management.
* **Compliance:** Follow the AMFI Code of Conduct and applicable SEBI and IRDAI guidelines in every client interaction and communication.

Requirements

* **Experience:** 3 to 5 years in sales or business development, in any industry. Any field where you have sold a product or service, generated your own leads and hit targets.
* **Education:** Graduate in any discipline. MBA is a plus.
* **Track record:** Proven ability to source clients independently and meet monthly or quarterly targets.
* **Communication:** Confident presenting and negotiating with individuals, business owners and groups.
* **Mobility:** Comfortable with regular travel across Mumbai for client meetings.
* **Tools:** Working knowledge of MS Excel and a CRM or lead tracker.
* **Certification:** NISM Series V-A (Mutual Fund Distributors), or willingness to clear it within 60 days of joining. We will support you with the preparation.

**Added advantage:** Prior experience in mutual funds, insurance, broking, banking or any other financial product sales, and an existing network of corporates, professionals, HNI clients, trusts or societies.

What We Offer

* Fixed salary with an incentive structure linked to new clients, SIP book and net AUM added, as well as loans, insurance and broking accounts opened.
* Full research, operations and back-office support, so you focus on the market.
* A complete product basket across major AMCs, SIF and insurance partners.
* An established firm with a client base built since 2008, and a clear growth path.

How to Apply

Send your CV to **smruti@devmanitraders.com** with the subject line **"Application: Business Development Executive"**, or call **022 4213 4213**.

**About SAR Transport Systems Pvt. Ltd.**

SAR Transport Systems Pvt. Ltd. is a multinational logistics and freight forwarding company with a presence in over 40 countries, 500+ professionals and 24 offices across India, the USA and Southeast Asia. The company offers integrated logistics, warehousing, transportation and freight forwarding solutions, with a strong focus on innovation, customer-centricity and operational excellence.

**Job Purpose**

We are looking for dynamic and detail-oriented professionals to join our Pricing team. The role involves handling freight rate procurement, pricing negotiations, customer quotations, rate management and coordination with shipping lines, airlines, overseas agents and internal teams. Candidates with relevant experience in Ocean Freight, Air Freight, Import, Export or ISO Tank pricing are encouraged to apply. The designation and responsibilities will be aligned with the candidate's experience and expertise.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Freight Rate Procurement & Negotiation**

* Obtain competitive freight rates from shipping lines, airlines, NVOCCs, overseas agents and other service providers.

* Negotiate freight rates, local charges and other applicable surcharges.

* Coordinate with carriers and vendors for spot rates, contractual rates and special rate requests.

* Develop and maintain strong relationships with shipping lines, airlines and overseas agents.

**2. Pricing & Quotation Management**

* Handle pricing enquiries received from Sales, Key Accounts and Operations teams.

* Prepare and submit competitive quotations to customers within defined timelines.

* Work on Ocean Freight (Import & Export), Air Freight (Import & Export) and ISO Tank pricing, depending on business requirements.

* Ensure accurate costing, rate calculations and appropriate profit margins.

* Follow up on quotations and provide necessary pricing support to the sales team.

**3. Rate Management & Database Maintenance**

* Maintain and update freight rate sheets, tariffs and pricing databases.

* Track rate validity, amendments, surcharges and market fluctuations.

* Maintain carrier-wise, sector-wise and trade-lane-wise pricing records.

* Ensure timely circulation of updated rates to concerned departments.

**4. Coordination & Vendor Management**

* Coordinate with internal Sales, Operations and Key Accounts teams for pricing requirements.

* Liaise with shipping lines, airlines, NVOCCs, transporters and overseas agents.

* Follow up for rate confirmations and resolve pricing-related queries.

* Support internal teams in developing competitive solutions for customer requirements.

**5. Market Analysis & Commercial Support**

* Monitor freight market trends, competitor pricing and trade-lane developments.

* Identify opportunities for cost optimisation and improved procurement.

* Analyse buying and selling rates to support business profitability.

* Ensure pricing approvals are obtained as per company guidelines.

**6. Reporting & MIS**

* Maintain pricing records, quotation trackers and rate databases.

* Prepare pricing-related reports and MIS as required.

* Track quotation status, rate movements and vendor performance.

* Ensure accuracy and timely submission of pricing information.

**Desired Candidate Profile**

* Graduate in any discipline; preference for Commerce, Logistics, Supply Chain or related fields.

* Candidates from Executive to Assistant Manager level with relevant experience in Freight Forwarding / Logistics Pricing are welcome.

* Experience in Ocean Freight Import & Export pricing will be an advantage.

* Exposure to Air Freight and ISO Tank pricing will be an added advantage.

* Good understanding of freight rates, shipping lines, airlines, trade lanes and logistics operations.

* Strong negotiation, analytical and coordination skills.

* Good knowledge of MS Excel and pricing-related MIS.

* Ability to manage multiple enquiries and work within deadlines.

**Key Skills**

* ISO Tank Pricing

* Freight Rate Procurement & Negotiation
