description:
**Company Description**

Every minute of every day, Smiths Detection’s threat detection and security screening technology helps to protect people and infrastructure, making the world a safer place.

Smiths Detection is a global leader in the development, manufacture and management of security and detection solutions designed to make the world a safer place. Our technology provides threat detection and screening solutions for customers in our key markets: aviation, ports and borders, defence, and urban security.

Our expertise spans 21 global offices, seven manufacturing sites and five R&D centres, with a global network of 3,000 dedicated colleagues contributing towards over 40 years at the frontline of advances in safety and security.

This results in careers built on variety and the opportunity to work on a range of state-of-the-art solutions, where you can develop your knowledge and experience every day.

 **Job Description**

**Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities:**

This position shall be responsible to spearhead and drive the complete “order-to-invoice” cycle for the Greater India Sales Team which also included the Greater India markets partners order fulfilment like Sri Lanka, Nepal, Maldives, Bhutan & Bangladesh which shall include (***but not limited to***):

* Order booking & order management process to Invoice and manage shipment, coordinate with sales managers & customers for dispatches and deliveries coordination’s. Manage the complete Order-to-Invoice cycle, including order booking, shipment planning, invoicing, dispatch coordination, and customer deliveries.
* Receiving, verifying, and processing customer orders accurately and efficiently.
* Maintaining accurate inventory records, ensuring sufficient stock levels, and identifying and addressing inventory issues.
* Coordinating with factories for customers’ FATs (factory acceptance tests) and likewise closely coordinating with respective sales managers.
* Tracking orders through the fulfillment process and providing updates to customers.
* Addressing any issues or discrepancies that arise during the fulfillment process, such as inventory shortages, shipping delays, or damaged products.
* Responding to customer inquiries related to orders, providing order status updates, and addressing customer concerns. Monitor orders throughout the fulfilment lifecycle, proactively communicate status updates, manage exceptions, and resolve customer concerns related to deliveries, shortages, damages, or shipment delays.
* Keeping sales managers updated on MADs, shipment status etc.
* Identifying areas for improvement in the order fulfillment process and implementing solutions to enhance efficiency.
* Coordinating with the factories and factory planners for Material Availability Dates (MAD), plan the shipment and dispatches aligned with the revenue recognition forecast schedule as per the incoterms of the consignment.
* Lead complete Order to invoice cycle, OTC (order to cash) cycle, book orders in SAP, PO placement to factories, inventory management, liaise with supply side (OE-Original Equipment side), Spares & Consumables side to support the aftermarket & service sales team.
* Responsible for revenue planning for the RunRate, Programs & Aftermarket Orders, Responsible for Revenue forecast and revenue recognition as per the agreed forecast on monthly, quarterly and yearly basis. Responsible for accounting and forecasting.
* Responsible for maintaining various trackers for shipment, deliveries, open orders fulfilment, revenue planning etc. and with clearly defined Business matrix dashboard. Develop and maintain dashboards, trackers, and performance reporting for orders, deliveries, revenue, OTTR, and fulfilment KPIs.
* Have analytical bent of mind and strong reasoning skills and eye for details.
* Responsible for Stock count/inventory management/customer outstanding management and work closely alongside the supply chain and logistics team and with sales team.
* Data integrity. Analyzing order fulfillment data to identify trends, track performance, and make data-driven decisions.
* Taxation – GST, commercial acumen to qualify clean orders before order bookings and performing detailed sanity check of Sales Orders/Customer PO’s before booking the orders in the system.
* Process all type of sales orders in full cycle from order entry to invoicing to dispatch planning to deliveries to invoice submissions including invoice submissions at various platforms like GeM etc.
* Responsible for post-sales support such as physical return, replacement of equipment’s, spares etc.
* Liaise with freight forwarders to coordinate shipment and on time delivery to customers and responsible for various metrices like OTTR etc.
* Strong adherence to shipment and invoice timelines.
* Manage order fulfilment activities for neighboring markets including Sri Lanka, Nepal, Bangladesh, Bhutan, and Maldives, including Letter of Credit execution and trade compliance requirements. Liaise with the trade compliance officer to ensure all processes are adhered.
* Must to have strong working level knowledge of ERP, SAP, Power BI with strong logical reasoning and analytical skills with strong proficiency on SAP and MS-Office including Excel.
* Good presentation skills to present various dashboards and metrices to leadership team during monthly management meetings.
* Revenue forecasting and revenue planning in close coordination with all sales managers including the aftermarket sales managers and in consultation with the Sales Director.
* Decent experience on working on GeM Portal and GeM tender submissions, registrations etc.
* Candidate should have detailed understanding of the intricacies that are involved in revenue forecasting and planning and aligning the dispatches and deliveries.
* The role shall require coordinating with various internal stakeholders (including global) (working closely with Finance, Commercial, Supply Chain, Service, Operations teams etc.) to accomplish various KPIs of Revenue, OTTR, Deliveries, Cash Collection, Overdues Reduction etc.
* The position requires close coordination with global demand planning team and factory planners for IBP demand planning and hygiene.
* Should have strong communication, interpersonal and business orientation skills. Should be able to prioritize activities and achieve various submission timelines.
* Adaptable to stringent timeline requirements / deadlines and cross-markets time zones and willingness to stretch and work during business demanding critical timelines.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to resolve order-related issues.
* Identify and implement process improvements and cost-saving measures.
* Ensure compliance with company policies and industry regulations.
* Participate in strategic planning for warehouse capacity and resource management.
* Handle escalated customer inquiries related to order fulfillment and delivery.
* Conduct cycle counts and physical inventory audits to maintain inventory accuracy.
* Coordinate and manage special projects and bulk order processing tasks.
* Maintain accurate records of transactions, shipments, and inventory adjustments.

  
**Qualifications**

**Experience and Background:**

* Strong candidate from Order-to-Invoice (OTI) & Commercial background. Strong understanding of order fulfillment processes and logistics.
* Technically strong and should bring experience in hi-tech sectors. MBA preferred.
* 12+ years of industry experience with excellent organizational and time management skills.
* Keen exposure to effective sales processes as well as systems to monitor, review and report various MIS sales reporting.
* Hands-on on sales analytics, dashboards and reporting analysis with multitasking abilities.
* Proficiency in using inventory management software and related tools.

**Skills and Competencies:**

* Unquestionable integrity and work ethics.
* Ability to stretch and adapt to business-critical demanding timelines, working hours etc.
* Self-starter and motivated individual with high level of initiative & desire to succeed.
* Must have the ability to create unique & efficient OTI processes and SOPs.
* Ability to handle complex, large value order bookings, invoicing, complicated shipments and deliveries and complex revenue planning etc.
* Excellent communication skills and confidence to interact with senior officials and executives in customer organisations.
* Exposure to have worked in multinational cross-markets and cross-functions environment.
* Systems and processes driven with ability to operate successfully in a complex, matrix organisation.
* Behavioral Attributes: Internal stakeholder management (sales, finance, logistics, SCM, Global factories etc.), customer talk (delivery check), communication, assertive, Takes Ownership & Accountability of KPIs. Flexible with time.
* Attention to detail to ensure accuracy in order processing and inventory management.
* Familiarity with customer service principles.

  
**Additional Information**

Join us and we’ll help build your career, with excellent training and opportunities for career growth across the business, both locally and globally. You’ll experience an inclusive environment, with strong leadership and a focus on safety and wellbeing. You’ll also have the flexibility to choose from a wide range of benefits to suit your lifestyle, offering you and your family support from a health and wellbeing, financial and lifestyle perspective.

**Join us and work for a world-leader, with the benefits and training to reward your dedication and skills. Be part of a team where we are making the world a safer place.**

We believe that different perspectives and backgrounds are what make a company flourish. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment regardless of color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, economic status, disability, age, or any other legally protected characteristics. We are proud to be an inclusive company with values grounded in equality and ethics, where we celebrate, support, and embrace diversity.

At no time during the hiring process will Smiths Detection, nor any of our recruitment partners ever request payment to enable participation – including, but not limited to, interviews or testing. Avoid fraudulent requests by applying jobs directly through our career’s website.

**Job Title: Cataloging & Inventory Executive**

**About the Role** We are looking for a highly organized Operations Executive to manage the cataloging and inventory operations. Because our business involves thousands of unique designs, intricate materials, and massive seasonal volume spikes, this role requires exceptional attention to detail. You will be responsible for end-to-end SKU creation, **maintaining digital and physical catalogues**, and ensuring absolute accuracy between physical warehouse stock and system records. The ideal candidate loves data, is a master of Excel/ERP systems, possesses basic product photography skills, and thrives in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Cataloging & Master Data Management:**

● **Product Photography & Asset Management:** Take clear, high-quality pictures of new products and designs, organizing and maintaining these visual assets across the ERP system, PDF brochures, and internal drives.

● **Catalogue Management:** Take full ownership of creating and **maintaining digital and physical catalogues**, ensuring they are always up-to-date, accurate, and ready for B2B buyers and internal sales teams.

● **SKU Creation:** Generate and manage accurate SKU codes, product names, descriptions, and packaging hierarchies for thousands of new and existing designs.

● **ERP/System Updating:** Enter and maintain flawless master data in the ERP (Tally, SAP, or custom software), ensuring pricing, barcodes, imagery, and product attributes are perfectly synced.

**Inventory & Stock Management:**

● **Stock Tracking:** Monitor the daily inwarding of finished goods from the factory and the outwarding of dispatches to ensure zero leakage.

● **Reconciliation:** Conduct regular physical stock audits at the warehouse to reconcile physical inventory against system records, immediately investigating and resolving any discrepancies.

● **Packaging & Raw Material Tracking:** Monitor inventory levels of boxes, labels, and primary packaging materials so dispatch is never delayed due to stock-outs.

● **Seasonal Load Management:** Organize warehouse binning and storage logic so high-demand items are easily accessible during peak dispatch months.

**Cross-Functional Coordination:**

● **Production Alignment:** Work closely with the Factory/Production team to track manufacturing schedules and warehouse arrival times.

● **Dispatch & Sales Support:** Coordinate with the Sales and Dispatch teams to ensure the right SKUs are picked, packed, and billed precisely according to client orders.

**Requirements**

● **Experience:** 3–5 years in Inventory Management, Cataloging, Master Data Management, or Warehouse Operations.

● **Industry Background:** Proven experience in industries with massive SKU counts (e.g., Apparel, Jewelry, Footwear, or Seasonal Gifting).

● **Technical Skills:** Exceptional proficiency in Advanced Excel/Google Sheets (VLOOKUP, HLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, conditional formatting are mandatory).

● **System Knowledge:** Strong hands-on experience with ERP systems (Tally ERP 9 / Prime, or similar inventory modules) and barcoding systems. Basic photography and PDF creation skills are required.

● **Communication:** Fluent in Hindi and English, with the ability to communicate clearly with corporate teams and warehouse staff alike.

● **Problem-Solving:** High analytical capability—you can spot a stock mismatch or catalog error before it becomes a business problem.

**What We Value** We value people who build trust through integrity, earn loyalty through consistency, and take ownership with a bias for action. We are looking for someone who is curious, patient, adaptable, and eager to learn; a team player who uses technology intelligently and has the stability and genuine intent to grow with the organization.

title: Marketplace & Quick Commerce Executive
company: A.V. Thomas & Co. Ltd., Consumer Product Division
description:
**Role Purpose:**

To manage and grow AVT's complete online business across marketplaces and quick-commerce platforms, with responsibility for sales achievement, product availability, assortment, listings, pricing, promotions, digital visibility, inventory, platform coordination and commercial performance. The position should be treated as a business and sales role, not merely an online coordination role.

**Key Job Functions:**

**1. Sales & Target Achievement:**
Own monthly and annual platform-wise sales targets. Monitor daily and weekly sales, identify gaps and implement corrective actions. Analyse performance by platform, city, brand, SKU and pack size.

**2. Marketplace Management – Amazon / Flipkart:**
Manage Seller/Vendor Central, listings, account coordination, platform campaigns, commercial issues, ratings/reviews and new-product activation.

**3. Quick-Commerce Management – Blinkit / Zepto / Instamart:**
Manage city-wise and dark-store-wise business performance. Track active stores, availability, assortment and sales. Ensure AVT expands into relevant new cities and dark stores as platforms grow.

**4. Availability & Stock-Out Control:**
Maintain high availability of priority AVT SKUs. Monitor OOS, inventory cover and replenishment requirements and coordinate with Supply Chain and distributors.

**5. Assortment & Range Expansion:**
Ensure the right AVT brands, SKUs and pack sizes are listed. Increase average SKUs per platform/dark store and identify opportunities for range expansion.

**6. Digital Shelf & Product Content:**
Maintain accurate product titles, images, descriptions, MRP, pack information and enhanced content. Improve search visibility and category ranking.

**7. Pricing & Promotions:**
Maintain approved pricing and monitor competitor prices. Execute coupons, discounts and platform campaigns within approved budgets and evaluate incremental sales and profitability.

**8. Platform Advertising & Visibility:**
Coordinate sponsored search, product advertising and platform visibility. Monitor ROAS/ACOS and ensure advertising expenditure produces measurable business results.

**9. New Product / New Market Launches:**
Ensure timely listing and activation of new AVT products. Identify new cities, platforms and dark stores and execute launch plans.

**10. Competition Tracking:**
Maintain a weekly competitor dashboard covering price, discounts, assortment, search position, availability, ratings, new launches and sponsored visibility.

**11. Inventory, Fill Rate & OTIF:**
Forecast requirements based on sales run rates, maintain adequate inventory, prevent promotion-related stock-outs and monitor fill rate and OTIF.

**12. Claims & Reconciliation:**
Track platform deductions, returns, shortages, claims and commercial settlements and coordinate with Finance for timely reconciliation.

**Primary Performance Outcomes:**

The role will ultimately be evaluated on four principal outcomes:

·      Sales Growth

·      Availability

·      Distribution & Assortment Expansion

·      Profitability

The executive is expected to function as the operational business owner for all assigned marketplace and quick-commerce platforms, with disciplined coordination across Marketing, Supply Chain, Finance and Sales.

About TripKadaii.com

TripKadaii.com is a travel company specialising in international and domestic holidays, customised trips.

We are looking for a responsible, proactive and highly organised Travel Operations & Client Servicing Executive to take complete ownership of customer bookings after the sale is confirmed.

This is a hands-on role. You will be coordinating with customers, DMCs, hotels, airlines and other travel partners and ensuring that every booking runs smoothly from confirmation until the customer returns home.

What you will be responsible for?

Once a booking is confirmed by the sales team, you will take over the complete operational process.

DMC & Supplier Coordination

Coordinate with international and domestic DMCs, hotels, transport providers and activity providers.

Send booking requirements and collect confirmations.

Follow up regularly with suppliers for pending confirmations.

Verify hotels, transfers, activities, sightseeing and other inclusions against the confirmed itinerary.

Identify and resolve discrepancies before they become customer issues.

Maintain proper records of all supplier communications and confirmations.

Customer Coordination

Take ownership of customers after booking confirmation.

Communicate booking updates clearly and professionally.

Create and manage customer WhatsApp groups.

Share vouchers, confirmations, itineraries and other required documents.

Respond to customer queries related to their upcoming trip.

Conduct pre-departure calls and ensure customers have everything required before travel.

Coordinate with customers during the trip whenever operational assistance is required.

Follow up after the trip where required.

Payments & Booking Follow-up

Track customer payment schedules and send timely reminders.

Track DMC/supplier payment deadlines.

Remind the management team about upcoming supplier payments.

Follow up with DMCs regarding payment-linked confirmations.

Maintain accurate records of booking and payment status.

Flights & Visa Coordination

Coordinate flight bookings and ticketing requirements with customers/suppliers.

Assist customers with flight-related information and changes.

Coordinate basic visa documentation and follow-ups according to TripKadaii's process.

Maintain visa checklists and ensure customers submit required documents on time.

Track visa application progress and communicate updates to customers.

Pre-Departure & Quality Checks

Before every customer's departure, you will be responsible for ensuring that:

Hotels are confirmed.

Transfers are confirmed.

Activities and sightseeing are confirmed.

Flight details are checked.

Vouchers are shared.

DMC/driver/contact details are available.

Customer documents are in place.

Any pending payment or requirement has been followed up.

The customer knows what they need to do before and during the trip.

What we are looking for

We need someone who is:

Extremely organised and detail-oriented.

Good at following up without being repeatedly reminded.

Comfortable handling multiple bookings simultaneously.

Excellent at WhatsApp, email and phone communication.

Comfortable speaking to customers professionally.

Comfortable coordinating with DMCs and travel suppliers.

Good at maintaining checklists, trackers and deadlines.

Able to identify problems before the customer does.

Calm and solution-oriented when something goes wrong.

Willing to take ownership rather than simply waiting for instructions.

Comfortable working in a fast-paced travel environment.

Good with Google Sheets/Excel, Gmail, WhatsApp and basic digital tools.

Available to handle genuine travel emergencies when required.

The most important quality

Ownership.

We are looking for someone who sees a booking and thinks:

"What needs to happen next, and have I completed it?"

rather than waiting for someone to tell them what to do.

You should be comfortable managing a booking from confirmation to completion with minimal supervision.

Experience

Preferred:

2–3 years of experience in travel operations, travel agency, DMC, tour operations, customer servicing or a similar role.

Experience handling international travel bookings is an advantage.

Experience coordinating with DMCs is a strong advantage.

This role is NOT for you if

You are a fresher

You need to be reminded about every task.

You are uncomfortable making follow-up calls.

You don't like dealing with customers.

You struggle to manage multiple deadlines.

You tend to wait for instructions instead of taking initiative.

You are looking for a purely desk-based administrative role.

What you will get

Work directly with the founder and be involved in real travel operations.

Exposure to international travel, DMCs, hotels, flights, visas and customised holidays.

Opportunity to grow into a senior travel operations/management role.

A fast-paced environment where you will have significant responsibility and ownership.

How to apply

Send your CV + a short introduction about yourself + details of your previous travel/operations experience to:

[hello@tripkadaii.com / +91 9600838088]

Please mention "Travel Operations Executive Hiring" in the subject/message.

title: Retail Operations Manager
description:
About Z18 Jewels

Z18 Jewels is a rapidly growing, modern fashion jewelry brand specializing in premium 18k, 14k, 9k gold, and 925 silver collections. Operating out of high-footfall retail environments and premium mall kiosks across India, we are dedicated to delivering exceptional design, quality, and customer experiences.

Role Summary

We are seeking a highly organized and results-driven Retail Operations Manager to oversee our multi-branch retail operations. Based in Kochi, you will serve as the linchpin of our daily business, traveling frequently to our various mall kiosks to drive sales performance, manage retail teams, ensure a seamless supply chain, and oversee inventory flow and merchandising strategy.

Key Responsibilities

Inventory & Merchandising Management

**Stock Control:** Monitor and manage inventory levels across all kiosks and branches, ensuring optimal stock availability while minimizing dead stock.

**Merchandising Strategy:** Analyze daily and weekly product performance to identify fast-moving vs. slow-moving designs, forecasting demand to raise accurate and timely purchase orders.

**Audits & QC:** Travel to kiosk locations to conduct regular physical stock audits, reconcile system discrepancies, oversee quality control checks on incoming stock, and implement strict loss-prevention measures.

**Visual Merchandising:** Ensure display trays, lighting, and product placements adhere to Z18’s visual standards across all locations to maximize aesthetic appeal and customer engagement.

Sales & Performance Leadership

**Daily Operations:** Directly oversee daily sales operations and manage retail staff across multiple Z18 kiosks and branches via regular site visits.

**Target Management:** Define, allocate, and monitor individual sales targets for branch staff, ensuring that broader team and store-level revenue goals are consistently achieved or exceeded.

**Data Analysis:** Generate and present comprehensive sales reports to the executive team, identifying market trends and operational bottlenecks.

Operational & Team Management

**Site Visits & Supervision:** Travel consistently between the Kochi base and other kiosk locations (e.g., Trivandrum) to provide on-the-ground support, supervision, and operational troubleshooting.

**Shift Planning:** Plan and optimize staff shift schedules across all retail locations to ensure peak operational coverage and efficiency.

**Staff Development:** Lead, motivate, and train retail teams on product knowledge, sales techniques, and operational protocols during site visits.

Vendor & Agency Coordination

**Vendor Relations:** Build and maintain strong relationships with jewelry manufacturers and suppliers, ensuring timely inventory replenishment and smooth supply chain operations.

**Marketing Oversight:** Serve as the primary point of contact for external advertising and marketing agencies, guiding the execution of both online and offline campaigns to align with brand objectives.

Qualifications & Requirements

**Industry Experience:** Minimum of 4 years of proven operational, inventory, or sales management experience within the retail jewelry sector.

**Mobility & Travel:** Must be based in Kochi with the willingness and ability to travel frequently to various retail kiosks and mall locations across the region.

**Merchandising & Inventory Skills:** Strong background in retail merchandising, stock auditing, and utilizing Point of Sale (POS) or Inventory Management Systems.

**Product Expertise:** Deep technical and market knowledge of gold (including 14k, 18k, and 9k variations) and 925 silver fashion jewelry.

**Technical Proficiency:** Advanced command of data management and reporting tools, specifically Google Sheets and Microsoft Excel, for complex sales and inventory reporting.

**Communication:** Exceptional English communication skills with the ability to negotiate with vendors, guide marketing agencies, and lead diverse retail teams.

title: TC-CS-AD-Cyber LDE
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY GDS CYBER LARGE DEAL GROUP**
**Cyber Solutions Architect**
Pre-Sales | Client Storytelling | Commercial & Pricing | Turnkey Cyber Services
  
  
**Executive mandate to**
Shape and lead differentiated, executable and commercially compelling turnkey cyber services propositions for strategic pursuits, converting complex client priorities into a persuasive value story, integrated architecture, delivery model and price-to-win.
  
  
**The opportunity**
The Cyber Large Deal Engine brings together Business Case Researchers, Cyber Domain Specialists, Solution Architects, and Finance & Commercial Specialists to create an integrated deal-shaping capability, connecting client and market insight, deep cyber expertise, end-to-end solution architecture, and commercial modelling to build propositions that are differentiated, deliverable and positioned to win.
  
  
It is a senior pursuit leadership position for an architect who can operate credibly across the boardroom, the solution room and the commercial model. The role requires breadth across cyber domains, depth in at least one major cyber capability, and the judgement to integrate specialist inputs into one coherent, differentiated and deliverable proposition.
  
  
**Role Accountabilities**
**Lead strategic solutioning and pursuits**

* Own the solution from qualification and discovery through business case build out , architecture, proposal development, governance, oral presentation, negotiation and BAFO.
* Establish the solution strategy, win themes, design principles and response plan for complex RFPs, RFIs and proactive pursuits.
* Translate client requirements into an integrated managed services model spanning people, process, technology, governance, service management and transformation.
* Define scope, architecture, operating model, transition approach, delivery footprint, staffing model, service levels, assumptions, dependencies and risks.
* Mobilise and lead multidisciplinary contributors across domains and geographies, ensuring one solution, one story and one commercial position.

**Create a compelling customer story**

* Frame the client’s business context, cyber risk and operational challenge before presenting the solution.
* Convert technical complexity into an outcome-led narrative that is relevant to CISOs, CIOs, business executives and procurement leaders.
* Connect solution choices to measurable outcomes such as risk reduction, resilience, control effectiveness, experience, operational efficiency and cost transparency.
* Lead executive discovery sessions, workshops, whiteboarding, solution walkthroughs, oral pitches and solution-defence discussions.
* Anticipate objections and competitive alternatives, articulating clearly why the proposition is credible, differentiated, scalable and valuable.

**Own commercial solutioning and pricing**

* Translate the solution into a robust bottom-up cost model covering resource pyramids, effort, delivery locations, platforms, licences, transition and ongoing run costs.
* Work with finance and commercial teams to develop competitive, sustainable and traceable pricing, with clear linkage between scope, service levels, cost and price.
* Evaluate fixed-price, consumption-based, unit-based, outcome-aligned and hybrid charging models based on client context and risk allocation.
* Optimise the solution through automation, standardisation, global delivery leverage, right-shoring, reusable assets and platform choices without compromising outcomes.
* Understand margin drivers, contingencies, contractual dependencies and change levers; support commercial governance, negotiation, BAFO and renewal decisions.

**Architect integrated turnkey cyber services**

* Provide broad solution leadership across Identity and Access Management, Privileged Access Management, Customer IAM, Non-Human Identity, Threat Detection and Response, SOC, SIEM, SOAR, XDR, Vulnerability Management, Threat Intelligence and Threat Hunting.
* Bring familiarity with major platforms including SailPoint, Saviynt, Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, CyberArk, BeyondTrust, Delinea, Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender, Splunk and CrowdStrike.
* Design for cloud, on-premise and hybrid environments, integrating EY capabilities, alliance partners, technology vendors and client-retained responsibilities.
* Know when to make an architectural decision and when to engage a deep specialist, while retaining accountability for the integrity of the end-to-end solution.
* Position AI-enabled security operations, automation and platform-led delivery where they create a credible and measurable client advantage.

**Build repeatable deal-engine capability**

* Create and improve reference architectures, solution patterns, estimators, pricing models, proposal content, assumptions libraries and executive storytelling assets.
* Capture pursuit insights, commercial benchmarks and lessons learned to improve future speed, consistency and win quality.
* Coach solution contributors on structured solutioning, client storytelling, estimation discipline and executive presentation.

**Decision scope and influence**

* Recommends the end-to-end solution strategy, architecture, delivery model and commercial assumptions for assigned pursuits.
* Challenges requirements and design choices that reduce value, increase delivery risk or weaken competitiveness.
* Balances client outcomes, architectural integrity, delivery feasibility, commercial sustainability and speed to market.
* Influences partners, pursuit leaders, SMEs, alliances, delivery executives and commercial stakeholders without relying on formal authority.
* Escalates material solution, delivery, contractual and financial risks with clear options and recommendations.

**Measures of success**

* Pursuit impact: Quality and competitiveness of strategic proposals; contribution to progression and wins.
* Client impact: Clarity of the story, executive confidence and alignment to measurable outcomes.
* Commercial quality: Accurate, traceable estimates and sustainable pricing with risks made explicit.
* Solution integrity: Integrated, scalable and deliverable solutions with clear ownership and dependencies.
* Execution discipline: Timely mobilisation, governance and high-quality outputs under pursuit deadlines.
* Capability uplift: Reusable assets, improved consistency and stronger solutioning maturity across the engine.

**Experience And Capabilities**

* Typically 15+ years of relevant experience in cyber consulting, solution architecture, pre-sales or managed services, with demonstrated leadership of large and complex pursuits.
* Proven ability to move fluently between executive business conversations, cyber architecture, operating model design and commercial/pricing discussions.
* Depth in at least one major cyber domain, combined with sufficient breadth to shape integrated solutions across multiple capabilities.
* Practical experience building bottom-up estimates, cost models and pricing inputs for managed services opportunities.

We’re looking for a client-facing AI Agent Engineer to design, integrate, and deploy enterprise-grade Voice and Chat AI agents and AI Copilots. This is a hands-on, delivery-focused role centered on bringing AI solutions to life within customer environments—not building foundational AI models.

You will work directly with customers to translate requirements into working solutions by configuring integrations, designing prompts and workflows, and deploying scalable AI agents. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys problem-solving across systems, working with APIs, and delivering real-world AI applications.

title: Space Systems Analyst
description:
**Role overview and responsibilities:**

Dhruva Space is seeking a Senior Space Systems Analyst to lead opportunity qualification, technical solution shaping, and proposal capture for satellite missions end to end. The role turns incomplete customer requirements into feasible technical solutions, defensible pricing, and winning proposals. Working across engineering, program management, finance, and legal, you will lead proposal pods, defend solutions to clients, and drive bids to secure contracts across space agencies, defense, and commercial sectors.

**Responsibilities include but are not limited to:**

* Assess incoming RFIs, RFPs, and customer enquiries for strategic fit and margin to deliver rigorous bid/no-bid recommendations.
* Translate customer mission requirements into feasible technical solutions mapped to Dhruva’s portfolio while flagging development gaps early.
* Run first-pass technical feasibility studies with documented assumptions and secure engineering sign-offs on critical subsystem trade-offs.
* Lead end-to-end proposal development, managing storyboarding, compliance matrices, SOWs, and technical volumes for on-time submission.
* Serve as the single accountable point of contact across engineering, program management, finance, legal, and regulatory stakeholders.
* Build defensible commercial pricing models, separating recurring costs from NRE, defining cost drivers, and setting milestone schedules.
* Structure contract terms in coordination with legal, establishing clear deliverables, acceptance criteria, liabilities, and IP rights.
* Lead technical clarifications, bid defenses, and formal solution presentations before customer engineering panels and executive leadership.
* Represent Dhruva Space at defense and aerospace trade shows, channeling competitor insight and customer demand back into the portfolio.
* Maintain and enhance proposal boilerplate, costing tools, SOPs, and post-bid debriefs while upholding strict CRM pipeline hygiene.

**Candidate requirements:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Aerospace, Space Systems, Electronics/Communications, Mechanical Engineering, or Physics.
* 6+ years of total professional experience, with at least 3 years in a customer-facing technical role such as proposals, solutions, or technical BD.
* Solid technical understanding of satellite subsystems, including structures, power, communications/RF, AOCS, and overall mission design.
* Exceptional written English communication skills to author concise executive summaries and technical bid volumes with minimal editing.
* Strong verbal presentation and defense skills with proven confidence addressing both technical panels and senior executive audiences.
* Demonstrated ability to handle multiple tight deadlines concurrently, turning incomplete customer requirements into structured proposals.
* Prior experience with space/defense procurement (ISRO, IN-SPACe, MoD/DRDO, ESA), export regulations (SCOMET, ITAR/EAR), or Incoterms.

title: Bids & Tenders Specialist
description:
**ABOUT US:**

Join a team that is redefining the accessibility of space. Azista space is a transformative force in the global aerospace sector, uniquely positioned at the intersection of indigenous innovation and industrial scalability. Operating India’s first private-sector satellite mass-production facility in Ahmedabad, we have bridged the gap between complex engineering and high-volume manufacturing.

As a vertically integrated leader, we provide end-to-end solutions from the precision design of satellite buses and advanced payloads to mission management and communication systems. We don’t just build hardware, we are democratizing the final frontier by providing global clientele with the cost-effective, high-performance technology needed to power the next generation of orbital missions. At Azista, you won't just be starting a job, you’ll be fuelling the future of space exploration.

**JOB SUMMARY:**

We are looking for a proactive, highly organized Bids & Tenders Specialist to own our end-to-end proposal engine. Based in Hyderabad, you will spearhead the complete bid management lifecycle for high-stakes aerospace and defense programs across domestic and international markets.

In this role, you will act as the critical bridge between Engineering, Finance, Legal, and Supply Chain teams to transform complex technical capabilities into fully compliant, winning proposals. You will directly impact Azista’s growth pipeline by tracking opportunities, mitigating compliance risks, and owning key metrics around bid accuracy, compliance rates, and win ratios for agencies like ISRO, DRDO, NASA, and Tier-1 aerospace contractors.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* **Opportunity Pipeline Tracking:**
  Actively monitor public procurement portals (GeM, CPPP, SAM.gov) and defense buyer networks to scout, evaluate, and present actionable RFPs, RFQs, and EOIs.
* **End-to-End Bid Management:**
  Drive the full proposal workflow—from initial query generation to final submission—ensuring strict adherence to technical, financial, and timeline requirements.
* **Cross-Functional Orchestration:**
  Collaborate with technical SMEs, Engineering, Legal, and Supply Chain to assemble robust technical compliance sheets, Basis of Estimates (BOE), and project schedules.
* **Commercial & Financial Assembly:**
  Prepare comprehensive commercial proposals, including price schedules, payment terms, EMDs, and Performance Bank Guarantees (PBG).
* **Regulatory & Compliance Governance:**
  Ensure rigorous compliance with international defense and quality standards, including ITAR, AS9100, FAR/DEFCON, and DAP/DPP guidelines.
* **Bid Asset Management:**
  Build, scale, and maintain a centralized proposal content library, including past performance certificates, standard responses, and capability matrices to streamline future bid cycles.

**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR?**

* **Education:**
  Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Aerospace, ECE, Industrial) or Business Administration.
* **Experience:**
  2+ years of direct experience managing bids, tenders, and RFPs within the Aerospace, Space, or Defense sectors.
* **Portal Expertise:**
  Proven experience navigating public procurement platforms (e.g., GeM, CPPP, DRDO/ISRO portals, SAM.gov).
* **Commercial Literacy:**
  Solid understanding of financial bid terms, including INCOTERMS, EMD, PBG, Liquidated Damages (LD), and cost structures.
* **Regulatory Knowledge:**
  Hands-on exposure to regulatory frameworks such as ITAR, AS9100, or DAP/DPP guidelines.
* **Tool Proficiency:**
  Advanced skills in MS Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and experience with ERP systems (e.g., SAP).

**NICE-TO-HAVE**

* Prior experience dealing with international defense procurement channels or Tier-1 global aerospace prime contractors.
* Formal certifications in Bid and Proposal Management (e.g., APMP).

**WHY JOIN US ?**

* **Pioneer Space Tech:**
  Work at the forefront of the new space movement and play a direct role in democratizing access to orbit.
* **Tangible Impact:**
  Your bids will directly win contracts for missions heading into low Earth orbit (LEO) and beyond.
* **Collaborative Culture:**
  Thrive in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment where engineering excellence meets entrepreneurial agile scale.
* **Career Growth:**
  Unmatched exposure to cross-functional operational leadership and global aerospace stakeholders.

Central access creation (Rate Contracts, registrations, listings, GTE and tenders) is owned by the Central Account Team; the incumbent facilitates that access at account level and converts it into procurement and reimbursed sales. Launch priority accounts are Army, CGHS and Railways, expanding to ESI, States, Autonomous institutes and PSU as the business scales. The unifying discipline is: Map deeply → Facilitate access → Shape protocol & biologic sequencing → Identify opportunity pool.
  
  
**Major Duties & Responsibilities**
In order of importance, briefly describe, in sentence form, the major responsibilities of this position as it exists today. Describe the job, not the person in the job. Each item should be a major responsibility, not a day-to-day activity. Typically no more than seven or eight major responsibilities ranked in order of highest percentage time to least.
  
  
**Approximate**
**Major Duties / Responsibilities**
Reimbursed Business Delivery & Tremfya Commercial Ownership
  
  

* Accountable for achieving Tremfya reimbursed sales targets (PSO, PsA and IBD SKUs) in assigned accounts, in line with the RB incentive plan
* Own the account outcome: grow account budget share and drive quarter-on-quarter reimbursed growth.
* Ensure accurate demand forecasting, order fulfilment coordination and timely account receivables in partnership with the Value and Supply teams.
* Map each account end-to-end — PsD / IBD patient pool, treating specialists, formulary and access status — and build a prioritized 360° launch account plan.
* Apply account-archetype logic: Army (early adoption / biologic leadership), CGHS (referral roadmap + formulary), Railways (scalable platform), ESI (future pathway), Autonomous / State (setting pathway and discussions for Franchise (Product promotion) & Medical Team for advocacy & protocol inclusion)

Facilitate Access & Navigate Reimbursement Pathways
  
  

* Facilitate the Value Team’s central access (Army RC, CGHS listing, Railway AMI/registration, GTE inclusion) at account level via account intelligence, documentation and ground follow-up — the KAM facilitates and utilises access.
* Navigate account-specific approval and procurement processes (e.g., Army MMF / PVMS, CGHS STC / non-STC, local-purchase routes) to minimise access-to-treatment timelines.

Value, Influence, Stakeholder Orchestration & Compliance
  
  

* Deliver the differential IL-23 value proposition vs IL-17 / anti-TNF competition, engage KOLs and government decision networks, and build advocacy for formulary and protocol inclusion .
* Act as cross-functional ‘quarterback’ across Medical, Franchise and Value; ensure ethical, compliant engagement and adherence to SOPs on tender interactions and HCC.

**Quality, Regulatory & Compliance (QRC) Responsibilities**
Describe important QRC responsibilities applicable for this job.
  
  

* Ensure all account and commercial activities comply with the J&J Credo, Health Care Compliance (HCC) policies, anti-bribery / anti-corruption standards and applicable local regulations.
* Adhere to SOPs on tender management, sales-achievement documentation, interactions with government officials and pharmacovigilance / adverse-event reporting requirements.

**Key Performance Indicators**
Primary measures of success for this position.
  
  

* Tremfya reimbursed business growth % and target achievement (PSO, PsA, IBD SKUs) vs. plan and vs. the incentive threshold.
* PsD / IBD accessible-pool conversion: eligible → treated patients, and account budget-share growth.
* New patient starts and patient continuation / persistence rates on Tremfya.
* Biologic-adoption progress: protocol inclusion, IL-23 share vs IL-17 / anti-TNF, and Stelara-to-Tremfya IBD upgradation.
* Access utilisation of Value-Team-secured RCs, listings and formulary inclusions (facilitation, not ownership).
* Quality of launch account plans, forecasting accuracy and KOL / stakeholder engagement.

**Functional Competencies**
Competencies (skills, knowledge and attributes) required to perform the job.
  
  

* Commercial / Target Delivery & Selling
* Biologic Adoption & Scientific Selling
* Strategic Account Management
* Access & Reimbursement Pathway Navigation
* Market & Policy Knowledge and Compliance
* Financial Acumen & Forecasting

**Behavioural Competencies**
Behavioural and leadership competencies required to perform the job (Leadership Imperatives).
  
  

* Collaboration and Partnering
* Influence and Impact
* Decision Making
* Customer & Patient Insights
* Change Management
* Ethical Conduct

**Key Working Relationships**
The most important working relationships inside and outside the company.
  
  
Internal
  
  
Value Team, Immunology Franchise, Medical Affairs (MAF), Market Access, Supply Chain, HCC and Finance teams.
  
  
External
  
  
Dermatologists, rheumatologists, gastroenterologists, KOLs, institutional decision-makers, government / scheme authorities, empanelled hospitals, distributors and service providers.

**Preferred Skills:**
Account Management, AI Judgement Integration, Business Behavior, Clinical Experience, Competitive Landscape, Cross-Functional Collaboration, Cultural Competence, Customer Centricity, Data Savvy, Developing Partnerships, Immunology, Market Knowledge, Pharmaceutical Industry, Pharmaceutical Sales Marketing, Problem Solving, Product Knowledge, Sales, Sales Enablement, Sales Trends, Strategic Sales Planning

* High levels of ownership, resilience, judgement, collaboration, and adaptability in a fast-growing, matrixed environment.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Management, or a related field; relevant advanced study or professional sales certification is advantageous.

**What We Offer:**

* The opportunity to shape commercial growth across India's major metropolitan markets and represent a differentiated GCC and workforce solutions portfolio.

* A collaborative, ambitious, and customer-led culture that values performance, ownership, innovation, and responsible use of technology.

title: Senior Solutions Architect
description:

Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

**An Overview Of This Role**
As a Senior Solutions Architect on GitLab's India team, you'll be a trusted advisor to prospects, customers, and partners across India. You'll help them understand how GitLab's AI-powered DevSecOps platform addresses technical requirements and business goals across the software development lifecycle. This role supports Commercial and Enterprise segments in India's Southern Region. Experience with Global Capability Centers (GCCs), Digital Native organizations, and startups is highly valued given the accounts you'll support.
  
  
You'll partner closely with Account Executives and cross-functional teams to own technical evaluations, including proofs of value and workshops, shape solution architectures, and bring customer feedback to Product Management. You'll also occasionally support regional go-to-market partners that provide Professional Services. Your work will help customers adopt GitLab successfully, support revenue growth through solution selling, and build long-term, trusted relationships.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Lead technical discovery, demonstrations, and validation to show how GitLab's AI-powered DevSecOps platform meets customers' technical and business needs across the software development lifecycle.
* Own the technical evaluation process, including solution design, proofs of concept or value, workshops, and technical contributions to tenders, audits, and value stream assessments.
* Collaborate with Account Executives and regional sales teams across Commercial and Enterprise segments to shape account strategies for new customer acquisition and expansion, with a focus on GCC, Digital Native, and startup accounts.
* Support regional go-to-market partners that provide Professional Services, helping them deliver consistent technical guidance and apply effective practices during partner-led engagements.

* Build trusted relationships with technical practitioners and business leaders, guide GitLab-driven transformation, and help customers become GitLab advocates.
* Advise customers on modern software development, continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD), security, and cloud practices to improve their return on investment.

The Solutions Architect team is part of GitLab's Sales organization and serves as the technical counterpart to Account Executives. This role focuses on Commercial and Enterprise opportunities across India's Southern Region and works with Account Executives, the broader go-to-market team, and regional partners that provide Professional Services. title: TC-CS-AD-Cyber LDE
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY GDS CYBER LARGE DEAL GROUP**
**Cyber Solutions Architect**
Pre-Sales | Client Storytelling | Commercial & Pricing | Turnkey Cyber Services
  
  
**Executive mandate to**
Shape and lead differentiated, executable and commercially compelling turnkey cyber services propositions for strategic pursuits, converting complex client priorities into a persuasive value story, integrated architecture, delivery model and price-to-win.
  
  
**The opportunity**
The Cyber Large Deal Engine brings together Business Case Researchers, Cyber Domain Specialists, Solution Architects, and Finance & Commercial Specialists to create an integrated deal-shaping capability, connecting client and market insight, deep cyber expertise, end-to-end solution architecture, and commercial modelling to build propositions that are differentiated, deliverable and positioned to win.
  
  
It is a senior pursuit leadership position for an architect who can operate credibly across the boardroom, the solution room and the commercial model. The role requires breadth across cyber domains, depth in at least one major cyber capability, and the judgement to integrate specialist inputs into one coherent, differentiated and deliverable proposition.
  
  
**Role Accountabilities**
**Lead strategic solutioning and pursuits**

* Own the solution from qualification and discovery through business case build out , architecture, proposal development, governance, oral presentation, negotiation and BAFO.
* Establish the solution strategy, win themes, design principles and response plan for complex RFPs, RFIs and proactive pursuits.
* Translate client requirements into an integrated managed services model spanning people, process, technology, governance, service management and transformation.
* Define scope, architecture, operating model, transition approach, delivery footprint, staffing model, service levels, assumptions, dependencies and risks.
* Mobilise and lead multidisciplinary contributors across domains and geographies, ensuring one solution, one story and one commercial position.

**Create a compelling customer story**

* Frame the client’s business context, cyber risk and operational challenge before presenting the solution.
* Convert technical complexity into an outcome-led narrative that is relevant to CISOs, CIOs, business executives and procurement leaders.
* Connect solution choices to measurable outcomes such as risk reduction, resilience, control effectiveness, experience, operational efficiency and cost transparency.
* Lead executive discovery sessions, workshops, whiteboarding, solution walkthroughs, oral pitches and solution-defence discussions.
* Anticipate objections and competitive alternatives, articulating clearly why the proposition is credible, differentiated, scalable and valuable.

**Own commercial solutioning and pricing**

* Translate the solution into a robust bottom-up cost model covering resource pyramids, effort, delivery locations, platforms, licences, transition and ongoing run costs.
* Work with finance and commercial teams to develop competitive, sustainable and traceable pricing, with clear linkage between scope, service levels, cost and price.
* Evaluate fixed-price, consumption-based, unit-based, outcome-aligned and hybrid charging models based on client context and risk allocation.
* Optimise the solution through automation, standardisation, global delivery leverage, right-shoring, reusable assets and platform choices without compromising outcomes.
* Understand margin drivers, contingencies, contractual dependencies and change levers; support commercial governance, negotiation, BAFO and renewal decisions.

**Architect integrated turnkey cyber services**

* Provide broad solution leadership across Identity and Access Management, Privileged Access Management, Customer IAM, Non-Human Identity, Threat Detection and Response, SOC, SIEM, SOAR, XDR, Vulnerability Management, Threat Intelligence and Threat Hunting.
* Bring familiarity with major platforms including SailPoint, Saviynt, Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, CyberArk, BeyondTrust, Delinea, Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender, Splunk and CrowdStrike.
* Design for cloud, on-premise and hybrid environments, integrating EY capabilities, alliance partners, technology vendors and client-retained responsibilities.
* Know when to make an architectural decision and when to engage a deep specialist, while retaining accountability for the integrity of the end-to-end solution.
* Position AI-enabled security operations, automation and platform-led delivery where they create a credible and measurable client advantage.

**Build repeatable deal-engine capability**

* Create and improve reference architectures, solution patterns, estimators, pricing models, proposal content, assumptions libraries and executive storytelling assets.
* Capture pursuit insights, commercial benchmarks and lessons learned to improve future speed, consistency and win quality.
* Coach solution contributors on structured solutioning, client storytelling, estimation discipline and executive presentation.

**Decision scope and influence**

* Recommends the end-to-end solution strategy, architecture, delivery model and commercial assumptions for assigned pursuits.
* Challenges requirements and design choices that reduce value, increase delivery risk or weaken competitiveness.
* Balances client outcomes, architectural integrity, delivery feasibility, commercial sustainability and speed to market.
* Influences partners, pursuit leaders, SMEs, alliances, delivery executives and commercial stakeholders without relying on formal authority.
* Escalates material solution, delivery, contractual and financial risks with clear options and recommendations.

**Measures of success**

* Pursuit impact: Quality and competitiveness of strategic proposals; contribution to progression and wins.
* Client impact: Clarity of the story, executive confidence and alignment to measurable outcomes.
* Commercial quality: Accurate, traceable estimates and sustainable pricing with risks made explicit.
* Solution integrity: Integrated, scalable and deliverable solutions with clear ownership and dependencies.
* Execution discipline: Timely mobilisation, governance and high-quality outputs under pursuit deadlines.
* Capability uplift: Reusable assets, improved consistency and stronger solutioning maturity across the engine.

**Experience And Capabilities**

* Typically 15+ years of relevant experience in cyber consulting, solution architecture, pre-sales or managed services, with demonstrated leadership of large and complex pursuits.
* Proven ability to move fluently between executive business conversations, cyber architecture, operating model design and commercial/pricing discussions.
* Depth in at least one major cyber domain, combined with sufficient breadth to shape integrated solutions across multiple capabilities.
* Practical experience building bottom-up estimates, cost models and pricing inputs for managed services opportunities.
* Exceptional customer presence, storytelling, writing, facilitation and presentation skills, including leadership of oral pitches and solution defence.
* Strong analytical judgement and the ability to make pragmatic trade-offs under ambiguity, commercial pressure and demanding deadlines.
* Experience working across distributed global teams and with alliance partners, technology vendors, finance, legal, risk and contracting stakeholders.
* Bachelor’s degree such as BTech/BE or equivalent; MCA or another relevant postgraduate qualification is advantageous.

**Preferred Credentials And Exposure**

* Relevant certifications in security architecture, IAM, cloud security, SIEM/SOC or major technology platforms.
* Experience in competitive deal shaping, transformation programmes, renewals and transition from incumbent providers.
* Experience creating reusable propositions, reference architectures, estimators or pricing assets.
* Working knowledge of regulatory, legal, compliance and contractual considerations for managed services.
* Ability to operate effectively with international stakeholders and support Europe and US working hours when required.

**Leadership profile**

* Client-first: listens before designing and anchors the proposition in the client’s priorities.
* Commercially astute: understands that the strongest architecture must also be executable, priceable and competitive.
* Persuasive: makes complex ideas simple and turns technical capability into business value.
* Integrative: creates alignment across specialists, geographies, partners and competing priorities.
* Accountable: owns the quality and integrity of the whole solution, not only an individual component.
* Composed under pressure: brings structure, pace and judgement to high-value pursuits with incomplete information.

**Why this role matters**
The Cyber Solutions Architect will directly influence the quality, differentiation and commercial strength of EY’s most strategic turnkey cyber services pursuits. The role offers the opportunity to shape major client transformations, work across leading technology ecosystems and build the repeatable solutioning capability of the Cyber Large Deal Engine.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

A Consultant/Manager/Analyst for Customer Data Platforms serves as the day-to-day marketing technology point of contact and helps our clients get value out of their investment into a Customer Data Platform (CDP) by developing a strategic roadmap focused on personalized activation. You will be working with a multidisciplinary team of Solution Architects, Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and Digital Marketers.

title: Senior Professional, Solutions Architect
description:
**Job Description**
The Solution Architect is responsible for designing technology solutions within the Solution Delivery function across a global engineering and professional services organisation of over 75,000 employees, as a member of a global team of Solution Architects.
  
  
The role designs solutions primarily in support of corporate functions, while also supporting engineering and digital fee-earning business areas where required. Solutions may range from SaaS platforms requiring integration with enterprise systems through to bespoke applications developed to meet WSP's specific business requirements.
  
  
The role converts business needs into secure, scalable, supportable and cost-effective designs, predominantly on Microsoft Azure, that align with Enterprise Architecture and WSP policy and are approved through the Cloud Design Review Board (CDRB).
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Requirements & Solution Design**

* Requirements Translation – Convert business needs into clear technical specifications, working with business stakeholders and analysts to understand requirements and constraints.
* End-to-End Solution Design – Create holistic designs across applications, data, integration, cloud, infrastructure, security and supporting IT services.
* Scalability & Performance – Design systems for growth, resilience and reliability.
* Integration & Data Movement – Define API, integration, data movement and orchestration patterns across applications, SaaS platforms and enterprise systems.
* Operational Design – Define monitoring, backup and disaster recovery, support handover to service management, and plan for lifecycle and decommissioning.

**Technology Selection & Cost Efficiency**

* Technology Selection – Recommend appropriate tools, platforms and services, evaluating SaaS, platform and bespoke options. Where appropriate, facilitate the commissioning of technology resources.
* Proof of Concept – Develop or direct proof-of-concepts to validate architecture, technology choices and solution feasibility before committing to delivery.
* Cost Efficiency – Optimise solutions for performance and cost, promoting reuse of existing platforms and patterns.
* Estimating & Costing – Produce build and running-cost estimates for solution options to support business cases and investment approval.

**Governance, Risk & Quality**

* Architectural Alignment – Align solutions with Enterprise Architecture and WSP Infrastructure and InfoSec policy. Take designs through CDRB approval, meeting the requirements of the cloud, security and workplace (Entra ID / directory services) teams, and keep delivery aligned with the approved design.
* Risk Mitigation – Apply Zero Trust and secure-by-design principles, and identify and design around technical risks, dependencies and architectural debt.
* Data Protection – Ensure designs meet GDPR and regional data protection and residency requirements, supporting data protection impact assessments where required.
* Quality Assurance – Ensure solutions are maintainable, secure and compliant through design and conformance reviews.
* Application Modernisation – Guide the transition of legacy applications to supported, cloud-native and maintainable architectures.

**Collaboration & Communication**

* Cross-Team Coordination – Liaise between business analysts, developers, testers, infrastructure, security, data, integration and service management teams to ensure designs are understood and delivered as intended.
* Documentation & Communication – Produce clear, consistent architecture documentation and communicate technical concepts, options and trade-offs to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Standards & Patterns – Support the Lead Solution Architect by contributing to Solution Architecture standards, reusable patterns and reference designs.
* AI-Assisted Delivery – Use AI tools to accelerate documentation, design options and proof-of-concepts, with appropriate architect review.

**Core Technical Skillset**

* Architecture: cloud-native, microservices, API and integration architecture, full-stack application layers (frontend, APIs, backend services, data), clean architecture, SaaS integration, application modernisation.
* Azure: Logic Apps, APIM, Functions, Service Bus, Data Factory, App Service/Container Apps, Azure SQL, Key Vault.
* Identity & Security: Entra ID, managed identity, OAuth/on-behalf-of, RBAC, Zero Trust, secrets management.
* Engineering & DevOps: .NET, REST API design, GitHub Actions CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code (Bicep/Terraform), Dev/Test/Prod environment strategy and promotion.
* AI: GitHub Copilot, responsible AI-assisted development and emerging technologies.

**Qualifications**
**Knowledge, Skills & Experience**
**Essential**

* 8+ years' experience in solution architecture or a senior technical design role.
* Proven end-to-end design of SaaS and bespoke solutions, from requirements to delivery.
* Strong Azure and .NET knowledge, including integration, security and modern delivery practices.
* Experience taking designs through formal design review boards.
* Ability to evaluate technologies on fit, cost, risk and scalability.
* Strong documentation, communication and stakeholder skills.

**Desirable**

* Experience within a global engineering, consulting or professional services organisation.
* Power Platform & Microsoft 365: Power Automate, Copilot Studio, SharePoint, Teams.
* Experience designing solutions for both corporate functions and fee-earning business areas.
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305) or other relevant architecture or cloud certifications.
* Awareness of AWS and/or Google Cloud.

**Key Expectations**
The successful candidate will:
  
  

* Deliver high-quality designs that consistently pass CDRB review first time.
* Act as a trusted technical partner to business stakeholders and delivery teams.
* Make design decisions and technology recommendations within the standards and governance set by the Solution Architecture function.
* Balance business outcomes, technical quality, risk and cost.
* Contribute to reuse, continuous improvement and knowledge sharing across the team.

title: Key Account Manager

**Key Account Manager – India**

Base.com is looking for a

to own our relationships with ecommerce brands across the country. You'll be the client's main point of contact from the day they sign. You'll lead onboarding, drive adoption after go-live, and grow each account over time. You'll work closely with our sales, implementation and support teams in India, and with product teams in Poland.

**Why Base.com?**

We're on a mission to become the global operating system for multichannel commerce. Over 30,000 companies use Base to manage orders, inventory, listings and workflows across marketplaces and storefronts. We offer 2000+ integrations, including Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, Shopify, Zoho, Tally, Shiprocket and Delhivery. We're headquartered in Poland with teams in 17 countries, and India is one of our fastest growing markets.

**What You'll Own & Drive**

* **Client Onboarding**

  : Run detailed requirement gathering with new clients after the deal is signed. Define scope, timelines and success metrics, and hand a clear plan to the implementation team.

  : Be the main point of contact for a portfolio of ecommerce brands, from founders to operations and finance teams.
* **Adoption & Value Delivery**

  : Make sure clients get full value from Base after go-live, including inventory sync, order processing, payment reconciliation and accounting integrations. Track and report the impact on their business.
* **Retention & Renewals**

  : Monitor account health, spot churn risks early and resolve them with the right internal teams. Own renewals for your portfolio.
* **Account Growth**

  : Find expansion opportunities such as new channels, warehouses, add-ons and higher volumes. Scope and price custom work.
* **Voice of the Customer**

  : Bring client feedback and India-specific requirements to our product teams.

**Who You Are**

* **Ecommerce Industry Experience (Mandatory)**

  : Prior experience in the Indian ecommerce industry is a must. This could be at a D2C brand, marketplace, 3PL, logistics provider or ecommerce SaaS company. Profiles without ecommerce experience will not be considered.

  : 3–6 years in key account management, customer success or client onboarding, ideally in B2B SaaS.
* **Operations Know-How**

  : You understand marketplaces, fulfilment, warehousing, returns, GST invoicing and payouts. You're comfortable discussing integrations and APIs, though no coding is required.
* **Commercial Mindset**

  : Confident leading renewal and upsell conversations and scoping paid work.
* **Multilingual Communicator**

  : Fluent in English (B2+), and at least one of Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Marathi, Gujarati or Bengali.
* **Bonus Points**

  : Experience with OMS or WMS or accounting tools.

**What's In It For You?**

* **Ownership**

  : Your own portfolio of growing ecommerce brands, end to end.
* **Remote-First, Freedom-Led**

  : Work independently with global peers and no micromanagement.
* **Influence the Product**

  : Your client insights shape what we build for India.
* **Long-Term Growth**

  : Join during hypergrowth and grow into leadership roles as we scale India.

**Ready to Build for India's Ecommerce Future?**

If you know Indian ecommerce and want to own client relationships end to end,
**apply now**

Your main responsibility will be to speak with families who contact the company for healthcare services, understand their requirements and help them book appointments with the right therapists.

This is a combination of healthcare sales, customer handling and appointment booking.

You will not have to do aggressive sales. The focus is on understanding people's needs, explaining the services and helping them choose the right support.

The company will provide training about Australian healthcare services and the NDIS system.

***Job Responsibilities***

* **Handle New Enquiries:**
  Contact new customers within 5 minutes of receiving an enquiry.
* **Understand Customer Needs:**
  Speak with patients, parents and families to understand their requirements and suggest suitable healthcare services.
* **Explain Services & Book Appointments:**
  Explain the company's services and NDIS funding, answer queries and book appointments with the right therapists.
* **Follow Up with Leads:**
  Follow up with interested and pending customers through calls, emails and messages to confirm appointments.
* **CRM Management:**
  Update customer details, call records, follow-ups and lead status in the CRM.
* **Appointment Coordination:**
  Coordinate with customers and therapists to schedule and confirm appointments.
* **Process Improvement:**
  Manage follow-up reminders and suggest ways to improve the calling and booking process.
* **Marketing Support:**
  Support the marketing team, track enquiries and bookings, and work towards monthly targets.

***Candidate Requirements***

* Educational background in healthcare, allied health, occupational therapy, psychology, speech therapy, nursing or a related field.
* Good spoken and written English communication skills.
* Confident in speaking over the phone with good listening and interpersonal skills.
* Patient, polite and comfortable interacting with patients and their families.
* Good organisational and time-management skills.
* Ability to handle multiple enquiries and regular follow-ups.
* Basic computer knowledge and willingness to learn CRM software.
* Experience in sales, telecalling, customer handling or appointment booking will be an added advantage.
* Knowledge of CRM tools like GoHighLevel, HubSpot or Zoho will be preferred.
* Basic marketing knowledge and experience working with Australian, UK or US clients will be an added advantage.

***Salary and Benefits***

* Fixed monthly salary plus performance-based incentives.
* Training on Australian healthcare services, NDIS and CRM software.
* Proper guidance and support to help you learn the role.
* Opportunity to work with an Australian company and international clients.
* Professional office environment.

description:
**Role Purpose:**

To manage and grow AVT's complete online business across marketplaces and quick-commerce platforms, with responsibility for sales achievement, product availability, assortment, listings, pricing, promotions, digital visibility, inventory, platform coordination and commercial performance. The position should be treated as a business and sales role, not merely an online coordination role.

**Key Job Functions:**

**1. Sales & Target Achievement:**
Own monthly and annual platform-wise sales targets. Monitor daily and weekly sales, identify gaps and implement corrective actions. Analyse performance by platform, city, brand, SKU and pack size.

**2. Marketplace Management – Amazon / Flipkart:**
Manage Seller/Vendor Central, listings, account coordination, platform campaigns, commercial issues, ratings/reviews and new-product activation.

**3. Quick-Commerce Management – Blinkit / Zepto / Instamart:**
Manage city-wise and dark-store-wise business performance. Track active stores, availability, assortment and sales. Ensure AVT expands into relevant new cities and dark stores as platforms grow.

**4. Availability & Stock-Out Control:**
Maintain high availability of priority AVT SKUs. Monitor OOS, inventory cover and replenishment requirements and coordinate with Supply Chain and distributors.

**5. Assortment & Range Expansion:**
Ensure the right AVT brands, SKUs and pack sizes are listed. Increase average SKUs per platform/dark store and identify opportunities for range expansion.

**6. Digital Shelf & Product Content:**
Maintain accurate product titles, images, descriptions, MRP, pack information and enhanced content. Improve search visibility and category ranking.

**7. Pricing & Promotions:**
Maintain approved pricing and monitor competitor prices. Execute coupons, discounts and platform campaigns within approved budgets and evaluate incremental sales and profitability.

**8. Platform Advertising & Visibility:**
Coordinate sponsored search, product advertising and platform visibility. Monitor ROAS/ACOS and ensure advertising expenditure produces measurable business results.

**9. New Product / New Market Launches:**
Ensure timely listing and activation of new AVT products. Identify new cities, platforms and dark stores and execute launch plans.

**10. Competition Tracking:**
Maintain a weekly competitor dashboard covering price, discounts, assortment, search position, availability, ratings, new launches and sponsored visibility.

**11. Inventory, Fill Rate & OTIF:**
Forecast requirements based on sales run rates, maintain adequate inventory, prevent promotion-related stock-outs and monitor fill rate and OTIF.

**12. Claims & Reconciliation:**
Track platform deductions, returns, shortages, claims and commercial settlements and coordinate with Finance for timely reconciliation.

**Primary Performance Outcomes:**

The role will ultimately be evaluated on four principal outcomes:

·      Sales Growth

·      Availability

·      Distribution & Assortment Expansion

·      Profitability

The executive is expected to function as the operational business owner for all assigned marketplace and quick-commerce platforms, with disciplined coordination across Marketing, Supply Chain, Finance and Sales.

title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:
Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many industries. We’re growing our Product Excitement team within the LCS (Lifetime Collaboration Software) division to elevate our brand presence. We’re seeking an energetic and creative Digital Marketing Manager who is passionate about storytelling, brand reputation, and building authentic connections with our customers and community.
  
  
In this role, you will lead our social media marketing for LCS reputational campaigns, spearhead customer advocacy and G2 peer review initiatives, manage blog publishing and WordPress updates, drive our internal newsletter, and orchestrate comprehensive communication plans for key projects.
  
  
This is a unique opportunity to shape the voice of our software, amplify customer success stories, and make a high-impact contribution to our digital footprint in a fast-paced, innovative environment.
