title: Customer Experience Engineer, L2
description:
HackerRank helps companies like NVIDIA, Amazon, and Microsoft hire and upskill the next generation of developers based on skills, not pedigree. Our platform is trusted by over 2,500 of the world’s most innovative companies to build strong engineering teams ready for what’s next.
  
  
Software has entered an era where humans and AI build side by side. As this shift accelerates, the definition of strong technical talent is changing. We give companies better ways to identify and invest in next-generation skills.
  
  
People at HackerRank care deeply about the impact of their work and sweat the small details so our customers can be wildly successful with products they genuinely love to use. We move with urgency and believe great outcomes come from high standards.
  
  
**About The Role**
Customer Experience Engineering is where customers, product, and engineering meet. As a CXE 2, you’ll be trusted to lead complex, ambiguous, high-risk, and enterprise customer problems end to end. You’ll design investigations where no playbook exists, connect behaviour across systems, make sound decisions under pressure, and hold the thread across customers, Engineering, Product, and GTM until the outcome is complete.
  
  
This is not a traditional Support role. CXE 2s do not wait for ‘level-appropriate’ tickets or hand work away after identifying a bug. You’ll share responsibility for one CXE queue, lead the situations where experience matters most, and convert recurring problems into tooling, AI-enabled workflows, product action, and prevention.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Lead complex, ambiguous, enterprise, solution-led, and escalated customer issues from investigation through resolution and trust-restoring closure.
* Design and execute investigations across web applications, APIs, integrations, authentication, data, logs, configurations, and system behaviour, even when no playbook exists.
* Resolve the majority of technical issues independently and engage Engineering only with clear evidence, reproduction steps, impact, and a strong technical hypothesis.
* Lead high-severity incident response and customer-facing RCAs, driving containment, stakeholder alignment, proactive communication, corrective action, and follow-through.
* Manage multiple concurrent priorities while protecting the health of the shared queue, service levels, and communication quality across shifts and regions.
* Use AI and coding tools to accelerate debugging, analyse patterns, build or maintain reliable agents and automations, and contribute lightweight code or tooling fixes.
* Turn recurring issues into adopted runbooks, onboarding improvements, evaluation loops, automation, product feedback, or Engineering action that reduces repeat work.
* Mentor CXE 1 engineers through pairing, reviews, and case debriefs; raise the team’s judgment without taking ownership away from them.
* Partner confidently with Engineering, Product, Customer Success, and Account teams, making important calls and keeping accountability clear during pressure.
* Participate in rotational shifts and on-call coverage, including occasional evenings or weekends, to support global customer needs.

**Who You Are**

* 3 to 7 years of experience in technical support, product support, solutions engineering, implementation, cloud support, software engineering, SDET, or a similar customer-facing technical role.
* Strong debugging depth across web applications, REST APIs, distributed integrations, logs, configurations, and customer workflows.
* Solid SQL skills and the ability to independently investigate data issues and validate platform behaviour.
* Working knowledge of SSO, SAML, OAuth, and common identity or integration failure modes.
* Hands-on coding ability in Python or a similar language; comfortable reading production code and creating scripts, automations, or lightweight fixes.
* Proven judgment in ambiguous or high-pressure situations, including prioritisation, incident response, and deciding when and how to involve other teams.
* Clear, precise, and empathetic communicator who can lead difficult calls, executive-visible updates, and multi-stakeholder customer moments.
* Strong ownership: you drive outcomes without being chased and remain accountable even when work crosses team boundaries.
* Open to rotational shifts and occasional on-call coverage across a global customer base.

**Even better if you have**

* Debugged ATS, HR-tech, developer-tooling, or other complex B2B SaaS integrations.
* Built production-quality internal tools, agents, or automations with measurable impact.
* Used AI coding tools such as Claude, Cursor, Copilot, or similar to debug, evaluate, automate, or build.
* Contributed fixes or improvements to a production codebase in a support, tooling, solutions, or software engineering context.

**You will thrive here if**

* You solve problems rather than route them and own outcomes rather than activity.
* You are calm under pressure and can turn a difficult customer moment into trust.
* You connect individual issues to broader product, reliability, and business context.
* You treat AI as a capability multiplier and care about making its output reliable, safe, and reusable.
* You raise the bar for the team through judgment, coaching, and systems that outlast the individual ticket.

* Experience working with global organizations and complex time-entry policies.

description:
**Role Description**
The Workstation Migration to Microsoft Intune Engineer is responsible for designing, planning, and executing the transition of enterprise workstations and laptops from legacy management platforms (such as on-premises SCCM/MECM, Active Directory Group Policies, or legacy MDMs) to a cloud-native, modern endpoint management model powered by Microsoft Intune and Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD). Looking for a candidate who is having experience of 8-12 years of experience. Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Assessment & Strategy: Audit existing workstation inventories, GPOs, SCCM workloads, security baselines, application packages, and driver dependencies.
* Architecture & Design: Design the target-state cloud endpoint architecture, including Windows Autopilot, Hybrid vs. Cloud-Native Entra Joins, Conditional Access policies, and Microsoft Defender integration.
* Migration Execution: Lead migration waves, cutovers, and zero-touch or touch-point workstation re-enrollments/re-imaging.
* Policy & Profile Translation: Convert legacy Active Directory GPOs and local scripts into modern Intune configuration profiles and compliance policies.
* Application Packaging & Deployment: Package, test, and deploy Win32 apps, Microsoft 365 Apps, and scripts via the Intune Company Portal.
* Automation & Scripting: Use PowerShell and Microsoft Graph API to automate pre-migration checks, migration tracking, and post-enrollment cleanups.
* Troubleshooting & Tier-3 Support: Resolve enrollment blocks, policy conflicts, BitLocker/TPM issues, and user data/profile migration anomalies.
* Documentation & Handover: Produce runbooks, transition guides, and operational training for helpdesk and L2/L3 support teams. Required Technical Skills & Qualifications
* Core Platform: Deep, hands-on experience with Microsoft Intune (Unified Endpoint Management / MDM).
* Identity & Security: Strong grasp of Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, Zero Trust frameworks, and Microsoft Defender for Endpoint.
* Provisioning & Deployment: Experience with Windows Autopilot, SCCM/MECM co-management, and tenant-attach strategies.
* Scripting: Proficiency in PowerShell scripting for endpoint automation and bulk configurations.
* Operating Systems: Windows 10/11 administration; multi-platform experience (macOS/iOS/Android) is often a strong plus.
* Certifications (Preferred):
* Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate (MD-102)
* Microsoft Certified: Security Operations Analyst Associate (SC-200)

**Skills**
Active Directory, Application Packaging, BitLocker

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. As a Senior Technical Support Engineer for Focused Services - XDR, you will be a dedicated partner to our customers, ensuring their success with our Cortex XDR products. This role is pivotal in managing escalations, performing root cause analysis, and collaborating with internal teams to drive swift resolutions and enhance the customer experience.

Facilitate comprehensive root cause investigations and manage the implementation of corrective and preventative measures to prevent future occurrences.
  
  
Proactively engage with customers to address Cortex XDR technical needs and provide escalation management for enterprise deployment issues.

Reproduce customer issues in a lab environment to assist developers in resolving technical challenges and provide timely product feedback.

Required Qualifications
  
  
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, a related technical field, equivalent military experience, or equivalent practical experience.
  
  
Relevant experience in a technical support, systems engineering, or similar role with a focus on customer service.
  
  
Demonstrated experience with endpoint security technologies such as XDR, SOAR, or SIEM.
  
  
Expertise in troubleshooting and debugging applications on Windows, Linux, and macOS operating systems.
  
  
Strong experience with Microsoft environments (SCCM, GPO, AD, MSSQL, IIS) and a fundamental understanding of malware and exploits.

Experience with bash or Python scripting for automation and analysis.
  
  
Knowledge of cloud infrastructure (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and VDI environments (e.g., VMware, Citrix).
  
  
Experience with additional security tools like Antivirus, DLP, IPS, and NAC.
  
  
Experience troubleshooting Android OS based applications.

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

**Job Title:**
Major Incident Management
  
  
**Location**
**:**
Bangalore
  
  
**Who We Are**
Unisys is a global information technology company that builds high-performance, security-centric solutions for the most digitally demanding businesses and governments on Earth. Unisys’ offerings include security software and services; digital transformation and workplace services; industry applications and services; and innovative software operating environments for high-intensity enterprise computing. Unisys builds better outcomes securely for its clients across the Government, Financial Services and Commercial markets. For more information, visit www.unisys.com.
  
  
**Our Vision:**
Enhancing people’s lives through secure, reliable advanced technology.
  
  
**Our Core Beliefs**

* Curiosity: We embrace the unknown and continuous learning.
* Creativity: We look past routine ways of doing things.
* Client-Centricity: Our clients’ success is our success.
* Integrity: We act ethically and honestly.

**Role Purpose**
Support Service Management transformation by analysing operational information, identifying improvement opportunities, developing practical automation and AI-enabled solutions, and assisting senior specialists with implementation. This role is intended for someone earlier in their career who has sound Service Management fundamentals, strong analytical ability, curiosity and the potential to develop into a transformation specialist.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Analysis and Improvement**

* Analyse incident, problem, change and service operational data to identify patterns, recurring issues and improvement opportunities.
* Support proactive Problem Management and service-improvement activities.
* Validate findings with Service Management practitioners, resolver teams and technical specialists.
* Help quantify the expected and realised impact of improvements.

**AI and Automation Support**

* Identify repetitive manual activities that may be suitable for automation.
* Use approved AI and productivity tools to accelerate analysis, reporting, documentation and operational activities.
* Support development and testing of simple ServiceNow workflows, Power Automate solutions, dashboards or similar automations.
* Document use cases, testing results, controls and user guidance.

**Service Management Delivery**

* Support Incident, Major Incident, Problem, Change and Continual Improvement activities as required.
* Assist senior specialists with process assessments and transformation initiatives.
* Maintain improvement actions, risks, decisions, dependencies and outcome tracking.
* Help ensure that operational learning is converted into practical actions rather than reporting alone.

**Technical Collaboration**

* Work alongside Cloud, Infrastructure, Application, Platform and Engineering teams.
* Learn how monitoring, events, logs, metrics and traces connect with Service Management processes.
* Support correlation of incidents with operational events, changes and technical data.
* Escalate data-quality, tooling or process gaps to the relevant workstream owner.

**Continuous Learning and Knowledge Sharing**

* Develop knowledge of AI, automation, Cloud, DevOps, SRE and observability concepts.
* Experiment with new approaches under appropriate guidance and controls.
* Create clear documentation and reusable analysis templates.
* Share successful solutions and lessons with other team members.

**You will be successful in this role if you have:**
**Experience And Skills**
**Must Have**

* Approximately 2-5 years of experience in IT Operations, Service Management or a related discipline.
* Working understanding of at least one area such as Incident, Major Incident, Problem or Change Management.
* Strong Excel or equivalent data-analysis capability.
* Good written communication, problem-solving and attention to detail.
* Ability to collaborate with Service Management and technical teams.
* Strong curiosity, learning agility and willingness to take ownership of assigned work.

**Should Have**

* Exposure to ServiceNow, Jira or a comparable ITSM platform.
* Basic understanding of Cloud or modern IT operations.
* Exposure to Microsoft Copilot, Claude or equivalent AI tools.
* Interest in automation, analytics or workflow improvement.

**Good to Have**

* Power BI or another visualisation platform.
* Power Automate or comparable workflow tools.
* Basic scripting or API awareness.
* Exposure to monitoring or observability tools.
* ITIL Foundation or equivalent knowledge; certification is not mandatory.

**Success Measures**

* Accurate analysis that leads to actionable improvement opportunities.
* Assigned automation, dashboard or improvement tasks completed to agreed quality.
* Clear documentation and reliable tracking of actions and outcomes.
* Demonstrated growth in Service Management, analytics and automation capability.
* Positive collaboration with senior specialists, operational teams and engineering stakeholders.

**Role Boundaries**
The role is not expected to arrive as a fully formed transformation consultant. The individual will work under guidance on larger initiatives while progressively taking ownership of analysis, automation and improvement deliverables. Coding and deep Cloud engineering expertise are not mandatory.

You coordinate remotely with the Morrisville-based Systems Administrator, GPU/AI Infrastructure, Network Engineer on shared standards, escalations, and cross-site incident response, and you provide secondary technical support back to Morrisville. The role sits within Lenovo SSG’s Hybrid Cloud and AI Infrastructure Services (HCAIS) Offering Architecture Engineering organization.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Infrastructure Deployment and Administration
  
  

* Network: deploy, support, and administer lab networking for the Bangalore site.
* Compute: deploy, support, and administer physical and virtual compute infrastructure across the Bangalore lab.
* Storage: deploy, support, and administer lab storage systems across block and file tiers.
* Operating Systems: install, patch, and administer operating systems across Bangalore lab infrastructure.

Hybrid Cloud Platform Administration
  
  

* VMware: deploy, support, and administer VMware virtualization infrastructure (vSphere, ESXi, vCenter).

title: People Technology Service and Experience Senior Product Specialist
description:
**Mott MacDonald**
is a global engineering, management, and development consultancy committed to delivering impactful work that shapes the future.
  
  
We are a team of over 20,000 experts working across the world in more than 50 countries.
  
  
We are proud to be part of an ever-changing global industry, delivering transformative work that’s defining our future. It’s our people who power that performance. As an employee-owned business, we invest in creating a space for everyone to feel safe and valued and empowered with the right tools and support.
  
  
Whether you want to pursue excellence in your specialism or broaden your experience with flexible roles across our business, you’ll be connected to a community of global experts championing you to be your best. Join us and shape your story with Mott MacDonald, where everyone has the opportunity to be
**brilliant**
.
  
  
**Job Description**
We are creating a new Group People Technology function to provide clear ownership, expertise and direction across the technology that supports our global People services.
  
  
The People Technology Service & Experience Senior Product Specialist will work with business stakeholders to understand service challenges, user needs and desired outcomes, translating these into practical, scalable and supportable digital solutions across the People Service & Experience portfolio.
  
  
Reporting to the People Technology Service & Experience Product Manager, you will collaborate with Project Managers, People teams, business regions, IT, technical specialists and external delivery partners. You will bring strong knowledge of ServiceNow, particularly HR Service Delivery, across capabilities such as case management, service catalogue, knowledge, self-service, lifecycle events and workflow automation.
  
  
This is a hands-on product delivery role. You will lead discovery and requirements workshops, challenge solution-led requests, shape service and functional designs, complete authorised configuration, coordinate testing and releases, investigate incidents and defects and deliver service improvements. You will also help design joined-up People services and lifecycle journeys involving other functions, while those functions remain responsible for their own services and activities.
  
  
You will maintain the configuration, design, testing, release and operational documentation required for governance, auditability, service continuity and future change. Through direct delivery, partner challenge, knowledge transfer and continuous learning, you will strengthen internal capability and reduce unnecessary reliance on external partners.
  
  
Although primarily aligned to People Service & Experience, you may support other People Technology domains where demand, resilience, holiday cover or development priorities require.
  
  
Key responsibilities
  

* Work with global, regional and functional stakeholders to understand service challenges, business problems, user needs and desired outcomes, ensuring discussions remain focused on the need rather than a predetermined technology solution.
* Lead discovery, requirements and solution-shaping workshops, translating business and service requirements into clear options, service designs, functional requirements, workflow designs and acceptance criteria.
* Act as a senior subject-matter specialist for ServiceNow HR Service Delivery, bringing strong platform knowledge, leading practices and service insight into business and delivery decisions.
* Deliver authorised ServiceNow configuration, administration, enhancements, workflow improvements and optimisation within agreed access, security, data-protection, change-control and segregation-of-duties requirements.
* Take ownership of assigned changes from discovery through design, configuration, testing, release, operational handover and early-life support, maintaining appropriate traceability, documentation and evidence throughout the lifecycle.
* Analyse People services, processes, user journeys, case-management requirements, service-catalogue structures, knowledge needs, workflows, roles, permissions and integrations to shape effective end-to-end solutions.
* Support the development of consistent global People services and ways of working, simplifying, standardising and automating processes while recognising legitimate regional and regulatory requirements.
* Configure and improve Employee Centre and digital service experiences, service-catalogue, case-management, knowledge, employee and manager self-service and workflow capabilities, including forms, record producers, routing, assignment, approvals, notifications, service levels and supporting metadata.
* Design and configure HRSD lifecycle events, coordinating with other functions where journeys include activities such as IT provisioning, identity and access, equipment, Security, Facilities, Learning or background screening, while those functions remain accountable for their own services.


+ Apply service-design, journey-mapping and experience-design practices to simplify employee and manager interactions and improve end-to-end service outcomes.
+ Assess incidents, defects, service issues, enhancements and optimisation opportunities, investigating root causes and recommending appropriate resolutions or improvements.
+ Coordinate functional, regression and user-acceptance testing and support product and vendor-release cycles, including impact assessment, business readiness, deployment, operational handover and post-release review.
+ Create and maintain configuration workbooks, requirements, service and functional designs, workflow and service-catalogue records, test evidence, release artefacts, operating procedures and product knowledge, ensuring documentation remains aligned to the live platform and supports auditability, continuity and future change.
+ Monitor product health, service and workflow performance, adoption and usability, identifying opportunities to improve configuration, simplify services, increase automation and deliver greater business value.
+ Work confidently with support and implementation partners, reviewing and constructively challenging designs, configuration, testing, documentation and delivery outputs, while ensuring effective knowledge transfer and reducing unnecessary partner dependency.
+ Maintain and develop relevant ServiceNow expertise through product learning, release awareness, practical delivery and appropriate certification, sharing knowledge to improve resilience across the team.
+ Contribute to the Service & Experience People Technology Community, working with regional stakeholders, super users and champions to gather insight, strengthen adoption and improve effective use of the portfolio.
+ Support the future development of colleague-listening and experience-management capabilities, including Qualtrics, translating feedback and journey insight into actionable service and product improvements.
+ Partner with the Foundation team and architecture, security, data, integration and Microsoft product teams to support effective integration between ServiceNow, SAP SuccessFactors, OpenText, Microsoft products and other enterprise technologies.
+ Support other People Technology domains where demand, resilience, holiday cover or development priorities require, while maintaining accountability for assigned Service & Experience responsibilities.

**Candidate Specification :**
**Essential**

* Strong hands-on experience with ServiceNow HR Service Delivery, including practical configuration, functional or service design, testing and controlled platform-change delivery.
* Strong understanding of HR service delivery, case management, service catalogues, knowledge management, employee and manager self-service, workflow automation, lifecycle events and related People services.
* Experience leading discovery, requirements and solution-shaping workshops, keeping stakeholders focused on business problems, service needs and desired outcomes rather than predetermined technology solutions.
* Ability to translate business and service requirements into clear service designs, functional requirements, workflow designs, configuration decisions and acceptance criteria.
* Experience taking ownership of ServiceNow changes from analysis and design through configuration, testing, release, operational handover and post-implementation review.
* Experience configuring and improving HRSD capabilities such as case management, record producers, service catalogues, forms, routing, assignment rules, workflows, notifications, approvals, knowledge and lifecycle events.
* Experience assessing incidents, defects, service issues, enhancements and optimisation opportunities, including impact analysis, root-cause investigation and recommendations, together with experience coordinating product and vendor-release cycles.
* Experience producing and maintaining configuration workbooks, functional and service designs, workflow documentation, service-catalogue records, test evidence, release artefacts, operating procedures and product knowledge.
* Confidence working with business stakeholders, Product Managers, Project Managers, technical specialists and third-party partners, including constructively challenging proposed designs, configuration, testing outputs and documentation.
* Ability to deliver authorised configuration and improvements while observing security, access, data-protection, change-control and segregation-of-duties requirements.
* Commitment to maintaining deep ServiceNow expertise through practical delivery, release awareness, relevant learning or certification and active knowledge sharing.
* Ability to contribute across adjacent People Technology capabilities when demand, resilience, holiday cover or development priorities require.

**Desirable**

* Experience configuring ServiceNow lifecycle events or orchestrating employee journeys involving People, IT, Security, Facilities, Learning, identity and access, equipment or background-screening activities.
* Experience designing or improving global service catalogues, service taxonomies, case-management models or knowledge-management frameworks.
* Experience applying service design, experience design, journey mapping, user-experience or human-centred-design practices to improve employee and manager services.
* Experience with Qualtrics or comparable colleague-listening, survey or experience-management platforms.
* Experience integrating ServiceNow with SAP SuccessFactors, OpenText, Microsoft products or other enterprise platforms.
* Experience delivering change through internal teams, blended delivery teams and partner-led arrangements.
* Experience supporting global People services while balancing global standards with regional, regulatory and operational requirements.
* Experience working with super users, champion networks, communities of practice or a People Technology Community to support feedback, knowledge sharing and adoption.
* Experience using agile, iterative or structured change and release-management practices.
* Experience contributing across multiple People Technology products, platforms or functional domains.

**Qualifications & Certifications: Desirable**
Product and Platform
  

* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator
* ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist: Human Resources
* Other relevant ServiceNow implementation, application-development or workflow certification
* Qualtrics or comparable experience-management certification

Service and Experience Design
  

* ITIL Foundation or higher certification
* Service-design qualification
* Journey-mapping, user-experience or human-centred-design qualification
* Knowledge-management qualification

**Flexible working**
At Mott MacDonald, we support our staff to create work-life balance which works for them and welcome candidates looking for career flexibility. We are open to discussing flexible working at interview stage.
  
  
**Our benefits package is designed to enhance your experience:**

* Agile working
* Critical illness and compassionate leave
* Paternity Leave
* Group term life insurance, and Group medical insurance coverage
* Career mobility options
* Short and Long-term global employment opportunities
* Global collaboration and knowledge sharing

**Employment Compliance Requirement**
As part of our global compliance requirements, all candidates must hold a valid Right to Work (RTW) document in India, which will be verified during the recruitment process.
  
  
**Acceptable documents include a Passport, Voter ID, or Birth Certificate.**
By applying, you
**confirm**
that you can provide valid documentation if and when required.

title: Hospital management system Support/ Implementation Analyst
description:
**Position Overview**

We are seeking a hands-on **HIMS Business & Implementation Analyst** to drive end-to-end implementation, workflow optimization, and ongoing client success for the **HIMS Platform**.

In this role, you will bridge the gap between clinical stakeholders and engineering teams. You will work directly with doctors, nurses, billers, and hospital administrators to translate complex operational needs into technical specifications, optimize clinical and administrative workflows, manage system rollouts, and ensure high user adoption.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Requirements Gathering & Workflow Optimization**

· Engage directly with healthcare staff (physicians, nursing, administrative, billing, and lab teams) to map clinical workflows and identify operational bottlenecks.

· Translate business and clinical requirements into technical specifications for the product and development teams.

· Propose tailored solutions using the HIMS Platform to streamline patient registration, appointment scheduling, billing, EHR management, and diagnostic machine integrations.

**2. End-to-End System Implementation**

· Lead the full system lifecycle—from pre-implementation setup and module configuration to data migration and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).

· Perform system testing, master data imports, and pre-go-live readiness checks.

· Ensure strict alignment with national/regional healthcare standards and regulations (such as HIPAA).

**3. Customer Support & SLA Management**

* Act as the escalation point for incoming customer support requests, software troubleshooting, and operational inquiries.
* Manage helpdesk ticketing operations, prioritizing incidents, conducting root cause analysis, and enforcing strict SLA resolution targets.
* Troubleshoot software bugs, database queries (SQL/MySQL), integration issues (biometric readers, lab analyzers, printers), and operational bottlenecks.
* Perform routine system health checks and coordinate regular software releases, feature updates, and patch deployments with client IT teams.

**4. Training, Change Management & Analytics**

* Design and execute tailored onboarding and training programs for both technical and non-technical healthcare personnel.
* Develop standard operating procedures (SOPs), user manuals, and standardized pre-implementation questionnaires.
* Analyze clinical, financial, and operational data to deliver actionable performance insights (e.g., patient wait times, bed utilization, support ticket trends) to hospital leadership.

**Qualifications & Education**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Healthcare Administration, Business Administration, Information Technology, Computer Science, or Bio-Medical Engineering.
* **Experience:** 3+ years of combined experience in HIS/HMS/EHR implementation, healthcare IT business analysis, and application technical support.

**Core Competencies & Technical Skills**

* **Domain & Operational Expertise:** In-depth knowledge of hospital operations (OPD, IPD, LIMS, RIS, HR/Payroll, Billing) and healthcare compliance.
* **Customer Support & Escalation Handling:** Proven track record in managing L2/L3 customer support, helpdesk ticketing tools, client SLAs, and customer retention strategies.
* **Technical & Database Proficiency:** Hands-on experience with SQL/relational databases, data migration, machine-to-software integrations, and biometric hardware setup.
* **Communication & Conflict Resolution:** High empathy and clear communication skills to effectively interface with hospital executives, doctors, and non-technical support staff under high-pressure scenarios.

**Interview Evaluation Criteria**

**Evaluation Pillar**

**Focus Areas & Key Competencies**

**1. Healthcare Operations & Workflows**

OPD/IPD flows, revenue cycle management, LIMS/RIS processes, hardware integrations, and regulatory standards.

**2. Implementation & Technical Analysis**

Requirements gathering, UAT management, SQL database queries, data migration logic, and technical gap analysis.

**3. Customer Support & SLA Operations**

Incident classification, root cause analysis, helpdesk management, SLA enforcement, and handling disgruntled clients during critical system outages.

**4. Communication & Leadership**

Executive reporting, change management, training non-technical clinical staff, and cross-functional team coordination.

title: Product Support Analyst (L2) – Client Support | UAT | Jira
description:
At EVERSANA, we are proud to be certified as a Great Place to Work across the globe. We’re fueled by our vision to create a healthier world. How? Our global team of more than 7,000 employees is committed to creating and delivering next-generation commercialization services to the life sciences industry. We are grounded in our cultural beliefs and serve more than 650 clients ranging from innovative biotech start-ups to established pharmaceutical companies. Our products, services and solutions help bring innovative therapies to market and support the patients who depend on them. Our jobs, skills and talents are unique, but together we make an impact every day. Join us!
  
  
Across our growing organization, we embrace diversity in backgrounds and experiences. Improving patient lives around the world is a priority, and we need people from all backgrounds and swaths of life to help build the future of the healthcare and the life sciences industry. We believe our people make all the difference in cultivating an inclusive culture that embraces our cultural beliefs. We are deliberate and self-reflective about the kind of team and culture we are building. We look for team members that are not only strong in their own aptitudes but also who care deeply about EVERSANA, our people, clients and most importantly, the patients we serve. We are EVERSANA.
  
  
**Job Description**
The purpose of the role “Product Support Analyst” is to provide functional Level 2 support to global customers for the application through different channels. The role will be responsible for issue analysis, coordination with internal cross-functional teams, testing, data validation, client communication, SLA adherence, and continuous process improvement.
  
  
The Product Support Analyst will also be expected to leverage AI and Generative AI tools responsibly and effectively to improve research, analysis, documentation, testing, process efficiency, and overall quality of deliverables.
  
  
**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**

* This role is focused on managing Level 2 support of the Product.
* Perform the first level of analysis after an issue or change is reported by the client and coordinate with internal cross-functional teams to drive resolution.
* Perform testing after bug fixes or changes in UAT/Pre-Production environments before Production deployment and/or client sign-off.
* Conduct smoke testing and sanity checks in Production environments.
* Continuously follow up with cross-functional teams to ensure tasks and bug fixes are completed within predefined SLAs.
* Act as an effective communicator and coordinator between internal teams and clients to ensure timely resolution and closure of issues.
* Interact directly with global clients through calls, emails, chats, and other communication channels.
* Ensure adherence to SLAs and drive timely closure of client requests, incidents, changes, and ad hoc requests.
* Perform data loads through ETL procedures and validate data accuracy and completeness.
* Analyze data, identify issues or trends, and support troubleshooting and resolution activities.
* Develop, document, and continuously improve business and support processes.
* Maintain a high standard of quality across all deliverables and client interactions.
* Proactively identify opportunities to improve support processes, efficiency, quality, and customer experience.
* Strive to generate strong customer satisfaction scores through effective communication, ownership, and timely resolution.

**Ai & Generative Ai Proficiency**
The candidate should be proficient in the responsible use of AI, Generative AI, and Large Language Model (LLM) tools to improve the speed, quality, accuracy, and efficiency of project and support-related work.
  
  
**This Includes The Ability To**

* Use AI/LLM tools for research, self-learning, issue investigation, root cause analysis, and understanding functional or business requirements.
* Use AI tools to assist in creating, editing, reviewing, and improving deliverables such as support documentation, incident summaries, root cause analysis documents, test scenarios, test scripts, test data, process documentation, status reports, client communications, and project assessments.
* Apply effective prompting techniques to obtain relevant and useful outputs while independently validating the accuracy and reliability of AI-generated information.
* Demonstrate sound judgment regarding what AI-generated content can be trusted, edited, escalated, or rejected.
* Validate AI-generated outputs for accuracy, completeness, consistency, and alignment with business and organizational standards.
* Understand and manage risks associated with AI usage, including data privacy, confidentiality, sensitive information, inaccurate outputs, and inappropriate use of customer or company data.
* Identify opportunities to use AI to automate or accelerate repetitive support, testing, documentation, analysis, and reporting activities.
* Have introductory-level experience or understanding of AI agents, agent-based workflows, or automation using AI, with the ability to contribute to the development or use of agents that improve team productivity, implementation timelines, quality, and efficiency.
* Demonstrate proven examples of using AI to deliver faster, more efficient, higher-quality, or higher-value outcomes.

**Qualifications**
**MINIMUM KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:**

* 5+ years of relevant experience in Product Support, Application Support, Business Analysis, or a similar client-facing support role.
* Experience working in client-facing roles and directly supporting international clients, preferably across US and/or European geographies.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to perform issue analysis, data interpretation, validation, and troubleshooting.
* Experience working with UAT, Pre-Production, and Production environments, including smoke testing and sanity testing.
* Experience creating or executing test scenarios, test scripts, and validating application changes.
* Strong understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and software release processes.
* Proficiency in using AI/Generative AI/LLM tools for research, analysis, documentation, testing, and productivity improvement, with the ability to validate outputs and manage associated risks.
* Ability to demonstrate good accuracy, judgment, risk management, and value creation when using AI tools.
* Strong proficiency in MS Excel, including data analysis, interpretation, validation, and functions such as VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP.
* Experience using ticketing and issue management tools such as JIRA, ServiceNow, or similar platforms.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong stakeholder management, coordination, and follow-up skills.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, SLA-driven environment and drive issues through to resolution.
* Proactive, detail-oriented, and result-oriented with strong time-management skills.
* Ability to work flexible hours, including European and/or US business hours.
* Ability to quickly learn new products, technologies, processes, and AI-enabled tools.
* Experience with chat support is preferred but not mandatory.
* Ability to maintain high levels of customer satisfaction through effective communication and service delivery.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* BE / BTech / ME / MTech / BCA / MCA / BCS / MCS or equivalent relevant experience.
* Experience using AI or Generative AI tools to improve support operations, testing, documentation, analysis, or process efficiency.
* Exposure to AI agents, agent-based workflows, AI automation, or building simple AI-enabled workflows is preferred.
* Experience identifying and implementing process improvements or automation initiatives.

**Additional Information**
**OUR CULTURAL BELIEFS:**
**Patient Minded**
I act with the patient’s best interest in mind.
  
  
**Client Delight**
I own every client experience and its impact on results.
  
  
**Take Action**
I am empowered and empower others to act now.
  
  
**Grow Talent**
I own my development and invest in the development of others.
  
  
**Win Together**
I passionately connect with anyone, anywhere, anytime to achieve results.
  
  
**Communication Matters**
I speak up to create transparent, thoughtful and timely dialogue.
  
  
**Embrace Diversity**
I create an environment of awareness and respect.
  
  
**Always Innovate**
I am bold and creative in everything I do.

title: Infrastructure Engineer

We are a FTSE100, global business of around 15,000 colleagues, based in 50 countries.

Our solutions have a real impact on lives across the planet, enabling industry, improving healthcare, enhancing security, advancing connectivity, and supporting new homes. Our products and services are often critical to our customers’ operations, while our proprietary technology and high service levels help create competitive advantage. We welcome colleagues with a curious mind, who are happy with responsibility, enjoy a challenge and are attracted by the idea of working at a business with an almost 170-year history of innovation, and four global divisions, all experts in their field.

As an Infrastructure Engineer, you will play a key role in maintaining and enhancing the technology services that support Smiths' global operations. Working across Infrastructure, Monitoring tools, Managed File Transfer (MFT) and Cloud technologies, you will help deliver reliable, secure and modern services for colleagues worldwide while contributing to technology improvement and transformation initiatives.

We are looking for a proactive individual who takes ownership, takes pride in delivering excellent service, and is motivated to identify opportunities to improve the user’s experience, resolve problems and help colleagues succeed.

* Proactively ensure high levels of systems and infrastructure availability
* Support and administer Microsoft infrastructure technologies, including Windows Server, Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Azure, and Azure Local (Azure Stack HCI).
* Troubleshoot end-to-end solutions spanning multiple Operating Systems, Cloud platforms, Monitoring and MFT technologies.
* Support and administer Microsoft operating systems, Hyper-V, AD, Azure and Azure Local (Azure Stack HCI)
* Perform Monitoring and MFT tools upgrades, patching, agent deployment, and platform maintenance activities.
* Onboard and manage Windows servers, applications, and infrastructure components within monitoring tools.
* Support the implementation and adoption of Smiths BIS standards
* Collaborate with colleagues across infrastructure, cloud, networking and service teams to deliver effective technology solutions.

**Qualifications**

**Technical Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:**

* Experience supporting Windows Server (Wintel), Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Azure, and Azure Local environments.
* Experience administering SolarWinds monitoring and Serv-U Managed File Transfer solutions.
* Knowledge of infrastructure monitoring, system administration, and operational support practices.
* Familiarity with ITIL processes and service management principles.
* Strong troubleshooting, communication, and collaboration skills
* Strong sense of ownership and accountability for delivering high-quality outcomes
* Proactive approach to identifying, investigating and resolving issues

**Planning and Decision Making:**

* Identify opportunities to enhance infrastructure services, processes and user experience
* Anticipate potential issues and take preventative action where possible
* Prioritise activities and issues effectively within a complex global environment
* Contribute ideas and recommendations that support continuous improvement and operational excellence
* Work collaboratively with internal teams and external partners to resolve problems and shape future technology direction

**Additional information**

**Impact and Scope:**

* Global scope supporting all Smiths divisions and business functions
* Contribute to the delivery of secure, reliable and high-performing technology services used by colleagues worldwide
* Support infrastructure services that enable business operations, productivity and growth across the organization

**Key Internal and External Relationships:**

* Demonstrate and promote Smiths Core Values: Customer Focus, Ownership, Integrity, Safety and Respect
* Build strong working relationships with Infrastructure Management, Service Management, Business Partnering and Infrastructure teams
* Collaborate with colleagues across technology functions to deliver reliable and effective services
* Maintain productive relationships with strategic vendors including AT&T and other third-party technology partners

At Smiths, our values guide everything we do. We act with integrity, always doing what’s right and holding ourselves accountable. We bring passion to our work, striving for excellence and innovation. Our customer focus drives us to deliver outstanding service and solutions. We take ownership of our actions and outcomes, working collaboratively to achieve shared goals. And we treat everyone with respect, fostering an inclusive and supportive environment where diverse perspectives are valued.

With colleagues stretching across the globe, we are proud of our diversity. To foster inclusivity, we run employee resource groups (ERGs) to provide a safe space for employees to connect and support each other. Our cross-business ERGs include Veterans, Pride Network, Black Employee Network, Women@Work Network, and Neurodiversity.

Across our company, we recognize excellence, culminating in the Smiths Excellence Awards, our annual celebration of the most extraordinary activities, people, and projects that best showcase our strengths and help drive our business forward. We announce these on our annual Smiths Day, a global celebration of Smiths around our network.

Join us for a great career with competitive compensation and benefits, while helping engineer a better future.

We believe that different perspectives and backgrounds are what make a company flourish. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment regardless of color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, economic status, disability, age, or any other legally protected characteristics. We are proud to be an inclusive company with values grounded in equality and ethics, where we celebrate, support, and embrace diversity.

title: IT Solutions Analyst (Universal Robots, Bangalore - India)
description:
The
**IT Solutions Analyst - ServiceNow**
is the functional and technical bridge between business stakeholders and the ServiceNow platform, responsible for designing, configuring, enhancing, and supporting solutions across Customer Service Management (CSM), Manufacturing Commercial Operations (MCO), and Sales and Order Management (SOM).
  
  
This role translates customer service, asset management, contracts management, and entitlement-related requirements into scalable ServiceNow workflows, custom applications, and integrations. The analyst partners with Sales, Field Service, Customer Care, Manufacturing, and other IT teams to improve customer experience, order accuracy, and service efficiency, and acts as a subject-matter expert and escalation point for production support. As part of the IT Enterprise Applications team, the analyst also designs and supports integrations between ServiceNow and other systems, including Salesforce, on-premise applications, and databases.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities****
**Requirements analysis and solution design**

* Gather, document, and refine business requirements through workshops, interviews, and process mapping with Sales, Customer Service, Manufacturing, and Finance stakeholders.
* Translate requirements into functional specifications, user stories with acceptance criteria, and solution designs aligned to ServiceNow best practices.
* Assess the impact of platform upgrades, new releases, and process changes, and recommend out-of-the-box (OOTB) approaches over customization where practical.

**Platform configuration and development**

* Configure and enhance CSM (case management, customer and account data, entitlements, SLAs, Customer Service Portal, Virtual Agent, knowledge management).
* Configure and enhance MCO and SOM (product and quote catalogs, order capture, decomposition and fulfillment orchestration, order tracking, and commercial and manufacturing operations workflows).
* Design and build custom scoped applications using Flow Designer, Workflow Studio, Business Rules, Script Includes, UI Policies, Client Scripts, UI Builder / Workspaces, and Service Portal.
* Build and maintain integrations between ServiceNow and Salesforce, on-premise applications, databases, ERP, PLM, MES, telephony, and other enterprise systems using REST/SOAP APIs, Integration Hub, MID Server, JDBC, and data import sets.
* Implement and tune ServiceNow AI features (Now Assist skills, AI Agents, Virtual Agent, AI Search, Build Agent) across CSM, MCO, and SOM processes, and measure their impact on case deflection, resolution time, and agent productivity.

**Testing, deployment, and release management**

* Develop test plans and test cases, execute functional and regression testing, and coordinate user acceptance testing (UAT).
* Manage update sets / application repository deployments across instances and follow established change, release, and source-control practices.
* Produce release notes, training materials, and knowledge articles, and support end-user and super-user training.

**Production support and continuous improvement**

* Provide Tier 2/3 support for CSM, MCO, and SOM, including incident triage, root-cause analysis, and permanent fixes within SLA targets.
* Monitor platform health, data quality, and performance, and proactively identify and close process or configuration gaps.
* Support platform upgrades, family release adoption, and technical debt reduction.
* Maintain solution documentation, data models, and process flows; contribute to the product backlog and sprint planning.

**Governance and collaboration**

* Work with architects, developers, and platform owners to uphold standards for security, ACLs, data governance, and compliance.
* Report on solution adoption and process KPIs (case resolution time, order cycle time, SLA attainment) using Performance Analytics and dashboards.
* Mentor junior analysts and share knowledge across the ServiceNow community of practice.

****All About You****
We seek individuals who share our passion and determination. Our commitment to customer success drives us to go the extra mile. If you’re ready to join us in this mission, take a closer look at the minimum criteria for the position.
  
  
****Education And Experience****

* Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5+ years of hands-on ServiceNow experience as a platform analyst, administrator, or developer, focused specifically on ServiceNow solutions.
* Demonstrated implementation and support experience in at least two of the three target modules: CSM, MCO, and SOM.
* Proven experience developing custom scoped applications on the ServiceNow platform, from requirements through deployment and support.
* Experience supporting production ServiceNow environments, including incident management, root-cause analysis, upgrades, and release cycles.

**ServiceNow certifications**
**Certification**
**Requirement**
ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA)
  
  
**Required**
ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist – Customer Service Management (CSM)
  
  
Optional (preferred)
  
  
ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist – Sales and Order Management (SOM)
  
  
Optional (preferred)
  
  
ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD)
  
  
**Required**
Candidates holding certifications in Manufacturing Commercial Operations (MCO) or comparable manufacturing-industry ServiceNow credentials will be given strong preference.
  
  
****Technical Skills****

* Strong working knowledge of ServiceNow data model, tables, ACLs, roles, and CMDB / Customer Service data structures.
* Proficiency with JavaScript (server-side and client-side), Glide APIs, Flow Designer, Workflow Studio, and scoped application development.
* Experience with integrations to Salesforce, on-premise applications, and databases (SQL, JDBC) using REST/SOAP, Integration Hub spokes, MID Server, and import sets / transform maps.
* Hands-on experience with ServiceNow AI capabilities, including Now Assist skills for CSM and SOM (case and order summarization, resolution notes, knowledge generation), Now Assist Virtual Agent, AI Search, and customizing skills with Now Assist Skill Kit (NASK).
* Working knowledge of agentic AI on the platform, including features available through the Australia release: building, configuring, and governing AI Agents and agentic workflows, selecting model providers (Now LLM Service or third-party models), and managing Now Assist administration, licensing tiers, and guardrails.
* Experience with Customer Service Portal, Service Portal, UI Builder, and Workspaces (Customer Service Workspace).
* Understanding of order-to-cash, quote-to-order, entitlement, and warranty / contract processes.
* Familiarity with Agile (Scrum / SAFe) delivery, user story writing, and tools such as ServiceNow Agile Development, Jira, or Azure DevOps.
* Ability to write functional specifications, test cases, and process documentation, and to present solutions to technical and non-technical audiences.

****Preferred Qualifications****

title: Technical Onboarding Engineer - IFS Logistics
description:
IFS is a billion-dollar revenue company with 7000+ employees on all continents. Our leading AI technology is the backbone of our award-winning enterprise software solutions, enabling our customers to be their best when it really matters–at the Moment of Service™. Our commitment to internal AI adoption has allowed us to stay at the forefront of technological advancements, ensuring our colleagues can unlock their creativity and productivity, and our solutions are always cutting-edge.

We help solve some of society’s greatest challenges, fostering a better future through our agility, collaboration, and trust.

We celebrate diversity and understand our responsibility to reflect the diverse world we work in. We are committed to promoting an inclusive workforce that fully represents the many different cultures, backgrounds, and viewpoints of our customers, our partners, and our communities. As a truly international company serving people from around the globe, we realize that our success is tantamount to the respect we have for those different points of view.

By joining our team, you will have the opportunity to be part of a
**global, diverse environment;**
you will be joining a
**winning team**
with a
**commitment to sustainability;**
and a company where we get things done so that you can
**make a positive impact**
on the world.

We’re looking for innovative and original thinkers to work in an environment where you can
**#MakeYourMoment**
so that we can help others make theirs. With the power of our AI-driven solutions, we empower our team to change the status quo and make a real difference.

If you want to change the status quo, we’ll help you make your moment. Join Team Purple. Join IFS.

**Job Description**

**About IFS Logistics**

IFS Logistics helps enterprise shippers connect transport data, manage carrier spend and automate execution. The product began as 7bridges and is now part of IFS, with a small team building and running it.

**The role**

We are hiring two Tech Onboarding Engineers for six-month fixed-term roles, starting as soon as possible. You will connect carriers and providers, bring customer data into the platform and help named customers reach production while the core squads continue building longer-term foundations.

The work is hands-on integration engineering. You will deal with ERP exports, shipment files, invoices, APIs and third-party feeds that are rarely as clean or stable as their documentation suggests.

The goal is not simply to process more onboarding work. When the same manual step appears repeatedly, you will turn it into a template, configuration option, self-service tool or well-defined product change. By the end of the contract, the platform should need less manual onboarding than it did when you joined.

This is a genuine six-month engagement with no implied permanent conversion.

**What you'll work on**

* Connect new carriers and providers through APIs and file feeds, including credentials, testing and go-live support.
* Map, clean and validate customer ERP exports, shipment files and invoices into our data model.
* Own onboarding tasks for named customers against clear delivery dates.
* Support the Product Operations team as they onboard customers and handle master data management.
* Diagnose failures involving authentication, pagination, rate limits, schema changes and poor source data.
* Convert repeated manual steps into reusable templates, configuration or self-service tooling.
* Document integrations and failure modes so the core squads can support them after the contract ends.

**Qualifications**

**What we're looking for**

* Around two to five years of hands-on software or integration engineering experience.
* Python and enough SQL to investigate data properly.
* Experience with REST APIs, authentication, pagination, retries and rate limits.
* Confidence working with inconsistent third-party data, including missing fields, changing schemas and bad encodings.
* A track record of automating repeated work rather than quietly absorbing it.
* The ability to run a technical working session with a customer's team and communicate data problems clearly.
* Regular use of AI coding tools such as Cursor or Claude, with a reliable process for checking output.
* The ability to organise your own work and become productive quickly in a time-boxed engagement.

**Nice to have**

* Logistics, freight, parcel or supply-chain data experience.
* BigQuery, dbt or comparable data-warehouse tooling.
* EDI or carrier and 3PL integrations.
* Previous onboarding or implementation engineering in a SaaS company.

**Tech stack**

Python and Django REST, TypeScript, Node and React; BigQuery, dbt, Cube Cloud and Superset; Pub/Sub and Datastream; GCP, Kubernetes, Terraform and GitLab CI/CD. We use Cursor and Claude for development, Notion for specifications and Jira for delivery.

**What success looks like in the first six months**

* The named customers assigned to you are live on time.
* New carrier and provider integrations are running with their known failure modes documented.
* At least two previously manual onboarding steps have become self-service or automated.
* The permanent squads have a clear, usable handover for every integration you owned.

**Why we're hiring now**

Customer and carrier onboarding demand is higher than the core squads can absorb while they improve the platform itself. These roles provide immediate delivery capacity and turn the lessons from current onboardings into better tooling for the next ones.

**Additional Information**

*We embrace flexibility and hybrid work opportunities to support diverse needs and lifestyles, while also valuing inclusive workplace experiences. By fostering a sense of community, we drive innovation, strengthen connections, and nurture belonging. Our commitment ensures you can work in a way that suits you best, while also engaging with colleagues to share ideas and build meaningful relationships.*

title: Customer Operations Manager
description:
**About Us**
At ANZ, we're shaping a world where people and communities thrive, driven by a common goal: to improve the financial wellbeing and sustainability of our millions of customers.
  
  
Join Business & Private Bank and help deliver our growth ambitions by backing Australian businesses and private clients with the insights, solutions and support they need to move forward. We play a critical role in delivering the ANZ 2030 Strategy and you’ll be part of a team guided by our values to put customers first, deliver with excellence, own the outcome and work as one.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Team Leader in Private Bank Service and Payments, you will lead team members who support Private Bank customers and relationship managers with everyday servicing and payment requests. You will organise the flow of work, maintain strong turnaround times and ensure requests are completed accurately and with the responsiveness expected in Private Bank.
  
  
The role works closely with relationship managers and operational partners to clarify requests, resolve issues and keep customers informed through the people who manage their relationship. You will coach the team, use performance and quality insights to improve delivery, and maintain disciplined controls across servicing and payments activity.
  
  
This role suits a hands-on people leader who understands the importance of pace, accuracy and clear communication, and who can build trusted working relationships while keeping the team focused on safe, consistent customer outcomes.
  
  
Role Location: Bengaluru
  
  
Role Type: Permanent
  
  
**What will your day look like?**
As a Team Leader - Private Bank Service and Payments, you will:
  
  

* Lead the day-to-day delivery of servicing and payment work, setting priorities and allocating capacity so requests are progressed within agreed timeframes.
* Coach team members to deliver accurate, responsive service and build confidence across Private Bank servicing processes, payment requirements and customer interactions.
* Use turnaround time, quality, workflow and contact data to identify pressure points, address performance issues and improve the consistency of service.
* Maintain strong relationships with Private Bank relationship managers, providing clear updates, resolving escalations and agreeing practical responses to urgent or complex customer needs.
* Oversee the quality and safe execution of payment activity, ensuring required checks, approvals and controls are completed and concerns are escalated promptly.
* Support operational excellence through clear daily rhythms, effective work management and disciplined follow-through on service, quality and risk actions.
* Identify recurring issues and lead improvements that reduce rework, simplify servicing and make it easier for relationship managers and customers to get timely support.
* Manage individual performance and development through regular feedback, quality conversations and coaching tailored to each team member's capability and responsibilities.

**What will you bring?**
To grow and be successful in this role, you will ideally bring:
  
  

* Experience leading people in banking operations, payments, customer servicing or a comparable service environment.
* Strong coaching skills and experience lifting individual performance, quality and confidence through practical feedback and support.
* Sound operational judgement, including the ability to prioritise time-sensitive work and respond calmly when customer needs or payment deadlines change.
* A strong focus on accuracy, process discipline and non-financial risk, with an understanding of the consequences of errors in customer servicing and payments.
* The ability to use service, workflow and quality data to guide decisions and hold constructive performance conversations.
* Confidence engaging with relationship managers and operational partners, including handling escalations and communicating progress clearly.
* Experience identifying root causes and making practical improvements that strengthen service and reduce avoidable effort.
* An inclusive leadership style that sets clear expectations, supports accountability and builds a reliable team environment.

**'Good To Have' Knowledge, Skills And Experience**

* Knowledge of Private Bank products, client service expectations and relationship-managed customer journeys.
* Experience with domestic or international payment processing, cut-off times, authorities and payment controls.
* Familiarity with operational workflow, case management or work queue systems.
* Exposure to operational excellence, continuous improvement or change implementation.
