title: Studio Head - Agency Operations
description:
**Job Description: Studio Head – Agency Operations**

**Company:**
BrandStory Group

**Location:**
Bengaluru

**Experience:**
10–15 Years

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time | Leadership Role

**Reporting To:**
Chief Executive Officer (CEO)

**About BrandStory**

BrandStory is an integrated digital marketing, creative and technology agency delivering solutions across Digital Marketing, Branding, Creative, Performance Marketing, SEO, Social Media, Content, Public Relations, Video Production and Technology.

With a multidisciplinary team and a diverse portfolio of clients, BrandStory operates at the intersection of strategy, creativity, technology and execution.

We are looking for an experienced Studio Head who can take complete ownership of the agency's day-to-day operations and build a high-performing, efficient and commercially accountable studio.

**Role Overview**

The Studio Head will be responsible for independently running the agency's operations, overseeing people, departments, production, delivery, resource utilisation, quality and operational profitability.

Reporting directly to the CEO, this is a senior leadership position that requires strong operational ownership, people management, commercial understanding and decision-making capabilities.

The role demands someone who can lead multidisciplinary teams, establish operational discipline, optimise resources, resolve challenges and ensure consistent delivery excellence across all agency functions.

The core mandate is to run the studio independently, ensuring the right people, processes and systems deliver the right outcomes—on time, at the expected quality and within approved budgets.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. End-to-End Studio Operations**

* Take complete ownership of the agency's day-to-day studio operations.
* Oversee the functioning of Creative, Design, Social Media, SEO, Performance Marketing, Content, Technology, Production, PR and other delivery functions.
* Ensure seamless coordination between departments, functional heads and Client Servicing teams.
* Establish clear operational priorities, production schedules and delivery commitments.
* Drive daily execution, workflow management and operational discipline.
* Independently resolve operational bottlenecks, competing priorities, resource challenges and internal escalations.
* Ensure the studio operates efficiently without continuous intervention from the CEO.
* Maintain operational readiness to support existing accounts, new projects and business growth.

**2. People Leadership & Performance Management**

* Lead department heads, team leads and cross-functional delivery teams.
* Establish clear reporting structures, ownership, responsibilities and accountability.
* Drive performance management, productivity reviews and corrective action plans.
* Work with HR on hiring requirements, talent development, retention and succession planning.
* Identify skill gaps, performance issues and organisational inefficiencies.
* Build a high-performance culture centred on ownership, collaboration, quality and speed.
* Manage internal conflicts and ensure effective coordination between departments.
* Develop capable team leaders who can independently manage their respective functions.

**3. Production Planning & Delivery Management**

* Own end-to-end delivery performance across client retainers, campaigns and projects.
* Ensure projects are planned, allocated, executed, reviewed and delivered within agreed timelines.
* Establish centralised production planning and project tracking.
* Ensure clear briefs, milestones, responsibilities and deadlines across all projects.
* Review critical delivery schedules and proactively manage delays or operational risks.
* Establish effective quality assurance and internal approval processes.
* Minimise avoidable revisions, production errors and missed commitments.
* Coordinate with Client Servicing teams to ensure delivery plans align with client expectations.
* Maintain consistent delivery standards across all departments.

**4. Resource Utilisation & Capacity Management**

* Own resource planning, allocation and utilisation across the studio.
* Monitor team bandwidth, workloads, productivity and available capacity.
* Ensure optimal deployment of talent across client accounts and projects.
* Identify underutilisation, resource overload and staffing inefficiencies.
* Balance workloads across teams to improve efficiency and delivery predictability.
* Plan hiring, freelance support and outsourcing requirements based on business demand.
* Align studio capacity with the agency's revenue pipeline and growth plans.
* Drive continuous improvement in productivity and output per resource.

**5. Studio Profitability & Commercial Efficiency**

* Take responsibility for the studio's operational profitability and cost efficiency.
* Monitor manpower costs, resource utilisation, delivery budgets and operating expenses.
* Ensure project execution remains aligned with approved budgets, retainers and scopes of work.
* Identify and control scope creep, unbilled efforts, excessive revisions and resource leakage.
* Work closely with Finance, Business and Account Management teams to protect delivery margins.
* Track estimated versus actual effort and costs across major projects.
* Evaluate opportunities for outsourcing, automation and operational cost optimisation.
* Improve studio profitability without compromising delivery quality or team effectiveness.
* Provide the CEO with regular visibility into operational costs, utilisation and profitability.

**6. Process Excellence, Systems & Automation**

* Develop, implement and continuously improve studio-wide standard operating procedures.
* Establish structured processes for briefs, task allocation, production, reviews, approvals and delivery.
* Ensure effective adoption of project management, resource planning and reporting systems.
* Build operational dashboards providing real-time visibility into projects, resources and deadlines.
* Identify opportunities to implement AI, automation and productivity-enhancing technologies.
* Eliminate unnecessary handoffs, duplicated work and inefficient coordination.
* Establish escalation mechanisms and accountability frameworks.
* Build scalable processes that support agency growth while maintaining operational efficiency.

**7. Quality Control & Client Delivery Excellence**

* Ensure all client-facing deliverables meet the agency's standards for quality, accuracy and professionalism.
* Establish quality-control checkpoints across departments.
* Work with functional heads to maintain creative, technical and execution standards.
* Coordinate with Account Management teams to ensure client commitments are consistently fulfilled.
* Manage critical delivery escalations and implement timely corrective actions.
* Monitor revision cycles, client feedback and recurring quality concerns.
* Reduce preventable client escalations and delivery-related dissatisfaction.
* Ensure operational excellence contributes to improved client satisfaction and retention.

**8. Cross-Functional Leadership & Business Alignment**

* Act as the central operational leader connecting all studio departments.
* Work with Business Development and Client Servicing teams to assess delivery capacity for new accounts.
* Ensure a structured transition from sales commitments to project execution.
* Evaluate resource requirements, implementation timelines and operational feasibility for new projects.
* Coordinate with Finance and HR on manpower planning, budgets and organisational requirements.
* Support the CEO in translating business growth objectives into operational plans.
* Ensure departmental priorities remain aligned with overall business objectives.

**9. CEO Reporting & Operational Governance**

* Report directly to the CEO on studio performance, delivery, people, productivity and operational profitability.
* Establish and manage daily, weekly and monthly operational review mechanisms.
* Maintain a central studio performance dashboard.
* Conduct structured reviews with department heads and functional leaders.
* Provide regular reporting on:
* Project delivery status and upcoming commitments.
* Resource utilisation and capacity availability.
* Department-wise productivity and performance.
* Studio costs, effort overruns and profitability.
* Quality concerns, revisions and client escalations.
* Staffing requirements and capability gaps.
* Operational risks and corrective actions.
* Take independent operational decisions within defined authority levels.
* Escalate only strategic, financial or business-critical matters requiring CEO intervention.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* **Studio Operations:**
  Ensure smooth, efficient and independent day-to-day functioning of the studio with minimal CEO intervention.
* **On-Time Delivery:**
  Achieve 95%+ adherence to committed project and campaign delivery timelines.
* **Resource Utilisation:**
  Maintain 75–85% productive utilisation across teams, adjusted by role and function.
* **Studio Profitability:**
  Maintain delivery costs and project margins within approved budgets and profitability targets.
* **Team Productivity:**
  Drive measurable improvements in individual, departmental and overall studio productivity.
* **Quality Control:**
  Reduce avoidable revisions, production errors and delivery-related quality issues.
* **People Management:**
  Ensure strong team accountability, performance management, talent retention and leadership development.
* **Project Visibility:**
  Maintain 100% visibility into active projects, workloads, ownership, timelines and delivery status.
* **Process Compliance:**
  Ensure consistent adoption of standardised workflows, SOPs and operational systems.
* **Client Escalations:**
  Minimise preventable client escalations arising from delivery delays, quality concerns or coordination gaps.
* **Cost Optimisation:**
  Improve operational efficiency through effective resource allocation, outsourcing, automation and cost management.
* **Operational Scalability:**
  Support business and revenue growth without proportionate increases in manpower and operating costs.
* **CEO Dependency:**
  Independently resolve routine operational challenges and escalate only strategic or business-critical decisions.

**Candidate Requirements**

**Professional Experience**

* 10–15 years of experience in a digital marketing, creative, advertising or integrated marketing agency.
* Minimum 5 years in a senior studio management, agency operations, delivery leadership or comparable role.
* Proven experience managing large, multidisciplinary agency teams, preferably within organisations of 75–150+ employees.
* Demonstrated ability to independently run daily agency operations across multiple departments.
* Strong understanding of creative production, digital marketing, campaign management, technology and integrated service delivery.
* Experience managing multiple client accounts, retainers, projects and production pipelines simultaneously.
* Hands-on experience in resource planning, operational budgeting, cost optimisation and delivery profitability.
* Experience implementing process improvements, productivity systems and operational transformation.
* Familiarity with project management platforms, workflow automation and AI-enabled productivity tools.

**Essential Leadership Competencies**

* **Operational Ownership:**
  Ability to take complete responsibility for studio performance and independently manage daily operations.
* **People Leadership:**
  Strong capability to lead department heads, manage multidisciplinary teams and drive accountability.
* **Commercial Acumen:**
  Understanding of agency economics, resource utilisation, delivery costs, project margins and profitability.
* **Execution Excellence:**
  Ability to translate business commitments into structured execution plans and measurable outcomes.
* **Decision-Making:**
  Confidence to independently resolve operational challenges, resource conflicts and delivery priorities.
* **Process Orientation:**
  Ability to establish scalable systems and operating discipline without introducing unnecessary bureaucracy.
* **Problem-Solving:**
  Proactive identification of bottlenecks and implementation of sustainable corrective measures.
* **Technology Orientation:**
  Ability to leverage automation, AI and workflow platforms to improve efficiency.
* **Communication:**
  Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage effectively with the CEO, department heads and cross-functional teams.

**First 90-Day Expectations**

**First 30 Days – Operational Assessment & Ownership**

* Understand the agency's structure, teams, workflows and delivery commitments.
* Assess resource utilisation, team capabilities and existing operational challenges.
* Establish clear daily operational governance and reporting mechanisms.
* Identify delivery bottlenecks, process gaps and immediate improvement opportunities.
* Assume ownership of routine studio decisions and execution management.

**Days 31–60 – Operational Discipline & Performance Control**

* Implement structured production planning and resource allocation.
* Standardise key workflows, reporting systems and escalation mechanisms.
* Establish department-wise productivity, quality and delivery metrics.
* Improve coordination between departments and Client Servicing teams.
* Introduce regular utilisation, delivery and profitability reviews.
* Address recurring operational inefficiencies and performance issues.

**Days 61–90 – Performance Improvement & Scalability**

* Demonstrate measurable improvements in delivery predictability and efficiency.
* Optimise resource utilisation and workload distribution.
* Establish stronger quality assurance and operational accountability.
* Improve visibility into studio costs, productivity and profitability.
* Reduce CEO dependency for day-to-day studio management.
* Present a six-month roadmap for operational optimisation, productivity improvement and scalability.

**What We Are Looking For**

We are looking for a hands-on, decisive and commercially aware studio leader who can take charge of a fast-moving agency environment.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable managing people, making operational decisions, resolving challenges and driving results across multiple functions.

The candidate must understand that running a successful agency studio requires more than project tracking or task coordination. It requires ownership of people, performance, productivity, profitability and delivery excellence.

This is not a conventional Project Manager, Traffic Manager or Administrative Operations role.

It is a senior leadership position with direct accountability to the CEO for the operational performance of the agency.

Success in this role means building and running a studio that delivers consistently, operates profitably, scales efficiently and functions independently—allowing the CEO to focus on business growth, strategic relationships and long-term organisational direction.

Management reporting, business partnering and decision support. Process excellence, financial controls, compliance, automation and analytics. Strong experience in R2R, P2P, O2C, financial reporting, reconciliations, budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis and financial modelling. Ability to manage end-to-end operations, interpret financial performance, engage senior stakeholders, lead teams, strengthen controls and deliver process improvements. Roles and Responsibilities:

* Ensure accurate financial reporting, compliance with accounting standards and effective financial controls.
* Analyse revenue, costs, margins, variances, risks and performance trends.

* Partner with business leaders and cross-functional stakeholders to resolve financial and operational issues.
* Drive process standardization, automation and continuous improvement.

* Prepare executive reports and presentations.

title: Supply Chain Manager
description:
The Essentials

* A graduate degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Operations, or a related discipline
* A Postgraduate Diploma in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Materials Management, or a similar stream. This one is a requirement, not a preference
* 1 to 2 years of relevant experience in supply chain, procurement, materials management, or inventory operations

**About Aurm**

**Aurm is building India’s first 24x7 smart, secure locker infrastructure for residential communities. Founded by Armed Forces veterans and the creators of MyGate, we’re already live in communities across the country and growing fast. You’d be joining at a stage where the product has real traction.**

**The Role**

**We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Supply Chain Manager to manage end-to-end supply chain operations, including procurement, vendor development, inventory control, warehouse management, and coordination with production and deployment teams. The role requires strong planning, negotiation, analytical, and coordination skills to ensure material availability, cost efficiency, and timely delivery.**

**What You’ll Do**

* Procurement and vendor management: manage purchase orders, vendor sourcing, negotiations, and supplier performance
* Inventory management: maintain accurate stock records, monitor stock levels, and prevent shortages or excess inventory
* Material planning: coordinate with production and operations teams to ensure timely material availability as per BOM requirements
* Logistics and order fulfilment: manage domestic and international shipments, and coordinate with suppliers, freight forwarders, customs agents, and transporters to ensure timely delivery, proper documentation, and cost-effective logistics
* Cost and process optimization: identify cost-saving opportunities and improve supply chain processes
* Reporting and coordination: maintain procurement and inventory reports, and coordinate with internal teams and suppliers

**What We’re Looking For**

* Good understanding of procurement, inventory management, warehouse operations, and logistics
* Strong vendor negotiation and relationship management skills
* Working knowledge of BOMs, material planning, stock reconciliation, and inventory valuation
* Proficiency in MS Excel or Google Sheets, and ERP or inventory management tools
* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving abilities
* Effective communication and coordination across procurement, production, engineering, finance, and operations teams
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet delivery timelines
* Experience in manufacturing, electronics, industrial automation or technology-driven organizations will be an added advantage

title: Associate Director - Global Real Estate Services Operations Lead
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Associate Director - Global Real Estate Services Operations Lead**
**The opportunity**
EY's Real Estate Services (RES) team is responsible for enabling one of the world's largest corporate real estate portfolios, supporting approximately 440,000 professionals across more than 2.3 million square meters of office space and delivering approximately 300 real estate projects annually across the globe.
  
  
The Global Real Estate Services Operations Lead is a strategic leadership role responsible for driving operational excellence, service delivery, transformation, technology enablement and governance across EY's global real estate function. As a member of the Real Estate Services Leadership Team, this individual will lead the operational framework, systems, processes and teams that support the effective delivery of real estate services globally.
  
  
This role will play a critical part in shaping the future operating model of Global Real Estate Services through the adoption of advanced technologies, automation, AI-enabled capabilities, data-driven decision making and continuous improvement initiatives.
  
  
The successful candidate will bring a combination of operational leadership, global stakeholder management, technology enablement, financial management and change leadership experience within complex, multinational environments.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Global Operations Leadership

+ Lead the operational strategy and execution framework supporting EY's global real estate portfolio.
+ Establish and maintain global operating standards, governance structures and service delivery models.
+ Drive consistency, scalability and operational excellence across Real Estate Services functions.
+ Partner closely with Real Estate Leaders, Procurement, Finance, Technology, Risk, Legal, Security and Talent teams to ensure aligned and efficient service delivery.
+ Monitor operational performance and implement corrective actions to continuously improve delivery outcomes.

* Transformation, Innovation and AI

+ Lead strategic transformation initiatives across the global RES organization.
+ Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize and automate processes.
+ Drive the implementation and adoption of emerging technologies, including AI, automation and advanced analytics.
+ Develop operational roadmaps that support future workplace, real estate and business strategies.
+ Champion innovation and promote a culture of continuous improvement.

* Data, Analytics and Business Insights

+ Own the development and delivery of operational reporting and performance management frameworks.
+ Provide executive-level reporting, insights and recommendations to support strategic decision making.
+ Support scenario planning and portfolio analysis supporting optimization, efficiency and cost management objectives.
+ Develop KPI and service performance frameworks that measure operational effectiveness and business value.

* Technology and Systems Management

+ Provide leadership and oversight for key operational platforms including TRIRIGA, SAP, Ariba and related technologies.
+ Drive data quality, governance and reporting excellence across the global portfolio.
+ Partner with technology teams to optimize existing platforms and evaluate future capabilities.
+ Ensure operational systems effectively support business requirements and strategic objectives.

* Financial and Commercial Management

+ Support the development and management of the global RES operating budget.
+ Oversee operational financial performance, forecasting and reporting activities.
+ Drive cost optimization initiatives while maintaining service quality and business outcomes.
+ Support governance of chargeback, allocation and cost recovery processes where applicable.

* Service Provider Management

+ Provide operational oversight of strategic third-party service providers supporting the RES function.
+ Establish and monitor service level agreements, operational metrics and performance standards.
+ Build strong partnerships with external providers to drive innovation, value creation and continuous improvement.
+ Ensure alignment with EY procurement, risk and compliance standards.

* People Leadership

+ Lead and develop a globally dispersed operations team across EY Global Delivery Services locations.
+ Create a high-performance culture focused on collaboration, accountability, innovation and continuous learning.
+ Provide leadership for talent attraction, succession planning, coaching and professional development.
+ Build organizational capabilities that support the long-term evolution of the global RES function.

* Stakeholder Management

+ Serve as a trusted advisor to senior leaders across EY.
+ Act as the primary operational point of contact for global Real Estate Services matters.
+ Build productive relationships across Finance, Technology, Talent, Risk Management, Legal, Security, Procurement and Workplace functions.
+ Influence strategic decisions through strong business acumen, data-driven insights and collaborative leadership.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strategic thinker with strong operational execution capabilities.
* Proven ability to lead within highly matrixed global organizations.
* Strong business, financial and commercial acumen.
* Exceptional communication and executive stakeholder management skills.
* Demonstrated ability to lead large-scale transformation and change initiatives.
* Experience implementing automation, digital transformation and AI-enabled solutions.
* Ability to influence outcomes without direct authority.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
* Collaborative, adaptable and resilient leadership style.
* Commitment to innovation, service excellence and continuous improvement.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Real Estate, Facilities Management, Engineering, Finance or a related field.
* Minimum 12 years of relevant experience in corporate real estate, workplace services, facilities management, operations management or related functions.
* Minimum 5 years of leadership experience managing regional or global teams.
* Experience operating in multinational, matrixed organizations.
* Experience leading operational transformation, process improvement and organizational change initiatives.
* Strong understanding of corporate real estate operations, lease administration, portfolio management and workplace services.
* Experience with enterprise platforms and operational systems such as TRIRIGA, SAP, Ariba or comparable solutions.
* Strong financial planning, budgeting and reporting experience.

**Ideally, you'll also have**

* Experience working within a Global Business Services (GBS) or Global Delivery Services (GDS) environment.
* Experience supporting large global property portfolios.
* Knowledge of lease management, lease accounting and portfolio analytics.
* Experience managing outsourced service providers and global consulting partners.
* Knowledge of workplace strategy, facilities management and capital project delivery.

**Professional Certifications (Preferred)**
One or more of the following certifications would be advantageous:
  
  

* RICS
* MCR or SLCR
* PMP or PRINCE2
* CFM
* IFMA certifications
* Lean Six Sigma
* Prosci Change Management Certification

**What We Offer**
This is an opportunity to join the leadership team of a globally recognized professional services organization and help shape the future of workplace, real estate operations and service delivery at scale. You will work with senior leaders across the organization, influence strategic decisions and lead transformational initiatives that impact EY professionals around the world.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Director – SAP Delivery and Support Services
description:
Sandisk understands how people and businesses consume data and we relentlessly innovate to deliver solutions that enable today’s needs and tomorrow’s next big ideas. With a rich history of groundbreaking innovations in Flash and advanced memory technologies, our solutions have become the beating heart of the digital world we’re living in and that we have the power to shape.
  
  
Sandisk meets people and businesses at the intersection of their aspirations and the moment, enabling them to keep moving and pushing possibility forward. We do this through the balance of our powerhouse manufacturing capabilities and our industry-leading portfolio of products that are recognized globally for innovation, performance and quality.
  
  
Sandisk has two facilities recognized by the World Economic Forum as part of the Global Lighthouse Network for advanced 4IR innovations. These facilities were also recognized as Sustainability Lighthouses for breakthroughs in efficient operations. With our global reach, we ensure the global supply chain has access to the Flash memory it needs to keep our world moving forward.
  
  
**Description**
Sandisk is seeking a Director – SAP Delivery and Support Services, based in India, to build and lead our offshore SAP delivery factory and to own application support for the global SAP estate. Reporting to the Senior Director – ERP, this leader will stand up a scalable configuration and development capability in India, direct vendor-delivered Application Managed Services (AMS) teams, and establish the service levels, governance, and engineering standards that keep SAP stable while major transformation programs are underway. This is a build role: the successful candidate will create the capability, not inherit it.
  
  
**Essential Job Duties And Responsibilities**
**Leadership & Strategic Management**

* Lead and grow the India-based SAP delivery and support organization, combining Sandisk employees, contract resources, and vendor-managed service partners into a single accountable operating unit.
* Define and own the offshore delivery strategy, including the target operating model, capability build sequence, location strategy, and the balance between retained core roles and flexible vendor capacity.
* Serve as the senior Sandisk IT leader on the ground in India for Enterprise Systems, representing the function to local stakeholders, vendor executives, and site leadership.
* Partner closely with the Senior Director – ERP and the value-stream Directors (Order-to-Cash, Source-to-Pay, Plan-to-Fulfill, Record-to-Report, Technical Services) to align offshore capacity with global priorities incl. the Malaysia factory.

**Offshore Delivery Factory Build-Out**

* Design, establish, and scale an offshore SAP configuration and development factory delivering functional configuration, custom development, enhancements, integrations, data work, and testing across the SAP landscape.
* Define the factory operating model end to end: demand intake, estimation, work allocation, sprint and release cadence, peer review, quality gates, and acceptance criteria.
* Build a predictable capacity model that flexes with project demand, with transparent unit costs and a clear view of available and committed effort by skill.
* Establish engineering standards and reusable assets – development guidelines, reference architectures, accelerators, templates, and code and configuration repositories – to reduce rebuild effort across similar work.
* Convert recurring, bespoke requests into repeatable, catalogued services with defined service levels and published turnaround times.
* Embed AI-assisted development and testing tooling to accelerate delivery throughput, with defined guardrails for data use, human review, and quality assurance.

**SAP Application Managed Services & Support Operations**

* Own the end-to-end performance of vendor-delivered AMS teams supporting the global SAP estate, including incident, problem, change, and service request management.
* Direct day-to-day production support across SAP functional and technical areas, ensuring incidents are resolved within agreed priority and response targets and that root cause is addressed, not just symptoms.
* Establish follow-the-sun and overlapping core-hours coverage models that provide responsive support to manufacturing, factory, and commercial operations across US, Malaysia, and India time zones.
* Own the support escalation path, acting as the primary point of escalation for high-severity incidents and major-incident management, including executive communication during outages.
* Drive down recurring ticket volume through problem management, permanent fixes, automation of repetitive tasks, and targeted user enablement.
* Maintain and continuously improve support documentation, runbooks, knowledge articles, and the standing knowledge transfer process between project teams and support teams.

**Vendor Management & Commercial Governance**

* Manage the performance of SAP AMS and delivery vendors, including statements of work, deliverable acceptance, service credits, and remediation of underperformance.
* Negotiate and govern vendor commercial constructs, moving the portfolio toward outcome and ticket-based pricing where it improves predictability and value.
* Establish formal vendor governance: operational reviews, monthly service reviews, quarterly business reviews, and a clear escalation ladder with named accountabilities on both sides.
* Drive continuous cost efficiency across the vendor base through productivity commitments, automation credits, pyramid optimisation, and rate benchmarking.
* Ensure vendor teams meet Sandisk standards for security, access control, data handling, background screening, and compliance with corporate policy.

**Service Quality, Governance & Continuous Improvement**

* Define, publish, and report Service Level Agreements (SLAs), Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), and operational metrics for both delivery and support, including cycle time, first-time-right rate, defect escape rate, and service availability.
* Operate a disciplined release and change management process, ensuring all transports and changes move through controlled, auditable promotion paths.
* Partner with the SOX and Compliance function to maintain IT general controls, segregation of duties, and audit evidence across development and support activity.
* Own quality assurance for offshore-delivered work, with defined review gates so that work handed back to onshore teams is complete, tested, and documented.
* Run a structured continuous improvement program with measurable annual targets for productivity, quality, and cost per unit of delivery.

**Talent, Capability & Retention**

* Build the India talent pipeline for SAP skills that are difficult and expensive to source onshore, including SAP S/4HANA functional configuration, ABAP and extension development, integration, and Basis and security.
* Hire, develop, and retain a deep technical bench, with succession cover for critical roles and deliberate removal of single points of dependency.
* Establish a structured capability development program – certification paths, cross-training across value streams, and rotation between project delivery and support work.
* Create a compelling engineering culture and employee value proposition that competes effectively for SAP talent in the Indian market and keeps attrition within target.
* Protect institutional knowledge through documented handover, shadowing, and knowledge retention practices, particularly during vendor transitions.

**Business Partnership & Global Coordination**

* Act as the trusted delivery partner to onshore value-stream Directors, IT business relationship managers, and solution architects, converting approved demand into delivered outcomes.
* Provide transparent, regular reporting on delivery status, support performance, capacity, risk, and vendor health to Enterprise Systems leadership.
* Work with factory and plant operations stakeholders to ensure support coverage genuinely meets the needs of twenty-four-hour manufacturing operations.
* Communicate clearly and credibly with both technical teams and non-technical business stakeholders across multiple geographies and time zones.

**Budget & Resource Allocation**

* Own the budget for offshore delivery capacity, AMS vendor contracts, support operations, and India-based headcount, in the $5–$10 million range.
* Optimise the mix of employees, contractors, and vendor-managed services to balance cost, capability retention, and flexibility.
* Provide accurate forecasting and cost transparency so the cost of scaling delivery capacity is visible before it is committed.
* Identify and deliver year-on-year cost reduction through offshore leverage, automation, and the retirement of redundant support scope.

**Transformation & Program Support**

* Provide scalable offshore delivery capacity to major SAP transformation programs, including SAP S/4HANA implementation, phased rollouts, and post go-live stabilisation.
* Stand up the hypercare and transition-to-support model for go-live events, including the criteria and gates for moving scope from project teams into steady-state support.
* Sequence the build-out of offshore capability so that it strengthens, rather than disrupts, concurrent enterprise transformation programs.
* Support the retirement of legacy platforms by absorbing and then decommissioning the associated support scope on a committed schedule.

**Supervisory Responsibilities**
**Direct Reports**

* Hires, retains, trains, coaches, guides, directs, and develops direct reports (e.g., Senior Managers, Managers, Delivery Leads, Technical Leads) using company-wide processes, tools, and resources.

**Indirect Reports**

* Oversees large third-party vendor delivery and support teams, offshore contract resources, and matrixed project teams, providing direction, performance management, and escalation governance.

**Travel Requirements**

* Travel up to 25% (Domestic and International), including periodic travel to Sandisk sites in the United States and Malaysia.

**Minimum Qualifications**
**Education Level**

* Master’s degree, Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent senior-level experience in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field.

**Field Of Study/Area Of Experience**

* 14+ years of progressive IT delivery and support leadership experience, with at least 10+ years in SAP delivery, application managed services, or global capability centre leadership.
* Atleast 1-2 years of SAP S/4 HANA on RISE & SAP Ariba experience
* Demonstrated experience building or materially scaling an offshore SAP delivery or support organisation, including the operating model, governance, and talent strategy – not solely running an established one.
* Deep working knowledge of the SAP landscape across functional configuration, ABAP and extension development, integration, and Basis and security, with the credibility to govern technical decisions.

Additional Information
  
  
Sandisk thrives on the power and potential of diversity. As a global company, we believe the most effective way to embrace the diversity of our customers and communities is to mirror it from within. We believe the fusion of various perspectives results in the best outcomes for our employees, our company, our customers, and the world around us. We are committed to an inclusive environment where every individual can thrive through a sense of belonging, respect and contribution.
  
  
Sandisk is committed to offering opportunities to applicants with disabilities and ensuring all candidates can successfully navigate our careers website and our hiring process. Please contact us at jobs.accommodations@sandisk.com to advise us of your accommodation request. In your email, please include a description of the specific accommodation you are requesting as well as the job title and requisition number of the position for which you are applying.

title: Performance Management Lead
description:
**About the Role**

We're looking for someone who can take our leadership team's goals and turn them into something every department can work toward and be measured on:
**clear KPIs, real ownership, and a simple way to see whether we're on track**
.You'll be working on business performance across the whole organisation. That means figuring out what "good" looks like for Projects, Design, MEP, Finance, Procurement, Sales and Operations, building the systems to track it, and helping leaders act when things slip.

**Responsibilities**

* **Building the performance framework.**
  You'll set up a performance system for the whole company that connects our annual goals to department targets, team targets and individual KRAs. Everyone should know what they own, what they're aiming for, and how it'll be measured.
* **Designing KPIs**
  A KPI for a site project manager looks nothing like one for a sales lead or a finance controller. You'll design role-specific KPIs with the right weightages, benchmarks and targets, tied to quality, timelines, cost and profitability. As the business changes, you'll revisit them.
* **Running the PMO**
  . You'll track our key initiatives and strategic priorities, including milestones, deliverables, budgets and timelines. When something is stuck or falling behind, you'll spot it early and bring it to leadership with a clear picture of what's going on.
* **Fixing how we work.**
  You'll look closely at how things get done across departments and find where time, money or effort is being wasted. Then you'll work with functional heads to fix it through better workflows, SOPs, process maps and responsibility matrices, and follow up to make sure the changes stick.
* **Linking performance to rewards.**
  You'll design bonus and incentive frameworks that are fair, transparent and tied to real outcomes: score calculations, achievement slabs, eligibility and payouts. You'll work with Finance to keep these in line with budgets, and set up support plans for teams or individuals who aren't hitting the mark.
* **Being leadership's performance partner.**
  You'll work directly with the CEO, COO and business heads. You'll run performance reviews, build the dashboards they rely on, and bring honest, data-backed insight on what's working, what isn't, and what to do about it.
* **What success looks like**
  after a yearEvery department and key role has clear, agreed performance metricsLeadership can see how the business is performing at any point, without chasing anyone for updatesStrategic initiatives are tracked properly and delays are caught earlyA few process improvements have made a visible difference to efficiencyBonus and incentive decisions are transparent and based on dataPeople across the organisation feel more ownership over resultsIf this sounds like the kind of role you'd enjoy building from the ground up, we'd love to hear from you.

**Qualifications**

* 8–12 years in
  **PMO, Business Excellence, Strategy Execution, Operational Excellence or Process Improvement**
* An MBA/PGDM in Operations, Strategy, Finance, Business Management or something related

**Required Skills**

* You've built KPI/KRA frameworks at an organisational level, not just for one team
* You've designed scorecards and dashboards that leadership actually uses
* You've worked on incentive or variable pay frameworks
* You're comfortable with process re-engineering and standardisation
* You can hold your own with senior leaders and get cross-functional teams aligned

**Preferred Skills**

* People from management consulting, corporate strategy, business transformation or operational excellence backgrounds tend to do well here.
* If your experience is mainly in HR appraisal cycles, this probably isn't the right fit.

**Why Join Zyeta**

* Competitive fixed compensation that reflects your experience, expertise and the impact you bring to the organisation.
* Performance-linked bonus, with an opportunity to contribute to building the organisation's performance and reward framework while benefiting from it yourself.
* An opportunity to work closely with the Founders, CEO, COO and business leaders, directly influencing key business decisions and shaping the organisation's growth.
* The freedom to build performance frameworks, business processes and measurement systems from the ground up, with ownership to drive meaningful change.
* An opportunity to grow with Zyeta, with increasing responsibilities, influence and leadership opportunities as the organisation expands.

title: Sr, Associate Resident Account
description:
**About Revantage**
Revantage, a Blackstone Real Estate portfolio company, is a global provider of corporate services.
  
  
With a corporate purpose of ‘In Pursuit of Better,’ Revantage delivers value-added services and world-class talent for Blackstone Real Estate portfolio companies, spanning diverse asset classes, including residential, logistics, office, hospitality and retail sectors. The company’s footprint extends across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific.
  
  
Creating a culture that inspires impact and momentum requires the right team. We know what it takes to lead an industry, and are looking for leaders who seek constant growth, want to excel, and continuously improve upon themselves and the industry.
  
  
In addition to supporting Revantage, we also recruit for Blackstone Real Estate portfolio companies, giving you the unique opportunity to work within a network of best-in-class professionals across a broad real estate platform.
  
  
**India**
With offices in Bengaluru and Gurugram, our teams in India deliver expertise, innovation and operational excellence that support thousands of assets across logistics, data centers, residential, commercial and hospitality.
  
  
Whether you’re building new capabilities, driving critical initiatives or strengthening partnerships, you’ll have the opportunity to truly
**Build What Matters.**
**Role Summary**
We are seeking a Resident Account Supervisor for a Blackstone Real Estate portfolio company and the largest owner, manager and developer of high-quality student housing communities in the United States. This role is based in Bengaluru, India and is hired through Revantage India.
  
  
The Resident Account Supervisor leads a Bengaluru-based team of Resident Account Specialists responsible for supporting the accuracy, collection and administration of applicant, resident and former-resident accounts across an assigned portfolio. Working closely with US-based leadership and property Operations teams, the Supervisor is accountable for the quality and timeliness of the team’s work, effective management of delinquency and resident-account exceptions, and delivery of strong service to property teams, residents and other stakeholders.
  
  
The Resident Account Supervisor serves as the primary day-to-day point of accountability for the offshore team, including workload management, escalation support, productivity monitoring, training and process execution. The role maintains strong knowledge of resident account policies, lease requirements, collections processes and applicable operating procedures, and helps drive consistent, scalable practices across the portfolio.
  
  
**Primary Role**

* Lead the day-to-day execution of resident account activities across the assigned portfolio, ensuring accurate and timely processing of receivables, payments, refunds, credits, collections activity and related account transactions.
* Lead and develop the Bengaluru-based Resident Account Specialist team, establishing clear performance expectations, allocating workload, providing coaching and training, and ensuring consistent execution of established processes.
* Monitor team productivity, service levels and key operating metrics, including account reconciliations, collections activity, delinquency, refunds, unresolved exceptions and other measures of execution quality and timeliness.
* Provide escalation guidance and support to Resident Account Specialists, property teams, residents, guarantors and other stakeholders, helping resolve complex account issues in a timely and service-oriented manner.
* Oversee collection and delinquency processes for the assigned portfolio, including payment arrangements, required notices, third-party collection activity and coordination of eviction-related account support in accordance with established procedures.
* Oversee daily and recurring account reconciliation processes, ensuring payments, returns, refunds, charges and other resident-account transactions are complete, accurate and appropriately supported.
* Review and support execution of Statement of Deposit Account (SODA) and move-out account processes, ensuring refunds, charges and final balances are handled accurately and within applicable deadlines.
* Maintain strong working knowledge of ACC lease requirements, resident account policies and applicable state and local requirements affecting payment timing, late fees, refunds, collections and eviction-related processes.
* Partner closely with US-based Operations and Finance leadership on portfolio performance, delinquency trends, escalated resident-account matters and other issues requiring coordinated resolution.
* Maintain and improve team procedures, training materials and process documentation, ensuring the offshore team follows consistent practices across assigned properties.
* Identify opportunities to improve resident account workflows, collections effectiveness, system utilization and team productivity, and support systems enhancements, testing and deployments.
* Collaborate with Collections, Resident Management Systems, Accounting and other internal teams to support account integrity, resolve recurring issues and perform targeted account audits or reviews.
* Manage a limited portfolio of resident accounts directly as needed to maintain familiarity with processes, provide coverage and support team execution.
* Partner with US-based leadership and Revantage India on staffing, hiring, performance management and team development to ensure appropriate capacity and capability.
* Work from the Bengaluru office under the hybrid working model, with working hours aligned to provide meaningful daily overlap with US business hours; flexibility is expected during Turn, month-end, peak collections periods and other high-volume operating cycles.
* Perform other projects and responsibilities as assigned

**Qualifications & Skills**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, accounting, finance, commerce or a related field is preferred; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
* Four or more years of experience in accounts receivable, collections, resident accounting, property operations or another related transactional finance or customer-account role.
* Prior experience supervising, coaching or providing day-to-day direction to a team is strongly preferred.
* Strong understanding of accounts receivable and collections processes, including payment application, account reconciliation, delinquency management, refunds and exception resolution.
* Experience working in a high-volume, multi-property, shared-services or centralized operations environment is preferred.

title: City Lead - Dining Partnerships (Bangalore)
description:
**About GoSats**
GoSats is a consumer fintech with a Visa prepaid card that earns rewards in gold on every spend. We're backed by Y Combinator, Accel and Konvoy. We process about $6M a month in payments for tens of thousands of active users, with Bangalore as our largest city.
  
  
The role You'll build our dining network from zero. You'll sign restaurants, bars and cafés to offers paid for by the restaurant, which our cardholders unlock by paying with their GoSats card. You'll own supply end to end: which restaurants, what deal, getting them live, and keeping them performing.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Sign restaurants in 2–3 Bangalore neighbourhoods first (e.g. Koramangala, Indiranagar, HSR), then expand.
* Structure deals: discount or cashback %, time slots (off-peak first), caps, and our fee.
* Get each outlet live: merchant ID mapping, offer setup, staff briefing, in-store material.
* Track every outlet: redemptions, spend, repeat visits. Renew what works and drop what doesn't.
* Work with product and finance on monthly restaurant invoicing and dispute handling.
* Hire and lead 2–3 field partnership executives once the pilot works.

**First 90 days**

* 50 restaurants live in your starting neighbourhoods.
* First 1,000 redemptions by GoSats cardholders.
* A clear read on deal economics: what restaurants will fund, at what fee, and which categories repeat.

**You have**

* 4–7 years of restaurant supply, merchant acquisition or city operations at Dineout, District, EazyDiner, Magicpin, Thriwe or similar.
* A track record of signing restaurants yourself, with numbers you can share: outlets signed per month, live rate, retention.
* Existing relationships with Bangalore restaurant owners and managers.
* Comfort with deal maths and simple spreadsheets.
* Energy for field work. This is not a desk job.

**Nice to have**

* Understanding of card payments at restaurants (terminals, merchant IDs, settlement).
* Experience with restaurant billing systems like Petpooja or Restroworks.
* Kannada.

title: Senior Manager - Operations (Pharma Distribution)
description:
**Job Opening – Senior Manager, Operations (Pharma Distribution)**
==================================================================

**Company:** Curtis Drug Point Private Limited (Kauvery Hospital Group)
  
**Position:** Senior Manager – Operations
  
**Department:** Operations & Supply Chain
  
**Experience:** 12–15 Years (Minimum 5 Years in a Managerial Role)
  
**Location:** Chennai
  
**Qualification:** B.Pharm / B.Sc. / B.Com; MBA in Operations / Supply Chain preferred

### **Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented Senior Manager – Operations to lead end-to-end pharmaceutical distribution operations across all four Curtis Drug Point locations. The role involves overseeing warehousing, inventory management, order fulfilment, dispatch, logistics, regulatory compliance, cost optimization, and operational efficiency.

The ideal candidate should have strong experience in pharmaceutical supply chain management, multi-location operations, process standardization, and team leadership.

### **Key Roles & Responsibilities**

* **Operations Management & Leadership**

* Lead and monitor day-to-day warehouse, dispatch, and outlet operations across all four locations.
* Develop and implement standardized SOPs for receiving, storage, picking, billing, credit notes, and dispatch.
* Establish and monitor operational KPIs, including order fill rate, turnaround time, inventory accuracy, and service levels.
* Drive process automation, AI-based warehouse management initiatives, and ERP/HMS system improvements.

* **Warehouse & Inventory Management**

* Ensure effective inventory control, stock accuracy, and adherence to FIFO/FEFO procedures.
* Oversee proper pharmaceutical storage, cold-chain management, and stock audits.
* Minimize near-expiry, expired, damaged, and non-moving inventory.
* Implement centralized purchase order and indent processing.
* Reduce inventory losses, stock variances, and wastage.

* **Order Fulfilment & Logistics**

* Ensure accurate and timely processing of customer and hospital unit orders.
* Oversee dispatch planning, transportation, delivery routes, and logistics vendor performance.
* Resolve delivery delays, shortages, and operational escalations.
* Develop strategies to optimize transportation and distribution costs.

* **Regulatory Compliance & Quality Control**

* Ensure compliance with drug licence conditions, the Drugs and Cosmetics Act, GST requirements, and applicable regulations.
* Maintain statutory documentation, licences, and operational compliance across locations.
* Coordinate internal and external audits and drug inspector visits.
* Implement operational controls to ensure product safety and regulatory compliance.

* **Cost Optimization & Process Improvement**

* Monitor operational expenses, including manpower, logistics, inventory losses, and wastage.
* Identify opportunities for process improvement, automation, and operational efficiency.
* Implement cost-saving initiatives and strengthen internal controls.
* Collaborate with IT teams to enhance ERP/HMS functionalities and resolve system gaps.

* **Team Management & MIS Reporting**

* Lead and develop warehouse, operations, and dispatch teams.
* Plan manpower deployment, shifts, training, and performance reviews.
* Prepare and present operations MIS reports covering stock accuracy, order fulfilment, turnaround time, near-expiry stock, and compliance.
* Coordinate with Sales, Purchase, Pharmacy, Finance, and IT departments for seamless operations.

### **Required Skills & Competencies**

* Strong expertise in pharmaceutical distribution, warehousing, and supply chain operations.
* Experience managing multi-location pharmaceutical operations.
* Knowledge of inventory management, FIFO/FEFO, and cold-chain processes.
* Understanding of pharmaceutical regulatory compliance and drug licensing requirements.
* Experience with ERP/SAP, warehouse management systems, and operations MIS.
* Strong cost control, process improvement, and operational planning skills.
* Excellent leadership, analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.

### **Candidate Requirements**

* **Education:** Graduate in Pharmacy, Science, or Commerce; MBA in Operations / Supply Chain preferred.
* **Experience:** 12–15 years in pharmaceutical operations or supply chain management, including at least 5 years in a managerial role.
* Experience in pharmaceutical distribution, CFA operations, or pharmacy chain management preferred.
* Proven experience managing warehouse operations, inventory control, logistics, and cross-functional teams.
* Experience handling multi-location operations and implementing operational improvements will be an advantage.

**Key Skills:** Pharma Operations, Pharmaceutical Distribution, Supply Chain Management, Warehouse Management, Inventory Control, Logistics Management, FIFO, FEFO, Cold Chain Management, ERP, SAP, Operations MIS, Regulatory Compliance, Cost Optimization, Process Improvement, Team Management.

title: Head of Operations
description:
**Location:**
 Hyderabad

**Department:**
 Operations

**Designation:**
 Head of Operations

**Reporting to:**
Core Management Team

**Experience:**
 6–8 years (with substantial multi-outlet QSR experience)

**About Vyroo :**

Vyroo is a growing South Indian QSR and tiffin centre chain focused on delivering high-quality breakfast and food products through standardised operations, consistent taste and operational efficiency.

We are building a technology-driven restaurant operating ecosystem through 
**Vyroo 360**
, our proprietary operations intelligence platform, to automate inventory management, demand forecasting, recipe standardisation, wastage control and store performance monitoring.

We are looking for an experienced Head of Operations who can lead our multi-outlet operations, build a strong management hierarchy and prepare the organisation for the next phase of expansion.

**Role Objective :**

To take complete ownership of the operational performance of all Vyroo outlets, establish standardised operating systems, develop cluster and store-level leadership, improve outlet profitability and build an organisation capable of scaling to 20–50 outlets.

**Key Responsibilities :**

**1. Multi-Outlet Operations Management**

* Manage and oversee operations across all existing outlets.
* Build and manage a structured hierarchy of Cluster Managers, Store Managers and Team Leads.
* Ensure consistent operational standards across every outlet.
* Conduct periodic store visits, inspections and performance reviews.
* Ensure smooth daily operations without excessive founder involvement.

**2. Sales & Profitability Management**

* Drive outlet-wise revenue and profitability targets.
* Monitor food cost, labour cost, operational expenses and contribution margins.
* Identify revenue leakage, unnecessary expenses and operational inefficiencies.
* Improve sales per outlet and overall operating profitability.

**3. Inventory & Cost Control**

* Establish strict inventory management and reconciliation systems.
* Monitor raw material consumption against standard recipes and expected yields.
* Control wastage, pilferage and stock variances.
* Implement systematic procurement, stock transfers and vendor coordination.
* Ensure adherence to established consumption benchmarks.

**4. Product Quality & Standardisation**

* Maintain consistent taste, quality and presentation across outlets.
* Standardise recipes, portion sizes and preparation methods.
* Monitor batter, chutney and other product preparation processes.
* Work with the product and kitchen teams to improve productivity and quality.
* Implement regular food safety, hygiene and quality audits.

**5. People & Team Management**

* Recruit, train and develop Cluster Managers and Store Managers.
* Establish clear job descriptions, responsibilities and KPIs.
* Introduce performance evaluation and accountability systems.
* Manage manpower planning, attendance, productivity and attrition.
* Build a strong second line of operational leadership.

**6. SOP & Technology Implementation**

* Establish standard operating procedures for every operational function.
* Ensure complete adoption of Vyroo 360 across outlets.
* Drive technology-based task management, inventory audits and operational reporting.
* Implement automated performance dashboards and escalation mechanisms.
* Use operational data to identify problems and improve decision-making.

**7. Expansion & Business Scalability**

* Develop operational readiness plans for new outlet launches.
* Establish systems that can be replicated across multiple locations.
* Create manpower, training, procurement and infrastructure requirements for expansion.
* Ensure new outlets achieve operational stability within defined timelines.

**Candidate Profile - Mush Have**

* 6–8 years of experience in restaurant, QSR or food-service operations.
* Proven experience managing multiple outlets simultaneously.
* Strong preference for candidates from South Indian tiffin, breakfast, QSR or high-volume casual dining chains.
* Experience managing at least 8–10 outlets, preferably more.
* Experience managing Cluster Managers, Area Managers and Store Managers.
* Strong understanding of restaurant P&L, food cost, inventory and manpower management.
* Experience in SOP implementation, operational audits and process standardisation.
* Strong leadership, analytical and execution capabilities.
* Comfortable working with technology-driven operational platforms.

**Preferred Experience**

Candidates who have worked with established multi-outlet brands such as South Indian QSR chains, breakfast chains and organised restaurant groups will be preferred.

**Key Performing Indicators (KPIs)**

The Head of Operations will be evaluated on:

1. Outlet-wise revenue growth.
2. Overall outlet profitability and EBITDA improvement.
3. Food cost and inventory consumption control.
4. Reduction in wastage and stock variance.
5. Labour productivity and manpower efficiency.
6. Customer satisfaction and complaint reduction.
7. SOP and operational audit compliance.
8. Store Manager and Cluster Manager performance.
9. Successful implementation of Vyroo 360.
10. Operational readiness and successful launch of new outlets.

**What We Expect**

We are not looking for someone who simply supervises restaurants or manages daily activities.

**We want a hands-on operations leader who can:**

* Build a professional multi-outlet management structure.
* Take complete ownership of operational execution.
* Establish systems that work without constant supervision.
* Drive profitability through data and operational discipline.
* Build strong managers who can independently run outlets.
* Scale the business from its current stage to a professionally managed, multi-location QSR chain.

**Compensation:**
 Competitive, based on experience and demonstrated multi-outlet management capability.

* **Application:**
   Interested candidates can share their updated CV along with details of the number of outlets managed, brands worked with, team size handled and operational achievements.

title: Senior Technical Release Manager
description:
**About Sureify**
Sureify is dedicated to modernizing the life insurance and annuity industry. We provide cutting-edge digital solutions that empower insurers to easily engage with, sell to, and service their customers. Our mission is to drive meaningful digital transformation by offering scalable technology that enhances customer engagement and streamlines carrier operations. Sureify's products deliver the advanced digital experiences that life insurance carriers, agents, employees, and consumers now expect in this rapidly evolving technological landscape. At Sureify, we cultivate a culture that prioritizes innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are looking for a
**Senior Technical Release Manager**
to join our Hyderabad office. This role will be responsible for managing all production releases across our enterprise platform and customer-specific solutions. Unlike traditional release roles, this position serves as a
**Technical Release Governor**
in a complex hybrid environment consisting of both
**multi-tenant**
products and
**multi-instance**
siloed environments.
  
  
As we scale our
**carrier customer**
base, we are looking to adopt best of the breed release practices. You will be the single point of accountability for replacing high-intensity manual interventions in releases with a systematic, technically rigorous process. You will ensure releases are delivered with quality, predictability, and efficiency while bridging the gap between engineering, QA, product, and client support teams.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Release Lifecycle Leadership:**
Own and manage the end-to-end release lifecycle for all production deployments, including core platform production updates and customer-specific customizations. Define, document, and enforce
**release management processes and standards**
. Create and maintain the
**release calendar**
, ensuring transparency and alignment across teams.
  
  
**Technical Gatekeeping:**
Conduct deep-dive release readiness reviews. You will audit "Release Manifests" by validating steps such as SQL migrations or PDF template migrations, Temporal workflow versioning, Kafka schemas, and AWS resource configurations. A good overall understanding of deployment architecture in AWS is essential for this role.
  
  
**Environment Governance:**
Manage "Instance Parity" across our
**AWS**
multi-instance architecture to prevent "Environmental Drift" and ensure customer-specific secrets and variables match our global standards.
  
  
**Cross-Functional Orchestration:**
Facilitate formal "Go/No-Go" decisions by tracking a global checklist that includes technical and non-technical readiness.
  
  
**Risk Mitigation:**
Identify, document, and mitigate technical sequencing risks (e.g., database locks or stateful workflow conflicts) associated with production releases.
  
  
**Continuous Improvement:**
Monitor release performance, generate and provide metrics and reports and drive the transition from manual coordination to
**Automated Production Quality Gates**
within our release pipelines.
  
  
**Required Qualifications & Experience**
**10+ years of overall technical experience**
, with a background in software engineering, SRE, or backend operations.
  
  
**5+ years of direct release management experience**
in a complex, enterprise hybrid SaaS environment (Multi-tenant & Multi-instance).
  
  
**Cloud-Native Expertise:**
Expert-level knowledge of
**AWS**
(EKS, RDS, Secrets Manager, IAM, S3, MSK) and the ability to audit infrastructure-level configurations.
  
  
**Stack Fluency:**
Demonstrated familiarity with
**Typescript**
,
**PHP, Go-lang, and Node.js**
ecosystems. You must understand the deployment nuances of each.
  
  
**Modern Orchestration:**
Hands-on experience or strong knowledge of
**Temporal**
(stateful workflows) and
**Kafka**
(event streaming). You understand the risks of deploying to "in-flight" asynchronous processes.
  
  
**Database Proficiency:**
Strong proficiency in
**MySQL and Postgres**
, specifically in auditing complex migration scripts and data sequencing.
  
  
**Containerization Mastery:**
Deep understanding of
**Kubernetes (K8s)**
manifest auditing and deployment patterns (Canary, Blue-Green, or Rolling Updates).
  
  
**Communication & Gravitas:**
Excellent stakeholder management skills with the professional authority to enforce discipline and halt releases if technical or business criteria are not met.
  
  
**Preferred / Nice-to-Have Skills**
Experience in the insurance or financial services domain (or other regulated industries).
  
  
Knowledge of security, compliance (SOC2/ISO), or audit processes as they relate to release operations.
  
  
Experience with
**Infrastructure as Code (IaC)**
tools like Terraform or CloudFormation.
  
  
Familiarity with Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles such as Error Budgets and SLIs/SLOs.
  
  
**Why Join Sureify?**
At Sureify, you’ll be part of a collaborative, innovation-driven culture where your expertise will directly influence the quality and success of products, transforming the life insurance landscape. You’ll work alongside passionate technologists and industry experts, tackling complex challenges with cutting-edge technologies while helping shape the future of digital insurance.
  
  
**Our Guiding Principles**
Our products are for nothing if their creators are not fulfilled in their work. We want our employees to flourish at Sureify. We do not fawn over status or titles; instead, we honour effort and intelligence. The best idea wins, no matter which colleague proposed it. We do not shortcut our mission with overblown claims or false promises. Sticking to the truth is both a strategy and a principle for us.
  
  
Sureify is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to diversity. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, ancestry, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, age, disability, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

title: Logistics Manager

title: Senior Manager, IT Delivery (WT Monitor)
description:
**About Vanguard**
Founded in 1975, Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment management companies. The firm offers investments, advice, and retirement services to tens of millions of individual investors around the globe—directly, through workplace plans, and through financial intermediaries.
  
  
**Vanguard India**
Vanguard’s office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. We are committed to establishing an enduring technology center in Hyderabad, Telangana and are excited to be adding talent who will focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile, and cloud-based technologies that drive our business outcomes and deliver a world-class experience for our clients.
  
  
**Role Summary**
Lead a high-performing technology delivery organization responsible for delivering enterprise technology solutions and driving strategic business outcomes. Oversee end-to-end delivery, Agile and SDLC execution, release management, risk mitigation, and operational excellence initiatives. Partner with business and technology leaders to define priorities, shape technology roadmaps, and drive the adoption of AI-enabled capabilities across software engineering and delivery teams. Champion AI-assisted development, testing, automation, and operational practices to enhance productivity, accelerate innovation, improve quality, and deliver measurable business value while ensuring scalable, secure, and compliant technology solutions. Foster stakeholder alignment, vendor governance, and a culture of continuous improvement and delivery excellence.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead, coach, and develop high-performing technology teams, including talent development, workforce planning, and performance management.
* Oversee delivery of technology solutions, software releases, and strategic business initiatives.
* Lead the development and execution of AI-driven technology strategies aligned with business objectives and product roadmaps.
* Drive adoption of AI-enabled capabilities across technology teams to accelerate innovation, improve customer outcomes, and deliver measurable business value.
* Champion AI adoption across the SDLC through AI-assisted engineering, testing, automation, and operational practices.

company: Aditya Birla Health Insurance Company Limited
description:
**Job Purpose**
The purpose of this role includes ensuring accurate and timely submission of periodic and ad-hoc reports related to Claims to the Regulatory Authority, handling Audits (IRDA, internal audits and other audits), preparing the claims register, bring in process improvements, automation, publishing analytical reports / Claims MIS and daily dashboard.
  
  
The purpose involves Data Support and inter-department coordination with all stakeholders including sales, finance, internal claims and actuary teams.
  
  
**Job Context & Major Challenges**
**About The Health Insurance Industry –**
While the current market sees more than 15 non-life players in the private space and 5 exclusive private players in the health insurance space trying to capture a sizable market share, the nationalized service provider (6) remains a strong competitor. In addition to this the business dynamics are such that the overall market on an annual basis which is to the tune of roughly 10,000 Crs sees close to 85 % of the business renewing with the existing service provider itself. This narrows down the opportunity of the fresh business actually being seriously fought in the market to approximately 1500 odd Crs. With the SME and the start-ups being the driving force of Indian economy, the opportunity to cater to these segments is immense and is increasing manifold year on year. The challenge here therefore remains as to how we capture a larger share of the opportunity by developing specific solutions to cater each segment of the business. Also by creating an inexpensive and standardized solution to increase the reach into the pockets of channel partners across the country to harness on their captive business and explore new opportunities with them.
  
  
Market Opportunities – With the advent of medical advancements, lifestyle changes, change in Indian socio-economic scenario and Indian healthcare space, and the insurers are facing challenges to cater to the needs of this diverse clientele. Increasingly Indian customers have started considering health insurance partners as extensions of health advisers. In this scenario it becomes extremely important to understand their psyche and then provide tailored solutions with wellness benefits which would help them meet their end objectives and bring in profitable revenue source for the company.
  
  
**About The Aditya Birla Health Insurance –**
Aditya Birla Health Insurance Co. Limited (ABHICL) was incorporated in 2015 as a 51:49 joint venture between Aditya Birla Capital Limited (ABCL) and MMI Strategic Investments (Pty) Ltd. ABHICL commenced its operations in October 2016.
  
  
ABHICL has entered the competitive health insurance market with an aim to expand the category to wider customer segments, beyond the ones that health insurance companies traditionally have marketed to. As the 6th entrant in a category with well-established players, ABHICL is creating differentiation and equity for itself though the unique business proposition of “Health Insurance for All”, a one of a kind proposition in India at the moment. This is a philosophy that is being built through every single consumer touch point and into every single backend process of the company to ensure a customer’s experience of our proposition is continuous and seamless.
  
  
ABHI’s unique offering to market includes proposition includes -
  
  

* A Comprehensive Incentivized Wellness Program that will attract the young and health conscious and will motivate, guide and reward them to stay healthy
* A Chronic Care Management Program to cater to the unmet needs of a growing Indian population of those suffering from chronic lifestyle conditions like Diabetes, Asthma, High Cholesterol and Hypertension from Day 1
* ABHICL serves as an enabler and influencer of health and healthcare choices that customers make, in addition to being a payer of healthcare expenses. Thus, ABHICL would act like a much needed catalyst to grow the prevalent health insurance landscape in India through product innovations and a wider choice of consumer relevant products.
* ABHICL’s vision has always been digital. The company has been successful in adopting paper-less approach right from identifying to on-boarding to delivering seamless experience of its customers & employees.

**Key Result Areas**
**KRA (Accountabilities) (Max 1325 Characters)**
**Supporting Actions (Max 1325 Characters)**
KRA1 Accurate and timely submission of periodic and ad-hoc reports related to Claims to the Regulatory Authority/GI Council
  
  

* Develop, Implement shortcuts, macros, formulae on excel, using alternative tools/methods for timely submission
* Develop, train the team, delegate and review their accountability
* Do cursory/sanity checks before submission

KRA2 Audits: IRDA, Internal, Stat, others
  
  
Data submission/query response/ad-hoc reports to IRDA/GI Council
  
  
Closure of audit observations
  
  

* Team training, Time management, Delegation
* Strong coordination skills with other departments, sharp and on the spot thinking, proactive approach, soft skills, excel skills, working with other tools/macros

KRA3 Monthly / Quarterly / Annual Data submission
  
  
Policyholder’s protection committee, Quarterly board meetings, monthly Ops Review, Weekly Claims Review
  
  

* Work closely with Finance, Actuary, Operations, Internal Claims team.

title: Revenue & Operations Manager
description:

**Salary:** ₹25,000 per month (gross)

**Reports To:** Strategy & Business Operations Lead and Content & Creative Strategy Lead (jointly)

About Media Star AI

Media Star AI produces AI-powered entertainment content, including short dramas, concept films, and creative video productions. We are a small, fast-moving team where operations and finance discipline keep creative work running smoothly. Your work ensures every project is billed, documented, and cleared properly.

About the Role

We are looking for a detail-oriented, organized **Revenue & Operations Manager** to manage the business records behind our productions. You will coordinate project revenue, invoicing and collections, writer contracts and payouts, rights and clearance documentation, production costs, and publication records. You will work with external accounting professionals and report jointly to two leads, preparing clear summaries for management.

Key Responsibilities

**Revenue, Invoicing and Collections**

* Track collections, outstanding payments, and billable project milestones.
* Follow up on pending payments and flag overdue items to management.

**Tax and Accounting Coordination**

**Writer Contracts and Payments**

* Maintain writer contracts, signatures, and payment records.
