* Track contract status, renewals, and pending signatures.

**Rights, Consent and Clearances**

* Maintain title-wise rights, consent, and asset-clearance records.
* Ensure documentation is complete before a title moves toward publication.

**Cost and Budget Monitoring**

* Monitor AI software subscriptions, API usage, and production expenses.
* Track project budgets, cost variations, and gross margins.
* Flag overspending or unusual cost increases early.
* Maintain the project cost and margin dashboard.

**Operations and Documentation**

* Maintain publication approval and version-history records.
* Document vendor details and approved tool-account records.
* Escalate missing approvals, permissions, or documentation.
* Prepare operations and revenue summaries for management.

Expected Deliverables

* Invoice and collection register
* Writer payment and rights-clearance records
* Project cost and margin dashboard
* Publication approval documentation
* Monthly operations and revenue summary for management

Required Skills

* Basic accounting and financial documentation
* Invoice and payment tracking
* Budget monitoring and cost tracking
* Excel / Google Sheets (formulas, pivot tables, dashboards)
* Contract administration and record management
* Understanding of GST and TDS coordination
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy
* Clear written and verbal communication
* Time management and ability to follow up persistently

Preferred Tools

* Excel and Google Sheets
* Google Workspace (Drive, Docs, Forms)
* Tally, Zoho Books, or similar accounting software (a plus)
* Invoicing and payment tracking tools
* Looker Studio or basic dashboard tools (a plus)

Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Commerce, Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field
* 1–2 years of experience in accounts, billing, operations, finance administration, or a related role
* Working knowledge of invoicing, GST basics, and TDS coordination
* Proficiency in English and Telugu; Hindi is a plus

Good to Have

* Experience in media, entertainment, production, or creative services
* Familiarity with contract management and rights documentation
* Experience tracking SaaS or API subscription costs
* Comfort with AI tools used in content production

Success Metrics (First 90 Days)

* Invoice and collection register fully set up and updated weekly
* All active writer contracts and payment records organized and current
* Rights-clearance records maintained for every active title

What We Offer

* Opportunity to work at the front line of AI-powered entertainment
* Hands-on exposure to how a media production business runs financially

Important Note

Statutory filings, contractual approvals, and financial authorizations are handled by designated authorized professionals and management. This role supports record-keeping, coordination, tracking, and reporting.

Work Schedule and Location

Full-time, on-site in Hyderabad, Telangana.

Apply through Indeed with your resume and a short note on your experience with invoicing, accounts, or operations. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an interview.

title: Global Service Delivery Manager
description:
**Role Overview**
The Global Field Services Manager is responsible for leading two core functions: Local EUC and EUC Services. Local EUC provides onsite and regional technology support across corporate offices, retail locations, airport sites, vaults, data centre locations and other operational environments. EUC Services acts as the third-line, centrally managed EUC capability, responsible for workstation endpoint, OS hardening, patching, software deployments, mobile device management, device lifecycle management, endpoint compliance and other centrally controlled EUC services.
  
  
The successful candidate will provide strong operational leadership across both functions, ensuring that onsite support and centrally managed EUC services are responsive, secure, consistent and aligned to global IT design standards. The role will work closely with Global Service Delivery, Network Operations, Infrastructure, Security, Retail Operations, Facilities, Change Management, vendors and country leadership teams to ensure local and central EUC services remain stable, supportable and fit for business use.
  
  
**Role Purpose**
The purpose of this role is to provide global leadership for the Local EUC and EUC Services functions, ensuring Travelex colleagues and operational sites receive consistent, high-quality onsite technology support while also benefiting from a robust, centrally managed third-line EUC service. The role will drive standardisation, accountability, lifecycle discipline, endpoint compliance and continual service improvement across both regional field support and centrally managed EUC capabilities.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Global Field Services Leadership**

* Lead the Global Field Services function across two core capabilities: Local EUC and EUC Services.
* Define and maintain the global operating model for both functions, including roles, responsibilities, escalation paths, service standards, technical ownership boundaries and governance routines.
* Ensure Local EUC and EUC Services operate as an integrated support model, with clear hand-offs between onsite support, second-line support, third-line engineering and central service ownership.
* Ensure services are delivered consistently across regions, while allowing controlled local adaptation where business, regulatory or operational requirements justify it.
* Act as the senior escalation point for field services and EUC service issues impacting business operations, colleague productivity, retail trading, endpoint compliance or site readiness.
* Develop a high-performing, customer-focused and accountable global field services culture across both local and central EUC teams.

**Local EUC and Workplace Technology Support**

* Own the delivery of onsite support for end-user devices, workplace technology and local infrastructure across global sites.
* Ensure effective support for laptops, desktops, mobile devices, operating systems, Microsoft 365, collaboration tools, printers, scanners, peripherals, meeting-room technology and approved business applications.
* Oversee executive and VIP support standards, ensuring responsive and professional service for senior stakeholders while maintaining consistent service principles for all users.
* Drive improvements in first-time fix, ageing ticket reduction, service quality, knowledge management and user experience.
* Work closely with EUC Services to ensure endpoint standards, deployment models and support playbooks are understood and adopted consistently by Local EUC and field teams.

**EUC Services and Third-Line Endpoint Engineering**

* Lead EUC Services as the third-line, centrally managed EUC capability responsible for endpoint engineering, standards, control and service reliability.
* Own central EUC responsibilities including OS hardening, patching, endpoint configuration, software packaging, software deployments, mobile device management, endpoint compliance and centrally managed EUC tooling.
* Ensure EUC Services defines and maintains global endpoint build standards, baseline configurations, deployment models, support playbooks and technical acceptance criteria.
* Provide technical escalation and engineering support for complex endpoint, operating-system, application deployment, MDM and device compliance issues that cannot be resolved through local or second-line support.
* Partner with Security, Infrastructure, IT Asset Management and Change Management to ensure endpoint services meet cyber, operational, lifecycle and compliance requirements.
* Drive automation, standardisation and proactive remediation across endpoint services, reducing manual effort and improving resilience, compliance and employee experience.

**Retail, Vault and Site Technology Operations**

* Lead field services support for retail and operational site technology, including tills, workstations, rate boards, local connectivity, peripherals, branch technology, vault support equipment and other approved site devices.
* Ensure technology incidents affecting retail trading, customer-facing services, site openings or operational continuity receive appropriate priority and ownership.
* Partner with Retail Operations, Facilities, Network Operations, Infrastructure and Application Support teams to support site openings, relocations, refurbishments, closures and technology remediation activity.
* Maintain strong operational controls for hardware inventory, site records, local support documentation and technology acceptance evidence.
* Support the adoption of a global Retail Technology Blueprint, ensuring sites are assessed against agreed hardware, configuration, security, resilience and supportability standards.

**Endpoint Lifecycle, Asset, Configuration and Compliance Management**

* Own the combined Local EUC and EUC Services execution model for endpoint build, deployment, replacement, recovery, decommissioning and disposal activities in line with global standards.
* Ensure accurate asset, stock, warranty, ownership, location, configuration and lifecycle information is maintained for equipment managed by field and EUC teams.
* Drive remediation of ageing, unsupported, duplicate, missing, non-compliant or under-utilised devices in partnership with IT Asset Management, Security and EUC Services.
* Oversee centrally managed EUC activities including operating-system upgrades, workstation changes, MDM adoption, software deployments, OS hardening, endpoint patching and endpoint compliance initiatives.
* Ensure Local EUC and EUC Services teams follow controlled processes for secure disposal, data protection, evidence capture, CMDB updates and compliance reporting.

**Service Management and Operational Governance**

* Ensure all field services work is managed through the ITSM platform with clear ownership, accurate categorisation, timely updates and complete resolution notes.
* Establish and monitor field services KPIs, including SLA performance, ticket age, backlog, repeat incidents, customer satisfaction, site readiness, asset accuracy and remediation progress.
* Contribute to incident, major incident, problem and change management processes where onsite support, local infrastructure or site technology is required.
* Drive root-cause analysis and corrective action for recurring local technology issues.
* Create consistent governance routines, reporting packs and operational reviews for regional teams, vendors and senior stakeholders.

**Security, Risk and Compliance**

* Ensure local technology services comply with Travelex security standards, endpoint configuration requirements, access control expectations and operational policies.
* Support vulnerability remediation, endpoint protection, encryption, secure configuration, software compliance and device hygiene activities across the global site estate.
* Ensure suspected security incidents are escalated promptly and relevant evidence is preserved in line with incident response procedures.
* Support audit, risk, regulatory and compliance evidence requests relating to local technology, end-user devices, site equipment and field services processes.
* Promote a security-first culture within field teams, ensuring convenience and speed are balanced with appropriate control and risk management.

**Transformation, Automation and Continuous Improvement**

* Lead field services participation in technology transformation programmes, including ITSM platform uplift, endpoint modernisation, site technology refreshes, security improvements and operational standardisation.
* Identify opportunities to automate repeatable support activities, improve self-service, enable shift-left support and reduce unnecessary onsite demand.
* Use service data, operational insight and regional feedback to drive measurable improvement in service quality, cost efficiency and operational resilience.
* Support global standardisation of workstation builds, site technology design, support documentation, deployment processes and operating procedures.
* Champion pragmatic innovation, including AI-enabled knowledge management, predictive support insights and improved field service scheduling where appropriate.

**Stakeholder, Supplier and Regional Management**

* Build trusted relationships with country leadership, Retail Operations, Facilities, Technology teams, Service Delivery and third-party suppliers.
* Translate local operational needs into clear global requirements, ensuring local teams have a voice in central technology decisions.
* Manage regional escalations, service risks, resourcing pressures, supplier issues and delivery dependencies.
* Ensure vendor activity is governed effectively, including site access, quality assurance, documentation, service acceptance and escalation management.
* Provide clear and concise reporting to senior leadership on field services performance, risks, issues, priorities and improvement plans.

**Essential Experience**
**Experience and Skills Required**

* Significant experience leading field services, Local EUC, deskside support, EUC engineering, workplace technology or regional IT support functions in a complex multi-site organisation.
* Proven experience managing geographically distributed teams across multiple countries, regions or time zones.
* Strong understanding of retail technology support, corporate workplace technology, endpoint lifecycle management, local infrastructure support and centrally managed EUC services.
* Experience leading or working closely with a third-line EUC capability responsible for endpoint engineering, OS hardening, patching, software deployments, MDM, endpoint compliance and technical escalation.
* Experience operating within ITIL-aligned incident, request, problem, change and service transition processes.
* Strong knowledge of Microsoft 365, Windows/MacOS endpoint environments, mobile device management, endpoint deployment, collaboration tools and workplace technologies.
* Experience managing operational performance through KPIs, SLAs, service reviews, governance forums and continuous improvement plans.
* Demonstrable experience supporting business-critical sites, including retail, airport, branch, vault, warehouse, operational or customer-facing environments.
* Experience working in a global, matrixed, multi-vendor technology environment.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, including the ability to influence senior business, technology and regional leaders.

**Desirable Experience**

* Experience within financial services, payments, retail, travel, foreign exchange, aviation or another regulated customer-facing sector.
* Experience delivering hardware refresh, operating-system upgrade, site technology refresh, MDM, endpoint compliance or workstation standardisation programmes.
* Experience operating within or partnering with a Global Capability Centre or offshore support model.
* Experience with endpoint management tooling such as Microsoft Intune, Windows Autopilot, Apple MacOS, Ivanti, Jamf, Entra ID, Active Directory, remote support tools and asset discovery platforms.
* Experience improving asset accuracy, stock control, device lifecycle governance and field service scheduling.
* Experience supporting audit, cyber security, risk or compliance evidence activities relating to endpoint and site technologies.

**Leadership and Behavioural Expectations**

* Leads with ownership, accountability and a strong service mindset.
* Builds high-performing teams across different regions, cultures and working models.
* Communicates clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders, including senior leaders.
* Balances urgency with control, ensuring service issues are resolved quickly without compromising security, governance or quality.
* Uses data and operational insight to drive better decisions, prioritisation and service improvements.
* Creates a culture of collaboration, standardisation, continuous improvement and customer service excellence.
* Demonstrates resilience and calm leadership during high-pressure incidents, escalations and business-critical service issues.

**Qualifications And Certifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Information Systems or equivalent professional experience.
* ITIL certification is strongly preferred.
* Relevant Microsoft, endpoint management, service management, project delivery or leadership certifications are advantageous.
* Additional qualifications in IT asset management, cyber security, Lean, Agile, Prince2, COBIT or SIAM are desirable.

Noatum Maritime Services differentiates itself through deep domain knowledge, strong local relationships, understanding of local nuances and risk, and the ability to leverage the broader ecosystem of Noatum to deliver value added solutions to clients.

The role ensures that all operational activities meet agreed service levels, quality standards, and client expectations.

• Oversee accurate and complete updates of operational data in the Hub application by the team.

• Identify operational issues arising during daily activities and escalate them proactively to Line Managers as required.

• Verify and confirm the list of services delivered by Performing Offices for accuracy and completeness.

• Handle urgent requests from Principals, ensuring Performing Offices are alerted immediately, and Line Managers are kept informed.

• Conduct regular team meetings to communicate updates, discuss challenges, address process gaps, and propose solutions to avoid recurring issues.

• Support team members in training activities, ensuring the team is equipped with the necessary skills and updated knowledge.

• Prepare team schedules/rota and enhance team efficiency by providing operational and administrative support.

• Prepare operational reports as required by Line Managers for review and decision making.

• Assist in resolving Disbursement Account (DA) queries, ensuring timely and accurate responses.

• Provide support in debt collection activities, ensuring timely follow up and coordination.

• Demonstrate excellent attention to detail and accuracy in all operational tasks.

• Maintain an ability to work under pressure, handle time sensitive tasks, and meet tight deadlines.

• Apply strong analytical and problem-solving skills to improve workflows and resolve operational challenges.

**Educational and Technical Qualifications:**

• Minimum bachelor’s degree.

• Proficient in Microsoft Office.

• Able to work independently.

• Good working knowledge of Port Agency and Crewing Managers.

**Years of Experience:**

• Min. 08 Years Shipping Agency (Hub) Port Agency operations / Crewing Managers / Ship Management / Cruise Industry.

title: Custody Operations
description:
To manage the Custody, Clearing, Settlement, Treasury and Liquidity Management functions of the AMC and Mutual Fund schemes, ensuring timely settlement of trades, effective cash management, adequate scheme liquidity, reconciliations, operational controls and coordination with Custodian, Banks, Brokers, Clearing Corporations, RTA and Fund Accountant.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Manage day-to-day Custodian, Clearing and Settlement operations and relationships for equity, debt, money market and other permitted investments.
* Ensure accurate and timely securities and cash reconciliation between Custodian, Banks, Brokers, Clearing Corporation and Fund Accounting records.
* Monitor trade confirmation, allocation, settlement, pay-in/pay-out, failed trades and settlement exceptions.
* Monitor and process corporate actions and ensure timely collection/reconciliation of scheme entitlements.
* Manage daily scheme-wise treasury and cash positions, including expected inflows/outflows and payment obligations.
* Monitor liquidity requirements including intra-day borrowing for redemptions, investments, settlements, margin obligations, distributions and other scheme commitments.
* Prepare cash-flow forecasts and maintain adequate liquidity buffers while minimising idle cash
* Prepare daily/periodic Cash, Liquidity, Settlement, Custody and Reconciliation MIS for Senior Management/Fund Managers.
* Monitor margin and collateral requirements and ensure timely funding/release.
* Establish SOPs, maker-checker controls and exception monitoring for custody and treasury operations.
* Monitor applicable SEBI/AMFI, exchange, clearing and depository requirements and implement necessary process changes.

**KEY SKILLS:**

* **Custody, Clearing & Settlement:**
  Strong understanding of end-to-end trade lifecycle, settlement processes, pay-in/pay-out, failed trades and settlement exceptions.
* **Treasury & Liquidity Management:**
  Expertise in scheme-wise cash management, liquidity planning, cash-flow forecasting, funding requirements and optimisation of idle cash.
* **Capital Markets Operations:**
  Good knowledge of Equity, Debt, Money Market, Derivatives and other permitted investment products.
* **Reconciliation:**
  Strong experience in securities, cash, bank, custodian, broker, clearing corporation and fund accounting reconciliations.
* **Margin & Collateral Management:**
  Understanding of margin funding, collateral movement, utilisation, release and reconciliation.
* **Corporate Actions:**
  Knowledge of processing, monitoring and reconciliation of dividends, interest, redemptions, bonus, splits and other corporate actions.
* **Management MIS & Reporting:**
  Ability to prepare and analyse daily/periodic Treasury, Cash, Liquidity, Settlement, Custody and Reconciliation MIS and provide actionable insights to Senior Management and Fund Managers.
* **Data Analysis & Excel:**
  Strong MS Excel skills including data analysis, MIS preparation, reconciliations, dashboards and exception reporting.
* **Operational Controls & Risk Management:**
  Strong understanding of SOPs, maker-checker controls, exception management, process controls and operational risk mitigation.
* **Regulatory Knowledge:**
  Good understanding of applicable SEBI, AMFI, RBI, Exchange, Clearing Corporation and Depository regulations and operational requirements.
* **Stakeholder Management:**
  Effective coordination with Custodians, Banks, Brokers, Clearing Corporations, RTA, Fund Accountants, Fund Managers and Internal Teams.
* **Process Improvement & Automation:**
  Ability to identify operational gaps and implement process improvements, automation and control enhancements.
* **Problem Solving:**
  Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to manage time-sensitive settlement, liquidity and operational issues.
* **Communication & Team Management:**
  Strong written and verbal communication, coordination and team-management skills with the ability to work effectively under strict market timelines.

title: LAB MANAGER
description:
****JOB DESCRIPTION****
Laboratory Manager
  
  
The position is an experienced laboratory manager with excellent understanding of high pressure hydraulic testing for product qualification, electronic component testing and laboratory equipment operations. The candidate will report to the Site Director. We are seeking a candidate who possesses a strong background in high pressure testing and can demonstrate proficiency in a variety of analytical techniques. Observe and maintain safety requirements. Supervise, manage, and motivate the laborateam tory members daily. Focal contact point for the lab for all team members, including upper management regarding prijects, HSE, budget, compliance, etc.
  
  
****RESPONSIBILITIES****
SAFETY, SECURITY & COMPLIANCE
  
  

* Maintains the highest standards of corporate governance, ensuring that all activities are carried out ethically and in compliance with Company’s Security, Compliance & HSE policies, Management System, relevant laws, regulations, standards, and industry practices and complies with the Company’s Rules to Live By
* Places Quality, Health & Safety, Security and protection of the Environment as core values while never intentionally placing employees, our processes, customers or the communities in which we live and work at risk
* Seeks continual improvement in Health, Safety, Security & protection of the Environment, taking into account responsible care, process vulnerabilities, public, customer and employee inputs, knowledge and technology and best business practices to exceed customer expectations
* Supervisors & Managers should demonstrate effective safety leadership for the health and safety arrangements of all subordinates and for any persons visiting them while on the Company premises
* Responsible for all HSE related matters and legal compliance for the lab.

QUALITY
  
  

* Responsible for being familiar with the Company's Quality policies and takes an active role in the compliance and improvement of Weatherford’s Management System
* Maintains service quality as immediate priorities when working across all areas of the business and continually seeks areas for improvement
* Responsible for ensuring quality at the lab for all projects and processes.

OPERATIONS
  
  

* Contribute to product test & qualification, analysis of results, and supervise all activities at the lab.
* Maintain testing schedule for the lab assets, tracking utilization of assets, and ensuring the documentation of maintenance performed on test assets and equipment.
* Responsible to ensuring appropriate cost allocation of tests to the respective teams.
* Assists in training of non-professionals, especially in their area of experience. Within limits, consults with, and advises people requiring help with specific laboratory technical problems and procedures.
* Handles and disposes of hazardous and non-hazardous materials in accordance with safety protocols.
* Maintains and organizes laboratory supplies. Monitors inventory levels and orders or secures supplies as needed.
* Performs other miscellaneous duties as directed by the supervisor.

COMMUNICATION
  
  

* Maintains effective communications with all key stakeholders both internal and where appropriate external
* Supervisors & Managers should clearly communicate expectations, roles and responsibilities to their reports

FINANCIAL
  
  

* Responsible for the budget for the lab including lab expenses and project direct expenses.
* All employees have an accountability to the organisation to be financially responsible whether they are in charge of a function budget or simply their own expenses
* Costs incurred should be within approved budget, processed within agreed time frames & following the relevant financial policy and procedure

PEOPLE & DEVELOPMENT
  
  

* Responsible for training & development of all employees at the lab.
* Employees have a responsibility for developing their own careers within the Company including completing all necessary function, compliance & business standards training to enhance their knowledge, skills and experience
* Employees should engage on a regular basis with their line manager to discuss their personal performance, objectives and opportunities to enhance their skills and experience to support their career potential
* Supervisors are expected to actively engaging their employees to support talent management through Weatherford’s performance management process, including but not limited to talent assessments, succession planning & regular coaching opportunities
* Supervisors should collaborate with Human Resources & Training Development to drive strategies for the recruitment & retention of key personal & to foster an environment that supports the attraction & retention of a high performing talented workforce

VISION & LEADERSHIP
  
  

* Demonstrates leadership, ethical behaviour and adherence to Weatherford standards at all times

**Required**
**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Minimum Bachelors Degree with 10-12 years of operations / industrial laboratory work experience
* Experience operating material handling equipment (Forklift, Overhead Hoist, etc.).
* Experience using hand tools (Pipe Wrench, Adjustable Wrench, Screwdriver, Measuring Tape, etc.).
* 5+ years in a leadership role managing people and lab operations.
* Experience with Down-hole oilfield tools (assembly/testing/troubleshooting)

**Preferred**

* Knowledge of electronic componment testing and qualification.
* Knowledge of metallic & non-metallic material testing and qualification.
* Knowledge of API / ISO standards

**Required**
Knowledge, Skills & Abilities
  
  

* Must be able to communicate and comprehend accurately, clearly, and concisely in English at a level required to perform the job as outlined. Must have ability to make professionally effective presentations, both oral and written.
* Knowledge of laboratory tests and analyses. Knowledge of laboratory terminology and equipment.
* Must possess good work habits, a strong work ethic, and be able to adhere to company work hours, policies, and standard business etiquette.
* Ability to physically respond to emergency situations.
* Ability to read and comprehend drawings/prints and tool layouts.
* Ability to use critical thinking to solve problems.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Proficient in scheduling and time management.

**Preferred**

* Understanding of qualification processes for electronic components / PCB / electronic tools

By balancing a refined outlook with the best lifestyle programming, we capture the excitement of being in-the-know -- connecting people to the city, the culture and the moment.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Job Purpose**
To ensure the safe placement, inspection, testing, and commissioning of all electrical systems in the hotel and plant room machinery, ensuring their smooth and efficient operation.
  
  
**Prime Function**
Oversee the installation, testing, and maintenance of electrical systems and plant room machinery, coordinating with relevant vendors and management to ensure that all systems are fully operational, safe, and compliant with standards.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Understanding and Oversight of Electrical Systems**

* Thoroughly understand the High Tension (HT), Low Tension (LT), and LT to Distribution side Single Line Diagrams (SLD).
* Actively participate in the installation, testing, and commissioning of transformers, LT panels, and bus duct systems.
* Involves the testing and commissioning of each HT and LT breaker, ensuring all parameters meet the required standards.
* Ensure that transformer testing results are satisfactory and report any issues promptly.

**Generator and Plant Room Machinery Management**

* Inspect the mechanical and electrical fittings of generators, ensuring that load testing is performed jointly, and all parameters meet operational requirements.
* Oversee the testing and commissioning of bus duct systems, verifying that all parameters adhere to established standards.
* Take handover of chillers, pumps, and all plant room machinery, ensuring their technical parameters align with design specifications.

**Operational Testing and Maintenance**

* Supervision of Maintenance:

+ Supervise the maintenance and repair of the hotel's interior and exterior, including guest rooms, common areas, and external facilities. Work with the Design and Construction team, engineers, and outside architects for renovations and other projects.
+ Regularly monitor the operation of all pumps and systems, ensuring they function according to design parameters.
+ Fully engaged in the testing and commissioning of all major plant machinery, ensuring that all parameters meet operational needs.
+ Conduct daily inspections of the plant room area, reporting progress and issues as they arise.
+ Routinely check each floor’s electrical work, ensuring quality and safety, and coordinate with electrical vendors to understand the cable routing and distribution panels.

**Documentation and Record-Keeping**

+ Take responsibility for the handover of all systems, ensuring that they are operational and that all relevant documentation, including drawings and technical readings, is properly recorded.
+ Create and maintain service trackers for each system, updating history cards regularly.
+ Feed daily technical readings into the HLP sheet and maintain utility and waste management records.

**Shift Management and Reporting**

* Conduct daily inspections of plant rooms and equipment, managing energy and water use, and maintaining log sheets for shift activities.
* Follow up on pending work, ensuring a smooth handover to the next shift.

title: Head of Client Growth & Relationships
description:
**SUMMARY**

The Head of Client Growth & Relationships is responsible for leading the commercial relationship management function for the Fund Administration business, combining strategic client relationship management with revenue growth responsibility across the Group's fund administration client portfolio. The role is accountable for developing long-term partnerships with fund managers, asset managers, investment firms, and institutional clients, ensuring exceptional client experience while proactively identifying opportunities for revenue expansion, cross-selling, new mandates, and increased client value. The role leads and develops a team of Commercial Relationship Managers who are responsible for managing client relationships, strengthening client engagement, and driving commercial outcomes across their assigned portfolios. The Head acts as the senior escalation point for strategic clients and ensures the business maintains strong executive relationships with key clients. The successful candidate will bring a commercial mindset to client management, combining deep understanding of client businesses, investment strategies, growth plans, fundraising activities, geographic expansion, and operational requirements to identify opportunities where the Group can provide additional value.

**PRIMARY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Commercial Leadership & Revenue Growth**

• Develop and execute the commercial relationship strategy for the Fund Administration business, aligning client management activities with the Group's revenue growth objectives and strategic priorities.

• Own the commercial performance of the client portfolio, driving revenue growth through client retention, cross-selling, upselling, fee reviews, new fund launches, additional jurisdictions, and expanded service offerings.

• Establish commercial targets, monitor portfolio performance, review revenue trends, and implement strategies to maximize client lifetime value and profitability.

• Identify opportunities to increase wallet share by understanding client business models, investment strategies, fundraising plans, expansion objectives, and future operational requirements.

• Partner with senior management to develop commercial initiatives, market strategies, and growth opportunities across priority client segments. Strategic Client Relationship Management - Build and maintain trusted relationships with senior executives, fund managers, investment professionals, boards, and key decision-makers across strategic client accounts.

• Act as the executive sponsor for key strategic clients, ensuring senior-level engagement, strong relationship governance, and alignment between client objectives and Group capabilities.

• Develop a deep understanding of client businesses, including investment strategies, fundraising activities, portfolio growth, operational challenges, geographic expansion, and future service requirements.

• Conduct regular executive business reviews, strategic account meetings, and relationship assessments to strengthen partnerships and identify opportunities for collaboration.

• Manage complex client relationships and commercial escalations, coordinating internal stakeholders to ensure timely resolution and continued client confidence.

**Client Growth Planning & Portfolio Management**

• Establish a structured client growth planning framework across the relationship management team, ensuring each strategic client has a documented commercial development plan.

• Ensure Relationship Managers actively identify growth opportunities, including new funds, additional entities, new jurisdictions, additional services, and increased utilization of existing capabilities.

• Review client portfolios regularly to assess revenue opportunities, profitability, relationship strength, service quality, retention risks, and strategic importance.

• Develop client segmentation strategies to ensure appropriate focus, resources, and engagement models across different client categories.

• Monitor client lifecycle management activities from onboarding through expansion and renewal.

**Leadership of Commercial Relationship Management Team**

• Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of Commercial Relationship Managers responsible for managing fund manager and institutional client relationships.

• Establish clear objectives, revenue targets, client ownership responsibilities, and performance expectations for the Relationship Management team.

• Conduct regular account reviews, pipeline reviews, coaching sessions, and commercial planning meetings to improve team effectiveness.

• Build commercial capability within the team by developing skills in relationship management, consultative selling, negotiation, client strategy, and revenue generation.

• Promote a culture of accountability, proactive client engagement, continuous improvement, and ownership of commercial outcomes.

**Client Experience & Service Excellence**

• Champion a client-centric culture across the Fund Administration business, ensuring client experience remains a key strategic priority.

• Work closely with Operations, Fund Accounting, Investor Services, Compliance, Finance, and Technology teams to ensure client expectations are understood and effectively delivered.

• Monitor service quality, client satisfaction, operational challenges, and recurring issues, ensuring improvement initiatives are implemented where required.

• Establish effective communication channels between clients and internal teams to ensure transparency, responsiveness, and service excellence.

• Use client feedback and market insights to identify opportunities to improve products, services, and operating models.

**Commercial Proposals, Renewals & Negotiations**

• Lead or support commercial discussions relating to new mandates, contract renewals, pricing reviews, fee negotiations, and expanded service requirements.

• Review client agreements, commercial terms, pricing structures, and profitability considerations in collaboration with Finance, Legal, and Operations teams.

• Ensure commercial proposals reflect client needs while maintaining appropriate profitability and strategic value for the Group.

• Support successful conversion of opportunities generated through Relationship Management, Digital Business Development, and strategic partnerships.

**Collaboration with Business Development & Product Teams**

• Work closely with Digital Business Development, Strategic Partnerships, Product Specialists, and senior commercial teams to convert opportunities into sustainable client relationships.

• Support targeted campaigns and market initiatives by providing client insights, industry intelligence, and commercial feedback.

• Coordinate with product teams to identify opportunities for new service offerings, product enhancements, and market expansion.

• Ensure effective handover and transition between prospect acquisition, onboarding, relationship management, and ongoing client growth.

**Market Intelligence & Commercial Strategy**

• Monitor fund industry trends, competitor developments, regulatory changes, client expectations, and emerging opportunities within the alternative investment industry.

• Translate market intelligence into actionable commercial strategies, product opportunities, and client engagement initiatives.

• Maintain awareness of competitor positioning, pricing trends, service innovations, and evolving client requirements.

• Provide insights to senior management regarding market opportunities, client trends, and potential business risks.

**Commercial Reporting & Governance**

• Develop and maintain commercial reporting covering revenue growth, client retention, cross-selling, pipeline activity, profitability, client satisfaction, and relationship performance.

• Establish regular commercial governance meetings, portfolio reviews, account planning sessions, and performance discussions.

• Provide management with visibility over client opportunities, commercial risks, relationship health, and growth initiatives.

• Ensure CRM systems are effectively utilized to maintain accurate client information, opportunity tracking, relationship history, and commercial intelligence.

**OTHER DUTIES**

• Undertake the role of director, trustee, nominee, manager, partner, secretary, authorized signatory, Compliance, MLRO or any related position in internal entities or client entities of the Group, where necessary and required by the Management.

• Undertake such other duties, as may from time to time, be required by the Management or/ and Group Human Resources.

**CANDIDATE PROFILE**

• Bachelor's Degree in Finance, Business Administration, Economics, Commerce, or a related discipline.

• Professional qualifications in finance, investment management, client relationship management, or business leadership would be advantageous.

• Minimum 12-14 years of experience in financial services, fund administration, asset management, fiduciary services, or institutional client relationship management.

• Significant experience managing senior client relationships within the fund industry, including experience with fund managers, alternative investment managers, private equity firms, hedge funds, or institutional investors.

• Demonstrated experience managing individual and team revenue targets, client portfolios, commercial negotiations, and business growth initiatives.

• Experience leading and developing relationship management or client servicing teams.

• Strong understanding of fund administration, fund accounting, investor services, transfer agency, alternative investment structures, private equity funds, hedge funds, and institutional investment operations.

• Strong understanding of client lifecycle management, commercial account management, pricing strategies, profitability analysis, and revenue growth models.

• Knowledge of CRM platforms, commercial reporting tools, pipeline management systems, and business intelligence solutions.

• Ability to interpret financial information, client profitability data, operational performance metrics, and market intelligence.

title: Senior Manager- Key Accounts
description:
**Job Description**
**About the Function:**
Sales is where our brands meet the real world. This team builds the relationships that bring our products to life, partnering closely with customers across markets, channels and occasions to make sure our brands are part of moments that matter.
  
  
It’s a dynamic, people-focused environment where curiosity, commercial thinking and strong relationships make the difference. You’ll have the opportunity to grow your network, develop your skills and see the direct impact of your work every day.
  
  
**About The Role**
AREAS OF RESPONSIBILITY
  
  
1 Commercial delivery
  
  

* Develop sales and marketing plans to build consumer preference and drive volumes for achievement and growth in the territory.
* Develop and monitor individual sales objectives on monthly / quarterly and annual basis.
* Ensure the NSV achievement in the territory is as per budget and maintain the right brand mix.
* Ensure Increase in Share of Business (Market Share) across segments as per plan NSV

2 Relationship & team management
  
  

* Maintain relationships with all the key accounts for ensuring overall pipeline & revenue growth within channel and territory.
* Engage channels to close sales and deliver services thereby ensuring higher market share.
* Work as SPOC for the organisation and establish strong rapport with channel partners to win confidence, anticipate needs and deliver appropriate product solutions

3 S&D/ Tie-ups
  
  

* Meet the WOD targets of the brands by ensuring the availability of relevant brands & variants on the outlets in the territory.
* Manage the new product launches in the region.
* Negotiate & finalize annual contract and terms of trade with key accounts in the territory. WOD

4 Customer marketing
  
  

* Responsible for on time and smooth execution of the activations as per marketing plan by selecting the right outlets in the territory
* Prepare reporting on the brand’s performance, needs and forecasts.
* Ensure proper usage of brand and promotional elements and measure effectiveness of consumer activations (ROS / M&E).
* Coordinate with 3rd party agency for execution of the activations / launch at the outlet. On time/Right outlets selection/ROS/M&E

5 Process & systems
  
  

* Make regular sales calls to designated on premise accounts to cultivate customer relations and satisfaction with service provided.
* Keep the trade informed about pricing, promotion schemes etc.
* Responsible for the correct and timely submission of the claims and daily sales reports.
* Keep a track on the competitor’s activity and report the same to the reporting manager.
* Keep track of the KAE's monthly Outlet wise Sales plan & report & monitor the same to ensure monthly IOP NSV & Market share targets are being met for the Region Reports

6 Execution & staff training
  
  

* Maintain the organisation standard wrt. Quality, distribution, visibility, promotion, price and persuasion at the outlet.
* Effectively train customer staff on products and execute product tastings and product presentations.
* Execute the marketing plans at the outlets as per the guidelines of the from state / regional marketing team while working within company policies, resources and budgets. QDVP Contracts to drive Market share/Visibility/Activations

7 Collection
  
  

* Review customers' credit status and collect outstanding as per the USL credit policy.
* Coordinate with Finance department on a weekly basis to ensure accounts remain in good standing Collections

**Experience / Skills Required**

* MBA in Sales / Marketing preferred

**Experience**

* 6-8 year’s experience in sales in Alco-Bev or FMCG industry
* Could be from the hospitality sector

**Knowledge & Skills**

* Maintain healthy Client Relationships
* Thorough knowledge of Sales Planning & MIS
* Emphasizing strong focus on Excellence
* Developing & managing a team
* Negotiation & commercial acumen
* Presentation Skills
* Communication Skills

Best Suited for someone who
  
  

* Likes to understand the psyche of others
* Has a very strong service focus
* Believes in perfection when it comes to execution
* Wants to be in the premium end of the business
* Is more Urban/Metro/Headquarter oriented
* Interested in learning about Premium/Luxury brands
* Is a good team player & Good Team Manager

**Working with us**
Flexibility is key to our success. Talk to us about what flexibility means to you, so that you’re supported to manage your wellbeing and balance your priorities from day one.
  
  
We recognise and value performance, offering our people a highly competitive Rewards and Benefits package.
  
  
Our purpose is crafting iconic drinks chosen for life’s moments. And it’s our people, with their different experiences, perspectives and talents, who make that possible.
  
  
We value diversity in its broadest sense and want everyone to feel they can belong, contribute and strive for their personal best. You’ll work alongside people with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives — challenging, supporting and learning from one another as one outstanding team.
  
  
Together, we’re constantly learning and improving, combining the strength of our people, capabilities and iconic brands to raise the bar, grow and win. Wherever you join us, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute, make an impact and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.
  
  
Ready to bring your best? This could be your opportunity.

title: Operations Manager
description:
Operations Manager – Hospitality & Resort Operations

**Location:** The Whispering Woods Resort, Mumbai  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time | On-Site  
**Accommodation:** Must be willing to stay at the property

Job Summary

We are looking for a highly responsible, hands-on, and experienced **Operations Manager** to oversee and manage the complete day-to-day operations of The Whispering Woods Resort.

The Operations Manager will be responsible for ensuring the smooth and efficient functioning of every department, including Front Office, Housekeeping, Food & Beverage, Kitchen, Maintenance, Guest Relations, Stores, Security, and other operational functions.

This is a hands-on leadership role that requires someone who can take complete ownership of the property's daily functioning, manage departmental teams, establish systems and SOPs, monitor performance, resolve operational challenges, and ensure that all departments work together seamlessly.

The ideal candidate should be highly organised, proactive, disciplined, and capable of running the entire operational setup independently, with minimal day-to-day supervision from management.

**The candidate must be willing to stay at the property and remain available as and when operational requirements arise, including during weekends, holidays, and busy periods.**

Key Responsibilities1. Overall Property Operations

* Take complete ownership of the day-to-day operations of the resort.
* Oversee all departments and ensure smooth coordination between teams.
* Ensure that every department is functioning efficiently and meeting operational expectations.
* Conduct daily property rounds and monitor the overall readiness, cleanliness, maintenance, and functioning of the resort.
* Ensure all guest areas, rooms, restaurants, activity areas, outdoor spaces, and facilities are maintained to the required standards.
* Identify operational gaps and take immediate corrective action.
* Ensure the property is always prepared for guest arrivals, events, group bookings, and special occasions.

2. Departmental Management

* Directly supervise and coordinate with departmental heads and team leaders.
* Monitor the performance of Front Office, Housekeeping, Food & Beverage, Kitchen, Maintenance, Stores, Security, and Guest Relations.
* Establish clear responsibilities, reporting structures, and accountability across departments.
* Ensure adequate manpower deployment and effective duty allocation.
* Monitor attendance, punctuality, grooming, discipline, and staff productivity.
* Conduct regular departmental meetings and performance reviews.
* Ensure interdepartmental coordination and prevent operational delays or communication gaps.

3. SOP Development & Implementation

* Develop, document, and implement Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for every department.
* Establish clear workflows, checklists, reporting formats, and daily operating routines.
* Create opening and closing checklists for departments.
* Implement standard processes for guest check-in, check-out, housekeeping, room inspections, food service, maintenance requests, inventory, and complaint handling.
* Ensure all employees are trained on their respective SOPs.
* Conduct regular audits to ensure SOP compliance.
* Continuously improve systems to increase efficiency and reduce operational errors.

4. Team Management & Leadership

* Lead, manage, train, and motivate the entire operational team.
* Ensure every employee understands their responsibilities and performance expectations.
* Identify staffing requirements and coordinate with HR for recruitment.
* Ensure proper onboarding and departmental training for new employees.
* Address staff grievances, disciplinary matters, and performance-related concerns.
* Maintain a professional, accountable, and service-oriented work culture.
* Develop strong departmental leaders who can independently manage their respective teams.

5. Guest Experience & Service Standards

* Ensure exceptional guest experiences throughout the guest journey.
* Monitor guest feedback, complaints, and service quality.
* Personally handle escalated guest concerns and ensure timely resolution.
* Ensure rooms, restaurants, facilities, and guest areas are ready before guest arrival.
* Monitor service delivery, response times, and guest satisfaction.
* Coordinate with all departments to ensure special requests, celebrations, and guest requirements are fulfilled.
* Maintain consistent hospitality standards across the property.

6. Maintenance & Property Upkeep

* Oversee the maintenance and upkeep of the entire property.
* Ensure timely preventive maintenance of electrical systems, plumbing, HVAC, equipment, furniture, fixtures, pools, and other facilities.
* Maintain a preventive maintenance schedule and ensure timely execution.
* Coordinate with technicians, contractors, and external vendors.
* Ensure all operational issues are reported, tracked, and resolved.
* Maintain the overall appearance, landscaping, cleanliness, lighting, and infrastructure of the resort.

7. Inventory, Procurement & Cost Control

* Monitor departmental inventories, stock levels, and consumption.
* Establish proper inventory tracking and stock management systems.
* Ensure purchase requests, GRNs, stock registers, and consumption reports are maintained.
* Monitor wastage, pilferage, and unnecessary operational expenses.
* Coordinate with procurement and vendors to ensure timely availability of supplies.
* Maintain accountability for departmental assets, equipment, and consumables.
* Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency and control costs without compromising guest experience.

8. Events & Special Operations

* Oversee operational planning and execution of events, weddings, corporate gatherings, private celebrations, and special experiences.
* Coordinate with Sales, Events, F&B, Housekeeping, Security, and Maintenance teams.
* Ensure manpower, equipment, food, décor, and facilities are arranged as per event requirements.
* Conduct pre-event inspections and post-event reviews.
* Ensure events are executed smoothly without disrupting regular resort operations.

9. Reporting & Performance Monitoring

* Prepare and maintain daily, weekly, and monthly operational reports.
* Monitor departmental performance, manpower productivity, guest feedback, maintenance issues, and inventory consumption.
* Establish measurable KPIs for every department.
* Review departmental checklists and compliance reports.
* Report operational challenges, requirements, and improvement plans to management.
* Provide regular updates on property performance and ensure timely closure of pending tasks.

10. Compliance, Safety & Discipline

* Ensure adherence to applicable statutory requirements, safety standards, and property policies.
* Monitor fire safety, security, hygiene, food safety, and emergency preparedness.
* Ensure proper documentation, registers, licences, and departmental records are maintained.
* Conduct regular safety and operational inspections.
* Ensure employees follow grooming, uniform, hygiene, and workplace discipline standards.

On-Site Responsibilities & Availability

* The candidate must reside at the resort premises.
* Must be available to handle operational requirements beyond standard working hours whenever necessary.
* Must be actively involved during peak occupancy, weekends, holidays, and major events.
* Should be capable of independently handling unexpected operational situations and emergencies.
* Must maintain a strong presence across departments and ensure continuous operational supervision.

Qualifications & Experience

* Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Hotel Management, Hospitality Management, or a related field.
* 5–10 years of experience in hotel, resort, or hospitality operations.
* Prior experience as an Operations Manager, Resort Manager, Assistant General Manager, or senior departmental operations professional.
* Experience managing multiple departments and large operational teams.
* Strong understanding of Front Office, Housekeeping, Food & Beverage, Kitchen, Maintenance, and Guest Services.
* Proven experience in developing and implementing SOPs and operational systems.
* Experience in handling events and high-occupancy operations will be an advantage.

Required Skills

* End-to-End Resort Operations Management
* Multi-Department Supervision
* SOP Development & Implementation
* Team Leadership & Workforce Management
* Guest Experience Management
* Operational Planning & Execution
* Inventory & Cost Control
* Vendor & Procurement Coordination
* Maintenance & Property Management
* Staff Training & Performance Monitoring
* Reporting & MIS
* Problem Solving & Crisis Management
* Time Management & Decision Making
* Strong Communication & Interpersonal Skills

Preferred Candidate Profile

* A hands-on professional who believes in taking ownership rather than simply delegating responsibilities.
* Strong leadership skills with the ability to manage different departments and teams.
* Highly disciplined, organised, and process-oriented.
* Capable of independently running the property's day-to-day operations.
* Someone who can identify problems before they escalate and take corrective action.
* Strong attention to detail and high standards of cleanliness, service, and maintenance.
* Comfortable working in a dynamic hospitality environment with operational demands beyond regular office hours.
* Willing to stay at the property and take complete responsibility for its functioning.

Compensation

Competitive salary, commensurate with experience, qualifications, and operational expertise.

Pay: ₹30,000.00 - ₹50,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Food provided

* Current CTC ?

Diploma / BE in Mechanical Engineering

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented Machine Shop Manager to lead our machining operations. The candidate will be responsible for managing CNC, VMC, HMC, VTL and conventional machining processes, ensuring production targets, product quality, machine utilisation and timely delivery.

Key Responsibilities

1. Manage day-to-day machine shop operations, including CNC, VMC, HMC, VTL and grinding machines.
2. Plan and execute production schedules to achieve daily and monthly targets.
3. Monitor machine utilisation, OEE, productivity and cycle time.
4. Ensure optimal utilisation of manpower, machines, tools and raw materials.
5. Reduce machining cycle time, rejections, rework and production losses.
6. Coordinate with Quality, Maintenance, Planning, Purchase and Dispatch departments.
7. Ensure adherence to engineering drawings, tolerances and customer specifications.
8. Implement 5S, Kaizen, Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement practices.
9. Monitor tool management, tool life, cutting parameters and machining costs.
10. Ensure preventive maintenance and minimise machine breakdowns.
11. Develop and manage supervisors, operators and shop-floor employees.
12. Maintain production reports, rejection reports, downtime records and other MIS data.
13. Ensure compliance with workplace safety standards and company procedures.

Required Skills & Competencies

* Strong knowledge of CNC, VMC, HMC, VTL and precision machining.
* Knowledge of machining processes, cutting tools and tooling selection.
* Ability to read engineering drawings and understand GD&T.
* Strong production planning and shop-floor management skills.
* Knowledge of OEE, TPM, 5S, Kaizen and Lean Manufacturing.
* Experience in manpower management and productivity improvement.
* Strong leadership, problem-solving and decision-making abilities.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Production target achievement
* Machine utilisation and OEE
* On-time delivery performance
* Rejection and rework percentage
* Cycle time reduction
* Machine downtime
* Manpower productivity
* Tool consumption and machining cost

Preferred Candidate

* A hands-on manufacturing professional with strong technical knowledge, leadership capabilities and the ability to manage high-volume precision machining operations while maintaining quality, productivity and delivery commitments.

title: Supply Planning Leader
description:
**About WhiteCrow**

We are global talent research, insight and pipelining specialists with offices in the UK, USA, Singapore, Malaysia, Hong Kong, Dubai, and India. Our international reach has helped us to understand and penetrate specialist markets at a global level. In addition to this, our service is also extended to complement our client’s in-house research.

**About our client**

For more than 80 years, our client’s engineers and product specialists have partnered with customers to produce highly engineered connectivity and sensing solutions that make a connected world possible. Their focus on reliability, durability, and sustainability exemplifies their commitment to progress. The unmatched range of their product portfolio enables companies, large and small, to turn ideas into technology that can transform how the world works and lives tomorrow.

**About the role**

* Supply Planning Leader is accountable for end-to-end supply planning across an assigned product portfolio and multiple distribution centers.
* The role ensures timely, cost-effective product availability while balancing customer service, inventory health, working capital, capacity, and logistics performance. This leader converts demand into feasible supply plans, manages risks and constraints, and drives cross-functional execution and continuous improvement in a global, matrix environment.

**As a Supply Planning Leader, you will be responsible for...**

* Developing and executing supply plans aligned with customer demand, inventory targets, business priorities, capacity, material availability, supplier constraints, and transportation lead times.
* Ensuring finished-goods availability and timely replenishment across distribution centers, regional warehouses, and source plants by driving MRP recommendations and monitoring plan adherence.
* Leading weekly and monthly supply reviews and actively supporting S&OP and S&OE by providing supply status, reviewing demand outlook, recommending trade-offs, and driving approved actions.
* Optimizing safety stock, MRP policies, inventory deployment, stock coverage, turns, availability, and working capital while maintaining healthy inventory levels.
* Managing phase-in and phase-out planning for the assigned portfolio.
* Identifying demand-supply gaps, capacity bottlenecks, material constraints, revenue risks, and service opportunities; leading root-cause analysis, recovery plans, prioritization, and allocation decisions.
* Supporting customer-service targets, including Fill Rate, STR, OTIF, and PP Confirmation, by aligning commitments with realistic supply capabilities.
* Partnering with Demand Planning, Procurement, Manufacturing, Logistics, Customer Service, Product Management, and Sales on material availability, inventory strategy, supply risks, and executive reviews.
* Preparing monthly and annual inventory and freight projections and improving sourcing and transportation economics, including ocean buying from source.

**What you already have...**

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Operations, Business, or a related field.
* 10+ years of experience in supply planning, materials planning, inventory management, manufacturing, distribution, OEM, automotive, industrial, or aftermarket environments.
* At least 4 years of team-leadership experience, with demonstrated stakeholder management, influencing, communication, and problem-solving capability.
* Experience working effectively in fast-paced, global, matrix, and ambiguous environments.
* Strong knowledge of supply and demand planning, forecasting, inventory optimization, capacity and constraint management, distribution networks, transportation, warehousing, and S&OP/S&OE.
* Proficiency in SAP MRP and inventory planning, SAP IBP, and advanced Microsoft Excel; strong Microsoft PowerPoint and analytics capability.

title: Social Team Lead (India)
description:
Pattern is one of Australia's leading e-commerce digital agencies, awarded Australia's Best Digital Agency at the NORA Awards. We are also the largest seller on Amazon globally, representing brands across all product categories.
  
  
Our team is data-driven, collaborative and ambitious, working across digital marketing, e-commerce consultancy and marketplace management. We support professional development with structured training and development plans in the first 12 months.
  
  
Pattern is expanding, and we are looking for a Social Team Lead to lead our India-based social assistants in Pune. You will own the team's social workload, across paid social builds and social commerce, and drive the AI and automation initiatives that help our Australian and Indian social teams deliver more, faster and with fewer errors. This role suits a proactive leader and innovator with a genuine curiosity for AI and process improvement.
  
  
**What is the day in the life of a Social Team Lead?**
**Team leadership**

* Line-manage the two Social Assistants: 1:1s, delegation, capacity planning, quality checks, career development and performance reviews.
* Manage and allocate the team's ad build workload across all clients, acting as the first point of contact for Account Managers on build requests, timelines and capacity.
* Ensure briefs are actioned within agreed SLAs and quality check builds before Account Manager QA, so campaigns go live with no errors.
* Create and maintain playbooks so best practice is applied consistently across accounts and team members.
* Flag capacity risks early, especially in the lead-up to peak, and recommend solutions.

**AI and automation**

* Own the social team's AI and automation roadmap: identify manual, repetitive work, prioritise what to build and deliver it (e.g. automated ad briefing, ad builds, reporting, pacing alerts, bulk updates, AI-assisted optimisation).
* Run and improve the automated ad briefing workflow (client content calendar to Asana), including tagging the right builders and keeping briefs and calendars in sync.
* Build and maintain automated workflows and alerts (e.g. Claude with the Supermetrics connector, n8n, Launchpad/Payload) that cut manual effort and errors, starting with Meta and expanding to other platforms.
* Track and report the hours saved by each automation, reviewed monthly.
* Drive adoption of internal and AI tools across the team, and document every automation in the Social AI Bible (what it does, how to run it, who owns it) so it can be reused.
* Feedback to the tech team on internal tool feature requirements, and ensure all tools follow Pattern's data privacy and client data requirements.

**Paid social execution and optimisation**

* Execute and optimise paid social activity across Meta, TikTok, Pinterest and Reddit, including budget and KPI/results tracking.
* Monitor campaign performance, look for opportunities to scale and improve results, and make recommendations.
* Support TikTok Shop and social commerce delivery, including shop and product catalogue setup, Shop ads (GMV Max) builds and optimisation, and affiliate creator campaigns, working with the AU team as Pattern's social commerce offering grows.
* Stay across platform updates and social trends, and share relevant learnings with the team.

**Reporting, process and collaboration**

* Partner with Analytics and Account Managers to turn reporting (Looker Studio, Supermetrics) into decisions and recommendations.
* Keep refining processes to improve efficiency without losing quality.
* Work closely with the AU-based Social team, communicating clearly across time zones on progress, blockers and timelines.

**Skills And Qualifications**

* At least 5 years' experience in social media, paid social or performance marketing (social commerce experience a plus), ideally within an agency.
* Team management experience.
* A proven track record of using AI tools (e.g. Claude) and automation or workflow tools (e.g. n8n) to remove manual work, with examples of time saved.
* Proficient in social ad managers including Meta, TikTok, Pinterest and Reddit.
* Excellent analytical skills, including budget management, data interpretation and attention to detail, with experience in Supermetrics, Looker Studio, Google Analytics and Google Suite.
* Experience with Asana or similar project management tools.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, and comfortable working with an Australian team across time zones.
* Marketing, Communications and/or Social Media university graduate.
* Experience working with retail or e-commerce brands (desirable).

**Desired Traits & Competencies**

* Game Changers - look at problems with an open mind, share new ideas, and actively pursue improvements to Pattern's processes and outcomes, especially through AI and automation.
* Data Fanatics - understand problems through data, draw unbiased conclusions that lead to actionable solutions, and keep tracking the effects (e.g. hours saved, error rates).
* Partner Obsessed - clearly explain the status of work to Account Managers and clients, listen to expectations and deliver results that exceed them.
* Team of Doers - uplift team members and recognise their contributions, take initiative, and hold themselves accountable to the team and to partners.
* Builds delivered within agreed SLAs, with minimal errors reaching Account Manager QA.
* Measurable hours saved per week from automation initiatives, reviewed monthly.
* Every automation documented in the Social AI Bible with a clear owner.
* Be prepared to talk about professional accomplishments with specific data to quantify examples.
* Bring examples of automations or AI workflows you have built, and the time they saved.
* Be ready to talk about how you have led and developed a team.
* Focus on how you would make a difference at Pattern.

**Why should I work at Pattern?**
Pattern offers big opportunities to make a difference. We are a company full of talented industry experts that evolves quickly and often, we set big goals and work tirelessly to achieve them, and we love our Pattern family. We also believe in having fun and balancing our lives.
  
  
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Provide strategic, technical, and people leadership for Stantec’s global Data Center business. Lead the growth of the GDC’s end-to-end data center capability, leveraging multidisciplinary expertise to deliver resilient, sustainable, and scalable solutions across the full project lifecycle. Develop strong client and stakeholder relationships, support business growth, build technical and digital capability, and establish the GDC as a trusted global delivery partner for hyperscale, colocation, enterprise, and AI-driven data center projects.

Other duties as requested by the Team Lead and Business Line Lead.
  
  
**Person Specifications And Qualifications**
Stantec needs an experienced Data Center professional with a strong engineering background and broad multidisciplinary understanding. The ideal candidate will combine technical depth with client leadership, commercial awareness, business development and team-building capability.

description:
**Company Description**
Global Hospital and Research Institute, Pune is a NABH-accredited tertiary care hospital, offering comprehensive medical and surgical services to a wide range of patients. The hospital is committed to delivering high-quality, evidence-based care supported by robust clinical governance and safety standards. Located in Pune, it serves as a key healthcare provider for the region, with a focus on patient-centric services and continuous improvement. The institute also emphasizes research and advanced medical practices, creating opportunities for healthcare professionals to grow in a structured, quality-driven environment.
  
**Role Description**
The MRD Incharge / MRD Executive is responsible for overseeing and managing the Medical Records Department (MRD) to ensure accurate, secure, and timely handling of patient records. Day-to-day tasks include organizing, updating, and retrieving medical records; ensuring compliance with hospital policies, NABH standards, and legal requirements; and maintaining confidentiality and proper documentation practices. The role involves coordinating with clinical and administrative teams for record completion, coding, filing, and archiving, as well as supporting audits, data reporting, and quality initiatives related to medical records. This is a full-time, on-site role located in the Pune Division, requiring consistent presence to supervise MRD operations and support smooth hospital workflows.
  
**Qualifications**

* Strong knowledge of medical records management, including filing systems, indexing, archiving, and retrieval processes, preferably in a NABH-accredited hospital.
* Understanding of hospital documentation standards, regulatory and medico-legal requirements, and compliance with patient data confidentiality and privacy norms.
* Proficiency in hospital information systems, electronic medical records (EMR), and basic computer skills (MS Office, data entry, database management).
* Effective organizational, time management, and coordination skills to handle high volumes of records and support departmental workflows.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with medical, nursing, and administrative staff and address documentation queries.
* Attention to detail and accuracy in record verification, coding, and documentation, with an ability to support audit and quality improvement activities.
* Relevant educational background such as a diploma or degree in Hospital Administration, Health Information Management, or a related field; prior MRD experience in a healthcare setting is preferred.
* Ability to work in a structured, fast-paced hospital environment, uphold ethical standards, and support continuous process improvement in the MRD.
