**About the Role**

We are seeking a handson Production Head to lead the planning, execution, and delivery of high-quality video and visual content across campaigns, product stories, digital platforms, and brand communications.

This role requires both creative judgement and strong operational leadership: you will shape the visual direction of shoots, manage production teams and external partners, control budgets and timelines, and build reliable systems for content production at scale.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1.Production Strategy & Planning**

* Own the end-to-end production pipeline for video and visual content: briefing, concepting, pre-production, shoot execution, post-production, versioning, and delivery.
* Translate campaign briefs, creative directions, and brand objectives into practical production plans, schedules, budgets, and resource requirements.
* Develop scopes of work, production estimates, timelines, staffing plans, call sheets, and shoot schedules for projects of varying scale.
* Plan shoots to maximise asset output, ensuring each production supports campaign films, product videos, social-first content, website assets, and multi-format adaptations.
* Anticipate production risks, resolve on-set challenges quickly, and escalate issues with clear recommendations.

**2.Creative & Cinematic Leadership**

* Collaborate with the Creative Director and photography team to develop campaign concepts, treatments, moodboards, storyboards, shot lists, and visual references.
* Provide strong creative direction on visual storytelling, framing, composition, lighting, camera movement, styling interactions, and overall production aesthetic.
* Act as a senior creative and technical lead on set when required directing talent, camera crews, stylists, art directors, and production assistants.
* Ensure the visual language remains premium, cohesive, and aligned with the brand’s identity across every asset.
* Stay current with emerging formats, platform trends, music trends, production techniques, and competitor benchmarks to keep content relevant and distinctive.

**3.Team, Vendor & Budget Management**

* Lead, mentor, and coordinate internal videographers, editors, photographers, production assistants, and freelance crew.
* Build and manage a trusted roster of production partners, directors, DoPs, stylists, editors, colourists, sound designers, rental houses, and post-production vendors.
* Source, evaluate, negotiate with, and manage external vendors and agencies to ensure quality, cost efficiency, and timely delivery.
* Own project budgets, forecasts, cost tracking, vendor negotiations, contracts, invoices, equipment rentals, and resource allocation.
* Identify opportunities to improve cost efficiency without compromising creative quality or brand standards.

**4.Shoot Execution & Quality Control**

* Oversee studio and location shoots, including logistics, permits, equipment, crew coordination, talent requirements, styling needs, and safe working practices.
* Ensure cameras, lighting, grip, audio, and technical workflows are appropriate for each project’s creative and budgetary requirements.
* Review footage, rough cuts, edits, colour grades, sound mixes, and final masters to ensure technical quality, continuity, and brand consistency.
* Manage feedback loops with creative, design, styling, marketing, and social teams; consolidate feedback and drive revisions efficiently.
* Maintain high standards across all deliverables, from cinematic campaign films to fast-turnaround social content.

**5.Post-Production & Asset Management**

* Oversee editing, colour grading, sound design, motion graphics, subtitles, versioning, and adaptations across formats and platforms.
* Build standardised post-production workflows, review processes, naming conventions, file structures, and delivery specifications.
* Manage the organisation, backup, archival, rights documentation, and reuse of footage and finished assets.
* Ensure timely delivery of final assets and adaptations across web, social, retail, paid media, and internal channels.

**Qualifications & Skills**

* **4–5 years of experience in video production, content production, agency production, or in-house brand creative teams.**
* Proven experience leading shoots and managing multiple projects from brief to final delivery.
* **Strong portfolio or production reel**

  demonstrating campaign content, product videos, fashion/lifestyle work, social content, and high-quality visual storytelling.
* Hands-on proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro and/or DaVinci Resolve; working knowledge of After Effects, Audition, Photoshop, and Lightroom is preferred.
* Solid understanding of camera systems, lenses, lighting, composition, colour grading, sound, and post-production workflows.
* Experience managing production budgets, vendor negotiations, crew bookings, equipment rentals, and project timelines.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to balance creative ambition, operational practicality, and commercial efficiency.
* Comfort leading teams while remaining hands-on during shoots and urgent content requirements.
* Willingness to travel for shoots, when required.
* Experience in fashion, luxury, lifestyle, beauty, retail, e-commerce, or craftsmanship led brands.
* Experience in planning and executing experiential events, brand activations, on-ground shoots, and live brand experiences, including production planning, vendor coordination, logistics, and on-site execution.

**Equipment:**

Candidates must own a professional camera and lens kit, essential lighting and grip equipment, editing hardware, and storage/backup solutions.

title: Procurement Manager
description:
**Company Description**
Amrita Hospital, Faridabad is India’s largest multispeciality private hospital, offering comprehensive healthcare services across a wide range of specialties. The hospital combines exceptional facilities and advanced medical technology to deliver high-quality patient care. With round-the-clock services, the team is committed to providing compassionate care 24x7. Amrita Hospital fosters a collaborative, patient-centered environment where healthcare professionals and support teams work together to help individuals embrace good health.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Procurement Manager role based at Amrita Hospital in Faridabad. The Procurement Manager will oversee end-to-end procurement activities, including sourcing medical equipment, consumables, services, and non-medical supplies in line with hospital standards and budgetary guidelines. Daily responsibilities include managing supplier relationships, evaluating vendor performance, negotiating contracts and pricing, and ensuring timely availability of critical items to support clinical and operational needs. The role involves coordinating with clinical departments, finance, and operations to forecast requirements, maintain optimal inventory levels, and adhere to regulatory and compliance standards. The Procurement Manager will also monitor procurement data, analyze spending patterns, and implement process improvements to enhance efficiency and cost-effectiveness.

* Proficiency in contract negotiation and contract management to secure favorable terms and ensure compliance with hospital policies.

description:

Hospital Operations

Chief Operating Officer (COO)

Krisha Hospital, Ahmedabad

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

1. JOB PURPOSE

The Junior Manager – Healthcare Management will work closely with the
**Chief Operating Officer (COO)**
to support the efficient functioning, coordination, monitoring, and continuous improvement of hospital operations.

The role will focus on ensuring that clinical, administrative, patient-care, and support functions operate in a coordinated, efficient, patient-centric, and process-driven manner.

The candidate will be expected to understand hospital workflows, identify operational gaps, coordinate with different departments, monitor performance, and support implementation of systems and processes defined by the COO.

2. KEY RESPONSIBILITIESA. Hospital Operations

* Monitor day-to-day hospital operations and ensure smooth functioning of all departments.
* Coordinate between OPD, IPD, OT, physiotherapy, nursing, reception, billing, pharmacy, diagnostics, and other support services.
* Identify operational bottlenecks and report them to the COO.
* Assist in implementing corrective and preventive actions.
* Ensure that hospital SOPs and operational protocols are followed.
* Monitor patient movement and workflow from registration to consultation, investigations, admission, surgery, discharge, and follow-up.

B. Patient Experience & Service Quality

* Monitor patient experience at various touchpoints.
* Track patient complaints, feedback, delays, and service-related concerns.
* Coordinate with relevant departments for timely resolution of complaints.
* Develop and maintain patient-service improvement initiatives.
* Monitor waiting times and patient flow.

C. Data & MIS Management

* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly operational MIS reports.
* Track OPD, IPD, surgeries, admissions, discharges, cancellations, occupancy, revenue, and other operational indicators.
* Maintain dashboards for management review.
* Analyse operational data and highlight trends, gaps, and areas requiring intervention.
* Support the COO in preparing management presentations and review reports.

D. Quality & Compliance

* Assist in implementation and monitoring of NABH-related processes.
* Ensure departmental documentation and records are maintained appropriately.
* Conduct periodic internal operational audits as directed.
* Monitor compliance with hospital SOPs and checklists.
* Assist in preparing the hospital for inspections, audits, and accreditation activities.

E. Human Resource Coordination

* Coordinate with departmental heads regarding staffing requirements and operational issues.
* Monitor attendance, duty rosters, punctuality, and manpower deployment where required.
* Assist in onboarding and orientation of new employees.
* Identify training requirements and coordinate staff training programmes.
* Support performance monitoring of operational staff.

F. OT & Clinical Operations Coordination

* Coordinate with OT, nursing, anaesthesia, physiotherapy, and other departments to facilitate smooth surgical workflows.
* Monitor OT scheduling and identify avoidable delays.
* Coordinate pre-operative and post-operative processes.
* Assist in improving surgical turnaround time and patient preparedness.

G. Inventory & Resource Management

* Monitor availability of essential operational supplies.
* Coordinate with stores, pharmacy, purchase, and administration.
* Identify wastage, shortages, and unnecessary expenditure.
* Assist in maintaining appropriate inventory levels.

H. Process Improvement

* Identify opportunities for improving hospital efficiency.
* Assist in developing SOPs, checklists, workflows, and dashboards.
* Support digitalisation and automation of hospital processes.
* Conduct root-cause analysis for recurring operational problems.
* Assist the COO in implementing new operational initiatives.

3. KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)

* OPD/IPD operational efficiency
* Patient waiting time
* Patient satisfaction and complaint resolution
* OT utilisation and operational efficiency
* Admission-to-discharge process efficiency
* SOP compliance
* MIS accuracy and timeliness
* Operational cost control
* Staff productivity and coordination
* Quality and NABH compliance
* Successful implementation of COO-directed projects

4. REQUIRED QUALIFICATION

**Preferred:**

* MBA/MHA/PG Diploma in Hospital & Healthcare Management
* BHA/Bachelor's in Hospital Administration or equivalent
* MBBS/BDS/BPT/B.Sc. Nursing with healthcare management experience may also be considered.

5. EXPERIENCE

* **2–5 years**
  of experience in hospital/healthcare operations preferred.
* Experience in a multispecialty/specialty hospital will be an advantage.
* Candidates with strong hospital-management internships and demonstrable operational skills may also be considered.

* Data analysis
* SOP implementation
* Problem-solving
* Team management
* Communication skills
* Patient-service orientation

title: Technical Analyst - Trader
description:
Job Title: Technical Analyst

Location: Noida

**Company Overview:**

SIHO Research is a cutting-edge stock research and analytics firm that provides high-quality, data-driven investment insights. We leverage the latest technology, including AI, ML, and both fundamental and technical analysis, to evaluate and execute investment opportunities. We are a team of Software Architects, Engineers, Equity research analysts, AI engineers who are passionate about equity investing with a vision to make investing simple and provide the best research services. Our first B2C product is
investvidhi.com
. 

**Job Role Overview:**

We are looking for a Technical Analyst who can identify trading opportunities in Indian equities and turn analysis into clear, actionable research.

You should be comfortable explaining
**why a trade is attractive, what would invalidate it, and how its risk should be managed.**

The role combines chart analysis, strategy testing, market tracking, and research communication.

**Key responsibilities**

* Analyse price action, volume, trends, market structure, support and resistance, and relative strength.
* Identify swing and positional trading opportunities using a repeatable research process.
* Prepare a weekly watchlist and timely trade proposals with entry conditions, stop-loss, targets, expected holding period, and supporting rationale.
* Assess market direction, sector strength, liquidity, volatility, and relevant company events before proposing trades.
* Monitor active recommendations and propose timely updates, exits, or invalidations.
* Backtest trading strategies and evaluate their performance after transaction costs and slippage.
* Maintain a complete research journal covering successful, unsuccessful, and missed trades.
* Work with fundamental analysts to strengthen stock selection and identify material business risks.
* Collaborate with engineers to build screeners, alerts, dashboards, and research automation.
* Prepare clear research notes and educational content following internal review and compliance processes.

**Required skills**

* Strong understanding of technical analysis and Indian equity markets.
* Practical knowledge of price-volume behaviour, breakouts, pullbacks, trend reversals, and risk management.
* Ability to distinguish a promising chart pattern from a strategy supported by evidence.
* Proficiency in TradingView or similar charting platforms.
* Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills.
* Ability to communicate research in simple English; Hindi communication is an advantage.
* Discipline in documenting decisions, acknowledging mistakes, and following a defined process.

**Good to have**

* Python, pandas, Pine Script, or experience building automated screeners.
* Knowledge of backtesting pitfalls, including look-ahead bias, survivorship bias, and overfitting.
* Familiarity with fundamental analysis and earnings-related risks.
* Relevant NISM certifications or progress toward the CMT qualification.

**How success will be measured**

* Quality, clarity, and timeliness of research.
* Consistent adherence to the research and risk-management process.
* Performance across a meaningful sample of trades, including expectancy, drawdown, and risk-reward.
* Accuracy and completeness of recommendation tracking.
* Useful contributions to strategy improvement and research automation.

**Performance will be assessed beyond win rate, with attention to risk, repeatability, and research integrity.**

**Who will thrive in this role**

Someone who is curious, analytical, accountable, and comfortable challenging their own conclusions. You should enjoy researching markets, learning from evidence, and taking ownership of work without repeated follow-ups.

What We Offer:

* Competitive compensation and benefits package.
* ESOPs.
* Mentorship and growth opportunities within the team.
* Access to the latest development tools and technologies.
* A collaborative, inclusive work environment with a strong focus on learning and professional development.

**How to apply**

Share your CV along with:

* Two sample technical research reports with annotated charts.
* One successful and one unsuccessful trade analysis, explaining the original rationale and lessons learned.
* A brief description of a trading strategy you have tested, including its rules and results.

Personal trading profits are not a prerequisite. We value the quality of your reasoning, evidence, and process.

Please send your resume to
jsr.nitin@sihoresearch.com

**Associate Director – Legal**

Our elite hedge fund client is seeking an accomplished legal professional to take on a senior leadership role within the Legal and Compliance function of a globally established investment and technology-driven organisation.

This is an opportunity to lead and expand a high-performing legal team while supporting complex international business operations. The role combines strategic leadership with hands-on involvement in drafting and negotiating commercial, intellectual property and trading agreements. You will work closely with global stakeholders, strengthen legal capabilities and contribute to initiatives that shape the organisation's broader legal and compliance priorities.

* Lead, manage and expand a sub-team within the Legal department, ensuring effective delivery across the global legal and compliance function.
* Draft, review and negotiate a broad range of international commercial agreements, particularly those relating to intellectual property and trading activities.
* Oversee contractual arrangements including licensing agreements, SaaS contracts, ISDA, GMRA, trading confirmations, repos, NDAs and vendor agreements.
* Maintain hands-on involvement in complex negotiations while overseeing the broader contract portfolio and associated legal risks.
* Collaborate with global and local stakeholders to address legal matters and support business requirements.
* Drive talent acquisition, development and retention initiatives to build a high-performing legal team.
* Mentor team members, provide career guidance and create meaningful professional growth opportunities.
* Contribute to departmental initiatives, process improvements and strategic priorities impacting the global organisation.
* Report to and work closely with the India General Counsel.

**Experience And Skills**

* Approximately 12 years of relevant legal experience, including at least 6 years of experience leading large legal teams.
* Experience working across both law firms and multinational organisations.
* Strong track record in drafting, reviewing and negotiating complex commercial and financial agreements.
* Demonstrated expertise in intellectual property and trading-related contracts.
* Proven experience managing, developing and retaining high-performing legal teams.
* Strong understanding of international contractual frameworks and legal risk management.
* Experience working with global stakeholders across multiple jurisdictions.
* Excellent negotiation, communication and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage competing priorities and deliver high-quality outcomes in a fast-paced environment.

**Tools, Tech And Platform Capabilities**

* Familiarity with SaaS agreements, technology licensing and vendor contractual arrangements.
* Understanding of legal contract management processes and frameworks.
* Exposure to data privacy-related legal matters and compliance practices.

**Qualifications, Licenses And Academic Achievements**

* Bachelor's degree in Law (LLB) is essential.
* Master's degree in Law (LLM) is preferred.

**Who is our client and what they need**

* A strategic legal leader who can balance hands-on legal responsibilities with broader team management.
* An accomplished negotiator with strong commercial awareness and sound legal judgement.
* Someone capable of building trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across global offices.
* A people-oriented leader who takes ownership of recruitment, talent development and team performance.
* Highly organised, detail-oriented and comfortable navigating complex legal matters under tight deadlines.
* A professional who demonstrates integrity, discretion and sound decision-making.

Perforce is looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Static Analysis team in India. We are seeking an experienced engineer who enjoys solving complex problems, building reliable software, and taking ownership of technical execution.

Leading companies across automotive, aerospace, telecom, medical devices, and other safety/mission-critical industries rely on us to prevent showstopper defects and security issues from reaching production. Chances are that you use technology today that was scanned by Static Analysis.
Static Analysis is a highly accurate and trusted SAST (Static Application Security Testing) and static code analysis solution supporting languages such as C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, Python, Kotlin, and more. It is designed to scale to large codebases and fit into modern Agile/DevOps workflows via integrations such as IDE plugins, web portals, APIs, and command-line automation. Experience and/or interest to work with other programming languages (e.g., C#) is a strong asset. Experience with Java is a strong asset. title: Devops Release Manager
description:
About The Role 
 As a DevOps Release Manager , you will own end-to-end software release planning, coordination, and delivery across cloud and customer environments. In this role, you protect when and how work is releasednot what shipsworking primarily through Jenkins , Microsoft Azure , and the Operations Portal . You will partner daily with the US/North America-based Release Manager to ensure seamless, round-the-clock release management.  
 What You’ll Do - 
 Release Planning & Ownership: Own the multi-stream release calendar, preventing schedule collisions and managing Mid/End-Cycle and Service Pack releases (scope freeze, readiness reviews, communications). Hotfix Execution: Lead rapid hotfix intake and delivery without disrupting the planned release train. Tooling & Audit: Execute releases via Jenkins , Azure , and the Operations Portal , maintaining complete audit trails. Standards Enforcement: Define and enforce change windows, freeze periods, rollback plans, and post-release verification. Readiness & Gating: Confirm release readiness (including QA Ready evidence). Recommend release delays when risk is unacceptable (Product Manager holds final Go/No-Go authority). Cross-Functional Collaboration: Maintain clean handoffs with the stateside Release Manager. Partner closely with CloudOps, Support, Product, Engineering, QA, and Security teams. Continuous Improvement: Improve CI/CD release automation, runbooks, and documentation—leveraging AI tools to accelerate workflows while maintaining human judgment. 
 How You’ll Work - 
 Individual Contributor: Direct focus on coordination and execution with no people management duties. Follow-the-Sun Support: Paired with a stateside Release Manager to maintain near 24-hour coverage. Cross-Functional Orchestrator: Coordinates delivery across Product Managers, Delivery Leads, Tech Leads, CloudOps, Support, QA, and Security without directly managing the development teams. 
 What You’ll Bring 
 Experience: Strong background in DevOps, release management, or engineering operations managing multi-stream release calendars (cycles, service packs, hotfixes). Time Zone Flexibility: Comfort working overlapping Pune/North America time zones and supporting releases outside standard local business hours. Technical Proficiency: Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure and Jenkins (pipeline-as-code, promotion/gating) and controlled rollout/deployment tooling. CI/CD & Risk Judgment: Solid understanding of versioning, CI/CD pipelines, and rollback strategies. Communication & AI: Strong written and verbal communication for asynchronous team handoffs, and comfort using AI-assisted productivity tools (e.g., Cursor). Experience with enterprise communications or high-availability software platforms (e.g., Avaya or similar contact-center/UC platforms) - (Nice to have) Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, Bicep, ARM), Azure Monitor, ITIL/CAB experience. Scripting capability in PowerShell, Bash, or Python. 
 What Success Looks Like 
 Collision-Free Cadence: Mid/End-Cycle and Service Pack release trains remain consistently on schedule. Rapid Remediation: Urgent hotfixes ship rapidly without breaking planned release trains. Seamless Handoffs: Asynchronous handoffs between India and US teams remain low-friction and timely. Low Risk: Deployments are auditable, low-risk, and well-communicated to operations and support teams.

description:
1. Position Overview • Experience in software testing, specializing in Artificial Intelligence (AI) systems and assure quality of an Agentic AI platform built using LLMs, LangChain/LangGraph, CrewAI, and related orchestration frameworks. The role includes testing autonomous agent behaviour, multi agent workflows, RAG pipelines, tool integrations, and domain-specific flows across insurance scenarios such as claims, underwriting, and policy servicing.. The role involves validating AI/ML models, ensuring robustness of end-to-end machine learning workflows, and driving quality engineering practices across data, models, and deployment environments. The engineer will collaborate with data scientists, ML engineers, and DevOps teams to ensure trustworthy, scalable, and production-ready AI solutions. • strong analytical skills, experience with AI workflow testing, and the ability to design robust test suites for dynamic reasoning systems. • Strong understanding of both manual and automated testing methodologies, with the ability to design, develop, and execute test scripts. • Responsible for the testing and delivery of parts of a product, in accordance with the customers requirements and interpersonal quality norms. • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, along with a proactive approach to identify and resolve issues, are essential. • Responsible for ensuring that the testing process is efficient, effective, and aligned with project goals and timelines. 
 2. Responsibilities / Job Description • Design and execute test strategies for machine learning models (classification, regression, NLP, CV, etc.). • Validate model accuracy, fairness, bias detection, explainability, and robustness under varying datasets. • Perform adversarial testing and edge-case validation for AI systems. • Test autonomous agents, multi-step reasoning paths, and state transitions. • Validate correctness, grounding, consistency, and safety of LLM outputs. • Evaluate prompt robustness and behavioral variations across scenarios. • Validate retrieval accuracy, grounding quality, and hallucination reduction. • Test vector store behavior, document chunking logic, and retriever configurations. • Validate fallback behaviors when tools or external services fail. • Execute adversarial, prompt-injection, and red team style testing. • Validate compliance with data privacy, business rules, and insurance guidelines. • Benchmark LLM latency, throughput, and multi-agent performance. • Validate concurrency handling, degradation logic, and retry mechanisms. • Document test cases, behavior maps, prompt variations, and evaluation reports. • Work closely with AI engineers and SMEs to refine agent workflows. • Functional & Non-Functional Testing: o Conduct API testing for AI services and model endpoints. o Validate performance, scalability, and latency of AI inference services. o Perform security testing for data pipelines and model-serving endpoints. • Quality Governance & Compliance: o Ensure compliance with AI ethics, data privacy, and regulatory standards. o Establish KPIs for model quality (precision, recall, F1-score, drift detection). o Document test strategies, results, and provide audit-ready evidence. • Collaboration & Leadership: o Work closely with data scientists, ML engineers, and DevOps teams to integrate testing into the AI lifecycle. o Mentor junior testers and contribute to building reusable test accelerators. o Represent the testing function in client discussions, providing insights on AI quality assurance. • Develop automated test frameworks for AI/ML pipelines. • Implement synthetic data generation for edge-case testing. • Conduct bias and fairness testing across diverse datasets. • Validate monitoring dashboards for model drift and performance degradation. • Perform regression testing for retrained models. • Create reusable test assets for AI projects (scripts, datasets, frameworks). • Provide detailed defect analysis and SLA-driven closure. 3. Required Skills • Strong experience in software testing (manual + automation) with focus on AI systems. • Hands-on expertise in Python for test automation, data validation, and AI testing scripts. • Knowledge of Gen AI frameworks (Langchain, Langgraph, CrewAI). • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI). • Strong understanding of data validation, model evaluation metrics, and drift detection. • API testing experience (REST, GraphQL) with tools like Postman or REST Assured. • Solid knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) for AI deployments. • Exposure to AI ethics and compliance testing. • Knowledge of containerization & orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes). • Experience with Big Data ecosystems (Spark, Hadoop) for large-scale AI testing. • Familiarity with observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack). • Understanding of security testing for AI pipelines (data poisoning, adversarial attacks).

This is a newly created Data Scientist II role within our Analytics Engine Optimization org and will be based in our India office. Purpose of the role As a Data Scientist II on the Analytics Engine Optimization team, you will be responsible for conducting analysis, applying statistical and mathematical techniques, and developing models to support digital marketing measurement and investment optimization across our global portfolio. The role will measure and analyze digital, investment, and sales data to evaluate marketing effectiveness, support optimization efforts, and serve as the Marketing Analytics SME. In this role you will partner across Insights & Analytics, The Agency, Digital & Technology, Sales, Finance, Operating Units (OUs), and Business Units (BUs) to leverage Data and Advanced Analytics to solve problems and implement key initiatives.

Develop and implement data-driven solutions using advanced analytics and machine learning techniques to measure marketing effectiveness. Build, validate, and maintain causal inference pipelines and measurement strategies such as Marketing Mix Models. Create statistical and machine learning models to quantify the campaigns and interactions that affect consumers’ purchase behavior. Build statistical model-based Omni-channel marketing solutions to optimize investment and maximize impact across different channels. Develop attribution model solutions to optimize the delivery and timing of marketing initiatives across different channels and audiences. Design, recommend, and measure statistically proven A/B tests by applying best practices. Communicate insights, model outputs, and recommendations clearly to non-technical audience. Partner with third-party vendors/agencies to define measurement strategy. Ensure the necessary data will be available at the right level to enable evaluation and optimization of marketing programs. Construct production ready, reusable, large scale or scalable complex optimization, simulation & machine learning models that provide real time insights aligning with General Mills Data Science standards. Contribute to existing Data Science projects and initiatives. Develop forecasts and build simulation models to predict the outcome of complex and real-world scenarios. Responsible for monitoring and improvement of model performance metrics in terms of accuracy, optimal near optimal recommendations with feedback incorporated from business partners. Understand both current uses and future state of promotional planning/optimization at General Mills, capture ongoing needs, and support integration with existing systems, data sets, reports. Provide thought leadership and apply creative analytical solutions to ad-hoc projects. Possess R&D mindset by prototyping and carrying out tests. Influence, educate, and train the organization to adopt new processes and systems Vet Analytics components with 3rd-party tools, evaluating their performance and providing recommendations to help drive procurement decisions. Mix analytical insights with business knowledge to build solutions that work in the real world MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS Bachelor’s Degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Operations Research, Physics, or related quantitative discipline At least 5+ years of relevant experience in Data Science, Modeling, and Advanced Analytics Expertise in problem-solving including experience/knowledge of statistical measurement, forecasting, and econometrics Working knowledge in statistical algorithms, predictive modeling techniques, especially Regression, Bayesian, Classification, Boosting, and Optimization models Strong SQL skills Expertise level knowledge in Python or R Working knowledge of relational databases and Cloud-based environment such as GCP Experience working data visualization tools (e.g. Tableau), and data integration platforms (e.g. Alteryx, Talend) Experience in Data Mining, building and working with APIs Familiarity with Data Clean Room technology. title: Voice AI Engineer - AI Agents / Telephony
description:
Build the calling agent: connect to the phone network (Twilio / SIP), dial insurance companies, press the right keys on the phone menu (IVR), wait on hold, and talk to the representative using our scripts. Capture the answers: save claim status, denial code, amount paid, reference number and representative name into our Supabase / Postgres database in a fixed format. Build the AI checker: a second program that reads each call transcript, checks the saved answers against it, and sends doubtful calls to a human for review. Test and measure: build a test setup with a fake insurance phone menu, run test calls every day, and track speed, success rate and cost per call on a dashboard. Keep it running: fix the agent when an insurance company changes its phone menu, track which insurance companies work well, and switch off the agent for any that do not. Follow US healthcare data rules (HIPAA): use only approved vendors, keep patient data off your laptop, and keep logs clean. We will train you on this. Document everything so our team can run the system without you. Skills we need (must have) Strong Python (Node.js / TypeScript is a plus). Have built at least one AI voice agent or AI chat agent college project, hackathon, freelance or job — that we can try: a phone number we can call, a live demo, or a video of it working, plus the code on GitHub. Phone technology: Twilio Programmable Voice or SIP; sending DTMF key tones; call recording. One voice-agent framework: Pipecat, LiveKit, Retell, Vapi, or your own Twilio media-stream code. Working with LLM APIs (Anthropic Claude or OpenAI): function / tool calling, JSON output, prompt management. Curiosity and self-learning: you follow the voice-AI and LLM space (new models, Pipecat / LiveKit releases, Anthropic and OpenAI updates) and have tried the tools yourself. Testing habit: you have measured how fast and how often your agent works, and can tell us the numbers. PostgreSQL / Supabase, REST APIs and webhooks. Good written and spoken English.

description:

Model training is not required; strong backend engineering and secure integration are.

 Experience: 4+ years of professional backend development (6+ years preferred); minimum 3 years building production APIs and services Demonstrable end-to-end ownership of at least one production backend service , covering design, data model, deployment and monitoring Experience integrating with external APIs and identity providers (OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SAML) at scale Experience integrating LLM APIs, or building API gateways, policy engines or provider adapters, is a strong plus Experience with durable workflow engines or event-driven systems is a plus Experience with Digital India platforms such as DigiLocker or API Setu is a plus 
 Key Responsibilities: API & Service Development Design and build APIs with clear OpenAPI contracts and versioning, design data models and optimise queries, and implement caching, queues and background jobs AI Gateway & Platform Services Build and extend gateway services: adapters for self-hosted, Indian, cloud and commercial model backends behind one OpenAI-compatible API, with routing, fallbacks, circuit breakers, rate limits and caching Implement data-classification routing, PII detection, and usage, token and cost logging per tenant, and build service-catalogue and subscription APIs System Integration Integrate AI services with government identity, document, e-office and payment systems and departmental databases, with retries, idempotency and audit logging Build document-intake, workflow and human-review services, including durable workflows for multi-step AI processes Quality & Operations Write tested code with unit, integration and contract tests in CI, instrument services with logs, metrics and traces, and take part in on-call Security & Privacy Implement authentication and authorisation, secrets handling and input validation, and apply OWASP Top 10 and OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications controls, including defences against prompt injection at service boundaries Handle personal data in compliance with DPDPA 2023, including data sent to external model providers 
 Technical Competencies: Languages & Frameworks: Python (FastAPI, Pydantic, asyncio), and Go or Java (Spring Boot) APIs & Gateways: REST with OpenAPI, gRPC, WebSockets and server-sent events; Kong or Envoy; LiteLLM; OpenAI-compatible APIs Data & Messaging: PostgreSQL (with pgvector), Redis or Valkey; Kafka, RabbitMQ or NATS; Temporal Identity & Security: OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SAML, JWT; Keycloak; HashiCorp Vault or OpenBao; Microsoft Presidio; OWASP ASVS Testing & Operations: pytest, contract testing (Pact), k6; Docker, Kubernetes, Helm; GitLab CE CI; OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana
